100% Invisibility Exploit VS Hardcore SMP is the 77th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
It starts when Mapicc discovers a glitch that gives true invisibility, hiding the player even in armour. Spoke and Mapicc decide to abuse this glitch, finding a new player, JackLIVE_XD, who seems to be live streaming and messing around with him. They start by breaking and placing blocks around him and setting him on fire. Jack assumes this is the tutorial. They then convince him that they are the creators of Minecraft, and that Spoke and Mapicc were there to guide him. Netherite players suddenly appear, the players being ApexPoint, who was a notorious griefer, and ZeroCycleDEMON3D. Spoke and Mapicc panic, and Spoke starts leading Jack away from the players with stone blocks, but they catch up and corner Jack. The players start trying to rob Jack, and Spoke tries to help him escape and Mapicc helps create a distraction. However, this fails and Jack end up getting invited to and joining ApexPoint and ZeroCycle's team, and they lead him away.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the BAT headquarters to warn Leow0ok of ApexPoint's return. Leo informs Spoke that BAT's spies had something strange hidden in the mountains, presumably belonging to ApexPoint. The mission was to sneak into the place and steal all the stashed items. Spoke teaches Leo how to do the true invisibility glitch, except he tells him he cannot use it. The plan is for Leo to act as a distraction while Spoke and Mapicc raid the base. Leo pretends he is a front door salesman and Spoke and Mapicc invade the base, however, all the chests they have are empty. Mapicc then discovers a secret room behind a painting which leads to a fully obsidian box with a gold throne and a door in the back of the room surrounded by iron bars. Spoke breaks the gold throne, assuming that was the stashed items, and finds a secret chest under the table with TNT. Spoke leaves the painting room and enters another room with a hole filled with sheep and cows, and also sees Jack open a secret passage. Mapicc tries entering the room, but accidentally sets himself on fire with the lava, and it reveals him. ApexPoint hears them and goes back into the base. Mapicc escapes into the wall and Spoke starts attacking ApexPoint. Someone sets off a TNT minecart and it reveals Spoke. Spoke and Mapicc escape.

Mapicc and Spoke create a secret base in the sky. They head to a cherry forest with houses, and they plan to troll the people living there. TheRealSquiddo appears at the base. They start opening chests and trapdoors near her, and they also try fishing rod her and moving around in boats. Mapicc traps Squiddo inside a stone box. ApexPoint, ZeroCycle, and Jack show up. They ask her whether she had seen either Spoke or Mapicc. Spoke and Mapicc start punching everyone, placing cobwebs, setting people on fire, and throwing tridents. Spoke starts setting Squiddo's house on fire. Spoke accidentally gets set on fire and reveals himself, and ApexPoint starts attacking him. Spoke and Mapicc escape back to the spot where they made themselves invisible, and go back. Spoke and Mapicc start getting bored, so Spoke pulls out a soundboard. Spoke first plays a discord message ping, then he plays the sound of stone breaking. This makes the group think someone is mining near them. Mapicc and Spoke start playing noises, which make ApexPoint and ZeroCycle think Jack is the one making the noises. ApexPoint finds another player near them, and assumes they're the one making the noises, so they kill them. ApexPoint splits up with ZeroCycle and Jack to head back to their base, while ZeroCycle and Jack leave to raid another base. Spoke and Mapicc both follow ZeroCycle and Jack.

While Jack and ZeroCycle are preparing to raid the base, Spoke and Mapicc discover the owner of the base is Jepexx. Spoke and Mapicc put on fake voices (not voice changers) to warn Jepexx. Spoke and Mapicc pretend to be a devil and an angel, then ZeroCycle and Jack appear to raid the base. Mapicc takes the horse while Spoke and Jepexx escape up the mountain and into the ocean. Spoke repeatedly breaks ZeroCycles boat, causing him to fall behind. Spoke steals Jacks boat, so Jack gets into ZeroCycles boat. Spoke steals that boat as well. Mapicc, Jepexx, and Spoke escape to an island with the horse. Spoke and Mapicc then follow ZeroCycle and Jack into a tunnel to their secret base and as they reunite with ApexPoint, The team has a fight about whether the creators of Minecraft were messing with them or not while Spoke and Mapicc investigate around the base. Spoke decides to build a dripstone trap in the floor. Spoke accidentally places a wither rose on Mapicc, revealing him. Jack, who is still live streaming, says his chat saw a nametag. Mapicc wind charges upward to get on the roof, accidentally knocking Spoke off of a small hill. Spoke takes damage from this, and he gets revealed as well. Spoke breaks into the house through a window, but they see him anyway. Mapicc makes a nether portal and they escaped through the nether. Spoke traps the nether portal with a TNT minecart, but they enter through a different nether portal. Spoke and Mapicc start running. They enter a bastion, and ZeroCycle gets distracted by the gold blocks. Spoke and Mapicc leave the bastion. 

After running for a while, Spoke manages to lose them and escapes into a nether portal into him and Mapicc's secret base. Unfortunately, ApexPoint, ZeroCycle, and Jack appear as well. They start blowing up the base with TNT, and Spoke starts running. Spoke tridents up the water into the base and cuts off the water source. Spoke and Mapicc make a plan to invade their base. As they turn themselves invisible again, ApexPoint, ZeroCycle, and Jack watches them. The team also starts abusing this glitch, however, they all take some form of damage before they could get too annoying. Spoke and Mapicc blow up and burn all of their items. Spoke and Mapicc also accidentally take damage, revealing themselves, and a fight breaks out. Spoke and Mapicc continue wrecking havoc and blowing up everything.

Spoke asks ApexPoint for a truce, and ApexPoint agrees. Spoke makes a chair to commence the dealing process, and makes ApexPoint build his chair on top of Spokes dripstone trap he made earlier. Spoke breaks the block under ApexPoint's chair, and ApexPoint falls directly into the trap, killing him and banning him off of the server. Mapicc and Spoke immediately start attacking ZeroCycle as well, killing  and banning ZeroCycle off of the server. Jack hides in the floor, and Spoke and Mapicc talk about possibilities of inviting Jack to their team. Spoke and Mapicc return to the invisibility exploit, and blow it up.

title: 100 Days Arc
content:
Story 
Spoke sneaks into Point Nemo, the secret base of Ashswagg and TheRealSquiddo. He spends a while searching the base, uncovering secret vaults and passages, before finally finding a villager, which Ash plans to trade to Reddoons. Spoke rigs the trade, stealing the payment and killing the villager, then steals everything else in the entire base, but is forced to burn most of it to stop Ash from finding it again. He follows Ash to a different secret base, where Ash catches him, revealing he sold the dragon egg to Reddoons, and that there's nothing left for Spoke.

Spoke sneaks into the base of Reddoons and Yeah Jaron. He spies on them for a while, and is forced to visit PlanetLord for a duplicate of a pet he accidentally kills. Planet and Mapicc follow him back, and they all spy together. Spoke pranks Jaron as he’s showing his friend Baconnwaffles0 around the base. They prepare for the final raid of every item, which is successfully completed despite Jaron’s attempted interferences. However, Reddoons reveals they missed the dragon egg room, and claims it for himself, so Spoke promises to hunt him down until he gives it up.

Spoke finds their new base and hides inside. He messes up multiple trade deals they attempt to make while also stealing from their farms. After multiple close calls, he discovers they have a villager, but before he can steal it, thieves raid the base. Spoke blows them up, but accidentally destroys the entire base with them, including all his wealth.

Spoke sneaks into the Bounty Assassin Team’s base, but gets trapped inside there, forcing him to be stealthy once more. However, B.A.T. knows he’s there and are intent on killing him, believing him to be the player they’re hunting: The Director. He begins calling himself that without knowing what it means. Eventually, he goes on a pranking spree, dangling pets over the void, destroying farms, and setting off fireworks. In the end, he gets captured and interrogated by BAT, but escapes with chorus fruit. While they chase him, he manages to lose them and successfully escapes, fleeing the base.

title: 100 Days Hidden in a Minecraft Chunk Base
content:
100 Days Hidden in a Minecraft Chunk Base is the 37th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Spoke shows the base he is about to infiltrate and hide in for the next 100 days which is owned by Reddoons and Yeah Jaron. Out of the 1000 players online, it is considered to be the #1 base. 

Spoke follows Jaron inside the base but as he was about to go inside the door closed. Spoke tries placing a block on the observer but the door kept closing before he could make it inside. Spoke decides to use an elytra and firework rockets. Spoke cannot make too much noise because Reddoons was inside the base.

The goals of the base were 'Build An Empire, Get Rich and Get More Rich'. Spoke was snooping around but then Reddoons came down he hid behind the bookshelves that were used for the enchanting table setup. Consequently, the book on the enchanting table opened and faced towards Spoke. Luckily, Reddoons didn't spot it.

Spoke tried hopping downbut he took fall damage that makes noise that could alert Reddoons about his whereabouts. 

On day 3, Spoke went to his stash to get some potion materials, ender pearls and even a chorous fruit. Spoke went back inside the base but when he tried hopping up using a boat, he almost immediately got spotted. Once Reddoons left, Spoke went up and block his cobblestone to hide his tracks. Spoke noticed Jaron's nametag in a  contraption below. Spoke noticed some automatic farms. One produced beeswax, another produced pumpkins. Spoke tried going up the stairs but Reddoons was blocking  him, Spoke waited for Reddoons to pass and he went up and even saw a cactus farm, a wheat farm, a carrot farm, a wheat farm, a potato farm and a sweetberry farm. 

Spoke decides  to mine out his secret bunker but Reddoons came back up and before Spoke could block it Reddoons saw it. Spoke wasn't sure if his cover was blown, but Reddoons simply just covered it up probably thinking it was his basemate's tunnel. 

On Day 5, Spoke goes up another layer and finds an automatic sugarcane farm; but then Spoke heard a chest open. It was Jaron. 

On Day 6, Spoke decides to build his secret base near the automatic cactus farm. 

On Day 7, He mined out the area for his base, and placed down his brewing stand, a crafting table and four furnaces. He also mined out the floor and stored  the loot he stole from the last base he raided in I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Base and I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base.... 

On Day 8, he made a room to make a map of the base. Spoke realises his invisibility ran out and reinvis. 

On Day 9, Spoke explores the base and he finds their storage. Spoke doesn't steal Reddoons opens the chest so he doesn't make sound, Spoke saw a board for their upcoming trades and in how many days that trade would take in. On the opposite board it was the enemies list with Spoke, Mapicc, EvilMaster and PlanetLord included on it. Finally Reddoons dropped down. Spoke decides this is his chance to find some crazy farms.

On Day 10, Spoke finds the chests of Pumpkins, Melons and Honey Bottles and some ominous potions. 

On Day 11, Spoke heard someone climbing up the ladder which was Reddoons. Spoke thought he was fine until his invisibility ran out. Spoke hid behind the wall of their storage room. Spoke needed to stay crouched or he'll be exposed. Spoke jumps down leaving him barely alive with 2 hearts. Somehow his damage noise was just out of range  and Reddooons didn't notice; when he was out of sight, Spoke quickly drank another potion of invisibility. 

On Day 12, Spoke goes back to his secret base and replaced his walls with melons and pumpkins.

On Day 13, he finished renovating his base. 

On Day 14,  Spoke crafted some hoppers, and created a model of how Spoke would leech off their farms and take it's resources. 

On Day 15, he put his plan in action. and implemented it on the automatic sugarcane farm. 

He was practically finished on Day 16, but then he saw Reddoons right through the walls. Reddoons opened some chests but he didn't spot Spoke's hoppers. 

On Day 17, Spoke was able to start mining. 

On Day 18, Spoke connected the tunnel to his secret base.

On Day 19,  Spoke made the bunker even prettier. 

On Day 20, Spoke lit the tunnels with torches and checked how much profit he made from the farms. 

On Day 21, He went back out to search out for better farms. 

On Day 22, Spoke spotted a new chest that was added to the storage room which was filled with cobwebs. 

On Day 23, Spoke went all the way up to see whats at the top of the secret base. Spoke saw Jaron's nametag but somehow he was above the roof. So, Spoke found a spot in the wall and dug up. However, instead of seeing a secret room he saw the night sky. Since Spoke was curious why Jaron was standing on the top of the mountain he sticked around. 

On Day 24, Spoke was replenishing his invisibility when 2 players showed up. The players demanded Jaron to drop the items but in return Jaron asked them to show him their items. Jaron realised they weren't here to trade but they were here to rob him. Jaron tried running but Spoke, and the players chased after him incase someone died. Spoke realized he needed Jaron alive if he wanted to gain more profit so Spoke places cobwebs on them trying to slow them down just so Jaron could escape. They then tried to escape once Spoke equipped his armor. Spoke then stroke a deal with them that would come in handy later.

On Day 25, Spoke checked when Jaron's next trade would occur. (17 days from now). 

On Day 26, Spoke checked how much the farms had made. 

On Day 27, Spoke got distracted.

On Day 28, Spoke made an ender pearl stasis to get out of trouble. 

On Day 29, Spoke was going to find more farms to raid but he almost broke the block right infront of Reddoons. Spoke eventually found what seemed to be a lava farm and also a cobblestone farm. 

On Day 30, Spoke discovered a chorous fruit farm but it didn't seem like it was working; so, Spoke began to fix their farm for them. Although Reddoons was right behind Spoke, Reddoons didn't notice Spoke and neither did Spoke. 

On Day 31, Spoke remembered his goal of rigging a farm. Eventually, Spoke found something useful; a mushroom farm which is a key ingredient in making fermented spider eyes which are used to brew invisibility potions. 

On Day 32, Spoke finished rigging the mushroom farm and connected it to his secret base. 

On Day 33, Spoke was staying productive and kept searching. Until Spoke noticed Reddoons returning on a flying machine with a minecart with a chest. Spoke waited for Reddoons to leave and checked and in the chest there was 192 torches, 36 diamonds, and 256 golden carrots. 

On Day 34. Spoke was back at the secret base and he added the new rooms he found to his map.

On Day 35, Spoke used his stolen lava buckets to add some "new features". 

On Day 36, Spoke finished adding his new features. 

On Day 37, Spoke was about to leave but then he noticed Reddoons was coming towards his direction. Spoke quickly got on the stairs to avoid Reddoons as Spoke was running out of invisibility. Spoke hid in the wall. 

On Day 38, Spoke drank a potion of invisibility to reinvis. 

On Day 39, Spoke expanded his bunker even more.

On Day 40, Spoke was back to exploring and he found an automatic potion brewer. Spoke takes a bunch of Harming and Poison potions. 

On Day 41, Spoke spotted Jaron which reminded Spoke tomorrow was the day of the trade. 

On Days 42 and 43, The player had arrived. Spoke had the bandits set up stasises and the bandits reappeared and killed the player. Spoke had rigged their stasises because Spoke knew the bandits would kill him; so Spoke threw poison and harming on them which killed them. 

On Day 44, Spoke went back inside the base like nothing happened. 

On Day 45, Spoke saw some new trades added to the board despite recent events. 

On Day 46, Spoke made his bunker even prettier. 

On Day 47, Spoke made some hoppers, and chests. 

On Day 48, Spoke rigged a bunch of farms; secretly taking items from the farms.

On Days 49 and 50, Spoke finished connecting all the tunnels. 

On Day 51, Spoke noticed he stole 0 items so he decided to check but he saw Reddoons at the farm. Spoke watched Reddoons place a new sign on the trading board.

On Day 52, Spoke finally fixed the problem. 

On Day 53, Spoke remembered another trade was coming up. 

On Day 54, Jaron seemed to be grabbing some items.

On Day 55, Spoke was waiting for Jaron to go to the top but instead Jaron started running down one of the tunnels. 

On Day 56, They finally made it to the top where another player was waiting. Spoke tried to troll them.

On Day 57, FartSteve08 tried to kill Spoke for trying to interrupt their trade. Spoke elytra'd away from FartSteve. 

On Day 58, To make up for not getting items Spoke decided to search for valuables inside the base.

On Day 59, Spoke renovated his bunker.

On Day 60 and 61, Spoke checked all his rigged farms to see if they were getting him items. 

On Day 62, Spoke decides to rig the Chicken egg farm. 

On Day 63, Spoke had the hoppers completely set out.

On Day 64, Spoke connected everything.

On Day 65, Spoke made his system more time efficient because he came up with a design to lead all the hoppers of the rigged farms into one singular chest.

On Days 66 and 67, Spoke mined out all the area.

On Day 68, Spoke set out with a mission of finding the best farm. Spoke found out that trades were coming up in 4 and 15 days respectively. Spoke changed the coordinates of the trades coming up in 4 days from 9000 ~ -7200 to 45000 ~ -600

On Day 69, Spoke watched Reddoons do his normal routine and when he looked at the board he didn't suspect a thing. Reddoons went on the flying machine and Spoke followed it from  the ground.

On Day 70, Spoke kept following the flying machine. 

On Day 71, Reddoons finally stopped the machine. 

On Day 72, Under the snow was Hopper Minecarts that would pick up any items dropped. The player Spoke asked to be bait was Jepexx. Unfortunately Jepexx was AFK which hampered Spoke's plan. 

On Day 73, Jepexx was nowhere near his computer. So, Reddoons left.

On Day 74, Spoke followed Reddoons back. 

On Day 75, Spoke was back on the mission of finding the best farm. 

On Day 76, Spoke found a pitcher pod and torchflower seeds farm using sniffers.

On Day 77, Spoke decides to rig this farm anyways. 

On Day 78, Spoke finished connecting it all. 

On Day 79,  Spoke noticed Jaron's next trade was in 2 days.

On Day 80, Spoke went on top of the mountain ready to fish the items towards him.

On Day 81, The trade had begun. 

On Day 82, Spoke did nothing.

On Day 83, Spoke cleared his mind by doing some therapeutic building. Spoke also threw eggs everywhere; even in the lava. 

On Day 84, Spoke realised he is a failure.

On Day 85, Spoke realised some pumpkins aren't going to save him from his bad decisions.

On Day 86, Spoke decided to get some fresh air which meant going out into the base. 

On Day 87, Spoke decided to rig the chorous fruit farm but he ran out of hoppers.

On Day 88, Spoke just stole from the chorous fruit chest.

On Day 89, Spoke had a blast in the base.

On Day 90, Spoke decided to check on what Jaron's been doing at the bottom of the base.

On Day 91, Spoke saw the raid bar and freaked out because a team on the server called The Invisible Mafia killed all the villagers and mobs don't spawn for unknown reasons and raids need at least a minimum of one villager. Therefore, the base somehow had a villager. 

On Day 92, Spoke decided to try and steal the villager.

On Day 93, Spoke went down a water chute but found nothing.

On Day 94, Spoke went back up but he got stuck. He couldn't mine up because Jaron was right there. Spoke managed to swim down and break a glass to escape.

title: 100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP
content:
100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP is the 118th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
On the Unstable SMP, every one in ten players make it out of spawn alive, but even those who get to escape do not live for long. The players have accepted this as how Unstable is, but in the first time in history, they had voted for a king of the server, and that person is Parrot.

The episode begins with Parrot standing on top of the Northern Council and giving a speech to the entire server, he tells everybody that he has seen power be in the wrong hands and ensures that it wouldn't happen again. He promises to take responsibility and make sure that everyone can live peacefully. The crowd boos and shouts that they wanted LettuceK to be king. Parrot hears the backlash and says if players can not spawn onto the server safely within a hundred Minecraft days, or thirty three hours, he'd resign from king. Parrot knew Lettuce was unable to save spawn even with his powers, and if Parrot managed to do so, he'd prove everyone that he was worthy of being king.

Parrot has a meeting with his friends, Theo, Fymada, and Horace. Theo thinks Parrot is crazy for attempting to make spawn a safe place in such a short amount of them when Lettuce was unable to during his regime. Fymada and Horace has their own plans on how they could improve the server and Theo says he'd be Parrot's royal guard. Theo asks what their first decree is, Parrot says they'll have to take back spawn. The two go to spawn and start their mission of killing off all the withers. As they get closer up to the top of spawn, the withers start focusing on them, which prevents more deaths from happening. At the same time, Parrot helps out players and gives them protection and food to make sure they get to a safe place. They kill off the withers at the top, but the rest of the withers are down under and they've been slowly drained of their armor and resources. Luckily, Fymada and Horace come to assist killing off all the withers and regear. On the fifth day, players no longer die from withers and the new players joining the server walk up to Parrot and praise him for saving them. However, players may still die from fall damage, so he asks Horace to rebuild the entirety of spawn.

The next step of Parrot's journey of being king, he needs to give people a safe place to go, and players usually head to Capital City for that. However, Capital City is ran by a corrupt mayor and Parrot goes to declare Fymada the new mayor. When Parrot, Theo, and Fymada step foot into the city, SirPig tells Parrot that the three of them have taxes to be paid or else they'd be escorted out. Parrot tells him that's going to be a problem since he's king now and grants Fymada the title of the mayor of Capital City. They hold a meeting with the players there, Fymada starts up by saying there will be an expansion to the city and reduce the percentages of taxes so players can keep what they earn. After Fymada has her speech, Parrot and Theo go back to their old potion shop and reminisces of the past. As they're about to head out, DragonMC comes to visit and tells them before they go, on behalf of Capital City, they're given horses for being king. Dragon says the first horse Parrot chooses is destined to be fate and will be the horse for the entirety of his kingship. Parrot looks through all of the horses and sees a lone white horse out of all of the horses there. He sits on the horse and tames it first try. This horse was truly fate, as it was extremely fast and could jump very high. As for Theo, he tamed a donkey and Parrot forces him to keep it.

After making room for more players, Parrot's next step is to supply players with food so they don't starve. Parrot and Theo visit the train station and meet up with an old friend, lezy, and asks for two tickets to Redstone Town. Lezy gives the tickets for free and says the king doesn't need to pay. Parrot, still with the mindset that they're still players, decides to pay it either way. Parrot and Theo spend the next few days on the railway on their horses and ironically runs out of food, so they make a pitstop at a village to buy food. As they walk into the tavern, Parrot says what's up and the entire place goes quiet. One person speaks up and asks what they're doing there. Parrot goes up to the owners and asks if they can buy food, the owners say yes and says they can get twenty steaks for a few diamonds, Theo pays and they only give two steak. Parrot says they need food to get to Redstone Town, but the owners say he's ruining the server and that nobody likes him. The players in the tavern all start booing and pushing them out. They make it to Redstone Town and visits 4CVIT, Parrot asks 4CVIT to help them out with an automatic chicken farm, but 4CVIT refuses to help since the members of the town would be upset with him. This forces Parrot and Theo to build it on their own, and they spend several Minecraft days attempting it, with 4CVIT watching in the distance. 4CVIT feels bad seeing Parrot build so many chicken farms when he could've been finished way earlier, but 4CVIT is not able to provide them with a chicken and tells them that they can get one through an auction over at Merchant City. 

They head over to Merchant City and asks the auctioneer what the average price of a chicken is, the auctioneer tells them a thousand diamonds, but the two of them only have a total of 400 diamonds, so they decide to play games around the city to earn diamonds. The first game they head to is an archery game, one shot is three diamonds, each target is worth one to three diamonds depending on the distance respectively, and the minecart at the back is worth ten diamonds. Parrot shoots the minecart and uses the prize to buy more shots and hits the minecart over and over again. The owner of the game gets angry and accuses Parrot of cheating, so he makes Parrot stand back further to make the shot harder, but it doesn't change anything and Parrot makes the shots still. The owner makes Parrot stand even further back on top of a house that's fifty blocks away, Parrot charges his bow and times it, he hits the shot and asks to buy more shots, but the owner gets frustrated and refuses to sell anymore and says he's went into debt from the game and storms off. They had garnered over 900 diamonds, which may be enough to buy the chicken, so they head over to the auction. During the auction, Theo bids for a Law-owned spear and an enchanted golden apple, but Parrot tells Theo to stop bidding on anything besides the chicken. Parrot notices the person sitting right next to Theo may be a problem, since he bid over 800 on an enchanted book. The last item is the chicken, Parrot and the other person bidding goes back and forth, when the price goes up too high, Parrot tells him that without the chicken, his kingdom will fall and bids everything they have. The other player bids more than what they have, as Parrot thinks they're going to lose the bet, Theo steps up and bids over a hundred thousand diamonds, thinking that it was a hundred more than what the previous bid was, winning the auction immediately. Parrot quietly leaves with the chicken and tells the auctioneer they'll have the payment in the future. 

Back at Redstone Town, 4CVIT and the other members of the city had built farms that can produce more food than necessary. They spend the next few Minecraft days breeding the chicken and storing chickens into the farms to their fullest limit. After their hard work, they stand on top of a hill and look at the farm. Parrot says they may be able to win people over, Theo asks if it bothers Parrot that people still hate him even with all the effort he's been putting, and that people still want Lettuce to be king. Parrot says it did bother him a little, but it's not to make people like him and only wants to do what's right. They wait several more Minecraft days for the farm to work its magic, they now have a new problem; transporting all of the chicken would take a long time using railroads. Parrot follows the minecarts full of chicken while Theo goes ahead and deals with whatever players or situation may be waiting for them. On the second wave of players, a group of lawmen try to attack Theo, but he kills them off and one runs away, Theo chases them. Theo's horn is blown, signaling to Parrot that it's safe to continue, but Parrot notices SargeLAW, who says he's going to stop Parrot from being king. Parrot tells him if he destroys the chicken supplies, he won't be able to become king and will cause players to die. SargeLAW says if Parrot succeeds on becoming king, they wouldn't have a server to play on, especially with a king like Parrot. SargeLAW and his group of lawmen begin looking through the minecart chests, which were all empty. Parrot slowly backs up away from The Law and had managed to juke them. The truth was he had 4CVIT transport all the chicken using a happy ghast and that they'd buy him as much time as possible. 

On the 94th day, Parrot made it back to spawn, which had been fully reconstructed. Parrot is astonished at how quickly Horace rebuilt spawn. Horace brings Parrot to the designated food giver and shows them where players spawn now. Afterwards, he rides through the obsidian highway and greets the players that he stumbles across, but every time he stops to talk to them, they tell him how he had ruined the server. Parrot goes back to the Northern Council and down to the prison where he looks at Lettuce. Parrot asks Lettuce why people still hate him despite all of his work, it's only the new players that are supportive, not the old ones, and asks why that may be the case. Parrot mentions before they locked Lettuce up, he said the server was unrepairable and asks if that may be related. Lettuce only answers by saying, "Who knows?" Parrot calls him pathetic and says he did everything Lettuce could never do in thirty hours, Lettuce says if he really wanted to save all the players, he could've, he then asks Parrot why he didn't choose to. Parrot says he could've done something about it, Lettuce says sometimes you have to do whatever it takes to protect the people and that he'll find out soon enough and wishes him luck as a king and that he's surprised Parrot had made it this far as king.

On the hundredth day, an influx of the player base had grown exponentially, and Parrot's kingdom has grown with it. Parrot and Theo stand up top of the castle looking down at Northern Council. Parrot asks Theo if it was strange that players used up so many resources on withers to use at spawn, and that he thought it may be trollers or griefers, but doesn't understand why people would've taken it that far. Parrot says he doesn't care about who is responsible for it and focuses on what's more important: building up his kingdom.

 Trivia 

 A player can be seen wearing netherite armor with quartz trims, the same ones used by The Director during Fymada's speech in Capital City.

The owner of the game gets angry and accuses Parrot of cheating, so he makes Parrot stand back further to make the shot harder, but it doesn't change anything and Parrot makes the shots still. The owner makes Parrot stand even further back on top of a house that's fifty blocks away, Parrot charges his bow and times it, he hits the shot and asks to buy more shots, but the owner gets frustrated and refuses to sell anymore and says he's went into debt from the game and storms off. They had garnered over 900 diamonds, which may be enough to buy the chicken, so they head over to the auction. During the auction, Theo bids for a Law-owned spear and an enchanted golden apple, but Parrot tells Theo to stop bidding on anything besides the chicken. Parrot notices the person sitting right next to Theo may be a problem, since he bid over 800 on an enchanted book. The last item is the chicken, Parrot and the other person bidding goes back and forth, when the price goes up too high, Parrot tells him that without the chicken, his kingdom will fall and bids everything they have. The other player bids more than what they have, as Parrot thinks they're going to lose the bet, Theo steps up and bids over a hundred thousand diamonds, thinking that it was a hundred more than what the previous bid was, winning the auction immediately. Parrot quietly leaves with the chicken and tells the auctioneer they'll have the payment in the future. 

Back at Redstone Town, 4CVIT and the other members of the city had built farms that can produce more food than necessary. They spend the next few Minecraft days breeding the chicken and storing chickens into the farms to their fullest limit. After their hard work, they stand on top of a hill and look at the farm. Parrot says they may be able to win people over, Theo asks if it bothers Parrot that people still hate him even with all the effort he's been putting, and that people still want Lettuce to be king. Parrot says it did bother him a little, but it's not to make people like him and only wants to do what's right. They wait several more Minecraft days for the farm to work its magic, they now have a new problem; transporting all of the chicken would take a long time using railroads. Parrot follows the minecarts full of chicken while Theo goes ahead and deals with whatever players or situation may be waiting for them. On the second wave of players, a group of lawmen try to attack Theo, but he kills them off and one runs away, Theo chases them. Theo's horn is blown, signaling to Parrot that it's safe to continue, but Parrot notices [[SargeLAW]], who says he's going to stop Parrot from being king. Parrot tells him if he destroys the chicken supplies, he won't be able to become king and will cause players to die. SargeLAW says if Parrot succeeds on becoming king, they wouldn't have a server to play on, especially with a king like Parrot. SargeLAW and his group of lawmen begin looking through the minecart chests, which were all empty. Parrot slowly backs up away from [[The LAW|The Law]] and had managed to juke them. The truth was he had 4CVIT transport all the chicken using a happy ghast and that they'd buy him as much time as possible. 

On the 94th day, Parrot made it back to spawn, which had been fully reconstructed. Parrot is astonished at how quickly Horace rebuilt spawn. Horace brings Parrot to the designated food giver and shows them where players spawn now. Afterwards, he rides through the obsidian highway and greets the players that he stumbles across, but every time he stops to talk to them, they tell him how he had ruined the server. Parrot goes back to the Northern Council and down to the prison where he looks at Lettuce. Parrot asks Lettuce why people still hate him despite all of his work, it's only the new players that are supportive, not the old ones, and asks why that may be the case. Parrot mentions before they locked Lettuce up, he said the server was unrepairable and asks if that may be related. Lettuce only answers by saying, "Who knows?" Parrot calls him pathetic and says he did everything Lettuce could never do in thirty hours, Lettuce says if he really wanted to save all the players, he could've, he then asks Parrot why he didn't choose to. Parrot says he could've done something about it, Lettuce says sometimes you have to do whatever it takes to protect the people and that he'll find out soon enough and wishes him luck as a king and that he's surprised Parrot had made it this far as king.

On the hundredth day, an influx of the player base had grown exponentially, and Parrot's kingdom has grown with it. Parrot and Theo stand up top of the castle looking down at Northern Council. Parrot asks Theo if it was strange that players used up so many resources on withers to use at spawn, and that he thought it may be trollers or griefers, but doesn't understand why people would've taken it that far. Parrot says he doesn't care about who is responsible for it and focuses on what's more important: building up his kingdom.

* A player can be seen wearing netherite armor with quartz trims, the same ones used by [[Wifies|The Director]] during Fymada's speech in Capital City.

title: 100 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master
content:
Minecraft Combat Master VS 100 Hunters is the 80th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The video begins with a recap of the fight in SOLO Player VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP which was between FlameFrags and Wemmbu with Spoke watching invisible and from the sidelines. As Flame was about to go to the courtroom where Parrot and Theo had trapped Wemmbu, the leader of The Law, LettuceK showed up at his base. Lettuce calls Flame to the new Law base which is about 100 blocks from Flame's base. Lettuce says he recruited around 100 goons (from the nether) to take down Flame. Flame is impressed by how they built a new base in just one day. Lettuce introduces him to Deputy_Ace; his right-hand man. Lettuce tries to persuade Flame to drop all his items in his inventory and ender chest and sit in a prison cell for a fortnight but Flame refuses. Lettuce gave Flame three more days to think and rehabilitate to become a law-abiding citizen. Flame calls his best friend Lomedy to help him gear up to fight the Law. Flame calls Lomedy to Merchant City and on the way, Flame tells him about the recent encounter with LettuceK. Flame makes a plan to disguse themselves with a law shield to learn about their battle strategies. Flame and Lomedy sneak into Law territory. Flame warns Lomedy to communicate with signs only and to not speak so their identity isn't blown. They search for Lettuce as the players are just "yapping". Flame and Lomedy listen in on LettuceK's  conversations. Lettuce makes an announcement of their gear shipment. Flame and Lomedy are stopped by Lettuce at the front gate as they try  to intercept the gear shipment. Lettuce tells them use of invisibility is prohibited in the Law Base. Flame stops Lomedy from speaking by breaking his signs. Lettuce threatens them to kick them out of Law and take action for breaking their simplest rule if they don't drink milk or speak. They run away into the nearby river. 42hunterdude is killed by LettuceK. Lomedy tries to convince Flame to turn himself in but he doesn't listen. They successfully intercept the shipment and kill the whole party plus their happy ghast. They take the shipment for themselves. Lomedy tells Flame he didn't have to kill them and Lomedy questions Flame's violent ways. Flame tells Lomedy about his motives. He explains that he is hunting Wemmbu because he is trying  to show that real skill doesn't come from power, orbital strike cannons, maces or dishonor. He explains that if people like Wemmbu prevail, people will forget about skill. Lomedy says that Flame should attack the Law right now. Flame makes another wolf machine.  Lettuce makes a speech about how Flame could stop this pointless bloodshed could stop if he turns himself in. Flame refuses. They fight and eventually, Flame comes out on top forcing Lettuce to run and killing his entire army. Flame goes back to his base. 

Parrot shows up and he asks Flame why he didn't show up at the Capital City courtroom. Flame says that he was fighting off the Law.

 Trivia 

 The video's original title was SOLO Player VS 100 Minecraft Hunters.

title: 1 88 x
content:
_1_88_____x is the leader of one squad of Null Hunters. They were wearing a redstone flow-trimmed netherite chestplate along with the netherite flow-trimmed netherite helmet, leggings, and boots, which distinguished them from other hunters with a netherite flow-trimmed netherite chestplate. He also uses a multishot crossbow with black fireworks and pearls.

 History 
They find SpokeIsHere in his base but get trapped. They dissapear before JumperWho comes. They soon after find him at a chungie's base and ambush him. He hides in another chungie's house, who's former inhabitant is killed by them. Spoke goes invis and escapes. They find him again but he elytras away. 

His group fights the spies whilst he chases down Jumper and Spoke, who both escape. After SirPig_ escapes custody they and their army ambush the prison. He follows Jumper and Spoke throughut the whole fight, but they lose him eventually. They meet again, and the chase continues. They run into the Railgun that Spoke prepared and are killed by Jumper. They drop a book titled misson: null.

Their loot was collected by the rest members. Another squad including their leader _x_6_00 appeared through a newly generated nether portal and built a tomb with wither rose for him.

title: 1 VS 1000 Player Minecraft War
content:
1 vs 100 Player Minecraft War is the 127th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
FlameFrags begins the episode by explaining that he's going to fight Mistrul, the leader of the Mist civilization, one of the most powerful teams on the entire Unstable SMP, which would free all of the members of the civilization from his reign. The first time Flame fought Mistrul, he lost the fight and escaped via a happy ghast until his best friend Lomedy was shot off.

The episode begins with Flame looking down at where Lomedy dropped off, Mistrul then flies right into the happy ghast, maces it and kills it, leading to Flame dropping down and wind charge clutching. At the bottom are huge ice spikes, Flame looks in the general vicinity for Lomedy, unfortunately for Flame, Mistrul drops down and demands a rematch right there. Flame thinks he's cheap for wanting another fight when he is unprepared and that Mistrul had time to restock himself. Mistrul calls him a coward and blows a horn, which signaled hundreds of Mist members run in and join the fight. Flame tries to mend his armor before they catch up, Mistrul lands a mace hit instantly, and he isn't able to get any free time on the high ground, as the players all have wind charges of their own. Flame decides to run due to the sheer amount of players and his game performance started to drop. Mistrul taunts him for being a combat master running away and says Flame will never escape the Mist. The camera moves to a player sitting on top of an ice spike throwing an invis potion down for Flame, Flame notices it and goes full invis and hides inside an ice spike. Mistrul says he has won the duel and tells his players that they're going to hunt Flame. For Flame, the bigger problem is that Lomedy is missing stuck in the middle of nowhere, so he goes to find him. He runs around cluelessly yelling Lomedy's name until he sees a player glowing on top of an ice spike. He wind charges up and notices it's another player, NotSkrilley. Skrilley explains that Flame needs his help and that he knows everything about the Mist that most players don't. Flame doesn't believe him at first, but gives in only under one circumstance; if he leads him away from Lomedy, he's dead.

They traverse through the Mist terrain, Flame asks why they're heading this specific way, Skrilley says if Lomedy had any sense, he would hide. Flame then asks where he's taking him if he knew where Lomedy could be, Skrilley explains that the Mist is bigger than he thinks and that it's hidden from the server. Before he got trapped, he was an explorer with his friends that thought they discovered something new and found the routes until Mistrul found them and forced them to work for the civilization. Flame asks why he hasn't escaped yet, and Skrilley says it's not as easy as he thinks and that there's an ice wall that's heavily guarded, and if Mistrul found out you even tried, he'd kill you. Shortly after, they make it to Skrilley's village with other refugees. Skrilley gathers them all up and tells them that he found Flame, who would help them escape and kill the Mist if they found Lomedy. Flame agrees to the deal as long as Lomedy is brought back to him safely. They all split off in different directions to go look, Flame and Skrilley keep together just casually talking, one of the refugees, Flowtives, comes up to them and asks to join them. Flame says he's better off alone, but Skrilley insists as Flow is really good at PvP. Flow tells them they should go to the cave since Lomedy may have moved there, Flame doesn't think it makes sense to scatter all over and would rather look where Lomedy had dropped, but Skrilley says he's going with the flow.

As they enter the cave, Flame has a lot of questions, wondering if Mistrul is the leader, Skrilley says there is no real leader, the strongest basically leads the civilization. Flame asks Flow how long he's been there and asks why he hasn't tried to kill his way out, Flow gets irritated by how much Flame is talking and Skrilley tells them both to calm down. They reach the insides of the cave with massive ice spikes all over, Flame calls out for Lomedy's name and complains about how it made no sense to start here rather than start in order. Right in the middle of him complaining, they hear the Mist horn, which means they found something inside of the cave, and if it was them, they'd have to do something quick. Flow has spare Mist armor sets and comes up with the plan of blending in with the army invis. Flame is skeptical at the fact that it has curse of binding in it, but puts it on as he has no other choice if he wants to survive. The three attempt to blend in, Mistrul calls them out immediately and instructs the army to kill them. No matter what they did, they got relentlessly chased, and with no way out as the door got blocked off. Flame realized that they got noticed cause of their invis, so him and Flow get tons of players stuck in a hole and splash all of them with invis, giving them enough time and distraction to run away. Mistrul kills off his own players that are invisible, Flame and the other two manage to successfully escape.

They come to the village with no good news for the rest of the refugees, Flame proceeds to ask if anyone had seen Lomedy, griffincoat6, one of the other refugees, speaks up and says they found Lomedy and spoke to him, they said they were going to bring Lomedy back until several Mist players attacked them. Griffin froze and panicked, knowing he wasn't good at PvP, so he told Lomedy to head to an old escape route, which was a dead end. Flame says they need to get there fast, but they're afraid of losing more of them if they go out again. Griffin asks to be trained in order to be good enough, Flame starts to lose his patience and threatens to kill them all, Skrilley jumps in and calms him down. Griffin says to train them fast and they'll go, Flame angrily agrees, but if Lomedy dies within that time, he'd kill them all. Skrilley gets them over to the training grounds, Flame asks why he's paying his part of the deal now, Skrilley tells him they're scared and asks to train them shortly just enough to survive. Flow says he's making a mistake by training them, if the players show any skill or power and the Mist sees they can't fight back, the players would just get killed. Flame insists on training them, Flow says he's going to head to the tunnel where Lomedy is while Flame goes and messes things up. Flame then goes to the rest of the refugees and explains combat in a very basic manner. While Flame teaches them, he spots tons of usernames at the village and they all head over. Mistrul says he's let this village live for too long and decides to end it there. Flame is unable to see who's apart of his team and who isn't, and with no other choice, he tells Skrilley he has to abandon the rest of his village if he wants to survive. The two run away, Skrilley is in disbelief that he left the rest of his group, Flame apologizes for leaving everyone else behind, he tells Skrilley after they find Lomedy, he'll take on all of Mist himself and Skrilley can leave. Skrilley doesn't want Flame to die for him, he only cared about playing on the server with his friends and having fun. They then head towards the tunnel, Flame tells Skrilley once they find Lomedy, he thinks Skrilley would get a long with him and talks about Lomedy and what he's like. Flame thanks Skrilley for helping him, Skrilley said if he stopped being kind, he wouldn't be himself anymore.

Flame and Skrilley arrive to the escape tunnel and enter in, they see a glowing player and Flame thinks it's Lomedy. As they run closer to the player, it appears to be Flow and a tomb. Flow apologizes and says it wasn't personal, Mistrul then appears right behind saying that the escape tunnel was blocked off and it was only a rumor PvPers told themselves when they were desperate. Flame says he knew there was something off with Flow, Flow tells Flame when he asked how Mistrul was so good, it's because Flow trained him and his job was to never allow anyone to leave the Mist. Mistrul says he should've never came here and thought there wouldn't be consequences. Mistrul tells Skrilley to switch sides or else he dies, Flame says they aren't going to die and keeps his promise of leaving this place. Flame then has a realization, if Flow killed him, where was Lomedy's mace, just as he has that thought, Mistrul breaks blocks beneath them and sets off TNT. Flame and Skrilley down a dropper-like area with ice spikes. Skrilley tells Flame if Mistrul says someone's dead, it really is true, he asks Flame to help him since he's the only person he has left. Flame says he promised to and would keep his word. Mistrul and Flow drop down right after and begin fighting Flame, Flame tells Skrilley to run while he deals with them two. Flow gets Mistrul to get on Skrilley so Flame can have the 1v1 with Flow. During the fight, Flow drops and pops his totem via fall damage, him and Mistrul reunite and fight Flame together. Flame goes up to Skrilley and sees he hadn't left on his own to survive. Flow and Mistrul catch up and combo Flame. In the midst of everything, Flame accidentally throws his sword out and asks himself how he even did that. Flow and Mistrul stop, Flow laughs at Flame for dropping his sword and throws it to Flame because he didn't even want a sword of a "combat master". Flow taunts Flame for losing his composure after finding out Lomedy died. They all make it out of the tunnel, Flame crafts a boat and they ice boat away, leaving Mistrul and Flow behind.

Flame and Skrilley find an abandoned tower to reside in, Skrilley apologizes, and Flame tells him to leave before they find him again. When Skrilley leaves, Flame goes on top of the tower and sits there.

Flame's monologue then plays, Lomedy's death was all of his fault, he regrets putting Lomedy in such a dangerous area such as the Mist. All because of his goal of being a combat grandmaster. It was his every decision that caused the death, and he regrets not giving Lomedy the opportunity to live his life to do everything he liked and enjoyed doing. Flame calls himself pathetic and weak that he couldn't do anything to avenge Lomedy. He knew he wasn't strong enough to fight Mistrul in a 1v1, yet alone an outnumbered battle. Flame remembered he was missing one thing; ItzRealMe taught him how to enter the zone, Itz believed Flame could reach that part of his mind. Flame couldn't be able to see it because his mind was stuck in the Mist, he hadn't been able to focus, but now that he's alone, he's able to control the zone.

Flame walks into the civilization again and sees Mistrul waiting in the fighting arena. Mistrul notices that Flame is more quiet than usual, but doesn't care and says Flame will still die in the end. The fight begins, Mistrul can already see something has changed in Flame when he starts landing more hits. Mistrul is unable to get Flame low at all, Flame then manages to land a six hit combo on Mistrul, then another eight before Mistrul flies away. Flame pearls right onto Mistrul and hits one more time, this time being the final blow and kills Mistrul. The players of the civilization come out of hiding and start attacking Flame. Flame gets a few picks off, he then goes in his ender chest to get other weapons. When a group of players are all in one place, he places a rail and blows them all up with a TNT minecart. The remaining players run away, Flow walks in and questions what just happened there. Flame gives Flow the remains of Mistrul, they then have an actual fair 1v1 that Flame asked for. During the fight, Flow still tells Flame he has a lot to learn and that he's the most worthy opponent he's had to face yet. With Flow almost dead, Flame tells him to stop and that he's not going to kill him, he wants Flow to live with the same feeling as how he felt. Flame takes Mistrul's Elytra and mace out of his ender chest and throws it to give to Flow. Before Flow could pick it up, Flame burns them both. Flow says those items were beyond any player and that it belonged to the Mist. Flame says he doesn't care and that he gets to live with that, Flow says they only did it to break him, and Flame says that it worked and leaves the civilization to Flow's hands.

Flame rides a happy ghast back to his base, Skrilley shows up and Flame says that he's glad that he was able to come back. Skrilley says he has some good news and brings out Lomedy. Lomedy explains that he ran and hid, he says it was true someone found him and ditched him, so Lomedy acted tough with his mace, which caused the Mist to run away. Flame realized he killed a bunch of Mist members and their leader over his devastation and now has beef with Flow over nothing. Skrilley adds onto it and says he lost all his friends and his village for him, Lomedy says sorry for being bad at the game and that he's just a farmer. Flame and Skrilley jokingly say they're going to kill him and chase him around the base for all of the troubles and grief they just went through.

 Trivia 

 The video is recorded in 4K, whereas most videos are recorded in 1440p.
 This video marks the first time in Unstable history where all of the protagonists uploaded twice before Wemmbu.
 With A/B testing, the video will either be shown as 1 VS 1000 Player Minecraft War or Finding My Best Friend Who Went Missing.
 This is the first Unstable Video to have an enemy POV
 The video was originally titled "1 VS 100 Player Minecraft War".

Flame decides to run due to the sheer amount of players and his game performance started to drop. Mistrul taunts him for being a combat master running away and says Flame will never escape the Mist. The camera moves to a player sitting on top of an ice spike throwing an invis potion down for Flame, Flame notices it and goes full invis and hides inside an ice spike. Mistrul says he has won the duel and tells his players that they're going to hunt Flame. For Flame, the bigger problem is that Lomedy is missing stuck in the middle of nowhere, so he goes to find him. He runs around cluelessly yelling Lomedy's name until he sees a player glowing on top of an ice spike. He wind charges up and notices it's another player, [[NotSkrilley]]. Skrilley explains that Flame needs his help and that he knows everything about the Mist that most players don't. Flame doesn't believe him at first, but gives in only under one circumstance; if he leads him away from Lomedy, he's dead.

They traverse through the Mist terrain, Flame asks why they're heading this specific way, Skrilley says if Lomedy had any sense, he would hide. Flame then asks where he's taking him if he knew where Lomedy could be, Skrilley explains that the Mist is bigger than he thinks and that it's hidden from the server. Before he got trapped, he was an explorer with his friends that thought they discovered something new and found the routes until Mistrul found them and forced them to work for the civilization. Flame asks why he hasn't escaped yet, and Skrilley says it's not as easy as he thinks and that there's an ice wall that's heavily guarded, and if Mistrul found out you even tried, he'd kill you. Shortly after, they make it to Skrilley's village with other refugees. Skrilley gathers them all up and tells them that he found Flame, who would help them escape and kill the Mist if they found Lomedy. Flame agrees to the deal as long as Lomedy is brought back to him safely. They all split off in different directions to go look, Flame and Skrilley keep together just casually talking, one of the refugees, [[Flowtives]], comes up to them and asks to join them. Flame says he's better off alone, but Skrilley insists as Flow is really good at PvP. Flow tells them they should go to the cave since Lomedy may have moved there, Flame doesn't think it makes sense to scatter all over and would rather look where Lomedy had dropped, but Skrilley says he's going with the ''flow''.

As they enter the cave, Flame has a lot of questions, wondering if Mistrul is the leader, Skrilley says there is no real leader, the strongest basically leads the civilization. Flame asks Flow how long he's been there and asks why he hasn't tried to kill his way out, Flow gets irritated by how much Flame is talking and Skrilley tells them both to calm down. They reach the insides of the cave with massive ice spikes all over, Flame calls out for Lomedy's name and complains about how it made no sense to start here rather than start in order. Right in the middle of him complaining, they hear the Mist horn, which means they found something inside of the cave, and if it was them, they'd have to do something quick. Flow has spare Mist armor sets and comes up with the plan of blending in with the army invis. Flame is skeptical at the fact that it has curse of binding in it, but puts it on as he has no other choice if he wants to survive. The three attempt to blend in, Mistrul calls them out immediately and instructs the army to kill them. No matter what they did, they got relentlessly chased, and with no way out as the door got blocked off. Flame realized that they got noticed cause of their invis, so him and Flow get tons of players stuck in a hole and splash all of them with invis, giving them enough time and distraction to run away. Mistrul kills off his own players that are invisible, Flame and the other two manage to successfully escape.

They come to the village with no good news for the rest of the refugees, Flame proceeds to ask if anyone had seen Lomedy, griffincoat6, one of the other refugees, speaks up and says they found Lomedy and spoke to him, they said they were going to bring Lomedy back until several Mist players attacked them. Griffin froze and panicked, knowing he wasn't good at PvP, so he told Lomedy to head to an old escape route, which was a dead end. Flame says they need to get there fast, but they're afraid of losing more of them if they go out again. Griffin asks to be trained in order to be good enough, Flame starts to lose his patience and threatens to kill them all, Skrilley jumps in and calms him down. Griffin says to train them fast and they'll go, Flame angrily agrees, but if Lomedy dies within that time, he'd kill them all. Skrilley gets them over to the training grounds, Flame asks why he's paying his part of the deal now, Skrilley tells him they're scared and asks to train them shortly just enough to survive. Flow says he's making a mistake by training them, if the players show any skill or power and the Mist sees they can't fight back, the players would just get killed. Flame insists on training them, Flow says he's going to head to the tunnel where Lomedy is while Flame goes and messes things up. Flame then goes to the rest of the refugees and explains combat in a very basic manner. While Flame teaches them, he spots tons of usernames at the village and they all head over. Mistrul says he's let this village live for too long and decides to end it there. Flame is unable to see who's apart of his team and who isn't, and with no other choice, he tells Skrilley he has to abandon the rest of his village if he wants to survive. The two run away, Skrilley is in disbelief that he left the rest of his group, Flame apologizes for leaving everyone else behind, he tells Skrilley after they find Lomedy, he'll take on all of Mist himself and Skrilley can leave. Skrilley doesn't want Flame to die for him, he only cared about playing on the server with his friends and having fun. They then head towards the tunnel, Flame tells Skrilley once they find Lomedy, he thinks Skrilley would get a long with him and talks about Lomedy and what he's like. Flame thanks Skrilley for helping him, Skrilley said if he stopped being kind, he wouldn't be himself anymore.

Flame and Skrilley arrive to the escape tunnel and enter in, they see a glowing player and Flame thinks it's Lomedy. As they run closer to the player, it appears to be Flow and a tomb. Flow apologizes and says it wasn't personal, Mistrul then appears right behind saying that the escape tunnel was blocked off and it was only a rumor PvPers told themselves when they were desperate. Flame says he knew there was something off with Flow, Flow tells Flame when he asked how Mistrul was so good, it's because Flow trained him and his job was to never allow anyone to leave the Mist. Mistrul says he should've never came here and thought there wouldn't be consequences. Mistrul tells Skrilley to switch sides or else he dies, Flame says they aren't going to die and keeps his promise of leaving this place. Flame then has a realization, if Flow killed him, where was Lomedy's mace, just as he has that thought, Mistrul breaks blocks beneath them and sets off TNT. Flame and Skrilley down a dropper-like area with ice spikes. Skrilley tells Flame if Mistrul says someone's dead, it really is true, he asks Flame to help him since he's the only person he has left. Flame says he promised to and would keep his word. Mistrul and Flow drop down right after and begin fighting Flame, Flame tells Skrilley to run while he deals with them two. Flow gets Mistrul to get on Skrilley so Flame can have the 1v1 with Flow. During the fight, Flow drops and pops his totem via fall damage, him and Mistrul reunite and fight Flame together. Flame goes up to Skrilley and sees he hadn't left on his own to survive. Flow and Mistrul catch up and combo Flame. In the midst of everything, Flame accidentally throws his sword out and asks himself how he even did that. Flow and Mistrul stop, Flow laughs at Flame for dropping his sword and throws it to Flame because he didn't even want a sword of a "combat master". Flow taunts Flame for losing his composure after finding out Lomedy died. They all make it out of the tunnel, Flame crafts a boat and they ice boat away, leaving Mistrul and Flow behind.

Flame and Skrilley find an abandoned tower to reside in, Skrilley apologizes, and Flame tells him to leave before they find him again. When Skrilley leaves, Flame goes on top of the tower and sits there.

Flame's monologue then plays, Lomedy's death was all of his fault, he regrets putting Lomedy in such a dangerous area such as the Mist. All because of his goal of being a combat grandmaster. It was his every decision that caused the death, and he regrets not giving Lomedy the opportunity to live his life to do everything he liked and enjoyed doing. Flame calls himself pathetic and weak that he couldn't do anything to avenge Lomedy. He knew he wasn't strong enough to fight Mistrul in a 1v1, yet alone an outnumbered battle. Flame remembered he was missing one thing; [[ItzRealMe]] taught him how to enter the zone, Itz believed Flame could reach that part of his mind. Flame couldn't be able to see it because his mind was stuck in the Mist, he hadn't been able to focus, but now that he's alone, he's able to control the zone.

Flame walks into the civilization again and sees Mistrul waiting in the fighting arena. Mistrul notices that Flame is more quiet than usual, but doesn't care and says Flame will still die in the end. The fight begins, Mistrul can already see something has changed in Flame when he starts landing more hits. Mistrul is unable to get Flame low at all, Flame then manages to land a six hit combo on Mistrul, then another eight before Mistrul flies away. Flame pearls right onto Mistrul and hits one more time, this time being the final blow and kills Mistrul. The players of the civilization come out of hiding and start attacking Flame. Flame gets a few picks off, he then goes in his ender chest to get other weapons. When a group of players are all in one place, he places a rail and blows them all up with a TNT minecart. The remaining players run away, Flow walks in and questions what just happened there. Flame gives Flow the remains of Mistrul, they then have an actual fair 1v1 that Flame asked for. During the fight, Flow still tells Flame he has a lot to learn and that he's the most worthy opponent he's had to face yet. With Flow almost dead, Flame tells him to stop and that he's not going to kill him, he wants Flow to live with the same feeling as how he felt. Flame takes Mistrul's Elytra and mace out of his ender chest and throws it to give to Flow. Before Flow could pick it up, Flame burns them both. Flow says those items were beyond any player and that it belonged to the Mist. Flame says he doesn't care and that he gets to live with that, Flow says they only did it to break him, and Flame says that it worked and leaves the civilization to Flow's hands.

Flame rides a happy ghast back to his base, Skrilley shows up and Flame says that he's glad that he was able to come back. Skrilley says he has some good news and brings out Lomedy. Lomedy explains that he ran and hid, he says it was true someone found him and ditched him, so Lomedy acted tough with his mace, which caused the Mist to run away. Flame realized he killed a bunch of Mist members and their leader over his devastation and now has beef with Flow over nothing. Skrilley adds onto it and says he lost all his friends and his village for him, Lomedy says sorry for being bad at the game and that he's just a farmer. Flame and Skrilley jokingly say they're going to kill him and chase him around the base for all of the troubles and grief they just went through.

== Trivia ==

* The video is recorded in 4K, whereas most videos are recorded in 1440p.
* This video marks the first time in Unstable history where all of the protagonists uploaded twice before [[Wemmbu]].
* With A/B testing, the video will either be shown as 1 VS 1000 Player Minecraft War or Finding My Best Friend Who Went Missing.
* This is the first Unstable Video to have an enemy POV
* The video was originally titled "1 VS 100 Player Minecraft War".

title: 2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master
content:
2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master is the 115th episode featured in Unstable Universe. This marks the end of FlameFrags's perspective of The Kings Arc.
Plot
Flame does a foreshadow about the upcoming fight against The Law in Northern Council. Flame recaps about the battles he had took part in against the Law until he took part against a 2v1000. The news spread like wildfire and eventually causing Flame to get exiled. Flame had trained for a month all leading up to this moment.

Flame returns to his base realizing it got griefed with banners with the Law's insignia. LettuceK comes to Flame's base trying to convince Flame to stop. Lettuce fails to convince Flame, so he goes back to the Northern Council. Just as he leaves, Wemmbu digs into Flame's base base, asking, "Have you seen an eggchan?" Flame responds with no and Wemmbu says that he wants to team up with him because he needs to get a friend out of the prison. Flame says he also has a friend he needs to get out of the prison. They both agree to get their friends out. They fight the local garrison led by SargeLAW. They defeat the garrison but SargeLaw retreats to get Lettuce. They notice PrinceZam, SpokeIsHere and JumperWho are also killing the guards inside the prison. Flame asks Wemmbu where Lomedy is. Wemmbu asks Flame if Lomedy really  wants to leave and Wemmbu tells Flame to free all the prisoners inside and he'll stall Lettuce. Flame goes inside the prison and kills the guards one by one and destroying the doors and security. Flame meets Spoke, Zam and Jumper where the cells are. Th3Blurpinstein is seen running away as the others keep fighting. After the massacre, Flame requests Lomedy to escape but Lomedy refuses until his sentence has been fulfilled and refuses as he is not breaking the law. Lomedy also doesn't trust Flame as eh stole his mace, destroyed his farm and keeps fighting the Law and doesn't admit he's in the wrong. Lomedy says he's going to leave if the Law lets him go. Lomedy requests his mace but Flame refuses until he leaves. Flame is now only left with the option of taking down Law. Flame decides to use his mace for the army at the top of Law headquarters. They massacre the army and Flame notices Jaden MAN in the fight. Flame requests Jaden drop it but he says he can ask for it later. Wemmbu drops Orbital Strike Cannons on the headquarters until its rubble. Spoke asks them if they had seen ParrotX2. Wemmbu asks them why they need Parrot but they say they need to sway the public so another group doesn't form another Law.  

Spoke leads them to his base in The Amplified. Flame doesn't want to work with them due to them mostly provoking Flame in the past. Spoke led massive armies in an attempt to kill Flame; Jaden stole his friend: Lomedy's other mace and betrayed Flame; and Jumper worked with BAT in attempts to kill him. There they meet up with Mapicc and MinuteTech both enemies of Flame. Spoke tries to rally them together as they've had been involved in conflicts against each other but it barely helps. Minute supplys them with shulker boxes to fight the Law. Wemmbu notices an invisible person and warns them about it but later is informed that is a spy. The spy informs them that thousands of law soldiers are converging to a single area. Spoke hypothesizes that the area must be where Parrot escaped to. They get into a debate on why they need Parrot. Spoke asks Wemmbu what he is going to do after he kills Lettuce and he replies with that he is going to ride off into the sunset. Zam and Spoke calls him stupid and then asks Flame what he is going to do after he kills Lettuce. Flame replies with that he is going to gain all the aura and that everyone is going to pat him on the head and the immortal demon is back in town and then he is going to slime out Jaden. Flame starts attacking Jaden for not giving him his mace and Wemmbu orbitals trying to stop them from fighting.   

Wemmbu elytras over to the location and Flame walks over there. Together, Flame, Parrot, TheobaldTheBird and Wemmbu kill every lawmen there. They go up top and get on a happy ghast and fly over to the base. Parrot asks them who was here during The Invisible Mafia Arc and leads them to District 13.  Parrot gives a speech to rally their troops and leads them to Northern Council. They fight off  the first wave of diamond lawmen and they go into the palace to confront Lettuce and his generals. Lettuce then reveals the netherite legions. They barely fight them off and Flame, drained of resources decides to fight Jaden to try and take Lomedy's mace. Wemmbu intervenes. During the fight, Lettuce comes back and surrenders. The group leads them to the palace. They hold a vote on whether to kill Lettuce. They ultimately vote to let him live in the prison. Lettuce tells Flame that he should change so that all of the horrible actions he had done wouldn't be in vain and prove the world wrong that he was wrong. Flame goes back into the Law headquarters and free Lomedy and gives him back his mace.

title: 29mxq a
content:
__29mxq__a was the third squad leader of Null Hunters appeared in the Unstable Universe and the first shown to have a mic. He did not have multishot crossbow. His squad did not have the totem stasis mechanism, and is much weaker compared with elite squads at Spawn led by _1_88_____x and _x_6_00.

 History 
He was commanded to search for players that have escaped from Null Hunters in Far Lands. His squad hunted down Spoke, Jumper and Mapicc throughout Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing, capturing PlanetLord in the process. His squad was killed by them in the dark forest. He was captured by them, interrogated and forced to lead them to a staircase, before attempting to escape and being killed by Spoke. He told Spoke only elite squads can have totem stasis mechanism.

His death was rather sad because he had done his part of the deal and led them to the fabric of NULL. He only wanted to remain a NULL leader (If he was seen with Spoke, he would probably have been deemed a traitor) and yet Spoke killed him. That really shows that Spoke really has no care for others and no mercy at all. Even JumperWho, seemed rather taken aback from his sudden death at the hands of Spoke.

title: 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters
content:
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters is the 106th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Parrot recaps all of the events that has happened in previous episodes, ever since Lettuce got 6,000 votes at the start of the election, Parrot had a plan. Ever since The Law took over the server, LettuceK got ahold of Wemmbu and put him in custody, but Parrot knew Wemmbu had escaped and fled to the Great Sea, being one of the few people that knew about it. Lettuce gathers the final four candidates to make an announcement, he says he'll host another debate a day from now, deciding who will make it to the final round, Parrot uses this chance to try and get Wemmbu to go to the debate and expose Lettuce. The plan is risky, as if Lettuce found out Parrot was doing this, he would send his lawmen to take down Wemmbu, but Parrot had no other choice.

Parrot travels sixteen hours to the Great Sea, he goes to the Pirate City base only to see it be abandoned. He stands on top of the building and sees Wemmbu and eggchan standing at another point of the base. Parrot runs to them, Wemmbu questions why he was there. Although it had been a while since Parrot last talked to Wemmbu and that they weren't on the greatest of terms, Parrot still had to try and see if Wemmbu would work with him. Parrot asks Wemmbu if he knows all about the election, Wemmbu says he's been too busy getting hunted, so Parrot explains what's been going on at spawn and asks if Wemmbu would work with him to take down Lettuce. Wemmbu says why would he ever work with Parrot, Parrot says if Lettuce ends up winning, he'd never be able to return to the main server, and before Parrot could continue, Wemmbu punches Parrot off the edge to talk to egg first. Parrot waits in the meantime, Wemmbu says he'll agree to help defeat Lettuce, leaving egg behind as it would be too dangerous for him. Parrot asks Wemmbu if he knows a faster way back to spawn since traveling by boat would take too much time before the debate started. Wemmbu says there's a dolphin tunnel that connects to Capital City, but is more dangerous with all the lawmen that guards the area. 

They boat towards the island, Parrot comes up with the idea to fight them, but Wemmbu isn't geared enough to do so. The next best idea was for Parrot to run up to the island and pretend to rat Wemmbu out, all the lawmen run into the ocean except the netherite guard, who says he has to stay and protect the island. Parrot lies to the guard and says if he captured Wemmbu, he'd get a promotion in The Law, the guard believes it and leaves the island in search for Wemmbu. Parrot and Wemmbu, who was invisible the whole time, make it to the tunnel. While Parrot and Wemmbu are traveling back, Lettuce hosts a meeting at the Northern Council with all of his lawmen, he suspects that Parrot is bringing Wemmbu back to Law territory and instructs them to stop them from coming back into The Law's territory and to kill them. Back in the tunnel, Parrot and Wemmbu make good progress on their way back until lawmen start coming from the opposite direction, going unnoticed at the speed they're going, so they dig through the wall and boat up on surface the rest of the way back.

Back on land, Parrot says there's a happy ghast with loot in the cherry biome headed above, he explains that they can use the happy ghast to fly above all of Law territory and make it to the debate. Parrot and Wemmbu surface and loses the lawmen, Wemmbu asks where they're going and Parrot says they're going to a special river. Parrot asks for the best way to get back to spawn without encountering The Law, Coin says they have to go down the Kings River and go northwest, leading to a path called The Smuggler's Pass and past The Law graveyard until they get to the professional smugglers. They make it to a checkpoint, Parrot looks and sees a gate that may block off their way there, but he sees a player with nothing coming out the other way with a nautilus, so they sneak their way past the lawmen guarding the checkpoint.
