content:
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players is the 85th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The episode starts off with Wemmbu and FlameFrags starting their rematch, but unexpectedly, LettuceK and his team of lawmen come and jump them. The two try to kill off the lawmen, but it would've drained too much of their resources, so they decide to leave. Wemmbu escapes and restocks, and Flame follows along to try and continue their battle. The lawmen catch up and jump them again. Wemmbu uses an orbital strike cannon to kill some of them off, but it barely did anything. He flees from the fight since there's too many of them still.

As Wemmbu is swimming away, Flame chases again and is ready to fight once more. Wemmbu gives the idea to deal with Lettuce first and then fight, but Flame says he's going to run from the fight. Wemmbu stops running and the two decide to work together to defeat Lettuce first. They go back to Flame's base to restock, and when Wemmbu goes outside to farm sugar cane for rockets, he sees lawmen coming from a distance. After deafting the army of lawmen once again, Lettuce flies away. Wemmbu and Flame pursue him, but their tridents break mid-chase.

The two then try to sneak into The Law's base and kill Lettuce there. Wemmbu makes it to the main building, and Lettuce notices him immediately. Flame and Wemmbu jump Lettuce, Flame tells Lettuce that he won't beat Flame no matter what. Lettuce tells them if they kill him, nothing would change since there's a chain of command and it would break connections between Capitol City and Merchant City. Lettuce then says he won't stop hunting them until they submit or become a prisoner. Instead, Wemmbu proposes a fight with Lettuce and all his lawmen, and Lettuce accepts the deal. 

Wemmbu and Flame go back to Flame's base to collect the loot of the dead lawmen. They then head to the black market inside of Capitol City to rob players for their experience. Wemmbu tries to be intimidating, but it doesn't work. He starts killing players if they don't abide, and it starts to work. The people begin to chase them as they leave, but are unable to catch up. Wemmbu and Flame head to Merchant City next and talk to a rich civilian who lives there. He asks for netherite ingots in exchange for mending books, but Wemmbu doesn't have mending books, instead giving the civilian netherite sets with mending on them. He also trades off a few more sets of armor for shulkers full of materials. 

The two begin to minecart to their designated fighting location. In the midst of it, Wemmbu falls down some sort of trap, but survives since it was already set off. They fly the rest of the way there, standing on top of a massive statue. They wait days for the lawmen to arrive, and they see thousands of players coming into view. Lettuce blows a horn to signal them to start attacking. Wemmbu activates three orbital strike cannons, which kills hundreds of players instantly. For the first half of the fight, they kill the lawmen with ease. However, later on in the fight, players with maces and Elytras start to appear. Though it being a bit challenging, Wemmbu kills one of the mace wielders that was AFK, and kill a few more soon after. He gives Flame a mace and an Elytra, Flame rejects it at first, but takes them out of pity. 

center|thumb|600px|The location after the fight.

They kill the last remaining lawmen, and Wemmbu looks at the battlefield and the destruction they have caused. Behind him, Flame burns the Elytra and mace given to him and starts to attack Wemmbu. Flame uses a fishing rod to teleport his dogs to his location and Wemmbu tries to orbital strike them. Flame says he wants Wemmbu to admit that he's stronger than him. Wemmbu then has an epiphany, he tells Flame he can have the title of being the strongest player again. Flame then leaves after hearing what he wanted to hear. Wemmbu looks in his inventory, having three maces, an extra from one of the lawmen. He throws the extra away into down a hole created by the stab shot. Out of nowhere, Lettuce appears and says Wemmbu has definitely seen better days. He elytras down into the hole and picks the mace up. He comes back up and thanks Wemmbu for it. Lettuce, seeing the current state Wemmbu is in, then takes him as a prisoner or else he dies.

 Trivia 

 This is the second longest episode after The Invisible Mafia Arc.
 This is one of the fastest growing episodes in terms of views as it has has an average of 1M views per day. (as of Nov 4, 2025)
 This episode has the most amount of Unstable Events players.
 Wemmbu accidentally kills LettuceK during the event this episode was based on but obviously, the scene was cut. 
 This episode has 10 Million Views on Youtube.

Flame and Wemmbu jump Lettuce, Flame tells Lettuce that he won't beat Flame no matter what. Lettuce tells them if they kill him, nothing would change since there's a chain of command and it would break connections between [[Capitol City]] and [[Merchant City]]. Lettuce then says he won't stop hunting them until they submit or become a prisoner. Instead, Wemmbu proposes a fight with Lettuce and all his lawmen, and Lettuce accepts the deal. 

Wemmbu and Flame go back to Flame's base to collect the loot of the dead lawmen. They then head to the black market inside of Capitol City to rob players for their experience. Wemmbu tries to be intimidating, but it doesn't work. He starts killing players if they don't abide, and it starts to work. The people begin to chase them as they leave, but are unable to catch up. Wemmbu and Flame head to Merchant City next and talk to a rich civilian who lives there. He asks for netherite ingots in exchange for mending books, but Wemmbu doesn't have mending books, instead giving the civilian netherite sets with mending on them. He also trades off a few more sets of armor for shulkers full of materials. 

The two begin to minecart to their designated fighting location. In the midst of it, Wemmbu falls down [[I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Redstone Genius|some sort of trap, but survives since it was already set off]]. They fly the rest of the way there, standing on top of a massive statue. They wait days for the lawmen to arrive, and they see thousands of players coming into view. Lettuce blows a horn to signal them to start attacking. Wemmbu activates three orbital strike cannons, which kills hundreds of players instantly. For the first half of the fight, they kill the lawmen with ease. However, later on in the fight, players with maces and Elytras start to appear. Though it being a bit challenging, Wemmbu kills one of the mace wielders that was AFK, and kill a few more soon after. He gives Flame a mace and an Elytra, Flame rejects it at first, but takes them out of pity. 

[[File:DestroyedBattlefield.png|center|thumb|600px|<center>The location after the fight.</center>]]

They kill the last remaining lawmen, and Wemmbu looks at the battlefield and the destruction they have caused. Behind him, Flame burns the Elytra and mace given to him and starts to attack Wemmbu. Flame uses a fishing rod to teleport his dogs to his location and Wemmbu tries to orbital strike them. Flame says he wants Wemmbu to admit that he's stronger than him. Wemmbu then has an epiphany, he tells Flame he can have the title of being the strongest player again. Flame then leaves after hearing what he wanted to hear. Wemmbu looks in his inventory, having three maces, an extra from one of the lawmen. He throws the extra away into down a hole created by the stab shot. Out of nowhere, Lettuce appears and says Wemmbu has definitely seen better days. He elytras down into the hole and picks the mace up. He comes back up and thanks Wemmbu for it. Lettuce, seeing the current state Wemmbu is in, then takes him as a prisoner or else he dies.

== Trivia ==

* This is the second longest episode after [[The Invisible Mafia Arc]].
* This is one of the fastest growing episodes in terms of views as it has has an average of 1M views per day. (as of Nov 4, 2025)
* This episode has the most amount of [https://discord.gg/unstableevents Unstable Events] players.
* Wemmbu accidentally kills LettuceK during the event this episode was based on but obviously, the scene was cut. 
* This episode has 10 Million Views on Youtube.

title: 2 VS 1000 Player Minecraft Battle
content:
2 VS 1000 Player Minecraft Battle is the 86th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The episode begins with a recap of the fight they're about to take at the ending of Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Faked His Death. Flame makes a recap of the full episode and talking how Wemmbu had beat him "dishonourable" means in SOLO Player VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP. 

Wemmbu asks Flame for where to fight the 1000 players. Together, both of them travel to a big statue in minecarts as traveling by minecarts would have more "aura". Flame is worried of a TNT minecart trap at the end of the railway. Wemmbu says he already satisfied and doesn't want to fight Flame anymore because he already had beaten him. Flame says Wemmbu faked his death to dodge a fight from him and Wemmbu was searching the entire globe for him. Wemmbu argues that he doesn't care about Flame that much so he didn't fake his death to dodge a fight. Flame and Wemmbu arrive at the statue and they see a giant horde of players all lead by a player named LettuceK; the leader of The Law. As the players load in a massive amount of lag sets in. Wemmbu detonates two nuke shots that kills a portion of  the players but not enough so all the lag is gone. Flame jumps down into the pit while Wemmbu circles in the skies. Flame pulls one of his wolf rods to kill some players. Flame struggles to eat golden apples due to the immense lag. Flame is swarmed by dozens of players even some in  full netherite. Flame decides to use TNT minecarts to kill a lot of players but he demands Wemmbu to give him some space so he can take some out of his shulker box. Flame manages to kill huge groups of players with his TNT minecarts. Wemmbu asks Flame to get in a corner so he can stab-shot and kill hundreds of the horde. Flame runs out of experience bottles; a vital resource to mend his armor. Flame moles his way back up to the ground. Flame restocks while Wemmbu is also running low on his experience bottle supply. Flame kills hundreds of players in a cave using TNT minecarts. In the process he pops himself. Flame runs back to the surface to meet up with Wemmbu. Flame's helmet breaks. Despite his dilapidated state, Flame goes on a killing spree killing over 20 players.  Flame runs up to the top of  the statue to get extra gear. Flame starts running as his armor his on the  verge of breaking. Some player's stole Wemmbu's armor shulkers and run. The fact of whether they got their shulkers back is unknown. Flame eventually takes a mace and an elytra from Wemmbu which he picked up from dead players of the 1000 player army. They meet up at the top of the statue to receive his mace and elytra. Flame states that he picked up the elytra and mace due to the 1000v2 situation and he'll fight unfair if the enemy is fighting unfair. The army is decimated. Flame even gets some cool kills such as TNT minecart - mace (stun slam) combo to kill a player, Mace - Mace (stun slam) combo, quick dropping a netherite player and comboes that exceed  the double digits. Eventually all that remains is Venthatguy. Flame restocks while wemmbu kills the last player. While Wemmbu is restocking, Flame betrays him and starts killing him. Flame pulls his wolf rod to counter wemmbu's nukes. wemmbu misses his last stab shot as Flame dodges it. Wemmbu then pulls a nuke shot that barely kills a wolf, although it did damage the wolf armor by a notable amount. Wemmbu's armor breaks and Wemmbu falls into a hole. Flame then asks Wemmbu to accept defeat and accept that he is the strongest player on the Unstable SMP. Wemmbu reluctantly agrees and Flame leaves. The scene changes to The Law's headquarters where Lettuce's right-hand man, Deputy Ace asks why he lead a thousand players into a meat grinder. Lettuce replies with, "Which idot would play all their cards in one move?" stating that he has a plan to kill or capture both Flame and Wemmbu.  

 Trivia 

 This video's title was originally "1000 Minecraft Hunters VS Minecraft's Deadliest Duo" but then being "SOLO Player VS 1000 Minecraft Hunters" but Wemmbu was added to the thumbnail making it 1001. It has since then been changed to "Minecraft Combat Master VS 1000 Hunters" and then "1000 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master"
 Furthermore, the title differs slightly with the title of Wemmbu's video of the same battle which is titled "2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Minecraft Hunters". This however signifies a very big contrast in what are their perceptions of each other are, with Wemmbu treating Flame more as an ally, while Flame still treats Wemmbu more as a foe.
 The thumbnails also support this idea because Wemmbu's thumbnail shows both of them together preparing for the battle instead of Flame's thumbnail which shows Wemmbu on the opposing side.
 As of April 28th 2026, there are 5 variations of the title: 
 1000 Minecraft Hunters VS Minecraft's Deadliest Duo
 SOLO Player VS 1001 Minecraft Hunters
 SOLO Player VS 1000 Minecraft Hunters 
 1000 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master 
 2 VS 1000 Player Minecraft Battle
 The thumbnail has been changed 1 time.

title: 4CVIT
content:
4CVIT, also known as 4C, is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe.

 Personality 
On the Unstable SMP is characterized as a highly skilled, technical, and often strategic Minecraft player, known for being a top-tier parkourer and a "blue slime" persona. He is recognized for his involvement in complex, high-stakes events like the Nuke War and Presidential arcs.

 History 

 Season 1 
4CVIT builds a base in the end. Parrot creates a civilization in the end, attracting mafia members to search in the end. 4CVIT joins the civilization. He later shows Parrot after the civilization is destroyed his base.

 Season 2 
It is descovered that 4C runs a place called Redstone Town, an outpost dedicated to his obsession with redstone, and made for others like him to trade, build and socialize over redstone. 

MrCube6 delivers items to 4CVIT in Redstone Town. He later gives these items to Parrot as Parrot tells him that they were stolen from Bounty Assassin Team.

Leow0ok buys explosives from 4CVIT to kill a hacker named TruOriginal.

Bounty Assassin Team pays 4CVIT a shulker box of netherite armor to get him to tell them about the Director, who supposedly bought redstone materials from him.

Wemmbu threatens 4CVIT into showing him the pearl cannon that Conexion used to get to the Farlands.

Wemmbu again threatens him into showing him a pearl cannon to the Farlands, but he refuses, instead calling guards on him.

Parrot asks 4CVIT to build an ender pearl cannon for Wemmbu to reach the Farlands, which he obliges to. 

 Season 3 
4C becomes the mayor of Steampunk City. During the civil war with Cindercrest, he helps ParrotX2 by constructing arrow cannons in various different cities in Parrot's Kingdom to defend them against Cindercrest. The machines kills almost their entire army. 

 Boundaries 

 Fanart rules 

 Okay:
 Changing hair, clothing, species, and body type
 Alcohol
 Depressive or manic moods
 Death
 Maybe (Requires permission from 4C):
 Cross dressing and gender swap
 Romantic portrayal with other characters
 Drugs and smoking

 IRL 

 No NSFW
 No sexualization

title: 4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players
content:
4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players is the 113th episode featured in Unstable Universe. This marks the end of SpokeIsHere's perspective of The Kings Arc and The BAT Arc.

 Plot 
Spoke foreshadows about the upcoming fight vs The Law and their armies. 

Spoke, PrinceZam, Mapicc and  JumperWho have prepared makeshift arrow cannons at the tunnels Leow0ok blew up. They trigger the cannons killing a chunk of the invading force but not enough to stop the invasion. They try escaping but Zam falls back in. Jumper pulls Zam's stasis to bring Zam to safety. The bunker had been overran.

They decide to recruit more people to fight Bounty Assassin Team and The Law. They go to a prison to save some more people and recruit them. Jumper directs them to a prison holding her spies while Jumper splits off to go somewhere. They splash invisibility to sneak into the prison. They see the castle that reminds them of The Invisible Mafia's architecture that's not built by B.A.T or The Law. Zam suggests going in guns blazing but they realize they aren't well-equipped enough. So, Spoke suggests using a tunnel to save the spies. Spokes invisibility runs out before he could even make it in the castle. Mapicc throws invisibility on Spoke redisguising Spoke. Spoke elytras down to the base of the prison and calls Zam to come down. They mine into the prison. Spoke slowly rescues them one by one.   

Spoke tries to stop Zam and Mapicc from blowing up the prison from the bottom using carts but Spoke is unable to stop them and they explode it from the floor. They fight and the guards at the prison seem to have powerful gear almost killing Spoke. Spoke isn't geared for this as Jumper said that there wouldn't be a fight. They're fighting and almost dead but then MinuteTech and Jumper show up saving them. Jumper had recruited MinuteTech. Together, they slaughter the guards. Minute threatens to kill Spoke as Spoke griefed his base in the end incident  Spoke apologizes and says he's trying to bring all his friends back. Spoke shows Jumper the spies they had rescued and gives them gear. Jumper says she's got gear for the spies and they know where to go to get invisibility and gear. Spoke asks what are the spies going to do if they aren't fighting and Jumper replies with they're going to gain intel on The Law and B.A.T. Minute gives them gear and he decides to go back into the end and take his gear stashes. Mapicc decides he's also going to follow Minute to help him in the end as Minute's wanted in the end.  

Jumper says the next person she's going to free is ParrotX2. Jumper says Parrot is rumored to be in the prison Spoke broke Zam out of. The group figures the prison is going to have increased security due to Spoke's jailbreak. They decide they'll meet back up at The Amplified's Castle. Zam doeesn't want to go back in the prison due to his trauma for being in there for four months. They invis and sneak into the prison. The prison also turns out to be the headquarters of the Law. They sneak past the guards. They are spotted by SilentMountain. Spoke tells them to get ready to run down the stairs when his TNT explodes.  They block their path behind them with obsidian. They equip their armor and blow up a Level 3 Access door. They go through the halls and kills some guards. They even get level access cards and milk buckets from the loot.    

Spoke blows up any clogs. They also blow up the item checker. They are attacked by a lot of guards once the door opens. They go to the solitary as they couldn't find Parrot in the main jail. But they do not find Parrot in solitary either. Spoke checks the backrooms but no luck. They go back to the main prison cells as they didn't check it all the way. They hear SargeLaw talking. They free Th3Blurpinstein and Lomedy, and also meet FlameFrags killing guards. Lomedy refuses to leave his cell and Spoke locks him in a smaller cell. They watch Flame use his Orbital Dog Cannon which summons an army of wolves. SargeLaw focuses Zam due to Zam wearing SargeRaxby's shield and due to SargeRaxby being SargeLaw's brother. They still couldn't find Parrot and SargeLaw chases them. Spoke mines ender chests without a silk touch pickaxe to obtain obsidian. Spoke blocks SargeLaw outside with obsidian rendering him out of the equation. They go back to the solitary cells and figure that they The Law must be hiding something if there were six guards protecting the place, so they summon a wither and boar through the obsidian towards a nametag. They free Jaden MAN, king of the Pirates who was captured by the Law in Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea. Spoke thinks Jaden is a guard but Zam tells him he is Jaden from the Great Sea. They recruit Jaden, Wemmbu and FlameFrags to join the resistance against the Law. They go to their headquarters in the Amplified. They meet Minute and Mapicc. But another glaring problem was present; Wemmbu and Flame are rivals and even more of an issue, Jaden betrayed Flame and Lomedy's mace in I Got BETRAYED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP. Flame tried killing Minute in Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Went Missing to get information on Wemmbu. So Flame tries to kill Jaden but is eventually stopped by the others.   

A spy shows up dropping a book and quill to Jumper stating that armies were converging to a specific point. They figure that Parrot was most likely there. Flame and Wemmbu says they want to attack LettuceK at the Northern Council. They go to 19500 ~ -10200. Immediately, Wemmbu elytras over there and leaves. Minute follows behind trying to reason with him and Flame goes there by foot. Spoke thinks on how to go faster than an elytra. They decide to make an ender pearl cannon with TNT minecarts to boost the ender pearl. Spoke goes there instantaneously beating Wemmbu and flame to the location. Spoke makes cart traps and lures the guards to the traps killing groups of them. There he sees Parrot and TheobaldTheBird up in the sky. Then Wemmbu arrives but he doesn't actually start fighting until FlameFrags show up.    

After a hard-fought battle, they loot the base and load it into chest boats strapped to a happy ghast although this is pretty impractical. Wemmbu is kicked off the happy ghast and flies over to their headquarters. Parrot leads them to District 13 where he had raised an army to confront LettuceK. They march to Northern Council where they see Lettuce, G0dOfWar, Purpled, SargeLaw and Leow0ok standing. Lettuce and Parrot walk up and talk. No peace was able to be made. Wemmbu drops 3 nukes on the players killing over a half of their forces. Their forces are able to kill the diamond players with ease. They confront Lettuce as they went up into their palace. Lettuce asks them how stupid do they think he is and reveals that the full netherite players were stationed in the walls and now encircling them. They are forced to fight or die, After a long fight, Lettuce and the Law is defeated and ran away. Flame attempts to kill Jaden, but Wemmbu intervenes. Lettuce comes back with no armor and surrenders.   

They take Lettuce to a vote. To either execute him or imprison him. The majority voted on imprisoning him. Parrot then reveals that he was going to allow Lettuce run in the election and if he wins he'll let Lettuce be king. They revolt and Lettuce says it's a lost cause. He knew Parrot was supposed to win the moment the execution against Parrot and Theo failed. Jumper interrupts Spoke to tell him Leow0ok was only a couple hundred blocks away and they beeline to Leo's exact location. They fight Leo and breaks all of his armor except for his leggings. Leo tells Spoke this will never end until he is dead and stasis away only to find out it was rigged to drop him in the void. Leo dies in the void.   

 Trivia 

 This is the second longest post mafia Unstable SMP episode
 This is Spoke's 100th video.

== Plot ==
Spoke foreshadows about the upcoming fight vs [[The Law]] and their armies. 

Spoke, [[PrinceZam]], [[Mapicc]] and  [[JumperWho]] have prepared makeshift arrow cannons at the tunnels [[Leow0ok]] blew up. They trigger the cannons killing a chunk of the invading force but not enough to stop the invasion. They try escaping but Zam falls back in. Jumper pulls Zam's stasis to bring Zam to safety. The bunker had been overran.

They decide to recruit more people to fight [[Bounty Assassin Team]] and [[The Law]]. They go to a prison to save some more people and recruit them. Jumper directs them to a prison holding her spies while Jumper splits off to go somewhere. They splash invisibility to sneak into the prison. They see the castle that reminds them of [[The Invisible Mafia|The Invisible Mafia's]] architecture that's not built by B.A.T or The Law. Zam suggests going in guns blazing but they realize they aren't well-equipped enough. So, Spoke suggests using a tunnel to save the spies. Spokes invisibility runs out before he could even make it in the castle. Mapicc throws invisibility on Spoke redisguising Spoke. Spoke elytras down to the base of the prison and calls Zam to come down. They mine into the prison. Spoke slowly rescues them one by one.   

Spoke tries to stop Zam and Mapicc from blowing up the prison from the bottom using carts but Spoke is unable to stop them and they explode it from the floor. They fight and the guards at the prison seem to have powerful gear almost killing Spoke. Spoke isn't geared for this as Jumper said that there wouldn't be a fight. They're fighting and almost dead but then [[MinuteTech]] and Jumper show up saving them. Jumper had recruited MinuteTech. Together, they slaughter the guards. Minute threatens to kill Spoke as Spoke griefed his base in [[1017 Players VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP...|the end incident]]  Spoke apologizes and says he's trying to bring all his friends back. Spoke shows Jumper the spies they had rescued and gives them gear. Jumper says she's got gear for the spies and they know where to go to get invisibility and gear. Spoke asks what are the spies going to do if they aren't fighting and Jumper replies with they're going to gain intel on The Law and B.A.T. Minute gives them gear and he decides to go back into the end and take his gear stashes. Mapicc decides he's also going to follow Minute to help him in the end as Minute's wanted in the end.  

Jumper says the next person she's going to free is [[ParrotX2]]. Jumper says Parrot is rumored to be in the prison Spoke broke Zam out of. The group figures the prison is going to have increased security due to Spoke's jailbreak. They decide they'll meet back up at [[The Amplified]]'s Castle. Zam doeesn't want to go back in the prison due to his trauma for being in there for four months. They invis and sneak into the prison. The prison also turns out to be the headquarters of the Law. They sneak past the guards. They are spotted by SilentMountain. Spoke tells them to get ready to run down the stairs when his TNT explodes.  They block their path behind them with obsidian. They equip their armor and blow up a Level 3 Access door. They go through the halls and kills some guards. They even get level access cards and milk buckets from the loot.    

Spoke blows up any clogs. They also blow up the item checker. They are attacked by a lot of guards once the door opens. They go to the solitary as they couldn't find Parrot in the main jail. But they do not find Parrot in solitary either. Spoke checks the backrooms but no luck. They go back to the main prison cells as they didn't check it all the way. They hear [[SargeLaw]] talking. They free [[Th3Blurpinstein]] and [[Lomedy]], and also meet [[FlameFrags]] killing guards. Lomedy refuses to leave his cell and Spoke locks him in a smaller cell. They watch Flame use his [[Orbital Dog Cannon]] which summons an army of wolves. SargeLaw focuses Zam due to Zam wearing [[SargeRaxby|SargeRaxby's]] shield and due to SargeRaxby being SargeLaw's brother. They still couldn't find Parrot and SargeLaw chases them. Spoke mines ender chests without a silk touch pickaxe to obtain obsidian. Spoke blocks SargeLaw outside with obsidian rendering him out of the equation. They go back to the solitary cells and figure that they The Law must be hiding something if there were six guards protecting the place, so they summon a wither and boar through the obsidian towards a nametag. They free [[Jaden MAN]], king of the [[Pirates]] who was captured by the Law in [[Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea]]. Spoke thinks Jaden is a guard but Zam tells him he is Jaden from the Great Sea. They recruit Jaden, [[Wemmbu]] and FlameFrags to join the resistance against the Law. They go to their headquarters in the Amplified. They meet Minute and Mapicc. But another glaring problem was present; [[Wemmbu]] and Flame are rivals and even more of an issue, Jaden betrayed Flame and Lomedy's mace in [[I Got BETRAYED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP]]. Flame tried killing Minute in [[Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Went Missing]] to get information on Wemmbu. So Flame tries to kill Jaden but is eventually stopped by the others.   

A spy shows up dropping a book and quill to Jumper stating that armies were converging to a specific point. They figure that Parrot was most likely there. Flame and Wemmbu says they want to attack [[LettuceK]] at the [[Northern Council]]. They go to 19500 ~ -10200. Immediately, Wemmbu elytras over there and leaves. Minute follows behind trying to reason with him and Flame goes there by foot. Spoke thinks on how to go faster than an elytra. They decide to make an ender pearl cannon with TNT minecarts to boost the ender pearl. Spoke goes there instantaneously beating Wemmbu and flame to the location. Spoke makes cart traps and lures the guards to the traps killing groups of them. There he sees Parrot and [[TheobaldTheBird]] up in the sky. Then Wemmbu arrives but he doesn't actually start fighting until FlameFrags show up.    

After a hard-fought battle, they loot the base and load it into chest boats strapped to a happy ghast although this is pretty impractical. Wemmbu is kicked off the happy ghast and flies over to their headquarters. Parrot leads them to [[District 13]] where he had raised an army to confront LettuceK. They march to Northern Council where they see Lettuce, [[G0dOfWar]], [[Purpled]], SargeLaw and Leow0ok standing. Lettuce and Parrot walk up and talk. No peace was able to be made. Wemmbu drops 3 nukes on the players killing over a half of their forces. Their forces are able to kill the diamond players with ease. They confront Lettuce as they went up into their palace. Lettuce asks them how stupid do they think he is and reveals that the full netherite players were stationed in the walls and now encircling them. They are forced to fight or die, After a long fight, Lettuce and the Law is defeated and ran away. Flame attempts to kill Jaden, but Wemmbu intervenes. Lettuce comes back with no armor and surrenders.   

They take Lettuce to a vote. To either execute him or imprison him. The majority voted on imprisoning him. Parrot then reveals that he was going to allow Lettuce run in the election and if he wins he'll let Lettuce be king. They revolt and Lettuce says it's a lost cause. He knew Parrot was supposed to win the moment the execution against Parrot and Theo failed. Jumper interrupts Spoke to tell him Leow0ok was only a couple hundred blocks away and they beeline to Leo's exact location. They fight Leo and breaks all of his armor except for his leggings. Leo tells Spoke this will never end until he is dead and stasis away only to find out it was rigged to drop him in the void. Leo dies in the void.   

== Trivia ==

* This is the second longest post mafia Unstable SMP episode
* This is Spoke's 100th video.

title: Alt
content:
thumb
Alt was the signature exploited Netherite Chestplate owned by Spoke, with every incompatible protection enchantment on it. It was broken by Mapicc after he knew the truth that Spoke instead of Leow0ok was the one who tried to kill JamatoP and encountered Spoke in a maze, surviving 130 episodes all the way from the beginning of Unstable Universe series. Of all destroyed items, this one bears the most significance, and lasted for the longest time.

 Origin 
Alt is first seen when Spoke is shown JamatoP's base which came from an armour set with "Ctrl" (helmet), "Delete" (leggings), and "Escape" (boots). This armour set has all types of incompatible protection enchantments, which is normally impossible. Wemmbu destroyed the rest of the set, but Spoke kept Alt for months. 

Alt has pronounced symbolic significance: It can represent Spoke's pride, Spoke's facade, Spoke's personal heroism, Spoke's false friendship with JamatoP, Spoke's manipulation, Spoke's crime, or Spoke's inner goal to use exploits to take over the server. 

Ironically, Alt was broken by Spoke's former best friend, Mapicc, in Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players.

 History 
He was a peaceful player, building his base with his friends, until Null Hunters showed up. They raided his base and kidnapped him and his friends. They were brought to the Road of NULL, where Antics used the ender pearl cannon to teleport to the Far Lands.

He built a new ender pearl cannon to take him to spawn. He wrote a book called road of null before getting captured by them.

title: ApexPoint
content:
ApexPoint was a character in Unstable Universe Season Two. He was known as a notorious bandit, leading to BAT ordering SpokeIsHere to assassinate him.

 Personality 
ApexPoint is loud, obnoxious and very full of himself, often proclaiming his name to players (like Spoke) several times and asking if they know who he is. His overconfidence would ultimately be his downfall as he would meet his end at the hands of one of Spoke's traps. ApexPoint fashioned himself as "The Ruler of the Amplified" and believed that everything about him was amplified.

 History 

 Trivia 

 ApexPoint's Minecraft username was changed to Revenant44 in Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing. Though only the name appears, the skin was changed with it too.

ApexPoint fashioned himself as "The Ruler of the Amplified" and believed that everything about him was amplified.

title: Arachn1d
content:
arachn1d_ is a minor antagonist in Unstable Universe Season 2 and the secondary antagonist in Kingdoms. He was a candidate for king of Unstable SMP and served as a major antagonist of I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge.  In the Kingdoms, he is the secondary antagonist making his own faction and calling himself the rightful king. 

History

In the video mentioned above, he first stole Fymada's book before waiting for Boosfer to come so he could steal his books too. He created a giant trap using TNT to kill ParrotX2, Horace_Altman and Fymada. It fails because Fymada is able to sneak in potions of Turtle Master, so they survive. He gives them the books. He tries to interfere when Purpled traps Horace, but he is forced to leave. 

At the start of I Explored The World's Largest Minecraft Server, a group of three players working for arachn1d who dubbed him the "true king of Unstable" told Wemmbu to come to the caves, where arachn1d would supposedly be waiting for him. Wemmbu killed these players with an Orbital Strike.

Arachn1d is also shown in Flamefrags' new episode, where he told Flame to "always look behind his shoulder." He gives his men actually decent gear and is angry when FlameFrags kills them. 

Trivia 

He is shown to play clash royale

title: Arcn
content:
Arcn is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe.

 History 
Mapicc, Fantst, Only_A_Squid, Sharooh, and Arcn, all teamed with SpokeIsHere find a looted trial chamber. Mapicc finds Wemmbu and PrinceZam, and a fight breaks out. Wemmbu and PrinceZam make it to the surface, and Wemmbu starts killing the team with a mace. They all escape using stasis chambers.

Arcn is seen as a miner in Capital City.

Arcn joins the Skyblock Civilization. The Skyblock Civilization is eventually taken over by The Invisible Mafia.

Arcn is seen as a part of the Ice Mountain Civilization.

Arcn is seen as a part of the Egg Civilization, which he ends up betraying, due to Jaden paying him more than Wemmbu.

title: Arrow Cannon
content:
thumb|Regular Arrow Cannon using TNTthumb|Arrow Cannon using TNT minecartsthumb|Arrow Cannon using wind charges
An Arrow Cannon is a powerful ranged weapon that fires in a fixed trajectory. It is also called railgun. It works by using TNT to launch arrows at an extremely high velocity, capable of one-shot killing even fully geared netherite players with double-handed totems due to the arrows registering as several rapid hits instead of one.

A variant of the arrow cannon is the Orbital Arrow Cannon, which kills player at your crossheir direction instead of a fixed direction). It can either be ground-to-air or air-to-ground.

 History 
The Director used an arrow cannon to kill Nufuli. The same arrow cannon was used by WyLL_ to pop Wemmbu's totem. After WyLL left, Wemmbu found the cannon, packed it into a shulker box and assembled it in Mafia City which was then occupied by WyLL. He used the arrow cannon to fight against WyLL, killing his allies and finally defeated him.

Wemmbu popped a totem when exploring the Mysterious Tomb and shot by an arrow cannon.

Spoke and Jumper used arrow cannons to kill Law players when the base was revealed with underground TNT railguns (what's the proper name?) built by Leow0ok. They proceeded to use one arrow cannon to kill _1_88_____x, the first leader of Null Hunters to chase them.

Invis Guy popped Wemmbu's totem with an arrow cannon at the beginning after teleporting away from entrance to Wemmbu's house to lure him out. After he stasised away, Wemmbu found the cannon and destroyed it with a nuke shot.

Parrot asked ReinaDrop to build a ground-to-air orbital arrow cannon to counter Cindercrest's attack from the blimp, killing a lot of their soldiers, which marked the debut of orbital arrow cannons on Unstable SMP. He later asked ReinaDrop to do the same at highwater town, and asked 4CVIT to use materials torn from Capitol City to build an air-to-ground one, in order to achieve full coverage, which were destroyed by FlameFrags and ShoeBilly_ respectively during the battle.

title: Ashswagg
content:
Ashswagg, or simply Ash, was one of the two main antagonists (alongside ClownPierce) of Unstable Universe Season 1. He was the leader of The Invisible Mafia. He is a supporting character in Season 2. 

Personality
Ashswag is known to be power-hungry, controlling, egotistical, manipulative, and evil, seeking to bring down civilizations with the end goal of taking over the server with his Mafia. He thrives on entertainment and mostly uses this as a point of contingent to mock other's attempts to take him down. 

He is usually not seen wearing armor, because as the leader of the largest group of players, one that almost encompasses the entire server, he feels that he doesn’t need armor. When Ash does get damaged, he uses some kind of stasis mechanic to teleport him away. 

He claims to have a master stasis, so that if he dies, everybody in the Mafia dies with him, including the innocent players that were indoctrinated in. 

He tends to feign importance and uses more 'abstract' ideas, using indirect and flowery language, biblical motifs/metaphors, and basing a lot of his actions around philosophical ideas and metaphors. 

Ash very commonly uses and shows manipulation tactics: going into detail on using fear as a method of control in I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City, or pretending to be poor and hopeless around Spoke to earn his trust and gain access to an important book, until ultimately betraying Spoke's mission and threatening to kill Mapicc.

Despite this, he has shown a more unserious side, as shown in his interactions with Squiddo along with his dramatic lamenting while talking to lesser ranked Mafia members. His interactions with Fish Bucket and his friends also show that he's rather lonely and insecure.  

He also tends to seem to somewhat fear remorse, and he shields himself from the his and other's emotions. This is exhibited when Parrot confronts Ash about killing Wifies in Unstable SMP: Doomsday, Ash says 'He was not the one to kill Wifies, The Director was' when he did the action, thinking of the question as 'who wanted to kill Wifies?' rather than 'who did the action of killing Wifies?'

When he was finally defeated, he revealed to Spoke and his friends that he is just a regular player who is seeking power but went to far, even mentioning that every action they do, i.e. build a house or a Redstone contraption, is to seek for power. 

He is on many bounty lists- not many want him alive, as SpokeIsHere said.  

 History 

 Season 1 
Spoke and Mapicc plan to rig every farm on the server to not work to get rid of lag. They go to a raid farm, and see three invisible players. They almost die to the invisible players, but ashswagg comes and tells the invisible players to leave, and they oblige. Ashswagg says he doesn’t know the players.

Spoke and Mapicc go to TheRealSquiddo’s house to see if there are any duped items there. Under the floor, they find a bunch of books with coordinates. Ashswagg finds Spoke and Mapicc and says that he wants to team with them.

Jepexx shows Spoke and Mapicc his panda farm, but then a group of invisible players come and try to kill Jepexx. Spoke and Mapicc yell out for ashswagg to stop, and all the invisible players run away. Ashswagg says that he was just trying to help them.

Spoke and Mapicc find that ashswagg completely obliterated the coordinates that they give to him for farms to rig to not produce items.

They go to the next farm and find two invisible players destroying it with TNT. He pops one of their totems and it reveals they are USmellLikeUpdog. Ashswagg teleports USmellLikeUpdog into the void, banning him because he stated ashswagg was the leader. Mapicc leaves because he doesn’t trust ashswagg. Spoke meets ashswagg at the next farm.

Spoke gives the rest of the coordinates to the farms to ashswagg. Ashswagg uses a fishing rod to teleport away.

Spoke and Mapicc, which is a flower farm. They see Roshambogames and PlanetLord there. Ashswagg destroys the entire farm with TNT. Mapicc says he saw invisible people leaving, implying this was ashswagg. They go to the other farms and see ashswagg destroyed all of them. 

Spoke and Mapicc go to the last farm, which is an EOL farm. They made it there before ashswagg destroyed it. Mapicc leaves so Spoke can talk to ashswagg. Ashswagg tells him that, since Spoke was the one at every farm, everyone will think he destroyed them. Ashswagg tries to convince Spoke to give him exploits he knows about, but he says no Spoke and Mapicc are able to escape.

Mapicc is captured by the Mafia, a team that ashswagg is the leader of. Spoke is saved by MinuteTech

Spoke and Mapicc go over to an outpost and find a lot of Mafia members. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after being handed a book.

PlanetLord and Spoke discover that JamatoP’s base is destroyed. Spoke and PlanetLord try to dupe in the base, but realize that it doesn’t work anymore. Ashswagg comes in and reveals that all the glitches and exploits were patched, and that Jamato told him so. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech was working for him, and orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. Spoke and PlanetLord escape.

Spoke infiltrates the Mafia and breaks out Mapicc. 

While Spoke and his team are infiltrating the Mafia, Spoke is tasked to kill ParrotX2 but fails. Ashswagg kills one of the members who was helping them. They run away.

Spoke and his team are now tasked to get diamonds. Ashswagg promotes them to gold tier.

Ashswagg promotes the team to iron after giving ashswagg nine elytra.

Spoke and his team are tasked with killing PlanetLord, but they don't kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the Mafia members there until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Spoke is tasked with killing iMajesticRose. He obliges and kills her with dripstone. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond tier Mafia player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. He fights a diamond tier player to try and become diamond tier. Spoke’s totem of undying is used, revealing to ashswagg that he’s Spoke. They try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he's MinuteTech.

Ashswagg takes the warrior members of Far Lands Civilization hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. After evacuating all of the members, Parrot goes over to ashswagg’s castle to talk to him. Parrot leaves using his fishing rod stasis chamber. Ashswagg destroys the farlands civilization.

The members of District 13 try to kill ashswagg, but he escapes. ClownPierce tries to kill them, but they are able to escape.

Parrot and Wifies try to kill ashswagg, but because his death automatically kills everyone in the Mafia, including their friends, they don’t kill him.

Parrot and Wifies build a house in a snowy biome. They see a sign that says "I found you." Ashswagg tells them to join the Mafia. Wifies joins the Mafia for Parrot.

Ashswagg meets Parrot at Parrot and Wifies house. Ashswagg kills Wifies in front of him by dropping him into the void.

Spoke ends the Mafia by destroying every stasis chamber.

Spoke finds ashswagg’s stasis chamber and activates it. He spares ashswagg.

Parrot finds ash to give him forgiveness for all he has done. Ash tells Parrot that he did not cause any of this, and that a secret player named the Director was pulling the strings the entire time. Parrot gets a little upset and says that he didn’t believe him, thinking that ash is making excuses. He leaves, still in forgiveness, sparing ash.

 Season 2 
While Spoke is spying on ashswagg, he sees ashswagg enter a secret base. Spoke decides to spy on him inside of the base. Inside of the secret base, he finds a second secret tunnel. Following the tunnel, he finds a new secret base. He sees TheRealSquiddo smelt something and a tunnel opens up. Spoke makes a secret base inside of the base.

Spoke hears ashswagg talking about having a dragon egg. Spoke accidentally sets an alarm, but TheRealSquiddo says it was probably just a fish. Spoke eventually finds a stash of items. Spoke eventually finds a new room with a villager, which is very rare on the server. Spoke accidentally kills the villager. Reddoons pays ashswagg hundreds of mending books for the villager, only to discover that the villager is gone. Spoke raids the entire base.

Spoke finds the void room, containing a large amount of unrenewable items. Ashswagg catches him. Ashswagg tells Spoke that he traded the dragon egg to Reddoons.

 Boundaries 

 Nothing that goes against the boundaries of any of his friends/anyone being portrayed
 Nothing that goes against the terms of service of the platform it’s being posted on
 If he sees something he doesn't like, he will call it out
 Don't use AI for any fanart, writing, or creative work or submit it to any AI models

Trivia

Mentioned in a Lifesteal stream, Ash was originally meant to fill ManePear's role.

Ashswagg reveals that [[MinuteTech]] was working for him, and orders him to kill [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and [[PlanetLord]]. [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and [[PlanetLord]] escape.

[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] infiltrates the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] and breaks out [[Mapicc]]. 

While [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and his team are infiltrating the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]], [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] is tasked to kill [[ParrotX2]] but fails. Ashswagg kills one of the members who was helping them. They run away.

[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and his team are now tasked to get diamonds. Ashswagg promotes them to gold tier.

Ashswagg promotes the team to iron after giving ashswagg nine elytra.

Spoke and his team are tasked with killing [[PlanetLord]], but they don't kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the Mafia members there until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Spoke is tasked with killing [[IMajesticRose|iMajesticRose]]. He obliges and kills her with dripstone. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond tier Mafia player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. He fights a diamond tier player to try and become diamond tier. Spoke’s totem of undying is used, revealing to ashswagg that he’s Spoke. They try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he's MinuteTech.

Ashswagg takes the warrior members of [[Far Lands|Far Lands Civilization]] hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. After evacuating all of the members, Parrot goes over to ashswagg’s castle to talk to him. Parrot leaves using his fishing rod stasis chamber. Ashswagg destroys the farlands civilization.

The members of [[District 13]] try to kill ashswagg, but he escapes. [[ClownPierce]] tries to kill them, but they are able to escape.

Parrot and [[Wifies]] try to kill ashswagg, but because his death automatically kills everyone in the Mafia, including their friends, they don’t kill him.

Parrot and Wifies build a house in a snowy biome. They see a sign that says "I found you." Ashswagg tells them to join the Mafia. Wifies joins the Mafia for Parrot.

Ashswagg meets Parrot at Parrot and Wifies house. Ashswagg kills Wifies in front of him by dropping him into the void.

Spoke ends the Mafia by destroying every stasis chamber.

Spoke finds ashswagg’s stasis chamber and activates it. He spares ashswagg.

Parrot finds ash to give him forgiveness for all he has done. Ash tells Parrot that he did not cause any of this, and that a secret player named the Director was pulling the strings the entire time. Parrot gets a little upset and says that he didn’t believe him, thinking that ash is making excuses. He leaves, still in forgiveness, sparing ash.

=== Season 2 ===
While Spoke is spying on ashswagg, he sees ashswagg enter a [[Point Nemo|secret base]]. Spoke decides to spy on him inside of the base. Inside of the secret base, he finds a second secret tunnel. Following the tunnel, he finds a new secret base. He sees TheRealSquiddo smelt something and a tunnel opens up. Spoke makes a secret base inside of the base.

Spoke hears ashswagg talking about having a dragon egg. Spoke accidentally sets an alarm, but [[TheRealSquiddo]] says it was probably just a fish. Spoke eventually finds a stash of items. Spoke eventually finds a new room with a villager, which is very rare on the server. Spoke accidentally kills the villager. [[Reddoons]] pays ashswagg hundreds of mending books for the villager, only to discover that the villager is gone. Spoke raids the entire base.

[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] finds the void room, containing a large amount of unrenewable items. Ashswagg catches him. Ashswagg tells [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] that he traded the dragon egg to [[Reddoons]].

== Boundaries ==

* Nothing that goes against the boundaries of any of his friends/anyone being portrayed
* Nothing that goes against the terms of service of the platform it’s being posted on
* If he sees something he doesn't like, he will call it out
* Don't use AI for any fanart, writing, or creative work or submit it to any AI models

title: BAT Headquarters
content:
The BAT Headquarters was a base owned by Bounty Assassin Team. The base was eventually destroyed by TruOriginal. 

 Features 
 Player-launching system 
This system helped players exit the base, launching them a thousand blocks in the sky, so they could use elytra more effectively.

 Control room and alarm signal 
The operator in the control room could send alarm signals to all rooms or to a specific room.

 Emergency button 
Players could send an emergency signal through a button in their rooms.

 Communication system 
Each room was equipped with a dispenser which could send written books to the other members of BAT. The sender would input the room's number as the book's name.

 Privacy system 
This system is a special lava-curtain between the two layers of the window.

 Storage room 
Although mostly blown up this room still contains massive amounts of wealth and treasure

title: Battles of Unstable
content:
FYI none of this is in chronological order yet. You have been warned.

 Battles of Capital City 
Invisible Knight arc, BAT/Law arc

 Battle of Capital City 2.0 
The battle on Capital City 2.0 was a huge war of riches and strength. The battle was first thought up by Boosfer, a player who wanted all of Capital City to himself. Capital City's army heard about this and planned to put a stop to this by arranging a plan and an army. This army included Wemmbu, who at the time was an anonymous player.

 The Battle of Capital City 3.0 
The battle of Capital City for the third time is Spoke vs Deputy_Ace, Spoke outgears and beats Deputy_Ace army, he almost nuked Capital City 2.0 until Parrot stopped him

 Battle of Stasis Chambers: Fear vs Hope 
Spoke and Mapicc take down the mafia

center|thumb|399x399px|Video of the End-Of-Battle Speech

 Summary 
left|thumb|198x198px|Picture of the Mafia's Chambers before Destruction
The Battle Of Stasis is one of the most important battles of the servers history - the battle that ended The Invisible Mafia. Directed by ParrotX2 in the famous District 13 base, the "battle" was performed by mainly two players, them being SpokeIsHere and Mapicc.

 Planning 
The idea of the battle was that the two players would go to the mafia's "stasis chamber headquarters", which was used to keep the mafia's members forever loyal, and destroy them, ending Ashswagg's power arc. It took many weeks of planing to get the coordinates for the HQ, but in the end, with spoke's help, they managed to pull it off by using a book that was found in Quackenstein123's base. It had hints to the HQ's location which was later deciphered in another act. After destroying all the chambers, the mafia's members were free from the curse, and they could become visible again. This day is the reason for the BMC/AMC Timeline, as the Battle of Stasis is the mid marking point for the server's time according to this fandom's users.

WifiesMapicc

 Battle of the Zam Empire 
left|thumb|582x582px

 Summary 
The Zam Empire was, at the time, the biggest civilisation of all time, rivaling even The Invisible Mafia in power and controll of the server. The empire was based on a social-monarchy type system. PrinceZam was the emperor of this complex. He owned most (if not all) of the land and power. In the mist of all of this, a new conflict started

 The Conflict 
It all started when Princezam made enemies with Wemmbu.  Zam batrayed him and broke their alinace as Wemmbu was "so unbelievably weak" for the civilations development. Wemmbu, and his small team were enraged by this, but Princezam took no fear. He did not belive a player he found "useless" could do anything against his team of some of the best players on the, including the imortal deamon himself, FlameFrags. Little did Zam know, Wemmbu had constructed a team of players (Info at bottom) and a plan. ParrotX2 and Wifies, who were now involved, and they built the wepon that would turn the tide at any battle.  An Orbital Strike Cannon. Basicly, it's a redstone machine that can bow up almost anything in a wide range, and you can controll it to go anywhere you want, even in a empire.

 The Battle and Aftermath 
left|thumb|324x324px|Wemmbu (In Elytra) boming the empire. 
thumb|536x536px|The Aftermath, the empire, once evolving, now blown up
When the time was right, Wemmbu initiated the plan, bombing the whole complex and ruining the city. Princezam was in shock, and so were his guards as not even they were able to stop him. 

After the place got "nuked" as Wemmbu says, Princezam and Wemmbu have a duel, only for a draw in the end. The aftermath was devastating, but sooner than Wemmbu thought, eveyone moved on to start something else, like Flamefrags becoming a high-teir Mafia Player.

 The Six Day War 
Battle of the Northern Council

The Six Day War was a war that was fought between The Law and District 13 led by SpokeIsHere and ParrotX2. District 13's members consisted of many players that were affected by LettuceK in a way, and so their goal was to gain back their freedom from The Law.  

The battle opened with Parrot trying to talk to Lettuce to lead to a peaceful resolution of the conflict. Lettuce flanked by over 500 players and his 2 remaining commanders, TheG0dOfWar and SargeLAW, and with Purpled and Leow0ok taking place of the other two. Lettuce blew his goat horn signaling the first move of the war. Wemmbu dropping three nukes on the army of lawmen killing a good portion of them.  As District 13 charged into battle, they decimated the first wave with ease. After the wipeout of the diamond armored players, they went up and confronted Lettuce and his commanders. Lettuce tells them he isn't stupid and to look back, hundreds of invisible players come out of hiding and equip their netherite armor.

This signals the begining of the real fight. Almost instantly the army wipes out almost all of Parrots army leaving only a few soldiers left.

 The Civil War 
Parrot and co vs Cindercrest

The Unstable SMP's Civil War is an upcoming battle between King ParrotX2, The LAW, Merchant City Vanguards, The Bandits, Capitol City Guard Force, and the Royal Army VS Cindercrest, along with FlameFrags, saparata, ShoeBilly, and SargeLAW.
This war was initiated by Cindercrest as an act to attempt genocide against every new player in Unstable SMP.

 The Siege Of The End Civilization 
After escaping from Proton, Parrot and Wifies plan to make a safe civilisation hundreds of thousands of blocks out in the end. On the way there, they encounter an invis player. Parrot pops their totem, clearing the invis and revealing he's DeanTheBean9. Together, they hire professional builder Horace_Altman to construct the empire and the chunk bans around it.

This happens right in the middle of the Mafia arc, spearheaded by Ashwagg, who wishes to reign supreme over Unstable. However, the chunk bans around the empire prevent the Mafia from entering - so they send a fighter TNT jet. Following this, Horace encircles the civilisation in water.

Then, the Mafia gets a mole in who turns off the chunk bans. Following this, Parrot is forced to flee.

[[File:BattlofZamsupercut.png|left|thumb|582x582px]] === Summary === The [[Zam Empire]] was, at the time, the biggest civilisation of all time, rivaling even [[The Invisible Mafia]] in power and controll of the server. The empire was based on a social-monarchy type system. [[PrinceZam]] was the emperor of this complex. He owned most (if not all) of the land and power. In the mist of all of this, a new conflict started === The Conflict === It all started when Princezam made enemies with [[Wemmbu]]. Zam batrayed him and broke their alinace as Wemmbu was "so unbelievably weak" for the civilations development. Wemmbu, and his small team were enraged by this, but Princezam took no fear. He did not belive a player he found "useless" could do anything against his team of some of the best players on the, including the imortal deamon himself, [[FlameFrags]]. Little did Zam know, Wemmbu had constructed a team of players (Info at bottom) and a plan. [[ParrotX2]] and [[Wifies]], who were now involved, and they built the wepon that would turn the tide at any battle. An [[Orbital Strike Cannon]]. Basicly, it's a redstone machine that can bow up almost anything in a wide range, and you can controll it to go anywhere you want, even in a empire. === The Battle and Aftermath === [[File:ZamBattlepic.png|left|thumb|324x324px|Wemmbu (In [[Elytra]]) boming the empire. ]] [[File:Zam empire destroyed.png|thumb|536x536px|The Aftermath, the empire, once evolving, now blown up]] When the time was right, Wemmbu initiated the plan, bombing the whole complex and ruining the city. Princezam was in shock, and so were his guards as not even they were able to stop him. After the place got "nuked" as Wemmbu says, Princezam and Wemmbu have a duel, only for a draw in the end. The aftermath was devastating, but sooner than Wemmbu thought, eveyone moved on to start something else, like Flamefrags becoming a high-teir Mafia Player. {| class="fandom-table" |+'''Players in the Battle''' !'''Organiser(s)''' !'''Contributors''' !'''Extras''' !'''''Opponents''''' |- |[[Wemmbu]] |[[Wemmbu]] [[Eggchan]] [[ParrotX2]] [[Wifies]] |[[ItsLilKae,]] [[LuckyMixx]], [[Block_Facts]] |[[Zam Empire]] |}
== The Six Day War == Battle of the Northern Council
The Six Day War was a war that was fought between [[The LAW|The Law]] and [[District 13]] led by [[SpokeIsHere]] and [[ParrotX2]]. District 13's members consisted of many players that were affected by [[LettuceK]] in a way, and so their goal was to gain back their freedom from The Law. The battle opened with Parrot trying to talk to Lettuce to lead to a peaceful resolution of the conflict. Lettuce flanked by over 500 players and his 2 remaining commanders, [[TheGOdOfWar|TheG0dOfWar]] and [[SargeLAW]], and with [[Purpled]] and [[Leow0ok]] taking place of the other two. Lettuce blew his goat horn signaling the first move of the war. Wemmbu dropping three [[Orbital Strike Cannon|nukes]] on the army of lawmen killing a good portion of them. As District 13 charged into battle, they decimated the first wave with ease. After the wipeout of the diamond armored players, they went up and confronted Lettuce and his commanders. Lettuce tells them he isn't stupid and to look back, hundreds of invisible players come out of hiding and equip their netherite armor. This signals the begining of the real fight. Almost instantly the army wipes out almost all of Parrots army leaving only a few soldiers left.
== The Civil War == Parrot and co vs Cindercrest
The Unstable SMP's Civil War is an upcoming battle between King ParrotX2, The LAW, Merchant City Vanguards, The Bandits, Capitol City Guard Force, and the Royal Army VS Cindercrest, along with FlameFrags, saparata, ShoeBilly, and SargeLAW. This war was initiated by Cindercrest as an act to attempt genocide against every new player in Unstable SMP.
== The Siege Of The End Civilization ==
After escaping from [[Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison|Proton]], Parrot and Wifies plan to make a safe civilisation hundreds of thousands of blocks out in the end. On the way there, they encounter an invis player. Parrot pops their totem, clearing the invis and revealing he's [[Deanthebean9|DeanTheBean9]]. Together, they hire professional builder [[Horace_Altman]] to construct the empire and the chunk bans around it. This happens right in the middle of the Mafia arc, spearheaded by Ashwagg, who wishes to reign supreme over Unstable. However, the chunk bans around the empire prevent the Mafia from entering - so they send a fighter TNT jet. Following this, Horace encircles the civilisation in water. Then, the Mafia gets a mole in who turns off the chunk bans. Following this, Parrot is forced to flee. == Great Sea War ==

title: Black Market
content:
About 

The black market is a place hidden from Capital City (season 2). It is an illegal trading hall where there are no taxes. When The Law took over Capital City, it was still used as a trading hall to sneak in banned items.

 History 
ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird go into the vaults to make illegal business deals with someone to save their friend from Spawn. 

Wemmbu and FlameFrags rob the place for XP

Theo and Flame come back to buy TNT minecarts for their supply. The criminals in the black market are hostile towards them. Following that G0d0fWar pardons all the criminals saying that LettuceK does not care about taxes.  

The Black Market is now probably open to all players as it was one of G0d0fWar's demands. It no longer is a "Black Market" in the real sense but it is the only trading settlement that is not guarded by The Law. It is also possible that it has been since disbanded with all players returning to Captial city.

title: Boosfer
content:
Boosfer is a major antagonist featured in Unstable Universe. He is the leader of the Treasure Hunters, and is supported by Kier and Dev.

 Personality 
Boosfer is mildly egotistical, but also slightly immature, often making a fool of himself in serious situations. He has no issue throwing around money, as he can easily regain it.  

He attempts to seize power of The End Civilization through a rigged election, but ironically, he loses regardless of his efforts. He mistreats Kier and Dev and constantly bullies them, despite their loyalty. Boosfer is an intentionally unserious character, and although he is a relatively small character, he is very memorable.

 History 
Boosfer sends Kier and Dev to steal certain items from ParrotX2 and Wemmbu despite them telling Boosfer to stop.

Boosfer then hires Wemmbu to destroy "the valley", which is actually rekrap2's base, which Parrot and Wifies are defending. Wemmbu agrees to team with Parrot and Wifies to steal from Boosfer. They destroy Boosfer's base and steal thousands of netherite and diamond blocks.

Boosfer runs for president against Parrot in The End Civilization. Boosfer is unable to win the election as even Kier and Dev vote against him. Boosfer tries to leave and accidentally chunk bans himself.

Boosfer recruits a team of bandits to scam people across the server. The scam consists of a rail with three chest minecarts, one of which contains rare items (one enchanted golden apple, one netherite ingot and one nether star), players would then have to guess which minecart had the items in it. The scam part was that, underneath one of the rails the chest minecarts were on, a minecart with a hopper was secretly placed, which would then collect the items from the chest minecart as it passed over it. As the player guessed which minecart they thought the items were in, one of Boosfer's goons would secretly place the items in a different minecart from the player's chosen cart. ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird later attempt the game, but soon realize it's a scam, and subsequently ruin their scamming operation by stealing their items. Boosfer is upset by this, and chases after Parrot and Theo, repeatedly catching up to them and fighting them even though they get away each time. 

Later, Boosfer tries to get clues for Verdaria. He repeatedly interrupts ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird's scavenger hunt, demanding they hand over each clue they obtain as well as demanding they solve it for him in order to find the city. When the location of the third clue is found, the group realizes that ClownPierce had already found the location, and by association, Verdaria. Boosfer gives up thinking that it lead to nothing, and leaves.

Boosfer and a small group of his bandits approach Capital City and kill a random player outside the walls where Wemmbu is guarding. Wemmbu, while invisible, attacks Boosfer and his team, thus breaking the treaty between Capital City and Boosfer's bandits. As a response, Boosfer wages war on Capital City, leading a large army of bandits to the city. However, he loses, and a majority of his army is killed, prompting Boosfer and what remains of his bandits to retreat. Wemmbu finds Boosfer and a few of his bandits at Branzy's base, and drinks milk in front of them to get rid of his invisibility, revealing his identity to them before killing almost all of them. However, Boosfer and one of his teammates, Boomie, manage to escape. 

Boosfer then manipulates FlameFrags, promising to reveal Wemmbu's whereabouts for a price. Boosfer tasks Flame with a few missions, like getting armor and building an escape tunnel, which is secretly a trap, claiming that he will reveal what he knows about Wemmbu in exchange. Flame eventually finds out that he is being manipulated, and indirectly teams with Wemmbu to try to kill Boosfer, but Boosfer manages to escape (with Wemmbu) into the escape tunnel he had Flame build.

Boosfer then manages to knock Wemmbu into a void trap he set in the nether, but instead was punched into his own trap by Wemmbu, however he was able to pull Wemmbu in as well by pulling him down with a fishing rod. Just when they are about to die, they fall in a weird dimension under the nether void (The Underworld). They get separated, before reuniting when Wemmbu saves him from getting captured by the inhabitants of the weird dimension. However, they are later captured again, and imprisoned. After some convincing, Wemmbu manages to get Boosfer’s mace and they manage to escape the weird dimension. Wemmbu then swears that he won't hunt Boosfer in exchange for him not leaking Wemmbu’s identity.

Boosfer is later seen on the scoreboard for the Kings Election with 383 votes. He later explains he got his votes by getting people to try write his name with their eyes closed in a book and signing it.

Boosfer does not say anything in his debate against JumperWho. 

Boosfer passes the second round of eliminations with 624 votes. 

Boosfer passes the third round of eliminations with 984 votes, even after losing a large amount of votes in the form of books, with most of them being stolen by Arachn1d_. 

Boosfer does not say anything in the debate of the semi-final. 

LettuceK persuades Boosfer and Purpled into endorsing him. Unlike Purpled, however, Boosfer is not seen at the Battle of The Northern Council. 

 Boundaries 

 Shipping is okay
 No drawing him making out with someone
 No NSFW

 Trivia 
Boosfer accidentally chunk bans himself while storming away from the election in The End Civilization.
Boosfer is one of the only players on Unstable SMP to still possess a mace (likely still unenchanted).

[[Boosfer]] is a major antagonist featured in ''[[Unstable Universe]]''. He is the leader of the [[Treasure Hunters]], and is supported by [[Kierrrr|Kier]] and [[Its_Dev_|Dev]].

== Personality ==
Boosfer is mildly egotistical, but also slightly immature, often making a fool of himself in serious situations. He has no issue throwing around money, as he can easily regain it.  

He attempts to seize power of The End Civilization through a rigged election, but ironically, he loses regardless of his efforts. He mistreats Kier and Dev and constantly bullies them, despite their loyalty. Boosfer is an intentionally unserious character, and although he is a relatively small character, he is very memorable.

== History ==
Boosfer sends Kier and Dev to steal certain items from [[ParrotX2]] and [[Wemmbu]] despite them telling Boosfer to stop.

Boosfer then hires Wemmbu to destroy "the valley", which is actually [[rekrap2]]'s base, which Parrot and Wifies are defending. Wemmbu agrees to team with Parrot and Wifies to steal from Boosfer. They destroy Boosfer's base and steal thousands of netherite and diamond blocks.

Boosfer runs for president against Parrot in [[The End Civilization]]. Boosfer is unable to win the election as even Kier and Dev vote against him. Boosfer tries to leave and accidentally chunk bans himself.

Boosfer recruits a team of bandits to scam people across the server. The scam consists of a rail with three chest minecarts, one of which contains rare items (one enchanted golden apple, one netherite ingot and one nether star), players would then have to guess which minecart had the items in it. The scam part was that, underneath one of the rails the chest minecarts were on, a minecart with a hopper was secretly placed, which would then collect the items from the chest minecart as it passed over it. As the player guessed which minecart they thought the items were in, one of Boosfer's goons would secretly place the items in a different minecart from the player's chosen cart. ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird later attempt the game, but soon realize it's a scam, and subsequently ruin their scamming operation by stealing their items. Boosfer is upset by this, and chases after Parrot and Theo, repeatedly catching up to them and fighting them even though they get away each time. 

Later, Boosfer tries to get clues for [[Verdaria]]. He repeatedly interrupts [[ParrotX2]] and [[TheobaldTheBird]]'s scavenger hunt, demanding they hand over each clue they obtain as well as demanding they solve it for him in order to find the city. When the location of the third clue is found, the group realizes that ClownPierce had already found the location, and by association, Verdaria. Boosfer gives up thinking that it lead to nothing, and leaves.

Boosfer and a small group of his bandits approach Capital City and kill a random player outside the walls where Wemmbu is guarding. Wemmbu, while invisible, attacks Boosfer and his team, thus breaking the treaty between [[Capital City 2.0|Capital City]] and Boosfer's bandits. As a response, Boosfer wages war on Capital City, leading a large army of bandits to the city. However, he loses, and a majority of his army is killed, prompting Boosfer and what remains of his bandits to retreat. Wemmbu finds Boosfer and a few of his bandits at [[BranzyCraft|Branzy]]'s base, and drinks milk in front of them to get rid of his invisibility, revealing his identity to them before killing almost all of them. However, Boosfer and one of his teammates, [[Boomie]], manage to escape. 

Boosfer then manipulates [[FlameFrags]], promising to reveal Wemmbu's whereabouts for a price. Boosfer tasks Flame with a few missions, like getting armor and building an escape tunnel, which is secretly a trap, claiming that he will reveal what he knows about Wemmbu in exchange. Flame eventually finds out that he is being manipulated, and indirectly teams with Wemmbu to try to kill Boosfer, but Boosfer manages to escape (with Wemmbu) into the escape tunnel he had Flame build.

Boosfer then manages to knock Wemmbu into a void trap he set in the nether, but instead was punched into his own trap by Wemmbu, however he was able to pull Wemmbu in as well by pulling him down with a fishing rod. Just when they are about to die, they fall in a weird dimension under the nether void ([[The Underworld]]). They get separated, before reuniting when Wemmbu saves him from getting captured by the inhabitants of the weird dimension. However, they are later captured again, and imprisoned. After some convincing, Wemmbu manages to get Boosfer’s mace and they manage to escape the weird dimension. Wemmbu then swears that he won't hunt Boosfer in exchange for him not leaking Wemmbu’s identity.

Boosfer is later seen on the scoreboard for the Kings Election with 383 votes. He later explains he got his votes by getting people to try write his name with their eyes closed in a book and signing it.

Boosfer does not say anything in his debate against [[JumperWho]]. 

Boosfer passes the second round of eliminations with 624 votes. 

Boosfer passes the third round of eliminations with 984 votes, even after losing a large amount of votes in the form of books, with most of them being stolen by [[Arachn1d_]]. 

Boosfer does not say anything in the debate of the semi-final. 

LettuceK persuades Boosfer and [[Purpled]] into endorsing him. Unlike Purpled, however, Boosfer is not seen at the Battle of The Northern Council. 

== Boundaries ==

* Shipping is okay
* No drawing him making out with someone
* No NSFW

== Trivia ==
*Boosfer accidentally chunk bans himself while storming away from the election in The End Civilization.
*Boosfer is one of the only players on Unstable SMP to still possess a mace (likely still unenchanted).
