title: Bounty Assassin Team
content:
The Bounty Assassin Team, commonly known as BAT, was a team of players featured in Unstable Universe Season 2.

 History 
ItzRealMe tries to assassinate ParrotX2. A team of people save him from ItzRealMe. They escape to the nether. They invite Parrot to Bounty Assassin Team. In the meeting room there was a blackboard with a list of players captioned The Director List, indicating they have already started to investigate the Director, likely overhearing Ashswagg's talk in the Far Lands. Parrot and Leow0ok see ItzRealMe inside of Parrot’s house. They start constructing a prison around ItzRealMe.

Parrot is given his own room in the BAT Headquarters. BAT tries to kill ItzRealMe, but are forced to run away as he has a mace. ItzRealMe later finds Parrot in the BAT Headquarters. BAT saves Parrot. ItzRealMe tells Parrot that The Director is the one who hired him to assassinate him. 

BAT tries to kill FlameFrags but fail and run away. 

MrCube6 tries to assassinate Parrot by trapping him under the void. Derapchu finds Parrot and saves him. Parrot sees an invisible player sitting in one of the chairs.

Derapchu is trapped by MrCube6 on a pressure plate. Parrot and the team have to figure out which redstone lines to activate to save him and the entire base from exploding within a certain amount of time. MrCube6 also says that he sent a TNT bomber plane towards their base. They are able to save Derapchu.

Parrot sets up a trap and catches MrCube6. They trap him in a prison. MrCube6 manages to escape. MrCube6 steals all of the gear from the headquarters. He gives these items to 4CVIT. Parrot and Derapchu take the shulker boxes of items back. A team of bandits try to steal from Parrot and Derapchu, but fail.

BAT finds MrCube6 and detains him. They interrogate MrCube6. They give MrCube6 a dandelion. MrCube6 escapes with a stasis chamber, but not before he gives Parrot a book. The book states something about a dandelion, implying that The Director somehow knew that MrCube6 got a dandelion.

Parrot finds a chest in his room with a sign saying to run. Inside the chest is two stacks of ender pearls and an invisibility potion. The BAT headquarters go into lockdown mode, so Parrot uses an invisibility potion and hides. The BAT tries to find Parrot to presumably kill him. Parrot flies away to make his own base.

BAT finds Parrot and claim that he’s The Director. Parrot runs to the nether. They find Parrot on the nether roof. Parrot manages to escape.

JumperWho finds Parrot in an abandoned city. JumperWho tells him that she was the one who put the chest and the sign in his room. Parrot becomes a JumperWho spy to figure out how he had been framed for being The Director.

JumperWho gives Parrot the pieces of evidence that BAT thought showed he was The Director. Leow0ok does a "mole check" to see if any of JumperWho’s spies were moles by having them hold a green shield. Parrot takes a green banner off of the wall and combines it with his shield. Parrot is the only spy who holds a green shield, showing that he is a mole. Parrot manages to escape.

Parrot finds a book asking Parrot to meet up with him. Parrot spies on BAT’s meeting. JumperWho betrays him. Parrot manages to escape during the chaos. JumperWho tells Parrot that he was actually just pretending to betray Parrot because BAT didn’t trust her. Parrot discovers that someone was spying on them. JumperWho uses a goat horn to call back her spy. They kill the spy.

BAT watches Parrot and The Director have a conversation, which convinces BAT that Parrot is not The Director. The Director teleports away. Leow0ok discovers that JumperWho killed a spy, and kick her off the team.

A player named TruOriginal tries to kill Nufuli, Parrot, and Leow0ok using hacks. They are eventually able to escape. The BAT headquarters is destroyed by TruOriginal who uses a hack to use other people's usernames and skins. TruOriginal tries to kill them. Leow0ok stays behind so BAT can escape. Leow0ok eventually escapes and finds BAT.

TruOriginal tries to kill them but eventually runs away. BAT make a new base that Parrot and Nufuli guard. TruOriginal tries to kill them again. He changes time to try and kill them. BAT lead TruOriginal into a trap to try and kill him, but he teleports Parrot into the trap, almost killing him. He is luckily able to escape. They pretend that they have a second trap and scare TruOriginal away.

TruOriginal finds Parrot and Nufuli. Unbeknownst to him, Parrot and Nufuli were above a secret underground base, where Derapchu and Leow0ok were AFK sleeping in real life. TruOriginal deletes all of Parrot's items. TruOriginal teleports Parrot thousands of blocks into the sky. Nufuli saves Parrot from dying.

TruOriginal kidnaps Derapchu and Leow0ok. He pretends to be Leow0ok using a hack and tries to kill Parrot and Nufuli. Using a trap, they are able to kill TruOriginal.

Nufuli leaves the team, and as he is leaving, the Director kills him. They see the Director and try to kill him. The Director uses a pearl cannon to escape. BAT use the pearl cannon to try and go after the Director. They find themselves in an obsidian room, where the Director tries to kill them using an army of zombies with netherite armor and weapons. They are able to escape.

BAT go over to a redstone shop to see if the Director is there. They eventually find a player wearing the same armor as the Director. They force him to drink milk, revealing he is MrCube6. The real Director comes over and saves MrCube6. The Director tries to kill BAT using TNT but fails.

JumperWho rejoins BAT after saving Parrot. She leads them to a secret base that she created. The Director gives BAT a message, telling Parrot to meet up with him in one week. SpokeIsHere finds the secret base BAT live in and secretly pranks them and steals from them, and pretends he's the Director. Spoke is eventually caught and is forced to escape.

BAT spies on the Director and Parrot having their conversation. JumperWho's spies spy on a list of suspects for people who could potentially be the Director. They see all of them online while the Director and Parrot have their conversation. Parrot sees the Director hold a chest plate with a red armor trim, causing him to believe the Director is Spoke, as Spoke wears that chest plate. Parrot convinces Leow0ok and Derapchu to pretend to be spies so that Parrot can threaten to kill the supposed spies unless JumperWho confesses. This plan fails as Leow0ok and Derapchu stop pretending to be spies after JumperWho doesn't confess.

While JumperWho and Derapchu are out of the base, Leow0ok tries to kill Parrot. He eventually decides to spare Parrot's life. Parrot tells Leow0ok to leave and he obliges.

JumperWho and Derapchu find Parrot at Wifies' base, and Parrot tells them about Leow0ok trying to kill him. The Director finds them, and so they try to kill them. The Director traps JumperWho and Derapchu in an obsidian room over the void.

Parrot and Leow0ok make a plan to save JumperWho and Derapchu using a happy ghast. Leow0ok saves them using a happy ghast while Parrot distracts the Director.

After Parrot leaves BAT. BAT is remade in The Amplified. Mapicc and SpokeIsHere join BAT. 

Spoke burns down a village by mistakes. He tries to cover up his tracks but his crimes are spotted by Leow0ok. Spoke then kills a lot of spies. Leow0ok demands for Spoke's execution but JumperWho is insistent on finding evidence first. Leo proves that Spoke tries to kill him and uses his spies as sodliers. He solidifies his alliance with LAW and LettuceK. 

JumperWho betrays Leow0ok and takes her spies and leaves. They fight Leow0ok in BAT vault. The result of the battle is Leow0ok, leader of BAT is ousted and joins LAW and member conflicts lead to the Spies rallying around JumperWho and leaving. 

Some spies are arrested by LAW for betraying Leow0ok and imprisoned. These Spies are later broken out by Spoke, Mapicc, Minutetech and JumperWho. 

BAT spies are present on the final battle against The LAW on both sides. A spy reveals the location of Leow0ok leading to his death. JumperWho continues with her spies and allies with Spoke

title: BranzyCraft
content:
BranzyCraft, also known as Branzy, is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. Branzy is a good friend of ClownPierce. 

History

Parrot considers killing BranzyCraft but changes his mind after talking with him.

title: Breaking Hardcore Minecraft to Get Revenge
content:
Breaking Hardcore Minecraft to Get Revenge is the 105th episode feature in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
On the Unstable SMP, Spoke has learned to break the laws and physics of Minecraft, he's had close encounters with death multiple times, and with these game-breaking exploits, he'd become unstoppable. The only person stopping him is his greatest enemy, Leow0ok. Spoke swore to put an end to Leo's time on the Unstable, and so his mission starts when Spoke, Mapicc, and PrinceZam find a village full of people. title: Breaking Into Minecraft's Most Illegal Vault
content:
Breaking Into Minecraft's Most Illegal Vault is the third episode featured in Unstable Universe and the first episode released by Wemmbu. 

Plot
The episode starts with Wemmbu stuck in a room filled with minecarts, which prevents him from doing anything. The vault he is in belongs to a player named SpokeIsHere and protects hundreds of thousands of exploited items. 

Everything starts when Wemmbu notices a new player on the server, Spoke, heading to another player's base and, out of boredom, decides to follow him invisibly. By chance, he catches an interesting conversation between him and JamatoP about illegal exploits. Unsure what exactly is going on, but knowing the bad history that Spoke previously had with exploits, he decides to continue following out of suspicion. 

Wemmbu cautiously follows them, and, after overhearing an illegal armor exploit and finding out that these two are the only people who know about it, he realizes how risky this is. He escapes to a nearby cave and decides he is going to discover every single exploit Spoke and Jamato know. He trails Spoke for the next few days until he is able to confront him in the end about the illegal armor he is wearing.
thumb|258x258px|Spoke and JamatoP plotting inside Jamato's base
Spoke brushes the inquiry off while emphasizing the normality of the armor and hoe much he grinded to obtain it.  Wemmbu knows Spoke is clearly lying as he saw him obtain the armor a few days ago while he was trailing him. He leaves the end knowing Spoke is clearly hiding something. He gets even more suspicious when Spoke announces a server-wide recruitment to protect builds called The Wonders. Knowing Spoke usually doesn't care about those sort of things, he suspects they may have something to do with the exploits. He applies for a guardian position, knowing the risks he is be facing.
thumb|258x258px|Wemmbu flexing his orbital cannonSpoke asks Wemmbu to show him one talent in order to get the job. Wemmbu brings him to an open field and then shows him his secret weapon, an orbital strike cannon that he built himself, which greatly surprises Spoke. After he blows up the entire field, Spoke sees Wemmbu's power and gives him the job. Spoke warns Wemmbu that if he catches him inside any of The Wonders, he will be kicked out of the guardian team and further actions will be taken. 

Not wanting to get on the bad side of an exploiter, Wemmbu guards his monument faithfully. Every time he tries to enter The Wonders, Spoke somehow knows about it and stops him, then goes to the end. Wemmbu decides to go to the end to figure out what is significant about it. He catches Spoke in the midst of building something, then realizes Spoke hollowed out the end pillars and is working inside of them. When confronted about it, Spoke is clearly stressed out and justifies it, saying it is an end project, and orders Wemmbu not to come in. He tries to shift the conversation onto Wemmbu, asking him why he isn't guarding his Wonders.

Wemmbu doubles down and Spoke refuses to tell him what he is up to, saying that there is nothing to know about and asks him to protect The Wonders. Wemmbu respawns the ender dragon, resetting the end pillars and deleting all of Spoke's shulkers. Spoke gets mad and comes up while not wearing the exploited armor, then gets further interrogated by Wemmbu. He restates that he was simply checking his shulkers, which Wemmbu doesn't buy one bit. Spoke then shifts the blame on Wemmbu, asking him why he is here and why he built an orbital strike cannon. He admits he was in the end because he received a little package from Jamato to work on his project.
thumb|258x258px|Wemmbu chasing Spoke to the outer end islands
Wemmbu laughs it off, exposing the stupidity of the excuse (why would he hide for his project), and asks him what Jamato has to do with all of this. Spoke says Jamato asked him to kill Wemmbu and attacks Wemmbu, doing little to no damage. Wemmbu realizes how useless he is and decides to talk to Jamato. He mocks Spoke's weak attacks, and after a while, decides to pop Spoke's totem. Wemmbu easily intimidates Spoke while mocking him and hitting him with his fists. Spoke continues to boast about his supposed crazy power. He escapes to the outer end islands, so Wemmbu continues to chase after him until he loses him.

Wemmbu decides to head to Jamato's base to talk to him, but realizes both Jamato and Spoke have completely vanished from both of their bases. He decides to check inside of The Wonders and spots Spoke doing something inside of one of them. Spoke seems relieved that some items are still here, so Wemmbu decides to confront him. Spoke is mad, seeing Wemmbu inside of The Wonders, as he ignored his warnings. He yet again tries to justify that this is a storage room, despite the extremely suspicious setup and illegal armor. Spoke asks Wemmbu to leave, but Wemmbu laughs it off. Spoke says he is going to be gone for a while and that he is packing up for a trip, which is an obvious lie, so Wemmbu starts attacking him.
thumb|258x258px|Spoke and Wemmbu inside The Wonders
Spoke secures the armor and a brawl ensues, which Wemmbu is obviously winning. After a while, Spoke decides to put on his illegal armor, but he still continues to lose. He starts pearling everywhere to escape. Wemmbu pops Spoke's totems twice and two pieces of Spoke's armor break, but Spoke barely manages to get away inside of a wall in a split second. On his trail, Wemmbu manages to hear him through the walls as Spoke decides to try to break every machine inside of The Wonders so nobody can get their hands on them, especially Wemmbu. He finally loses Spoke and realizes he took every single exploited item inside of the chests during the fight. Disappointed, he continues his search with ParrotX2, a new player, until they start noticing that the monuments are getting destroyed to cover up what is under them.

Luckily for Wemmbu, the destruction of the wonders angers Parrot, who decides to protect them, not knowing their true purposes. After a bit of manipulation, Parrot gives Wemmbu Spoke's coords, millions of blocks out. Wemmbu finds an enormous vault, presumably protecting the exploited items. He decides to start breaking in around the bottom of the vault until he hits the first obstacle: soul sand and lava. He easily gets across until he hears a guard's voice. Wemmbu tries to advance sneakily, limiting all noise, but is spotted by the guard Tyrad. A fight quickly ensues and Wemmbu manages to escape by chorus fruiting out of the prison.
thumb|258x258px|Full view of The Vault created by Spoke
Wemmbu reenters the prison and reengages with Tyrad, seemingly stuck in his own prison. The fight seems much more even. Wemmbu carts Tyrad and gets a few good hits, but Tyrad keeps pushing. Wemmbu continues the fight out of the prison and manages to get away using invisibilty potions. He tries to break in for the third time, but this time, much more sneakily, making sure nobody notices him. While Tyrad is looking for him, he manages to slip past the first defense and enter the next one, where he is attacked by underwater wardens. He barely manages to get past it while being shot by wardens. He notices through the walls two other guards, RealReeon and Sharkilz_, messing around.

The two of them are clearly not taking this seriously while Wemmbu continues to advance through the base's defense. Tyrad informs the other guards about Wemmbu's break in, so they all start looking for him. Wemmbu gets mining fatigue while he is mining, but that doesn't stop him as he continues to get through the defenses while drinking milk until he actually makes it inside of the vault's rooms.

Wemmbu explores the vault's corridors, blocking off certain paths so he doesn't encounter guards. He narrowly avoids them, as they are not taking this seriously, hitting each other and joking around. He gets spotted as he is potting up and a 3 v 1 ensues. After splashing himself with swiftness, Wemmbu escapes by blocking the paths, aided by the elder guardian's mining fatigue. He frenetically looks around until he finds his way down the prison into a lower floor as the hunters are catching up to him. 

Wemmbu starts killing the elder guardians and manages to get to an even lower floor using an elevator where he is yet again spotted while carelessly moving around. Sharkilz and Reeon immediately start attacking him, Wemmbu does good damage and manages to fend them off for a bit, giving him time to escape deeper into the vault. In a brilliant manner, Wemmbu manages to trap both Sharkilz and Reeon in the lower floor using obsidian, allowing him time to prepare and explore. He reaches the guard's storage room and steals useful equipment.
thumb|258x258px|Moments before Tyrad's death
thumb|258x258px|Moments before getting trapped
The guards find him and attack him again, and he uses end crystal to blow the hunters up, where he manages to kill Tyrad and run away by blocking everything off. The hunters hesitate a little, but decide to continue chasing after him, despite the death of their comrade. Wemmbu almost manages to kill Sharkilz using end crystals, but he is saved by the arrival of a large quantity of vexes, which all start attacking Wemmbu. He kills all of them and starts walking around. He realizes that the two guards are not following him anymore. Wemmbu wanders around the base until he finds a hidden passage under soul sand, leading him to another floor.

Wemmbu finds the two guards waiting in a corridor on that floor, and after spying on them for a little,  he decides to attack them yet again. Everything is going well until he is ambushed by a third guard, Only_A_Squid, which turns the tide of the battle. Wemmbu is forced to run away. He manages to escape for a little while using chorus fruit until he is found again. He manages to swim up a water column and block everything behind him. The hunters, out of milk, aren't able to keep up, so Wemmbu narrowly escapes death. He gets some rest while the hunters fetch milk.

Wemmbu finds an elevator activated by a random button, and he manages to go back to where he originally came from, where he finds an odd bubble column, bringing him to a totally new huge and decorated room. A trapped chest sits on a single TNT. While laughing, Wemmbu breaks the TNT, only to find himself falling as the ground below him breaks into a totally new room. 

Spoke menacingly tells Wemmbu that he sees him as he tries to escape by climbing the sides of the huge pit with water. Spoke says that this is a lot worse than a vault as TNT starts falling from the sky. He announces to Wemmbu that he isn't going to be able to leave the prison as payback for what he did earlier. As Wemmbu is getting shot from all sides by wardens, he tries to mine into the walls of the prison, but is stopped by Spoke, who pushes him into the pit as lava is falling from the sky. Wemmbu tries to chorus fruit out, but the wardens pop his totem. Spoke announces that he is actually gonna kill him, unlike what Wemmbu did in the end.
thumb|258x258px|Wemmbu completely trapped in minecarts
He finally manages to chorus fruit out, but he is yet again trapped in a room filled with chest minecarts, preventing him from doing anything. Surprised, Wemmbu comes to the realization that he is completely cornered. Spoke mocks Wemmbu, laughing about his inability to find the vault and the way he is currently trapped. He is attacked by a warden stuck with him, so he decides to do everything in his power to escape. Spoke boasts about getting the best prison designers to create this trap while he tries to chorus fruit everywhere.

Wemmbu tries to find a weakness inside the trap where he can break the walls, but to no avail. He manages to break a few minecarts, giving him just enough room to mine out of the walls using a milk bucket, where he escapes the first layer of the prison. Spoke continues to ramble about his perfect revenge until he notices that Wemmbu actually escaped.thumb|258x258px|Spoke mocking Wemmbu's escape
Spoke is clearly flustered as Wemmbu tries to break in inside the actual rooms of the prison. He is burning to the lava while Spoke mocks him trough the glass separating him from the inside of the prison. Wemmbu finds a hole in the lava defense, bringing him back inside the vault, where he restocks and prepares to fight Spoke.
thumb|259x259px|The Vault's exit
Wemmbu doesn't hesitate and jumps Spoke, who escapes the exact same way as him before: blocking up the tunnels. Wemmbu runs after him and finds a suspicious trap door leading to a room filled with lava. He gets splashed by a ton of bad effects, meaning he fell into a trap. Wemmbu finds a flaw in the trap and kills the witches throwing potions at him. 

After escaping the trap using chorus fruit, Wemmbu wanders around the base, where he finds tons of false traps until he discovers a bubble column hiding a trapdoor leading to a crawling tunnel leading to a door leading to an underwater exit. Wemmbu laughs as he gets out, seeing Spoke crouching at the other end of the exit. He attacks him without hesitation. Spoke pretends to be indiferrent to Wemmbu leaving the prison, even though he is clearly shocked.

Spoke escapes using an ender pearl stasis chamber.

Spoke secures the armor and a brawl ensues, which Wemmbu is obviously winning. After a while, Spoke decides to put on his illegal armor, but he still continues to lose. He starts pearling everywhere to escape. Wemmbu pops Spoke's totems twice and two pieces of Spoke's armor break, but Spoke barely manages to get away inside of a wall in a split second. On his trail, Wemmbu manages to hear him through the walls as Spoke decides to try to break every machine inside of The Wonders so nobody can get their hands on them, especially Wemmbu. He finally loses Spoke and realizes he took every single exploited item inside of the chests during the fight. Disappointed, he continues his search with [[ParrotX2]], a new player, until they start noticing that the monuments are getting destroyed to cover up what is under them.

Luckily for Wemmbu, the destruction of the wonders angers Parrot, who decides to protect them, not knowing their true purposes. After a bit of manipulation, Parrot gives Wemmbu Spoke's coords, millions of blocks out. Wemmbu finds an enormous vault, presumably protecting the exploited items. He decides to start breaking in around the bottom of the vault until he hits the first obstacle: soul sand and lava. He easily gets across until he hears a guard's voice. Wemmbu tries to advance sneakily, limiting all noise, but is spotted by the guard [[Tyrad]]. A fight quickly ensues and Wemmbu manages to escape by chorus fruiting out of the prison.
[[File:The vault.png|thumb|258x258px|Full view of The Vault created by Spoke]]
Wemmbu reenters the prison and reengages with Tyrad, seemingly stuck in his own prison. The fight seems much more even. Wemmbu carts Tyrad and gets a few good hits, but Tyrad keeps pushing. Wemmbu continues the fight out of the prison and manages to get away using invisibilty potions. He tries to break in for the third time, but this time, much more sneakily, making sure nobody notices him. While Tyrad is looking for him, he manages to slip past the first defense and enter the next one, where he is attacked by underwater wardens. He barely manages to get past it while being shot by wardens. He notices through the walls two other guards, [[RealReeon]] and [[Sharkilz_]], messing around.

The two of them are clearly not taking this seriously while Wemmbu continues to advance through the base's defense. Tyrad informs the other guards about Wemmbu's break in, so they all start looking for him. Wemmbu gets mining fatigue while he is mining, but that doesn't stop him as he continues to get through the defenses while drinking milk until he actually makes it inside of the vault's rooms.

Wemmbu explores the vault's corridors, blocking off certain paths so he doesn't encounter guards. He narrowly avoids them, as they are not taking this seriously, hitting each other and joking around. He gets spotted as he is potting up and a 3 v 1 ensues. After splashing himself with swiftness, Wemmbu escapes by blocking the paths, aided by the elder guardian's mining fatigue. He frenetically looks around until he finds his way down the prison into a lower floor as the hunters are catching up to him. 

Wemmbu starts killing the elder guardians and manages to get to an even lower floor using an elevator where he is yet again spotted while carelessly moving around. Sharkilz and Reeon immediately start attacking him, Wemmbu does good damage and manages to fend them off for a bit, giving him time to escape deeper into the vault. In a brilliant manner, Wemmbu manages to trap both Sharkilz and Reeon in the lower floor using obsidian, allowing him time to prepare and explore. He reaches the guard's storage room and steals useful equipment.
[[File:Tyrad's death.png|thumb|258x258px|Moments before Tyrad's death]]
[[File:Right before getting trapped.png|thumb|258x258px|Moments before getting trapped]]
The guards find him and attack him again, and he uses end crystal to blow the hunters up, where he manages to kill [[Tyrad]] and run away by blocking everything off. The hunters hesitate a little, but decide to continue chasing after him, despite the death of their comrade. Wemmbu almost manages to kill Sharkilz using end crystals, but he is saved by the arrival of a large quantity of vexes, which all start attacking Wemmbu. He kills all of them and starts walking around. He realizes that the two guards are not following him anymore. Wemmbu wanders around the base until he finds a hidden passage under soul sand, leading him to another floor.

Wemmbu finds the two guards waiting in a corridor on that floor, and after spying on them for a little,  he decides to attack them yet again. Everything is going well until he is ambushed by a third guard, [[Only_A_Squid]], which turns the tide of the battle. Wemmbu is forced to run away. He manages to escape for a little while using chorus fruit until he is found again. He manages to swim up a water column and block everything behind him. The hunters, out of milk, aren't able to keep up, so Wemmbu narrowly escapes death. He gets some rest while the hunters fetch milk.

Wemmbu finds an elevator activated by a random button, and he manages to go back to where he originally came from, where he finds an odd bubble column, bringing him to a totally new huge and decorated room. A trapped chest sits on a single TNT. While laughing, Wemmbu breaks the TNT, only to find himself falling as the ground below him breaks into a totally new room. 

Spoke menacingly tells Wemmbu that he sees him as he tries to escape by climbing the sides of the huge pit with water. Spoke says that this is a lot worse than a vault as TNT starts falling from the sky. He announces to Wemmbu that he isn't going to be able to leave the prison as payback for what he did earlier. As Wemmbu is getting shot from all sides by wardens, he tries to mine into the walls of the prison, but is stopped by Spoke, who pushes him into the pit as lava is falling from the sky. Wemmbu tries to chorus fruit out, but the wardens pop his totem. Spoke announces that he is actually gonna kill him, unlike what Wemmbu did in the end.
[[File:Trapped in minecart.png|thumb|258x258px|Wemmbu completely trapped in minecarts]]
He finally manages to chorus fruit out, but he is yet again trapped in a room filled with chest minecarts, preventing him from doing anything. Surprised, Wemmbu comes to the realization that he is completely cornered. Spoke mocks Wemmbu, laughing about his inability to find the vault and the way he is currently trapped. He is attacked by a warden stuck with him, so he decides to do everything in his power to escape. Spoke boasts about getting the best prison designers to create this trap while he tries to chorus fruit everywhere.

Wemmbu tries to find a weakness inside the trap where he can break the walls, but to no avail. He manages to break a few minecarts, giving him just enough room to mine out of the walls using a milk bucket, where he escapes the first layer of the prison. Spoke continues to ramble about his perfect revenge until he notices that Wemmbu actually escaped.[[File:Spoke mocking wemmbu.png|thumb|258x258px|Spoke mocking Wemmbu's escape]]
Spoke is clearly flustered as Wemmbu tries to break in inside the actual rooms of the prison. He is burning to the lava while Spoke mocks him trough the glass separating him from the inside of the prison. Wemmbu finds a hole in the lava defense, bringing him back inside the vault, where he restocks and prepares to fight Spoke.
[[File:The Vault's exit.png|thumb|259x259px|The Vault's exit]]
Wemmbu doesn't hesitate and jumps Spoke, who escapes the exact same way as him before: blocking up the tunnels. Wemmbu runs after him and finds a suspicious trap door leading to a room filled with lava. He gets splashed by a ton of bad effects, meaning he fell into a trap. Wemmbu finds a flaw in the trap and kills the witches throwing potions at him. 

After escaping the trap using chorus fruit, Wemmbu wanders around the base, where he finds tons of false traps until he discovers a bubble column hiding a trapdoor leading to a crawling tunnel leading to a door leading to an underwater exit. Wemmbu laughs as he gets out, seeing Spoke crouching at the other end of the exit. He attacks him without hesitation. Spoke pretends to be indiferrent to Wemmbu leaving the prison, even though he is clearly shocked.

Spoke escapes using an ender pearl stasis chamber.

title: Capital City
content:
For the new Capital City in season 2, see Capital City 2.0.

Capital City, led by Reddoons (and quoted by Ash to be 'basically his'), is a civilization in Unstable Universe. The city is split into two parts: The Mines, and The City. The City is empty and it is dubious if The City was always a ruse for The Mines or citizens of Capital City were placed into The Mines prematurely to produce more diamonds.

Allyship 
Most of Capital City's plot relevance is with it's allyship with The Invisible Mafia. In I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia, it is expanded upon that the allyship between Capital City and The Invisible Mafia is a one-way transactional relationship where Red will supply the Mafia with goods and the Mafia will remain neutral with Red.

In I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization, guards are shown to be stationed at Capital City, but in I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia they are gone, so it can be assumed that between videos, stations ended at Capital City, along with more interpersonal things like Red's position in the mafia.

 The Mines 
The Mines are a subsection of Capital City, being where most people in Capital City reside. It is alluded to be some kind of equivalent to a labor camp--minus it being prisoners placed in there; made to mine for valuable ores all day until nightfall. The Mines subsection was watched over CoinMonke as a warden.

The pitfall most workers found themselves in was the promise to be able to leave The Mines if they reach an absurd quota of diamonds, mostly being impossible without the help of Parrot stealing from Red's vaults. 

It gradually grew to also have a roulette table, following Red's gambling motifs, to kill one player after a week as a punishment for being the target of Red's suspicions.

The Mines are now seemingly defunct after I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City.

 History 
ParrotX2, Wifies, and deanthebean9 try to steal from Capital city. They are caught by Reddoons and five invisible guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

They find a group of miners, with CoinMonke as the warden. Parrot spends his time mining. Parrot and his friends steal from Capital City vaults. Parrot gives PikaTM more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital City for them to be set free.

Reddoons finds out about people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in the vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

Parrot overhears Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that ashswagg suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and The Invisible Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they say no. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber and they escape.

Members of Skyblock Civilization investigate Capital City. They pretend to be members of The Mafia to infiltrate however, the invisible players are able to tell the fake ones and attack the Skyblock Civilization members.

Spoke, Mapicc and Leow0ok are sent on a mission to trade with Reddoons. The leader of the mission is disappointed by Red's offerings. Since Red isn't rich enough anymore, the gold player just goes with it and they leave.

 Trivia 
 Capitol City is named after a city Reddoons owned in Lifesteal SMP Season 3.

title: Capitol City
content:
Capitol City is a city leaded by Fymada, located near spawn. It was previously known as Capital City before Fymada was appointed as Mayor, and will be referred as Capital City 2.0 below before renaming to distinguish it from the abandoned Capital City. Centered a few hundred blocks from Spawn, this metropolis is a safe space for all players. It is home to many shops, jobs, and houses. Hundreds of players live here—which formerly included ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird.

 Structure 
Capitol City is home to many shops and structures. The city takes a "Desert Empire" theme, being made out of a lot of sandstone and other yellow blocks. But this is not all, as there are some more mental structuring as well. The City has many rules, some are not that great or fair. For example, there is a 90% tax on all items sold. The currency is diamonds, so for every 100 diamonds you make, you will only get 10 after taxes. Most of these goods are sold on "Market Street". This is also where you could have had found ParrotX2, as he used to run a potion shop there as well. There are many different buildings and places in Capitol City as well, each having their importance. 

 Main Building 
left|thumb|Picture of the Building |342x342px
The Main Building is one of Capitol City's most important attractions. Built in the middle of the complex, this tower is huge, reaching over a hundred blocks in height. This is also where you will most likely find Reddoons, the owner of the city. He does meetings and tax calculations on the top floor. For people who want to explore The Main Building, there are only two known ways of reaching higher floors. You can either climb the ladder to the top—which will take a while or use the secret mini elevators that are reserved for guards and important people, as seen in Wemmbu's "Orbital Strike Cannon vs Unstable SMP". Either way, you still must get a reservation before climbing to the top, as Reddoons is almost always busy. 

 Train Station 
left|thumb|274x274px|Picture of the Station Capitol City's Train Station is an important part of the civilization. It consists of 50 tracks each leading to separate stations all across the spawn area of Unstable. It costs four diamonds per ticket now, due to inflation, which might not seem like a lot, but it is because of taxes. In total, with 90% taxes, it actually costs forty diamonds to get only four back. Anyhow, you buy a ticket from the front desk for that price and your good to go—it just might take a while to wait in line. On the bright side though, you can look around to find less popular front desks, i.e like the one that Lezy ran, which had no people in line for it. 

 Grand Hotel 
left|thumb|302x302px|Picture of the Hotel
The Grand Hotel is not just for a temporary stay, it's also a business outpost of some kind. Although not much is known about it canon-wise, it is still an important part of the city, being the second largest building in the complex. It can house up to 800 players due to some simple math, although there have still been reports that stay is way too expensive—even from Theo himself, who was in major debt to the hotel, having to give up his elytra, which he later received back after "paying back" his debts. 

 Post Office/Mail Building 
left|thumb|382x382px|Picture of the Mailing Complex
The Mail Building/Post Office is home to the city's mailing industry, located near Merchant Street. Here is where you pick up and drop off mail, and from there, the workers will take care of the rest, carefully sorting out and placing your deliveries where they are supposed to be. The line is long, just like the Train Station, but you can still have a faster waiting experience if you just look around for a shorter line. 

 The Lionels 
left|thumb|150x150px|Picture of the Left Lionel
The Lionels are some of the most exotic attractions in the entire city. They resemble two huge lions, each on a short pillar. They have a powerful sense in them that suggests to the city's strong power.

 History 
ParrotX2 and Theo went to Capital City 2.0, where Parrot found a job in a potion shop, and a secret job with Theo of taking players out of spawn safely to Capital City 2.0.  They made a lot of diamonds doing this, but they do get in trouble from Reddoons when he caught them invading the 90% tax and Parrot's failure to pay rent on time. Reddoons promised to forgive them, and let them keep all their diamonds if they rescue one of Reddoons' friend, Hexatope from spawn. Parrot said that he did not do that anymore, as it was cruel that saving people was pay-to-win, as only the people who paid for saving could actually get saved. Parrot said he would only do it if Reddoons clears the debt of every player in the city, which surprisingly, Reddoons immediately agreed. Everyone was happy with what Parrot did, and he became a city hero.

In SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server, FlameFrags went into Capital City 2.0 to retrieve potions from mrlegend101. 

In Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP, Wemmbu entered the city, threatened the guard with stab shot and met SirPig_. He asked where FlameFrags was. SirPig_ initially refused to answer, but after part of the city got nuked he told Wemmbu that Flame had gone to The Law's old base southwest of the city (not the Law City, which is southeast of the city).

In How I DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP, Wemmbu, with a new identity after faking his death, was a peaceful guard of Capital City, until Boosfer and his massive 50 player army tried to take it over in the Battle of Capital City 2.0. Boosfer lost, but said he's comming back for more.

Salvationism, a former leader in Capital City 2.0, allied with Wemmbu, and helped set up a trap to kill FlameFrags and Boosfer, but the plan failed and Salvationism was killed in the process. 

It is revealed that SirPig was the new leader of the city, but he was just as bad as Reddoons. 

SpokeIsHere planned to nuke the city and brings the server into ruins, however, Parrot stepped in and eventually convinces Spoke from destroying Capital City 2.0.

 The Kingdoms Arc 
Parrot, after becoming king, fires SirPig from as the mayor, giving Fymada the role instead. She lowers taxes from 90% to 10% and receives mostly positive support. The city's name was changed to Capitol City.

Parrot becomes king but his policies are generally unfriendly towards OG's and old players in the server. The reason for this is over population and lack of resources. The Capitol City Police almost take over the running off the city. New players who try to enter are killed at the gate and the new players already at Capitol City are forced to live in crowded buildings with a 2x2 for a room.  

Shoebilly teams up with the Police to find Parrot. He kills some innocent players when he was fighting with Theo but when he enters the building he starts killing every single player. The police force is also engaged in the massacre possibly killing up to 100 players or even more. The police force warned that that was just the start and threatened on doing a purge of new players in the city. Luckily for all the new players, the plot failed however for the players who originally lived in Capitol city as well as OG's throughout the server, their conditions are not getting better. Parrot's regime seems to favour new players which could be the reason why players like Arachn1d and Yungyx are able to recruit hundreds of players into their armies and get a lot of support.

 Trivia 
 We know the name was changed from Capital City to Capitol City through the newspaper DanchoGold gave to ParrotX2 in I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization, and the sign in the recently refurbished Spawn in I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army.

[[Capitol City]] is a city leaded by [[Fymada]], located near spawn. It was previously known as [[Capitol City|Capital City]] before Fymada was appointed as Mayor, and will be referred as [[Capitol City|Capital City 2.0]] below before renaming to distinguish it from the abandoned [[Capital City]]. Centered a few hundred blocks from [[Spawn]], this metropolis is a safe space for all players. It is home to many shops, jobs, and houses. Hundreds of players live here—which formerly included [[ParrotX2]] and [[TheobaldTheBird]].

== Structure ==
Capitol City is home to many shops and structures. The city takes a "Desert Empire" theme, being made out of a lot of sandstone and other yellow blocks. But this is not all, as there are some more mental structuring as well. The City has many rules, some are not that great or fair. For example, there is a 90% tax on all items sold. The currency is diamonds, so for every 100 diamonds you make, you will only get 10 ''after'' taxes. Most of these goods are sold on "Market Street". This is also where you could have had found [[ParrotX2]], as he used to run a potion shop there as well. There are many different buildings and places in Capitol City as well, each having their importance. 

=== Main Building ===
[[File:Capital City Building.png|left|thumb|Picture of the Building |342x342px]]
The Main Building is one of Capitol City's most important attractions. Built in the middle of the complex, this tower is huge, reaching over a hundred blocks in height. This is also where you will most likely find [[Reddoons]], the owner of the city. He does meetings and tax calculations on the top floor. For people who want to explore The Main Building, there are only two known ways of reaching higher floors. You can either climb the ladder to the top—which will take a while or use the secret mini elevators that are reserved for guards and important people, as seen in [[Wemmbu]]'s "[[Orbital Strike Cannon vs Unstable SMP]]". Either way, you still must get a reservation before climbing to the top, as [[Reddoons]] is almost always busy. 

=== Train Station ===
[[File:Capital City Train Station.png|left|thumb|274x274px|Picture of the Station ]]Capitol City's Train Station is an important part of the civilization. It consists of 50 tracks each leading to separate stations all across the spawn area of [[Unstable Universe|Unstable]]. It costs four diamonds per ticket now, due to inflation, which might not ''seem'' like a lot, but it is because of taxes. In total, with 90% taxes, it actually costs forty diamonds to get only four back. Anyhow, you buy a ticket from the front desk for that price and your good to go—it just might take a while to wait in line. On the bright side though, you can look around to find less popular front desks, i.e like the one that [[Lezy]] ran, which had no people in line for it. 

=== Grand Hotel ===
[[File:Capital City Hotel.png|left|thumb|302x302px|Picture of the Hotel]]
The Grand Hotel is not just for a temporary stay, it's also a business outpost of some kind. Although not much is known about it canon-wise, it is still an important part of the city, being the second largest building in the complex. It can house up to 800 players due to some simple math, although there have still been reports that stay is way too expensive—even from [[Theo]] himself, who was in major debt to the hotel, having to give up his elytra, which he later received back after "paying back" his debts. 

=== Post Office/Mail Building ===
[[File:Capital City Mail.png|left|thumb|382x382px|Picture of the Mailing Complex]]
The Mail Building/Post Office is home to the city's mailing industry, located near Merchant Street. Here is where you pick up and drop off mail, and from there, the workers will take care of the rest, carefully sorting out and placing your deliveries where they are supposed to be. The line is long, just like the Train Station, but you can still have a faster waiting experience if you just look around for a shorter line. 

=== The Lionels ===
[[File:LionelsCapitalcity.png.png|left|thumb|150x150px|Picture of the Left Lionel]]
The Lionels are some of the most exotic attractions in the entire city. They resemble two huge lions, each on a short pillar. They have a powerful sense in them that suggests to the city's strong power.

== History ==
[[ParrotX2]] and [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]] went to Capital City 2.0, where [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] found a job in a potion shop, and a secret job with [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]] of taking players out of spawn safely to Capital City 2.0.  They made a lot of diamonds doing this, but they do get in trouble from [[Reddoons]] when he caught them invading the 90% tax and [[ParrotX2|Parrot's]] failure to pay rent on time. [[Reddoons]] promised to forgive them, and let them keep all their diamonds if they rescue one of [[Reddoons]]' friend, [[Hexatope]] from spawn. [[SirPig_]] initially refused to answer, but after part of the city got nuked he told Wemmbu that Flame had gone to [[The Law]]'s old base southwest of the city (not the [[Law City]], which is southeast of the city).

[[Boosfer]] lost, but said he's comming back for more.

[[Salvationism]], a former leader in Capital City 2.0, allied with [[Wemmbu]], and helped set up a trap to kill [[FlameFrags]] and [[Boosfer]], but the plan failed and [[Salvationism]] was killed in the process.

[[SpokeIsHere]] planned to nuke the city and brings the server into ruins, however, [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] stepped in and eventually convinces [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] from destroying Capital City 2.0.

=== [[The Kingdoms Arc]] ===

title: Cart PvP/Carting
content:
Cart PvP or Carting is one of the strongest yet hardest PvP styles in Minecraft. It can pop players in one shot by explosion, but requires more sequential actions and is much harder to master compared with end crystals or respawn anchors. If triggered via a Flame bow, it is called Insta cart and deal moderate damage (roughly equivalent to a TNT) and can be performed in milliseconds. If triggered via flint and steel and a crossbow, it is called X-bow and deal massive damage (roughly between a respawn anchor and an end crystal, often popping the cart PvPer themselves).

title: Chunk ban
content:
A Chunk ban is a real Minecraft exploit commonly used throughout the entirety of Unstable Universe. It has been used for various prisons, traps, and other notable structures. 

 Mechanics 
See: Tutorials/Chunk ban

title: Chunk suppressor
content:
Chunk Suppressor/Update Suppressor is a machine that stops game updates in a specific area, often to perform exploits like duplicating items. In the context of computer science and data processing, "chunk suppressor" refers to "mode-suppression," a technique in file-sharing systems like BitTorrent that prevents the sharing of the most frequently requested data chunks to ensure stability and prevent network congestion.

 Function: An update suppressor machine prevents the game from processing updates in a designated "chunk" of the game world.
 Purpose: This can be used for exploits, such as creating duplicate items ("shadow items") or for creating areas where sounds no longer play.
 Mechanism: It works by creating a state that forces the game to stop a series of block updates and skip them, often by triggering a specific, controlled crash or an error state. 
 it may have been used by Spoke.

title: Cindercrest
content:
Cindercrest is a faction led by Saparata that kills new players or forces them to work for them. ShoeBilly_ is a notable mercenary actively working for them by killing members of the Skymore Civilization. FlameFrags and Lomedy are also working with them and they have also made a alliance with Arachn1d making Wemmbu work for them too which means that they have all of the most powerful fighters on the server. It is seen as one of the richest factions to be ever on the server able to equip thousands of players with full netherite armor and make them stacked. They are the main antagonists in Kingdoms.

 History  
The new players joining the server have been taking up huge amounts of resources, leading to a food shortage for old players. Therefore they've made it their primary goal to eliminate the server's new players, destroy ParrotX2's kingdom and kill everyone not involved with them. After he and his friends almost starved to death and his friends were killed by bandits Saparata decided to create Cindercrest to enact revenge on the new players of the server blaming them for the food and resource shortage. Many other old players who suffered the same face as Saparata join Cindercrest.  

Cindercrest hire the Capital City Police Force to frame ParrotX2. Some of their members become high-ranking members, such as their leader ReinforcedLad, and their second-in-command Bossstream. Parrot escapes, kills their leader and imprisons Bossstream. 

Cindercrest attacks Skymore Civilization and kills all but 10 of their 1000 members, enslaving the survivors. 8 more of the survivors die. 

Zoe444 escapes from Cindercrest. She leaves a set of clues for her friend ReinaDrop to find. 

ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird return to Skymore with a handfull of guards but they find Skymore abandoned. ShoeBilly and his team blow the same horn that Parrot uses to signal the guards tricking them into riding straight into a trap. It is presumed that Shoebilly and his gang kill all of the guards Parrot brings to Skymore.

TheobaldTheBird kills 5 members of Cindercrest. he then fights ShoeBilly_. 

Cindercrest gathered thousands of maxed out netherite players to march towards Spawn to lock it down. FlameFrags and ShoeBilly_ were seen on its giant airship. This is because Lomedy likes Cindercrest.

After FlameFrags is recruited by Cindercrest, Saparata leads the grand Cindercrest army to Fort Feather. Their plan is to take over the training ground via an aerial assault using the giant blimp that they have. With almost no cassualties they manage to take over the fort with relative ease. The army stationed there is overwhelmed and flees and many are killed. It is a major victory for Cindercrest but Parrot's escape tunnels allow most of his legion to escape in time.

Saparata says that to achieve victory Cindercrest should use the orbital strike cannons. He sends FlameFrags on a mission to get the cannons while the rest of the army regroups. FlameFrags fails to obtain the cannons from Wemmbu and Eggchan. Without the cannons the Cindercrest army marches to merchant city anyway. They see that Parrot has put white flags on merchant city and says that he has come to surrender. FlameFrags says that they should storm merchant city as Parrot is surrendering but Saparata sees it as a trick and orders another aerial assault using the blimp. Turns out it was a trick but the other way around as Parrot used reverse psychology to make Saparata attack from the air. When they drop down below with slow falling Parrot uses a special arrow cannon to kill all the Cindercrest soldiers dropping down and in the end only FlameFrags and Lomedy get down. Flame retreats from battle and sees that the Grand Cindercrest army has also retreated. It is a major defeat for Cindercrest and they lose the momentum they gained. Cindercrest also does not have as many troops as Parrot's kingdom and it is more difficult for them to obtain players.

Earlier, FlameFrags had said that Cindercrest should form an alliance with the Arachn1d kingdom. Saparata did not take this seriously then but after losing a major battle he reconsiders. He orders the Grand Cindercrest army to march towards Arachn1d's kingdom saying that he wants to make an alliance with them. FlameFrags starts to lose hope in Cindercrest but Lomedy is not swayed.

Saparata forms a alliance witht he Arachn1d kingdom. After that he plans to march onto Highwater city. After the loss at merchant city Saparata asks a Cindercrest player to assasinate Parrot. He manages to blow up about a dozen of his guards and innocent people too but fails to actually kill him. Parrot tortures the player for information in which he tell him that Cindercrest is planning to take Highwater.

Parrot says that Highwater is very important since 80% of the food in his kingdom is in the city. If the grand Cindercrest army was to take Highwater it would mean that Parrot's kingdom would starve. He prepares lots of defences at Highwater.

Cindercrest attempts to take a path to Highwater which involves a bridge. FlameFrags and Lomedy talk Parrot. Lomedy says its Parrots fault for the fact that the people are starving. After the conversation ends about 60 of Parrots army delay the Grand Cindercrest army. They are almost overwhelemed but The LAW legion arrives to rescue Parrot in time. 

The LAW legion is eventually overwhelmed by The Grand Cindercrest army and the army marches to Highwater. Parrot prepares a defence involving a minigun and a huge arrow cannon which can decimate an army. He knows that if he wins the battle Parrot might win the civil war however Saparata is not stupid and has a plan.

Saparata has a conversation with Parrot in which he calls Parrot weak in almost every single way. Afterwards Parrot gives the order to fire the arrow cannons. The huge arrow cannons destroy the Grand Cindercrest army in minutes. Shoebilly attempts to take down the cannon but Parrot's anti air defence forces him to retreat. Finally only the last 60 members of the Grand Cindercrest army are left.

Saparata orders the last of his army (Including himself, FlameFrags, Lomedy & Shoebilly) to do one last suicide charge. While Parrot wipes out the last of the army FlameFrags comes in and blows up the anti air defence allowing Shoebilly to destroy the huge arrow cannon. 

Cindercrest's plan is revealed. They had planned to use their entire army as bait so that Parrots defences would be fully immobilized. Saparata blows his goat horn and Wemmbu & Yungyx come in. Wemmbu attacks the city with his orbital cannons completely destroying King Parrots army and the Arachn1d kingdom helps the remaining Cindercrest soldiers to wipe out the remnants of Parrots army. Parrot is helpless against Wemmbu's orbital strikes and with his army destroyed he, TheobaldtheBird & Reina all flee from the destroyed city. It is a decisive Cindercrest victory as now Parrot's kingdom has a chance to collapse from within and Cindercrest has also destroyed one of Parrots legions. Saparata gives a speech invitiing all the old players of the server to unite under Cindercrest saying that they will "bring back rule to those who deserve it".

title: ClownPierce
content:
ClownPierce, also known as Clown, is one of the two main antagonists (alongside Ashswagg) of Unstable Universe Season 1. He is one of the secondary antagonists of Unstable Universe Season 2 alongside the Law's Elite Force.

 Personality 
ClownPierce has a reputation of being both ruthless and dangerous. He takes extreme measures to achieve his goals, such as relentlessly hunting down ParrotX2 with the help of his team during the events of I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players. He enjoys entertainment and often torments his targets with grand entrances or complex games, social experiments, and scavenger hunts. The fear and terror he inflicts onto the server have caused him to gain some notable enemies, with some people even going as far as creating entire alliances based on killing Clown. 

He is also known to have one weak spot (an "achilles' heel" as described by Parrot), that being Branzy. He is also close friends with FerreMC, they care about each other’s life, but they don’t usually have to worry about each other because both Ferre and Clown are very skilled players. 

 History 

 Season 1 
PrinceZam pays ClownPierce to assassinate ParrotX2.

Parrot and Wifies find ClownPierce in a carnival. This is where he plans to have a fair 1v1 with Parrot. Parrot and Wifies 2v1 ClownPierce. They get mining fatigue meaning that they can not break out and have to fight ClownPierce. Leow0ok, Willsion, and Woogiex, enemies of ClownPierce break Parrot and Wifies out before they die.

ClownPierce follows Parrot to Wemmbu's Civilization and tries to kill him. He overhears Parrot trying to team with Wemmbu. He starts killing Wemmbu’s villagers for information, but Wemmbu says he has no good information.

Wemmbu tells PrinceZam’s guards that Parrot joined the colony, and later a team of people with red and white trims begin trying to kill Wemmbu and eggchan. The invisible player is revealed to be ClownPierce.

Leow0ok agrees to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, FerreMC, and Mugm_ come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues. The team against ClownPierce runs away. Wifies comes to his base and sees that ClownPierce blew up the terrain around it.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok’s team to help him kidnap BranzyCraft, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Parrot fights ClownPierce in a 1v1. He’s secretly made a trap with 30,000 TNT. Parrot is unable to kill ClownPierce with his trap. He discovers ClownPierce blew up Leow0ok’s team headquarters secret meeting room.

Parrot discovers a book in his house. The book says to meet him at specific coordinates, and it has been written by ClownPierce. He thinks this book might have the answers to why certain players have disappeared from the server. Parrot and Wifies go to these coordinates and find two players, Jaden_MAN and Spongs, who call themselves the game masters. They state that for the quest, they can only use items that they give them, and they can not cheat. They go on a quest to get items, while Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ hinder them. At the end, ClownPierce tells Parrot to put his spyglass in the item frame.

ClownPierce traps Wemmbu and PrinceZam in a prison, but Wemmbu escapes using an ender pearl cannon. The rest of the members remain.

Parrot, Wifies, Derapchu, JumperWho, _Kenadian_, and Rekrap2 are trapped by ClownPierce in a prison called Proton. They eventually escape using a honey stasis chamber and outside visitors.

ClownPierce traps Wemmbu and PrinceZam in an escape room designed by Wato1876. In the end, Clown states that he has destroyed all the ominous trial vaults, meaning that, most importantly, heavy cores and maces are no longer obtainable on the server. And the few left are the last and only ones.

Wato1876 goes to Skyblock Civilization to avoid ClownPierce.

FlameFrags gives ClownPierce a mace that he stole from Wemmbu. Clown gives it to FerreMC. ClownPierce is seen helping ashswagg in The Mafia.

ClownPierce and FerreMC destroy ManePear’s tree. Wemmbu and Eggchan escape by going into the nether. Wemmbu and eggchan agree to team with Parrot to kill ClownPierce.

Wemmbu distracts ClownPierce by fighting him while SpokeIsHere destroys the Mafia.

 Season 2 
We got mentioned about Clown first that it is known that he executed Verda and citizens of "mining town" because they resisted to tell where the Verdaria was.

It is rumored that ClownPierce claimed the entire Nether dimension as his territory. He constructed a massive, highly-secured vault to store his wealth and began hunting any player who entered the dimension without permission. His goal was to create a monopoly over Netherite and other essential Nether resources.

ClownPierce’s growing monopoly eventually forced rivals into a desperate alliance. FlameFrags and Parrot (With TheobaldTheBird) launched a high-stakes infiltration mission with dual objectives: FlameFrags wanted to make an assassination of ClownPierce in order to get information about Wemmbu, while Parrot aimed to breach and loot his secure vault. But, they had some kind of accident, and Flame betrays Parrot and Theo and tells Clown where their location is in exchange for Wemmbu's location.

They then went to location of the birds (Parrot and Theo) and while Parrot gets to escape, Theo is being captured. Parrot jumped down attempting to negotiate, but in result got captured also.

Clown apologizes and tells Flame that he knows nothing about Wemmbu location and proceeds to execute Parrot, but Flame accepts it and tells Clown that they'd have to get through him first, betraying him in result. Clown runs away to catch Parrot so his vault isn't ransacked leaving his army behind.

Some time later, Clown is met by Parrot, who came to request an order of 40,000 TNT to use to defend his kingdom from Cindercrest. Clown, still holding a grudge against Parrot for raiding his vault, charges three times the price (60,000 diamonds up from 20,000). Parrot initially declines the offer, however Clown tells him that Cindercrest have already departed towards his kingdom, revealing that Cindercrest purchased goods from Clown prior to their conversation, and says they would stand no chance without potions, technology, or gear. Parrot reluctantly agrees to the deal and pays Clown the diamonds. Clown tells Parrot before he leaves that he is welcome to come back to him whenever he needs to buy more things, however warns him that if he comes back for any reason other than that, he would kill him.

[[ClownPierce]], also known as [[ClownPierce|Clown]], is one of the two main antagonists (alongside [[Ashswagg]]) of [[Unstable Universe]] [[Season 1]]. He is one of the secondary antagonists of Unstable Universe Season 2 alongside [[The Law's Elite Force|the Law's Elite Force.]]

== Personality ==
ClownPierce has a reputation of being both ruthless and dangerous. He takes extreme measures to achieve his goals, such as relentlessly hunting down [[ParrotX2]] with the help of his team during the events of [https://youtu.be/VSI12NnAnAY I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players]. He enjoys entertainment and often torments his targets with grand entrances or complex games, social experiments, and scavenger hunts. The fear and terror he inflicts onto the server have caused him to gain some notable enemies, with some people even going as far as creating entire alliances based on killing Clown. 

He is also known to have one weak spot (an "achilles' heel" as described by Parrot), that being [[BranzyCraft|Branzy]]. He is also close friends with FerreMC, they care about each other’s life, but they don’t usually have to worry about each other because both Ferre and Clown are very skilled players. 

== History ==

=== Season 1 ===
[[PrinceZam]] pays ClownPierce to assassinate [[ParrotX2]].

[[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and [[Wifies]] find ClownPierce in a carnival. This is where he plans to have a fair 1v1 with Parrot. Parrot and Wifies 2v1 ClownPierce. They get mining fatigue meaning that they can not break out and have to fight ClownPierce. [[Leow0ok]], [[Willsion]], and [[Woogiex]], enemies of ClownPierce break Parrot and Wifies out before they die.

ClownPierce follows Parrot to [[Wemmbu's Civilization]] and tries to kill him. He overhears Parrot trying to team with [[Wemmbu]]. He starts killing Wemmbu’s villagers for information, but Wemmbu says he has no good information.

Wemmbu tells PrinceZam’s guards that Parrot joined the colony, and later a team of people with red and white trims begin trying to kill Wemmbu and eggchan. The invisible player is revealed to be ClownPierce.

Leow0ok agrees to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, [[FerreMC]], and [[Mugm_]] come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues. The team against ClownPierce runs away. Wifies comes to his base and sees that ClownPierce blew up the terrain around it.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok’s team to help him kidnap [[BranzyCraft]], as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Parrot fights ClownPierce in a 1v1. He’s secretly made a trap with 30,000 TNT. Parrot is unable to kill ClownPierce with his trap. He discovers ClownPierce blew up Leow0ok’s team headquarters secret meeting room.

Parrot discovers a book in his house. The book says to meet him at specific coordinates, and it has been written by ClownPierce. He thinks this book might have the answers to why certain players have disappeared from the server. Parrot and Wifies go to these coordinates and find two players, [[Jaden_MAN]] and [[Spongs]], who call themselves the game masters. They state that for the quest, they can only use items that they give them, and they can not cheat. They go on a quest to get items, while [[Kierrrr]] and [[Its_Dev_]] hinder them. At the end, ClownPierce tells Parrot to put his spyglass in the item frame.

ClownPierce traps Wemmbu and PrinceZam in a prison, but Wemmbu escapes using an ender pearl cannon. The rest of the members remain.

Parrot, Wifies, [[Derapchu]], [[JumperWho]], [[Kenadian|_Kenadian_]], and [[Rekrap2]] are trapped by ClownPierce in a prison called [[Proton]]. They eventually escape using a honey stasis chamber and outside visitors.

ClownPierce traps Wemmbu and PrinceZam in an escape room designed by [[Wato1876]]. In the end, Clown states that he has destroyed all the ominous trial vaults, meaning that, most importantly, heavy cores and maces are no longer obtainable on the server. And the few left are the last and only ones.

Wato1876 goes to [[Skyblock Civilization]] to avoid ClownPierce.

[[FlameFrags]] gives ClownPierce a mace that he stole from Wemmbu. Clown gives it to FerreMC. ClownPierce is seen helping [[ashswagg]] in [[The Invisible Mafia|The Mafia]].

ClownPierce and FerreMC destroy [[ManePear]]’s tree. Wemmbu and Eggchan escape by going into the nether. Wemmbu and eggchan agree to team with Parrot to kill ClownPierce.

Wemmbu distracts ClownPierce by fighting him while [[SpokeIsHere]] destroys the Mafia.

=== Season 2 ===
We got mentioned about Clown first that it is known that he executed [[Verda]] and citizens of "mining town" because they resisted to tell where the [[Verdaria]] was.

It is rumored that ClownPierce claimed the entire Nether dimension as [[Nether Civilization|his territory]]. He constructed a massive, highly-secured vault to store his wealth and began hunting any player who entered the dimension without permission. His goal was to create a monopoly over Netherite and other essential Nether resources.

ClownPierce’s growing monopoly eventually forced rivals into a desperate alliance. FlameFrags and Parrot (With [[TheobaldTheBird]]) launched a high-stakes infiltration mission with dual objectives: FlameFrags wanted to make an assassination of ClownPierce in order to get information about Wemmbu, while Parrot aimed to breach and loot his secure vault. But, they had some kind of accident, and Flame betrays Parrot and Theo and tells Clown where their location is in exchange for Wemmbu's location.

They then went to location of the birds <small>(Parrot and Theo)</small> and while Parrot gets to escape, Theo is being captured. Parrot jumped down attempting to negotiate, but in result got captured also.

Clown apologizes and tells Flame that he knows nothing about Wemmbu location and proceeds to execute Parrot, but Flame accepts it and tells Clown that they'd have to get through him first, betraying him in result. Clown runs away to catch Parrot so his vault isn't ransacked leaving his army behind.

Some time later, Clown is met by Parrot, who came to request an order of 40,000 TNT to use to defend his kingdom from [[Cindercrest]]. Clown, still holding a grudge against Parrot for raiding his vault, charges three times the price (60,000 diamonds up from 20,000). Parrot initially declines the offer, however Clown tells him that Cindercrest have already departed towards his kingdom, revealing that Cindercrest purchased goods from Clown prior to their conversation, and says they would stand no chance without potions, technology, or gear. Parrot reluctantly agrees to the deal and pays Clown the diamonds. Clown tells Parrot before he leaves that he is welcome to come back to him whenever he needs to buy more things, however warns him that if he comes back for any reason other than that, he would kill him.

title: CoinMonke
content:
CoinMonke, also known as Coin, is a supporting character in Unstable Universe. He formerly worked as a guard in Capital City. He betrayed Reddoons after the death of LuigiToan and escaped to the Far Lands. LuigiToans journal reveals that he and CoinMonke were friends before the events of Mining City, and it is implied that Luigi told Coin about the Far Lands and they planned to escape together before Coin became a warden at Capital City. 

Personality
CoinMonke first appears as a rude and nagging individual, being in charge of collecting the diamond quotas in Capital City. He gives numerous amounts of threats to the workers, and is quick to burst at them when offended. He is strict and often belittles the workers if they are not producing enough diamonds.

It is later revealed that he heavily dislikes the thought of killing, unable to kill ParrotX2 or LuigiToan during the roulette events of I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City. His pacifism lead to him being fired by Reddoons, however CoinMonke returns to Mining City for LuigiToans funeral, showing how sensitive he can be. He also offers to assist in the uprising against Capital City, however, Parrot and Wifies insist on Coin going home because he had everything to lose. Despite this Coin stays behind to protect his friends, and while Dean, Wifies, and Parrot were being threatened by Ashwagg and the Mafia, CoinMonke pulls their stasis and helps them escape, showing how loyal and determined he is to stand for what is right.    

CoinMonke, although he was a minor character, had great character development, and was loyal to his friends after he realized how corrupt Reddoons was.    

 History 
LuigiToan and CoinMonke are revealed to be formerly friends in a book.

Parrot, Wifies, and deanthebean9 are forced to mine for diamonds for Reddoons in capital city and have to reach a quota of 10,000 diamond blocks. They find a group of miners with CoinMonke as the warden.

Parrot and his friends steal from Capital city vaults. Parrot gives PikaTM more than 3,000 diamond blocks so CoinMonke lets him free. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital city for them to be set free.

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen.

Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. 

CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

Parrot overhears Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that ashswagg suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and the Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they say no. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber and they escape.

CoinMonke escapes to Far Lands.

CoinMonke is part of a team that tries to break into the Tomb of the Mafia and is the only member who survives. He joins Parrot and TheobaldTheBird when they journey back to the closer end islands.

title: Conexion
content:
Conexion, also known as Sharpness, is a supporting character of Unstable Universe Season Two. 

Personality
He is confiding and a little bit silly, And is shown to be able to be tricked pretty easily, Shown in FlameFrags's Video "I Got REVENGE on the Unstable SMP".

 History 

Conexion was a competitor in a PVP tournament.

Conexion steals one of Wemmbu's maces called "Crucible" using a pot. Wemmbu chases him into the Farlands to get it back, where Conexion almost falls into the void. Wemmbu ends up saving him and asks for the mace back, but Sharpness secretly hides it in his ender chest instead.

Later, Sharpness and The Avengers hunt Wemmbu down. Sharpness gives Wemmbu's mace to FlameFrags, thinking that he knew a duplication glitch. Flame eventually fools him before the fight with Wemmbu, The Avengers lost the battle after Flame betrayed them, and Conexion flees. After that Flame returns Wemmbu his mace back.

 Trivia 
His skin is based off Saber Alter from Fate Universe.
He is one of the antagonists in the scripted minecraft series Heartless Horizon.
