title: Deanthebean9
content:
deanthebean9, more commonly known as Dean, was a supporting character in Unstable Universe. Dean was a teammate of ParrotX2 and Wifies, and a former member of The Invisible Mafia, Dean was portrayed as an unintelligent and relatively unskilled player. 

History
While Parrot and Wifies fly to create an End Civilization. They notice an invisible player following them. They use the totem of the player revealing he is deanthebean9. Parrot and Wifies allow him to join the civilization. 

Parrot goes into the Mafia’s base to get rid of deanthebean9's stasis chamber. They are successful in getting rid of it. 

The civilization is eventually taken over by the Mafia. 

Parrot, Wifies, and deanthebean9 try to steal from Capital City. They are caught by Reddoons and five guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. He says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks. 

They find a group of miners, with CoinMonke as the warden. Parrot and his friends steal from Capital city vaults. Parrot gives PikaTM more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital City for them to be set free. 

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. CoinMonke is fired. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in a vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

The miners overhear Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that ashswagg suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal diamonds from Reddoons for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and the Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they decline. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber.

Parrot and his team run away. The Mafia stops chasing them. The Mafia finds them underground and begin blowing up the area. They are able to escape. The team goes into the nether, and again, the Mafia finds them there and begins exploding the area. Using suspicious stew giving fire resistance, they go underground and escape to the overworld.

While boating, a Mafia member finds them. They manage to use the players totem of undying by exploding them with a TNT minecart. He is teleported to the void for not being invisible. While inside of an ancient city, Mafia members come in and begin exploding the ancient city. A warden spawns. They escape to the nether. After travelling a million blocks out, they find two players, R4trick and Finiahn, who agree to help them cross an obsidian wall that is owned by the Mafia. R4trick says there are thousands of Mafia members.

Parrot starts destroying an iron farm, but the Mafia members find them destroying it, and R4trick runs away. They escape using invisibility. They loot a trial chamber, but find that all of the ominous vaults were removed. They hear people who are revealed in a later episode to be SpokeIsHere and his friends, and start mining out. They go to the nether to escape.

They go onto the nether roof with horses and begin making it to the farlands. The Mafia finds them and begins killing them. They escape to the overworld.

Right before getting to the farlands, deanthebean9 tells Parrot that he has been the reason the Mafia found them every time. Deanthebean9 leaves because he feels guilty.

Parrot finds deanthebean9 in a house, but Parrot still doesn’t trust him. 

Deanthebean9 joins the Mafia to secretly help Parrot and regain trust. Parrot goes to visit deanthebean9, but sees he isn’t there. Parrot sees a bunch of TNT bomber planes heading towards spawn. He pops the totem of undying of one of the Mafia members, revealing it is deanthebean9. Deanthebean9 is teleported into the void and dies. 

 Trivia 

 The 9 in the username deanthebean9 is due to the fact that the first 8 iterations of "deanthebean" were already taken.
 Dean held onto the goat horn that Parrot and Wifies gave him at the start of "The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands".

Dean's Goat Horn was a goat horn (Yearn) given to deanthebean9 by Wifies after being told by Parrot to give it to him. It was an item that Dean would use if he was ever in danger, since as Parrot said, Dean was not smart enough to use messages. Dean asks if he can join Parrot but Parrot refuses as the reason for Dean leaving the team was because he had been leaking there coordinates to the Mafia, a team who was hunting them. Parrot says that he can't trust Dean, Dean asks if there is a way that he can make it so Parrot trusts him again, Parrot says not yet and leaves. However Parrot and Dean fight after Dean re-joins the mafia but instead of helping the mafia he helps Parrot, however Parrot tries to kill him because he is invisible and Parrot doesn't know its Dean. Dean was not smart to message Parrot, so he know that its him, so he will surivle. After Parrot popped Dean's totem, he blew the horn one last time before being teleported into the void by the mafia, the punishment if you ever lost your invisibility. The Horn falls in the void and despawns.

title: Deputy Ace
content:
Deputy_Ace, or Ace was a major antagonist in Unstable Universe. He is the secondary antagonist of The Kings Arc serving as LettuceK’s right hand man, alongside The Law Elite Force.

 Personality 
Deputy_Ace is a serious and loyal member of The Law, however he is shown to really question LettuceK's decision making and overall view on "justice." His views were shown when he opposed using an orbital cannon on the people of the Great Sea, executing Wemmbu, and assassinating Parrot. 

 History 
Deputy_Ace is seen briefly in FlameFrags video 100 Hunters VS Minecraft Combat Master as someone who sits at the desk and guards the prison. 

Deputy_Ace is confronts LettuceK, informing him that all the lawmen are dead. Lettuce tells him that what Unstable needs is a king. 

Deputy_Ace along with loppezz take Wemmbu and displays him being captured to the entire server during LettuceK's speech. Ace, along with loppezz and LettuceK bring Wemmbu back to the prison however, SpokeIsHere splashes them with invisibility. Wemmbu later gets caught due to a player snitching on him.  

Deputy_Ace hunts down FlameFrags despite him being exiled. Flame outruns him and kills his horse. FlameFrags practices a new strategy he found with Lomedy and his farmers until he gets confronted by Ace. Ace fights FlameFrags and leaves afterwards, promising to bring more players. After he returns, his army raids Lomedy's farm and attacks FlameFrags. Flame is able to kill the army until they begin using slow falling. Flame loses again and Lomedy gets arrested by The Law.

He was present when Wemmbu arrived at The Law's Great Sea base to destroy the orbital cannon, however hesitated to fire the cannon which lead to it being destroyed, and ultimately chose not to pursue Wemmbu, allowing him to escape.  

Deputy_Ace sabotages the prison, allowing Parrot to escape. 

Deputy_Ace is instructed by LettuceK to kill Parrot and TheobaldTheBird. He refuses, killing the other netherite Law soldiers, giving them the gear, and helps them escape. Deputy_Ace gives his pickaxe to TheobaldTheBird and holds off The Law. He is ultimately killed by SargeLAW.  

 Thumbnails 

 Trivia 
 Deputy_Ace is one of LettuceK's only two friends, the other being loppezz, as mentioned by LettuceK on a reaction of the Parrot Law Arc Finale. The rest of the Elite Force are just "coworkers."

Deputy_Ace is confronts [[LettuceK]], informing him that all the lawmen are dead. Lettuce tells him that what Unstable needs is a king. 

Deputy_Ace along with [[loppezz]] take [[Wemmbu]] and displays him being captured to the entire server during LettuceK's speech. Ace, along with loppezz and LettuceK bring Wemmbu back to the prison however, [[SpokeIsHere]] splashes them with invisibility. Wemmbu later gets caught due to a player snitching on him.  

Deputy_Ace hunts down [[FlameFrags]] despite him being exiled. Flame outruns him and kills his horse. FlameFrags practices a new strategy he found with [[Lomedy]] and his farmers until he gets confronted by Ace. Ace fights FlameFrags and leaves afterwards, promising to bring more players. After he returns, his army raids Lomedy's farm and attacks FlameFrags. Flame is able to kill the army until they begin using slow falling. Flame loses again and Lomedy gets arrested by The Law.

He was present when Wemmbu arrived at The Law's Great Sea base to destroy the orbital cannon, however hesitated to fire the cannon which lead to it being destroyed, and ultimately chose not to pursue Wemmbu, allowing him to escape.  

Deputy_Ace sabotages the prison, allowing Parrot to escape. 

Deputy_Ace is instructed by LettuceK to kill Parrot and [[TheobaldTheBird]]. He refuses, killing the other netherite Law soldiers, giving them the gear, and helps them escape. Deputy_Ace gives his pickaxe to TheobaldTheBird and holds off The Law. He is ultimately killed by [[SargeLaw|SargeLAW]].

title: Derapchu
content:
Derapchu is a character in Unstable Universe. He's a former member working for Spoke to take over the Unstable SMP, and a member of Bounty Assassin Team. 

 Personality 
Derapchu is a sincere and funny character, he is loyal to his cause and dislikes people who disagree with his ideas, such as Kenadian or Spoke. He is incredibly loyal to Jumperwho and they have always been on the same team. He is willing to do what he needs to in order to survive, although he is willing to put everything on the line for his team. Since joining BAT, we see a more insecure and gentle side of him. He is insecure due to the way people often dismiss him and dumb and airheaded, although he admittedly is clumsy and gets into bad situations. He feels the need to overcompensate for his lack of general ability and the fact that he always seems to need saving, as well as various other factors. He is often overly apologetic even when no one is blaming him, due to the fact he is so used to being the cause of issues. This insecurity, though, pushes him to do better, which leads to him risking his life and saving ParrotX2 from MrCube6. 

 History 

 Season 1 
Derapchu is hired to be a guard of one of The Wonders.

Derapchu is convinced to not let ParrotX2 fire an Orbital Strike Cannon. Derapchu later agrees to team with Parrot to build a new orbital cannon to stop an orbital cannon from destroying the Frosted Palace Wonder.

Derapchu is seen as a guard for Spoke in an end base.

Derapchu is chunk banned in an ocean.

Parrot and Rekrap2 free Derapchu by destroying the chunk ban. Derapchu agrees to team with Parrot to break more people out.

Parrot and Rekrap and Derapchu go over to the next prison, which is built in a jungle. They start breaking into the prison. They manage to explode the chunk ban using a TNT cannon.

While travelling to the Zam Empire, the server crashes. When they join, they are sent back to a previous save. It turns out that PrinceZam had added a new defense which makes it so that the server crashes when getting too close to certain locations. This is called a memory ban.

The team go to a nether prison, and try to break in. They discover that there are three chunk bans in this prison. They manage to destroy one of the chunk bans.

They move onto an ice themed prison. Using flying machines, they are able to free Fantst. Fantst agrees to join their team to break people out of prisons.

They go to a sky prison. They are able to destroy the chunk ban.

Fantst chunk bans himself as he thinks that the prisons will just get harder and harder to break people out of.

They go to a new end prison and use TNT minecarts to destroy the chunk ban. The player released has no interest of teaming with them. The team goes over to the first end prison they went to, and easily destroy the chunk ban using TNT minecarts. The player freed is JumperWho, who agrees to help them.

The team uses the nether to avoid the memory bans that crash the server. They find the prison that holds Spoke and Wifies and try to break in. They retreat back to a cave to plan an escape. They figure out how they can chunk ban the guards. They set up an underground chunk ban setup, and have JumperWho lead the guards to the chunk ban. They manage to chunk ban all of the guards. Parrot is able to get _Kenadian_ to help them break out Spoke and Wifies using a wither bore. They kill the baby piglins which are holding chunk bans using flying machines and TNT minecarts. They are successful in breaking out Wifies. They also accidentally break out Spoke.

Derapchu is seen as a part of Leow0ok’s team to kill ClownPierce.

Parrot is sent to get a heart of the sea for a quest. This heart of the sea is Derapchu’s most prized possession.

Parrot, Wifies, JumperWho, _Kenadian_, Rekrap2, and Derapchu are put inside of a prison called Proton by ClownPierce. They escape the prison by making a honey stasis chamber and having Wemmbu give them contraband items.

 Season 2 
Derapchu joins Bounty Assassin Team

The Director hires MrCube6 to assasinate Parrot by trapping him under the void. Derapchu finds Parrot and saves him. Parrot sees an invisible player sitting in one of the chairs.

Derapchu is trapped by MrCube6 on a pressure plate. Parrot and the team have to figure out which redstone lines to activate to save him and the entire base from exploding within a certain amount of time. MrCube6 also says that he sent a TNT bomber plane towards their base. They are able to save Derapchu.

Parrot sets up a trap and catches MrCube6. They trap him in a prison. MrCube6 manages to escape. MrCube6 steals all of the gear shulker boxes from the headquarters. MrCube6 gives these items to 4CVIT. Parrot and Derapchu take the shulker boxes of items back. A team of bandits try to steal from Parrot and Derapchu, but fail.

BAT finds MrCube6 and detains him. They interrogate MrCube6. They give MrCube6 a dandelion. MrCube6 escapes with a stasis chamber, but not before he gives Parrot a book. The book states something about a dandelion, implying that The Director somehow knew that MrCube6 got a dandelion.

Parrot finds a chest in his room with a sign saying to run. Inside the chest is two stacks of ender pearls and an invisibility potion. The BAT Headquarters go into lockdown mode, so Parrot uses an invisibility potion and hides. BAT tries to find Parrot to presumably kill him. Parrot flies away to make his own base.

BAT finds Parrot and claim that he’s The Director. Parrot runs to the nether. They find Parrot on the nether roof. Parrot manages to escape.

Parrot spies on BAT’s meeting with the help of JumperWho. JumperWho betrays him revealing his location. Parrot manages to escape during the chaos. 

BAT watches Parrot and The Director have a conversation, which convinces BAT that Parrot is not The Director.

The BAT headquarters is destroyed by TruOriginal who uses a hack to use other people's usernames and skins. TruOriginal tries to kill them. Leow0ok stays behind so BAT can escape. Leow0ok eventually escapes and finds BAT.

TruOriginal tries to kill them but eventually runs away. BAT make a new base and guard it. TruOriginal tries to kill them again. BAT lead TruOriginal into a trap to try and kill him, but he teleports Parrot into the trap, almost killing him. He is luckily able to escape. They pretend that they have a second trap and scare TruOriginal away.

Derapchu and Leow0ok are kidnapped by TruOriginal while they are sleeping.

Nufuli leaves the team, and as he is leaving, the Director kills him. They see the Director and try to kill him.

Derapchu is trapped in an obsidian box by the Director. He is later saved by Leow0ok who uses a happy ghast to save him.

Derapchu works as a guard in Paragon.

title: District 13
content:
District 13 was a rebellion against The Invisible Mafia (inspired by District 13 shown in the Hunger Games).

It was founded by ParrotX2, along with his allies Wifies, Wato1876, Kenadian, TheobaldTheBird, R4trick, Finahn, Derapchu, Rekrap2, and JumperWho. It was built by Horace_Altman who later left the same day it was founded.

Later District 13 would be reformed to fight The Law and LettuceK with ParrotX2 and SpokeIsHere as their leaders. Horace Altman would come back to rebuild the base and it would be continued to use as the HQ of the resistance.

 History 
District 13 is founded by some the former members of Far Lands. After the main headquarters were created, Horace decided to leave and join the Mafia.  

Some district 13 members go looking for new people to add to the team, Parrot was suspicious of the person they found (Yusai) and killed the new member.

SpokeIsHere and Mapicc are added to District 13 as they find a book allegedly containing the coordinates of where every stasis chamber is stored. They go to the coordinates and find a new book appearing to be coordinates to something else. District 13 is disappointed as they believe the book is likely fake.

Everyone but Parrot and Wifies either leave District 13 or join the Mafia due to minimal progress.

Wemmbu and eggchan join District 13. Spoke, Mapicc, Wemmbu, eggchan, and Parrot break into the spawn prison where they force people to join the Mafia. Wato1876 and Kenadian help them. The team eventually succeeds in destroying every stasis chamber.

By the time of the Unstable SMP election, the former resistance base had been turned into a town by a small group of players. Parrot, Theo, Horace, and Fymada would arrive at the base seeking to use it as a staging ground for a rebellion against LettuceK and The Law, where they would ally with it's new inhabitants. Horace would restore the base to it's former glory, and with the arrival of reinforcements in the form of Spoke, Mapicc, Wemmbu, FlameFrags, PrinceZam, JumperWho, JadenMAN, MinuteTech, and other recruits; the District 13 resistance group was officially reformed and set out to defeat The Law in a final confrontation at the Northern Council. At the end of the battle of the Northern Council, District 13 would decide the fate of LettuceK allowing him to live however imprisoning him for life.
Category:Teams

Trivia

 Named after a destroyed district from the Hunger Games trilogy.
 The alliance made to destroy The Law has also been called The Ultimate Alliance. It has also been called The Avengers (Not to be confused with The Avengers created by Jaden_Man)

Parrot, Theo, Horace, and Fymada would arrive at the base seeking to use it as a staging ground for a rebellion against LettuceK and The Law, where they would ally with it's new inhabitants. Horace would restore the base to it's former glory, and with the arrival of reinforcements in the form of Spoke, Mapicc, Wemmbu, FlameFrags, PrinceZam, JumperWho, JadenMAN, MinuteTech, and other recruits; the District 13 resistance group was officially reformed and set out to defeat The Law in a final confrontation at the Northern Council. At the end of the battle of the Northern Council, District 13 would decide the fate of LettuceK allowing him to live however imprisoning him for life.

title: Dominating Minecraft's Deadliest PVP Tournament
content:
Dominating Minecraft's Deadliest PVP Tournament is the 51st episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

 Plot 
FlameFrags participates in a PVP tournament hosted by AJTHEBOLD to get another rematch against Wemmbu. The point of the tournament is to determine who is the strongest PVPer. Each fighter has 3 totems. If all of them pop they get their stasis pulled back into the lobby and get disqualified.

Flame first fights Willsion and easily beats him. Flame then watches other players fight including WyLL, FerreMC, Wemmbu, Conexion, and  TheobaldTheBird which actually kills his enemy. AJ has Horace Altman clean out the arena. 

Flame teases Wemmbu by taking his shulker boxes and beating him up with his fists. Flame then watches Wemmbu fight Wyll which Wemmbu wins. Flame fights Ferre and gives a recap of Ferre's playstyle in fighting and his past. Flame beats Ferre and goes into the minigames to talk with the other contestants. It was there Flame realized the power of Theo's carts so he decided to go into Merchant City to buy blast protection. Flame then fights Theo and switches his netherite leggings with his diamond leggings with blast protection periodically to negate the cart's damage and switch back to his protection IV leggings to block Theo's melee damage. Flame wins and then moves into the finals.

Wemmbu and Flame begin preparing for their match. When the finals start, Wemmbu begins macing Flame while also using melee. However, it didn't take long for Flame to figure out his pattern and block his mace hits. Flame ends up popping Wemmbu's totem after comboing him. Flame taunts Wemmbu until he pops his totem by pillaring up and macing him multiple times. Wemmbu eventually ends up running out of wind charges and has to use armour stands + his wind burst mace to launch himself but Flame already knew he was going to do that thus avoiding him when he does that. Wemmbu's helmet and leggings break. Flame's armour breaks too letting Wemmbu pop his totem. Wemmbu's chestplate breaks and Flame shoots him, popping his totem again. Flame pops Wemmbu for the third time making him win the tournament. Flame begins teasing Wemmbu after he wins the tournament.

Echoes or Memories are strange, looping phenomenons that are found beyond the Far Lands and are prevalent in The Underworld's fields. Echoes are physical replays of moments in the Unstable Universe seemingly stuck in a loop infinitely, consisting of both detailed structures and simulated player entities from the past.

 List of Echos  

 Player Entities
 The Burgle5 echo (a documentation of a player wandering through the farlands and starving to death)
 The Founding echo (a documentation of the founding of the Zam Empire, which included FlameFrags, ManePear, Pangi, Sorhin, and PrinceZam)
 Structures:
 A perfect copy of the Zam Empire before it was blown up by Wemmbu during the Prince Zam Empire Arc

title: Eggchan
content:
Eggchan, or simply Egg, is Wemmbu's best friend and teammate on the Unstable SMP.

 Personality 
Eggchan is a composed and lighthearted individual. He claims his eye 'sees all,' but his render distance says otherwise. He always allies himself with Wemmbu and is one of the few people he trusts. When he's first introduced, Egg was originally a pacifist, claiming that wars can only produce more wars, but in recent episodes, he forgoes this sentiment in favor of the belief that 'sometimes death is the only answer.' He is generally distrusting and picks up on other players odd or sneaky behavior very quickly.     

Egg is more than willing to risk himself to save others that he trusts as seen in recent videos. He is usually depicted as the brains between Wemmbu and himself, although he is seen as a more unskilled and unserious player than his ally. He enjoys simple and calm tasks, such as fishing, saying that after he escaped Proton, he was going to go somewhere to fish for the rest of his time of the server. He opposes lying and advocated protecting the Snow Civilization from the Mafia, rather than using its citizens to advance Wemmbu’s training.    

 History 
Season 1
PrinceZam tells Wemmbu to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make him a colony to help guard a vault he has. PrinceZam also tells him not to ever go inside. Wemmbu gets his friend eggchan to help him build this empire.

FlameFrags tries to kill them, but using a TNT minecart trap they are able to escape. Eggchan accidentally breaks all of Wemmbu’s armor.

A team of people including Jaden_MAN come and try to kill them. They are able to win the war against them using traps.

Wemmbu has a professional builder, Horace_Altman help build the empire. They invite a couple of people to the empire.

ClownPierce is seen chasing an invisible player, ParrotX2. He kills Wemmbu and eggchan's villagers to try and get information out of Wemmbu and eggchan, but they say they don't have any good information. Parrot leaves.

Wemmbu and eggchan go over to Parrot’s testing base and take a lot of useful items, two sets of netherite armor, golden apples, etc.

Wemmbu tells eggchan that he heard Merffinn and ManePear messing with their rail gun. They discover that they broke the rail gun. Wemmbu and eggchan decide to see what is inside the vault. They dig down and discover there is nothing in it.

Parrot comes back and asks if they can protect him. They agree to do so for now. Parrot builds chunk bans around the colony to stop intruders.

A team of people including Jaden_MAN and FlameFrags invade the colony. The empire manages to get them to run away, but the entrance of the colony is destroyed. Parrot leaves the empire. FlameFrags comes back and tries to kill Wemmbu and eggchan. PrinceZam logs on and FlameFrags stops killing them and leaves. PrinceZam comes and says that his original plan was to get rid of them by having FlameFrags kill him, but now he sees he’s too weak to be a threat to the Zam Empire.

Wemmbu goes to his Orbital Strike Cannon to try and destroy the Zam Empire but sees the orbital cannon has been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam Empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and eggchan set up a job where people can hire them to blow up things. Roshambogames hires Wemmbu and eggchan to blow up SpokeIsHere’s end base. They are successful in doing so. Woogiex hires them to blow up FerreMC’s base. They find that Ferre has a secret tunnel system in his tower, so they go to investigate. Ferre catches him and Wemmbu tries to escape. He goes underground, and eventually Ferre leaves. Wemmbu and eggchan come back to destroy the base. 

They send three TNT missiles to destroy the base. They are able to destroy the base using TNT, and are able to escape by going underground. Woogiex gives Wemmbu and eggchan their payment of a shulker box of netherite ingots. Woogiex says that all of the members of the team against ClownPierce disappeared.

Wemmbu and eggchan discover that PrinceZam has started taking over spawn. Once they are far enough from the Zam Empire, ManePear says that he’s not a big fan of being a guard of PrinceZam, and that if they need help, he can help him.

ManePear tells Wemmbu and eggchan to go over to the treasure hunters base and gives them coordinates to go to. Once there, they see two players, Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. It turns out that Kier and Dev are working for Boosfer. They say they’re not the treasure hunters, but this is a lie. Boosfer pays them to destroy "the valley". Wemmbu goes to destroy the valley alone.

Parrot and Wifies help Wemmbu build an orbital cannon to destroy Boosfers base. Wemmbu agrees to only use one shot on Boosfer and one shot on PrinceZam. They use the orbital cannon, withers, and TNT to destroy their headquarters. Wemmbu finds their obsidian vault of items. Wemmbu steals thousands of netherite blocks and thousands of diamond blocks.

Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and his civilization try to use the orbital cannon to destroy the Zam empire but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray the Zam empire.

== Personality ==
Eggchan is a composed and lighthearted individual. He claims his eye 'sees all,' but his render distance says otherwise. He always allies himself with Wemmbu and is one of the few people he trusts. When he's first introduced, Egg was originally a pacifist, claiming that wars can only produce more wars, but in recent episodes, he forgoes this sentiment in favor of the belief that 'sometimes death is the only answer.' He is generally distrusting and picks up on other players odd or sneaky behavior very quickly.     

Egg is more than willing to risk himself to save others that he trusts as seen in recent videos. He is usually depicted as the brains between Wemmbu and himself, although he is seen as a more unskilled and unserious player than his ally. He enjoys simple and calm tasks, such as fishing, saying that after he escaped Proton, he was going to go somewhere to fish for the rest of his time of the server. He opposes lying and advocated protecting the [[Snow Civilization]] from the Mafia, rather than using its citizens to advance Wemmbu’s training.

Wemmbu and eggchan go over to the [[Ice Mountain Civilization]], and find some players from the [[Skyblock Civilization]]. The Mafia begins attacking them. One of the diamond tier mafia players and Wemmbu agree to have a 1v1. The other Mafia members join into the fight because Wemmbu uses a restock shulker box, so Wemmbu and eggchan run away.

ManePear gives Wemmbu back his mace that Wemmbu paid him with for training. ManePear has them kill the Mafia members in the ice mountain. They are able to kill the gold tier players. They see ManePear fighting a diamond tier player. The Mafia member escapes. ManePear helps Wemmbu learn how to use the mace.

ManePear tries to convince Wemmbu to give him the mace. ManePear tells the Mafia about eggchan breaking the rules of the Mafia and not being invisible, so his stasis chamber is activated. Wemmbu tries to break eggchan out of an obsidian prison and uses the totem of undying of one of the Mafia members, revealing that they are FlameFrags. Wemmbu gives him the mace so that he doesn’t kill eggchan. FlameFrags gives the mace to ClownPierce.

ClownPierce and FerreMC destroy ManePear’s tree. Wemmbu and eggchan agree to team with Parrot to kill ClownPierce. Together, they kill a diamond tier mafia player by trapping them in an obsidian box, granting Wemmbu a mace. Wemmbu says that he was the one who killed the diamond tier player, and that Parrot and Wifies didn’t help. Wemmbu leaves.

Wemmbu tries to kill ClownPierce and FerreMC but fails. FerreMC threatens to kill eggchan if Wemmbu doesn’t let ClownPierce kill him. Ferre fails to kill eggchan and he escapes. They almost kill Ferre by breaking all of his armor. Ferre gives them their mace to not die.

Wemmbu and eggchan distract the Mafia while Parrot, Spoke, and [[Mapicc]] break into the spawn prison. Wemmbu and eggchan eventually go inside of the prison and find Parrot there. Everyone goes back to the base. Parrot tells them that Wifies died. The Mafia starts killing them.

Wemmbu, [[Wato1876]], and eggchan distract ClownPierce by trying to kill him while Spoke and Mapicc destroy the Mafia. They eventually leave by using a fishing rod stasis chamber. Spoke and Mapicc end the Mafia.

===Season 2===
Wemmbu and eggchan travel millions of blocks out to make a base. [[TheobaldTheBird]] secretly follows them as he wants to PvP someone. Theo leaves. Wemmbu and eggchan set up a trap with the creaking. Theo destroys their base again. _Kenadian_ helps Wemmbu and Eggchan make their base more secure. Theo breaks into the base and tries to kill Wemmbu. Theo threatens to kill _Kenadian_ if Wemmbu doesn’t have a fair fight with him. TheobaldTheBird eventually runs from the fight.

While Wemmbu and eggchan are building a creeper farm, a group of players come over and try to kill Wemmbu for stealing their bottles of enchanting. Wemmbu kills almost the entire team. Wemmbu invites Wato1876 to [[Egg Civilization|an empire]] that Wemmbu and eggchan are building at ManePear’s tree.

Wemmbu and eggchan go to Pangi’s base. Pangi gives them free bottles of enchanting. Wemmbu sees [[Spongs]] being robbed by Jaden_MAN and his team. Wemmbu saves Spongs.

Wemmbu goes back to the base and sees that Horace_Altman greatly improved the civilization. Wemmbu steals two shulker boxes of bottles of enchanting from a group of players. Wemmbu sees that eggchan invited Spongs to the civilization. Wemmbu follows Spongs and sees that he goes over to a pirate themed base. Wemmbu comes back to the civilization. Jaden_MAN and his team threaten to kill eggchan if Wemmbu does not drop all of his stuff and all of the stuff in his ender chest.

Jaden_MAN exiles Wemmbu to the [[Pirate Islands]]. Wemmbu sees eggchan who was captured by three pirates. Wemmbu kills the pirates and frees eggchan.

Wemmbu and eggchan find two players in diamond armor. They try to loot the items in their house, but the two players, loppezz and [[LettuceK]] find them. Wemmbu and eggchan threaten to blow up the entire island, killing them, if they don’t give them their gear.

A team of pirates try to kill Wemmbu and eggchan. Wemmbu and eggchan are captured. Wemmbu finds an ender chest and uses his mace in it to kill the pirates.

Wemmbu and eggchan find Jaden_MAN and try to kill him. While fighting him, someone bombs Jaden’s castle. TheobaldTheBird tells Wemmbu and eggchan that he was secretly helping him. Wemmbu and TheobaldTheBird try to kill Jaden_MAN.

Wemmbu and eggchan follow Jaden_MAN into an [[The Abandoned Civilization|abandoned civilization]]. Wemmbu and eggchan eventually are able to trap Jaden_MAN in the civilization with no items.

Wemmbu stops wearing his armor due to it having trims which is rare on the server, and he wants to avoid being robbed. Wemmbu and eggchan see who tries to rob him, but Wemmbu kills him. Wemmbu and eggchan get gear. Wemmbu and eggchan find a group of players who try to kill them. They are able to kill them using a mace. They find a new group of players and steal two of their cows for leather. They find Wemmbu and try to kill him, but he eventually manages to escape.

Eggchan follows Wemmbu questing through the [[Far Lands]] in an attempt to recover Wemmbu's breach-enchanted mace. Eggchan did not have an elytra, forcing Wemmbu to walk with him. 

They fight some original members of the server, and Eggchan gets knocked into the end. He is now trapped due to the fact he set his spawn out in the farlands. When MinuteTech goes missing, Egg hides in a wall. 

Wemmbu is told by Spoke that all Eggchan has to do to leave the end is to throw an ender pearl through the end portal. Eggchan leaves the end. Him and Wemmbu travel to The Great Sea by a dolphin tunnel while being chased by Law. They are cornered at The Great Sea but is saved by Jaden_Man. They join Jaden's pirate civilization. 

In Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea, Eggchan is with Wemmbu for a part of the video and attempts to make himself leader of the remnants of The Pirates after Jaden_Man's capture. Not much of importance occurs other than Lettuce attempting and failing to recruit Egg into the LAW. 

In [[2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters]], Egg was there with Wemmbu when Parrot wanted to talk because he needed Wemmbu for the election debate. Egg stays behind in the Pirate Civilization. He is seen infiltrating under the disguise of a law member to help Parrot and Wemmbu, when asked why by Parrot, he responds that he simply wanted to. After a short while, Egg is instructed by Wemmbu to box Parrot in and Wemmbu then blames Parrot for revealing his identity after a short conversation. Egg helps Parrot convince Wemmbu to go to the debate speech after they try to find the smugglers at the graveyard. It is then revealed that the person was a member of The LAW and sets off a TNT minecart, blowing up the whole area. Egg, Wemmbu, and Parrot survived but not before it is revealed 4CVIT had made an ender pearl cannon so that they could return to the Farlands. 

Eggchan is present in The fall of LAW. He calls for Lettuce to be spared. Afterwards an invisible player(s) start stalking Eggchan and Wemmbu. 

Eggchan is then taken hostage by the Sculk Kingdom under orders of Arachn1d. They push for Eggchan to drop his book containing the servers history and secrets with coordinates and notes from earliest days of the server.   

Wemmbu destroys the Sculk Kingdom to let Eggchan be free. Eggchan is forced to give up his book though. 

At first the Invisible Player simply tries to get a mace from Wemmbu (In which he fails) The Invisible Player watches Wemmbu destroy the [[Sculk Kingdom]] and is interested in Eggchan's book. After the civilization is destroyed the invisible player steals Eggchan's book. 

The invisible player realises all of the secrets in Eggchan's book. After that he sets out to kill him to make sure no one else ever finds out about these secrets. 

Other players such as Arachn1d realises how valuable Eggchan really is. 

The invisible player hunts down Eggchan and Wemmbu protects him. Wemmbu gives Eggchan his mace, Crucible. Wemmbu fights an Invisible Assassin and kills him but by that point The other Invisible players succesfully track down Eggchan and kidnap him.  

Somewhere in that point the [[Invisible Guy|invisible players]] lose Eggchan again and cooperate with [[Cindercrest]] to find him. Flamefrags and the invisible player succesfully finds Eggchan. FlameFrags says that Cindercrest needs to ask Eggchan some questions because of how valuable he is. 

FlameFrags accidentaly leads the Invisible Player to where he is keeping Eggchan. The Invisible Player decides to steal Eggchan for himself. 

Wemmbu, FlameFrags, Jaden MAN, Yungyx, and Arachn1d all arrive at an island. The invisible player says he will sell Eggchan to the player who gives the highest price. Wemmbu loses his patience and uses his orbital strikes to blow up the island. A battle begins with all sides fighting each other so that they can have Eggchan. 

Finally the Invisible Player demands the battle to stop. He says he has Eggchan's statis chamber and can kill him at any moment. Then he continues the Auction. FlameFrags says he will give him some loot and his combat skills, Wemmbu says he will give him his entire enderchest but the Invisible Player seemed to had enough of this and decided to sell Eggchan to Arachn1d who promises him a lot of loot. In the end Wemmbu thinks about giving up Gambit but the Invisible Player already accepts Arachn1ds offer without giving the other people a chance.

* Eggchan owns a book full of thousands of coordinates to locations across the server. 
* He isn't very good at PvP. Many members joke with him over this fact.
* He has a bow named "How did you die to me", shown at 1:14:11 in [[2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master]]. Someone actually uploaded their POV of dying to Eggchan.
* He was unaware at first that the SMP was going to be heavily lore/combat based, lamenting that he wouldn't have joined if he had to be serious.

* In [[Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Player Civilization|Minecraft Pro vs 1000 Player Civillization]], it is seen that he has 7771 experience levels. 
* Eggchan is one of the few major characters who has been a part of the [[The Invisible Mafia|Invisible Mafia]] and [[The LAW|The Law]], the others being [[FlameFrags]] and [[Leow0ok]].

title: Eight-Fold
content:
Eight-Fold 
Eight-Fold is a game on the Unstable SMP. It's very similar to Poker.

In this game, players are each dispensed two different items. Each item has a different point value, ranging from Dirt with 1 point to Netherite Ingot with 8 points. 

Players place bets on their victory. All players must match or exceed the bet of the other. Whoever has the best hand wins. Players can also fold, automatically losing the game. 

People who have played Eight-Fold: 
ParrotX2 Rasplin

title: Ender Pearl Cannon
content:
Ender Pearl Cannon is a mechanism to teleport player or entities to a specific location on the server. It is widely used on the Unstable SMP.

 Mechanism 
Ender Pearl Cannon use TNT duper to provide momentum for aligned ender pearl and offsets velocity to determine target location. The pearl loads the chunks during travelling.

 History 
The Invisible Mafia used a pearl cannon to transport pearls from Spawn to Mafia Stasis Chambers, which Spoke went through to destroy the stases.

Wemmbu and Egg were exiled to Great Sea through a pearl cannon after Jaden took Egg as hostage and forced him to clear his inventory.

Wemmbu traveled to Far Lands to retrieve mace from Sharpness through a pearl cannon built by 4CVIT. Later the Avengers went through the same pearl cannon to hunt down Wemmbu.

The Director escaped through an ender pearl cannon near BAT Headquarters, and BAT followed them through, only to find themselves in a director-trimmed netherite zombie trap. Parrot changed the zombie trap to a void lava TNT dog trap and asked Theo to drain and corner the Invisible Knight and force them to use the same cannon in order to force reveal their identity.

Spoke went through a pearl cannon again built by 4CVIT that leads to a lighthouse and JamatoP's flowery mountain house near Far Lands. Wemmbu went through the same pearl cannon only to find he go to the wrong quadrant of the Far Lands.

[[Ender Pearl Cannon]] is a mechanism to teleport player or entities to a specific location on the server. It is widely used on the [[Unstable Universe|Unstable SMP]].

== Mechanism ==
Ender Pearl Cannon use TNT duper to provide momentum for aligned ender pearl and offsets velocity to determine target location. The pearl loads the chunks during travelling.

== History ==
[[The Invisible Mafia]] used a pearl cannon to transport pearls from [[Spawn]] to [[Mafia Stasis Chambers]], which [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] went through to destroy the stases.

[[Wemmbu]] and [[Eggchan|Egg]] were exiled to [[Great Sea]] through a pearl cannon after [[Jaden_MAN|Jaden]] took Egg as hostage and forced him to clear his inventory.

Wemmbu traveled to [[Far Lands]] to retrieve mace from [[Conexion|Sharpness]] through a pearl cannon built by [[4CVIT]]. Later [[the Avengers]] went through the same pearl cannon to hunt down Wemmbu.

[[The Director]] escaped through an ender pearl cannon near [[BAT Headquarters]], and [[BAT]] followed them through, only to find themselves in a director-trimmed netherite zombie trap. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] changed the zombie trap to a void lava TNT dog trap and asked [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]] to drain and corner [[the Invisible Knight]] and force them to use the same cannon in order to force reveal their identity.

[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] went through a pearl cannon again built by [[4CVIT]] that leads to a lighthouse and [[JamatoP]]'s flowery mountain house near [[Far Lands]]. [[Wemmbu]] went through the same pearl cannon only to find he go to the wrong quadrant of the Far Lands.

[[Spoke]] built a simplified pearl cannon for him, [[JumperWho|Jumper]] and [[PrinceZam|Zam]] to travel faster than [[Wemmbu]] and [[FlameFrags]] who had elytra or riptide trident to [[the Law]] base.

[[Null Hunters]] had a pearl cannon at coords (50,000, 50,000) to "Road of NULL" that was offset by [[Anticsparty06]] and later destroyed by [[_x_6_00]] when Spoke and Jumper tried to forcefully go through.

[[Mapicc]] led Spoke and Jumper through an ender pearl cannon that leads near [[Far Lands]] when escaping [[Null Hunters]] but [[Mapicc]] told them the target location was wrong so they had to find Mapicc and Revenant's camp in the Far Lands.

title: Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison
content:
Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison is the 50th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Parrot gets trapped in a cell in a prison named Paragon. Wifies arrives at the cell to give Parrot some food. He then leaves after. Parrot had snuck some items and he used his fishing rod to pull Wifies away from his flying machine and uses a wind charge to get on it and he escapes the cell. However upon escaping Parrot realizes that there's way more to this prison that just one cell. Wifies tells Parrot that it's impossible to escape the prison and that when Parrot realizes they will build a world where Parrot doesn't have to worry about dying and Wifies doesn't have to worry about Parrot dying.

Wifies clears all of Parrot's items and after he realizes that he has one boat left, he tells Parrot to throw his spyglass. Parrot throws his spyglass out of the tower they were standing on and asks Wifies why would he want his spyglass. Parrot plans on killing Wifies after this. Parrot crafts a wooden sword and upon seeing Wifies he tries to kill him but after his totem pops he got teleported away. After this Parrot rushes to get the spyglass he threw because it reminded him of who Wifies used to be before he faked his death. Parrot then tries to escape by bridging to the walls, however, 2 guards splash him with slow falling and push him off the bridge. Parrot decides to check the nether as well, however, there was also a wall there. Parrot decides to explore the prison and he finds Wifies' house. He burns the house down. Parrot decides to build his own house and also go fishing until Wifies shows up and starts fishing as well. Parrot plans on making it seem like he is escaping to distract the guards.

Parrot goes to the nether to trade with piglins for ender pearls to set a stasis at his house and also make it look like he is trying to escape through the nether roof and as soon as the guards find out they stop him from doing so. After his stasis activates he celebrates by taunting Wifies and starts towering to the walls of the prison until Wifies shows up and tells him to get down before he hurts himself. Parrot tries to convince Wifies that he gave up and he doesn't care if it takes weeks or even months to kill him and escape. Wifies pretends to go AFK and when Parrot decides to try to kill him using dripstone but Wifies moves away at the last second.

Over the next few weeks Parrot and Wifies play minigames like Hide and Seek, Parkour and more. Wifies opens the wall to the outside world and tells Parrot to take a look at those dandelions. Wifies also tells Parrot how he knew about the dandelions from when Parrot and BAT had imprisoned MrCube. Wifies told Parrot that he had leverage over Jumper and that if she didn't listen to him, he would leak the identities of all of her spies. Wifies tells Parrot that if you could control something that someone cares about, you can control that person and that's why the guards work in the prison 24/7 and without them the prison wouldn't function. Parrot and Wifies patch up the hole. Parrot manages to trap one of the guards and it was revealed to be Jumper. Jumper tells Parrot that she was a guard along with Leowook and Derapchu and she begs him not to escape because Wifies will just reveal the identities of her spies if he does. Wifies falls into the room that Parrot trapped Jumper in and dismisses her. Parrot tells Wifies that they can still leave the prison and go back to spawn or far away from spawn and he eventually realizes that it wont work on him.

Wifies tells Parrot that he has been tracking his entire inventory and starts telling him every item that he has. Wifies clears Parrot's inventory again except this time, Parrot keeps the spyglass since Wifies is unaware of his spyglass. Wifies brings Parrot back to the same tower where the cell from the beginning of the video is except this time he takes Parrot to a chamber that looks similar to the one that MrCube used to try to kill him. Wifies clears out his entire inventory too and tells Parrot to step on a pressure plate. Wifies also steps on the pressure plate and tells Parrot that if any of them step off of the pressure plate, the TNT below them explodes and they both die. Parrot shows Wifies the spyglass and tells him why he didn't let it despawn. Wifies tells Parrot that he killed that version of himself and that he had to and shouts out the guards' and Parrot tells Wifies that he never gave up on Wifies and he hoped that one day he would snap out of it and become who he used to be. He even tells Wifies that when he gets out of the prison he won't remember him as the person who did horrible things and killed people but as the person he used to be. Wifies tells Parrot to give him the spyglass before he hurts himself and Parrot responds by saying "It's all yours" just like that one time when Wifies gave him the spyglass before getting chunk banned by Spoke and drops his spyglass to the pressure plate. After Parrot leaves, Wifies starts to look back at all the memories he had with Parrot back when they were friends and he starts running for the spyglass. After getting the spyglass the TNT blows up and he dies in the explosion. 

The video concludes with Parrot getting some food and blocks and leaving the prison.

 Analysis 

 We learn how MrCube6 knew about the dandelion in the BAT's Prison dandelion incident - it was JumperWho, threatened by Wifies revealing all of her spies' identities.
 We learn about the philosophical principles of manipulation and people owning.
 The final act of Wifies grabbing the spyglass restores his sanity.
 The blow of Wifies, holding the spyglass, has symbolical contribution to the plot - it represents the lost genuine point of their friendship.

title: Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP
content:
Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP is the 92nd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
It's been a week since Wemmbu was put in solitary confinement and LettuceK lets him out of his cell. While Wemmbu was waiting out his time in solitary confinement, he thought about his previous escape attempt and how Spoke bypassed the security, meaning there's a way to escape. As the next day start, the prisoners get their food and begin their new job of tree chopping. Loppezz instructs the prison guard to only give the prisoners one milk bucket to mine, but the guard is lenient and gives them more. Fantst tries to smuggle a bucket to Wemmbu, but loppezz catches them and tells Wemmbu to drop the bucket, and Wemmbu drops all but one. Afterwards, they get to the inventory checking area, PrinceZam, Baablu, and Fantst all go before Wemmbu. They anger loppezz to the point where by the time Wemmbu goes in, she is yelling at the others while Wemmbu secretly puts the cake back into the chest, making him appear to have more inventory space than he does. He drops everything except a milk bucket, some logs, and one cake. They go back to their cells and loppezz says she's had enough and is taking a break. When the lights go off, Wemmbu crafts a full set of wooden tools, a boat, signs, and trapdoors. He gets rid of the evidence and waits out the night. 

A new day arrives and loppezz says she hired someone to whip them into shape. SargeRaxby says they will be the future of The Law and leads them to a rec room. SargeRaxby stands on stage, talking about how The Law has lots of enemies and has to be strong. While he's talking, Wemmbu picks up water from a nearby pond. SargeRaxby then makes them begin their training, starting off with archery and brings Baablu and Fantst up first. Wemmbu talks to Zam using signs, saying they need to come up with an actual plan to escape rather than doing the same things over and over again. Zam says they'll be put in solitary again, but Wemmbu says it's better to escape, and they need to plan with Baablu and Fantst as well. Zam thinks they should leave the two, but Wemmbu says they all need to work together or else Lettuce will execute him. They try to break the sign, but the mining fatigue makes it too slow, so they come up with a plan while they can. Wemmbu tells Zam to take the blame about having the sign, and Wemmbu asks Zam if he has any invisibility in his ender chest, in which he doesn't. The sergeant catches them writing on a sign and scolds Zam while he begs for his life. Wemmbu gets Fantst and asks if he has invisibility potions, but Fantst says he doesn't know. The sergeant catches them and breaks the sign. They go to the next training area, which is a fighting arena. Wemmbu and Baablu go first, they fight until one of their totems pop, and Wemmbu ends up winning. While Zam and Fantst are fighting, Wemmbu puts down another sign and asks Baablu if he has invisibility, and he says he thinks so. Wemmbu then says they need to break their armor and asks Baablu if he knows where an ender chest is around here, but Baablu says no. As Wemmbu writes they need to scout for on, he's called up to fight Zam. Wemmbu ends up beating Zam, since Zam was already low on health. As a reward, Wemmbu gets to keep his totem. The sergeant doesn't item check them, thinking they don't have anything, and over the course of the next few days, the guards don't either since they assumed the prisoners thought escape was impossible. 

The next time they work, they're put into a wheat farm, and Wemmbu goes into the furthest corner and uses his water bucket to climb up the lights and get a few levers that activated the glowstone lamps. While walking through the prison, they find out the guard rooms have ender chests in them. When they get back to their cells, Lettuce brings a new prisoner, Lomedy. During lunch break, Wemmbu writes to Baablu they need to get to an ender chest now, then tells Zam to distract the guards when the doors open. Wemmbu and Baablu are unable to open the door without a key access, so they take a button from the guards panel and begin placing it in spots where redstone may open it. Loppezz runs in from hearing all the commotion, Wemmbu and Baablu hide inside of the panel and sneaks past loppezz while the door is still open. They make it in and find the ender chest, Baablu places down a shulker with invisibility pots when loppezz catches him. Wemmbu sneaks around, but is eventually caught by loppezz too. She makes them do an inventory check, Wemmbu manages to smuggle a cake, while Baablu smuggles in one invis pot. They're put into solitary confinement, and Spoke comes through a secret door, keeping his promise of coming back. Wemmbu tells Spoke to leave and that he didn't mean to get put back in solitary confinement. Spoke says the invis potion is the last key to Wemmbu's escape, and if they can keep it a secret between them then he can escape. Wemmbu still doesn't accept Spoke's deal, and Spoke says he needs him as much as he needs him, then teleports out.

The next day during lunch break, Wemmbu tells Zam they need to leave. Their job is to mine again, Wemmbu and Baablu dig a tunnel and get their helmet durability down to 1 and does it for the rest of the prisoners in secret. They all gather up in a tunnel and Baablu splashes invis. They try to break each others armor, but runs low on food and starts to get low. Lettuce overhears them talking about needing food, and catches them in their escape attempt. Wemmbu and Baablu dig out as Lettuce and loppezz blow up the area in search for them. They make it into a cave and digs up, Lettuce is right on their tail, they almost make it free until their hole is blown up. They're sent back to the prison and is forced to mend their armor. Lettuce then puts all four of them in permanent solitary confinement. Zam thinks they'll be in confinement forever, but Wemmbu says there's another way out and to just wait. When the lights go off, Spoke comes in and kills two guards. Before they can head forward, Spoke asks Wemmbu to accept his part of the deal, but Wemmbu still won't do it. Spoke says the blame of the guard's deaths will be put on Wemmbu's hands unless he agrees, so Wemmbu says yes. Wemmbu lets Baablu and Fantst out and they start to fight off the guards. They head to Lomedy's cell and get him to escape, but Lomedy says he's safe in there and will abide to them. Loppezz comes with a large army of guards, but all the guards die and loppezz manages to run off. They make it out of the ravine and onto The Law's main ground, and bunch of netherite guards show up, and the prisoners run. Wemmbu and loppezz face each other, and loppezz backs off when she gets low. Wemmbu uses this chance to escape since he wasn't able to do much more in that fight.

Wemmbu knows The Law will stop at nothing to execute him, he could've handled all of the netherite guards with the right resources, but he's missing his two fighting techniques, Elytra macing and orbital strike cannons. Wemmbu doesn't have enough power to destroy all of Law, so he heads back to the Farlands to obtain more orbital strike cannons.

It's been a week since [[Wemmbu]] was put in solitary confinement and [[LettuceK]] lets him out of his cell. title: Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
content:
Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison is the 15th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
After ParrotX2 and Wifies arrive at Proton, they find that the cell they are put in is rather large, with a hilly plains terrain and a river cutting through it. Directly across the hill they are standing on are multiple leafless cherry trees, which they immediately chop down and turn into slabs so they can scale to the build-limit-high crying obsidian walls with a broken green line that circulates it. They decide to stop at one of the green platforms, which Wifies steps on, getting him chunk banned by a fox ban. 

Parrot goes back down and waits until a guard arrives. He tries to convince the guard to free Wifies, but the guard doesn't say anything and ignores his request. He gives Parrot a pearl and leads him through a tunnel that takes him to a nearly identical cell to the previous one, but with red platforms and acacia trees. Parrot goes to an unfinished house with a crafting table and two signs that read "if you can see this" and "jumperwho and derapchu were here." 

rekrap2 arrives shortly after and tells Parrot that he was with _Kenadian_ before he got transferred to the red cell. Parrot informs him that he was with Wifies, but he got chunk banned. He shows Rekrap the signs, and Rekrap explains that the prison is newly built and that it contains all of the missing players that Parrot was searching for. Rekrap informs him that before he was with Kenadian, he was with Wemmbu, but he managed to escape before they started moving the prisoners. 

Rekrap asks Parrot what they were doing in the previous cell, and Parrot tells him that they were scaling to the top of the walls. They didn't manage to do so before Wifies got banned and suggests that they try again. While gathering materials, Wifies is freed, and Parrot tries to whisper to him, "Are you all good?" before crashing. Parrot attempts to message Wifies again, only to discover the same thing. He tells Rekrap to message him, which makes Rekrap crash. Parrot tries again, only to crash. Parrot then tries to type in the normal chat, butit doesn't show up in the log at all. 

Parrot and Rekrap go down to see if the walls reach bedrock, only to discover that they do. They scale the walls all the way to build height and find the two other cells that are connected to a central room, as well as an outer wall of one layer of obsidian. They go down via waterfall and Parrot almost falls to his death. They decide to write signs that say "and Parrot ∋ and rek," "message from ∋ parrot and rek ∋∋ went to top --," "saw three cells ∋ also small outer ∋ walls," "red green blue ∋ cells. 2 ppl per ∋ cell. as of now, we think it is," "parrot, rekrap, ∋ wifies, jumper, ∋ derapchu, ∋ kenadian," and "messaging is ∋ also banned for ∋ some reason," in front of Jumper and Derapchu's signs. 

Rekrap asks if they should scale the entrances which are curved to see if they can look through them. While scaling, Parrot talks about how calculated Proton is, especially compared to PrinceZam's prison. Rekrap discusses how there has to be a weak spot like the Death Star from Star Wars, Parrot retorts, saying to look around. Rekrap retorts that he has to believe 'cause what else are they supposed to do. Rekrap goes mining while Parrot looks around. Parrot almost dies while wandering around which made them decide to make a wheat farm. Rekrap tries to discuss possible ways to escape a chunkban but Parrot can't think of possible ways to do so and neither can Rekrap. Parrot then decides to go mining while Rekrap gathers food, agreeing to meet back up in 10 minutes. When Parrot returns he doesn't see Rekrap but does see a guard who hits and gestures for him to get going. The guard gives Parrot a pearl, which Parrot keeps, then asks the guard if they want to use the bridge that he and Rekrap made, to which the guard agrees.

The guard then leads Parrot to the blue cell, where he finds Kenadian, with Ken confirming that he came from the green cell. Parrot informs Ken he was with Wifies first, then with Rek, while Ken informs him he was with Rek first, then Derapchu. Parrot is happy that Ken is with him because he knows what he's doing, to which Ken hesitates, saying that it's a lot easier from the outside. Ken then informs Parrot that there are rings of bubble elevators in the outside that can be seen just about when one builds high enough. Parrot then goes inside a wooden shack that has a sign on it saying, "I am safe ∋ - Wifies ∋ - Jumper." Parrot and Ken then discuss the prison. Ken points out the three beacons and informs Parrot that they came from the control room, which means that there really are only three cells. Parrot then stops and asks Ken to repeat himself; Ken then pointed at the beacons, the ones coming off to the side. Parrot then leads Ken to the tunnel, discussing how Ken said the beacons come from the control room and how Parrot and Rek were discussing the possibility of a control room earlier. Parrot then grills Ken about making the assumption that the beacons are coming from the control room while Ken tries to defend his case. Parrot then interrogates Ken about the fact that he doesn't know anybody else on the server who's capable of making a prison like this, and that he doesn't know how Ken ended up in the prison, but that he wants Ken to be honest with him about whether or not they made the prison. Ken eventually relents saying that he may have in fact designed it and didn't inform Parrot 'cause he didn't want him to get mad. Ken then confirms that Clown hired him to design the prison but that he didn't know what he was gonna use it for. They then climb to build height and Parrot tells Ken that he doesn't care that Ken designed the prison 'cause it doesn't affect him and that it probably helps them because he knows the entire inner layout. And that Parot understands Ken keeping it a secret from them 'cause he didn't want them getting mad, to which Ken interrupts saying it wasn't just that, that with his knowledge of the cell their chances of escape was 0, that he patched so many ways to escape but that they can still try but that it's his knowledge against him and why he's pretty much given up and that it's nice in the prison anyway. Parrot then asks, "Is it though?" Ken replies "It's cozy." Parrot then tells him that if they don't try then they have no shot in the first place and that he wants to get everyone out, that he doesn't know how but he's gonna try but that if he wants to help then he's gonna have to be truthful 100% of the time. Ken agrees. They then go back to the shack to discuss the layout of the prison. Ken then informs him that they've modified the prison but that he'll try his best. Parrot then asks for all the information Ken knows, and Ken gives a rundown of everything he knows about the prison's design and possible courses of action. Ken suggests maps to distribute amongst the prisoners. Parrot then points out that the guards don't really patrol the inside of the cells and brings up the possibility of getting someone inside to bring an ender chest.

A guard arrives while Parrot gathers wheat and leads him to the green cell. Parrot finds a cobblestone shack with three signs in it that read "rekrap and ∋ jumper," "you can turn ∋ chunkbans on ∋ and off," and "at least 2-3 ∋ different guards." Parrot finds Derapchu and catches up with him because of how long it's been since they last saw each other. Derapchu then informs Parrot that there used to be a lot more people in the prison and that Wemmbu was one of them, but he escaped. Parrot then tells Derapchu that Ken built the prison; Derapchu then exclaims that he hates Ken, but Parrot reasons that it's good 'cause he knows the ins and outs of the prison. Parrot then discusses how to spread messages between the prisoners using maps with copies of each of the cells. Derapchu and Parrot then go mining for redstone. Eventually they find some and test it out by having Derapchu place blocks that say "HI" and "YO" while Parrot sees if it shows up in his map. They then keep a number of maps among them and plan to distribute them by the time they get redistributed. They then see a guard coming and say their farewells.

Parrot then follows the guard, who leads him to the red cell, and along the way, Parrot guesses there's at least 2 or 3 guards and lists off what he's observed: one sprint-jumps the whole way, and the one who was currently leading him turns around a lot. When Parrot arrives, he makes a map and greets Jumper. Parrot then tells Jumper about their map plan and gives Jumper one. Parrot then discovers that the maps blank out after moving, so he makes a cartography table to hopefully fix the problem. They then test out various blocks they can use for writing and find out that diorite is the most legible. They then write, place, andseveral diorite blocks until it shows up on the map as a dot. They run out of diorite in the middle of it and go mining; once they have a good number, then they make a flat plane of dirt for the purpose of writing. Parrot then convinces Jumper to go into solitary confinement in order to expand the map. Jumper then goes to build height and pearls out in order to get caught by guards. Leo suddenly arrives at the cell as a visitor and asks Parrot what was up with Jumper. Parrot asks Leo how many guards took Jumper, and he said 3. Parrot feels bad because of how quickly the guards took Jumper, and Leo is upset at the fact his teammate got taken to solitary confinement. Leo asks Parrot for help breaking out his teammates, and Parrot agrees 'cause he was already planning to do that anyway. Leo then tells Parrot he needs to make a stasis chamber so he can come back later. Parrot then asks Leo how long he's waiting until he or someone else comes but is teleported away before he can answer. Parrot then makes a sign that says, "Grab the maps in ∋ the chest," and hides it behind a wall. Parrot asks for a pearl to pearl into the tunnel, which the guard does give, but Parrot decides to go through the bridge instead to save his pearl. Parrot asks the guard where Jumper went, but they don't answer. Parrot hits the guard and hides; the guard slashes Parrot and takes out half his health.

Parrot is taken to the green cell where he reunites with Wifies, where they lament the fact that they couldn't talk with one another without crashing. Parrot gives Wifies a map and finds that someone in the blue cell has a map. Wifies then tells Parrot that, as he was transported, he heard a voice he's never heard before. Parrot tells Wifies about Leo wanting a stasis chamber made using honey, for which they would need saplings, and Wifies informs Parrot that the cells are large enough to spawn wandering traders but that they would still need to figure out how to get emeralds. Parrot opens his map again and finds that the person in the blue cell has written "...---..." (SOS) in their cell. They decide to reply with "EMERALD" (./--/./.-./.-/.-../-..), while the other person has also written "..-/--./---/---/-.." (UGOOD). They decide to leave it up for 5 minutes and go down mining to look for emeralds and find 3. They then resurface and take down the message. A guard then comes to get Parrot while he is in the middle of taking down Wifies' diorite structure. Parrot fails to pearl into the tunnel the first time and had to be given another one. While Parrot is crossing the tunnel, he hears eggchan ask if there was anybody there and to help him. Parrot tried to listen in on where eggchan was but was made to continue walking by the guard.

Parrot is back in the red cell with Rek and finds out he was the one who sent the code and that Rek has 6 emeralds. They then split up to look for the wandering trader, and Rek gives Parrot 3 emeralds. Parrot doesn't find anything and goes back to get bonemeal. Rek finds the wandering trader in the snow mountain who has a birch sapling trade for 5 emeralds. Parrot trades for one of the saplings and asks Rek if he heard "Wemmbu's friend" in the hallway, which Rek confirms he did, but that he didn't say anything back 'cause he was scared of how rough the guard was. Parrot then explains to Rek about Leo wanting a stasis chamber and that they can make one out of honey. They get a hive tree after the third attempt and attempt to get more. Parrot dives under the river to try to find sand but discovers there aren't any, but Rek informs him that wandering traders trade for sand. They then keep trying to get hive trees. Parrot realizes they'd need sticky pistons but don't know how to obtain slime. Parrot then makes a sign for the next round of prisoners that says, "Shear trees ∋ turn into bonemea ∋ grow trees ∋ get hives." A guard then comes to fetch Rek out of the cell and into the green cell. Parrot sneakily follows Rek and the guard but doesn't cross the line and goes back to the red cell and goes back to the green one. Another guard then comes to fetch Parrot; along the way, he asks who is inside the cells and if he's allowed to go in there. Naturally the guard doesn't answer.

Before arriving at the blue cell, Parrot blocks off the guard with wooden blocks before seeing the diorite Morse code that Rek made and didn't get rid of. Parrot goes to Ken and explains what has happened so far and their plans to get stasis chambers. Ken then realizes that there shouldn't even be emeralds in the cells and that they might not have mined them all, which means they have a chance to get out, but it's still risky. Parrot then relays another problem: he wants to get everyone out, but Jumper is in solitary. Parrot then asks Ken how to get Jumper out, and the only thing Ken can think of is to take full control of the control room. Wemmbu then suddenly appears and asks Parrot if he has the stasis set up. Parrot is confused because it's only been 4 hours at this point; Wemmbu is confused because why would setting up soulsand and water take so long? Parrot then informs him they don't have soulsand. Wemmbu asks if they have redstone; Parrot confirms they do. Wemmbu then asks if they have slime; Parrot confirms they don't and that there's probably some sort of mob switch. Parrot then asks if Wemmbu only has 10 minutes of visitation like Leo did; Wemmbu confirms he does. Ken and Parrot then tell Wemmbu that he came to the prison for nothing. Parrot then asks if Wemmbu expected there to be a stasis chamber set up already, which Wemmbu confirms, to which Parrot says they need at least a couple more hours. Wemmbu then asks what they need; Parrot tells him they need honey and that it's set up in another cell. Wemmbu is confused about there being another cell; Parrot asks him if Leo told him anything at all, to which Wemmbu confirms he didn't. Parrot then explains that there are 3 cells and 6 prisoners and that they are being rotated around. Wemmbu then asks about Egg and Zam; Parrot is confused and asks what he means. Wemmbu explains that there were a lot more people when he was in the prison and asks if there were anybody aside from the 6 people. When Parrot doesn't answer, Wemmbu exclaims that they're wasting time. Parrot then explains that Egg is in a maximum-security solitary confinement chamber. Wemmbu then asks how Leo escaped. Parrot becomes confused and frustrated and asks what Wemmbu was even doing there. Wemmbu then explains that Leo just told him to go there and that they had a stasis chamber set up, that he went through the entire visiting process naked only to find that they've been bumming around and don't even have a stasis chamber set up. Parrot tells him to come back in 6 hours, but Wemmbu tells him that he isn't sure if they'll let him in again 'cause he had to pull some strings to even enter and that they most likely did not want him to be there. Wemmbu then asks why they can't just message him when they have one set up; Parrot tells him to try messaging him right now; Wemmbu crashes, of course. They go to the wooden shack, and Parrot tells Wemmbu how it is, that they're playing with time. Wemmbu interrupts him, saying they don't have time for a yap speech, and asks how much time they need. Parrot tells him 6 hours, and Ken contests the 6-hour claim, saying that he's being optimistic. Parrot then says the 6 hours is only for having the stasis chamber set up, not necessarily for having a plan of escape. Parrot asks Wemmbu if he wants to send a message of any kind to Egg; Wemmbu questions him about that since he's supposedly in solitary confinement, and Parrot explains he can talk to him through the walls. Wemmbu then says to tell Egg, "Keep it pushing, man." Wemmbu then confirms the stasis chamber is getting done in 6 hours, and he gets stasised away. Parrot and Wifies then confirm that not only do they have to build a stasis chamber in 6 hours, but that they have to ensure it doesn't get found within that timeframe. Parrot then decides to destroy the Morse code but gets interrupted when he sees a guard watching him for who knows how long before getting transported. While getting transported, Parrot keeps stopping, and the guard poisons him because of it. Parrot gets down to 1 heart and tells the guard not to hit him anymore.

When Parrot arrives at the green cell, he tells the guard, "You are a sad, miserable little guard." Parrot meets up with Wifies and tells him that the guards may be catching onto them because Rek didn't get rid of their Morse code and 'cause a guard saw the honey farms that they started. Wifies asks Parrot how long solitary confinement takes, 'cause he heard Jumper ramble, "Bro, this guy really made me go into the center for the map," which was 5 hours ago. Parrot then tells Wifies that the voice he heard was Egg's and that Wemmbu was arriving in 5 & 1/2 hours. They then go to look for wandering traders. Wifey finds one, but it didn't have any useful trades. Wifies hits the trader with an axe, assuming it would only get it low only to kill it. Parrot then proposes following Wifies while invis, and Wifies retorts that he'll just get caught when they come to fetch him. Parrot then says he just needs to relay the plan to Jumper. Parrot asks Wifies if he wants to get to the top since he never really saw it, and Wifies agrees. While climbing, Parrot says that he feels like he's lost all sense of time while in the prison, then falls but manages to water clutch. They find another wandering trader (without llamas) on the way back to the staircase that sells 8 sand for 1 emerald; Parrot buys 16 sand before realizing he also sells 1 slimeball for 4 emeralds. Since Parrot only has 2 emeralds left, he and Wifies go looking for emeralds. Parrot and Wifies managed to find 2 emeralds before the trader despawned, so Parrot buys 1 slimeball. Parrot doesn't want to buy anything else from the trader, so they decide to kill him but do so prematurely, preventing an item drop. '''Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison''' is the 15th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]]. 

==Plot==
After [[ParrotX2]] and [[Wifies]] arrive at [[Proton]], they find that the cell they are put in is rather large, with a hilly plains terrain and a river cutting through it. Directly across the hill they are standing on are multiple leafless cherry trees, which they immediately chop down and turn into slabs so they can scale to the build-limit-high crying obsidian walls with a broken green line that circulates it. They decide to stop at one of the green platforms, which Wifies steps on, getting him [[Chunk ban|chunk banned]] by a fox ban. 

Parrot goes back down and waits until a guard arrives. He tries to convince the guard to free Wifies, but the guard doesn't say anything and ignores his request. He gives Parrot a pearl and leads him through a tunnel that takes him to a nearly identical cell to the previous one, but with red platforms and acacia trees. Parrot goes to an unfinished house with a crafting table and two signs that read "''if you can see this''" and "''[[JumperWho|jumperwho]] and [[derapchu]] were here.''" 

[[rekrap2]] arrives shortly after and tells Parrot that he was with [[_Kenadian_]] before he got transferred to the red cell. Parrot informs him that he was with Wifies, but he got chunk banned. He shows Rekrap the signs, and Rekrap explains that the prison is newly built and that it contains all of the missing players that Parrot was searching for. Rekrap informs him that before he was with Kenadian, he was with [[Wemmbu]], but he managed to escape before they started moving the prisoners. 

Rekrap asks Parrot what they were doing in the previous cell, and Parrot tells him that they were scaling to the top of the walls. They didn't manage to do so before Wifies got banned and suggests that they try again. While gathering materials, Wifies is freed, and Parrot tries to whisper to him, "Are you all good?" before crashing. Parrot attempts to message Wifies again, only to discover the same thing. He tells Rekrap to message him, which makes Rekrap crash. Parrot tries again, only to crash. Parrot then tries to type in the normal chat, butit doesn't show up in the log at all. 

Parrot and Rekrap go down to see if the walls reach bedrock, only to discover that they do. They scale the walls all the way to build height and find the two other cells that are connected to a central room, as well as an outer wall of one layer of obsidian. They go down via waterfall and Parrot almost falls to his death. Rekrap asks if they should scale the entrances which are curved to see if they can look through them. Parrot then discusses how to spread messages between the prisoners using maps with copies of each of the cells. Derapchu and Parrot then go mining for redstone. Eventually they find some and test it out by having Derapchu place blocks that say "HI" and "YO" while Parrot sees if it shows up in his map.
