Parrot then follows the guard, who leads him to the red cell, and along the way, Parrot guesses there's at least 2 or 3 guards and lists off what he's observed: one sprint-jumps the whole way, and the one who was currently leading him turns around a lot. When Parrot arrives, he makes a map and greets Jumper. Parrot then tells Jumper about their map plan and gives Jumper one. Parrot then discovers that the maps blank out after moving, so he makes a cartography table to hopefully fix the problem. They then test out various blocks they can use for writing and find out that diorite is the most legible. They then write, place, andseveral diorite blocks until it shows up on the map as a dot. They run out of diorite in the middle of it and go mining; once they have a good number, then they make a flat plane of dirt for the purpose of writing. Parrot then convinces Jumper to go into solitary confinement in order to expand the map. Jumper then goes to build height and pearls out in order to get caught by guards. [[Leow0ok|Leo]] suddenly arrives at the cell as a visitor and asks Parrot what was up with Jumper. Parrot asks Leo how many guards took Jumper, and he said 3. Leo then tells Parrot he needs to make a stasis chamber so he can come back later. Parrot then makes a sign that says, "''Grab the maps in ∋ the chest,''" and hides it behind a wall. Parrot asks for a pearl to pearl into the tunnel, which the guard does give, but Parrot decides to go through the bridge instead to save his pearl. Parrot asks the guard where Jumper went, but they don't answer. Parrot hits the guard and hides; the guard slashes Parrot and takes out half his health.

Parrot is taken to the green cell where he reunites with Wifies, where they lament the fact that they couldn't talk with one another without crashing. Parrot gives Wifies a map and finds that someone in the blue cell has a map. Wifies then tells Parrot that, as he was transported, he heard a voice he's never heard before. Parrot tells Wifies about Leo wanting a stasis chamber made using honey, for which they would need saplings, and Wifies informs Parrot that the cells are large enough to spawn wandering traders but that they would still need to figure out how to get emeralds. Parrot opens his map again and finds that the person in the blue cell has written "...---..." (SOS) in their cell. They decide to reply with "EMERALD" (./--/./.-./.-/.-../-..), while the other person has also written "..-/--./---/---/-.." (UGOOD). They decide to leave it up for 5 minutes and go down mining to look for emeralds and find 3. They then resurface and take down the message. A guard then comes to get Parrot while he is in the middle of taking down Wifies' diorite structure. Parrot fails to pearl into the tunnel the first time and had to be given another one. While Parrot is crossing the tunnel, he hears [[eggchan]] ask if there was anybody there and to help him. Parrot tried to listen in on where eggchan was but was made to continue walking by the guard.

Parrot is back in the red cell with Rek and finds out he was the one who sent the code and that Rek has 6 emeralds. They then split up to look for the wandering trader, and Rek gives Parrot 3 emeralds. Parrot doesn't find anything and goes back to get bonemeal. Rek finds the wandering trader in the snow mountain who has a birch sapling trade for 5 emeralds. Parrot trades for one of the saplings and asks Rek if he heard "Wemmbu's friend" in the hallway, which Rek confirms he did, but that he didn't say anything back 'cause he was scared of how rough the guard was. Parrot then explains to Rek about Leo wanting a stasis chamber and that they can make one out of honey. They get a hive tree after the third attempt and attempt to get more. Parrot dives under the river to try to find sand but discovers there aren't any, but Rek informs him that wandering traders trade for sand. They then keep trying to get hive trees. Parrot realizes they'd need sticky pistons but don't know how to obtain slime. Parrot then makes a sign for the next round of prisoners that says, "''Shear trees ∋ turn into bonemea ∋ grow trees ∋ get hives.''" A guard then comes to fetch Rek out of the cell and into the green cell. Parrot sneakily follows Rek and the guard but doesn't cross the line and goes back to the red cell and goes back to the green one. Another guard then comes to fetch Parrot; along the way, he asks who is inside the cells and if he's allowed to go in there. Naturally the guard doesn't answer.

Before arriving at the blue cell, Parrot blocks off the guard with wooden blocks before seeing the diorite Morse code that Rek made and didn't get rid of. Parrot goes to Ken and explains what has happened so far and their plans to get stasis chambers. Ken then realizes that there shouldn't even be emeralds in the cells and that they might not have mined them all, which means they have a chance to get out, but it's still risky. Parrot then relays another problem: he wants to get everyone out, but Jumper is in solitary. Parrot then asks Ken how to get Jumper out, and the only thing Ken can think of is to take full control of the control room. Wemmbu then suddenly appears and asks Parrot if he has the stasis set up. Parrot is confused because it's only been 4 hours at this point; Wemmbu is confused because why would setting up soulsand and water take so long? Parrot then informs him they don't have soulsand. Wemmbu asks if they have redstone; Parrot confirms they do. Wemmbu then asks if they have slime; Parrot confirms they don't and that there's probably some sort of mob switch. Parrot then asks if Wemmbu only has 10 minutes of visitation like Leo did; Wemmbu confirms he does. Ken and Parrot then tell Wemmbu that he came to the prison for nothing. Parrot then asks if Wemmbu expected there to be a stasis chamber set up already, which Wemmbu confirms, to which Parrot says they need at least a couple more hours. Wemmbu then asks what they need; Parrot tells him they need honey and that it's set up in another cell. Wemmbu is confused about there being another cell; Parrot asks him if Leo told him anything at all, to which Wemmbu confirms he didn't. Parrot then explains that there are 3 cells and 6 prisoners and that they are being rotated around. Wemmbu then asks about Egg and Zam; Parrot is confused and asks what he means. Wemmbu explains that there were a lot more people when he was in the prison and asks if there were anybody aside from the 6 people. When Parrot doesn't answer, Wemmbu exclaims that they're wasting time. Parrot then explains that Egg is in a maximum-security solitary confinement chamber. Wemmbu then asks how Leo escaped. Parrot becomes confused and frustrated and asks what Wemmbu was even doing there. Wemmbu then explains that Leo just told him to go there and that they had a stasis chamber set up, that he went through the entire visiting process naked only to find that they've been bumming around and don't even have a stasis chamber set up. Wemmbu then asks why they can't just message him when they have one set up; Parrot tells him to try messaging him right now; Wemmbu crashes, of course. Parrot asks Wemmbu if he wants to send a message of any kind to Egg; Wemmbu questions him about that since he's supposedly in solitary confinement, and Parrot explains he can talk to him through the walls. Wemmbu then says to tell Egg, "Keep it pushing, man." Wemmbu then confirms the stasis chamber is getting done in 6 hours, and he gets stasised away. Parrot and Wifies then confirm that not only do they have to build a stasis chamber in 6 hours, but that they have to ensure it doesn't get found within that timeframe. Parrot then decides to destroy the Morse code but gets interrupted when he sees a guard watching him for who knows how long before getting transported. While getting transported, Parrot keeps stopping, and the guard poisons him because of it. Parrot gets down to 1 heart and tells the guard not to hit him anymore.

When Parrot arrives at the green cell, he tells the guard, "You are a sad, miserable little guard." Parrot meets up with Wifies and tells him that the guards may be catching onto them because Rek didn't get rid of their Morse code and 'cause a guard saw the honey farms that they started. Wifies asks Parrot how long solitary confinement takes, 'cause he heard Jumper ramble, "Bro, this guy really made me go into the center for the map," which was 5 hours ago. (SOS), which she can read through her map. When Parrot arrives, the guard drops a rotten flesh for him, to which Parrot says, "Ok, bro, you're real funny." Parrot goes down to eat the rotten flesh, then meets with Derapchu. Derapchu then comments that Ken is a weird guy for thinking it's cozy. Parrot and Derapchu go down, and Parrot promises that all 6 of them will get out. When Parrot arrives at the red cell, he tells the guard, "Have a great day, and thank you for killing my horse. I appreciate it." He then kills a chicken with a flint and steel and eats it. A guard arrives while Parrot is farming wheat and tramples one of the plots. On the way to the tunnel, Parrot asks if they want to talk about what the guards just did or if they want to be silent like always; unsurprisingly, it's the latter. While in the tunnel he asks the guard if they can have their bee hives back but is interrupted by Egg. As they cross the threshold to the green cell, Parrot goes back and tells Egg that Wemmbu told him to tell Egg, "Keep pushing." The guard peels back to the cell and hits Parrot with a pickaxe to make him keep going until they arrive at the green cell.

When Parrot arrives at the green cell, he finds a new bridge and goes to meet up with Ken. Ken asks Parrot how his progress on the escape plan is, and Parrot gives him the chamber parts and asks him where he wants to build it and to build it quickly since they don't know when Wemmbu is coming. Ken suggests finding a cave below y0. Parrot asks if they need an anvil, and Ken confirms it and tells him that he almost has enough iron. While going down Parrot and Wifies' emerald mine, Parrot asks Ken if it's true what Derapchu said, that Ken would rather stay in the prison than escape it. Parrot replies that it makes no sense; Ken asks what part of it, and Parrot asks how he can be happy in the prison. Ken asks if there's anything making Parrot unhappy; Parrot replies that he can't do anything, that he can't build anything without the possibility of it being destroyed. Parrot then tells Ken that the bee farm got destroyed, and Ken replies maybe it's because he was making bee hives; Parrot confirms, and Ken says, "Well, there's your problem." Ken digs into some sculk and asks if it's a good place, and Parrot confirms but then goes to get some coal. While going up, Ken says he has a better place but that he'll show it to Parrot when he comes back. Parrot goes to the new place Ken found and asks Ken if he's really happy in the prison, and Ken replies that he's fine. Ken then says that he handed him a bunch of honey and told him an escape plan and that he's not just gonna steal it from him. Ken then builds the chamber, and they get to testing it. Ken asks Parrot how many pearls he has, and Parrot says he only has 2. Ken then suggests Parrot use snowballs, but he doesn't have any, so they go up to get some. On the way up, Parrot suggests that Wifies can keep throwing snowballs until he finds the correct place, and then he can use a pearl, and Ken agrees it's a good idea. When they surface, Wifies asks if the green cell even has snow; they realize that it was the red cell that has it. Ken then suggests eggs, so they go to breed some chickens. While waiting for the chickens to breed, Parrot spots Wemmbu falling from the ceiling, and they head towards him. Parrot grabs the eggs while Ken leads Wemmbu to the chamber. Ken forgot where the mine was, but they managed to find it soon enough. They had a bit of trouble finding the chamber, and while looking for it, Parrot asks Wemmbu how much time he has left. Wemmbu answers he walked around for a bit, so a couple of minutes.

When they arrive, Wemmbu comments how he can see it's going to take some timing, and Parrot explains how it works while demonstrating using eggs since he brought 10 eggs and they only have 3 pearls. Parrot then tells Ken that the block the anvil is on should be made of honey. Wemmbu burns through all the 8 remaining eggs, the last one hatching a chicken, and 1 pearl. Parrot then explains where to aim, and Wemmbu tries again but fails. Parrot explains how to aim again in more detail while Ken comments that it's superstitious, but he should go for it. Wemmbu does go for it, and he finally gets it while Parrot celebrates. Parrot then asks Wemmbu what he's bringing in; Wemmbu replies that he's bringing everything. Ken takes out a TNT block, and Parrot asks what he's doing. Parrot then punches Ken, and Ken retracts the TNT. Parrot again asks what Wemmbu's bringing, and Wemmbu confirms he's bringing ender chests and shulkers full of gear that he had stashed thanks to a war. While Wemmbu lists specific items, Ken removes all the honey blocks in the stasis chamber. The chamber is still working with only the sticky piston left, so Parrot and Wifies just move on from it, but Parrot keeps an eye on Ken the whole time they discuss what items to bring. Ken then holds dirt while saying sorry, so Parrot punches him away from the chamber and blocks him off with birch wood. Ken then relays that he has conflicting feelings, and Wemmbu asks if they're doing a betrayal arc right now. Ken clarifies that he has no ill intentions and to stop. Ken promises he won't do anything, and Wemmbu tells Parrot to give him blocks. Parrot crafts birch planks and gives some to Wemmbu. Ken is then freed, and Parrot asks if he understands the alternative to breaking free, and Ken replies that it's fine and that it's a pleasant life. Parrot replies it's not, and Ken asks who's complaining but backpedals and says don't answer that. while Wemmbu says that they can escape while Ken can stay in the prison all by herself. Parrot says that this is their way out, and Ken retorts that it's not and that he doesn't know the prison like he does. Wemmbu asks Ken if he'd rather take this opportunity away from them. Parrot then argues that he doesn't care that there's only a 3% chance of them succeeding, that he'd rather die trying than get stuck in the prison being unable to do anything and getting put in solitary every time they break the rules. Ken retorts, Just don't break the rules. Ken then reveals he knows a better honey chamber design but figured if they messed up, they'd give up. Parrot then asks if he wasn't expecting them to make that 3rd pearl; Ken confirms that he didn't but that he was impressed. Parrot then asks Ken to be honest with them and asks if Ken has been sabotaging them; Ken denies. Parrot then asks why he sabotaged at the last moment, and Ken replies he's not praying for their downfall; Parrot retorts that he is, and Ken retorts that he just thinks they're being reckless. Parrot then says that Wemmbu is going to be bringing as much contraband as he can and coming back to get them out and what he's going to do about it. Ken asks Parrot if he remembered what he specifically said at the beginning, "Stay safe." Parrot asks what that means, and Wemmbu attacks Ken with a wooden sword but gets stasised away. Parrot then says that he's putting his life on the line, that he can't stop him, but he's asking him to think about what he's doing. That if he breaks the stasis, they'll be stuck in the prison forever, Ken says he doesn't want to. Ken asks Parrot to promise him that he knows what he's doing. Parrot says he'll promise to if he promises not to break the stasis, that it's their only way out, Ken says, "Fine."

As they leave the cave and Parrot asks Ken if he realizes he could've died there, Ken asks what he means, and Parrot says that Wemmbu tried to kill him. Ken silently says, "Yeah." Parrot tells Ken that he's pulling the stasis the moment he gets rotated in. Parrot then says that he doesn't have a deadset plan on how to get out. Ken asks Parrot to give him a step-by-step of Parrot's plan; he asks what Parrot is planning to do after they get the contraband. Parrot replies that they're going to go to everybody else's cell to distribute the contraband. Ken asks what they're going to do after that; Parrot replies they're going to have to figure it out, but that the point is that they don't have time because the guards know they're communicating. Ken asks Parrot if he thinks it's easy escaping prisons from the inside, that she's not trying to put herself on a pedestal, just that Parrot sounds naive. Parrot then says that hope keeps him going too, which Ken scoffs about. Parrot then asks Ken what he could be doing instead of being in the prison, that the prison is just a mirage and that's why they need to get out. Ken then agrees that he doesn't think about getting out; it's just that he tries not to. Parrot then says that he doesn't know if Ken was contemplating sabotaging 'cause he wants to stay, but that at some point they're gonna need him, that he's gonna need him to promise to help them 'cause they genuinely can't get out without him. Ken then says that whether or not he sabotages, which he wouldn't 'cause it's too late and it would be to his detriment, that he's always had their best interest in mind even if they disagreed, that he's on their side. Parrot asks what Ken thinks are the chances of them pulling the escape off; Ken answers that it depends on a lot. Parrot says that anything's possible if you put your mind to it; Ken retorts that it's really not. Ken says that he'll put his mind to it but that it's not an easy puzzle to solve because he doesn't know the guard's rotations. Parrot then spots a guard and starts talking about having an egg on a croissant for breakfast or possibly a smoked salmon on a bagel. He then asks the guard if they want a smoked salmon bagel while hitting them; the guard nods. Parrot remarks that even the guards and prisoners have some stuff in common. Parrot then jokes that this might be one of the last times they'll be seeing each other, which made the guard stare at him. Parrot backpedals by saying he's just kidding and that they'll be seeing each other every hour. Parrot looks for Egg while crossing the tunnel but finds the cell empty and open. The guard keeps hitting him to get him going, but Parrot goes inside the cell to check it out. When Parrot resurfaces, the guard splashes him with poison.

Parrot then heads to the blue cell and meets with Wifies. Parrot tells Wifies they need to talk about something important, leading him up the build height waterfall. Wifies says, Alright, no rush, but Parrot says that they don't. Parrot asks Wifies if he remembers the first time they went up there and how they didn't have anything except hope; Wifies says that they still have it; Parrot says they've always had it. Parrot tells Wifies the next time Parrot gets put in the green cell, they're breaking out; Wifies asks if the plan's ready, and Parrot confirms it. Parrot and Wifies go to the middle so nobody can hear them. Parrot tells Wifies about their plan, and Wifies asks Parrot how they're going to get to the command room, to which Parrot answers that they'll be using pearls. Wifies asks about Egg, and Parrot tells him that Egg wasn't there. Wifies wonders if the guards would filter Egg in with them. Wifies asks if they'd be doing this in rotations, and Parrot denies it, saying they'll be doing it all in one sweep. Wifey's remarks that they would only have one chance realistically, and if they fail, they'd be sent to solitary. Wifies asks Parrot if he wants better armor; Parrot says he's fine. Wifies asks Parrot if there's anything else he'd like to do before they get out, and Parrot asks what they haven't done yet, and Wifies lists out some possibilities, like building what they can with the 4 limited blocks they have. Parrot decides to lead Wifies into the wooden shack and places down a cobblestone in between them and gives Wifies 1 of the 2 remaining honey bottles he has, which they then drink together. Wifies comments, "Not bad, locally sourced!" and Parrot replies, "Exactly. Fine prison honey," and Wifies comments back, "That's about as fresh as it gets." Wifies asks how many cycles it's been since Wemmbu set his stasis, and Parrot tells him to shut up 'cause he saw a guard heading their way. Parrot tells Wifies that if they're coming for him, they'll be seeing each other very, very soon. Wifies replies he'll be waiting. The guard did go for Parrot, and he asks them where they put Egg and sees his former cell still empty.

Parrot arrives at the green cell and tells Rek that they're going to go activate the stasis. Rek asks if anybody saw, and Parrot replies he doesn't think so. On the way to the chamber they see Ken and meet up with him. Parrot questions why they put 3 people in a cell, and Rek tells him to just roll with it and that they'll use it to their advantage. Ken leads them to the mine, which was still exposed, but Ken figures it's fine. Parrot asks if they should do a victory speech, but Rek argues they don't have much time. Parrot then says they have an hour before they actually catch on to them. When they get in the chamber cave, Parrot says he doesn't know why there are 3 of them in a cell and how they ended up here; Ken asks if he can do the honors, and Parrot replies it's all hers. Ken deactivates the stasis, which teleports Wemmbu over. Wemmbu places an ender chest, and the three of them immediately start gearing themselves while Wemmbu asks if it's escaping time. In the commotion, Wemmbu wasn't heard, and he commented, "Okay, everyone is ignoring me." Parrot confirms that it was escaping time. Wemmbu comments he has shulkers for them, one of which contains nothing but copies of the guards' shields. Parrot tells them to bring 2 each. Wemmbu says that he has 10 shulkers of Ken's escape kits and asks if he wants one; Ken replies that he has his own. Parrot doesn't have a kit, so he asks Rek for one. Wemmbu asks Parrot where Egg is; Parrot tells him bad news that Egg wasn't in the same solitary chamber he was in before, which means he got transferred somewhere. Wemmbu says that he'll just go look for him then while they're gearing. Before leaving, Wemmbu gives them several eggs. Ken asks if they're ready, and Parrot confirms that he is; Rek also confirms he's ready but that he doesn't know what they're doing. Ken replies that's his problem. They have a bit of trouble getting out at first but manage it. Rek asks how they're getting past the chunk bans, and Parrot says he'll show Rek. Parrot comments on how good it feels to have the gear they have inside a prison, and Rek shares the same feeling, adding that the guards are about to regret putting them there. As they're getting out, Ken comments that he may know Parrot's plan. Parrot asks if they both have pearls and rockets, which they both confirm. He then tells them to follow him right before the chunkban and then explains his plan of flying to the other side as fast as they can in an upward direction, then pearling to the outside before dropping straight down. All three of them manage to get out, and then they head out to distribute the contraband.

They first head to the red cell where Derapchu and Wifies are. Rek asks Derapchu if he needed gear, and Derapchu says yes, so Rek gave him 2 shulkers. Parrot asks if Jumper is still in solitude, but nobody answers him. Rek asks if they're heading to the blue cell next, and Ken confirms it. Parrot then says that nobody is in blue since all 5 of them are there with only Jumper remaining, who's in solitary. Ken asks why they wouldn't want anyone in blue, and Parrot replies that he doesn't know and comments that it's really strange. Rek comments that it's all super sus. Wifies says that it doesn't matter, while Rek comments that they just need to keep moving. They then head to one of the platforms, and Parrot explains again how to go past the chunkban. They all manage to get out, and Parrot explains they need to go to the control room. Ken explains the layout of the control room. Parrot asks if it's just a lever to deactivate the chambers, and Ken confirms it but says that they have to make sure that they don't activate one of the force lockdowns. Parrot asks what the chances are that the guards are inside; Ken replies that it's guaranteed. Parrot then realizes that they can pretend to be the guards using invis. Rek brings out a shulker full of 3-min invis potions for them to use. Ken asks what their plan is and asks whether the guards would be invis as well or not. Parrot replies that they probably just stay invis. Ken then asks if the plan is to just flick the lever inconspicuously; Parrot replies they can try. Ken asks, What if it doesn't work, then what? Parrot replies, They'd be cooked. Wifies asks Ken if the lever is on or off to free them; Ken says there should be signs that indicate it. Ken then explains that the middle area filled with nothing but air is free of chunk bans. Derapchu remains in the blue cell to wait for Jumper while the rest head to one of the ice bridges. Parrot then tells them no talking and no elytra as they head towards the tower.

When they get inside one of the control rooms, [[Spongs]] greets them, but they remain silent but greet crouch him. Parrot goes up a floor and presses the buttons to open the chambers but gets interrupted by two of the guards who ask him if he's there to take over their shift. Parrot nods, then goes back to pressing the buttons. The guards then try to stop him, and then Parrot proceeds to break things. Parrot goes down several floors and flips the levers that open the chambers before checking the map to see if Jumper is out. The guards arrive and start attacking Parrot just as he announces that Jumper's out and asks for help. Rek then points out that he's invis, and Parrot realizes he can just blend in. The guards run out of invis as they're fighting, and Parrot asks what it's like to be a guard. Spongs replies that it's really sad and lonely and that he's glad they're there 'cause it's some excitement. [[Rejoicin]] asks why they want to escape; the prisoners laugh, baffled, and ask what he means by why they want to escape. Rejoicin(?) says they make it so nice for them, and Spongs exclaims they have it good there. Parrot then tells them all to head up top, where they continue fighting. Parrot then tells them to go down again, where they keep fighting. Due to the multiple invis players, there is a lot of confusion and hesitance on who to hit. Parrot sneaks out of the fight and heads outside and messages the others to go to the red cell. He then heads to the blue cell and sees Derapchu, who is AFK, then realizes he's in the wrong cell. He then heads to the red cell and sees Wifies, Ken, and Jumper and puts out an ender chest. Parrot asks where Rek is; Ken then tells Parrot how he hates his incompetence and recklessness. Ken tells them how he manually disabled the lockdowns just as Rek arrived. Parrot tells them the bad news that Derapchu is out of the question and that they should just build "this thing." Parrot asks if Jumper needs gear, and Jumper confirms it. Rek offers her a shulker of Ken's escape kit. Parrot asks Jumper if she has an elytra, and Jumper denies it. Parrot then asks the others if they have any, which they don't, with Rek having used his backups for decoration before they got imprisoned. Parrot then says that he'll double up with Jumper by dropping his elytra after throwing a pearl but then realizes he needs to stay behind to demonstrate to Jumper how to do it. Ken offers to do the doubling up instead and goes first in order to do it. 

Eventually, they find that they have a total of two elytra between them, and they reach the place that would allow them to leave. After building the platform, they all take turns using the two elytra and dropping them. However, one elytra is caught in a chunk ban and the guards had caught up to them at that point. At last, it is down to Ken and Parrot. Ken insists that Parrot should have it, but Parrot tells him that he made a promise to get them all out. After a frantic back-and-forth argument, Parrot finally agrees reluctantly, and he leaves the prison, meeting up with the others in front of a 'WELCOME HOME' sign that they built out of obsidian. When the others ask, Parrot tells them that 'he is still trapped in there because... that's all he wanted'. After leaving the region of Proton, they mope around about Ken's fate, until Parrot suddenly realises that Ken would be able to send morse code to them. The message reaads 'EPSC base', which refers to a stasis he set in his base. The video ends as Parrot activates it. 

== Trivia ==

* People often mistaken this video as episode 14 as it was posted before [[How I Escaped Minecraft's Largest Prison|Wemmbu's video]].

title: Fantst
content:
Fantst is a reoccurring character featured in Unstable Universe. He was a minor protagonist in Season 1 and an antagonist and supporting character in Season 2 in Wemmbu's episodes.

 History 
Fantst is hired to be a guard of one of The Wonders

The Wonder Fantst is guarding is destroyed.

Fantst is convinced to not let Parrot fire his Orbital Strike Cannon. Fantst later agrees to team with Parrot to build a new orbital cannon to stop Spoke’s orbital cannon from destroying the Frosted Palace Wonder.

Mapicc, Arcn, Only_A_Squid, Sharooh, and Fantst, all teamed with SpokeIsHere find a looted trial chamber. Mapicc finds Wemmbu and PrinceZam, and a fight breaks out. Wemmbu and PrinceZam make it to the surface, and Wemmbu starts killing the team with a mace. They all escape using stasis chambers.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam use an exploit with TNT and an arrow to find Fantst and Sharooh. Fantst runs away.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam find an obsidian box, and inside is Mapicc. Spoke and his teammates come in, including Fantst, and they start to fight Wemmbu and PrinceZam. They almost kill PrinceZam, breaking all of his armor, but they all run away and escape using a stasis chamber after PrinceZam holds a chunk ban, which they’re afraid of.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam find an underwater base. Inside they find Sharkilz_ and Fantst. They chunk ban Fantst and Sharkilz_.

Parrot and Rekrap2 destroy the chunk ban that Fantst is in.

Fantst chunk bans himself again.

Fantst is un-chunk banned by Wemmbu and joins his civilization. Eventually the civilization is destroyed.

Fantst joins The End Civilization. The civilization is later taken over by The Invisible Mafia.

Fantst joins the Far Lands Civilization as a warrior. The civilization was later destroyed by The Invisible Mafia.

 Season 2 
Fantst takes over the Ice Mountain Civilization. He implants a bomb in the civilization. Fantst eventually blows up the entire base despite Wemmbu and loppezz's attempts to stop him. Wemmbu tries to kill Fantst but fails as he runs away.

Fantst and Baablu try to duplicate ender dragons to destroy Spawn after Baablu convinces Wemmbu to revive the ender dragon while Wemmbu tries to get elytras to trade with people for items. Wemmbu and Minutetech try to kill Fantst but he runs away again.

Fantst, Baablu, Sharpness and a bunch of Wemmbu's other enemies chase Wemmbu down in the fartherlands.

Fantst is trapped in LettuceK’s prison with Baablu, Wemmbu, PrinceZam, and Blurpinstein. He attempts to make an escape, success is unknown.

title: Fantst's Team
content:
Fantst's Team were a group of players owned by Fantst.  

The first appeared in How How I DESTROYED a Hardcore Minecraft SMP. They were responsible for destroying Ice Mountain Civilization. They later tried to flood the spawn with Ender Dragons. They used Wemmbu to weaken MinuteTech, so they could enter the End. They sent GamerCat021 and two other members to kill them, which resulted in everyone dying except for GamerCat. They fought them again at the End City. They fought them for a third time in the main End island, which resulted in multiple casualties, including GamerCat. Everyone eventually retreats except for Baablu and SuperstionalRealism, the latter of which is killed by Wemmbu. Baablu is spared.

title: Far Lands
content:
The Far Lands is a terrain that "replaces the world border" and generates 12 million blocks from Spawn. The more you traverse into the Far Lands, the more glitches occur, and more terrain is corrupted and deleted. The glitches are said to change a lot. The end of the Far Lands is the Minecraft void. There are many directions in the Far Lands; however, the one seen the most is the direction towards the Far Lands Civilization and SerpentBound's kingdom. PlanetLord says that he thinks that the player who first discovered The Far Lands was the one to make it such a mysterious places and generated all of these Biomes, glitches and exploits.

 Places and Terrain 
The Far Lands have many historical places and echoes which have been seen in many Unstable SMP episodes. These are some of the mentioned places. Direction is labelled after each place.

 Ashswagg's House (unknown) 
Ashswagg lived in a house in the Far Lands. He abandoned the house and lived in an underground base since the Invisible Mafia disbanded.

 The Far Lands Civilization (+Z) 

The Far Lands Civilization was one of the last resistance cells fighting against the Invisible Mafia. It had 3 districts to organize themselves and used beacon signals to communicate with other resistance cells. Its remoteness meant that other resistance cells could not help it when it was overrun by the Mafia. The final battle against The Mafia lasted a few minutes before the civilization was overrun and destroyed by The Mafia. Its ruins still stand as a memory of the terror of the Mafia.
thumb|The Far lands Civilization|201x201px

 The Far Lands Portal (±X, ±Z) 
thumb|The Underworld Portal from I Explored the Minecraft Farlands|204x204px
This is a portal in the Far lands which allows people in the Far Lands to quickly travel millions of blocks. The portal first leads to the Underworld, where the people in the Underworld allow others to travel using the portals. These people are allied to JamatoP, whom they seem to recognize. There are many portals spanning all the directions of the Far Lands. Wemmbu and JamatoP went from −X Far Lands to +Z Far Lands in I Explored the Minecraft Farlands.

 The Spikelands (+Z) 
thumb|The Spikelands from I Got REVENGE on the Unstable SMP.|214x214px
This is not a very important place in The Far Lands, as the Far Lands has other terrain; however, it is important to the lore as this is the place where The Avengers were defeated by FlameFrags and Wemmbu, and this is where the rivalry between Flame and Jaden began. Funnily enough, somewhere in this biome, there is an echo of a player named Burgle5 who starved to death. 

 The Cherry Grove (+Z) 
This is also another overlooked aspect of the Far Lands; however, due to its natural beauty,p> 

thumb|The Zam empire echo from I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands|221x221px
This is one of the anomalies in The Far Lands, as a nexact copy of Zam Empire is found by Wemmbu and Eggchan. There is also a real echo of FlameFrags and other higher-ranking members of Zam Empire before PrinceZam himself. There is no real explanation why this happens.

 The Far Lands Temple (+Z) 
thumb|The Far Lands Temple from I Explored the Minecraft Farlands (Cameo)|242x242px
This is a place with the statues of all the first-generation players in the Far Lands. A first-generation player is a player who is wealthy and wants to be in the Far Lands. This is also where Lakerek was killed and where we first found out about the forge.

 Serpentbound's Kingdom (+Z) 
thumb|301x301px|Serpentbound's Kingdom from I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void

This is the most influential place in the Far Lands. It is owned by some of the First Generation Players. After the death of Lakerek, Serpentbound333 became the highest authority in the kingdom, hence the kingdom's name. These players are very hostile to intruders, and they know about something called the Forge that presumably is a place to dupe weapon-related items and structures like maces, bottles of enchanting and Orbital Strike Cannons. During the Power Arc, Wemmbu invaded the civilization for answers about the Forge. Wemmbu managed to kill some of the first-generation players, but they refused to tell anything about the Forge. Wemmbu ended up leaving without any answers and instead used the Orbital Strike Cannons near the civilization. In I Explored the Minecraft Farlands Wemmbu met some first-generation players again but avoided the kingdom. These first-generation players are very rich, so rich in fact that they had 3 double chests of maces and some of the only villagers on the server. This means that they can infinitely produce rare items such as experience bottles and mending books. They also have an unknown method of getting netherite that Serpentbound referred to as a trade secret (presumably related to the Forge). This is odd because the portals in the Far Lands don't work, and the select few that do only lead to the Underworld. JamatoP also knows this kingdom and maintains good relationship with it. They may also have some kind of relationship with the underworld, as the Soul Keepers have a portal that leads near Serpentbound's Kingdom.

 The Red Plain (+Z) 
thumb|315x315px|The Red Plain in Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
The red plain is a biome covered with netherrack and crimson nylium and trees made of unusual blocks. It is where Revenant and Mapicc built their camp after escaping Null Hunters. The camp had been looted by Null Hunters before Spoke and Jumper came. It has a tunnel to a flowery plain biome. It is one of the many biomes in The Far Lands and it also has a floating mineshaft in the sky filled with Lost Players. These Lost players are players who have been trapped in The Far Lands and they could be also referred to as Farlands Zombies. 

 PlanetLord's Base and The Biome (+Z) 
thumb|311x311px|PlanetLord's Base from Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
PlanetLord built his base in a biome with periodic, intertwined, and stacked sine waves of grass blocks. It had a maxed out enchanting table, tree farm, food farm and multiple other players. Its goal was to help players who get lost in Far Lands. It was later taken over by Null Hunters. This base is in a weird, hard to describe biome and it was in the path to The Dark Forest.  

 The Dark Forest (+Z) 
thumb|310x310px|The NULL Leader being trapped in The Dark Forest from Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing.
Is a forest that is completely dark and torches can operate only in shorter-than-usual range. Nametags are hidden even without crouching here.  Because of the darkness having reinforcements here or allies is very hard and this is one of the most dangerous biome in The Farlands.  Spoke, Jumper and Mapicc managed to isolate Null Hunters and even capture their leader using the darkness. PlanetLord even said something about people being corrupted because of the darkness. The NULL leader was forced to lead them to a staircase that leads to Null Hunters' tunnels as well as possibly Null Hunters'  true leader. He seemed scared, for his rank and his life and also refused to continue (If he was seen with Spoke, he would have probably been labeled as a traitor) and was brutally killed. The staircase he led them to seemed to go infinitely down.  

 The Fabric (+Z) 
This is a biome that resemble Wifies's World that Doesn't Exist ARG series' thumbnails, with lots of tunnels inside a dark open space. It is on the side of the aforementioned staircase. It is possibly in the space between the Overworld and the Underworld due to Spoke exclaiming how deep the staircase is. Spoke, Jumper and Mapicc met Jamato in a torch-lit altar here.

 The Road of Null (unknown) 
Anticsparty06 managed to offset the pearl cannon to the Road of Null before being killed and landed in the Far Lands. Therefore the Road of Null must be somewhere in the Far Lands, if not further in the void.

 Inhabitance 
In the Far Lands, you will most likely find 3 types of individual player entities. First, there are the Farland Zombies, people trapped in with no clear way out, (Some of these players are just trapped from earlier adventures though majority have been trapped by NULL) First Generation Players, who are more experienced and richer "zombies".  Echoes. Not real players, just predictions of them that repeat over and over. Almost nothing is known about them, and finally NULL who patrol The Farlands and capture escaped players. (Farlands Zombies)

The Null Hunters is known to recently starting to take over Far Lands. This created more Farland Zombies who had to survive in the resource-scarce region or refugees like in PlanetLord's base. NULL, however is not invincible. Despite their resource advantage they can be killed like how a entire squadron was destroyed in The Dark Forest. NULL hunters in The Farlands are also less experienced and thus do not have Totems Of Undying that can teleport them since they usually fight players who have like iron armour and do not usually need them

 Glitches and Mechanics 
The Far Lands has many glitches and mechanics that make it a truly mysterious place on the Unstable SMP. These are some of the seen glitches and mechanics of the Far Lands.

This includes infinite repeating loops of past historical events. The main echoes that the Far Lands give home to include the Zam Empire creation echo and the First Generation Players vs Elder Guardian. Echoes, or memories, are repetitions of past events. They occur in the Far Lands as well as in the Underworld.

Perhaps the biggest elephant in the room is the repeating patterns of the Far Lands. These patterns take existing structures, whether man-made or not, and make them so that they infinitely repeat. A few of the infinite repeating patterns include the infinite dungeon and spawner that Wemmbu and Eggchan looted, gaining over 64 enchanted golden apples. Another massive repeating pattern is the infinite array of Orbital Strike Cannons. These are the very orbitals that Wemmbu uses to this day. It is unknown what creates a repeating pattern because it's not as though they only repeat naturally generated structures, but they also include the orbital cannons, which aren't natural. This implies that there are duplication glitches in the Far Lands, which would explain how the OG players got to be so rich in the first place, and are likely related to the Forge. Sharpness also only went to the Far Lands to try and find a duplication glitch.

Another glitch is that of connection between the Underworld and the Far Lands, because when you use a nether portal anywhere but the Far Lands, it takes you to the nether, but when you use an existing nether portal in the Far Lands (you cannot build one), it takes you to the Underworld. This is interesting because it implies that there is a significant history that links the Underworld and the Far Lands together. Null Hunters can light portals in the Far Lands but not normal players. It is unclear whether these portals lead to the Nether or the Underworld.

A staircase was found to go infinitely down in the Far Lands. It is theorized to connect to the Underworld. It was in the Dark Forest.

Nametags are hidden even without crouching in the Dark Forest. But they do show in the staircase as well as in the fabric biome.

PlanetLord has said that the first person who discovered the Farlands generated all of these glitches. 

 Trivia 
The four protagonist have all been to Far Lands. The sequence of arrival is Parrot, Wemmbu, Flame and Spoke.

title: Far Lands Civilization
content:
Far Lands City was a civilization built in the Far Lands.  

Structure
To thrive, the Farlands was divided into 3 different districts; the Builders, the Farmers, and the Warriors. Each district's objective was to fulfill their role to benefit everyone in their Civilization.

Builders
Builders were tasked to build for the Civilization.

Farmers
Farmers were tasked to provide resources for the Civilization.

Warriors
Warriors were tasked to defend the Civilization and were the main and biggest faction.

Sorting
A player was put into a test to decide which district they belong in. They were required to kill a wither with 5 items of their choice. The player would then be sorted into their faction depending on what approach they take.

If the player decided to fight the wither head on, they were most likely to be sorted into the Warriors.
If the player decided to hide from the wither until it's gone, they were most likely to be sorted into the Builders.
If the player decided to devise a way to trap the wither, they were most likely to be sorted into the Farmers.

History
Season 1

The Warriors District fails to protect the Farming District when The Invisible Mafia attacks, so they stop giving the Warriors resources.

ParrotX2 travels to the far lands and sees a player named Qu1nten. Qu1nten leads him to the civilization. Parrot convinces Horace_Altman, the leader of the civilization, to team up with him. Parrot joins the Warriors District after his test result was both farmer and warrior. Parrot is sent to blow up a mafia storage. After blowing it up, they get tricked into going into an obsidian hallway, where a diamond tier mafia player is. The player kills the mission leader Dimofyy. The others manage to escape using nether portals.

Parrot and TheobaldTheBird have a competition for who becomes the next mission leader. TheobaldTheBird wins using TNT minecarts to pop Purpled's totem.

The warriors and the farmers play capture the flag. The farmers win the game. Parrot goes on a mission with the warriors to kill a diamond tier mafia player in Mafia City. They retreat from the fight. Purpled gives them diamond trimmed boots. Parrot agrees to fight DumbIsDumb to become a council member. By flooding the arena with water and using tridents, Parrot is able to win.

The civilization discovers that there are Mafia players near the farlands. They find a gold tier player in the nether who is able to escape. They intercept the gold tier player when he is giving his message to ashswagg. They pretend to be diamond tier players, and then kill him with a fall trap.

Purpled tries to have the council members kill Parrot, but he escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members. Parrot unites the warriors and the farmers, and tells everybody to throw their diamond trimmed armor into a cactus and replace it with normal netherite armor.

Ashswagg takes the warriors hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. The Mafia destroys the Far Lands Civilization.

Parrot comes back to activate the beacon system in farlands civilization before leaving.

Season 2

Wemmbu visits the city while flying through the farlands, chasing Sharpness or Conexion.

[[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and [[TheobaldTheBird]] have a competition for who becomes the next mission leader. TheobaldTheBird wins using TNT minecarts to pop [[Purpled|Purpled's]] totem.

The warriors and the farmers play capture the flag. The farmers win the game. Parrot goes on a mission with the warriors to kill a diamond tier mafia player in [[Mafia City]]. They retreat from the fight. [[Purpled]] gives them diamond trimmed boots. Parrot agrees to fight [[DumbIsDumb]] to become a council member. By flooding the arena with water and using tridents, [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] is able to win.

The civilization discovers that there are [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] players near the farlands. They find a [[Mafia Gold Players|gold tier player]] in the nether who is able to escape. They intercept the gold tier player when he is giving his message to [[ashswagg]]. They pretend to be [[Mafia Diamond Players|diamond tier players]], and then kill him with a fall trap.

Purpled tries to have the council members kill Parrot, but he escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members. Parrot unites the warriors and the farmers, and tells everybody to throw their diamond trimmed armor into a cactus and replace it with normal netherite armor.

[[Ashswagg]] takes the [[Warriors District|warriors]] hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. [[The Invisible Mafia|The Mafia]] destroys the Far Lands Civilization.

Parrot comes back to activate the beacon system in farlands civilization before leaving.

'''Season 2'''

Wemmbu visits the city while flying through the farlands, chasing Sharpness or [[Conexion]].

title: Farland Zombies
content:
Intro 
left|thumb|344x344px
The Farlands is located 12 millon blocks from Spawn and is a weird terrain glitch that basically changes the world around it. But with it comes a problem. Back in the servers old days, the Farlands was not known to exist until players, trying to reach what should have ben the world border, found IT instead. The weird part about this is that the game did not get laggy as they pressed on with their exploration. They entered, explored and exited bringing the news to everyone they met. 

 Getting Lost 
As news spread many players went to the farlands to colonize. The great part about this was that, since the farlands was so far away, no griefers would try to bomb it. Many people went to build there to build their homes. Houses were built, towns were made, but then, players got too adventurous. They went too far and they lost track of how to get back. Since the debug menu (for seeing coordinates) was not working, as we saw in Wemmbu's POV, people could not figure out how to get back, nor did they have the resources required to. They were stuck in a land with dangerous terrain and a glitchy atmosphere, thus becoming the infamous "Farland Zombies"*. 

*In order to become a Farland Zombie, our definition would be to have been in the farlands for more than 26,300 in-Minecraft Days, 7/8 of which cannot be with any social interaction. More than 1/8 social interaction is called a First Generation Player.

thumb|473x473px|Farlands Zombie BaguetteBattler8 (right) next to his house

 The Life 
Because of the size of the farlands, it is almost impossible to find another player. Most zombies only see a player once every 2 real life years, and most of the time it's just a random explorer who does not care about the zombie. Zombies usually live in cheap houses with little-to-no interior design. They survive only on farms they tend, for their sustenance. Usually, the farms are growing carrots or potatoes as they serve enough hunger points to survive. Items like netherite and Maces are one of the hardest items to obtain on the SMP, but in the farlands, a single diamond is worth more. The Farlands is a place where the needs are way more expensive and hard to find than the wants. A Zombie has almost no hope of escaping unless someone helps them do so.  

 Farland Zombie List (Confirmed) 

 BaguetteBattler8 
Wemmbu found this player in "I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands" when he was trying to retrieve one of his Maces from Conexion. This was when he confirmed that Farland Zombies were real. 

 Burgle5 
Wemmbu found this player in the video "I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Fartherlands". This player was found in the ice spikes mega biome, and was actually an echo, a ghost player that has past

 Players who have escaped Null Hunters 
Spoke, Mapicc and Jumper found players that have escaped Null in the Far Lands. Some tried to rob Mapicc, and others stayed at refuges like PlanetLord's base.

title: FerreMC
content:
FerreMC, also known as Ferre, is a character in Unstable Universe. He is the teammate and righthand man of ClownPierce.

 History 

 Season 1 
Leow0ok agrees with ParrotX2 and Wifies to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, FerreMC, and Mugm_ come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues.

Parrot convinces Leow0ok’s team to help him kidnap BranzyCraft, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go. ClownPierce and FerreMC find Parrot's jungle base and destroy it.

Wemmbu and Eggchan set up a job where people can hire them to blow up things. Woogiex hires them to blow up Ferre’s base. They find that Ferre has a secret tunnel system in his tower, so they go to investigate. Ferre catches him and Wemmbu tries to escape. He goes underground, and eventually Ferre leaves. Wemmbu and eggchan come back to destroy the base. They send three TNT missiles to destroy the base. They are able to destroy the base using TNT, and are able to escape by going underground.

ClownPierce puts PrinceZam and Wemmbu in a prison. FerreMC is seen as a guard at this prison.

FerreMC joins the Invisible Mafia and becomes the leader of the diamond players.

ClownPierce and FerreMC destroy ManePear's Treehouse. Wemmbu and eggchan escape by going into the nether.

Wemmbu tries to kill ClownPierce and FerreMC but fails. FerreMC threatens to kill eggchan if Wemmbu doesn’t let ClownPierce kill him. Ferre fails to kill eggchan and they escape. They almost kill Ferre by breaking all of his armor. Ferre gives them a mace in exchange for his life to be spared. (Not without Wemmbu attempting to kill him until Eggchan convinces Wemmbu not to)

Wemmbu, Wato1876 and eggchan distract ClownPierce and FerreMC by fighting them while SpokeIsHere destroys The Invisible Mafia.

 Season 2 
ParrotX2, FlameFrags, and TheobaldTheBird take FerreMC hostage. He is eventually able to escape.

 Trivia 
 FerreMC is confirmed to be part of a Nether Civilization consisting of ClownPierce, Mugm, and other powerful players who aim to monopolize resources only obtainable in the nether.
 FerreMC is ClownPierce's righthand man.
 FerreMC ranks #35 on MCTiers.

title: FieldsOfElysium
content:
FieldsOfElysium is a supporting character in Unstable Universe. He is the current ruler of The Wheat Kingdom and wields a mace.

 History  
FieldsOfElysium is seen in the beginning telling a hostile group to leave. When the group tries to resort to violence, Wemmbu steps in and threatens them with his mace. Yungyx, the leader, flees. FieldsOfElysium thanks Wemmbu for the help and offers him bread which Wemmbu vehemently declines yet is given anyway.

Wemmbu is concerned for the kingdom's safety, which prompts FieldsOfElysium to tell him the story of an old protector they had that has since left the server, and owned a mace. He tells Wemmbu to look for LordSirWessley, as he is the only person the hero told about the whereabouts of the mace. Wemmbu leaves hastily after FieldsOfElysium tells him the festival Wessley would be at would be ending soon. 

Wemmbu returns with the mace and gives it to FieldsOfElysium. The monarch thanks him profusely and offers him anything the kingdom has in return, including two horses, one for Wemmbu and the other for his best friend, Eggchan.

title: Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players
content:
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players is the 130th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Spoke recaps his previous episode where he went to the Farlands, where it is rumored that thousands of players disappeared and was waiting to be found. If they wanted to bring the server back to peace, he'd have to act fast, as well as avoiding the people who've been behind all of this: NULL. When Spoke, Mapicc, and JumperWho found the deepest part of the Farlands, instead of finding the missing players, they found JamatoP, who was behind it all.

The episode starts with Mapicc wondering how Jamato is still alive, Jamato brushs it off says that that's what he wanted them to belive but there's a bigger problem at hand, being NULL and the players. Spoke thinks to himself that Jamato returning felt off and it wasn't a coincidence. Jamato gives the three of them a shulker box with some gear, in one of the slots has a book with Spoke's name on it signed by Jamato. Spoke opens the book and it tells him that he'll never find the players and that Mapicc and Jumper will turn on him, and that if he tries anything, Jamato would reveal everything and put an end to it all. Jamato had blackmailed Spoke, he's unsure to why Jamato would do such a thing. However, the book was signed by Jamato, which would be his biggest mistake.

The four of them reach the exit, Spoke stalls and tries to get Jamato to go up first while Spoke gives them the book. Jamato "accidentally" picks up the book and gives it back to them. Mapicc reads it and says they got the same book, Spoke opens it back up and the contents of it changed, now saying to enjoy the kit and to stay safe. Spoke burns the book and heads up with them, as he goes up the steps, he picks up another book named "Spoke_Log_Full", in which Jamato had been keeping track of Spoke the entire time since he joined the server. Spoke knows Jamato is trying to use his past against him, and if his real intentions were to lead them away, he'd have to sabotage Jamato's plans. He burns that book too then speaks up and says they should look where they came from if they spent all that time going down, Jumper agrees and asks why they're going up, and Jamato says they're moving forward.  

When they get out of the stairway system, new terrain of terricotta spike-like terrain with bridges built across each from each other, and hundreds of villager houses cover the floor appear right before their eyes. Mapicc asks what bridge they should take, Jamato says NULL occupies most of the Nether and has thousands of players, so they can't take them all in a fight, but that they can't find the missing players without finding NULL. Jamato offers to take them to a secret back way to find the players. Spoke intervenes and says they can't take down NULL with just the four of them and that they should head towards the opposite direction to find more rebel groups to help them. Jamato says the numbers don't mean anything and that they're not going to fight, he then asks if Spoke doesn't trust him. Jumper jumps in and is on Jamato's side, believing they're getting closer. Spoke says it'll take time, but if this is their only hope, then he isn't willing to take that chance and decides to head north by himself. Mapicc is onboard, Jumper sounds unsure, and Jamato agrees to go with whatever plan Spoke has, telling him he's making a mistake under his breath. 

Spoke was curious to see what Jamato was willing to do to turn them back, but just as he has that thought, a Nether portal appears on the pillar right in front of them. They water downwards and try to keep heading north, more portals appear, which makes Spoke blow the bridges up to dodge them. The Null hunters chase after them and they're forced to fight them or knock them down. Although Jumper and Jamato thinks it's risky to keep going north, Spoke decides to keep on going and head towards the hunters and fight. They fend off the hunters and Spoke breaks their portal, Spoke starts bridging towards a new pillar as the Null hunters wait on top for them. Spoke pearls onto a bridge nearby, the hunters catch up and get him down to half a heart. The other three kill off a few more hunters, giving some time to traverse. More hunters show up, Spoke and Mapicc use knockback swords to knock the hunters off and kill them. 

Eventually, they find a new biome and they bridge towards it. As they enter Jamato tells them it's still not too late to turn back, they don't have to cross back on the bridges, but they need to head the right way. Mapicc says he recognizes this group because Revenant says a rainbow forest has a group of stacked players. Mapicc asks Jamato if he's been around here, in which he says he hasn't. Spoke is uncertain what Jamato even wants, one moment he uses his group to turn them back and the next he's okay with just following them. Little did both of them know, they were headed towards a trap. They go deeper into the biome and find a player towering up a tree, Mapicc wind charges him off and they clutch. They try to ask the player, chromesanctuary, questions, but they appear to not have a mic and they start running; they follow. A piston fall trap gets pulled, and Chrome asks what they're doing in their biome. Spoke tries to convince them they're good and that they're trying to work with them. Chrome doesn't believe him when he has full netherite and a Null shield. He then says they'll let them talk to their leader, and Spoke says he can try and explain what they're trying to do with the leader. Jamato says they'll take off their gear in order for to gain the Rainbow Forest's group's trust. The players let them out and lead them back to the surface, Spoke tries to tell them he's trying to save them, but Chrome says they love the Farlands and getting rich. They reach the leader of the group, DylPickle, who welcomes them to Pickletopia. He makes his group give them space and asks what they're here for. Jumper says they were taken by force, but asks for any gear if he has any, which he says all their gear is taken up. * This marks the first time in a long time where a protagonist has nothing to their name.
* The biome that the group emerged from the staircase is a direct reference to This episode referenced [[Wifies]]' popular "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NnTycJg1MIo Destroying a World That Doesn't Exist]" ARG video.
* People on Twitter have caught onto the fact that the reaction roles for Spoke in the Unstable Events server have decreased significantly. This could've possibly hinted towards the fact that Jamato was erasing Spoke from the server.<ref>https://x.com/omsonichater/status/2052805274780774850?s=46</ref>
* Another detail to back this up is that Spoke's name hasn't been mentioned by any of the other protagonist's in their videos in a while either<ref>https://x.com/kohiiiaip/status/2052795409534185639?s=46</ref>, but all three other protagonists have been mentioning or seeing each other almost every video. 
* At around 24:41, [[JamatoP|JamatoP's]] name is shown as "JamatoB". 
* When Spoke was looking at Jamato through the window, a flower pot with a rose could also be seen, which could be said to be [[iMajesticRose]], showing the two players that have "ruined" Spoke's life on the server.<ref>https://x.com/spokeisms/status/2052801787623850390?s=46</ref>
* Spoke is the third and possibly last protagonist to have their ender chest cleared, not counting [[ParrotX2|Parrot]], as Parrot has not used an ender chest since [[Season 1]].
** Wemmbu's ender chest was cleared in [[I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands]] and Flame blew up the items inside his ender chest in [[SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server]].
* Spoke's legendary chestplate [[Alt]] was ironically broken by his former best friend [[Mapicc]], surviving 130 [[Unstable Universe|episodes]] all the way from the very first one.
* Another person on Twitter gathered the following information from a Mapicc stream about this video:<ref>https://x.com/missionnull/status/2053283006190592159</ref>
** Spoke allows Mapicc to freestyle his lines in every video that he's in.
** Spoke's pickaxe breaking was intentional.
** Mapicc was watching Instagram Reels for a majority of the video.
** Mapicc didn't hear Spoke say sorry to him when he went through the portal.

title: Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia
content:
Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia is the 87th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Parrot recaps what the Invisible Mafia was, and how they took most of the resources on the server. However, rumors say how the resources were never destroyed, but stored somewhere hundreds of thousands of blocks out in a tomb in the End dimension. Parrot and Theo head out to the outer End islands, and they both nearly drop into the void after entering an end gateway. They make it to the end of the first End rings, so they use a flying machine to travel the rest of the way there. Hours pass, and they get to a huge island filled with cherry blossom trees. The two follow the path that leads to a massive door. In front of the door has two hoppers, which means a key is needed to access it. Parrot spots players coming and both of them hide. Parrot notices that one of the players was CoinMonke, one of his friends is part of the group that was trying to access the tomb too. One of the other players try to break the door down, but is suddenly given the darkness effect. An invisible player in full netherite with a quartz eye trim appears right behind them once the darkness wears off. The invisible player drinks milk, revealing themselves to be Marlowww, Minecraft's best PvPer. The group is confident they can take Marlowww in a fight, having an advantage with players, but they quickly drop. Parrot and Theo decide to save Coin and run off the island.

Parrot, Theo, and Coin flies away from the island, heading towards an End station. They head inside, where everybody there is playing games and gambling. Parrot looks around, everyone stares back at him intimidatingly. Two of the people that were playing games begin to argue, and a fight breaks out, causing one of them to die. Coin lets Parrot run free and makes him talk to Rasplin. Parrot asks Rasplin for any hints on the tomb, but Rasplin wants to play a game of eight-fold for it. He says he has a key to the tomb, but Theo thinks he could be scamming. They play the first round, and Parrot loses. They keep going, with wagers going higher and higher each round. On the last round, Parrot has a good hand, and Rasplin wants Parrot to wager everything, his armor, totems, and shulker boxes in exchange for the key. Parrot wagers everything in and he loses. Then, the darkness sets in again, and Rasplin instantly gets killed by Marlowww. Parrot goes through an escape tunnel, but before leaving, he looks at Marlowww, and she's staring back at him. 

Parrot and Theo come back to the island where the tomb is located, Theo gives Parrot his Elytra since he has no armor. Parrot says they stand no chance fighting against Marlowww, and they only need to get the key from her. His idea is to lock the hoppers so the key can't be put in the hoppers and have Theo take it while Parrot shoots her away with a punch bow. Marlowww comes back to the island and they wait until she's gone to set the plan in motion. Parrot locks the hoppers and hides behind a rock to wait for Marlowww to come back. As Marlowww is coming back, Parrot is prepared to shoot and Marlowww is about to put the key in until she says, "Don't you know that I can see you right there?" Parrot, thinking his cover has been blown, hides behind the rock. However, it was another player was hiding nearby and Marlowww kills them. Marlowww then drops the key and Parrot manages to get the shot off, and Theo gets the key. They meet back at a lake where Parrot said to come to if they ever split off and lose each other. The two hide inside a cave for days until Marlowww leaves the island to enter the tomb. Days go by, and Parrot thinks enough time has passed, so they go and unlock the door to the tomb. 

Once inside, a huge elevator leads them down to what appears to be a huge maze. Parrot and Theo wander around until the darkness effect hits them. Knowing that Marlowww appears whenever the darkness effect is given, Theo tells Parrot to run. Theo says he'll do his best to fend off Marlowww. Parrot hides for a bit and comes back to the fighting grounds, with no trace of Theo anywhere. Parrot had a choice to either leave empty-handed, or try and find Theo, knowing he could still be alive, so he keeps going. Parrot finds a chest with all of Theo's loot and a sign written by Marlowww saying if Parrot keeps going, he'd end up dead like Theo. Parrot decides to keep going, and eventually makes it to the end of the maze, which leads to a massive cave with two invisible diamond trim statues in front of the door leading to the stash. Parrot walks closer to the door, and the darkness effect kicks in. Parrot flies away before the darkness wears off and before he's confronted by Marlowww. He stumbles into another part of the cave and explores further down. At the end, he finds what appears to be Marlowww's secret base. Marlowww has bookshelves full of books, using them to journal what happens day by day, and Parrot reads through them. The books show that Marlowww's best friend joined the Mafia and that Marlowww joined herself to protect her friend, the stash is set to kill any remaining Mafia members if any items were taken from it, and that Marlowww was never a monster, but only appearing to be one in order to protect her friend and anybody else. The last one reveals that Marlowww didn't kill Theo because he reminded her too much of her best friend, the two would protect their friends with their life. Parrot puts the book back, and turns around to see Marlowww. He realizes Marlowww isn't even and is only doing what's best to protect other players. Marlowww pulls a hidden lever that reveals the remaining ender pearl stasis chambers, then she walks away. Parrot apologizes and walks to the front of the door where the stash is located. He enters it, going down another big cave, and another door at the end of it awaits. He walks right through and finds the stash. There are tons of rooms, each built for specific resources. Parrot looks around, only to take nothing. 

He comes back up and reunites with Theo and gives all his items back. The two begin to head back, Marlowww watches them from the island and goes back to being invisible. Theo asks if Parrot found the tomb and how much he took, and Parrot said he took nothing and that he was wrong about Marlowww and everybody else. Parrot says he's done hunting treasure and that he doesn't know what to do after. He asks if Theo would come with him once he figures it out, and Theo happily agrees.

title: Firestar2008
content:
Firestar2008 is a supporting character of Unstable Universe Season 2.

 History 
While Wemmbu found a trial chamber in the Far Lands, Firestar2008 fights him and accidentally revealed a lodestone compass revealing the location of their base.

In Wemmbu's video "I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void" Firestar2008 asked Wemmbu to train him in Mace PVP. Wemmbu hardly ignored him. After that Firestar2008 fought him alongside the other First Generation Players and teleported away when being knocked into the void.

5 months later, in "I Explored the Minecraft Farlands", Wemmbu found Firestar2008 at the Far Lands on an Orbital Strike Cannon. For some reason he had a deeper voice, but he was still very afraid of Wemmbu as Wemmbu simply gave him a bluff and he surrendered the orbitals.

 Trivia 

 Firestar is the only First Generation Player to be played by somebody else, with loppezz playing them. 
 However, in I Explored the Minecraft Farlands, Firestar got a new voice actor.

title: FlameFrags
content:
FlameFrags, also known as Flame, is one of the four main protagonists of Unstable Universe alongside ParrotX2, SpokeIsHere, and Wemmbu. He was formerly one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside PrinceZam) during Season 1, being a high-ranking guard for the Zam Empire, one of the formal archenemies of Wemmbu and Eggchan. He was the most recent one to be added to the protagonists, uploading his own perspective only since the beginning of Season 2. He was also a diamond tier Mafia member who refused to hold a mace due to a strong code of honor he abides by. 

 Personality 
Flame is a highly skilled and combat-focused player whose personality has largely centered around his pride in his fighting skills and fortitude. He has demonstrated capabilities to endure long fights and shows resilience and resourcefulness even in the face of impossible odds.  Thus, he's earned himself the title of being called The Immortal Demon. 

He can be condescending towards lower-skilled players, reflecting a confident attitude towards PvP. His self-worth is deeply intertwined with his title, causing him to stubbornly defend his reputation and taking on difficult challenges and fighting strong opponents in a constant battle to prove himself.  

He has shown great care for his friend, Lomedy. Going great lengths to save him and their relationship. Flame struggles to show his emotions outside of battle and will sometimes prioritize a fight over personal relationships. He seems to be afraid of letting others get too close and then losing them.  

Flame loves dogs and builds machines to unleash their combat power.  

 Gear

 Relationships
Lomedy
Flame met Lomedy during his Solo Players arc when he was being hunted down by a toxic Minecraft civilization. After fighting some of their men, he began looking for resources and found Lomedy’s farm. He decided to use the farm as a base for resources, despite Lomedy’s refusal. While their relationship was rocky at first, Flame defended his farm and ended up receiving Lomedy’s trust, when the farmer gifted Flame his old teammate’s mace to fight the toxic players. After defeating the civilization, Flame returned the mace and left the farm.

Over the course of the server, the two would help each other out with various missions. Flame assisted Lomedy in the Farm War, and Flame tried to help Lomedy after his mace was stolen.

When The Law was hunting down Flame, they captured Lomedy and held him in prison to use as leverage against Flame. When Flame broke into the Law prison to free Lomedy, he refused to leave. He did not like that Flame was killing players and being needlessly cruel. It wasn’t until Flame defeated the Law and apologized to Lomedy that he left with Flame.

After the Law, Flame and Lomedy created a base in the mesa to live in together.

Wemmbu
When Flame worked under PrinceZam, he was ordered to pretend to betray the Empire and attack Wemmbu. He raided his kingdom multiple times.

When Flame was in the Invisible Mafia, he kidnapped Wemmbu’s best friend, Eggchan, and took his mace.

Wemmbu fought Flame at his base. Flame won the battle and showed Wemmbu around his base.

Flame participated in a PVP tournament that Wemmbu also competed in. They taunted each other throughout and fought each other in the finals where Flame won.

Flame frees his friend, Jaden, from an underground civilization. When Jaden reveals it was Wemmbu who trapped him, he worked together with a few other players, The Avengers, to hunt him down in the Far Lands. Flame tricked one of the players, Sharpness, to give him a mace that he had stolen from Wemmbu. Flame betrays the Avengers and returns Wemmbu’s mace.

After being ordered by Spoke, Flame goes to an abandoned mafia outpost where he finds Wemmbu. Wemmbu fights him using orbital strike canons, defeating him and making him run from the fight. Flame vowed to get revenge.

Someone tells Flame that Wemmbu had died, but he did not believe it. He hunted down Wemmbu, protecting Boosfer who claimed to know where he was. He hunted down ClownPierce in the nether after being falsely told that he had killed Wemmbu, and eventually the teamed up with Parrot to unveil the Invisible Knight who they suspected to be Wemmbu. They trapped an Ender Pearl canon and revealed Wemmbu’s identity using dogs, with Flame insisting they have a rematch for the unfair fight they had previously. Wemmbu agreed, but they were interrupted by The Law.

The two put their fight on hold to hunt down the Law. They fought the Law’s army of 1000 players together. Afterwards, they fought once more, where Wemmbu gives up and tells Flame that he can be the Strongest Player.

Flame found out that Wemmbu had been imprisoned by the Law, and he was exiled from the server.

Flame and Wemmbu team up once again to fight The Law, along with Spoke and Parrot. They succeeded, but Flame attacked Wemmbu’s friend, Jaden, for stealing Lomedy’s mace. Wemmbu protected him.

ManePear
The two both worked under PrinceZam together in the Zam Empire. However, ManePear betrayed the empire, which caused them to fight and seperate.

When Flame joined the Invis Mafia, Mane fought against them. Wemmbu told Mane that he had fought a diamond player who did not use a mace, who Mane figured out was Flame. Mane managed to hunt down Flame and they fought, but Wemmbu and Eggchan interrupted the fight, causing Flame to flee. Mane tried to find him again, but Wemmbu didn’t tell him where he was.

When Flame was exiled from Unstable by the law, he sought out the masters of every weapon in order to become a master of Minecraft combat. For the spear, he found ManePear, who was living in a cave far away from the rest of the server. Mane trains Flame in exchange for Flame’s help at killing a group of players that had been annoying Mane.

When Flame was captured by the Law, Mane invaded the prison to rescue him, going against his former “lone wolf” persona.

 Trivia 

 Flame is one of the few major characters who has been apart of the Invisible Mafia and The Law, the others being eggchan and Leow0ok.
 Flame likes to say "bro", "like" and "dude" during combat.
 Flame had a dog, Ashen, who was regarded as an almighty god called the “Immortal Dog” by a group of potion masters. This reputation was earned because Ashen killed two players, however Flame says that says more about the players than the dog.
 Flamefrags and ManePear are commonly known as the Blindfold Brothers.
