But you should know by now that I'm not most players."|[[FlameFrags]]|opening monologue of [[I Became Immortal on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP]]}} [[FlameFrags]], also known as [[FlameFrags|Flame]], is one of the four main protagonists of ''[[Unstable Universe]]'' alongside [[ParrotX2]], [[SpokeIsHere]], and [[Wemmbu]]. He was formerly one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside [[PrinceZam]]) during [[Season 1]], being a high-ranking guard for the [[Zam Empire]], one of the formal archenemies of Wemmbu and [[Eggchan]]. He was the most recent one to be added to the protagonists, uploading his own perspective only since the beginning of [[Season 2]]. He was also a diamond tier [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] member who refused to hold a mace due to a strong code of honor he abides by. == Personality == Flame is a highly skilled and combat-focused player whose personality has largely centered around his pride in his fighting skills and fortitude. He has demonstrated capabilities to endure long fights and shows resilience and resourcefulness even in the face of impossible odds. Thus, he's earned himself the title of being called The Immortal Demon. He can be condescending towards lower-skilled players, reflecting a confident attitude towards PvP. His self-worth is deeply intertwined with his title, causing him to stubbornly defend his reputation and taking on difficult challenges and fighting strong opponents in a constant battle to prove himself. He has shown great care for his friend, [[Lomedy]]. Going great lengths to save him and their relationship. Flame struggles to show his emotions outside of battle and will sometimes prioritize a fight over personal relationships. He seems to be afraid of letting others get too close and then losing them. Flame loves dogs and builds [[Orbital Dog Cannon|machines]] to unleash their combat power. == Gear == {| class="wikitable sortable collapsible" style="margin:2px;" !Item Name !Item Type !Enchantment(s) |- |''Fragger'' |Netherite Sword |Sharpness V, Sweeping Edge III, Unbreaking III, Fire Aspect II, Looting III, Mending |- |''The Flame'' |Netherite Sword |Sharpness V, Sweeping Edge III, Unbreaking III, Knockback I, Fire Aspect II, Looting III, Mending |- |''Inferno'' |Netherite Axe |Efficiency V, Sharpness V, Unbreaking III, Mending |- |''Incendiary'' |Bow |Power V, Flame, Punch II, Unbreaking III, Mending |- |''Pyromania'' |Crossbow |Piercing IV, Unbreaking III, Quick Charge III, Mending |- |''Cremator'' |Netherite Spear |Sharpness V, Unbreaking III, Mending |- |''Carbonizer'' |Netherite Spear |Lunge III, Sharpness V, Unbreaking III, Mending |- |🔥 |Netherite Pickaxe |Silk Touch, Efficiency V, Unbreaking III, Mending |- |🔥 |Shield |Unbreaking III, Mending |- |🔥 |Netherite Helmet |Respiration III, Unbreaking III, Protection IV, Aqua Affinity, Mending |- |🔥 |Netherite Chestplate |Unbreaking III, Protection IV, Mending |- |🔥 |Netherite Leggings |Swift Sneak III, Unbreaking III, Protection IV, Mending |- |🔥 |Netherite Boots |Feather Falling IV, Soul Speed III, Unbreaking III, Protection IV, Depth Strider, Mending |- |''Wolf Rod'' |Fishing Rod |Trigger [[Orbital Dog Cannon]] and instantly breaks when used. |} == Relationships== ===Lomedy=== Flame met Lomedy during his Solo Players arc when he was being hunted down by a toxic Minecraft civilization. After fighting some of their men, he began looking for resources and found Lomedy’s farm. He decided to use the farm as a base for resources, despite Lomedy’s refusal. While their relationship was rocky at first, Flame defended his farm and ended up receiving Lomedy’s trust, when the farmer gifted Flame his old teammate’s mace to fight the toxic players. After defeating the civilization, Flame returned the mace and left the farm. Over the course of the server, the two would help each other out with various missions. Flame assisted Lomedy in the Farm War, and Flame tried to help Lomedy after his mace was stolen. When [[The LAW|The Law]] was hunting down Flame, they captured Lomedy and held him in prison to use as leverage against Flame. When Flame broke into the Law prison to free Lomedy, he refused to leave. He did not like that Flame was killing players and being needlessly cruel. It wasn’t until Flame defeated the Law and apologized to Lomedy that he left with Flame. After the Law, Flame and Lomedy created a base in the mesa to live in together. ===Wemmbu=== When Flame worked under [[PrinceZam]], he was ordered to pretend to betray the Empire and attack Wemmbu. He raided his kingdom multiple times. When Flame was in the [[The Invisible Mafia|Invisible Mafia]], he kidnapped Wemmbu’s best friend, [[Eggchan]], and took his mace. Wemmbu fought Flame at his base. Flame won the battle and showed Wemmbu around his base. Flame participated in a PVP tournament that Wemmbu also competed in. They taunted each other throughout and fought each other in the finals where Flame won. Flame frees his friend, [[Jaden MAN|Jaden]], from an underground civilization. When Jaden reveals it was Wemmbu who trapped him, he worked together with a few other players, [[The Avengers]], to hunt him down in the [[Far Lands]]. Flame tricked one of the players, [[Conexion|Sharpness]], to give him a mace that he had stolen from Wemmbu. Flame betrays the Avengers and returns Wemmbu’s mace. After being ordered by [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]], Flame goes to an abandoned mafia outpost where he finds Wemmbu. Wemmbu fights him using orbital strike canons, defeating him and making him run from the fight. Flame vowed to get revenge. Someone tells Flame that Wemmbu had died, but he did not believe it. He hunted down Wemmbu, protecting [[Boosfer]] who claimed to know where he was. He hunted down [[ClownPierce]] in the nether after being falsely told that he had killed Wemmbu, and eventually the teamed up with [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] to unveil the Invisible Knight who they suspected to be Wemmbu. They trapped an Ender Pearl canon and revealed Wemmbu’s identity using dogs, with Flame insisting they have a rematch for the unfair fight they had previously. Wemmbu agreed, but they were interrupted by The Law. The two put their fight on hold to hunt down the Law. They fought the Law’s army of 1000 players together. Afterwards, they fought once more, where Wemmbu gives up and tells Flame that he can be the Strongest Player. Flame found out that Wemmbu had been imprisoned by the Law, and he was exiled from the server. Flame and Wemmbu team up once again to fight The Law, along with Spoke and Parrot. They succeeded, but Flame attacked Wemmbu’s friend, Jaden, for stealing Lomedy’s mace. Wemmbu protected him. ===ManePear=== The two both worked under PrinceZam together in the [[Zam Empire]]. However, ManePear betrayed the empire, which caused them to fight and seperate. When Flame joined the [[The Invisible Mafia|Invis Mafia]], Mane fought against them. Wemmbu told Mane that he had fought a diamond player who did not use a mace, who Mane figured out was Flame. Mane managed to hunt down Flame and they fought, but Wemmbu and [[Eggchan]] interrupted the fight, causing Flame to flee. Mane tried to find him again, but Wemmbu didn’t tell him where he was. When Flame was exiled from Unstable by the law, he sought out the masters of every weapon in order to become a master of Minecraft combat. For the spear, he found ManePear, who was living in a cave far away from the rest of the server. Mane trains Flame in exchange for Flame’s help at killing a group of players that had been annoying Mane. When Flame was captured by the Law, Mane invaded the prison to rescue him, going against his former “lone wolf” persona. == Boundaries == * No NSFW * No Shipping == Quotes == {{Quote|You dropped TNT on me, you dropped wardens, and you had [[Jaden MAN|Jaden]] betray me, and I’m still standing. You can’t kill me.| [[FlameFrags|Flame]]|to [[The LAW]] in [[I Almost DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP]]}}{{Quote|I am a Minecraft Combat Master. A master of every weapon.|[[FlameFrags|Flame]]|opening monologue of [[I Became a Minecraft Combat Master]]}}{{Quote|[[ClownPierce|Clown]],You're not taking them anywhere bro. Cause you're gonna have to go through me first.|[[FlameFrags|Flame]]|to [[ClownPierce]] in [[SOLO Player VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction]]}} == Trivia == * Flame is one of the few major characters who has been apart of the [[The Invisible Mafia|Invisible Mafia]] and [[The LAW|The Law]], the others being [[eggchan]] and [[Leow0ok]]. * Flame likes to say "bro", "like" and "dude" during combat. * Flame had a dog, [[Ashen]], who was regarded as an almighty god called the “Immortal Dog” by a group of potion masters. This reputation was earned because Ashen killed two players, however Flame says that says more about the players than the dog. * Flamefrags and [[ManePear]] are commonly known as the Blindfold Brothers. ==Gallery== === Skin(s) === File:FlameFrags.png| Flame's regular skin ===Thumbnails===

title: FlameFrags/History
content:
History 
 Season 1 
 The PrinceZam Empire Arc 
FlameFrags is seen guarding a castle in the Zam Empire.

ManePear, Sorhin, and Flame attack Wemmbu and JamatoP in the latter's base, asking if they know anything about SpokeIsHere. After a short clash, they agree to take Wemmbu to the Zam Empire.

Flame is sent by PrinceZam to pretend to betray the Zam Empire and kill Wemmbu. Flame fails to kill Wemmbu due to a TnT minecart trap pulled off by him and his friend eggchan.

Wemmbu sees that Flame and Merffinn are trying to invade Roshambo’s Civilization. Flame nearly kills Roshambo, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges Flame to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in Roshambo's Civilization to evacuate, and then escapes using a stasis chamber.

The Zam Empire destroys Wemmbu's Civilization. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box while Flame and ManePear fight, with the former being indignant over the idea of a traitor keeping the armor of the empire after Mane betrayed them to work with Wemmbu.

 The Invisible Mafia Arc 
After the Zam Empire falls, Flame joins The Invisible Mafia as a diamond player. He threatens to kill eggchan unless Wemmbu gives him a mace. After successfully winning their duel utilizing slow falling and his superior skill in sword PvP, he gives the mace to ClownPierce.

Flame kills Dimofyy after trapping Parrot and a few members of the Warriors District.

 Season 2 
 The Toxic War Arc 
After the mafia falls, he retreats to live by himself in a base he constructed, but is constantly harassed by bandits. Three players try to trap him at his base but fail. He kills all of the players. A team of players including SpokeIsHere try to kill him. Flame finds one of the bandits' base, kills them, and steals their netherite sword.

A team of players try to steal from Flame despite TheobaldTheBird, their leader, telling them not to. Flame kills them. Flame travels to Merchant City to trade for gear. While he is leaving, a team of players from Bounty Assassin Team try to kill him. They fail to kill him and run away.

Wemmbu tries to kill Flame at his base at spawn. They eventually stop fighting. Spoke and a team of players try to kill Flame again but fail.

A team of players destroy Flame's base. Flame kills most of the players, but one of the members of the team escapes. The team finds him again and manage to steal his netherite sword. FlameFrags is able to kill them by splashing a strength potion and using his fist. FlameFrags finds two of the members of the team at his camp, who mention a player named Razor. FlameFrags kills them both. He picks up a lodestone compass from one of the players and follows it to a base.

Flame finds the leader of the team, Razor2gud, and tries to kill him. Razor says that he'll only fight him if FlameFrags uses worse items, such as not using netherite armor, weapons, and strength potions. Flame agrees to this, only for Razor to have his team try to kill Flame. Flame is able to kill all of them except for Razor, who escapes.

Flame finds a map showing the locations of every base owned by the team. He goes to a bunker to try and get materials for destroying more bases, and kills everyone there. Flame finds a team of players in diamond armor, including Razor. Flame kills their entire team except for Razor, who runs away again. While destroying the base they fought in, Flame finds another lodestone compass in a hidden barrel that supposedly leads to Razor's base.

Flame continues destroying bases. After destroying all of them, he goes to Razor's base. Flame and Razor agree to have a fair 1v1. They set up a trap to try and kill Flame, but it fails to kill him. FlameFrags kills every player, including Razor.

Flame's dog, Ashen, gets kidnapped by the same team.

Flame kills everyone in his team before fighting T0X1N. T0X1N starts losing the fight and threatens to kill Ashen. He gives Flame instructions, which are intended to kill him. However, Flame smuggled a bundle with a wind charge and manages to survive using the wind charge. Right as T0X1N is about to kill Ashen, Flame kills him.

More players attempt to kill FlameFrags but fail. 

FlameFrags looks for a base to stay in and he meets Lomedy. Players try to kill FlameFrags but fail. 

 The Betrayal Arc 
Flame joins a PvP tournament. FlameFrags is just barely able to win the tournament.

Flame learns that his friend Jaden_MAN has gone missing, and asks several players about his whereabouts, including Spongs, CookieBunsquat, and LettuceK. He finds Lettuce's answer to be incredibly suspicious and vague, deciding to trail him back to his base while invisible. Once there, he sees a signboard of targets with Jaden's name listed under 'captured.' He later returns and attempts to kill them, but fails. He comes back with invisibility, and secretly listens in on their conversation.

FlameFrags goes to Leowook's base with the intent of learning his cart PvP strategies, but finds it blown up and abandoned. He sees Leo amongst the rubble, and signs a deal with Leo for an IOU and a stack of experience bottles in exchange for lessons. A few days later, he arrives at an auction held by the Law. LettuceK is able to escape.

Returning to Leo, they make another deal for another stack where Leo pretends to be captured by the Law so Flame can find out where Jaden is being kept. It doesn't go to plan, with the Law pausing to inventory check Leo, so the two of them team up to fight against the Law. They escape using a pearl cannon, but he follows them to an island and chases them down to the Abandoned Civilization where Jaden was trapped by Wemmbu. He finds Jaden after searching the civilization, and they reunite.

After Jaden is free, Jaden asks Flame to kill Wemmbu, and Flame agrees to do so. Together, they recruit a team with people whom disliked Wemmbu, named The Avengers

They learned from 4CVIT that Wemmbu was chasing after Conexion, one of their common enemies, in the Farlands. Before going, he and Jaden set up stasis chambers so they could return easily. They find Wemmbu in the farlands and attempt to kill him, but fail.

The team begins to argue again, and splits up to cover more ground. While journeying, they find Sharpness again. Flame fights Sharpness to try to obtain his mace. Sharpness hides it in his ender chest as leverage, and Jaden comes over, convincing him to join the team. FlameFrags tricks Conexion into thinking he can duplicate the mace that Conexion has, so Conexion gives Flame the mace, and Flame then leaves.

The Avengers attempt to kill Wemmbu but fail, as FlameFrags decides to betray the team, and eventually gives the mace back to Wemmbu. FlameFrags' ender pearl stasis chamber is pearled one week after, into a void trap. His quick reaction time allows him to place a block in the trap, saving his life. He is able to escape the trap. Jaden asks FlameFrags for full netherite armor, so Flame makes it his goal to get him netherite armor. Lettuce tries to kill FlameFrags again, but fails. Flame gives Jaden a netherite helmet which he got from one of the players trying to kill him.

Jaden and Flame rob a town, and Jaden gets a pair of netherite leggings. The Law attacks Flame and Jaden. Jaden doesn't help with the fight. Flame is able to escape, and meets back up with Jaden, angry that he didn't help. Flame and Jaden go to the Law's base to try and kill them. Jaden betrays Flame, leaving him to die. Flame is able to escape.

Jaden offers Flame to join the Pirates, which he declines. Jaden tries to kill Flame with his pirates, but fails.Before hunting down Jaden, Flame realizes he needs a place to re-gear after battle. He asks Lomedy to help him rebuild the base, who now has two maces. They work together to fix the terrain, walls, and base itself. While they are doing this, Jaden watches them from a nearby hill and attacks Lomedy as he's leaving. Jaden steals Lomedy's mace using pots, so Flame begins to try to kill Jaden.

Flame is winning the fight until it starts to rain, allowing Jaden to trident-mace him from above. Flame hides in a shallow cave while Jaden taunts him from outside it. Jaden gives him a lodestone compass to the new pirate islands before leaving. 

FlameFrags and Jaden fight. 

 Skill vs Power Arc 
FlameFrags and Lomedy participate in the "farm war", in which he was not allowed to use weapons, and could only use netherite armor. Using traps, FlameFrags is able to kill some players. FlameFrags also kills players using a diamond hoe, which Lomedy dislikes. Flame and Lomedy destroy the raiders base. 

Spoke tricks Flame into doing things for him, and also tells him to go to an old Mafia stash. Once there, Flame finds Wemmbu, who tries to kill him. Flame is forced to run due to Wemmbu using maces and orbital strike cannons. Flame's signature chest plate is broken. 

Multiple players attempt to kill FlameFrags but fail. Flame creates a machine which can summon a large amount of dogs by using a fishing rod.

Flame is told that Wemmbu died. Flame begins looking for Luke4472, who supposedly knows about Wemmbu. Flame and The_CodMaster421 begin trying to find Luke. They eventually find Luke4472, and they discover that Luke heard about Wemmbu dying from MinuteTech.

Flame and MinuteTech fight due to him not explaining where Wemmbu is. Minute escapes using the outer end islands.

Boosfer claims to know what happened to Wemmbu. He gives a proposition, saying that he will tell him the information if Flame works for Boosfer. He agrees. Flame finds an invisible player, known as the Invisible Knight, who is secretly Wemmbu.

Flame returns to his base to see Boosfer under attack by the invisible player leading a crew of players. The Invisible Knight advises them to run, but they don't listen and die. 

Boosfer asks Flame to retrieve him ParrotX2's helmet and potion stash. He approaches Parrot, who is annoyed to see him and mocks him for being bossed around by Boosfer, calling him a henchman. Flame takes the stuff and leaves. Boosfer still refuses to give information on Wemmbu.

He and Flame create an escape tunnel in his base together under the jukebox that ends in a nether portal. After they're done, the Invisible Knight arrives at his base once again, who attacks Boosfer, until Boosfer promises to tell Flame about Wemmbu if he kills the Invisible Knight. The player leads him to a desert void trap that Flame nearly falls into, but he and Boosfer manage to survive. The remaining people of Capital City's force who created the trap fight Flame and Boosfer. Flame wins the fight, with all but the Invisible Knight and Salvationism dead.

The Invisible Knight begins speaking to Flame, saying that Boosfer has no evidence that he knows where Wemmbu is. He convinces him to begin to distrust Boosfer, and Flame attacks Boosfer. Boosfer manages to escape through the escape tunnel they made before. When they're chasing him through it, he says that ClownPierce killed Wemmbu and then goes through the nether portal. 

Flames ventures into the nether, looking for ClownPierces's Castle but encounter a hiding ParrotX2 and TheoBladTheBird, attacking them thinking they were guards, but stopped because they planned to rob Clown's vault. They worked together with parrot promising Flames that he could get his fight with Clown. They stormed Clown's Castle and looked for FerreMC, which knows where the vault is, attacked and kidnapped him with Clown and his guards unsuccessfully preventing them from kidnapping Ferre. They interrogated Ferre and Parrot give him a elytra to fly to get loots, but putting a tracker on him too, tracking where he will go (the vault) and follow after him. 

Parrot and Theobald talked about Flame being a bad person and doesn't deserve to have a chance of fighting Clown, Flame hearing all of this, mine his way through and looked for Clown's Castle, Flame demand to know where Wemmbu is but ClownPierce will only tell if Flame can offer them something, in which Flame leaked where Parrot and Theo is, leading them to finding and capturing them. 

Flames wanted to know what happen to Wemmbu but Clown said he knew nothing since he stayed in the Nether, which angers Flame and he attacked Clown's army, taking on all Clown's elite guards all while Clown looked for Parrot, Theo went missing. After killing all of Clown's guards, Flame went back to the over world. 

Flame then encounters LettuceK, in which he told Flame that they built a new base near Flame's base, Lettuce gives Flame a tour of their new base and meets Deputy_Ace, a law commander. Lettuce then decided to ask them to stay in prison, in which Flame refuses. Lettuce gives Flame alongside Wemmbu, three days to prepare and face Lettuce's new army, having over 1,000 players. 

Flame and Wemmbu encounter the 1000 players and Lettuce. Flame and Wemmbu eventually kill all 1000 players except Lettuce, but Flame fights Wemmbu to finally see who the strongest player on the server is. Flame won this fight leaving Wemmbu and Lettuce behind. 

 The Kings Arc 
This arc is concurrent to The BAT Arc.

Flamefrags returns to his base, finding it to be griefed by the Lawmen. He enters his base just to find his walls covered in the Law's colors, he hears a goat horn and turns. Opposite of him is LettuceK, the same person who exiled him, the same person who had terrorized him for months on end. Lettuce tells Flame to calm down, saying that its only him and that he wants to talk because they had a history for one last time. Flame reluctantly agrees but holds out a double totem, LettuceK questions if Flame really thinks that he's in the right, Flame hesitates before answering saying that he doubts that it matter and that he himself thinks that Lettuce isn't in the right to which Lettuce replies with that he knows, LettuceK asks Flame if he really doesn't think that Lettuce knows what type of leader he has become? 

Lettuce continues, going on a rant about how Flame, Wemmbu and others like them have always disturbed the peace, He then says that if he (lettuce) has to go down in history as a ruthless leader then so be it. As long as Flame and Wemmbu were banned from the server, he believed that his actions were justifiable. He claimed that the actions the actions he made were for the betterment of the server. He said that he wishes that Flame would take account for his actions, not just for Lettuce but for the massacre players. Lettuce blames Flamefrags for everything, if this didn't happen, if Flame could take accountibility for all of his actions of killing 1000 players. If Flame hadn’t done this, then Jaden Man wouldn't have been freed, then Lomedy wouldn't be held captive. Lettuce tells that he is giving Flame a chance to turn around and leave to let Lettuce do his job as becoming king. 

Flamefrags refuses, going for an attack on Lettuce who starts to run away. LettuceK leaves after realizing that theres no convincing Flame, Flame watches him leave before going into a secret part of his base. In the secret section, he finds his wolf army, who luckily were still alive. 

Flamefrags gets ready to storm the Law prison, wanting to save his best friend Lomedy. But right as Flame prepared his inventory, Wemmbu appears. Flame is asks why Wemmbu was there to which Wemmbu ignores him and asks if he has seen Eggchan. The two start to bicker until calming down and Wemmbu offers to work together to free their friends.  

The two attack the Law base and quickly vanquish the netherite/diamond players, teasing SargeLaw for killing his own army in the process. After killing at the players they head for the prison building, Wemmbu asks flame if lomedy actually wants to be freed, and flame replies with a no. Before going down, Wemmbu snags a few of flame’s items and Flame calls him greedy. Eventually Flamefrags goes down tells wemmbu to gaurd abovr.  

While going through the halls of the prison, Flame kills everyone in his way while going to Lomedy. He arrives in a corridor to hear Prince Zam letting everyone free alongside Spokeishere and Jumperwho. Flame uses his dogs help him, while being assisted by Spoke. The battle continues with the small group of attackers banning the law employees. 

The fight ends and Flamefrags goes to Lomedy, telling him that it's time to escape. Lomedy refuses, asking if Flamefrags is crazy and actually thinks that Lomedy would break the law. The peacefull moment fleeing the second Lomedy said that. Flamefrags laughs, thinking that Lomedy is joking, asking Lomedy to come with him. Lomedy starts yelling, questioning why he should trust Flame, he starts to list reason after reason; Flamefrags stole his mace, got his farm destroyed and still continues to fight the Law as if they were in the wrong. Flamefrags starts to get desperate, asking Lomedy to reconsider and come with him but Lomedy keeps saying no, reciting that he doesn't trust Flame. 

Flamefrags wonders why Lomedy doesn't trust him because he broke into prison for him, then he asks what Lomedy's sentence is to which Lomedy replies with months. Flame still tries to convince Lomedy to leave but Lomedy doesn't listen, Lomedy keeps asking why he should trust Flame, asking Flamefrags why he would trust someone who wasn't willing to change, why he should trust someone who fighting the Law. Flamefrags questions if Lomedy is serious, Lomedy states that the only reason he would leave is if the Law lets him go. 

Lomedy asks for his mace back, the one Flame supposedly stole when running from the Law. Flamefrags lies and tells Lomedy that he still needs the mace. Flamefrags starts to leave, walking up the destroyed staircase with Lomedy's yelling chasing him, he yells at Flame that he's now friends with a thief. Flamefrags jumps back down from the small bridge and starts to walk away, leaving his friend behind. 

On the way up Flamefrags decided to not hold back anymore, if he wanted Lomedy to be free then he had to take down the Law once and for all. He arrives on the surface to find an army of the Law standing ready. Flamefrags starts to fight using the mace, a mace that isn't his. 

The fight stretches with Zam trying to order everyone around and Flamefrags laughing about it, it was like the old days in Zam's words. Flamefrags is able to spot Jaden and is surprised to see him. Flame goes to attack Jaden wanting Lomedy's mace back. Jaden disappears into the crowd and Flame continues to attack everyone, Spoke tries to stop Flame from killing his members but Flamefrags doesn't care. The battle continues with only LettuceK and SargeLaw and a few Lawmen remaining. They kill off the rest just to discover that LettuceK had fled. Wemmbu unleashes an orbital strike cannon for free and kills one of Flame's dogs resulting in Flame attacking him. Flame and Wemmbu continue to mess around until Spoke speaks. 

Spoke asks everyone if they had seen Parrot, since nobody really knew where Parrot went, they think that they need to recruit chungies to fight in the war against the Law. Spoke and everyone headed to Spoke's "secret base", in which was a castle in plain sight, after entering Spoke's castle. 

In the base they enter a small sandstone house where the rest of the team is, like MinuteTech who questions why Flamefrags was there. Flame is in high alert and very suspicious of Spoke's base in which he held out totem in case the entire place exploded even after Spoke assure him that it was very much safe, he still have a slight suspicion, this continues throughout the entire discussion. The team moves from the sandstone house and into the castle for better discussion. Spoke tries to start a speech about that they aren't on the best terms but fails with Wemmbu laughing at him. 

Minute places down some shulkers from his enderchest with loot for the team, to which Flame takes the entire shulker and Wemmbu following up and doing the same. After settling the matter of gear they continue, with Flame questioning why he's here. Spoke explains the plan of needing people to defeat the Law, the answer causes Wemmbu to ask why they needed to go 60,000 blocks out to the castle and he suggests him and Flame going to defeat Law again since it all started with them defeating the 1000 players. Spoke shuts it down quickly saying that they didn't defeat the Law completely. 

One of JumperWho's spies walked in and give her a book, which lead to a Law's stashes of items useful for the war, and its also said that a large group of Law's chungies are also heading there, hinting that Parrot might be there too. Wemmbu asks why they don't just go to Northern Council and decimate the Law. Spoke ignores him. With the discussion continuing Flame got bored and asked Wemmbu if he wanted to leave with a sign. Wemmbu doesn't respond and the team starts to argue about Parrot, asking why they need him in the first place. 

Spoke questioned Wemmbu and Flame intention on what they are gonna do after killing LettuceK, Wemmbu said that he will "Ride off into the sunset and uhh I don't know", after asking Flame the same question, Flame said that he will get all the aura to which the team falls silent, get patted on the head by everyone and then slime off Jaden.

After Flame said that he wanted to slime out Jaden, everyone gasped and Wemmbu stepped in to defend his friend. Flame get real aggressive and hitting Jaden with wind charges, Flame continues and insults Jaden. Flame continues to demand Lomedy's mace back, he starts to get very upset and attacks Jaden with the mace. Everyone else tried to stop Flame but Flame doesn't listen and pots up, Wemmbu see this as an attack and uses a stab shot. They continue to fight until MinuteTech is able to split them up.

Flamefrags tries to attack Jaden but is swiftly stopped by Minute. Wemmbu starts a rant on that JumperWho was lying about no knowing Jaden since she disappeard from his base and popped back up by the prison to which Flamefrags jumps in with that Jumper was affiliated with BAT. Jumper said that she isn't affiliated with Leo or BAT anymore, Wemmbu asked for rockets again and Flame being Flame, took it and they started chasing, Flame got trapped in a dead end and Wemmbu blew a second hole into Spoke's house then Flame threw it down the house and made Wemmbu fetch it. After Jumper read the location Wemmbu set off to do it himself. 

Flamefrags leaves and uses his riptide trident to get there. When he arrives he finds Parrot and the other protagonists already fighting. The fight continues with Flame and Wemmbu arguing about kills and overall getting in each others way. After the battle ends Flamefrags moves to get back to his team and steals one of Theo's enderchests on the way, infuriating Theo with Flame laughing at him. 

Flame starts to troll the protagonists using a voice changer with Parrot getting annoyed. Wemmbu was trying to cover for him until Parrot found Flamefrags. After that they return to the castle to meet up with the rest. After talking for a bit they decide to head for the District 13 where Parrot's own army is. Wemmbu flies off into the distance as first. 

They enter the base and look around before Wemmbu returns with EggChan. Flame rushes to greet them then Wemmbu and him start to beat each other up, Wemmbu unleashes an orbital strike and blows a hole in the ground. They laugh about it with EggChan asking why Wemmbu would do that. Returning back to where the rest are and Parrot decides to have a speech. In the speech, Parrot names up all the things the Law had did to them, from Flame being exiled to Parrot being tricked. 

After the speech the team head for the Northern Council for a fight. The team heads out of District 13 with minor casualties like Parrot and Mapicc falling into the hole Wemmbu created. When trying to go through the door they notice more of Wemmbu's destruction like the breaking of the redstone honey and slime wall. Ignoring the casulaties they leave for the Northern Council. 

The battle starts with Wemmbu dropping 3 orbitals and the rest of the team charges, Flamefrags decided to use the mace and spear, the spear to get close to enemies and the mace for damage. The battle continues with Flame and Wemmbu fighting for kills but besides that goes smoothly, they are able to vanquish all the players. They head for the Council and finds LettuceK and the Elites on top. 

Lettuce asks them if they think he's really that stupid. The team turn around and sees netherite players climbing over the walls, hundreds of them. While the amount of players is comparable to the diamond team the armor and gear isn't. Still the team are able to kill some of them, slowly but surely the numbers of the netherite players start to dwindle. Wemmbu continues to drop orbitals with the team freaking out. Flame and Wemmbu also continue to argue about kills again. Flame leaves to restock with Zam and Wemmbu joins them, netherite players storm them and Wemmbu uses another orbital to kill them off. 

After the restock Flame and Wemmbu decide to dual mace to kill off the netherite players faster but they eventually get split up. Flame gets into a fight with Purpled and the G0dofWar. When nobody shows up Flame starts to get worried that he got betrayed once again. Being able to escape the battle Flame meets up with Wemmbu and Theo to fight. Flame finds Minute for a restock. 

The battle ends with the team coming out victorious, sadly LettuceK had run away. Wemmbu returns from chasing Lettuce with the news that he escaped. Flamefrags rethinks about what happened, with Lettuce being able to escape, they weren't successfull in stopping the Law and Lomedy would still be held captive. Deciding to do something for Lomedy, Flamefrags aimed for an attack on Jaden, attempting to get his friends mace back. Inmeddiatly, Wemmbu and MinuteTech jump to stop Flame from killing Jaden. 

Flamefrags and Wemmbu start to fight with Wemmbu defending Jaden from being slaughtered, they argue about Flame wanting his mace back. They continue to fight with Eggchan encouraging them. Flamefrags stops attacking Wemmbu and goes for Jaden, asking for his mace back. Jaden laughs and mocks him questioning what use does Lomedy have with the mace. Theo tries to stop them but Flame doesn't care, shooting back asking what Theo would do if Parrot's mace was stolen? 

The fight between Flame and Wemmbu ends with Flame falling into a pit and Wemmbu laughing at him. They both listen to the rest of the team and turn to see Lettuce by the gate. They bring Lettuce inside for voting, either they kill him or they keep him alive. Flamefrags wants to kill him but isn't able to. Flamefrags starts to get upset with Wemmbu, to him it was Wemmbu who chose to save him. Flame was likely hoping that Wemmbu would choose to kill him. 

They start to move again, Flamefrags continues to ask Parrot if they can kill him with Parrot ignoring him. Right before the staircase they stop, Parrot announces that he wants to continue the election which causes an uproar in the team. Wemmbu states that most of the server likely doesn't now what happened and would pick LettuceK to win. Lettuce stops them all, saying that its too late. Lettuce says that he tried to warn Parrot, not explaining for what. Flamefrags jumps at the chance to kill him, twisting Lettuce's words into that he wants to die to which Parrot shuts him down. Wemmbu asks why they need to change the server so badly, Flame agrees and asks Parrot the same. 

Parrot replies saying that before LettuceK came to power, didn't Flame rob innocent players for gear. Flame hesitates but agrees, knowing its true. Parrot continues to interrogate Flame, asking if he asked if he wanted Flame dead, would Flame be mad? Of course Flame responds with that most of the players wanted him dead at some point in time, Parrot continues questioning why Flame would then have the right to choose if Lettuce should live or not to which Flame replies with that they had all put in effort to defeat the Law. Parrot doesn't listen and continues to throw accusations, that the situation wouldn't have escalated so badly if Flame didn't do what he did. Flame falls silent and admits that he understands Parrot's point of view. After this altercation, Flame doesn't speak again. (In the scene) 

They continue into the discussion room of the Council and lock Lettuce up in an obsidian box. Parrot and Wemmbu leave with Flamefrags standing by the cell and Theo by the doorway. 

When the other two leave, Lettuce and Flame start to talk, for one last time. Lettuce chuckles when rethinking old memories, how the entire thing started with Flame. He continues, talking about Deputy_Ace's death, how his army is scattered, how he has fallen from the power. Lettuce asks Flamefrags to prove him wrong, that Flame can change, to not let every horrible thing he has done be in vain. Flame doesn't speak, only a slight hum before leaving the room, rethinking the conversation they had in the beginning, remembering what Lomemdy had said, remembering Parrot's words. In the doorway he stops, turning back to Lettuce and promising to think about it, then he leaves. 

Flamefrags goes outside to find Parrot and they start to talk after a few moments of silence. Parrot asks Flame where he's going and Flame says that he's going to find an old friend. Before Flame leaves, Parrot wishes him goodluck. 

After walking over the highway, Flamefrags heads for the Law headquarters to save Lomedy. He spots Lomedy standing on top of the destroyed pathway, Flamefrags tries to speak but Lomedy runs away. Flame calls him back and Lomedy stops, waiting to listen to what Flame has to say. Flame explains how the Law was gone, that they were all killed. This annoys Lomedy into walking away again with Flame stopping him again. He starts to talk, saying that Lomedy was right, that Flame had heard it again and again and it started to wear him down. Flame continues, apologizing for everything, for getting Lomedy into the situation, for the destruction of the farm, for the robbing of the mace. Then he places down an enderchest and drops the mace, surprising Lomedy. Flame continues to talk, explaining that he wants to change while most of his goals include conflict, he would try to stop as much as possible. 

Flame starts to walk away, accepting Lomedy's distrust and says farewell. While walking away, he is attacked by a mace and looks up to see Lomedy holding the mace. Flame is startled and asks Lomedy what he's doing, Lomedy laughs and says that he'll forgive Flame as long as he promises to change. Flame quickly promises, happy to have his friend back. They walk out of the headquarters, laughing about the earlier attack and Lomedy clarifying he needed to get his revenge somehow. They walk over the bridge, talking about how they need to get the copper armor to break before Lomedy playfully attacks him. The camera pans away as the two playfully fight and leave the ruined LAW base together. 

 Season 3 
 The Kingdoms Arc 

Flame and Lomedy return to Flame's old base to see if they can repair it. There, they find an invisible player in full netherite holding TNT. The player blows up the base and reveals himself to be HernadoDomin3_. He requests Flame for a duel, citing his reason for blowing up the latter's base was to get a duel out of him. Flame is flabbergasted and initially tells Hernado to go away but after repeated refusals he decides to fight him, but chooses to spare him at the end after Hernado flees. 

Flame and Lomedy decide to make attempts to clean up the area and build a new base. While they are doing this, Flame is approached by OrionCat and PleasentRoses11_, who give him a newspaper. After a brief conversation, Flame asks Orion and his crew to help him build a base. While the builders work, Flame and Lomedy head to Merchant City to purchase potion supplies. 

While waiting for the suppliers, Flame gets shot at by Spongs and Willsion. He gets annoyed and warns them but they still keep pestering him and Lomedy. Flame quickly trades for the potion supplies, gets scammed, but brushes it off in favor of leaving quickly to escape Spongs and Willsion. Flame decides to leave the city to go by to the Megabase, only being attacked by Arachn1d and his soldiers. Lomedy is able to pull the trap, while Flame uses his orbital wolves to pick out some soldiers. 

While Flame is chilling in the desert, The Law approaches him, saying that the base rent is too much for them to pay. The Law soldiers start taking down Flame's base, but Flame decides to work for them for the next  100 Days. He later saves the Wheat kingdom and does many important tasks for Law, eventually losing a couple of teammates to Arachn1d's kingdom, but manages to keep his Megabase since he joined Law. 

Flame was hired to infiltrate Mist Civilization. He killed their leader Mistrul and defeated Flowtives during searching for Lomedy.

== History ==
=== [[Season 1]] ===
==== [[The PrinceZam Empire Arc]] ====
FlameFrags is seen guarding a castle in the [[Zam Empire]].

[[ManePear]], [[Sorhin]], and Flame attack Wemmbu and [[JamatoP]] in the latter's base, asking if they know anything about SpokeIsHere. After a short clash, they agree to take Wemmbu to the Zam Empire.

Flame is sent by PrinceZam to pretend to betray the Zam Empire and kill Wemmbu. Flame fails to kill Wemmbu due to a TnT minecart trap pulled off by him and his friend eggchan.

Wemmbu sees that Flame and Merffinn are trying to invade [[Roshambogames Civilization|Roshambo’s Civilization]]. Flame nearly kills Roshambo, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges Flame to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in Roshambo's Civilization to evacuate, and then escapes using a stasis chamber.

The Zam Empire destroys [[Wemmbu's Civilization]]. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box while Flame and ManePear fight, with the former being indignant over the idea of a traitor keeping the armor of the empire after Mane betrayed them to work with Wemmbu.

==== [[The Invisible Mafia Arc]] ====
After the Zam Empire falls, Flame joins [[The Invisible Mafia]] as a diamond player. He threatens to kill eggchan unless Wemmbu gives him a [[Maces|mace]]. After successfully winning their duel utilizing slow falling and his superior skill in sword PvP, he gives the mace to [[ClownPierce]].

Flame kills [[Dimofyy]] after trapping Parrot and a few members of the [[Warriors District]].

=== Season 2 ===
==== [[The Toxic War Arc]] ====
After the mafia falls, he retreats to live by himself in a base he constructed, but is constantly harassed by bandits. Three players try to trap him at his base but fail. He kills all of the players. A team of players including SpokeIsHere try to kill him. Flame finds one of the bandits' base, kills them, and steals their netherite sword.

A team of players try to steal from Flame despite [[TheobaldTheBird]], their leader, telling them not to. Flame kills them. Flame travels to [[Merchant City]] to trade for gear. While he is leaving, a team of players from [[Bounty Assassin Team]] try to kill him. They fail to kill him and run away.

Wemmbu tries to kill Flame at his base at spawn. They eventually stop fighting. Spoke and a team of players try to kill Flame again but fail.

A team of players destroy Flame's base. Flame kills most of the players, but one of the members of the team escapes. The team finds him again and manage to steal his netherite sword. FlameFrags is able to kill them by splashing a strength potion and using his fist. FlameFrags finds two of the members of the team at his camp, who mention a player named [[Razor2gud|Razor]]. FlameFrags kills them both. He picks up a lodestone compass from one of the players and follows it to a base.

Flame finds the leader of the team, Razor2gud, and tries to kill him. Razor says that he'll only fight him if FlameFrags uses worse items, such as not using netherite armor, weapons, and strength potions. Flame agrees to this, only for Razor to have his team try to kill Flame. Flame is able to kill all of them except for Razor, who escapes.

Flame finds a map showing the locations of every base owned by the team. He goes to a bunker to try and get materials for destroying more bases, and kills everyone there. Flame finds a team of players in diamond armor, including Razor. Flame kills their entire team except for Razor, who runs away again. While destroying the base they fought in, Flame finds another lodestone compass in a hidden barrel that supposedly leads to Razor's base.

Flame continues destroying bases. After destroying all of them, he goes to Razor's base. Flame and Razor agree to have a fair 1v1. They set up a trap to try and kill Flame, but it fails to kill him. FlameFrags kills every player, including Razor.

Flame's dog, [[Ashen]], gets kidnapped by the same team.

Flame kills everyone in his team before fighting [[T0X1N]]. T0X1N starts losing the fight and threatens to kill Ashen. He gives Flame instructions, which are intended to kill him. However, Flame smuggled a bundle with a wind charge and manages to survive using the wind charge. Right as T0X1N is about to kill Ashen, Flame kills him.

More players attempt to kill FlameFrags but fail. 

FlameFrags looks for a base to stay in and he meets [[Lomedy]]. Players try to kill FlameFrags but fail. 

==== [[The Betrayal Arc]] ====
Flame joins a PvP tournament. FlameFrags is just barely able to win the tournament.

Flame learns that his friend [[Jaden_MAN]] has gone missing, and asks several players about his whereabouts, including [[Spongs]], CookieBunsquat, and LettuceK. He finds Lettuce's answer to be incredibly suspicious and vague, deciding to trail him back to his base while invisible. Once there, he sees a signboard of targets with Jaden's name listed under 'captured.' He later returns and attempts to kill them, but fails. He comes back with invisibility, and secretly listens in on their conversation.

FlameFrags goes to Leowook's base with the intent of learning his cart PvP strategies, but finds it blown up and abandoned. He sees Leo amongst the rubble, and signs a deal with Leo for an IOU and a stack of experience bottles in exchange for lessons. A few days later, he arrives at an auction held by [[the Law]]. LettuceK is able to escape.

Returning to Leo, they make another deal for another stack where Leo pretends to be captured by the Law so Flame can find out where Jaden is being kept. It doesn't go to plan, with the Law pausing to inventory check Leo, so the two of them team up to fight against the Law. They escape using a pearl cannon, but he follows them to an island and chases them down to the [[The Abandoned Civilization|Abandoned Civilization]] where Jaden was trapped by Wemmbu. He finds Jaden after searching the civilization, and they reunite.

After Jaden is free, Jaden asks Flame to kill Wemmbu, and Flame agrees to do so. Together, they recruit a team with people whom disliked Wemmbu, named [[The Avengers]]

They learned from [[4CVIT]] that Wemmbu was chasing after Conexion, one of their common enemies, in the Farlands. Before going, he and Jaden set up stasis chambers so they could return easily. They find Wemmbu in the farlands and attempt to kill him, but fail.

The team begins to argue again, and splits up to cover more ground. While journeying, they find Sharpness again. Flame fights Sharpness to try to obtain his mace. Sharpness hides it in his ender chest as leverage, and Jaden comes over, convincing him to join the team. FlameFrags tricks [[Conexion]] into thinking he can duplicate the mace that Conexion has, so Conexion gives Flame the mace, and Flame then leaves.

The Avengers attempt to kill Wemmbu but fail, as FlameFrags decides to betray the team, and eventually gives the mace back to Wemmbu. FlameFrags' ender pearl stasis chamber is pearled one week after, into a void trap. His quick reaction time allows him to place a block in the trap, saving his life. He is able to escape the trap. Jaden asks FlameFrags for full netherite armor, so Flame makes it his goal to get him netherite armor. Lettuce tries to kill FlameFrags again, but fails. Flame gives Jaden a netherite helmet which he got from one of the players trying to kill him.

Jaden and Flame rob a town, and Jaden gets a pair of netherite leggings. The Law attacks Flame and Jaden. Jaden doesn't help with the fight. Flame is able to escape, and meets back up with Jaden, angry that he didn't help. Flame and Jaden go to the Law's base to try and kill them. Jaden betrays Flame, leaving him to die. Flame is able to escape.

Jaden offers Flame to join the [[Pirates]], which he declines. Jaden tries to kill Flame with his pirates, but fails.Before hunting down Jaden, Flame realizes he needs a place to re-gear after battle. He asks Lomedy to help him rebuild the base, who now has two maces. They work together to fix the terrain, walls, and base itself. While they are doing this, Jaden watches them from a nearby hill and attacks Lomedy as he's leaving. Jaden steals Lomedy's mace using pots, so Flame begins to try to kill Jaden.

Flame is winning the fight until it starts to rain, allowing Jaden to trident-mace him from above. Flame hides in a shallow cave while Jaden taunts him from outside it. Jaden gives him a lodestone compass to the new pirate islands before leaving. 

FlameFrags and Jaden fight. 

==== [[Skill vs Power Arc]] ====
FlameFrags and Lomedy participate in the "farm war", in which he was not allowed to use weapons, and could only use netherite armor. Using traps, FlameFrags is able to kill some players. FlameFrags also kills players using a diamond hoe, which Lomedy dislikes. Flame and Lomedy destroy the raiders base. 

Spoke tricks Flame into doing things for him, and also tells him to go to an old Mafia stash. Once there, Flame finds Wemmbu, who tries to kill him. Flame is forced to run due to Wemmbu using maces and orbital strike cannons. Flame's signature chest plate is broken. 

Multiple players attempt to kill FlameFrags but fail. Flame creates a machine which can summon a large amount of dogs by using a fishing rod.

Flame is told that Wemmbu died. Flame begins looking for [[Luke4472]], who supposedly knows about Wemmbu. Flame and The_CodMaster421 begin trying to find Luke. They eventually find Luke4472, and they discover that Luke heard about Wemmbu dying from MinuteTech.

Flame and MinuteTech fight due to him not explaining where Wemmbu is. Minute escapes using the outer end islands.

Boosfer claims to know what happened to Wemmbu. He gives a proposition, saying that he will tell him the information if Flame works for Boosfer. He agrees. Flame finds an invisible player, known as the Invisible Knight, who is secretly Wemmbu.

Flame returns to his base to see Boosfer under attack by the invisible player leading a crew of players. The Invisible Knight advises them to run, but they don't listen and die. 

Boosfer asks Flame to retrieve him [[ParrotX2]]'s helmet and potion stash. He approaches Parrot, who is annoyed to see him and mocks him for being bossed around by Boosfer, calling him a henchman. Flame takes the stuff and leaves. Boosfer still refuses to give information on Wemmbu.

He and Flame create an escape tunnel in his base together under the jukebox that ends in a nether portal. After they're done, the Invisible Knight arrives at his base once again, who attacks Boosfer, until Boosfer promises to tell Flame about Wemmbu if he kills the Invisible Knight. The player leads him to a desert void trap that Flame nearly falls into, but he and Boosfer manage to survive. The remaining people of Capital City's force who created the trap fight Flame and Boosfer. Flame wins the fight, with all but the Invisible Knight and [[Salvationism]] dead.

The Invisible Knight begins speaking to Flame, saying that Boosfer has no evidence that he knows where [[Wemmbu]] is. He convinces him to begin to distrust Boosfer, and Flame attacks Boosfer. Boosfer manages to escape through the escape tunnel they made before. When they're chasing him through it, he says that ClownPierce killed Wemmbu and then goes through the nether portal. 

Flames ventures into the nether, looking for ClownPierces's Castle but encounter a hiding ParrotX2 and TheoBladTheBird, attacking them thinking they were guards, but stopped because they planned to rob Clown's vault. They worked together with parrot promising Flames that he could get his fight with Clown. They stormed Clown's Castle and looked for FerreMC, which knows where the vault is, attacked and kidnapped him with Clown and his guards unsuccessfully preventing them from kidnapping Ferre. They interrogated Ferre and Parrot give him a elytra to fly to get loots, but putting a tracker on him too, tracking where he will go (the vault) and follow after him. 

Parrot and Theobald talked about Flame being a bad person and doesn't deserve to have a chance of fighting Clown, Flame hearing all of this, mine his way through and looked for Clown's Castle, Flame demand to know where Wemmbu is but ClownPierce will only tell if Flame can offer them something, in which Flame leaked where Parrot and Theo is, leading them to finding and capturing them. 

Flames wanted to know what happen to Wemmbu but Clown said he knew nothing since he stayed in the Nether, which angers Flame and he attacked Clown's army, taking on all Clown's elite guards all while Clown looked for Parrot, Theo went missing. After killing all of Clown's guards, Flame went back to the over world. 

Flame then encounters LettuceK, in which he told Flame that they built a new base near Flame's base, Lettuce gives Flame a tour of their new base and meets Deputy_Ace, a law commander. Lettuce then decided to ask them to stay in prison, in which Flame refuses. Lettuce gives Flame alongside Wemmbu, three days to prepare and face Lettuce's new army, having over 1,000 players. 

Flame and Wemmbu encounter the 1000 players and Lettuce. Flame and Wemmbu eventually kill all 1000 players except Lettuce, but Flame fights Wemmbu to finally see who the strongest player on the server is. Flame won this fight leaving Wemmbu and Lettuce behind. 

==== [[The Kings Arc]] ====
:<small>''This arc is concurrent to [[The BAT Arc]].''</small>

Flamefrags returns to his base, finding it to be griefed by the Lawmen. He enters his base just to find his walls covered in the Law's colors, he hears a goat horn and turns. Opposite of him is [[LettuceK]], the same person who exiled him, the same person who had terrorized him for months on end. Lettuce tells Flame to calm down, saying that its only him and that he wants to talk because they had a history for one last time. Flame reluctantly agrees but holds out a double totem, LettuceK questions if Flame really thinks that he's in the right, Flame hesitates before answering saying that he doubts that it matter and that he himself thinks that Lettuce isn't in the right to which Lettuce replies with that he knows, LettuceK asks Flame if he really doesn't think that Lettuce knows what type of leader he has become? 

Lettuce continues, going on a rant about how Flame, Wemmbu and others like them have always disturbed the peace, He then says that if he (lettuce) has to go down in history as a ruthless leader then so be it. As long as Flame and Wemmbu were banned from the server, he believed that his actions were justifiable. He claimed that the actions the actions he made were for the betterment of the server. He said that he wishes that Flame would take account for his actions, not just for Lettuce but for the massacre players. Lettuce blames Flamefrags for everything, if this didn't happen, if Flame could take accountibility for all of his actions of killing 1000 players. If Flame hadn’t done this, then [[Jaden MAN|Jaden Man]] wouldn't have been freed, then [[Lomedy]] wouldn't be held captive. Lettuce tells that he is giving Flame a chance to turn around and leave to let Lettuce do his job as becoming king. 

Flamefrags refuses, going for an attack on Lettuce who starts to run away. LettuceK leaves after realizing that theres no convincing Flame, Flame watches him leave before going into a secret part of his base. In the secret section, he finds his wolf army, who luckily were still alive. 

Flamefrags gets ready to storm the Law prison, wanting to save his best friend Lomedy. But right as Flame prepared his inventory, Wemmbu appears. Flame is asks why Wemmbu was there to which Wemmbu ignores him and asks if he has seen Eggchan. The two start to bicker until calming down and Wemmbu offers to work together to free their friends.  

The two attack the Law base and quickly vanquish the netherite/diamond players, teasing [[SargeLaw]] for killing his own army in the process. After killing at the players they head for the prison building, Wemmbu asks flame if lomedy actually wants to be freed, and flame replies with a no. Before going down, Wemmbu snags a few of flame’s items and Flame calls him greedy. Eventually Flamefrags goes down tells wemmbu to gaurd abovr.  

While going through the halls of the prison, Flame kills everyone in his way while going to Lomedy. He arrives in a corridor to hear [[PrinceZam|Prince Zam]] letting everyone free alongside [[SpokeIsHere|Spokeishere]] and [[JumperWho|Jumperwho]]. Flame uses his dogs help him, while being assisted by Spoke. The battle continues with the small group of attackers banning the law employees. 

The fight ends and Flamefrags goes to Lomedy, telling him that it's time to escape. Lomedy refuses, asking if Flamefrags is crazy and actually thinks that Lomedy would break the law. The peacefull moment fleeing the second Lomedy said that. Flamefrags laughs, thinking that Lomedy is joking, asking Lomedy to come with him. Lomedy starts yelling, questioning why he should trust Flame, he starts to list reason after reason; Flamefrags stole his mace, got his farm destroyed and still continues to fight the Law as if they were in the wrong. Flamefrags starts to get desperate, asking Lomedy to reconsider and come with him but Lomedy keeps saying no, reciting that he doesn't trust Flame. 

Flamefrags wonders why Lomedy doesn't trust him because he broke into prison for him, then he asks what Lomedy's sentence is to which Lomedy replies with months. Flame still tries to convince Lomedy to leave but Lomedy doesn't listen, Lomedy keeps asking why he should trust Flame, asking Flamefrags why he would trust someone who wasn't willing to change, why he should trust someone who fighting the Law. Flamefrags questions if Lomedy is serious, Lomedy states that the only reason he would leave is if the Law lets him go. 

Lomedy asks for his mace back, the one Flame supposedly stole when running from the Law. Flamefrags lies and tells Lomedy that he still needs the mace. Flamefrags starts to leave, walking up the destroyed staircase with Lomedy's yelling chasing him, he yells at Flame that he's now friends with a thief. Flamefrags jumps back down from the small bridge and starts to walk away, leaving his friend behind. 

On the way up Flamefrags decided to not hold back anymore, if he wanted Lomedy to be free then he had to take down the Law once and for all. He arrives on the surface to find an army of the Law standing ready. Flamefrags starts to fight using the mace, a mace that isn't his. 

The fight stretches with Zam trying to order everyone around and Flamefrags laughing about it, it was like the old days in Zam's words. Flamefrags is able to spot Jaden and is surprised to see him. Flame goes to attack Jaden wanting Lomedy's mace back. Jaden disappears into the crowd and Flame continues to attack everyone, Spoke tries to stop Flame from killing his members but Flamefrags doesn't care. The battle continues with only LettuceK and SargeLaw and a few Lawmen remaining. They kill off the rest just to discover that LettuceK had fled. Wemmbu unleashes an orbital strike cannon for free and kills one of Flame's dogs resulting in Flame attacking him. Flame and Wemmbu continue to mess around until Spoke speaks. 

Spoke asks everyone if they had seen Parrot, since nobody really knew where Parrot went, they think that they need to recruit chungies to fight in the war against the Law. Spoke and everyone headed to Spoke's "secret base", in which was a castle in plain sight, after entering Spoke's castle. 

In the base they enter a small sandstone house where the rest of the team is, like [[MinuteTech]] who questions why Flamefrags was there. Flame is in high alert and very suspicious of Spoke's base in which he held out totem in case the entire place exploded even after Spoke assure him that it was very much safe, he still have a slight suspicion, this continues throughout the entire discussion. The team moves from the sandstone house and into the castle for better discussion. Spoke tries to start a speech about that they aren't on the best terms but fails with Wemmbu laughing at him. 

Minute places down some shulkers from his enderchest with loot for the team, to which Flame takes the entire shulker and Wemmbu following up and doing the same. After settling the matter of gear they continue, with Flame questioning why he's here. Spoke explains the plan of needing people to defeat the Law, the answer causes Wemmbu to ask why they needed to go 60,000 blocks out to the castle and he suggests him and Flame going to defeat Law again since it all started with them defeating the 1000 players. Spoke shuts it down quickly saying that they didn't defeat the Law completely. 

One of JumperWho's spies walked in and give her a book, which lead to a Law's stashes of items useful for the war, and its also said that a large group of Law's chungies are also heading there, hinting that Parrot might be there too. Wemmbu asks why they don't just go to Northern Council and decimate the Law. Spoke ignores him. With the discussion continuing Flame got bored and asked Wemmbu if he wanted to leave with a sign. Wemmbu doesn't respond and the team starts to argue about Parrot, asking why they need him in the first place. 

Spoke questioned Wemmbu and Flame intention on what they are gonna do after killing LettuceK, Wemmbu said that he will "Ride off into the sunset and uhh I don't know", after asking Flame the same question, Flame said that he will get all the aura to which the team falls silent, get patted on the head by everyone and then slime off Jaden.

After Flame said that he wanted to slime out Jaden, everyone gasped and Wemmbu stepped in to defend his friend. Flame get real aggressive and hitting Jaden with wind charges, Flame continues and insults Jaden. Flame continues to demand Lomedy's mace back, he starts to get very upset and attacks Jaden with the mace. Everyone else tried to stop Flame but Flame doesn't listen and pots up, Wemmbu see this as an attack and uses a stab shot. They continue to fight until MinuteTech is able to split them up.

Flamefrags tries to attack Jaden but is swiftly stopped by Minute. Wemmbu starts a rant on that [[JumperWho]] was lying about no knowing Jaden since she disappeard from his base and popped back up by the prison to which Flamefrags jumps in with that Jumper was affiliated with [[Bounty Assassin Team|BAT]]. Jumper said that she isn't affiliated with Leo or BAT anymore, Wemmbu asked for rockets again and Flame being Flame, took it and they started chasing, Flame got trapped in a dead end and Wemmbu blew a second hole into Spoke's house then Flame threw it down the house and made Wemmbu fetch it. After Jumper read the location Wemmbu set off to do it himself. 

Flamefrags leaves and uses his riptide trident to get there. When he arrives he finds Parrot and the other protagonists already fighting. The fight continues with Flame and Wemmbu arguing about kills and overall getting in each others way. After the battle ends Flamefrags moves to get back to his team and steals one of Theo's enderchests on the way, infuriating Theo with Flame laughing at him. 

Flame starts to troll the protagonists using a voice changer with Parrot getting annoyed. Wemmbu was trying to cover for him until Parrot found Flamefrags. After that they return to the castle to meet up with the rest. After talking for a bit they decide to head for the [[District 13]] where Parrot's own army is. Wemmbu flies off into the distance as first. 

They enter the base and look around before Wemmbu returns with [[Eggchan|EggChan]]. Flame rushes to greet them then Wemmbu and him start to beat each other up, Wemmbu unleashes an orbital strike and blows a hole in the ground. They laugh about it with EggChan asking why Wemmbu would do that. Returning back to where the rest are and Parrot decides to have a speech. In the speech, Parrot names up all the things the Law had did to them, from Flame being exiled to Parrot being tricked. 

After the speech the team head for the Northern Council for a fight. The team heads out of District 13 with minor casualties like Parrot and [[Mapicc]] falling into the hole Wemmbu created. When trying to go through the door they notice more of Wemmbu's destruction like the breaking of the redstone honey and slime wall. Ignoring the casulaties they leave for the Northern Council. 

The battle starts with Wemmbu dropping 3 orbitals and the rest of the team charges, Flamefrags decided to use the mace and spear, the spear to get close to enemies and the mace for damage. The battle continues with Flame and Wemmbu fighting for kills but besides that goes smoothly, they are able to vanquish all the players. They head for the Council and finds [[LettuceK]] and the Elites on top. 

Lettuce asks them if they think he's really that stupid. The team turn around and sees netherite players climbing over the walls, hundreds of them. While the amount of players is comparable to the diamond team the armor and gear isn't. Still the team are able to kill some of them, slowly but surely the numbers of the netherite players start to dwindle. Wemmbu continues to drop orbitals with the team freaking out. Flame and Wemmbu also continue to argue about kills again. Flame leaves to restock with Zam and Wemmbu joins them, netherite players storm them and Wemmbu uses another orbital to kill them off. 

After the restock Flame and Wemmbu decide to dual mace to kill off the netherite players faster but they eventually get split up. Flame gets into a fight with [[Purpled]] and the [[G0dOfWar|G0dofWar]]. When nobody shows up Flame starts to get worried that he got betrayed once again. Being able to escape the battle Flame meets up with Wemmbu and Theo to fight. Flame finds Minute for a restock. 

The battle ends with the team coming out victorious, sadly LettuceK had run away. Wemmbu returns from chasing Lettuce with the news that he escaped. Flamefrags rethinks about what happened, with Lettuce being able to escape, they weren't successfull in stopping the Law and Lomedy would still be held captive. Deciding to do something for Lomedy, Flamefrags aimed for an attack on Jaden, attempting to get his friends mace back. Inmeddiatly, Wemmbu and MinuteTech jump to stop Flame from killing Jaden. 

Flamefrags and Wemmbu start to fight with Wemmbu defending Jaden from being slaughtered, they argue about Flame wanting his mace back. They continue to fight with Eggchan encouraging them. Flamefrags stops attacking Wemmbu and goes for Jaden, asking for his mace back. Jaden laughs and mocks him questioning what use does Lomedy have with the mace. Theo tries to stop them but Flame doesn't care, shooting back asking what Theo would do if Parrot's mace was stolen? 

The fight between Flame and Wemmbu ends with Flame falling into a pit and Wemmbu laughing at him. They both listen to the rest of the team and turn to see Lettuce by the gate. They bring Lettuce inside for voting, either they kill him or they keep him alive. Flamefrags wants to kill him but isn't able to. Flamefrags starts to get upset with Wemmbu, to him it was Wemmbu who chose to save him. Flame was likely hoping that Wemmbu would choose to kill him. 

They start to move again, Flamefrags continues to ask Parrot if they can kill him with Parrot ignoring him. Right before the staircase they stop, Parrot announces that he wants to continue the election which causes an uproar in the team. Wemmbu states that most of the server likely doesn't now what happened and would pick LettuceK to win. Lettuce stops them all, saying that its too late. Lettuce says that he tried to warn Parrot, not explaining for what. Flamefrags jumps at the chance to kill him, twisting Lettuce's words into that he wants to die to which Parrot shuts him down. Wemmbu asks why they need to change the server so badly, Flame agrees and asks Parrot the same. 

Parrot replies saying that before LettuceK came to power, didn't Flame rob innocent players for gear. Flame hesitates but agrees, knowing its true. Parrot continues to interrogate Flame, asking if he asked if he wanted Flame dead, would Flame be mad? Of course Flame responds with that most of the players wanted him dead at some point in time, Parrot continues questioning why Flame would then have the right to choose if Lettuce should live or not to which Flame replies with that they had all put in effort to defeat the Law. Parrot doesn't listen and continues to throw accusations, that the situation wouldn't have escalated so badly if Flame didn't do what he did. Flame falls silent and admits that he understands Parrot's point of view. After this altercation, Flame doesn't speak again. (In the scene) 

They continue into the discussion room of the Council and lock Lettuce up in an obsidian box. Parrot and Wemmbu leave with Flamefrags standing by the cell and Theo by the doorway. 

When the other two leave, Lettuce and Flame start to talk, for one last time. Lettuce chuckles when rethinking old memories, how the entire thing started with Flame. He continues, talking about [[Deputy Ace|Deputy_Ace's]] death, how his army is scattered, how he has fallen from the power. Lettuce asks Flamefrags to prove him wrong, that Flame can change, to not let every horrible thing he has done be in vain. Flame doesn't speak, only a slight hum before leaving the room, rethinking the conversation they had in the beginning, remembering what Lomemdy had said, remembering Parrot's words. In the doorway he stops, turning back to Lettuce and promising to think about it, then he leaves. 

Flamefrags goes outside to find Parrot and they start to talk after a few moments of silence. Parrot asks Flame where he's going and Flame says that he's going to find an old friend. Before Flame leaves, Parrot wishes him goodluck. 

After walking over the highway, Flamefrags heads for the Law headquarters to save Lomedy. He spots Lomedy standing on top of the destroyed pathway, Flamefrags tries to speak but Lomedy runs away. Flame calls him back and Lomedy stops, waiting to listen to what Flame has to say. Flame explains how the Law was gone, that they were all killed. This annoys Lomedy into walking away again with Flame stopping him again. He starts to talk, saying that Lomedy was right, that Flame had heard it again and again and it started to wear him down. Flame continues, apologizing for everything, for getting Lomedy into the situation, for the destruction of the farm, for the robbing of the mace. Then he places down an enderchest and drops the mace, surprising Lomedy. Flame continues to talk, explaining that he wants to change while most of his goals include conflict, he would try to stop as much as possible. 

Flame starts to walk away, accepting Lomedy's distrust and says farewell. While walking away, he is attacked by a mace and looks up to see Lomedy holding the mace. Flame is startled and asks Lomedy what he's doing, Lomedy laughs and says that he'll forgive Flame as long as he promises to change. Flame quickly promises, happy to have his friend back. They walk out of the headquarters, laughing about the earlier attack and Lomedy clarifying he needed to get his revenge somehow. They walk over the bridge, talking about how they need to get the copper armor to break before Lomedy playfully attacks him. The camera pans away as the two playfully fight and leave the ruined LAW base together. 

=== [[Season 3]] ===
==== [[The Kingdoms Arc]] ====
{{Section Improvement}}
Flame and Lomedy return to Flame's old base to see if they can repair it. There, they find an invisible player in full netherite holding TNT. The player blows up the base and reveals himself to be [[HernadoDomin3_]]. He requests Flame for a duel, citing his reason for blowing up the latter's base was to get a duel out of him. Flame is flabbergasted and initially tells Hernado to go away but after repeated refusals he decides to fight him, but chooses to spare him at the end after Hernado flees. 

Flame and Lomedy decide to make attempts to clean up the area and build a new base. While they are doing this, Flame is approached by [[OrionCat]] and [[PleasentRoses11_]], who give him a newspaper. After a brief conversation, Flame asks Orion and his crew to help him build a base. While the builders work, Flame and Lomedy head to Merchant City to purchase potion supplies. 

While waiting for the suppliers, Flame gets shot at by [[Spongs]] and [[Willsion]]. He gets annoyed and warns them but they still keep pestering him and Lomedy. Flame quickly trades for the potion supplies, gets scammed, but brushes it off in favor of leaving quickly to escape Spongs and Willsion. Flame decides to leave the city to go by to the Megabase, only being attacked by Arachn1d and his soldiers. Lomedy is able to pull the trap, while Flame uses his orbital wolves to pick out some soldiers. 

While Flame is chilling in the desert, The Law approaches him, saying that the base rent is too much for them to pay. The Law soldiers start taking down Flame's base, but Flame decides to work for them for the next  [[I Survived 100 Days on a Hardcore Minecraft Server|100 Days]]. He later saves the Wheat kingdom and does many important tasks for Law, eventually losing a couple of teammates to Arachn1d's kingdom, but manages to keep his Megabase since he joined Law. 

Flame was hired to infiltrate [[Mist Civilization]]. He killed their leader [[Mistrul]] and defeated [[Flowtives]] during searching for Lomedy.

title: Flowtives
content:
Flowtives is a minor antagonist in FlameFrags's POV. He started off as an ally of Flame, but then later tells him that he killed Lomedy, under Mistrul's order. He is actually Mistrul's trainer.

 History 
He accompanied Flame and NotSkrilley when they went to search for Lomedy. They got attacked, and Flow helped them fight off the Mist players. When Griffincoat6 forces Flame to train them, he goes to the place where Lomedy is hiding. He tells Flame not to train them so that Mistrul and the Mist don't kill them because they seem more of a threat.

He tells Flame that he killed Lomedy to get him enraged. He beats him with ease. After killing Mistrul and 60 other Mist players, Flame fights Flowtives and beats him, as he is in the zone. Flame let's him live so that he can live with the grief of losing his friend. Flow tries to explain to Flame that Mistrul was not the villain here. He says he was only the protector. Flame, however, does not listen.

 Trivia 

He is considered to be one of the best pvpers in the entire world, right now being 22nd on MCTiers, having a RHT1 and many T2 and T3. He is also known for cart PvP as RLT2.
In the comment section of the video Flow says "until we meet again, FlameFrags", hinting on him returning in a future video

title: FluffalsSupreme
content:
FluffalsSupreme_ is a member of the Mist, and the only person who could see through FlameFrags and realise he had no interest in joining the Mist. He had a friend who participated in the 1000 player battle.

 History 
elemental_R3d introduced Supreme to Flame. Supreme couldntell something was off. He knew that flame had gone asking around about Mistrul, and didn't trust him a single bit. What was even worse for Flame was that he had to be his partner and roommate.

He takes charge immediately until they get to the trial chamber, where he explains that he had a friend who died in the 1000 player battle. He says he is determined to expose Flame for who he truly is. They continue to clear out the Trial Chamber, with Supreme keeping an eye out at all times. He then proceeded to lock Flame on the trial chamber, but Flame survived.

He tried to get the other Mist members to hate him as well, but then elemental_R3d decided they deal with it using trial by combat. Even though he and his teammate, who he got as Flame was stronger and more skilled, were surprisingly good at PvP, they were outskilled by Flame and lost. Flame was then assigned a new teammate.

He possibly participated in the Mist fight against Flame, but ran.

Fymada is a citizen of Capitol City 2.0. She was first seen having to pay off taxes to Reddoons and didn't have enough diamonds to pay. After Reddoons left her, Parrot and Theo secretly gave her enough diamonds to pay her taxes. After Reddoons cleared all taxes, she, as well as the rest of Capitol City thanked Parrot and Theo.

Fymada runs for ruler of Unstable Universe. She wins the debate against SirPig_ and says that she will lower the taxes in Capital City which got her many votes.

In round 2 of voting, Fymada is eliminated from the election after she befriends Parrot and Horace because Arachn1d steals some of her votes.

In Parrot's first 100 days as king, she is declared Mayor of Capitol City. She also saves Parrot and Theo from withers a long with Horace Altman.

During the events of I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization Fymada feels incredibly disapointed in what she believes is her ability to rule Capitol City with the police killing every new player who tries to join Capitol City. Eventually Parrot convices Fymada to help him prove his inoccence she does this by getting a bunch of players to hear the Capitol City police confess to there crimes.

She appeared to be a commander of Royal Army.
