title: GeeGeeGamer
content:
GeeGeeGamer is a supportive character in Unstable Universe Season Two.

 Personality 
He loves building. He has no mic and instead communicates with signs, with most of what he writes being about how much he loves to build. He is  described as an og player by Eggchan, due to his use of the programmer art texture pack.

 History 
GeeGeeGamer shows Wemmbu and Eggchan his place. The textures get replaced by classic Minecraft textures to show the feel of old Minecraft while GeeGeeGamer tours them. Wemmbu tells GeeGeeGamer to tell him where The Forge is or else he will die because he knows that they are just trying to distract them. GeeGeeGamer responds, telling him that only the fighters know where The Forge is and that he only builds.

Wemmbu and Eggchan follow them and they make it to Lakerek's room in the city. They make it to the top of the staircase and find an end portal. Serpentbound333 tells Wemmbu that The Forge is on the other side of the portal and GeeGeeGamer aims a punch bow at Wemmbu during their conversation.

Eggchan notices GeeGeeGamer pointing the bow and as he shoots, Eggchan takes the arrow and gets sent into the end portal. 

Wemmbu realizes that the entire thing was a trap as Nitenly attempts to hit Wemmbu in and they have a fight. == Personality ==
He loves building. He has no mic and instead communicates with signs, with most of what he writes being about how much he loves to build. He is  described as an og player by Eggchan, due to his use of the programmer art texture pack.

GeeGeeGamer shows [[Wemmbu]] and [[Eggchan]] his place. The textures get replaced by classic Minecraft textures to show the feel of old Minecraft while GeeGeeGamer tours them. Wemmbu tells GeeGeeGamer to tell him where The Forge is or else he will die because he knows that they are just trying to distract them. GeeGeeGamer responds, telling him that only the fighters know where The Forge is and that he only builds.

Wemmbu and Eggchan follow them and they make it to [[Lakerek|Lakerek's]] room in the city. They make it to the top of the staircase and find an end portal. [[Serpentbound333]] tells Wemmbu that The Forge is on the other side of the portal and GeeGeeGamer aims a punch bow at Wemmbu during their conversation.

Eggchan notices GeeGeeGamer pointing the bow and as he shoots, Eggchan takes the arrow and gets sent into the end portal.

During their fight, Wemmbu gets hit with slow falling and he also doesn't have strength giving him a disadvantage. They eventually run out of slow falling making the fight easier for Wemmbu.

Pirates like the Lobsters, a team run by TheLobsterMan, find out rumors about a treasure with great value. title: Horace Altman
content:
Horace_Altman, also known as Horace, is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. He is the current mayor of Newtopia. He is also an important helper for Unstable Universe videos behind the scenes.

Personality
Horace is hardworking and relatively friendly. He is an incredibly talented builder and built Wemmbu's Civilization, The End Civilization, Capital City, Skyblock Civilization, District 13 and Eggchan's Civilization. He has a deadpan sense of humor and often tries to stay out of conflict due to him being a builder and not PvP oriented. 

He also takes a lot of pride in his building, and is very upset when his civilizations get destroyed. He holds a grudge against the Invisible Mafia, claiming he knows them very well because they keep destroying his builds. He also holds a slight grudge against Parrot, when he remarks several times about the fact Parrot promised that the End Civilization would not be destroyed, which turned out to be false.  He has been an incredibly helpful player at several points in the story and is in general very dedicated and generous. Unfortunately he joined the Invisible Mafia due to these reasons, after helping Eggchan in the Egg Civilization. 

 History 

 Season 1 
Horace helps PrinceZam build the Zam Empire.

Horace helps build Wemmbu's Civilization.

Horace helps build the The End Civilization. The civilization is later taken over by the Mafia.

Horace helps build Capital City.

Horace creates the Far Lands Civilization. Horace is the leader of the civilization. The Mafia later destroys the civilization. After the destruction of the civilization,

Horace joins District 13. He later leaves District 13 and joins the Mafia because Parrot broke his trust saying that the Far Lands were never going to be destroyed.

 Season 2 
Horace builds a tower for eggchan in Eggchan's Civilization. He is then recruited to Eggchan's Civilization.

Horace joins the election for ruler of Unstable SMP, and was kicked out of the elections in the second round of voting. Horace also befriends Parrot and Fymada while The Purge is happening.

Horace builds a castle at Spawn under Parrot's orders for new players to spawn and get food while they are heading out into the server. 

 Season 3 
Horace becomes the mayor of Newtopia.

 Quotes 

Trivia
 While his first real appearance was in I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization, Horace actually appears on the tab list in It's Impossible to Catch this Player in spectator mode, which was likely not intentional.
 Horace has been hired by both ChuckNasty and Sipover for videos regarding Unstable, and rather for their own videos.
 He and his team actually creates most of the builds on Unstable behind the scenes. His minecraft account has a "Realms Mapmaker" official cape that only 410 people in the world have according to namemc.com.

Horace is hardworking and relatively friendly. He is an incredibly talented builder and built [[Wemmbu's Civilization]], [[The End Civilization]], [[Capital City]], [[Skyblock Civilization]], [[District 13]] and [[Eggchan's Civilization]]. He has a deadpan sense of humor and often tries to stay out of conflict due to him being a builder and not PvP oriented. 

He also takes a lot of pride in his building, and is very upset when his civilizations get destroyed. He holds a grudge against [[The Invisible Mafia|the Invisible Mafia]], claiming he knows them very well because they keep destroying his builds. He also holds a slight grudge against [[ParrotX2|Parrot]], when he remarks several times about the fact Parrot promised that the End Civilization would not be destroyed, which turned out to be false.  He has been an incredibly helpful player at several points in the story and is in general very dedicated and generous. Unfortunately he joined the Invisible Mafia due to these reasons, after helping Eggchan in the Egg Civilization. 

== History ==

=== Season 1 ===
Horace helps PrinceZam build the [[Zam Empire]].

Horace helps build [[Wemmbu's Civilization]].

Horace helps build the [[The End Civilization]]. The civilization is later taken over by the Mafia.

Horace helps build Capital City.

Horace creates the [[Far Lands Civilization|Far Lands Civilization.]] Horace is the leader of the civilization. The Mafia later destroys the civilization. After the destruction of the civilization,

Horace joins [[District 13]]. He later leaves District 13 and joins the Mafia because Parrot broke his trust saying that the Far Lands were never going to be destroyed.

=== Season 2 ===
Horace builds a tower for eggchan in [[Egg Civilization|Eggchan's Civilization]]. He is then recruited to Eggchan's Civilization.

Horace joins the election for ruler of Unstable SMP, and was kicked out of the elections in the second round of voting. Horace also befriends [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and [[Fymada]] while The Purge is happening.

Horace builds a castle at [[Spawn]] under [[ParrotX2|Parrot's]] orders for new players to spawn and get food while they are heading out into the server. 

=== Season 3 ===
Horace becomes the mayor of Newtopia.

== Quotes ==
{{Quote|I'm sorry... what?! What the heck did I just watch? You killed a wither with chickens?!|[[Horace Altman|Horace]]|to [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] in [[Unstable SMP: The First War]]}}

==Trivia==
* While his first real appearance was in [[I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization]], Horace actually appears on the tab list in [[It's Impossible to Catch this Player]] in spectator mode, which was likely not intentional.
* Horace has been hired by both ChuckNasty and Sipover for videos regarding Unstable, and rather for their own videos.
* He and his team actually creates most of the builds on Unstable behind the scenes. His minecraft account has a "Realms Mapmaker" official cape that only 410 people in the world have according to [https://namemc.com/profile/Horace_Altman.1 namemc.com].

title: How I "DIED" on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
content:
How I "DIED" on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP  is the 74th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
After Wemmbu faked his own death, two people learned the truth, Boosfer and Boomie, Wemmbu killed Boomie and his next goal is to get rid of Boosfer. Wemmbu needs to stay anonymous to keep his identity hidden, he's unable to go to Capital City as the owner of the potion shop there, Parrot, had started getting suspicious of him being invisible, so he heads over to Merchant City. He talks to one of the merchants and they explained that valuable items were sold in the inner layer of the city, so Wemmbu goes over and speaks to other merchants, who tell him that potion ingredients were all out of stock and were waiting for shipments from the Nether. The ingredients are monopolized by a team of the deadliest players in Minecraft, making these ingredients harder to come by. The merchants at the portal tell him the shipment should arrive in ten minutes, which Wemmbu has enough invis potions to wait out, while waiting, FlameFrags comes by and waits for a shipment of ender pearls. The nether guards as well as FerreMC come to receive their payment and give the merchants the shipment. Hearing that pearls were high in demand, Wemmbu trades some in exchange for the potion materials and heads out, he quickly leaves Merchant City after using up his last potion and digs in a mountain to brew more as his invisibility runs out. Once brewing enough potions to hunt Boosfer again, he plans on going back to the End dimension to talk to eggchan and ask about Boosfer's whereabouts. When he arrives in the End, instead of being greeted with MinuteTech, who usually protects the End dimension, he finds Salvationism there, who was also there to hunt for Boosfer. Wemmbu goes around the island looking for Minute, instead he spots players in the base raiding it, they claim that they defeated Minute and begins to attack Wemmbu, and he lets Salvationism kill them to keep his identity hidden. They look around the base and Wemmbu sees egg hiding behind leaves, who says they were the only people who have found him. Wemmbu asks egg what happened here, in which he explains Flame came asking for Wemmbu, but Minute wouldn't tell him, so they started fighting, which caused Minute to leave the main island and hasn't returned. Wemmbu tells Salvationism to look for anymore bandits as he asks egg for information about Boosfer, who is now teamed with Flame. Wemmbu goes to tell Salvationism he knows where Boosfer is and gets them to join along.

Although Wemmbu wanted to go alone, Salvationism insisted on bringing reinforcements in Capital City since they're the leader of the guard force over there. They go to a crowded part of the city to announce a mission, nobody stops to hear them out. The next scene shows Wemmbu, Salvationism and three guards heading over to Flame's base, one haven't ever been in a fight before. They spot Flame's base and Wemmbu devises a new plan, he would scout himself and tells the guards to stand back unless told otherwise. He spots Boosfer there all alone, he sneaks up close and Boosfer hears him and steps outside and spots Wemmbu. Boosfer asks why Wemmbu is attacking him and that he's guarding his secret from Flame. While fighting, the guards come charging in, which Wemmbu didn't tell them to do so yet, but Boosfer seemed to be struggling, so he stands back to let them finish the job. As that's happening, Flame arrives back at his base and Wemmbu instructs them to run. Flame kills all of the guards and lets Salvationism runs away before focusing on Wemmbu, he decides to run away from the fight since he's unable to use any of his signature weapons while in disguise. Thinking he's in the clear, Wemmbu mends his armor when Flame and Boosfer catch up to him, Wemmbu uses his riptide trident to get reach an ocean and actually get away this time.

Wemmbu heads back to Capital City and sees that Salvationism also managed to successfully escape from the battle and they walk further into Capital City, Wemmbu doesn't even know why he's there and says he's going to deal with it himself, but Salvationism says that they're going to build a void trap in the desert. They gather up more guards this time around and tells them the plan, they begin their journey back to Flame's base and make it to the desert biome right next to the badlands biome where Flame's base is located, Wemmbu goes to Flame's base to see if he's there so they can start building the trap. Wemmbu doesn't contribute to the trap and lets Salvationism and their guard force deal with it while he played Clash Royale. After a bit, Salvationism asks Wemmbu to come help as they're scared Flame would come anytime soon while Wemmbu was in the middle of a Clash Royale match. Salvationism tells Wemmbu that he could've helped with the hole, in which Wemmbu said he isn't going to help, but is taken aback by the sheer size of the hole. Salvationism shows Wemmbu the world eater and asks for his help placing signs so they don't get suspicious, Wemmbu doesn't care to help and digs in a hole and goes back to playing Clash Royale. After a while, the signs have all been placed as well as the sand on top of it, Salvationism asks Wemmbu to bait them towards the trap. 

Wemmbu goes over to the base and stands there, they ask why he's back, he pots up and targets Boosfer specifically. Flame asks Boosfer why he should keep helping him out and asks for leads on where Wemmbu is, Boosfer lies and says he'll tell Flame if he kills the invisible person. As soon as Flame jumps on Wemmbu, he riptide tridents out and towards the direction of the trap. Wemmbu runs into the trap zone and experiences a lag spike, Flame managed to save himself from falling into the trap using cobwebs, as Boosfer saves himself by landing on the edge of the trap. Flame begins to fight the guards, Wemmbu gets a few hits in before deciding to target Boosfer again. Flame starts to struggle and asks Boosfer for help, Boosfer is struggling himself but is still able to tell Flame where a small stash is located inside of the walls, which gave him enough gear to kill off the rest of the guard force as well as Salvationism. 

Wemmbu now being the only one alive, goes towards a waterfall and riptides up it, briding up and across the void, attempting to fishing rod Boosfer off, or using anything to knock him off in general. For the last time, Flame asks Boosfer where Wemmbu is otherwise he's going to kill him. Now out of the trap, Wemmbu and Flame fight each other while Boosfer spectates. Wemmbu asks Flame if he enjoys working for Boosfer, but he's only working with him to figure out where a friend is, and Wemmbu asks if Boosfer has given any proof of said information and that he's been helping Boosfer and killed off an entire army all for information that Boosfer may not even have. 

They both realize that they're fighting for nothing, Boosfer tries to push the blame onto Flame saying that they pulled the trap on Flame and not him, but Wemmbu counters the argument by saying he's apart of Capital City and that they only wanted Flame dead is because he's working with Boosfer and that they didn't have anything against him. Flame finally realizes that Boosfer has been lying about having leads on Wemmbu, and Boosfer says that he's closer to finding Wemmbu than he thinks. Wemmbu and Flame start to attack Boosfer, Boosfer runs back to Flame's base where he uses an escape tunnel Flame made for him. Dropping down, Wemmbu fails the clutch and pops a totem, revealing his identity for a second, he splashes invis again seconds before Flame drops down and fails the clutch too. Boosfer runs down the tunnel and blocks it off behind him, the two keep running down the tunnel, Boosfer runs out of blocks and tells Flame that ClownPierce killed Wemmbu last second before entering a Nether portal, Wemmbu tells Flame to break the portal with water as he pearls into the portal, which instantly sends him into the Nether. The screen turns black and Boosfer can be heard cheering as Wemmbu takes ticks of damage.

content:
How I DESTROYED the Unstable SMP is the 43rd episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The video begins with Wemmbu looting a trial chamber until loppezz calls him. Wemmbu gets startled and maces her until he realizes it's loppezz. Loppezz explains to Wemmbu that a team took over her ice mountain and she wanted him to help her get it back. Wemmbu gets into the ice mountain and attacks members of Fantst's team. Fantst says that if he keeps trying to kill his teammate he will blow up the ice mountain. Loppezz tells Wemmbu to stop because she tells him that they're not lying. 

Wemmbu and loppezz enter the ice mountain again but invisible. Fantst's teammate, homunculus1031 spots them and puts them inside a cell. Wemmbu and loppezz annoy Fantst's teammate to leaving. Wemmbu tells loppezz that he cannot solve any problems without killing anyone. Loppezz insists that they try to defuse the bomb by putting water all over the insides of the base. While they are doing so homunculus spots them so they leave.

Wemmbu sneaks in to the ice base until a player spots him so he kills them. Homunculus gets Fantst to stop being afk and informs him that Wemmbu is back in the base. Fantst and Homunculus both attack Wemmbu and Wemmbu almost kill both of them until Fantst blows up the ice mountain base. Loppezz watches the explosion and feels helpless. Wemmbu kills Homunculus and right as he's about to kill Fantst he teleports away using a statis chamber. Wemmbu goes back to loppezz and gives her a full set of netherite armour before leaving.

 Trivia 

 Loppezz made a tribute to Snow Civilization that can be found here https://x.com/i/status/1940451912140407244
 There was an Unstable Event where players build Snow Civilization 2.0.

title: How I Escaped Minecraft's Largest Prison
content:
How I Escaped Minecraft's Largest Prison is the 14th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
The episode starts off with a recap of last episode’s ending. Wemmbu and PrinceZam are kidnapped and forced into an obsidian box with no roof, containing a hyperrealistic world simulating normal Minecraft with the same biomes and features as the real game. They are each given three totems for their indefinite stay.

Wemmbu collects a bit of wood before Zam finds him and immediately starts attacking him. He pops all three of Wemmbu’s totems before he manages to escape. Wemmbu explores the world and gears himself up before ClownPierce, their captor, announces that a few new prisoners are joining them. He heads to the place where he spawned in by an ender pearl cannon to kill the new players for their totems, but instead, Eggchan drops into the world. He says that he was with Pangi, a former Zam Empire guard, during the security checks. He only has one totem, though. They build a trap for Pangi and get Wemmbu his totem. 

Wemmbu and Egg build a rough draft of a skybase in a corner of the world away from Zam and get themselves iron armour. They run into Zam, who has half diamond armour, and Pangi. Zam offers them to join the Zam Empire 2.0, but Wemmbu declines, and they start fighting. Zam has a Flame and Power bow, and Wemmbu and Egg realise that they are extremely undergeared. They barely make it out alive and return to home base. 

Wemmbu dives underground to get diamond gear while Egg starts making a creeper farm for gunpowder. They want to escape the prison by using an ender pearl cannon because that was the method Clown used to get them into the prison, and that there are certainly chunk bans behind the walls. 

Wemmbu resurfaces from his mining excursion right in the middle of the Zam Empire 2.0. He investigates the empire and steals some semi-useful resources when he sees that Zam and Pangi aren’t there. He returns to Egg and tells him the news. They craft diamond armour and start fishing for enchantments. Egg catches a Protection III book, a Looting book, an Infinity and a Power IV bow, and other random enchants while Wemmbu comes up empty-handed.

Their fishing trip is quickly interrupted by Clown announcing that he will send a juggernaut into the prison to kill them. If they manage to pop his totem, he will teleport away and they’ll be safe. Wemmbu and Egg head to the Zam Empire 2.0 to negotiate a temporary peace treaty. Zam says that they can team up if they put the Zam Empire insignia onto their shields. Egg accepts but Wemmbu refuses, so they start fighting again.

The juggernaut, FerreMC, Clown’s right-hand man, attacks them. They decide to team up anyway, and eventually pop Ferre’s totem, along with his helmet, with no deaths.

Wemmbu and Egg go back to building their creeper farm. They head to the Zam Empire 2.0 to spy, and see that Zam has obtained obsidian and created a nether portal. Pangi goes through and is chunk banned. Wemmbu tells Egg to get the obsidian with his charm, but he only succeeds in making friends with Zam. Seeing that Zam has obsidian, it won’t be long until he has maxed out gear from an enchanting table. 

Wemmbu and Egg head back to their dysfunctional creeper farm and realise that they need Zam’s help to fix it. Wemmbu jumps Zam in his villager trading hall and asks him to help with their creeper farm, as well as how he got obsidian and villagers, since there is no village or lava pool  in this prison. He says that he got the obsidian from a raid and that zombie villagers spawn in here. He agrees to help them with their creeper farm and form a temporary alliance. He tells them that with the amount of gunpowder they need (two and a half stacks), they could use an alternative method and just get it the old-fashioned way, by killing creepers.

They reach the creeper farm and Zam inspects it. He tells Egg to never use the tutorial he did again. The only advice he comes up with is to make it larger, since the spawn area is too small. They head back to the Zam Empire 2.0, but are met with a surprise. Clown announces that he knows about their escape plans, and that since a certain someone in the prison is so obsessed with orbital cannons, he’d send them a little gift.

Not five seconds after, a ball of TNT strikes the Zam Empire 2.0. Multiple orbital cannon shots strike the base. Wemmbu digs underground to hide from the explosives. Once the detonations end, there is nothing left of the Zam Empire 2.0. 

Zam starts blaming everything on Wemmbu, that the entire reason he has nothing left is because Wemmbu came knocking on his door that day when he wanted Zam’s help to catch SpokeIsHere. He not only blew up his first empire, but also caused the second one to be decimated. Wemmbu tells him that Clown wouldn’t let Zam kill him just to mess with them for his own personal enjoyment. He takes off all of his armour, and sure enough, Clown’s voice sounds again, this time announcing another juggernaut attack. 

Realising that now they have a bigger enemy to deal with, Zam and Wemmbu team up again for the time being. Since they don’t have Pangi to help this time, they decide to sacrifice some of their gunpowder to cart Ferre. Ferre soon arrives, and a fight ensues. After a while, Ferre tells them to pause and drop all of their carts, because apparently they aren’t allowed to have them. Zam distracts Ferre while Wemmbu charges up his bow and they pop Ferre’s totem from a cart. He is teleported out. 

Zam tells Wemmbu that he’ll leave them alone again if they don’t come bother him. However, their peace is interrupted when Clown says that there will be new prisoners joining them. They head towards the entrypoint and see Zam giving a speech to the prisoners, _Kenadian_, LuckyMixx, Spepticle, loppezz, SykerMC, and Dol9hin. He says that they will rebuild the Zam Empire, but shows no interest in escaping. Wemmbu tells everyone that they have an escape plan, and if anyone joins them, they can escape them as well. 

Wemmbu and Egg recruit _Kenadian_, a master escapist, LuckyMixx, and Spepticle to their team. They ask Kenadian what he knows about this prison, and he tells them that he doesn’t have an escape plan. They fill him in on their plans and ask him if it will work. He says that he doesn’t know anything about TNT mechanics, and that they’ll have to calculate the distance they need to shoot the ender pearl. They end up with about 350 blocks.

Egg stalls the guards as Wemmbu crafts and sets up all of the TNT carts and the ender pearl, then pulls the lever.

The TNT explodes and the ender pearl flies out of sight, but nothing happens. Wemmbu falls to the ground and the guards immediately swarm on him. He tries to fight, but the guards end up popping his totem. Knowing that he’s probably going to be taken prisoner again as well, Wemmbu gives up and surrenders, putting away his weapon. Before the guards can take him away, though, everything goes black. 

The pearl flies all the way across the inner obsidian wall, through the obsidian spikes, through the chunk bans, through the outer wall, all the way to the other side. 

Egg messages Wemmbu that the guards have captured him, but Wemmbu quickly runs, away from the prison and towards freedom.

title: How I HUNTED the Unstable SMP
content:
I Got HUNTED on the Unstable SMP is the 42nd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The video begins with Wemmbu looting the abandoned BAT base until he gets attacked by three players. One of them has a full set of netherite armour. The three players build an obsidian pillar and stand over it. Wemmbu realizes why they are standing on a pillar and holds his totem of undying to survive the arrow canon. Wemmbu runs away from the base but he decides to return just to spy on one of the players who attack him. The player goes on a mining trip so Wemmbu holds his pets hostage. Wemmbu kills two of his pets but gives him one of his dogs back only to kill the dog and kill him too.

The guy in netherite armour with emerald trims then attacks Wemmbu again. After escaping, Wemmbu tries to mace him until the netherite guy pulls his stasis chamber. Wemmbu goes back to the BAT base to continue looting it and get resources in case he gets attacked again. He then heads to another base until an invisible person starts wearing armour. The invisible player tells Wemmbu that he is about to die and blows up the entire base. Wemmbu survives the explosion and gets ambushed by two invisible players. Wemmbu kills both of them using the mace and gets a free set of netherite armour along with a lodestone compass.

The lodestone compass leads to Mafia City. The netherite guy with emerald trims along with four other people without trims. The guy with trims reveals himself and it turns out that he was Wyll the entire time. Wyll tells Wemmbu to move away from where they were standing and he blows it up. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he could trust him because he could've killed him but he didn't. He then gives Wemmbu a tour around his base (aka Ash's old castle). Wyll then tells Wemmbu to kill a player named Gigasigma37. He finds him in an old house in Zam Empire and eventually kills him. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he lied and traps him into the void. Wemmbu barely manages to escape using MrCube's void trap in the old BAT base.

Wemmbu returns to Mafia City and infiltrates Wyll's group and begins stealing their resources. Wyll notices something suspicious and decides to get everyone to drink milk to reveal themselves. Wemmbu  tries to kill Wyll. He pops his totem and Wyll starts mending. Wemmbu goes back into the old Ashswagg castle to steal more of their resources. Wyll warns his team that Wemmbu may be around until he notices that Wemmbu forgot to switch his shield. They jump him and Wemmbu manages to kill all of them using an arrow cannon and just as he's about to kill Wyll, he uses a statis chamber to escape.

 Trivia 

 The video's original title was "How I HUNTED a Hardcore Minecraft SMP" before changing it to "How I HUNTED the Unstable SMP". As of current, it is now "I Got HUNTED on the Unstable SMP".

title: How I SAVED the Unstable SMP
content:
How I SAVED the Unstable SMP is the 47th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Wemmbu travels to a stronghold to go to the end to get elytras and sell them to get rich. Upon entering a stronghold, he finds out there are people living in there. He meets Baablu in the stronghold. As Wemmbu finds the stronghold, Baablu tells him not to enter the portal because someone is keeping it for themselves. Baablu wants Wemmbu to respawn the ender dragon but he needs end crystals. Wemmbu and Baablu set their stasises and head to the Wormhole Vault. They finally find the end crystals in a stash and leave the vault via stasis chamber. 

Wemmbu goes in to the end and meets MinuteTech. Minute asks why Wemmbu is in the end. Wemmbu tells Minute he has to respawn the ender dragon. Wemmbu attempts to respawn the ender dragon but Minute wont let him so he tries to kill Minute. During the fight, Wemmbu spawns withers to distract Minute. Baablu enters the end to fight Minute. Minute warns Wemmbu about what he's about to do but Wemmbu respawns the dragon anyways. Wemmbu helps Baablu kill Minute now that he successfully respawned the dragon until Fantst appears out of nowhere and begins attacking Wemmbu. Baablu reveals that he was just using Wemmbu to respawn the dragon.

Wemmbu and Minute head to the outer end islands. Minute explains that Baablu wants to respawn the ender dragon so that they can duplicate them and destroy spawn completely. Wemmbu didn't care about saving spawn although he did care about Fantst and Baablu being on the same team. Wemmbu and Minute realize they could've won the fight if they didn't waste their resources on fighting each other. Wemmbu and Minute get jumped by members of Fantst's team and they try to escape the fight due to minimal resources but they follow them. Wemmbu and Minute manage to kill all of them except for one. 

Wemmbu and Minute search for an unlooted end city and after travelling 100k blocks away from the main end island, they find 2 unlooted end cities, one of them with a ship. They loot the end city but they were followed by the same person who they spared due to lack of resources. They then get jumped by Fantst, Baablu and the rest of the team. Wemmbu and Minute get geared enough and they manage to fight them off. They head to the main end island and restock before returning and heading to the main end island.

They notice there are now 3 ender dragons. Wemmbu maces one of them and almost kills it. Fantst, Baablu and their entire attempt to kill Wemmbu and Minute. They kill some people in their team and pop all of Fantst and Baablu's totems. Fantst escapes along with everyone else who hasn't been killed in their team. Wemmbu goes back to the overworld now that his job is done.

title: How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft Tournament
content:
How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft Tournament is the 49th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Wemmbu participates in a PVP tournament hosted by AJTHEBOLD to get another rematch against FlameFrags. The point of the tournament is to determine who is the strongest PVPer. Each fighter has 3 totems. If all of them pop, they get their stasis pulled back into the lobby and get disqualified. However, elytra aren't allowed, giving Wemmbu a major disadvantage. 

The first fight is Wemmbu vs. Epaxial. Wemmbu uses his mace and also pillars up above Epaxial to pop his totem with the mace. Wemmbu easily pops the rest of Epaxial's totems, disqualifying him. Wemmbu watches the other matches. FlameFrags wins against Willsion, Wyll and Ferre win their matches, TheobaldTheBird accidentally kills his opponent, and Sharpness wins against Horace while using his fists.

Horace begins cleaning up the arena, but he is seen with a wooden pickaxe. Wemmbu gives him his pickaxe to help him. Wemmbu heads to the festival, where Flame begins teasing him. Wyll peers towards Wemmbu to tell him that he will be fighting him the next round. Wyll happened to be correct, as his next fight was against him. Wyll has access to stacks of god apples and slow-falling arrows, making the fight annoying for Wemmbu. After a few close calls, Wemmbu wins the fight.

Wemmbu watches the other matches, and everyone is dismissed into the festival. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he's going to fight Sharpness next and gives him advice on how he can win against Sharpness, along with telling him not to use any mace techniques against Sharpness when Flame is watching. They return to the festival, and everyone starts teasing Wemmbu.

The next match happens to be Sharpness, as Wyll mentioned, along with an ice arena. During their fight, Wemmbu notices that FlameFrags wasn't watching the fight, so he begins using some of his mace techniques against Sharpness. Wemmbu notices that Flame returned, and he stops using his mace techniques. Sharpness pops Wemmbu's totem. Wemmbu is now on his last totem, and if he wants to win the match, he will have to listen to Wyll's advice. Wemmbu wins against Sharpness. Flame also won his match, putting them both in the finals.

Wemmbu and Flame begin preparing for their match. When the finals start, Wemmbu begins macing Flame while also using melee. title: How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP
content:
How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP is the 38th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Wemmbu gets threatened by a player in iron armour while he has no armour while monologuing about how he wants to survive in a server where people are destined to become powerful. Wemmbu kills the player with his mace. Wemmbu and Eggchan mine for basic armour and materials. They attempt to find leather to make an enchanting table however they realized that mobs don't spawn in the server. Eggchan suggests that they find the base of the guy who threatened to kill Wemmbu. As soon as they arrive to the base, Eggchan distracts the people in the team while Wemmbu steals anything valuable from them. Wemmbu finds 5 leather and notices Eggchan getting robbed. Wemmbu grabs Eggchan and they run from them. Wemmbu kills almost everyone in the team but one of the members. Wemmbu gets so distracted at trying to kill the remaining player that all the items from the previous people they killed had despawned.

They head back to the village/base from the team they robbed from and enchant their gear. They head closer to spawn to get more books to get better enchantments. Upon their journey to spawn they find lots of structures that have been looted until they find a base that appears operational with stacked players in it too. Wemmbu spots cows in their base so they attempt to steal two cows from them. While doing so, Wemmbu and Eggchan make a base and try digging under the cow patch to steal two cows. The team's leader spots oddly placed cobblestone and they find Wemmbu and Eggchan. They all chase Wemmbu and he eventually kills one of them. He uses their weakest member as leverage to get them to stop trying to kill him. Wemmbu steals some of the books in their enchanting table and they start trying to kill him again. The team is fed up on the leader forcing them to follow his orders so they decide to kill him instead of Wemmbu.

Eggchan tells Wemmbu to stop risking himself doing other things instead of achieving their goals. He tells Wemmbu he won't watch his rematch against FlameFrags because he's leaving to focus on his studies and gives Wemmbu his armour, elytra and rockets before logging off. 

Wemmbu returns to the base ready to wipe out the entire team and notices them hosting a funeral for their leader and expressing how much they hate him. He then kills everyone else in the team and loots the entire base. 

Wemmbu enters Flame's house and tells him that he wants a rematch since he lost to him the last time they fought. Wemmbu's totem pops as FlameFrags combos him but he goes to a more open space and starts macing Flame. Wemmbu breaks Flame's shield and almost kills him before Flame enters his house. Wemmbu begins griefing Flame's house to try to kill him. Flame exits his house again to splash Wemmbu with slow falling before he can mace him. Eventually they agree to stop fighting because the fight would've taken a long time if they continued. They start arguing over who won the fight until the video cuts to Flame giving Wemmbu a tour of his house.   

 Trivia 

 This is the shortest Unstable Universe video as it is less than 25 minutes long.
 This video was originally titled "How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft SMP" before being changed to "How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP"

title: How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room
content:
How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room is the 17th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The episode starts off with Wemmbu and PrinceZam locked inside of a large escape room created by ClownPierce. Inside of the small box they are in has an end portal with four eyes filled and a wind charge inside of an item frame. Wemmbu tries to use the wind charge to gain height and get out of the hole, but instead redstone goes off, and it dispenses a trapdoor. They use the trapdoor to go into crawl mode and escape the first room.

The second room has even more trapdoors, their plan was to use the trapdoors on the floor and stay in crawl mode to crawl out the wall again. The plan works and now they're onto the third puzzle. Because Wemmbu took so long, Zam said he could've solved it by himself. A flashback appears of the last episode, showing Zam attempting to kill Wemmbu inside of Proton.

The third room has hoppers that consists of a bunch of different items, there is also a dropdown to another room with pigs down below. They can't access the next room without an item to break their fall, so they look for anything to help progress. Wemmbu uses a snowball to get the raw iron that was placed in an item frame and smelts it. With the iron ingot and the rest of the items given, Wemmbu crafts a crossbow and has tipped weaving arrows. He uses the crossbow and kills a pig, which spawns a cobweb where it dies. They manage to get down safely.

The fourth room has a goat placed inside of a house. Zam finds a bucket inside of the house and milks the goat to get rid of the mining fatigue. They mine out the floor, as well as the autocrafter inside of the house. Copper is scattered all around in item frames and they craft it into a raw copper block. They try to use all the blocks they have to crawl into the hole in the middle, the path down to the fifth room. Eventually they find a way to get into crawl mode, the most important item being the pink concrete powder.

The fifth room is a small room, and another goat is with them. The room is also surrounded by a bigger sphere. Wemmbu builds up with the few blocks he has remaining, not enough to get out of the room, but enough to see into the hoppers outside of the room. Zam asks for the blocks and builds out since he had an autocrafter on him still. Wemmbu manages to put the concrete powder and iron door inside of a hopper, which lets Zam to access the next room. There is a dispenser underneath the floor, which allows Zam to give Wemmbu items from down under. He gives Wemmbu a leaping potion and the concrete. Wemmbu makes it out, but gets mining fatigue as soon as he reaches the top of the small room. He is unable to get the concrete powder back. Being softlocked, Wato, the creator of the escape room, comes to assist them. He shows Wemmbu the intended way to solve the room and stasises out. Wemmbu goes into crawl mode and goes to where Zam is. The next room is right below the dispenser, powdered snow is waiting for them beneath.

The sixth room is the biggest one so far, being a manmade Mesa biome, having access to powdered snow, an armadillo, and the first room to be able to freely break blocks without mining fatigue. They find rabbit hide, which makes them think they need leather boots for the powdered snow. While messing around, Wemmbu finds out they can very briefly jump on powdered snow before they start sinking, which leads them to attempt three consecutive parkour jumps to get to a hopper that was barely out of reach. The two take turns, running out of food in the process. After many attempts, Wemmbu finally makes the jump. They now have four rabbit hide and three leather, which is enough to make leather boots. They get lost and don't know where to build up until Zam notices a gold platform above. Wemmbu lets Zam go up first. Wemmbu messages Zam asking what's at the top, Zam goes quiet. Wato comes back, seeing that Wemmbu is stuck. They go through with the emergency exit, which is to use the armadillo to break through a wall near a patch of gold ore. Wato gives Wemmbu a milk bucket so he can break the lectern to get out.

Wemmbu gets out of the room and ends up on the outsides of the escape room. He takes potions from a random station that are located in specific areas. Wemmbu breaks into another room and uses the bucket Wato gave him to pick up water and swim out. Wemmbu tries to cheese the room, Wato hits Wemmbu with a sword, causing Wemmbu to give up the bucket. On a random armor stand has maxed out Netherite boots on them, Wemmbu takes them. A hopper right next to it contained some eyes of ender and a maxed out Netherite sword. Wato forces Wemmbu to do the rest of the room legitimately, which Wemmbu does.

After finishing the room that was broken into, Wemmbu obtains a wind charging potion. He finds a bunch of chickens stacked on top of each other, splashes them and kills them. This launches him into another room with a bunch of dispensers and flowing lava. Wemmbu breaks a bunch of things inside of the room and cheeses it by wind charging out. Wato doesn't like that and forces Wemmbu to solve it legitimately again. Wemmbu manages to figure it out, but with Wato's help.

The next step to progress is to build upwards using the sand blocks he has, held up by tripwire hooks and redstone torches. Wemmbu makes it and Wato leaves. Wato tells Wemmbu to tread carefully, since he's worried about Wemmbu falling for the same tricks. Wemmbu finally meets back up with Zam. In the time they were separated, Zam obtained a heavy core and a few enchanted books. Zam gives Wemmbu the heavy core and a enchanted book with wind burst on it, which Wemmbu crafts a mace and enchants. Wemmbu uses the mace on an armor stand, which allows both of them to gain enough height to get onto the next platform. This technique is used for the next few platforms until they make it to a room with brewing stands and magma cubes. They use the slime block to brew oozing potions, splashing them onto the magma cubes and turning them into slime, giving them over a stack of slime balls. Wemmbu crafts them into slime blocks, which gives them just enough blocks to get to the next platform.

Wemmbu maces up into a room once again, with an actual puzzle inside of the room. He uses a fishing rod to get Zam up with him. Wemmbu realizes that they need to use the resources inside of the room to reach the next platform. Zam suggests using the mace instead to gain more height and to reserve resources. Wemmbu maces Zam and rods Zam up and they do that multiple times until they make it up top. They get to the end of the platform, with nowhere else to go, they mace up one more time. On top of the box is a hole that leads to where they started. They drop down and fill the end portal. Once entering the End, ClownPierce congratulates them for escaping.

Clown demands for the mace back, but Wemmbu refuses to until Clown tells him where Eggchan is. Wemmbu whispers to Zam to give him the netherite armor and mace, Clown instructs Wato to respawn the Ender Dragon, but Wato flakes. Wemmbu tells Zam to go through the portal when he drops Clown. Zam makes it out and Clown respawns the dragon himself. Wemmbu and Clown begins to fight. Wemmbu's armor breaks and Wemmbu gives up the mace. Clown says he just gave up one of the last remaining maces on the server and that things are about to go down. Clown then flies off to the end islands. The episode ends with Wemmbu killing the dragon and going through the end portal.

title: How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items
content:
How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items is the 4th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
The episode begins with SpokeIsHere explaining how one week ago, millions of duped items appeared on the server. The players stashed them in secure vaults that were supposedly unbreachable, until he found one of them.

Spoke starts digging into their defenses and breaks into a room filled with players. He later realizes that they are just armor stands and spots a hole in the center, which he assumes leads to what he is looking for. He bridges over but sees that he would die from the fall, so he opens his ender chest and grabs a pearl to clutch with. Once inside, there are rows of double chests filled with the duped items. He blew everything up, but fell through the floor and clutched with another ender pearl, ending up standing in front of Roshambogames in an obsidian box filled with end crystals with a bow pointed at his face.

Roshambo threatens to shoot Spoke and blow him up if he tries anything stupid and tells him that there’s a player on his way to kill him right now. Instead of taking his chances, Spoke shoots himself and blows up the end crystal. He then elytras out of the prison, leaving Roshambogames behind.

Spoke resolves to get rid of the duped items once and for all, but decides to keep the two pieces of exploited armor. He heads toward spawn and discovers that someone had set it on fire. Someone starts playing music nearby and finds the base of Mapicc, a player who hates Roshambo. He tells Spoke that he used to steal from him all the time, but that he somehow got really rich all of a sudden. He then reveals that he heard everything Spoke said, including the fact that Roshambo has duped items. Spoke offers to help him raid the vaults on the condition that they don’t keep any of the duped items. Mapicc agrees.

They head over to the Zam Empire, supposedly where the second vault is. Spoke splashed himself with invis and proceeds to tell Mapicc that he has a big target on his back. They dig down into the first floor and run into FlameFrags and Leow0ok, two of PrinceZam guards. Mapicc tells the guards that Spoke is his little brother and that he doesn’t like to talk. Spoke’s invisibility runs out and FlameFrags, Leow0ok, and another guard Merfinn start chasing them. They escape and elytra onto the roof of a nearby building.

Spoke explains that the real reason why they came to the Zam Empire was to not only destroy the duped items, but to also bring them back to the way they were, which means that they can’t destroy any builds or kill any players, or else they would be just as bad as Roshambo. They pearl back into the castle and enter the vault, blowing up as many duped items as they can. The server starts lagging and they get away by pearling into the walls. They elytra onto a balloon and head into the nether. They build up onto the roof of the portal and watch the guards elytra away, heading back into the overworld.

Mapicc asks Spoke how Roshambo knew how to dupe items in the first place and Spoke reveals to him that he was the one who found the dupe glitch. He tells Mapicc that this was before he saw the consequences of his actions and that he had used a lot of the duped items to pay players to do stuff. Mapicc is angry at first but calms down once Spoke says that an old friend convinced him to never touch exploits again.

Mapicc suggests that they head to TheRealSquiddo's base, which might contain some of the duped items since Spoke paid her a lot of them. They find the duped items stashed in barrels around her base and Spoke sets a pile of netherite blocks on fire when Squiddo logs online. Spoke and Mapicc try to make up an excuse, but are interrupted by the fire that has spread throughout the castle. While trying to stop the fire, Spoke finds a chest with the coordinates of what he thinks are the coordinates of Roshambo’s vaults.

They head to the first set of coordinates and find an unassuming trading hall in a mountain. There is a pile of chests in the center that contain lots of enchanted books and emeralds, though they aren’t sure if they’re duped or not. They then find the duped items in barrels located at the columns and start carefully burning them. However, the owner of the trading hall, Jepexx, discovers them and crashes out. He tells Spoke that these aren’t duped items and that he skipped his final exam grinding for them. Jepexx doesn’t know about the duped items in the barrels, so when he finds them, he tries to steal them to trade with villagers. Spoke apologizes and tries to compensate with a fully maxed out kit to distract Jepexx while Mapicc breaks the barrels and burns them. Jepexx gets mad again, so they lead him out and tell him they have more emeralds for him. Mapicc starts a conversation with Jepexx while Spoke covers the trading hall with dirt to make it blend in with the hill. Once Spoke covers the trading hall up, he tells Jepexx that his trading hall disappeared and that he should probably check on his base to make sure it hasn’t disappeared. Once he leaves, they hide the rest of the duped items.

Spoke and Mapicc elytra back to spawn and decide to set an ender pearl stasis chamber. They search for a premade one and end up at Wemmbu's base, discovering his secret room under his house. They set their ender pearl stasis and head over to the second set of coordinates, a sky vault in the jungle. Once below the vault, they spot the outlines of players and their horses and decide to elytra up to check it out. The guards, PlanetLord and Leow0ok start attacking them and Spoke finds that he lost his TNT, so he and Mapicc start burning as much as the duped items as they can. Eventually, they realize that this isn’t going to work, so they retreat. 

Back on the ground, Spoke proposes an idea to use the orbital cannon to destroy the vault, because chances are, it was also made out of duped items. He leads Mapicc to the top of his prison where the orbital cannon is, but discovers that someone nuked part of the cannon. Spoke says that he thinks he knows where the builders kept the extra materials, so they head to the entrance of the prison. Once they get through the outer defenses, they ring a bell and spot pillagers arranged in arrows that point toward the items. They successfully retrieve the materials and fix the orbital cannon.

Spoke then shows Mapicc the button that will activate the orbital cannon and explains that the room they’re in was where he last saw JamatoP. Mapicc presses the button and nothing happens. Spoke realizes that the cannon already went off and that they had to get to the vault before it was bombed to warn the guards. They don’t believe him, however, and start engaging with them. The orbital cannon strikes in the middle of their combat and everyone panics and elytras away from the zone. The duped items are completely gone, but the guards are furious. Spoke and Mapicc manage to knock them off of the vault, and they try to climb up a dirt pillar. Spoke threatens to shoot them off if they continue to advance and they pause. He takes the opportunity and asks them if there were any more vaults that they didn’t know about. The guards finally relent and tell them that there is a final vault. Spoke ends up shooting them off.

Spoke and Mapicc return to Mapicc’s base to discuss their plan to attack. Spoke suggests that they use the orbital cannon to strike the coordinates again. However, they are interrupted by an explosion that blows up Mapicc’s base. Spoke reasons that since the person who lit the TNT heard their conversation, they should strike the next vault now in case they told Roshambo. They activate the orbital cannon again and head to the third set of coordinates.

However when they arrive, they discover that the coordinates aren’t located at a vault, but instead at Jepexx’s base. They start a conversation with him and discover that this base meant a lot to him and that he lived here since almost the start of the server. Mapicc and Spoke fly away and Mapicc reveals to Spoke that these were the coordinates that the orbital cannon was set to strike. They decide to check if there was anything at the exact coordinates, so they dig into one of Jepexx’s wheat fields and find the actual vault under his base. Spoke reasons that Jepexx doesn’t even know that there is a vault under his field. They try to think of a solution and head down to Jepexx’s base to check things out again, but they’re too late.

The orbital cannon strikes, wiping out everything that was Jepexx’s home. Jepexx is devastated and tells Spoke to leave and that he’s done enough. Spoke and Mapicc feel very guilty, realizing that they took everything from an innocent player, and they swear never to touch the orbital cannon again, even against duped items. They resolve to find everyone who was affected by the duped items a new home at the end of this. 

Spoke and Mapicc leave Jepexx behind and head to the fourth and final set of coordinates before the final vault. There, they find a huge red and white mansion that they assume contains the duped redstone. Instead of redstone, they find a chest containing a book called “the final vault” by Roshambo. They realize that he probably already moved everything to the final vault and open the book, finding the coordinates to the final vault. Spoke knows that Roshambo is clearly up to no good because the coordinates are only a thousand blocks away from spawn. He knows for sure that there is nothing there, so they devise a plan to set an ender pearl stasis for Spoke. If anything goes wrong, Spoke tells Mapicc that he will message him and tell him to pull the stasis. 

Spoke then heads alone to the coordinates in the book and spots Roshambo. He leads him to the Soul Sand Vault, a stone wall with arrows of soul sand and wither skulls pointing into the ground. PlanetLord and Leow0ok are also stationed there, and ominously greet him. They lead him into the final vault and Spoke discovers that it isn’t a trap after all. However, when he looks into the chests, they are mostly empty, with a few containing soul sand and wither skulls arranged in the crafting recipe for a wither. Leow0ok tells him that this isn’t the real final vault and Roshambo digs out the blocks under Spoke, which drops him into an end portal. They respawn the ender dragon and several withers and tell him that this indeed was a trap all along. Roshambo and his henchmen start attacking Spoke. He messages Mapicc to pull the stasis, but it fails because the end isn’t freed from the dragon yet. 

In a voiceover, Spoke says that truthfully, he just wanted to stay there to prove to them that he could handle them, that he wasn’t afraid, when in reality, he was scared. Not of death, but of the fact that the chestplate and leggings he had on were the first and would be the last exploited items on this server and that if he lost or broke them, he would never forgive himself, as they were the only things left of Jamato. He wasn’t really sure if this was worth it anymore. 

Spoke reaches the end islands and concludes that if Roshambo, Leow0ok, and PlanetLord want to escape the end, then they would have to defeat the dragon, freeing him as well. He splashes himself with an invis potion, sneaking back to the main end island. He spots Roshambo and his henchmen getting chased by the withers. Eventually, they fly away into the void. Spoke follows them and reaches a massive end base, which he thinks is the final vault. He stalks them around the base, ending up in a giant chest room. Once his invis ran out, the Leow0ok discovers him, so he gears up for a fight, but Roshambo says that there’s no point in attacking anymore. Leow0ok asks him how he found the vault and Spoke tells them his plans. Roshambo laughs and reveals that they’re okay with trapping themselves in the end because their base was here. Spoke checks the chests and discovers that they’re all empty. 

Convinced that this is indeed the final vault, Spoke is persistent in his search despite Roshambo telling him that there is nothing here for him. Spoke then accuses them of moving the items into their ender chests, which Roshambo responds to by telling him to move on, that he was chasing a ghost. He says that finding and getting rid of the duped items wasn’t going to get Jamato back. Spoke is confused as to how he knew about Jamato, but all he gets in return is the information that the “someone” who told Roshambo (implied to be Wemmbu) was coming to kill him. Spoke argues that it’s Wemmbu who’s the bad guy, and that he tried to kill him once and would gladly do it again. Seeing no more use in staying, he flies away into the distance. 

Once back at Wemmbu’s base, Spoke tells Mapicc everything that happened. Mapicc says that it doesn’t make sense that Spoke had already found all of the vaults. Spoke tells him that they’ve already been to every single vault together… but they haven’t. Only Spoke was at the first vault, and it was the only vault Roshambo was actually at. 

They elytra to the first vault and jump into the room Roshambo was waiting for Spoke at. Spoke realizes that the lag he first experienced in the room wasn’t from all the end crystals and TNT, but from the hidden duped items. He mines into the floor but finds nothing. Then he mines into the walls and is greeted with countless barrels covering every inch of obsidian, all filled to the brim with duped items. This was the actual final vault. They start blowing up every single barrel, but Spoke stops in his tracks. He turns to Mapicc and says that if they blow everything up, Roshambo would lose all of his fortune. The big end base that was supposed to be his home would now be fair game. 

“I think we got a place to move into,” Spoke says.

 Errors 

 In various sections of the video, the health bar switches from hardcore hearts to regular hearts.

title: How to Destroy the Unstable SMP
content:
How to Destroy the Unstable SMP is the first episode featured in Unstable Universe and the first episode released by SpokeIsHere.

 Plot
The video begins on a cold opening. SpokeIsHere tells JamatoP that the server is running out of time. He says that he discovered something that shouldn’t exist: a set of diamond armour with all four protection enchantments. The two enter Jamato’s base, where Spoke explains that a couple hours prior he was at a zombie farm enchanting his gear when he accidentally put all four protection enchantments on each piece.

Jamato tells Spoke that this was once possible in an older version of Minecraft and leads Spoke to an underground vault housing old Minecraft glitches and exploits that have never been possible to occur either at the same time or on the same server. These glitches include a spliced portal, a weaponless skeleton, a set of redstone-trimmed netherite armour with all the protection enchants that Spoke equips, and most notably, a machine that strips the data of blocks and transforms them into other blocks. 

Spoke realises what functioning ancient exploits could entail. He and Jamato both agree that nobody can find out about this, and Jamato says to start with the safe ones as to not raise suspicion. Spoke suggests they find a working duplication glitch to get the resources needed to test more exploits and build more machines. In voiceover, Spoke describes a duplication glitch that was patched years ago, but assuming it’s back he decides he has to use it. All he needs for it is a single shulker box, so he goes to the end to get one. In voiceover he says getting this shulker box “would prove to be the hardest part.” 

Spoke sees Wemmbu in the distance and approaches. Wemmbu tells Spoke that he has to leave and Spoke asks what he’s doing. Wemmbu says he’s just doing a “side-hobby project.” Wemmbu  asks about the armour Spoke is wearing, the redstone trimmed netherite armour from Jamato’s exploit vault. He asks what the armour is and where Spoke got it. Spoke lies, telling Wemmbu that he went mining and enchanted it at the zombie farm. Spoke changes the subject, wishing Wemmbu  luck on his project before asking if that's really what he is  doing. Wemmbu then shows Spoke a shulker box full of elytra, sarcastically saying “good luck finding an elytra,” and leaves the end. 

Spoke goes hunting for shulker shells in the nearby end cities and gets what he needs. Returning to the overworld, he brings Jamato to the dupe stash behind a painting in his base. They begin to duplicate gold, ancient debris, diamonds, emeralds, iron, experience bottles, shulker shells, anvils, and redstone components for the next couple of hours.

They devise a plan to use update suppression to splice a portal, but Spoke asks where they should build it. Jamato suggests putting it in a base that nobody would want to break into. However, neither of them can build something grand enough, so Jamato tells Spoke to ask TheRealSquiddo and her master builders to set up a meeting at spawn.

Spoke commissions Squiddo and her builders to build five Great Wonders, paying thirteen shulker boxes of duped items. Squiddo tells Spoke that the builders can finish by the next day, but unable to wait, Spoke digs under one of the Wonders, the Pyramid of Anubis, to build the chunk suppressor with Jamato. After finishing it, Jamato suggests waiting until everyone is offline to test it, but Spoke pulls the lever regardless, crashing the server. When rejoining, Jamato explains that while that wasn’t necessarily bad, it could mean that the builders find out. To be safe, Spoke  mines out to check on the builders and finds Squiddo standing in front of a spliced portal. Squiddo explains that she was trying to mine the portal when the server crashed, and after rejoining, she found it split in half. Squiddo says she needs to tell people about it, but Spoke talks her out of it, claiming it's just lag. He says he knows how to fix it and puts a block inside the portal, which breaks it. He again tells her that she shouldn’t tell anyone.

Mining back into the Pyramid, Spoke tells Jamato about what happened and Jamato tells him that that’s not how it works, which confuses both of them. They decide to lay low to test some smaller exploits. Spoke boats to the raid farm to see if he can obtain a glitched crossbow. He doesn’t find it , but says that he will check  after each glitch and heads to the next Wonder.

Under one of the Wonders in a netherrack room, Spoke transforms arrows of healing into uncraftable tipped arrows. Spoke goes back to the raid farm and again doesn’t find the crossbow, but brings back chests. He then attempts a dupe glitch that ultimately fails. Spoke goes back to the raid farm and again doesn’t find the crossbow. He comes back to the netherrack room with a brewing stand to attempt the two billion bottles glitch, but that also fails. Spoke goes back to the raid farm and finally finds the glitched crossbow. 

After showing Jamato the arrow and the crossbow, Spoke goes on to explain that certain exploits don’t work. He brings up the chunk suppressor, as they still don’t know how Squiddo’s Nether portal was spliced. Jamato explains that the suppressor wasn’t just working properly, it was working in a way it had never before. This confuses both of them, having never heard of anything like it before. 

Jamato offers to show Spoke another glitch that will not only dupe, but also stack totems of undying. The glitch is performed by dropping a totem on the ground and using an auto-clicker on the recipe book to turn one totem into a totem stack. The glitch gets Spoke a stack of eighty-five totems, which he uses to tank multiple crits from Jamato to test if they work. 

Wanting netherite, Spoke asks if they can dupe any. Instead, Jamato gives Spoke the illegal redstone trimmed netherite set on an armour stand. Spoke swaps the armour he’s wearing with the one on the stand, but then realises that there are a lot of entities in the room. He asks Jamato if there’s a way to make a force field to prevent a pie graph or chunk loader from picking them up. Spoke says that they’re absolutely not using chunk bans. Jamato says they may need to bring in more people, so they interview Roshambogames, JumperWho, Derapchu, and Fantst to become the Guardians of the Wonders. Spoke pays them in duped items to not speak to anyone about this. Knowing he needs to hire one more person, he interviews Wemmbu to be the fifth Guardian. When asked for his skill, Wemmbu says they should go somewhere else. He shows Spoke an empty plains. A massive lag spike hits the area and moments later, circles of TNT appear and vaporise the field. This was a result of Wemmbu’s orbital cannon, which he’d previously built on the Lifesteal SMP. Spoke is hesitant to hire him, and explains that if he is found inside any of the structures he will be kicked off of the Guardian team. 

Spoke returns to the netherrack room, swapping his armour again and accidentally unstacking his totems in the process. He sees this as a good thing, however, and reminds himself that the only reason he’s executing these exploits is to find answers, and that once he abuses them, the server will truly be ruined. 

Later, Spoke and Jamato are in a stone room under one of the Wonders. Using an exploit, they plan make blocks without data. The goal is to blow up a brewing stand with an end crystal that is on fire on the same frame as placing an enchanting table. They  have to log out, log back in, and see if it works. When logging back in, the book is removed from the enchanting table. They do the same thing with an ender chest and a wither skeleton skull, which turns them invisible. After doing this, they plan their next exploit. Jamato is worried they’ll become  overconfident and get caught from the impact this next glitch could have. He says in order to perform this glitch, they need “the goofiest and almost illegal mobs they can find.” Spoke sets up camp at the Crone and hunts the illegal mobs. He finds a skeleton, names it, and gives it a stack of wooden swords made using the recipe book glitch. After relogging, it creates the same weaponless skeleton found in Jamato’s exploit vault.

Meeting under the Crone, Spoke shows Jamato the three weaponless mobs he’s collected: the skeleton, a zombified piglin, and a wither skeleton. Jamato reveals that the Crone is on top of a stronghold, and that this exploit will put the mobs partially in the end and partially in the overworld, duping them. Because the mob exists in the end, it will be able to be teleported to the overworld multiple times. Spoke goes in to get the materials, which are hidden inside an end pillar. 

From the outside, Wemmbu hears Spoke talking to himself inside the pillar. Wemmbu asks what he’s doing, and Spoke frantically tells him not to come down into the pillar, saying that he’ll meet him on the surface. He tells Wemmbu that he’s working on an “end project,” but Wemmbu knows Spoke has been up to something and wants to know what they are. Spoke again says he’ll meet Wemmbu above, but Wemmbu proceeds to respawn the ender dragon, turning the shulker boxed of duplicated restone components into obsidian. Wemmbu continues to be confrontational, asking what Spoke has been up to. Spoke is at a loss for words and tries to muster an excuse. He says that Jamato sent him to get materials for his project, but Wemmbu does not believe that the redstone was legitimately obtained. He realises talking to Spoke is pointless and that he’s better off asking Jamato about it.

Spoke begins to attack Wemmbu, which he doesn’t react to until it becomes annoying. Wemmbu fights back, popping his totem. Spoke runs away, escaping through an end gateway and losing Wemmbu. He goes back, defeats the dragon, and goes through the central portal.

In voiceover, Spoke explains that if Jamato found out that Wemmbu was onto them, he would call off the operation. He decides that the next best step was to destroy every end portal so he could build the mob duper in peace. However, he realises that in order to truly stop Wemmbu he’d need to build something that could truly get rid of him for good. He knows there’s only one exploit capable of that. 

In Spoke’s base, Jamato asks what happened in the end. Spoke tells Jamato that he ran into a player, but that he doesn’t know what’s he and Jamato are building. He tells Jamato that they’re going to need to destroy the end portals, but Jamato protests. He tells Spoke that his goal is to save the server, not play god. Spoke tells him that he’s not playing god. Jamato continues, saying the only way to save the server is to bring it back to how it was. Spoke tells him that they’re the only players on the server with illegal armour, and that there’s a reason why they found it. He says they can’t stop now or they’ll never be able to build the final machine: the chunk splicer.

Jamato tells him that that was never the plan. He says it could fundamentally break the server and he won’t be a part of it anymore. He tells Spoke he shouldn’t be part of it either.

Watching Jamato walk off, Spoke realises he’s again alone. He thought that if Jamato wasn’t going to save the server from Wemmbu, he’d have to do it alone. He collects the materials he would need and heads towards the final Wonder with the intention of creating a command block. Once he acquires one, he intended to show Jamato how they could use it for good, but without Jamato, Spoke has a difficult time getting the machine to work, not realising the exploit he was using had been patched. 

But suddenly, Spoke discovers a never before seen glitch that hasn’t been possible ever before, proving that the server was truly unstable. None of that mattered to him anymore, however, because he’d finally gotten the command block and other illegal blocks. 

Spoke shows Jamato the items, but Jamato insists he gets rid of them and wants nothing to do with them. Spoke then realises when he say Squiddo earlier, Squiddo was wearing red trimmed netherite and suspects she stole the illegal armour. Spoke rushes back to the netherack room and the armour is still there but Wemmbu is waiting for him. The two begin a fight as Spoke manages to equip the illegal armour, throughout the fight Spoke uses his bedrock and Wemmbu breaks Spokes helmet and boots but Spoke manages to get out.  

Spoke decides to destroy the evidence inside of the wonders using an orbital TNT cannon. He constructs it a million blocks out but right before he fires Jamato enters. Spoke tells Jamato he's built the largest vault of illegal items and he's not going to destroy it but Jamato tells Spoke that he's not here to stop him. Jamato tells Spoke that after this he'll be leaving and he was just here to say goodbye. The two of them press the button and fire the cannon.

content:
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Disappeared is the 72nd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The video begins with a recap of Flame's identity and his fight against Wemmbu and about a rumor of Wemmbu's death.

Flame demands Boosfer to tell him what happened to Wemmbu. Boosfer in return demanded for payment Flame didn't have. Boosfer then ordered Flame to work for him to get information about Wemmbu. Flame reluctantly agrees. Boosfer demands Flame brew some potions to be ready for battle. He also ordered Flame to repair his armor and gear up for battle, Flame travels to Merchant City to acquire some ender pearls but since ender pearls are a Nether resource, and Nether resources are monopolized by a player named ClownPierce and his team, the ender pearl booth was out of stock. Therefore, Flame had to wait. Flame meets a player named The Invisible Knight. The nether shipment finally arrives and the guards at Merchant City are forced to bow down to FerreMC, Clown's right-hand man. Flame receives the items and travels back to his base to find out Boosfer placing a bunch of Boosfer banners around his base.

When Flame had arrived back, Flame found Boosfer getting tossed around like a baby by The Invisible Knight and Capital City general Salvationism leading an army to kill Boosfer. As soon as Flame arrives they retreat leaving The Invisible Knight and Salvationism as the sole survivors. Flame asks Boosfer to give him his promised information on Wemmbu but Boosfer refuses stating that the players were there for Flame not him. Boosfer also added that was not his plan. Boosfer then offers Flame to retrieve him a helmet from ParrotX2 as a favor. Boosfer states that Parrot has too many colors on his skin and he "pisses him off". Flame asks him if he retrieves the helmet, will he receive the information about Wemmbu. Boosfer dodges the question. Flame then travels to Capital City to meet Parrot in his potion shop. Parrot sighs as he meets Flame. Flame then demands Parrot to drop his potions then his helmet. Parrot questions him on the fact that he's demanding his helmet. Parrot asks him why Flame is asking for his helmet. Parrot realizes Flame is getting "Bossed around" stating that "The great Immortal demon getting bossed around by a random player". Parrot says Flame could tell him who it is and that he is an open-book. Flame replies with "Boosfer". Parrot starts laughing at Flame's reply. Flame getting frustrated starts getting violent at Parrot for making fun of him. Parrot says Boosfer is using him and Boosfer knows nothing about what happened to wemmbu and Boosfer is trying to get his get-back on him. Parrot states if Flame takes all his potions he becomes a "Boosfer henchmen" because Flame is getting bossed around by Boosfer. Parrot then drops Flame his helmet stating that if Flame takes his helmet he is an independent person but if he takes the helmet he is just another Boosfer Henchmen. Parrot then states the fight Flame wishes to seek is probably closer to Flame then he thinks. Parrot drops a quote from Wifies: "You need me more than I need you."

Flame sees the horrendous new room Boosfer made that is basically a Boosfer shrine. Flame drops Boosfer Parrot's helmet then asking Boosfer for information about wemmbu. Boosfer keeps dodging the question stating he maybe will give the information. Boosfer thinks Flame gave him a fake helmet as the helmet had just Unbreaking III. Boosfer  then refuses to give Flame the information as the helmet was trash. Boosfer then demands Flame to build him an escape tunnel so he doesn't die in a future fight against The Invisible Knight and Capital City. Boosfer forces Flame to build an escape tunnel down to bedrock (Y -64). Boosfer splashes Flame with strength rather than haste to quicken the process. Flame builds a Nether Portal at the end of tunnel. Flame starts questioning Boosfer about the fact that he really has the information Flame wants. Flame starts critting out Boosfer frustrated of his lack of information on Wemmbu. The invisible Knight appears behind Flame. The Invisible Knight starts killing Boosfer, but Flame doesn't jump in until Boosfer promises to give him information he wants. Flame finally jumps in, but The Invisible Knight splashes Flame with weakness. The Invisible Knight leads Flame into a sand pit trap but the trap fails to kill either. Flame jumps into the pit and fights the horde of players lead by Salvationism. Boosfer also jumps in the pit eager to kill the horde. Eventually the horde of players are massacred by Flame and Boosfer leaving The Invisible Knight as the sole survivor. Flame starts chasing  the Invisible Knight but he is able to persuade Flame to turn on Boosfer. Both start chasing Boosfer but Boosfer escapes via escape tunnel that he forced Flame to build.

 Trivia 

 For some reason, Flame removed Wemmbu, Clown, and Ferre from the description.
