Flame getting frustrated starts getting violent at Parrot for making fun of him. Parrot says Boosfer is using him and Boosfer knows nothing about what happened to wemmbu and Boosfer is trying to get his get-back on him. Parrot states if Flame takes all his potions he becomes a "Boosfer henchmen" because Flame is getting bossed around by Boosfer. Parrot then drops Flame his helmet stating that if Flame takes his helmet he is an independent person but if he takes the helmet he is just another Boosfer Henchmen. Parrot then states the fight Flame wishes to seek is probably closer to Flame then he thinks. Parrot drops a quote from [[Wifies]]: "You need me more than I need you."

Flame sees the horrendous new room Boosfer made that is basically a Boosfer shrine. Flame drops Boosfer Parrot's helmet then asking Boosfer for information about wemmbu. Boosfer keeps dodging the question stating he maybe will give the information. Boosfer thinks Flame gave him a fake helmet as the helmet had just Unbreaking III. Boosfer  then refuses to give Flame the information as the helmet was trash. Boosfer then demands Flame to build him an escape tunnel so he doesn't die in a future fight against The Invisible Knight and Capital City. Boosfer forces Flame to build an escape tunnel down to bedrock (Y -64). Boosfer splashes Flame with strength rather than haste to quicken the process. Flame builds a Nether Portal at the end of tunnel. Flame starts questioning Boosfer about the fact that he really has the information Flame wants. Flame starts critting out Boosfer frustrated of his lack of information on Wemmbu. The invisible Knight appears behind Flame. The Invisible Knight starts killing Boosfer, but Flame doesn't jump in until Boosfer promises to give him information he wants. Flame finally jumps in, but The Invisible Knight splashes Flame with weakness. The Invisible Knight leads Flame into a sand pit trap but the trap fails to kill either. Flame jumps into the pit and fights the horde of players lead by Salvationism. Boosfer also jumps in the pit eager to kill the horde. Eventually the horde of players are massacred by Flame and Boosfer leaving The Invisible Knight as the sole survivor. Flame starts chasing  the Invisible Knight but he is able to persuade Flame to turn on Boosfer. Both start chasing Boosfer but Boosfer escapes via escape tunnel that he forced Flame to build.

== Trivia ==

* For some reason, Flame removed Wemmbu, Clown, and Ferre from the description.

title: Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist
content:
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist is the 45th episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

 Plot 
The video starts with the ending of I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Hacker, where BAT chase the director across the destroyed BAT headquarters. Eventually, the Director uses a Enderpearl cannon and asked Parrot not to follow. Ignoring the warning, BAT followed. The Director is seen waiting in an obsidian room, and questions why Parrot follow him. Regardless of their answer, The Director activate a trap with multiple Full Netherite Zombies to attack them. Despite this, BAT managed to escape the trap by killing all the zombies, getting the extremely rare Netherite in the process. When going out, Parrot wonders how the Director get all the Netherite, considering the Mafia had mined out nearly all of the netherite on the server.

BAT then went to the Redstone Town, with the intention of finding out who the Director is by asking 4CVIT to list out every mass buyers. 4CVIT mentions about recent mass buyers, and said that he cannot list them out due to privacy. Parrot then bribes 4CVIT with a shoulder of netherite gear, and he mentions about a invisible guy in armor similar to The Director coming from a certain direction.

Parrot then hides and ambushes the buyer. When the buyer came, Parrot and his small team began to stealthily chase the buyer into an abandoned town, where they decide to strike. Eventually they forced the buyer to reveal himself, revealing to be MrCube6, who claims he is the director. BAT then decides to kill him when he never give any information, before the actual Director come. The Director gave one last warning to not chase him, in which Parrot still did. The Director said that they would have to guess who he is in 2 weeks or else bad things will happen. 

The Director then set off TNT, prompting BAT to fly up. Parrot's elytra broke on the way up, and began falling to his death. However, JumperWho showed  up and dropped Parrot an elytra, saving him. JumperWho eventually shows BAT her Void Base, which just happens to be in the same abandoned town Parrot and The Director first met. After giving a tour, Jumper asked BAT on what to do, which Parrot replies with the deal The Director made. BAT then decides to find out who the Director is with the help of Jumper. On one day, one of Jumper’s spies gave Parrot a book mentioning on The Director meeting with him in a week, and he could choose a place where he wants as he will always be watching where he is. Parrot then sees invis particles and told BAT to lockdown the base to find out who was inside their base.

Over the next few days, strange things began to happen to the base. Parrot, convinced that he is the Director, decided to chase after him. He is later revealed to be Spoke who claims to be the director. BAT corners Spoke and starts to interrogate him. Spoke explains that he doesn't know anything about the director, and that the hunt was all a waste of time. Just as BAT tries to kill him, Spoke eats a chorus fruit, leading to his escape.

With time being spent on hunting Spoke, Parrot only had a few days left before the meeting. Parrot then decides to ask the spies to cover every suspicious person while the Director is speaking to Parrot. At the end of the meeting, the Director “accidentally” held up Spoke’s chestplate, making Parrot suspicious that Spoke is the Director. However, Jumper said that Spoke is doing his normal things while Parrot has his meeting. Parrot is suspicious on Jumper, but after doing a trust test, BAT calms Parrot down.

In the last week, Parrot decides to spy on Spoke, but to no avail. On the last day though, Leow0ok sent Jumper and Derapchu to find any leads of the Director, but when they leave, he said that Parrot does not care about BAT and is simply only caring about chasing the director. He then attacks Parrot. He mentions how BAT was normal and rich until Parrot came. Parrot falls into the void using slow falling potions, but without fireworks or anything, he slowly drifts into the void with his elytra. He then talks to Leow0ok about his fate and how he misses him being supportive, but Leow0ok did not listen. Parrot then mentions on a phrase that Leo once said, which calms Leo down and saves him from being voided.

Parrot tells Leo to leave. Parrot decides to go back to the house he and Wifies made in the snow biome. Derapchu and Jumper managed to find him and questions why he wasn’t in the base, which Parrot said about the fight he has with Leow0ok. Eventually, the Director came. He proved again his superiority over Parrot by revealing him that the flash of the chestplate was done on purpose.  Derapchu and Jumper chase him down, only to fall in powdered snow in The Director’s trap. Desperate, Parrot finds Leo in the former BAT base and asked him to save Derapchu and Jumper, which he declines until Parrot made a offer to no longer chase the Director if he does, which Leo agrees. 

Parrot came up with a plan where Leo would fly on a Happy Ghast to save Jumper and Derapchu, while Parrot guesses who the Director is. Derapchu and Jumper is suprised to see Leo and initially declines to be saved, until Leo said he made terms with Parrot. Meanwhile, Parrot talks to the Director which he chose not to guess who the Director is. The Director then brings Parrot back to his house, asking Parrot to make the dog stand up, and when Parrot tries the dog doesn't do so, making Parrot realize that the dog inside of the house was not his. Parrot then again asks The Director what happened to Wifies, leading to The Director to drink a milk bucket and reveal that he is indeed Wifies and explains that he sends assassins to “kill” but yet spare Parrot, because he only wanted to study how Parrot works and behaves. Wifies then explains to him how he faked his death. He also explains that Parrot was never in any real danger, and he did everything to protect him. Then he reveals his plan to "create a world where nobody has to worry about dying ever again". He asks Parrot to follow him. Parrot refuses, saying that Wifies obviously isn't gonna kill him if he doesn't. Wifies says that while that's true, he will not hesitate to kill Parrots friends. Parrot, realizing that Wifies has changed, follows him.

 Analysis 

 In the video, The Director wasted hundreds of fully trimmed sets of netherite on a zombie trap that didn’t even work. Netherite is extremely rare, since The Mafia (And probably The Director who is Wifies) mined all of it to a long distance out in the nether. Wifies turns out to be The Director, so who knows how rich he really is. He also had zombie spawn eggs, so that also proves he is super rich.

title: Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Faked His Death
content:
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Faked His Death is the 82nd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode starts with a recap of what happened in the Hunt for Wemmbu Arc so far. Wemmbu "unfairly" winning the fight, his "death" which was suspected to be faked, and the sudden appearance of the Invisible Knight, suspected to be him. These events made FlameFrags search for him, eventually making him allies with ParrotX2 and a team of builders. Together, they made a trap for the Invisible Knight so that it forces him to reveal his identity and hoping that it was Wemmbu in disguise.

It cuts to the present, in which The Invisible Knight has fallen for the said trap with ParrotX2 in front of him and the invisible FlameFrags unknowingly behind him. They chat and after a while, FlameFrags drinks milk and reveals himself. The Invisible knight wind charge pearls up but misses a wind charge that causes it to go through the powdered snow,  then through the lava igniting it and onto the TNT which blows it up and Flame's and Parrot's wolves. Since the Invisible Knight was the one who threw the wind charge the death message of the tamed wolves will reveal the Invisible Knights true identity. Defeated, the Invisible Knight drinks milk revealing himself to be wemmbu. 

Flame and wemmbu pearls  to the Main Island. Flame challenges wemmbu to a duel but as they're fighting The Law ambushes them. They escape but Flame used his Orbital Dog Cannon which originally was meant for wemmbu. Flame tracks wemmbu down and keeps attacking him. Then, the law shows up again to disrupt their fight but this time both of them are drained of their resources. They escape.

Flame keeps attacking wemmbu but wemmbu says the Law will attacking them and they need to team up temporarily. They go to Flame's Base to regear.  The Law attacks them again but Flame and wemmbu kill the army after a bit. They chase LettuceK but he uses his elytra and fireworks. They try to riptide after him but their tridents break. 

They sneak into the Law's headquarters which just happened to be 100~ blocks from Flames base. There Flame and wemmbu attack LettuceK but Lettuce makes a fair point. The entire server loves Lettuce. If either of them kills him they would lose access to Merchant City, Redstone Town, Capital City 2.0 and much more and his second in command; Deputy Ace could replace him. So wemmbu comes up with a compromise: Lettuce brings his entire force to fight Flame and wemmbu but if they win Lettuce has to promise to stop attacking them but if they lose they'll sit in a cell.

title: Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Went Missing
content:
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Went Missing is the 68th episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

 Plot 
The episode starts from the end of the last episode, Flame questions _keycapper of who told him of Wemmbu's death. He tells Flame that a player named  "Luke4472" told him. Flame starts asking players on the streets of the whereabouts of Luke4472 but everyone runs away from him.  A player named "SpringMike" attacks him and Flame kills him in 2 hits. After a while, a player named "The_Codmaster14" tries telling Flame he doesn't know anything about Luke4472. Eventually the player leads Flame to Luke4472's base. Flame points out the obvious banner of the Skullhound Bandits, suggesting he got captured or even worse, killed. The player persuades Flame to help him find out what happened to Luke4472.      

Flame follows a path of gravel that eventually leads to a railway track. Flame makes an inference that Luke got intercepted by bandits while he was on the railway tracks. Flame decides he's going to let the bandits capture them. The_Codmaster14 is forced to go first as he is the bait. They notice a brick wall that's guarded by 3 bandits. They demand Flame to drop his sword. Flame refuses but instead places an ender chest and places it inside. The bandits now demand Flame to drop all of his ender chest's contents but Flame also refuses. They threaten Flame to take him hostage. Flame embraces and demands to be taken hostage. Flame also demands the bandits to take The_Codmaster14 too. They are escorted to a staircase and forced to live in an obsidian box. The bandits said that Flame is going to rot in the box until he decides to drop all of his ender chest's contents. Flame asks them where is Luke. The bandits said there is no Luke. In return Flame starts singing and The_Codmaster14 starts making even more singing. Flame said that he thought there was going to be another prisoner. The_Codmaster14 said the bandits are going to kill them. The_Codmaster14 demands Flame to make a plan. One of the players named  AlbertJustice_ starts insulting The_Codmaster14's skin saying his skin is 'chopped'. The bandit demands them to drop their armor, Flame agrees to drop it, but then kills him as he is organizing his inventory. The other bandits ran away seeing their comrade's death.      

Flame ransacks their outpost and finds Luke's armor, showing more proof of that Luke was here. Flame notes down Luke's armor trim which is redstone trim with wild armor trim on iron armor. Flame says that the sweet berries are suspicious due to the berries being a horrendous food source, he hints at the fact that they could've passed through a taiga, but The_Codmaster14 argues that idea is dumb. Flame argues that they should find the nearest taiga but The_Codmaster14 says that could be anywhere. Flame then resorted to making fun of his skin, he argues that Flame is reaching and connecting berries to a taiga is like connecting a fish to an ocean. Flame calls The_Codmaster14 a chicken, and he insults Flame by saying he is only good at PvP. The_Codmaster14 says Flame is chasing shadows, and Flame says that he would've done nothing and given up by now and if that's not the case, and to formulate a plan right now. He argues that his plans are reliant to hope. The_Codmaster14 says he wants to restart and Flame says for him to shut up. He starts protesting saying they wasted their time, so they part ways. Flame finds a banner belonging to the Skullhound Bandits. Flame keeps walking for presumably five hundred or so blocks. Flame finds three random players by the names of AdvancedKathrin, Elm_0Paid2 and VanadiumBaldine. The group says they're searching for a certain group of bandits. Flame asks them how much of  the area they're familiar with. They respond with most of the area. Flame asks them to tell them the areas where bandits reside. They ask for payment. Flame offers some armor. They demand Flame's full set of Netherite Armor. The group tells Flame the bandits are at from the Northwest Region the exact same way Flame came from. Frustrated, Flame attacks them. Flame chases Elm_0Paid2; the group's leader. Flame chases him down into a hole as he doesn't have silk touch on his pickaxe. Elm_0Paid2 drops Flame the map. Flame goes northwest. Flame feels bad as northwest was the correct direction so he attacked them for no reason at all.     

Flame sees a huge amount of bandits guarding Luke. Flame uses his wolf rod to kill all the bandits garrisoned there. A total of 8 bandits. Flame frees Luke and asks him where did he learn about the supposed death of Wemmbu. Luke answered he was told by a player named MinuteTech, the guardian of the End. Flame decides to go to the nearest stronghold which had a convenient Trial Chamber infused with it. So Flame geared up in the trial chamber; repairing his armor preparing to fight if Minute didn't tell him. When Flame and Luke arrived at the end, Flame kills a player who is talking to Minute. Minute; infuriated Flame, and they slip into a battle which had Luke glazing himself. Eventually Flame won by forcing Minute to run back into a end gateway. Flame decided to not pursue as the end gateway could be trapped. Frustrated, Flame decided to go back through the return portal of the End. Flame at his base is approached by a player named Boosfer. According to Boosfer, he says he has information regarding Wemmbu.     

 Trivia 
 The person who voices _keycapper at the beginning is different from the one at the end of the previous video.

They demand Flame to drop his sword. Flame refuses but instead places an ender chest and places it inside. The bandits now demand Flame to drop all of his ender chest's contents but Flame also refuses. They threaten Flame to take him hostage. Flame embraces and demands to be taken hostage. Flame also demands the bandits to take The_Codmaster14 too. They are escorted to a staircase and forced to live in an obsidian box. The bandits said that Flame is going to rot in the box until he decides to drop all of his ender chest's contents. Flame asks them where is Luke. The bandits said there is no Luke. In return Flame starts singing and The_Codmaster14 starts making even more singing. Flame said that he thought there was going to be another prisoner. The_Codmaster14 said the bandits are going to kill them. The_Codmaster14 demands Flame to make a plan. One of the players named  [[AlbertJustice_]] starts insulting The_Codmaster14's skin saying his skin is 'chopped'. The bandit demands them to drop their armor, Flame agrees to drop it, but then kills him as he is organizing his inventory. The other bandits ran away seeing their comrade's death.      

Flame ransacks their outpost and finds Luke's armor, showing more proof of that Luke was here. Flame notes down Luke's armor trim which is redstone trim with wild armor trim on iron armor. Flame says that the sweet berries are suspicious due to the berries being a horrendous food source, he hints at the fact that they could've passed through a taiga, but The_Codmaster14 argues that idea is dumb. Flame argues that they should find the nearest taiga but The_Codmaster14 says that could be anywhere. Flame then resorted to making fun of his skin, he argues that Flame is reaching and connecting berries to a taiga is like connecting a fish to an ocean. Flame calls The_Codmaster14 a chicken, and he insults Flame by saying he is only good at PvP. The_Codmaster14 says Flame is chasing shadows, and Flame says that he would've done nothing and given up by now and if that's not the case, and to formulate a plan right now. He argues that his plans are reliant to hope. The_Codmaster14 says he wants to restart and Flame says for him to shut up. He starts protesting saying they wasted their time, so they part ways. Flame finds a banner belonging to the Skullhound Bandits. Flame keeps walking for presumably five hundred or so blocks. Flame finds three random players by the names of [[AdvancedKathrin]], [[Elm_0Paid2]] and [[VanadiumBaldine]]. The group says they're searching for a certain group of bandits. Flame asks them how much of  the area they're familiar with. They respond with most of the area. Flame asks them to tell them the areas where bandits reside. They ask for payment. Flame offers some armor. They demand Flame's full set of Netherite Armor. The group tells Flame the bandits are at from the Northwest Region the exact same way Flame came from. Frustrated, Flame attacks them. Flame chases Elm_0Paid2; the group's leader. Flame chases him down into a hole as he doesn't have silk touch on his pickaxe. Elm_0Paid2 drops Flame the map. Flame goes northwest. Flame feels bad as northwest was the correct direction so he attacked them for no reason at all.     

Flame sees a huge amount of bandits guarding Luke. Flame uses his wolf rod to kill all the bandits garrisoned there. A total of 8 bandits. Flame frees Luke and asks him where did he learn about the supposed death of Wemmbu. Luke answered he was told by a player named [[MinuteTech]], the guardian of the End. Flame decides to go to the nearest stronghold which had a convenient Trial Chamber infused with it. So Flame geared up in the trial chamber; repairing his armor preparing to fight if Minute didn't tell him. When Flame and Luke arrived at the end, Flame kills a player who is talking to Minute. Minute; infuriated Flame, and they slip into a battle which had Luke glazing himself. Eventually Flame won by forcing Minute to run back into a end gateway. Flame decided to not pursue as the end gateway could be trapped. Frustrated, Flame decided to go back through the return portal of the End. Flame at his base is approached by a player named [[Boosfer]]. According to Boosfer, he says he has information regarding Wemmbu.     

== Trivia ==
* The person who voices _keycapper at the beginning is different from the one at the end of the previous video.

title: IMajesticRose
content:
iMajesticRose, also known as Rose, is a minor character in Unstable Universe. She is BeckyTronVIII's sister.

 Personality 
iMajesticRose was a sweet and innocent player. She was very trusting and willing to help players who requested her help, even if she didn't know them. Before she was killed, she gave Spoke a Cornflower to give to her brother, highlighting how much she loved and cared for him. 

 History 
She was new to the game and began building a small cabin far away from spawn with her little brother, BeckyTronVIII. Spoke was forced to kill her by ashwagg during his infiltration to Mafia after failing to kill PlanetLord and nearly dying to ClownPierce's mace. He built a dripstone trap and lured her in, claiming that it was for the good of the server. Her tragic death marked the turning point of Spoke's madness and evilness, and haunted her family for a long time.

In Unstable SMP: Doomsday, it was revealed that iMajesticRose was the daughter of Quackenstein123, a former Diamond Trimmed member of The Invisible Mafia.

In The End of the Minecraft Mafia Quackenstein was found to be a diamond level Mafia member and was forced to tell SpokeIsHere and Mapicc his backstory. It turned out iMajesticRose and Quackenstein built the stasis chambers for The Invisible Mafia.
 Trivia 

 Both Rose and BeckyTron are SpokeIsHere's siblings in real life.https://youtu.be/HnZU7KXp40s?t=10359

title: I Almost DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
content:
I Almost DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP is the 57th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The episode starts with Flame immediately being teleported into a trap that would drop him into the void. Flame clutches and saves himself, but LettuceK and his group of lawmen start to shoot at him to try and knock him down. Flame places a block above, but they start to use TNT to destroy the blocks, Flame thinks quickly and uses wind charges to knock the TNT off the block he is standing on. It destroys all the buttons and he's able to place ender chests above him, which are not affected by TNT explosions. While digging up, he restocks and kills half the lawmen before they decide to run away. Jaden_MAN shows up behind right after, Flame thinks he's there to kill him, but Jaden says he's over the entire situation and wants Flame to help get him full Netherite in exchange for giving away his mace. While they're heading to the location of a town, The Law sets off a TNT minecart trap which failed to kill Flame. The Law had learned to use carts in combat, but run out and is forced to run away. One of the lawmen had a Netherite helmet, which completed a fourth of the full set Jaden had requested.

Flame and Jaden make it to the town located inside of a mountain. Flame thinks they're there to trade for the Netherite, but Jaden informs Flame that he's a pirate and that he intends on stealing from the town. They quickly rob the town before The Law shows up, he ends up getting Netherite leggings from a player and gives it to Jaden. As soon as the robbery is done, The Law shows back up and attacks Flame, they go outside and spawn a Wither to help fight. Flame starts to mole in a cave and use TNT to do tons of damage, Lettuce and his lawmen are afraid of the tactic and backs off. Flame doesn't understand how The Law is finding them, and Jaden says they might just be following them and Flame accuses Jaden of telling them of his location, but Jaden reminds Flame that they're best friends and that he wouldn't betray. Flame says they should head to The Law's base and kill all of them, especially Lettuce to get Jaden his full set of Netherite. 

They head to The Law's base and Lettuce notices them and gets his guards to attack, some lawmen die and Lettuce instructs them all to head back into the base. Flame chases and is knocked into an obsidian box by an invisible player. Flame thinks they only tried to kill him with a dripstone at the bottom, but then hundreds of TNT start dropping down into the box, in which Lettuce claims is impossible to survive. Lettuce is shocked to see that Flame survived it, so they activate phase two of the trap: Wardens. Flame kills the first Warden, and they bring out two at once, and Flame kills both of them. With no other traps, Lettuce and his guards jump in to kill Flame themselves. Flame calls out for Jaden, but Jaden doesn't answer and runs away. Lettuce reveals that Jaden had been with The Law the entire time, they struck a deal to set Flame up, and every time Flame ran into The Law was because Jaden lead him to them. Flame gets constantly hit by slow falling arrows and gets drained of his resources while waiting for the effect to wear off. Once the effect wears off, Flame pearls out from one of the holes and drops a few more guards. Flame has a standoff with Lettuce and tells Lettuce that he failed to kill him, The Law tried to use TNT, Wardens, and even his own best friend against him and is still standing. Flame is ready to fight more, but Lettuce and his men say they're good and walk off.

 Trivia 

 This episode shows that Flame shows empathy towards players who owns pets just like he does.

title: I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP...
content:
I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP... is the 95th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Spoke looks down at Quackenstein123 and his families base as Leow0ok and his group of spies blow the entire base up in search of their armor pieces. Before making a run for it, one of the spies shows Leo where Spoke and the family are hiding and they run down an escape tunnel. Mapicc waits for them at the end and they boat away, the spies catch up to them easily, so they dig into a cave and Spoke sends the family through a Nether portal for their safety. Spoke breaks the portal, Leo, JumperWho, and their team of spies come in shortly after and forces Spoke to do an inventory check with his entire inventory and ender chest. They find no armor pieces, Jumper still defends Spoke due to lack of proof that he has the armor. Leo takes Spoke to spawn to hand him over to The Law and they go to the Northern Council to see LettuceK have his speech. When Lettuce brings Wemmbu out, Spoke gets the idea to have Wemmbu kill Leo for him. After the speech, Spoke pearls into the crowd, losing sight of Leo and goes invisible and follows The Law and Wemmbu on their way back to the prison, splashing them with invisibility, but loses track of Wemmbu immediately after. Spoke meets back up with Mapicc, who has infiltrated B.A.T. as one of their spies, and they go towards The Law's base, Spoke gets Mapicc to do a report of the entire building and routine of every guard. Spoke finds Leo near spawn and eavesdrops on his conversation with a spy, he follows them around and hears Leo asking players on where Spoke could be. Leo and the spy head to The Law's base and talks to Lettuce for a bit before heading towards Jumper's vault. Spoke follows along, watching Leo and Jumper in the middle of the vault from afar. Spoke then crafts a bunch of chests and bridges above them, planning to kill Leo. As he places a dripstone, a water droplet drips down and Leo notices, Spoke escapes without anybody seeing.

Spoke returns outside of The Law's base and Mapicc has his report of the prison, they dig into the prison using a blind spot and Spoke makes it into the prison. He finds Wemmbu and presented the offer of letting Wemmbu out if he completed his favor, but Wemmbu didn't want to work with Spoke. Spoke says the offer still stands before heading up and getting out. After days, Wemmbu made no progress in escaping and he couldn't find a time to get Leo alone to kill him, so he heads back to the vault and finds a message by Leo that says he needs guards to protect his spawn point at the old B.A.T. Headquarters. Spoke flies towards the direction said in the book and finds blocks recently broken inside of the base and finds Leo's hidden base with a pearl stasis inside of it. Spoke makes up his mind on what he wants to do and goes back to the prison and breaks Wemmbu and the rest of the prisoners out. As they make it out the prison, the Netherite mercenaries arrive and Wemmbu runs, in which Spoke and PrinceZam run from as well. Spoke, Zam, and Mapicc head back to the B.A.T. Headquarters in the amplified lands where Wemmbu finds them again. Wemmbu asks for a favor, but Spoke wants Wemmbu for his favor first, and so they head to the other B.A.T. base and pulls Leo's stasis, Leo somehow manages to survive a mace attack from a big height and all of them start attack Leo, who seemed unfazed about being jumped by multiple people. As Leo's armor begins to break, Spoke's invisibility runs out, which was Leo's plan the whole time. After Leo caught Spoke, he stasises away. It was never about the armor, it was to see when Spoke was desperate enough to make a mistake and prove that Spoke was guilty. Spoke knows that the rest of B.A.T. would come, and he waits for them there as he has nothing else left to lose.

 Trivia 

 Lettuce and loppezz are not credited in the description despite being in the video.
 PrinceZam posted a screenshot on Twitter showing that he played TrucksandTrains in the video.

title: I Bankrupted Minecraft's Richest Civilization
content:
I Bankrupted Minecraft's Richest Civilization is the 11th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
The episode begins with a voiceover from SpokeIsHere, saying that after he and Mapicc destroyed Roshambogames's stash of duped items, they have somehow come back, richer than ever. They need to find out if these items were legit, or if they had discovered a new glitch. Spoke caught wind of Roshambo making stockpiles of these items, so they head to one.

The first location is a hole in the side of a mountain with chests lining one wall, but they are empty. They check everywhere, but are interrupted by PlanetLord, which forces them to hide. Spoke and Mapicc emerge from the wall and catch Planet standing one shulker boxes of duped items, including totems, redstone, gunpowder, and emeralds. They grab the shulkers and chase after Planet. However, the server lags and Planet escapes. 

Spoke and Mapicc head back to their end base to make a plan. They decide to check the raid farm to see if the items in the shulkers are legit, and if it’s been lagging the server. It seems like Roshambo and his henchmen are using the farm. To prevent them from using the farm without breaking it, Spoke and Mapicc make a secret stash underground to contain all of the loot. They check to see if their storage system is working, but spot a group of invisible players arriving at the farm. They start blowing the farm up, so Spoke and Mapicc start fighting them. Mapicc sees that they’re all attacking Spoke, and he realises that this isn’t Roshambo. 

They head to land and Spoke is just about to drop when an isolated player that hasn’t interacted with anyone on this server named ashwagg shows up and shoos the attackers away. Ash says that he was just passing by when he saw the players chasing them and that he’ll see them around.

Spoke and Mapicc head back to Spoke’s base at spawn. Spoke says that they need to check all of the farms to rig the ones that are lagging the server. However, they need a player who knows all of the farms on this server. The only choice is TheRealSquiddo, who’s base they destroyed before. They head there and find Squiddo with her hamster, Garlic Hamster. Mapicc distracts Squiddo while Spoke finds a book with all of the coords of the all of the farms on this server. They are chatting with Squiddo when Ash appears. He wants to join them in their quest, but they refuse. He is persistent, though, and tells them to find him if they need anything. 

Spoke gives Mapicc the coord book and he leads them to a dysfunctional iron farm. They place soul soil under the sources of water to disrupt it, even though it’s already broken. They head to the next farm, but only find a railgun on a nearby hill. They search around the island, eventually finding a skyblock island. They check it out and discover that the cobblestone generator is built wrong, so they fix it. 

The third set of coordinates are at spawn, but the only thing at the location is a house made of TNT. They discover that the letter next to each coordinate is the dimension it’s in, so they head to the end instead and find an enderman farm. However, they find a PrinceZam guard named ManePear farming XP. They splash invis and spleef a block under him. Mapicc distracts him while Spoke messes up the farm. They both engage with Mane, pushing him back through into the overworld. That buys them time, and they rig the farm before Mane comes back and starts attacking again. They escape into the overworld and regroup at Spoke’s base.

They find Squiddo at their front door and politely tell her to leave. They turn around to find Ash in their house, and Spoke updates him on their progress. He still wants to help them, so they take him in and give him some coordinates to farms. They tell him to not destroy or blow up anything. He requests a copy of the coord book, but they refuse. After Ash leaves, they find that Squiddo has built a heart-shaped doorway at the pathway in front of their base. Mapicc says that Ash has a weird obsession with the coord book, wanting something from Spoke, and that he doesn’t care about him at all, but Spoke says that he’s just trying to be helpful. 

They head to the fourth set of coordinates, and, after digging underground for a while, they find a sugarcane farm that doesn’t even work. 

The fifth coordinates, however, are at the Zam Empire. They head to a random house in the empire and sneak into the basement. To their disappointment, they find a simple rail duper in the enemy territory. Mapicc tests it and finds that it doesn’t even work. They just block the room off and leave.

Mapicc changes his armour to plain netherite and splashes himself with invis to blend in with the crowd and go unnoticed. They take the search to the nether, where Mapicc and Spoke reconvene underground. The episode closes off with the sound of someone digging towards them. 

This was only the beginning, Spoke realises.

== Errors ==

* In [[Why I Destroyed the Unstable SMP]], Wemmbu blows up Spoke's base near the beginning of the video and blows up the PrinceZam statue near the end of the video. In this video, it's the other way around.

title: I Became Immortal on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
content:
I Became Immortal on a Hardcore Minecraft Server is the 39th episode featured in Unstable Universe. It is also the first episode released by FlameFrags. 

 Plot 
The video begins in FlameFrags entering his house until he falls into a dripstone trap. He clutches the trap but gets ambushed by the trappers. One of the players attempt to blow him up with a minecart but it blows up before it gets to him. Flame leaves after most of his armour breaks and he kills the entire team. Flame stashes their gear in his stash of gear from killing players. Flame is determined to get a full set of netherite armour again and embarks on a journey to get it. 

Flame crafts new armour with the diamonds he gets and enchants it along with getting new gear before getting confronted by Spoke and his team of players that he assembled to kill Flame. Flame wipes most of the team out and follows one of the players. The player explains to their team that he needs to kill Flame with a netherite sword. Flame reveals himself and wipes everyone out except for the player he followed and then looted their base until he found the netherite sword. 

Flame continues his journey to get a full netherite set and begins to head to Merchant City until he gets robbed by TheobaldTheBird's Cart-PvP students. Theo tells them not to rob Flame but they don't obey thus getting wiped out by Flame. Flame finally makes it to Merchant City and makes a trade with a fan and gets a netherite helmet and some totems for all the loot in his donkeys.  

As he heads out of Merchant City he gets attacked by Bounty Assassin Team. One of the members, Parrot warns them not to attack Flame since it would be a waste of time and resources and he believes that they need all their resources to be used on The Director. Flame's armour begins to break mid-fight but he realizes that the spies each have curse of vanishing on their armour to prevent anyone from taking the armour after a spy dies. Flame luckily kills a spy which has an extra set of armour that doesn't have curse of vanishing and he wears it. He picks up the spy's armour along with some XP bottles and the fight turns around with him wiping out all the spies. The rest of BAT run away after the spies get killed. Flame checks out all the loot from the fight and finds netherite boots without curse of vanishing.  

Flame heads back to his base to upgrade it by making more farms and expanding the base until Wemmbu shows up. Wemmbu explains that he wants to do a rematch against Flame since he hasn't ever won against him. The fight goes well at first, until Wemmbu begins rocket-macing him. Flame's shield breaks and his last totem pops. Without any other choice, he crafts slow-falling potions to counter his mace. Wemmbu gives up and they begin talking about who won the fight. Flame shows Wemmbu around his base and explains to Wemmbu that he's been fighting off Spoke's minions. Wemmbu gives Flame the coordinates one of Spoke's bases.  

Flame heads to Spoke's base to confront him and Spoke begins taunting him and telling him to drop all his items until attempting to kill Flame using TNT minecarts. Flame begins chasing Spoke and he activates a void trap. Flame clutches using ender pearls. Flame continues chasing Spoke until he activates another TNT minecart trap. Flame begins attacking Spoke again, thinking that he ran out of traps until Spoke activates a void trap that they had been standing on the entire time. Flame clutches by using a slow-falling potion that he had brewed during the fight with Wemmbu and he clutches. Spoke runs away and a group of players emerge. Flame takes out the entire group of players and he finally gets netherite leggings; finishing his full netherite set.   

 Trivia 

 The video was originally titled "I Became Immortal on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP"
 The is FlameFrags' debut as the fourth protagonist of Unstable Universe.

title: I Became King of the Unstable SMP
content:
I Became King of the Unstable SMP is the 112th episode featured in Unstable Universe. This marks the end of Parrot's perspective of The Kings Arc.

 Plot 
Parrot starts off the episode by explaining how many players have tried ruling the Unstable SMP, but all have failed except one; LettuceK. Lettuce started like any other player, all the way at the bottom and joined the corrupt Capital City and forced to mine for the rest of his life with no chance of escape. This was until Parrot came along and joined the mining civilization and managed to free everybody there. Ever since that day, Lettuce tried to fulfill his promise and created the group known as The Law, hunting players that were corrupt, but was still undermined, and needed to have more power and become the king of the server. This lead to Lettuce sending a thousand players to their death against FlameFrags and Wemmbu, he used the leverage of the aftermath to run an election and rig it for himself. Parrot, who saved Lettuce in the past, saw right through his lies and rivaled him against the competition. Throughout the entire election, Lettuce had blackmailed, framed, and attempted an assassination on Parrot, and after realizing Lettuce would've lost the election due to the second debate, he declared himself the first king of Unstable. Parrot ends off his dialogue by saying Lettuce had become what he swore once to destroy.

Lettuce, his right-hand man Deputy_Ace, and eleven other lawmen take Parrot to prison on their happy ghasts. Parrot dislikes the idea of having to sit around and watch Lettuce become the king although he hadn't won the election and calls out Lettuce for power grabbing. Lettuce says he's scared of what would happen if he didn't win and says it's nothing personal. Parrot reminds Lettuce that they used to be friends back in the mining city, Lettuce says he hadn't forgotten and he wanted to be like Parrot when he freed him and hated that Parrot was his opponent. They make it to Law HQ and Lettuce brings Parrot down to the prison. Parrot says he's making a mistake, Lettuce says he's doing what needs to be done. Parrot asks what if he doesn't comply, and Lettuce says he would kill him, but doesn't want to and to not make it difficult with a saddened voice. Parrot goes ahead and follows, an inventory check is conducted and he gets cleared. Lettuce starts leading him to his cell and gives him a set of curse of binding copper armor as per protocol due to Wemmbu's previous escape attempts. After getting put into the solitary confinement cell, Lettuce tells Parrot if he ever wants to see Theo again, he'd have to admit that he was wrong about everything and to endorse him. Parrot asks if he's stupid for thinking Parrot would do any of that after his best friend got kidnapped and got sent to prison. Lettuce says no and knows eventually he'd do so. Lettuce and Ace leaves, a new commander named BenjaminTheI keeps watch of Parrot. Soon later, Ace returns and brings Th3Blurpenstein into solitary and tells Benjamin to look out for them. Parrot and Blurpenstein talk to each other and Blurpenstein reveals that Wemmbu had escaped this exact prison, Parrot asks how Wemmbu did so, Blurpenstein explains that the lights went out and a riot begun. Benjamin blocks off the iron bars and door so the two can't see each other anymore. Parrot thinks to himself no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't do anything as Lettuce became the king of the server. All of a sudden, the lights go out and a secret door opens up behind Parrot and a shulker box full of gear is placed right at the door. Parrot blows up the doors that requires keycards and runs out of the Law HQ. Parrot realizes that thousands of lawmen roam around the server and the potential of stumbling across one was very high. A lawman spots him and sees that Parrot was the escapee and says he's gonna snitch on Parrot. Parrot hits him back to knock him away and run the opposite direction, Parrot grabs a piece of cactus and intends to use it to break his armor. He isn't able to take on the fight with his copper armor and the lawman did eight hearts of damage per hit. Parrot gets multiple hits on the lawman and eventually gets all of his armor broken, he equips all of his diamond armor and locks in and demands where Theo is. The lawman tells Parrot to stop and tells him that Theo is at Smuggler's Pass. Parrot asks why he should believe him and the lawman describes the terrain of Smuggler's Pass and says he saw Theo there himself. As Parrot's heading off, the lawman says there's no chance he could free Theo as he'd have to be a smart player to do so and that he would report Parrot to Lettuce. Parrot charges up his crossbow and uses his flint and steel and TNT minecart to blow the lawman up instantly.

Parrot then walks all the way to the Smuggler's Pass and splashes invis. He goes down a tunnel inside of the mountain and sees a massive castle built inside of it. He sneaks his way into the castle without being seen and sees Theo standing in the middle surrounded by lava at the very bottom. Parrot splashes fire resistance and climbs up a lava flow. He then uses a punch bow to launch himself onto a manmade stalactite and bridges over to the platform, clutches with water, and splashes both of them with invis and tells Theo to hide. The two lawmen keeping an eye out bridged over to the platform and they use the time to cross over and escape. They catch up on what happened over the past few days, Theo says Parrot could not endorse him and they need a plan, Theo says Lettuce made him set another stasis chamber and gets teleported as soon as he says that. Lettuce comes seconds after and says he wants to prove to Parrot that his friend's life is always in his hands and reminds Parrot if he wants to free Theo, he needs his endorsement and that he can't get Parrot in the way. Parrot says his whole plan was to keep his friend hostage until he gets endorsed and asks Lettuce what kind of king he is for doing all of this. Lettuce says the only one that's fit to rule and one that's willing to do whatever it takes. Lettuce says he's going to hold an announcement at the Northern Council in two hours and expects Parrot to endorse him there, and if he doesn't, a lot of people would get hurt, and if he tries to fight back, the server would be too divided. Parrot says it won't happen after he got sent to prison, the election got held off, and his best friend got kidnapped. Parrot angrily demands Lettuce to give Theo back, Lettuce says it wouldn't happen, Parrot pots up and tries to attack Lettuce and he calls out his commanders to protect him. With no other choice, Parrot goes with Lettuce to the Northern Council.

Parrot and Lettuce ride a happy ghast all the way to the Northern Council, Lettuce reminds Parrot that him and Theo will die if he doesn't renounce his statements and that he's willing to offer them positions in his kingdom. The announcement starts, Lettuce first mentions that the election has been put on hold, but the remaining candidates had something to share. Boosfer goes first and says he was never interested in the election and asks for all his supporters to send his votes over to Lettuce. Purpled goes next and says the same thing as Boosfer and to have all his supporters to move their votes to Lettuce. It gets to Parrot's turn, he says the last time he was up on stage he called Lettuce a hypocrite and now wants to tell the server that it's still the case and will not be endorsing him after he kidnapped Theo and tells the crowd to not make Lettuce their king. Lettuce tells Parrot to follow him into the castle and asks him who he thinks he is for saying that, Parrot says he wouldn't endorse him no matter what and that Lettuce had the audacity to bring Parrot up on stage. Lettuce thought Parrot would come to his senses and gave him so many chances, but this was Parrot's last and makes Parrot follow him. Lettuce, Ace, and a dozen lawmen bring Parrot back to the mining city where Theo is being held hostage by two Law elite guards. Lettuce says they were there and forced to mine and never have the chance to escape and thinks Parrot regrets ever helping Lettuce out back then, Parrot says he doesn't regret it at all and that he saw a kind person and not the person that's standing in front of him now. Lettuce says he can't do it himself and makes Ace and the two elite guards the ones to kill them, him and the rest of the lawmen go on the other side of the island and blows the horn signaling Ace to kill Parrot and Theo. Parrot says this it it and says it was fun playing on the server with Theo. The camera goes off of Parrot and looks up, two hits are heard and the wither sound effect plays twice, hinting that two players died. It pans back down and Parrot is standing there. Parrot is shocked that Ace killed off the two guards and he says they have to go now. Lettuce comes back and maces Parrot and asks what Ace is doing, Parrot says there's a mine somewhere and goes down into it and covers it up. With the little time they have, Ace reveals that Lettuce had ignored everything he said for too long and that he was the one that freed Parrot out of the prison. Ace gives them his pickaxe and says he was going to hold them off and tells Parrot that he'd be a great king. Lettuce confronts Ace, Ace says what he's doing is wrong and what Parrot and Theo stand for is better than what Lettuce is doing. The last words Ace says before he gets killed off is "I'd rather die standing than live kneeling." They dig out of mining city and Parrot builds a tombstone for Ace. Parrot says they finally need to defeat Lettuce then says they need to return back to District 13 to prepare. 

At the entrance of the District 13, Parrot calls out Horace and Fymada for following them. All four of them walk in and see a group of players who used this base as their town, Parrot goes on to explain to them about the election and Lettuce and if nobody was going to step up, Lettuce would be the permanent king of Unstable. The people see that Parrot was the one that stood up against Lettuce and agrees to help them out. They start setting up their plan, Horace would stay back with the others to rebuild the base as Parrot, Theo, and Fymada went out to recruit more players. Parrot and Theo tasked themselves to find Flame and Wemmbu each while Fymada recruited any players that she knew that were interested. Parrot recruited a few random players who were interested, but knew Wemmbu was practically impossible to find at this rate, so after a full day of looking, he returns back to District 13. Parrot sees the new revamped base and sees that Theo hadn't come back, so he teaches the new players how to PvP. After two days full of practice, Theo comes back and Horace reveals that he knew a Law stash full of loot and so Parrot and Theo go out to get it. They park their happy ghast at an island nearby and swims over to the Law stash where lawmen still guard it. They sneak into it and grab a few armor sets and Parrot writes on a sign to keep looking. Parrot sees a room being guarded by two lawmen and sees that it's a room that has chests full of potions. Parrot mines through the stone, but Theo coughs unmuted and alerts the lawmen that they're there. Theo says he only brought four minecarts to fight and that there's more in his ender chest, but is unable to get them since he gave his pickaxe to Parrot. The two go back to the island with their happy ghast and fly up, the lawmen begin to build up to them, Parrot tries to bow them off and kill them with fall damage, but the water saves them. Parrot uses his spyglass to look down and sees an invisible player with a trident and thinks it's Spoke. Spoke summons multiple withers and blows up tons of lawmen, Parrot and Theo jump down to help him. Parrot asks what Spoke was doing there, Spoke says there's been too much that's happened since the last time they talked. They deal with the last few remaining lawmen and Spoke says that BAT had a revolution and now JumperWho and her spies are sided with Spoke and that he'd been searching for Parrot to combine forces. They loot more of the chests and Spoke explains that they fought a huge army at their prison and expected them to come to the Northern Council, but instead they were heading over to where they are now. The next wave of lawmen show up and get onto the island, at the same time, Wemmbu comes flying towards the castle and sets off an orbital strike cannon onto the castle. There are too many lawmen for all of them to deal at once, and Flame comes right after. It's revealed that Spoke had already recruited Flame and Wemmbu apart of their army. 

Parrot, Theo, Spoke, and Flame all ride back to District 13, but Spoke says the happy ghast is too slow, so he makes Theo fly back alone and the other three go back to the castle where Spoke has the rest of his army to go get them. At the castle, Mapicc, Jumper, PrinceZam, MinuteTech, and Jaden_MAN are all there and welcome them in. They then all go back to District 13 and gears Parrot's army up. Parrot and Spoke step up and have their speech, Parrot starts off by saying they have all been affected by Lettuce and his army someway and somehow. Lettuce had hunted, blackmailed, and tried to kill all of them, all because true justice is served by doing whatever it took. Parrot says they're going to storm into the Northern Council and show Lettuce wrong. By the time they start heading off, Lettuce knew that they had all combined forces and gathered up all of Law to stop them. They step onto the Northern Council, Parrot steps up and has a talk with Lettuce first before heading head first. Parrot says Lettuce probably wished he banned him off, Lettuce asks what he thinks he's doing and that all of the server's problems are standing right behind Parrot and everyone that he's sacrificed would had been all for nothing and says Parrot is wrong for thinking Lettuce would let the world take everything from him again. Lettuce gives Parrot one last chance to turn back around, Parrot says it's too late to surrender and everybody behind him has a reason to fight back. The two wish each other good luck and backs up to their team, Wemmbu immediately sets off three orbitals and kills hundreds of lawmen in those shots. Parrot thinks Lettuce is stupid for thinking that this army was able to take down his army after wiping out a majority of the lawmen in a short amount of time. They all realize that neither Lettuce or the commanders were at the fight and go up to where Lettuce and his commanders were. Parrot says Lettuce let all of his people to die and ran like a coward, Lettuce reminds them again he isn't stupid and makes them turn around and hundreds of Lettuce's netherite lawmen come out of hiding and a second fight begins. Parrot knows he's not good enough to kill the players off individually, and goes off to be a distraction for the better PvPers of the army to get the kills. The perspective switches over to Theo's, who blows up multiple lawmen in one minecart each time. Back over to Parrot, he towers up and places his shulker boxes full of gear, Wemmbu flies over to regear as well, and Lettuce comes flying in and maces them off. Parrot starts to run out of resources and needs a way back onto the tower to regear, but it's practically impossible with how many lawmen are on him at once. Parrot goes onto the side of the Northern Council and builds up on the back of the election board to get to his shulkers. It switches back over to Theo again, who's shown to be destroying the lawmen once more.

After an hour of fighting, it was only Lettuce and a few remaining lawmen left, all of Parrot's army target Lettuce until it's down to his chestplate being the only armor piece remaining, he then flies out of the fight. They count who's there and see if anyone died, Wemmbu and Minute come back and says Lettuce managed to escape. They're all finally able to rest from all of the fighting and Parrot walks around the Northern Council just looking at the ground. Lettuce is then shown walking back through the front of the Northern Council. Parrot asks Lettuce what he's doing there and Lettuce says if they really want to kill him, to do it and that he doesn't want to live on a server that doesn't want him, and that his goal was to enforce the will of the server, but if the server doesn't want justice, he surrenders. Parrot makes Lettuce follow him, but some people like Flame wants to kill him right there. They all decide a vote to see who wants Lettuce dead and it ends in a tie. Flame asks why Parrot wants to keep Lettuce alive, Parrot says if they kill him, they're no better than him. Parrot says he will resume the election that Lettuce started and if Lettuce somehow manages to win, then that's the server's decision. Lettuce says he knew he wasn't going to win ever since Parrot's execution failed and says the server was too far gone now and he tried to warn Parrot. Parrot tells Lettuce that he's going to prison for a long time. Parrot looks at the warzone that they had caused, Wemmbu and eggchan come out and ask if he's gonna become king now, egg says he wouldn't vote for Parrot and Wemmbu says he'd vote for egg over Parrot, which was fine with him. Parrot asks where they're headed now, Wemmbu says he doesn't know and the two of them head off and says it was fun fighting alongside him.

The next scene shows Parrot with 5,828 votes and Lettuce has 3,973 votes. Parrot now wears a crown on his skin, him and Theo are inside of the castle ready to walk out, Theo asks what Parrot will do as king, Parrot says he doesn't know but he has some things planned. Parrot heads up and Theo tells him good luck and that he's proud of him, but not to let it get to his head since he's still not the biggest bird. Parrot steps up in front of the crowd as the episode ends.

 Trivia 

 Mapicc, Jaden_MAN and a few others were not featured in the description, however, this may be Parrot overlooking at all of the people in the video.
 While Parrot was looking for Wemmbu, he hears Wemmbu and eggchan open the Farlands end portal.
 At the end of the video during the scenes District 13 decides LettuceK's fate, an invisible player can be spotted spying on them. This was confirmed to be one of Jumper's spies in Spoke's POV.
 This is Parrot's 100th video.
 Deputy_Ace's final words were also said in Parrot's finale of the Invisible Mafia arc, where Parrot told Ash the exact same thing when Ash tried to force him to join the Mafia.
 The video's thumbnail is a reference to Unstable SMP: The First War's thumbnail implying that this is the second big server-wide war.

Parrot reminds Lettuce that they used to be friends back in the mining city, Lettuce says he hadn't forgotten and he wanted to be like Parrot when he freed him and hated that Parrot was his opponent. They make it to Law HQ and Lettuce brings Parrot down to the prison. Parrot says he's making a mistake, Lettuce says he's doing what needs to be done. Parrot asks what if he doesn't comply, and Lettuce says he would kill him, but doesn't want to and to not make it difficult with a saddened voice. Parrot goes ahead and follows, an inventory check is conducted and he gets cleared. Lettuce starts leading him to his cell and gives him a set of curse of binding copper armor as per protocol due to Wemmbu's previous escape attempts. After getting put into the solitary confinement cell, Lettuce tells Parrot if he ever wants to see [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]] again, he'd have to admit that he was wrong about everything and to endorse him. Parrot asks if he's stupid for thinking Parrot would do any of that after his best friend got kidnapped and got sent to prison. Lettuce says no and knows eventually he'd do so. Lettuce and Ace leaves, a new commander named BenjaminTheI keeps watch of Parrot. Soon later, Ace returns and brings [[Th3Blurpinstein|Th3Blurpenstein]] into solitary and tells Benjamin to look out for them. Parrot and Blurpenstein talk to each other and Blurpenstein reveals that Wemmbu had escaped this exact prison, Parrot asks how Wemmbu did so, Blurpenstein explains that the lights went out and a riot begun. Benjamin blocks off the iron bars and door so the two can't see each other anymore. Parrot thinks to himself no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't do anything as Lettuce became the king of the server. All of a sudden, the lights go out and a secret door opens up behind Parrot and a shulker box full of gear is placed right at the door. Parrot blows up the doors that requires keycards and runs out of the Law HQ. Parrot realizes that thousands of lawmen roam around the server and the potential of stumbling across one was very high. A lawman spots him and sees that Parrot was the escapee and says he's gonna snitch on Parrot. Parrot hits him back to knock him away and run the opposite direction, Parrot grabs a piece of cactus and intends to use it to break his armor. He isn't able to take on the fight with his copper armor and the lawman did eight hearts of damage per hit. Parrot gets multiple hits on the lawman and eventually gets all of his armor broken, he equips all of his diamond armor and locks in and demands where Theo is. The lawman tells Parrot to stop and tells him that Theo is at Smuggler's Pass. Parrot asks why he should believe him and the lawman describes the terrain of Smuggler's Pass and says he saw Theo there himself. As Parrot's heading off, the lawman says there's no chance he could free Theo as he'd have to be a smart player to do so and that he would report Parrot to Lettuce. Parrot charges up his crossbow and uses his flint and steel and TNT minecart to blow the lawman up instantly.

Parrot then walks all the way to the Smuggler's Pass and splashes invis. He goes down a tunnel inside of the mountain and sees a massive castle built inside of it. He sneaks his way into the castle without being seen and sees Theo standing in the middle surrounded by lava at the very bottom. Parrot splashes fire resistance and climbs up a lava flow. He then uses a punch bow to launch himself onto a manmade stalactite and bridges over to the platform, clutches with water, and splashes both of them with invis and tells Theo to hide. The two lawmen keeping an eye out bridged over to the platform and they use the time to cross over and escape. They catch up on what happened over the past few days, Theo says Parrot could not endorse him and they need a plan, Theo says Lettuce made him set another stasis chamber and gets teleported as soon as he says that. Lettuce comes seconds after and says he wants to prove to Parrot that his friend's life is always in his hands and reminds Parrot if he wants to free Theo, he needs his endorsement and that he can't get Parrot in the way. Parrot says his whole plan was to keep his friend hostage until he gets endorsed and asks Lettuce what kind of king he is for doing all of this. Lettuce says the only one that's fit to rule and one that's willing to do whatever it takes. Lettuce says he's going to hold an announcement at the [[Northern Council]] in two hours and expects Parrot to endorse him there, and if he doesn't, a lot of people would get hurt, and if he tries to fight back, the server would be too divided. Parrot says it won't happen after he got sent to prison, the election got held off, and his best friend got kidnapped. Parrot angrily demands Lettuce to give Theo back, Lettuce says it wouldn't happen, Parrot pots up and tries to attack Lettuce and he calls out his commanders to protect him. With no other choice, Parrot goes with Lettuce to the Northern Council.

Parrot and Lettuce ride a happy ghast all the way to the Northern Council, Lettuce reminds Parrot that him and Theo will die if he doesn't renounce his statements and that he's willing to offer them positions in his kingdom. The announcement starts, Lettuce first mentions that the election has been put on hold, but the remaining candidates had something to share. [[Boosfer]] goes first and says he was never interested in the election and asks for all his supporters to send his votes over to Lettuce. [[Purpled]] goes next and says the same thing as Boosfer and to have all his supporters to move their votes to Lettuce. It gets to Parrot's turn, he says the last time he was up on stage he called Lettuce a hypocrite and now wants to tell the server that it's still the case and will not be endorsing him after he kidnapped Theo and tells the crowd to not make Lettuce their king. Lettuce tells Parrot to follow him into the castle and asks him who he thinks he is for saying that, Parrot says he wouldn't endorse him no matter what and that Lettuce had the audacity to bring Parrot up on stage. Lettuce thought Parrot would come to his senses and gave him so many chances, but this was Parrot's last and makes Parrot follow him. Lettuce, Ace, and a dozen lawmen bring Parrot back to the mining city where Theo is being held hostage by two Law elite guards. Lettuce says they were there and forced to mine and never have the chance to escape and thinks Parrot regrets ever helping Lettuce out back then, Parrot says he doesn't regret it at all and that he saw a kind person and not the person that's standing in front of him now. Lettuce says he can't do it himself and makes Ace and the two elite guards the ones to kill them, him and the rest of the lawmen go on the other side of the island and blows the horn signaling Ace to kill Parrot and Theo. Parrot says this it it and says it was fun playing on the server with Theo. The camera goes off of Parrot and looks up, two hits are heard and the wither sound effect plays twice, hinting that two players died. It pans back down and Parrot is standing there. Parrot is shocked that Ace killed off the two guards and he says they have to go now. Lettuce comes back and maces Parrot and asks what Ace is doing, Parrot says there's a mine somewhere and goes down into it and covers it up. With the little time they have, Ace reveals that Lettuce had ignored everything he said for too long and that he was the one that freed Parrot out of the prison. Ace gives them his pickaxe and says he was going to hold them off and tells Parrot that he'd be a great king. Lettuce confronts Ace, Ace says what he's doing is wrong and what Parrot and Theo stand for is better than what Lettuce is doing. The last words Ace says before he gets killed off is "I'd rather die standing than live kneeling." They dig out of mining city and Parrot builds a tombstone for Ace. Parrot says they finally need to defeat Lettuce then says they need to return back to [[District 13]] to prepare. 

At the entrance of the District 13, Parrot calls out [[Horace Altman|Horace]] and [[Fymada]] for following them. All four of them walk in and see a group of players who used this base as their town, Parrot goes on to explain to them about the election and Lettuce and if nobody was going to step up, Lettuce would be the permanent king of Unstable. The people see that Parrot was the one that stood up against Lettuce and agrees to help them out. They start setting up their plan, Horace would stay back with the others to rebuild the base as Parrot, Theo, and Fymada went out to recruit more players. Parrot and Theo tasked themselves to find [[FlameFrags|Flame]] and [[Wemmbu]] each while Fymada recruited any players that she knew that were interested. Parrot recruited a few random players who were interested, but knew Wemmbu was practically impossible to find at this rate, so after a full day of looking, he returns back to District 13. Parrot sees the new revamped base and sees that Theo hadn't come back, so he teaches the new players how to PvP. After two days full of practice, Theo comes back and Horace reveals that he knew a Law stash full of loot and so Parrot and Theo go out to get it. They park their happy ghast at an island nearby and swims over to the Law stash where lawmen still guard it. They sneak into it and grab a few armor sets and Parrot writes on a sign to keep looking. Parrot sees a room being guarded by two lawmen and sees that it's a room that has chests full of potions. Parrot mines through the stone, but Theo coughs unmuted and alerts the lawmen that they're there. Theo says he only brought four minecarts to fight and that there's more in his ender chest, but is unable to get them since he gave his pickaxe to Parrot. The two go back to the island with their happy ghast and fly up, the lawmen begin to build up to them, Parrot tries to bow them off and kill them with fall damage, but the water saves them. Parrot uses his spyglass to look down and sees an invisible player with a trident and thinks it's [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]. Spoke summons multiple withers and blows up tons of lawmen, Parrot and Theo jump down to help him. Parrot asks what Spoke was doing there, Spoke says there's been too much that's happened since the last time they talked. They deal with the last few remaining lawmen and Spoke says that [[Bounty Assassin Team|BAT]] had a revolution and now [[JumperWho]] and her spies are sided with Spoke and that he'd been searching for Parrot to combine forces. They loot more of the chests and Spoke explains that they fought a huge army at their prison and expected them to come to the Northern Council, but instead they were heading over to where they are now. The next wave of lawmen show up and get onto the island, at the same time, Wemmbu comes flying towards the castle and sets off an orbital strike cannon onto the castle. There are too many lawmen for all of them to deal at once, and Flame comes right after. It's revealed that Spoke had already recruited Flame and Wemmbu apart of their army. 

Parrot, Theo, Spoke, and Flame all ride back to District 13, but Spoke says the happy ghast is too slow, so he makes Theo fly back alone and the other three go back to the castle where Spoke has the rest of his army to go get them. At the castle, [[Mapicc]], Jumper, [[PrinceZam]], [[MinuteTech]], and [[Jaden_MAN]] are all there and welcome them in. They then all go back to District 13 and gears Parrot's army up. Parrot and Spoke step up and have their speech, Parrot starts off by saying they have all been affected by Lettuce and his army someway and somehow. Lettuce had hunted, blackmailed, and tried to kill all of them, all because true justice is served by doing whatever it took. Parrot says they're going to storm into the Northern Council and show Lettuce wrong. By the time they start heading off, Lettuce knew that they had all combined forces and gathered up all of Law to stop them. They step onto the Northern Council, Parrot steps up and has a talk with Lettuce first before heading head first. Parrot says Lettuce probably wished he banned him off, Lettuce asks what he thinks he's doing and that all of the server's problems are standing right behind Parrot and everyone that he's sacrificed would had been all for nothing and says Parrot is wrong for thinking Lettuce would let the world take everything from him again. Lettuce gives Parrot one last chance to turn back around, Parrot says it's too late to surrender and everybody behind him has a reason to fight back. The two wish each other good luck and backs up to their team, Wemmbu immediately sets off three orbitals and kills hundreds of lawmen in those shots. Parrot thinks Lettuce is stupid for thinking that this army was able to take down his army after wiping out a majority of the lawmen in a short amount of time. They all realize that neither Lettuce or the commanders were at the fight and go up to where Lettuce and his commanders were. Parrot says Lettuce let all of his people to die and ran like a coward, Lettuce reminds them again he isn't stupid and makes them turn around and hundreds of Lettuce's netherite lawmen come out of hiding and a second fight begins. Parrot knows he's not good enough to kill the players off individually, and goes off to be a distraction for the better PvPers of the army to get the kills. The perspective switches over to Theo's, who blows up multiple lawmen in one minecart each time. Back over to Parrot, he towers up and places his shulker boxes full of gear, Wemmbu flies over to regear as well, and Lettuce comes flying in and maces them off. Parrot starts to run out of resources and needs a way back onto the tower to regear, but it's practically impossible with how many lawmen are on him at once. Parrot goes onto the side of the Northern Council and builds up on the back of the election board to get to his shulkers. It switches back over to Theo again, who's shown to be destroying the lawmen once more.

After an hour of fighting, it was only Lettuce and a few remaining lawmen left, all of Parrot's army target Lettuce until it's down to his chestplate being the only armor piece remaining, he then flies out of the fight. They count who's there and see if anyone died, Wemmbu and Minute come back and says Lettuce managed to escape. They're all finally able to rest from all of the fighting and Parrot walks around the Northern Council just looking at the ground. Lettuce is then shown walking back through the front of the Northern Council. Parrot asks Lettuce what he's doing there and Lettuce says if they really want to kill him, to do it and that he doesn't want to live on a server that doesn't want him, and that his goal was to enforce the will of the server, but if the server doesn't want justice, he surrenders. Parrot makes Lettuce follow him, but some people like Flame wants to kill him right there. They all decide a vote to see who wants Lettuce dead and it ends in a tie. Flame asks why Parrot wants to keep Lettuce alive, Parrot says if they kill him, they're no better than him. Parrot says he will resume the election that Lettuce started and if Lettuce somehow manages to win, then that's the server's decision. Lettuce says he knew he wasn't going to win ever since Parrot's execution failed and says the server was too far gone now and he tried to warn Parrot. Parrot tells Lettuce that he's going to prison for a long time. Parrot looks at the warzone that they had caused, Wemmbu and [[eggchan]] come out and ask if he's gonna become king now, egg says he wouldn't vote for Parrot and Wemmbu says he'd vote for egg over Parrot, which was fine with him. Parrot asks where they're headed now, Wemmbu says he doesn't know and the two of them head off and says it was fun fighting alongside him.

The next scene shows Parrot with 5,828 votes and Lettuce has 3,973 votes. Parrot now wears a crown on his skin, him and Theo are inside of the castle ready to walk out, Theo asks what Parrot will do as king, Parrot says he doesn't know but he has some things planned. Parrot heads up and Theo tells him good luck and that he's proud of him, but not to let it get to his head since he's still not the biggest bird. Parrot steps up in front of the crowd as the episode ends.

== Trivia ==

* Mapicc, Jaden_MAN and a few others were not featured in the description, however, this may be Parrot overlooking at all of the people in the video.
* While Parrot was looking for Wemmbu, he hears Wemmbu and eggchan open the Farlands end portal.
* At the end of the video during the scenes District 13 decides LettuceK's fate, an invisible player can be spotted spying on them. This was confirmed to be one of Jumper's spies in Spoke's POV.
* This is Parrot's 100th video.
* Deputy_Ace's final words were also said in Parrot's [[Unstable SMP: Doomsday|finale]] of the Invisible Mafia arc, where Parrot told Ash the exact same thing when Ash tried to force him to join the Mafia.
* The video's thumbnail is a reference to [[Unstable SMP: The First War]]'s thumbnail implying that this is the second big server-wide war.

title: I Became Powerful on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
content:
I Became POWERFUL on a Hardcore Minecraft Server is the 66th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The video starts with a recap of how he lost against Wemmbu and his title of "The Immortal Demon". 

A player named "RottenBanana" steals his iron and runs. Flame eventually kills RottenBanana. Flame; now in full iron makes a long trek to his base only to get ambushed by the Skullhound Bandits. The Bandits chase him outside as he pillars up with cobblestone. The bandits make fun of him for losing to Wemmbu.  Flame runs back to his horse and runs away. Flame finds a spot in a mesa hill to build his new base as his old base was  overran by bandits and Wemmbu left a giant hole infront of it. Flame equips a diamond chestplate from his shulker box. Flame tames a wolf and explains his plan to breed a wolf army to take his revenge against Wemmbu.

Flame finds a town and the town's people don't drop anything due to his loss against Wemmbu. Flame massacres them. Flame takes everything from  their chests and their armadillos to make wolf armor and a silverfish exp farm. 

Flame calls Lomedy to make his base an actual functioning base. Lomedy makes an armadillo farm to get stacks of armadillo scutes. Flame uses the armadillo farm to make a cobweb farm. Coincidentally, the farm also gives him a bunch of experience, one of the most prized things in the server. Lomedy shows him his new base. Lomedy then asks him why is he building a new base. Flame tells him the whole story.  Lomedy gives Flame some motivation. Motivated, Flame decides to spin back on the bandits that he ran away from. Flame realizes a crucial issue. His lack of golden apples.

Flame decides to go to the nether to mine some gold. As he is mining for gold, he is ambushed by Clown's nether force. The guard attack him hoping to get a promotion if he kills Flame. The guard dies and Flame picks up his netherite chestplate. He has no time to wear it as he is quickly ambushed by another 2 guards also working for Clown. This time the guards are in full netherite armor. Flame uses his invisibility potion and runs into the lava escaping the guards. Luckily, the guards don't follow.

Flame makes an errand to Redstone Town to gather materials to build a redstone wolf machine. Flame builds a wolf machine. Flame travels back to his old base and this time, he kills all the Skullhound Bandits garrisoned there, including their leader: CraftedJoker. Flame picks up their loot including a netherite helmet, netherite leggings and netherite boots which is enough for him  to get a full set of Netherite Armor.

Flame goes to Capital City to question a citizen to learn about Wemmbu's whereabouts. There, he learns that Wemmbu died.

 Trivia 

 The video was originally called I Became Powerful on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP before being changed to I Became Powerful on the Unstable SMP and then being reverted before being changed to I Became Powerful on a Hardcore Minecraft Server.
