title: I Became a Bounty Hunter on the Unstable SMP
content:
I Became a Bounty Hunter on the Unstable SMP is the 69th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
It all started when the invisible assassins ambushed Spoke, Leow0ok and Mapicc. They hurdle towards the ground only to find themselves saved by powdered snow under some carpets. They had survived a 100 block fall due to the carpets and powdered snow. Spoke and Mapicc discover that Leow0ok; the player they had been with, was the one who orchestrated  the whole trap. Leow0ok had betrayed them just to hand  them over to the bandits or so they thought. Spoke guesses that Leo had been paid about 64 diamonds for Spoke and some copper for Mapicc. Mapicc takes offense and says 1000 diamonds for him (Mapicc). Leo says Spoke should drop his Riptide III trident but Spoke makes a pitiful attempt at escape and Leo threatens to kill Mapicc. Mapicc makes a bluff that he could 10v1 them. Spoke decides he isn't going to argue with the guy who has 5 hit-men. Spoke drops the trident.  Leo makes an ominous laugh.

Leo says if they need food they'll  give it to them but if they try to run, they'll kill them. Spoke and Mapicc follow  them to the new and improved BAT Headquarters 2.0. Spoke finds out that they weren't getting killed but rather they're being trained if  they're truly worthy of being a member of  The Bounty Assassin Team. Spoke's first mission is to find and kill the person who griefed and destroyed over 30 bases; ApexPoint. Spoke has  to find him in the glitchy Amplified. But Spoke had a plan : he places furnaces in the terrain and checks them an hour later as furnaces only smelt if there's a nearby player; effectively cutting the searching time by half. 

Using this, Spoke finally finds ApexPoint's base; a cramped obsidian box with a mooshroom, an enchanting table, 6 mangrove logs and finally ApexPoint. ApexPoint is preoccupied listening to YouTube Shorts or in other words, ApexPoint is AFK. Spoke carts ApexPoint but he lives  the initial blast and Spoke is tranced into a 1v1 against him but Spoke is drastically under geared compared to him. ApexPoint makes a terrible joke about everything he does is Amplified including his health. Spoke notices a pattern; he holds up his shield everytime Spoke places a rail. This would make sense to block a TNT minecart explosion but Spoke does a switch-a-roo. He places down a pot on top a rail. Since pots a feature where if you right-click on it you can store items. Using this mechanic Spoke places a pot and ApexPoint accidentally places his sword into the pot and Spoke breaks the pot successfully stealing the sword  from ApexPoint. ApexPoint, stunned is now half disarmed with only his Netherite Axe. ApexPoint decides he is going to run via his escape tunnel and Spoke loses him. 

Leo comes over to inspect Spoke's work. Spoke makes up some fake evidence but overall Leo normally wouldn't give it a pass but to an extent, Spoke did a good job and was successful on disarming the enemy. But in the time Spoke took to complete one, his opponents: SmileyyMC and PlanetLord did 2 and 3 missions respectively. Spoke tried  to continue his missions normally but it wasn't working as Smileyy stole Spoke's kill. In Spoke's building mission it was also a catastrophe. Spoke realizes his opponent: PlanetLord had made a better tower than him. Spoke complains about that his home is worse than Smileyy's and Planet as Smileyy has a bed and chests, Planet has all of those and on top of that, he also has flowers while Spoke has none of that luxury. Smileyy respectfully asks Spoke to quiet down as he is struggling to read his next mission due to Spoke's complaints.

Spoke tests his new idea to get out of cobwebs quickly: an Efficiency V, Unbraking III, Mending shears as in his last fight against ApexPoint, he was afraid that his pet fish George Junior would die. Spoke then shows off his drain kit which has 17 stacks of cobwebs or  1088 cobwebs alone, 4 sponge, 4 stacks of empty buckets or 64 buckets, and 2 stacks of chorus fruit or 128 chorus fruit. 

Spoke decides  to try and complete his next one. He meets a player named DrinkHotdogwater and asks him to clear some trees. Spoke asks him  if he could use a flint & steel but the player refuses replying with "Fire is  too dangerous". To the player's dismay, Spoke ignores him and lights the trees on fire but the fire quickly spiraled out of control. Spoke then meets a full gold player whose name is TREELEAF2021 whose base had been exploded, griefed and lit on fire by none  other than ApexPoint. 

Spoke then meets ApexPoint on top the roof of that poor player's tower. Spoke and ApexPoint fight again as ApexPoint demands for his sword. Spoke drains ApexPoint 2 times as TREELEAF2021 cries. Spoke then drains ApexPoint a 3rd time. After a while Spoke is knocked off and he pops a Totem of Undying which saves his life from  the fall. Spoke realises his boots broke. Spoke tries to run but as he is running Spoke formulates a plan to get his point. But as he forms a plan his helmet breaks. Spoke crafts an iron helmet and iron boots and trances ApexPoint into fighting him again. Spoke lures ApexPoint to BAT hq to finish him off but as he is doing that, Spoke's leggings break and he crafts a new pair of iron leggings to replace his diamond ones. Spoke realises Ender Pearls are the items that could ruin his plan. So he tries to make ApexPoint waste as many as possible. Spoke runs to the top of a mountain and then from a water source he Trident-Pearls and with that, he pearls over 500 blocks. Leo asks Spoke how did the mission go. Spoke then lies his way by convincing Leo that ApexPoint is now deceased.

Spoke then says he is only losing by 2 missions to Smileyy and 3 missions to PlanetLord. Spoke got word that they were helping each other out by teaming. Spoke with "no other choice" disguises himself with invisibility and sits on a mountain waiting for FlameFrags; the most wanted target of BAT. Spoke drops Flame a netherite ingot which peaks Flame's interest. Spoke then asks Flame to get him potions for  more. Spoke then says he found it from Smileyys chest; while flame was out getting the stolen potions, Spoke had  to do some more missions too like trapping the notorious trapper; fruitguppy4. Spoke kills him as the trapper accidentally is blown into his own  obsidian box. The next mission was when ironezekiel asked Spoke to create Minecraft's most secure base. title: I Became a Minecraft Combat Master
content:
I Became a Minecraft Combat Master is the 117th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
FlameFrags has become a Minecraft combat master, having mastered every weapon there is. His next step is to become a Minecraft combat grandmaster, a fighter with no weakness. On the Unstable SMP, he is nowhere near ready for this journey and needs a base, so him and his best friend, Lomedy, go back to his old base to try and fix it. Lomedy is disgusted at how bad the outside of his base looks. When they enter the actual base, it appears untouched, only being affected by the Law-themed walls, but then an invisible player in full netherite comes out and pulls a level and blows up the entire base. The person drinks milk and reveals to be a random player named HernandoDomin3_. He says he heard Flame is trying to train to become a combat grandmaster and asks Flame to fight him. Flame thinks it's a waste of time fighting this guy, but because the guy is so hesitant, Flame pots up and combos the guy, barely giving him the chance to get a hit on Flame. After four totem pops, Hernando runs away.

Flame and Lomedy begin reconstructing their base, Flame clears out the debris from past battles with The Law while Lomedy builds a new home for the two of them. In the distance, The Law horn is blown and a Law commander walks up to Flame and gives him a weekly newspaper. One page sticks out in particular, it mentions how more players than usual have been spotted with a certain shield pattern, this could be foreshadowing about arachn1d_'s attempt of trying to rule the server. The commander says that Flame's not wanted under their new leadership and tells him if he ever needs anything, just ask since they're neighbors. Flame remembered that The Law base was built in 24 hours, and so he asks for a group of lawmen to help clear out the debris. The commander explains how the lawmen will build, but appliances will have to be handled themselves, so Flame and Lomedy head to Merchant City to get potion materials. When they walk in, a player overhears them talking about nether items and says they haven't received shipment and needs to wait at the portal. Flame and Lomedy start getting shot with arrows with effects, Flame looks behind and sees Spongs and Willsion pretending to hide behind a tree and breaking it. The shipment arrives and Flame overpays for nether items and they leave back to their base, Spongs and Willsion follow them, but Flame gets them to stop. Knowing that the lawmen builds at a fast rate, they come back to a huge base fully built. 

Flame says The Law can protect his base when he's not there, but thinks it needs to be more fortified in case they aren't able to. Spongs and Willsion appear in front of them and is interested in helping them build traps around the base. They mess around the entire time and WIllsion asks Flame to get redstone materials. Although they came to Flame's base and demands Flame to get materials, Flame decides to do so to get peace and quiet away from Spongs. Spongs follows along and ragebaits him, Spongs stumbles across a group of players and walks up in front of them. They begin surrounding them and demands for Flame and Spongs to drop their items, Spongs gives them whatever random items he has in his inventory and Flame refuses to do so and walks away. This causes the group of players to attack Spongs, Flame tells him to turtle master while Flame preps for the fight. Flame uses his crossbow and TNT minecarts in this fight and kills all of them. Flame and Spongs then arrive at Redstone City, Spongs continues to ragebait Flame and gets told to be quiet. Flame finds 4CVIT and trades a few diamond armor sets and a netherite sword for two redstone kits. After the trade, he doesn't find Spongs anywhere and assumes that he may have went back to the base, so Flame heads back.

Willsion and Lomedy show Flame a fall trap they made right in front of the base, Flame then asks Lomedy to build an XP farm so he can mend his gear. After Flame fixes his armor, he wonders why Spongs hasn't come back yet, then in the distance, he sees Spongs getting chased by even more players. Flame asks Lomedy for his mace to help deal with the players since TNT minecarts would destroy his base, and quickly kills off the group of players. Now that they almost have everything, the last thing Flame needs is wolves, but requires cows to breed them, so Flame and Lomedy head to Capital City. They get stopped by a player saying Flame isn't welcome in Capital City, Flame has a flashback of him hitting a player off when this happened before, and he decides to spare the person and digs through the cobblestone wall. Lomedy is surprised Flame didn't kill him, Flame says even if he made the player believe he's a combat master, it doesn't matter what he says unless he proves that he is good. They find a few cows wandering around Capital City and decide to take them. On their way back home, Lomedy mentions how Flame dislikes Spongs and WIllsion, but says Willsion taught him a lot about trapping and takes an interest in trapping. Flame says he wouldn't enter that realm, but thinks they could combine PvP with trapping in certain cases, like if the fight is unwinnable and there are way too many players. When they arrive back at the base, a lawman stands in front of the base and informs the two of a wanted criminal around the area and they're after Flame. Flame thanks him for the information, as well as for the base. Lomedy starts breeding the cows and Flame builds his orbital dog cannon machine. Flame tells Lomedy to hide and to let him deal with whoever the assassin is.

Flame waits in the middle of his base, arachn1d_ stands up on top of his base and says he's been awaiting. Arachn1d says Flame killing his group of players was the worst mistake of his life, Flame tries to make excuses to get away from this. Arachn1d says his base will become his territory soon and there will be nothing to stop him, not The Law, not a king, not anything. Arachn1d says this wouldn't be the last time Flame would see him and to keep looking over his shoulder and walks away. A group of players with the spider shield pattern gets to Flame's base, Flame tries to reason with them, but they were hesitant on killing him to repay for the deaths of the players he killed earlier. Flame pulls his orbital dog cannon and kills half the players. Flame goes up his base and grabs another fishing rod from a shulker and sets off another round of wolves. This time, he kills off everybody except one who runs away, who he doesn't bother to chase. Lomedy comes out of hiding and asks if they'll get attacked more often and would Flame become evil again, Flame says he wouldn't kill people for no reason, just only focusing on becoming a combat grandmaster and that he's only getting attacked because of his reputation. Flame says because Lomedy wants to get better at trapping and he wants to get better at combat, they'll fight for survival and they'll use traps and wolves to fight those wars, and when there's not conflict, Flame will seek out more trainers. 

 Trivia 

 This thumbnail suggests he grew throughout Season 2. In SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server, Flame was destroyed by Wemmbu and did not stand a chance.
 The video is recorded in 4K, whereas other videos are recorded in 1440p.

title: I Became a Minecraft Killer
content:
I Became a Minecraft Killer is the 107th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode begins where Wemmbu's previous episode left off, Parrot stands right behind Wemmbu and eggchan, wanting help from Wemmbu to take LettuceK down. Wemmbu wants to ban Parrot, as he's the one that revealed Wemmbu's secret identity to the server, which has caused a chain reaction to lead him to the situation he's at right now. Wemmbu knocks Parrot off into the water to talk to egg privately, egg says Parrot's offer is good, but Wemmbu says Lettuce would become king regardless and wants to kill Parrot, but not right now due to their lack of resources. Wemmbu tells egg to take his trident and to follow them from behind while he goes with Parrot.

They go towards the island with the dolphin tunnel leading to Capital City, Parrot says they could fight off the lawmen, but Wemmbu says he can't, so Parrot gives Wemmbu invis and covers up to get all the lawmen off the island. There aren't enough dolphins in the tunnel, so Wemmbu goes out into the Great Sea to grab a dolphin and bring back. Wemmbu struggles to get the dolphin across the fence, Parrot says there's extra in the tunnel, so they head off. The guards get back onto the island and sees them as they leave. While traveling back to Capital City, more nametags can be seen coming from the other direction, so they exit the dolphin tunnel and dig into a wall and surfaces. Parrot says he has a happy ghast with loot in the cherry blossom biome, but he looks at a chest that detects any movement nearby and sees that it had been set off over a hundred times, they see that The Law held a stakeout at that very location and has to go off track. At a village, Parrot tries to tell Wemmbu to crouch, but it's already too late. Wemmbu alerted the three lawmen that were there, he tries to kill them, but Parrot says to run, and Wemmbu quickly realizes it was a bad idea to fight when one hit took half his health.

Wemmbu surfaces and Parrot comes up shortly after, Parrot tells him that they're going to a river, when they get close, Parrot checks to see if this is the right location. Egg whispers to Wemmbu and says that he's been following them as planned and that he joined The Law to blend in. Egg asks why he hasn't killed Parrot yet, Wemmbu explains that Parrot may have a contingency plan. Egg heads back into the cave he came from and leaves, Wemmbu goes towards Parrot, and they make it to a nautilus shop owned by CoinMonke. Coin questions why Parrot is working with Wemmbu and says he doesn't trust Wemmbu, but Parrot explains that this is the only way to win the election, and so Coin calms down. Parrot asks for the fastest way to go back to spawn, Coin explains the plan as Wemmbu wanders around. They then get on the nautilus and begin traversing the river. In the middle of their expedition, lawmen had come from the opposite direction, and the two have to run back onto land. Wemmbu kills a lawman, but wasn't able to pick up the loot, Parrot tells Wemmbu to keep running. They stumble across a pig with a saddle, Parrot leads it and tells Wemmbu to tower up. Just as the lawmen are about to corner them, Parrot asks for Wemmbu's elytra, but he doesn't want to give it up, so Parrot makes Wemmbu fly off as he sits on the pig instead, and teaches him how to fly infinitely without using rockets. Wemmbu's elytra breaks in the process, but they had gotten far enough for The Law to stop chasing them.

title: I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP
content:
I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP is the 90th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode begins in the end of 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players where Wemmbu attempts to escape LettuceK. He almost dies and Lettuce clears his inventory. Lettuce imprisons Wemmbu and tells him to put on a prisoner skin and assigns a cell for him. He also explains that during the night, all prisoners must be in their cell and on top of their bed and if he doesn't listen to the guards he will go to solitary. Lettuce tells loppezz to guard Wemmbu's cell. Wemmbu tries to break the cell and gets caught by loppezz. The next morning, loppezz assigns all the prisoners to do a task to clean the floor but they'll get fed before the job. Wemmbu encounters Baablu and Fantst in the prison too. Wemmbu tells them that they have to settle their differences if they want to escape. A guard emerges from the walls and warns them about escaping and punishes them by forcing them to work in a ravine.

Loppezz gives the prisoners an item check to make sure they aren't smuggling any items. They also receive a wooden pickaxe. They try to smuggle items, but the guards are suspicious of them. Fantst then covers for Wemmbu and Baablu as they try to make an exit for it, loppezz quickly catches up and brings them back inside. Baablu and Fantst gets sent back and Lettuce tells Wemmbu that he has a special assignment. They start heading towards spawn where nobody is to be seen. When the make it to the Northern Council, Lettuce instructs Wemmbu to sit in a corner until the event starts. When it starts, Lettuce begins his speech about the server needing a king, marking a new era of the Unstable SMP. Once the speech is over, they begin to head back to the prison. An invisible player follows them from behind and soon after splashes Wemmbu with invisibility, giving him the opportunity to run and escape. Wemmbu makes it to a base and loots it for food, the owner of the base returns and sees Wemmbu's invis particles and asks who he is. With no time left before The Law came, Wemmbu tries to get them to cover for him, but they snitch and Lettuce captures him. Loppezz corners him with iron bars, and while none of the guards are looking, Wemmbu gets on a horse that was in reach and attempts to escape, but the horse is too slow to outrun them. 

They make it back to the prison and Lettuce runs an inventory check on Wemmbu again. He leads Wemmbu to his office and reveals he knew Wemmbu smuggled in items and forces him to give him the items. Lettuce then enacts a new protocol because of Wemmbu's escape attempt and brings the rest of the prisoners into the office. He forces all of the prisoners to put on curse of binding armor, Wemmbu is then put in solitary confinement. As Wemmbu sits in his cell, the lights suddenly go out. An invisible player sneaks up to the window and they drink milk, it is revealed to be Spoke. Spoke turns out to be the invisible player from earlier that helped Wemmbu. He proposes a deal to let Wemmbu out if he helps him using the orbital strike cannons he has left. Wemmbu thinks Spoke's only using him for his powers and would be imprisoned as a slave for Spoke, and declines the offer. Spoke says the offer is still available if Wemmbu does want to escape before heading off, remarking that he would like to see how Wemmbu escapes.

 Trivia 

 This is PrinceZam's first appearance in an Unstable video in over a year, the last one being How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room.
 This video's original title was "I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP". The other title used was "I Became a Minecraft Prisoner".
 The featured creators in the scene showing the players are Parrot, Theo, Jaden, Flame(invis), Leo, Spoke, Horace, Yungwilx (without his skin)

title: I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
content:
I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison is the 7th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
The episode starts off with ParrotX2 and rekrap2 breaking into the first prison, a purple hurricane-shaped prison. They splash themselves with an invis potion and ender pearl in, getting through the bubble column and sign maze defense before the guards start investigating the prison. They discover the break in and find the duo in the lava defense, so Parrot and Rekrap chorus fruit out, digging away and escaping from the prison. 

In a voice over, Parrot explains that in the center of the prison is a chunk ban, an area in which if you step in, you are banned off of the server. A few days ago, one of Parrot’s best friends, Wifies, stepped into one. Before he could free Wifies, SpokeIsHere, one of the most wanted players on this server, stepped into the chunk ban as well. The construction of a prison was ordered to keep Spoke banned forever. But even though it seemed impossible, Parrot was going to break Wifies out. 

To be able to break Wifies out, Parrot and Rekrap would have to assemble a team of players to help break him out, which was why they were going to the smaller prisons to break Spoke’s former underlings, who were also trapped in chunk bans, out. Parrot would be responsible for building a TNT cannon that would destroy the chunk ban, while Rekrap would distract the guards, Merffinn, yungwillx, and woogiex. 

The second prison was an end prison with a network of islands connected by flying machines. Parrot and Rekrap invis and attempt to make it to the prison undercover by the flying machines, but the guards spot Rekrap, so Parrot takes the chance to elytra in. However, his attempt to build the TNT cannon catches the guards’ attention, and after multiple failed tries, he and Rekrap decide to dip and lead the guards on a big chase before finally getting away. 

Parrot and Rekrap decide to head to the Zam Empire to negotiate a deal with PrinceZam, the player that ordered the construction of the prisons. Parrot asks him to lift the ban for sixty seconds, but PrinceZam declines. Parrot then tells him that he and Rekrap are going to break out out Wifies, but PrinceZam laughs and says that the new technology (atom grid, auto piglin banners, and sculk cake chunk bans) he’s implemented won’t allow it. Parrot doesn’t believe him and he and Rekrap leave the castle and reconvene at Rekrap’s base to prepare for the next prison. 

They go on a scouting mission to the next prison, a completely underwater one. They splash themselves with invis and go down to check out the prison, but realize that they can’t see anything through the water. There is one big issue to breaking into this prison, Parrot reasons. If the entire prison is underwater, then the chunk ban will also likely be encased in water. They would have to find a way to blow up the chunk ban underwater. They find a way to blow up submerged TNT using blocks of sand and spawning withers. 

Parrot and Rekrap return to the prison with all the necessary supplies needed to blow up the chunk ban. They manage to sneak into the prison’s defenses, an obsidian maze, without any guards noticing, but they quickly catch on. The guards, woogiex, Willsion, and What_Max all start chasing Rekrap, and he and Parrot are separated in the chaos. Parrot finds the chunk ban, which is surrounded by a glass wall that marks the borders of the ban, but a guard finds him. They both manage to escape, regrouping a ways away from the entrance (26:47: gyatt). 

Heading back into the prison, they immediately are found by guards and quickly make their way to the chunk ban. Parrot then starts spawning loads of withers while Rekrap distracts the guards. Just as they predicted, after a while, one of the withers blew up the chunk ban and they make their very frantic escape. They meet back up at a nearby mountain and recruit the player freed from the chunk ban, Derapchu, as the third member of their prison-breaking team.

Derapchu leads them to another prison that he knows the coords of, located in the jungle. They then head back to base to start prepping for the prison. Parrot decides that since withers were too random and that they got lucky breaking the last chunk ban, the only way to destroy the next one was with a TNT cannon. They start practicing constructing TNT cannons and eventually find a simplified design of it that the three of them combined could complete in under fifteen seconds. 

The fourth prison break begins with invis Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu sneaking into the prison. They dig into the walls and find weird redstone contraptions. The guards, Merffinn, Peentar, and yungwillx, however, find evidence of the broken redstone, and realize that someone is trying to break in. Searching the floors, Parrot discovers a chunk ban at the top floor. The guards, however, find Derapchu and start chasing after him. Realizing there was no way of communicating with the rest of his team, Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu decide to get on a phone call. Eventually, the guards start catching on to Parrot and he tells Rekrap to start blowing the chunk ban up. 

Parrot leads the guards on a big chase while Rekrap starts attempting to blow the chunk ban up. They all end up on the floor of the chunk ban and a big fight ensues (57:17: magical chunk ban). Parrot realizes that the only way to actually successfully build the chunk ban was to get rid of all of the guards. They attack the guards and continue fighting until all of the guards had no choice but to dip or risk getting killed. With no one to hinder the blowing up of the chunk ban, they free one of Spoke’s henchmen. However, Parrot realizes that they had freed someone who wouldn't want to join their prison-breaking team. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu decide to head to the first prison to check what kind of defenses PrinceZam had added, but before they even came within a thousand block radius, their game immediately crashed and respawned them in a nearby taiga forest. This was one of the new technologies that Zam added to the prison holding Spoke and Wifies, a server-crashing piece of technology. Not knowing how to solve this, they leave it for now and focus on the next prison. 

The next prison is a prison situated in the nether in a volcano, so Parrot proposes a new solution to breaking the chunk bans: flying machines and TNT minecarts. They scout the prison first and instead of one or two chunk bans, there are three stacked a ways apart from each other. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu sneak into the prison, but are quickly found out. Parrot starts building a flying machine, but is caught in the act and narrowly escapes, leading the guards on a big chase and giving Rekrap and Derapchu the chance to destroy the chunk bans. Once he loses the guards, Parrot heads back to the prison and sneaks into the walls. Rekrap and Derapchu, however, are caught and engages with the guards. Parrot takes the opportunity to successfully break the middle chunk ban with a flying machine when the guards weren’t paying attention. They all get into a big fight with Merffinn, FlameFrags, SykerMC, Sorhin, and Woogie and decide to dip and head back to base. Parrot manages to loose the guards in the wall and mines out. 

They regroup back at Rekrap’s base and decide to head to the Zam Empire to possibly swipe information about PrinceZam’s new technology. He reveals to them that that is something called a memory ban, but when Parrot tries to pry more info about the memory ban, he deigns to tell them anything. Parrot also voices that many of the same guards are guarding the prisons they went to, so asks him if he cycles the guards. They meet back at base and Parrot reasons that if the guards are being cycled throughout the prisons, then there must be a way in and out that the guards take. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu head to the next prison, a snowglobe prison in the middle of a snowy taiga. They splash invis and start scouting out the snowglobe, discovering a group of drowned patrolling the top of a soul sand water elevator containing a beacon. Parrot realizes that if the chunk ban stretched all the way to the top of the snowglobe, then there was no way PrinceZam could have it covered, so the top must be safe to break in from. They dig into the wall and eventually break through into the actual prison containing the chunkban. However, the guards, Sorhin, Merffinn, and SykerMC, catch onto them, so Rekrap quickly creates a TNT distraction to occupy the guards. Parrot successfully builds and sends out a flying machine to break the chunk ban. He escapes through a ruined portal in the desert and reconvenes with everyone at the base, where another freed player is waiting for them. 

As a skilled PVPer, Fantst was a very good player to have on their side, so after a bit of convincing, Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu add Fantst to their prison-breaking team. He also knows the whereabouts of a sky prison, which they make their way to. They land on one of the surrounding islands in the sky, but don’t spot any guards. They spot the chunk ban exposed in the middle of the central castle and sneak in. However, one of the guards, Willsion, spots them and starts attacking. They exit and lure the rest of the guards, who are invis, outside. Parrot, Derapchu, and Fantst distract the guards while Rekrap destroys the chunk ban. They then engage into a big fight with ManePear, Willsion, SykerMC, and SmileyyMC, but after realizing that they couldn’t win this battle, they dip. 

After meeting back up at Rekrap’s base, the prison-breaking team reflects on the previous prison and how easy it was. Fantst then says that their mission wasn’t possible, shocking everyone. He elytras over to a nearby cobblestone platform on the shore of the ocean right next to an active chunk ban. He tells Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu that what they’re doing is too risky for him, and he doesn’t want to get banned. At the last prison, he was the one tanking all the damage and carrying everyone. Leaving with that, he steps into the chunk ban without a second thought. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu are downcast, as they had just gained Fantst and losing him was a big blow. Even with that loss, they have no choice but to keep breaking into prisons if they wanted to accomplish their goal. With that, they head to the next and final prison before the ultimate breakout, another end prison. 

They start sneaking into the walls, spotting the guards, loppezz and SykerMC. They eventually find the central room with the chunk ban and form a plan: Rekrap and Derapchu will distract the guards while Parrot destroys the chunk ban with TNT minecarts. The chunk ban is blown up and Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu start fighting the guards in a 3v2. Realizing that they’re outnumbered, loppezz and SykerMC dip and elytra out of the prison, leaving Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu alone there. Unfortunately, despite their easy victory, they had freed someone who had no intention of teaming with them.

While in the end, Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu decide to go to the other end prison. Upon arrival, they find one of the guards, FlameFrags, munching on pizza in real life. Seeing that he seemed to be the only guard here and was willing to let them destroy the chunk ban, they left him alone and blew up the chunk ban. However, once he was done with the pizza, he started attacking them, so after a short fight, they dip and head back to base. 

A few minutes after Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu return back to base, a player named JumperWho whom they had freed from the second end prison arrives. JumperWho agrees to join them, becoming the fourth member of their team. 

Parrot, Rekrap, Derapchu, and JumperWho start brainstorming ways to break out Wifies and Spoke from the final prison. After they do that, they make a road of ancient debris and send hundreds of TNT minecarts to damage the piglin from below. After hours of testing, failure, and trying again, the ban is finally lifted. Wifies and Spoke were freed and that is how the greatest prison-breaking team broke into Minecraft’s most secure prison. 

However, the story isn’t over yet. PrinceZam placed a target and bounty over Parrot’s head for breaking into the prisons, and he is now being hunted by Minecraft's deadliest player.

'''I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison''' is the 7th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

The episode starts off with [[ParrotX2]] and [[rekrap2]] breaking into the first prison, a purple hurricane-shaped prison. They splash themselves with an invis potion and ender pearl in, getting through the bubble column and sign maze defense before the guards start investigating the prison. They discover the break in and find the duo in the lava defense, so Parrot and Rekrap chorus fruit out, digging away and escaping from the prison. 

In a voice over, Parrot explains that in the center of the prison is a [[chunk ban]], an area in which if you step in, you are banned off of the server. A few days ago, one of Parrot’s best friends, [[Wifies]], stepped into one. Before he could free Wifies, [[SpokeIsHere]], one of the most wanted players on this server, stepped into the chunk ban as well. The construction of a prison was ordered to keep Spoke banned forever. But even though it seemed impossible, Parrot was going to break Wifies out. 

To be able to break Wifies out, Parrot and Rekrap would have to assemble a team of players to help break him out, which was why they were going to the smaller prisons to break Spoke’s former underlings, who were also trapped in chunk bans, out. Parrot would be responsible for building a TNT cannon that would destroy the chunk ban, while Rekrap would distract the guards, [[Merffinn]], [[yungwillx]], and [[woogiex]]. 

The second prison was an end prison with a network of islands connected by flying machines. Parrot and Rekrap invis and attempt to make it to the prison undercover by the flying machines, but the guards spot Rekrap, so Parrot takes the chance to elytra in. However, his attempt to build the TNT cannon catches the guards’ attention, and after multiple failed tries, he and Rekrap decide to dip and lead the guards on a big chase before finally getting away. 


Parrot and Rekrap decide to head to the [[Zam Empire]] to negotiate a deal with [[PrinceZam]], the player that ordered the construction of the prisons. Parrot asks him to lift the ban for sixty seconds, but PrinceZam declines. Parrot then tells him that he and Rekrap are going to break out out Wifies, but PrinceZam laughs and says that the new technology (atom grid, auto piglin banners, and sculk cake chunk bans) he’s implemented won’t allow it. Parrot doesn’t believe him and he and Rekrap leave the castle and reconvene at Rekrap’s base to prepare for the next prison. 

They go on a scouting mission to the next prison, a completely underwater one. They splash themselves with invis and go down to check out the prison, but realize that they can’t see anything through the water. There is one big issue to breaking into this prison, Parrot reasons. If the entire prison is underwater, then the chunk ban will also likely be encased in water. They would have to find a way to blow up the chunk ban underwater. They find a way to blow up submerged TNT using blocks of sand and spawning withers. 

Parrot and Rekrap return to the prison with all the necessary supplies needed to blow up the chunk ban. They manage to sneak into the prison’s defenses, an obsidian maze, without any guards noticing, but they quickly catch on. The guards, woogiex, [[Willsion]], and [[What_Max]] all start chasing Rekrap, and he and Parrot are separated in the chaos. Parrot finds the chunk ban, which is surrounded by a glass wall that marks the borders of the ban, but a guard finds him. They both manage to escape, regrouping a ways away from the entrance ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6dtNsa-MGs8&list=PLxePSnmeZqGAWsM-Nl4laQAb-DWbJ4Dh8&index=7 26:47]: gyatt). 

Heading back into the prison, they immediately are found by guards and quickly make their way to the chunk ban. Parrot then starts spawning loads of withers while Rekrap distracts the guards. They meet back up at a nearby mountain and recruit the player freed from the chunk ban, [[Derapchu]], as the third member of their prison-breaking team.

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu decide to head to the first prison to check what kind of defenses PrinceZam had added, but before they even came within a thousand block radius, their game immediately crashed and respawned them in a nearby taiga forest. This was one of the new technologies that Zam added to the prison holding Spoke and Wifies, a server-crashing piece of technology. Not knowing how to solve this, they leave it for now and focus on the next prison. 

The next prison is a prison situated in the nether in a volcano, so Parrot proposes a new solution to breaking the chunk bans: flying machines and TNT minecarts. They scout the prison first and instead of one or two chunk bans, there are three stacked a ways apart from each other. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu sneak into the prison, but are quickly found out. Parrot starts building a flying machine, but is caught in the act and narrowly escapes, leading the guards on a big chase and giving Rekrap and Derapchu the chance to destroy the chunk bans. Once he loses the guards, Parrot heads back to the prison and sneaks into the walls. Rekrap and Derapchu, however, are caught and engages with the guards. Parrot takes the opportunity to successfully break the middle chunk ban with a flying machine when the guards weren’t paying attention. They all get into a big fight with Merffinn, [[FlameFrags]], [[SykerMC]], [[Sorhin]], and Woogie and decide to dip and head back to base. Parrot manages to loose the guards in the wall and mines out. 

They regroup back at Rekrap’s base and decide to head to the Zam Empire to possibly swipe information about PrinceZam’s new technology. He reveals to them that that is something called a [[Memory Ban|memory ban]], but when Parrot tries to pry more info about the memory ban, he deigns to tell them anything. Parrot also voices that many of the same guards are guarding the prisons they went to, so asks him if he cycles the guards. They meet back at base and Parrot reasons that if the guards are being cycled throughout the prisons, then there must be a way in and out that the guards take. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu head to the next prison, a snowglobe prison in the middle of a snowy taiga. They splash invis and start scouting out the snowglobe, discovering a group of drowned patrolling the top of a soul sand water elevator containing a beacon. Parrot realizes that if the chunk ban stretched all the way to the top of the snowglobe, then there was no way PrinceZam could have it covered, so the top must be safe to break in from. Parrot successfully builds and sends out a flying machine to break the chunk ban. He escapes through a ruined portal in the desert and reconvenes with everyone at the base, where another freed player is waiting for them.

They then engage into a big fight with [[ManePear]], Willsion, SykerMC, and SmileyyMC, but after realizing that they couldn’t win this battle, they dip. 

After meeting back up at Rekrap’s base, the prison-breaking team reflects on the previous prison and how easy it was. Fantst then says that their mission wasn’t possible, shocking everyone. Even with that loss, they have no choice but to keep breaking into prisons if they wanted to accomplish their goal. Unfortunately, despite their easy victory, they had freed someone who had no intention of teaming with them.

title: I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization
content:
I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization is the 16th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

Plot
Parrot and Wifies traveled millions of blocks in the end dimension to make a civilization as they were tired of getting hunted and kidnapped by people. However they were being followed by an invisible person. Parrot and Wifies make a trap and pop the totem of the invisible person. The invisible person is revealed to be a player named Deanthebean9. Dean tells them that he's going to die if anyone finds out that he isn't invisible and Ashswagg is going to kill him. Wifies tells Dean not to come back and they won't tell anyone about him being visible, however, Parrot sees this as an opportunity to recruit their first member since Dean doesn't know where to go. Parrot and Wifies lead Dean to their first hut in the civilization. Dean tells them that if you kill a high ranking player in the Mafia you can leave and Dean wanted to get out of the Mafia as fast as possible and that was why he followed them. Wifies guesses that Dean's life was in danger because he threw an ender pearl and Dean confirms his statement. Parrot and Wifies goes to the overworld to recruit more members from Zam Empire but upon arrival they notice that Zam Empire was destroyed. As they realize that Zam Empire is abandoned they decide to take all the slime blocks and other redstone materials from the balloons to build flying machines. Parrot and Wifies find a village and transport them to the end where they meet Dean again. They transport the villagers to the outer end islands where their civilization is.

While transporting the villagers, they get attacked by The Mafia again. Parrot tells Dean to go invisible so that they don't find out that Dean is against them. After escaping Parrot and Wifies find their flying machines and villagers mostly intact, one of the flying machines aren't damaged and the villager is alive while the other one is completely damaged and the villager died. Parrot heads back to the civilization paranoid that The Mafia now has an idea of where it is located so he recruits more members. He arrives to Wemmbu's civilization and finds Horace Altman, Horace explains that he spent weeks building a civilization for Wemmbu and it got blown up. Parrot invites Horace to his civilization. Horace tells Parrot he will help expand the civilization along with this builders and promises it would last forever. Parrot also visits Kenadian at the chunk ban prison built by him and Zam Empire to invite him to the civilization. Parrot tells Kenadian to help transport villagers because last time they did so they were attacked by The Mafia. While Kenadian transports the villagers, Parrot finds an invisible player and distracts them by mining into the void and flying away without them realizing. After Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian transport the two villagers, they notice a huge island done by Horace. Parrot tells Horace to make the island 100 blocks lower. Parrot also makes 4 statis chambers,

Kenadian tells Parrot that stasis chambers are cross dimensional and Parrot gets worried about Dean. Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian make a plan on how to save Dean's life. Parrot goes to one of The Mafia's outposts and pops Dean's totem, Wifies distracts the invisible players and Kenadian pulls Dean's stasis chamber when Parrot tells him to do so. Dean tells Parrot his coordinates so that Parrot can fly to their outpost and he begins fighting them. He pops Dean's totem and right as Dean is about to get stasised into the void, Parrot spam messages Kenadian telling him to pull Dean's stasis. Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian celebrate Dean getting out of The Mafia. They plan on expanding the civilization however, Wifies and Kenadian log off so Parrot tells Dean to watch over his stasis chamber. Parrot goes to the overworld and breaks his bed that way he can go back to the end and arrive at spawn, however, he can't leave the end now. Parrot writes a book asking if anyone can sign up for his civilization and places it into a chest on a broken enderman farm and places a sign telling whoever reads it to go to the enderman farm. After Dean pulls Parrot's stasis chamber, Parrot tells Dean that he's about to log off but before this, Dean thanks Parrot for saving his life in the end.

The next morning, Parrot and Dean log on and fall down 100 blocks. It turns out Horace listened to his request. Parrot requests Horace to build a castle. Parrot and Dean fly to the main end island to see if anyone signed up for the civilization. They find out JumperWho, 4CVIT and Baablu signed up. They interview JumperWho first. Parrot invites JumperWho because he knows he can trust her because of everything they've been through, then he interviews 4CVIT. Parrot gets a bit worried because 4CVIT is wearing the Zam Empire shield however 4CVIT tells Perrot that he isn't part of Zam Empire anymore because they also chased him. 4CVIT tells Parrot that he needs more information about the civilization because he hasn't fully trusted Parrot yet and Parrot removes all of his armour and totem and tells 4C to kill him if he was sent by PrinceZam to kill him. He also makes a deal where if Parrot does invite him he will work on something else and they can ignore him. After 4C gets invited he flies away which makes Parrot a bit concerned. While Parrot interviews Baablu, Baablu tells Parrot that he can't go anywhere without it getting destroyed. Parrot invites Baablu to his civilization and tells him that there's nothing he can do to go back after he joins so he tells Baablu to get anything he still needs and asks Dean to lead him to the civilization. Parrot flies to the civilization and finds Wifies. Upon Dean and Baablu returning they warn Parrot and Wifies about invisible players 10 000 blocks away from the civilization. Parrot takes Wifies to the main end island and tells him that The Mafia tampered with spawn teleportation in the end. Wifies tests if the portal works for him and to his surprise, it does. After Parrot and Wifies return to the end civilization and the next day, Parrot and Dean find out the castle has been built along with a sign saying that they built outposts 1k-1.5k blocks away from the civilization.

Parrot and Dean fly back to the civilization and find Wifies, as they talk about the civilization they see an unexpected guest. Boosfer enters the civilization. Parrot tells Boosfer to leave but Boosfer does nothing but other Parrot about the civilization. Parrot tells Boosfer that his civilians will not be bribed by him but he tells Parrot how he found out the civilization's coordinates. Boosfer also tells Parrot he wants to become the king of the civilization. After Boosfer leaves, Parrot and Horace discuss on how they can make the civilization safer. Horace suggests that they could use chunk bans and Parrot agrees. Parrot visits Wifies in one of the outposts and Parrot writes a sign telling whoever sees the chunk ban prison to contact either him, Wifies or Dean to open the chunk ban. Upon flying back to the civilization they notice chunk bans all over the place. Horace turns off the chunk bans and Parrot and Wifies fly to the civilization. Dean returns telling them that he received a message from Dol9hin to deactivate the chunk bans. Parrot tells Dolphin to ender the island as he doesn't have much time to talk. Dolphin tells Parrot, Wifies and Dean that his friend What Max is also arriving to the civilization however Max asks Parrot if he is one of the 4 invisible guys jumping him. Parrot, Wifies and Dolphin fly to one of the towers. Parrot tells Max to follow him to an end city after they arrive to the outpost to fight the invisible players. Parrot's helmet breaks so he tells Wifies to take Dolphin and Max to the civilization while he flies away to distract the invisible players. Wifies tries to contact Parrot to help him and save him but Parrot couldn't respond since he was still getting jumped by members of The Mafia. Parrot runs out of fireworks and has to run from an invisible player. The invisible player gets distracted by endermen buying Parrot time to leave. Parrot tells WIfies his coordinates and Wifies gives Parrot rockets and invisibility. 

After going back to the civilization, Parrot tells Dolphin and Max about the election for king and both Dolphin and Max tell Parrot that they will vote for him. Parrot, Wifies, Horace and Dean work on the civilization over the course of the next few hours and Parrot works on a garden before logging off. The next day, Parrot notices the castle's interior has been finished along with a village. Wifies tells Parrot that he noticed a crater while he was at recon with Dean. He leads Parrot to where the crater was. After this, Parrot tells Wifies he still needs to find a way to get back to the overworld and goes to the main end island until they find Boosfer. They talk about the elections and Parrot tells Boosfer that he's confident in winning the election due to his loyalty to the people there while Boosfer has 2 people working for him. Boosfer tells them that loyalty is a figment of your imagination and leaves. 

Upon returning to the civilization, 4CVIT returns to the civilization impressed about how much has changed since he was last there. Parrot asks 4CVIT why he wasn't present in the civilization and 4CVIT tells Parrot that he was working on collecting resources for the civilization. 4CVIT also criticizes the civilization and said that it is going to be found and destroyed. 4CVIT tells Parrot that he needs to be in the civilization.

Parrot tells Wifies and Dean that there are new members in the civilization, Fantst and LettuceK. Fantst warns Parrot about some invisible players. Parrot and Wifies find Dean and tell him about the new features and members and lead Dean to the civilization. They spot invisible players presumably building a TNT cannon along with a red line. They turn back and see a gold trimmed player riding an A1C Bomber plane. They realize that there are three A1C bomber planes. One of them wen through their obsidian wall so they mined it. After destroying all three bomber planes they have a meeting about how they can make the civilization stronger. Parrot tells Horace to build a dome with water. 4CVIT tells Parrot he has to leave to check on something so Parrot sends him out and gets 4 people to make sure that nothing fishy is going on. Parrot also made sure of him being elected and everyone agreed to vote Parrot. After this Parrot and Wifies talked about what happened in the past day and Wifies tells Parrot that he should tell everyone about the portal. Parrot opens another meeting telling everyone about The Mafia tampering with the end portal. The people didn't mind getting trapped in the end as long as nothing happens to the civilization. 

During the election day, Horace finishes building the orb so Parrot and Wifies place water all over the orb so that it can't get destroyed by TNT. Boosfer arrives with Kier and Dev. What Boosfer didn't know was that Parrot had already told everyone that they were stuck in the end and they were fine with it. During the election, Kier and Dev vote for Parrot and play dumb. Kier and Dev insist that they leave and Parrot agrees however, if they want to join his civilization he will let them. After winning the election, Parrot returns to his garden and finds Dean. Parrot tells Dean that he actually feels safe in the civilization now however, Dean warns Parrot about an invisible player in the town square. Parrot gets worried and flies searching for the player. He decides to check the chunk ban. Parrot asks Dean why he didn't say anything about it and Dean tells Parrot he was scared. The civilization has another meeting where Dean tells them that there was an invisible person hiding and everyone assembled to find the invisible player.     

They notice their civilization getting attacked again as they spot A1C bombers flying again. While they try to destroy the A1C bombers, Horace tells Parrot to check the sewers which Parrot wasn't aware of. As they check the sewers they find a bunch of shulkers. Something ticks in Parrot's mind to check the chunk bans. He realizes that they were disabled and starts to panic. Before he realizes it, The Mafia attacks the civilization and there's a diamond trimmed player present in the attack. They focus on the diamond trimmed player until the diamond player starts macing them. Parrot tells them to retreat because it isn't worth dying to a diamond player like that. Parrot deactivates the chunk ban allowing the members of the civilization to flee. They head to one of the outposts. Parrot tells them that the empire isn't going to get blown up because if they wanted to blow it up they would've done it already so Parrot decides to destroy the civilization himself as he states that it shouldn't exist if he's not running it. Parrot tells 4CVIT about the civilization getting raided and 4CVIT shows Parrot what he's been working on the entire time. After Parrot tells 4C that he wants to destroy the empire, 4C gives Parrot, Wifies and Dean a bunch of TNT. As they head back to the civilization, Wifies notices that the dome is gone. As they place TNT around the entire  castle, Parrot gets caught so Wifies distracts the invisible players. After Parrot ignites the TNT, he thinks about the old memories they had during their time leading the civilization.

The scene where Parrot, Wifies, Dolphin and Max get attacked in the end and Parrot barely escaping changes the course of Parrot and Wifies' friendship as revealed in Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist.

'''I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization''' is the 16th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

==Plot==
[[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and [[Wifies]] traveled millions of blocks in the end dimension to make a civilization as they were tired of getting hunted and kidnapped by people. However they were being followed by an invisible person. Parrot and Wifies make a trap and pop the totem of the invisible person. The invisible person is revealed to be a player named [[Deanthebean9]]. Dean tells them that he's going to die if anyone finds out that he isn't invisible and [[Ashswagg]] is going to kill him. Wifies tells Dean not to come back and they won't tell anyone about him being visible, however, Parrot sees this as an opportunity to recruit their first member since Dean doesn't know where to go. Parrot and Wifies lead Dean to their first hut in the civilization. Dean tells them that if you kill a high ranking player in the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] you can leave and Dean wanted to get out of the Mafia as fast as possible and that was why he followed them. Wifies guesses that Dean's life was in danger because he threw an ender pearl and Dean confirms his statement. Parrot and Wifies goes to the overworld to recruit more members from [[Zam Empire]] but upon arrival they notice that Zam Empire was destroyed. As they realize that Zam Empire is abandoned they decide to take all the slime blocks and other redstone materials from the balloons to build flying machines. Parrot and Wifies find a village and transport them to the end where they meet Dean again. They transport the villagers to the outer end islands where their civilization is.

While transporting the villagers, they get attacked by The Mafia again. Parrot tells Dean to go invisible so that they don't find out that Dean is against them. After escaping Parrot and Wifies find their flying machines and villagers mostly intact, one of the flying machines aren't damaged and the villager is alive while the other one is completely damaged and the villager died. Parrot heads back to the civilization paranoid that The Mafia now has an idea of where it is located so he recruits more members. He arrives to [[Wemmbu's Civilization|Wemmbu's civilization]] and finds [[Horace Altman]], Horace explains that he spent weeks building a civilization for [[Wemmbu]] and it got blown up. Parrot invites Horace to his civilization. Horace tells Parrot he will help expand the civilization along with this builders and promises it would last forever. Parrot also visits [[Kenadian]] at the chunk ban prison built by him and Zam Empire to invite him to the civilization. Parrot tells Kenadian to help transport villagers because last time they did so they were attacked by The Mafia. While Kenadian transports the villagers, Parrot finds an invisible player and distracts them by mining into the void and flying away without them realizing. After Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian transport the two villagers, they notice a huge island done by Horace. Parrot tells Horace to make the island 100 blocks lower. Parrot also makes 4 statis chambers,

Kenadian tells Parrot that stasis chambers are cross dimensional and Parrot gets worried about Dean. Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian make a plan on how to save Dean's life. Parrot goes to one of The Mafia's outposts and pops Dean's totem, Wifies distracts the invisible players and Kenadian pulls Dean's stasis chamber when Parrot tells him to do so. Dean tells Parrot his coordinates so that Parrot can fly to their outpost and he begins fighting them. He pops Dean's totem and right as Dean is about to get stasised into the void, Parrot spam messages Kenadian telling him to pull Dean's stasis. Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian celebrate Dean getting out of The Mafia. They plan on expanding the civilization however, Wifies and Kenadian log off so Parrot tells Dean to watch over his stasis chamber. Parrot goes to the overworld and breaks his bed that way he can go back to the end and arrive at spawn, however, he can't leave the end now. Parrot writes a book asking if anyone can sign up for his civilization and places it into a chest on a broken enderman farm and places a sign telling whoever reads it to go to the enderman farm. After Dean pulls Parrot's stasis chamber, Parrot tells Dean that he's about to log off but before this, Dean thanks Parrot for saving his life in the end.

The next morning, Parrot and Dean log on and fall down 100 blocks. It turns out Horace listened to his request. Parrot requests Horace to build a castle. Parrot and Dean fly to the main end island to see if anyone signed up for the civilization. They find out [[JumperWho]], [[4CVIT]] and [[Baablu]] signed up. They interview JumperWho first. Parrot invites JumperWho because he knows he can trust her because of everything they've been through, then he interviews 4CVIT. Parrot gets a bit worried because 4CVIT is wearing the Zam Empire shield however 4CVIT tells Perrot that he isn't part of Zam Empire anymore because they also chased him. 4CVIT tells Parrot that he needs more information about the civilization because he hasn't fully trusted Parrot yet and Parrot removes all of his armour and totem and tells 4C to kill him if he was sent by [[PrinceZam]] to kill him. Parrot takes Wifies to the main end island and tells him that The Mafia tampered with spawn teleportation in the end. Wifies tests if the portal works for him and to his surprise, it does. After Parrot and Wifies return to the end civilization and the next day, Parrot and Dean find out the castle has been built along with a sign saying that they built outposts 1k-1.5k blocks away from the civilization.

Parrot and Dean fly back to the civilization and find Wifies, as they talk about the civilization they see an unexpected guest. [[Boosfer]] enters the civilization. Parrot tells Boosfer to leave but Boosfer does nothing but other Parrot about the civilization. Parrot tells Boosfer that his civilians will not be bribed by him but he tells Parrot how he found out the civilization's coordinates. Boosfer also tells Parrot he wants to become the king of the civilization. After Boosfer leaves, Parrot and Horace discuss on how they can make the civilization safer. Horace suggests that they could use chunk bans and Parrot agrees. Parrot visits Wifies in one of the outposts and Parrot writes a sign telling whoever sees the chunk ban prison to contact either him, Wifies or Dean to open the chunk ban. Upon flying back to the civilization they notice chunk bans all over the place. Horace turns off the chunk bans and Parrot and Wifies fly to the civilization. Dean returns telling them that he received a message from [[Dol9hin]] to deactivate the chunk bans. Parrot tells Dolphin to ender the island as he doesn't have much time to talk. Dolphin tells Parrot, Wifies and Dean that his friend [[What Max]] is also arriving to the civilization however Max asks Parrot if he is one of the 4 invisible guys jumping him. Parrot, Wifies and Dolphin fly to one of the towers. Parrot tells Max to follow him to an end city after they arrive to the outpost to fight the invisible players. Parrot's helmet breaks so he tells Wifies to take Dolphin and Max to the civilization while he flies away to distract the invisible players. Wifies tries to contact Parrot to help him and save him but Parrot couldn't respond since he was still getting jumped by members of The Mafia. Parrot runs out of fireworks and has to run from an invisible player. The invisible player gets distracted by endermen buying Parrot time to leave. Parrot tells WIfies his coordinates and Wifies gives Parrot rockets and invisibility. 

After going back to the civilization, Parrot tells Dolphin and Max about the election for king and both Dolphin and Max tell Parrot that they will vote for him. Parrot, Wifies, Horace and Dean work on the civilization over the course of the next few hours and Parrot works on a garden before logging off. The next day, Parrot notices the castle's interior has been finished along with a village. Wifies tells Parrot that he noticed a crater while he was at recon with Dean. Boosfer tells them that loyalty is a figment of your imagination and leaves. 

Upon returning to the civilization, 4CVIT returns to the civilization impressed about how much has changed since he was last there. After destroying all three bomber planes they have a meeting about how they can make the civilization stronger. Parrot tells Horace to build a dome with water. 4CVIT tells Parrot he has to leave to check on something so Parrot sends him out and gets 4 people to make sure that nothing fishy is going on. Parrot opens another meeting telling everyone about The Mafia tampering with the end portal. The people didn't mind getting trapped in the end as long as nothing happens to the civilization.

title: I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization
content:
I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization is the 8th episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

Plot
The episode starts off with PrinceZam summoning Wemmbu to his castle in the Zam Empire for a meeting. PrinceZam tells him that since he helped Wemmbu ban SpokeIsHere, the villain of the server, off, Wemmbu still owes him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to build him a colony of the Zam Empire to guard a vault he has. He also gives Wemmbu lots of materials to build the empire, and tells him to not go into the vault. Wemmbu gives PrinceZam all of his elytras to make space in his ender chest.

Wemmbu heads to the coordinates PrinceZam sent him, located on the top of a big hill in a plains biome. The vault is under a red tulip and when he digs down, he finds a big obsidian box, but doesn’t go in it. He gets started on building a town hall for the colony, but realizes that he doesn’t have the necessary skills to make a good-looking build, so just builds a starter wooden house which he calls the shed.

Another key factor Wemmbu would need to create a colony would be people to live in it, so he invites one of his friends, Eggchan, to help him establish it. He meets Egg and they head to his house near spawn, but find that it’s been blown up. Having a new source of motivation to grow this colony since they’re now homeless, Wemmbu and Egg get to work on a new pumpkin farm and storage room for all of the shulkers of materials under the shed.

Wemmbu soon discovers that Egg isn’t very good at Minecraft, so he heads into the nether to gather materials for an ender pearl stasis chamber in case anything goes wrong. He sets both of their stases in the room below the shed and shows Egg how to use it. He starts farming the pumpkin farm when FlameFrags, one of PrinceZam’s guards, arrives at the colony. What was weird was that Flame wasn’t wearing his Zam Empire armor or shield. He starts attacking Wemmbu, who stasises away into the shed’s underground bunker where Egg is waiting for him. 

They form a plan, where Egg will go out to lure Flame to the underground bunker, where Wemmbu will set up traps of TNT for him. He gives Egg his combat kit and a crash course on how to survive PVPing someone. Using the TNT minecarts, they escape and Flame leaves the colony. Wemmbu is dismayed when he finds out that Egg broke the entirety of his god set, leaving them broke with nothing but a blown up colony. The shulker box with all of the redstone in it was also blown up.

He shows Egg the vault PrinceZam asked him to guard, and Egg wants to look inside of it, but Wemmbu doesn’t let him. He theorizes that that’s why Flame came to the colony. They build a villager breeder, a block of campfires, and a two block high obsidian wall as a defense around the central area of the colony. Wemmbu starts a raid to obtain more totems. They also make a dripstone trap in front of the shed, a TNT minecart trap at the entrance, and start regearing their armor. Another player called C4CorvetteOwner is invited into their colony, but later leaves.

Later, a big group of rather undergeared players, LettuceK, Twirps, Spongs, youri_mc, Falconu, and Jaden_MAN, which FlameFrags ordered to kill them show up. They engage in a big fight and eventually chase the players away, winning the battle thanks to Wemmbu’s elytra. However, the battle left them with an even more blown up colony. The strange thing was that no one tried to get into the obsidian vault. Their only goal seemed to be to kill Wemmbu. Since the situation seems to be suspicious, Egg suggests cutting them off from the Zam Empire, but Wemmbu tells him that it’s a bad idea and gives him a history lesson on the Zam Empire. 

Both Egg and Wemmbu suck at building, so they invite a professional builder called Horace_Altman to give feedback on their work. After a few minutes of being criticized by him, Wemmbu gives up and just hires him for twelve emeralds to build them a real colony using the materials in their shulker boxes. 

The next day, Wemmbu and Egg return to the colony to find that Horace built an entire castle as the center of the town and an entire village at the base of the hill just like the Zam Empire. They pay him twelve more emeralds to make other renovations to the colony and add another town hall. 

They start recruiting residents in their colony and their first recruit is TheRealSquiddo, who was previously chunk banned by Wemmbu. He is surprised to see her and asks her how she managed to get unbanned. Squiddo tells him that she just logged on and ended up outside of a prison unbanned. When they are heading up to the castle, they see a message in chat that ClownPierce has logged on. Wemmbu notices that ParrotX2 is also online and explains to Egg that ClownPierce is one of the people who are at FlameFrag’s skill level. They then recruit another two resident, Dione4K and Block_Facts to their colony. 

They return to the castle and a while later, spot two players in full netherite landing in the town square, one invis, who is Parrot, and the other, ClownPierce. He lands at the castle and asks them about Parrot’s whereabouts. He starts looking around the castle as Wemmbu receives a message from Parrot saying “help me.” Once Clown leaves to look for Parrot, he reveals himself and asks for help. Wemmbu tells him to hide in the villager breeder, but Clown returns and starts killing all of his villagers, somehow sensing that Parrot is in there. Eventually, Clown goes away. 

Parrot tells them that Clown was hired by PrinceZam to assassinate him. They go to the shed’s underground bulker to talk. Clown blew up Wifies's house and jumped Parrot and Wifies. Parrot had gotten Wifies and a bunch of Spoke’s henchmen out of the chunk bans, which was why Zam had put a bounty on his head. Wemmbu realizes that that was how Squiddo had gotten out, and that Parrot had basically undid weeks of work. Wemmbu tells him that he is with Zam, and Parrot immediately gets out of the shed. Wemmbu tells him that he trusts Zam, but Parrot questions it and Wemmbu finds out that Spoke isn’t chunk banned anymore. He decides to let Parrot go, and Parrot tells him that he could free Fantst, one of Spoke’s underlings in a chunk ban, and get him to join their colony. 

Before they can go free Fantst, PrinceZam and two of his guards, ManePear and Merffinn, show up and ask for an update on how things are going. Wemmbu tells him everything and asks why FlameFrags attacked them and why ClownPierce was hunting Parrot. PrinceZam says that Flame betrayed them but says nothing about Clown. He checks the vault and tells Wemmbu that he is glad that no one broke into the vault. He leaves ManePear and Merffinn at the colony to protect them. 

They successfully free Fantst from the chunk ban and recruit him as a resident of their colony. While at the chunk ban, they find rekrap2's base nearby, Parrot and the rest of his prison-breaking team's headquarters. They find two sets of god armor and lots of OP items. They take everything of use from that base and get stacked from the loot. They make another vault below the first one under the shed to store all of their stuff. Wemmbu sends Egg a railgun tutorial to build one as a defense using all of the redstone they gained, as well as terraform a hill to hide it. Egg starts building a gold farm, so Wemmbu goes to check it out. 

Horace messages Wemmbu to head back to their colony. When they arrive, they see that Horace built giant wall at least thirty blocks tall around the entire colony, as well as sprawling farms and a town hall. Later, ManePear and Merffinn ask to see all of their traps, but at night, Wemmbu catches them tampering and rigging the railgun so that it wouldn’t work. He stays undercover and doesn’t interrupt them to not raise any suspicions. In the morning, while the guards are logged off, they check the railgun and find that they weren’t very discreet in sabotaging it. 

After recruiting another resident called Spepticle to their colony, Wemmbu takes Egg to the castle and tells him about the guards’ sabotage. Egg tells him that since this happened, there was no reason not to look into the vault. The guards had moved the auto-loader and left wood blocks on the machine. Egg then asks why they wouldn’t want them to kill FlameFrags. After checking the other traps, it seems that the guards hadn’t touched anything else. Wemmbu wants to ask PrinceZam about this, but Egg convinces him not to because then PrinceZam wouldn’t tell him anything, and he would also know. Egg wants them to trust Parrot instead of PrinceZam, and most important of all, to look in the vault. Wemmbu lets Egg check the vault and says that if they get caught, they could just blame it on Dione. However, they discover the vault is empty. 

Egg says that they are virtually useless because there is nothing that they’re guarding. Either PrinceZam is an awful emperor, or that they don’t know everything. Now Wemmbu is questioning everything they’ve worked for. Egg proposes that they get information out of the guards, since they probably know what’s going on. 

Wemmbu and Egg go about minding their own business, until Parrot shows up again, this time asking for their protection. He says that he had joined another team, made up of Leow0ok, JumperWho, Derapchu, and WoogieX, whose only goal was to kill ClownPierce, but they didn’t care about his safety at all, so he left them. The Wemmbu civilization was now the only team on the server that could protect him. Wemmbu agrees to take him in because if he tells ManePear and Merffinn that Parrot joined their colony, if ClownPierce and FlameFrags showed up at their doorstep right after, then that would confirm everything about Zam. 

Wemmbu also asks Parrot to build other traps, since ManePear and Merffinn already found all of the defenses they have. Parrot builds them a chunk ban trap to defend against invaders. Wemmbu tells him that they won’t risk the entire Wemmbu civilization for keeping Parrot safe, but they will try to protect him. He also explains why the Wemmbu civilization was created in the first place. Parrot goes to start building the chunk bans while Wemmbu and Egg gear up the citizens.

They grab all of the PVP kits they have and bring everyone to the town hall, as well as a new citizen called expchan. Wemmbu makes amends with Fantst and Fantst tells him that Parrot is trustworthy. He gathers everyone and tells them not to trust ManePear and Merffinn, to ignore them, Parrot is building chunk ban traps called flycatchers, so don’t go near them, and that ClownPierce and FlameFrags may be showing up at any moment.

Merffinn finally log back on and Wemmbu gives them an update on the empire, making sure to tell them that Parrot is now a citizen in the Wemmbu civilization. 

A while later, Wemmbu and Egg spot Parrot frantically flying towards them. He tells them that there are people at the front gate who are planning to attack them. Jaden_MAN was chunk banned, but there were still more than they were comfortable with, so they gather all of the citizens and head to the gate, where FlameFrags, Falconu, LettuceK, Spongs, and an invis player that was most definitely ClownPierce. They build a TNT cannon to shoot at them, but don’t have a daylight sensor, so the cannon blows up. Eventually the enemies find out that they can pearl in, so a battle ensues in the city walls, where the crop fields get bombed. 

Parrot has to dip and regear mid fight because his boots broke, but eventually, they manage to chase their opponents away. Wemmbu proclaims it as a victory as no one dropped, even though they’re drained of resources and half the town is bombed. Once they restock, Parrot thanks them for their help and leaves to mind his own business, while Wemmbu and Egg start brainstorming ways to get rid of FlameFrags. 

Wemmbu and Egg start discussing what had just happened when out of nowhere, FlameFrags appears at the top of the hill, pots up, and starts attacking. He takes the fight to a nearby ocean monument to try and stall Flame, but the elder guardian, a crucial part of his plan, despawns, leaving Wemmbu helpless and without rockets. They return to the colony, where Egg distracts Flame while Wemmbu escapes with a nearly broken trident. However, when Egg got away, Flame finds Wemmbu and starts attacking once again. Just when Wemmbu is about to drop, Flame stops attacking and lets him live, leaving for some unknown reason. Wemmbu and Egg return and group up at the castle, finding PrinceZam, Sorhin, Merffinn, and FlameFrags waiting for them. 

PrinceZam, as always asks for a tour, so Wemmbu shows him everything. He then exposes Zam for everything that he’s done to the Wemmbu civilization, but this time, Zam doesn’t make anything up or try lie to him. PrinceZam tells Wemmbu that Flame was working to kill him under his orders all along, and that now, he doesn’t consider Wemmbu as a big enough threat to actually do anything, so he orders his guards to blow up the empire. PrinceZam tells him that he is unbelievably weak, so much so that he should just get out of the Zam Empire’s way. Wemmbu responds that this was just PrinceZam’s way to laugh not being able to stop the weakest player on the server, Parrot, from breaking into his prisons and freeing everyone that was chunk banned, and that ClownPierce had already failed at killing Parrot. 

As Wemmbu and PrinceZam stand there watching the colony blow up, Wemmbu tells him that PrinceZam had made a big mistake in underestimating him.
