'''I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization''' is the 8th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].  

==Plot==
The episode starts off with [[PrinceZam]] summoning [[Wemmbu]] to his castle in the [[Zam Empire]] for a meeting. PrinceZam tells him that since he helped Wemmbu ban [[SpokeIsHere]], the villain of the server, off, Wemmbu still owes him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to build him a [[Wemmbu's Civilization|colony]] of the Zam Empire to guard a vault he has. He also gives Wemmbu lots of materials to build the empire, and tells him to not go into the vault. Wemmbu gives PrinceZam all of his elytras to make space in his ender chest.

Wemmbu heads to the coordinates PrinceZam sent him, located on the top of a big hill in a plains biome. The vault is under a red tulip and when he digs down, he finds a big obsidian box, but doesn’t go in it. He gets started on building a town hall for the colony, but realizes that he doesn’t have the necessary skills to make a good-looking build, so just builds a starter wooden house which he calls the shed.

Another key factor Wemmbu would need to create a colony would be people to live in it, so he invites one of his friends, [[Eggchan]], to help him establish it. He meets Egg and they head to his house near [[spawn]], but find that it’s been blown up. Having a new source of motivation to grow this colony since they’re now homeless, Wemmbu and Egg get to work on a new pumpkin farm and storage room for all of the shulkers of materials under the shed.

Wemmbu soon discovers that Egg isn’t very good at Minecraft, so he heads into the nether to gather materials for an ender pearl stasis chamber in case anything goes wrong. He sets both of their stases in the room below the shed and shows Egg how to use it. He starts farming the pumpkin farm when [[FlameFrags]], one of PrinceZam’s guards, arrives at the colony. What was weird was that Flame wasn’t wearing his Zam Empire armor or shield. He starts attacking Wemmbu, who stasises away into the shed’s underground bunker where Egg is waiting for him. 

They form a plan, where Egg will go out to lure Flame to the underground bunker, where Wemmbu will set up traps of TNT for him. He gives Egg his combat kit and a crash course on how to survive PVPing someone. Using the TNT minecarts, they escape and Flame leaves the colony. Wemmbu is dismayed when he finds out that Egg broke the entirety of his god set, leaving them broke with nothing but a blown up colony. The shulker box with all of the redstone in it was also blown up.

He shows Egg the vault PrinceZam asked him to guard, and Egg wants to look inside of it, but Wemmbu doesn’t let him. He theorizes that that’s why Flame came to the colony. They build a villager breeder, a block of campfires, and a two block high obsidian wall as a defense around the central area of the colony. Wemmbu starts a raid to obtain more totems. They also make a dripstone trap in front of the shed, a TNT minecart trap at the entrance, and start regearing their armor. Another player called C4CorvetteOwner is invited into their colony, but later leaves.

Later, a big group of rather undergeared players, [[LettuceK]], Twirps, [[Spongs]], [[YouriMC|youri_mc]], [[Falcuno|Falconu]], and [[Jaden_MAN]], which FlameFrags ordered to kill them show up. They engage in a big fight and eventually chase the players away, winning the battle thanks to Wemmbu’s elytra. However, the battle left them with an even more blown up colony. The strange thing was that no one tried to get into the obsidian vault. Their only goal seemed to be to kill Wemmbu. Since the situation seems to be suspicious, Egg suggests cutting them off from the Zam Empire, but Wemmbu tells him that it’s a bad idea and gives him a history lesson on the Zam Empire. 

Both Egg and Wemmbu suck at building, so they invite a professional builder called [[Horace_Altman]] to give feedback on their work. After a few minutes of being criticized by him, Wemmbu gives up and just hires him for twelve emeralds to build them a real colony using the materials in their shulker boxes. 

The next day, Wemmbu and Egg return to the colony to find that Horace built an entire castle as the center of the town and an entire village at the base of the hill just like the Zam Empire. They pay him twelve more emeralds to make other renovations to the colony and add another town hall. 

They start recruiting residents in their colony and their first recruit is [[TheRealSquiddo]], who was previously [[Chunk ban|chunk banned]] by Wemmbu. He is surprised to see her and asks her how she managed to get unbanned. Squiddo tells him that she just logged on and ended up outside of a prison unbanned. When they are heading up to the castle, they see a message in chat that [[ClownPierce]] has logged on. Wemmbu notices that [[ParrotX2]] is also online and explains to Egg that ClownPierce is one of the people who are at FlameFrag’s skill level. They then recruit another two resident, Dione4K and [[Block_Facts]] to their colony. 

They return to the castle and a while later, spot two players in full netherite landing in the town square, one invis, who is Parrot, and the other, ClownPierce. He lands at the castle and asks them about Parrot’s whereabouts. He starts looking around the castle as Wemmbu receives a message from Parrot saying “help me.” Once Clown leaves to look for Parrot, he reveals himself and asks for help. Wemmbu tells him to hide in the villager breeder, but Clown returns and starts killing all of his villagers, somehow sensing that Parrot is in there. Eventually, Clown goes away. 

Parrot tells them that Clown was hired by PrinceZam to assassinate him. They go to the shed’s underground bulker to talk. Clown blew up [[Wifies|Wifies's]] house and jumped Parrot and Wifies. Parrot had gotten Wifies and a bunch of Spoke’s henchmen out of the chunk bans, which was why Zam had put a bounty on his head. Wemmbu realizes that that was how Squiddo had gotten out, and that Parrot had basically undid weeks of work. Wemmbu tells him that he is with Zam, and Parrot immediately gets out of the shed. Wemmbu tells him that he trusts Zam, but Parrot questions it and Wemmbu finds out that Spoke isn’t chunk banned anymore. He decides to let Parrot go, and Parrot tells him that he could free [[Fantst]], one of Spoke’s underlings in a chunk ban, and get him to join their colony. 

Before they can go free Fantst, PrinceZam and two of his guards, [[ManePear]] and [[Merffinn]], show up and ask for an update on how things are going. Wemmbu tells him everything and asks why FlameFrags attacked them and why ClownPierce was hunting Parrot. PrinceZam says that Flame betrayed them but says nothing about Clown. He checks the vault and tells Wemmbu that he is glad that no one broke into the vault. He leaves ManePear and Merffinn at the colony to protect them. 

They successfully free Fantst from the chunk ban and recruit him as a resident of their colony. While at the chunk ban, they find [[Rekrap2|rekrap2's]] base nearby, Parrot and the rest of his [[I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison|prison-breaking team's]] headquarters. They find two sets of god armor and lots of OP items. They take everything of use from that base and get stacked from the loot. They make another vault below the first one under the shed to store all of their stuff. Wemmbu sends Egg a railgun tutorial to build one as a defense using all of the redstone they gained, as well as terraform a hill to hide it. Egg starts building a gold farm, so Wemmbu goes to check it out. 

Horace messages Wemmbu to head back to their colony. When they arrive, they see that Horace built giant wall at least thirty blocks tall around the entire colony, as well as sprawling farms and a town hall. Later, ManePear and Merffinn ask to see all of their traps, but at night, Wemmbu catches them tampering and rigging the railgun so that it wouldn’t work. He stays undercover and doesn’t interrupt them to not raise any suspicions. In the morning, while the guards are logged off, they check the railgun and find that they weren’t very discreet in sabotaging it. 

After recruiting another resident called [[Spepticle]] to their colony, Wemmbu takes Egg to the castle and tells him about the guards’ sabotage. Egg tells him that since this happened, there was no reason not to look into the vault. The guards had moved the auto-loader and left wood blocks on the machine. Egg then asks why they wouldn’t want them to kill FlameFrags. After checking the other traps, it seems that the guards hadn’t touched anything else. Wemmbu wants to ask PrinceZam about this, but Egg convinces him not to because then PrinceZam wouldn’t tell him anything, and he would also know. Egg wants them to trust Parrot instead of PrinceZam, and most important of all, to look in the vault. Wemmbu lets Egg check the vault and says that if they get caught, they could just blame it on Dione. However, they discover the vault is empty. 

Egg says that they are virtually useless because there is nothing that they’re guarding. Either PrinceZam is an awful emperor, or that they don’t know everything. Now Wemmbu is questioning everything they’ve worked for. Egg proposes that they get information out of the guards, since they probably know what’s going on. 

Wemmbu and Egg go about minding their own business, until Parrot shows up again, this time asking for their protection. He says that he had joined another team, made up of [[Leow0ok]], [[JumperWho]], [[Derapchu]], and [[Woogiex|WoogieX]], whose only goal was to kill ClownPierce, but they didn’t care about his safety at all, so he left them. The Wemmbu civilization was now the only team on the server that could protect him. Wemmbu agrees to take him in because if he tells ManePear and Merffinn that Parrot joined their colony, if ClownPierce and FlameFrags showed up at their doorstep right after, then that would confirm everything about Zam. 

Wemmbu also asks Parrot to build other traps, since ManePear and Merffinn already found all of the defenses they have. Parrot builds them a chunk ban trap to defend against invaders. Wemmbu tells him that they won’t risk the entire Wemmbu civilization for keeping Parrot safe, but they will try to protect him. He also explains why the Wemmbu civilization was created in the first place. Parrot goes to start building the chunk bans while Wemmbu and Egg gear up the citizens.

They grab all of the PVP kits they have and bring everyone to the town hall, as well as a new citizen called [[expchan]]. Wemmbu makes amends with Fantst and Fantst tells him that Parrot is trustworthy. He gathers everyone and tells them not to trust ManePear and Merffinn, to ignore them, Parrot is building chunk ban traps called flycatchers, so don’t go near them, and that ClownPierce and FlameFrags may be showing up at any moment.

Merffinn finally log back on and Wemmbu gives them an update on the empire, making sure to tell them that Parrot is now a citizen in the Wemmbu civilization. 

A while later, Wemmbu and Egg spot Parrot frantically flying towards them. He tells them that there are people at the front gate who are planning to attack them. Jaden_MAN was chunk banned, but there were still more than they were comfortable with, so they gather all of the citizens and head to the gate, where FlameFrags, Falconu, LettuceK, Spongs, and an invis player that was most definitely ClownPierce. They build a TNT cannon to shoot at them, but don’t have a daylight sensor, so the cannon blows up. Eventually the enemies find out that they can pearl in, so a battle ensues in the city walls, where the crop fields get bombed. 

Parrot has to dip and regear mid fight because his boots broke, but eventually, they manage to chase their opponents away. Wemmbu proclaims it as a victory as no one dropped, even though they’re drained of resources and half the town is bombed. Once they restock, Parrot thanks them for their help and leaves to mind his own business, while Wemmbu and Egg start brainstorming ways to get rid of FlameFrags. 

Wemmbu and Egg start discussing what had just happened when out of nowhere, FlameFrags appears at the top of the hill, pots up, and starts attacking. He takes the fight to a nearby ocean monument to try and stall Flame, but the elder guardian, a crucial part of his plan, despawns, leaving Wemmbu helpless and without rockets. They return to the colony, where Egg distracts Flame while Wemmbu escapes with a nearly broken trident. However, when Egg got away, Flame finds Wemmbu and starts attacking once again. Just when Wemmbu is about to drop, Flame stops attacking and lets him live, leaving for some unknown reason. Wemmbu and Egg return and group up at the castle, finding PrinceZam, [[Sorhin]], Merffinn, and FlameFrags waiting for them. 

PrinceZam, as always asks for a tour, so Wemmbu shows him everything. He then exposes Zam for everything that he’s done to the Wemmbu civilization, but this time, Zam doesn’t make anything up or try lie to him. PrinceZam tells Wemmbu that Flame was working to kill him under his orders all along, and that now, he doesn’t consider Wemmbu as a big enough threat to actually do anything, so he orders his guards to blow up the empire. PrinceZam tells him that he is unbelievably weak, so much so that he should just get out of the Zam Empire’s way. Wemmbu responds that this was just PrinceZam’s way to laugh not being able to stop the weakest player on the server, Parrot, from breaking into his prisons and freeing everyone that was chunk banned, and that ClownPierce had already failed at killing Parrot. 

As Wemmbu and PrinceZam stand there watching the colony blow up, Wemmbu tells him that PrinceZam had made a big mistake in underestimating him.

title: I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army
content:
I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army is the 129th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Parrot begins the episode by explaining that In five days, the Cindercrest army is going to invade his kingdom. As the king of Unstable, Parrot will do everything in his power to stop them, so he has to garner an army to fight back. Luckily for him, there's always tens of thousands of players online at all time, and his goal is to create one bigger than any of the ones in the past.

As of now, it's not going to be easy to gather up that many players. His only teammates are his friends TheobaldTheBird and ReinaDrop. They were drained out of all their resources after traveling back from their failed Skymore Civilization. They follow a trail down to Merchant City, but is stopped by a group of bandits who stop them to rob them out of their gear. Parrot begs to let them free, the leader of the bandits, RocketBandit3 says they're on his land now. Parrot threatens them by bringing Theo up and says he can 20v1 them, but they see right through them. RocketBandit hits Parrot down to half a heart, he panics, then asks them to join his army, in which they'll get far more gear and food than if they were to kill him right there. RocketBandit agrees so, as well as the others. He holds a small speech and tells all the bandits he's willing to let any bandit join his army as long as they promise not to steal or hurt anyone else. RocketBandit tells Parrot he can bring him to the bandit base.

The army goes up to the front of the bandit base, Parrot asks to see the bandit king and the guards tell him to leave. Parrot tells them he has an offer the king can't refuse, so they let him in and threatens him if he tries anything. He goes up to the king, OutlawAndrew, and tells him about Cindercrest and how they're going to try and take back their land and asks the bandits for a helping hand. Andrew laughs and says they take things by force. Parrot makes an offer; his best warrior fights their best warrior, and picks Theo to fight. Andrew tells Parrot he knows who Theo is, and since they're on his land, they play by his rules and makes Parrot choose somebody else. Parrot chooses Reina to fight, Theo yells at Parrot and tells him he sold by picking her. Andrew accepts Reina as Parrot's fighter and gets his fighter, ralamus, to come forward. They go to the fighting arena, Parrot gives Reina a trident and tells her she can beat him. As Andrew counts down for the fight to start, Reina throws the trident, which causes dripstone to fall and kill ralamus. The crowd is completely silent while Theo cheers for Reina. Parrot goes up to Andrew and welcomes him to the army.

Parrot gets to Merchant City with his army, his next plan is to hire the Merchant City Vanguard. They stop at the gates, the guards tell Parrot they're not allowed to come in with the bandits. Parrot is allowed to come in alone and convinces the guards to let Theo and Reina come with him. Parrot goes to DanchoGold and requests 150,000 diamonds and 300 of his men with a 3:1 return. Dancho laughs and reminds Parrot that he's still in debt to him and knows he's uncapable of paying that back, and so, he gets his guards to surround them and arrest Parrot. Parrot gives Theo the sigh to cart them and take Dancho hostage, which was their plan all along to try and get the vanguard on their side. They get out of the building and see the entire vanguard spread across Merchant City, they have to get Dancho out safely. Parrot and Theo tell the vanguard to back up otherwise they kill Dancho. Parrot tells the guards holding the gate to open it, the guards tell him if they kill Dancho, they'll drop down and kill him. Parrot tells the vanguard that if they join his army, once the war is over, he'll let Dancho free. One of the players speaks up and says if Dancho is dead, they won't have to work for him anymore, which changed all of their minds and likes the idea of killing him. Dancho gets on a stray horse and runs away, adding 300 more playing to Parrot's army.

The next part of Parrot's plan is to head over to the Nether and talk to ClownPierce. Theo is skeptical about it, but Parrot says it's the only way to get resources for his army. Before Parrot goes through, he tells Theo and Reina to set up base where the bandit base was. Parrot explains that the Nether is a dangerous dimension that's controlled by Clown and usually anyone who tries to enter the Nether is killed. Since Parrot is the king, they made an exception for him. Parrot tells Clown the reason why he's here, Cindercrest is going to invade his army and he wants to buy 40,000 TNT from Clown. Clown reminds Parrot that he raided his vault half a year ago and asks what he could possibly be doing with that much TNT. Parrot says it doesn't matter and asks how much he owes him. Clown says it's typically 20,000, but he triples the price for all the damages of his vault. Parrot knows Clown is scamming and begins to head off to buy from someone else. Clown says Cindercrest is already departing and will arrive to his kingdom in less than 24 hours and says he hopes he finds someone else fast. Parrot thinks Clown is bluffing, and Clown says he's more fitting to be a jester than a king. He goes on and says Cindercrest came to him and bought loads of items from him as well, and if he doesn't have the gear to fight back, he's not going to win. Parrot gives in and gives Clown all of the diamonds. Parrot goes to follow the guards, Clown stops him and says he wasn't originally a fan of Parrot opening up spawn, but thinks it's one of the best decisions he's ever made. Clown then tells Parrot he's always welcome to come back to buy something, but if he ever comes to the Nether for any reason besides that, he's going to kill him.

Now that he has the resources to grow his army, Parrot is unsure if there was enough time. Parrot tells his army the bad news, he tells Theo he spent all the funds to buy 40,000 TNT, which Theo is shook by, and Reina reassures him that Parrot has a plan. He doesn't know if Clown was actually telling the truth, so he tasks Theo and Reina to scout them out. Parrot has a plan for the rest of his army, he believes he can grow the army to 10,000 players with the help of the army. While that's happening, Theo and Reina headed deeper into Cindercrest territory. They go through biome after biome, until they reach a snowy biome where they hear the horn being blown. They see a massive blimp flying towards the direction of spawn and hundreds, if not thousands of players in full netherite walking the same direction. Reina looks up and sees two players standing on top of the blimp, Theo sees them and notices that it's FlameFrags and ShoeBilly. Theo accidentally places water and it falls down the hill, two Cindercrest members notices it and inspects it, Theo and Reina hide right below their feet, and the players don't see anybody. Theo and Reina head back to spawn once the coast is clear. 

With Cindercrest arriving to Parrot's kingdom in less than a day, Parrot goes to the next place to recruit more players. They head to The Law's base, who was once the biggest army on the server. Even after the war against The Law, they still had a thousand soldiers, which was double than Parrot's army. Getting Law wasn't about getting more players, it was more so about the gear they had to supply thousands of players. Parrot keeps his army behind while he walks up to SargeLAW. Sarge tells him to leave before Parrot could explain himself. Parrot tells him what he's told everyone else, Cindercrest is coming to invade his kingdom and they're going to kill all of the new players. Sarge says he believes Parrot, but is going to join Cindercrest. Parrot asks Sarge to join them, but he's reluctant and says no, so Parrot walks past him and asks the lawmen to make a decision to either join him, or if they stay on Sarge's side, he assumes they're going to join Cindercrest and will have no other choice than to kill them. Tons of lawmen join Parrot's side, Parrot begs for anymore to come up and join him. Parrot says he doesn't want to kill everyone, Sarge says Theo isn't there with him and they don't have a chance to win the fight. Parrot asks RocketBandit if everything was setup, and RocketBandit says it's ready. Parrot readies his bow and shoots at a target, which blows up the entire front of the base and kills off a ton of the remaining lawmen who were on Cindercrest's side. A battle breaks out between Parrot's and SargeLAW's army, in the end, Parrot's army has won and they looted the entirety of the base. 

With all of the gear and players from The Law, Parrot can grow his army big enough to defeat Cindercrest. He goes back to spawn to expand the army as fast as possible. It cuts to more cinematic scenes, over at spawn, players can choose to live in Capitol City or join the army, players build up a new path that directs whoever wants to join the army to another castle where all of the gear is. Players are farming, mining a massive chunk, practice fighting, and much more. Parrot is writing in a book when Theo and Reina come back and tells him that they're cooked. Parrot doesn't say anything about that and says they came back in time since he was just about to give a speech to his army. The episode ends as Parrot tells them to follow him, Theo says if they're going to fight back, they're going to need thousands, Parrot says they're going to need tens of thousands and shows them the massive army he was able to garner up, even Fymada shows up with her own group of players to join the army.

 Trivia 

 The video's title with A/B testing will either show it as I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army or I Created the World's Largest Army. This may be subject to change.
 ReinaDrop's pov is shown in this video.
 Starting from Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing, every protagonist uploaded 2 days apart from each other up until this video.

Clown says Cindercrest is already departing and will arrive to his kingdom in less than 24 hours and says he hopes he finds someone else fast. Parrot thinks Clown is bluffing, and Clown says he's more fitting to be a jester than a king. He goes on and says Cindercrest came to him and bought loads of items from him as well, and if he doesn't have the gear to fight back, he's not going to win. Parrot gives in and gives Clown all of the diamonds. Parrot goes to follow the guards, Clown stops him and says he wasn't originally a fan of Parrot opening up spawn, but thinks it's one of the best decisions he's ever made. Clown then tells Parrot he's always welcome to come back to buy something, but if he ever comes to the Nether for any reason besides that, he's going to kill him.

Now that he has the resources to grow his army, Parrot is unsure if there was enough time. Parrot tells his army the bad news, he tells Theo he spent all the funds to buy 40,000 TNT, which Theo is shook by, and Reina reassures him that Parrot has a plan. He doesn't know if Clown was actually telling the truth, so he tasks Theo and Reina to scout them out. Parrot has a plan for the rest of his army, he believes he can grow the army to 10,000 players with the help of the army. While that's happening, Theo and Reina headed deeper into Cindercrest territory. They go through biome after biome, until they reach a snowy biome where they hear the horn being blown. They see a massive blimp flying towards the direction of spawn and hundreds, if not thousands of players in full netherite walking the same direction. Reina looks up and sees two players standing on top of the blimp, Theo sees them and notices that it's [[FlameFrags]] and [[ShoeBilly]]. Theo accidentally places water and it falls down the hill, two Cindercrest members notices it and inspects it, Theo and Reina hide right below their feet, and the players don't see anybody. Theo and Reina head back to spawn once the coast is clear. 

With Cindercrest arriving to Parrot's kingdom in less than a day, Parrot goes to the next place to recruit more players. They head to [[The Law]]'s base, who was once the biggest army on the server. Even after the war against The Law, they still had a thousand soldiers, which was double than Parrot's army. Getting Law wasn't about getting more players, it was more so about the gear they had to supply thousands of players. Parrot keeps his army behind while he walks up to [[SargeLAW]]. Sarge tells him to leave before Parrot could explain himself. Parrot tells him what he's told everyone else, Cindercrest is coming to invade his kingdom and they're going to kill all of the new players. Sarge says he believes Parrot, but is going to join Cindercrest. Parrot asks Sarge to join them, but he's reluctant and says no, so Parrot walks past him and asks the lawmen to make a decision to either join him, or if they stay on Sarge's side, he assumes they're going to join Cindercrest and will have no other choice than to kill them. Tons of lawmen join Parrot's side, Parrot begs for anymore to come up and join him. Parrot says he doesn't want to kill everyone, Sarge says Theo isn't there with him and they don't have a chance to win the fight. Parrot asks RocketBandit if everything was setup, and RocketBandit says it's ready. Parrot readies his bow and shoots at a target, which blows up the entire front of the base and kills off a ton of the remaining lawmen who were on Cindercrest's side. A battle breaks out between Parrot's and SargeLAW's army, in the end, Parrot's army has won and they looted the entirety of the base. 

With all of the gear and players from The Law, Parrot can grow his army big enough to defeat Cindercrest. He goes back to spawn to expand the army as fast as possible. It cuts to more cinematic scenes, over at spawn, players can choose to live in [[Capitol City (Season 2)|Capitol City]] or join the army, players build up a new path that directs whoever wants to join the army to another castle where all of the gear is. Players are farming, mining a massive chunk, practice fighting, and much more. Parrot is writing in a book when Theo and Reina come back and tells him that they're cooked. Parrot doesn't say anything about that and says they came back in time since he was just about to give a speech to his army. The episode ends as Parrot tells them to follow him, Theo says if they're going to fight back, they're going to need thousands, Parrot says they're going to need tens of thousands and shows them the massive army he was able to garner up, even [[Fymada]] shows up with her own group of players to join the army.

== Trivia ==

* The video's title with A/B testing will either show it as I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army or I Created the World's Largest Army. This may be subject to change.
* ReinaDrop's pov is shown in this video.
* Starting from [[Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing]], every protagonist uploaded 2 days apart from each other up until this video.

title: I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization
content:
I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization is the 20th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The episode begins with Wemmbu emulating skyblock in Spawn until he saw 3 invisible players flying to Skyblock Civilization. Wemmbu begins exploring until he finds Pangi. Pangi tells Wemmbu that he has to take him to Jaron since they kill outsiders. Jaron tells Wemmbu that the civilization is supposed to be private and he's heard a few things about Wemmbu and also states that if he doesn't become a citizen they have to kill him. Wemmbu attempts to escape the civilization but gets caught by Straight. Straight tells him he will kill him if he leaves. He then takes Wemmbu to Jaron and tells promises that he will always watch him. 

Pangi takes Wemmbu to the farms of the civilization and teaches him how to work on those farms and store them in storage rooms. Wemmbu and Pangi work on the farms while other civilians just watch. After a while Straight returns to check up on Wemmbu and tells him that he will be watching over him. Pangi tells Straight that Wemmbu was talking trash about him and that he can beat him in a fight. Wemmbu begins complaining to Straight that he's an incredibly skilled PvPer forcing him to do these tasks. Their argument comes to an end when Straight tells Wemmbu to 1v1 him. If Wemmbu wins, he can leave but if Straight wins, Wemmbu has to stop complaining about the city.

Wemmbu enters the colosseum where he would do a sumo duel with Straight. They both get their inventories cleared up and make it to the platform where they would begin their 1v1. Wemmbu attempts to combo Straight to the edge but Straight gains the upper hand and wins the 1v1. 

Wemmbu and Wato have a conversation on how they ended up in Skyblock Civilization. Wemmbu explains that he followed 3 invisible players and didn't think he would get stuck against his will. Wato explains that he joined to hide from ClownPierce since he betrayed him by refusing to respawn the ender dragon after Wemmbu and PrinceZam solved the escape room. Wemmbu asks if Wato can leave in which he responds by saying that normal citizens like him can leave but they are in war time. 

They head to Wato's secret home and Wato gives him a tour around his home. Wemmbu goes back to grinding materials until Pangi shows up again. Pangi tells Wemmbu he has to take a break and shows him his house. He shows him around his house and then shows him around his house. Wemmbu finds Pangi's basement which was in progress. Wemmbu and Wato throw a bunch of eggs to hatch chickens where they would then make noise to cover up villagers. Pangi returns and they continue working on their basement. 

As they work on the basement, Straight returns and takes Wato to the castle to see Jaron. Wemmbu follows Wato and Straight secretly to eavesdrop in their conversation. They discuss about why Wato shouldn't do any meaningless tasks and instead do something impactful. Jaron tells Wato to go on a scouting mission to clear the airspace to prevent more people entering the civilization without any notice so they have likely left something behind. Wemmbu interrupts their conversation and states that they in fact did leave something behind and mentions what happened before he ended up in Skyblock Civilization. Wemmbu then tells them to take him to the mission with them so that he can show them the skyblock island at spawn.     

They set their stasises for Wato to pull when they are done and pearl onto spawn. Wemmbu finds an ender chest and he gears up. He shows Straight and Jaron the skyblock island where he was playing skyblock on until three invisible players show up on the island. The iron trimmed player tells them that they are "investigating" the island. Wemmbu, Straight and Jaron pot up and begin attacking the invisible players. One of them dies from fall damage. During the fight, Straight kills the iron trim while the other no trim runs away. They return to the island and destroy it. Before Wato pulls the stasis, Wemmbu asks Jaron why the civilization doesn't have villagers; Jaron tells Wemmbu that they don't need villagers because they are only obtainable outside of skyblock. Jaron believes its fun without villagers and they don't need any. Wemmbu tells them that he wants to leave Skyblock Civilization and he has the items to leave; if Straight hunts him down he can just ruin the economy. Straight tells Wemmbu that he can kill him quickly. Wemmbu, realizing he has no other choice puts all his items into his ender chest but he smuggles 6 ender chests.      

Wato pulls their stasis chambers and Wemmbu heads to Pangi's basement along with Wato to show him what he had smuggled but Straight follows them the entire time and watches them. Wato distracts Straight by telling him about the stasis chambers and the security of the Skyblock Civilization and he tells him to destroy the stasis chamber. Straight leaves to do so leaving Wemmbu and Wato alone. Wemmbu finally shows Wato the ender chests that he had smuggled on their mission; Wato is impressed and also warns Wemmbu about showcasing items that "aren't obtainable" in Skyblock Civilization.         

Pangi enters Wemmbu's house and tries to take them to a drowned farm that he had been working on. Wemmbu and Wato try to reject the offer because they were worried that Straight will get mad; they then proceed because they feel bad for Pangi. Pangi gives them cobblestone slabs to fill up the top of the farm. As they finish, they continue hanging out with Pangi. Wemmbu and Wato have a discussion about the unobtainable items. Wemmbu tells Wato that he will spy on Jaron with invisibility. After their discussion, Wemmbu goes to visit Loppezz and her snow civilization. Wemmbu tells them that he will only join if they help him distract Jaron.            

Wemmbu tries to break in to the castle only to find Straight. Straight interrogates Wemmbu about his motives for sneaking in. Wemmbu lies to him stating that he's helping Jaron integrate a new feature in the castle and Jaron doesn't want anyone else to know. Wemmbu tells Straight that he can ask Wato about it. After Straight leaves, Wemmbu warns Wato that Straight is going to interrogate him before breaking into the castle. Wemmbu uses invisibility while hiding on the ceiling of the meeting room. During meeting Jaron discusses about the invisible players and finding out where they reside by leaving one alive. Straight gets dismissed and Jaron begins placing shulkers, presumably the unobtainable items. Wemmbu leaves the castle and goes back to his house where he has another meeting with Wato.              

 Trivia 

 This video shows that the height limit is higher than regular on Unstable.
 Wemmbu's elytra was enchanted in the beginning, but became unenchanted in the next scene when he lands in Sky Civilization.

title: I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension
content:
I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension is the 76th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The episode starts off with Wemmbu entering the Nether and immediately getting hit into a void trap made by Boosfer. Quickly thinking, he pearls up and makes it back up and starts attacking Boosfer. Wemmbu manages to knock Boosfer down the trap, but Boosfer uses a fishing rod to lure Wemmbu down with him. Rather than taking damage from the void, the two fall down to a new dimension underneath the Nether. They are not able to break or place blocks inside of this dimension. 

Wemmbu starts to explore the dimension and finds a player riding a Happy Ghast, and starts to follow them. Eventually the player and their Happy Ghast gets low enough to the ground for Wemmbu to hit, Wemmbu gets on the Happy Ghast and steals it, he uses it to explore a bit more. Wemmbu discovers a tower with brewing stands and potion materials, allowing him to brew invisibility potions and fighting potions. 

Three soul keepers come to the tower with Happy Ghasts as well, Boosfer is seen being held hostage by them. They try to imprison Wemmbu as well, but this causes a fight to start. The soul keepers run away, Wemmbu explores further and finds a giant castle with cages with players inside of them in front. Wemmbu sneaks into the castle and eavesdrops on Boosfer talking to the soul keepers. When they leave, Wemmbu tries to get Boosfer to drop his mace, Boosfer talking alerts the soul keepers and they begin to fight again. They trap Wemmbu in a corner since he isn't able to break blocks and begins to break his armor. Wemmbu surrenders and lets them imprison him. A few soul keepers then leave to find more Happy Ghasts.

Wemmbu and Boosfer talk, and Boosfer uses a pearl he smuggled and teleports out of the cage. They make a truce to help each other escape the dimension. Boosfer gives Wemmbu his mace and a pearl to get out the cage. Wemmbu jumps a soul keeper and kills one of them. Wemmbu and Boosfer explore the castle for loot. The two stumble across a gold block that makes their game lag, it is unknown if this block has a purpose.

They go back to the tower from earlier, Wemmbu convinces Boosfer that they would work together to get out, instead he attacks Boosfer trying to get the pearls from him. Boosfer says if Wemmbu doesn't kill him, he'll actually help get them both out of here. They sneak back to the big castle using invisibility potions, their plan was to steal a Happy Ghast and get out of there, but Boosfer was spotted. They still manage to get on a Happy Ghast, but the soul keepers are able to catch up to them. When they get to where the void trap was set, they find a base built by the soul keepers there. They use their pearls to glitch through the bedrock without having to use the void trap to avoid being seen. Boosfer manages to get back up, and he goes to regear while Wemmbu fights off the soul keepers. Boosfer comes back with wind charges and experience for Wemmbu, allowing him to be able to use the mace. Once Wemmbu killed their leader, the rest retreat. Wemmbu and Boosfer get back up, escaping this dimension.

Boosfer asks Wemmbu if he's going to kill him now, instead, Wemmbu gives Boosfer his mace back and tells him not to leak his identity. Boosfer agrees not to, and promises to not attack Capital City either as a truce for not banning him. The episode ends with Wemmbu splashing himself with invisibility, hiding his identity once again.

 Trivia 

 In Wemmbu's previous video, Boosfer can be heard cheering as Wemmbu takes damage at the end. However, neither Boosfer laughing or the rapid damage ticks can be heard at the beginning of this video.

title: I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands
content:
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands is the is the 53rd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 

The video begins with Wemmbu going to where Eggchan logged off due to him rejoining the server. Sharpness tells Wemmbu to fight him and he proceeds in doing so. Sharpness places a pot and steals one of Wemmbu's maces and runs away. Wemmbu tries chasing him but he teleports away using an ender pearl stasis chamber. Wemmbu asks a bunch of people if they know where Sharpness which didn't go well until he asked 4CVIT. 4CVIT tells Wemmbu he was commissioned to make a pearl cannon by Sharpness. 4CVIT takes Wemmbu and Eggchan to the pearl cannon where they teleport to the beginning of the farlands.

Wemmbu and Eggchan begin exploring the farlands until they spot Sharpness next to the Far Lands City. During their fight, Sharpness goes into a barely intact house in the city where he then begins breach swapping. Wemmbu and Eggchan begin destroying the entire house for more space. Sharpness replaces the broken blocks while trying to dodge Wemmbu's mace hits which at first doesn't go well but he successfully blocks them. Wemmbu grabs spare TNT to blow up the house and they begin fighting under the house. Wemmbu and Sharpness fight in a confined tunnel. Sharpness almost kills Wemmbu but he escapes with the help of Eggchan and Sharpness leaves. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan notice that firework rockets don't no longer work and their ender chests are empty so Wemmbu uses wind charges instead. They notice a house and some glitched chests however the chests don't have anything valuable so they continue exploring. As they continue exploring, they notice more glitched terrain as well as glitched versions of old structures. They notice another house this time with someone living in it. They ask the person if they knew where Sharpness was. After struggling to interact with him they finally got a lead to where Sharpness could be and begin heading to the direction. As soon as they arrive they see a completely intact version of Zam Empire. They begin exploring the empire until they find another strange thing. Ghost players resembling Pangi, ManePear, FlameFrags, Sorhin and PrinceZam. It appears that PrinceZam is ranking them up. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan continue exploring to find resources until Sharpness begins macing Wemmbu. They have another fight however Sharpness enters another house. Wemmbu's plays passive as his helmet was about to break. After his helmet breaks Wemmbu goes to the edge of the farlands to go back to the surface of the farlands. They begin fighting on the surface but since Wemmbu almost died a few times, he puts his mace in his ender chest. Sharpness gets annoyed by that and tells him that he will do a rematch in 30 minutes. Sharpness breaks Wemmbu's ender chest and leaves.

'''I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands''' is the is the 53rd episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Plot ==

The video begins with [[Wemmbu]] going to where [[Eggchan]] logged off due to him rejoining the server. [[Conexion|Sharpness]] tells Wemmbu to fight him and he proceeds in doing so. Sharpness places a pot and steals one of Wemmbu's maces and runs away. Wemmbu tries chasing him but he teleports away using an ender pearl stasis chamber. Wemmbu asks a bunch of people if they know where Sharpness which didn't go well until he asked [[4CVIT]]. 4CVIT tells Wemmbu he was commissioned to make a pearl cannon by Sharpness. 4CVIT takes Wemmbu and Eggchan to the pearl cannon where they teleport to the beginning of the farlands.

Wemmbu and Eggchan begin exploring the farlands until they spot Sharpness next to the [[Far Lands|Far Lands City]]. During their fight, Sharpness goes into a barely intact house in the city where he then begins breach swapping. Wemmbu and Eggchan begin destroying the entire house for more space. Sharpness replaces the broken blocks while trying to dodge Wemmbu's mace hits which at first doesn't go well but he successfully blocks them. Wemmbu grabs spare TNT to blow up the house and they begin fighting under the house. Wemmbu and Sharpness fight in a confined tunnel. Sharpness almost kills Wemmbu but he escapes with the help of Eggchan and Sharpness leaves. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan notice that firework rockets don't no longer work and their ender chests are empty so Wemmbu uses wind charges instead. They notice a house and some glitched chests however the chests don't have anything valuable so they continue exploring. As they continue exploring, they notice more glitched terrain as well as glitched versions of old structures. They notice another house this time with someone living in it. They ask the person if they knew where Sharpness was. After struggling to interact with him they finally got a lead to where Sharpness could be and begin heading to the direction. As soon as they arrive they see a completely intact version of [[Zam Empire]]. They begin exploring the empire until they find another strange thing. Ghost players resembling [[Pangi]], [[ManePear]], [[FlameFrags]], [[Sorhin]] and [[PrinceZam]]. It appears that PrinceZam is ranking them up. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan continue exploring to find resources until Sharpness begins macing Wemmbu. They have another fight however Sharpness enters another house. Wemmbu's plays passive as his helmet was about to break. After his helmet breaks Wemmbu goes to the edge of the farlands to go back to the surface of the farlands. title: I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Fartherlands
content:
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Fartherlands is the 54th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Wemmbu and Eggchan begin obtaining more resources to survive the farlands and they get attacked by a group named called The Avengers, consisting of all of Wemmbu's past enemies (FlameFrags, Spongs, Willsion, Jaden MAN, Wyll, Fantst and Baablu). Wemmbu begins hiding until Fantst finds him. Wemmbu successfully escapes and they give up.

Wemmbu and Eggchan continue exploring for more gear. They find a dungeon but there isn't anything useful. Soon, the pair notice more strange terrain generation, though this time it is just gravel with some grass on the surface. As they traverse through the gravel lands, they see a different place with spiky mountains in the distance. They explore it until they see another ghost player replaying their death to starvation. Wemmbu continues exploring until his elytra breaks, so he chooses to walk since he now has no way of flying. They reach the end of the spiky mountains biome and find a continuation of the gravel lands. This time there are more trees and life to it. In the center of the biome, they find a ginormous golden temple with five large statues standing ominously along the path to its entrance.

As they enter the temple, Wemmbu and Eggchan are met with two people. Wemmbu punches them to make sure they are real people and not ghosts, and he finds that they are in fact real people. With this knowledge, he proceeds to rob them for their food and resources. Wemmbu asks the player if he has any XP since they are being hunted. The player gives Wemmbu his boots instead, however, they're only enchanted with protection one. He also tells Wemmbu that Lakerek has some items from The Forge and he would give it if Wemmbu wins against him in a fight.  

The player then wakes up Lakerek who proceeds to attack Wemmbu. During their fight, a massive pit opens up and they begin fighting in the pit. They continue their fight as usual until Lakerek gives Wemmbu golden apples and XP bottles to mend his armour. Little did he know it was to prepare him for the next stage of his fight. Lakerek begins firing orbital strikes on Wemmbu. After surviving the orbital strikes and restocking afterwards, Wemmbu and Lakerek continue fighting. Lakerek gives up as he can no longer fire orbital strikes and he lets Wemmbu kill him. He then returns to Eggchan and mxsterwu (the player who introduced Wemmbu to The Forge) and he kills mxsterwu as well and he loots them both.

Wemmbu and Eggchan get jumped by the players who had attacked them earlier however, Spongs had weaker gear along with FlameFrags, Sharpness and Jaden MAN being absent. After a while, everyone leaves except for Fantst who is getting mercilessly attacked by Wemmbu. Fantst tells Wemmbu that he has info about his mace and he know about the mace because Sharpness is in his team. Fantst gives Wemmbu his boots and Eggchan his shield. Wemmbu and Eggchan leave the temple and go back to the mountain spikes biome. 

They get attacked by FlameFrags and Jaden MAN again, and the entire team eventually joins in and tries to kill them again. Sharpness and Wyll begin fighting each other while also fighting Wemmbu and the entire fight becomes chaotic as everyone is trying to kill each other. FlameFrags also gets jumped by the team giving Wemmbu an opportunity to team with him. As the fight endures, Eggchan gives Wemmbu and FlameFrags some shulkers that they had which had some armour. Wemmbu and FlameFrags try to kill Sharpness but he leaves. FlameFrags gives Wemmbu his mace back telling him that he doesn't need it. Eggchan tells Wemmbu that the shulkers he gave them were from their secret hideout. Wemmbu tells them that they aren't going to leave the farlands because they have to find The Forge.

title: I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void
content:
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void is the 60th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode begins with Wemmbu and Eggchan find a city in the void however, they get attacked by it's citizens using TNT cannons. Wemmbu begins fighting Nitenly as he was the one firing the TNT cannons Nitenly gets confronted by a player named Serpentbound333. Serpentbound brings Wemmbu and Eggchan to a dorm while they have a meeting and their dorm is being guarded by another player named GeeGeeGamer. Eggchan notices that the whole floor is TNT and they will get blown up if they try to escape. They find out that the TNT trap was defunct and leave the dorm as GeeGeeGamer had stopped guarding it. 

They explore the city and find an arena and a potion brewer along with an armoury with a lot of rare items and some villagers which are extinct on the regular Unstable SMP. They loot the armoury and get attacked by Nitenly once again. They have a battle in the arena until Serpentbound confronts him again. Serpentbound decides to allow Wemmbu to take anything and ask him any question he wants since he's afraid of him. Wemmbu asks Serpentbound if the city was The Forge but he states that it isn't. Serpentbound asks Wemmbu and Eggchan what they like to do; Wemmbu tells him that he loves PvPing people who are skilled and Eggchan tells him that he loves building. Serpentbound tells GeeGeeGamer to tour him around his place since he loves building as well.

GeeGeeGamer shows Wemmbu and Eggchan his place. The textures get replaced by classic Minecraft textures to show the feel of old Minecraft while GeeGeeGamer tours them. Wemmbu tells GeeGeeGamer to tell him where The Forge is or else he will die because he knows that they are just trying to distract them. GeeGeeGamer responds, telling him that only the fighters know where The Forge is and that he only builds. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan head back to their dorm where Nitenly gives them both PvP kits with netherite armour enchanted with thorns. Wemmbu keeps his diamond armour because he doesn't want thorns or frost walker. They continue exploring the city until they find more villagers. They trade with the villagers to get the ideal netherite armour set. They also find chests of maces which Wemmbu burns because he doesn't want anyone matching his power. They also find every trim and loot some trims. 

Firestar2008 interrupts them and asks Wemmbu if he could teach him PvP because he wants to get good at it. They head to Firestar's room where Wemmbu tells him that he will teach him PvP as long as he tells him where The Forge is after. Wemmbu does a brief "lesson" and pops Firestar's totem and then tells Firestar to reveal where The Forge is but Firestar refuses as he wants Wemmbu to teach him more. Firestar begins bothering Wemmbu telling him to give him his mace to try to replicate what Wemmbu does and also pearl catches a few times. Wemmbu tells Eggchan to duel Firestar and Firestar begins winning the fight and Wemmbu gets impatient so he pops Firestar's totem and demands that he tells him where The Forge is. Firestar reveals that he didn't know what The Forge was and he told him he knew just so that he could teach him PvP. Wemmbu and Eggchan head out but Firestar tells them that they could look around Lakerek's room as they may find the forge there. As they look around Lakerek's room, he tells them that his room has been emptied since he died and Wemmbu begins crashing out on him for taking them to an empty room and they leave.

Wemmbu crafts invisibility potions to spy on Serpentbound's meeting with Nitenly but they don't seem to be talking about anything interesting until Serpentbound tells Nitenly that he can just wait before Wemmbu and Eggchan leave before going to The Forge. Wemmbu's invisibility starts to run out so he hides before gearing up and leaving. Eggchan explains to Wemmbu that while Firestar was bothering him in Lakerek's room, he found a puzzle and he got a lodestone compass after solving it. They gather blocks before bridging and following the lodestone compass. 

They make it back to the farlands where they find a bunch of repeating orbital strike cannons. Wemmbu realizes that this was how Lakerek was able to strike him during the fight. They decide to test it but the tickrate increases which speeds everything up for them when they tick the lever. Wemmbu makes an observation stating that this could be how Lakerek was able to bypass the delay on orbital strikes. Wemmbu decides to finally test it but he cannot load chunks as he needs to go to the nether to unload chunks, but he cannot go to the nether. Eggchan tells Wemmbu to make a stasis chamber and set his render and simulation distance to the bare minimum, activate the tickrate machine and set his fishing rod. Eggchan then teleports Wemmbu using the stasis and they test the orbital strike cannon. After a successful test, they return to the orbital strike cannons and Wemmbu notices that the time isn't getting altered anymore so they return to check up on it only to get confronted by Serpentbound, GeeGeeGamer and Nitenly. Wemmbu claims that the orbital strike cannons was The Forge. Serpentbound tells him that it isn't The Forge and that he does know where The Forge is. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan follow them and they make it to Lakerek's room in the city. They make it to the top of the staircase and find an end portal. Serpentbound tells Wemmbu that The Forge is on the other side of the portal and GeeGeeGamer aims a punch bow at Wemmbu during their conversation. Eggchan notices GeeGeeGamer pointing the bow and as he shoots, Eggchan takes the arrow and gets sent into the end portal. Wemmbu realizes that the entire thing was a trap as Nitenly attempts to hit Wemmbu in and they have a fight. During their fight, Wemmbu gets hit with slow falling and he also doesn't have strength giving him a disadvantage. They eventually run out of slow falling making the fight easier for Wemmbu. Wemmbu kills GeeGeeGamer and attempts to kill Nitenly but he escapes along with Firestar. Serpentbound tells Wemmbu that they can work something out. Wemmbu tells Serpentbound to set the orbital strike cannons and Serpentbound takes Wemmbu back to the end portal in Lakerek's room and pushes him in the portal.

title: I Explored a Deserted Minecraft Civilization
content:
I Explored a Deserted Minecraft Civilization is the 33rd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode begins with Jaden_MAN demanding that Wemmbu and eggchan throw a pearl into his pearl cannon, launching their pearl towards the Pirate Islands, teleporting both of them in there. Wemmbu begins exploring until he sees a player who accuses Wemmbu of trying to steal his food and attacks him. He kills the player's friend and steals her weapons. He then fights the player and kill him. Wemmbu begins exploring and taking their food until he sees another island. He sets sail to the island and finds eggchan in a cell. One of the people who had imprisoned eggchan asks him if he has any items. Wemmbu distracts him and kills his entire group while eggchan escapes.

Wemmbu and eggchan begin mining to find ores however, during their mining trip, they have found no ores. Wemmbu begins digging straight down but he receives mining fatigue. Wemmbu and eggchan go to a random hut to store their items. Eggchan digs down and actually finds a room with 2 golden apples and a totem of undying. 

Wemmbu and eggchan continue exploring and they find an "abandoned" house. Eggchan digs down again and finds a base with an enchanting table. They also find a trial chamber however, the vaults were destroyed. They loot the chests and pots from the trial chamber. They go fishing again and sail to another island that appears to be inhabited.  

As they sail to the island, Wemmbu and eggchan two people in diamond armour fishing. Wemmbu breaks in to their house and attempts to rob them but there aren't any items to steal. They go down a ladder and find an ice circuit. They get caught by LettuceK who chases them. Soon after, they get chased by loppezz. Wemmbu escapes and enters the house again where he would pull a lever which emits a glass barrier. Loppezz states that if he breaks any glass block the house blows up. Wemmbu uses this as an advantage as he demands loppezz and LettuceK to drop all their items and uses that as leverage. 

They return to the underground ice road circuit. As they explore, Wemmbu finds a room with a massive trident but he doesn't think much of it and returns to his home island with eggchan to upgrade his armour. title: I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization
content:
I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization is the 36th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The video begins with Wemmbu falling into the massive pit that Jaden had fallen into with the intent to find and kill Jaden. Wemmbu receives mining fatigue as he falls in and eggchan follows him. They search a village to find better armour since Wemmbu's armour is almost broken, harvest chorus fruit. Wemmbu and eggchan try to have a better view of the civilization to find any structure that may have potentially good gear. Wemmbu spots a castle and decides to go visit it until he finds a pillar and notices that Jaden is trying to escape. Wemmbu chases Jaden to try to kill him. Jaden fires back and as his bow is more effective than Wemmbu's trident, he digs up the pillar after realizing that his mining fatigue was wearing off. Since Jaden's helmet broke, he had to stop pillaring which left Wemmbu a chance to seal the hole. Wemmbu then fights Jaden on a vine to try to kill him and end this once and for all. Jaden manages to knock Wemmbu and eggchan off the vines. 

Wemmbu and eggchan continue exploring to find Jaden. Eggchan spots a spire and they explore the spire. Eggchan takes a lore book about the spire from a lectern with a redstone comparator which activates a warden trap. They manage to escape the wardens and reach the top of the spire where they meet Rejoicin. Wemmbu asks Rejoicin if he had seen Jaden. He tells Wemmbu that he had seen him and points to an armoury. Rejoicin explains that he is also protecting the civilization from The Mafia but they've been disbanded. He then leads Wemmbu and eggchan to an ice boat road which leads to the armoury. They find the armoury and spot Jaden pretending to be afk without any armour. They try to jump Jaden and kill him but he equips his armour and fights Wemmbu. During the fight, Jaden nearly kills Wemmbu. They enter a building and Wemmbu finds out that Jaden was trapped behind two doors with mining fatigue and no TNT, making it hard to escape. Wemmbu taunts him and places more blocks to give him a harder time to escape.   

Wemmbu and eggchan begin exploring the armoury to find any gear to survive Jaden. They search through an abandoned villager trading hall and find a shulker box of enchanted books. They use the enchanted books to enchant their armour with protection. They begin plotting on how they can kill Jaden since he's trapped in a confined space and eggchan suggests that they use wardens to kill him. After some searching, they find out that there are wardens in the castle. The wardens get angry and chase them down which serves as an opportunity to lure them to Jaden. They finally make it to where Jaden was trapped but they find out that he escaped. The wardens continue chasing them and Wemmbu kills them using his mace. Eggchan tells Wemmbu about a vault of treasure that can be used to defeat Jaden. Wemmbu doubts him as he believes that there is nothing better than a mace.   

They continue exploring the civilization and find a warped forest. They find Loppezz in the forest and Wemmbu kills most of her pigs for food. Loppezz tells Wemmbu and eggchan about her life in the forest after Jaden had banished her into the abandoned civilization and they decide to team up with her to defeat Jaden. Eggchan tells Wemmbu that he found an underground storage area with gold blocks but loppezz places the gold blocks. They head back to the armoury to get apples to craft golden apples. Loppezz finds the place where Jaden was trapped and they chorus through the wall and find elder guardians that are actively being transported through rails giving the entire civilization mining fatigue. Loppezz used this as a great opportunity to find Jaden; if he was in these transportation stations, there would be empty minecarts. Wemmbu became impatient and decided to look for Jaden himself.    

Eventually, Wemmbu finds Jaden killing elder guardians and ambushes him. Wemmbu falls into a hole and as he gets back up, he notices Jaden in the same hole. He ends up popping Jaden's totem with his mace and Jaden traps them both with cobwebs after his helmet breaks. They continue fighting despite both being trapped in cobwebs in a 1x1 area until they decide to pause the fight to break a cobweb. They resume the fight after Jaden breaks a cobweb. They decide to continue to try to get out until they find out that Jaden has a flint and steel and they were surrounded by wool. Wemmbu and Jaden continue fighting but eventually Wemmbu runs away since he had ran out of food and his boots were about to break. He grabs some raw cod from the elder guardians that Jaden had been killing. Wemmbu manages to escape but Jaden also escapes using chorus fruit and begins fighting him. Wemmbu's boots break during the fight. Wemmbu finds the spire again and Jaden gets distracted by Rejoicin. Wemmbu tries to get inside of the spire using chorus fruit and Jaden finds him. Rejoicin gives Wemmbu golden apples and tries to settle their beef. Jaden attacks Rejoicin and Rejoicin helps Wemmbu by splashing him with strength and speed to try to kill Jaden. Jaden climbs into a staircase and Rejoicin warns Wemmbu not to follow him as there are wardens. Jaden manages to leave the warden spawning facility and Wemmbu had failed to escape using chorus fruits however, by the time he actually managed to escape, it was already too late.     

As Wemmbu and Rejoicin return to the forest they decide to plan on how they can corner Jaden and kill him due to him always finding a way out of bad situations. Wemmbu expects loppezz and eggchan to actually make some progress but they have been making songs with note blocks the entire time and they made a house with the blocks from the parkour course. They all trim their armour and hunt for Jaden. They all search for Jaden and eventually find a stone cube with tons of wardens. They all manage to enter the stone cube successfully fighting Jaden. Wemmbu on the other hand gets unlucky with his chorus fruit so he decides to mine instead. As he finally breaks in, he joins the fight. Wemmbu manages to break Jaden's helmet but he wears a spare helmet. Jaden begins unleashing the wardens unraveling chaos inside the stone cube. They try to fight back, but the wardens are too much for them. Jaden escapes the stone cube while Rejoicin fights for his life while getting beaten up by a bunch of wardens. Wemmbu tries to help him out by killing the wardens but its too late as Rejoicin's helmet and leggings break, and he gets killed by the wardens. Wemmbu picks up some of Rejoicin's items before attempting to escape using chorus fruit, but the chorus fruit is no use.      

He exits by using a hole he found continues to fight Jaden. He doesn't talk during the entire fight after what happened to Rejoicin. Jaden taunts Wemmbu during the fight, eggchan and loppezz try to help Wemmbu but Jaden begins using his mace. They make it to the castle and eggchan suggests that they elevate themselves through the water. They seal themselves inside the warden spawning cage they found while going up the water. As they walk into a corridor, Wemmbu suggests that there's a shulker box on the other side of the room that is sealed with cobblestone. Eggchan and loppezz manage to break in and blow up the cobblestone, allowing Wemmbu to enter the room as well. Wemmbu opens the shulker box and finds an elytra and fireworks. Jaden attacks them again but this time, Wemmbu finally has a chance to kill him. They have a fight and Wemmbu eventually pops all of Jaden's totems and he begins teasing Jaden. Wemmbu promises to let Jaden out as long as he drops all his items. Wemmbu then burns all the items Jaden dropped and gets his mace back. He decides to let Jaden live because Rejoicin didn't want to kill but rather to negotiate peace and he also gives Jaden food so that he doesn't die soon and destroys all the chorus fruit so that there is no way of escaping. He tells eggchan and loppezz that he's done with Jaden and they all leave him in the abandoned civilization.       

 Trivia

title: I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
content:
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands is the 108th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode starts with Wemmbu and eggchan teleporting negative twelve million blocks out on the X-axis, compared to the positive twelve million out on the Z-axis. They find JamatoP's house located from afar and see the tombstone made for him and decides to rob his house. Jamato shows up at the front door and ask what they are doing out in the Far Lands, Wemmbu tells him they're there to meet the OG players that lived out there. Jamato is surprised that Wemmbu knows about them and says that nobody knows about those players, he then tells Wemmbu to press F3 and show that he's on the opposite side of the world from where they're trying to go. Jamato asks if they used their stasis, but egg says they used their last pearls to get back, Jamato says there's another way there and tells them to follow him. They start towering up the Far Lands, as soon as Jamato and Wemmbu make it up top, Wemmbu asks Jamato if he has any spare blocks and knocks Jamato down while he's distracted. Wemmbu secretly tells egg that they have a problem, he promised Serpentbound that he wouldn't return back to their base, so they plan on betraying Jamato once they get there.

Wemmbu asks how they're actually going to get there, Jamato says Nether portals used to work at a very specific coordinates and can travel super fast. After traveling 10,000 blocks, they make it to a forest full of mushrooms with a portal built inside of the massive tree. Jamato says to keep on path or else they'd set off traps, Wemmbu spots a small bridge that's off path and says they could go there, Jamato says not to. They stop at a few monuments and take a look, Wemmbu sees a build that resembles the underworld and brings it up, Jamato says he's not supposed to know about that place and that it's a bad place. Wemmbu and egg walk on the grass back on the path, but the defense mechanism had already set off, summoning multiple withers. Wemmbu's elytra is broken and bows them down. Down to the last wither, Jamato allows Wemmbu to kill it on his own to mend his elytra. Before heading into the Nether, Jamato says to stay behind him and let him do the talking. Wemmbu tells egg to be cautious, in case he thinks the people on the other side are the Soulkeepers that he had killed in the past. 

In the Nether, they're stuck in the portal and are unable to break blocks, one of the soulkeepers named Soulkeeper67 comes breaking the glass and Jamato tells him they're heading to Serpentbound's kingdom, and he leads the three to another portal nearby. On the other side, they make it to the decayed area of the Far Lands, Jamato says they have to bridge out a few more thousand blocks, but Wemmbu says this is where they part ways. Jamato immediately realizes that Wemmbu was never friends with the Far Lands people and calls him like the rest of them. Wemmbu tells Jamato to go back through the portal, Jamato asks how Wemmbu actually knows about Serpentbound, as he doesn't trust Wemmbu, and Wemmbu stays silent. Jamato pots up and sprints towards Wemmbu and the two fight, Wemmbu pops Jamato multiple times, and Jamato teleports away instantly. 

Wemmbu says they have to bridge the other way to avoid the Far Lands people from knowing they're back. Egg bridges first, but makes Wemmbu bridge after a bit to give time to think. In the distance, Nitenly comes bridging fast with swift sneak. He starts shooting them with crossbows with fireworks. They continue bridging up to the desert temple for a platform to stand on. Wemmbu hits two consecutive mace hits on Nitenly, causing him to fly off, Wemmbu chases him down and maces him, preventing Nitenly from landing back on blocks. Wemmbu and Nitenly then go all the way back down to the decayed area, Wemmbu breaks one of the cobblestone that was placed, Nitenly leaps forward into the void and stasises out. Wemmbu loots the temple quickly and they begin bridging more. They see one of the other players, Firestar, who was actually Serpentbound on his account. He tells the two to leave the premises, Wemmbu says to rethink his decision and reminds him of the last time they fought. Firestar stasises away, Wemmbu and egg uses the time to load up on orbital strikes. Egg then gives Wemmbu a fishing rod that would activate a stasis bmack to the orbital strikes if he ever needed more, then they head over to a stronghold outside. Egg stands in the middle and begins filling in the portal, Wemmbu stops him before the last one gets put in, since The Law may be waiting out there. '''I Explored the Minecraft Farlands''' is the 108th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Plot ==
The episode starts with [[Wemmbu]] and [[eggchan]] teleporting negative twelve million blocks out on the X-axis, compared to the positive twelve million out on the Z-axis. They find [[JamatoP]]'s house located from afar and see the tombstone made for him and decides to rob his house. Jamato shows up at the front door and ask what they are doing out in the [[Far Lands]], Wemmbu tells him they're there to meet the OG players that lived out there. Jamato is surprised that Wemmbu knows about them and says that nobody knows about those players, he then tells Wemmbu to press F3 and show that he's on the opposite side of the world from where they're trying to go. Jamato asks if they used their stasis, but egg says they used their last pearls to get back, Jamato says there's another way there and tells them to follow him. They start towering up the Far Lands, as soon as Jamato and Wemmbu make it up top, Wemmbu asks Jamato if he has any spare blocks and knocks Jamato down while he's distracted. Wemmbu secretly tells egg that they have a problem, he promised [[Serpentbound333|Serpentbound]] that he wouldn't return back to their base, so they plan on betraying Jamato once they get there.

Wemmbu asks how they're actually going to get there, Jamato says Nether portals used to work at a very specific coordinates and can travel super fast. After traveling 10,000 blocks, they make it to a forest full of mushrooms with a portal built inside of the massive tree. Jamato says to keep on path or else they'd set off traps, Wemmbu spots a small bridge that's off path and says they could go there, Jamato says not to. They stop at a few monuments and take a look, Wemmbu sees a build that resembles the underworld and brings it up, Jamato says he's not supposed to know about that place and that it's a bad place. Wemmbu and egg walk on the grass back on the path, but the defense mechanism had already set off, summoning multiple withers. Wemmbu's elytra is broken and bows them down. Down to the last wither, Jamato allows Wemmbu to kill it on his own to mend his elytra. Before heading into the Nether, Jamato says to stay behind him and let him do the talking. Wemmbu tells egg to be cautious, in case he thinks the people on the other side are the Soulkeepers that he had killed in the past. 

In the Nether, they're stuck in the portal and are unable to break blocks, one of the soulkeepers named Soulkeeper67 comes breaking the glass and Jamato tells him they're heading to Serpentbound's kingdom, and he leads the three to another portal nearby. On the other side, they make it to the decayed area of the Far Lands, Jamato says they have to bridge out a few more thousand blocks, but Wemmbu says this is where they part ways. Jamato immediately realizes that Wemmbu was never friends with the Far Lands people and calls him like the rest of them. Wemmbu tells Jamato to go back through the portal, Jamato asks how Wemmbu actually knows about Serpentbound, as he doesn't trust Wemmbu, and Wemmbu stays silent. Jamato pots up and sprints towards Wemmbu and the two fight, Wemmbu pops Jamato multiple times, and Jamato teleports away instantly. 

Wemmbu says they have to bridge the other way to avoid the Far Lands people from knowing they're back. Egg bridges first, but makes Wemmbu bridge after a bit to give time to think. In the distance, Nitenly comes bridging fast with swift sneak. He starts shooting them with crossbows with fireworks. They continue bridging up to the desert temple for a platform to stand on. Wemmbu hits two consecutive mace hits on Nitenly, causing him to fly off, Wemmbu chases him down and maces him, preventing Nitenly from landing back on blocks. Wemmbu and Nitenly then go all the way back down to the decayed area, Wemmbu breaks one of the cobblestone that was placed, Nitenly leaps forward into the void and stasises out. Wemmbu loots the temple quickly and they begin bridging more. They see one of the other players, Firestar, who was actually Serpentbound on his account. He tells the two to leave the premises, Wemmbu says to rethink his decision and reminds him of the last time they fought. Firestar stasises away, Wemmbu and egg uses the time to load up on orbital strikes. Egg then gives Wemmbu a fishing rod that would activate a stasis bmack to the orbital strikes if he ever needed more, then they head over to a stronghold outside. Wemmbu mentions how they might see [[MinuteTech]] if they head back to the End, but also remembers that [[The LAW|The Law]] took the dimension over. Egg stands in the middle and begins filling in the portal, Wemmbu stops him before the last one gets put in, since The Law may be waiting out there. He takes out a few stab shots, intending on using it on any lawmen if he has to. The episode ends with Wemmbu jumping into the end portal.
