title: I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea
content:
I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea is the 97th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
After the events of the previous episode, Jaden says that he knows Lettuce is hunting Wemmbu and offers him safety to help the Pirates fight off The Law, since he also dislikes the idea of Unstable having a king. Wemmbu agrees to the deal, bringing eggchan along, Jaden asks for the riptide tridents that the lawmen dropped before heading off to Pirate City. Jaden tells them to gear up in the market while he talks to his scouts, and so Wemmbu and egg go off and explore the market. However, the merchants there didn't sell supplies for battle, egg gets scammed over water breathing potions, then they head to Jaden's meeting room, he tells them that The Law had started making an outpost at the start of the Great Sea and are shipping redstone materials, planning on making a different version of the Orbital Strike Cannon that is way more powerful and destructive. The cannon needs all the discs for the encoder to tell it where to shoot, and luckily because of the mob cap, it's impossible to get any new discs and they aren't able to finish it, there are rumors of the Great Sea having a rare item collector with a full set of discs. Jaden wants Wemmbu and egg to find this person, Wemmbu asks why they can't just destroy the cannon themselves, Jaden says that The Law outnumbers them twenty to one.

The two head off and egg suggests they buy custom boats that have a few extra utilities to travel the Great Sea, and so they buy a small custom boat with extra storage and an anchor, then they head out into the sea to explore while the other Pirates siege The Law. Three hours later, they have yet to find anything, egg suggests looking at the islands that Wemmbu explored from his previous adventure, their first stop is at an island full of frog lovers. They ask the civilians if they know anything about a rare item collector, but none of them have any idea. Egg points out how they have slimeballs, which is a rare item due to the mob cap, and so they start threatening the frog people to know where they got the slimeballs from. While interrogating, a death message shows up with Lettuce's name, which means he was nearby, so Wemmbu and egg go hide. Wemmbu sees that Lettuce is alone and has the chance to assassinate him right then and there, so he uses the opportunity to jump Lettuce, however it backfires when he blows the horn and the lawmen invade the island. Wemmbu instructs egg to get to the boat and sail off, Wemmbu finds the leader of the island and have them point to the direction of where the rare item collector may be, he gets to the boat while the lawmen are swimming closer to them, but Lettuce tells them to let them go.

Back into the vast emptiness of the sea, they get stopped by a group of bandits who apparently have been looking for Wemmbu for over a year due to the "tree incident". They demand Wemmbu and egg to drop their items, while egg does so, Wemmbu doesn't and the bandits start shooting them with crossbows and Wemmbu fights back. Wemmbu then realizes that the leader of this group, DaFroDo, was from the old team of Pirates when Jaden and Wemmbu were still enemies and they robbed Wemmbu's civilization. DaFroDo tries to boat off, but egg shoots his boat down and Wemmbu asks for clues on where they could get slimeballs from, and he tells them about a floating marketplace nearby. They take him hostage until they get to the marketplace, DaFroDo escapes while they were messing around, but they let him go since they already made it to the marketplace.

The marketplace appeared to be deserted until they find a tavern named The Floating Parrot that is booming with players. Wemmbu finds Jaden there, Wemmbu thought he was busy sieging The Law, but Jaden says that they needed to restock. Wemmbu and Jaden talk about their progress, Jaden says that they found the island that the cannon is being built, and Wemmbu has a lead on the rare item collector that lead to the marketplace, but it was closed so people could do other things on the server. Jaden tells them to hurry as the cannon could be finished soon, the marketplace opens as Wemmbu and egg leave. They find a player that sells slime, Wemmbu asks how much slime would cost, and the seller says a stack would cost both of their armor sets. Although they weren't there to buy slime, they ask who their supplier is and they refuse to tell because they would go out of business. They dangle the seller above a pit of lava to get answers out of the seller, which they say the seller comes invisible and doesn't know the name, and egg burns their supplies. While that is happening, Wemmbu spots an invisible player running around the marketplace and chases them. He tries to kill the invisible player to reveal their identity, but they riptide trident and escape, holding out a compass on accident while doing so. Wemmbu goes back to egg and lets the seller free, he tells egg that they can use a strategy that they've used before, following the direction of a compass to figure out a location. Egg tries to calculate the direction they need to head, in the meantime The Law arrive at the marketplace and begins killing the people there, Jaden arrives soon after and helps fight off The Law while egg finishes his calculations. More lawmen show up as well as Lettuce, he charges up a railgun and sets it off, killing innocent players who were in its way. Lettuce and his other deputy The_Oroboros use debuff arrows to prevent Wemmbu from killing anyone, egg finally finishes his calculations and Jaden tells them to keep going while he fends The Law off. Lettuce is then shown splashing invisibility and taking off all his armor.

Back at sea, Wemmbu realizes how close the floor of the ocean is to the surface. They head into the ocean itself and use the water breathing potions from earlier to explore, Wemmbu finds a sculk sensored door that leads into a secret base. In the middle of the base is a huge tree, a person in full Netherite comes out, who is presumably the rare item collector, named "Ouroboroid". Wemmbu tells him to give up the music disc collection, he nods his head no, so Wemmbu gears up and attacks them. As the fight continues, the collector activates another sculk sensor door, opening another secret door that leads to another part of the base, this time only having a massive bridge and a waterfall. The collector uses experinece bottles to mend their armor, some experience orbs aren't picked up and Wemmbu uses it to mend his Elytra just a bit, which lets him Elytra mace again. Wemmbu breaks every piece of their armor besides the chestplate, they write a sign to chill and ask what Wemmbu wants, and he says he needs the music disc collection destroyed. The collector asks why it matters and Wemmbu explains how to him how The Law will take over the Great Sea if they get their hands on the discs, the collector says he doesn't want his home to be destroyed, so he agrees to help Wemmbu, he mentions that he also has more items in his stash and brings Wemmbu to it. He shows Wemmbu the chest with shulkers that have all of the music discs inside of them, some of them get taken out of the chest and Lettuce reveals himself, at the same time, the collector throws a wind charge to activate a self destruct button, but it was already too late. Wemmbu stalls Lettuce while the collector regears, planning on 2v1ing Lettuce to get rid of the discs, but Lettuce clearly knew what they were up to. Lettuce blows his horn and his Netherite lawmen come in and attack Wemmbu as Lettuce kills the collector. Wemmbu escapes the lawmen and gets out of the base and climbs the boat anchor that egg left after hearing an explosion. Lettuce comes up from the hole and tries to Elytra mace, but fails miserably, Wemmbu lands a mace hit and Lettuce flies away.

The last scene shows Lettuce returning back to the main island with Deputy_Ace and The_Oroboros, he says that they have everything needed to build the cannon now, but Deputy_Ace thinks blowing up all of the Pirate's builds and banning them isn't the greatest idea. Lettuce also admits it isn't the best idea, but the Pirates chose their side and forced them to do it for a needed sacrifice. He instructs Deputy_Ace to start charging the cannon possibly wiping out all of the Pirates in one attack, or Deputy might show more resentment and explode the cannon there and refuge to the pirate base.

 Trivia 

 The other title used was "I Joined a Pirate Minecraft Civilization".

 This is one of the three thumbnails where Wemmbu's OptiFine cape can be shown, the other two being I Explored the Minecraft Farlands (with his Elytra being vibrant purple), I Explored a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server, and Unstable SMP: After The Mafia

title: I Explored the Minecraft Mist
content:
I Explored the Minecraft Mist is the 124th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
On the Unstable SMP, millions of blocks out lies a civilization in the mist. Less than one percent of the playerbase knows about this place, because anybody who enters this place is never seen again. The few who attempt to escape is hunted by a warrior named Mistrul, and so Flame is hired by The LAW to assassinate this player.

Flame decides to infiltrate the Mist, he rides a happy ghast with elemental_r3d, who's apart of the Mist civilization. He asks why Flame decides to join them, Flame says he gets bored and wants to fight, so he joins civilizations to get that satisfaction of fighting. Elemental is glad that Flame is tagging along, but warns him that the civilization is really hidden and fights aren't as common, knowing where to go is more of a problem. The most important thing Elemental tells Flame is that he isn't able to leave them since it leaves the risk of having them being exposed and the only way out is by dying. They arrive at the base; Elemental tells Flame to find an empty room for himself and that players are usually out doing tasks around the area rather than in the civilization itself.

Flame wanders around and settles into an empty room, he now has a new task for himself, which is to not get suspected of infiltrating otherwise he'd have to deal with the Mist and Mistrul at the same time. Although he was hired to kill Mistrul, he only accepted it to get a duel out of it, since his main goal is to become a combat grandmaster and defeat anybody who gets in his way. Before he gets enrolled in the Mist, Flame goes around the civilization and talks to the players around to get info on Mistrul. Flame learns that Mistrul is somewhat of a myth around the Mist and that he doesn't live in the civilization, but rather a base of his own.

The first step was to figure out a way to get over the walls, which would already be a problem when Elemental and a new member walk into Flame's room and comments on how Flame branded his room with his fire branded banner and preferred if he used the Mist's. Elemental says Flame is forced to share his room with the new player and, until he's trusted, they have to be paired. The other player, FluffalSupreme_, says he's heard a lot about Flame already, seeing that he was asking about Mistrul, and until he knows what he's really doing here, that he's keeping an eye on him. Elemental gives them their first task of raiding the trial chambers nearby so they can trade with Merchant City. When Flame and Supreme goes down to the trial chambers, Supreme says he had a friend who was killing by Flame and Wemmbu during their 2v1000, Flame explains that it was self defense. Supreme says he's lying and that Flame will be exposed for who he really is. The two silently clear out the trial chambers and collect the loot. On the third wave, Flame jumps down to kill the mobs and sees Supreme doing nothing and asks for his help. Flame then sees that Supreme blocked off the path with obsidian and leave. Flame quickly finishes the room and breaks through the obsidian and confronts Supreme for leaving him behind. Other than that, they're done with the trial chambers and go to the storage room to store their loot. Supreme suddenly yells out to the other players there that Flame's intentions of being there is to kill Mistrul putting the attention on the both of them. This also grabs the attention of Elemental, who asks why they're still arguing about it and decides to make them do a trial by combat to resolve this.

A crowd circles Flame and Supreme as Elemental stands inbetween them. Elemental starts off by saying they're settling an accusation by Mist law. Supreme accuses Flame of disloyalty, but with no proof, it will be resolved by combat. Supreme is given a second teammate to make the fight against Flame fairer. If Flame loses, he gets kicked out of the Mist. If Flame wins, all accusations will be retracted, and he will receive a new partner. Flame uses his knowledge to his advantage, both of them are wearing diamond armor, which is more vulnerable to knockback, so he plans on using a knockback sword to win the fight. In the end, Flame is victorious and Supreme reluctantly takes back his statement. Elemental pulls Flame aside and gives him a choice, if he has someone that he knows outside of the Mist, they can bring that person in to be his new partner, but in return, that player belongs to the Mist. Flame has somebody in mind, and Elemental brings Lomedy to the civilization, who isn't excited to be there. Flame and Lomedy go back down to the trial chambers to finish up the task. When Lomedy calmed down, Flame explains that he needed Lomedy specifically to be there because his other partner was going to rat him out and knows that Lomedy wouldn't do so. Flame explains the plan; they're going to go invis and go out the walls to find someone that can lead them to Mistrul. 

They sneak past the walls and Flame overhears Elemental talking about how Flame joining the Mist was random other player about how it would be foolish to join only to hunt down Mistrul. Flame and Lomedy run straight until they hit a cobblestone wall. Suddenly, a group of arachn1d's soldiers come from behind and start attacking them. With so many players on them, Flame has to think quickly and comes up with a plan to kill them. He takes a fishing rod from one of his shulker boxes and activates his Orbital Dog Cannon. However, these players had learned from the last time and started stocking up on turtle master potions. Flame tries to spear-boat them but that doesn't work either. Both Flame and Lomedy's armor starts to wear down, and they decide to run. They reach a cave, but the group of players are too afraid of following Flame in saying that it's not about Flame, but rather about who's inside of the cave.

The two go deeper into the cave and sees huge ice rivers and spikes. After walking for a while longer, they find a house and enter it. They discover Mistrul standing AFK inside, reading a book. Flame gets his attention and tells Mistrul that he was hired to assassinate him but wanted an actual duel rather than to be cheap and simply just kill him. Mistrul thinks Flame is extremely stupid for stepping foot in his cave. Mistrul leaves the house and tells Flame he is the strongest player he'll ever fight, and that his biggest mistake is thinking they're even on the same level of skill. Mistrul suddenly maces Flame when he least expected it. Flame goes in the water to dodge the mace attacks; they fall into a different area of the cave and start fighting with swords. Flame runs away and his totem pops; he goes to mend his armor and grabs two more fishing rods for his dogs before going back to continue the fight. Flame and his dogs manage to pop Mistrul's totem. Flame starts to turn the fight around and gets tons of damage in. Mistrul gets fed up and decides to finish the fight himself and flies over to Lomedy in an attempt to kill him. Flame keeps running, he hears Lomedy's voice telling him to jump and so he wind charges into the darkness and lands on the happy ghast waiting for him. Mistrul says the duel wasn't even fight and that he technically won since Flame popped four times compared to his two. '''I Explored the Minecraft Mist''' is the 124th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Plot ==
On the Unstable SMP, millions of blocks out lies a civilization in the mist. Less than one percent of the playerbase knows about this place, because anybody who enters this place is never seen again. The few who attempt to escape is hunted by a warrior named [[Mistrul]], and so [[FlameFrags|Flame]] is hired by [[The LAW]] to assassinate this player.

Flame decides to infiltrate the Mist, he rides a happy ghast with [[Elemental R3d|elemental_r3d]], who's apart of the Mist civilization. He asks why Flame decides to join them, Flame says he gets bored and wants to fight, so he joins civilizations to get that satisfaction of fighting. Elemental is glad that Flame is tagging along, but warns him that the civilization is really hidden and fights aren't as common, knowing where to go is more of a problem. The most important thing Elemental tells Flame is that he isn't able to leave them since it leaves the risk of having them being exposed and the only way out is by dying. They arrive at the base; Elemental tells Flame to find an empty room for himself and that players are usually out doing tasks around the area rather than in the civilization itself.

Flame wanders around and settles into an empty room, he now has a new task for himself, which is to not get suspected of infiltrating otherwise he'd have to deal with the Mist and Mistrul at the same time. Although he was hired to kill Mistrul, he only accepted it to get a duel out of it, since his main goal is to become a combat grandmaster and defeat anybody who gets in his way. Before he gets enrolled in the Mist, Flame goes around the civilization and talks to the players around to get info on Mistrul. Flame learns that Mistrul is somewhat of a myth around the Mist and that he doesn't live in the civilization, but rather a base of his own.

The first step was to figure out a way to get over the walls, which would already be a problem when Elemental and a new member walk into Flame's room and comments on how Flame branded his room with his fire branded banner and preferred if he used the Mist's. Elemental says Flame is forced to share his room with the new player and, until he's trusted, they have to be paired. The other player, [[FluffalsSupreme|FluffalSupreme_]], says he's heard a lot about Flame already, seeing that he was asking about Mistrul, and until he knows what he's really doing here, that he's keeping an eye on him. Elemental gives them their first task of raiding the trial chambers nearby so they can trade with Merchant City. When Flame and Supreme goes down to the trial chambers, Supreme says he had a friend who was killing by Flame and [[Wemmbu]] during their 2v1000, Flame explains that it was self defense. Supreme says he's lying and that Flame will be exposed for who he really is. The two silently clear out the trial chambers and collect the loot. On the third wave, Flame jumps down to kill the mobs and sees Supreme doing nothing and asks for his help. Flame then sees that Supreme blocked off the path with obsidian and leave. Flame quickly finishes the room and breaks through the obsidian and confronts Supreme for leaving him behind. Other than that, they're done with the trial chambers and go to the storage room to store their loot. Supreme suddenly yells out to the other players there that Flame's intentions of being there is to kill Mistrul putting the attention on the both of them. This also grabs the attention of Elemental, who asks why they're still arguing about it and decides to make them do a trial by combat to resolve this.

A crowd circles Flame and Supreme as Elemental stands inbetween them. Elemental starts off by saying they're settling an accusation by Mist law. Supreme accuses Flame of disloyalty, but with no proof, it will be resolved by combat. Supreme is given a second teammate to make the fight against Flame fairer. If Flame loses, he gets kicked out of the Mist. If Flame wins, all accusations will be retracted, and he will receive a new partner. Flame uses his knowledge to his advantage, both of them are wearing diamond armor, which is more vulnerable to knockback, so he plans on using a knockback sword to win the fight. In the end, Flame is victorious and Supreme reluctantly takes back his statement. Elemental pulls Flame aside and gives him a choice, if he has someone that he knows outside of the Mist, they can bring that person in to be his new partner, but in return, that player belongs to the Mist. Flame has somebody in mind, and Elemental brings [[Lomedy]] to the civilization, who isn't excited to be there. Flame and Lomedy go back down to the trial chambers to finish up the task. When Lomedy calmed down, Flame explains that he needed Lomedy specifically to be there because his other partner was going to rat him out and knows that Lomedy wouldn't do so. Flame explains the plan; they're going to go invis and go out the walls to find someone that can lead them to Mistrul. 

They sneak past the walls and Flame overhears Elemental talking about how Flame joining the Mist was random other player about how it would be foolish to join only to hunt down Mistrul. Flame and Lomedy run straight until they hit a cobblestone wall. Suddenly, a group of [[arachn1d]]'s soldiers come from behind and start attacking them. With so many players on them, Flame has to think quickly and comes up with a plan to kill them. He takes a fishing rod from one of his shulker boxes and activates his [[Orbital Dog Cannon]]. However, these players had learned from the last time and started stocking up on turtle master potions. Flame tries to spear-boat them but that doesn't work either. Both Flame and Lomedy's armor starts to wear down, and they decide to run. They reach a cave, but the group of players are too afraid of following Flame in saying that it's not about Flame, but rather about who's inside of the cave.

The two go deeper into the cave and sees huge ice rivers and spikes. After walking for a while longer, they find a house and enter it. They discover Mistrul standing AFK inside, reading a book. Flame gets his attention and tells Mistrul that he was hired to assassinate him but wanted an actual duel rather than to be cheap and simply just kill him. Mistrul thinks Flame is extremely stupid for stepping foot in his cave. Mistrul leaves the house and tells Flame he is the strongest player he'll ever fight, and that his biggest mistake is thinking they're even on the same level of skill. Mistrul suddenly maces Flame when he least expected it. Flame goes in the water to dodge the mace attacks; they fall into a different area of the cave and start fighting with swords. Flame runs away and his totem pops; he goes to mend his armor and grabs two more fishing rods for his dogs before going back to continue the fight. Flame and his dogs manage to pop Mistrul's totem. Flame starts to turn the fight around and gets tons of damage in. Mistrul gets fed up and decides to finish the fight himself and flies over to Lomedy in an attempt to kill him. Flame keeps running, he hears Lomedy's voice telling him to jump and so he wind charges into the darkness and lands on the happy ghast waiting for him. Mistrul says the duel wasn't even fight and that he technically won since Flame popped four times compared to his two. He tells them to leave and that nobody cares about the score, he says that he won't tell the Mist he came by, as Flame is beneath his concern. 

As they fly out, Flame says his skills do hold up to his name and that he is strong even without honor. Lomedy questions if fighting Minstrul is worth obtaining that grandmaster title and that the Mist knows they're gone and they should leave while they still can. Flame says he prefers growth over stability and that he must beat Mistrul in order to progress. The episode ends with Lomedy standing on the happy ghast to ask Flame a question but is shot off by an arrow mid-sentence.

title: I Explored to the END of the Minecraft Farlands
content:
I Explored to the END of the Minecraft Farlands is the 58th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Wemmbu and Eggchan continue exploring the farlands to get more powerful since Wemmbu is tired of losing fights. They explore a cherry blossom biome then a few mountain biomes. Their goal is to find The Forge and get powerful gear. They continue exploring until they find a trial chamber. Wemmbu didn't like the sight of a trial chamber as he is one of the only mace wielders remaining since The Mafia destroyed all the trial chambers on the regular Unstable SMP. He loots the trial chamber and destroys all the ominous vaults until he gets attacked by a player in full netherite named Firestar2008. He almost kills Firestar2008 but he uses a stasis chamber.

Eggchan suggests that they should find him as he may know something about The Forge. Wemmbu tells Eggchan that he cannot follow him because he doesn't know where he went; Eggchan sends Wemmbu screenshots from the fight where Firestar2008 messes up and shows his lodestone compass. They follow the direction they believe the lodestone compass lead to. As they explore they find more weird biomes such as more glitched terrains, and a biome with chunks of every biome in the game. They attempt to go to the nether but to their surprise, it doesn't work in the farlands. 

They continue exploring and finding more glitched terrain with repeating patterns. They get lucky as they find a repeating dungeon with infinite enchanted golden apples and experience until the chests gets cut off. They continue exploring and they reach the bottom which is water that leads to the void. They ride a boat until they see the end of the terrain. They see an ocean monument covered by glass. They explore it and find more echoes. This time it's an echo of Lakerek with all his friends fighting an elder guardian. They leave and check their stasis chambers. They continue exploring until they find a fractal-like pattern of grass blocks. They fly through the grass blocks and Wemmbu notices the blocks getting farther apart from each other. Wemmbu tries to restock on wind charges from Eggchan but they get attacked by another player named Nitenly. 

Nitenly tries to kill Wemmbu since he also has a mace. Wemmbu successfully hits Nitenly to the void but he doesn't die which could mean that one of the stasises that they had previously encountered belonged to Nitenly. Eggchan suggests that he's attacking because they don't want them entering their home since he killed Lakerek. They are about to reach the absolute end of the farlands as there are much less grass blocks. They find a stronghold and loot it to find eye trims (which no longer exist on the regular Unstable SMP since The Mafia used them all) they make a cobblestone generator in the portal room to get more blocks to bridge with. Wemmbu finds another trial chamber farm and he also finds a house which he then blows up by making TNT with the gunpowder from the dungeons he looted earlier. 

As they reach the end, they find a platform with a tree. Wemmbu decides to attack Nitenly again as he was the one guarding the platform. Wemmbu breaks some of Nitenly's armour and he escapes using his stasis. They continue bridging as the sign warned them to turn back and they find a city in the void.

 Trivia 

 In How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP, Wemmbu calls flint and steel by its abbreviated name "FnS", and explains to Eggchan what it stands for. In this video, he calls flint and steel FnS again, but Eggchan appears to not remember what it means.

title: I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization
content:
I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization is the 122nd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
After Parrot opened up spawn, tens of thousands flooded into the server and moved into Capital City. However, rumors started spreading about Capital City's police force has been arresting these new players. Parrot decided to ignore these rumors since one of his best friends, Fymada, was running the city. One day, the police force stormed through the castle with the intent of arresting Parrot as their next target. The leader of the group says Parrot is under arrest for the death of 43 players inside of Capital City, TheobaldTheBird says Parrot wasn't capable of even killing that many players, but Parrot decides to go with them to avoid anymore trouble.

Parrot is sent to the courtroom, the judge named JudgeCourtalomew sentences Parrot to trial for the murders of the players, Parrot interrupts him and says he hasn't been in Capital City in days. Courtalomew has one of the witnesses named pineengine speak up, asking if they saw Parrot commit the murders, but pineengine says they didn't see Parrot and only a death message, they were then assassinated by a falling anvil. Courtalomew decides to continue the trial and brings up Fymada for her side of the story. Fymada tells the judge that Parrot had no reason to do any of this and she saw the death messages herself and that Parrot is innocent. Courtalomew brings up Theo next, he yells at the entire courtroom and insults them for believing that Parrot is a murderer. Parrot is brought back up, Courtalomew brings up the fact that Parrot had cleared spawn and new players have been flooding in and that it's convenient that all of the deaths were players that have been playing on the server before Parrot had fixed spawn. Courtalomew accuses Parrot of working with the new players to get rid of the older ones, Parrot restates his point, he wasn't in Capital City when this occurred. Parrot is then asked if he'd rather save old players or new ones, which one would he choose, Parrot thinks that's a stupid question and he'd save both and would protect either no matter what. Courtalomew has heard enough and says Parrot is guilty and would be executed within the next 24 hours, and afterwards, the police force would take over and the Capital City purge would commence.

Parrot and Theo are locked in a cell inside of the black market, which was repurposed to keep Parrot held. Parrot explains to Theo how the police force had always existed, but they don't work for the city, but rather whoever pays them the most. Parrot tries to convince the police guard to let them out, but to no avail, so he had no choice other than to wait. Time goes by and the Merchant City vanguard comes barging in and frees Parrot and Theo. The leader of the group says they need to go to Merchant City as it's the bosses order. Over at Merchant City, Parrot stands in front of DanchoGold, the leader of Merchant City and asks why they were brought there. The boss instructs one of his knights, ArthurTheKnight2 to give Parrot the Unstable newspaper and have him read it out loud. Parrot opens the book and reads the first headline, which says Parrot was convicted of murder, Parrot says he's being framed, and Dancho laughs. He knows Parrot is too soft to kill a player, yet alone 43 players and says he needs Parrot to be king, not because of what he does as king, but he needs Parrot alive to pay off his debts. Dancho tells Parrot his vanguard is at his disposal whenever he needs it and to find out who's been framing him. 

Parrot is now in charge of a group of players from the vanguard, they ask what the first step of the plan is, Parrot says he thinks he knows how the players framed him, by using named dogs under his username and have them kill players inside of the city. He needs to talk to Fymada and help get the police force to confess that they were behind all of this. Arthur understands that part and then asks why Parrot had them breed so many cows, Parrot says ClownPierce had stopped supplying nether supplies to the overworld and cows were the best alternative for sneaking into the city. They head over to Capital City, one of the vanguards has all the cows tied to a lead and Parrot is in the middle of the cows with a white leather cap to blend in. They stand in line and see three new players who have just spawned in attempting to come into Capital City, but the police guard in front kills them for being new players. Arthur steps up and tells the police guard they are traders and are trying to trade the cows. The guard sees through his lies and knows they're trying to smuggle somebody in and extorts them out of a stack of diamonds or else all of them would get in trouble. Parrot knew the police force would protect the front of Capital City, and after that, the rest of his team would scout out across the city and eliminate any threats. As Parrot is pushing further into Capital City, it switches over to Theo's perspective. Arthur comes up to Theo and asks if he's the hero from the battle with The Law and asks Theo to train him in PvP. Theo asks Arthur if he's ever heard of an assassin named Billy on the server, Arthur asks if Theo is talking about ShoeBilly the Butcher and that he is aware of Billy. Theo says he trained with Billy months ago and has a suspicion that he may be around the area. As Theo watches Parrot get further into Capital City, ShoeBilly maces Arthur in an instant. Billy says he was offered to kill Theo and Parrot.

Parrot makes it to the tower where Fymada resides and is given a bow by one of the other vanguard members to protect himself. He goes up the elevator, and hides and eavesdrops on Fymada's conversation with one of the policemen, Fymada has been given a choice to either step down as mayor for 10,000 diamonds or else she gets killed. The policeman leaves and gives her a day to think of her decision. Parrot comes out of hiding and apologizes to Fymada for putting her into this situation, Parrot brings up that the police force had planned to kill all of the new players tomorrow and asks for her help, Fymada says she can't help him. Fymada says her own police force turned on her and she wasn't able to fight back, Parrot says when he became king, he promised everyone that he would protect them, but if he can't prove that he was framed, he didn't know what was going to happen to them or the city. He then goes on to say he'd rather be banned off the server than to give up on that promise. 

Back over to Theo, a fight starts between him and Billy, Theo is in shock that Billy had gotten his hands on an Elytra and a mace. Theo runs around Capital City and builds a roof above his head to avoid getting maced. Theo runs into a tavern, Billy walks in and Theo speaks up by saying he never thought he'd work with Capital City's police. Billy says he didn't expect this from Theo, he thought Theo would take his place, but instead he worked to help out new players as an old player and tells him how wrong that is of him. Billy says he's going to kill Parrot, Theo drops down from his spot and tells Billy to stop. Billy tells Theo one of the first things he taught Theo was having someone or something to care about makes them weak and that Parrot would drop him in a heartbeat. Billy says that they aren't so different and they're both killers at heart and that killers aren't supposed to have friends. He ends it by asking if Theo thinks Parrot sees him as a friend, which infuriates Theo and begins attacking Billy again.

Parrot finishes up telling Fymada his plan and that it could come to fruition in the next 30 minutes or so, the police force then comes up the elevator and says Parrot is under arrest. Parrot begins walking on a tightrope that leads to another building that's still being worked on, he tries shooting the police off with the bow, but fails. He then sees that police were also on the other side of the tightrope, so he resorts to melee. He goes back and forth and disabling their shields while also trying not to get knocked down himself. Parrot knocks down a few policemen when he an idea, he runs past the guards from one side and jumps off the tightrope into a small water fountain. 

Another fight between Theo and Billy breaks out, a bunch of civilians huddle around to spectate, some get in between the crossfire and die from the hands of both Theo and Billy. Theo's resources gets drained and is out of minecarts, he tries to fight Billy with swords, but is unable to land any hits on Billy with his movement. A horn is then blown, which signals to Billy that his teammates failed to kill Parrot and he flies away. Back over to Parrot, he runs into a building he doesn't know and runs into a random room, hides, and loses the police. The police says they can look through every room and threatens the people that were also hiding to tell them where Parrot is hiding. They realize that it would take forever to look through every room, so they leave. Parrot asks the person whose room he was hiding in why there were so many people inside of this building and to explore the server. The player says they aren't allowed to, as the police force told them not to leave their rooms and that they were provided food and that the outside was dangerous. Billy then blows up the building, killing a bunch of players in the process. Parrot gets the players that were still hiding to evacuate immediately, Parrot hears Theo and gets him to save him via a happy ghast. As they're escaping, Billy uses TNT to launch himself high up into the air and Elytra's over to the happy ghast and maces it. Parrot lands in a water fountain, Theo tells him to run and Billy chases after Theo. Theo pearls up on top of a streetlight, Billy says when he heard that Theo was Parrot's royal bodyguard, that he was surprised and that he's wasting a time protecting someone who's making the server worse. Theo says he doesn't care if Parrot is weak and that if he wanted to kill Parrot, he'd have to go through Theo first. Billy says Theo really has changed and walks off, before he goes for good, he says that he's waiting Theo to understand. 

Parrot continues to get chased by the police force and gets cornered into a building. He asks the police why they even framed him before he dies, the police says they don't know what he's talking about, Parrot says he knows they named dogs and gives them credit and says it was smart of them to do that. The leader of the group admits to it, Parrot then asks what the purge is all about, and he explains how after Parrot dies, they plan to get rid of thousands of new players right after. Parrot then says what they plan on doing won't happen anymore and calls out for Fymada and hundreds of witnesses to reveal themselves, who can now testify that Parrot is innocent. The police say they won't leave any witnesses then, but Parrot says they aren't able to do that either and tells them to look up, Theo stands up above on top of the building and calls them pieces of garbage.

In the next scene, the leader of the police force calls a meeting with all the police in the black market, he says all the new players will be killed and that the city will be saved. Parrot barges in with his team and tells them that won't be happening. All of the police force are put inside of a singular cell, Parrot thanks the two vanguards and Fymada for their help, and thanks the three policemen that snitched on the rest of their team and lets them free to play on the server. 

Parrot stands on top of the Northern Council castle, he reads the new Unstable newspaper headlines, it says that he had proven his innocence, but the identity of the actual killer is still hidden and that Fymada has now taken control over the Capital City police. Theo says it sucks that they still don't know who's behind the actual killings, Parrot assumes that the same person who framed him was the same person who built the withers at spawn. He realizes that this player is trying to get rid of all the new players and that's the reason why they don't like him as king. The episode ends with Parrot telling Theo that they need to stop whoever it may be.

 Trivia 

 There is a reference to Season 1 when Billy told Theo that they aren't so different from each other. ClownPierce said the same thing to Parrot, PrinceZam said the same thing to Wemmbu, and Ashswagg said the same thing to Spoke.
 In the video and in the description, the word "Capital" is spelled as "Capitol".
 This could be on purpose since the definition of capitol is a building where a legislature meets to conduct government business.
The entire plot of this episode is based off of Attack on Titan. Additionally, this is not the first time Unstable has an episode inspired by an anime.

'''I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization''' is the 122nd episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Plot ==
After [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] opened up spawn, tens of thousands flooded into the server and moved into [[Capital City (season 2)|Capital City]]. However, rumors started spreading about Capital City's police force has been arresting these new players. Parrot decided to ignore these rumors since one of his best friends, [[Fymada]], was running the city. One day, the police force stormed through the castle with the intent of arresting Parrot as their next target. The leader of the group says Parrot is under arrest for the death of 43 players inside of Capital City, [[TheobaldTheBird]] says Parrot wasn't capable of even killing that many players, but Parrot decides to go with them to avoid anymore trouble.

Parrot is sent to the courtroom, the judge named JudgeCourtalomew sentences Parrot to trial for the murders of the players, Parrot interrupts him and says he hasn't been in Capital City in days. Courtalomew has one of the witnesses named pineengine speak up, asking if they saw Parrot commit the murders, but pineengine says they didn't see Parrot and only a death message, they were then assassinated by a falling anvil. Courtalomew decides to continue the trial and brings up Fymada for her side of the story. Fymada tells the judge that Parrot had no reason to do any of this and she saw the death messages herself and that Parrot is innocent. Courtalomew brings up Theo next, he yells at the entire courtroom and insults them for believing that Parrot is a murderer. Parrot is brought back up, Courtalomew brings up the fact that Parrot had cleared spawn and new players have been flooding in and that it's convenient that all of the deaths were players that have been playing on the server before Parrot had fixed spawn. Courtalomew accuses Parrot of working with the new players to get rid of the older ones, Parrot restates his point, he wasn't in Capital City when this occurred. Parrot is then asked if he'd rather save old players or new ones, which one would he choose, Parrot thinks that's a stupid question and he'd save both and would protect either no matter what. Courtalomew has heard enough and says Parrot is guilty and would be executed within the next 24 hours, and afterwards, the police force would take over and the Capital City purge would commence.

Parrot and Theo are locked in a cell inside of the black market, which was repurposed to keep Parrot held. Parrot explains to Theo how the police force had always existed, but they don't work for the city, but rather whoever pays them the most. Parrot tries to convince the police guard to let them out, but to no avail, so he had no choice other than to wait. Time goes by and the [[Merchant City]] vanguard comes barging in and frees Parrot and Theo. The leader of the group says they need to go to Merchant City as it's the bosses order. Over at Merchant City, Parrot stands in front of DanchoGold, the leader of Merchant City and asks why they were brought there. The boss instructs one of his knights, ArthurTheKnight2 to give Parrot the Unstable newspaper and have him read it out loud. Parrot opens the book and reads the first headline, which says Parrot was convicted of murder, Parrot says he's being framed, and Dancho laughs. He knows Parrot is too soft to kill a player, yet alone 43 players and says he needs Parrot to be king, not because of what he does as king, but he needs Parrot alive to pay off his debts. Dancho tells Parrot his vanguard is at his disposal whenever he needs it and to find out who's been framing him. 

Parrot is now in charge of a group of players from the vanguard, they ask what the first step of the plan is, Parrot says he thinks he knows how the players framed him, by using named dogs under his username and have them kill players inside of the city. He needs to talk to Fymada and help get the police force to confess that they were behind all of this. Arthur understands that part and then asks why Parrot had them breed so many cows, Parrot says [[ClownPierce]] had stopped supplying nether supplies to the overworld and cows were the best alternative for sneaking into the city. They head over to Capital City, one of the vanguards has all the cows tied to a lead and Parrot is in the middle of the cows with a white leather cap to blend in. They stand in line and see three new players who have just spawned in attempting to come into Capital City, but the police guard in front kills them for being new players. Arthur steps up and tells the police guard they are traders and are trying to trade the cows. The guard sees through his lies and knows they're trying to smuggle somebody in and extorts them out of a stack of diamonds or else all of them would get in trouble. Parrot knew the police force would protect the front of Capital City, and after that, the rest of his team would scout out across the city and eliminate any threats. As Parrot is pushing further into Capital City, it switches over to Theo's perspective. Arthur comes up to Theo and asks if he's the hero from the battle with [[The LAW|The Law]] and asks Theo to train him in PvP. Theo asks Arthur if he's ever heard of an assassin named Billy on the server, Arthur asks if Theo is talking about ShoeBilly the Butcher and that he is aware of Billy. Theo says he trained with Billy months ago and has a suspicion that he may be around the area. As Theo watches Parrot get further into Capital City, [[ShoeBilly]] maces Arthur in an instant. Billy says he was offered to kill Theo and Parrot.

Parrot makes it to the tower where Fymada resides and is given a bow by one of the other vanguard members to protect himself. He goes up the elevator, and hides and eavesdrops on Fymada's conversation with one of the policemen, Fymada has been given a choice to either step down as mayor for 10,000 diamonds or else she gets killed. The policeman leaves and gives her a day to think of her decision. Parrot comes out of hiding and apologizes to Fymada for putting her into this situation, Parrot brings up that the police force had planned to kill all of the new players tomorrow and asks for her help, Fymada says she can't help him. Fymada says her own police force turned on her and she wasn't able to fight back, Parrot says when he became king, he promised everyone that he would protect them, but if he can't prove that he was framed, he didn't know what was going to happen to them or the city. He then goes on to say he'd rather be banned off the server than to give up on that promise. 

Back over to Theo, a fight starts between him and Billy, Theo is in shock that Billy had gotten his hands on an Elytra and a mace. Theo runs around Capital City and builds a roof above his head to avoid getting maced. Theo runs into a tavern, Billy walks in and Theo speaks up by saying he never thought he'd work with Capital City's police. Billy says he didn't expect this from Theo, he thought Theo would take his place, but instead he worked to help out new players as an old player and tells him how wrong that is of him. Billy says he's going to kill Parrot, Theo drops down from his spot and tells Billy to stop. Billy tells Theo one of the first things he taught Theo was having someone or something to care about makes them weak and that Parrot would drop him in a heartbeat. Billy says that they aren't so different and they're both killers at heart and that killers aren't supposed to have friends. He ends it by asking if Theo thinks Parrot sees him as a friend, which infuriates Theo and begins attacking Billy again.

Parrot finishes up telling Fymada his plan and that it could come to fruition in the next 30 minutes or so, the police force then comes up the elevator and says Parrot is under arrest. Parrot begins walking on a tightrope that leads to another building that's still being worked on, he tries shooting the police off with the bow, but fails. He then sees that police were also on the other side of the tightrope, so he resorts to melee. He goes back and forth and disabling their shields while also trying not to get knocked down himself. Parrot knocks down a few policemen when he an idea, he runs past the guards from one side and jumps off the tightrope into a small water fountain. 

Another fight between Theo and Billy breaks out, a bunch of civilians huddle around to spectate, some get in between the crossfire and die from the hands of both Theo and Billy. Theo's resources gets drained and is out of minecarts, he tries to fight Billy with swords, but is unable to land any hits on Billy with his movement. A horn is then blown, which signals to Billy that his teammates failed to kill Parrot and he flies away. Back over to Parrot, he runs into a building he doesn't know and runs into a random room, hides, and loses the police. The police says they can look through every room and threatens the people that were also hiding to tell them where Parrot is hiding. They realize that it would take forever to look through every room, so they leave. Parrot asks the person whose room he was hiding in why there were so many people inside of this building and to explore the server. The player says they aren't allowed to, as the police force told them not to leave their rooms and that they were provided food and that the outside was dangerous. Billy then blows up the building, killing a bunch of players in the process. Parrot gets the players that were still hiding to evacuate immediately, Parrot hears Theo and gets him to save him via a happy ghast. As they're escaping, Billy uses TNT to launch himself high up into the air and Elytra's over to the happy ghast and maces it. Parrot lands in a water fountain, Theo tells him to run and Billy chases after Theo. Theo pearls up on top of a streetlight, Billy says when he heard that Theo was Parrot's royal bodyguard, that he was surprised and that he's wasting a time protecting someone who's making the server worse. Theo says he doesn't care if Parrot is weak and that if he wanted to kill Parrot, he'd have to go through Theo first. Billy says Theo really has changed and walks off, before he goes for good, he says that he's waiting Theo to understand. 

Parrot continues to get chased by the police force and gets cornered into a building. He asks the police why they even framed him before he dies, the police says they don't know what he's talking about, Parrot says he knows they named dogs and gives them credit and says it was smart of them to do that. The leader of the group admits to it, Parrot then asks what the purge is all about, and he explains how after Parrot dies, they plan to get rid of thousands of new players right after. Parrot then says what they plan on doing won't happen anymore and calls out for Fymada and hundreds of witnesses to reveal themselves, who can now testify that Parrot is innocent. The police say they won't leave any witnesses then, but Parrot says they aren't able to do that either and tells them to look up, Theo stands up above on top of the building and calls them pieces of garbage.

In the next scene, the leader of the police force calls a meeting with all the police in the black market, he says all the new players will be killed and that the city will be saved. Parrot barges in with his team and tells them that won't be happening. All of the police force are put inside of a singular cell, Parrot thanks the two vanguards and Fymada for their help, and thanks the three policemen that snitched on the rest of their team and lets them free to play on the server. 

Parrot stands on top of the [[Northern Council]] castle, he reads the new Unstable newspaper headlines, it says that he had proven his innocence, but the identity of the actual killer is still hidden and that Fymada has now taken control over the Capital City police. Theo says it sucks that they still don't know who's behind the actual killings, Parrot assumes that the same person who framed him was the same person who built the withers at spawn. He realizes that this player is trying to get rid of all the new players and that's the reason why they don't like him as king. The episode ends with Parrot telling Theo that they need to stop whoever it may be.

== Trivia ==

* There is a reference to [[Season 1]] when Billy told Theo that they aren't so different from each other. ClownPierce said the same thing to Parrot, PrinceZam said the same thing to Wemmbu, and Ashswagg said the same thing to Spoke.
* In the video and in the description, the word "Capital" is spelled as "Capitol".
** This could be on purpose since the definition of capitol is a building where a legislature meets to conduct government business.
*The entire plot of this episode is based off of Attack on Titan. Additionally, this is not the first time Unstable has an episode inspired by an anime.

title: I Faked My Death on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
content:
I Faked My Death on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP is the 70th episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

 Plot 
The episode begins with Wemmbu going to the end after defeating FlameFrags. In the end, Eggchan suggests that Wemmbu goes under a fake identity. Wemmbu tries out some armour trims for his new identity and he finally decides to go with something similar to WyLL's armour trims (dune) but with netherite trims and in diamond armour. Eggchan tells Wemmbu that if anyone asks any question regarding him, he will tell them that he died. As Wemmbu is about to leave, MinuteTech asks him why he looks completely different now. Wemmbu tells him that he is faking his death and creating a new identity because he is tired of dealing with people wanting to fight him and just wants a fresh start. MinuteTech warns him that FlameFrags isn't ending on a loss before letting him leave the end.

Wemmbu is now at Spawn. He has to escape Spawn without killing any withers using his mace or using his elytra to fly away. Since Wemmbu is limited on invisibility potions, he has to go to Capital City to buy some, however there is a wither trying to kill him so without a choice he uses his mace to kill the wither. He realized that a player had watched him kill the wither and he continues his journey to Capital City as if nothing happened. 

As Wemmbu arrives at Capital City, he meets a few guards who try to stop him since someone had dropped a nuke at Capital City. He uses signs to talk to them since he cannot speak. The guard who had voice chat formally invites him to the guard force because he likes his trims. As Wemmbu traverses Capital City, he notices that there are less people than usual. He also begins reminiscing about himself nuking Capital City. He also hears a player talking about Eggchan killing Wemmbu and he almost gives himself away by responding but he walks away as if nothing happened. Wemmbu decides to take some inspiration from The Director and uses a voice changer to mask his voice.  

Wemmbu asks to join the guard force but he has to wait for a while since the leader of the guard force hasn't arrived. After a long time, Salvationism, the leader of the Capital City guard force arrives and tests them. They all get accepted into the guard force (except for one player who gets killed during the test) and Wemmbu didn't have to do the test as he was already accepted due to his wealth. As Salvationism is about to give the players gear, he notices that the chests are empty and decides to change his plans.   

Wemmbu goes to the walls of Capital City as been told by Salvationism. After a bit of waiting, Wemmbu finds a player starving to death and he gives him some food before sending him off. A guard wants to trade guarding areas with Wemmbu but he refuses. Wemmbu spots the player he had helped and the player gets killed by Boosfer. Wemmbu starts a fight with Boosfer and his bandits. He realizes that he cannot go aggresive or else he will accidentally kill one of them revealing his name. He uses a wooden sword to fight them instead and he breaks Boosfer's armour, breaking the treaty with Boosfer and Capital City. Since he isn't intimidating enough he goes back to using his netherite sword but with weakness. Wemmbu continues exploring Capital City; finding new shops, and meeting new people. He finds a potion shop which is run by ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird.   

Wemmbu asks for a shulker of weakness potions and invisibility potions and he gives them golden carrots and shulkers so that they can brew the potions. While they are brewing, they talk about why they need materials to protect players and Wemmbu blowing up some of Capital City. Theo mentions Wemmbu getting killed and the fight with Flame. After they finish brewing the potions, Parrot tells Wemmbu that he should try harder at keeping his identity a secret. Wemmbu decides to leave since he thinks staying in Capital City will get his identity leaked in the end so he enters the guard building to let them know he's leaving. However there was a crowd that had assembled. SirPig_, the mayor of Capital City discusses about breaking the treaty with Boosfer because Boosfer had declared war on Capital City and they now had to defend it. They make the barriers taller before Boosfer and his bandits attack.    

During the fight, Wemmbu splashes himself with weakness to make sure he doesn't accidentally kill someone. As the bandits begin reaching the border, Wemmbu realizes that he has to contribute to the battle more so he begins using his mace but he only maces people who have a totem on as to not reveal his identity. As Boosfer notices that the the invisible player he's been fighting has a mace, he reveals that he also has a mace and uses it. Eventually, another wave of bandits enter the battle and attack. Boosfer's helmet breaks and they retreat, ending the war. Salvationism asks Wemmbu why he didn't want to kill anyone and wanted people to kill for him. Wemmbu responds by telling him to train the guards more and get more resources, and he also states that he will kill Boosfer.    

As Wemmbu gets Boosfer's location from Eggchan, he arrives at Branzy's Castle and he reveals his identity to Boosfer and the bandits, promising that he will kill all of them. He kills all the bandits, leaving Boomie and Boosfer as they were barely able to survive before escaping. After Boosfer and Boomie escape, Wemmbu re-equips his armour from his fake identity and returns to Capital City to make sure his identity wasn't already leaked, and thankfully it wasn't. Wemmbu promises to hunt and kill both Boosfer and Boomie to make sure his identity doesn't get revealed as he leaves Capital City.     

The video ends with FlameFrags asking a Capital City guard if they've seen Wemmbu and the Capital City guard tells him that Wemmbu had died.    

 Trivia 

 The original title of this video was How I DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP, sharing almost the same title as one of the other episodes, the only difference being that the word DIED having a quotation mark while it didn't in this video.

title: I Got BETRAYED on the Unstable SMP
content:
I Got BETRAYED on the Unstable SMP is the 59th episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

 Plot 
Flame is out for revenge on Jaden_MAN for betraying him, and with no leads on where Jaden could be, Flame returns to his old base, the one place Jaden would come looking. When Jaden gets there, he gives Flame one last chance to join his Pirate Civilization and if he doesn't, he would get hunted down by him and his pirates. Flame doesn't accept the offer, so Jaden runs off and lets his pirates deal with Flame, but all die in the process. Flame needs to prepare for the next encounter with Jaden, but his base is in shambles and calls up Lomedy to help rebuild it. They flatten out the land and Flame goes inside of his base to brew potions, while that's happening, Jaden attacked Lomedy and stole one of his maces. Flame and Jaden begin to fight until it starts to rain, which allows Jaden to use his riptide trident more efficiently with the mace, Flame's shield breaks and all of his totems pop, Flame goes in a cave and tells Jaden to fight him inside of the cave, but Jaden taunts Flame by proving that the immortal demon ran from a fight. Neither of them want to go in or out of the cave, so Jaden gives Flame a compass that leads to the pirate islands and only to come when it's raining. Flame comes up with the idea to use slow falling arrows, but have no idea to get them, Lomedy tells him that he has some, but it comes with a price. Lomedy wants Flame to grief Spongs, his rival farmer's base for the arrows. 

Flame and Lomedy use their Happy Ghast to fly over to Spongs' farm, Lomedy goes and distracts Spongs while Flame kills all his animals and blows up his house. They run away on their Happy Ghast and go back to Flame's base, Lomedy gives him the slow falling arrows, but he thinks Jaden's trident mace combo is overpowered and offers his other mace, but Flame would rather win the fight with actual skill. Flame heads close enough to the pirate islands and waits for it to rain before moving closer. Flame kills off a bunch of pirates in full iron armor demanding to know where Jaden is, he gets to the castle and finds Jaden. Flame says how he saved Jaden, but Jaden retaliates by saying how Flame betrayed first and that he gave everything to him after Flame let him out, his pirates, his castle, and the mace. They begin to fight and Flame uses the slow falling arrows which work very effectively, Jaden agrees to stop using his strategy in exchange for Flame to stop using slow falling. Jaden loses the sword fight and tells Flame he's the villain for betraying first, but Flame says Jaden was using him and that they were brothers and Jaden was his last brother. Jaden says Flame just started a war with the pirates and his team will be more powerful the next time they see him. Flame goes back to his base and tells Lomedy the news about how he cut Jaden off for good and they can go back to fix their base in peace. Unfortunately for them, Spongs and Willsion are right outside of Flame's base ready to get their revenge.

 Trivia 

 The video was originally called I Got Betrayed on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP before being changed to I Got BETRAYED on the Unstable SMP.

Flame comes up with the idea to use slow falling arrows, but have no idea to get them, Lomedy tells him that he has some, but it comes with a price. Lomedy wants Flame to grief [[Spongs]], his rival farmer's base for the arrows. 

Flame and Lomedy use their Happy Ghast to fly over to Spongs' farm, Lomedy goes and distracts Spongs while Flame kills all his animals and blows up his house. They run away on their Happy Ghast and go back to Flame's base, Lomedy gives him the slow falling arrows, but he thinks Jaden's trident mace combo is overpowered and offers his other mace, but Flame would rather win the fight with actual skill. Flame heads close enough to the pirate islands and waits for it to rain before moving closer. Flame kills off a bunch of pirates in full iron armor demanding to know where Jaden is, he gets to the castle and finds Jaden. Flame says how he saved Jaden, but Jaden retaliates by saying how Flame betrayed first and that he gave everything to him after Flame let him out, his pirates, his castle, and the mace. They begin to fight and Flame uses the slow falling arrows which work very effectively, Jaden agrees to stop using his strategy in exchange for Flame to stop using slow falling. Jaden loses the sword fight and tells Flame he's the villain for betraying first, but Flame says Jaden was using him and that they were brothers and Jaden was his last brother. Jaden says Flame just started a war with the pirates and his team will be more powerful the next time they see him. Flame goes back to his base and tells Lomedy the news about how he cut Jaden off for good and they can go back to fix their base in peace. Unfortunately for them, Spongs and [[Willsion]] are right outside of Flame's base ready to get their revenge.

== Trivia ==

* The video was originally called '''I Got Betrayed on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP''' before being changed to '''I Got BETRAYED on the Unstable SMP.'''

title: I Got Banished from a Hardcore Minecraft Server
content:
I Got Banished from a Hardcore Minecraft Server is the 89th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Flame heads to Capital City but is greeted by everybody hitting and surrounding him. He wonders why, and a person speaks up and says they heard all about his fight with The Law and that he's not allowed to step foot inside of Capital City. Although Flame was only there to trade, they see him as a bad person and force him to leave Capital City, exiling him from coming back. Flame threatens to fight, but his armor is quickly broken by the crowd, and he is forced to run.

Flame returns to his base to restock, and Luke4472 comes to his base. He tells Flame that The Law told everyone to stay away from him and tells him about a meeting at the Northern Council. Tens of thousands of players were invited, with Flame being the only one not getting one since he's blacklisted, so he goes to the meeting secretly. Once he gets close enough to the meeting area, he goes invisible and pearls onto a statue to listen in. LettuceK begins his announcement; he talks about how Wemmbu and Flame have terrorized the server for years and that they need to figure out a way to stop them and any other threats in the future. He proposes that the server have a ruler that serves justice to anyone who tries to harm the server. He allows the people to vote for whoever should be the ruler and who should run. Before he lets the people choose, he explains why he would be the best king of Unstable by bringing out Wemmbu, who has nothing and is being walked down by guards. Lettuce says if he is elected king, his first act would be to execute Wemmbu off the server. He mentions how Flame is being monitored at all times and will be brought to justice as well.

Flame heads back to his base to clean up from his last fight when all of a sudden a player with Netherite armor runs towards him, already potted up, and begins to attack him. He tells Flame he was hired by B.A.T., who's now working with The Law to kill him. They start to fight; Flame quickly breaks the assassin's armor and kills him shortly after. Flame needed resources to restock and for traps, but going anywhere near spawn would be too dangerous for him, so he calls one of his last remaining friends left, Lomedy, to help him. When they meet up in front of Merchant City, Lomedy's demeanor has changed. He thought Flame's intentions were good and that players looked up to him, but he sees Flame as a liar now. Lomedy agrees to help Flame out but tells him he won't help him ever again. After a long time, Lomedy doesn't return, so Flame goes into Merchant City to investigate. The entire city has turned into a ghost town, with nobody to be seen. Flame sees players inside of the circus in the middle of the plaza, and he sees Lettuce and a dozen Law members inside holding Lomedy hostage. Lettuce tells him they're either going to capture or kill him, so it's best if he leaves. Flame says to let Lomedy leave and that he's innocent, but Lettuce doesn't believe it. He says the only chance Lomedy has to live is if Flame leaves now, and as soon as Lettuce is about to use his mace on Lomedy, Flame pearls in and splashes Lomedy with invis. Lomedy is able to escape, leaving Flame to deal with the lawmen. They manage to drain Flame's resources and even break some of his armor pieces, which causes him to hide and flee from the fight.

Flame heads back to his base again, where he told Lomedy to meet back up, and he asks for the trap materials. Lomedy says Flame is a problem and that he's the reason why they've been put in this situation in the first place. Flame says he saved Lomedy's life, but Lomedy says that doesn't fix anything. Flame tells Lomedy he doesn't enjoy killing; he wants to keep his title of the strongest player rather than submitting to them and being a nobody. Lomedy says Flame is too far gone and to not drag him down with his title before giving the materials. Flame sets up a few traps and another machine that teleports hundreds of dogs; once he's done, with nothing else to do, he waits for Lettuce and his lawmen to show up. When they come, they immediately start to attack Flame, and he uses his dripstone trap, which kills a lot early on. Flame kills off the rest of the players easily, due to the fact that they were only in diamond armor, leaving Lettuce the only one alive. They run into a cave, where Lettuce tries to lure Flame inside, but Flame thinks it's a trap and doesn't follow. He only goes in once he restocks his inventory; he attacks Lettuce, and they drop down into another part of the cave, where Lettuce blows his horn, revealing his actual army of full Netherite players that begin to attack Flame. Even with the skills Flame has, he doesn't know what to do with the dozens of Netherite players fighting him all at once. He sets off his dog machine, which doesn't have much of an effect on the fight but does kill 2 players. Flame tries to fight the assassins off but can only get 2 kills due to the assassins constantly splashing weakness potions. 21 die due to wardens, while the rest drain Flame of his resources. Flame ends up running away and digging into a cave to escape. Lettuce speaks up, knowing Flame couldn't have gone far. He admits he can't beat Flame through skill, so he beats him through strategy. He says how all the previous empires on the server had one flaw: they thought they could rule with power, while Lettuce used strategy. He says Flame followed all of those civilizations around like a dog while he learned, and he would use his influence for the better. He tells Flame to stay in that hole or to get lost since he's not needed anymore.

This marks Flame's second loss in a short amount of time; he tried to return back to his base, but lawmen were already there. Flame had no other choice but to accept that he was exiled, and so he gets on his horse and heads off into the distance. However, Flame doesn't care that he lost his base and his gear; he cares about what happened to his name. To fix his reputation, he vows to not return from exile until he is stronger and masters Minecraft combat.

 Trivia 
 As of April 11th, 2026, there are four variations of the video's title
 The original was "I Got Exiled from the Unstable SMP".
 The second was "I Got Exiled from the World's Largest Minecraft Server".
 The third was "I Got Banished from the World's Largest Minecraft Server".
 As of now, the fourth and current one is "I Got Banished from a Hardcore Minecraft Server".

title: I Got Betrayed by my 1000 Player Army...
content:
I Got Betrayed by my 1000 Player Army... is the 63rd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Spoke explains that Spoke and Mapicc were casually playing on the Unstable SMP until they saw them. Spoke's 1000 player army that he had gathered and raised in 1017 Players VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP... but he quickly lost control and thought it was over. Mapicc calls Spoke to see the incoming threat but Spoke refuses and says that he's making a zombie farm. Mapicc calls Spoke again but Spoke replies the same and that he doesn't care and he's making a zombie farm. Mapicc says they should execute Protocol 32. Hundreds or thousands of players storm their base and blow it up from above. Spoke and Mapicc use their secret escape. Together, they make it over to their chicken cannons and escape to Mapicc's sky base. Spoke realises their hunters have found them and now pillaring up. An invisible player with a voice changer approaches them and that invisible player says that "Hello, Hello, Hello. Now you have been having some troubles recently. I'd say that sometimes you need to learn Spoke. Spoke sometimes you need to learn that your actions have consequences and you might not like what's on the otherside-"  Spoke quickly interrupts the invisible player by pointing out it's trash quality of the microphone. The invisible player drops Spoke a written book-and-quill and a single raw porkchop and then jumps off. Spoke tries to find where the invisible player went up from. Spoke finds a nether portal. Spoke reads the book.

"                                d      e           a                               r 

S          p              o                         k      e ,

1989

the players were                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               rebelling. 

but all they needed was a new form of leadership.

A leader that shared their same desire.

Here I am!

Spoke, your crimes will finally catch up  to you. 

Better start running

-  T         H             E

E      X       E       C     U      T    I     V    E                                         "

Spoke crafts some tnt, grabs some wind charges, lava buckets and some ender pearls. Mapicc wind charges some of them. Spoke shoots one of them off their pillar killing him immediately. Spoke ignites a TNT on them to slow the players down. Spoke uses a fishing rod to try and fling some of them off their tower. It doesn't work. They soon resort to bombing the players. Spoke is knocked off; the players make up to their sky base and quickly pillage it. They soon overrun the base. They soon retreat to the nether portal only to realise it broken and they have no obsidian. Spoke pearls to the ground and goes underground with Mapicc. They make a nether portal underground and escape. Mapicc makes a ... not so pretty wooden hut. Spoke realises his Riptide III trident is on 1 durability. Spoke finds The Executive ominously standing on a basalt pillar. The executive tries to throw Spoke a book but it burns in lava. The Executive turns off his voice changer and then back on realizing his mistake. The executive warns Spoke his army is going to kill him. Spoke realises he couldn't run forever as they were running low on resources. Spoke builds a platform in the nether. He contructs 5 TNT cannons but one blew up leaving him with 4. Mapicc stays in the lava. They defend for an impressive amount of time but eventually he is forced to retreat and nether portals into Leow0ok's base. Leo agrees to defend them from their hunters as the players are griefing his base. Together, they kill all the hunters. 

 Trivia 

 The video's original title was "1000 Players Hunt Me in Hardcore Minecraft".
 This is the least viewed Unstable Universe video.

title: I Got Hunted By Minecraft's Smartest Player
content:
I Got Hunted By Minecraft's Smartest Player is the 81st episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

 Plot 
The episode starts off from last episode, with Wemmbu escaping the courtroom encased in obsidian box. However, Parrot and Theo are chasing him. Wemmbu flies to a mountain nearby to prevent them from seeing his bright purple Elytra, as well as being able to restock. The two attack Wemmbu, and Wemmbu asks them why they're attacking him. Parrot tries to justify their actions by saying it's because that Wemmbu killed Boomie and Sky. 

Wemmbu begins to explore for the server for an ender chest, since the fight took most of his resources. A lot of his choices aren't viable since they're a threat to Wemmbu's hidden identity. His last option is the End dimension, where his friend, eggchan, keeps a lot of their valuables. Wemmbu tries to avoid going to the End because Parrot knows that he goes to the End often, but with no other choice, he heads to the stronghold. Wemmbu loots an untouched potion room in the stronghold and eventually finds ender chests.

As he's heading to the portal, he stumbles into Parrot again. As Parrot tries to give him a choice to reveal his identity, Wemmbu tries to kill him again. Parrot then flies down a massive 3x3 manmade tunnel with Wemmbu chasing him. The end of the tunnel lead to another obsidian box, this time, it's the hidden meeting room Parrot made underneath B.A.T's old base, and Theo is inside waiting for him. The two begin to attack him again, but they're more prepared this time. They set up elder guardians around the trap and have slow falling arrows, disallowing Wemmbu to use his mace. Wemmbu tries to escape by lighting Nether portals in the wall, but Theo quickly breaks them. Instead, Wemmbu has another plan, he uses TNT to blow up logs to craft ladders in order to escape by pearl glitching. He places a ladder in the corner of the room, but is not able to pearl out. Parrot and Theo start to run out of resources, causing Parrot to flee. Wemmbu tries to pearl glitch a few more times, some attempts unsuccessful, but he ends up managing to pull it off and get out.

With Wemmbu and Theo back on surface, Wemmbu has less than a minute of invisibility left. Wemmbu quickly realizes that this was a base he's looted before, and he begins looking for more invisibility. He manages to get his hands on more potions with mere seconds left, Theo flies away to restock. The two begin to fight again, but Wemmbu finds it suspicious how Parrot hasn't been around, and with him being low on resources, he decides to leave. Wemmbu uses an ender pearl cannon that was built nearby, thinking it was his escape. Instead, he gets teleported into a wind burst machine that launches him downwards into a huge semicircle build. He lands on a platform, and there is nothing but void underneath him. Across from him is Parrot, and Parrot tells Wemmbu that this is the end of his fake identity. Parrot then explains how he figured out that The Invisible Knight was Wemmbu.

He then reveals that FlameFrags is there with them. Wemmbu doubles down and says that "he's not Wemmbu." He then tries to escape by pearl catching, but because one of the wind charges missed, it went through the powdered snow the build was made of, going through lava, igniting the wind charge, setting off TNT that exploded the entire build. Because the TNT went off from Wemmbu's wind charge, it blew up dogs that Flame tamed, showing that the dog was blown up by Wemmbu in chat. Wemmbu asks once again why this happened, and Parrot says he "had to tie some loose ends" and that because they disliked each other. Wemmbu expresses that he's never disliked Parrot, and Parrot goes on to list the problems Wemmbu has caused while being invisible.

Flame demands a rematch from Wemmbu right then and there. The episode ends with Wemmbu splashing speed and diving right into the fight.
