title: I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia
content:
I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia is the 22nd episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

Plot
The episode opens with SpokeIsHere and PlanetLord searching for the base of The Invisible Mafia using a mysterious compass left by JamatoP in his base. When the compass finally turned during the duo’s journey on their elytras, they discovered an ominous castle, finding members of the The Invisible Mafia within and leaving the castle. After burrowing into the fortress walls and ceiling, they spotted 3 invisible players, and took the chance to drop dripstone from the ceiling. The dripstone killed a member and popped another’s totem, which is then revealed to be the missing player Leow0ok. The third player then escaped from the scene by flying out of the castle from the ceiling. After Leow0ok’s invisibility was disabled, he burrowed into a nearby pillar, while Spoke and Planet landed down on the ground to investigate.

After searching around the pillar, Leow0ok then revealed himself to the duo, and explained that he was infiltrating the Mafia to kill ClownPierce. Before they could leave the castle, TNT minecarts were triggered to blow up, and the entire building was obliterated. After barely escaping the structure, a Golden Trim player then led Spoke, Planet and Leow0ok to the Mafia City, where they entered and blended in with the other members.

After a visit to a factory mass producing invisibility potions, Leow0ok then mentioned to Spoke and Planet to hold out a specific item to represent themselves, with Spoke holding out his Bucket of Salmon (later referred to as ‘Fish Bucket’ by Ashswagg) and Planet holding out a tipped arrow. The trio then gaslighted an untrimmed player, saying that Gold Trimmed players were requiring him to fly to a remote location (Coordinates: [x] -1500, [y], [z] 4000). After the player leaving, a Diamond Trimmed player was spotted up on a roof of a house, looking down at the trio, and soon disappearing after they had turned a corner.

The trio then made their way to the prison of Mafia City, hoping to find and rescue Mapicc. At the entrance of the prison, a Gold Trimmed player was standing guard, and after being refused entry to the prison, Planet then took out a golden chestplate, and was almost killed by the Gold Trimmed player. Suddenly, the Diamond Trimmed player appeared behind the trio, and had a long stand off with the Gold Trimmed player, resulting in the Gold player flying off. The trio then entered the prison, where they found multiple other prisoners like Lifesteal Admin, who then jumped into lava, and was banned off the server. After searching for a while, the trio then spotted the cell where Mapicc was held.

After some discussion, PlanetLord decided to give his Netherite Armour to Mapicc, and using invisibility to sneak out of the prison. The new trio (Spoke, Leow0ok and Mapicc) then left the prison, and made sure that PlanetLord was safe and out of Mafia City.

Leow0ok then explained how the Mafia ranking works, collecting ‘Upgrade Tokens’ by completing missions, and receiving trims (Trims includes: Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond) for every three tokens they collect. The trio then flew to a manmade lake inside the Mafia City, where a Gold Trimmed player hands out missions (book and quill) to the members. Their first mission was to survive a raid with iron armour and tools, and after a somewhat struggling fight, they finally defeated the mobs and received a Upgrade Token.

After returning to Mafia City, the Diamond Trimmed player was again spotted overlooking the trio. They then hurried to receive their next mission from the Gold Trimmed Player at the lake, and the mission was revealed to be an assassination of ParrotX2. After following the Gold Trimmed player for a while, they spotted Parrot, Wifies and deanthebean9. A chase began, and it was revealed that Spoke and Mapicc were The Invisible Mafia members who chased Parrot in his adventure to the Far Lands.

After a long chase, they were unsuccessful at killing Parrot. The Gold Trimmed player quickly gave the Upgrade Tokens to Spoke and Mapicc, and was panicking. After a while, Ashswagg showed up and killed the Golden Trim player for failure at the task. Spoke and Mapicc quickly sneaked away after seeing the punishment of their ‘leader’.

They run away. They are then tasked with guarding a vault. ManePear and Wemmbu start trying to break into the vault and succeed.

The team is now tasked to get diamonds. Leow0ok (Sword) helps them cheat by giving them some of his wealth, being lots of diamond blocks. The gold player, after seeing the results, tells them to wait there and flies away. Ashswagg soon shows up. He promotes them to copper tier. They are then tasked with killing Baconnwaffles0 for a mission. Bacon says they are betraying the mafia in chat, so they destroy his base. They go over to Reddoons at Capital City to complete a trade.

The team is given the task of getting an elytra. Spoke asks Wemmbu if he can give him any elytra since Wemmbu took all the elytras near and far out into the End. Wemmbu sais he gave them to PrinceZam. They are able to find nine elytra in the Zam empire. Wemmbu finds a mafia member following them and starts killing them, but realizes it's eggchan after he pops his totem.

They are promoted to iron after giving ashswagg the elytras. They are then tasked with building redstone machines. They sabotage the other mafia member's plots and win.

They are tasked with killing PlanetLord, but don't kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the members one by one until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke (As Fish Bucket) steps up and says he did it once Mapicc was about to be killed next. They are dismissed.

Spoke is tasked with killing IMajesticRose by Ashswagg to prove that he can kill. He obliges and kills her with dripstone to avoid his name showing in chat. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him. In a sentimental place of the diamond player’s choice. He would have to kill the diamond player alone, or the diamond player would kill him. His name would have to pop up in chat.

Spoke runs away after that back to his house, and starts cleaning it from past griefers, not knowing what to do about his name popping up in chat if he kills the diamond player, or if he can even survive. Mapicc Leo, and Planet soon arrive and they start talking and supporting Spoke. Him and the team come up with a plan to kill Ashswagg. He goes back to Ashswagg’s castle and gives Ash a book and quill. Ash gives Spoke another book and quill to where they would fight. He fights a diamond player to try to become diamond. Spoke’s totem of undying is used, revealing to ashswagg that he is Spoke. Ashswagg tries to teleport Spoke in the void, but then realizes that he did not set a stasis, so he couldn’t. He throws his fishing rod on the ground seeing that it’s useless in this scenario. They talk for a bit then Ashswagg orders the diamond player to kill them. The diamond player pots strength and tries to kill Ashswagg. The rest join in. But before they could get a second hit on him, he teleports away using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he's MinuteTech. MinuteTech tells them to run. They fly away.

They land nearby later and start talking. Leo gives Spoke Ashswagg’s fishing rod. Spoke realizes that it was a Unbreaking 1 fishing rod that whole time. They talk more.

 Trivia 

 In various sections of the video, the health bar switches from hardcore hearts to regular hearts.

title: I Joined a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server
content:
I Joined a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server is the 116th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Wemmbu is peacefully building his house when three players under arcachn1d_'s rule comes knocking at his door, calling him the true king and tries to force Wemmbu to join them in the caves, Wemmbu refuses and sends a stab shot directly at them and kills all three of them. After blowing up the players, Wemmbu runs out of froglights to build his house to build his house, so he goes out to a village that sells building blocks. He visits a store that sells tons of building blocks by exchanging gear from the previous war for it, while he waits, another faction arrived at the village. Wemmbu spots yungyx threatening to blow up the village if they don't give up their resources, steps up and tells him to leave by pulling his mace out. Yungy is intimidated and lets the village see another day. The leader of the village, FieldsOfElysium, thanks Wemmbu and explains how there used to be a guardian of the village who used to protect them, but quit a while ago. Fields says that the protector had left a mace in a tomb, that it's dangerous to find, and that they don't even know where it is. Wemmbu agrees to help find the mace, and Fields explains that the guardian told one other person the location of it, being LordSirWesley the Third. Wemmbu asks where he could find the player, and Fields says he goes around festivals near Merchant City. Wemmbu says he'll go get the mace back, and that he'd keep it to himself, as maces are rare and Wemmbu doesn't want to give it up that easily.

Wemmbu flies to the festival and walks right in, spotting a player wearing netherite armor and sees that it is Wessley. He asks for the location of the mace, Wessley says he'd only tell Wemmbu if they have a 4v4. Wemmbu says he could do a 1v4, but Wessley wants an honorable fight, so Wemmbu goes around to look for combat masters. He flies back to his base and asks eggchan to help fight with him, egg says he's too busy studying, Wemmbu gives him a stab shot fishing rod, which convinces him to join. Wemmbu tells egg to go find Jaden_MAN and recruit him while he recruits one more person. Wemmbu goes back to the festival and recruits a random player, egg arrives shortly after with Jaden and they head into the arena. The host explains the rules: No elytras and no griefing or excessive attacks. Egg calls a timeout and gets shaken up by seeing TheG0dOfWar being on the enemy team. Wemmbu's random fighter digs out of the arena and leaves them with only three people, the host says they need to find a fourth in one minute, and some invisible player in full netherite jumps down from the crowd and asks to join. As the fight starts, Wemmbu tells his team to focus on Wessley, since popping the team leader's totems would immediately disqualify the entire team. Jaden manages to pop yungy's totem, disqualifying him. Wemmbu focuses on Wessley and breaks his helmet, popping his totem soon after. Wessley says he's a man of his word and tells Wemmbu there's a path at the wheat village and once he sees a blue cornflower, he'll find the mace. The invisible netherite player overhears their conversation from a distance. Wemmbu goes to Jaden and wishes him luck with whatever he's doing and grabs egg to go on a journey.

In the wheat fields, egg tells Wemmbu to test out his orbital strike on it and it blows up a small portion of the field with how massive the field is. They head into the village and look at the back of the castle, they don't see a path, but realizes the path is made by clearing out the trees, so they head into the forest. They see a house coming up ahead, egg goes in first and loots the house, obtaining a netherite chesetplate and a book. Egg reads the book and it says the violent nature of the server gets stale and repetitive. While egg reads the book, multiple invisible diamond players sneak up to the house and Wemmbu hears their footsteps and activates an orbital to blow up the house and everything surrounding it. Egg explains the book says if they keep going on this path of destruction, it'd only lead to boredom, which is true because Wemmbu had faked his own death out of boredom before. They explore further down the path and spots a bridge and crosses it. After walking down a little more, they see the blue cornflower and breaks it, which opens up a hidden door in the wall of the mountain. They head inside and zombies with full protection 4 diamond armor get sent up, Wemmbu makes egg fight them off himself. In their path is a bridge, egg says it may be trapped, Wemmbu walks down the bridge and activates an arrow cannon that pops his totem immediately. Egg pearls across the bridge and sees a warden spawn right next to Wemmbu. Wemmbu maces the wardens at first, but resorts to using stab shots to kill them. They head past another bridge and sees a sword build with an item frame on it with the mace there. An invisible player pearls onto it and grabs it before they do. The player puts their armor on and it turns out to be the same player that helped them in the tournament. They thank Wemmbu for setting off the traps and saving their armor durability, Wemmbu says it'd waste more durability fighting him, and a fight starts. The player goes full invis to his advantage and Wemmbu has an idea to instantly kill them. He leads the person to the bridge where the arrow cannon is facing, Wemmbu asks egg to activate the trap, but egg says he broke it. Wemmbu uses his plan B and uses his stab shot on the player, launching himself up in the air at the same time. He goes flying down and maces the player, but they use a turtle master potion while he was falling, so they survive the attack, but breaks all their armor in the process. They put another set on and Wemmbu continues attacking, the player tells him to stop and says there's other places he can get a mace, drops the mace, and leaves.

They go back to the village and hand off the mace to Fields. Fields thanks them for returning the mace and says they can get a free horse and building blocks as a way to repay them, and so they go to get their horses. As they leave, Wemmbu apologizes for blowing up their wheat field. The episode ends with them riding off into the sunset in the wheat field. An extra scene can be seen at the very end where Wemmbu maces his own horse to test if he gains height, and horse burns to death.

 Trivia 

 There are Six variations of the video's title:
 The original "I Explored the World's Largest Minecraft Server".
 The second being "I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server".
 The third being "I Explored a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server".
 Fourth being "I Joined a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server".
 Fifth being "I Joined The World’s Largest Minecraft Server"
 Sixth being "I Explored a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server", likely to avoid Parrot's video with the same exact title (I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server).
 and the Seventh current being "I Joined a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server"
This is one of the three thumbnails where Wemmbu's OptiFine cape can be shown, the other two being I Explored the Minecraft Farlands (with his Elytra being vibrant purple) and I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea.

content:
I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Army is the 132nd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Flame starts off the episode by explaining that since the Unstable SMP is the largest hardcore in the world, it has some of the biggest armies to exist in Minecraft. After he joined the Invisible Mafia, one of the former largest teams on the server, he didn't want to join another massive team again, as he preferred to be a solo player. However, this all changed when his best friend Lomedy wanted to talk to him.

Lomedy tells Flame he wants to talk to Flame about something serious, he says ever since Parrot opened up spawn for new players, he says it came at a cost of old players have been running out of resources, starving to death, getting robbed by bandits, and Parrot hadn't done anything about it and that a new kingdom named Cindercrest has a goal to overthrow Parrot. Flame asks Lomedy if he thinks that sounds bad, Lomedy says he understands that it's bad, but if they helped Cindercrest this once, they could live on the server peacefully. He brings up that Flame told him they could do something he wanted to do, and doing this was what he had his mind on. Flame says he's not interested and that it's a terrible idea, and so Lomedy heads off on his own to join himself. Flame quickly goes after Lomedy and warns him of the dangers of joining Cindercrest. Lomedy brushes him aside and is hesitant on joining, Flame says that he is misunderstanding. In Flame's mind, this was a horrible idea as Lomedy could potentially die, and if Flame joined, there would be no benefit in joining when he could be training instead. Flame keeps trying to stop Lomedy from joining, Lomedy tells Flame if letting people starve and die, Flame is more selfish than he thought. Flame says he doesn't believe Parrot would let players just die like that, Lomedy says to him to tell that to the players that died and walks into the Cindercrest castle.

The two walk into the main castle and goes to the king of Cindercrest, Saparata. Saps asks if he can help them, Lomedy says he's joining Cindercrest, and Saps asks what skills he has. Lomedy says he's good at farming, which isn't exactly what Saps was looking for, so he asks what else, Lomedy says he has a mace, which instantly lets him in. Saps asks them if they know why they're doing this and goes on to tell them Parrot is letting old players to starve and they're going to make him pay for it. He then asks Flame if he's joining, Flame says he's not there because he belives in the cause, but he decides to join anyway. Saps then tells them they're going need to prepare soon, as they're heading into war. Lomedy is happy that they're fighting for a cause, Flame doesn't think they should join a war that has nothing to do with them and says there's no tradeoff. Lomedy says this is a cause he respects and decides to prepare. 

In the next scene, Flame stands right alongside ShoeBilly on a blimp, he makes small talk with Billy by saying it's interesting that it's only them on the blimp, Billy says it's obvious that they're both killers and among all of Cindercrest, they're the strongest.

Flame then monologues about how in order to take over the entirety of spawn, it's a game of control. They'd need to take control of all the major locations that surrounded spawn. Their first target was the training ground where Parrot kept his army; Fort Feather. The plan was for most of the army to attack from the ground, distracting them from below while a large group of them attacked from above.

The blimp gets closer to Fort Feather, Lomedy takes deep breaths in order to prepare. Flame then instructs everybody to huddle up in a corner and splashes them all with slow falling, he opens up the trapdoors and they all drop down into the fort and begins the war. Flame attacks a few players outside of the main building, he enters the building and a massive explosion trap gets set off, blowing up and killing everyone inside of it. Flame gets Lomedy and the players of Cindercrest to back up. After the explosion is done, there's only one player in Parrot's army remaining, as the rest of them were distracted by the blimp and fled. Once the last player was dealt with, they had taken over Fort Feather. This was great for Cindercrest, but there were still many places they needed to take over. 

Saps calls a meeting with Flame to talk about their next steps. Flame sits in a meeting with Saps, Lomedy, and an invisible assassin. Saps says their next location they should take on is Merchant City and that the blimp worked well, but thinks they need a better weapon: the orbital strike cannon. He says Wemmbu is the only person that he knows that wields these kinds of weapons and the only person who has beaten Flame in a fight, only because of these orbitals. Saps tasks Flame to find the location of the cannons and tells him to move fast and that there's no time. He gives Flame an Elytra which would help move faster and brings up the invisible assassin and mentions that they know a lot about the server. Flame stops him and tells him an Elytra has nothing to do with mastering combat and he doesn't want to work with the invisible player. Saps says he doesn't care about Flame's combat quest and taking down Parrot is more important, if they win, the server would go back to how it's supposed to be. Flame reluctantly agrees and asks the assassin what to do. The assassin says their best chance to get their hands on the orbitals is to take Eggchan hostage to interrogate him about where the cannons are, and if he doesn't comply, they'll kill him.

Flame monologues again, he explains that the orbital strike cannons are capable of one-shotting fully stacked players, and the wielders of these cannons was Wemmbu, who had the strongest weapons on all of Unstable. Forcing information out of him wasn't going to be easy, so targetting egg was the better option.

Flame and the assassin run through a desert, he asks how they're going to find egg, as he knows nothing about egg besides that he's Wemmbu's friend. The assassin says they have an idea and tells Flame to wait there, they pull a stasis and teleports away. Flame wanders around the desert and complains about Saps forcing him to work with a random player, just then, the assassin teleports right back to Flame and says they found him and tells him to follow them. They make it to Wheat Civilization, Flame asks why they're headed towards there, the assassin says egg is friends with them. Flame sees that all of the wheat has been taken and wonders what happened, the assassin says they were attacked and robbed out of all their food. Flame then asks how they stasised away and back, but he doesn't expect an answer of how. They keep walking into the civilization, they find egg standing at the front of the castle, egg already knows what's going on and asks what he wants with him. Flame apologizes and tells him to come with him and the assassin for questioning and if he complies, he can come back. A member of the civilization writes in a sign saying they can't take him, a group of players from the civilization then begin attacking Flame. Flame ignores them and tells egg to follow them, egg tells them to stop and agrees to go with them in order to not see them die. 

Back over at Flame's base, Flame encages egg inside a pile of obsidian for safety precautions and if he answers their questions, he can leave. He finally asks egg where the orbital strike cannons are, and egg says he can't answer that. Flame begins hitting him, egg says he can't answer that because of his integrity and keeps insisting that he can't tell Flame. Flame says he already admitted to knowing where they are by saying he can't tell him and that he should be able to know as he's Wemmbu's best friend. Egg says back to him he hops on Minecraft because they're best friends, but that doesn't mean he knows Wemmbu's secrets. Flame asks how Wemmbu would feel if he died right there and egg asks if they want him to call him and asks how he would feel. Flame blocks off the block emitting light into where egg is, he says he's being nice with all things considered. He asks one more time for the location, egg says he doesn't know again. Just as he says that, two guards protecting Flame's base dies, Flame assumes it's Wemmbu and tells Lomedy to be careful. Wemmbu confronts Flame and asks if he has egg, Flame says he's forced to work with the assassin because he's in Cindercrest. Wemmbu asks for egg back, Flame says no and he'll bring egg back to him when he answers their questions. Wemmbu gives them a final warning before he sets off orbitals all over the base. Flame says he's being unreasonable and that he didn't give them enough time. Wemmbu and Flame keep on fighting, Flame gives Lomedy the sign to kill egg. Lomedy is insistent on it, he asks if Wemmbu is on him, which gets Wemmbu to focus his attention on Lomedy. When they get to the obsidian pile, they see that egg isn't there anymore and they all stop fighting. Wemmbu asks if they told the invisible assassin where egg was and Flame says they worked together to get egg, Wemmbu then says that the player took egg. Flame blames Wemmbu for this even happening and that he blew up the base for no reason, Wemmbu says they were the ones who kidnapped egg for no reason. Flame asks what they're going to do next, Wemmbu says he was just betrayed and that they should work together to figure out who the invisible player is and that will lead to egg's whereabouts. Wemmbu says he knows a person that can help them and Flame agrees to come along. 

Flame's monologue goes on to say that him and Wemmbu were relatively cool with each other and admits that it sucks to go behind his back to kidnap Eggchan all to steal his cannons, but if he didn't, Cindercrest would have no chance in beating Parrot, which would put Lomedy at risk. With all that, he had to put himself first. They head out to the Great Sea, where they met up with Linnwyrm, who knew where the assassin could've been. They also ran into Jaden_MAN, who Flame had bad history with. Flame had no other choice but to work with him, and once Wemmbu regeared, they were ready to go on their journey.

The three of them boat to a huge island, they spot five players, yungyx and arachn1d_ and three members of their civilization. Wemmbu threatens to blow them all up, but yungy says if they fight, egg would die. All of them walk together up the island to the platform where egg is located with the invisible player. The invisible player says they gathered them all there to make a proposition: whoever pays the most will be given egg. Yungy offers three diamonds at first, egg asks to raise the value as he believes he's valued more. The invisible player pulls egg's stasis to another location for his own safety. Wemmbu then steps up and offers his entire ender chest. Yungy goes higher and offers a stack of diamond blocks, Flame says he'll offer two stacks of diamond blocks on behalf of Cindercrest as well as his combat skills. Wemmbu thinks all of this is to bring egg back to them, but Flame says this was on behalf of Cindercrest, which meant he was still trying to get egg for himself. The auction keeps going, the invisible player tells arachn1d to go all out and keep bidding. Wemmbu interrupts and says to give him egg now or else everyone there dies. He sets off an orbital strike cannon and a fight between all of them break out. Wemmbu targets Flame and pops him, Flame flies up on top of a peak to grab his own fishing rod, hooked up to it is his own orbital dog cannon. The dogs do tons of damage to yungy, which causes him to fall down a hole created by a stab shot. 

They drop down into the cave area of the island, Flame gets yungy in webs and pops his totems, he gets yungy to drop rockets in exchange for sparing his life. A fight breaks out with only Flame and Wemmbu, a stab shot reveals another part of the island, a lush cave hidden deeper down. Wemmbu finds himself getting in a fight with the invisible player, so Flame focuses on yungy. Yungy asks what they're fighting for, Flame says he doesn't know and that it's for egg, yungy says they're both trying to get to egg and suggests trying to find him together, but Flame likes the idea of killing yungy more. Yungy decides to go find egg himself and flies off towards an unexplored area.  Flame keeps chasing and attacking yungy through the maze until they make it to another platform surrounded by lava. They're forced to stop when Wemmbu says egg will die if they keep on fighting. The invisible player speaks up, they say they're willing to negotiate. Arachn1d goes first, he offers the entire treasury of the caverns in exchange for egg becoming a prisoner. The invisible player accepts the offer, they say eggchan will be safely delivered as soon as they receive the first half of the payment, and once he's delivered, they expect the second half. Flame asks Wemmbu if he wants to kill them, but Wemmbu says they can't cause they're just going to kill egg. Flame asks what's stopping him, Wemmbu says he's going to tell them where Lomedy is and he'll be in the exact same situation. With that being said, Flame decides to head out. Flame couldn't get the orbitals without taking things too far, which meant Cindercrest would lose their best chance at beating Parrot in the next battle. 

Flame returns to Fort Feather to figure out his next plan. Saps wants to hear good news from Flame, but Flame says he lost egg and can't even explain what happened. Saps expected more from somebody who used to be in the Mafia and asks how he even lost egg, Flame said the assassin he hired betrayed. Saps asks for his Elytra back, Flame doesn't even care and gives it without hesitation. He then brings up working with arachn1d isn't the worst idea if they want more players in the future. Saps says they're going to be on their own for now to get an idea of what they're getting themselves into without orbitals. Flame says Parrot is smart and tells Saps if he wonders if Parrot has an idea to counter the blimp, Saps says he might've planned for it, but they're all out of options and need to keep moving forward.

The Cindercrest army marches towards Merchant City, they see white flags in the distance, which meant they had surrendered. As they get closer, Parrot tells them himself that they surrender. Saps tells Parrot to come on down if he is going to surrender, but Parrot tells them to go on through as they all surrendered. Flame thinks they should take this opportunity to walk right in, but Saps sees right through Parrot and tells all of them to not go through. Saps decides to call the blimp over as their way of coming through, it's clear that neither party wants to move forward with the other's plan. Saps calls all of them to go back to the blimp and tells Parrot to try harder next time. Saps asks if they really think that's a real surrender, but Flame thinks they could easily just come right in and roll them. Flame asks again if Saps hadn't thought about if Parrot could counter the blimp, but there's nothing Parrot could realistically do about the blimp. 

In the blimp. Flame keeps saying Parrot might've accounted for it. Lomedy says he hoped they were honest about surrendering and all of the deaths wasn't necessary and that only Parrot cares about his own kingdom. Flame says he's never seen Parrot as that kind of player and that this isn't what he would be fighting for. The blimp gets closer and closer, they see that nobody is towering up to the blimp or attempting to, and once they reach the middle of the town, Flame stops the blimp and begins the procedure again of splashing them all with slow falling and attacking. However, this time, as they fall through the sky, arrows begin shooting upwards at insane speeds. Lomedy accidentally drops, Flame tells him to hold out a totem or a shield, but Lomedy's voice doesn't reply back to Flame. Flame looks in chat to see if Lomedy died, luckily, Lomedy comes in range and tells Flame that he's alive. '''I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Army''' is the 132nd episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Plot ==
[[FlameFrags|Flame]] starts off the episode by explaining that since the Unstable SMP is the largest hardcore in the world, it has some of the biggest armies to exist in Minecraft. After he joined the [[The Invisible Mafia|Invisible Mafia]], one of the former largest teams on the server, he didn't want to join another massive team again, as he preferred to be a solo player. However, this all changed when his best friend [[Lomedy]] wanted to talk to him.

Lomedy tells Flame he wants to talk to Flame about something serious, he says ever since [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] opened up spawn for new players, he says it came at a cost of old players have been running out of resources, starving to death, getting robbed by bandits, and Parrot hadn't done anything about it and that a new kingdom named [[Cindercrest]] has a goal to overthrow Parrot. Flame asks Lomedy if he thinks that sounds bad, Lomedy says he understands that it's bad, but if they helped Cindercrest this once, they could live on the server peacefully. He brings up that Flame told him they could do something he wanted to do, and doing this was what he had his mind on. Flame says he's not interested and that it's a terrible idea, and so Lomedy heads off on his own to join himself. Flame quickly goes after Lomedy and warns him of the dangers of joining Cindercrest. Lomedy brushes him aside and is hesitant on joining, Flame says that he is misunderstanding. In Flame's mind, this was a horrible idea as Lomedy could potentially die, and if Flame joined, there would be no benefit in joining when he could be training instead. Flame keeps trying to stop Lomedy from joining, Lomedy tells Flame if letting people starve and die, Flame is more selfish than he thought. Flame says he doesn't believe Parrot would let players just die like that, Lomedy says to him to tell that to the players that died and walks into the Cindercrest castle.

The two walk into the main castle and goes to the king of Cindercrest, [[Saparata]]. Saps asks if he can help them, Lomedy says he's joining Cindercrest, and Saps asks what skills he has. Lomedy says he's good at farming, which isn't exactly what Saps was looking for, so he asks what else, Lomedy says he has a mace, which instantly lets him in. Saps asks them if they know why they're doing this and goes on to tell them Parrot is letting old players to starve and they're going to make him pay for it. He then asks Flame if he's joining, Flame says he's not there because he belives in the cause, but he decides to join anyway. Saps then tells them they're going need to prepare soon, as they're heading into war. Lomedy is happy that they're fighting for a cause, Flame doesn't think they should join a war that has nothing to do with them and says there's no tradeoff. Lomedy says this is a cause he respects and decides to prepare. 

In the next scene, Flame stands right alongside [[ShoeBilly]] on a blimp, he makes small talk with Billy by saying it's interesting that it's only them on the blimp, Billy says it's obvious that they're both killers and among all of Cindercrest, they're the strongest.

Flame then monologues about how in order to take over the entirety of spawn, it's a game of control. They'd need to take control of all the major locations that surrounded spawn. Their first target was the training ground where Parrot kept his army; Fort Feather. The plan was for most of the army to attack from the ground, distracting them from below while a large group of them attacked from above.

The blimp gets closer to Fort Feather, Lomedy takes deep breaths in order to prepare. Flame then instructs everybody to huddle up in a corner and splashes them all with slow falling, he opens up the trapdoors and they all drop down into the fort and begins the war. Flame attacks a few players outside of the main building, he enters the building and a massive explosion trap gets set off, blowing up and killing everyone inside of it. Flame gets Lomedy and the players of Cindercrest to back up. After the explosion is done, there's only one player in Parrot's army remaining, as the rest of them were distracted by the blimp and fled. Once the last player was dealt with, they had taken over Fort Feather. This was great for Cindercrest, but there were still many places they needed to take over. 

Saps calls a meeting with Flame to talk about their next steps. Flame sits in a meeting with Saps, Lomedy, and an [[Invisible Guy|invisible assassin]]. Saps says their next location they should take on is [[Merchant City]] and that the blimp worked well, but thinks they need a better weapon: the [[Orbital Strike Cannon|orbital strike cannon]]. He says [[Wemmbu]] is the only person that he knows that wields these kinds of weapons and the only person who has beaten Flame in a fight, only because of these orbitals. Saps tasks Flame to find the location of the cannons and tells him to move fast and that there's no time. He gives Flame an Elytra which would help move faster and brings up the invisible assassin and mentions that they know a lot about the server. Flame stops him and tells him an Elytra has nothing to do with mastering combat and he doesn't want to work with the invisible player. Saps says he doesn't care about Flame's combat quest and taking down Parrot is more important, if they win, the server would go back to how it's supposed to be. Flame reluctantly agrees and asks the assassin what to do. The assassin says their best chance to get their hands on the orbitals is to take [[Eggchan]] hostage to interrogate him about where the cannons are, and if he doesn't comply, they'll kill him.

Flame monologues again, he explains that the orbital strike cannons are capable of one-shotting fully stacked players, and the wielders of these cannons was Wemmbu, who had the strongest weapons on all of Unstable. Forcing information out of him wasn't going to be easy, so targetting egg was the better option.

Flame and the assassin run through a desert, he asks how they're going to find egg, as he knows nothing about egg besides that he's Wemmbu's friend. The assassin says they have an idea and tells Flame to wait there, they pull a stasis and teleports away. Flame wanders around the desert and complains about Saps forcing him to work with a random player, just then, the assassin teleports right back to Flame and says they found him and tells him to follow them. They make it to [[The Wheat Kingdom|Wheat Civilization]], Flame asks why they're headed towards there, the assassin says egg is friends with them. Flame sees that all of the wheat has been taken and wonders what happened, the assassin says they were attacked and robbed out of all their food. Flame then asks how they stasised away and back, but he doesn't expect an answer of how. They keep walking into the civilization, they find egg standing at the front of the castle, egg already knows what's going on and asks what he wants with him. Flame apologizes and tells him to come with him and the assassin for questioning and if he complies, he can come back. A member of the civilization writes in a sign saying they can't take him, a group of players from the civilization then begin attacking Flame. Flame ignores them and tells egg to follow them, egg tells them to stop and agrees to go with them in order to not see them die. 

Back over at Flame's base, Flame encages egg inside a pile of obsidian for safety precautions and if he answers their questions, he can leave. He finally asks egg where the orbital strike cannons are, and egg says he can't answer that. Flame begins hitting him, egg says he can't answer that because of his integrity and keeps insisting that he can't tell Flame. Flame says he already admitted to knowing where they are by saying he can't tell him and that he should be able to know as he's Wemmbu's best friend. Egg says back to him he hops on Minecraft because they're best friends, but that doesn't mean he knows Wemmbu's secrets. Flame asks how Wemmbu would feel if he died right there and egg asks if they want him to call him and asks how he would feel. Flame blocks off the block emitting light into where egg is, he says he's being nice with all things considered. He asks one more time for the location, egg says he doesn't know again. Just as he says that, two guards protecting Flame's base dies, Flame assumes it's Wemmbu and tells Lomedy to be careful. Wemmbu confronts Flame and asks if he has egg, Flame says he's forced to work with the assassin because he's in Cindercrest. Wemmbu asks for egg back, Flame says no and he'll bring egg back to him when he answers their questions. Wemmbu gives them a final warning before he sets off orbitals all over the base. Flame says he's being unreasonable and that he didn't give them enough time. Wemmbu and Flame keep on fighting, Flame gives Lomedy the sign to kill egg. Lomedy is insistent on it, he asks if Wemmbu is on him, which gets Wemmbu to focus his attention on Lomedy. When they get to the obsidian pile, they see that egg isn't there anymore and they all stop fighting. Wemmbu asks if they told the invisible assassin where egg was and Flame says they worked together to get egg, Wemmbu then says that the player took egg. Flame blames Wemmbu for this even happening and that he blew up the base for no reason, Wemmbu says they were the ones who kidnapped egg for no reason. Flame asks what they're going to do next, Wemmbu says he was just betrayed and that they should work together to figure out who the invisible player is and that will lead to egg's whereabouts. Wemmbu says he knows a person that can help them and Flame agrees to come along. 

Flame's monologue goes on to say that him and Wemmbu were relatively cool with each other and admits that it sucks to go behind his back to kidnap Eggchan all to steal his cannons, but if he didn't, Cindercrest would have no chance in beating Parrot, which would put Lomedy at risk. With all that, he had to put himself first. They head out to the [[Great Sea]], where they met up with [[Linnwyrm]], who knew where the assassin could've been. They also ran into [[Jaden_MAN]], who Flame had bad history with. Flame had no other choice but to work with him, and once Wemmbu regeared, they were ready to go on their journey.

The three of them boat to a huge island, they spot five players, [[yungyx]] and [[arachn1d_]] and three members of their civilization. Wemmbu threatens to blow them all up, but yungy says if they fight, egg would die. All of them walk together up the island to the platform where egg is located with the invisible player. The invisible player says they gathered them all there to make a proposition: whoever pays the most will be given egg. Yungy offers three diamonds at first, egg asks to raise the value as he believes he's valued more. The invisible player pulls egg's stasis to another location for his own safety. Wemmbu then steps up and offers his entire ender chest. Yungy goes higher and offers a stack of diamond blocks, Flame says he'll offer two stacks of diamond blocks on behalf of Cindercrest as well as his combat skills. Wemmbu thinks all of this is to bring egg back to them, but Flame says this was on behalf of Cindercrest, which meant he was still trying to get egg for himself. The auction keeps going, the invisible player tells arachn1d to go all out and keep bidding. Wemmbu interrupts and says to give him egg now or else everyone there dies. He sets off an orbital strike cannon and a fight between all of them break out. Wemmbu targets Flame and pops him, Flame flies up on top of a peak to grab his own fishing rod, hooked up to it is his own [[Orbital Dog Cannon|orbital dog cannon]]. The dogs do tons of damage to yungy, which causes him to fall down a hole created by a stab shot. 

They drop down into the cave area of the island, Flame gets yungy in webs and pops his totems, he gets yungy to drop rockets in exchange for sparing his life. A fight breaks out with only Flame and Wemmbu, a stab shot reveals another part of the island, a lush cave hidden deeper down. Wemmbu finds himself getting in a fight with the invisible player, so Flame focuses on yungy. Yungy asks what they're fighting for, Flame says he doesn't know and that it's for egg, yungy says they're both trying to get to egg and suggests trying to find him together, but Flame likes the idea of killing yungy more. Yungy decides to go find egg himself and flies off towards an unexplored area.  Flame keeps chasing and attacking yungy through the maze until they make it to another platform surrounded by lava. They're forced to stop when Wemmbu says egg will die if they keep on fighting. The invisible player speaks up, they say they're willing to negotiate. Arachn1d goes first, he offers the entire treasury of the caverns in exchange for egg becoming a prisoner. The invisible player accepts the offer, they say eggchan will be safely delivered as soon as they receive the first half of the payment, and once he's delivered, they expect the second half. Flame asks Wemmbu if he wants to kill them, but Wemmbu says they can't cause they're just going to kill egg. Flame asks what's stopping him, Wemmbu says he's going to tell them where Lomedy is and he'll be in the exact same situation. With that being said, Flame decides to head out. Flame couldn't get the orbitals without taking things too far, which meant Cindercrest would lose their best chance at beating Parrot in the next battle. 

Flame returns to Fort Feather to figure out his next plan. Saps wants to hear good news from Flame, but Flame says he lost egg and can't even explain what happened. Saps expected more from somebody who used to be in the Mafia and asks how he even lost egg, Flame said the assassin he hired betrayed. Saps asks for his Elytra back, Flame doesn't even care and gives it without hesitation. He then brings up working with arachn1d isn't the worst idea if they want more players in the future. Saps says they're going to be on their own for now to get an idea of what they're getting themselves into without orbitals. Flame says Parrot is smart and tells Saps if he wonders if Parrot has an idea to counter the blimp, Saps says he might've planned for it, but they're all out of options and need to keep moving forward.

The Cindercrest army marches towards Merchant City, they see white flags in the distance, which meant they had surrendered. As they get closer, Parrot tells them himself that they surrender. Saps tells Parrot to come on down if he is going to surrender, but Parrot tells them to go on through as they all surrendered. Flame thinks they should take this opportunity to walk right in, but Saps sees right through Parrot and tells all of them to not go through. Saps decides to call the blimp over as their way of coming through, it's clear that neither party wants to move forward with the other's plan. Saps calls all of them to go back to the blimp and tells Parrot to try harder next time. Saps asks if they really think that's a real surrender, but Flame thinks they could easily just come right in and roll them. Flame asks again if Saps hadn't thought about if Parrot could counter the blimp, but there's nothing Parrot could realistically do about the blimp. 

In the blimp. Flame keeps saying Parrot might've accounted for it. Lomedy says he hoped they were honest about surrendering and all of the deaths wasn't necessary and that only Parrot cares about his own kingdom. Flame says he's never seen Parrot as that kind of player and that this isn't what he would be fighting for. The blimp gets closer and closer, they see that nobody is towering up to the blimp or attempting to, and once they reach the middle of the town, Flame stops the blimp and begins the procedure again of splashing them all with slow falling and attacking. However, this time, as they fall through the sky, arrows begin shooting upwards at insane speeds. Lomedy accidentally drops, Flame tells him to hold out a totem or a shield, but Lomedy's voice doesn't reply back to Flame. Flame looks in chat to see if Lomedy died, luckily, Lomedy comes in range and tells Flame that he's alive. Theo taunts Flame and thanks him for all of the loot, Parrot then instructs [[ReinaDrop|Reina]] to let all of the [[Merchant City Vanguard|vanguard]] in. Flame doesn't want to kill Parrot, Parrot says Flame was the one who raided the city. The Merchant City Vanguard come barging in, Flame easily gets outnumbered by the amount of guards, he tells Lomedy to run and goes around seeing if anymore Cindercrest members are alive, but sees no one. He pearls out and tries to crossbow cart the vanguard right before the pearl lands, but fails. 

Saps calls a meeting with the remaining players of Cindercrest, they had suffered a major loss at Merchant City, but they have to move quickly, since Parrot may be coming to their location next. Saps says they're going to form an alliance with the arachn1d kingdom and to prep quickly and they'll go to arachn1d's kingdom as soon as possible. Flame asks Saps what that was all about, he thought they had a real chance at taking over Merchant City and without his doubts, him and Lomedy would've been dead because of him. Saps says he said best shot, not a guaranteed shot, and Flame was the one who failed to get the orbitals. He says that death happens in war and tells Flame to start marching and heads off. Flame stays back and asks Lomedy to leave the war, he says there's nothing in it for either of them, Flame isn't getting any better and Lomedy isn't saving anybody. Lomedy still wants to help, he believes it'll help once they win and the server won't have to suffer anymore. Flame thinks it's pointless, Lomedy says he just doesn't understand and tells Flame he's selfish for thinking this way. Flame admits that he is selfish, but being selfish is how your survive on a server like Unstable. The episode ends as Lomedy goes to march with the rest of Cindercrest and Flame stands on top of the house all angrily looking down on the rest of the players.

title: I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server
content:
I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server is the 62nd episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

 Plot 
After escaping Paragon, Parrot takes the end portal to get to spawn — which has been completely destroyed, leaving nothing but lava cast towers and Withers in the sky, while Parrot has nothing but nine carrots in his inventory. The Withers begin to chase him, and his food runs out. Just then, he finds his old friend, TheobaldTheBird, who has built a small shelter and is fighting off Withers with just a set of iron armour. Miraculously, he manages to kill two of them, giving Parrot food to survive. Theo says that with the two Nether Stars he collected, he will pay his taxes in a city called Capital City. Paranoia sets in for Parrot — suspecting that Theo will either kill him or leave him behind, but Theo has no ill intentions, and the two of them set off for the city.

Capital City is ruled by Reddoons, a greedy tyrant who kept the poor in servitude during the Mafia regime. Anyone can start a business, but they have to pay a tax of 90% of their earnings. Parrot is given a small shop on Market Street, where the previous owner left behind brewing supplies. However, in an entire day, Parrot makes only one sale. He doesn't plan on staying for long, but upon seeing the vast crowds of players and his low potion sales, he realizes he will be stuck here for a while. When Reddoons isn't monitoring the players, they gather in a secret underground black market nearby to conduct illegal business. Puqi, a friend of Theo, sells him illegal explosives and gives an offer to help them rescue his friend from spawn for 64 diamonds. Parrot initially refuses to participate, finding it risky, but Theo pressures him into it. Back at shop, Parrot is still hesitant to go with Theo to smuggle the player in, but after getting robbed in broad daylight by FlameFrags and another player who breaks his chest of potions, he ultimately agrees.

During the rescue mission, Parrot and Theo use invisibility potions to go unnoticed. Although their target, DragonMC, is fifteen minutes late, they successfully rescue him and escape the Withers. Upon arriving in Capital City, DragonMC is impressed by its sheer scale.

Word gets out that Parrot and Theo were rescuing players from spawn and smuggling them into the city, and it becomes a stable form of income for the two, one they keep hidden from Reddoons. On one mission, they encounter a group of scammers led by Boosfer, who are gaining diamonds through a rigged minecart-based gambling game. The mechanism of the scam is well-designed, but Parrot figures it out just as Theo loses for the second time. Parrot loots the hopper underneath the rails, stealing all the items, and the two flee despite the threats from Boosfer and his friends.

Back in the city, Reddoons is collecting taxes. Parrot has nothing, but Reddoons gives him a second chance. His neighbour, however, owes 3 stacks of diamonds and since she can't pay, Reddoons threatens to kick her out. With all the kindness in his heart, Parrot secretly enters her house and places valuable totems of undying, netherite, and enchanted apples he stole from the scammers in one of her chests, helping her pay off her debts.

A short time later, Parrot is informed that he has a letter. The post office is in the town hall, in front of which a large crowd has gathered. The post office, however, is empty. Parrot's delivery is somewhere in the complex minecart transport system. Inside, there is a lodestone compass and a book from Leow0ok. In it, he explains that BAT is starting over and that everything is fine now, along with the location of Parrot's Happy Ghast. He wishes Parrot all the best and informs him that the location the compass points to is where he can find the Happy Ghast (affectionately named Sky) whom Parrot used during the BAT rescue operation in the war against the Director.

Parrot and Theo take train number 50 from the impressive central station. Along the route, however, they are ambushed by the scammers. The two friends split up. While Theo goes to get the ghast, Parrot creates a diversion, bluffing that the stolen items are hidden nearby. But the gangsters realize that and begin chasing the protagonist. Parrot escapes using ender pearls, a potion of speed, and wind charges. He climbs an incredibly steep mountain he had spotted during the journey, where Theo is waiting for him with the Happy Ghast. They make their escape and leave the ghast with the mayor's "Animal Care" department.

Their player rescue business brings them chests full of diamonds in profit, but they realize they aren't contributing to the server's well-being. For every player they save, hundreds more die. The two abandon their business, and Parrot closes his shop. Days later, however, Reddoons calls them in his office. He tells them he has found out about their business. After a short dialogue, the mayor offers them a deal: rescue a player named Hexatope. In return, Parrot demands the clearing of the entire city's debt, Reddoons agrees immediately.

Hexatope is loaded onto the Happy Ghast while Parrot and Theo are intercepted by Boosfer's crew of scammers. They decide it all ends here and now. In the ensuing fight, all of Boosfer's men are killed, and he flees. Back in the city, Reddoons announces the forgiveness of all debts in a solemn speech. A procession follows Parrot to his house where, as a token of her gratitude, his neighbor gives him an elytra— the very same elytra that Theo had wanted back in the city. The celebrations continue. The two friends climb the massive city wall and reflect on what has happened, deciding to become a team once more. Parrot says: "90% of the people on this server die at spawn, and for the vast majority of the survivors, Capital City is their reality."

"What do we do about it?" asks TheobaldTheBird.

"We save them," is Parrot's firm reply.

 Trivia 

 YouTubers 8slice, also known as jameschargesit and ItzBlake can be seen in the crowd where Reddoons held his speech. They are not credited in the description as they are not official Unstable members despite being creators, instead, they joined the Unstable Event hosted by Parrot.
 Many people attended multiple events, some being mocaps, while others were at spawn with PvP enabled and withers flying around, potentially causing them to die. You can see some players have their original usernames in one scene, then a different variation of their username in another. This is caused by dying, then requeuing back into the event.
 The video's original title was “The Unstable SMP Experience”.
 The players walking backwards was completely improvised by the players during the event, Parrot saw it and liked it so much that he said he'd try to find a way to include it in the video.
 Players made another chain during the event and started a congo line inside of the black market. Although Parrot found it amusing, he wanted players to scatter around.

Parrot is given a small shop on Market Street, where the previous owner left behind brewing supplies. However, in an entire day, Parrot makes only one sale. He doesn't plan on staying for long, but upon seeing the vast crowds of players and his low potion sales, he realizes he will be stuck here for a while. When Reddoons isn't monitoring the players, they gather in a secret underground black market nearby to conduct illegal business. [[Puqi]], a friend of Theo, sells him illegal explosives and gives an offer to help them rescue his friend from spawn for 64 diamonds. Parrot initially refuses to participate, finding it risky, but Theo pressures him into it. Back at shop, Parrot is still hesitant to go with Theo to smuggle the player in, but after getting robbed in broad daylight by [[FlameFrags]] and another player who breaks his chest of potions, he ultimately agrees.

During the rescue mission, Parrot and Theo use invisibility potions to go unnoticed. Although their target, [[DragonMC]], is fifteen minutes late, they successfully rescue him and escape the Withers. Upon arriving in Capital City, DragonMC is impressed by its sheer scale.

Word gets out that Parrot and Theo were rescuing players from spawn and smuggling them into the city, and it becomes a stable form of income for the two, one they keep hidden from Reddoons. On one mission, they encounter a group of scammers led by [[Boosfer]], who are gaining diamonds through a rigged minecart-based gambling game. The mechanism of the scam is well-designed, but Parrot figures it out just as Theo loses for the second time. Parrot loots the hopper underneath the rails, stealing all the items, and the two flee despite the threats from Boosfer and his friends.

Back in the city, Reddoons is collecting taxes. Parrot has nothing, but Reddoons gives him a second chance. His neighbour, however, owes 3 stacks of diamonds and since she can't pay, Reddoons threatens to kick her out. With all the kindness in his heart, Parrot secretly enters her house and places valuable totems of undying, netherite, and enchanted apples he stole from the scammers in one of her chests, helping her pay off her debts.

A short time later, Parrot is informed that he has a letter. The post office is in the town hall, in front of which a large crowd has gathered. The post office, however, is empty. Parrot's delivery is somewhere in the complex minecart transport system. Inside, there is a lodestone compass and a book from [[Leow0ok]]. In it, he explains that BAT is starting over and that everything is fine now, along with the location of Parrot's Happy Ghast. He wishes Parrot all the best and informs him that the location the compass points to is where he can find the Happy Ghast (affectionately named [[Sky]]) whom Parrot used during the BAT rescue operation in the war against the [[Wifies|Director]].

Parrot and Theo take train number 50 from the impressive central station. Along the route, however, they are ambushed by the scammers. The two friends split up. While Theo goes to get the ghast, Parrot creates a diversion, bluffing that the stolen items are hidden nearby. But the gangsters realize that and begin chasing the protagonist. Parrot escapes using ender pearls, a potion of speed, and wind charges. He climbs an incredibly steep mountain he had spotted during the journey, where Theo is waiting for him with the Happy Ghast. They make their escape and leave the ghast with the mayor's "Animal Care" department.

Their player rescue business brings them chests full of diamonds in profit, but they realize they aren't contributing to the server's well-being. For every player they save, hundreds more die. The two abandon their business, and Parrot closes his shop. Days later, however, Reddoons calls them in his office. He tells them he has found out about their business. After a short dialogue, the mayor offers them a deal: rescue a player named Hexatope. In return, Parrot demands the clearing of the entire city's debt, Reddoons agrees immediately.

[[Hexatope]] is loaded onto the Happy Ghast while Parrot and Theo are intercepted by Boosfer's crew of scammers. They decide it all ends here and now. In the ensuing fight, all of Boosfer's men are killed, and he flees. Back in the city, Reddoons announces the forgiveness of all debts in a solemn speech. A procession follows Parrot to his house where, as a token of her gratitude, his neighbor gives him an elytra— the very same elytra that Theo had wanted back in the city. The celebrations continue. The two friends climb the massive city wall and reflect on what has happened, deciding to become a team once more. Parrot says: "90% of the people on this server die at spawn, and for the vast majority of the survivors, Capital City is their reality."

"What do we do about it?" asks TheobaldTheBird.

"We save them," is Parrot's firm reply.

== Trivia ==

* YouTubers 8slice, also known as jameschargesit and ItzBlake can be seen in the crowd where Reddoons held his speech. They are not credited in the description as they are not official Unstable members despite being creators, instead, they joined the Unstable Event hosted by Parrot.
* Many people attended multiple events, some being mocaps, while others were at spawn with PvP enabled and withers flying around, potentially causing them to die. You can see some players have their original usernames in one scene, then a different variation of their username in another. This is caused by dying, then requeuing back into the event.
* The video's original title was “The Unstable SMP Experience”.
* The players walking backwards was completely improvised by the players during the event, Parrot saw it and liked it so much that he said he'd try to find a way to include it in the video.
* Players made another chain during the event and started a congo line inside of the black market. Although Parrot found it amusing, he wanted players to scatter around.

content:
I Manipulated 1000 Players on the Unstable SMP is the 56th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Spoke attacks Bacon because he called him "broke". Then he sails out to a piece of land and declares it the capital of the Spoke Galactic Empire. Spoke makes some rules such as "No Treason", "Never Hit Spoke", "Don't touch the Rules", and "Have fun". Spoke then attacks Jaron to get revenge on him. Jaron escapes. They take his cows although the cows and players were never seen again. Spoke punishes the players who kill others such as Odessify_Sigma. He then attacks Horace's secret base and takes him back to the capital. There, Horace is forced  to teach the citizens of the Spoke Galactic Empire to build. Spoke survives an assassination attempt. Spoke notices he's being stalked by an invisible diamond player who later turns out to be Mapicc. Spoke takes Mapicc to spawn to show the obsidian highway that the players used from the massive spawn prison during the The Invisible Mafia Arc. They return back to the capital to turn out the capital was under attack by it's own citizens. Houses were burning, players killed, assassination attempts as common as a blade of grass in a plains. Spoke leads the players to the remains of Sleepy Nation that once joined the Invisible Mafia. Spoke finds Hannahxxrose and drops a quote of Theseus. Spoke orders the players to attack Hannah. Hannah pops several times. Hannah eventually escapes via escape route. Spoke notices the noticeable lack of armor during the fight. Someone tried to respawn anchor bomb Spoke but he survives. Spoke returns back to the capital to see how much progress Horace has made on his castle. To his surprise he finds his castle complete. Spoke realizes his castle was built on a gravestone. Spoke realises someone is trying to build a taller house thana him. He goes to investigate only to realize it was a trap. Spoke pops a totem but survives the trap. Spokes makes a conclusion that all of these assassination attempts are due to the fact that they haven't had enough conquering and violence yet. Spoke leads his troops to the End Dimension to find MinuteTech. Spoke realises  he's going to accidentally grief Minute's end base. Once the players arrive, the players completely overwhelm Minute. Spoke leads  them back to the overworld to prevent any further damage. Spoke slowly loses control of his army and they eventually turn on him. 

 Trivia 

 This is the first episode to be entirely based on Unstable Events.
 This is the second least viewed Unstable Universe video.
 The video's original title was "1017 Players VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP..."

title: I Mastered Minecraft Combat
content:
I Mastered Minecraft Combat is the 23rd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

Plot

While being shown around his treehouse, Wemmbu asks ManePear if he can be taught how to fight. Mane replies by saying that everyone wants to learn how to fight, but not all are willing to put in the effort, and if he were to train Wemmbu, there would still be nothing that would make him stand out. Mane walks him outside, but Wemmbu, willing to prove himself, attempts and fails to mace him twice. Now realizing that mafia members could kill Wemmbu and take the weapon, Mane agrees to train him, though on one condition: he takes the mace until the training is complete.

Wemmbu builds a PvP kit. The two travel to a mafia outpost and grief it, killing one player in the process. They later spar on a playing field, where Wemmbu learns more about what he needs to improve on. He makes another kit under the instruction to “make an ideal [one].” Then, he is told about the mafia rankings, and invited to eat dinner with Mane. Over the meal, Mane says that the outpost they raided was an untrimmed base, and that there is a gold-trimmed one in a nearby mesa. Here, Wemmbu kills an iron-trimmed player, and Mane kills a gold, iron, and untrimmed player with the mace. They loot the building only to be chased out by multiple gold-trimmed players, as well as one diamond-trimmed.

Back at Mane’s treehouse and using his materials, Wemmbu creates many restock boxes, and stores them in his enderchest. Mane pretends to be a mafia member to test his reflexes. They spar again, and Wemmbu is taught to play dirty and without honor. In dutiful response, Wemmbu begins the fight without letting him finish. During that night’s dinner, Mane suggests he fight against gold-trimmed players to more efficiently improve his capabilities. They discuss the differences in what (battle) items each rank holds. Understanding that gold-trimmed players would need shoulder boxes to restock, Wemmbu brings up the idea of camping out at a shulker farm, to which Mane says it would be unlikely since it’s not the players themselves who would be farming, but it was possible. Wemmbu sets out to do this and returns with the chestplate of three gold-trimmed players he killed. Mane is impressed, though he argues against Wemmbu’s idea to track down a diamond-trimmed player because, as illustrated by his words, “they use enchanted golden apples as regular golden apples.” They then discuss fighting styles and the fact that Wemmbu doesn’t have one. Mane heavily suggests he do. While going over the psychology of battle, Wemmbu attacks him. After almost getting popped, the video cuts back to a continuation of the psychology conversation where Mane is being annoyingly vague about how to go about making progress. Before Wemmbu leaves, however, he is told to offhand his totem. Mane attempts to mace him, but fails. He succeeds the second time. 

While flying with no set destination, Wemmbu encounters a hollowed out ice mountain and discovers that the hidden civilization belongs to Arcn and Loppezz. Angry at his presence, they kick him out. Wemmbu then travels to spawn, where he strikes a deal with Spoke—offering the location of elytras if Spoke tells him where he can find a diamond-trimmed player. They travel to the old PrinceZam Empire and loot it, eventually finding multiple in a chest underneath a pile of valuable blocks. When Wemmbu asks for the location, Spoke admits he doesn’t know where a specific player is, only the base where they reside. Shortly after, Wemmbu notices an invisible player and pops their totem, only to find that it’s eggchan, who has joined the mafia. Spoke leaves.

Egg explains that his duration in the mafia was boring, spending most of his time AFK at farms. He only came to Zam’s empire for a solo mission and thus is not able to give Wemmbu the coordinates to Mafia City as he states the only way he knows where it is in the first place was by following other players. Wemmbu takes Egg back to Mane’s treehouse, where Mane becomes upset by Egg’s arrival because he doesn’t want visitors. It’s implied that they know each other. Mane eventually relents and agrees to help Egg learn how to fight, though humiliates him by attacking and winning without any armor. He later says Egg can stay only if he builds farms and other useful things.

The next day, Wemmbu and Egg return to the hidden ice civilization in hopes of gaining their trust to lure a diamond-trimmed player in and kill him. Egg is not happy about the concept of betrayal, but agrees to the term, conseting half heartedly to his name being used as a sign of honor. When gold-trimmed players eventually come and take the citizens hostage, Wemmbu challenges the diamond-trimmed player to a fair one-on-one duel with no restocks. The terms are agreed upon, but then Wemmbu restocks anyway, and the diamond-trimmed player calls for backup. In the end, they draw as Wemmbu escapes. Egg tells him that he can’t work alone, and needs the help of others. They return to the treehouse, where Wemmbu tells Mane he popped a diamond-trimmed player. In response, Mane returns the mace, and asks to return to the ice civilization because he has something to do or discuss with said player. He tells Wemmbu and Egg to stay close when they spot the diamond-trimmed player flying out, but Wemmbu, convinced by Egg, stays behind to defend the civilization. After the mafia leaves, Egg and Wemmbu track Mane down, where they find him with the diamond-trimmed player. However upon arrival, the diamond-trimmed player flees, annoying Mane and making him upset at the two for ruining his plan. He later apologizes.

Wemmbu practices with the mace and becomes proficient with it, consistently popping Egg’s totems, however is told to properly enchant it with Wind Burst 1 (rather than 3). So he returns to spawn, where he gets playfully attacked by Spoke, who rants about annoying missions he’s been sent on by the mafia. Wemmbu tells Spoke he no longer cares about the coordinates for the mafia base on one condition: he gives Wemmbu a book for Wind Burst instead. The deal is made and Wemmbu returns to the treehouse, where Mane begs him for the mace. Confused and suspicious, Wemmbu refuses, while also inquiring about Egg’s whereabouts—a question that also goes unanswered. Mane, irritated by Wemmbu’s defiance, accuses him of never listening to instructions, which is “the reason why [he] isn’t improving.” In response, Wemmbu snaps at Mane and says he’ll fix whatever was currently happening himself, and travels to a field where Egg is being held hostage by FlameFrags, who says that Wemmbu has two choices: he hands over the mace or Egg dies. Wemmbu puts up a good fight and pops his totem, though is forced to give up his weapon in the end. 

He and Egg return to the treehouse. Mane doesn’t reply when Wemmbu calls out for him, but as Wemmbu flies around, searching for any trace, he finds a sign that says “lost cause.” He breaks it and returns to Egg, avoiding the question posed to him about Mane’s location by replying that he doesnt think he’s coming back.

 Trivia 

 This is the longest Unstable Universe video as it is a second away from being 4 hours long.
