title: I Ran for King on the Unstable SMP
content:
I Ran for King on the Unstable SMP is the 99th episode feature in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Parrot recaps the previous episode and mentions that LettuceK rigged the election from the start and planned to become the king himself. The election begins and Lettuce gathers the fifteen other candidates and tells them the three major rules: 1. Every two weeks the candidate pool will be cut in half. 2. Unlike other elections, votes are not permanent and players can change their votes at any time. 3. During the election, all candidates must live inside of the Northern Council, the top eight will live in the castle while the bottom eight will live in the towers. Once the rules are stated, Lettuce allows them to head to their rooms and wishes them luck winning the election. Parrot meets up with Theo to check out his room. Parrot knows that the election isn't hopeless as two days prior he received a message from a person who was named the Owl, who is presumably an insider of The Law, who without their help, Parrot wouldn't have gotten enough votes. A book is left inside of a lectern like they did in Parrot's shop asking to meet up from a week from now that would give Parrot information about Lettuce. Parrot tries to tell Theo about what he just read, but Theo is too distracted about the gear that was provided to them, which wasn't anything to use, Theo goes back to their potion shop to move their items to their new home. While Theo was doing so, Parrot goes to scout his competition out, he sees some familiar faces and some new. One of them is Boosfer, who Parrot questions how he even managed to get 380 votes. He asks Boosfer to show where he resides and Boosfer shows him around, Parrot spots a book planted in a lectern in Boosfer's room and makes up an excuse to leave, he mistakenly left the Owl's message in his room and goes back to his room. When he gets back to his room, he's greeted by a player who says he was sent by Lettuce to guard him, but Lettuce never mentioned any type of guard to protect, Parrot questions him and the guard makes up an excuse to leave, Parrot takes a look at the book and realizes that the book had been compromised and was replaced with a fake, he calls out for the guard who went invisible. With no other choice, Parrot aims his bow at the invis particles with intent of killing the player, he misses his first few shots, but miraculously managed to hit the player and killing him, which also luckily was far out enough to not load the message for the guards to see, he had successfully protected the Owl's identity. 

The next day, Lettuce called for another meeting, saying that the update has been updated. He says that a lot of the server members don't know who the candidates are and wants to host a debate and asks how the candidates feel about it. Boosfer speaks up and says the idea is garbage and doesn't like the idea of it as he believes the others wouldn't stand a chance against him. However, Lettuce says anybody who isn't present in the debate will automatically be removed from the election and that it'll be held one week from now. The debate is randomized using dispensers and Deputy_Ace steps up to call out who goes against who, Parrot is picked to go up against Lettuce. After everyone gets their opponent, Lettuce informs them that a guard of The Law went missing the night prior and asks the candidates knows anything about what happened, nobody speaks up and he says that they'll keep searching.

Parrot goes back to his room and catches Theo up with what the announcement was about, Theo is as shocked as Parrot, and Parrot thinks that it was rigged and there was a chance Lettuce picked Parrot himself, but he also finds this a good opportunity to actually debate Lettuce in front of thousands of players and potentially win and become king. Parrot reads the book again written by the Owl, which hinted at the fact that the information could help win against Lettuce, but in the meantime, Parrot and Theo heads off to try and get more votes. Their first stop is Capital City, their plan was to go around door to door, but Theo comes barging into people's houses which wasn't the way to go about this. They ended up getting no votes, Parrot wants people to vote who care rather than forcing them to vote, so they devise a plan to make posters. They swim to a middle of an ocean and start building a massive sign that says "VOTE PAROT", Parrot laughs in disbelief from the misspelling, but Theo thinks it's okay and still gets the point across. They put all of their signs in one place and Boosfer comes from behind and messes with them for the misspelling. Parrot asks how Boosfer even managed to get enough votes and Boosfer shows him the strategy of manipulating players to close their eyes and write his name in a book as fast as they can and sign it.

After three days of campaigning, they made little to no progress. Parrot and Theo are walking up to the Northern Council, they're stopped by Lettuce and a guard, as they try to walk past him, Lettuce asks to run an item check after the death of one of The Law's guards death. Parrot is scared, but still agrees to the item check although he still has the Owl's message in his inventory. Parrot remembers that the books weren't signed and deletes the entire message in the books and fills his entire inventory with cakes, Lettuce takes a look at the books and finds nothing and lets Parrot and Theo head forward, but lets them know that surveillance has been improved. Theo asks what's the deal with the guard and Parrot uses the book to write to him to meet outside of the Northern Council to talk, Parrot tells Theo how he had to kill the guard because he stole the message, which was bad since the security was now on high alert, would be a risk since the Owl wanted to meet in the middle of the Northern Council, but Parrot still planned on meeting up with them nonetheless.

Back in their room, Parrot and Theo practice their debate, Theo tries to convince Parrot to talk down on Lettuce and how terrible of a job he's done, but Parrot thinks it's wrong to stand somebody else. They spend hours debating, still waiting on a message from the Owl. As it turns nighttime, a few players start arriving at the Northern Council, who Parrot believed the Owl used as a distraction to meet up with Parrot. He asks Theo for invis potions and sneaks out of his room invis and investigates. It appears that Lettuce held a small meeting to mourn the death of the guard, another invisible player spots Parrot and Parrot follows them up top on the castle. The invisible player drinks milk, revealing themself to be Spepticle, who tells Parrot that he is the Owl. He says that he is a higher up in The Law and doesn't understand how he ended up there, Parrot gets Spepticle to confirm he was the one who sent him to Treebo Village and to meet up in the middle of the Northern Council and asks why he was chosen. Spepticle tells him that he doesn't know a lot about him, but wanted to say thank you as ever since he joined Unstable SMP, every town, every civilization he's joined, he ended up at the bottom, he then moved to Capital City and fell into debt, but Parrot gave him enough materials to pay them all off. With the kind gesture, it inspired Spepticle to help other players out and looked around the server to find opportunities to, and so he joined The Law. As he climbed the ranks, he realized Lettuce's definition of justice was skewed, and after he announced that he wanted to run for king, Spepticle didn't feel right about it, and it reminded him about Parrot and thinks Parrot is the one who is actually capable of saving the server and became the Owl to become a bird like Parrot. With his higher position, he decided to change rules and add new ones in order to help Parrot out in the election. He says that Lettuce believes that no matter what, he's going to win, but Spepticle lets Parrot know something: He doesn't have ahold of Wemmbu anymore and that Wemmbu escaped. This proved The Law's imcompetency and it would show there would be no more reason to vote for Lettuce. Spepticle also informs Parrot that he was assigned to be the commentator during the debate and assures Parrot that he'll make it to the top eight candidates. Parrot decides to head back to his room as it's getting early on in the day and asks Speticle to meet back up after the debate. 

The day of the debate comes, Lettuce gives Spepticle to commentate the debate. Most of the candidates talk about their plans and intentions if they become the king. One debate stands out in particular, during JumperWho and Boosfer's debate, Jumper says how one person was rooting for her and how she didn't care about it, so she drops out of the election, when it's Boosfer's turn, he says nothing. Of the first debates, the most emotional is the one between SirPig_ and Fymada. It highlights, on the one hand, greed and carelessness, and on the other, compassion. While the mayor of the Capitol city, SirPig_, explains how there is no need for improvement and talks arrogantly about himself, Fymada shares her worst personal experiences with taxes. The crowd jumps in her support.

Lastly, it is finally time for Parrot and Lettuce's debate. Spepticle first asks Lettuce what he would do to help the server if he were to become king, but Lettuce talks about what he's already done for the server, such as mass increases of wealth and protection for places such as Capital City and Redstone Town, planning on expand it further out to the Amplified and Far Lands. Parrot steps in and mentions how Parrot traveled hundreds of thousands of blocks to Treebo Village where The Law had no presence in, and that any civilization that is outside of the general area of spawn is in risk of danger. Lettuce says that's a big accusation and argues that he's been fighting the Pirate oppressors in the Great Sea, which has the crowd cheering for him. Spepticle asks Parrot the same question of what he would do as king, and Parrot says that there is a massive issue that needs to be addressed; a majority of people who join the server don't make it out of spawn, and if they manage to do so, they are forced to live on the server without any food or any shelter. He brings up the topic of the thousand players that Lettuce lead, who all died. He says how Lettuce sacrificed a thousand players in order to capture one player, which offends Lettuce. Parrot then asks if he's even able to bring out a captured Wemmbu twelve hours from now, then reveals to the entire crowd that Lettuce doesn't have custody of Wemmbu anymore and that it took a thousand players for Wemmbu to escape. Lettuce says that's a bold claim, then says it doesn't matter as he shouldn't take orders from a murderer. He then reveals that his investigation unit looked into his room and found the dead lawman's items in his room and was going to execute Parrot right then and there. Parrot then realized that Lettuce knew the entire time that Parrot killed the guard, only holding in the truth to expose him in front of the entire server. Spepticle steps up and covers for Parrot, he admits to killing the guard and storing the loot inside of Parrot's room. Lettuce asks for Spepticle's armor and makes him step in the cauldron, Parrot tries to get Spepticle to stop and take the blame for himself, but Spepticle takes the execution in order to let Parrot keep running for election.

After the debate, Parrot walks down the main highway when he sees Deputy_Ace and two guards running the opposite direction of Capital City where he repeatedly yells that the city is under attack. He sees a TNT cannon built high up in the distance and TNT placed all over the city and goes to investigate it. He splashes invisibility and goes all the way up to where the cannons are and destroys the redstone, he sees Spoke standing on one of them and sneakily breaks the redstone behind him, his invisibility runs out and he puts his armor on, which alerts Spoke of his presence. Spoke sounds extremely distraught and Parrot doesn't understand what lead to Spoke to act like this, and Spoke mentions that they killed his friend and that what he's going to do isn't as bad as what he's gone through. Parrot tells him that he can't do this, Spoke says he doesn't understand what he's saying, and if Parrot lost a friend, somebody that he cared about more than anyone else on the server, he would understand. Parrot says he's gone through just as much as Spoke has and Spoke isn't the only one who has lost friends on the server, he then asks what happened. Parrot talks Spoke out of blowing up the server, which gives Spoke the motivation to find his best friend again.

Over the course of the next few days, Parrot receives more votes despite what happened during the debate and managed to get into the top eight candidates after the first two weeks.

The last scene shows Lettuce and Deputy_Ace talking privately in their meeting room. Lettuce sounds stressed and says that everything was going wrong, Deputy_Ace says there's nothing to be worried about as he's still on top of the leaderboard. Lettuce says that he knows Spepticle was a traitor and saw Parrot kill him with his own eyes, he knows Spepticle saw something in Parrot and wants him to win and was snaking The Law the entire time. Deputy_Ace now notices and asks what Lettuce is going to do about it, Lettuce says he needs Parrot gone as he sees him as too big of a threat. Deputy_Ace thinks it's wrong to kill off one of the candidates, Lettuce says he's right and that it's too much of a risk to kill Parrot himself, so he's going to leave it to the rest of the candidates, so he decides to commence "The Purge".

 Trivia 

 Naparizel's shield banner pattern is the same one he uses on another scripted series called Heartless Horizon.
 There is most likely no connection between the two servers, as he's shown to be an antagonist in Heartless Horizon, but trying to seek peace in Unstable.
Boosfer said in one of his streams that almost everything he said was improvised, and that Parrot liked the peasant line so much, he asked Boosfer to keep saying it.

title: I Secretly Got Trained By My Minecraft Killer
content:
I Secretly Trained Got Trained By My Minecraft Killer is the 96th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
FlameFrags finds Swight, the fourth-best PvPer in the world, out in a town looking for students to teach PvP. Flame recognizes the banner pattern on his shield is similar to one of The Law, so he goes invisible, and Swight picks him up as a student. Swight is suspicious of Flame for not talking and being completely invisible, so Flame puts on a voice changer and heads to Swight's dojo. All of them head to the arena, and Swight teaches his students the basics of sword combat first. He fights them one on one, and Flame purposely plays badly at first so Swight doesn't suspect anything. Once Swight gives him a tip to improve, Flame trades hits with Swight, which impresses him. Next is shield disabling. Swight teaches them a technique to disable shields using their sword and axe at the same time. The other students fail to; Flame does it, and Yungy also manages to do it. Swight eliminates the students who did the worst and takes the remaining students to an archery range for practice and lets them chill for a minute. While Swight is gone, the other students press Flame for being invisible and having a voice changer and find it weird that he learned the techniques as soon as he was told how to. Swight returns and brings them back to the front of the dojo and sends the students on a mission that will test their real-world skills; he assigns them into two different groups to get the payments that he has yet to claim and to be aware of bandits around.

Flame and his group follow the compass, which directs them to a cave where usernames are shown underground; they gear up and go down into their base. Flame tries to talk to the people living in the base to see if they can get their treasures and leave, but they say it's inside of their base, so they own it, so Flame pots up and attacks them. Flame pops one of their totems, which Flame realizes would be bad since it would reveal his name, so he makes it his goal to keep his teammates alive so they can kill the bandits instead and in order to show that he can protect them. The bandits kill one of Flame's groupmates; Flame weakens the bandits and constantly webs them and lets Shandrea, his other groupmate, get the kills. They head back to the dojo; Swight is disappointed that they lost a player but still retrieved the loot nonetheless. Yungy and his groupmate Fredrick3D return with the loot but had it easier, only having to deal with one bandit. During the elimination process, Yungy argues that Flame's group should be eliminated for losing a player, but Swight counts the loss as the elimination. 

The next strategy Swight teaches them is how to drain a player's water bucket when webbed; he lets them split into two groups to train on each other. Yungy goes with Shandrea, leaving Flame with Frederick. During the practice, Flame's invisibility gets low, and when he places his shulker box, Fredrick steals it. Flame digs underneath the arena and hides; he tries to get to the auto-brewery to obtain more, but Fredrick mines towards him. Flame gets to the auto-brewer, gets invisibility, and gets Fredrick to give his shulker back. Back at the arena, Fredrick flexes that he beat Flame in a fight, and Flame says otherwise. Yungy defends Fredrick by saying Fredrick had better utility and beat Flame badly. Yungy accuses Flame of being somebody pretending to be bad to get advice from Swight, but Swight says he doesn't care about his identity or where he comes from, only to see people's true skills, and he makes Flame and Fredrick have a rematch; Flame beats Fredrick with ease. This time around, Swight eliminates two players, being Fredrick and Shandrea. Fredrick doesn't want to leave and decides to attack Swight, promptly causing Swight to fight back and kill him.

Swight's last task to see who gets to be his partner is to fight two elite bandits; he claims they are way better than them and will be hard to beat without proper training. While walking to the location, Flame and Yungy converse, and Yungy says Flame is cheating because he uses invisibility and doesn't know anything about him, which makes it unfair. They spot the bandits in the distance and pot up and go in for an attack. The bandits use TNT minecarts, which makes them play more cautiously. Yungy's armor durability gets low, and he runs away. The bandits say that it was embarrassing that Flame's teammate left, but Flame says he won't back down, but the bandits see it as a waste of time and walk away. Flame follows them back to their base and demands to fight again. The bandits say nothing will change if he tries fighting them again. Flame lets his invisibility run out and reveals his identity and starts fighting the bandits. Flame pops their totems, and they run deeper into their base; one of the bandits blows themselves up, and the other runs further down into the base. Flame continues to follow them and kill them. Flame returns to the dojo; walking up, he hears Yungy talking to Swight. He says that he ran from the fight and says that Flame died in the fight. As he said that, Flame shows up right behind him and surprises Yungy. Flame corrects him by saying he took the fight and killed both the bandits and that Yungy was the only one that fled. This showed Swight enough to eliminate Yungy, leaving Flame to be his sidekick. Yungy calls Flame a fraud before heading off. Swight pushes his mission with The Law to the side and starts a mission that he and Flame can do and tells Flame to follow him.

 Trivia 

 This video was originally titled "I Secretly Trained With My Own Killer", before being changed to "I Secretly Got Trained By My Minecraft Killer".
 One of the elite bandits, TBotWarrior54, had a sword named after Orbitorn and had his skin on. However, Orbitorn said he did not play the bandit.
 Flame refers to Wemmbu as a friend in this video, even though he has always considered him a rival.

Flame recognizes the banner pattern on his shield is similar to one of [[The Law]], so he goes invisible, and Swight picks him up as a student. Swight is suspicious of Flame for not talking and being completely invisible, so Flame puts on a voice changer and heads to Swight's dojo. All of them head to the arena, and Swight teaches his students the basics of sword combat first. He fights them one on one, and Flame purposely plays badly at first so Swight doesn't suspect anything. Once Swight gives him a tip to improve, Flame trades hits with Swight, which impresses him. Next is shield disabling. Swight teaches them a technique to disable shields using their sword and axe at the same time. The other students fail to; Flame does it, and [[Yungwillx|Yungy]] also manages to do it. Swight eliminates the students who did the worst and takes the remaining students to an archery range for practice and lets them chill for a minute. While Swight is gone, the other students press Flame for being invisible and having a voice changer and find it weird that he learned the techniques as soon as he was told how to. Swight returns and brings them back to the front of the dojo and sends the students on a mission that will test their real-world skills; he assigns them into two different groups to get the payments that he has yet to claim and to be aware of bandits around.

Flame and his group follow the compass, which directs them to a cave where usernames are shown underground; they gear up and go down into their base. Flame tries to talk to the people living in the base to see if they can get their treasures and leave, but they say it's inside of their base, so they own it, so Flame pots up and attacks them. Flame pops one of their totems, which Flame realizes would be bad since it would reveal his name, so he makes it his goal to keep his teammates alive so they can kill the bandits instead and in order to show that he can protect them. The bandits kill one of Flame's groupmates; Flame weakens the bandits and constantly webs them and lets Shandrea, his other groupmate, get the kills. They head back to the dojo; Swight is disappointed that they lost a player but still retrieved the loot nonetheless. Yungy and his groupmate Fredrick3D return with the loot but had it easier, only having to deal with one bandit. During the elimination process, Yungy argues that Flame's group should be eliminated for losing a player, but Swight counts the loss as the elimination. 

The next strategy Swight teaches them is how to drain a player's water bucket when webbed; he lets them split into two groups to train on each other. Yungy goes with Shandrea, leaving Flame with Frederick. During the practice, Flame's invisibility gets low, and when he places his shulker box, Fredrick steals it. Flame digs underneath the arena and hides; he tries to get to the auto-brewery to obtain more, but Fredrick mines towards him. Flame gets to the auto-brewer, gets invisibility, and gets Fredrick to give his shulker back. Back at the arena, Fredrick flexes that he beat Flame in a fight, and Flame says otherwise. Yungy defends Fredrick by saying Fredrick had better utility and beat Flame badly. Yungy accuses Flame of being somebody pretending to be bad to get advice from Swight, but Swight says he doesn't care about his identity or where he comes from, only to see people's true skills, and he makes Flame and Fredrick have a rematch; Flame beats Fredrick with ease. This time around, Swight eliminates two players, being Fredrick and Shandrea. Fredrick doesn't want to leave and decides to attack Swight, promptly causing Swight to fight back and kill him.

Swight's last task to see who gets to be his partner is to fight two elite bandits; he claims they are way better than them and will be hard to beat without proper training. While walking to the location, Flame and Yungy converse, and Yungy says Flame is cheating because he uses invisibility and doesn't know anything about him, which makes it unfair. They spot the bandits in the distance and pot up and go in for an attack. The bandits use TNT minecarts, which makes them play more cautiously. Yungy's armor durability gets low, and he runs away. The bandits say that it was embarrassing that Flame's teammate left, but Flame says he won't back down, but the bandits see it as a waste of time and walk away. Flame follows them back to their base and demands to fight again. The bandits say nothing will change if he tries fighting them again. Flame lets his invisibility run out and reveals his identity and starts fighting the bandits. Flame pops their totems, and they run deeper into their base; one of the bandits blows themselves up, and the other runs further down into the base. Flame continues to follow them and kill them. Flame returns to the dojo; walking up, he hears Yungy talking to Swight. He says that he ran from the fight and says that Flame died in the fight. As he said that, Flame shows up right behind him and surprises Yungy. Flame corrects him by saying he took the fight and killed both the bandits and that Yungy was the only one that fled. This showed Swight enough to eliminate Yungy, leaving Flame to be his sidekick. Yungy calls Flame a fraud before heading off. Swight pushes his mission with The Law to the side and starts a mission that he and Flame can do and tells Flame to follow him.

== Trivia ==

* This video was originally titled "I Secretly Trained With My Own Killer", before being changed to "I Secretly Got Trained By My Minecraft Killer".
* One of the elite bandits, TBotWarrior54, had a sword named after Orbitorn and had his skin on. However, Orbitorn said he did not play the bandit.
* Flame refers to Wemmbu as a friend in this video, even though he has always considered him a rival.

title: I Secretly Joined My Enemy's Minecraft Team
content:
I Secretly Joined My Enemy's Minecraft Team is the 71st episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The story begins with Wemmbu overhearing that Boosfer is after a great treasure in the Great Sea. As Wemmbu was walking through spawn, he saw Jaden_MAN recruiting new pirates, he then joined Jaden’s crew just to kill Boosfer, although he didn’t mention the reason. They then travelled to many islands, before encountering the Marine Rangers, which they infiltrated, which they found Parrot and Theo were also doing. The attack ends in a loss when it is a 2v5 for Wemmbu and Jaden, which they managed to escape. Locating a few pixels of an island, they travelled to that island, only to find nothing. While searching around, they were ambushed again, but this time Wemmbu saw one of the two players that knew about his identity and followed him. It started to rain, and Wemmbu used the riptide trident to catch up. He sneaks up behind Parrot as he's talking to Boomie and proceeds to use a Stab Shot on him, killing Boomie instantly. However, Parrot saw this and said that he only wanted peace and actually wonders who Wemmbu’s fake identity is. Wemmbu, feeling guilty but yet accomplished, riptided back to Jaden who had massacred the Marine Rangers. Jaden said that his treasure was actually an empty area to build his new pirate empire, which Wemmbu said he already has, bringing him back to the Marine Ranger's base. When returning, they saw TheLobsterMan, the leader of the Rangers. Wemmbu then started a fight with him, and ended up killing him, revealing his identity to Jaden. When he went to him, Jaden asked if he had read it right, Wemmbu lets Jaden keep his empire and threatens to kill Jaden if he ever steps foot out out of the Great Sea to avoid his identity from getting leaked. The episode ends with a flashback of the Pirate Arc, and Wemmbu being remembered on how he took the place of Jaden, killing an innocent who wants peace in front of a major character. The relationship between Jaden and Wemmbu still remains positive despite their recent conflicts as shown in a later episode

title: I Secretly Teamed With My Minecraft Killer
content:
I Secretly Teamed With My Minecraft Killer is the 100th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
After being picked up by Swight to be his sidekick, Flame joins Swight to help assist his mercenary jobs and get one on one training in order to beat The Law, still invisibile to prevent his identity from being revealed. Their first job is to help defend a village from a team of mountain bandits, the leader of the village mentions that if they keep coming back, the whole village would go extinct, they also aren't very wealthy and offers the enemy team's vault full of items as payment. Swight agrees on the deal, taking everything the enemy team has once the mission is done. During their time off, Flame and Swight practice PvP, Swight teaches Flame the basics of shield disabling as well as some tips to help better improve his skills. In the middle of practice, a horn is blown, signaling that the bandits were coming. The leader shows them dripstone traps and TNT cannons set up all across the base for them to use, then they go into hiding to let the two deal with it. Flame tells Swight to bait the bandits into the holes so the cannons can blow them up, but after the second shot, the cannon blows itself up. Flame jumps down and gets the bandits attention on him, he goes back into the village and uses a knockback sword to knock the bandits into the dripstone trap and dropping dripstone on them, killing them without showing his name. Swight falls into the trap and Flame pops the bandit's totems in the meantime. Swight gets back up and Flame pops more totems and uses the trap to kill more bandits, he gets knocked into a trap himself with two bandits, he has no way to escape, Swight comes down and kills the bandits stuck down there with him. They kill the last of the bandits, Swight asks why Flame wasn't directly fighting them, Flame says he was popping totems, which gets Swight off his tail. The leader leaves their hiding spot and tells them about another village that was recently attacked and asks to bring any remaining survivors back to their village. 

During their expedition, Flame asks Swight about his job and who he goes after, Swight says it doesn't really matter who, and only cares about how skillful the player is and how much he gets paid. He also mentions how he despises people who kill for titles or vengenace. They get to the village, which seems to be raided, but they look through the houses and see a few players hiding in them. One of the players tell them to do a sweep of the houses for anymore players, the first house Flame steps inside of has a fall trap and a dripstone at the bottom of it, he pops a totem and his invisibility gets cleared, Swight asks if he needs help, and Flame says no. He breaks all of the armor stands and splashes invis again before Swight comes down to help. They take the two remaining survivors back to the village, one of them falls into a powdered snow trap when he wasn't looking, the other walks back into the village where all of the people cheer for him. The leader tells Flame and Swight that there's downtime for them as their scouts were on the hunt for the enemies base. 

They go back to training, Swight notices Flame's aggressive playstyle, but isn't able to get close to him, so he shows Flame how to bow boost. Next, Swight tells Flame how important game sense is and to pay attention to what the opponent is doing, they practice against each other so Flame can learn Swight's fighting style. The leader comes and tells them that they found the bandit's base and leads the two there himself, once they get near, he leaves and lets Flame and Swight deal with it. They get to the top of the base, where the roof is made out of glass, Flame tells Swight to jump in while he drops carts from above. The cart strategy manages to kill tons of bandits, but when Flame isn't looking, one of the bandits TNT minecarts Flame and pops his totem, Flame quickly splashes invisibility and has to fend off the bandit. Flame uses the strategy of analyzing their playstyle to prevent getting carted, the bandit loses the battle and runs away. Flame jumps in and carts the rest of the bandits.

The two collect the loot and Swight complements Flame on how smart he is and how their styles match well. While restocking, the signature Law horn could be heard, which meant The Law has caught up to them, and they have a strict no invisibility rule. The lawman says that they have intel on Flame and tells Swight how Flame went missing and presumably faked his death to prevent being hunted, and to look out for him and that he uses cobwebs a lot and is a quick learner, Swight looks at Flame suspiciously and says that the description matches with him. Swight asks Flame to let the invisibility run out to regain his trust, Flame tries to lie and say he has no name and other excuses, but he has no other way to convince otherwise, so he lets his invisibility run out. The lawman goes to call for backup and tells Swight to hold him off, Swight sounds angry at the fact that he's been working with the person he was hired to kill. Swight says he could kill Flame himself rather than have The Law back him up so he can get the credit he deserves. Flame tries to tell his side of the story, how The Law is the same team that took everything from him, but Swight doesn't care about his problems and only cares about completing his mission. 

Flame pots up and challenges Swight to a fight, giving Swight his reputation if he does succeed in killing Flame. With the both of them being skilled PvPers, Swight pulls out his netherite armor, the fight goes on until Flame tells Swight to make a deal and that he'll keep running, he says how he would tell The Law how Swight trained him and teamed with him, taking all of Swight's credit and tarnishing his reputation. Swight asks what Flame could even offer, Flame says he can take the vault and doesn't care about the loot, so they head down to the vault, where hundreds of armor sets are stored and has a good amount of other resources. Swight seems satisfied and lets Flame off the hook, but before heading off, Swight gives Flame credit for being able to get him to put his netherite armor on and to stand proud. He tells Flame to become a mercenary himself once it's all over, he then leaves Flame with one last piece of advice: Learn the rest of the items and to find different players with different skills in order to master them. Flame heads out of the base and begins his journey to find his next trainer.

 Trivia 
This is the 100th video of Unstable Universe.

title: I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base...
content:
I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base... is the 32nd episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
After destroying The Invisible Mafia, Spoke stalks ashswagg for weeks on end and stumbles across his hidden base, Point Nemo. On the first day, ash goes out of the base and flies away, Spoke uses this as an opportunity to sneak into the base to look around, he then spots Squiddo and hides until he sees her go down a hidden path. On day two, he promises himself to stay inside of the base for a hundred days without being caught, he goes around finding more hidden entrances throughout the base, finding valuables as he goes along. On the third day, he decides to make his own secret base inside of the secret base. Over the next few days, he upgrades his base and makes hidden places where he can spy on ash and Squiddo, eavesdropping on their conversations. At one point, ash mentions needing to decorate the Dragon Egg room, which confirms that he still has the egg and is located inside of the base. Spoke wonders around and accidentally sets off pressure plates, playing noteblocks with a creeper head above it and emitting a creeper sound. He hides in the water as his invisibility runs out, hearing that ash and Squiddo were now on high alert and believes somebody is in the base, but in the end believed that it was something else they built that set it off. Spoke wanders around the base more and finds out about more hidden bases, he then sets up a room inside of his secret base to map out all of the rooms he's discovered. Days go by, and Spoke realizes in one of the tunnels he always headed left instead of straight, which lead to a secret Nether themed room with a portal. He sees Squiddo leaving the Nether as he came by, and goes in the Nether after her, the Nether has tons of Nether materials and a fountian of lava in the middle. Squiddo comes back to grab lava, Spoke hides in the fountain using fire resistance, and Squiddo mentions how the fountain of lava wasn't necessasry and picks the lava up. She leaves the Nether before the fountain is fully drained, and before Spoke's fire resistance ran out.

Afterwards, Spoke makes more secret entrances leading to his base, he spots Squiddo in a direction he's never seen before. He goes to investigate and sees Squiddo in her own hidden room, talking to her pet animals and building a house for them. While spying on Squiddo, Spoke's invisibility is about to run out, he's not able to drink more as Squiddo will hear it, so he parkours up on the clouds on the walls and up onto the corner of the roof. Squiddo doesn't spot him and he makes a tunnel leading back to his base from there. Spoke goes around the base and finds more hidden bases, where he finds a dragon head, which is considered rare on the server. One of the hidden entrances lead to a strange room with a bunch of mobs, Spoke gets anxious about getting caught with all his items, so he goes back. He sees Squiddo going through another direction that he's never seen before, he figures out how to activate the secret door, but it lead to only a room with a tree. He sits there for a few days until he decides to leave it, ash decides to come back on the same day and informs Squiddo that items have started to go missing from their chests. Ash says they need to set up more traps inside of the base and that if even one person knows where the base is, the entire thing would be compromised. For the next few days, Spoke builds more escape tunnels and looks for more traps and alarms. The next day, he realized that he never went through the room behind the lava wall, which lead to a strange meeting room with a room behind a painting, which was even more odd. The next day, he gets use out of the meeting room and overhears ash mentioning wanting to do a trade with Reddoons, the richest player on Unstable. Spoke plans on intercepting the trade and becoming the richest player himself. Over the next few days, he tries to look for the villager that was for trade, with no leads, he decides to watch one of them and follow them. He follows Squiddo down to a new hidden base, which lead down to an automatic sorter, but the room had no way out, so Spoke trapped himself down there for a day or two. Eventually, he finds a block of powdered snow disguised with the white carpets, where he finds tons of chickens in a hole with potions of wind charging and harming, he uses it to launch all the way up to a skybase full of shulkers.

The day after that, ash comes back and sounds the alarm, questioning where one of his leather armor sets went. Squiddo doesn't know and leads ash to her secret base she was working on, indirectly saving Spoke. He follows and hears ash saying they needed to set more alarms, so Spoke follows Squiddo to see where evrey alarm was placed so he could disarm them all. Squiddo tries to set one up in the mob room, but the mining fatigue didn't let her, so she leaves. Spoke uses this chance to stock up on potions to find any hidden entrances in the room, he finds a trapdoor behind a magma cube that lead to a door that required a passcode, he tries to break through it, but the mining fatigue didn't let him. He tries every other trick, but nothing helps, so he ends up mining the door down, which right after he realized he didn't have to do when there were redstone torches all around him. The room leads to a whole bunch of armor sets, with a few netherite sets, as well as a few weapons. He didn't want to steal yet, so he uses the button behind the armor stands to open another door, but it's too far away to press and run back. He tries to grab a riptide trident hanging above from an item frame, but it falls in the lava, however, he manages to get the other riptide trident. In his attempts to escape, he kills his fish George Junior. The hidden room had nothing inside of it, so he goes back and finds a button that lead to an exit that lead back to the mob room. While examining the mob room, Spoke spotted ash's name swimming out from one of the lava pillars and decides to check out if there were any bases above or under the lava pillars. He finds a lever behind the ghast, which opens the glass underneath one of the pillars, which reveals a stash with tons of rare items, but not the void one that ash mentioned. He sees ash heading down the lava, Spoke panics since he didn't want ash to see any particles, so he makes a portal from the room being built with all obsidian. He heads into the nether and when he went back through the portal, he was back in the hidden nether room and heads back to his base.

Over the next few days, he upgrades his base and makes hidden places where he can spy on ash and Squiddo, eavesdropping on their conversations. Spoke wonders around and accidentally sets off pressure plates, playing noteblocks with a creeper head above it and emitting a creeper sound. He hides in the water as his invisibility runs out, hearing that ash and Squiddo were now on high alert and believes somebody is in the base, but in the end believed that it was something else they built that set it off. Spoke wanders around the base more and finds out about more hidden bases, he then sets up a room inside of his secret base to map out all of the rooms he's discovered. Days go by, and Spoke realizes in one of the tunnels he always headed left instead of straight, which lead to a secret Nether themed room with a portal. He sees Squiddo leaving the Nether as he came by, and goes in the Nether after her, the Nether has tons of Nether materials and a fountian of lava in the middle. Squiddo comes back to grab lava, Spoke hides in the fountain using fire resistance, and Squiddo mentions how the fountain of lava wasn't necessasry and picks the lava up. She leaves the Nether before the fountain is fully drained, and before Spoke's fire resistance ran out.

He sits there for a few days until he decides to leave it, ash decides to come back on the same day and informs Squiddo that items have started to go missing from their chests. title: I Spent 100 Days Trapped in a Minecraft Void Base...
content:
I Spent 100 Days Trapped in a Minecraft Void Base...''' is the 44th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
Spoke sees an abandoned base or so he thought. He sees JumperWho . Spoke decides to hold out until Day 2 and that's when he saw Jumper showing off her base to the rest of Bounty Assassin Team. Spoke drank invisibility and followed them inside.

Spoke realises he had hit the jackpot for getting rich and realizes the base was suspended above the void. Spoke sees full netherite invisible players roaming the halls. On day 3, Spoke decides to explore the base. The base had areas to grow trees, mushrooms, and a mob grinder that seemed to be non-functional. On day 4, Spoke decides to eat some bread in the corner to muffle as much sound as possible so the base members don't hear him. On day 5, Spoke listened in on the conversation between Jumper and ParrotX2. On day 6, Spoke is almost caught by Derapchu, Parrot and Jumper. On day 7, Spoke hid from the spies. On day 8, Spoke found a vent. On Days 9 and 10, Spoke found more vents and explored them. He also found a bedroom of the spies that held invisibility. Spoke finds their meeting room. On day 11, Spoke got so lost he ended back up in the main room. Spoke found their map but he didn't know how to read it with just numbers. Spoke stumbled across a massive storage room and a cemetery. On day 12, Spoke roamed around the halls and eventually, stumbled across their server racks and control room that turned off/on lockdown, the lights, airlocks, etc... 

On day 13, Spoke made it back to the main room and found out how to get to the bedrooms. Spoke listens in on a meeting between Parrot, Derapchu, Jumper and Leow0ok. On day 14, Spoke was back in the main room. On day 15, Spoke was cutting it thin on food so he tried to figure out which number on the map meant "food". Eventually (after roaming around) Spoke found their farm and took some bread. On day 16, Spoke is caught eating a carrot in the farm by Parrot and tells Jumper and Derapchu to lockdown the base. Spoke hides in the vents avoiding Jumper and Derapchu who are checking the vents. Parrot thinks this invisible player is The Director. 

On day 17, Spoke decides this is his time to escape. Spoke fails to make it to the top due to his lack of firework rockets. On day 18, Spoke is caught by Parrot up in the ceiling, On day 19, Spoke barely escapes from Leow0ok. Spoke jukes them. On day 20, Spoke goes back into the control room and turns off the lockdown mode. Spoke turns everything off turning the base pitch black. On days 21 and 22, Spoke evades Jumper and Parrot. Parrot tells Jumper to fill the entire vents with water so they will either drown or must have access to a respiration III helmet. 

On day 23, Spoke listens to Parrots plan to remove any materials that are used to make invisibility potions. Spoke is caught in the vents but yet again he escapes from them. It was day 24 and 25, Spoke was running out of invisibility to stay hidden. Spoke found enough invisibility to last him 5 days in the potion room. Parrot decides to remove all sugar cane. Initially Spoke was confused on why Parrot told Jumper to remove sugarcane but that's when it hit him; sugarcane is an essential ingredient of making paper and therefore, firework rockets. Theoretically, Spoke could escape by flying out below the bedrock but the closest void hole was 50k blocks away. On day 26, Spoke stumbled across a flower room. On days 27 and 28, and 29 Spoke explored the vents hoping to find materials in the spy rooms.

Spoke didn't know who the Director was but he thought it was a cool name so he addressed himself as the director. By day 30, Spoke was running out of invisibility again. so he tried to find an ender chest. On days 31 and 32, Spoke went into the meeting room hoping  to meet an ender chest. Instead he saw Parrot. On day 33, Spoke left the meeting room in search of an ender chest. Throughout day 34, Spoke stalked his enemies. On day 35, Spoke saw a spy place an ender chest and realize he can't mine it due to the mining fatigue. On day 36, Spoke was on his way to his secret base to find he was locked out due to the mining fatigue. Day 37, all the cows were massacred. On day 38 there was no milk in the storage room either. On day 39, Spoke located the optimal tunnel that led to 3 different spy rooms conducting that milk was probably in one of the spy rooms. it took Spoke until day 40 to realize the map was actually useless and flipped. On day 41, Spoke swam into the graveyard. On day 42, Spoke nearly drowns. On day 43, Spoke brew some invisibility potions until on day 44, a random spy came into the room and started drinking all of his invisibility potions. 

On day 45, Spoke wanted to break an ender chest but Derapchu was in the other room. On day 46, Spoke saw and spy thought that he couldn't be cooler than the moonwalking spy. By day 47 Spoke was banking on the mob farm but it didn't. On day 48, Spoke almost gets caught by a spy. Spoke stumbles into a mysterious empty room on day 49. On day 50, Spoke explored the library finding hidden trapdoors disguised as decorative blocks. On days 51, and 52 Spoke started fishing. On day 53, Spoke went into his base and turned on toggle sneak to sleep. On day 54, Spoke tries his attempt at fixing the mob grinder. On day 55 Spoke finds a spy riding a pig. Spoke crafted rockets on day 56 and flew into the mod grinder. On day 57, Spoke tried getting out but he placed his boat out of reach so he was trapped. On days 58 and 59, Spoke went to listen to BAT's next meeting. On day 60, Spoke swapped important items with useless items. On day 61, Spoke threw out all of the food. On day 62, Spoke broke the auto-brewer. On day 63, Spoke tried breaking all the fishing rods, On day 64, Spoke gambled. On day 65, Spoke built laughing face emojis all over the floor. Spoke sees Parrot set up a decoy room. Spoke enters the decoy room alerting Parrot know Spoke was still in the base. 

On day 66, Spoke realizes he could make their lives as miserable as possible. On day 67, Spoke attempted to start a famine by breaking all the crops. On day 68, Spoke destroys all their fishing rods. On day 69, Spoke dropped all their saplings and bonemeal. On day 70, Spoke destroyed all the nether wart and re-broke the auto-brewer. On day 71 Spoke tried trolling the mysterious room. On day 72, Spoke removed all the lapis lazuli. On day 73 and 74, Spoke fell into a trance of walking in a circle. On day 75, Spoke tried breaking a block for a full minute. Spoke broke a block and now there was hole that lead into the void. Spoke hangs a cat named "whiskers" but he accidentally dropped it in the void. On day 76, he hangs a cat named "Kittens" over the void hole. He also poured buckets of water in the water filtration room. On day 77, Spoke scraps the idea of replacing the water in the fishing pond with lava. On day 78, Spoke crafts 32 tnt and turns  the 1 tnt into a TnT minecart. 

On day 85, 86, 87, and 88, Jumper discovers the map to be messed up. Spoke places sign saying "I AM THE DIRECTOR". A spy informs them of the water room attack in day 76. Spoke places another sign saying "THE DIRECTOR IS HERE". Jumper and Parrot find out Spoke hang their pets dangling over the void. Jumper attempts to rescue them but Spoke breaks the lead killing all of the pets. Spoke then places a lot of dirt attempting to lock them in their own base but Jumper has milk and mines out.  On day 89 Spoke makes a TnT Minecart trap, and multiple void holes to kill people. On day 90, Spoke's void hole kills the pig riding spy. On day 91, Jumper investigates but accidentally falls in but since she had an elytra she escapes the trap. On day 92 Spoke makes a cart trap. On day 93, Spoke sees Parrot stashing armor in the chest labeled with an oak door. 

On day 94, Spoke interrupts the meeting and leads them to the cart trap and pulls it failing to kill them. Spoke tries to escape but fails. They chase Spoke around the base. On day 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100 Spoke attempts to make Leow0ok betray but fail. Spoke is eventually captured. Spoke is placed into custody but escaps via chorous fruit. Frustrated, they reluctantly accept Spoke had escaped.

 Trivia 

 The video was originally titled "100 Days TRAPPED in a Minecraft Void Base".

title: I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Minecraft Base
content:
I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Minecraft Base is the 35th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

Plot
Immediately after the events of the previous episode, Spoke takes off to find Red. Spoke buys coords from Jaron, but ends up getting scammed. He proceeds to stalk and follow Jaron and Red until he finds their base. While inside, Spoke follows them in invis, finding secret rooms and pulling tricks on them. When Spoke accidentally kills Jaron and Reds pet, a white fox, he goes to PlanetLord, a player who he used to be allied with, and had collections of rare pets, including a white fox. Spoke replaces the fox whom he killed with the one from Planet, and tries to go back about his days. However, he finds the Mapicc and Planet have followed him, marking their first interaction since the Season One Finale. They ask why he is stalking these players, and Spoke claims it is because Reddoons killed his pet fish. He tries to force the duo to leave, however they refuse to.  Mapicc refuses to leave his side, and they go about stalking Jaron and Red. Back in their hidden area away from Red and Jaron's space, the three of them have a bedroom building contest, spoke going for a minimalist style, whereas Planet and Mapicc both went for more maximalist styles. After planet accidentally blows up his room and a portion of Mapicc's, Spoke declares that he wins by default. They three of them argue for a moment before Mapicc says that they should invite Squiddo, Mapicc and Planet reminisce about Squiddo and their friendship, but Spoke shuts them down, claiming she is too busy with commissions. He tells them to go make tunnels instead. Shortly after this, Planet discovers the shulker box full of George Jr. fishes (that he uses to replace the fish after they die or he kills them), and Spoke forces him into silence, telling him to never tell Mapicc. Mapicc and Spoke discover a secret puzzle room and they try to walk across, however they are bombarded by arrows and the door still does not open. They attempt over and over ago to unlock but are unsuccessful until Planet claims he saw Yeah_Jaron complete the room. They try to complete it using the information they have, but are unsuccessful, until they look up and see the path carved onto the ceiling. They follow this path and discover a hidden room on the other side, an armory filled with netherite and diamonds. They also find a room that looks like it was meant to be a villager trading hall, however it is empty with the exception of a single farmer. After this, they pull a series of cruel pranks of Jaron, who is giving a base tour to his friend BaconnWaffles0. Bacon turns away from Jaron and shuns him, leaving the base. Shortly after this, they conduct the final raid, stealing endless amounts of valuables. Mapicc is caught by Jaron, but Planet takes the fall for them, urging the duo to complete the raid. Jaron gives chase to Planet, and eventually Spoke and Mapicc step in to ensure Planet doesn't get harmed. They fight for a while until Red logs on, and they argue verbally. Red goes to get the Dragon Egg, and Spoke chases him, trying to steal it before Red gets it. They pass the Egg around from party to party for a while until Red gets it and puts it in his ender chest. With this, Spoke turns to the viewer and explains that this was not the outcome he needed, nor wanted. He exclaims that he is going to stalk Red until he dies, quits, or gives him what he wants. He says that he is going to be the force that tears Red from his wealth, and says a variety of other ominous and cruel things. With that, the episode ends.

 Trivia 

 The video was originally titled "I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Base".

title: I Survived 100 Days on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
content:
I Survived 100 Days on a Hardcore Minecraft Server is the 120th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
FlameFrags has one of the greatest bases on the Unstable SMP. However, the base was built by The Law, and a group of lawmen come to claim back the base due to using too many resources on the base without permission and begin breaking down the base. Flame asks if he can do anything to keep his base and the commander tells him there's one thing in mind. Flame and Lomedy head over to the Law HQ and talk to the other commander who tells them they're in great debt for the mega base that was built for free for the next hundred days. Flame tries to give the commander netherite to pay off that debt, but the commander says Flame has more value than resources due to his skills. The Law hires Flame to be an elite and is given a squad to work alongside him, Flame picks Lomedy as his first squad member and heads outside to hire three more players. He hires two people with ease, but everyone else ignores Flame. With no hope, Flame says he'd take anyone at that point, Spongs then comes running up and admits that he's also poor and says they could work together again. The squad heads back to the commander, the commander gives Flame a horn to blow that signals him to be able to give instructions. The commander gives them their first task, which is to transport two happy ghasts to Capital City.

They go on for days on the happy ghasts and on day 9, Flame spots a player following them on a happy ghast from a distance. They stop for a second to see who it is, Flame realizes that it's players apart of the arachn1d_ group and tries to ride away as fast as possible. Flame and his squad stop, allowing Lomedy to switch happy ghasts and give him a bow and arrow to shoot them down. One of the squad members, Gunter_____, rides forward where there's more arachn1d minions waiting for them. Gunter decides to jump down, Spongs wants to leave him behind, but Flame has to save Gunter as a Law elite, otherwise he gets fired and loses his base. He asks for Lomedy's mace and jumps down to assist Gunter in the fight. Flame kills them all and afterwards tells Gunter to tap in when he blows his horn. After a few more days, they deliver the shipment and make it back to Law HQ. The commander gives them their next mission, which is a rescue mission of a Law compound and to save any scouts if there are any. The compound is located the Northern Council, Flame asks why the commander couldn't have told them that before since they were just at Capital City, and so it takes another eight days to walk there. 

They reach the front of the compound, Flame tells them they should scout it out first with invis, but their cover was blown almost instantly. A fight begins and Flame sees one of the scouts being interrogated by an elite arachn1d guard. Unfortunately for Flame, Gunter and his other squad member, JakeVC42_, dies and causes Flame, Lomedy, and Spongs to all retreat. The arachn1d group is afraid to chase them to the top of the castle, and after a day of waiting up there, Flame has the idea to use TNT minecarts and have Spongs and Lomedy shoot them and detonate them. The plan works, but the hostage was still being held captive by the elite guard who threatens to kill them if Flame tried anything. They all go back up on top of the castle and wait for another few days. Flame tells Spongs and Lomedy to wait on top of the castle. Flame jumps down and starts a bow duel with the guard, his plan is to get rid of the guard's totem and kill him then. Flame places blocks to cover line of sight and strategizes by shooting the guard with a spectral arrow, distracting them, going invis and digging down under with a shovel and TNT minecart-ing, killing him in an instant. Flame manages to save the scout and they head back to Law HQ. The commander sees that Flame lost a few team members, which sets them back a bit. The commander gives them a more simpler task, just help out The Law by recruiting new members and to not slip up. 

On day 55, they find a group of players and he tries to convince them to join, but they don't trust him due to his reputation of killing over a thousand players twice. Spongs gives Flame the idea of using a voice changer and invis, which does work on another group of players. Flame's invis runs out without him realizing, and the players all back up once they see Flame's true identity. On day 64, they decide to explore and find a way to help out The Law. They stumble across a player that's on a reverse landmine, if they step off the pressure plate, TNT would explode beneath their feet. Spongs gets Lomedy to switch positions with the player, but that did nothing. Spongs has another idea by having all three of them towering up and put a fishing rod on them, which would launch them up in the air. The player goes flying up in the air, the TNT blows up, and the player blows up when they fall back down. They start boating around, Flame admits that they didn't need to kill the player and that they could've saved them by throwing an item on top of the wooden pressure plate. They then stumble across two players who were arguing about who found the island that they were both living on first. Flame sees that their render distances didn't let them see more than twenty blocks, so he gets them to follow him to actual land, where the argument is then solved. On day 78, they went back to the Law compound and built graves for their fallen team members. 

On day 84, they make it back to the Law HQ and is put on wall duty. After a few days, Flame goes back to his base to regear. The commander over at Law HQ comes to his base and gives them their hardest mission yet, to escort a player back to Wheat Civilization. He tells them that arachn1d attacked them over at Law HQ and was saved, but now needs to be brought home. The commander says they usually don't escort players, but they made a deal with the leader of the Wheat Civilization and they want him back safe and sound. Lastly, the commander reminds them that to be a lawman, you are willing to sacrifice yourself for others in the name of justice. Flame asks the player to lead them to his base and they begin their journey. When they get closer to the civilization, they see arachn1d's group surrounding the area and needs to get through safely. Spongs notices a group of arachn1d's soldiers coming from behind, arachn1d is there with them and he tells Flame that he shouldn't have killed his soldiers. Flame sees Spongs getting chased by the group and instructs Lomedy to keep escorting the player while he saves Spongs. Flame gets the group to shift their focus onto him and gives Spongs the opportunity to follow Lomedy. Flame then lures arachn1d and his group into a cave, he digs a small hole, arachn1d tells his soldiers to all jump down. Flame then pearls up and drops a cart on them and kills a majority of the soldiers. Flame kills off the rest of the soldiers, leaving just arachn1d and him. Flame asks why he's being hunted, arachn1d says that it's his fault, and Flame doesn't understand what he means. Arachn1d explains Parrot beat him in the election, and since Parrot robbed him of his chance, he wants to make a kingdom of his own and is planning on killing him. Arach1nd says people like Flame is a threat to his kingdom and says he won't hesitate to kill Flame unless he joins the kingdom. He then asks Flame to teach him how to fight and he'll make Flame more powerful than anybody else. Flame says he doesn't really care if he takes over the server and is only focused on becoming a combat grandmaster. 

Flame makes it to the front of Wheat Civilization, Spongs says the player died, but Lomedy reveals he's joking and they lets the player go back home. Flame goes back to Law HQ and gives the commander the journal he used to write down his progress. He asks if that's all he needs to do since it's closing in on day 100, but the commander tells Flame that many lawmen aren't allowed to see a certain someone, being LettuceK. He doesn't trust the soldiers to visit Lettuce in prison and expect them to not free him, so he needs somebody trustworthy. Flame visits the prison and Lettuce says he doesn't want Flame there and asks why he's there. Flame says he was checking to see if he's still alive and begins to head off, but Lettuce stops him and asks what's been going outside of the prison. Flame explains he's changed the way he's been playing and that his goal is to become a combat grandmaster. Lettuce asks if The Law is still a thing and Flame says they actually sent him there. Lettuce says Flame may be lying about The Law sending him, but for his sake, he decides to believe Flame. With nothing else to talk about, Flame leaves and Lettuce tells him to look after The Law for him. It turns to day 100 as he walks up to the front of the Northern Council, and Flame had managed to keep his mega base.

 Trivia 

 Flame said in the comments section that this video was delayed due to losing audio, re-recording, creative burnout and other reasons.
 He also mentioned this video experimented more with his personality and PvP, but not all videos will be like this.

title: I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City
content:
I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City is the 18th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The video begins with Parrot, Wifies and Dean attempting to rob one of Reddoons' vaults in Capital City. They get caught by Reddoons and 5 invisible guards. Reddoons tells them to clear all their inventories or else they will all die so they proceed in clearing their inventories. Reddoons leads them to the top of his tower and makes them prove they don't have any items smuggled with them by using boats and tells them that if they want to get out, they would need to complete a quota of 10 000 diamond blocks. Reddoons leads them to the mining section of the city. Parrot uses his spyglass in front of Reddoons and he tells him to give him the spyglass or else he will double his quota. Parrot doesn't care about his quota being doubled as long as he keeps his spyglass. Reddoons says he will double the quota of everyone instead and because of Parrot's selflessness, he gives Reddoons the spyglass.  

After the guards leave, Parrot, Wifies, and Dean try to escape by using boats but they get caught by the guards. After this, Reddoons gets excited and tells Coin to kill Luigi and even encourages him to do it but Coin refuses. Reddoons gets fed up and kills Luigi himself and fires Coin.

During Luigi's funeral, they plan on starting a revolution and attacking Capital City. Parrot and Wifies made a speech about how they can use the diamonds as leverage to get Reddoons to free everyone so they have to steal all of them and also fight off the Mafia members there.  Plot 
The episode starts out with ParrotX2 explaining the current Arc and how he’s running for king to beat LettuceK, who's 7,000 votes ahead of him. With the second round about to start, Lettuce gathers the other candidates into the banquet hall, getting ready to celebrate. However, things would soon turn upside down. Lettuce explains the rules to the candidates again, in the meantime, outside of the castle came a group of assassins in netherite armor barging in and attempting to kill the candidates. Parrot stays back and watches Naparizel, one of the other candidates, try and fight back. He tries to help Napa by throwing invisibility at him to escape, but Napa stays, knowing that he's dying, he tells Parrot that he knows Parrot will be a good king.

Lettuce calls for an emergency meeting, telling the players a group of assassins killed a candidate as well as a handful of lawmen. Parrot angrily says that Lettuce was the one who told them to live inside the Northern Council for their own safety, but clearly wasn't enough to stop the assassins. Lettuce doesn't reply to Parrot and continue his meeting, he says the rules still remain and only the top four will go on, he then continues by mentioning that Napa wrote a book with instructions in case he ever died during the election. He gave the remaining candidates each 120 votes through a signed book with their name on it, in exactly 24 hours, whoever has all of the books will receive that amount of votes, and lastly, for the next 24 hours, the purge commences, all crime is allowed between candidates in order to receive these books. Parrot steps up again, he believes this should be a civil election, but Lettuce says it was the candidate's rules. Parrot walks up to the lectern and tries to convince the crowd and the candidates to continue the election normally and agree to not resort to violence, but one of the candidates pots up and attacks Parrot.

Parrot goes full invis and pearls into the castle and hides. After a while, Parrot comes out of hiding and goes back to his room to meet up with Theo, but when he gets there, Theo is nowhere to be found. Parrot places down a sign, but is interrupted by Purpled who is standing outside. Purpled demands the books from Parrot and threatens to take the book by force. Parrot tries to reason with him, but Purpled doesn't want to hear him out, so he sends his guards up to Parrot's room. Parrot sets up an automated dispenser to shoot arrows down the ladder as Purpled builds up and gets to Parrot. They start attacking Parrot just as Theo comes into distance, Parrot asks Theo to help, and Theo tells Parrot to run and that he has it under control. It then switches to Theo's perspective, he says that Parrot saved Purpled's life back in the Far Lands and that Theo should've killed him back then. Purpled says he doesn't care and says he would kill Theo even if that means winning the election. Theo pearls in and uses TNT minecarts, exploding his two guards, killing them in seconds. As Theo and Purpled were fighting, Parrot went to Merchant City to stock up on resources for the purge. Theo is shown winning the fight, and Purpled decides to run, Theo chases for a second, but says he doesn't have time to continue and starts to look for Parrot. Half an hour later, Parrot makes it to Merchant City, he decides to buy different types of arrows, since he's more skilled at bow than any other weapons. Afterwards, he decides to find other candidates, which coincidentally, he spots Boosfer and Horace. He follows them and finds Boosfer attempting to kill Horace with a trap, Parrot intervenes and says Boosfer is attempting to kill someone who has no armor over a book and tries to get him to stop. Boosfer says he will let Horace out if Horace gives him a second book, or if Parrot will. Parrot gives Boosfer his own book, and Boosfer lets Horace free.

They follow Boosfer from behind with invis, who heads to Capital City and asks people around about where Fymada could be. Boosfer finds Fymada in the garden and demands her to give her book up, but Fymada says someone else already took it from her.When Boosfer asks who, Fymada says the person behind a tree, which was arachn1d, one of the other candidates. Arachn1d starts to attack Boosfer for his books, Boosfer tells him to stop and drops one of his books, but arachn1d knows he has more and presses him for it. Boosfer drops his other books one by one, Parrot pearls in and grabs the last book. Parrot and Horace then team up with Fymada to get their books back, they start to follow arachn1d, who goes thousands of blocks out to camp out, Horace and Fymada begin to build their temporary base as Parrot watches, arachn1d goes into a cave and doesn’t come back out. Parrot goes to their base, Horace asks to see Boosfer’s book and Parrot reluctantly agrees, Horace is shocked that Parrot even did that and says he could’ve ran off with the book. 

Horace asks Parrot what happened to Theo, it cuts back to Theo's perspective, who confuses Parrot with a person named PearitX2, who has Parrot's skin on and with a completely different voice, saying they're using a voice changer, Theo believes it as it would help protect his identity during the purge. Back to Parrot, he spots arachn1d coming out of the cave and had disenchanted his armor and re-enchanted his netherite armor. He starts to book it, and the three start to follow him again, arachn1d then goes down into a cave. They wait outside to see if he ever resurfaces, but nothing comes out of it. Parrot suggests someone goes down to investigate, Horace agrees to go down as a favor since Parrot saved him in the past. Fymada gives him a goat horn to signal if anything goes wrong, and so he goes down. Arachn1d starts to attack Horace and he blows the horn, Parrot gives Fymada Boosfer's book and jumps into the cave. They 2v1 arachn1d, and arachn1d says if they don't stop and hand over their books, he would set off the TNT trap set inside of the cave. Parrot then realized that he disenchanted his armor to enchant it with blast protection. Parrot says he has Boosfer's book and that killing him would be a loss of 120 votes, so arachn1d forces the two to stay inside of the cave for the remainder of the purge.

Parrot messes with arachn1d for a few hours, he then came up with a plan; renaming arrows and shooting them would keep the name, so he renames arrows to send messages to Fymada who is still above. He renames arrows to ask Fymada to make turtle master potions and come down. In the meantime, arachn1d plays Clash of Clans and blares their ears with how loud it is, Parrot and Horace play tic tac toe to kill time. Eventually, Fymada comes down into the cave, arachn1d thinks she came down unknowingly, and holds her hostage as well. The three gather up and Fymada splashes them all with turtle master, Parrot runs to the lever and sets off the TNT. They outnumber arachn1d, knowing he can't do anything with his blast protection armor, he drops all of his books and they all make it out alive. They use a railroad system to back towards the town, Fymada asks Parrot about Theo, who is still with PearitX2, who keeps extorting Theo out of golden carrots. During their way back, Horace falls into a sand trap that was built by Purpled and arachn1d. Purpled betrays arachn1d and tells him to leave, Purpled's demand is all of their books, Parrot lies and says Boosfer took all of their books on their way back, Purpled tells them they have four hours to give him the books and that he'll be waiting at a nearby village and takes Horace hostage. Fymada says they can't give up the books and asks what they're going to do. Parrot replies, "We're going to have to rescue him." 

They sneak up to the viking village, they spot Purpled who is AFK, Fymada has the idea of trying to get a guard to get the location of Horace, so Parrot shoots an arrow at a guard post to redirect a guard's attention and dropping a trail of signs that lead them into the forest, where he shoots the guard into a trap. Parrot asks the guard to write down where Horace is located otherwise he dies, they say he's in the house with the furnace in front, so they begin to head up, and tells the guard that if they try to escape, there's TNT planted underneath. The two sneak their way into houses, looking for the house with furnaces in front. They spot the house they're looking for and dig down, they see Horace encaged above a pit of lava, Parrot takes out the fire resistance arrows from his bundle, Purpled appears right behind them and asks if they're there to give him the books, but Parrot says they're there to save Horace. Parrot questions Purpled's morality and says Purpled might not even free Horace once he receives the books, Purpled says in the situation they're in, he will. Parrot then shoots the target that drops Horace down, then shoots Horace with a fire resistance arrow, saving his life. Purpled chases Parrot to try and kill him, but loses sight of Parrot in a forest.

As they walk together, Horace asks to speak with Fymada privately, Parrot asks to come, but Horace says no. They come back to Parrot, and Horace asks to see the voting books, in which Parrot gives them to Horace. By the time they make it back to the Northern Council, Parrot asks how they should split the votes. Horace says Parrot isn't normal for giving up the voting books that easily, as they're competing against each other. Parrot says they don't have any bad intentions and they're working together and that Lettuce is the enemy, not them. They say that they were testing Parrot to see if he had good intentions, in which he did by trusting the people next to him, and never asking for the books back at anytime. Horace hands over all of the books to Parrot, Horace gives up all his votes to Parrot and endorses him, telling him that he will get his entire civilization to vote for Parrot as well. Fymada says that she would also endorse him. They tell Parrot what they want Parrot to do with the server, but Parrot says he doesn't have to fulfill their wishes and tells them he'll give them positions that would help make the server better, saying that he can't run the server all by himself. Before Parrot heads back to the Northern Council, Horace says the server needs him.

Parrot heads back up to his room, where he sees Theo talking to PearitX2, the impersonator runs away once they see Parrot. Parrot doesn't pursue them and just questions who the person was.

The next scene shows Lettuce and Deputy_Ace, Lettuce admits to hiring the assassins to kill off Napa, Ace is in disbelief that he even killed off a leading candidate and his own lawmen and says he can't keep supporting Lettuce. Lettuce says there was no point in trying to kill Parrot and he didn't think he'd make it to the top four without the purge. He says there's one loose end that he needs to tie up, and that there's no way Parrot could beat him.

The last scene has Parrot and Theo looking at the board, the four candidates remaining are Lettuce, Purpled, Parrot, and Boosfer. Theo says it may be over for Parrot, but Parrot says there's one more way to win the election and that they need to find someone. The episode ends with Mechanical God by AZALI playing in the back, hinting that the person Parrot is looking for is Wemmbu.

 Trivia 

 In the thumbnail for this video, Lettuce is seen with a crown. Though on NameMC, he has never worn a skin with a crown.
 The episode emphasizes Parrot's trust transformation - from avoiding friendships (S2E1, BAT)  to unconditional trust.
 A reference to the conflicts in FarLands Civilization is made when Theo says he spared Purpled there.
 This is one of the few videos where another player's POV is temporarily shown, this time being Theo's for a second time, the first being in "Unstable SMP : The First King".
 Unlike previous videos, we see Theo's POV more than once.
