title: I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP...
content:
I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP... is the 83rd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode starts off with Spoke spying on a group of players heading to their secret base. He plans on trapping them inside of their own base, since an hour before they all saw him griefing their village and could snitch on him. For the first group of players, Spoke rigs the staircase and a few more areas of the base. When the players come back, Leow0ok happens to be with them, doing a trade with them. Once the trade is done, Leo leaves the base. Spoke uses this opportunity to set off a chest trap and killing one of the bystanders. He sets off the staircase trap, but the person manages to clutch. He activates one last trap and kills another player. The last person finds Spoke's hidden redstone area and confronts him. They then try to run away, but Spoke kills them. Spoke cleans up the evidence and sets up more traps for the next group of players who also lived in the base. Spoke sets off a few traps, killing the rest of the group. As he's leaving, he spots spies coming to investigate the base. He tries to trap the spies, but inevitably fails, he then manages to escape without being caught.

Spoke returns to the B.A.T. headquarters and goes to the library to find the coordinates of the next hidden base. Leo comes up to him and questions Spoke about what he's up to. He brings Spoke to the village that was griefed and asks Spoke what he was doing before. Spoke lies and says he was building with Mapicc. Spoke then begins heading towards the next base, until he notices people following him from behind. He anticipated this, so he goes through the Nether and heads back the fortress that Mapicc was building. As the spies watch over them, Spoke sneaks out of the fortress and heads to the base.

When he gets to the base, three players are spotted, and they soon leave to collect seagrass for their turtle. Spoke sets up his trap once again while they're gone. When they arrive back at their base, Spoke manages to trap two of the three players, and the last one spots him. Spoke then uses a knockback sword to knock them down into a corner, where a backup trap is waiting, killing them. He overheard the players talking about more people coming back, and so he rigs the base with more traps. The players come back, and Spoke floods their base with lava and blowing it up in the process. Spoke looks at the damage he's done, he then sees the spies looking right at him. Spoke then comes up with a plan to kill the spies, since the spies had to neutralize their threats before heading back to base. He lures the spies into a small tunnel and sets off TNT minecarts, one dies to them, and Spoke kills off the other one himself. He then frames somebody else for the crimes he just did. He returns back to the fortress, where Leo is talking to Mapicc. Spoke wonders why Leo is back, and Leo says it's because two spies just died. Spoke acts clueless, but Leo says he knows Spoke was at the secret bases. Mapicc defends Spoke, pretending to be his alibi and saying that Spoke was there with him. Spoke says that the spies were watching them all along, but Leo says the spies only showed up to the secret bases. Leo hints that it could've been JumperWho, the same person who gave Leo the spies he has now.

Spoke then heads to the borders of the amplified lands, revealing that all of the items he's been collecting has been used to pay off his debts for Quackenstein123 and his family. The episode ends with JumperWho and one of her spies watching Spoke from afar.

 Trivia 

 The video's original title was "Trapping Secret Bases on a Hardcore SMP...".

Spoke then comes up with a plan to kill the spies, since the spies had to neutralize their threats before heading back to base. He lures the spies into a small tunnel and sets off TNT minecarts, one dies to them, and Spoke kills off the other one himself. He then frames somebody else for the crimes he just did. He returns back to the fortress, where Leo is talking to Mapicc. Spoke wonders why Leo is back, and Leo says it's because two spies just died. Spoke acts clueless, but Leo says he knows Spoke was at the secret bases. Mapicc defends Spoke, pretending to be his alibi and saying that Spoke was there with him. Spoke says that the spies were watching them all along, but Leo says the spies only showed up to the secret bases. Leo hints that it could've been [[JumperWho]], the same person who gave Leo the spies he has now.

Spoke then heads to the borders of the amplified lands, revealing that all of the items he's been collecting has been used to pay off his debts for [[Quackenstein123]] and his family. The episode ends with JumperWho and one of her spies watching Spoke from afar.

* The video's original title was "Trapping Secret Bases on a Hardcore SMP...".

title: I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
content:
I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret is the 5th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
border|right|frameless|190x190px|alt=This is the first destination of Parrot and Wifies' journey to discover the secret of the server.
border|right|frameless|190x190px
border|right|frameless|190x190px
The episode begins with ParrotX2 describing a mysterious music disk that he received from a player named SpokeIsHere. Upon inserting it into a jukebox with a texture pack Spoke sent him, Parrot receives a message telling him that there is a huge secret in the server and that he should bring a friend to the set of coordinates described in the disk.  

Parrot invites a player called Wifies to accompany him in this journey and arrives at the first destination, a twin set of medieval towers facing a large stone gate in the side of a hill. Standing on both pressure plates on the towers, the gate on the hill blows up, revealing a large abandoned city complex. The two find a chest containing a music disk telling them to "follow the light,” but right after they open the chest and take the disk out, they hear TNT exploding, so quickly elytra out. Parrot realizes that they must go to the lighthouse in Zam Empire to find the next clue. Being concerned about how Spoke knew exactly when they had gotten their hands on the disk, Parrot hands Wifies his prized spyglass as a token of trust. 

After heading toward the Zam Empire, Parrot and Wifies don't find anything significant and instead encounter Wemmbu and PrinceZam, who ask that they hand over the disks and let them take care of the secret instead. Parrot declines and Wifies splashes himself and Parrot with a potion of invisibility, escaping the clutches of the Zam Empire leader after a tense battle. Parrot and Wifies return to the lighthouse, noticing that it is blinking and decode it as a Morse code message which translates to "minus 64,” or the y level of -64 (in the void). 

After searching under the lighthouse, Parrot and Wifies discover a staircase leading to the void. They find another music disk telling them to fly in the void for two thousand blocks north, but after flying to the destination, they find a group of shulkers and a hole in the bedrock that was blocked off with obsidian. Parrot and Wives return to the hole they entered, but find that that hole has been blocked off as well. They return to the shulkers, running low on fireworks, and decide to fly to the void base of JumperWho, but with Wifies too low on fireworks to make it, they come up with the solution of using fishing rods to conserve. 

Barely surviving the void, Parrot and Wifies play the new disk, which gives them the code of 9783, the password to PrinceZam's vault. Parrot and Wifies splash themselves with a potion of invisibility, and after sneaking past FlameFrags and ManePear, they enter the vault where they grab the next disk and a lodestone compass just before Merffinn comes out of AFK. The two head to their destination, where a lodestone floats in the air in an ice spikes biome. Confused about where the next clue is, Parrot replays the message over and over again until they figure out that the "riddle" in the message is hidden in the phrase "it's pretty straightforward, it gets pretty straight to the point." After following a straight line between the point of a nearby ice spike and the lodestone, they find a chest beneath the ice containing another lodestone compass. 

Parrot and Wifies yet again follow the directions until they find a giant ice mountain with its insides carved out. An invisible player waits for them at the bottom in front of two large chests beside a parkour course that leads all the way to the top. He motions for them to put all their items in the chest before starting the parkour. They manage to make their way to the top with lots of close calls and retrieve their gear from two double chests as well as a third one that holds a lodestone compass and the next disk. They listen to the disk, which was just Spoke telling them good job and to continue finding the secret. Parrot then brings up the question of why he would want him to bring a friend, but they ignore that and head to the next location. 

Parrot and Wifies arrive at a giant obsidian dome and are greeted by the same invisible player that was waiting for them at the parkour. He places down two double chests and they put their stuff in it, but Parrot secretly keeps two invis potions and golden carrots. They head into the next challenge, a maze, but soon realize that they need to find the disk and get out as soon as possible because they hear the voices of Wemmbu and PrinceZam, who are likely here to hunt them down. They splash themselves with invis and eventually find their way to the exit, which is blocked, and since they have mining fatigue, they can’t get out. However, Wemmbu finds them and they strike a deal. If Wemmbu lets them go, then he can have the disk and turtle egg in the chest at the center. 

After their encounter with Wemmbu and PrinceZam, Parrot and Wifies decide to set an auto stasis chamber and sneak into PrinceZam’s vault to steal the disk, which will most likely be stored there. They splash themselves with invis, head into the vault, and steal the disk and turtle egg. The guards, ManePear and Peentar, and PrinceZam and Wemmbu attack them. They escape into the nether, but Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them. Parrot tells them that they can work together to find Spoke and after they give him the turtle egg and disk and return to the overworld, he breaks the portal. They escape again and listen to the disk.

Once the turtle egg hatched, Parrot and Wifies follow it all the way to the ocean, where they see a giant shipwreck in the water. On shore, the invisible player is waiting for them again with three double chests. They put their stuff in the first two chests and are supplied with two turtle shell helmets and eight water breathing potions. In the water, they find a shipwreck in the middle and ruins surrounding it. There are four towers surrounding the ship, each containing an item frame that they quickly deduct would have to be containing an item for a big hatch in the corner of the ruins to open. They find all of the items and open the hatch, which leads to an underwater graveyard, where they figure out where the chest is and take the disk and another lodestone compass. 

It leads Parrot and Wifies to a jungle. They split up to search and Parrot finds a jungle temple containing the disk. When played, Spoke tells them to fly to 5000, 5000 in the nether. The invisible player is waiting for them at the coordinates and they put their stuff in the chests again. 

On the other side of the portal is an escape room. Parrot and Wifies successfully complete all of the rooms and drop into a house in the middle of a mesa biome. Upon closer observation, however, the mesa is just a custom escape room inside a 100 by 100 obsidian box. They manage to escape that as well and collect the last disk. Spoke says that they are one step away from learning the secret and that it will change their life. Parrot then brings up the notion that Spoke had him bring a partner to do the scavenger hunt with, as well as the sheer amount of obsidian and manpower needed to complete that escape room. They head back to Parrot’s base and find the invisible player waiting for them there.

The invisible player drinks a bucket of milk and reveals himself to be Spoke all along. He takes Parrot and Wifies to the final obstacle, which is a series of tasks they will complete to determine the player who learns the secret. But here’s the catch: only one player can make it out alive. The other will get chunk banned. Parrot and Wifies debate whether to take the risk or not, but knowing everything they went through, they agree that they’ll figure something out. As they progress through the challenges (a puzzle, redstone parkour, maze, potion obstacle course, another parkour, and a mini escape room), when they reach the end, Parrot and Wifies are tied. However, Spoke has a tiebreaker, which is a game of chess. Parrot takes Wifies aside and they decide to end in a stalemate so Spoke can't ban either of them. 

The plan works, but Spoke refuses to let both of them go. After a long moment between Parrot and Wifies, Wifies asks him if this secret is really worth it. Parrot tells Wifies that he knows what he's going to say, so Wifies gives Parrot his spyglass and steps into the chunk ban.

Once Parrot and Spoke arrive at the surface, Spoke reveals that there is no secret. He just wanted to get revenge on him for something he did in the past. But the problem was that Parrot didn’t have anything of true value that Spoke could take away from him, so he made this scavenger hunt and had Parrot invite another player to join him. The sole purpose of all of these challenges were to bring Parrot and Wifies as close together as possible so Spoke could chunk ban one of them off of the server. He told Parrot that right before Wifies was banned, he could tell that Wifies was doing it for someone he cared about, and from Parrot’s silence, he had lost someone he deeply cared about. 

Parrot is speechless, but then, Wemmbu, PrinceZam, Merffinn, and LuigiToan. arrive. He realizes that they were tracking Spoke the whole time and this was why they wanted to hijack the scavenger hunt so badly. They chase him around the sky and eventually make their way all the way to the chunk ban. 

They are about to kill Spoke when he says, “Parrot, I’m sorry man, but—” and steps into the chunk ban.

 Trivia 

 This is the first Unstable Universe video to be over 3 hours long.
 This episode is where Wifies has his first debut.

title: Ice Mountain Civilization
content:
The Ice Mountation Civilization, also called the Snow Civilization or the Cold Civilization is a small empire built inside the jagged ice Mountation peaks that were built and terraformed by SpokeIsHere as part of ParrotX2 and Wifies Scavenger Hunt.  

 History 
SpokeIsHere likely pays someone to build an ice mountain for a scavenger hunt designed for Parrot and Wifies.

After the dissolution of Skyblock Civilization, loppezz, Arcn, and LettuceK flee to an isolated ice mountain, where they create a small nation. Wemmbu stumbles into the Snow Civilization, where he is promptly attacked and kicked out by loppezz, Arcn, and LettuceK, who are still upset at Wemmbu for leaving them with The Invisible Mafia in the Skyblock Civilization. Shortly after, Wemmbu returns with eggchan, who helps them come to a peaceful resolution and the pair become temporary citizens of the Civilization. Unbeknownst to loppezz and the others, Wemmbu had an alternate agenda to use the Snow Civilization to lure a diamond trim Mafia member to Wemmbu so he can complete his training for Mane. This upset Eggchan, who felt guilty for lying, and he convinces Wemmbu to protect the Snow Civilization from the Mafia members.   

The civilization is taken over and later destroyed by Fantst despite Wemmbu and loppezz trying to stop him.

title: Important Items in Unstable Universe
content:
Important Items in Unstable Universe are items that hold sentimental meaning to their players or are heavily lore relevant.

 Parrot's Spyglass 

thumb
Parrot's Spyglass is a recurring item in Unstable. It was originally given to Wifies by Parrot in I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret, mentioning that it has "sentimental value" to him. Eventually, Wifies gave it back to Parrot before chunkbanning himself. It appeared in most of Parrot's videos up until the finale of The Director Arc. In Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison, Parrot was forced to drop the spyglass by Wifies onto the platform below, which he picked up before it despawned. Later on, Wifies forced Parrot to stand with him on pressure plates which would detonate hundreds of TNTs and blow them up if one of them stepped off. However, Parrot kept the spyglass and dropped it on the pressure plate, allowing him to walk off of the trap. Wifies stepped off his pressure plate to run towards the spyglass so he can pick it up one last time, setting off the TNT and killing him as well as destroying the spyglass in the process. Parrot still has a spyglass, albeit being a different one.

 deanthebean9's Goat Horn 

thumb
Dean’s Goat Horn was a goat horn (Yearn) given to deanthebean9 in The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands by Wifies after Parrot told him to do so. The horn was meant to be used if Dean was ever in danger, since Parrot assumed that Dean was not smart enough to use messages. Later, Dean admits that he was leaking their coordinates to The Mafia, a faction that have been hunting them down, hence how they kept finding them every time, which led to Dean leaving the team after blowing the horn. Parrot later finds him in Unstable SMP: The First War in the jungle where they had their last argument, but refused to let him rejoin because of Dean's earlier betrayal. Wanting to help, Dean secretly rejoins the Mafia to help Parrot by sabotaging his mafia teammates during the war. Parrot, noticing this, tries to kill him, thinking he's a free kill, not knowing it was Dean because of invisibility. They both knock each other off a really high bomber plane, causing both of them to pop their totems when they land, which clears Dean's invisibility. Dean blew the horn one last time before the Mafia pulled his stasis, teleporting him into the void — the punishment for losing invisibility — and ultimately dies.

Gambit is a mace owned by Wemmbu. This was first given to Wemmbu by Yeah Jaron. This mace was stolen by Conexion, also known as Sharpness, forcing Wemmbu to chase him into the Far Lands. It was later given to FlameFrags, who eventually returned it to Wemmbu because he felt he did not need it.

thumbRejoicin's Sunflower is Rejoicin's favorite flower, possibly due to his Minecraft skin being based off one. He had multiple stacks of them in a double chest. The Invisible Guy is a major antagonist in Unstable Universe Season 3. They keep their identity hidden by using a voice changer and invisible potions. In the Kingdoms, he is a major antagonist where their goal is to kill Eggchan. The Invisible Guy is currently the main antagonist of Wemmbus POV .

title: It's Impossible to Catch this Player
content:
It's Impossible to Catch this Player is the 6th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
The episode starts off after Wemmbu's fight with SpokeIsHere, in which Spoke escaped using an ender pearl stasis chamber. Wemmbu, of course, makes it his goal to kill Spoke. Spoke’s base was, of course, empty, so he heads towards ParrotX2's base to ask him if he knows Spoke’s whereabouts, but Parrot doesn’t tell him anything. The only other player on the server that could know where Spoke was was JamatoP, but after interviewing him at his base, Wemmbu finds out that he doesn’t know anything. He is about to leave when he spots other players in the base and quickly hides. The other players turn out to be ManePear, Sorhin, and FlameFrags, three of PrinceZam's guards who are also looking for Spoke. 

Wemmbu decides to follow the guards back to the Zam Empire to see if PrinceZam wanted to form an alliance with him in their search for Spoke. However, in the middle of their conversation, Mapicc jumps them and they see a plane launching TNT onto the Zam Empire in the distance. PrinceZam’s castle is blown up and a fight ensues between Wemmbu, PrinceZam, and his guards, ManePear, FlameFrags, Sorhin, LuigiToan, ECorridor, zzye, loppezz, yungwillx, and Peentar, and Spoke’s cronies, Mapicc, JumperWho, SykerMC, TeamKalal, Chiffoi, Elemental_Man, RealReeon, Only_A_Squid, Derapchu, What_Max, Arcn, ItsRyanStuff, and Sharooh. They manage to blow up TeamKalal before Spoke’s goons stasis away.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam check with TheRealSquiddo first for the whereabouts of Spoke due to her previous affiliations with him. Squiddo agrees to DM them the coordinates of where Spoke last was. They find contraband items, stacked totems, and a spawn egg in her chests, so they chunk ban her.  

Wemmbu and PrinceZam spot Parrot and Wifies at the lighthouse on the outskirts of the Zam Empire. After a bit of prodding, Parrot reveals that Spoke sent them on a scavenger hunt for a secret that could change the server. Wemmbu demands the disk (when played with a texture pack reveals the next clue) they were talking about, but they refuse. Wemmbu and PrinceZam catch them breaking into the castle and chase them around the empire grounds, eventually losing them. 

They start heading to Squiddo’s coordinates, which are in the end. At the stronghold, they are attacked by Mapicc, Sharkilz_, and RealReeon, three of Spoke’s henchmen who are guarding the portal. Mapicc and Sharkilz_ are able to escape while they manage to chunk ban RealReeon. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam find a massive end base at the coordinates and sneak up on Spoke, JumperWho, and Derapchu. They chunk ban Derapchu and JumperWho, but Spoke escapes into the void. 

Seeing that chunk banning Spoke wasn’t as easy as they thought it would be, Wemmbu and PrinceZam come up with a plan to get him without a totem, then one-shot him with a mace. They trade for a trial chamber map and mess around for a while before finding the chambers, where they get the ingredients for the mace. However, Arcn, Only_A_Squid, Fantst, Sharooh, and Mapicc jump them in the trial chambers, so Wemmbu heads to the surface to get wood craft the mace while PrinceZam leads them to him. They then engage into a big fight and Arcn is chunk banned. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam change plans and decide to go after Spoke’s henchmen, assuming that they will lead them to Spoke himself. They use an arrow tracker to track down Only_A_Squid and chunk ban him. They leave the underground base and after a bit of flying, spot a nether portal. They land to check it out and are attacked by Fantst and Sharooh, chunk banning Sharooh. 

The next location is a giant obsidian box. They break inside and see Mapicc, engaging in a fight. They are about to drop him when a group of invisible players that are later revealed to be Spoke, Sharkilz_, and Fantst  jump them. They take PrinceZam hostage and use him as a bargaining chip for the mace. Wemmbu burns the mace, so they start attacking again. Wemmbu and PrinceZam are about to die when they suddenly stasis away, leaving them broke. 

Once Wemmbu and PrinceZam regear themselves, they head to another obsidian box which, upon entering, isn’t infested with Spoke or his minions. Inside the obsidian box is a maze, and after wandering around, they find themselves back at the entrance. They assume that this is a trap set up by Mapicc until they hear Parrot and Wifies’s voice somewhere else in the maze. Wemmbu tells PrinceZam to barricade and guard the entrance while he starts searching for Parrot and Wifies. He is about to give up when he sees a name tag and mines in through the roof with a bucket of milk to counter the mining fatigue. He finds Parrot and Wifies without armour and makes a deal with them: if they show him where the disk is, then he’ll let them go alive. Wemmbu obtains the disk and turtle egg that was inside the chest at the center, but realizes that they need the texture pack Spoke sent Parrot to listen to the disk after Parrot and Wifies already left. 

Regardless, Wemmbu and PrinceZam head back to the Zam Empire to set a trap for Parrot and Wifies, knowing that they would likely try to steal the disk. Since the arrow tracker pointed them to Parrot and Wifies, they must be related to Spoke in some way. They put the disk in PrinceZam’s castle’s vault and set their ender pearl stasis chambers in a pile of gold and emerald blocks. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam arrive at a manmade hole dug into the floor of an ocean decorated with custom coral, ruins, and many elder guardians. They come across a giant underwater castle and enter it, finding Sharkilz_ and chunk banning him after a short fight. However, not ten seconds after they ban him, the entire castle blows up, including the chunk ban, allowing Sharkilz_ to log back on and start attacking, as well as Fantst, who was hiding in the castle to jump them. In the end, they manage to chunk ban both Sharkilz_ and Fantst. 

Seeing that they only had one more location to go to, PrinceZam and Wemmbu split up so PrinceZam could go back to his empire to fetch more people and chunk bans and Wemmbu could stall Spoke. 

Wemmbu flies away until he eventually finds two twin towers guarding a blown up entrance into a mountain. He goes in and spots an invisible player, assuming that it was Mapicc. He communicates using signs and tells Wemmbu that he doesn’t care if he bans him off and that he would take Wemmbu to Spoke under a few conditions. 

The invisible player leads Wemmbu to a giant ice mountain that was hollowed out to create a parkour course inside. The player tells Wemmbu that he needs to complete the course without cheating and with no armour. After a few close calls with death, he completes the parkour, where he learns that this is part of the scavenger hunt Parrot and Wifies were doing. 

The player then leads Wemmbu to the next location, the same obsidian box he and PrinceZam previously found Parrot and Wifies in. The player tells Wemmbu that Spoke told him that he didn’t properly complete the maze. He forces Wemmbu to put all of his stuff in a chest and gives him two minutes to solve the maze. Wemmbu easily finds his way to the center and the player tells him that phase two is complete. He takes back all of his gear and the player leads him to the third location.

The invisible player puts down a sign that says “Squiddo’s castle.” Wemmbu, realizing that this wasn’t Mapicc, but instead, Spoke, starts critting him out, but he pulls his ender pearl stasis and disappears after a quick fight. 

Wemmbu elytras to Squiddo’s castle, assuming that Spoke is there. The castle is almost completely burned down with fire spreading everywhere. He quickly finds Spoke and lands in front of him. They quickly engage in battle while Spoke tries to overpower Wemmbu’s moral with his taunts. Spoke tells him that at the end of the day, no matter how many people Wemmbu chunk bans, he will still be on the losing side of this war. title: It's Impossible to Find this Player
content:
It's Impossible to Find this Player is the 12th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

Plot
After five of ParrotX2's friends, rekrap2, JumperWho, Kenadian_, Derapchu, and Leow0ok, disappear, along with ClownPierce, the server's deadliest player, Parrot and Wifies head to the location that Clown left them. Upon arrival, they stumble across a massive sky island. Parrot and Wifies find two players, Jaden_MAN and Spongs, who refer to themselves as the game masters. They tell Parrot and Wifies that if they want to find the missing players, they had to complete quests.  

Parrot and Wifies’s first quest is for a Heart of the Sea. They clean their inventories and the game masters give them a kit to complete the quest with. They destroy an underwater gold box in a lake and find a barrel with a lodestone compass. They are interrupted by two players named Kierrrr and Its_Dev. They say that they have been ordered by a player named Boosfer to assist them in their quest, but Parrot and Wifies get suspicious, so they pot invis and run away. They come across Clown-themed ships and Parrot finds a book that says "Dig where the winds meet.” Wifies tells him that they have to go in the direction of the sails. After obtaining the Heart of the Sea, Parrot realises that it’s Derapchu's prized possession. They put the item into the corresponding quest temple and a blue beacon lights up.thumb|the sky island Clown lead Parrot and Wifies.The game masters give Parrot and Wifies another kit and send them on another quest for a pair of netherite boots, Jumper’s prized possession. Parrot and Wifies find a town in the sky, but Kier and Dev show up again for "assistance.” They have to catch thirty-two fish, light all of the hot air balloons, replace all of the lanterns, repair all of the damaged crops, and fill all of the empty cauldrons. Parrot and Wifies place the lanterns. They find some flying machines and glowstone beneath carpets throughout the island. Parrot distract Kier and Dev by telling them that the hot air balloons are in the shape of an arrow, and they fly off. They follow a trail of glowstone to a sea lantern, where Wifies uses it to activate the flying machines. They look below a sea lantern flying machine and find the boots, which they place into a quest temple and activate a white beacon.thumb|Town that Parrot and Wifies explored during the questthumb|The glowing flying machines Parrot and Wifies activateParrot and Wifies don’t find the game masters, but they see their ender chests and kits for the next quest. They decide to go talk to Boosfer about why he wants the items so much. They head to his headquarters, an office building in a jungle. Boosfer says that he steals people’s prized possessions and sells them for lots of money. Parrot asks him to stop bothering them, but he declines and says he doesn’t care. Parrot tells him that the items were meant to help them find their missing friends and that if Boosfer interferes, they may be gone forever.  
thumb|Flower field with a hidden poppy
thumb|Rekrap's base (the large tree Parrot and Wifies find)
Parrot and Wifies go on another quest to look for a poppy, which they have no idea who it belongs to. They find a massive flower field in which they have to locate a poppy within. While searching for the poppy, Parrot gets irritated by how many red tulips are in the fields since they look like poppies. After a long time of searching and going insane over flowers, they finally find the poppy. They dig under the poppy and find a cave with lots of poppies as well. They realize that the poppies lead to something so they follow the path of the poppies and eventually reach a valley.  

Parrot and Wifies explore the valley until they see more moss and grass, which leads to a large tree. They walk around it until Parrot gets mining fatigue. They decide to check the inside of the tree and find an escape room. It goes wells until they hear the tree burning down and fireworks being shot by none other than Kier, Dev and Boosfer. Parrot and Wifies hide from them, but after they find them, they ask for the item. Wifies offers to distract them while Parrot continues looking for the item, but he declines and keeps them busy instead. He begins bluffing and deletes everything from the book, writing, "Through the valley's last edge, under the boulder below" on the first page and "deez nuts" on the second page before giving it to them. 

After a while of meandering around, they uncover Parrot’s bluff. He leads them to where they were actually supposed to go and mines down, but realises that the tree is Rekrap's base. Since Wifies stashed the item in his ender chest, Kier, Dev and Boosfer threaten to kill them and blow up the base. Parrot doesn’t want them to, giving them leverage over him and Wifies. They tell them to bring the item to their headquarters in thirty minutes or else the base gets destroyed.

Once they leave, Parrot and Wifies start evacuating all of the animals in Rekrap’s base. They hear withers and find bomber planes. They bridge up to them and find Wemmbu. He tells them that he was paid by someone anonymous to grief Rekrap's base. Parrot realizes it's Boosfer, Kier and Dev, and Wemmbu admits that they were the ones who hired him. He needs money to build another empire of his own and get revenge on PrinceZam and the Zam Empire by declaring war on them. Parrot tells Wemmbu that he doesn't need to stoop down Zam’s level to get revenge, and that they can rob Boosfer, Kier, and Dev, which Wemmbu agrees to. 

Parrot and Wifies place the flower in its quest temple’s item frame and activate the beacon. They retrieve their netherite gear to tell Boosfer that his plan to bomb the valley failed. He taunts them, and, realising that there is no point in staying, they head back to the quest temples.

Upon return, Parrot interrogates Jaden and Spongs about why they’re always absent. They play dumb and give them a cave quest. They are looking for a diamond, which Parrot assumes belongs to Leo. After entering the cave, they are met with another escape room. They complete it and find a cave maze. On the other side is an ancient city where they have to kill a warden to obtain a skulk catalyst needed to open a vault door. The warden is defeated and they find Leo’s diamond behind the vault door. 

Parrot and Wifies go back to the quest temples and activate the beacon for the diamond. However, Kier and Dev jump them and steal all of the items that they found. They just played dumb the entire time and waited for a chance to steal all of the items at once. There is nothing they can do without the game masters. When they finally arrive, Parrot lectures them about their irresponsibility and tell them that they need to deal with something else.

They head to the Wemmbu Civilization and form a plan to rob Boosfer, Kier, and Dev. Parrot tells Wemmbu that he will help destroy their base using an orbital cannon as long as Wemmbu only uses it on them and the Zam Empire. They launch the orbital cannon and grief Boosfer, Kier, and Dev’s base. After a successful heist in which they steal most of the Treasure Hunters’ riches, Parrot and Wifies head back to the quest temples.

Parrot tells the game masters to send them on the nether quest. They receive a book with six sets of coordinates. The first set has oddly placed nether quartz. They realise that it is morse code and they translate it to "Rurple," which is supposed to mean "Purple.” They go to the second set of coordinates but only find a lava ocean. They go to the third set of coordinates and are met with a bastion, along with a sign that says "840 32 cyan.” They head to the next set of coords and find a chest in a nether fortress with a magenta candle, a spruce button, an oak plank, and brown wool. The decode the blocks with their block IDs to find the message “670.5 brown.” They arrive above a lava lake and splash each other with fire resistance before jumping in and finding a sign that says “960.18 pink.” They go to the nether roof of the second set of coords and find two signs that say "390.43 blue” and "390.43 blue.” 

The last set of coordinates houses a library constructed over a lava ocean. Parrot and Wifies tame striders to ride and use the Dewey Decimal System to find specific books, which they use to unlock a vault at the back. They find a wither rose and Parrot realises that it belongs to Kenadian. They head back to the quest temples to activate their fifth beacon.

Parrot and Wifies go to the end quest. They do a parkour course/escape room to reach the portal to the outer end islands. They find a chest containing fireworks, elytras, and a book. They search the islands and find an end city with a cartography table and Wifies’s prized dragon head. Upon returning to the main end island, they run into Kier and Dev. They respawn the ender dragon and threaten to kill them. Parrot and Wifies obtain their gear through an ender chest in the end city and chase them away. They place Wifies’s dragon head in the sixth quest temple and activate the beacon. 

Parrot and Wifies head to their usual meeting place with Jaden and Spongs, but instead see Clown. Parrot asks him why there are seven quest temples since they completed all of the quests and only six beacons were lit. Clown tells Parrot that he is the last key. Parrot places down the final item to return the missing players, his precious spyglass. Clown empties all of their inventories before leading them to what they worked to achieve all along.

Welcome to Proton, Minecraft’s most secure prison.

They realize that the poppies lead to something so they follow the path of the poppies and eventually reach a valley.  

Parrot and Wifies explore the valley until they see more moss and grass, which leads to a large tree. They walk around it until Parrot gets mining fatigue. They decide to check the inside of the tree and find an escape room. It goes wells until they hear the tree burning down and fireworks being shot by none other than Kier, Dev and Boosfer. Parrot and Wifies hide from them, but after they find them, they ask for the item. Wifies offers to distract them while Parrot continues looking for the item, but he declines and keeps them busy instead. He begins bluffing and deletes everything from the book, writing, "Through the valley's last edge, under the boulder below" on the first page and "deez nuts" on the second page before giving it to them. 

After a while of meandering around, they uncover Parrot’s bluff. He leads them to where they were actually supposed to go and mines down, but realises that the tree is Rekrap's base. Since Wifies stashed the item in his ender chest, Kier, Dev and Boosfer threaten to kill them and blow up the base. Parrot doesn’t want them to, giving them leverage over him and Wifies. They tell them to bring the item to their headquarters in thirty minutes or else the base gets destroyed.

Once they leave, Parrot and Wifies start evacuating all of the animals in Rekrap’s base. They hear withers and find bomber planes. They bridge up to them and find [[Wemmbu]]. He tells them that he was paid by someone anonymous to grief Rekrap's base. Parrot realizes it's Boosfer, Kier and Dev, and Wemmbu admits that they were the ones who hired him. He needs money to build another empire of his own and get revenge on [[PrinceZam]] and the [[Zam Empire]] by declaring war on them. Parrot tells Wemmbu that he doesn't need to stoop down Zam’s level to get revenge, and that they can rob Boosfer, Kier, and Dev, which Wemmbu agrees to. 

Parrot and Wifies place the flower in its quest temple’s item frame and activate the beacon. They retrieve their netherite gear to tell Boosfer that his plan to bomb the valley failed. He taunts them, and, realising that there is no point in staying, they head back to the quest temples.

Upon return, Parrot interrogates Jaden and Spongs about why they’re always absent. They play dumb and give them a cave quest. They are looking for a diamond, which Parrot assumes belongs to Leo. After entering the cave, they are met with another escape room. They complete it and find a cave maze. On the other side is an ancient city where they have to kill a warden to obtain a skulk catalyst needed to open a vault door. The warden is defeated and they find Leo’s diamond behind the vault door. 

Parrot and Wifies go back to the quest temples and activate the beacon for the diamond. However, Kier and Dev jump them and steal all of the items that they found. They just played dumb the entire time and waited for a chance to steal all of the items at once. There is nothing they can do without the game masters. When they finally arrive, Parrot lectures them about their irresponsibility and tell them that they need to deal with something else.

They head to the Wemmbu Civilization and form a plan to rob Boosfer, Kier, and Dev. Parrot tells Wemmbu that he will help destroy their base using an [[Orbital Strike Cannon|orbital cannon]] as long as Wemmbu only uses it on them and the Zam Empire. They launch the orbital cannon and grief Boosfer, Kier, and Dev’s base. After a successful heist in which they steal most of the Treasure Hunters’ riches, Parrot and Wifies head back to the quest temples.

Parrot tells the game masters to send them on the nether quest. They receive a book with six sets of coordinates. The first set has oddly placed nether quartz. They realise that it is morse code and they translate it to "Rurple," which is supposed to mean "Purple.” They go to the second set of coordinates but only find a lava ocean. They go to the third set of coordinates and are met with a bastion, along with a sign that says "840 32 cyan.” They head to the next set of coords and find a chest in a nether fortress with a magenta candle, a spruce button, an oak plank, and brown wool. The decode the blocks with their block IDs to find the message “670.5 brown.” They arrive above a lava lake and splash each other with fire resistance before jumping in and finding a sign that says “960.18 pink.” They go to the nether roof of the second set of coords and find two signs that say "390.43 blue” and "390.43 blue.” 

The last set of coordinates houses a library constructed over a lava ocean. Parrot and Wifies tame striders to ride and use the [https://snicket.fandom.com/wiki/Dewey_Decimal_System Dewey Decimal System] to find specific books, which they use to unlock a vault at the back. They find a wither rose and Parrot realises that it belongs to Kenadian. They head back to the quest temples to activate their fifth beacon.

Parrot and Wifies go to the end quest. They do a parkour course/escape room to reach the portal to the outer end islands. They find a chest containing fireworks, elytras, and a book. They search the islands and find an end city with a cartography table and Wifies’s prized dragon head. Upon returning to the main end island, they run into Kier and Dev. They respawn the ender dragon and threaten to kill them. Parrot and Wifies obtain their gear through an ender chest in the end city and chase them away. They place Wifies’s dragon head in the sixth quest temple and activate the beacon. 

Parrot and Wifies head to their usual meeting place with Jaden and Spongs, but instead see Clown. Parrot asks him why there are seven quest temples since they completed all of the quests and only six beacons were lit. Clown tells Parrot that he is the last key. Parrot places down the final item to return the missing players, his precious [[Parrot's Spyglass|spyglass]]. Clown empties all of their inventories before leading them to what they worked to achieve all along.

Welcome to [[Proton]], Minecraft’s most secure prison.

title: Its Dev
content:
Its_Dev_, also known as Dev, is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. Him and his friend Kierrrr work for Boosfer as the Treasure Hunters.

 History 
Boosfer sends Kierrrr and Its_Dev to steal specific items from ParrotX2 and Wifies. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ try to intercept Parrot and Wifies during a quest, but they escape using invisibility.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find Parrot and Wifies again. Parrot gives them a book, but edits the book to get rid of some important clues. They convince Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ that the hot air balloons around the area are in the shape of an arrow. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ leave.

Parrot and Wifies go to Boosfers base, who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince him not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ steal all of the items that Parrot and Wifies obtained from a quest.

Boosfer pays Wemmbu to destroy "the valley". Wemmbu finds Parrot and Wifies and agrees to team with them to steal items from Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_. They destroy the top layer of their headquarters with an Orbital Strike Cannon. Wemmbu finds their secret vault of items and together, they steal thousands of netherite and diamond blocks from them.

Parrot and Wifies go to the end as part of their quest. They find Wifies prized dragon head. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ try to kill them, but they escape to the outer islands. Parrot and Wifies find an ender chest and use the items in there to try to kill Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They manage to escape.

Its_Dev_ and Kierrrr vote against Boosfer in The End Civilization.

title: ItzRealMe
content:
ItzRealMe, also known as Itz, is a character featured in Unstable Universe, serving as the main antagonist of episode called I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player. Later he serves as the deuteragonist in I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player.

 Personality 
ItzRealMe is incredibly stoic and cold, even coming off as rude to people who seem to idolize him, such as DylPickle. He is focused on his job and tends to streamline his thoughts and focus completely on his mission, blocking out things he deems as distractions, which can be a double-edged sword. He is self assured and very intelligent, as well as being a man of few words, believing that his actions speak louder than his words ever will. 

 History 
ItzRealMe tries to assassinate ParrotX2. A team of people called Bounty Assassin Team save him from Itz. They escape from Itz by going to the nether. Their leader, Leow0ok invites Parrot to BAT. Parrot and Leow0ok see Itz inside of Parrot’s house. They start constructing a massive obsidian prison around Parrots house because they knew Itz would sit there patiently and wait for the prey.

BAT tries to kill ItzRealMe, but are forced to run away as it reveals that he has a mace. Itz later finds Parrot in the BAT headquarters. The BAT team saves Parrot. 

After this incident ItzRealMe comes to Parrot's room and tells him that The Director is the one who hired him to assassinate Parrot.  

Seeking to become a "Combat Master," FlameFrags tracked down the legend to his remote hideout to request training.

Initially reluctant to return to combat, ItzRealMe was persuaded when Flame pointed out that they shared a common enemy: the Law, a faction hunting down elite players like them. Itz agreed to train Flame the mace techniques so that the student could eventually dismantle The Law, allowing both of them to live in peace.

The most vital lesson ItzRealMe imparted was the concept of "The Zone"—a state of absolute focus. He taught that a master must silence all distractions (including "yapping" or trash talk: "bro", "like", "dude", etc.) to observe the opponent’s habits and patterns. He emphasized that "the quieter you become, the more you can hear," using meditation as a tool to sharpen the senses.

 Quotes 

 Trivia 
 As said by Parrot, he is commonly known to be the "Best Minecraft Player", being first on the MCTiers Rankings and having Tier 1 in almost every gamemode before retiring on most of them.
 He is now currently the #1 player in the entire world on MCTIERS.

title: Jaden MAN
content:
Jaden_MAN, or simply Jaden, is a supporting character in Season 1 and the main antagonist in both the Pirate Arc and the Betrayal Arc. He is also the leader of The Pirates. He is a major character in the Kings Arc. Jaden_MAN is one of the only mace holders on the SMP and uses his riptide trident playstyle with his mace.

 History 

 Season 1 
A team of people, including Jaden_MAN, try to destroy Wemmbu's Civilization. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps.

A team of people, including FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN, invade Wemmbu's Civilization. The civilization manages to get them to run away, but the entrance area of the civilization is destroyed.

Jaden_MAN and Spongs are seen as game masters for a quest that ParrotX2 and Wifies are tasked to complete.

 Season 2 
Wemmbu sees Spongs being robbed by Jaden_MAN and his team. Wemmbu saves Spongs and then he also robs him.

Jaden_MAN and his team threaten to kill Eggchan if Wemmbu does not drop all of his stuff and all of his stuff in his ender chest. Jaden_MAN exiles Wemmbu to the Pirate Islands.

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN and tries to kill him. While fighting him, someone bombs Jaden’s castle. TheobaldTheBird tells  Wemmbu and Eggchan that he was secretly helps them. Wemmbu and TheobaldTheBird try to kill Jaden_MAN.

Wemmbu and Eggchan follow Jaden_MAN down a hole into an abandoned underground civilization. Wemmbu is given mining fatigue. They try to kill Jaden_MAN, but he leads them into a horde of wardens and escapes.

Wemmbu and Eggchan see Jaden_MAN trying to escape the civilization but manage to stop him from escaping. Wemmbu and Eggchan are knocked to the bottom of the civilization, and Jaden is able to get away from them. Wemmbu and eggchan go up a spire to try and find Jaden_MAN.

Wemmbu and Eggchan find Jaden in an armory. Because Jaden has a lot more gear than they do, they run away. They manage to trap Jaden between two iron doors. Wemmbu and Eggchan find a villager trading hall and enchant their gear. Wemmbu and Eggchan lead wardens over to Jaden to try and kill him, but see he escaped from his trap.

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN killing elder guardians and tries to kill him. Jaden almost kills Wemmbu, but Rejoicin stops the fight and tries to convince them to be friends. Jaden starts attacking Rejoicin. They try to kill Jaden, but he escapes.

Wemmbu and Eggchan learn that the civilization was going to have a vote to decide if they were going to go to the surface in a book, but the next page after that is blank. The team finds Jaden_MAN at a trap near a warden factory. Rejoicin is killed by a warden.

The team finds an elytra. Using the elytra and a mace, Wemmbu uses all of Jaden’s totems. Wemmbu makes him throw out all of his items, removes all of the chorus fruit in the civilization, and traps him underground in the civilization.

FlameFrags searches for Jaden until he encounters The LAW. 

After a long fight with The Law in the abandoned civilization, FlameFrags finds Jaden, who tells FlameFrags that Wemmbu was responsible for locking him inside the abandoned civilization before he breaks him out.

Jaden_MAN and FlameFrags form a team of Wemmbu's past enemies to kill him in the Farlands. After failing to kill Wemmbu, they fight Sharpness to get a mace to make killing Wemmbu easier. FlameFrags convinces Sharpness to give him his mace by telling him that he can duplicate it and then gives it to Jaden_MAN.

After acquiring a mace, Jaden, along with FlameFrags and the rest of the team, tries to kill Wemmbu in the mountain spike biome in the Farlands. The fight erupts into chaos as Sharpness and WyLL begin fighting and the rest of the team attack each other. Jaden fights FlameFrags until he lets him go. 

His new civilization is destroyed by Wemmbu. 

With the help of the Invisible Knight, Jaden manages to capture the Marine Ranger base, laying the foundation for the new Pirate Empire. 

Jaden saves Wemmbu and Eggchan by killing Law members.  

Jaden houses both Wemmbu and Eggchan.  

Jaden leads a group of pirates with Wemmbu and Eggchan to destroy the orbital cannon set up by the law to take over The Great Sea. Jaden is captured by the Law.  

After Jaden is captured by The Law, he is imprisoned and LettuceK has a plan to use him as leverage over Wemmbu. This forces Wemmbu to think twice before attacking LettuceK.   

He is freed from prison by Spoke and his team with the accidental help of Flame and by extension, Wemmbu. When the teams regroup, Flame begins to fight Jaden, demanding Jaden hand over Lomedy's mace. In the six-day war in The Northern Council against Lettice and The LAW, Jaden uses his mace to help eliminate the 2500 player army alongside the protagonists and allies. 

Post-battle, Flame starts attacking Jaden again which causes a brief scuffle that is interrupted by Wemmbu. Wemmbu protects Jaden and challenges Flame instead, Jaden remains quiet during this exchange in the background.    

In I Explored the World's Largest Minecraft Server, Wemmbu orders Egg to head to the Pirate Civilization to recruit Jaden for a 4v4. However, Egg fails to grasp what the situation was and relays the wrong request to Jaden but Jaden comes to help anyway. When he sees Wemmbu and realizes the true events Jaden is very confused but is still on-board to help. He stays by Wemmbu's side in what essentially became a 2v4 because the fourth random bailed and Eggchan was useless in combat. Jaden helps Wemmbu win the fight and is dismissed following the battle. 

In Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing, Jaden protects Old Man Lynn and sees Wemmbu at his island. He is some what confused but agrees to help Wemmbu find Eggchan. FlameFrags is also present but Jaden and Flame struggle to cooperate together. Jaden arrives at the island and helps Wemmbu at the auction of Eggchan. Wemmbu loses his patience and starts to attack everyone at the auction with Jaden being his ally. Jaden fights Arachn1d, Yungyx, and the Invisible Player in the battle. Jaden continues fighting them until the Invisible Player says that he will kill Eggchan if they continue to fight. Jaden stops fighting for Wemmbu's sake and tells Wemmbu about the threat. 

 Trivia 
 He was playing VEN0M in SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Civilization
 He is one of the few mace wielders. He stole it from Lomedy. FlameFrags tried to force him to return the mace but Wemmbu hindered him to do so.
 He is the antagonist of two arcs and yet turned into a ally for the protagonists (Particularly Wemmbu)

[[Jaden_MAN|Jaden_MAN]], or simply [[Jaden_MAN|Jaden]], is a supporting character in Season 1 and the main antagonist in both the [[Pirate Arc]] and the Betrayal Arc. He is also the leader of The Pirates. He is a major character in the [[The Kings Arc|Kings Arc]]. Jaden_MAN is one of the only [[Maces|mace]] holders on the SMP and uses his riptide trident playstyle with his mace.

== History ==

=== Season 1 ===
A team of people, including Jaden_MAN, try to destroy [[Wemmbu's Civilization]]. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps.

A team of people, including [[FlameFrags]] and Jaden_MAN, invade Wemmbu's Civilization. The civilization manages to get them to run away, but the entrance area of the civilization is destroyed.

Jaden_MAN and [[Spongs]] are seen as game masters for a quest that [[ParrotX2]] and [[Wifies]] are tasked to complete.

=== Season 2 ===
[[Wemmbu]] sees [[Spongs]] being robbed by Jaden_MAN and his team. [[Wemmbu]] saves Spongs and then he also robs him.

Jaden_MAN and his team threaten to kill [[Eggchan]] if [[Wemmbu]] does not drop all of his stuff and all of his stuff in his ender chest. Jaden_MAN exiles Wemmbu to the [[Pirate Islands]].

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN and tries to kill him. While fighting him, someone bombs Jaden’s castle. [[TheobaldTheBird]] tells  [[Wemmbu]] and [[Eggchan]] that he was secretly helps them. Wemmbu and TheobaldTheBird try to kill Jaden_MAN.

Wemmbu and Eggchan follow Jaden_MAN down a hole into an [[The Abandoned Civilization|abandoned underground civilization]]. Wemmbu is given mining fatigue. They try to kill Jaden_MAN, but he leads them into a horde of wardens and escapes.

Wemmbu and Eggchan see Jaden_MAN trying to escape the civilization but manage to stop him from escaping. Wemmbu and Eggchan are knocked to the bottom of the civilization, and Jaden is able to get away from them. Wemmbu and eggchan go up a spire to try and find Jaden_MAN.

Wemmbu and Eggchan find Jaden in an armory. Because Jaden has a lot more gear than they do, they run away. They manage to trap Jaden between two iron doors. [[Wemmbu]] and [[Eggchan]] find a villager trading hall and enchant their gear. Wemmbu and Eggchan lead wardens over to Jaden to try and kill him, but see he escaped from his trap.

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN killing elder guardians and tries to kill him. Jaden almost kills Wemmbu, but Rejoicin stops the fight and tries to convince them to be friends. Jaden starts attacking Rejoicin. They try to kill Jaden, but he escapes.

Wemmbu and Eggchan learn that the civilization was going to have a vote to decide if they were going to go to the surface in a book, but the next page after that is blank. The team finds Jaden_MAN at a trap near a warden factory. Rejoicin is killed by a warden.

The team finds an elytra. Using the elytra and a mace, Wemmbu uses all of Jaden’s totems. Wemmbu makes him throw out all of his items, removes all of the chorus fruit in the civilization, and traps him underground in the civilization.

FlameFrags searches for Jaden until he encounters The LAW. 

After a long fight with The Law in the abandoned civilization, FlameFrags finds Jaden, who tells FlameFrags that Wemmbu was responsible for locking him inside the abandoned civilization before he breaks him out.

Jaden_MAN and FlameFrags form a team of Wemmbu's past enemies to kill him in the Farlands. After failing to kill Wemmbu, they fight Sharpness to get a mace to make killing Wemmbu easier. FlameFrags convinces Sharpness to give him his mace by telling him that he can duplicate it and then gives it to Jaden_MAN.

After acquiring a mace, Jaden, along with FlameFrags and the rest of the team, tries to kill Wemmbu in the mountain spike biome in the Farlands. The fight erupts into chaos as Sharpness and WyLL begin fighting and the rest of the team attack each other. Jaden fights FlameFrags until he lets him go. 

His new civilization is destroyed by Wemmbu. 

With the help of the [[Wemmbu|Invisible Knight]], Jaden manages to capture the Marine Ranger base, laying the foundation for the new Pirate Empire. 

Jaden saves Wemmbu and Eggchan by killing Law members.  

Jaden houses both Wemmbu and Eggchan.  

Jaden leads a group of pirates with Wemmbu and Eggchan to destroy the orbital cannon set up by the law to take over The Great Sea. Jaden is captured by the Law.  

After Jaden is captured by The Law, he is imprisoned and LettuceK has a plan to use him as leverage over Wemmbu. This forces Wemmbu to think twice before attacking LettuceK.   

He is freed from prison by Spoke and his team with the accidental help of Flame and by extension, Wemmbu. When the teams regroup, Flame begins to fight Jaden, demanding Jaden hand over Lomedy's mace. In the six-day war in The Northern Council against Lettice and The LAW, Jaden uses his mace to help eliminate the 2500 player army alongside the protagonists and allies. 

Post-battle, Flame starts attacking Jaden again which causes a brief scuffle that is interrupted by Wemmbu. Wemmbu protects Jaden and challenges Flame instead, Jaden remains quiet during this exchange in the background.    

In [[I Explored the World's Largest Minecraft Server]], Wemmbu orders Egg to head to the Pirate Civilization to recruit Jaden for a 4v4. However, Egg fails to grasp what the situation was and relays the wrong request to Jaden but Jaden comes to help anyway. When he sees Wemmbu and realizes the true events Jaden is very confused but is still on-board to help. He stays by Wemmbu's side in what essentially became a 2v4 because the fourth random bailed and Eggchan was useless in combat. Jaden helps Wemmbu win the fight and is dismissed following the battle. 

In [[Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing]], Jaden protects Old Man [[Linnwyrm|Lynn]] and sees Wemmbu at his island. He is some what confused but agrees to help Wemmbu find Eggchan. FlameFrags is also present but Jaden and Flame struggle to cooperate together. Jaden arrives at the island and helps Wemmbu at the auction of [[Eggchan|Eggchan.]] Wemmbu loses his patience and starts to attack everyone at the auction with Jaden being his ally. Jaden fights Arachn1d, Yungyx, and the Invisible Player in the battle. Jaden continues fighting them until the Invisible Player says that he will kill Eggchan if they continue to fight. Jaden stops fighting for Wemmbu's sake and tells Wemmbu about the threat. 

== Trivia ==
* He was playing [[VEN0M]] in [[SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Civilization]]
* He is one of the few [[Maces|mace]] wielders. He stole it from [[Lomedy]]. [[FlameFrags]] tried to force him to return the mace but [[Wemmbu]] hindered him to do so.
* He is the antagonist of two arcs and yet turned into a ally for the protagonists (Particularly Wemmbu)

title: JakeVC42
content:
JakeVC42_, also known as Jake, was a soldier that served in FlameFrags's Law Team. He fought and died in a battle trying to reclaim a law base from Arachn1d's Kingdom. 

As said by FlameFrags, Jake "saved" their happy ghast mission by knocking the Arachn1d's soldier off their happy ghast, ultimately letting FlameFrags's Team escape. 

 Personality 
Jake was known for being more serious and focused than the rest of the Law Team. He was a relatively skilled player, getting kills before FlameFrags even with significantly weaker gear. He followed orders and stayed on task, often keeping formation and reacting to threats while others, like Spongs, Lomedy, and Gunter, were more chaotic. Many viewers saw him as one of the more reliable members of the Law Team, with some saying he was one of the only ones who listened to FlameFrags's commands. His behavior during the mission led to him being seen as a dependable member of the squad.

 Trivia 
 Jake is one of very few characters to gain significant screen time without being able to talk, often using only his expressions and movement to communicate.

title: JamatoP
content:
JamatoP, also known as Jamato, is a supporting character—turned antagonist, featured in the Unstable Universe. He was Spoke's first ally on the server and now serves as his arch-nemesis as the leader of the Null Hunters. He serves as the main antagonist of The NULL Arc

 Personality 
JamatoP was a kind individual as seen when he helped Spoke with figuring out how all the protections got on the same piece of armor and when he saves Mapicc from dying. He is bent on protecting the server even when that means losing his closest friends and allies, namely Spoke. He appears to be rather curious, willing to experiment with the exploits until he decided they were going too far at which he abandons Spoke and disappears. Even then, it seems that he deeply cared about Spoke's wellbeing until the latter attacked him after he revealed his plan to protect Mapicc from Spoke.  

After a period of hiding, Jamato seems to have developed a large amount of disdain for Spoke, as shown in the book he had written specifically for him to find in the gear set he gave him, stating that Jamato will make Jumper and Mapicc turn on Spoke if he ever tells them anything. By this time, Jamato had created the Null Hunters and seemed to go to extreme lengths to accomplish his goal of capturing Spoke and other players he deemed evil to make the server better and give everyone a chance to explore. Despite this seemingly self-righteous belief however, Jamato ordered Null to capture innocent players like PlanetLord, CookieBunsquat and JumperWho; infiltrated Spoke's team and broke Spoke's heart and his bond with Mapicc; and killed every player they met on sight, essentially defying his own purpose and integrity, showing that he was not above doing evil himself if it meant that he met his goals which he believed were for the betterment of the server. He even imprisons his friend Mapicc all to get revenge on the one he sees as the most dangerous person on the server.  

 History 
SpokeIsHere shows JamatoP a glitch which allowed him to get a full set of diamond armor with every protection enchantment, which is normally not possible. Jamato then guides Spoke through his base, where he shows him a lot of glitched features.

Jamato helps Spoke create glitched features in The Wonders, such as a chunk suppressor. 

Spoke tells him that he wants to destroy all the end portals so that he can duplicate mobs without interference by other players, but Jamato disagrees. He says that Spoke just wants to play god. He says he doesn’t want to be part of this anymore. Despite this, Spoke still tries to convince him otherwise and shows him that he obtained a barrier block, and a command block.

Jamato later finds Spoke and sees that he’s going to use a machine to destroy The Wonders. He tells him this is not a good solution.

JamatoP vanishes.

Wemmbu finds JamatoP in his base after he’s vanished. Jamato says that he doesn’t know where Spoke is because he parted ways with him and hasn’t seen him since. Other players from the Zam Empire come into the base, and start attacking Wemmbu and Jamato and asking if they know anything about Spoke. Eventually Wemmbu and Zam Empire leave.

JamatoP's base gets blown up by The Mafia after Ashswagg finds out that the exploits he taught Spoke were patched. Spoke and PlanetLord find a revamped version made out of wood and finds a book alongside a book and quill saying that he’s either captured by the mafia or dead, and a lodestone compass that leads to the Mafia outpost.

JamatoP explores multiple locations in the server, including the Far Lands and The Underworld. He settled near the Far Lands and built a house on a flowery mountain as his base.

JamatoP saves Mapicc from an attack by BAT using weapons that the BAT spies have never seen. The two escape to the Far Lands using an ender pearl cannon where Spoke (alongside PrinceZam) finds JamatoP's base that resides on the outskirts of the Far Lands. JamatoP is followed to a lighthouse by Spoke, where the two have an argument and JamatoP tells Spoke that he leeches off of the people he calls friends. JamatoP takes off all his armor and taunts Spoke, assuming that Spoke won't kill him. When Spoke tries to kill him, he swaps to his totem, which popped and triggered an exploit that instantly teleported him away. At the end of the video he is seen watching Spoke and his friends.

Soon after Spoke left his far land base, Wemmbu took 4CVIT's pearl cannon to the destroyed lighthouse and found JamatoP's flowery mountain base. He realized he arrived near the wrong direction of Far Lands. Jamato appeared outside the house. Wemmbu tricked him to believe that he was trustworthy as Serpentbound was inviting him to his kingdom. Jamato took Wemmbu to a giant portal after navigating through wither traps. The portal led them to a lobby in the Underworld, where Jamato asked soul keepers to guide them to portal to Far Lands near Serpentbound's Kingdom. They went through the portal, and Wemmbu revealed they would part ways and he was not Serpentbound's friend. Jamato fought Wemmbu but he was quickly defeated due to being bad at PvP. He popped a totem and disappeared instantly using the same exploit.

In Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters, Spoke is hunted down by a group of players which seem immortal. They use the same exploit as JamatoP uses as when they pop their totem of undying they are instantly teleported via a stasis chamber. Later Spoke asks SirPig about who is doing all of this.  In their brief conversation, SirPig mentions that Spoke's chestplate was given to him as a gift by Jamato, and that the person who hired the hunters demanded said chestplate as proof of Spoke's death.

JamatoP appeared after Spoke, JumperWho and Mapicc found the fabric / fiber next to the infinite downward staircase, stating that he came to help them from Null Hunters. Spoke discovered after a lot of theorizing that Jamato is indeed the leader of NULL that hunted him down. He fails to convince Mapicc about it, and instead, Mapicc treats it as a betrayal, believing that Jamato was actually helping them and Spoke worked with NULL to trap him. He broke Spoke's infamous Alt Chestplate inside a maze. After Mapicc does the job of breaking his armor, both Mapicc and Spoke are weakened and captured by NULL and are ordered to enter into a nether portal. Jamato burnt all of Spoke's belongings, including items in his ender chest, effectively removing Spoke's ability to do anything on the server making him as weak as a new player on the server. 

JamatoP's ruthlessness in his revenge against Spoke is clear as he tore Spoke's team apart and captured innocent players all to be part of his grand plan. It is likely he still has good intentions however he is shown to be ruthless in destroying the rebels and commands NULL.

 Quotes 

 Trivia 
 JamatoP is shown wearing full Netherite armor with Flow armor trims, which are very rare on the Unstable SMP as they're only found at a 22.5% chance in Ominous Vaults, all destroyed by ClownPierce, except for the ones in the Far Lands.
 JamatoP's Minecraft Skin directly resembles Nailmaster Mato from Hollow Knight, a scrolling platfomer made by Australian indie developer Team Cherry.
 JamatoP may have access to creative mode, shown when he disappeared and entered the Nether instantly when he touched the Far Lands portal in Wemmbu's perspective.
 The exploit JamatoP used to survive Spoke and Wemmbu was already used by Wemmbu at PvP tournament (which caused him to say he had seen this before), as well as by Wifies when Parrot attacked him in Paragon. It is likely shadow items, i.e. two "quantum entangled" reference to the same instance of totem, with one in the exploit user's hand and the other in a chest connected to comparator that triggers stasis machine. When the user's totem pops, the other reference in the chest also "pops", leading to the stasis being pulled.
 Jamatop has access to deadly weapons that he used against the bat spies however in his fight with Wemmbu he never used any of the weapons instead he just got folded by Wemmbu.thumb|JamatoP's name being JamatoB

When the user's totem pops, the other reference in the chest also "pops", leading to the stasis being pulled.

title: JumperWho
content:
JumperWho, more commonly known as Jumper, is a character in Unstable Universe. Jumper is in charge of spies in Bounty Assassin Team. She is shown to care a lot about morals and treats her spies very fairly. She sometimes however is forced to make difficult choices like allying with her enemies just for her morals. Her thinking is similar to Parrot in many ways.

 History 

 Season 1 
JumperWho is seen as a guard for one of The Wonders.

JumperWho is seen as a guard for SpokeIsHere in an end base.

ParrotX2 and his friends free JumperWho from a chunk ban. She agrees to help them break people out of prisons.

JumperWho is seen as part of early BAT when they are focused on killing ClownPierce.

Spoke and Mapicc find JumperWho, who is AFK. They move her onto the nether roof. She comes back and they run away to the overworld. Spoke and Mapicc destroy the guardian farm.

Parrot and Wifies go on a quest to obtain certain specific items. They obtain a pair of netherite boots which is one of JumperWho's most prized possessions.

JumperWho is trapped in a prison called Proton. She is put in solitary confinement. With the help of Parrot and the other prisoners, they are able to escape from prison.

JumperWho is seen as a member of The End Civilization.

JumperWho joins District 13.  She later leaves District 13 to join The Invisible Mafia after being unhappy with how things were going.

 Season 2 
JumperWho joins Bounty Assassin Team.

JumperWho puts a chest and a sign saying to run in Parrot's room with two stacks of pearls, and an invisibility potion. BAT comes into Parrot's room and tries to kill him as they think he is The Director.

JumperWho finds Parrot in an abandoned city. She tells Parrot that she was the one who put the chest and sign in his room. Parrot becomes a JumperWho spy to figure out how he had been framed for being The Director.

JumperWho gives Parrot the pieces of evidence that BAT thought showed he was The Director. Leow0ok does a "mole check" to see if any of JumperWho’s spies were moles by having them hold a green shield. Parrot takes a green banner off of the wall and combines it with his shield. Parrot is the only spy who holds a green shield, showing that he is a mole. Parrot manages to escape.

Parrot finds a book asking Parrot to meet up with him. Parrot spies on BAT's meeting. JumperWho betrays him, telling them that Parrot is spying on them. Parrot manages to escape during the chaos. JumperWho tells Parrot that she was actually just pretending to betray Parrot because BAT didn’t trust her. Parrot discovers that someone was spying on them. JumperWho uses a goat horn to call back her spy, and kill the spy. 

BAT watches Parrot and The Director have a conversation, which convinces BAT that Parrot is not The Director. The Director teleports away. Leow0ok discovers that JumperWho killed a spy, and kicks her off the team.

JumperWho rejoins BAT after saving Parrot from death to help hunt down the Director. JumperWho leads them to a secret base that she and her spies created.

JumperWho sends spies to secretly spy on suspects for the Director while the Director visits Parrot. The Director holds a chest plate with a red trim on it, causing Parrot to believe the Director is Spoke, as Spoke wears that netherite chest plate. Parrot convinces Leow0ok and Derapchu to pretend to be spies so Parrot can threaten to kill the spies so that JumperWho confesses to lying about none of the suspects being the Director. Parrot fails to do so.

JumperWho and Derapchu are trapped by the Director in an obsidian room. Leow0ok later saves them using a happy ghast.

JumperWho works as a guard in Paragon. Wifies reveals that he knows her spies identities and make Jumper work for him. This shows how much she cares about her spies.

JumperWho continues as a member of BAT. After SpokeIsHere kills several spies, she ends up conflicting with Leow0ok. Leow0ok wants to kill Spoke, but JumperWho requires finding the armor pieces of the dead spies as proof that Spoke was the one. 

JumperWho is one of the 16 candidates that get over 100 votes. She is pressured by Leow0ok to become a candidate. 

JumperWho drops out of the elections for unknown reasons but probably because she just did not want to and was forced by Leow0ok. 

JumperWho stalks Spoke and her spies attack him. After Leow0ok orders more of her spies to their death she finally loses it and helps Spoke fight  Leow0ok. 

JumperWho helps Spoke, Mapicc and PrinceZam attempt to kill Leow0ok.  She helps Spoke kill hundreds of Law men commanded by Leow0ok  using a rail gun. Later she faces Leow0ok and saves PrinceZam from dying. 

JumperWho fights alongside District 13 at the the Battle of The Northern Council. 

After the battle, JumperWho gets a book from one of her spies revealing Leow0ok's location. She and Spoke attack Leow0ok and break his armour completely. Leow0ok eyes both of them with contempt and says his last words before teleporting away, only to realise that his enderpearl statis was rigged by Spoke. Leow0ok is killed in the void and Spoke probably informs Jumper about this. 

Spoke hires jumper and pulled JumperWho and her spies stasis when Null hunters attacked his base, and they has since been both hunted by these hunters. the two of them help each other fight the Null hunters but most, if not all, JumperWho's spies were killed by Null hunters. She is saddened by this but for some reason does not blame Spoke for their deaths like she blamed Leow0ok.

JumperWho and Spoke explored the Far Lands under Mapicc's lead. They met JamatoP, who lead them into designed traps of Null Hunters, split them, made them turn against Spoke and captured all of them. Her former spy, CookieBunsquat, was also captured by Null Hunters.

 Trivia 

 Her name is derived from her old free Minecraft Pocket Edition skin named "Jumper?" and when she made her Minecraft username she changed the question mark to who and hence the name JumperWho.

 No shipping

title: JumperWho's Spies
content:
JumperWho's Spies (formerly known as the Bounty Assassin Team Spies) were a group of invisible players led by JumperWho and approved by Leow0ok. The group was split up when Leow0ok decided to devote spies as Law soldiers but Jumper disagreed because she thought this is abusing them. After the downfall of Law, the spies were killed and Jumper was captured by Null Hunters.

 History 
The Spies were first formed after the fall of the Invisible Mafia as a subgroup of the Bounty Assassin Team (BAT) under the supervision and leadership of JumperWho. The Spies were all given codenames and were instructed to stay invisible at all times. Numerous spies were killed by the various hunters dispatched by The Director to stalk and test Parrot, BAT's newest member, and to see he how would react when put in various scenarios. JumperWho additionally kills one of the spies to keep Parrot and herself safe when Parrot was thought to be the Director. Under Parrot's order, Leo pretended to be one of JumperWho's spies near a TNT minecart for Parrot to interrogate JumperWho about whether she serves a spy for the Director, which ended up in Leo himself becoming visible and hunting down Parrot. The identities of the spies would later be used as leverage by The Director to blackmail JumperWho and force her to guard Parrot inside Paragon.

Following Wifies' death and the conclusion of the hunt for the player who doesn't exist, the spies would replenish their numbers and move to a new base, where they would continue to operate under JumperWho and Leow0ok. Leo would dispatch the spies to follow SpokeIsHere, as he suspected that Spoke had something to do with the deaths of a previous Spy duo. Over the next few months, Leo's usage of the spies as ground troopers would put strain on his and Jumper's partnership, as she disapproved of Leo's insistence on sending Spies to fight and kill Spoke. Eventually, The Bounty Assassin Team, and by extension, the spies, would ally with The Law and LettuceK.  A squadron of spies sent by Leo to hunt and kill Spoke and his best friend, Mapicc, were caught off guard and killed by a mysterious player using weapons they had never seen before during a failed ambush on Mapicc.

Following this, JumperWho, fed up with Leo throwing her spies' lives away for his personal crusade against Spoke, would gather the surviving spies still loyal to her and leave BAT, allying with Spoke to kill and ban Leow0ok. The Spies would continue to fulfill their purpose as scouts and intelligence gatherers during the war against The Law, which ended with LettuceK captured, BAT disbanded, and Leow0ok banned at the hands of Spoke. However, during the final battle at the Northern Council, Mapicc had disappeared, leading to Spoke asking Jumper and the spies to help him locate his missing friend.

While Jumper was willing to help Spoke find Mapicc, she was hesitant to use her spies as soldiers, as that was the very reason she broke away from BAT and Leo. When the search for Mapicc took a mysterious turn at the revelation of a group of unknown players seemingly abducting hundreds of players across the server, Spoke managed to convince Jumper that the only way to get the backup they needed to complete their objective would be to use the Spies. Jumper hesitantly agreed, but not after ensuring that Spoke would give the spies a choice to decline accompanying them on the mission.

A squad of spies agreed to assist and were brought by JumperWho and SpokeIsHere to find a pearl cannon belonging to Null Hunters in Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing. However, the mission would end disastrously, and every participating spy was killed by the hunters.

The capture of Jumper and her former spy CookieBunsquat by Null Hunters marked the final downfall of Jumper's spies.
