title: Kenadian
content:
_Kenadian_, or Kenadian, is a character in Unstable Universe.

Personality
Kenadian is highly intelligent, adaptable, and cautious. He like to always have a plan and have extensive knowledge of Minecraft mechanics and prison escaping.   

Fearful of the risk of his friends dying, he was initially determined to keep all of them safe and inside of the prison rather than let them take on a heavy risk of escaping Proton. His pursuit for their team's safety leads him to nearly sabotage ParrotX2's breakout plan. Kenadian is very selfless when it comes to their friends and trusts them greatly, sacrificing himself to let Parrot escape, because he knew they would find his Stasis Chamber and break him out.  

 History 

 Season 1 
ParrotX2 and a team of people including _Kenadian_ break Wifies out of his chunk ban. SpokeIsHere is unintentionally broken out of prison as well.

Kenadian is trapped in a prison by ClownPierce.

Kenadian is trapped in Proton by ClownPierce. After helping everyone to escape, he gives the last elytra to Parrot, breaking him free. Later Kenadian was teleported out of Proton with a Stasis Chamber he built in his base.

Kenadian joins Far Lands. He joins the farming district. Far Lands is eventually destroyed by The Invisible Mafia.

Kenadian joins District 13. He eventually leaves and joins the Mafia due to minimal progress.

Kenadian helps Parrot, Spoke, Mapicc, Wemmbu, and eggchan break into a spawn prison built by the Mafia.

 Season 2 
Kenadian helps Wemmbu protect his base from TheobaldTheBird. TheobaldTheBird later threatens to kill Kenadian unless Wemmbu has a fair fight with him.

 Thumbnails 

Trivia
Following the release of I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison, Kenadian proceeded to debunk the final prison in a video on his second channel.

[[_Kenadian_]], or [[_Kenadian_|Kenadian]], is a character in ''[[Unstable Universe]]''.

==Personality==
Kenadian is highly intelligent, adaptable, and cautious. He like to always have a plan and have extensive knowledge of Minecraft mechanics and prison escaping.   

Fearful of the risk of his friends dying, he was initially determined to keep all of them safe and inside of the prison rather than let them take on a heavy risk of escaping [[Proton]]. His pursuit for their team's safety leads him to nearly sabotage [[ParrotX2|ParrotX2's]] breakout plan. Kenadian is very selfless when it comes to their friends and trusts them greatly, sacrificing himself to let [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] escape, because he knew they would find his Stasis Chamber and break him out.  

== History ==

=== Season 1 ===
[[ParrotX2]] and a team of people including _Kenadian_ break [[Wifies]] out of his [[chunk ban]]. [[SpokeIsHere]] is unintentionally broken out of prison as well.

Kenadian is trapped in a prison by [[ClownPierce]].

Kenadian is trapped in [[Proton]] by [[ClownPierce]]. After helping everyone to escape, he gives the last elytra to Parrot, breaking him free. Later Kenadian was teleported out of Proton with a Stasis Chamber he built in his base.

Kenadian joins [[Far Lands]]. He joins the farming district. [[Far Lands]] is eventually destroyed by [[The Invisible Mafia]].

Kenadian joins [[District 13]]. He eventually leaves and joins the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] due to minimal progress.

Kenadian helps [[ParrotX2|Parrot]], [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]], [[Mapicc]], [[Wemmbu]], and [[eggchan]] break into a spawn prison built by the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]].

=== Season 2 ===
Kenadian helps [[Wemmbu]] protect his base from [[TheobaldTheBird]]. [[TheobaldTheBird]] later threatens to kill Kenadian unless [[Wemmbu]] has a fair fight with him.

title: Kierrrr
content:
Kierrrr, also known as Kier, is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. He and his friend Its_Dev_ work for Boosfer as the Treasure Hunters.

 History 
Boosfer sends Kierrrr and Its_Dev to steal specific items from ParrotX2 and Wifies. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ try to intercept Parrot and Wifies during a quest, but they escape using invisibility.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find Parrot and Wifies again. Parrot gives them a book, but edits the book to get rid of some important clues. They convince Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ that the hot air balloons around the area are in the shape of an arrow. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ leave.

Parrot and Wifies go to Boosfers base, who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince him not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ steal all of the items that Parrot and Wifies obtained from a quest.

Boosfer pays Wemmbu to destroy "the valley". Wemmbu finds Parrot and Wifies and agrees to team with them to steal items from Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_. They destroy the top layer of their headquarters with an Orbital Strike Cannon. Wemmbu finds their secret vault of items and together, they steal thousands of netherite and diamond blocks from them.

Parrot and Wifies go to the end as part of their quest. They find Wifies prized dragon head. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ try to kill them, but they escape to the outer islands. Parrot and Wifies find an ender chest and use the items in there to try to kill Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They manage to escape.

Its_Dev_ and Kierrrr vote against Boosfer in The End Civilization.

title: Landmarks of Unstable
content:
Category:Landmarks
Category:Civilizations
Category:Places

The important places

 The Abandoned Civilization 
The mushroomy themed place under the Great Sea

thumb
The Abandoned Civilization (unnamed in video) is a civilization that was closed off from the outside world. The civilization was abandoned for unknown reasons. Multiple written books tell us about the lore of the civilization.

History
The civilization held a vote on whether or not they would block of the civilization from the outside world. The vote decides that they should block off contact from the outside world.

The civilization decides to hold a vote on if they should go back to the outside world.

The civilization is abandoned for unknown reasons.

Wemmbu and eggchan try to kill Jaden_MAN in the civilization. They eventually trap him in the civilization with mining fatigue III.

Later, FlameFrags rescues Jaden.

 The Amplified 
A place where terrain is amplified

The Amplified is a part of the server which contains amplified terrain. It is home to BAT Headquarters 2.0, BAT's secret vault and ApexPoint. Spoke used to live in a castle in the Amplified before Season 3. Quakenstein123's family used to live before BAT destroyed their home and they were forced to move back to the snowy biome. ParrotX2 once arrived in another part of the Amplified to rescue a Treebo Village member from the base of bandits named the Phantoms and then defend the whole village from these bandits. It also was home to Squiddo before Spoke burnt it down.

 The Basic Redstone Shop 
4C's shop in Redstone Town

The "Basic Redstone Shop" is a shop for redstone, located in Redstone Town. It is run by a player named 4CVIT.

 BAT Headquarters 
Bounty Assassin Team HQ 1.0 and 2.0

 BAT HQ 1 
The First BAT HQ

The BAT Headquarters was a base owned by Bounty Assassin Team. The base was eventually destroyed by TruOriginal. 

 Features 
 Player-launching system 
This system helped players exit the base, launching them a thousand blocks in the sky, so they could use elytra more effectively.

 Control room and alarm signal 
The operator in the control room could send alarm signals to all rooms or to a specific room.

 Emergency button 
Players could send an emergency signal through a button in their rooms.

 Communication system 
Each room was equipped with a dispenser which could send written books to the other members of BAT. The sender would input the room's number as the book's name.

 Privacy system 
This system is a special lava-curtain between the two layers of the window.

 Storage room 
Although mostly blown up this room still contains massive amounts of wealth and treasure

 BAT HQ 2 
BAT HQ Rebuilt

BAT Headquarters 2.0 (unnamed in video) is a base run by the Bounty Assassin Team.

 The Black Market 
(where the real money is made)

 About 

The black market is a place hidden from Capital City (season 2). It is an illegal trading hall where there are no taxes. When The Law took over Capital City, it was still used as a trading hall to sneak in banned items.

 History 
ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird go into the vaults to make illegal business deals with someone to save their friend from Spawn. 

Wemmbu and FlameFrags rob the place for XP

Theo and Flame come back to buy TNT minecarts for their supply. The criminals in the black market are hostile towards them. Following that G0d0fWar pardons all the criminals saying that LettuceK does not care about taxes.  

The Black Market is now probably open to all players as it was one of G0d0fWar's demands. It no longer is a "Black Market" in the real sense but it is the only trading settlement that is not guarded by The Law. It is also possible that it has been since disbanded with all players returning to Captial city. It is now used as a prison holding many people.

 Capital City 
The first, and the second

 Capital City 
The first

Capital City, led by Reddoons (and quoted by Ash to be 'basically his'), is a civilization in Unstable Universe. The city is split into two parts: The Mines, and The City. The City is empty and it is dubious if The City was always a ruse for The Mines or citizens of Capital City were placed into The Mines prematurely to produce more diamonds.

Allyship 
Most of Capital City's plot relevance is with it's allyship with The Invisible Mafia. In I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia, it is expanded upon that the allyship between Capital City and The Invisible Mafia is a one-way transactional relationship where Red will supply the Mafia with goods and the Mafia will remain neutral with Red.

In I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization, guards are shown to be stationed at Capital City, but in I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia they are gone, so it can be assumed that between videos, stations ended at Capital City, along with more interpersonal things like Red's position in the mafia.

 The Mines 
The Mines are a subsection of Capital City, being where most people in Capital City reside. It is alluded to be some kind of equivalent to a labor camp--minus it being prisoners placed in there; made to mine for valuable ores all day until nightfall. The Mines subsection was watched over CoinMonke as a warden.

The pitfall most workers found themselves in was the promise to be able to leave The Mines if they reach an absurd quota of diamonds, mostly being impossible without the help of Parrot stealing from Red's vaults. 

It gradually grew to also have a roulette table, following Red's gambling motifs, to kill one player after a week as a punishment for being the target of Red's suspicions.

The Mines are now seemingly defunct after I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City.

 History 
ParrotX2, Wifies, and deanthebean9 try to steal from Capital city. They are caught by Reddoons and five invisible guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

They find a group of miners, with CoinMonke as the warden. Parrot spends his time mining. Parrot and his friends steal from Capital City vaults. Parrot gives PikaTM more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital City for them to be set free.

Reddoons finds out about people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in the vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

Parrot overhears Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that ashswagg suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and The Invisible Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they say no. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber and they escape.

Members of Skyblock Civilization investigate Capital City. They pretend to be members of The Mafia to infiltrate however, the invisible players are able to tell the fake ones and attack the Skyblock Civilization members.

Spoke, Mapicc and Leow0ok are sent on a mission to trade with Reddoons. The leader of the mission is disappointed by Red's offerings. Since Red isn't rich enough anymore, the gold player just goes with it and they leave.

 Trivia 
 Capitol City is named after a city Reddoons owned in Lifesteal SMP Season 3.

 Capital City 2.0 
Capital City the Second lol

Capitol City 2.0, commonly known as Capitol City, is a city leaded by Fymada, located near spawn. Centered a few thousand blocks from Spawn, this metropolis is a safe space for all players. It is home to many shops, jobs, and houses. Hundreds of players live here—which formerly included ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird.

 Structure 
Capitol City is home to many shops and structures. The city takes a "Desert Empire" theme, being made out of a lot of sandstone and other yellow blocks. But this is not all, as there are some more mental structuring as well. The City has many rules, some are not that great or fair. For example, there is a 90% tax on all items sold. The currency is diamonds, so for every 100 diamonds you make, you will only get 10 after taxes. Most of these goods are sold on "Market Street". This is also where you could have had found ParrotX2, as he used to run a potion shop there as well. There are many different buildings and places in Capitol City as well, each having their importance. 

 Main Building 
left|thumb|Picture of the Building |342x342px
The Main Building is one of Capitol City's most important attractions. Built in the middle of the complex, this tower is huge, reaching over a hundred blocks in height. This is also where you will most likely find Reddoons, the owner of the city. He does meetings and tax calculations on the top floor. For people who want to explore The Main Building, there are only two known ways of reaching higher floors. You can either climb the ladder to the top—which will take a while or use the secret mini elevators that are reserved for guards and important people, as seen in Wemmbu's "Orbital Strike Cannon vs Unstable SMP". Either way, you still must get a reservation before climbing to the top, as Reddoons is almost always busy. 

 Train Station 
left|thumb|274x274px|Picture of the Station Capitol City's Train Station is an important part of the civilization. It consists of 50 tracks each leading to separate stations all across the spawn area of Unstable. It costs four diamonds per ticket now, due to inflation, which might not seem like a lot, but it is because of taxes. In total, with 90% taxes, it actually costs forty diamonds to get only four back. Anyhow, you buy a ticket from the front desk for that price and your good to go—it just might take a while to wait in line. On the bright side though, you can look around to find less popular front desks, i.e like the one that Lezy ran, which had no people in line for it. 

 Grand Hotel 
left|thumb|302x302px|Picture of the Hotel
The Grand Hotel is not just for a temporary stay, it's also a business outpost of some kind. Although not much is known about it canon-wise, it is still an important part of the city, being the second largest building in the complex. It can house up to 800 players due to some simple math, although there have still been reports that stay is way too expensive—even from Theo himself, who was in major debt to the hotel, having to give up his elytra, which he later received back after "paying back" his debts. 

 Post Office/Mail Building 
left|thumb|382x382px|Picture of the Mailing Complex
The Mail Building/Post Office is home to the city's mailing industry, located near Merchant Street. Here is where you pick up and drop off mail, and from there, the workers will take care of the rest, carefully sorting out and placing your deliveries where they are supposed to be. The line is long, just like the Train Station, but you can still have a faster waiting experience if you just look around for a shorter line. 

 The Lionels 
left|thumb|150x150px|Picture of the Left Lionel
The Lionels are some of the most exotic attractions in the entire city. They resemble two huge lions, each on a short pillar. They have a powerful sense in them that suggests to the city's strong power.

 History 
In The Unstable SMP Experience, ParrotX2 and Theo go to Capitol City, where Parrot finds a job in a potion shop, and a secret job with Theo of taking players out of spawn safely to Capitol City.  They make a lot of diamonds doing this, but they do get in trouble from Reddoons when he catches them invading the 90% tax and Parrot's failure to pay rent on time. Reddoons promises to forgive them, and let them keep all their diamonds if they rescue one of Reddoons' friend, Hexatope from spawn. Parrot says that he does not do that anymore, as it was cruel that saving people was pay-to-win, as only the people who paid for saving could actually get saved. Parrot says he would only do it if Reddoons clears the debt of every player in the city, which surprisingly, Reddoons immediately agrees too. Everyone is happy with what Parrot does, and he becomes a city hero.

In SOLO Player VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP, FlameFrags goes into Capitol City to retrieve potions from mrlegend101. 

In How I DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP, Wemmbu, with a new identity after faking his death, was a peaceful guard of Capitol City, until Boosfer and his massive 50 player army tried to take it over in the Battle of Capitol City. Boosfer lost, but says he's comming back for more.

Salvationism, a former leader in Capitol City, allied with Wemmbu, and helped set up a trap to kill FlameFrags and Boosfer, but the plan failed and Salvationism was killed in the process. 

It is revealed that SirPig is the new leader of the city, but he is just as bad as Reddoons. 

SpokeIsHere plans to nuke the city and brings the server into ruins, however, Parrot steps in and eventually convinces Spoke from destroying Capitol City.

 Kingdoms Arc 
Parrot, after becoming king, fires SirPig from as the mayor, giving Fymada the role instead. She lowers taxes from 90% to 10% and receives mostly positive support.  

Parrot becomes king but his policies are generally unfriendly towards OG's and old players in the server. The reason for this is over population and lack of resources. The Capitol City Police almost take over the running off the city. New players who try to enter are killed at the gate and the new players already at Capitol City are forced to live in crowded buildings with a 2x2 for a room.  

Shoebilly teams up with the Police to find Parrot. He kills some innocent players when he was fighting with Theo but when he enters the building he starts killing every single player. The Capitol City police is also engaged in the massacre possibly killing up to 100 players or even more. The Capitol City Police warned that that was just the start and threatened on doing a purge of new players in the city. Luckily for all the new players, the plot failed however for the players who originally lived in Capitol city as well as OG's throughout the server, their conditions are not getting better. Parrot's regime seems to favour new players which could be the reason why players like Arachn1d and Yungyx are able to recruit hundreds of players into their armies and get a lot of support.  

 Trivia 
 We only know the name was not Capital City but Capitol City through the sign in the recently refurbished Spawn.

 The Door Tunnel 
The door tunnel :D

thumb
The Door Tunnel appears in the video I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Base.  It serves as an escape tunnel from Reddoons secret base. It was built by Mapicc to escape in case he was hunted by Reddoons, it consists of oakdoors surrounded by stone and andensite. SpokeIsHere doesn't like The Door Tunnel.

 The Farlands Civilization 
A safe haven in the farlands for those hiding from the Mafia... or so they say

 Farlands City 
The city within which the factions resided

Far Lands City was a civilization built in the Far Lands.  

Structure
To thrive, the Farlands was divided into 3 different districts; the Builders, the Farmers, and the Warriors. Each district's objective was to fulfill their role to benefit everyone in their Civilization.

Builders
Builders were tasked to build for the Civilization.

Farmers
Farmers were tasked to provide resources for the Civilization.

Warriors
Warriors were tasked to defend the Civilization and were the main and biggest faction.

Sorting
A player was put into a test to decide which district they belong in. They were required to kill a wither with 5 items of their choice. The player would then be sorted into their faction depending on what approach they take.

If the player decided to fight the wither head on, they were most likely to be sorted into the Warriors.
If the player decided to hide from the wither until it's gone, they were most likely to be sorted into the Builders.
If the player decided to devise a way to trap the wither, they were most likely to be sorted into the Farmers.

History
Season 1

The Warriors District fails to protect the Farming District when The Invisible Mafia attacks, so they stop giving the Warriors resources.

ParrotX2 travels to the far lands and sees a player named Qu1nten. Qu1nten leads him to the civilization. Parrot convinces Horace_Altman, the leader of the civilization, to team up with him. Parrot joins the Warriors District after his test result was both farmer and warrior. Parrot is sent to blow up a mafia storage. After blowing it up, they get tricked into going into an obsidian hallway, where a diamond tier mafia player is. The player kills the mission leader Dimofyy. The others manage to escape using nether portals.

Parrot and TheobaldTheBird have a competition for who becomes the next mission leader. TheobaldTheBird wins using TNT minecarts to pop Purpled's totem.

The warriors and the farmers play capture the flag. The farmers win the game. Parrot goes on a mission with the warriors to kill a diamond tier mafia player in Mafia City. They retreat from the fight. Purpled gives them diamond trimmed boots. Parrot agrees to fight DumbIsDumb to become a council member. By flooding the arena with water and using tridents, Parrot is able to win.

The civilization discovers that there are Mafia players near the farlands. They find a gold tier player in the nether who is able to escape. They intercept the gold tier player when he is giving his message to ashswagg. They pretend to be diamond tier players, and then kill him with a fall trap.

Purpled tries to have the council members kill Parrot, but he escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members. Parrot unites the warriors and the farmers, and tells everybody to throw their diamond trimmed armor into a cactus and replace it with normal netherite armor.

Ashswagg takes the warriors hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. The Mafia destroys the Far Lands Civilization.

== Capital City == The first, and the second === Capital City === The first
{{TeamTemplate|title1=Capital City|allies=*[[The Invisible Mafia]] *[[Ashswagg]] *[[The Law]]|leader=[[Reddoons]]|former_members=*[[CoinMonke]] *[[Naparizel]] † *[[ParrotX2]] *[[Tai]] *[[PikaTM]] *[[Dol9hin]] *[[lezy]] *[[Novagriddy]] *[[Finiahn]] *[[R4trick]] *[[Arcn]] *[[Cristalit]] *[[LettuceK]] *[[Falcono]] *[[dizzyu]] *[[Reddoons]] (City's Mayor) *[[LuigiToan]] † *[[Wifies]] † *[[PukiTV]] *[[Sharooh]] *[[Nezoshoki]] *[[deanthebean9]] †|appears_in=*[[I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City]] *[[I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization]] *[[I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia]] *[[The Unstable SMP Experience]] *[[Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP]] (Wemmbu flew over) *[[I Became King of the Unstable SMP]]|debut=*[[I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City]]|status=Inactive|image1= Capital city.png|The City Capital city mines.png|The Mines |members=|Owner=*[[Reddoons]] Members: *[[CoinMonke]] *[[Naparizel]] ✝ *[[ParrotX2]] *[[Tai]] *[[PikaTM]] *[[Dol9hin]] *[[lezy]] *[[Novagriddy]] *[[Finiahn]] *[[R4trick]] *[[Arcn]] *[[Cristalit]] *[[LettuceK]] *[[Falcuno]] *[[dizzyu]] *[[Reddoons]] (City's Mayor) *[[LuigiToan]] † *[[Wifies]] † *[[PukiTV]] *[[Sharooh]] *[[Nezoshoki]] *[[deanthebean9]] †|goal=To acquire as much wealth as possible|enemies=*[[Skyblock Civilization]]|info=Members: *[[CoinMonke]] *[[Naparizel]] † *[[ParrotX2]] *[[Tai]] *[[PikaTM]] *[[Dol9hin]] *[[lezy]] *[[Novagriddy]] *[[Finiahn]] *[[R4trick]] *[[Arcn]] *[[Cristalit]] *[[LettuceK]] *[[Falcuno]] *[[dizzyu]] *[[Reddoons]] (City's Mayor) *[[LuigiToan]] † *[[Wifies]] † *[[PukiTV]] *[[Sharooh]] *[[Nezoshoki]] *[[deanthebean9]] †|caption-image1=|alias=*Minecraft's Most Corrupt City|appearances=}}{{Quote|Welcome to the mines.|Reddoons|[https://youtu.be/ZeTQAuvjFLQ I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City]|}} '''Capital City''', led by [[Reddoons]] (and quoted by Ash to be 'basically his'), is a civilization in [[Unstable Universe]]. The city is split into two parts: The Mines, and The City. The City is empty and it is dubious if The City was always a ruse for The Mines or citizens of Capital City were placed into The Mines prematurely to produce more diamonds. ==Allyship == Most of Capital City's plot relevance is with it's allyship with [[The Invisible Mafia]]. In [[I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia]], it is expanded upon that the allyship between Capital City and The Invisible Mafia is a one-way transactional relationship where Red will supply the Mafia with goods and the Mafia will remain neutral with Red. In [[I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization]], guards are shown to be stationed at Capital City, but in [[I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia]] they are gone, so it can be assumed that between videos, stations ended at Capital City, along with more interpersonal things like Red's position in the mafia. == The Mines == The Mines are a subsection of Capital City, being where most people in Capital City reside. It is alluded to be some kind of equivalent to a labor camp--minus it being prisoners placed in there; made to mine for valuable ores all day until nightfall. The Mines subsection was watched over [[CoinMonke]] as a warden. The pitfall most workers found themselves in was the promise to be able to leave The Mines if they reach an absurd quota of diamonds, mostly being impossible without the help of Parrot stealing from Red's vaults. It gradually grew to also have a roulette table, following Red's gambling motifs, to kill one player after a week as a punishment for being the target of Red's suspicions. The Mines are now seemingly defunct after I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City. == History == [[ParrotX2]], [[Wifies]], and [[deanthebean9]] try to steal from Capital city. They are caught by Reddoons and five invisible guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks. They find a group of miners, with [[CoinMonke]] as the warden. Parrot spends his time mining. Parrot and his friends steal from Capital City vaults. Parrot gives [[PikaTM]] more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital City for them to be set free. Reddoons finds out about people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items. Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in the vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults. Parrot overhears Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that [[ashswagg]] suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so [[LuigiToan]] dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself. CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and [[The Invisible Mafia]]. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they say no. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber and they escape. Members of [[Skyblock Civilization]] investigate Capital City. They pretend to be members of The Mafia to infiltrate however, the invisible players are able to tell the fake ones and attack the Skyblock Civilization members. [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]], [[Mapicc]] and [[Leow0ok]] are sent on a mission to trade with Reddoons. The leader of the mission is disappointed by Red's offerings. Since Red [[I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City|isn't rich enough anymore]], the gold player just goes with it and they leave. == Trivia == * Capitol City is named after a city Reddoons owned in Lifesteal SMP Season 3.
=== Capital City 2.0 === Capital City the Second lol
{{TeamTemplate (New version) |title=Capital City |image= Screenshot 2025-09-13 at 11.14.51 AM.png|The City Top View CapitalCitysideview.png|The City Side View |caption-image=The entire city top view |alias=*Capital City *Spawn City |status=Active |enemies=*[[Boosfer]] *[[Wemmbu]] (formerly) *[[SpokeIsHere]] (formerly) *[[FlameFrags]] (formerly) *[[Cindercrest]] |appears_in=*[[The Unstable SMP Experience]] *[[SOLO Player VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP]] *[[Orbital Strike Cannon vs Unstable SMP]] *[[The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom]] *[[I Faked My Death on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP]] *[[Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Went Missing]] *[[The Search for Minecraft's Sunken Empire]] *[[I Became Powerful on the Unstable SMP]] *[[Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Disappeared]] *[[How I "DIED" on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP]] *[[2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players]] *[[I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master]] *[[I Became a Minecraft Combat Master]] *[[100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP]] *[[I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization]] |debut=[[The Unstable SMP Experience]] |latest_appearence=[[I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization]] |leaders=*[[Fymada]] (Mayor) *[[SirPig_]] (former Mayor) *[[Reddoons]] (former actual controller) |allies=*[[The Law]] *[[ParrotX2]] *[[TheobaldTheBird]] |current_members=*[[Reddoons]] (whereabouts unknown) *[[Hexatope]] *[[DragonMC]] *[[Puqi]] *[[lezy]] *[[Fymada]] *Others seen roaming streets and shops |goal=Protect Spawn Players |former_members=*[[ParrotX2]] *[[TheobaldTheBird]] *[[SirPig]] *[[Icebergsleet]] ✝ *[[Spepticle]] ✝ *[[Fymada]]}} {{Quote|But, anyways, uh, I guess I should say, "Welcome to Capitol City, Parrot!"|[[Reddoons]] to [[ParrotX2]]|in [[The Unstable SMP Experience]]|}} [[Capitol City 2.0]], commonly known as [[Capitol City 2.0|Capitol City]], is a city leaded by [[Fymada]], located near spawn. Centered a few thousand blocks from [[Spawn]], this metropolis is a safe space for all players. It is home to many shops, jobs, and houses. Hundreds of players live here—which formerly included [[ParrotX2]] and [[TheobaldTheBird]]. == Structure == Capitol City is home to many shops and structures. The city takes a "Desert Empire" theme, being made out of a lot of sandstone and other yellow blocks. But this is not all, as there are some more mental structuring as well. The City has many rules, some are not that great or fair. For example, there is a 90% tax on all items sold. The currency is diamonds, so for every 100 diamonds you make, you will only get 10 ''after'' taxes. Most of these goods are sold on "Market Street". This is also where you could have had found [[ParrotX2]], as he used to run a potion shop there as well. There are many different buildings and places in Capitol City as well, each having their importance. === Main Building === [[File:Capital City Building.png|left|thumb|Picture of the Building |342x342px]] The Main Building is one of Capitol City's most important attractions. Built in the middle of the complex, this tower is huge, reaching over a hundred blocks in height. This is also where you will most likely find [[Reddoons]], the owner of the city. He does meetings and tax calculations on the top floor. For people who want to explore The Main Building, there are only two known ways of reaching higher floors. You can either climb the ladder to the top—which will take a while or use the secret mini elevators that are reserved for guards and important people, as seen in [[Wemmbu]]'s "[[Orbital Strike Cannon vs Unstable SMP]]". Either way, you still must get a reservation before climbing to the top, as [[Reddoons]] is almost always busy. === Train Station === [[File:Capital City Train Station.png|left|thumb|274x274px|Picture of the Station ]]Capitol City's Train Station is an important part of the civilization. It consists of 50 tracks each leading to separate stations all across the spawn area of [[Unstable Universe|Unstable]]. It costs four diamonds per ticket now, due to inflation, which might not ''seem'' like a lot, but it is because of taxes. In total, with 90% taxes, it actually costs forty diamonds to get only four back. Anyhow, you buy a ticket from the front desk for that price and your good to go—it just might take a while to wait in line. On the bright side though, you can look around to find less popular front desks, i.e like the one that [[Lezy]] ran, which had no people in line for it. === Grand Hotel === [[File:Capital City Hotel.png|left|thumb|302x302px|Picture of the Hotel]] The Grand Hotel is not just for a temporary stay, it's also a business outpost of some kind. Although not much is known about it canon-wise, it is still an important part of the city, being the second largest building in the complex. It can house up to 800 players due to some simple math, although there have still been reports that stay is way too expensive—even from [[Theo]] himself, who was in major debt to the hotel, having to give up his elytra, which he later received back after "paying back" his debts. === Post Office/Mail Building === [[File:Capital City Mail.png|left|thumb|382x382px|Picture of the Mailing Complex]] The Mail Building/Post Office is home to the city's mailing industry, located near Merchant Street. Here is where you pick up and drop off mail, and from there, the workers will take care of the rest, carefully sorting out and placing your deliveries where they are supposed to be. The line is long, just like the Train Station, but you can still have a faster waiting experience if you just look around for a shorter line. === The Lionels === [[File:LionelsCapitalcity.png.png|left|thumb|150x150px|Picture of the Left Lionel]] The Lionels are some of the most exotic attractions in the entire city. They resemble two huge lions, each on a short pillar. They have a powerful sense in them that suggests to the city's strong power. == History == In [[The Unstable SMP Experience]], [[ParrotX2]] and [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]] go to Capitol City, where [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] finds a job in a potion shop, and a secret job with [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]] of taking players out of spawn safely to Capitol City. They make a lot of diamonds doing this, but they do get in trouble from [[Reddoons]] when he catches them invading the 90% tax and [[ParrotX2|Parrot's]] failure to pay rent on time. [[Reddoons]] promises to forgive them, and let them keep all their diamonds if they rescue one of [[Reddoons]]' friend, [[Hexatope]] from spawn. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] says that he does not do that anymore, as it was cruel that saving people was pay-to-win, as only the people who paid for saving could actually get saved. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] says he would only do it if [[Reddoons]] clears the debt of every player in the city, which surprisingly, [[Reddoons]] immediately agrees too. Everyone is happy with what [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] does, and he becomes a city hero. In [[SOLO Player VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP]], [[FlameFrags]] goes into Capitol City to retrieve potions from mrlegend101. In [[How I DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP]], [[Wemmbu]], with a new identity after faking his death, was a peaceful guard of Capitol City, until [[Boosfer]] and his massive 50 player army tried to take it over in the [[Battles of Unstable|Battle of Capitol City]]. [[Boosfer]] lost, but says he's comming back for more. [[Salvationism]], a former leader in Capitol City, allied with [[Wemmbu]], and helped set up a trap to kill [[FlameFrags]] and [[Boosfer]], but the plan failed and [[Salvationism]] was killed in the process. It is revealed that [[SirPig]] is the new leader of the city, but he is just as bad as [[Reddoons]]. [[SpokeIsHere]] plans to nuke the city and brings the server into ruins, however, [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] steps in and eventually convinces [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] from destroying Capitol City. === Kingdoms Arc === [[ParrotX2|Parrot]], after becoming king, fires [[SirPig]] from as the mayor, giving [[Fymada]] the role instead. She lowers taxes from 90% to 10% and receives mostly positive support. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] becomes king but his policies are generally unfriendly towards OG's and old players in the server. The reason for this is over population and lack of resources. The [[Capitol City Police Force|Capitol City Police]] almost take over the running off the city. New players who try to enter are killed at the gate and the new players already at Capitol City are forced to live in crowded buildings with a 2x2 for a room. [[ShoeBilly|Shoebilly]] teams up with the [[Capital City Guard Force|Police]] to find [[ParrotX2|Parrot]]. He kills some innocent players when he was fighting with [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]] but when he enters the building he starts killing every single player. The [[Capital City Guard Force|Capitol City police]] is also engaged in the massacre possibly killing up to 100 players or even more. The [[Capital City Guard Force|Capitol City Police]] warned that that was just the start and threatened on doing a purge of new players in the city. Luckily for all the new players, the plot failed however for the players who originally lived in Capitol city as well as OG's throughout the server, their conditions are not getting better. [[ParrotX2|Parrot's]] regime seems to favour new players which could be the reason why players like [[Arachn1d]] and [[Yungyx]] are able to recruit hundreds of players into their armies and get a lot of support. == Trivia == * We only know the name was not Capital City but Capitol City through the sign in the recently refurbished [[Spawn]].
== The Door Tunnel == The door tunnel :D
[[File:The Door Tunnel.jpg|thumb]] The Door Tunnel appears in the video [[I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Base]]. It serves as an escape tunnel from [[Reddoons]] secret base. It was built by [[Mapicc]] to escape in case he was hunted by [[Reddoons]], it consists of oakdoors surrounded by stone and andensite. [[SpokeIsHere]] doesn't like The Door Tunnel.
== The Farlands Civilization == A safe haven in the farlands for those hiding from the Mafia... or so they say === Farlands City === The city within which the factions resided
{{TeamTemplate|title1=Far Lands City|alias=*The Far Lands Civilization|status=Destroyed|allies=|leader=|current_members=|appears_in=*[[The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands]] *[[Unstable SMP: The First War]] *[[Unstable SMP: Doomsday]] *[[I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands]] *[[I Got REVENGE on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP]]|debut=*[[The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands]]|former_members=|image1=Far Lands City.png|members=|Owner='''Leader''' *[[Horace_Altman]] '''Builders''' *[[duckyboat]] *[[Qu1nten]] *[[xknighty]] *[[SilencyZ]] *[[Modelow]] *[[Buids]] '''Farmers''' *[[Kenadian]] *[[Wato1876]] *[[Wifies]] *[[avatardotpng]] *[[cristalit]] *[[wavesss]] † *[[wZeta]] † *potatowar † *laufeyfan † *Alvv † *Leoric † *plat0nic † '''Warriors''' ([[Warriors District]]) *[[Purpled]] *[[DumbIsDumb]] *[[Naparizel]] *[[Lamibee]] *[[ParrotX2]] *[[TheSorta]] *[[lezy]] *[[R4trick]] *[[TheobaldTheBird]] *[[PikaTM]] *[[Falconu]] *[[Epaxialfx]] *[[Sharooh]] *[[Fantst]] *[[meta64]] *[[Pro4D]] *[[Nezoshoki]] *[[Finiahn]] *[[Dimofyy]] † '''Unknown''' *[[CoinMonke]] *[[ZeRaph]] *[[EthanMiner]]}} '''Far Lands City''' was a civilization built in the [[Far Lands]]. ==Structure== To thrive, the Farlands was divided into 3 different districts; the '''Builders''', the '''Farmers''', and the '''Warriors'''. Each district's objective was to fulfill their role to benefit everyone in their Civilization. ===Builders=== Builders were tasked to build for the Civilization. ===Farmers=== Farmers were tasked to provide resources for the Civilization. ===Warriors=== Warriors were tasked to defend the Civilization and were the main and biggest faction. ===Sorting=== A player was put into a test to decide which district they belong in. They were required to kill a wither with 5 items of their choice. The player would then be sorted into their faction depending on what approach they take. *If the player decided to fight the wither head on, they were most likely to be sorted into the Warriors. *If the player decided to hide from the wither until it's gone, they were most likely to be sorted into the Builders. *If the player decided to devise a way to trap the wither, they were most likely to be sorted into the Farmers. ==History== '''Season 1''' The [[Warriors District]] fails to protect the Farming District when The [[The Invisible Mafia|Invisible Mafia]] attacks, so they stop giving the Warriors resources. [[ParrotX2]] travels to the far lands and sees a player named [[Qu1nten]]. Qu1nten leads him to the civilization. Parrot convinces [[Horace_Altman]], the leader of the civilization, to team up with him. Parrot joins the Warriors District after his test result was both farmer and warrior. Parrot is sent to blow up a mafia storage. After blowing it up, they get tricked into going into an obsidian hallway, where a diamond tier mafia player is. The player kills the mission leader [[Dimofyy]]. The others manage to escape using nether portals. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and [[TheobaldTheBird]] have a competition for who becomes the next mission leader. TheobaldTheBird wins using TNT minecarts to pop [[Purpled|Purpled's]] totem. The warriors and the farmers play capture the flag. The farmers win the game. Parrot goes on a mission with the warriors to kill a diamond tier mafia player in [[Mafia City]]. They retreat from the fight. [[Purpled]] gives them diamond trimmed boots. Parrot agrees to fight [[DumbIsDumb]] to become a council member. By flooding the arena with water and using tridents, [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] is able to win. The civilization discovers that there are [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] players near the farlands. They find a [[Mafia Gold Players|gold tier player]] in the nether who is able to escape. They intercept the gold tier player when he is giving his message to [[ashswagg]]. They pretend to be [[Mafia Diamond Players|diamond tier players]], and then kill him with a fall trap. Purpled tries to have the council members kill Parrot, but he escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members. Parrot unites the warriors and the farmers, and tells everybody to throw their diamond trimmed armor into a cactus and replace it with normal netherite armor. [[Ashswagg]] takes the [[Warriors District|warriors]] hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. [[The Invisible Mafia|The Mafia]] destroys the Far Lands Civilization. Parrot comes back to activate the beacon system in farlands civilization before leaving. [[File:Builder sigil.png|thumb|Builder District's Sigil]] The '''Builders District''' was a district created by [[Horace Altman]] alongside with the [[Warriors District]] and the [[Farmers District]] to be a safe haven for the builders. The district includes; duckyboat, Qu1nten, xknighty, SilencyZ and Modelow. It has since been destroyed by the [[The Invisible Mafia]].
=== The Farmers' District === For the grinders and experts in game mechanics
[[File:Farmer sigil.png|thumb|The Farmer District's Sigil]] The '''Farmers District''' was a district created by [[Horace Altman]] alongside with the [[Warriors District]] and the [[Builders District]]. It consists of [[Kenadian]], [[Wato1876]], [[Avatardotpng]], [[Wifies]], [[Nezoshoki]], wavesss, wZeta, potatowar, laufeyfan, Alvv, Leoric, plat0nic and [[Cristalit]]. The Warriors were supposed to protect the Farmers and the Farmers are supposed to provide them resources to protect them and Kenadian built the Farming District several million blocks away from the farlands and he thought the Warriors would help protect them, however Kenadian had 3 days notice that The Mafia is about to attack them. He tried to contact the Warriors but none of them responded and The Mafia destroyed the Farming District and killed about 70-80% of the Farming District. After this, they stopped giving them resources. Due to this the Warriors and Farmers do not get along despite efforts by Parrot. The Farmers District was destroyed by [[The Invisible Mafia]].

title: Leow0ok
content:
Leow0ok, also known as Leo, was the leader of Bounty Assassin Team on the Unstable SMP. He was a major character in The Director Arc being an antagonist in Parrot's video I Got Hunted by Minecraft Bounty Hunters. He also is the main antagonist of Spoke's BAT arc. Leow0ok is a player who refuses to give up and sometimes thinks rationally. He is also willing to resort to the sword very quickly and has little restraint when doing something he believes is right and is usually seen as a morally gray character. At the end of 4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players, Leow0ok promised Spoke that the war would never end until Spoke was dead. Following this he pulled his statis chamber, not knowing that it was rigged by Spoke and was then killed in the void.

Leow0ok is one of the more tragic characters in the Unstable Universe. His best friend was Nufuli who was killed by the Director. His friend Derapchu left his team and he was forced to fight a war against Spoke. Even his closest ally, JumperWho betrayed him. Without his spies, wealth or any of his friends, Leow0ok ended his time on the server completely alone.

History
 Season 1 
Leow0ok is seen as a guard of a castle containing a large amount of duped items.

Leow0ok is seen as a guard of a sky base containing a large amount of duped items.

Leow0ok is seen at an end base.

Leow0ok and his team helps Parrot escape from ClownPierce in ClownPierce's Circus.

Leow0ok agrees with Parrot and Wifies to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, FerreMC, and Mugm_ come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues. The team runs away from the fight.

Parrot and Wifies come to complain about how they were abandoned.

Parrot leaves to get a better team.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok and his team to kidnap BranzyCraft, the only player ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Leow0ok helps break people out of Proton.

Leow0ok joins the Mafia to try and kill ClownPierce. He is allies with Spoke and Mapicc. The three of them inflitrate The Mafia and get to gold level.

 The Director Arc 
Leow0ok is seen as the leader of Bounty Assassin Team. He accepted Parrot into BAT as he could help hunt ItzRealMe down.

In I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Redstone Genius, Leow0ok constantly scolds Derapchu for being a bad member.

Leow0ok is prepared to kill Parrot and almost does so, as he believed Parrot himself was the Director and have caused too much trouble and loss to BAT. Even when Jumper and Parrot give him the truth, Leo is still determined to believe that Parrot is the Director and then scolds Jumper for killing one of her spies when he attempted to kill Parrot the whole time.

TruOriginal tries to kill Nufuli, Parrot, Derapchu, and Leo using hacks. They are eventually able to escape. The BAT headquarters is destroyed by TruOriginal. He tries to kill them. Leo stays behind so BAT can escape. Leo eventually escapes and finds BAT.

TruOriginal tries to kill them but eventually runs away. BAT make a new base and guard it. TruOriginal tries to kill them again. BAT scares TruOriginal away by pretending they have a trap ready.

TruOriginal kidnaps Derapchu and Leow0ok while they are sleeping. He pretends to be Leow0ok using a hack and tries to kill Parrot and Nufuli. Using a trap, they are able to kill TruOriginal.

Nufuli leaves the team, and as he is leaving, the Director kills him. They see the Director and try to kill him. The Director uses a pearl cannon to escape. BAT use the pearl cannon to try and go after the Director. They find themselves in an obsidian room, where the Director tries to kill them using an army of zombies with netherite armor and weapons. They are able to escape.

BAT go over to a redstone shop to see if the Director is there. They eventually find a player wearing the same armor as the Director. They force him to drink milk, revealing he is MrCube6. The real Director comes over and saves MrCube6. The Director tries to kill BAT using TNT but fails.

Jumper is re-added to BAT after saving Parrot from death. She leads BAT to a secret base that she created. The Director gives BAT a message, telling Parrot to meet up with him in one week.

SpokeIsHere finds the secret base BAT lives in and secretly pranks them and steals from them, and pretends he's the Director. Spoke is eventually caught and is forced to escape.

BAT spies on the Director and Parrot having their conversation. Jumper's spies spy on a list of suspects for people who could potentially be the Director. They see all of them online while the Director and Parrot have their conversation. Parrot sees the Director hold a chest plate with a red armor trim, causing him to believe the Director is Spoke, as Spoke normally wears that chest plate. Parrot convinces Leow0ok and Derapchu to pretend to be spies so that Parrot can threaten to kill the supposed spies unless Jumper confesses. This plan fails as Leow0ok and Derapchu stop pretending to be spies after Jumper doesn't confess.

While Jumper and Derapchu are out of the base, Leow0ok tries to kill ParrotX2. He eventually decides to spare Parrot's life. Parrot tells Leow0ok to leave and he obliges.

Parrot goes over to Wifies' base. Jumper and Derapchu find Parrot at his base, and Parrot tells them about Leow0ok trying to kill him. The Director finds them.

Leow0ok helps FlameFrags learn crossbow carting and fights The LAW. He seems to be wanted by them for some unknown reason.

The Director traps Jumper and Derapchu in an obsidian room over the void. Parrot and Leow0ok make a plan to save Jumper and Derapchu using a happy ghast named Sky. Leow0ok saves them while Parrot distracts the Director.

Leow0ok works as a guard in Paragon.

 The Bat Arc 
Leow0ok is still the leader of Bounty Assassin Team. 

After Spoke destroys a innocent village Leow0ok prepares a investigation against him. Spoke kills more spies. Leow0ok insists on killing Spoke despite Jumper telling him to gain sufficient proof first.

Leow0ok allows himself to have his enderpearl statis found by Spoke. Spoke, PrinceZam, Mapicc, and Wemmbu attempt to kill him but Leow0ok escapes. He uses this as proof to continue hunting down Spoke and attempting to kill him. 

In My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP, Leow0ok attempts to kill Spoke but his spies are blown up. He then pretends to kill Mapicc much to the horror of Spoke. Spoke pretends to be Leow0ok is in the Farlands and fight Zam and Mapicc to convince them not to leave him. 

TNT cart craters are in the BAT vault. Mapicc explains this by saying that Leow0ok might have abandoned his own team and had fought the other spies and Jumper. We don't know the reason for why this happened but we always knew that Jumper doubted Leow0ok. Since he no longer had command of BAT spies, he uses his connections with LettuceK so that he could use Law soldiers into hunting Spoke.

At the end of his video, Spoke seems to have finally found Leow0ok's true statis chamber which could allow him to kill Leow0ok once and for all. However, before he manages to get there he is teleported by Jumper.

It is revealed that Jumper split off from Leow0ok because he had the same mentality as LettuceK. Like LettuceK, he thought that all of his forces were expendable in battles. This results in Leow0ok using Lawmen to continue waging war on Spoke and Jumper. The two of them try to kill Leo, who also failed to kill any of them. 

He was a Law Commander at the Battle of The Northern Council fighting District 13.  

After the battle, Spoke and Jumper find Leow0ok and start attacking him. Leow0ok promises that the war was never going to end and he pulls a stasis chamber, not knowing Spoke had rigged it. Leow0ok falls into the void and is killed, ending the war between him and Spoke. 

 Boundaries 

 No shipping
 No NSFW

 Trivia 

 Leo is one of the few major characters who has been apart of the Mafia and the Law, the others being FlameFrags and Eggchan.
 Leow0ok died completely alone since almost all of his friends had betrayed him [JumperWho] died [Nufuli] or gone their own ways [Derapchu].
 Leo owned an IOU from FlameFrags in SOLO Player VS Minecraft Bounty Hunters, but it was never used before his death. It is unsure what would've happened if he were to use it.

Since he no longer had command of BAT spies, he uses his connections with [[LettuceK]] so that he could use Law soldiers into hunting Spoke.

After the battle, Spoke and Jumper find Leow0ok and start attacking him. Leow0ok promises that the war was never going to end and he pulls a stasis chamber, not knowing Spoke had rigged it. Leow0ok falls into the void and is killed, ending the war between him and Spoke.

LettuceK, or simply Lettuce, was a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe Season 1, and is one of the main antagonists in Unstable Universe Season 2. He is a minor antagonist in The Pirate Arc, the secondary antagonist in The Betrayal Arc, a major antagonist in both The Fake Identity Arc and the Skill vs Power Arc, and he is the antagonist of The Kings Arc. 

 Personality 
LettuceK portrays an intelligent personality throughout Season 2. He is willing to use violence and deception to achieve his goals and he calculates his moves carefully. He often uses other's fears as leverage, especially when he sees a threat.  He uses every strategy, gimmick or army that he has to fight. He rarely questions his own decisions from a moral standpoint, focusing instead on what he believes is the greater good. 

Unlike ParrotX2, LettuceK plans out his actions and prepares for what is to come. He is a master strategist always looking at the future and planning ahead. He can see things that others can't and can predict unrest in the server. 

 History 

 Season 1 

LettuceK is seen as a member of the Zam Empire.

LettuceK is seen as a member of a team which tries to destroy Wemmbu's Civilization.

LettuceK joins The End Civilization.

LettuceK is seen as a miner in Capital City.

LettuceK is seen as a member of Skyblock Civilization.

LettuceK is seen as a member of Ice Mountain Civilization alongside Arcn and Loppezz

 Season 2 
LettuceK is seen as a pirate in the Pirate Islands.

LettuceK is the leader of The Law.

After the 2v1000 player fight, Lettuce managed to capture Wemmbu, and brought him into custody with the four other prisoners, Baablu, Fanstst, PrinceZam, and Blurpenstein.

At the end of 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players we see him with Ace - 'justifying' his reasons for leading the 1000 players against Wemmbu and FlameFrags.

Seen briefly watching the prisoners whilst they're mining or completing other tasks.

He held the server wide meeting, and offered to have a voting to make someone a king/ruler of Unstable. He suggested the reason he should be voted is because he had captured Wemmbu - to which he then brings him out onto stage.

In I Got Exiled from the Unstable SMP, Lettuce sends someone from Law to try and kill Flamefrags and exile him from his base. Though, when that fails, he captures Lomedy at Merchant City, and offers Flamefrags an ultimatium. Give in, or he kills Lomedy. When Flame ignores and attacks anyway, Lettuce blows the goathorn and has his Lawmen attack Flame - eventually leading to him being exiled from his base. 

In I got Exiled from the Unstable SMP, during the end when LettuceK talks to FlameFrags, it seems as if LettuceK might have had good intentions in the past however his greed for power consumed him. LettuceK is really just a dictator but one who is favoured by the people. By the fact that he raises poorly equipped armies, letting them all die just to boost his reputation really shows that. 

Seen around the prison in Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP, and when the four prisoners (Wemmbu, Baablu, Fantst and Zam) make their escape through the ravine, he chases them and begins blowing up holes to find them faster. Wemmbu and Baablu make it into a cave, but Lettuce follows them, and once again blows up holes - leading to him finding the pair.

Back at the prison, Lettuce forces them to do an item check and mend their armour so that an escape like that can't happen again. Then takes the four of them down to solitary to leave them there forever - and Wemmbu till his execution.

At the end of Unstable SMP: The First King, Lettuce holds another server wide meeting to show who is on the leaderboard and how many votes they all have.

In I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea, Lettuce is searching the Great Sea for Wemmbu, and he's looking for the discs for the Obrbital Strike Canon. He goes to the Frog Civilisation out in the Great Sea and at first tries barginning/reasoning with them, but once Wemmbu steps in, him and his Lawmen begin killing them as they are 'pirates' who deserve to die because they're a threat to the server. Kills their leader whilst Wemmbu and Eggchan are boating away.

Brings rail guns and an army of Lawmen to the floating Trading Town with the intentions of destroying the place - along with a few pirates. He succeds with this, and ends up bringing Wemmbu back down into trenches, and then fighting with Jaden in an attempt to kill or capture him - which he fails at. 

Does try chasing and macing Eggchan or Wemmbu, but ends up flying away when Wemmbu pops one of his totems.

Reveals that he was following Wemmbu after he steals the disc shulkers, and calls down his army to try and kill Ouroboroid and Wemmbu. They end up killing Ouroboroid, but Wemmbu escapes, leaving Lettuce and his army to finish off the Orbital Canon.

In I Ran for King on the Unstable SMP, he gathers the contenstants together to tell them how the voting/competition is going to go. He speaks with them about the rules before telling them that they'll be staying at the Northern Council. Bottom eight around the walls, and the top eight inside the main building. He allows everyone to get settled, and simple leaves them to it. 

The next day, he gathers all the contenstants again for another important announcement. Tells them that he's going to host a debate, so that the contenstants can introduce themselves to the server - and allow the server to know what their terms will be when they become king. Lettuce is paired up with ParrotX2. Says that the debate is in exactly one week, and then dismisses them again.

Gives the leading statement at the beginning of the debate, and introduces the commentator - Spepticle, before heading back inside.

In his and Parrot's debate, he talks to the server about The Law have already accoplished under his rule, however, ParrotX2 instantly interjects - denying that The Law has actually offered as much help as they said they had. Lettuce then goes on to say that he's liberating The Great Sea - which gains great approval from the server. 

Denies Parrot's accusations of Wemmbu being loose - and then exposes that he knows Parrot killed Jackman, and tells him that he's going to be executed right there and then. However, Spepticle steps in, to which Lettuce is shocked - but has no choice to accept his statement of him killing Jackman instead of Parrot. He knows he now can't blame it on Parrot as Spepticle has confessed. Lettuce - despite knowing its a lie, decides to execute Spepticle instead to make an example. 

Spepticle's execution gains Lettuce huge support from the crowd - and it seems he has no sympathy for Spepticle, so does it without second thought. Executing Spepticle by dropping an anvil on him. Lettuce uses his death as a threat - saying that anyone who doesn't meet justice in his eyes, will meet the same fate as Spepticle - execution. However, like Ouranos from Greek mythology, he prophesied one day Lettuce will meet the same fate as him; executed using an anvil.

In The Battle For The Great Sea LettuceK successfully captured Jaden-Man and The Law has total domination over The Great Sea (Even without The Orbital Strike Cannon, which was a blow nevertheless) LettuceK is shown as power hungry and he also does not care about any Law Men who he views as expendable. His intentions have started to divulge a lot from what they were with others like Deputy Ace starting to doubt him and that he is really doing good for the server. LettuceK also massacres Pirates who were not even fighting and would have posed no threat to The Law. 

In, I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge, LettuceK hosts a banquette inside of the Northern Council for the candidates to try and have them 'know each other more' - where in reality, he's setting them up for the purge. He's briefly seen 'helping' in trying to kill the assassins, but disappears soon after, and leaves Naparaziel as well as twenty of his Lawmen to die. At the end, we see him with Deputy Ace again, and Lettuce says how there is still one loose end whilst zooming into his mace - likely referring to how Wemmbu escaped capture, and how Lettuce needs to re-capture him.

In 2 Minecraft Pros vs 1000 hunters LettuceK commands The Law into trying to kill Parrot and Wemmbu. Deputy_Ace questions his motives again but quickly backtracks and obeys LettuceK order. At the end of the video we can see that LettuceK is quite deranged. He is shocked of Wemmbu's arrival and by this point has no restraint in trying to take over the server. LettuceK forcibly makes himself "The Interim Leader until the server is safe." He also blackmails Parrot into backing down. The shocked crowd shows that more people are starting to question LettuceK motives. The Law itself has mostly 8 year olds who don't know anything and most people with experience are starting to wonder if LettuceK would be the right leader.

in Minecraft Trapper vs 1000 players, LettuceK is mentioned a few times. It seems like he has given thousands of Lawmen to Leow0ok who uses them to continue waging war on Spoke and JumperWho.

In Minecraft Pro VS 1000 players,  (By Wemmbu) LettuceK threatens to kill Jaden Man if Wemmbu does not back down. He is also mentioned by MinuteTech who says that LettuceK manipulated him into giving Lettuce control over the end dimension.

In I Became King On The Unstable SMP, he shows that he has control over Theo by teleporting him away after Parrot tries to break him out. He tells Parrot to endorse him, or he and his friend die. After Parrot publicly denies, he brings him to the original Capital City, where he orders Deputy_Ace to kill them when he blows his horn. Ace helps Parrot and Theo escape, which results in Lettuce ordering SargeLaw to kill him. LettuceK tells Parrot that he has some remorse for his actions but he is doing what needs to be done. 

Both he and SargeLaw are seen leading the Law army in the final battle against District 13 alongside G0dOfWar, Leow0ok and Purpled. He tries to get Parrot to side with him saying that all of his hard work and pain would have been for nothing but Parrot refuses to backdown. After his first army fails, he sends a second, stronger army which is fully equipped with Netherite Gear which is also defeated. He continues fighting until the very end when he only has a chestplate. He flees from the destroyed Northern Council.  Realising that everything he worked for was destroyed he soon after returns to the battlefield and surrenders, asking Parrot and District 13 to kill him. After a voting session with the rest of the group, he is allowed to live, but is given a lifetime prison sentence. Parrot says that if the people elect LettuceK to be their king he will be allowed to rule over the server. Lettuce replies saying that the server is too far gone now and that the server would never be united again. In the final election LettuceK gets over 3000 votes but as he said Parrot has more votes than him and he loses the election and with that his freedom.

Before LettuceK is imprisoned he asks FlameFrags to change and shows remorse for his actions. This has a huge affect on FlameFrags as he begins remembering everytime other players called him out to which he only ignored. Flame replies to Lettuce that he will try before leaving.

It is currently unknown where LettuceK is imprisoned. He is the first antagonist to be properly punished (If you don't count Jaden MAN being trapped in the abandoned civilization and Wifies being killed.) He allowed thousands of players to be killed and his crimes were on the same level as Ashswagg.   He is also the biggest antagonist of The Unstable Universe so far counting by videos and screen time.

 Season 3 
He is imprisoned in the Northern Council with mining fatigue, the same as Wemmbu's treatment.  He says to Parrot that his kingdom will collapse. He brings attention to a moment in the Kings Arc Finale where he says that the server is too far gone now. Despite Parrot coming to see him he refuses to give him any real valuable advice but mocks him for being a incompetent king. Parrot still does not understand why.

In Unstable SMP: Civil War Lettuce is seen still imprisoned with Soldier73. Though he has no lines in this episode and is only seen as a cameo.

 Boundaries 

 Changing body type, appearance, and species is okay
 Shipping is okay as long as the other person also thinks it's okay
 No full NSFW
 Slight gore is okay

 Trivia 

 He called two random Mafia members his best friend and his professor as a joke. 
 Lettuce played as T0X1N in SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Clan. 
 He has been in at least 4 civilizations on the Unstable SMP. 

 Quotes 

 Thumbnails 

 Navigation

Despite Parrot coming to see him he refuses to give him any real valuable advice but mocks him for being a incompetent king. Parrot still does not understand why.

In [[Unstable SMP: Civil War]] Lettuce is seen still imprisoned with Soldier73. Though he has no lines in this episode and is only seen as a cameo.

* Changing body type, appearance, and species is okay
* Shipping is okay as long as the other person also thinks it's okay
* No full NSFW
* Slight gore is okay

title: Lomedy
content:
Lomedy is Flame's best friend and teammate on the Unstable SMP. He was introduced in Season 2.

Personality

Lomedy is a supportive, attentive, encouraging, and caring person. He has a passion for farming and dedicates most of his time to maintaining and expanding his farm which he cares greatly for. He has an open-mind and understands why people fight even though he hates it. He motivates others to keep going, and does his best to maintain peace.

He cares greatly for his best friend, FlameFrags, going out of his way every time Flame needed him, providing assistance and shelter whenever Flame needed it. He also has a strict moral compass, as shown when he made the difficult choice to end their friendship after hearing Flame had killed a thousand lawmen and seeing Flame's stubborn refusal to change. 

 History 

 Season 2 
During Season 2, Lomedy was at his base when Flame suddenly arrived, threatened with death, Lomedy allowed Flame to stay, but faced many invasion and attack of the Toxic Civilization lead by VENOM. Even becoming a fighter, but not a very good one. 

Flame asked Lomedy to rebuild his base, when Lomedy arrived and showing double mace on both hand, they started to rebuild the wall and the house, but Jaden came back and stole Lomedy's mace using decorated pots and Lomedy hide. Lomedy wanted Flame to get it back in which Flame pursue Jaden for it. 

FlameFrags helps Lomedy with the Farm War.

While Flame is building a new base, Lomedy is there to help. Flame asked Lomedy to help him get The Law out of his way to kill Wemmbu. Lomedy helps Flame prevent the supplies from getting to The Law's Village.

After Flame is exiled and asks Lomedy to get materials from Merchant City, LettuceK holds him captive and threatens to kill him. However, Flame saves him by splashing him with an invisibility potion. Lomedy is eventually captured again. Wemmbu attempts to help him escape but he declines.

During the Second Prison break of the LAW HQ, FlameFrags was searching for Lomedy, but SpokeIsHere, PrinceZam, Mapicc, and JumperWho showed up to find and rescue ParrotX2, but he wasn't there so they freed Jaden MAN. After all those chaos happened, FlameFrags tried to break Lomedy out but Lomedy kept refusing and that FlameFrags is he reason why he even got imprisoned in the first place.

After The Law is defeated, FlameFrags went back to the prison to apologize to Lomedy, admitting that Lomedy was right about Flame needing to change and that Law actually had good reasons to go after him, and also apologizing for involving Lomedy in the conflict in the first place and returns his mace. Lomedy accepts his apology and they depart together.

 Season 3 
He helps Flame build a new base.

He is forced to serve as a part of the reformed Law with Flame.

Whilst FlameFrags was infiltrating The Mist, he had to choose a trusted teammate from outside the mist to be his partner in The Mist Civilization. FlameFrags chose Lomedy. While he initially wasn't in favor of being dragged into FlameFrags' mission of killing Mistrul, he ended up complying. After finishing their assignment in a trial chamber, they sneak out with Invisibility potions to go and look for Mistrul's base.

Whilst looking for the base, Flame and Lomedy ended up finding a wall of cobblestone, only to get jumped by hunters. They eventually run off to a cave, where the hunters retreated, fearing the person who lives there. Lomedy insists on leaving, however FlameFrags, saying that this was their only lead to Mistrul's base, ended up going in and exploring with Lomedy.

The two of them find a house, where they find Mistrul AFK. Flame and Mistrul begin fighting with nearly equal skill, while Lomedy stays in the sidelines uninvolved. They end the fight off, and Lomedy leaves the cave with FlameFrags with a happy ghast.

While flying back to The Mist civilization, Lomedy disrupts their transportation, telling Flame "You really don't think that one of these flights is eventually gonna --" however, before he could finish his sentence, an arrow came from the right and shot him off the ghast. 

Later, NotSkriley roamed around the Ice Spikes in the mist, And found Lomedy Alive. They went back to Flame's base.

Lomedy finds a team of old players called Cindercrest and joins them stating alleged issues of so called "hunger" and "lack of resources", FlameFrags joins as well to protect Lomedy. 
 Quotes 

 Trivia  
 He is the owner of Flame's mace, Incinerator. His other mace was stolen by Jaden, which FlameFrags could not retrieve due to Wemmbu defending Jaden.

title: Loppezz
content:
Loppezz is a supporting character in Unstable Universe. She was a former Law soldier who served directly under LettuceK.

 History 

 Season 1  

Loppezz is seen as a guard for multiple prisons by PrinceZam.

Loppezz is trapped in a prison by ClownPierce.

Loppezz is seen as a member of Skyblock Civilization.

Loppezz creates the Ice Mountain Civilization.

 Season 2 

Loppezz is seen in the Abandoned Civilization.

Wemmbu tries to help Loppezz defend the Ice Mountain Civilization from raiders, but fails. The Ice Mountain Civilization is destroyed. Wemmbu gives Loppezz full netherite armor.

Loppezz writes an oath for her destroyed home.

Loppezz was in a Pirate Crew with LettuceK and the leader was Jaden.

Loppezz is seen as a guard of a prison created by the Law, which houses Wemmbu and other people. When the prisoners are escaping, Loppezz is told by SargeRaxby that if they want their job back, then she has to kill the prisoners. The prisoners live, so she presumably lost her job.

{{Section Improvement}}
Loppezz is seen in [[the Abandoned Civilization]].

[[Wemmbu]] tries to help Loppezz defend the Ice Mountain Civilization from raiders, but fails. The Ice Mountain Civilization is destroyed. Wemmbu gives Loppezz full netherite armor.

Loppezz writes an oath for her destroyed home.

Loppezz was in a [[Pirates|Pirate Crew]] with [[LettuceK]] and the leader was [[Jaden MAN|Jaden]].

Loppezz is seen as a guard of a prison created by the Law, which houses Wemmbu and other people. When the prisoners are escaping, Loppezz is told by [[SargeRaxby]] that if they want their job back, then she has to kill the prisoners. The prisoners live, so she presumably lost her job.

Maces play a very powerful role in the Unstable SMP, a player owning one showcases immense power, often in the form of riches, influence, or combat prowess. All Diamond Trim members of the Invisible Mafia with the exception of FlameFrags owned a mace, but these maces have largely been destroyed and few remain.
