 Gambit 
Jaron gave Wemmbu this mace to defend the Skyblock Civilization, which was about to be raided by The Invisible Mafia. Straight (Minemanner), the person who betrayed Skyblock Civilization, threatens Wemmbu, stating he'll die with the Civilization if he listened to Jaron and fought for them. Unnerved, Wemmbu flees the battle with Gambit. 

Wemmbu briefly lends Gambit to ManePear for mace training. 

While fighting Flame, Wemmbu was forced to give Gambit away for Eggchan's life. Flame gives the mace to ClownPierce, who then gives it to his right-hand man, FerreMC. Wemmbu later recovers Gambit after defeating Ferre in a duel and taking him hostage. 

Wemmbu used Gambit to defeat a thousand LAW soldiers in 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players alongside Flame, then two-thousand-five-hundred soldiers in Unstable SMP: The LAW. Following these major battles and having shown the world his expertise and dominance with an elytra and mace, Gambit is known as Wemmbu's signature mace as well as the most iconic weapon in the Unstable Universe.

 Crucible 
As an unnamed mace, Crucible originally belonged to the diamond level Mafia member, Iqcniq. He was killed by the combined efforts of Wemmbu, Eggchan, ParrotX2, and Wifies with Crucible being picked up by Wemmbu. It was briefly stolen by Jaden after Eggchan's Civilization collapsed but he was forced to give it back at the end of I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization by Wemmbu. 

It was stolen again by Sharpness in I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands which led to Wemmbu chasing him into the Far Lands. FlameFrags tricks Sharpness into giving him the mace, lying that he knew a duplication glitch. Flame keeps the mace and reveals he never knew any dupes before leaving. He later returns the mace to Wemmbu, stating he had no use for it. 

It was given to Eggchan by Wemmbu in I Got Hunted by the World's Deadliest Assassin after the fight of Wemmbu and the invisible so Eggchan would have a weapon to protect himself with. Eggchan was seen holding out the mace often during the rest of the episode. It is likely that the Invisible Players have obtained it from him after they took Eggchan hostage but it is unknown what really happened. 

 Incinerator 
This mace was given to Lomedy by FlameFrags, after Flame defeated the ex-diamond-trim mafia member, VEN0M. It was given back to Flame during the The Great Farm War so that he could defend Lomedy's farm. It was used by Flame throughout his Training Arc and was named Incinerator during this time. 

It was used by Flame to defeat thousands of LAW men. In 2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master, Flame chooses to give Lomedy Incinerator back as a part of his apology to the farmer. While Flame is leaving, Lomedy uses Incinerator to mace Flame and pops his totem, saying it was his payback and forgives Flame. 

Lomedy gives Flame Incinerator in I Became a Minecraft Combat Master so that he can defend their new base against Arachn1d and his men. It is given back to Lomedy after the fight. 

 Executioner 
Executioner originally belonged to the LAW soldier, Venthatguy, who fought Wemmbu and FlameFrags with it in 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players. After Flame and Wemmbu kill him, Wemmbu picks up the mace and uses it against Flame after the latter initiates a duel. 

Wemmbu drops the mace down a stab shot hole as he has laid down the burden to compete with Flame after yielding to Flame and reflecting over their past fights. Unknowingly, LettuceK shows up and reveals he's been watching them fight, then he swoops down to pick up the mace Wemmbu dropped. LettuceK named the mace Executioner some time between this and the final battle. Its current status is unknown, for LettuceK was without it when he surrendered. 

 Jaden_MAN's Mace 
This unnamed mace originally belonged to Lomedy, but was stolen from him by Jaden after they were attacked while trying to build Flame a new base. Wemmbu stole it from Jaden during the Invisible Knight arc, but it was given back to Jaden in the same episode. 

Flame makes it his goal to retrieve this mace in 2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master because he believed it'd repair his and Lomedy's relationship. Flame is unable to retrieve it due to Wemmbu protecting Jaden.  

 FieldsOfElysium's Mace 
This mace originally belonged to an unnamed player who protected the Kingdom of Wheat. After retiring, the mace was left in a tomb with only one person knowing the way to it, SirLordWessley. Seeking protection, FieldsOfElysium asks Wemmbu to retrieve this mace. The mace is stolen by a invisible player who Wemmbu fights and successfully corners them into dropping it. Wemmbu decides to return the mace to FieldsOfElysium instead of keeping it for himself. It is unknown what happened to the civilization as it was destroyed and FieldsOfElysium was nowhere to be found.

 Destroyed Maces 
 Wemmbu owned a mace which he crafted. After it was given to Mapicc, he burned it. The mace had no enchants.
 TruOriginal's mace was destroyed by an orbital strike cannon by BAT.
 FlameFrags burned a mace that belonged to LAW soldier Weesean19x before re-matching Wemmbu.
 317 maces were in double chests in the Far Lands. The maces were burned by Wemmbu despite Eggchan's attempts to snag one for himself. All of them were unenchanted.
 Two maces were owned by invisible mafia members.
 There were seven mace wielders that were a part of the LAW. 

 Trivia 
 A mafia member with no trim had a mace, seen in the catacombs.
 PUNGI126, seen as a guard at the mining city, this was shown to have a mace during a flashback.

=== Gambit ===
[[Yeah_Jaron|Jaron]] gave Wemmbu this mace to defend the [[Skyblock Civilization]], which was about to be raided by [[The Invisible Mafia]]. [[Straight]] (Minemanner), the person who betrayed Skyblock Civilization, threatens Wemmbu, stating he'll die with the Civilization if he listened to Jaron and fought for them. Unnerved, Wemmbu flees the battle with Gambit. 

Wemmbu briefly lends Gambit to [[ManePear]] for mace training. 

While fighting Flame, Wemmbu was forced to give Gambit away for [[Eggchan]]'s life. Flame gives the mace to [[ClownPierce]], who then gives it to his right-hand man, [[FerreMC]]. Wemmbu later recovers Gambit after defeating Ferre in a duel and taking him hostage. 

Wemmbu used Gambit to defeat a thousand [[The LAW|LAW]] soldiers in [[2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players]] alongside Flame, then two-thousand-five-hundred soldiers in [[Unstable SMP: The LAW]]. Following these major battles and having shown the world his expertise and dominance with an elytra and mace, Gambit is known as Wemmbu's signature mace as well as the most iconic weapon in the ''Unstable Universe''.

=== Crucible ===
As an unnamed mace, Crucible originally belonged to the [[Mafia Diamond Players|diamond level Mafia member]], [[Iqcniq]]. He was killed by the combined efforts of Wemmbu, Eggchan, ParrotX2, and Wifies with Crucible being picked up by Wemmbu. It was briefly stolen by Jaden after [[Eggchan's Civilization]] collapsed but he was forced to give it back at the end of [[I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization]] by Wemmbu. 

It was stolen again by [[Conexion|Sharpness]] in [[I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands]] which led to Wemmbu chasing him into the [[Far Lands]]. FlameFrags tricks Sharpness into giving him the mace, lying that he knew a duplication glitch. Flame keeps the mace and reveals he never knew any dupes before leaving. He later returns the mace to Wemmbu, stating he had no use for it. 

It was given to [[Eggchan]] by [[Wemmbu]] in [[I Got Hunted by the World's Deadliest Assassin]] after the fight of Wemmbu and the invisible so Eggchan would have a weapon to protect himself with. Eggchan was seen holding out the mace often during the rest of the episode. It is likely that the Invisible Players have obtained it from him after they took Eggchan hostage but it is unknown what really happened. 

=== Incinerator ===
This mace was given to Lomedy by FlameFrags, after Flame defeated the ex-diamond-trim mafia member, [[VEN0M]]. It was given back to Flame during the [[Unstable SMP: The Great Farm War|The Great Farm War]] so that he could defend Lomedy's farm. It was used by Flame throughout his Training Arc and was named ''Incinerator'' during this time. 

It was used by Flame to defeat thousands of LAW men. In [[2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master]], Flame chooses to give Lomedy Incinerator back as a part of his apology to the farmer. While Flame is leaving, Lomedy uses Incinerator to mace Flame and pops his totem, saying it was his payback and forgives Flame. 

Lomedy gives Flame Incinerator in [[I Became a Minecraft Combat Master]] so that he can defend their new base against [[Arachn1d]] and his men. It is given back to Lomedy after the fight. 

=== Executioner ===
Executioner originally belonged to the LAW soldier, [[Venthatguy]], who fought [[Wemmbu]] and [[FlameFrags]] with it in [[2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players]]. After Flame and Wemmbu kill him, Wemmbu picks up the mace and uses it against Flame after the latter initiates a duel. 

Wemmbu drops the mace down a stab shot hole as he has laid down the burden to compete with Flame after yielding to Flame and reflecting over their past fights. Unknowingly, [[LettuceK]] shows up and reveals he's been watching them fight, then he swoops down to pick up the mace Wemmbu dropped. LettuceK named the mace ''Executioner'' some time between this and the final battle. Its current status is unknown, for LettuceK was without it when he surrendered. 

=== Jaden_MAN's Mace ===
This unnamed mace originally belonged to Lomedy, but was stolen from him by Jaden after they were attacked while trying to build Flame a new base. Wemmbu stole it from Jaden during the [[The Fake Identity Arc|Invisible Knight]] arc, but it was given back to Jaden in the same episode. 

Flame makes it his goal to retrieve this mace in [[2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master]] because he believed it'd repair his and Lomedy's relationship. Flame is unable to retrieve it due to Wemmbu protecting Jaden.  

=== FieldsOfElysium's Mace ===
This mace originally belonged to an unnamed player who protected the [[The Wheat Kingdom|Kingdom of Wheat]]. After retiring, the mace was left in a tomb with only one person knowing the way to it, [[SirLordWessley]]. Seeking protection, [[FieldsOfElysium]] asks [[Wemmbu]] to retrieve this mace. The mace is stolen by a invisible player who Wemmbu fights and successfully corners them into dropping it. Wemmbu decides to return the mace to FieldsOfElysium instead of keeping it for himself. It is unknown what happened to the civilization as it was destroyed and FieldsOfElysium was nowhere to be found.

== Destroyed Maces ==
* Wemmbu owned a mace which he crafted. After it was given to Mapicc, he burned it. The mace had no enchants.
* [[TruOriginal]]'s mace was destroyed by an orbital strike cannon by BAT.
* FlameFrags burned a mace that belonged to LAW soldier Weesean19x before re-matching Wemmbu.
* 317 maces were in double chests in the Far Lands. The maces were burned by Wemmbu despite Eggchan's attempts to snag one for himself. All of them were unenchanted.
* Two maces were owned by invisible mafia members.
* There were seven mace wielders that were a part of the LAW. 

== Trivia ==
* A mafia member with no trim had a mace, seen in the catacombs.
* PUNGI126, seen as a guard at the mining city, this was shown to have a mace during a flashback.

title: Mafia City
content:
Mafia City was a significant location within the Unstable Universe Minecraft server, known for being under the control of The Invisible Mafia.

 History 
The city was made up of multiple layers, with the bottom containing Mafia players with no trims, with the top containing diamond tier players. To rank up in the city, Mafia members would get three rank up tokens that were given by Ashswagg after completing certain tasks. To rank up and become a diamond tier mafia player, Mafia player's would first become a gold tier player and then have to kill a diamond tier player.

WyLL and his henchmen later took over the city after it was abandoned, becoming very rich in the process.

title: Mafia Stasis Chambers
content:
The Invisible Mafia's Stasis Chambers, built inside of a massive castle in an artificial mountain, were the locations where the pearls of all mafia members were stored. It was built by Quackenstein123 and his daughter iMajesticRose. 

 History 

Quackenstein gave SpokeIsHere and Mapicc a book with coordinates leading to a chest in the sky with directions through the underground tunnels where pearls were transported, then sent to the chambers with a pearl cannon. Mapicc modified the cannon to shoot them slightly shorter, allowing them to approach from afar. After scouting it out, Spoke and Mapicc returned to destroy the chambers by dropping the pearls into the void. Spoke initially went in without a shovel, forcing him to place a shulker of iron and craft one. After running out of fireworks, his stasis was pulled by Mapicc and Mapicc gave him an efficiency Diamond Shovel, allowing Spoke to break the chambers faster. 

While Spoke was still breaking chambers, two diamond players attacked, forcing him to use more fireworks to evade. The diamond players covered up all of the possible exits with obsidian, trapping the three below the void. However, Mapicc broke the diamond players' stasis mechanisms, preventing them from teleporting out. Spoke was able to use chorus fruit to teleport above the bedrock, while both diamond players eventually ran out of fireworks and died in the void.

After the stasis chambers were destroyed, the castle was abandoned.

title: ManePear
content:
ManePear, also known simply as Mane, is a top tier PvPer on the Unstable SMP. 

 Personality 
ManePear is portrayed as a cynical but highly skilled player. Mane prefers to play Minecraft for fun instead of sweat. He often encourages FlameFrags to stop caring about how others perceive him and to play for the "moola" (money) and the thrill of it. Despite his history of betraying people out of boredom, he maintains a brotherly bond with FlameFrags, stating, "Brothers are always a friend".

 History 

 Season 1 
Originally, he served as a high level guard for PrinceZam alongside Merfinn, FlameFrags, Pangi and a hand full of other good PvPers. However, after Zam betrayed Wemmbu, ManePear ended up betraying Zam "For Fun" and helping Wemmbu kidnap Peentar, Yungwillx, and Sorhin. ManePear helps in the destruction of the Zam Empire. 

During the beginning of Mafia Arc. Spoke and Mapicc attempted to recruit Mane to their team to defeat The Invisible Mafia. Mane, thinking they were trolling started killing them. Spoke and Mapicc ran. 

Later in Mafia Arc, ManePear helps train Wemmbu in mace PvP. He gave Wemmbu advice to name his mace. After some time, ManePear discovers that The Diamond Trim Mafia member that he fought in Ice Mountain Civilization was FlameFrags, he comes to Wemmbu and asks for his mace "Gambit". Wemmbu refuses and flees. Mane eventually leaves, placing a sign saying "Lost Cause". 

 Season 2 
There was a rumours that ManePear was hiding in the deep, remote caves. During his exile, ManePear became the first player to fully master the Spear. He developed a combat style that prioritizes speed over defense. He famously does not use totems or shields, choosing instead to rely on "Movement Mastery" to avoid hits and deal massive burst damage.

FlameFrags tracked ManePear down to learn the Spear. ManePear agreed to train him only if FlameFrags helped him take down a group of "stacked" players who were preventing ManePear from "eating good" (looting).

Later on when FlameFrags was captured by the faction known as The Law, ManePear abandoned his "lone wolf" persona to stage a rescue. He successfully broke FlameFrags out of a high-security cell by destroying his "Curse of Binding" armor. And looting LAW's vault as a payment for his mentoring to Flame.

 Boundaries 

 No NSFW
 No shipping or implied shipping
 No heavy gore
 Nothing IRL in general
 No ai art
 No drugs / alcohol

 Quotes 

Trivia 

 In his Discord, he joked about dying to a skeleton while AFK off camera.
 Mane himself and his moderators said he wouldn't return to Unstable, but it was revealed that they said it to keep his return a secret and a surprise. However, he may not return as often.
 In FlameFrags video called I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master Mane returns after a year of being missing on the Unstable SMP.
 The skeleton he almost died to was showcased in a cage in front of his base.

title: Mapicc
content:
Mapicc is Spoke's previous best friend and teammate on the Unstable SMP.

 Personality 
Mapicc has a somewhat silly and laidback demeanor. He can be just as mischievous as Spoke but is shown to have stronger boundaries than his chaotic comrade. These boundaries, which mostly consists of trying to do things without selfish intent, is what eventually causes him to abandon Spoke. He is a good fighter and incredibly loyal, refusing to kill Spoke out of revenge when given the chance, but is somewhat overly trusting at times, taking most people at their word. 

Mapicc dislikes being lied to and is deeply offended whenever he learns that someone has. 

History

Season 1
Mapicc helps Spoke steal from the Zam Empire, and TheRealSquiddo’s base to destroy duped items. Mapicc helps Spoke destroy more duped items.

Mapicc’s base is blown up.

Spoke and Mapicc set an Orbital Strike Cannon to destroy another dupe stash, but discover it’s Jepexx’s base, accidentally destroying his base.

Spoke and Mapicc go back to the first dupe stash that Spoke found, and find that there were hidden duped items behind the walls.

A war between Spoke’s team and the Zam Empire breaks out.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam decide to go to the end, and find RealReeon, Sharkilz_, and Mapicc guarding the stronghold. They all flee to the end except for RealReeon.

Mapicc, Fantst, Arcn, Only_A_Squid, and Sharooh find Wemmbu and PrinceZam in a trial chamber. They start fighting.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam use a technique involving TNT and an arrow to find Mapicc. They find an obsidian box, and inside of it is Mapicc. Spoke and his teammates come in and start fighting Wemmbu and PrinceZam. All of PrinceZam’s armor breaks, and he almost dies. PrinceZam is able to scare them away by holding a chunk ban.

Spoke and Mapicc find a stash of what he thinks are duped items. He finds the chests are empty. A player named PlanetLord comes in and they try to kill him as he places shulker boxes which appear to be duped because they have identical items in all of them. PlanetLord is able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the raid farm, and see three invisible players. They almost die to the invisible players, but Ashswagg comes and tells the invisible players to leave, and they oblige. Ashswagg says he doesn’t know the players.

Spoke and Mapicc go to TheRealSquiddo’s house to see if there are any duped items there. Under the floor, they find a bunch of books with coordinates. Ashswagg finds Spoke and Mapicc and says that he wants to team with them.

Spoke and Mapicc go to a bunch of farms they found in one of TheRealSquiddo’s books and rig them to not produce items.

Jepexx is seen at his villager trading hall. Spoke and Mapicc splash the villagers invisible and pretend they are dead. Jepexx also shows them their panda farm, but then a group of invisible players come and try to kill Jepexx. They yell out for ashswagg to stop, and all the invisible players run away. Ashswagg later says that he was just trying to help them.

Spoke and Mapicc find a melon farm which they blow up. They find a fish farm, where they see that ManePear is using the farm AFK. They trap him in a 1x1 obsidian box at an elder guardian farm.

They break a couple more farms. They find that Ashswagg completely obliterated the coordinates that they give to him. 

They find JumperWho, who is AFK. They move her onto the nether roof. She comes back and they run away to the overworld. Spoke and Mapicc destroy the guardian farm.

Spoke and Mapicc find a couple more farms and break them. They find ManePear in a piglin farm, appearing to be AFK, but he comes back. They are able to escape by poking a hole in the bedrock.

They go to the next farm and find two invisible players destroying it with TNT. He pops one of their totems and it reveals they are USmellLikeUpdog. Ash teleports USmellLikeUpdog into the void, banning him because he stated ashswagg was the leader. Mapicc leaves because he doesn’t trust ashswagg. Spoke meets ashswagg at the next farm.

Spoke gives ashswagg the rest of the coordinates to the farms.

Spoke goes over to Mapicc’s new base and they agree to team back up with each other.

Spoke and Mapicc go over to their end base, and see that Wemmbu and eggchan are destroying it. This is because they are being paid by Roshambogames to destroy the end base. They leave the base.

They go to the next farm, which is a flower farm. They see Roshambo and PlanetLord there. Ashswagg destroys the entire farm with TNT. Mapicc says he saw invisible people leaving, implying this was ashswagg. They go to the other farms and see ashswagg destroyed all of them. They go to the last farm, which is an EOL farm. They made it there before ashswagg destroyed it. Mapicc leaves so Spoke can talk to ashswagg.

Ashswagg tells him that, since Spoke was the one at every farm, everyone will think he destroyed them. Ashswagg tries to convince Spoke to give him exploits he knows about, but he does not oblige. Spoke and Mapicc see a lot of invisible players who try to kill them. Spoke is able to escape by using the nether. A player finds them in the nether named MinuteTech. MinuteTech saves them. MinuteTech reveals he was once part of the Mafia (the group of invisible players).

Spoke and Mapicc follow him back to his base. They show MinuteTech their base at spawn. They get attacked underground by the Mafia. MinuteTech kills one of the Mafia members using a mace. They manage to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord at Jepexx’s old villager trading hall. The Mafia comes over and tries to kill them. They trap the Mafia players using a sand trap, though none of them die. They are able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc try to prove to ManePear that there are invisible players attacking them, but ManePear decides to try and kill Spoke and Mapicc. They are able to escape. The Mafia starts attacking them. They are able to escape again.

Spoke and Mapicc invite TheRealSquiddo to their group.

The Mafia tries to kill Spoke and Mapicc. Spoke is able to escape, but Mapicc is not. Mapicc is captured.

Spoke and his team infiltrating the Mafia find Mapicc in a prison and break him out.

The team is tasked with killing PlanetLord, but they don’t kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the invisible mafia members until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Spoke is tasked with killing iMajesticRose. He obliges and kills her with dripstone. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. Spoke has to fight a diamond tier Mafia member to become diamond. Spoke’s totem of undying is used during the fight, revealing to ashswagg that he is Spoke. They try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he’s MinuteTech.

Spoke goes over to the Square Civilization to warn Cash that the Mafia is going to break into their civilization and destroy it. Cash doesn’t listen and everyone in the civilization dies. Spoke warns the Sleepy Nation that the Mafia is going to try to kill them. Together, the Sleepy Nation takes back their items that were stolen from the Mafia. The leaders of Sleepy Nation reveal that they are part of the Mafia and tries to kill them.

Spoke and Mapicc go over to TheRealSquiddo to try and find the coordinates of "The Withered", which was a base that ashswagg planned to takeover. She does not know what this is and the Mafia destroys her base. Spoke and Mapicc go to spawn where they see ParrotX2 and Wifies. They agree to team up to try and end the Mafia. They show Parrot and Wifies the area where they killed iMajesticRose. They find a diamond tier Mafia player and follow them. They find a village where there is a player in iron armor named Quackenstein123. They claim to be the father of iMajesticRose.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the end to get obsidian. They are able to escape the Mafia who try to kill them in the end. They go back to the Quackenstein’s base and find a secret staircase underneath it. They find a stash of loot, including the diamond tier players armor, and a mace, proving that Quackenstein is the diamond tier player. The player comes into the vault. Quackenstein gives them a book allegedly containing coordinates to where all the stasis chambers are stored. He shows Parrot this book, and Parrot invites him to District 13.

Spoke and Mapicc check the coordinates and find a chest containing a book called the gateway which appears to contain directions to something. They show the members of District 13 the book. The members are disappointed so Spoke and Mapicc leave. They find that spawn now has a prison to trap new players and force then to join the mafia and go back to get Parrot's help to break in.

Spoke, Parrot, and Mapicc break into a spawn prison. Their plan is to follow wherever pearls are thrown all the way to the main stasis chamber area. They find an area where guards transport the pearls and use the gateway book to find a pearl cannon. They use it to get teleported millions of blocks out, where they find a man-made mountain. Inside of the mountain is where every stasis chamber is stored.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the void and start destroying every soul sand. Diamond tier players try to kill him in the void, but using chorus fruit, Spoke is able to escape. The Mafia ends.

Season 2
Mapicc and PlanetLord help SpokeIsHere destroy a secret base owned by Reddoons.

Mapicc stalks Spoke as he creates an empire. Spoke finds Mapicc and shows him an obsidian highway created by the Mafia. He also tries to show him his empire, but they find it under attack by its own citizens. After resolving this and a couple more revenge sprees they lead the army to the end and accidentally grief MinuteTech's end base as Spoke is beginning to lose control of his empire. Upon returning to the overworld Spoke fully loses control of the empire and Spoke and Mapicc have to flee.

Spoke and Mapicc build a base and hide in it until the army finds them. The base is quickly destroyed, and the two friends use a chicken cannon to get to a skybase. The army begins to pillar up to them, and a mysterious invisible player somehow gets on the platform and confronts Spoke about his wrong doings. Spoke refuses to listen and the player drops a book and a singular porkchop before leaving. Spoke and Mapicc fight the quickly approaching army until they're forced to run away again. They make a nether portal underground and escape through it. They hide in the nether for a little bit and Mapicc makes a poorly done house until the mysterious player, called "The Executive" in the book they left, confronts them again. The player tries to throw them another book, but it burns in lava. The Executive warns that the army is going to kill Spoke before leaving. Spoke and Mapicc run through the nether and eventually build some TNT cannons on a platform in the center of a lava lake and fight the army that had found them by now. They fight for an impressive amount of time before being forced to flee back to the overworld. They end up at Leow0ok's base who agree to help the fight the army. The trio manage to defeat the entire army and kill all the players.

Leow0ok drops Spoke and Mapicc into a fall trap with powered snow at the bottom. He threatens to kill Mapicc if Spoke tries to run and forces him to give up his riptide trident. They follow Leo and some "hitmen" to the BAT HQ 2.0 where they find out Leo was only training them to see if they would be good members of BAT. Spoke gets his trident back and is sent on several missions while Mapicc stays at the base.

Mapicc discovers a complete invisibility glitch that makes you, your armor, and your items invisible until you take damage. He shows Spoke this and the pair begin to abuse it to troll other players. They start with messing with a new player called JackLIVE_XD and convince him that they're the creators of Minecraft and are there to guide him. ApexPoint and some of his friends eventually show up and attempt to rob Jack. Spoke and Mapicc attempt to save him but only succeed to extent of Apex inviting Jake to his team. Mapicc and Spoke go back the BAT Headquarters and warn Leo of Apex. They attempt to raid one of Apex's stashes of stolen loot with the help of Leo, but it goes downhill when Spoke and Mapicc both take damage and reveal themselves. Spoke and Mapicc go back to trolling and start to troll Squiddo. ApexPoint and his team show up again and inquire about if she's seen Spoke and Mapicc. Spoke and Mapicc begin messing with all four of the players until Spoke once again takes damage and they have to flee. They reapply the glitch and begin stalking Apex and his team. They get board as they walk and decide to troll the team with a sound board until Jack and ZeroCycle split off to raid a base. The base turns out to be owned by their friend Jepexx and they attempt to save him by pretending to be the angel and devil on his shoulders. After Japexx escapes they manage to follow Jack and ZeroCycle back to their base. Spoke and Mapicc begin trapping the base but accidentally take damage and are forced to run. When the pair thought they lost the team they reapply the glitch, but Apex's team sees them do this and does it themselves. Spoke and Mapicc go to Apex's base and begin raiding it until Apex, Jack, and Zero surprise them with the invis glitch on. Eventually, Spoke calls for a truce and makes chairs for everyone, secretly placing Apex's over a dripstone trap he made earlier. Spoke drops ApexPoint into the trap before killing ZeroCycle. They let Jack live and return to their exploit to destroy it.

Spoke goes too far on a mission and ends up destroying an entire village. He decides he needs to kill the witnesses of this, so he doesn't get in trouble. After killing the first group of witnesses Leo confronts him about the deaths and he lies and says he was building with Mapicc at that time. He makes his way towards the next witnesses' base but realizes that he's being followed so goes back to Mapicc and his castle instead. He tells Mapicc what is happening and his friend agrees to cover for him. Spoke sneaks off to eliminate more witnesses and ends up killing two spies who saw him do this. He goes back to his base where Leo was waiting for him. Spoke gives an alibi of being with Mapicc. Mapicc covers for him and defends this alibi which Leo begrudgingly accepts. 

After Spoke mistakenly kills two of JumperWho's spies and runs away with a book with his name on it. He then arrives back at his base to find Leow0ok arguing with Mapicc over Spoke's whereabouts once again. Leo tells Spoke that he has to come with him and Spoke gives Mapicc the book he stole before going with Leo. After he's interrogated Spoke returns to the base and Mapicc warns him that it's being watched from every angle, but that he has a plan to escape. Spoke and Mapicc escape invisible on a happy ghast, and Spoke reads the book he stole. He complains that there's no evidence to which Mapicc says there were tons of witnesses and killing them all wasn't the same. Mapicc and Spoke decided to get more information and Spoke disguises himself as a spy to sneak into a base while Mapicc waits with the happy ghast as a getaway vehicle. Spoke steals another book and Mapicc kills one of the spies with a trap Spoke instructed him to create. Spoke and Mapicc go back to their base where Jumper inquiries about where they've been. The pair run away through the nether and use an escape tunnel to trick a spy into being by themselves before killing them. Spoke pretends to be the spy and goes with the spy's teammates leaving Mapicc to return to the base.

Mapicc helps Spoke get his family to safety from BAT. Mapicc then pretends to be a spy and follows Spoke to LettuceK's announcement. Mapicc helps Spoke get away and later meets up with his friend. Spoke tells Mapicc to infiltrate the LAW prison to get information to help him free Wemmbu who he needed to kill Leo. After breaking Wemmbu, PrinceZam and a couple other prisoners out they (Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam) wait for Wemmbu at the BAT HQ 2.0 and force him to help them with killing Leo. They pull a Leow0ok stasis Spoke found and attempt to kill the BAT leader, but fail when Spoke's invisibly ran out and Leo teleports away. Zam and Wemmbu leave Spoke and Mapicc to think about what to do next.

Mapicc goes on a heist to loot a former mafia vault with a preset stasis in Spoke's base. Spoke realizes that Mapicc is taking too long so he pulls the stasis. But Mapicc shows up for a few seconds chanting "we gotta go, we gotta go", before vanishing. This starts a hunt for Spoke to find Mapicc, as he questions what he meant by "we".  After seeing Leo with a shield similar to Mapicc's, He threatens to nuke Capital city if not proven that Leo didn't kill Mapicc or is somewhat Imprisoned. After Parrot confronts Spoke and assures him that Mapicc wouldn't die on him so easily, he searches for Mapicc with Zam all the way to the farlands, where he finds Mapicc with JamatoP (Spoke's former best friend), who was trying to keep Mapicc away from Spoke, but failed. Spoke then attacks Mapicc and Zam with carts while invisible, acting as Leow0ok. He runs away after scaring the two, comes back without invis, and acts suprised. They three then go to the lighthouse, and, seeing explosions and xp, assume JamatoP has died. They make a grave for him, decorating it with a poppy flower.

They all leave the farlands and begin to search for Leow0ok. They find the reminisce of a fight between what seemed to be Leo and someone else. Someone begins to stalk them, and they run away to Spoke and Mapicc's castle to set some traps for the stalker. They then go through the nether and set an ender pearl stasis in a cave before returning to the castle to find all the traps distroyed. They make a skybase as another attempt to lose the stalker when the trio are alerted to the presence of Leo and some lawmen by some mysterious beacons. Leo finds them and begins to attack the skybase. The base is overrun and Spoke uses a glitch to blow the skybase up remotely. Mapicc, Spoke, and Zam then backtrack to jump Leo. They get ahold of one of Leo's arrows and use it to find his stasis. Part way there, Spoke is suddenly teleported away leaving Mapicc and Zam by themselves.

Spoke finds Mapicc and Zam and show them a base he "built" because he had challenged the entirety of LAW and BAT to kill him. When one of Spoke's sculk sensor locators goes off, he tells Mapicc and Zam to stay in the base and guard an ender pearl he left there. Mapicc and Zam find a secret room with a bunch of supplies and an enchantment set up. They show Spoke when he gets back. The locator goes off and Spoke instructs Mapicc and Zam to stay in the base again. Just after Spoke leaves, Mapicc and Zam find a book that says that Spoke actually wants them to follow so they do so. Spoke is confused when they find him and explains that he didn't want them to come because it's dangerous and that they need to go back to the base. Zam is nearly blown up by a land mine which proves Spoke's point, but it's too late and some lawmen find them. They fight the lawmen and kill them all. When they get back to the base they inquire more about the book to which Spoke simply vaguely answers that the stalker is still watching them. They leave the base once again to figure out where Leo was hiding which they do by kidnapping a lawman and interrogating them. They learn that Leo is hiding in the snowy biome and Spoke kills the lawman. The trio find the base and taunt Leow0ok from outside. A fight ensues and Zam nearly dies but JumperWho saves him. She reveals that she was the stalker and was trying to team with Spoke. Both Spoke and Leo eventually get riled up and fighting begins again. Leo escapes and Spoke confronts Jumper angrily. He reveals that Jumper had Zam and Mapicc's pearls. Jumper flies away and they follow her towards the desert in an attempt to trap and kill her. They're jumped by more lawmen and have to pull the trap (a sand fall trap) to save themselves. Right as the fight ends Spoke's pearl is pulled once again. Zam and Mapicc head back to the base and a rail gun destroys a good portion of it. They pull another stasis Spoke set and debate if they should run or fight. Jumper shows up and convinces them to fight. They use an arrow cannon to eliminate a good chunk of the lawmen before attempting to run. Zam gets trapped and Jumper shows Spoke and Mapicc where the two duratagonist's pearls are, pulling them and saving Zam's life. They all escape on a happy ghast and decide to begin to construct an army.

Mapicc, Zam, and Spoke break some spies out of a LAW prison that Jumper directed them to. They start a fight and a losing badly until Jumper shows up with MinuteTech. Spoke and Minute reconcile for the time he accidentally destroyed Minute's end hub. Mapicc splits off from the rest of the group to find some of Minute's end loot stashes. They all meet back up at Spoke and Mapicc's castle and split the loot between the current army consisting of JumperWho, Minute, Spoke, Wemmbu, Jaden, Mapicc, Flame, and Jumper's spies. Flame, Wemmbu, and Jaden fight until a spy shows up with a book saying that LettueK's army was converging at a certain point. Spoke, Flame, and Wemmbu all head to the coords given by the spy and everyone else says behind at the castle. The three protagonists return with Parrot, Theo, and loot from the base at the coords. They all head to District 13 where Parrot had been constructing an army of his own. After some preparation and an encoring speech, they make their way to the Northern Council. Mapicc gives Spoke a new shield with a banner on it which his friend receives excitedly. Once they reach the Northern Council a battle ensues and at some point Mapicc vanishes.

 Season 3 
Spoke searches for Mapicc frantically as a group of bounty hunters begin to chase him. Mapicc shows up at Spoke's base invis and wearing a copper helmet, a diamond chestplate, copper leggings, and iron boots, and drinks a milk bucket to reveal himself. 

They use a pearl cannon to get to the farlands in an attempt to stop NULL. They get jumped multiple times and eventually manage to kill a squad of NULL hunters in a dark forest. They enter the fabric of Unstable and run into JamatoP. 

Mapicc is excited but confused at seeing Jamato because he thought he was dead. Jamato provides them all with stuff to regear with and helps them leave the fabric. They get jumped again by some hunters and barely escape into the rainbow forest. Mapicc remembers his friend and fellow NULL escapee Revenant44 telling him about a stacked group of players that lives there. They are trapped and nearly killed by that group of players. Instead, their leader, DylPickleYT, gives them a compass to a stash to restock. They find the stash in a sand biome full of ravengers, but NULL hunters steal all the stuff. They leave the biome for a jungle-like one which has a group of friendly players lead by one of JumperWho's former spies. Spoke attemps to jump Jamato. Mapicc chases him down until he pops his friend's totem clearing Spoke's invis. He leaves Spoke, believing his friend to be unsafe and ludicrous. He runs into JamatoP who reveals that Spoke himself tried to kill him not Leo. JamatoP likely gives Mapicc new armor. Mapicc runs into Spoke again and attacks his former friend. He breaks Alt along with the rest of Spoke's armor. NULL appeared, breaks all his new armor and takes him to the nether.

Spoke goes over to Mapicc’s new base and they agree to team back up with each other.

Spoke and Mapicc go over to their end base, and see that Wemmbu and eggchan are destroying it. This is because they are being paid by [[Roshambogames]] to destroy the end base. They leave the base.

They go to the next farm, which is a flower farm. They see Roshambo and PlanetLord there. Ashswagg destroys the entire farm with TNT. Mapicc says he saw invisible people leaving, implying this was ashswagg. They go to the other farms and see ashswagg destroyed all of them. They go to the last farm, which is an EOL farm. They made it there before ashswagg destroyed it. Mapicc leaves so Spoke can talk to ashswagg.

Ashswagg tells him that, since Spoke was the one at every farm, everyone will think he destroyed them. Ashswagg tries to convince Spoke to give him exploits he knows about, but he does not oblige. Spoke and Mapicc see a lot of invisible players who try to kill them. Spoke is able to escape by using the nether. A player finds them in the nether named [[MinuteTech]]. MinuteTech saves them. MinuteTech reveals he was once part of the Mafia (the group of invisible players).

Spoke and Mapicc follow him back to his base. They show MinuteTech their base at spawn. They get attacked underground by the Mafia. MinuteTech kills one of the Mafia members using a mace. They manage to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord at Jepexx’s old villager trading hall. The Mafia comes over and tries to kill them. They trap the Mafia players using a sand trap, though none of them die. They are able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc try to prove to ManePear that there are invisible players attacking them, but ManePear decides to try and kill Spoke and Mapicc. They are able to escape. The Mafia starts attacking them. They are able to escape again.

Spoke and Mapicc invite TheRealSquiddo to their group.

The Mafia tries to kill Spoke and Mapicc. Spoke is able to escape, but Mapicc is not. Mapicc is captured.

Spoke and his team infiltrating the Mafia find Mapicc in a prison and break him out.

The team is tasked with killing PlanetLord, but they don’t kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the invisible mafia members until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Spoke is tasked with killing [[iMajesticRose]]. He obliges and kills her with dripstone. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. Spoke has to fight a diamond tier Mafia member to become diamond. Spoke’s totem of undying is used during the fight, revealing to ashswagg that he is Spoke. They try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he’s MinuteTech.

Spoke goes over to the [[Square Civilization]] to warn [[Cash]] that the Mafia is going to break into their civilization and destroy it. Cash doesn’t listen and everyone in the civilization dies. Spoke warns the [[Sleepy Nation]] that the Mafia is going to try to kill them. Together, the Sleepy Nation takes back their items that were stolen from the Mafia. The leaders of Sleepy Nation reveal that they are part of the Mafia and tries to kill them.

Spoke and Mapicc go over to TheRealSquiddo to try and find the coordinates of "The Withered", which was a base that ashswagg planned to takeover. She does not know what this is and the Mafia destroys her base. Spoke and Mapicc go to spawn where they see [[ParrotX2]] and [[Wifies]]. They agree to team up to try and end the Mafia. They show Parrot and Wifies the area where they killed iMajesticRose. They find a diamond tier Mafia player and follow them. They find a village where there is a player in iron armor named [[Quackenstein123]]. They claim to be the father of iMajesticRose.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the end to get obsidian. They are able to escape the Mafia who try to kill them in the end. They go back to the Quackenstein’s base and find a secret staircase underneath it. They find a stash of loot, including the diamond tier players armor, and a mace, proving that Quackenstein is the diamond tier player. The player comes into the vault. Quackenstein gives them a book allegedly containing coordinates to where all the stasis chambers are stored. He shows Parrot this book, and Parrot invites him to [[District 13]].

Spoke and Mapicc check the coordinates and find a chest containing a book called the gateway which appears to contain directions to something. They show the members of District 13 the book. The members are disappointed so Spoke and Mapicc leave. They find that spawn now has a prison to trap new players and force then to join the mafia and go back to get Parrot's help to break in.

Spoke, Parrot, and Mapicc break into a spawn prison. Their plan is to follow wherever pearls are thrown all the way to the main stasis chamber area. They find an area where guards transport the pearls and use the gateway book to find a pearl cannon. They use it to get teleported millions of blocks out, where they find a man-made mountain. Inside of the mountain is where every stasis chamber is stored.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the void and start destroying every soul sand. Diamond tier players try to kill him in the void, but using chorus fruit, Spoke is able to escape. The Mafia ends.

===Season 2===
Mapicc and PlanetLord help SpokeIsHere destroy a secret base owned by [[Reddoons]].

Mapicc stalks Spoke as he creates an [[Spoke Galactic Empire|empire]]. Spoke finds Mapicc and shows him an obsidian highway created by the Mafia. He also tries to show him his empire, but they find it under attack by its own citizens. After resolving this and a couple more revenge sprees they lead the army to the end and accidentally grief MinuteTech's end base as Spoke is beginning to lose control of his empire. Upon returning to the overworld Spoke fully loses control of the empire and Spoke and Mapicc have to flee.

Spoke and Mapicc build a base and hide in it until the army finds them. The base is quickly destroyed, and the two friends use a chicken cannon to get to a skybase. The army begins to pillar up to them, and a [[Baconnwaffles0|mysterious invisible player]] somehow gets on the platform and confronts Spoke about his wrong doings. Spoke refuses to listen and the player drops a book and a singular porkchop before leaving. Spoke and Mapicc fight the quickly approaching army until they're forced to run away again. They make a nether portal underground and escape through it. They hide in the nether for a little bit and Mapicc makes a poorly done house until the mysterious player, called "The Executive" in the book they left, confronts them again. The player tries to throw them another book, but it burns in lava. The Executive warns that the army is going to kill Spoke before leaving. Spoke and Mapicc run through the nether and eventually build some TNT cannons on a platform in the center of a lava lake and fight the army that had found them by now. They fight for an impressive amount of time before being forced to flee back to the overworld. They end up at [[Leow0ok]]'s base who agree to help the fight the army. The trio manage to defeat the entire army and kill all the players.

Leow0ok drops Spoke and Mapicc into a fall trap with powered snow at the bottom. He threatens to kill Mapicc if Spoke tries to run and forces him to give up his riptide trident. They follow Leo and some "hitmen" to the [[BAT Headquarters 2.0|BAT HQ 2.0]] where they find out Leo was only training them to see if they would be good members of BAT. Spoke gets his trident back and is sent on several missions while Mapicc stays at the base.

Mapicc discovers a complete invisibility glitch that makes you, your armor, and your items invisible until you take damage. He shows Spoke this and the pair begin to abuse it to troll other players. They start with messing with a new player called JackLIVE_XD and convince him that they're the creators of Minecraft and are there to guide him. [[ApexPoint]] and some of his friends eventually show up and attempt to rob Jack. Spoke and Mapicc attempt to save him but only succeed to extent of Apex inviting Jake to his team. Mapicc and Spoke go back the BAT Headquarters and warn Leo of Apex. They attempt to raid one of Apex's stashes of stolen loot with the help of Leo, but it goes downhill when Spoke and Mapicc both take damage and reveal themselves. Spoke and Mapicc go back to trolling and start to troll Squiddo. ApexPoint and his team show up again and inquire about if she's seen Spoke and Mapicc. Spoke and Mapicc begin messing with all four of the players until Spoke once again takes damage and they have to flee. They reapply the glitch and begin stalking Apex and his team. They get board as they walk and decide to troll the team with a sound board until Jack and ZeroCycle split off to raid a base. The base turns out to be owned by their friend [[Jepexx]] and they attempt to save him by pretending to be the angel and devil on his shoulders. After Japexx escapes they manage to follow Jack and ZeroCycle back to their base. Spoke and Mapicc begin trapping the base but accidentally take damage and are forced to run. When the pair thought they lost the team they reapply the glitch, but Apex's team sees them do this and does it themselves. Spoke and Mapicc go to Apex's base and begin raiding it until Apex, Jack, and Zero surprise them with the invis glitch on. Eventually, Spoke calls for a truce and makes chairs for everyone, secretly placing Apex's over a dripstone trap he made earlier. Spoke drops ApexPoint into the trap before killing ZeroCycle. They let Jack live and return to their exploit to destroy it.

Spoke goes too far on a mission and ends up destroying an entire village. He decides he needs to kill the witnesses of this, so he doesn't get in trouble. After killing the first group of witnesses Leo confronts him about the deaths and he lies and says he was building with Mapicc at that time. He makes his way towards the next witnesses' base but realizes that he's being followed so goes back to Mapicc and his castle instead. He tells Mapicc what is happening and his friend agrees to cover for him. Spoke sneaks off to eliminate more witnesses and ends up killing two spies who saw him do this. He goes back to his base where Leo was waiting for him. Spoke gives an alibi of being with Mapicc. Mapicc covers for him and defends this alibi which Leo begrudgingly accepts. 

After Spoke mistakenly kills two of JumperWho's spies and runs away with a book with his name on it. He then arrives back at his base to find Leow0ok arguing with Mapicc over Spoke's whereabouts once again. Leo tells Spoke that he has to come with him and Spoke gives Mapicc the book he stole before going with Leo. After he's interrogated Spoke returns to the base and Mapicc warns him that it's being watched from every angle, but that he has a plan to escape. Spoke and Mapicc escape invisible on a happy ghast, and Spoke reads the book he stole. He complains that there's no evidence to which Mapicc says there were tons of witnesses and killing them all wasn't the same. Mapicc and Spoke decided to get more information and Spoke disguises himself as a spy to sneak into a base while Mapicc waits with the happy ghast as a getaway vehicle. Spoke steals another book and Mapicc kills one of the spies with a trap Spoke instructed him to create. Spoke and Mapicc go back to their base where Jumper inquiries about where they've been. The pair run away through the nether and use an escape tunnel to trick a spy into being by themselves before killing them. Spoke pretends to be the spy and goes with the spy's teammates leaving Mapicc to return to the base.

Mapicc helps Spoke get his family to safety from BAT. Mapicc then pretends to be a spy and follows Spoke to [[LettuceK]]'s announcement. Mapicc helps Spoke get away and later meets up with his friend. Spoke tells Mapicc to infiltrate the LAW prison to get information to help him free Wemmbu who he needed to kill Leo. After breaking Wemmbu, [[PrinceZam]] and a couple other prisoners out they (Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam) wait for Wemmbu at the BAT HQ 2.0 and force him to help them with killing Leo. They pull a Leow0ok stasis Spoke found and attempt to kill the BAT leader, but fail when Spoke's invisibly ran out and Leo teleports away. Zam and Wemmbu leave Spoke and Mapicc to think about what to do next.

Mapicc goes on a heist to loot a former mafia vault with a preset stasis in Spoke's base. Spoke realizes that Mapicc is taking too long so he pulls the stasis. But Mapicc shows up for a few seconds chanting "we gotta go, we gotta go", before vanishing. This starts a hunt for Spoke to find Mapicc, as he questions what he meant by "we".  After seeing Leo with a shield similar to Mapicc's, He threatens to nuke Capital city if not proven that Leo didn't kill Mapicc or is somewhat Imprisoned. After Parrot confronts Spoke and assures him that Mapicc wouldn't die on him so easily, he searches for Mapicc with Zam all the way to the farlands, where he finds Mapicc with JamatoP (Spoke's former best friend), who was trying to keep Mapicc away from Spoke, but failed. Spoke then attacks Mapicc and Zam with carts while invisible, acting as Leow0ok. He runs away after scaring the two, comes back without invis, and acts suprised. They three then go to the lighthouse, and, seeing explosions and xp, assume JamatoP has died. They make a grave for him, decorating it with a poppy flower.

They all leave the farlands and begin to search for Leow0ok. They find the reminisce of a fight between what seemed to be Leo and someone else. Someone begins to stalk them, and they run away to Spoke and Mapicc's castle to set some traps for the [[JumperWho|stalker]]. They then go through the nether and set an ender pearl stasis in a cave before returning to the castle to find all the traps distroyed. They make a skybase as another attempt to lose the stalker when the trio are alerted to the presence of Leo and some [[The LAW|lawmen]] by some mysterious beacons. Leo finds them and begins to attack the skybase. The base is overrun and Spoke uses a glitch to blow the skybase up remotely. Mapicc, Spoke, and Zam then backtrack to jump Leo. They get ahold of one of Leo's arrows and use it to find his stasis. Part way there, Spoke is suddenly teleported away leaving Mapicc and Zam by themselves.

Spoke finds Mapicc and Zam and show them a base he "built" because he had challenged the entirety of LAW and [[Bounty Assassin Team|BAT]] to kill him. When one of Spoke's sculk sensor locators goes off, he tells Mapicc and Zam to stay in the base and guard an ender pearl he left there. Mapicc and Zam find a secret room with a bunch of supplies and an enchantment set up. They show Spoke when he gets back. The locator goes off and Spoke instructs Mapicc and Zam to stay in the base again. Just after Spoke leaves, Mapicc and Zam find a book that says that Spoke actually wants them to follow so they do so. Spoke is confused when they find him and explains that he didn't want them to come because it's dangerous and that they need to go back to the base. Zam is nearly blown up by a land mine which proves Spoke's point, but it's too late and some lawmen find them. They fight the lawmen and kill them all. When they get back to the base they inquire more about the book to which Spoke simply vaguely answers that the stalker is still watching them. They leave the base once again to figure out where Leo was hiding which they do by kidnapping a lawman and interrogating them. They learn that Leo is hiding in the snowy biome and Spoke kills the lawman. The trio find the base and taunt Leow0ok from outside. A fight ensues and Zam nearly dies but [[JumperWho]] saves him. She reveals that she was the stalker and was trying to team with Spoke. Both Spoke and Leo eventually get riled up and fighting begins again. Leo escapes and Spoke confronts Jumper angrily. He reveals that Jumper had Zam and Mapicc's pearls. Jumper flies away and they follow her towards the desert in an attempt to trap and kill her. They're jumped by more lawmen and have to pull the trap (a sand fall trap) to save themselves. Right as the fight ends Spoke's pearl is pulled once again. Zam and Mapicc head back to the base and a rail gun destroys a good portion of it. They pull another stasis Spoke set and debate if they should run or fight. Jumper shows up and convinces them to fight. They use an arrow cannon to eliminate a good chunk of the lawmen before attempting to run. Zam gets trapped and Jumper shows Spoke and Mapicc where the two duratagonist's pearls are, pulling them and saving Zam's life. They all escape on a happy ghast and decide to begin to construct an army.

Mapicc, Zam, and Spoke break some [[JumperWho's Spies|spies]] out of a LAW prison that Jumper directed them to. They start a fight and a losing badly until Jumper shows up with [[MinuteTech]]. Spoke and Minute reconcile for the time he accidentally destroyed Minute's end hub. Mapicc splits off from the rest of the group to find some of Minute's end loot stashes. They all meet back up at Spoke and Mapicc's castle and split the loot between the current army consisting of JumperWho, Minute, Spoke, [[Wemmbu]], [[Jaden MAN|Jaden]], Mapicc, [[FlameFrags|Flame]], and Jumper's spies. Flame, Wemmbu, and Jaden fight until a spy shows up with a book saying that LettueK's army was converging at a certain point. Spoke, Flame, and Wemmbu all head to the coords given by the spy and everyone else says behind at the castle. The three protagonists return with [[ParrotX2|Parrot]], [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]], and loot from the base at the coords. They all head to [[District 13]] where Parrot had been constructing an army of his own. After some preparation and an encoring speech, they make their way to the Northern Council. Mapicc gives Spoke a new shield with a banner on it which his friend receives excitedly. Once they reach the Northern Council a battle ensues and at some point Mapicc vanishes.

=== Season 3 ===
Spoke searches for Mapicc frantically as a group of [[Null hunters|bounty hunters]] begin to chase him. Mapicc shows up at Spoke's base invis and wearing a copper helmet, a diamond chestplate, copper leggings, and iron boots, and drinks a milk bucket to reveal himself. 

They use a pearl cannon to get to the farlands in an attempt to stop NULL. They get jumped multiple times and eventually manage to kill a squad of NULL hunters in a dark forest. They enter the fabric of Unstable and run into JamatoP. 

Mapicc is excited but confused at seeing Jamato because he thought he was dead. Jamato provides them all with stuff to regear with and helps them leave the fabric. They get jumped again by some hunters and barely escape into the [[Rainbow Forest|rainbow forest]]. Mapicc remembers his friend and fellow NULL escapee [[Revenant44]] telling him about a stacked group of players that lives there. They are trapped and nearly killed by that group of players. Instead, their leader, [[DylPickleYT]], gives them a compass to a stash to restock. They find the stash in a sand biome full of ravengers, but NULL hunters steal all the stuff. They leave the biome for a jungle-like one which has a group of friendly players lead by one of JumperWho's [[CookieBunsquat|former spies]]. Spoke attemps to jump Jamato. Mapicc chases him down until he pops his friend's totem clearing Spoke's invis. He leaves Spoke, believing his friend to be unsafe and ludicrous. He runs into JamatoP who reveals that [[My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP|Spoke himself tried to kill him not Leo]]. JamatoP likely gives Mapicc new armor. Mapicc runs into Spoke again and attacks his former friend. He breaks [[Alt]] along with the rest of Spoke's armor. NULL appeared, breaks all his new armor and takes him to the nether. 

== Quotes ==
{{Quote|You manipulated me for the entire time...|[[Mapicc]] to [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]| in [[Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players]]}}
{{Quote|No way. The infamous chestplate is gone...|Mapicc to [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]| in [[Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players]]}}

* Mapicc is allowed to freestyle his lines in every video that he's in.

title: Marlowww
content:
Marlowww, or Marlow, is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe, serving as the primary antagonist of Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia. 

 Personality 
Marlow is a dedicated player who is focused on keeping the Mafia Tomb untouched in order to keep every former Mafia member safe, even if she has to kill. She doesn't want to kill anyone but she has to just to keep the Tomb secure, even if it takes sacrificing lives to protect thousands more.

She also has a best friend that supported her when she first joined the server, and really misses to the point where she always wished to meet her again. During her time in the Mafia, she hated it due to not liking how every Mafia member has to stay invisible and wishes they can all just see each other's real faces, including her best friend.
 History 

 Season 1 
When Marlow joined the server, she had a best friend who always protected her during their times together. One day, her friend joined the Invisible Mafia, and wanting to keep her best friend safe, she joined the Mafia to look for her and protect her and every other member.

 Season 2 
After SpokeIsHere defeats the Mafia, Marlow decides to continue staying invisible because she knows about the Tomb of the Mafia, where if a single item is stolen, the rigged stasis chambers within will force every surviving Mafia member into the Void, killing thousands of players instantly. To prevent this from happening, Marlow guards the Tomb herself, killing anyone who tried to enter.

Rasplin steals the key to the gates of the tomb from Marlow, when CoinMonke and the other bandits try breaking through the tomb's gate. Marlow was able to give a blindness effect to everyone including ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird, who were hiding. Once the blindness wore off from everyone, she killed everyone in CoinMonke's group except for Coin. After Parrot, Coin, and Theo escaped from her. She followed them to the End Station, where she killed everyone and shortly after killed Rasplin, taking the key back from him.

Marlowww noticed a bandit called Nightv0ltage9 trying to hide from her and break into the vault and she kills the bandit. Parrot sabotages the key-opening mechanism of the gate and shoots Marlowww with a bow so that TheobaldTheBird can take the key. After Theo got the key, Marlow tried chasing them. Marlow encounters Parrot and Theo in the hallways of the tomb, where she fights Theo. Seeing Theo's selflessness, it reminded her of her best friend's bravery, so she decides to spare Theo and forces him to drop all his gear and then sent him out of the tomb, making it look like to Parrot that Theo died.

After encountering Parrot in the middle of the tomb, she gives the blindness effect to Parrot, but Parrot flies away and hides. A few moments later, she catches Parrot reading her diary. Seeing that Parrot understood what she felt, she decides to show Parrot the thousands of Stasis Chambers that are connected to every former Mafia member.
 Trivia 

 Every time Marlow is about to appear, she always briefly blinds everyone for a few seconds first before appearing. The only instance where she didn't blind before appearing or attacking is after ParrotX2 read her books, possibly signifying her gratitude for Parrot since he now understands Marlow's situation.
 It is currently unknown how she possesses the abilities to do so in the first place, whether by utilizing in-game mechanics or admin commands, however, it could be from the forge as the Mafia went to the Far Lands.
 As mentioned by Parrot, she was commonly known to be the "Best Minecraft Player", dethroning ItzRealMe and being ranked first on the MCTiers PVP Rankings.
 Marlow likes to write books about her feelings and experiences. Her only books that have been shown are Book #1, Book #35, and Book #66.
 Marlow's involvement in the Unstable SMP was hinted at during the Director Arc when her name was listed as one of the suspects for being the Director.

title: Memory Ban
content:
A memory ban is a Minecraft bug that is used to crash servers and revert the server to minutes prior to the memory ban being activated. In Unstable Universe, Memory bans were made by PrinceZam to stop Parrot, Rekrap, Derapchu and JumperWho from breaking Wifies out of a prison.

title: Merchant City
content:
Merchant City is the largest trading town in all of Unstable Universe. It functions as a major, neutral, and secure commercial hub. It serves as a central marketplace where players from various factions on the Unstable SMP can trade, buy, and sell items without the immediate risk of death, doom and despair. The city partakes in trade with ClownPierce, who controls the nether for related materials.

The city contains an outer and inner wall. The furthermost wall spans hundreds of blocks, and houses multiple watch points and entrances. There is a large river that goes through the entire city. title: Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Player Civilization
content:
Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Player Civilization is the 121st episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Wemmbu is about to fight a 1000-player civilization in order to save his best friend eggchan. 

It all starts when egg asks Wemmbu for help as a massive army pulls up to their base and tries to kill them. Wemmbu lures them to a flat surface to orbital strike them, but they were prepared and all splash themselves with turtle master. Egg believes there's only one way to get out of this, which is to turn himself in and get taken as hostage, and so he sacrifices himself. Wemmbu isn't able to bruteforce his way through this army since he doesn't have enough supply and gear to take them on, so he follows the army from behind. Two players spot him and Wemmbu kills them without the rest of the army seeing, he sees that they had turtle master potions, which meant that this army was designed to target him. He then continues to follow the army for a while until they stop and stand in a large circle. Arachn1d_ stands in the middle and talks to the leader of the Sculk Kingdom, driftop99. Arachn1d tells driftop99 they caught eggchan and eventually will be able to capture Wemmbu and if Wemmbu attacks to send a messenger. The two groups split off and Wemmbu follows one that he believes that has egg.

The army goes to a castle that leads underground and leaves a couple guards to keep an eye out. Wemmbu tries to talk to the guards, but they shoot him with their bow. Driftop comes out and Wemmbu demands an explanation on why they kidnapped egg, and driftop says they just felt like it. Wemmbu knows he's lying and driftop is about to get his army to capture Wemmbu, but Wemmbu argues that he's only in protection 2 diamond armor and thinks he's weak for needing an army to take him on, so driftop takes on the 1v1. Wemmbu uses stab shots to quickly drain driftop's armor, driftop then uses the sculk on the ground to mend his armor back up. Wemmbu comes up with an idea and would most likely die if he didn't pull it off, so he pops a turtle master, gets up in driftop's face and stab shots, survives it, and maces driftop when he's low and kills him. Wemmbu grabs the armor pieces right before the guards watching over jump down and start attacking Wemmbu. This causes the army inside to pull a trap that launches wardens right where Wemmbu is standing. Wemmbu kills the guards and the wardens get near him and start attacking him, causing him to flee the area. Wemmbu uses the sculk blocks dropped by driftop to mend the armor. A warden comes closer to Wemmbu, he tries to stab shot himself to launch himself towards the castle, but it fails, so he walks back. 

He walks deeper down the cave and investigates the kingdom built around an ancient city. He overhears yungyx talking to one of the soldiers, the soldier asks why he wants to capture Wemmbu and yungy tells them not to worry about it and to stick with the deal. Wemmbu sneaks around the army that appears to be fishing and enters the large castle, where he thinks egg may be held hostage in. It then switches to egg's POV where he's being interrogated by two people, who only want to know about the abandoned civilization since he's the lore holder of the server. Egg pulls out his journal that holds all the info, the people then force him to give up the journal and then puts him in a cage. When the guards aren't looking, egg breaks out of the cage, but is still stuck on the platform surrounded by lava. Wemmbu keeps trying to get his attention until egg realizes and pearls over to him. Wemmbu stab shots a random location knowing that it goes up to surface. He gets egg to throw a pearl and plans on stab shotting it, but forgets to pull the stab shot. The army is alerted of their presence, Wemmbu kills two guards and gives egg the armor they dropped, he stab shots egg upwards, egg launches up and lands in a river. Wemmbu gets chased around by the army, egg comes back with a handoff, but there's too many people around to drop it. Egg goes in the walls and Wemmbu digs to him. Egg places a shulker box with a full netherite set, stacks of gapples, bottles of exp, breeze rods, and a netherite spear. Wemmbu asks where egg all of this from, egg says he spoke to the Lord Linnwrym, the great sage of the sea. Wemmbu comes out of the walls and starts killing the army with ease. Egg says the same thousand player army is about to come and they should loot now or run, he decides to dig down a few blocks and hide in the middle of the room. Wemmbu asks egg if he's had the gear the entire time and egg says he did only in case of an emergency and didn't know that Wemmbu needed it at the beginning. Wemmbu then pots up, ready to take on the thousand players. 

Wemmbu jumps right in the fight and hears yungy with them and starts to target him. He then pulls a stab shot and kills hundreds of players in a matter of seconds. Yungy instructs his army to break Wemmbu's armor, but with the sheer amount of sculk down there, Wemmbu has no problem repairing his armor back to full durability. Yungy decides to retreat with his army when he sees this battle was unwinnable. A few players of the army stay back, Wemmbu spares their lives if they're there chilling and goes find egg. Egg is back in the cage with his armor off, Wemmbu breaks him out and asks egg to store all of the loot so they can sell later. Egg has no inventory space and Wemmbu realizes the equipment might not even be that good, so they leave.

The last scene ends with BaneC0untry and marine2021, players of the civilization talking, Bane explains how the whole civilization was evacuated, but atleast the two of them survived. The invisible player from the last episode sneaks up on them and blows up marine with a TNT minecart, Bane begs for his life, but is killed right after. The invisible player picks up eggchan's journal from Bane's inventory as the episode ends.

 Trivia 

 Wemmbu, Flame, and Spoke all had issues with their latest videos in some way and mentioned it in their own comments section respectively.
 This is the first time Eggchan's POV can be seen in a video that's not just a screenshot.
 The thumbnail has been changed 2 times
 Wemmbu's OptiFine cape can be seen in the thumbnail.

title: Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Players
content:
Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Players is the 111th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
After Wemmbu had gotten his hands on orbital strike cannons again, he has become the most powerful player on the Unstable SMP once more, ready to take down The Law once and for all. After entering the end portal at the end of the previous video, Wemmbu sees that the end had been reformed into a Law base with lawmen guarding from each side. He kills lawmen to get their gear as his armor was low on durability, dozens of lawmen on the other side of the wall slowly break down the ancient debris separating them, Wemmbu runs the other way with the lawmen on his side still chasing after him. He pulls a fishing rod expecting an orbital strike cannon to pop out, but suddenly realizes that the cannons only worked in the overworld, with no other option, he has to figure out how to escape. He reunites with eggchan and they start to run upwards into the base. Wemmbu drops down and goes back up at another part of the base, egg awaits him there and leads him towards a bridge that he built in the meantime. Wemmbu breaks the bridge as they cross as the lawmen bridges towards them. Wemmbu bows the lawmen to give them some time, he spots an ice bridge below them and tells egg to bridge over. They drop downwards and Wemmbu breaks the ice, which causes the entire bridge to break and turn into water, Wemmbu tells egg to riptide trident over the gap and they manage to get away for now.

With a few stragglers on the outer end islands with them, Wemmbu pots up and kills the lawmen for their armor. They walk out more in hopes of finding MinuteTech, but thinks Minute may have left the End. As they wander, Wemmbu talks about how him and Minute had a similar situation with the portal being guarded. Egg says Baablu told him about that plan and mentioned stashes he placed inside of the End to ensure that he didn't fail again. Wemmbu asks egg if he knew the locations of it, egg says he wrote one of them down. Egg looks through his books and says the stash is stored at 10k, 10k, which was a short journey from where they were now. Nearing the coordinates, they spot a house built that's glowing. The outer end islands stop forming and they're forced to bridge out. They get closer to the build and see Minute sitting there. Wemmbu says they need to borrow a stash, Minute says this wasn't the stash, but rather his temporary house, then asks how they got into the End if they were being hunted. Wemmbu says it wasn't a good idea for Minute to give up the End, Minute says Lettuce told him his plan of bringing peace to the main overworld, but hadn't been there himself to see it, but believes it was for a better cause. Wemmbu reveals to Minute that Lettuce is worse than he thought by attempting to kill candidates, rigging the election, and much more. Minute realizes that he's been blindsighted, he doesn't fully believe Wemmbu, but still goes on to trust him. He still gives Wemmbu the direction of the stash, he says after they'll go back to the main end island together, and if The Law reacts to Wemmbu like the way he's explained them to be, then he'll believe the story. Minute gives Wemmbu rockets as the stash requires an Elytra to get there and explains the stash is under a chorus fruit at a specific coordinate. Wemmbu finds the island the stash is at and counts the branches, but sees the bottom of the center one glowing. As soon as he breaks the last block he's standing on top of, an observer sets off TNT, Wemmbu quickly mines the blocks facing north and opens a chest with two shulker boxes full of items and Elytras up before TNT blows up the entire island. 

Wemmbu flies back to the island with Minute and egg and share the stash between the three of them. Minute asks what their plan was before coming there and Wemmbu explains that he tried to use his orbital cannons but wasn't able to do so, so the next step was to go back to spawn in order to use the orbitals. Minute dislikes the idea of banning tons of players, so he wants to take the fight away from spawn where there's only lawmen. As they make their journey back to the main end island, a flashback plays with Wemmbu and Parrot before Wemmbu used the ender pearl cannon back to the Far Lands, Parrot explains that Wemmbu will feel unstoppable with orbitals in his hands again, but he won't be able to take down The Law through bruteforce, Lettuce has won by blackmailing and manipulation to beat people and tells Wemmbu to be smart about it. The flashback ends, they make it back to the start of the outer end islands, Wemmbu tells egg to stay back while Wemmbu and Minute kill the lawmen. Wemmbu distracts the lawmen and kills them while Minute makes a safe tunnel for egg to go through later, he sees TheG0dofWar, the commander that egg had mentioned earlier that was incredibly strong, but instantly pops his totem expecting him to be better. He sees egg at the main island and asks why he came, egg said the signal was activated so he came, Wemmbu tells him it's still in the works. Wemmbu gets egg to go on the high ground so Minute can protect him, the lawmen switch their focus onto Wemmbu, he goes to a safe location to mend his armor before reentering the battle. Minute says the path has been made and needs to go up onto the main tower, but egg's pearls keep going the wrong direction, so they have to direct him to the right tower. They get on top of the main tower and Minute tells them to go to the other tower across from them with the wood on top, Wemmbu pearls over and gives egg Minute's Elytra, Minute arrives shortly after and Wemmbu gives him his Elytra back, Minute tells them to follow him once he places wood underneath the island, and they do so. TheG0dofWar finds them and begins to attack them, Wemmbu tells the two to keep going without him, Wemmbu kites TheG0dofWar around and manages to lose him quickly and flies underneath the island and meets back up with Minute and egg. They all pearl through the end portal and go back to spawn.

At spawn, the lawmen don't realize that they had gone through and is shown to be killing the random players with no armor instead. TheG0dofWar shows up, Wemmbu thinks about sending an orbital, but Minute reminds him to not use it around the civilians. Egg tells them they can use the obsidian highway, Wemmbu starts using his stab shots to try and kill the lawmen, he tells egg to hide inside of the wall while him and Minute go and restock. While they're restocking, Minute hears someone take damage above them and looks up to be TheG0dofWar, who says his sheckles has been set free. Wemmbu laughs at him and the two begin to fight him. They get him cobwebbed underground and Wemmbu pulls multiple stab shots on him, but didn't pop a single totem. Wemmbu's leggings and shield breaks, Minute gives him a new shield and more rockets, he tells Wemmbu to leave, but not to kill Lettuce. Wemmbu flies towards the Northern Council, hundreds of lawmen await his arrival, Wemmbu sets off an orbital and kills off a bunch of lawmen in one. The fight goes on and Wemmbu uses more of his orbitals and nuke shots while macing them too. After a few more orbitals and stab shots, Wemmbu manages to kill off the entire army of lawmen and flies into the Northern Council, Lettuce stands right in the middle. Wemmbu asks if Lettuce had given up and thinks he's too scared to fight with his army, Lettuce says he was just observing. Wemmbu says to give his army better armor next time, as if there will be a next time. Lettuce says he wanted to see if he could use something, Wemmbu asks what that means, and Lettuce reveals that he has Jaden's life on the line if he pulled the fishing rod in his hand.
