They drop downwards and Wemmbu breaks the ice, which causes the entire bridge to break and turn into water, Wemmbu tells egg to riptide trident over the gap and they manage to get away for now.

With a few stragglers on the outer end islands with them, Wemmbu pots up and kills the lawmen for their armor. They walk out more in hopes of finding [[MinuteTech]], but thinks Minute may have left the End. As they wander, Wemmbu talks about how him and Minute had a [[How I SAVED the Unstable SMP|similar situation]] with the portal being guarded. Egg says Baablu told him about that plan and mentioned stashes he placed inside of the End to ensure that he didn't fail again. Wemmbu asks egg if he knew the locations of it, egg says he wrote one of them down. Egg looks through his books and says the stash is stored at 10k, 10k, which was a short journey from where they were now. Nearing the coordinates, they spot a house built that's glowing. The outer end islands stop forming and they're forced to bridge out. They get closer to the build and see Minute sitting there. Wemmbu says they need to borrow a stash, Minute says this wasn't the stash, but rather his temporary house, then asks how they got into the End if they were being hunted. Wemmbu says it wasn't a good idea for Minute to give up the End, Minute says [[LettuceK|Lettuce]] told him his plan of bringing peace to the main overworld, but hadn't been there himself to see it, but believes it was for a better cause. Wemmbu reveals to Minute that Lettuce is worse than he thought by attempting to kill candidates, rigging the election, and much more. Minute realizes that he's been blindsighted, he doesn't fully believe Wemmbu, but still goes on to trust him. He still gives Wemmbu the direction of the stash, he says after they'll go back to the main end island together, and if The Law reacts to Wemmbu like the way he's explained them to be, then he'll believe the story. Minute gives Wemmbu rockets as the stash requires an Elytra to get there and explains the stash is under a chorus fruit at a specific coordinate. Wemmbu finds the island the stash is at and counts the branches, but sees the bottom of the center one glowing. As soon as he breaks the last block he's standing on top of, an observer sets off TNT, Wemmbu quickly mines the blocks facing north and opens a chest with two shulker boxes full of items and Elytras up before TNT blows up the entire island. 

Wemmbu flies back to the island with Minute and egg and share the stash between the three of them. Minute asks what their plan was before coming there and Wemmbu explains that he tried to use his orbital cannons but wasn't able to do so, so the next step was to go back to spawn in order to use the orbitals. Minute dislikes the idea of banning tons of players, so he wants to take the fight away from spawn where there's only lawmen. As they make their journey back to the main end island, a flashback plays with Wemmbu and [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] before Wemmbu used the ender pearl cannon back to the [[Far Lands]], Parrot explains that Wemmbu will feel unstoppable with orbitals in his hands again, but he won't be able to take down The Law through bruteforce, Lettuce has won by blackmailing and manipulation to beat people and tells Wemmbu to be smart about it. The flashback ends, they make it back to the start of the outer end islands, Wemmbu tells egg to stay back while Wemmbu and Minute kill the lawmen. Wemmbu distracts the lawmen and kills them while Minute makes a safe tunnel for egg to go through later, he sees [[G0dOfWar|TheG0dofWar]], the commander that egg had mentioned earlier that was incredibly strong, but instantly pops his totem expecting him to be better. He sees egg at the main island and asks why he came, egg said the signal was activated so he came, Wemmbu tells him it's still in the works. Wemmbu gets egg to go on the high ground so Minute can protect him, the lawmen switch their focus onto Wemmbu, he goes to a safe location to mend his armor before reentering the battle. Minute says the path has been made and needs to go up onto the main tower, but egg's pearls keep going the wrong direction, so they have to direct him to the right tower. They get on top of the main tower and Minute tells them to go to the other tower across from them with the wood on top, Wemmbu pearls over and gives egg Minute's Elytra, Minute arrives shortly after and Wemmbu gives him his Elytra back, Minute tells them to follow him once he places wood underneath the island, and they do so. TheG0dofWar finds them and begins to attack them, Wemmbu tells the two to keep going without him, Wemmbu kites TheG0dofWar around and manages to lose him quickly and flies underneath the island and meets back up with Minute and egg. They all pearl through the end portal and go back to spawn.

At spawn, the lawmen don't realize that they had gone through and is shown to be killing the random players with no armor instead. TheG0dofWar shows up, Wemmbu thinks about sending an orbital, but Minute reminds him to not use it around the civilians. Egg tells them they can use the obsidian highway, Wemmbu starts using his stab shots to try and kill the lawmen, he tells egg to hide inside of the wall while him and Minute go and restock. While they're restocking, Minute hears someone take damage above them and looks up to be TheG0dofWar, who says his sheckles has been set free. Wemmbu laughs at him and the two begin to fight him. They get him cobwebbed underground and Wemmbu pulls multiple stab shots on him, but didn't pop a single totem. Wemmbu's leggings and shield breaks, Minute gives him a new shield and more rockets, he tells Wemmbu to leave, but not to kill Lettuce. Wemmbu flies towards the [[Northern Council]], hundreds of lawmen await his arrival, Wemmbu sets off an orbital and kills off a bunch of lawmen in one. The fight goes on and Wemmbu uses more of his orbitals and nuke shots while macing them too. After a few more orbitals and stab shots, Wemmbu manages to kill off the entire army of lawmen and flies into the Northern Council, Lettuce stands right in the middle. Wemmbu asks if Lettuce had given up and thinks he's too scared to fight with his army, Lettuce says he was just observing. Wemmbu says to give his army better armor next time, as if there will be a next time. Lettuce says he wanted to see if he could use something, Wemmbu asks what that means, and Lettuce reveals that he has [[Jaden MAN|Jaden]]'s life on the line if he pulled the fishing rod in his hand.

title: Minecraft Trapper VS 1000 Players
content:
Minecraft Trapper VS 1000 Players is the 110th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode begins with Spoke writing a message to the players of the Unstable SMP, challenging them all to a duel, giving them all a chance of revenge and to capture him for all his crimes. He ends the book off with the coordinates to his location with Mapicc and PrinceZam. Zam thinks this is a bad idea when they're on top of a mountain in the middle of nowhere, Spoke said he specifically told them to bring everything they have, even Mapicc said he doesn't think they can take on all thousand players despite being geared. Spoke compares this fight to Wemmbu and Flame's battle against the thousand players, but says it's worse because Leow0ok is commanding all of the players. Spoke shows Zam and Mapicc shows a secret base of command that has everything they needed to survive and has maps of every biome surrounding the one they are in, which has also been rigged with hundreds of traps per biome. Spoke shows them a sculk powered sensor that detected which direction the lawmen were coming from, and while they decorate their rooms, the sensor goes off. Since Spoke knows all the locations of the traps, he decides to go out himself and sets an ender pearl stasis chamber and tells Zam and Mapicc to stay at the base. The reason why he decided to keep them there is because someone used Spoke's stasis from the previous episode and used it against him and hid the truth from them.

The senor detected players coming from the dark oak forest, which had traps that were designed to blend in with the terrain, but had to be used within a short distance. Spoke drinks invis and sees a glimpse of the lawmen and takes off his armor. Spoke assumed Leo tasked them to scout and slip through his defenses, however this was further from the truth. Spoke finds a lone lawman that sees a fall trap and knocks them into it, he then puts his armor back on and dives into the army and activates his secret TNT minecarts hidden in the mushrooms. The lawmen start burning down the forest to deactivate all of Spoke's traps, which worked out. The scouts retreat and Spoke goes to set up more traps when all of a sudden he spots an invisible scout spying on him. A chase ensues and Spoke gets trapped by a 8x8 fall trap, but manages to save himself by clutching halfway down. Spoke looks up and sees that the player that he was chasing was no ordinary lawman, a flashback is shown where Spoke's stasis is pulled into the base shown earlier, he wonders why he got teleported there and why the three invisible people don't kill him right there and asks who they are. The main person with trims on their armor drinks milk and reveals themselves to be JumperWho. He then realizes that Jumper was the one who deactivated his traps and built the beacons that led him to Leo, and especially the fact that she was the one that fought Leo. Spoke feels like Jumper would still try and kill Spoke despite their history, Jumper says she followed Spoke and his friends through the Nether and saw that they built an ender pearl stasis chamber. Spoke says Jumper has no more leverage on Spoke after pulling the pearl, but Jumper says she needs Spoke's help. She says they have one thing in common: they both want Leo dead, but for different reasons. Jumper dislikes the fact that Leo has been using spies as soldiers rather than actually using them for spying. Spoke says he's been doing fine and has a plan to kill Leo on his own and tells Jumper to not contact him again and forces them to leave his new base. Back to the present, Spoke says Jumper said so much about wanting to team and chose to attempt to kill him, Jumper vaguely responds back. Spoke reminds Jumper that he's fine on his own, Jumper says Spoke doesn't know half the amount of players that are hunting him down and that he won't be able to with her help. Jumper says she's only trying to keep him alive and Spoke says, "Is that so?" before pulling the TNT minecart with his fishing rod, causing it to blow up on Jumper and her spies. Spoke eats a chorus fruit and teleports down to the bottom of the trap and into a cave, he digs down all the way to bedrock while Jumper and her spies try to look for him. Zam pulls Spoke's stasis back to safety. While Spoke was gone, Zam and Mapicc found a hidden room that was blocked off, with an enchantment room and chests full of loot, Spoke knows this base was built by Jumper and that she wants to help, but he felt like he couldn't take anymore risks. Zam and Mapicc want to show off their rooms, and while they go over there, Spoke remembers that Jumper still had a hold of Zam and Mapicc's stasis somewhere, and that they were safer inside of the base than anywhere else and that Spoke and Leo's battle would have to stay between them. Spoke decides to go out again and sets a stasis, Zam and Mapicc wants to go out with Spoke because they're bored of staying inside of the base doing nothing, but Spoke gives them tasks to do.

Spoke leaves the base and goes towards the birch biome, which had dangerous traps such as landmines set up underneath the trees. Mapicc and Zam show up to the forest and meets up with Spoke, saying that Spoke left a book for them saying to come and that he changed his mind about leaving them behind. Spoke realizes Jumper left the book and tells them it's a dangerous biome to be in and that they needed to return back to the base, Zam accidentally triggers a landmine and they see why Spoke had a stasis. In the distance, a bunch of lawmen come and start to chase them, Spoke uses a spleef trap and gets a few kills off before running more. The landmines detonate as the lawmen follow them, removing a good percentage of the remaining lawmen. They make it to the most dangerous part of the biome, it appears to be a mined out chunk all the way down to the void, all three of them jump down to the side where beds are placed, reducing fall damage, while the rest lawmen fell down to their death. Despite what Spoke feared, he then realized that having his friends with him worked out and that there were no lawmen to go report back to Leo. Back at the base, Zam asks what the book was all about and Spoke vaguely answers that the stalker is still watching them and leaves it at that. He then changes the topic by saying they haven't seen Leo at all and says he has a way to find Leo. On surface, Spoke says they're going to find stragglers. Spoke comes from behind on a lawman and traps them in cobwebs. The three of them interrogate the lawman and asks for where Leo is at, but they say they don't know a Leow0ok and only knows a LettuceK. Spoke says he has the lawman's closest friends captured and will spare them if they say anything about Leo. The lawman reveals that Leo is building something inside of a different snow biome, and Spoke ends up killing them right after.

Spoke, Zam, and Mapicc arrive at the snowy biome and see a small base built there. Zam says he's ready for a fight, but Spoke says it's annoying to deal with all the lawmen and would rather use the traps to reduce the amount of lawmen before facing Leo. The three of them pot up and stand in front of the base, Leo and the lawmen stand top of the walls. Spoke teases Leo by saying he's already lost a good amount of his army and to finish off the three of them while they're weak. Leo takes the bait and pearls in and starts attacking Spoke. Leo instructs the lawmen to target Spoke, but the lawmen keep chasing after all three of them, where they detonate the TNT minecarts underneath the roses, killing off almost everyone. Leo brings out the second wave of lawmen that was hiding inside of the base, the three of them use up the remaining landmines and kills all of them too. With the rest of the army dead, Leo begins to target Zam after seeing that he's in full diamond compared to Spoke and Mapicc who are in full netherite. Leo uses a TNT minecart on Zam, popping his totem, and webs Zam and is about to kill him. Jumper comes from behind a tree in full invis, splashes Zam with turtle master, wind charges right where a dandelion is placed, and ten charged creepers come flying out of the ground, popping Leo's totem. 

Jumper reveals herself to everyone, and Leo says that she just saved Zam's life and asks if she knew she was trying to kill him. Jumper says she knew, and Leo says she's stupid for trying to kill him and mentions that leaving the election was a bad idea and now attempting to kill him. Leo argues that Jumper thinks BAT has changed when it hasn't and that he's trying to kill off one of their bounties, being Spoke. Jumper says Leo is corrupt in the way he's doing it and says that he's been using her spies for the wrong purpose and that he changed the way BAT has been, and that he's slowly turning into Lettuce, someone that's pure evil. Spoke comes up and talks, he says they're not trying to work with Jumper and brings up the piston trap she pulled on him, how she's the one that stalked them in the Amplified, and that she still has ahold of Zam and Mapicc's pearls. Spoke and Leo get riled up, they begin to pot back up and a fight starts between all of them. Spoke attacks both Jumper and Leo, while Jumper only wants to kill Leo, Leo's trying to fight off all four of them, and Zam and Mapicc are focused on Leo. Leo's armor begins to break and he uses an Elytra to fly away. Spoke doesn't have his Elytra in his inventory and looks through his ender chest to get it, but he doesn't chase. Spoke sees Jumper still there and yells at her, Jumper doesn't understand why Spoke is mad at her when she's only been trying to help. Spoke questions why she didn't chase Leo if she also had an Elytra on her, Jumper reveals that she's fought Leo before and almost died, and if she continued to chase, it would end in the same outcome as before. Spoke says he wouldn't let Jumper join his team when she's tried to kill him in the past and doesn't trust her at all. Jumper tries to address the things Spoke has accused her of, but Spoke doesn't let her and says the entire time Jumper's been setting up traps in case he betrays, that she has his friend's pearls just incase he's threat, and asks what makes her any different than Leo. Jumper says how Leo has sent thousands of players in battle to die, killed a bunch of people, and says she's a better person than Spoke. Spoke speaks up and questions why Jumper would want his help when there's better players for this mission, Jumper says she chose Spoke because they have the same motivation to take down Leo and that the entire server has to take down the alliance between Lettuce and Leo, and it all starts with them working together to take down Leo first. She then pots invis and flies away. Zam thinks that she's in the right because she has the same goals as us, but Mapicc argues that she has their pearls and has their lives in her hands. Zam doesn't know why they don't trust her, Spoke, after being silent this whole time, speaks up and says Jumper isn't as one-dimensional as she portrays herself, and he's seen moments where she's been genuine and where she has lied. He does believe that Jumper is trying to kill Leo, but doesn't understand why she chose the three of them to help. Spoke says they need more answers if they want any chance to defeat the army and needs to figure out where the main camp is, but needs to handle the problem of Jumper first. Spoke reveals that the direction Jumper went is the way the desert biome is, where Spoke had set up the most intricate traps yet and plans on trapping Jumper. Zam asks why Spoke kept the fact that Jumper had their pearls from them, Spoke says when he learned Jumper was the stalker, that anyone affiliated with him could be compromised and was scared.

Spoke is shown setting up a stasis while they make it to the desert biome. When they make it to the desert biome, Spoke gets all three of them to stand on their own corner of a sandstone block, revealing that there's a massive sand trap right below their feet and waits for Jumper to show up. In the distance, they see lawmen coming to their location rather than Jumper. Spoke says they can't activate the trap just yet and has to fend off for now. Spoke doesn't have the armor durability to fight off all of the lawmen, so he decides to pull the trap and kill off most of the lawmen. While the three are fighting off the rest of the lawmen, Jumper pulls Spoke's stasis. Spoke turns slowly and looks at Jumper, he says  he was hoping that he would be sent to a death trap or right in front of Leo, and that she had multiple chances to kill him and his friends and asks why she hadn't yet. Spoke asks why if Jumper wanted to make a team to stand against The Law would she come to him first when she knew he'd act like this, Jumper admits she didn't want to necessarily work with Spoke despite his past and that the person closest to being able to kill with Leo was Spoke and that was the reason why  Jumper came to him. Jumper says that there used to be so much more skillful and intelligent spies, but when Leo came along, they were all put into battle and the tradition died off, and mentions if  Leo and Lettuce continued to work together and conquer the server like they plan to, to imagine how much more would be taken from everybody else. Spoke says he doesn't know what he can do, Jumper says he can work with her and tells him to follow her. Spoke sets another stasis before following. Jumper builds up to the map and walks through the map, behind it is all black with a chain bridge that leads to a drop into the void. Jumper gives Spoke rockets and they begin flying underneath the bedrock to another hole in the bedrock. On the other side, they make it to a cave with names above them. They go invisible and go up, where another part of the cave has been mined out, they climb up more and overhear Leo asking if the machine is ready. Behold Spoke's eyes is a railgun that's facing the direction of Spoke's base. Leo talks to his lawmen and reveals that there are three other railguns ready to be used. Leo counts down and activates the railgun, it explodes through each side of the bunker, and Spoke's stasis is pulled by Zam and Mapicc. They say that the base was blown up multiple times, Spoke says that the lawmen will be coming from all sides at any moment and that they were never going to come from the surface. Jumper comes from one of the tunnels and says this was the opportunity to kill Leo, but Zam thinks running away was a better idea. Jumper says they can quickly prepare while they're coming and asks if the redstone had been blown up. They go to check and see that the materials hadn't been blown up, and Spoke says they can build something, but have to start building it immediately. They build a mini railgun contraption that blows up hundreds of lawmen from each direction, then start towering up to escape. Spoke, Jumper, and Mapicc all manage to escape, but Zam gets stuck down in the base while the lawmen attack him. Spoke remembers that Jumper still has his ender pearl, so they quickly run to the location and set it off, saving Zam's life.

All four of them escape the battlefield and Spoke thinks back of when he first wrote his declaration of war, he never thought it would end with him siding with somebody he once considered an enemy. He realizes that if he wanted to kill Leo, he'd only be able to do so with Jumper's help. As they fly away on a happy ghast, Spoke asks Jumper what's the next plan to save the server, Jumper says they have to recruit more people and asks Spoke if he had anyone in mind. Spoke tells them that there's a certain mace wielder on the server they have to pay a visit to.

 Trivia 

 A lot of the traps used in this video were inspired by JudeLow's video against 500 hunters.

Jumper says Leo is corrupt in the way he's doing it and says that he's been using her spies for the wrong purpose and that he changed the way BAT has been, and that he's slowly turning into Lettuce, someone that's pure evil. Spoke comes up and talks, he says they're not trying to work with Jumper and brings up the piston trap she pulled on him, how she's the one that stalked them in the [[The Amplified|Amplified]], and that she still has ahold of Zam and Mapicc's pearls. Spoke and Leo get riled up, they begin to pot back up and a fight starts between all of them. Spoke attacks both Jumper and Leo, while Jumper only wants to kill Leo, Leo's trying to fight off all four of them, and Zam and Mapicc are focused on Leo. Leo's armor begins to break and he uses an Elytra to fly away. Spoke doesn't have his Elytra in his inventory and looks through his ender chest to get it, but he doesn't chase. Spoke sees Jumper still there and yells at her, Jumper doesn't understand why Spoke is mad at her when she's only been trying to help. Spoke questions why she didn't chase Leo if she also had an Elytra on her, Jumper reveals that she's fought Leo before and almost died, and if she continued to chase, it would end in the same outcome as before. Spoke says he wouldn't let Jumper join his team when she's tried to kill him in the past and doesn't trust her at all. Jumper tries to address the things Spoke has accused her of, but Spoke doesn't let her and says the entire time Jumper's been setting up traps in case he betrays, that she has his friend's pearls just incase he's threat, and asks what makes her any different than Leo. Jumper says how Leo has sent thousands of players in battle to die, killed a bunch of people, and says she's a better person than Spoke. Spoke speaks up and questions why Jumper would want his help when there's better players for this mission, Jumper says she chose Spoke because they have the same motivation to take down Leo and that the entire server has to take down the alliance between Lettuce and Leo, and it all starts with them working together to take down Leo first. She then pots invis and flies away. Zam thinks that she's in the right because she has the same goals as us, but Mapicc argues that she has their pearls and has their lives in her hands. Zam doesn't know why they don't trust her, Spoke, after being silent this whole time, speaks up and says Jumper isn't as one-dimensional as she portrays herself, and he's seen moments where she's been genuine and where she has lied. He does believe that Jumper is trying to kill Leo, but doesn't understand why she chose the three of them to help. Spoke says they need more answers if they want any chance to defeat the army and needs to figure out where the main camp is, but needs to handle the problem of Jumper first. Spoke reveals that the direction Jumper went is the way the desert biome is, where Spoke had set up the most intricate traps yet and plans on trapping Jumper. Zam asks why Spoke kept the fact that Jumper had their pearls from them, Spoke says when he learned Jumper was the stalker, that anyone affiliated with him could be compromised and was scared.

Spoke is shown setting up a stasis while they make it to the desert biome. When they make it to the desert biome, Spoke gets all three of them to stand on their own corner of a sandstone block, revealing that there's a massive sand trap right below their feet and waits for Jumper to show up. In the distance, they see lawmen coming to their location rather than Jumper. Spoke says they can't activate the trap just yet and has to fend off for now. Spoke doesn't have the armor durability to fight off all of the lawmen, so he decides to pull the trap and kill off most of the lawmen. While the three are fighting off the rest of the lawmen, Jumper pulls Spoke's stasis. Spoke turns slowly and looks at Jumper, he says  he was hoping that he would be sent to a death trap or right in front of Leo, and that she had multiple chances to kill him and his friends and asks why she hadn't yet. Spoke asks why if Jumper wanted to make a team to stand against [[The Law]] would she come to him first when she knew he'd act like this, Jumper admits she didn't want to necessarily work with Spoke despite his past and that the person closest to being able to kill with Leo was Spoke and that was the reason why  Jumper came to him. Jumper says that there used to be so much more skillful and intelligent spies, but when Leo came along, they were all put into battle and the tradition died off, and mentions if  Leo and Lettuce continued to work together and conquer the server like they plan to, to imagine how much more would be taken from everybody else. Spoke says he doesn't know what he can do, Jumper says he can work with her and tells him to follow her. Spoke sets another stasis before following. Jumper builds up to the map and walks through the map, behind it is all black with a chain bridge that leads to a drop into the void. Jumper gives Spoke rockets and they begin flying underneath the bedrock to another hole in the bedrock. On the other side, they make it to a cave with names above them. They go invisible and go up, where another part of the cave has been mined out, they climb up more and overhear Leo asking if the machine is ready. Behold Spoke's eyes is a railgun that's facing the direction of Spoke's base. Leo talks to his lawmen and reveals that there are three other railguns ready to be used. Leo counts down and activates the railgun, it explodes through each side of the bunker, and Spoke's stasis is pulled by Zam and Mapicc. They say that the base was blown up multiple times, Spoke says that the lawmen will be coming from all sides at any moment and that they were never going to come from the surface. Jumper comes from one of the tunnels and says this was the opportunity to kill Leo, but Zam thinks running away was a better idea. Jumper says they can quickly prepare while they're coming and asks if the redstone had been blown up. They go to check and see that the materials hadn't been blown up, and Spoke says they can build something, but have to start building it immediately. They build a mini railgun contraption that blows up hundreds of lawmen from each direction, then start towering up to escape. Spoke, Jumper, and Mapicc all manage to escape, but Zam gets stuck down in the base while the lawmen attack him. Spoke remembers that Jumper still has his ender pearl, so they quickly run to the location and set it off, saving Zam's life.

All four of them escape the battlefield and Spoke thinks back of when he first wrote his declaration of war, he never thought it would end with him siding with somebody he once considered an enemy. He realizes that if he wanted to kill Leo, he'd only be able to do so with Jumper's help. As they fly away on a happy ghast, Spoke asks Jumper what's the next plan to save the server, Jumper says they have to recruit more people and asks Spoke if he had anyone in mind. Spoke tells them that there's a certain mace wielder on the server they have to pay a visit to.

== Trivia ==

* A lot of the traps used in this video were inspired by JudeLow's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uEjeO0a7rEk video] against 500 hunters.

title: Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters
content:
Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters is the 119th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode begins with Spoke inside of his base enchanting, when all of a sudden his alarm alerted him of players nearby. Spoke assumes it was bandits and would have them go through his traps first, but they turned out to be more dangerous than he thought. Skinless players with jumbled names came barging in and dodge the first trap, run into the base and attack Spoke. This isn't a fight Spoke can take on, so he kites all of the hunters into the middle of the base and sets off a piston trap and drops all of them down on dripstone. Spoke wind charges a lever which activates a stasis, pulling JumperWho and her spies to investigate, as there were no death messages. Spoke believes that someone had hired these hunters to go after him, but doesn't know how to fight them if they don't fear death. Jumper says she's seen them, but doesn't know anything about the hunters. And even with her spies, there had no leads to figuring out who they are. Spoke packs up his base and Jumper gives him a paper with coordinates to a safehouse, but he doesn't take it if Jumper isn't going to work on the mission on finding Mapicc. 

Spoke goes invisible and wanders off into the wilderness of the Unstable SMP. He talks to the viewers and explains that he hasn't seen Mapicc in over four weeks and after searching around for a few days, he hired Jumper and her spies to help. He says what was strange about the hunters was that they carried a shield with the same pattern as the one Mapicc gave him before the big battle against The Law. He goes closer to spawn to find more bases to camp in temporarily, finds a secret one in a mountain, and kills the person living there before him for being a hazard. He quickly realizes that was a bad idea since it would be shown to anyone nearby, and so he sets up a TNT minecart trap right above the entrance. He waits and sees the hunters coming closer, and when they enter the tunnel leading into the base, Spoke activates the trap, several hunters get their totems popped and they vanish instantly. Spoke escapes from the base with the remaining hunters chasing after him. The hunters have speed, which covers more horizontal ground and Spoke uses this to his advantage and uses pearls and his trident to get a lead from them. Spoke breaks into somebody's house and restocks, the hunters come shortly after and kill off the resident living there. He tries to leave the base fully invis, but the hunters see him and foils his plan. Spoke still manages to make it out and uses blue ice to gain speed and outrun them, and with no other choice, he decides to go to the coordinates to the safehouse. Spoke then decides to tower up and Elytra the rest of the way there. Although he dislikes using the Elytra, he thought it was necessary since it was an emergency. 

Only 200 blocks away, Spoke hides in a mountain quickly to use the bathroom and enables sneak toggle and lets the hunters run by. He inches closer and closer to the safehouse, but the hunters are tailing right behind him. Spoke enters the house, which seemed abandoned, but then spies come up from the ground and start fighting the hunters, giving Spoke time to escape. Jumper was also at the house and the two leave together as the hunters are distracted. Spoke asks if this was the safehouse, but Jumper said it wasn't and that it was just a house. As they run, the leader of the group, _1_88_____x chases after them, but then loses them after getting to the escape tunnel. At the end of the escape tunnel is the real safehouse, and Jumper instructs Spoke to stay inside of it until she and her spies handle it. Spoke says they don't know how the hunters work and he's seen it work in the past and says they're unkillable. However, Spoke knows a trap that can kill someone even with a totem and says that it's already built and will show Jumper it if he wasn't held hostage inside of the base they were standing inside of. 

They arrive at the trap, which turns out to be the same arrow railgun cannon they built inside in a previous episode. Spoke explains that you can trick the game into shooting it milliseconds after the first shot, and that it looks like there's three shots all in one. Jumper asks Spoke how he knows if killing them would stop this, but Spoke says it may not, but it would get a closer lead on figuring out where Mapicc is. Spoke brings up how Jumper had seen them before and asks what she saw, Jumper tells Spoke that she followed them along with her spies followed one of the hunters and based on what they found, they have a reason to believe Mapicc is still alive. She goes on and says how one of her traders went missing, so she went to the trader's base and saw the exact same hunters, so she followed the hunters for thousands of blocks, when all of a sudden, they'd stop moving and look into the distance. She got closer to get a better view of what happened and saw an armless player and they all started walking in a straight line. It was revealed that there was a bounty on that armless player's head and an hour later it was claimed and that they were dead, three hours before she saw that player marching. Spoke now understands that they're trying to break all of his armor to do the same thing to him. Spoke thinks this is a bigger threat than trying to find Mapicc and wants to put an end to this and wants to help out. 

As they walk to their destination, Jumper explains their targets have all had bounties on their heads, Spoke included, and Jumper went to Merchant City and kidnapped the person responsible for this. She says the person doesn't want to talk to Jumper or her spies, but was willing to talk to Spoke. They make it to the location and Jumper breaks a block, revealing a ladder going underground into an obsidian tunnel. Multiple spies guard the entire thing, and once they reach the obsidian box that holds the person, a guard breaks the obsidian, allowing Spoke and Jumper inside. The person that's responsible for this is SirPig_, former mayor of Capital City. He tells Jumper to leave and that everything is between him and Spoke. Spoke confronts SirPig and asks what he knows about the hunters, but SirPig says he has no idea. Spoke tries to bribe him to tell him information, but SirPig tells Spoke to stop worrying about him and start worrying about himself. Spoke says he's trying to work with him and asks for any clues, but all SirPig says is that all they asked for was a token to prove Spoke was dead as the chestplate gifted to him. Spoke asks for a name one last time or else SirPig dies, SirPig then pulls a fishing rod and stasises out. 

Spoke hears dozens of people right outside the box and tons of hunters come in and start attacking him. Jumper comes to help him get out, they get onto the surface, but the hunters make it up before them. Spoke tries to wind charge and pearl to get the hunters off their tail, but the hunters, specifically their leader, catch up quickly. The firework rockets shred through their armor and their resources slowly drain. Spoke tells Jumper he has a way to escape, but she won't be able to catch up and tells her to escape on her own for now. Spoke goes on top of a hill full invis and spots Jumper coming up, he quickly asks for an ender chest and grabs an invis potion from a shulker box. He splashes the both of them with invis and they go full invis and hide in a tree, losing track of the hunters. Jumper says her spies are in formation and they need to go activate the trap. The hunters stand looking at Spoke and Jumper, and as they get closer, Jumper commands her spies to come out. The spies serve as a distraction for the hunters. Spoke's armor starts to break, only having his chestplate and a turtle helmet left. Spoke and Jumper run from the fight with the leader, the only one chasing after them. As they near the trap, Spoke tells Jumper to get there first and he'll be there after. Spoke makes it to the house and kites the hunter around as Jumper prepares the trap. Once the trap is set up, Spoke runs towards it and wind charges above, and Jumper sets off the trap and kills them in an instant. Their inventory is scattered all over the floor, and Spoke picks up a book named "mission: null".

 Trivia 

 The shield that both Spoke and the bounty hunters use is illegal to make in survival Minecraft. In survival, it only allows players to put six patterns, but this shield uses nine or ten, and is only obtainable using command blocks, as even using chat to type in the command is too long.
 In the comment section of the video, Spoke says that he got sick and the video was originally meant to be aired a week earlier. 
 Throughout the video, Spoke can be seen visibly in danger whenever he's near roses, which hints that the death of iMajesticRose is what's been haunting him.

title: Minor Characters
content:
Minor Characters: A Small Explanation 
Minor characters, in the context of the Unstable Universe, are characters that are barely plot relevant, yet have been documented here anyways.

 How to Tell if the Character You Want To Add to the Wiki is Minor: 
Ask yourself these questions:

 Does this character have a youtube channel?
 Does this character show up often/have a lot of screen time?
 Does this character have a mic?
 Does this character have an inportant role in the plot? If so, is it important enough to add more than a single bullet point or side note?
 Does this character have enough info for at least a paragraph's worth of text?
 They appear in big fights or in the background and just die or do nothing.
 If the answer to most of these are "no" then you likely have a Minor Character on your hands.

 Does the Unstable Universe Wiki have ALL the Minor Characters? 
Goodness, no. We have several, but there are too many different people who have been on the server to count them all. The peeps we do have, however, are found in the following pages:

<~> Arachn1d's Kingdom <~> Capital City Black Market<~> Capital City Police Force <~> LAW <~> Mafia <~> Miscellaneous <~> NULL <~> Pirates <~> Skymore <~> Soul Keepers <~>

title: MinuteTech
content:
MinuteTech, also known as Minute, is a major supporting character in Unstable Universe. He currently wields two of the last few remaining maces left on the server, with three more stashed away in a shulker box. He is the End Guardian and a former diamond tier Mafia member. 

Personality
Minute is a stoic and cautious individual, in part due to his prolonged experience of being on the run from the Mafia. He  sets up multiple traps around the server, constantly moves his base, and always prefers to have a plan before carrying out operations. He views having teammates as a liability, but he is also shown being selfless and protective over his newfound friends- going out of his way to save Spoke and Mapicc, sharing his resources (even God Apples, armor sets, and XP). He ends up sacrificing himself to allow Spoke and Planet to escape from the hundreds of Invisible Players. 

He is a highly skilled player and PVPer, with his presence alone giving a sense of safety and security to his team who are confident in his abilities. Upon being forced to join the Mafia, he is immediately given the position of a diamond tier player. 

 History 
 Season 1 
Near the beginning of the server, Minute was a part of the original team that formed the Mafia. However, he left when Ashswagg assumed leadership and avoided the practice of setting a stasis chamber, preventing the execution that came from leaving. 

MinuteTech saves Spoke and Mapicc from the Mafia in the nether. Spoke and Mapicc secretly follow him back to his base. They are attacked underground by the Mafia. MinuteTech is able to kill one of the players using a mace and they manage to escape. 

PlanetLord introduces baconnwaffles0 and TheRealSquiddo to MinuteTech. A Mafia member named BobDaGreenFrog tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills them. The Mafia starts trying to kill them. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, to which MinuteTech replies "no". The Mafia continues attacking them. They are able to escape. 

The team goes over to the outpost and finds a very large amount of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after being handed a book. 

While Spoke and PlanetLord are in Jamato's now destroyed base, they see Ashswagg. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech is now working for him, and orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. Spoke and PlanetLord are able to escape from MinuteTech. 

Spoke has to fight a diamond tier player to become diamond tier. Spoke's totem of undying is used during the fight, revealing to Ashswagg that he is Spoke. Spoke and his friends try to kill Ashswagg but he escapes using a stasis chamber. The diamond tier player reveals he is MinuteTech. 
 Season 2 
MinuteTech got possession of the whole end. He controlled everyone who entered the End, but some players did not like this and tried to fight him. Baablu and Fantst had a goal to respawn the ender dragon, duplicate it, and bring it to spawn, with Babblu recruiting Wemmbu to help them. They succeeded, but Baablu betrayed Wemmbu and revealed he was just using him. Wemmbu and Minute then worked together to retake the end from their team. 

When in the Far Lands, Eggchan set his spawn and became trapped in the end. Minute welcomed him and allowed him to stay with him in the end. 

When Wemmbu was visiting Minute and Egg in the end, he talked about how he had nothing to do on the server after becoming the strongest. Egg suggested he create a new identity in which he could experience the player as a normal server. Minute agreed to help Wemmbu fake his death, but warned him to be careful. 

One day, while selling an elytra to a random player, Flamefrags went into the end and confronted MinuteTech. Though at first the interaction was peaceful, it eventually broke into a fight when MinuteTech refused to tell him where Wemmbu was, which was Flamefrags' objective. After an annoying fight, MinuteTech then reassures to Flame that Wemmbu is indeed dead but Flame refused to believe him. He then fled to the outer end islands. 

Wemmbu came through the end portal to visit and free Eggchan from his prison in the end. However, he is followed by players from the LAW. Minute killed them and then asked Wemmbu what was happening where Wemmbu revealed that he was now a wanted criminal.  

Wemmbu caught up Minute and Egg on what had been happening on the sever, since they never left the end. After Wemmbu finishes, Minute revealed that he indented to give the end to the LAW due to wanting to do what was best for the dimension. He said that he doesn't agree with LettuceK being the solo leader of the sever due to what happened with the mafia, but since Lettuce had tried to take the end multiple times, he wouldn't be able to hold it for much longer.  

Wemmbu returned to the end to free it from the LAW. He found Minute in the outer end islands and Minute told them that he had stashed away resources that could help them fight the army. Wemmbu retrieved them. Minute, Wemmbu, and Eggchan went back to the main end island to fight the army stationed there. They escaped to the overworld, where Wemmbu would be able to use his orbital strike canons to defeat the rest of the army. Minute tells him to draw the fight away from spawn, due to the abundance of innocents in the area. Wemmbu did what Minute said and led the army away before defeating it, giving Minute control of the end again.  

JumperWho brings Minute to save Spoke, Mapicc, and PrinceZam from the Law. He was, however, upset at Spoke for raiding the End with 1000 players, and originally planned on killing him. Spoke apologized and Minute ends up sparing him.  

Minute fought alongside District 13 at the Battle of the Northern Council. When the army was defeated, LettuceK fled. Minute and Wemmbu chased after him, but he escaped. While Wemmbu was angry, Minute told him that it wasn't necessarily a bad thing, since the server would now know who he really was and that was plenty of punishment. The two returned to the rest of District 13 to break the news. When Lettuce returned to the Northern Council and surrendered, they held a vote to decide what to do with him. Minute voted to spare him, mirroring what he had told Wemmbu earlier. Wemmbu also took his speech to heart and voted to let Lettuce live despite his former goal of killing the LAW commander.

[[MinuteTech]], also known as [[MinuteTech|Minute]], is a major supporting character in ''[[Unstable Universe]]''. He currently wields two of the last few remaining [[Maces|maces]] left on the server, with three more stashed away in a shulker box. He is the End Guardian and a former diamond tier [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] member. 

==Personality==
Minute is a stoic and cautious individual, in part due to his prolonged experience of being on the run from [[The Invisible Mafia|the Mafia]]. He  sets up multiple traps around the server, constantly moves his base, and always prefers to have a plan before carrying out operations. He views having teammates as a liability, but he is also shown being selfless and protective over his newfound friends- going out of his way to save [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and [[Mapicc]], sharing his resources (even God Apples, armor sets, and XP). He ends up sacrificing himself to allow [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and [[PlanetLord|Planet]] to escape from the hundreds of [[The Invisible Mafia|Invisible Players.]] 

He is a highly skilled player and PVPer, with his presence alone giving a sense of safety and security to his team who are confident in his abilities. Upon being forced to join the Mafia, he is immediately given the position of a diamond tier player. 

== History ==
=== Season 1 ===
Near the beginning of the server, Minute was a part of the original team that formed the Mafia. However, he left when [[Ashswagg]] assumed leadership and avoided the practice of setting a stasis chamber, preventing the execution that came from leaving. 

MinuteTech saves Spoke and Mapicc from the Mafia in the nether. Spoke and Mapicc secretly follow him back to his base. They are attacked underground by the Mafia. MinuteTech is able to kill one of the players using a mace and they manage to escape. 

PlanetLord introduces [[baconnwaffles0]] and [[TheRealSquiddo]] to MinuteTech. A Mafia member named [[BobDaGreenFrog]] tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills them. The Mafia starts trying to kill them. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, to which MinuteTech replies "no". The Mafia continues attacking them. They are able to escape. 

The team goes over to the outpost and finds a very large amount of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after being handed a book. 

While [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and [[PlanetLord]] are in [[JamatoP|Jamato]]'s now destroyed base, they see [[Ashswagg]]. [[Ashswagg]] reveals that MinuteTech is now working for him, and orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. Spoke and PlanetLord are able to escape from MinuteTech. 

[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] has to fight a diamond tier player to become diamond tier. [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]'s totem of undying is used during the fight, revealing to [[Ashswagg]] that he is [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]. [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and his friends try to kill [[Ashswagg]] but he escapes using a stasis chamber. The diamond tier player reveals he is MinuteTech. 
=== Season 2 ===
MinuteTech got possession of the whole end. He controlled everyone who entered the End, but some players did not like this and tried to fight him. [[Baablu]] and [[Fantst]] had a goal to respawn the ender dragon, duplicate it, and bring it to spawn, with Babblu recruiting [[Wemmbu]] to help them. They succeeded, but [[Baablu]] betrayed [[Wemmbu]] and revealed he was just using him. [[Wemmbu]] and Minute then worked together to retake the end from their team. 

When in the [[Far Lands]], [[Eggchan]] set his spawn and became trapped in the end. Minute welcomed him and allowed him to stay with him in the end. 

When [[Wemmbu]] was visiting Minute and [[Eggchan|Egg]] in the end, he talked about how he had nothing to do on the server after becoming the strongest. [[Eggchan|Egg]] suggested he create a new identity in which he could experience the player as a normal server. Minute agreed to help [[Wemmbu]] fake his death, but warned him to be careful. 

One day, while selling an elytra to a random player, [[FlameFrags|Flamefrags]] went into the end and confronted MinuteTech. Though at first the interaction was peaceful, it eventually broke into a fight when MinuteTech refused to tell him where [[Wemmbu]] was, which was [[FlameFrags|Flamefrags]]' objective. After an annoying fight, MinuteTech then reassures to [[FlameFrags|Flame]] that [[Wemmbu]] is indeed dead but [[FlameFrags|Flame]] refused to believe him. He then fled to the outer end islands. 

[[Wemmbu]] came through the end portal to visit and free [[Eggchan]] from his prison in the end. However, he is followed by players from the [[The Law|LAW]]. Minute killed them and then asked [[Wemmbu]] what was happening where [[Wemmbu]] revealed that he was now a wanted criminal.  

[[Wemmbu]] caught up Minute and [[Eggchan|Egg]] on what had been happening on the sever, since they never left the end. After [[Wemmbu]] finishes, Minute revealed that he indented to give the end to the [[The Law|LAW]] due to wanting to do what was best for the dimension. He said that he doesn't agree with [[LettuceK]] being the solo leader of the sever due to what happened with the mafia, but since [[LettuceK|Lettuce]] had tried to take the end multiple times, he wouldn't be able to hold it for much longer.  

[[Wemmbu]] returned to the end to free it from the [[The LAW|LAW]]. He found Minute in the outer end islands and Minute told them that he had stashed away resources that could help them fight the army. [[Wemmbu]] retrieved them. Minute, [[Wemmbu]], and [[Eggchan]] went back to the main end island to fight the army stationed there. They escaped to the overworld, where [[Wemmbu]] would be able to use his orbital strike canons to defeat the rest of the army. Minute tells him to draw the fight away from spawn, due to the abundance of innocents in the area. [[Wemmbu]] did what Minute said and led the army away before defeating it, giving Minute control of the end again.  

[[JumperWho]] brings Minute to save [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]], [[Mapicc]], and [[PrinceZam]] from the Law. He was, however, upset at [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] for raiding the End with 1000 players, and originally planned on killing him. [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] apologized and Minute ends up sparing him.  

Minute fought alongside [[District 13]] at the Battle of the Northern Council. When the army was defeated, [[LettuceK]] fled. Minute and [[Wemmbu]] chased after him, but he escaped. While [[Wemmbu]] was angry, Minute told him that it wasn't necessarily a bad thing, since the server would now know who he really was and that was plenty of punishment. The two returned to the rest of [[District 13]] to break the news. When [[LettuceK|Lettuce]] returned to the [[Northern Council]] and surrendered, they held a vote to decide what to do with him. Minute voted to spare him, mirroring what he had told [[Wemmbu]] earlier. [[Wemmbu]] also took his speech to heart and voted to let [[LettuceK|Lettuce]] live despite his former goal of killing the [[The LAW|LAW]] commander.

title: Mistrul
content:
Mistrul was a minor antagonist of FlameFrags's Season 3 videos featured in the Unstable Universe. He was the nominal leader of Mist Civilization and prevented every player from leaving the Mist.

History
thumb|1x1px

While Mistrul was reading a book, FlameFrags and Lomedy found him and Flame challenges him to a fight. He refused to fight him, however, he snuck in a cheap shot with a mace and popped Flames totem. This is what started their fight.  This was your average fight. Mistrul hit flame, flame hit misrul. When mistrul got low, he ran from Flame, and attacked Lomedy. Flame called him a coward. Mistrul claimed his victory by stating that he popped two more totems than Flame, though the latter deemed these as cheap shots. Mistrul said Flame was beneath his concern and prompted Flame to leave.

He hunted Flame multiple times later and defeated him with Flowtives, the actual leader and his PvP trainer behind Mist Civilization. Flame ran away and did a meditation to enter the zone. Flame wandered to the middle arena of the Mist Civilization, and found Mistrul waiting for a Duel. Flame was in the zone and killed Mistrul.

Trivia
His main combat style was Mace PVP.
He was also stated to be very impatient having killed someone because they took too long to deliver him breeze rods.

My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP is the 98th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Spoke and Mapicc were running low on resources, so Spoke sends Mapicc off on a mission to get resources, Spoke convinces Mapicc to set an ender pearl stasis as well. Mapicc is given blue ice blocks and lily pads from Spoke when leaving in case he needs to escape. After an hour, Mapicc has yet to return, so Spoke pulls his stasis, Mapicc appears for a split second and sounds afraid, screaming that "We have to run" multiple times while he was running with arrows all over him, before getting teleported again. Spoke thinks that Mapicc was taken by Leow0ok and packs up his items and heads to the Mafia stash. Spoke arrives and sees the aftermath of the fight between Mapicc and the spies, the fight was taken recently, as their items were still on the ground. He sees signs of Mapicc being there, seeing that he used the blue ice during the fight. Spoke has the thought of Mapicc possibly being with PrinceZam, and so he goes to Zam's base.

When he left the stash, eight spies are shown watching his every move, and follows him to Zam's base. Spoke flies and dodges their attacks while trying to look for an ice biome, where he had already set up TNT launchers that launched hundreds of TNT up in the air, killing all the spies except one, who turned out to be Leow0ok. Leo starts to attack Spoke, planning to ban him off the server. Spoke uses a TNT and fishing rod stunt, but Leo's TNT minecart strategies were too strong for him. Spoke runs away and asks Leo if he's hiding anything, trying to get Leo to confirm if he knew what happened to Mapicc. He gets Leo off his trail and goes to PrinceZam's base, which appeared to have been ransacked. A hidden sign has a secret message that tells the coordinates of his new base, and so Spoke goes out to find it. A flashback is shown where Spoke and Mapicc were looting random bases and find banner patterns, Mapicc puts a brick pattern with an orange and yellow gradient on his shield. The flashback ends and Spoke flies by the base where the flashback took place. Spoke enters Zam's new base and asks him if he has seen Mapicc, to which he replies he has not seen Mapicc since a while, and how he's too busy moving from base to base. Spoke plans on going back to his bunker, but Zam says it's a bad idea, Spoke argues that Mapicc wouldn't be happy that all of his items were left there. Spoke then goes to their bunker and is greeted to an invisible player, who he assumes is Mapicc because they had the same brick pattern shield as him. The player drinks milk and turns out to be Leo. He says how Mapicc put up a good fight, but couldn't take on Leo and his spies, and took his shield as a token to show he killed Mapicc. Spoke is in denial, and Leo says he can believe that, but the truth is different, Leo then activates a void trap right below Spoke, in which he manages to save himself from, and Leo stasises away as multiple invisible spies appear behind paintings to try and knock Spoke down. Spoke uses chorus fruit to escape and then goes through the Nether, planning on blowing up Capital City to get proof Mapicc is alive. He returns to Zam's base and asks for a favor to send a message to LettuceK about his plans to destroy Capital City. 

When the time comes, Spoke walks up to the front gates of Capital City, Deputy_Ace, a few lawmen and guards of Capital City await him, Deputy_Ace asks if Spoke thinks he can get away with blowing up Capital City, Spoke ignites a TNT and fishing rods them towards the guards, killing three in the process. Spoke blows up more guards and fights them off, Deputy_Ace and two guards flee, as they are unable to take on the fight. Spoke plants TNT around the entire city and builds a TNT cannon, waiting for somebody to tell him anything. He hears redstone being broken behind him and slowly looks back and sees Parrot. Spoke sounds broken and asks if breaking the cannon will fix anything, Parrot tells Spoke he's about to destroy homes of hundreds and doesn't know what happened to him to cause him to be this way. Spoke says he didn't want to do this, and what he's doing isn't anything compared to what he's been put through by BAT and the Law, lamenting to Parrot that he doesn't have a home or a friend anymore, he says how Parrot wouldn't understand, but if he lost his closest friends, maybe he'd understand how he felt. Parrot informs Spoke that he's been through just as much as he has, and Spoke isn't the only one who's lost somebody important to them. Spoke explains his situation to Parrot and mentions the shield pattern, Parrot knows about the shield pattern and says that Jumper had the exact same shield pattern. If what Parrot is saying is true, then that means the shield was a decoy and Mapicc could still be alive. Before heading off, Spoke tells Parrot to be the best king Unstable has ever seen and that the server needs him.

Spoke waits in front of the stash where Mapicc was last seen, meeting back up with Zam. They search for clues of where he could've went, Spoke reveals that neither The Law or BAT knows where Mapicc went and shows Zam that he discovered another floor of the stash where the spies were communicating with each other. The signs reveal that the spies planned on killing Mapicc, but Leo wanted to kill Mapicc himself. Another player came and helped Mapicc fight them off using weapons that haven't been seen before, somebody who knew Spoke but the spies didn't. The last signs say that they went a certain direction, and so Spoke and Zam begin to follow a trail that was left by Mapicc. They follow the ice blocks and lily pads placed by Mapicc, going from biome to biome, when they get to a snowy biome, they see light emitting from underneath the snow and look inside, which they find an ender pearl cannon. Spoke and Zam use it and spot a lighthouse in the distance, finding nothing there, so they keep moving. They spot a house in the distance with rings of flowers surrounding the entire house, confident that it's Mapicc and the mystery person, they head towards the house. As they wind charge up the flower field, Spoke spots the Far Lands in the distance, which reminds him of the only person he knows that resides there. Spoke finds Mapicc and JamatoP, Spoke's first friend and one of the few players on the server that knew exploits about the game. Spoke doesn't sound grateful that Mapicc is alive, but rather feels betrayed that Jamato returned only now to save Mapicc. Mapicc explains how they escaped and that BAT isn't a problem anymore, but Spoke says that's not winning and that they're running. Jamato says that he's always wanted to explore and learn, never with the rest of the server, he says that his plan was to go all the way out with Spoke, but with the way things ended between them, he wasn't able to do so. All of them say they want to go and explore the world rather than fighting, Jamato offers Spoke the opportunity to as well, he doesn't respond and wanders off far enough where they don't see him set an ender pearl stasis. He returns and agrees to explore the world with them, he asks if they're all good and looks at Jamato, who's still unsure about how to feel about Spoke, but is still glad to have him there. 

While Zam and Mapicc are packing, Jamato says he has some loose ends to tie up and walks away, Spoke pearls away and goes invis to follow him to the lighthouse, Jamato knows Spoke is there and tells him to reveal himself.  Jamato and Spoke debate for a while where Jamato says how Spoke is just using his own friends for his own good. Spoke angrily replies that Jamato who claimed to have had decided to protect the server was nowhere to be found during the reign of The Invisible Mafia. To which Jamato replies that the real threat to the server isn't The Mafia, it's Spoke. The server won't end with Leo or with The Law, and that Spoke is never satisfied. Spoke threatens to kill Jamato, and so he takes off all his armor and throws his totem off the lighthouse and tells Spoke to kill him. Spoke doesn't instantly try to kill him, and Jamato says, "That's what I thought," just as Spoke pots up and attacks. Jamato holds another totem out, which teleports him to a stasis set somewhere. 

Spoke goes invisible and goes back to the house pretending to be Leow0ok and using TNT minecarts to attack Mapicc and Zam. Getting close to death, Spoke pulls his stasis and blows up the netherite armor and puts on his normal armor and visible, he goes back to the house and pretends to not know what just happened. Spoke makes them believe that Leo followed them to the pearl cannon and they try to find Jamato. Spoke suggests going to the lighthouse and find a trail of explosions leading to the lighthouse. At the lighthouse, it's shown to be blown up and destroyed, Spoke makes Mapicc and Zam check the top so they don't hear him throw an experience bottle where Jamato threw his totem off, he then pretends to find Jamato's totem and experience, proving that Leo got to him and killed Jamato. They make a grave for JamatoP back at his house, Spoke instructs the two to go back to the lighthouse and give him some alone time to grieve. Once alone, he laughs maniacally; he knows Jamato is smart enough not to mess with him and that he almost had Mapicc and Zam convinced to turn their backs on him. Spoke says how in a different universe they could've been the best of friends and what it could've been. While that was all happening, Jamato is shown standing on the top of the Far Lands looking down at his house.

 Trivia 

 This is Spoke's first time being inside of Capital City 2.0, as well as being the last protagonist to come to Capital City.
 This also marks Spoke's first time being near the Far Lands, same with being the last protagonist to near in the Far Lands. His first entrance to Far Lands was several episodes later, in Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing.
 Despite villagers being extremely rare, some villagers can be seen in the villages.
 The hardcore hearts texture were edited in during the Capital City scene when Spoke opens up his inventory. 
 However, the overlay is not shown when Spoke opens his inventory during his fight with Mapicc and Zam and actually use the hardcore hearts texture.
 When JamatoP and Spoke talked at the lighthouse, the sky was dark with lightning. Same lightning was seen when Null Hunters hunt Spoke later on.
 When Spoke found the trail of explosions, he moved his cursor onto a red shulker full of TNT, indicating that he had deliberately created these explosions before he went invis and jumped Mapicc and Zam in order to convince them that Leow0ok had chased down and killed Jamato, and that he was just acting to be surprised. This makes sense because if Spoke had not picked up the totem dropped by Jamato down the lighthouse, made an explosion pit and dropped it to the pit, it would have either despawned or destroyed by the explosion if Jamato was the one who created the explosions and blew the lighthouse up.

title: Mysterious Tomb
content:
The mysterious tomb is a major location in I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server (Wemmbu). It is where Wemmbu fought an invisible player for FieldsOfElysium's mace. 

 Description  
The mysterious tomb's entrance is a drop-down into a pool of water which leads to a large cave with a large ravine-like skylight opening. Glowing amethyst crystals, fences, lamps, and large leafless trees can be seen scattered throughout the cave. Near the entrance, a wooden bridge sits atop a pool of water, walking over the bridge will trigger an arrow trap and spawn several wardens. 

There is a large sword with a cyan guard and yellow hilt near the back of the cave and in front of a waterfall. A broken bridge leads up to this spot. 

 Lore  
An unnamed hero who guarded the Wheat Kingdom placed their mace here for rest before quitting the server. According to FieldsOfElysium, this player was a strong fighter and the Kingdom is endangered without them.

The only person the hero told of their mace's whereabouts is LordSirWessley, whom Wemmbu sought out at the request of FieldsOfElysium. After a challenge, Wessley tells Wemmbu some vague instructions on how to find the tomb. Noticing Wemmbu's confusion, he explains that it is word-for-word what the hero had said to him. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan follow Wessley's instructions and find the tomb. Wemmbu breaks the blue cornflower and the door is revealed. Wemmbu accidentally breaks the door mechanism. They drop into the hole and Wemmbu loses a totem of undying while crossing the bridge and is forced to fight two wardens after. After defeating the wardens, Wemmbu and Eggchan make their way to the top of the cave where a large sword. The mace is in an item frame on the sword. 

Before Wemmbu can get to it, an invisible player snatches it. The two fight and Wemmbu launches several stab shots that ripped holes into the tomb's ceiling and floors. The invisible player yields and gives Wemmbu the mace.

title: Nagol
content:
Naggol is a character in the Unstable Universe.  

Naggol has appeared in many various location shown within the Unstable SMP, most notability, a devoted member of Spokes Galactic Empire.
 Personality 
Naggol is known to be very supportive, often telling his audience about his overwhelming support for Spoke, and how he only wanted the best for his army. He often focused on improving and providing moral support during the time where spokes army was active. He was present in a few of the empires battles, and was a loved member of the empire.

 History 
Naggol joined the Spoke Galactic Empire.

He is present in the battle against Sleepy Nation, and takes part in the attempt to assassinate hannahxxrose.

title: Naparizel
content:
Naparizel, commonly known as Napa, was a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe.

 History 

 Naparizel is seen as a miner in Capital City.

title: Northern Council
content:
The Northern Council is one of the largest builds constructed by the Law, where LettuceK hosted speeches and conducted the election. It also serves as the de-facto capital of Unstable SMP, where the King of the Unstable SMP lives and governs the server. 

 History 
This place was built and used by LettuceK and the Law. The Northern Council was also where the largest battle in the history of the server happened when District 13 fought 2500 Law-men and members of BAT. This battle would change The Unstable SMP forever. After being destroyed in the battle it was rebuilt and continues to be the place where the king of the Unstable SMP governs the server (The King being Parrot).

 Speeches at the Northern Council 

 The Debates 
The Debates in the Northern council were a series of speeches that were supposed to decide how the election really went. These speeches were conducted by LettuceK. It is notable that Spepticle was killed in one of these speeches. During these debates almost every single player in the mainland of the server attended them. Players were not allowed to wear armour and the whole place was guarded by a garrison of Law troops. 

 The Law Speeches 
The Northern Council also had speeches to Law men. The only time we really see this is when LettuceK gave The Law the order to hunt down Parrot and Wemmbu. It seems like LettuceK gave orders from The Northern Council. During the final battle of The Northern Council LettuceK had prepared for the battle before hand to give District 13 the false illusion of victory. It is possible that this was practiced at The Northern Council as it all Law troops knew where to go.

 The Battle Of The Northern Council 

 Beginning 
Parrot and the rest of District 13 marched on the Northern Council. Parrot talks to Lettucek that he should have "kept it between the two of them" and they both walk back to their respective sides. Parrot, the leader of the group, tells Wemmbu to fire his devastating and death banning nukes, which slaughtered most of the diamond lawmen.

title: Null Hunters
content:
Null Hunters are a team of bounty hunters consisting of players with unintelligible, scrambled names and black skins. Their base is in the Far Lands. They serve as the main antagonist faction of the NULL Arc. It was revealed that JamatoP was the leader behind Null Hunters.

Null Hunters have elite squads sent to spawn. They teleport away whenever their totem is popped, meaning that they can defy death except for an arrow cannon, which has killed one of their leaders, _1_88_____x. They have higher speed stats than normal players, and traverse terrain through the Nether, allowing them to travel faster and easier to hunt down targets. They were first seen chasing down Spoke. They all hold shields that have a pattern impossible to obtain in survival. Their job is to kidnap players written in books entitled mission: null, and kill any player they see on sight. 

The rest of Null Hunters patrol and take over the Far Lands. They can light nether portals at Far Lands which cannot be done by normal players like Wemmbu. 

 Structure 
 Hierarchy 
Null Hunters operate in squads and obey corresponding squad leader's order. Normal Null Hunters wear netherite flow-trimmed netherite armor sets. Squad leaders wear redstone flow-trimmed netherite chestplates. This chestplate-trim-color-based hierarchy system is similar to that of the Invisible Mafia.
RankingThe Null LeaderRedstoneNetherite

 Practices 
 For those selected that go to spawn:
 Each active member has an ender pearl stasis chamber triggered via certain glitch by popping their totems.
 They hunt down whoever appears on the leaders' mission: null books and their allies relentlessly, draining all targets' resources, including armor durability and food, until they surrender. The targets, after neutralized, are forced to march to a pearl cannon that leads to "the Road of Null" in the Far Lands. Any passing-by players are killed on sight. Their hunting pressure is equivalent if not higher than that of the Invisible Mafia.
 Their targets include those who have bounty on their head and trappers or other wrongdoers.
 Leaders use multishot black firework crossbows to slow down targets and help drain targets' resources.
 Blow up the pearl cannon in case anyone tries to forcefully use it.
 If one squad leader dies other leader(s) are immediately notified through some mechanism and the squad is merged to another squad.
 For those staying at Far Lands:
 Patrol and take over Far Lands.
 Neutralize and send players encountered through nether portal.

 History 
Mapicc was asked to join Null Hunters and given their shield on his way to the end with MinuteTech.

Mapicc gave Spoke Null Hunters' shield as a gift. He was then captured by Null to their base in the Far Lands. Null Hunters started to hunt down Spoke, Jumper and her spies. Spoke and Jumper, losing almost all spies, were forced to defend themselves, investigate and find a way to counter whilst being intensely hunted.

Mapicc reappeared and lead them to the Far Lands through a pearl cannon which was presumably offset by Null Hunters. They travelled across multiple biomes, dodging Null Hunters and escapers from Null along the way. Inside a dark forest, they killed a squad of Null Hunters and captured their leader, which lead them to an infinite downward staircase that is said to go to a scary place and connected to Null leader or Null base. JamatoP, not revealing himself as the leader yet, met all three of them. JamatoP travelled with them, telling Null Hunters to slowly drain their resources and precisely attack them and steal stashes along the process. He and Null Hunters were able to capture JumperWho and Mapicc, and corner Spoke, finally revealing himself to be the Null leader. He forced Mapicc to break all Spoke's armor including Alt, and then used Null Hunters to break Mapicc's armor until both of them are captured.

Aside from Null Hunters and JamatoP, this glitch was also used by Wemmbu at PvP tournament as well as by Wifies when Parrot attacked him in Paragon.

title: Orbital Dog Cannon
content:
thumb|401x401px|FlameFrags in front of his Orbital Dog Cannon

The Orbital Dog Cannon is a machine constructed by FlameFrags back in Lifesteal S6 (1000 Armored Wolves VS Lifesteal SMP, still manually trigger at that time), allowing him to teleport an army of thousands of armored wolves at him with a fishing rod similar to Wemmbu's Orbital Strike Cannon. The machine splash sitting wolves with speed, strength and fire resistance potions, before making them take fall damage, stand up and teleport to their owner, FlameFrags, due to Minecraft mechanics.

It is superior to Orbital Strike Cannon in that

 Being based on teleportation mechanics, it is not limited by spatial hinderance (though still need to be in same dimension) like obsidian roof.
 Dogs can take lethal damage from nuke or other sources with their armors.
 Swarms of dogs are hard to shield and relentlessly deal damage, as opposed to instant damage by Orbital Strike Cannon that is easily shielded.
 It never damages its owner.
 (If not on Unstable Universe) it triggers instantly without loading and does not need preset coordinates, while Orbital Strike Cannon needs loading and needs preset coordinates.

However, it also has severe limitations:

 It require large amount of resources like meat and scute, which is hard to find on the Unstable SMP given mob cap, thus limiting the number of such cannons and their reload frequency.
 It cannot be used to destroy structure.
 The dogs can be countered by lava / fire, more than one orbital strike cannons or more than one explosives.

The Orbital Dog Cannon was used in several battles by FlameFrags against players that annoy him, Wemmbu and the army of 1000 people by the Law and Mist Civilisation members.
