title: Orbital Strike Cannon
content:
thumb|356x356px|Picture of cannon. Credit: 

An Orbital Strike Cannon is a Minecraft build featured in Unstable Universe utilizing various mechanics to be able to drop hundreds of TNT onto a chosen location. The machine was designed by cubicmetre.

There can be two different types of shots. A nuke shot, which covers lots of distance but doesn’t have that much concentration of TNT per block, and a stab shot, which is tons of TNT concentrated on a single spot, usually going down to bedrock.

Orbital Strike Cannon is designed to use only in the Overworld, making Wemmbu passive when fighting the Law in the End.

 History 
Wemmbu shows Spoke that he can activate an orbital strike cannon using a fishing rod.

SpokeIsHere destroys The Wonders using an orbital strike cannon. Parrot builds an orbital strike cannon to stop the Wonders from being destroyed but fails.

Spoke destroys a sky base containing duped items using an orbital strike cannon.

Spoke accidentally destroys Jepexx's base using an orbital strike cannon.

ParrotX2 and Wifies help Wemmbu build an orbital strike cannon. Parrot and Wifies then use it to destroy the Treasure Hunters headquarters.

The Zam Empire destroys Wemmbu's orbital strike cannon and adds a giant obsidian shield over the empire to stop an orbital strike cannon from destroying it. PrinceZam gets too confident after seeing Wemmbu's weakened state and he removes the shield. Little did he know, Wemmbu was ready to destroy the empire.

ClownPierce uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy PrinceZam's base in a prison as Pangi tried to escape to the nether. Wemmbu and eggchan's base is also destroyed by ClownPierce.

ParrotX2 uses an orbital strike cannon and connects it with a line of mirror receivers to remotely activate it without a fishing rod. He used it alongside BAT to kill TruOriginal, the hacker that was hunting Parrot.

Wemmbu discovers an array of repeating orbital strike cannons in the farlands. Later on, he uses them to destroy the old Law base while trying to find FlameFrags. He then asks Jaden_MAN if he knew where FlameFrags was. Jaden stalls and eventually attacks Wemmbu. After Wemmbu defeats Jaden, he destroys his Pirate castle. Wemmbu goes to FlameFrags' old base where he kills another player who dropped a compass leading to where FlameFrags was. After finally finding FlameFrags, Wemmbu uses his orbital strike cannons to finally defeat him and be considered the strongest player.

Wemmbu uses some of his orbital strike cannons against Boosfer and his bandits in BranzyCraft's abandoned base. He manages to kill all the bandits except for Boomie. Wemmbu chases them down The Great Sea where he finally kills Boomie using his orbital strike cannons. 

ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird impersonate Wemmbu. While Wemmbu chases them down, he tries to kill them using his stab shots from his orbital strike cannons. 

Wemmbu uses three orbital strike cannon shots during his fight with FlameFrags against 1000 players to kill some of the players. After they won the battle, Wemmbu runs out of orbital strike cannons. He tries to use one against FlameFrags but FlameFrags dodges it.

The Law builds an orbital strike cannon to destroy the Pirates' base, but Wemmbu and eggchan destroy it before it can fire. 

Wemmbu returns to the Farlands to finally get his orbital strike cannons back. Wemmbu then uses the orbital strike cannons to fight against the Law, banning dozens of players and resulting in their long-awaited downfall. 

 Trivia 
 It's important to note that the orbital strike cannons featured in Wemmbu's videos aren't actually possible as the cannon's firing location is predetermined, along with other technical reasons. They cannot fire instantly in real Minecraft as it is not possible to change game speed locally like Wemmbu did in the Far Lands.

title: Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP
content:
Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP is the 65th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The episode begins with Wemmbu stating his intention with the Orbital Strike Cannons: to use them to seek revenge on his enemies and defeat FlameFrags, and obtain the title of the strongest player.

While on his journey to find Flame, he follows a few players towards Capital City, a place that newer members of the server go to in order to find safety. While there, many of the players seem to ignore him as if he is just another person, which seems to agitate him. He manages to corner one of them by a lamp post, asking if they knew where FlameFrags was. They respond on a sign, saying that only Reddoons knows where Flame is, and that there is a queue he must wait in. Wemmbu threatens the player with his Stab Shot, an ability that his cannons possess, and they eventually take him to what is supposedly Reddoons' office.

In the office, Reddoons is not there, and there is only a player by the name of SirPig_ in the room. The original player who had taken Wemmbu to the office in the first place mentions to the others that Wemmbu had threatened to blow up the entire city if he was not taken here. Wemmbu then asks, again, where Reddoons is, or if anyone knew the whereabouts of FlameFrags. After once again nuking part of the city, SirPig_ finally tells Wemmbu that FlameFrags had gone to The Law, a place south-west of Capital City. 

Once travelling there, he finds The Law's base, and he meets Falcuno and LettuceK. They order a group of new players they'd supposedly pulled from spawn to kill Wemmbu. The players, only owning iron and leather gear, are unable to kill him. Wemmbu uses his Nuke Shot to massacre them all at once, and then demands to know where Flame is. LettuceK tells him that Flame was likely trying to get revenge on Jaden_MAN and that he could be in Jaden's base but he is reluctant to tell Wemmbu where the coordinates are. Wemmbu blows up some of the city with the orbital strike cannon. Lettuce gives Wemmbu the coordinates and Wemmbu destroys the entire city just to make sure they don't hunt him again.  

Wemmbu finds an old pirate base and notices cobwebs. Wemmbu begins reminiscing FlameFrags wiping out players in the base and realizes that the base is abandoned. Wemmbu continues searching for Jaden's base until he finds a castle with a pirate branding. He realizes that the castle belongs to Jaden_MAN. Wemmbu asks Jaden to tell him where FlameFrags is and blows up some of his castle with the Stab Shot. Jaden suggests that Wemmbu checks Flame's base and begins looking for books in his chests and barrels. After a while of going through his stuff it begins raining. Jaden leaves the castle and Wemmbu looks in the castle for himself and it appears that there are no books.  

Out of no where, Jaden begins attacking Wemmbu with his mace and his riptide trident. Wemmbu tells Jaden that if he wants him to stop then he has to tell him where FlameFrags is but he eventually gets more focused on Jaden's mace rather than FlameFrags' location and when the rain stops, the fight is over and Wemmbu tells Jaden to give him the mace. Jaden drops a bucket and runs away. Wemmbu picks it up thinking that it's his mace. He tries to chase Jaden but he loses him. Wemmbu begins nuking Jaden's castle. 

Wemmbu decides to listen to Jaden and go to Flame's abandoned base where he meets a player in gold armour named TREELEAF2021. TREELEAF2021 tells Wemmbu to do a scavenger hunt but Wemmbu doesn't listen and instead kills him with a Stab Shot. He then finds a compass named "FlameFrags..." and not having any other choice Wemmbu follows the compass. The compass leads him to an old Mafia stash that Wemmbu had raided during his training with ManePear. Wemmbu waits on top of the pillar in one of the buildings until he finds FlameFrags. Wemmbu begins taunting FlameFrags, telling him that he is no longer the strongest player because he is about to take that title from him. Wemmbu uses a stab shot on FlameFrags and they begin fighting. They find themselves in an ancient city and wardens attack both of them. They eventually leave the ancient city and the fight continues. Wemmbu breaks Flame's chestplate and continues to blow him up with the stab shots. Wemmbu had finally defeated FlameFrags and he taunts FlameFrags for hiding and tells him that he will never be the strongest player ever again. Wemmbu stands on the same pillar from when the fight began before leaving.

'''Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP''' is the 65th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]]. 

== Plot ==
The episode begins with Wemmbu stating his intention with the [[Orbital Strike Cannon|Orbital Strike Cannons]]: to use them to seek revenge on his enemies and defeat [[FlameFrags]], and obtain the title of the strongest player.

While on his journey to find Flame, he follows a few players towards [[Capital City]], a place that newer members of the server go to in order to find safety. While there, many of the players seem to ignore him as if he is just another person, which seems to agitate him. He manages to corner one of them by a lamp post, asking if they knew where FlameFrags was. They respond on a sign, saying that only [[Reddoons]] knows where Flame is, and that there is a queue he must wait in. Wemmbu threatens the player with his Stab Shot, an ability that his cannons possess, and they eventually take him to what is supposedly Reddoons' office.

In the office, Reddoons is not there, and there is only a player by the name of SirPig_ in the room. The original player who had taken Wemmbu to the office in the first place mentions to the others that Wemmbu had threatened to blow up the entire city if he was not taken here. Wemmbu then asks, again, where Reddoons is, or if anyone knew the whereabouts of FlameFrags. After once again nuking part of the city, SirPig_ finally tells Wemmbu that FlameFrags had gone to [[The Law]], a place south-west of Capital City. 

Once travelling there, he finds The Law's base, and he meets [[Falcuno]] and [[LettuceK]]. They order a group of new players they'd supposedly pulled from spawn to kill Wemmbu. The players, only owning iron and leather gear, are unable to kill him. Wemmbu uses his Nuke Shot to massacre them all at once, and then demands to know where Flame is. LettuceK tells him that Flame was likely trying to get revenge on [[Jaden_MAN]] and that he could be in Jaden's base but he is reluctant to tell Wemmbu where the coordinates are. Wemmbu blows up some of the city with the orbital strike cannon. Lettuce gives Wemmbu the coordinates and Wemmbu destroys the entire city just to make sure they don't hunt him again.  

Wemmbu finds an old pirate base and notices cobwebs. Wemmbu begins reminiscing FlameFrags wiping out players in the base and realizes that the base is abandoned. Wemmbu continues searching for Jaden's base until he finds a castle with a pirate branding. He realizes that the castle belongs to Jaden_MAN. Wemmbu asks Jaden to tell him where FlameFrags is and blows up some of his castle with the Stab Shot. Jaden suggests that Wemmbu checks Flame's base and begins looking for books in his chests and barrels. After a while of going through his stuff it begins raining. Jaden leaves the castle and Wemmbu looks in the castle for himself and it appears that there are no books.  

Out of no where, Jaden begins attacking Wemmbu with his mace and his riptide trident. Wemmbu tells Jaden that if he wants him to stop then he has to tell him where FlameFrags is but he eventually gets more focused on Jaden's mace rather than FlameFrags' location and when the rain stops, the fight is over and Wemmbu tells Jaden to give him the mace. Jaden drops a bucket and runs away. Wemmbu picks it up thinking that it's his mace. He tries to chase Jaden but he loses him. Wemmbu begins nuking Jaden's castle. 

Wemmbu decides to listen to Jaden and go to Flame's abandoned base where he meets a player in gold armour named TREELEAF2021. TREELEAF2021 tells Wemmbu to do a scavenger hunt but Wemmbu doesn't listen and instead kills him with a Stab Shot. He then finds a compass named "FlameFrags..." and not having any other choice Wemmbu follows the compass. The compass leads him to an old Mafia stash that [[I Mastered Minecraft Combat|Wemmbu had raided during his training with ManePear]]. Wemmbu waits on top of the pillar in one of the buildings until he finds FlameFrags. Wemmbu begins taunting FlameFrags, telling him that he is no longer the strongest player because he is about to take that title from him. Wemmbu uses a stab shot on FlameFrags and they begin fighting. They find themselves in an ancient city and wardens attack both of them. They eventually leave the ancient city and the fight continues. Wemmbu breaks Flame's chestplate and continues to blow him up with the stab shots. Wemmbu had finally defeated FlameFrags and he taunts FlameFrags for hiding and tells him that he will never be the strongest player ever again. Wemmbu stands on the same pillar from when the fight began before leaving.

title: Ouroboroid
content:
Ouroboroid is a character in Unstable Universe. 

 History 
Ouroboroid had access to slime mobs, and hands them over to the trader RockyUnleashed39 while invisible.

Wemmbu attempts to converse with him and later kill him, but Ouroboroid has access to enchanted golden apples, wind charges, and a riptide trident. He is able to escape.

Wemmbu obtains a screenshot of Ouroboroid who had revealed a compass for a split second, and eggchan calculates where the compass leads to. 

Wemmbu finds Ouro's base and they get in a fight. Despite having many totems of undying, Ouroboroid is overpowered, and Wemmbu is able to negotiate with him and tell him about LettuceK's plans, and explain that Lettuce plans to destroy the Pirate Civilization. 

Ouroboroid takes Wemmbu to the storage. LettuceK was able to invisibly sneak in and steal a few shulker boxes with music discs in them. Ouro immediately threw a wind charge to the self-destruct button, but it was too late.

Wemmbu attempts to distract LettuceK while Ouroboroid gets gear. LettuceK kills Ouroboroid. 

 Trivia 
 Ouroboroid may be related to The_Oroboros, the soldier of the Law due to their similar names, and armor trims. 
 LettuceK tells Wemmbu and Ouroboroid "I got the better of the two of you", which may have a double meaning in this regard.

title: Pangi
content:
Pangi is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. Pangi was a member of Wemmbu's Civilization, a member of Skyblock Civilization, and a member of the Zam Empire. 

 Personality 
Pangi is a generally positive, excitable, and energetic player who is very loyal to his friends and allies.  He is willing to do many things for those he perceives as his friends. During the events of "I Found A Minecraft Sky Civilization," Pangi seems rather lonely and can sometimes be annoying or naive to Wemmbu and Wato1876.

Although he has a small role in the overall story, Pangi is a loyal ally and tries his best to stay out of conflict and be helpful. 

 History

Pangi is seen in Wemmbu's Civilization.

Pangi is seen as a prisoner in a very large prison. He is very loyal to PrinceZam in the prison. He tries to escape using the nether but is chunk banned.

title: Paragon
content:
Paragon was a prison built by Wifies to hold ParrotX2 where they could build a world together with no danger.

 History 
Parrot was eventually able to escape, after Wifies died. It was a world which was confined by obsidian walls 5 blocks thick up to the height limit and had JumperWho, Leow0ok and Derapchu as guards. To prevent Parrot from escaping, even whilst in the Nether. The roof in the Nether had obsidian blocks up to the height limit. Wifies was smarter than Parrot and knew him too well. After several weeks, Wifies did an inventory check on Parrot but Parrot managed to sneak the spyglass given by Wifies himself. They went into a secret chamber and Wifies forced parrot to stand on a pressure plate and he stood on it. He told there was TNT under and if either of them went away from the pressure plates. the entire chamber would explode, he planned for both of them standing on the pressure plates for the rest of their lives but Parrot shows him the Spyglass, he talks about how he misses the old Wifies how he talks about their times together Wifies is speechless and the last thing Parrot says is that when he gets out, when people ask who Wifies was he won’t talk of the Wifies who imprisoned himself or the evil villain Wifies he will talk about the best friend Wifies the one who gave this spyglass and the one who always had his back. Parrot puts it on the pressure plate and leaves. After Wifies emotionally getting flashback of his memories with Parrot he runs to the spyglass takes it and accepts his fate. Wifies dies and his death message was on chat which Parrot saw. He pillared to the top of the wall locked back at Paragon, got in a boat and went over the wall and rowed away from the prison.

title: ParrotX2
content:
ParrotX2, or simply Parrot, is one of the four main protagonists of Unstable Universe, alongside SpokeIsHere,  Wemmbu, and FlameFrags. Parrot is currently the king of Unstable Universe, a former member of the Bounty Assassin Team, the creator of The End Civilization, a former member and leader of the Warriors Council in Far Lands, and the leader of District 13.

 Personality 
Parrot is a highly calculated strategist; he compensates for his lack of PvP combat skills with exceptional intelligence. He is well-versed with the mechanics of Minecraft and often uses it to his advantage to solve puzzles or gain the upper hand. He is incredibly charitable and selfless, giving out riches to the new players of the server and regularly putting others before himself. His lack of PvP skills makes him susceptible to ambushes and attacks, so instead he strategies with others on the best form of action as well as letting other players take the brunt of most PvP action.

Despite his politeness to most players, he often can be cocky and egotistical when up against his enemies, using intimidation to gain the upper hand. When he is in a desperate and seemingly impossible situation, he will use sharp and condescending words to associate with them to the point it is considered amoral by his teammates. However, he primarily uses violence as a last resort. He is sometimes playfully cocky with his friends, especially his best friend, TheobaldThebird, consistently claiming himself to be the “biggest bird” out of the two.

Parrot is also extremely idealistic and heroic, believing he has to be the one to save everyone on the server no matter the consequences on him or the friends around him, and always refusing to be selfish. His strong convictions can occasionally blind him to alternative viewpoints. Nevertheless, he is generally considered among the most morally upstanding players on the server. 

 Boundaries 

 No shipping or implied shipping
 No NSFW or sexualization
 No gore or self-harm (battle injury is fine, but nothing crazy)
 Nothing related to drugs or anything like that
 Keep everything appropriate for all ages

 Quotes 

 Trivia 
 In R4trick's hypothetical scenario in The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands, where there is a collapsing cave and out of Wifies, Dean, and Parrot- one dies, one is trapped, and one survives. Parrot never directly gave his answer, instead suggesting "that there's some way to save all three."
 Parrot is constantly being fought over by Wifies and Derapchu, as seen in a series of tweets, videos, streams, and clips.
 While Parrot is first seen in This Button Destroys the World, his join message is temporarily seen in How to Destroy the Universe.
 He is seen to be quite good with a bow on multiple occasions.
 He is nerfed on the unstable SMP in terms of PvP, as his PvP is actually better (surviving four seasons on Lifesteal SMP the deadliest SMP, and roughly equivalent to DrDonut in Sword mode). TheobaldTheBird often trains him in real life.
 He is also quite good at crystal pvp.

ParrotX2, or simply Parrot, is one of the four main protagonists of ''[[Unstable Universe]]'', alongside [[SpokeIsHere]],  [[Wemmbu]], and [[FlameFrags]]. Parrot is currently the king of Unstable Universe, a former member of the [[Bounty Assassin Team]], the creator of [[The End Civilization]], a former member and leader of the [[Warriors Council]] in [[Far Lands]], and the leader of [[District 13]].

== Personality ==
Parrot is a highly calculated strategist; he compensates for his lack of PvP combat skills with exceptional intelligence. He is well-versed with the mechanics of Minecraft and often uses it to his advantage to solve puzzles or gain the upper hand. He is incredibly charitable and selfless, giving out riches to the new players of the server and regularly putting others before himself. His lack of PvP skills makes him susceptible to ambushes and attacks, so instead he strategies with others on the best form of action as well as letting other players take the brunt of most PvP action.

Despite his politeness to most players, he often can be cocky and egotistical when up against his enemies, using intimidation to gain the upper hand. When he is in a desperate and seemingly impossible situation, he will use sharp and condescending words to associate with them to the point it is considered amoral by his teammates. However, he primarily uses violence as a last resort. He is sometimes playfully cocky with his friends, especially his best friend, [[TheobaldTheBird|TheobaldThebird]], consistently claiming himself to be the “biggest bird” out of the two.

Parrot is also extremely idealistic and heroic, believing he has to be the one to save everyone on the server no matter the consequences on him or the friends around him, and always refusing to be selfish. His strong convictions can occasionally blind him to alternative viewpoints. Nevertheless, he is generally considered among the most morally upstanding players on the server. 

== Boundaries ==

* No shipping or implied shipping
* No NSFW or sexualization
* No gore or self-harm (battle injury is fine, but nothing crazy)
* Nothing related to drugs or anything like that
* Keep everything appropriate for all ages

content:
History 
 Season 1 
Parrot goes to his house, where he sees Wemmbu. Wemmbu leads him to a massive crater that he found created by an Orbital Strike Cannon, and says that he didn’t make it. Parrot thinks that SpokeIsHere made the crater. He checks The Wonders, as he thinks that is why Spoke would be making an orbital strike cannon. Roshambogames tells Parrot that The Gardens of Babylon Wonder got destroyed. Parrot then goes on to see the destroyed wonder

He follows Wemmbu to his base, however he's nowhere to be seen after he enters.

Parrot discovers that The Crone wonder has been destroyed, the one Fantst was guarding. Parrot again follows Wemmbu back to his base, and he is again nowhere to be seen. He meets Wemmbu at a new TNT cannon Parrot built, and lies to Wemmbu telling him he made notes in an in-game book on how to find Spoke. He says he put it in the Ice Castle Wonder, and Wemmbu goes over there to find it. Parrot goes over to Wemmbu's base, and finds a secret vault under it, but doesn’t go into the vault. He goes back to his cannon where he sees Wemmbu. He tells Wemmbu that to find Spoke and his orbital cannon, he has to use the lag. Parrot leaves Wemmbu and builds his own orbital cannon.

Wemmbu finds Parrot with his orbital cannon and tells Parrot that he doesn’t know what he's doing. Wemmbu presses a button which blows up part of the cannon. Parrot leaves and goes to The Pyramid of Anubis Wonder. Spoke's orbital cannon destroys the build.

Parrot goes back into Wemmbu's vault to see what’s in there, and finds a bunch of weird contraptions. Wemmbu walks in with Roshambo, and Parrot hides at the top of the vault on the weeping vines. He hears them talk about him, and tells Roshambo to not let Parrot fire his cannons. After Roshambo leaves, Parrot jumps down and tries to attack Wemmbu, but stops when he realizes he likely couldn't kill him. Wemmbu leaves, and Parrot follows him, but stops when realizing that he doesn’t have enough rockets. He goes to his cannon, where Roshambo, Derapchu, JumperWho, and Fantst, all of the guards of the wonders come. They tell him he can't set the cannon off. Parrot tries to show them Wemmbu's vault, however the vault is gone.

Parrot comes back to his cannon, where it’s been destroyed. The server lags, indicating that one of The Wonders has been destroyed. He checks The Marshland Mansion Wonder, which’s been destroyed by Spoke's orbital cannon. Parrot agrees to save the Frosted Palace Wonder with the guardians of The Wonders. He plans that if he gets all the materials for the orbital cannon in fifteen minutes, and builds it all in one hour, then he can destroy Spoke's cannon before it destroys the Frosted Palace. They build the orbital cannon. After they’re done, they wait four and a half hours for it to destroy Spoke's cannon, however Spoke and Parrot’s cannon go off at the same time, though the Frosted Palace wonder is still destroyed.

Parrot finds a music disc accompanied by a texture pack. When played, it gives a message of Spoke saying that there’s a secret in the server, and that Parrot has to show that he deserved to know it. He gave Parrot coordinates to go to. Parrot invites Wifies to help him find this secret. He finds a medieval castle and opens the door by having him and Wifies step on 2 pressure plates. They obtain a disc and fly out as the castle is exploding to TNT.

Spoke sends him another texture pack, so Parrot plays the disc and it says that he has to "follow the light". Parrot assumes this means to go to the Zam Empire. He sees Wemmbu at the castle, and after a bit of chatting with him, PrinceZamcomes over. Wemmbu and PrinceZam are eager to get information about what is happening, as it has to do with Spoke, and they plan to kill Spoke. Wifies and Parrot fly away over to the castle. Parrot almost dies multiple times as Wemmbu and PrinceZam attacks them, but eventually they’re able to escape. He waits for them to leave, and then sees that the lighthouse’s redstone lamp is blinking in morse code. The morse code comes out as "-64". They find a stairway in the lighthouse to the coordinates -64, and open a chest which contains a music disc.

The disc tells them to bring flight duration 3 rockets, and not flight duration one. They have to travel 2000 blocks north. They decide not to bring flight duration 3 rockets, as they realize that one flight duration one rocket can travel super far. They get to the coordinates and find a void base made out of chest minecarts and shulker mobs, however they realize that the opening is sealed with obsidian. They go back to the old opening, but realize that it has now been sealed with cobblestone and obsidian. They go back to the void base to try and figure out what to do. Parrot realizes that using a fishing rod, he can help Wifies travel more distance with his limited firework rockets. They go back to the old opening, and place a crafting table on the block where they broke a cobblestone. Parrot crafts a fishing rod, and uses that to fish Wifies all the way to a separate base 5000 blocks out, where there is a different void hole they use to escape from the void.

They use the music disc again which gives a code. Parrot figures out that this is the code to PrinceZam's castle. They break into the castle and take a compass.

They play the disc, and it says that the disc is "pretty straight forward" and that this riddle gets "pretty straight to the point". The riddle is “lodestone”. They follow the compass to a lodestone in an ice spikes biome. They eventually find a chest that contains another lodestone compass. They follow the compass to a parkour ice mountain. There’s a person in full netherite armor with the chestplate and leggings being trimmed with redstone. This person is Spoke, but Parrot and Wifies don’t know that. He signals for them to put their items in two chests. They oblige and do the parkour.

After finishing the parkour, the guard gives them a music disc along with their stuff. They play the disc and begin the next challenge. They follow a compass to a giant obsidian structure. The guard places two chests so Wifies and Parrot can put their items in there again. They go into the obsidian maze, and discover that there are people in it. These people are Wemmbu and PrinceZam. Wemmbu finds them in the maze while they have nothing. Parrot and Wifies agree to lead Wemmbu to the next clue. However since Wemmbu didn't have the texture pack, it would be useless to him. After PrinceZam and Wemmbu get the jukebox and disc, Wifies and Parrot leave.

They go to PrinceZam's empire to see if they hid the disc, so they break into the vault and get the disc and a turtle egg using an auto stasis, although nearly dying in the process.. They escape into the nether, but Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them. They convince PrinceZam and Wemmbu to go into the overworld so they can team up, but after they go into the overworld, they mine out of the nether cave and escape.

They use a turtle egg to get to a shipwreck, where the guard signals them to put away their stuff. They’re given five water breathing potions, and a turtle shell. They go into the giant ship and use the clues they are given to discover an underground area covered with sculk, sculk sensors, and sculk shriekers. Luckily, wardens don’t spawn with man-made sculk shriekers, which allows them to obtain the next disc and a lodestone compass.

They travel to the coordinates the lodestone compass is pointing to, a jungle temple. They take the music disc and leave. The disc says to go to the a specific set of coordinates in the nether. The guard tells them to put away their items. They go through a nether portal which leads to an escape room with multiple wardens. They eventually manage to get out.

They find themselves in a badlands biome, however it’s enclosed in an obsidian box, and no mobs can spawn. They explore around the area, and find a couple of useful items. They also find a cave spider spawner. Using slime block launchers and blocks they obtained from underneath sugarcane, they are able to get into a new room. They go back into the badlands biome as they’re probably missing something. They come back with more wool blocks, and finally escape with their items.

Parrot and Wifies go back to Parrot’s house, where they find the guard, who reveals that they’re Spoke. Spoke says that only one person can uncover the secret, and that the other person will be banned off the server. He has them put all of their gear into chests. They go down two different staircases. They go head to head in six challenges. After these challenges are completed, they’re tied 3 - 3. The final game they play is chess. Spoke shows an area marked with a red line, which is a chunk ban for whoever loses. Parrot talks to Wifies and plans to end the game as a stalemate.

Parrot and Wifies go through with the plan, playing out the chess game and ending it with a stalemate. Spoke says that somebody has to be banned. Wifies steps on the red line, banning himself. Spoke reveals that there was no secret, and that his plan was to give him a close friend such as Wifies, just to ban him at the end. Wemmbu and the Zam Empire find Spoke and begin to chase him. Parrot tries to help them kill Spoke, however Spoke bans himself in the chunk ban before they can do it, with Wifies also stuck in that chunk ban.

Parrot and Rekrap2 attempt to break into the prison which holds Wifies and Spoke, to get Wifies out. They get caught and have to eat a chorus fruit to escape.

Parrot and Rekrap plan to free one of Spoke's henchmen, so they go over to an end dimension chunk ban to try and free them. Parrot builds a TNT cannon to try and explode the chunk ban, but the TNT cannon explodes itself and the guards notice. The guards almost kill Parrot, but he's able to fly away and hide. He comes back to try and make a new TNT cannon, but the guards come back. Luckily, Parrot is invisible so he isn't caught. He quickly builds another TNT cannon, but again this one fails to break the chunk ban. Parrot builds another TNT cannon, but this time he’s caught. He flies away and escapes.

Parrot tries to convince PrinceZam to temporarily disable the chunk ban and let Wifies out, but he says no. Parrot and Rekrap start breaking into an underwater prison. Parrot and Rekrap spawn withers, and after a while, one of the withers collides with the chunk ban, destroying it, freeing Derapchu.

Parrot and Rekrap and Derapchu go over to the next prison, which is built in a jungle. They start breaking into the prison. They manage to explode the chunk ban using a TNT cannon.

While traveling to PrinceZam's empire, the server crashes. When they join, they are sent back to a previous save. It appears that PrinceZam had added a new defense which makes it so that the server crashes when getting too close to certain locations, called a memory ban.

The team go to a nether prison, and try to break in. They discover that there are three chunk bans in this prison. They manage to destroy one of the chunk bans.

They move onto an ice themed prison. Using flying machines, they are able to free Fantst. Fantst agrees to join their team to break people out of prisons.

They go to a sky prison. They are able to destroy the chunk ban.

Fantst chunk bans himself as he thinks that the prisons will just get harder and harder, and will be impossible to break into.

They go to a new end prison and use TNT minecarts to destroy the chunk ban. The teammate has no interest of teaming with them. The team goes over to the first end prison they went to, and easily destroy the chunk bans using TNT minecarts. The player freed is JumperWho, who agrees to help them.

The team uses the nether to avoid the memory bans that crash the server. They find the prison that holds Spoke and Wifies and try to break in. They retreat back to their cave area to plan an escape. They figure out how they can chunk ban the guards. They set up an underground chunk ban setup, and have JumperWho lead the guards to the chunk ban. They manage to chunk ban all of the guards. Parrot is able to get _Kenadian_ to help them break out Wifies using a wither bore. They kill the baby piglins which are holding chunk bans using flying machines and TNT minecarts. They are successful in breaking out Wifies. They also accidentally free Spoke.

It is implied that Parrot breaks everyone out of every other prison.

PrinceZam hires ClownPierce to kill Parrot.

ClownPierce tries to kill Parrot. He uses all of Parrot's totems, but then leaves and tells Parrot to meet him at his castle. Parrot meets ClownPierce at his castle and ClownPierce gives him five seconds to run away. Parrot is able to get away from ClownPierce.

Parrot and Wifies find ClownPierce in a carnival. This is where he plans to have a fair 1v1 with Parrot. Parrot and Wifies 2v1 ClownPierce. They get mining fatigue meaning that they cannot break out and have to fight ClownPierce. Leow0ok, Willsion, and Woogiex, enemies of ClownPierce, break Parrot and Wifies out before they die. JumperWho and Derapchu are also teamed with them and are enemies of ClownPierce. They bring Parrot and Wifies to their base. Parrot and Wifies are sent to ClownPierce's castle to blow it up. Parrot manages to escape.

Leow0ok agrees to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, FerreMC, and Mugm_ come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues.

Inside of the obsidian vault is an escape room. Parrot and Wifies try to find the escape. They figure out how to make it through the first two layers of the escape room. ClownPierce and his team break in. Parrot and Wifies hide in the second layer of the escape room. ClownPierce and his team find the second layer. Parrot and Wifies find an exit labeled B5 and escape.

Parrot and Wifies go to Leow0ok and his team to complain about how they were abandoned in the vault. Afterwards, Wifies comes to his base and sees that ClownPierce blew up the terrain around it. Parrot flies away to Wemmbu's Civilization. ClownPierce eventually leaves after being unable to find Parrot. ClownPierce overhears Wemmbu and Parrot trying to team, and starts killing Wemmbu's villagers for information. ClownPierce eventually leaves.

Parrot and Wifies train for fighting ClownPierce. Parrot, Wifies, and the players against ClownPierce set up chunk bans at his castle. The team ambushes ClownPierce and his team. Unable to kill anybody, Parrot and the team leave and go back to the base. They see that the base has been completely destroyed.

Parrot goes over to Wemmbu's civilization to get a better team. Wemmbu agrees to team with Parrot. Parrot helps Wemmbu build chunk bans around the colony to stop intruders such as ClownPierce. Wemmbu tells ManePear and Merffinn that Parrot is a part of the colony, who are both guards of PrinceZam. Later, FlameFrags and a team of people come to destroy Wemmbu's colony. The invisible player in the fight is likely ClownPierce. After the war, Parrot parts ways with Wemmbu and the colony.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok's team to help him kidnap Branzy, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Parrot leaves to a jungle and starts building a base there. Wifies is able to find Parrot. He tries to convince him to come back and defeat ClownPierce. ClownPierce and FerreMC find his jungle base and destroy it. Parrot runs away.

Parrot comes back to Wemmbu's empire and sees it is destroyed. He goes over to ClownPierce's castle with the team, and starts destroying his castle. He tells ClownPierce he wants to 1v1 him in a fight. Parrot goes over to Branzy's base to kill him, but changes his mind after talking with Branzy.

Parrot fights ClownPierce in a 1v1. He had secretly made a trap with 30,000 TNT. Parrot is unable to kill ClownPierce with his trap. Parrot discovers ClownPierce blew up the headquarters secret meeting room.

Parrot discovers a book in his house. The book says to meet him at specific coordinates, and it has been written by ClownPierce. He thinks this book might have the answers to why certain players have disappeared from the server. Parrot and Wifies go to these coordinates and find two players, Jaden_MAN and Spongs, who call themselves the game masters. They state that for the quest, they can only use items that they give them, and they cannot cheat. They tell them to get a heart of the sea and bring it back to them. They can only use iron gear for this. They go into an underwater trial and are able to get a lodestone compass.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find them while they follow the lodestone compass. They try to intercept the hunt, but Parrot and Wifies escape using invisibility. Parrot and Wifies find two ships which appear to be ClownPierce themed. They use the clue they find at the ships which say to go to where the winds meet. They find an escape room and quickly solve it and obtain the heart of the sea. They realize that Derapchu's most prized possession is a heart of the sea, meaning that each item will probably correlate to one of the missing players.

The next quest is to get a pair of netherite boots, which would make sense because netherite boots are one of JumperWho’s most prized possessions. They find a giant mountain which leads into the clouds, and go inside. They are given five tasks to help the town in the sky, which are found in a book. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find them again. Parrot edits the book to get rid of some clues, and then gives the book to them. After they do all the tasks, they tell Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ that the hot air balloons are in an arrow, and that they have to follow the arrow. This is a lie. After they leave, they figure out that by flicking a certain lever, it activates a bunch of flying machines which look like flying lanterns.

After finding the netherite boots, they go to Boosfer, who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince Boosfer not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

The next quest is to get a poppy. They find a giant field of flowers, and they have to find which one is the poppy. They eventually find the poppy. They accidentally dig under the poppy and find a giant underground forest. They find a very long cave and follow it. It’s made out of only stone.

Eventually they find a valley. Following the valley, they find a giant tree. Inside of the tree, they find an escape room. After solving the escape room, they get a riddle. As they read that, Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ come over to the tree and start destroying it. They see Parrot in leather armor, so Parrot runs away and hides. They are able to find Parrot and Wifies.

Parrot gives them a fake riddle. They figure out that it’s a fake riddle, but Wifies has already secured the item in his ender chest. They realize this is Rekrap2’s base. Boosfer and his team leave. Parrot and Rekrap figure out this is a save haven for the passive animals, so they start to move all the animals out. While moving the animals, they find multiple giant TNT bomber planes coming. This is because Boosfer paid Wemmbu to destroy the valley. After moving the animals in the mountains so they don’t get blown up, they build up using melon blocks.

Using melon blocks, they try to stop the planes. Wemmbu finds them and they agree to team up to steal Boosfer and his team’s items.

Parrot and Wifies go to the next quest, and they find a sculk themed escape room. They make it through the escape room and find a cave. After following the cave, they find an ancient city. The clue says that the key to the vault is the heart of a warden. This implies they have to kill a warden. They plan to use dripstone to kill the warden. After killing it, they make it through the vault and get a diamond. They put the diamond in the item frame at the base, however Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find the diamond and steal it, along with all of their items.

Wemmbu, Parrot, and Wifies go to the headquarters to blow it up. They build an orbital cannon to destroy the base. After flying to the base, they activate the orbital cannon, completely destroying the top layer of the base. They use TNT and spawn withers to destroy the base. Wemmbu finds a stash of netherite blocks and diamond blocks and they steal all the items.

In the nether, Parrot and Wifies find a bunch of nether quartz which appears to be morse code. Once translated, it says 090.256 rurple. They go to the next coordinates and find a sign that says 840.32 cyan. They next find a chest which has items in it. They find that the items in the chest probably mean 670.5 brown. They find a sign under lava that says 960.18 pink. On the nether roof they find a sign saying 390.43 blue. They find a giant castle and go inside using striders. They use the codes they found to find books in the castle. After finding all the books, they bring it to the vault and input the books. In the vault they find the item, a wither rose.

They move onto the next quest, which is to go to the end. They go to the end with almost no items. In the end, they find an escape room-like obstacle course. After finishing the course, the book they find says “+ +”. They end up finding an end city, and inside is Wifies prized dragon head. Right before going through the end portal to escape, they find Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to kill Parrot and Wifies, but they escape to the outer end islands. They get gear from end cities to try and kill the dragon to escape. They find an ender chest and get their gear from the ender chest, and escape the end.

Parrot and Wifies go back to the base, and find ClownPierce. They ask ClownPierce why people have been missing, but he says he doesn’t know. Parrot puts his last item, the spyglass, in the item frame.

Parrot and Wifies are trapped by ClownPierce in a prison called Proton. Inside of the prison, they are given a small world with resources in it. They purposefully went into the prison to try and break some of their friends out. They realize no mobs are spawning in the prison. Wifies tries to go to a specific green section of the prison, but when he walks into the area, he gets chunk banned. The guard moves him into a hallway leading into a new cell of the prison. Rekrap gets transferred into the same room of the prison as Parrot. They find a house with a sign saying that JumperWho and Derapchu were here.

Wifies is un-chunk banned. Parrot realizes that the /msg command does not work because if you try to send a message, you get kicked from the server. When normally chatting, the messages do not show up in chat.

Parrot is transferred to the next prison. He finds _Kenadian_. Kenadian says he doesn’t know who designed the prison, but Parrot gets suspicious of him and Kenadian admits he designed the prison.

Parrot is transferred to the next room, which has Derapchu. They make maps to try and communicate. The guard transfers him to the next prison. In the prison Parrot finds JumperWho and gives her a map. They expand the map to slowly load it while going to different cells. JumperWho uses a pearl to expand the map and gets put in solitary confinement. Parrot sees Leow0ok. It turns out that Leow0ok is a visitor who intends to help them break out of Proton.

Leow0ok leaves and Wifies comes over to Parrot. They see in a map that someone wrote S.O.S. in morse code. They communicate using morse code in maps. A guard comes in and moves Parrot to a new cell.

While going through the hallway to the new cell, he hears someone asking for help, who he thinks is Eggchan, who is Wemmbu's friend. In the new cell, he finds Rekrap2. They find a wandering trader and buy a birch sapling. They use the sapling to get a tree with a bee nest which they are going to use to get honey. They realize that all the sand required to collect honey has been removed, and the only way to get sand is using a wandering trader. Rekrap is transferred to a new cell. A guard moves Parrot to a new cell, and he sees Kenadian. He tells Kenadian his plan to escape the cell.

While he’s talking with Kenadian, Wemmbu is dropped into the prison as a visitor. Parrot tells Wemmbu that they have not set up the stasis chamber yet, meaning they can’t get contraband items. He tells Wemmbu that he thinks eggchan is stuck in solitary confinement. Parrot is transferred to the next cell.

In the next prison he finds Wifies. They find a wandering trader. They’re able to buy both sand and slime. When Wifies is being transferred, Parrot relogs with a crying obsidian skin and follows him. Parrot uses this to communicate to JumperWho the plan to escape. The guard catches him. He is put in solitary confinement. A guard eventually comes and lets him out.

He goes over to a room with Derapchu. Parrot is transferred to the next cell. Parrot finds Rekrap2 in the next cell. They harvest honey and make a sticky piston for a stasis chamber. A guard comes over and destroys all of the hives in the honey farm. Parrot is transferred to the next prison.

Parrot and Kenadian now have the materials to build a honey pearl stasis chamber. Using eggs, they find just the right spot to throw the pearl with test projectiles. Wemmbu comes back as a visitor. They get the stasis to work on the last pearl. Kenadian begins trying to break the stasis. Wemmbu is teleported out of the prison. Kenadian decides not to destroy the stasis. They rotate to the next cell.

Parrot sees that eggchan is out of solitary confinement. He sees Wifies in the next cell and tells him about the plan. Parrot is transferred to the next cell.

Rekrap and Parrot and Kenadian activate the stasis chamber. They use the stasis chamber, and Wemmbu gets teleported in with contraband items. They pearl into every cell and give them ender chests. They go into the control room invisible, and pretend to be guards. JumperWho escapes from solitary confinement. Kenadian builds three wither bores and a missile to destroy the chunk ban. Using a couple more TNT flying machines, they are able to destroy all of the chunk bans, until they find a slime block machine which stops them from going further. Using pearls, they are able to pearl over the rest of the chunk bans.

Parrot uses an elytra to escape, leaving Kenadian in the prison. Kenadian writes in morse code on the map that he has an ender pearl stasis chamber at his base. They find his base in a lava pool and activate his stasis chamber.

Parrot and Wifies try to create a civilization in the end. They see that a player has been following them. They pop the totem of the person underground and find that it’s deanthebean9. He says he’s a part of The Invisible Mafia. They recruit him as a member in their civilization. Parrot tries to recruit people from the Zam empire, but sees it is completely destroyed. They move villagers into their end civilization. Players from the mafia find them and start trying to kill them.

They are able to escape. Parrot hires Horace_Altman to build the civilization. They finish bringing the villagers and see Horace made a giant island for the civilization. Parrot goes into the Mafia’s base to destroy deanthebean9’s stasis chamber. They are successful in getting him out.

Parrot discovers for some reason he now cannot leave the end. Parrot logs on the next day and sees Horace moved the entire island 100 blocks down. A couple of members join the civilization. Parrot learns that Wifies is able to go to the overworld. Horace builds a giant castle at the civilization. He also builds outposts near spawn. Boosfer comes over and tries to take over the civilization, and says that he wants to hold an election to decide if he becomes the new leader, or if Parrot stays the leader. Horace sets up chunk bans around the civilization.

What_Max goes to an outpost to join Parrot’s civilization, but finds that the mafia is there. The civilization helps him escape, but Parrot almost dies.

Horace greatly expands the empire. Wifies shows Parrot that he found a giant crater near their base. While going to the main island, Boosfer talks more about how he’ll run against Parrot. Fantst and LettuceK tell Parrot that there are invisible players circling around the chunk bans. The mafia send multiple bomber planes, but the civilization is able to stop them. Parrot tells them in the meeting room that they are unable to leave the end if they do not have a bed in the overworld because of a glitch.

Horace builds a giant dome around the civilization. Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ come over for the election. Boosfer is unsuccessful in winning the election. He tries to leave but accidentally gets chunk banned.

Deanthebean9 tells Parrot that yesterday an invisible player got into the civilization. A new bomber plane is sent to destroy the civilization. The mole from the mafia is able to turn off the chunk bans. After the mafia invades, all of the members of the civilization run away.

Parrot and his friends try to explode the civilization.

Parrot, Wifies, and deanthebean9 try to steal from Capital City, owned by Reddoons. They are caught by Reddoons and five of his guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. He says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

They find a group of miners, with CoinMonke as the warden. Parrot spends his time mining. Parrot and his friends steal from capital city vaults. Parrot gives PikaTM more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital City for them to be set free.

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. CoinMonke is fired. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in a vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

LuigiToan mentions a farlands civilization to Parrot. Parrot overhears Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that Ashswagg suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons’s diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though Reddoons won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and the mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the mafia, but they disagree. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber.

Parrot and his team run away. The mafia stops chasing them. The mafia finds them underground and begin blowing up the area. They are able to escape. The team goes into the nether, and again, the mafia finds them there and begins exploding the area. Using suspicious stew giving fire resistance, they go underground and escape to the overworld.

While boating, a mafia member finds them. They manage to use the players totem of undying by exploding them with a TNT minecart. He is teleported to the void for not being invisible. While inside of an ancient city, mafia members come in and begin exploding the ancient city. A warden spawns. They escape to the nether. After traveling a million blocks out, they find two players, R4trick and Finiahn, who agree to help them cross an obsidian wall that is owned by the mafia. R4trick says there are thousands of mafia members.

Parrot starts destroying an iron farm the mafia owns, but mafia members find them destroying it, and R4trick runs away. They escape using invisibility. They loot a trial chamber, but find that all of the ominous vaults were removed. They hear people who are revealed in a later episode to be Spoke and his friends, and start mining out. They go to the nether to escape.

They go onto the nether roof with horses and begin making it to the farlands. The mafia finds them and begins killing them. They escape to the overworld.

Right before getting to the farlands, deanthebean9 tells Parrot that he has been the reason the mafia found them every time. Deanthebean9 leaves. Wifies burns the compass they were using to find the farlands civilization. Parrot leaves without Wifies.

He finds a player named Qu1nten at the farlands who helps him find the farlands civilization. Parrot convinces Horace_Altman, the leader, to team up with him. Parrot joins the warriors faction. As their first mission, they have to blow up a mafia storage. After blowing it up, they get tricked into going into an obsidian hallway for a mission, where a diamond tier player is. The player kills the mission leader. The others manage to escape using nether portals.

Parrot and TheobaldTheBird have a competition against Purpled for who becomes the next mission leader. TheobaldTheBird wins using TNT minecarts. Parrot sees Wifies in the civilization. Parrot goes over to the farming faction, and _Kenadian_ explains that the reason why they dislike the warriors is because the warriors never protected them when they needed protection, so they stopped giving them resources.

The warriors and the farmers play capture the flag. The farmers win the game. Parrot finds deanthebean9, but Parrot still doesn’t trust him. Parrot goes on a mission with the warriors to kill a diamond tier player in mafia city. They retreat from the fight. Purpled gives them diamond trimmed boots. Parrot agrees to fight DumbIsDumb to become a council member. By flooding the arena with water, Parrot is able to win.

The civilization discovers that there are mafia players near the farlands. They find a gold tier player in the nether who is able to escape. They intercept the gold tier player when he is giving his message to ashswagg. They pretend to be diamond tier players, and then kill him with a fall trap.

Purpled tries to have the council members kill Parrot, but he escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members. Parrot unites the warriors and the farmers.

Parrot goes to visit deanthebean9, but sees he isn’t there. Parrot sees a bunch of TNT bomber planes heading towards spawn. He uses the totem of undying of one of the mafia members, revealing it is deanthebean9. Deanthebean9 is teleported into the void and dies.

Ashswagg takes the warrior members hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. After evacuating all of the members, he goes over to ashswagg’s castle to talk to him. Parrot leaves using his fishing rod stasis chamber.

The mafia destroys the farlands civilization. Horace and the five other players who are still alive create a new civilization called District 13. Parrot invites R4trick and Finiahn. Horace joins the mafia and leaves the civilization. The team tries to kill ashswagg, but he escapes. ClownPierce tries to kill them, but they are able to escape.

A new player named Yusai_ is added to the civilization. Parrot kills him as he could be a part of the mafia. Parrot and Wifies go to spawn and see that the mafia is tearing down spawn. Spoke and Mapicc see them and they talk about the mafia. They go over to the base of iMajesticRose, where Spoke was sent to assassinate her while he was infiltrating the mafia. They see a diamond tier player at the base. They follow the diamond tier player to a base where a full iron armor player is at. The player asks if they know anything about who killed iMajesticRose, who was his daughter.

Spoke is able to find a book allegedly containing the coordinates of ashswagg’s stasis chamber. Parrot invites Spoke and Mapicc to the District 13. Spoke tells them that at the coordinates he went to where the stasis chamber would allegedly be, there was instead a book that looked like it was directions to something else. Spoke and Mapicc leave. R4trick, Finiahn, _Kenadian_, and JumperWho join the mafia. Rekrap2, Wato1876, and TheobaldTheBird leave District 13. It’s now just Parrot and Wifies.

Wemmbu and eggchan agree to team with Parrot to kill ClownPierce. Together, they are able to kill a diamond tier player. Parrot and Wifies try to kill ashswagg, but because him dying automatically kills everyone in the mafia, including their friends, they don’t kill him.

Parrot and Wifies build a house in a snowy biome. They see a sign that says "I found you." Ashswagg tells them to join the mafia. Wifies joins the mafia for Parrot. Parrot, Mapicc, SpokeIsHere, Wemmbu, and Eggchan break into the spawn prison where the mafia forces players to join the mafia.

Ashswagg meets Parrot at Parrot and Wifies house. Ashswagg kills Wifies in front of parrot. Parrot plans with Spoke and Wemmbu on how to end the mafia, as Spoke figured out the location of all the stasis chambers. They are able to end the mafia. Ashswagg and Parrot talk. Ashswagg says that The Director is the one who told him to Wifies.

 Season 2 
ItzRealMe tries to assassinate Parrot. A team of people save him from ItzRealMe. They escape to the nether. They invite Parrot to Bounty Assassin Team, also known as BAT. Parrot and Leow0ok see ItzRealMe inside of Parrot’s house. They start constructing a prison around ItzRealMe.

Parrot is given his own room in the BAT Headquarters. BAT tries to kill ItzRealMe, but are forced to run away as he has a mace. ItzRealMe later finds Parrot in the BAT headquarters. The BAT team saves Parrot. ItzRealMe tells Parrot that The Director is the one who hired him to assassinate Parrot.

MrCube6 tries to assasinate Parrot by trapping him under the void. Derapchu finds Parrot and saves him. Parrot sees an invisible player sitting in one of the chairs during a meeting, which is most likely MrCube6.

Derapchu is trapped by MrCube6 on a pressure plate. Parrot and the team have to figure out which redstone lines to activate to save him and the entire base from exploding within a certain amount of time. MrCube6 also says that he sent a TNT bomber plane towards their base. They are able to save Derapchu.

Parrot sets up a trap and catches MrCube6. They trap him in a prison. MrCube6 manages to escape. MrCube6 steals all of the gear from the headquarters. MrCube6 gives these items to 4CVIT. Parrot and Derapchu take the shulker boxes of items back. A team of bandits try to steal from Parrot and Derapchu, but fail.

BAT finds MrCube6 and detains him. They interrogate MrCube6. They give MrCube6 a dandelion. MrCube6 escapes with a stasis chamber, but not before he gives Parrot a book by The Director. The book states something about a dandelion, implying that The Director somehow knew that MrCube6 got a dandelion.

Parrot finds a chest in his room with a sign saying to run. Inside the chest is two stacks of ender pearls and an invisibility potion. The BAT headquarters go into lockdown mode, so Parrot uses an invisibility potion and hides. The BAT team tries to find Parrot to presumably kill him. Parrot flies away to make his own base.

BAT finds Parrot and claim that he’s The Director. Parrot runs to the nether. They find Parrot on the nether roof. Parrot manages to escape.

JumperWho finds Parrot in an abandoned city. JumperWho tells him that she was the one who put the chest and the sign in his room. Parrot becomes a JumperWho spy to figure out how he had been framed for being The Director.

JumperWho gives Parrot the pieces of evidence that BAT thought showed he was The Director. Leow0ok does a "mole check" to see if any of JumperWho’s spies were moles by having them hold a green shield. Parrot takes a green banner off of the wall and combines it with his shield. Parrot is the only spy who holds a green shield, showing that he is a mole. Parrot manages to escape.

Parrot finds a book asking Parrot to meet up with him. Parrot spies on BAT team’s meeting. JumperWho betrays him and tells BAT that he is spying on them. Parrot manages to escape during the chaos. JumperWho tells Parrot that she was actually just pretending to betray Parrot because BAT didn’t trust her. Parrot discovers that someone was spying on them. JumperWho uses a goat horn to call back her spy. They kill the spy.

The BAT team watches Parrot and The Director have a conversation, which convinces BAT that Parrot is not The Director. The Director teleports away. Leow0ok discovers that JumperWho killed a spy, and kick her off the team.

A player named TruOriginal tries to kill Nufuli, Parrot, and Leow0ok using hacks. They are eventually able to escape. The BAT headquarters is destroyed by TruOriginal who uses a hack to use other people's usernames and skins. TruOriginal tries to kill them. Leow0ok stays behind so BAT can escape. Leow0ok eventually escapes and finds BAT.

TruOriginal tries to kill them but eventually runs away. BAT make a new base and guard it. TruOriginal tries to kill them again. He changes time to try and kill them. BAT lead TruOriginal into a trap to try and kill him, but he teleports Parrot into the trap, almost killing him. He is luckily able to escape. They pretend that they have a second trap and scare TruOriginal away.

TruOriginal finds Parrot and Nufuli. Unbeknownst to him, Parrot and Nufuli were above a secret underground base, where Derapchu and Leow0ok were AFK sleeping in real life. TruOriginal deletes all of Parrot's items. TruOriginal teleports Parrot thousands of blocks into the sky. Nufuli saves Parrot from dying.

TruOriginal kidnaps Derapchu and Leow0ok. He pretends to be Leow0ok using a hack and tries to kill Parrot and Nufuli. Using a trap, they are able to kill TruOriginal.

Nufuli leaves the team, and as he is leaving, the Director kills him. They see the Director and try to kill him. The Director uses a pearl cannon to escape. BAT use the pearl cannon to try and go after the Director. They find themselves in an obsidian room, where the Director tries to kill them using an army of zombies with netherite armor and weapons. They are able to escape.

BAT go over to a redstone shop to see if the Director is there. They eventually find a player wearing the same armor as the Director. They force him to drink milk, revealing he is MrCube6. The real Director comes over and saves MrCube6. The Director tries to kill BAT using TNT but fails. Parrot flies up to avoid the TNT, and his elytra breaks. JumperWho saves Parrot from dying to fall damage. Jumper is re-added to BAT.

Jumper leads BAT to a secret base that she created. The Director gives BAT a message, telling Parrot to meet up with him in one week. SpokeIsHere finds the secret base BAT live in and secretly pranks them and steals from them, and pretends he's the Director. Spoke is eventually caught and is forced to escape.

BAT spies on the Director and Parrot having their conversation. JumperWho's spies spy on a list of suspects for people who could potentially be the Director. They see all of them online while the Director and Parrot have their conversation. Parrot sees the Director hold a chest plate with a red armor trim, causing him to believe the Director is Spoke, as Spoke normally wears that chest plate. Parrot convinces Leow0ok and Derapchu to pretend to be spies so that Parrot can threaten to kill the supposed spies unless JumperWho confesses. This plan fails as Leow0ok and Derapchu stop pretending to be spies after JumperWho doesn't confess.

While JumperWho and Derapchu are out of the base, Leow0ok tries to kill ParrotX2 because he had lost so much because of Parrot. He eventually decides to spare Parrot's life after Parrot falls into the void with slow falling, and begs Leo. After Leo saved Parrot, Parrot tells Leow0ok to leave and he obliges.

Parrot goes over to Wifies' base. JumperWho and Derapchu find Parrot at his base, and Parrot tells them about Leow0ok trying to kill him. The Director finds them, and so they try to kill them. The Director traps JumperWho and Derapchu in an obsidian room over the void.

Parrot and Leow0ok make a plan to save JumperWho and Derapchu using a happy ghast. Leow0ok saves them using a happy ghast while Parrot distracts the Director. The Director reveals to Parrot that he has secretly been Wifies the entire time. Wifies explains how he faked his death. He explains that Parrot was never in any real danger, and he did everything to protect him and to study and learn how Parrot works. He asks Parrot to follow him. Parrot refuses, saying that Wifies obviously isn't gonna kill him if he doesn't. Wifies says that while that's true, he will not hesitate to kill Parrots friends. Parrot, realizing that Wifies has changed, follows him.

Parrot is trapped in Paragon. Wifies gives Parrot some food and then leaves. Parrot attempts to escape the prison, only to discover that outside of his cell was a much bigger prison, enclosing the terrain of the map. Wifies tells Parrot to drop all of his items, and he obliges, including discarding his spyglass.

Parrot tries to kill Wifies, but he manages to escape as after his totem of undying was used, a stasis chamber teleported him away. Parrot tries to escape the prison, but as he is building out of the prison, two invisible players splash him with slow falling and hit him off. Parrot finds a house that presumably belongs to Wifies, and burns it down. Parrot trades with a piglin in the nether to get pearls. He set up a stasis chamber in the overworld which would activate when the sun set. He uses the second pearl to get to the nether roof. The guards stop him from escaping using the nether roof, but then Parrot's stasis chamber activates. Wifies stops him from escaping.

Parrot plans to get close to Wifies to then kill him. He tries to kill Wifies while he's AFK with dripstone, but fails. Wifies shows Parrot a door to the outside world, where Wifies says that the way he knew things that he shouldn't was by using JumperWho.

Parrot traps one of the guards to try and steal their gear and escape. The guard who is trapped is revealed to be JumperWho. She explains that the other guards are Derapchu and Leow0ok. Wifies catches Parrot and tells JumperWho to leave. Wifies shows that he knows the exact items in his hotbar, and how many hunger bars he has left. Wifies brings Parrot to a room where there are two pressure plates. After they step on them, Wifies tells Parrot that if either of them step off or break any blocks, the entire place explodes. Parrot manages to smuggle in a spyglass. Parrot drops the spyglass on the pressure plate and escapes. Wifies steps off the pressure plate to pick up the spyglass, and the entire base explodes, killing Wifies. Parrot escapes.

Parrot flees from Paragon and travels to an end portal, using it to go to spawn. Upon arriving at spawn, he finds a barren wasteland. As Parrot tries to escape spawn, a wither starts attacking him. After escaping the wither, a new wither begins attacking him. TheobaldTheBird saves Parrot from the wither.

Parrot fears that Theo will kill him. However, he says that he won't. They both venture to Capital City, which has now been completely remade, at spawn. After arriving, Theo uses the nether star from the dead wither to pay off his debt and Parrot opens a potion shop.

Running the shop did not go according to plan however, and only one sale was made. Theo and Parrot go to spawn to help players escape spawn for payment.

Parrot and Theobald enter a betting game led by Boosfer, which turns out to be a scam. Figuring this out, Parrot is able to steal their stash of three enchanted apples, three totems and three netherite ingots.

Back in the city, Parrot listens in proximity chat as his neighbor gets threatened by Reddoons. Parrot places all the items he had stolen from Boosfer inside one of their chests, to be nice.

Parrot gets a letter and a lodestone compass, from Leow0ok, explaining how Bounty Assassin Team is being remade. In the book, he instructs Parrot on how he could get a happy ghast. They are however, they are attacked by Boosfer and his guards, while going to the location. They are able to escape with the happy ghast.

Once back in Capital City, Parrot places the Happy Ghast in Reddoons' Animal Care Department. Reddoons asks Parrot to help Hexatope escape from spawn. In return, Parrot asks for the clearing of debt of all citizens of the city. Reddoons agrees.

Hexatope is able to escape spawn. Before they can enter Capital City, Boosfer and his guards confront them. Parrot and Theo are able to kill them, and Boosfer has to run away.

To have more room for the overflowing amount of new players Parrot decides to send 1000 players to explore a new area build a new civilization named Skymore and determine if the area is actually livable for the thousands of players who had no where left to go. Arriving in the desired area, Parrot gives a speech, announcing that the location would be the start of Skymore. Soon  after the players started to work, Parrot left, promising to come back in exactly a week to check in and deliver resources.

Following up with his promise, Parrot comes back to the civilization with 20 players only to find it abandoned. He yells out annoucing his presence but no one responds. Everybody's gone but there aren't any signs of an invasion or ransacking. After giving some intructions to investigate, the squad spreads out to find clues. Before letting them go, Parrot gives one more instruction; If he blows the goat horn then they have to report back to the kingdom immediatly. 

The squad heads off with Parrot and Theo searching around the village. The more they investigate, the stranger the situation becomes. All the signs are still standing and furnaces are still smelting. After a while of looking around the area they start to enter houses and thats when they finally find a sign in the attic. "Reina , I had to run follow the farmland." 

They go outside and pillar up next to the farmland. Parrot watches the ground for a while before having a realization and he tells Theo to cover up a few blocks. After covering up the blocks, the random dots and dashes in the ground turn out to be morse code. The message saying; "I RAN EAST E - ZOE" Theo questioned why they had to write in morse code and Parrot agrees, concluding that Reina and Zoe used to be members of Skymore and after whatever happened, the two were seperated and were trying to find each other. 

Parrot's thoughts are disturbed with a squad member running towards them and telling him he heard him blowing the emergency horn and he asked why. Parrot quickly jumped down and rushed towards the squad member, he didn't blow the horn, he never did. The guard tells him that it was blown from the east and with that, Parrot starts to blow his horn. He rushes towards the east section of the abandoned Skymore only to find no one, everybody has ran towards the other sound of a horn.

To Parrot's absolute dismay, only 5 of the 20 players returned. After commanding his remaining squadron to stay together and follow him, they start to travel east. The squadron, Parrot and Theo travel from a while until they hear the sound of a goat horn, coming from where their heading. They all pause for a moment, listening to the continues blows of the foreign person. Theo says that they have to go back because its too dangerous but Parrot decides against it and continues forward. Parrot follows the sound of the goat horn and arrives by a patch of grass and after digging, he finds a staircase downwards. He asks for anyone to go with him but the members of the squadron are too scared so Theo goes down with him.

The two slowly descend the staircase, expecting an attack from below but nothing comes. They find lots of chests containing the armor and items of the other 15 squadron members. They rumage through the chests before returning to the surface, only to find that the last 5 squad members had disappeared.
