== History ==
=== [[Season 1]] ===
Parrot goes to his house, where he sees [[Wemmbu]]. Wemmbu leads him to a massive crater that he found created by an [[Orbital Strike Cannon]], and says that he didn’t make it. Parrot thinks that [[SpokeIsHere]] made the crater. He checks [[The Wonders]], as he thinks that is why Spoke would be making an orbital strike cannon. [[Roshambogames]] tells Parrot that The Gardens of Babylon Wonder got destroyed. Parrot then goes on to see the destroyed wonder

He follows Wemmbu to his base, however he's nowhere to be seen after he enters.

Parrot discovers that The Crone wonder has been destroyed, the one [[Fantst]] was guarding. Parrot again follows Wemmbu back to his base, and he is again nowhere to be seen. He meets Wemmbu at a new TNT cannon Parrot built, and lies to Wemmbu telling him he made notes in an in-game book on how to find Spoke. He says he put it in the Ice Castle Wonder, and Wemmbu goes over there to find it. Parrot goes over to Wemmbu's base, and finds a secret vault under it, but doesn’t go into the vault. He goes back to his cannon where he sees Wemmbu. He tells Wemmbu that to find Spoke and his orbital cannon, he has to use the lag. Parrot leaves Wemmbu and builds his own orbital cannon.

Wemmbu finds Parrot with his orbital cannon and tells Parrot that he doesn’t know what he's doing. Wemmbu presses a button which blows up part of the cannon. Parrot leaves and goes to The Pyramid of Anubis Wonder. Spoke's orbital cannon destroys the build.

Parrot goes back into Wemmbu's vault to see what’s in there, and finds a bunch of weird contraptions. Wemmbu walks in with Roshambo, and Parrot hides at the top of the vault on the weeping vines. He hears them talk about him, and tells Roshambo to not let Parrot fire his cannons. After Roshambo leaves, Parrot jumps down and tries to attack Wemmbu, but stops when he realizes he likely couldn't kill him. Wemmbu leaves, and Parrot follows him, but stops when realizing that he doesn’t have enough rockets. He goes to his cannon, where Roshambo, [[Derapchu]], [[JumperWho]], and Fantst, all of the guards of the wonders come. They tell him he can't set the cannon off. Parrot tries to show them Wemmbu's vault, however the vault is gone.

Parrot comes back to his cannon, where it’s been destroyed. The server lags, indicating that one of The Wonders has been destroyed. He checks The Marshland Mansion Wonder, which’s been destroyed by Spoke's orbital cannon. Parrot agrees to save the Frosted Palace Wonder with the guardians of The Wonders. He plans that if he gets all the materials for the orbital cannon in fifteen minutes, and builds it all in one hour, then he can destroy Spoke's cannon before it destroys the Frosted Palace. They build the orbital cannon. After they’re done, they wait four and a half hours for it to destroy Spoke's cannon, however Spoke and Parrot’s cannon go off at the same time, though the Frosted Palace wonder is still destroyed.

Parrot finds a music disc accompanied by a texture pack. When played, it gives a message of Spoke saying that there’s a secret in the server, and that Parrot has to show that he deserved to know it. He gave Parrot coordinates to go to. Parrot invites Wifies to help him find this secret. He finds a medieval castle and opens the door by having him and Wifies step on 2 pressure plates. They obtain a disc and fly out as the castle is exploding to TNT.

Spoke sends him another texture pack, so Parrot plays the disc and it says that he has to "follow the light". Parrot assumes this means to go to the [[Zam Empire]]. He sees Wemmbu at the castle, and after a bit of chatting with him, [[PrinceZam]]<nowiki/>comes over. Wemmbu and PrinceZam are eager to get information about what is happening, as it has to do with Spoke, and they plan to kill Spoke. Wifies and Parrot fly away over to the castle. Parrot almost dies multiple times as Wemmbu and PrinceZam attacks them, but eventually they’re able to escape. He waits for them to leave, and then sees that the lighthouse’s redstone lamp is blinking in morse code. The morse code comes out as "-64". They find a stairway in the lighthouse to the coordinates -64, and open a chest which contains a music disc.

The disc tells them to bring flight duration 3 rockets, and not flight duration one. They have to travel 2000 blocks north. They decide not to bring flight duration 3 rockets, as they realize that one flight duration one rocket can travel super far. They get to the coordinates and find a void base made out of chest minecarts and shulker mobs, however they realize that the opening is sealed with obsidian. They go back to the old opening, but realize that it has now been sealed with cobblestone and obsidian. They go back to the void base to try and figure out what to do. Parrot realizes that using a fishing rod, he can help Wifies travel more distance with his limited firework rockets. They go back to the old opening, and place a crafting table on the block where they broke a cobblestone. Parrot crafts a fishing rod, and uses that to fish Wifies all the way to a separate base 5000 blocks out, where there is a different void hole they use to escape from the void.

They use the music disc again which gives a code. Parrot figures out that this is the code to PrinceZam's castle. They break into the castle and take a compass.

They play the disc, and it says that the disc is "pretty straight forward" and that this riddle gets "pretty straight to the point". The riddle is “lodestone”. They follow the compass to a lodestone in an ice spikes biome. They eventually find a chest that contains another lodestone compass. They follow the compass to a parkour ice mountain. There’s a person in full netherite armor with the chestplate and leggings being trimmed with redstone. This person is Spoke, but Parrot and Wifies don’t know that. He signals for them to put their items in two chests. They oblige and do the parkour.

After finishing the parkour, the guard gives them a music disc along with their stuff. They play the disc and begin the next challenge. They follow a compass to a giant obsidian structure. The guard places two chests so Wifies and Parrot can put their items in there again. They go into the obsidian maze, and discover that there are people in it. These people are Wemmbu and PrinceZam. Wemmbu finds them in the maze while they have nothing. Parrot and Wifies agree to lead Wemmbu to the next clue. However since Wemmbu didn't have the texture pack, it would be useless to him. After PrinceZam and Wemmbu get the jukebox and disc, Wifies and Parrot leave.

They go to PrinceZam's empire to see if they hid the disc, so they break into the vault and get the disc and a turtle egg using an auto stasis, although nearly dying in the process.. They escape into the nether, but Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them. They convince PrinceZam and Wemmbu to go into the overworld so they can team up, but after they go into the overworld, they mine out of the nether cave and escape.

They use a turtle egg to get to a shipwreck, where the guard signals them to put away their stuff. They’re given five water breathing potions, and a turtle shell. They go into the giant ship and use the clues they are given to discover an underground area covered with sculk, sculk sensors, and sculk shriekers. Luckily, wardens don’t spawn with man-made sculk shriekers, which allows them to obtain the next disc and a lodestone compass.

They travel to the coordinates the lodestone compass is pointing to, a jungle temple. They take the music disc and leave. The disc says to go to the a specific set of coordinates in the nether. The guard tells them to put away their items. They go through a nether portal which leads to an escape room with multiple wardens. They eventually manage to get out.

They find themselves in a badlands biome, however it’s enclosed in an obsidian box, and no mobs can spawn. They explore around the area, and find a couple of useful items. They also find a cave spider spawner. Using slime block launchers and blocks they obtained from underneath sugarcane, they are able to get into a new room. They go back into the badlands biome as they’re probably missing something. They come back with more wool blocks, and finally escape with their items.

Parrot and Wifies go back to Parrot’s house, where they find the guard, who reveals that they’re Spoke. Spoke says that only one person can uncover the secret, and that the other person will be banned off the server. He has them put all of their gear into chests. They go down two different staircases. They go head to head in six challenges. After these challenges are completed, they’re tied 3 - 3. The final game they play is chess. Spoke shows an area marked with a red line, which is a [[chunk ban]] for whoever loses. Parrot talks to Wifies and plans to end the game as a stalemate.

Parrot and Wifies go through with the plan, playing out the chess game and ending it with a stalemate. Spoke says that somebody has to be banned. [[Wifies]] steps on the red line, banning himself. Spoke reveals that there was no secret, and that his plan was to give him a close friend such as Wifies, just to ban him at the end. Wemmbu and the Zam Empire find Spoke and begin to chase him. Parrot tries to help them kill Spoke, however Spoke bans himself in the chunk ban before they can do it, with Wifies also stuck in that chunk ban.

Parrot and [[Rekrap2]] attempt to break into the prison which holds Wifies and Spoke, to get Wifies out. They get caught and have to eat a chorus fruit to escape.

Parrot and Rekrap plan to free one of Spoke's henchmen, so they go over to an end dimension chunk ban to try and free them. Parrot builds a TNT cannon to try and explode the chunk ban, but the TNT cannon explodes itself and the guards notice. The guards almost kill Parrot, but he's able to fly away and hide. He comes back to try and make a new TNT cannon, but the guards come back. Luckily, Parrot is invisible so he isn't caught. He quickly builds another TNT cannon, but again this one fails to break the chunk ban. Parrot builds another TNT cannon, but this time he’s caught. He flies away and escapes.

Parrot tries to convince PrinceZam to temporarily disable the chunk ban and let Wifies out, but he says no. Parrot and Rekrap start breaking into an underwater prison. Parrot and Rekrap spawn withers, and after a while, one of the withers collides with the chunk ban, destroying it, freeing Derapchu.

Parrot and Rekrap and Derapchu go over to the next prison, which is built in a jungle. They start breaking into the prison. They manage to explode the chunk ban using a TNT cannon.

While traveling to PrinceZam's empire, the server crashes. When they join, they are sent back to a previous save. It appears that PrinceZam had added a new defense which makes it so that the server crashes when getting too close to certain locations, called a [[Memory Ban|memory ban]].

The team go to a nether prison, and try to break in. They discover that there are three chunk bans in this prison. They manage to destroy one of the chunk bans.

They move onto an ice themed prison. Using flying machines, they are able to free Fantst. Fantst agrees to join their team to break people out of prisons.

They go to a sky prison. They are able to destroy the chunk ban.

Fantst chunk bans himself as he thinks that the prisons will just get harder and harder, and will be impossible to break into.

They go to a new end prison and use TNT minecarts to destroy the chunk ban. The teammate has no interest of teaming with them. The team goes over to the first end prison they went to, and easily destroy the chunk bans using TNT minecarts. The player freed is JumperWho, who agrees to help them.

The team uses the nether to avoid the memory bans that crash the server. They find the prison that holds Spoke and Wifies and try to break in. They retreat back to their cave area to plan an escape. They figure out how they can chunk ban the guards. They set up an underground chunk ban setup, and have JumperWho lead the guards to the chunk ban. They manage to chunk ban all of the guards. Parrot is able to get [[_Kenadian_]] to help them break out Wifies using a wither bore. They kill the baby piglins which are holding chunk bans using flying machines and TNT minecarts. They are successful in breaking out Wifies. They also accidentally free Spoke.

It is implied that Parrot breaks everyone out of every other prison.

PrinceZam hires [[ClownPierce]] to kill Parrot.

ClownPierce tries to kill Parrot. He uses all of Parrot's totems, but then leaves and tells Parrot to meet him at his castle. Parrot meets ClownPierce at his [[ClownPierce's Castle|castle]] and ClownPierce gives him five seconds to run away. Parrot is able to get away from ClownPierce.

Parrot and Wifies find ClownPierce in a carnival. This is where he plans to have a fair 1v1 with Parrot. Parrot and Wifies 2v1 ClownPierce. They get mining fatigue meaning that they cannot break out and have to fight ClownPierce. [[Leow0ok]], [[Willsion]], and [[Woogiex]], enemies of ClownPierce, break Parrot and Wifies out before they die. JumperWho and Derapchu are also teamed with them and are enemies of ClownPierce. They bring Parrot and Wifies to their base. Parrot and Wifies are sent to ClownPierce's castle to blow it up. Parrot manages to escape.

Leow0ok agrees to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. [[ClownPierce]], [[FerreMC]], and [[Mugm_]] come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues.

Inside of the obsidian vault is an escape room. Parrot and Wifies try to find the escape. They figure out how to make it through the first two layers of the escape room. ClownPierce and his team break in. Parrot and Wifies hide in the second layer of the escape room. ClownPierce and his team find the second layer. Parrot and Wifies find an exit labeled B5 and escape.

Parrot and Wifies go to Leow0ok and his team to complain about how they were abandoned in the vault. Afterwards, Wifies comes to his base and sees that ClownPierce blew up the terrain around it. Parrot flies away to [[Wemmbu's Civilization]]. ClownPierce eventually leaves after being unable to find Parrot. ClownPierce overhears Wemmbu and Parrot trying to team, and starts killing Wemmbu's villagers for information. ClownPierce eventually leaves.

Parrot and Wifies train for fighting ClownPierce. Parrot, Wifies, and the players against ClownPierce set up chunk bans at his castle. The team ambushes ClownPierce and his team. Unable to kill anybody, Parrot and the team leave and go back to the base. They see that the base has been completely destroyed.

Parrot goes over to Wemmbu's civilization to get a better team. Wemmbu agrees to team with Parrot. Parrot helps Wemmbu build chunk bans around the colony to stop intruders such as ClownPierce. Wemmbu tells [[ManePear]] and [[Merffinn]] that Parrot is a part of the colony, who are both guards of PrinceZam. Later, [[FlameFrags]] and a team of people come to destroy Wemmbu's colony. The invisible player in the fight is likely [[ClownPierce]]. After the war, Parrot parts ways with Wemmbu and the colony.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok's team to help him kidnap Branzy, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Parrot leaves to a jungle and starts building a base there. Wifies is able to find Parrot. He tries to convince him to come back and defeat ClownPierce. ClownPierce and FerreMC find his jungle base and destroy it. Parrot runs away.

Parrot comes back to Wemmbu's empire and sees it is destroyed. He goes over to ClownPierce's castle with the team, and starts destroying his castle. He tells ClownPierce he wants to 1v1 him in a fight. Parrot goes over to Branzy's base to kill him, but changes his mind after talking with Branzy.

Parrot fights ClownPierce in a 1v1. He had secretly made a trap with 30,000 TNT. Parrot is unable to kill ClownPierce with his trap. Parrot discovers ClownPierce blew up the headquarters secret meeting room.

Parrot discovers a book in his house. The book says to meet him at specific coordinates, and it has been written by ClownPierce. He thinks this book might have the answers to why certain players have disappeared from the server. Parrot and Wifies go to these coordinates and find two players, [[Jaden_MAN]] and [[Spongs]], who call themselves the game masters. They state that for the quest, they can only use items that they give them, and they cannot cheat. They tell them to get a heart of the sea and bring it back to them. They can only use iron gear for this. They go into an underwater trial and are able to get a lodestone compass.

[[Kierrrr]] and [[Its_Dev_]] find them while they follow the lodestone compass. They try to intercept the hunt, but Parrot and Wifies escape using invisibility. Parrot and [[Wifies]] find two ships which appear to be ClownPierce themed. They use the clue they find at the ships which say to go to where the winds meet. They find an escape room and quickly solve it and obtain the heart of the sea. They realize that Derapchu's most prized possession is a heart of the sea, meaning that each item will probably correlate to one of the missing players.

The next quest is to get a pair of netherite boots, which would make sense because netherite boots are one of [[JumperWho|JumperWho’s]] most prized possessions. They find a giant mountain which leads into the clouds, and go inside. They are given five tasks to help the town in the sky, which are found in a book. [[Kierrrr]] and [[Its_Dev_]] find them again. Parrot edits the book to get rid of some clues, and then gives the book to them. After they do all the tasks, they tell [[Kierrrr]] and [[Its_Dev_]] that the hot air balloons are in an arrow, and that they have to follow the arrow. This is a lie. After they leave, they figure out that by flicking a certain lever, it activates a bunch of flying machines which look like flying lanterns.

After finding the netherite boots, they go to [[Boosfer]], who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince Boosfer not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

The next quest is to get a poppy. They find a giant field of flowers, and they have to find which one is the poppy. They eventually find the poppy. They accidentally dig under the poppy and find a giant underground forest. They find a very long cave and follow it. It’s made out of only stone.

Eventually they find a valley. Following the valley, they find a giant tree. Inside of the tree, they find an escape room. After solving the escape room, they get a riddle. As they read that, Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ come over to the tree and start destroying it. They see Parrot in leather armor, so Parrot runs away and hides. They are able to find Parrot and Wifies.

Parrot gives them a fake riddle. They figure out that it’s a fake riddle, but Wifies has already secured the item in his ender chest. They realize this is Rekrap2’s base. [[Boosfer]] and his team leave. Parrot and Rekrap figure out this is a save haven for the passive animals, so they start to move all the animals out. While moving the animals, they find multiple giant TNT bomber planes coming. This is because Boosfer paid Wemmbu to destroy the valley. After moving the animals in the mountains so they don’t get blown up, they build up using melon blocks.

Using melon blocks, they try to stop the planes. Wemmbu finds them and they agree to team up to steal Boosfer and his team’s items.

Parrot and Wifies go to the next quest, and they find a sculk themed escape room. They make it through the escape room and find a cave. After following the cave, they find an ancient city. The clue says that the key to the vault is the heart of a warden. This implies they have to kill a warden. They plan to use dripstone to kill the warden. After killing it, they make it through the vault and get a diamond. They put the diamond in the item frame at the base, however Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find the diamond and steal it, along with all of their items.

Wemmbu, Parrot, and Wifies go to the headquarters to blow it up. They build an orbital cannon to destroy the base. After flying to the base, they activate the orbital cannon, completely destroying the top layer of the base. They use TNT and spawn withers to destroy the base. Wemmbu finds a stash of netherite blocks and diamond blocks and they steal all the items.

In the nether, Parrot and Wifies find a bunch of nether quartz which appears to be morse code. Once translated, it says 090.256 rurple. They go to the next coordinates and find a sign that says 840.32 cyan. They next find a chest which has items in it. They find that the items in the chest probably mean 670.5 brown. They find a sign under lava that says 960.18 pink. On the nether roof they find a sign saying 390.43 blue. They find a giant castle and go inside using striders. They use the codes they found to find books in the castle. After finding all the books, they bring it to the vault and input the books. In the vault they find the item, a wither rose.

They move onto the next quest, which is to go to the end. They go to the end with almost no items. In the end, they find an escape room-like obstacle course. After finishing the course, the book they find says “+ +”. They end up finding an end city, and inside is Wifies prized dragon head. Right before going through the end portal to escape, they find Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to kill Parrot and Wifies, but they escape to the outer end islands. They get gear from end cities to try and kill the dragon to escape. They find an ender chest and get their gear from the ender chest, and escape the end.

Parrot and Wifies go back to the base, and find ClownPierce. They ask ClownPierce why people have been missing, but he says he doesn’t know. Parrot puts his last item, the spyglass, in the item frame.

Parrot and Wifies are trapped by ClownPierce in a prison called [[Proton]]. Inside of the prison, they are given a small world with resources in it. They purposefully went into the prison to try and break some of their friends out. They realize no mobs are spawning in the prison. Wifies tries to go to a specific green section of the prison, but when he walks into the area, he gets chunk banned. The guard moves him into a hallway leading into a new cell of the prison. Rekrap gets transferred into the same room of the prison as Parrot. They find a house with a sign saying that JumperWho and Derapchu were here.

Wifies is un-chunk banned. Parrot realizes that the /msg command does not work because if you try to send a message, you get kicked from the server. When normally chatting, the messages do not show up in chat.

Parrot is transferred to the next prison. He finds _Kenadian_. Kenadian says he doesn’t know who designed the prison, but Parrot gets suspicious of him and Kenadian admits he designed the prison.

Parrot is transferred to the next room, which has Derapchu. They make maps to try and communicate. The guard transfers him to the next prison. In the prison Parrot finds JumperWho and gives her a map. They expand the map to slowly load it while going to different cells. JumperWho uses a pearl to expand the map and gets put in solitary confinement. Parrot sees Leow0ok. It turns out that Leow0ok is a visitor who intends to help them break out of Proton.

Leow0ok leaves and Wifies comes over to Parrot. They see in a map that someone wrote S.O.S. in morse code. They communicate using morse code in maps. A guard comes in and moves Parrot to a new cell.

While going through the hallway to the new cell, he hears someone asking for help, who he thinks is [[Eggchan]], who is Wemmbu's friend. In the new cell, he finds Rekrap2. They find a wandering trader and buy a birch sapling. They use the sapling to get a tree with a bee nest which they are going to use to get honey. They realize that all the sand required to collect honey has been removed, and the only way to get sand is using a wandering trader. Rekrap is transferred to a new cell. A guard moves Parrot to a new cell, and he sees Kenadian. He tells Kenadian his plan to escape the cell.

While he’s talking with Kenadian, Wemmbu is dropped into the prison as a visitor. Parrot tells Wemmbu that they have not set up the stasis chamber yet, meaning they can’t get contraband items. He tells Wemmbu that he thinks eggchan is stuck in solitary confinement. Parrot is transferred to the next cell.

In the next prison he finds Wifies. They find a wandering trader. They’re able to buy both sand and slime. When Wifies is being transferred, Parrot relogs with a crying obsidian skin and follows him. Parrot uses this to communicate to JumperWho the plan to escape. The guard catches him. He is put in solitary confinement. A guard eventually comes and lets him out.

He goes over to a room with Derapchu. Parrot is transferred to the next cell. Parrot finds Rekrap2 in the next cell. They harvest honey and make a sticky piston for a stasis chamber. A guard comes over and destroys all of the hives in the honey farm. Parrot is transferred to the next prison.

Parrot and Kenadian now have the materials to build a honey pearl stasis chamber. Using eggs, they find just the right spot to throw the pearl with test projectiles. Wemmbu comes back as a visitor. They get the stasis to work on the last pearl. Kenadian begins trying to break the stasis. Wemmbu is teleported out of the prison. Kenadian decides not to destroy the stasis. They rotate to the next cell.

Parrot sees that eggchan is out of solitary confinement. He sees Wifies in the next cell and tells him about the plan. Parrot is transferred to the next cell.

Rekrap and Parrot and Kenadian activate the stasis chamber. They use the stasis chamber, and Wemmbu gets teleported in with contraband items. They pearl into every cell and give them ender chests. They go into the control room invisible, and pretend to be guards. JumperWho escapes from solitary confinement. Kenadian builds three wither bores and a missile to destroy the chunk ban. Using a couple more TNT flying machines, they are able to destroy all of the chunk bans, until they find a slime block machine which stops them from going further. Using pearls, they are able to pearl over the rest of the chunk bans.

Parrot uses an elytra to escape, leaving Kenadian in the prison. Kenadian writes in morse code on the map that he has an ender pearl stasis chamber at his base. They find his base in a lava pool and activate his stasis chamber.

Parrot and Wifies try to create [[The End Civilization|a civilization in the end]]. They see that a player has been following them. They pop the totem of the person underground and find that it’s [[deanthebean9]]. He says he’s a part of [[The Invisible Mafia]]. They recruit him as a member in their civilization. Parrot tries to recruit people from the Zam empire, but sees it is completely destroyed. They move villagers into their end civilization. Players from the mafia find them and start trying to kill them.

They are able to escape. Parrot hires [[Horace_Altman]] to build the civilization. They finish bringing the villagers and see Horace made a giant island for the civilization. Parrot goes into the Mafia’s base to destroy deanthebean9’s stasis chamber. They are successful in getting him out.

Parrot discovers for some reason he now cannot leave the end. Parrot logs on the next day and sees Horace moved the entire island 100 blocks down. A couple of members join the civilization. Parrot learns that Wifies is able to go to the overworld. Horace builds a giant castle at the civilization. He also builds outposts near spawn. Boosfer comes over and tries to take over the civilization, and says that he wants to hold an election to decide if he becomes the new leader, or if Parrot stays the leader. Horace sets up chunk bans around the civilization.

Wemmbu then falls into the trap after using the ender pearl cannon. Parrot then revels Wemmbu's identity telling him the story of how he had found out of Wemmbu's real identity. Parrot asks Wemmbu why he had faked his death where Wemmbu just asks him why he doesn't just kill him now. Flame then comes out from behind him where he was standing invisible . 

Wemmbu actives the trap showing Parrot and Flame who he is. Flame gives him the book with the the cords to the tomb of the mafia. Wemmbu then univis and throws Parrot of the platform they were standing on knocking him into the void. Parrot then uses a mirror reviver to teleport away. 

Parrot reads the book witch has the cords and a message that says "What ever you do be carful of Her". They there reach a end ring chunks of void that they begin to cross over with a flying machine. They travel for hours and there find the island witch is cover in cherry trees. Parrot says that he thinks something is of. 

They travel along a path and find a door. Witch needs a key to enter. 5 Players (including CoinMonke one of Parrots old friends) then arrive at the island and Parrot and Theo hide behind a rock. The players then try to mine though the door but get blindness, Parrot and Theo also get it and after they can see again there is another player there, someone with full netherite and a quartz eye chest plate just like the higher tiers of the mafia used to wear. 

The invisible player then drinks milk, showing that she is Marlowww the best PvPer in minecraft. Marlow then kills the whole team aside from Coin can Parrot and Theo save Coin and run. Parrot then tells Coin that Marlow is the best player in all of minecraft. Coin then leads them to a end base where Theo goes ahead. Parrot asks why Coin was there where he says that he had joined a bandit group. When they go in Coin says that this is a place where alot of gambling happens. 

A player named Rasplin then kills a player after saying that he cheated in a game. Coin tells them to go talk to Rasplin who says that he has a key that he stole from Marlow. Parrot then starts gambling in order to try and get the key. Rasplin wins all the rounds taking all of Parrot's gear and diamands. 

They then get blindness and Marlow shows up and kills Rasplin and Theo and Parrot return to the cherry blossom island to also try to steal a key from Marlow. They wait need by for Marlow to try and enter the tomb where Parrot would shot her away and Theo would pick up the key. However when they are hiding Marlow says that she sees someone hiding there. Thankfully she doesn't see Parrot or Theo, just a bandit called [[Nightv0ltage9]], who she kills with her mace. Parrot and Theo mange to steal the key with there plan and they both esacpe. 

They meet back up and wait for Marlow to leave. Parrot asks Theo why he thinks Marlow would guard the tomb and Theo says that he thinks that Marlow probably likes to just kill the players who come. After Parrot is sure that enough time has past they use the key to open the door, letting them enter the tomb. They then go down some long corridors and find that there in a maze. 

After going though the maze a bit they get blindness and Marlow shows up. Theo tells Parrot to run and Theo stays behind to fight Marlow. Parrot hides and after some time he goes out and finds a battle field. Parrot continues though the maze to see if he can find Theo where he finds a chest with two sighs that say "This is what happened to your feathered friend. This is your last warning turn back now". Inside the chest Parrot finds Theo's items leading Parrot to believe that Theo was dead.

Parrot continues thought the maze where he eventually finds large cave with another door that has two giant diamond trimmed mafia statues next to it. Parrot once again get blindness and he leaves the room as fast as he can, flying into a near by cave. After traveling down the cave he finds a tunnel that leads to a small pink base. That he finds out is Marlow's. 

Parrot goes to a book on the shelf and picks it up. It is Marlow's journal. They talk about Marlow's experience in the mafia and her best friend that protected her when she first joined the server. In the journals it is revealed that if any item left the tomb, all of the former mafia members would be voided and killed. In the last book Marlow also says that she didn't kill Theo because he remined her to much of her old friend, willing to protect other people with there lives. 

After finishing the last book Parrot turns around and Marlow is there. Marlow then pushes a button showing Parrot all the stais chambers with all the former invisible mafia pearls. Marlow then leaves and Parrot goes through the door with the statues. after going though a second door and Parrot finds himself in the tomb. Inside the tomb there are thousands of items Parrot flies the path ways that connect all the rooms with item eventually he leaves not taking anything.

After he returnes to Theo Parrot give him his items back and they leave on a flying machine back to the main server. 

Parrot finds a lectern in his shop, telling him to go to the server-wide announcement of [[LettuceK|LettuceK.]] He mentions how anyone with over 100 votes will instantly be entered for the election. Theo was fascinated by Lettuce's silver tongue but Parrot snaps him out of it. Parrot had no intention on becoming leader, but the same person who placed the lectern ([[Spepticle]]), nicknamed 'The Owl', tells Parrot to participate. There's a compass above the book in an item frame and eventually decides, despite Theo's protests to follow it. 

On the way, Parrot spots three invisible players and calls them out. They drink milk and turn out to be bandits, bandits who call themselves Phantoms. The leader Kibaxmc demands that they hand over valuebles to which Parrot refuses, resulting in the bandits attacking them.Theo takes two of them and Parrot takes the leader. After a long chase Parrot is able to knock the leader off a cliff, unfortunately not killing him. 

They continue to follow the compass and arrive at a tree thats on fire. They meet [[Dtowncat]] (Pili) who's the leader of the group. Pili explains that her friend was taken by Phantoms. Pili shows him a direction and Parrot leaves. 

Parrot follows the lead and is met with fog the second it started raining, he landed, confused. Parrot ignores the fog and continues to fly, traversing the fog with speed. Through the mist, he spots some players and follows them, spying on the players with his spyglass. Parrot announces himself and is suprised to see that one of the players is someone he had met before, [[Herobanenair]] someone from the End Casino. The players threaten to kill PajamaSammy (the captured player) if he moves past the block they had placed. 

Kibaxmc blames Parrot for the death of the two Phantoms, Parrot shoots back instantly, accusing the leader that they had jumped him. Kibaxmc and Parrot start to fight with the rest of the Phantoms retreating, taking PajamaSammy with them. During the battle Kibaxmc mocks Parrot that he's worthless, nothing without Theo. Parrot continues to run from Kibaxmc eventually using his elytra to escape. 

Parrot returns to the tree and meets up with Theo. Parrot talks to Dtowncat and he explains that this village is called Treebo Village and it was built years ago, because it's a remote location, they were unaware of the election going on. Dtowncat explains how the Phantoms had been terrorizing them and Parrot asks if they had contacted the Law yet to which Dtowncat replies that they were too far for the Law to care. 

Parrot retraces his steps and sees a trail the Phantoms made while traversing the jungle. It starts to rain and so Parrot and Theo dig in a side of a mountain until it stops raining. Theo questions Parrot on how all of this would benefit Parrot in winning the election, Parrot says that it won't but that he can't let the Phantoms get away again. 

The rain has cleared and they set out again. After a while Parrot spots a small platform by the water, he jumps down and Theo suggest to run in and slaugther everyone to which Parrot says no. They use invisibility to enter the base undetected and find PajamaSammy in a hanging cage surrounded by guards. They leave and mine into the wall, Parrot continues to mine until they're above the cage. They repot on invisbility and use glowberries to save PajamaSammy. While escaping Parrot overhears the Phantoms discussing their attack on the village tomorrow. 

They successfully escape with Parrot shooting a happy ghast with players on it dead on the way back. They arrive back at Treebo Village. Dtowncat and Parrot have a speech and Pili tells the villagers to do the thing. Which was giving Parrot votes, through his efforts Parrot was able to gain 108 votes, guarentueeing his spot in the election. 

Parrot request the players to sit back down and tells them that he can't return to the main server and become king due to what they said, that the Phantoms would attack Treebo Village the next day. 

It's the day of the attack and Parrot had prepared with Pili for the attack. As Parrot and the village are fighting off the Phantoms, Theo fights HerobaneNair, the leader of them all. The villagers are able to defeat most of the Phantoms, leaving only Herobanenair and Kibaxmc remaining. Kibax is outnumbered and killed. Herobane runs away with Parrot telling him to never come back. 

Another meeting is held and despite Treebo village losing a few players, the village was safe once again. Parrot and Theo decide to head back to spawn but forgot where they left their horses. Pajamasammy shows the duo a hidden ice boat highway that leads all the way back to spawn. They are ecstatic when they realize that they would be able to make it back to spawn in time. They thank Sammy and boat off. 

On the way back, Parrot realizes [[Spepticle|The Owl]] had told them to go there not just for the votes but to show that there were more players out there needing help. Theo calls The Owl stupid because they made them go through so much trouble. 

The two arrive back at spawn and Parrot is at the bottom of the list with 109 votes, 108 from Treebo village and 1 from Theo. 

The next announcement takes place, with LettuceK telling the rules and working of the election. 1. Every two weeks the votes will be halved, the people with the least votes at the time will lose the election. 2. The rule being unusual, the votes aren't permanent and the voters can change their vote if wanted. 3. During the election, the cadidates must live in the Northern council, the bottom eight players along the wall and upper eight in the castle. Once the announcement finishes, LettuceK allows the participants to go to their chambers.  

Parrot goes to his respective tower and meets up with Theo. Parrot knows the election isn't hopeless due to him recieving another message from [[Spepticle|The Owl]] who claims to be an insider of the Law. He finds another lectern carrying a book once again, the book requesting Parrot to meet up with him in one week to provide information on Lettuce. Theo decides to go back to their potion shop which leads Parrot to go and meet his competitors one of them being [[Boosfer]]. After asking how he got 380 votes Parrot asks if he can see his room. In the room, Parrot spots a book on the lectern and remembers that he left the message of The Owl on the lectern. He makes an excuse to leave and he runs back to his room. 

When he arrives back in his room he's greeted by a person who claims to be a guard but Parrot's suspicious due to Lettuce not saying anything about a guard. Parrot starts to question him and the guard leaves. Parrot checks the book and discovers that the message is a fake. He rushes to his balcony and watches the guard run over the ground and going invisible. Parrot checks if anyone's nearby and he pulls his bow and aims, after missing a few shots he's able to kill the guard. He goes down the ladder and picks up the book and successfully protects The Owl's identity for another day. 

The next day Lettuce calls for another meeting. He says that a lot of the server members don't know who the candidates are and wants to host a debate and asks how the candidates feel about it. Boosfer speaks up and says the idea is garbage and doesn't like the idea of it as he believes the others wouldn't stand a chance against him. However, Lettuce says anybody who isn't present in the debate will automatically be removed from the election and that it'll be held one week from now. The duo's are chosen by [[Deputy_Ace]] with a dispenser. When everyone's opponent is chosen Lettuce announces that a guard went missing the night before and questions the candidates for information. When none of the participants speak up he says they'll keep searching and they are dismissed. 

(Heyy, finished off a small part of the video and wanted to say that I almost got an heart attack when the history part was removed from the main page. This is around the part I'll have to fill in) - Fluffywolfmonster 

Kings Arc Finale : 

Parrot gets imprisoned by [[LettuceK]], and escapes after having a conversation with [[Th3Blurpinstein]]. He then breaks all his copper armour and replaces it with Diamond armor that he got when he escaped. After that, he frees [[TheobaldTheBird]], but Theo gets stasised out and LettuceK appears. Parrot attacks Lettuce but fails due to Lettuce summoning the Law Elites, overpowering Parrot with ease. 

Parrot and Lettuce travel towards the Northern Council with Theo's life on the line, Parrot is told to endorse Lettuce. They arrive at Northern Council, [[Purpled]] and [[Boosfer]] endorse Lettuce with the promise that they would get positions. Parrot starts his speech, talking about everything he's said about Lettuce. Lettuce pushes Parrot to continue, hoping that Parrot would actually endorse him. 

But Parrot doesn't, Lettuce ends the announcement and pulls Parrot aside. They have a conversation and it leads to Parrot being brought back to the [[Capital City|old Capital City]], Deputy questions Lettuce's ways but is quickly shut down. In the destroyed mining city Theo and more Law Elites are waiting. Lettuce recaps on what Parrot did for him, stating that Parrot likely regretted saving him, to which Parrot replies with that he didn't regret it at all. Lettuce leaves after ordering [[Deputy_Ace]]<nowiki/>and the Elites to kill off Parrot and Theo once they hear the sound of a goat horn. Parrot and Theo talk, awaiting the fate thats coming for them. Then they hear the goat horn. The Elites and Ace pot up and run to kill them.

Parrot and Theo are still alive, looking at Ace who just killed the two Elites. Parrot questions why while grabbing the items on the ground, to which Ace replies with that they have to run. Lettuce arrives, macing Parrot instantly. Lettuce is surprised to see his own friend betray him, running after the trio to kill them all. Parrot leads them to a mine as Lettuce begs for Ace to tell him that it isn't happening. They dig down and enter the mine, Parrot once again questioning Ace. 

They travel through the mines, slowly mining a tunnel to escape. Ace hands Theo his pickaxe, telling them to continue as he holds them off. Theo starts to mine as the Lawmen get closer, Lettuce continuously begging Ace to stop, questioning what he's doing. Parrot and Theo continue to mine, ignoring the fighting thats happening behind them. Ace is being killed by SargeLaw, he says a line Parrot himself had said before: I'd rather stand die standing than live kneeling. Then Ace is banned. 

Parrot and Theo are able to escape, revising a plan to go to [[District 13]]. They set out for the abandoned base, on the way, Parrot is able to spot another 2 invisible players who turn out to be [[Fymada]] and [[Horace_Altman]]. They enter the base but are surprised to find a group of players living in the old base. 

After a slight hassle they are able to convince the players to join them for the fight. Parrot and Theo set out to find the players Wemmbu and Flamefrags and to convice more players to join. Despite Parrot's determination, he isn't able to find Wemmbu and eventually returns to the base. He comes back and is met with a rebuilt District 13. 

Without Theo present, Parrot starts to train the recruited players, in bow, sword and more. 

When Theo returns, him and Parrot decide to go loot a remote Law base. They arrive at the base and use invis to break in. They are able to find the armor rooms and steal some armor before getting caught. They run away and escape the Law base on a boat. Using the happy ghast, they fly above the base, watching the people there. Theo suggest to go back which Parrot shuts down. The players start to build up towards the happy ghast while Parrot and Theo fly higher, bowing at the towering players. 

Parrot is able to spot an invisible player with a trident, recognizing that its with Spoke and 2 withers are spawned. Spoke swiftly eliminates players using TNT minecarts. Parrot and Theo jump down to help Spoke, fighting off the Lawmen. Spoke explains that [[Bounty Assassin Team|BAT]] had a falling out. 

More Lawmen were starting to arrive and the trio are scrambling to load the items onto the happy ghast. Then Wemmbu arrives, using his orbital strike cannons to kill off the players. Next Flamefrags arrives, with Wemmbu immediately helping. Within minutes of Wemmbu and Flamefrags arriving, the entire Lawmen army were slaugthered. They continue to stock up the happy ghast and head off for District 13. 

On the way back, Spoke mentions that they need to pick up his own team. It leads Wemmbu, Flamefrags, Spoke and Parrot to go back to the castle where Spoke and his team resided in. They decide to return to District 13 to meet up with Parrot's team, Spoke mentioning that the place felt nostalgic. They entered the base an everyone proceeded to gear up with the items they had just stolen from the Law base. 

Parrot gives a speech with Spoke, recounting all the things Law did to them. From Flamefrags being exiled to Parrot being tricked. 

With Lettuce already knowing that they were on the way, the army set off for the Northern Council. Parrot knew that Lettuce would have gathered armies upon armies to defeat them. Parrot explains the plan, his team uses invisibility to mix in with the other armies and when attacked by allies to switch back to a normal shield. Then they stormed the castle. They entered to find an entire army standing ready. 

LettuceK tries to stop Parrot one last time, begging him to stop his attack, reasoning that he had sacrificed too much to lose it all. Parrot refuses, telling him that its too late to convince him to surrender. They continue to argue before they both step away, both ready to attack 

The orbitals drop, slaugthering players left and right. Both armies start to attack. Parrot using a bow and fireworks to deal damage. The other army is quickly overpowered by Parrot's army. Parrot questions if Lettuce is stupid, thinking that the army was enough to kill them. Parrot orders his team to swap back to normal shields. Parrot and his team question where the Elites and Lettuce are, not being able to find them on the battlefield. 

The Lawmen were defeated, they found the Elites on top of the castle. Wemmbu mocks Lettuce for thinking that the Lawmen could defeat them. Parrot accuses Lettuce of doing the exact same thing he did that started the arc, sending thousands of players to their inevitable doom, knowing that they had no chance and saving himself. 

Lettuce seems unfased, saying that he feels like he's has had the exact conversation countless times. He request Parrot to turn and they do, discovering that there are hundreds of fully stacked players climbing over the walls. 

They start to fight the netherite army. Parrot decides to serve as a distraction due to his own skills not being enough to rival the netherite players. Spoke starts to spawn withers as the POV is switched to Theo. Theo uses his carts to vanquish the players which he's successful in. 

The POV switches back to Parrot who's still serving as a distraction for the netherite players. Parrot starts to pillar up after the encouragement of Theo, he's knocked off multiple times and is forced to fight the players swarming him. 

Parrot is able to escape and starts to pillar up again. He builds a small platform to restock. Wemmbu lands next to him to also restock before they are both attacked by Lettuce, Lettuce is able to mace them and Parrot is blown off the platform, losing the shulkers that had all his items it in due to leaving it on the platform. He tries to throw a pearl and misses, landing on the ground instead. 

Parrot starts to use TNT to kill the players stopping him from returning to the platform. He continues to run while devising a plan to get back on the platform. Players continue to swarm Parrot while he's unable to return to the platform. He climbs up a ladder in the walls and is able to get onto the defenses. 

He meets Spoke there who asks Parrot if he needs anything to which Parrot ignores him and uses an enderpearl to get to the wall of votes. He starts teleport up and is able to reach the top of the board. Parrot starts to bridge towards the platform and is successfully able to reach it. 

The POV switches to Theo who continues to slaugther the players, being able to vanquish a few of them with each cart. 

A hour had passed since the start of the battle with Parrot and his team victorious, they kill off the last few standing Lawmen before making their way to fight LettuceK. The entire team are attacking Lettuce. He tries to run but the team quickly chases him down, giving him no space to retreat. 

Eventually, when most of the team falls behind, LettuceK is able to escape using his elytra. Wemmbu and MinuteTech follow him, leaving the rest of the team behind. 

Wemmbu and Minute return bearing news, Lettuce had escaped. Prince Zam tries to cheer up the team saying that they atleast destroyed the base to which Flamefrags bites back with that no one cares. 

Strangely, Lettuce returns. The team rushes to meet the person who returned, all surprised to see him here. LettuceK tells the team to kill him, stating that he cannot hurt anyone anymore, saying that he doesn't want to live in a server who doesn't want him. 

Parrot decides against it, despite Flamefrags relentless protests. They go into the Northern Council castle, casting a vote on to let Lettuce live or kill him. 

The vote decides that Lettuce gets to live. Flamefrags questions why Parrot wanted to keep him alive with Parrot replying that they would then be no better. Parrot announces that he's planning to continue the election and letting Lettuce participate, this announcement awakes more protests. Wemmbu saying that the majority of the server doesn't know what went down, that they would most likely choose incorrectly. But they eventually put Lettuce in an obsidian cell before leaving. 

Parrot stands over the ruins of the destroyed Northern Council until Wemmbu and Eggchan show up. Parrot asks the duo on where they are going now to which Wemmbu replies with he would see them later. Parrot watches the duo leave, until they're just two dots on the horizon. 

The scene cuts to Parrot on top of the vote leaderboard, stating that he has won the election. Parrot stands in the library with Theo beside him. Theo asks him what he is going to do, Parrot replies with that he has some plans up his sleeve before going up the staircase to overlook the massive crowd beneath him.

=== [[Season 3]] ===
==== [[The Kingdoms Arc]] ====

Parrot is booed by the crowd and vows to free spawn- and if he failed, he would resign as king. [W.I.P]

'''MOST RECENT VIDEO (Searching for a civilization that doesn't exist)'''

To have more room for the overflowing amount of new players Parrot decides to send 1000 players to explore a new area build a new civilization named Skymore and determine if the area is actually livable for the thousands of players who had no where left to go. Arriving in the desired area, Parrot gives a speech, announcing that the location would be the start of Skymore. Soon  after the players started to work, Parrot left, promising to come back in exactly a week to check in and deliver resources.

Following up with his promise, Parrot comes back to the civilization with 20 players only to find it abandoned. He yells out annoucing his presence but no one responds. Everybody's gone but there aren't any signs of an invasion or ransacking. After giving some intructions to investigate, the squad spreads out to find clues. Before letting them go, Parrot gives one more instruction; If he blows the goat horn then they have to report back to the kingdom immediatly. 

The squad heads off with Parrot and Theo searching around the village. The more they investigate, the stranger the situation becomes. All the signs are still standing and furnaces are still smelting. After a while of looking around the area they start to enter houses and thats when they finally find a sign in the attic. "[[ReinaDrop|Reina]] , I had to run follow the farmland." 

They go outside and pillar up next to the farmland. Parrot watches the ground for a while before having a realization and he tells Theo to cover up a few blocks. After covering up the blocks, the random dots and dashes in the ground turn out to be morse code. The message saying; "I RAN EAST E - [[Zoe444|ZOE]]" Theo questioned why they had to write in morse code and Parrot agrees, concluding that Reina and Zoe used to be members of Skymore and after whatever happened, the two were seperated and were trying to find each other. 

Parrot's thoughts are disturbed with a squad member running towards them and telling him he heard him blowing the emergency horn and he asked why. Parrot quickly jumped down and rushed towards the squad member, he didn't blow the horn, he never did. The guard tells him that it was blown from the east and with that, Parrot starts to blow his horn. He rushes towards the east section of the abandoned Skymore only to find no one, everybody has ran towards the other sound of a horn.

To Parrot's absolute dismay, only 5 of the 20 players returned. After commanding his remaining squadron to stay together and follow him, they start to travel east. The squadron, Parrot and Theo travel from a while until they hear the sound of a goat horn, coming from where their heading. They all pause for a moment, listening to the continues blows of the foreign person. Theo says that they have to go back because its too dangerous but Parrot decides against it and continues forward. Parrot follows the sound of the goat horn and arrives by a patch of grass and after digging, he finds a staircase downwards. He asks for anyone to go with him but the members of the squadron are too scared so Theo goes down with him.

The two slowly descend the staircase, expecting an attack from below but nothing comes. They find lots of chests containing the armor and items of the other 15 squadron members. They rumage through the chests before returning to the surface, only to find that the last 5 squad members had disappeared.

title: ParrotX2/Relationships
content:
Relationships 

 Wifies 
Wifies was formerly Parrot's best friend. After helping him with a plethora of tasks, such as breaking people out of prison, creating the End Civilization together, and more. This changed after Wifies faked his death, as he would go on to become the Director. Wifies did a lot of immoral things as the Director, causing Parrot to highly dislike Wifies after learning about his new identity. Wifies trapped Parrot in a miniature world where they could build, and have fun together, called Paragon.

Parrot still showed that he likely at least cared a little for Wifies still, even when Wifies died. When Wifies died, Parrot sighed. He also went back to get the spyglass that they were known for having, after he dropped it off of a building. Parrot still tried to kill Wifies multiple times unsuccessfully while he was in Paragon, however, after being led to a white room with quartz pillars and two pressure plates in the middle of a circle, Parrot was forced onto the pressure plates and Wifies said that stepping off would kill both of them by blowing up. Unfortunately for Wifies, Parrot had the spyglass. Using the spyglass, Parrot was able to step off and leave the chamber, where he would die to TNT.

 DeanTheBean9 
DeanTheBean was one of Parrot's best friends. They got to know each other during I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization when Wifies and Parrot uncovered his identity by removing his invisibility with a trap. After some talking Parrot decided to allow Dean to join the civilization. After finding out about Dean's condition where if his invisibility ran out, he would get sent into the void, Parrot saves his life by telling him to set another stasis and the moment his stasis gets pulled they pull his second stasis. DeanTheBean would explore the server with Parrot and Wifies until their relationship drastically changed when it was revealed that he was helping the Mafia find his location when they were looking for the Far Lands Civilization. Parrot and Dean's relationship was slowly built back up, however, he unfortunately died due since he rejoined The Mafia and his invisibility was removed upon his totem popping. Dean's death had one of the largest effects on Parrot which led him to believe some players are just inherently evil. An example of this is when he tried to kill Ashswagg even though if he did every single player in the Mafia would die. He was only stopped because some of his friends were in the Mafia but then hated every single Mafia member including his former friends. He was disgusted when his friends R4trick & F1nlo joined the Mafia and ranked up even though they probably did not have a choice. 

 Wemmbu 
Wemmbu and Parrot met each other in Parrot's debut video where Wemmbu showed Parrot the crater. Since that they weren't really close, usually rivaling each other like during the PrinceZam Empire Arc. In the Mafia arc, the two worked together in the District 13 to defeat the Mafia. 

After that they don't talk for a while until Parrot starts to hunt Wemmbu down. Parrot was impersonating Wemmbu when Wemmbu met him. Their relationship doesn't get any better due to Wemmbu killing his pet Happy Ghast Sky, after exposing Wemmbu's identity, they split ways on bad terms. During the Kings/Election Arc (Kings for Wemmbu, Election for Parrot, check the arcs naming) Parrot was looking for Wemmbu and requested him to go back to spawn to expose LettuceK for his lies.

On the way back Wemmbu threatened to kill Parrot after boxing him up to which Eggchan stops him and they go back to spawn. They expose Lettuce they split ways again. They meet up again with Flame and Spoke and they defeat the Law, after that Wemmbu and Eggchan leave.

 FlameFrags 

 Season 1 
Flame is featured in Parrot's I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players attacking Wemmbu's Civilization. 

In Unstable SMP: The First War, Flame kills Dimofyy forcing Parrot and the remains of Dimofyy's squadron to think strategically to escape him. 

 Season 2 
In The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadliest Vault, Flame goes to the nether and there he meets Parrot and TheobaldTheBird. They team up and capture ClownPierce's right-hand man FerreMC. Flame betrays Parrot and tells Clown the location of where they're at for information about Wemmbu. Upon arriving there, Clown tells Flame he doesn't know any information and upon hearing this, Flame betrays Clown giving  time for Parrot and Theo to escape and find Clown's nether vault. After raiding the vault, Parrot and Theo return to Capital City and their potion shop. Flame goes to their potion shop and gives Parrot a proposition. Find Wemmbu and in return he'll give them the coordinates of the tomb of The Invisible Mafia.

In The Search for Wemmbu, Parrot impersonates Wemmbu to gather intel about him and has a suspicion that The Invisible Knight was Wemmbu. Parrot traps Wemmbu in the Capital City coutroom but since Flame was preoccupied, Wemmbu escapes. Then Parrot constructs an elaborate plan to trap Wemmbu in the same type of box to give him a false sense of security and for Theo to drain him of all resources. But when Wemmbu takes the pearl cannon he is teleported into the box where Parrot and Flame was waiting. Wemmbu  tries to elytra mace them but he misses a wind charge that goes through the powdered snow then through lava igniting the projectile that ignited TNT. The TNT explodes and kills a group of tamed wolves and since Wemmbu threw the projectile, it says it was blown up by him. In return for all of Parrot's work, Flame drops Parrot a book with the exact location of the tomb  of the mafia. 

 SpokeIsHere 
Spoke and Parrot are currently close friends, but that wasn't always the case. In the beginning of Season 1, Spoke put Parrot and Wifies in a scavenger hunt and eventually chunk banned Wifies as a form of revenge towards Parrot for attempting to stop the destruction of The Wonders.  

Parrot and Spoke became friends during the The Invisible Mafia Arc when they put their beef aside and teamed up to destroy The Mafia. When Spoke was about to destory Capital City because he believed his friend, Mapicc had died, Parrot told him to stop which had led to him continuing to find Mapicc instead of trying to make others' lives miserable.

 TheobaldTheBird 
Parrot and Theo met in Unstable SMP: The First War in the Far Lands civilization. They were both part of the Warriors District and they worked together. Theo helped Parrot become the leader of the Warriors District and ended the dispute between the Warriors District and the Farming District. After The Mafia destroys the Far Lands civilization, Parrot creates District 13, however, Theo leaves District 13 due to the fact that they made minimal progress against The Mafia. 

They reunited when Theo saved him from two withers at spawn. Parrot thanked him for saving his life, so they teamed up together because Parrot knew that Theo would protect him at all costs. After him getting saved, he and Theo went to the nearest city, Capital City, and created a potion shop there where both could get stacked. They also went on Treasure quests in the Great Sea and Verdaria. They currently remain as best friends since their reunion.

 Ashswagg 
Ashswagg was the leader of the The Invisible Mafia Arc where he dragged people into becoming invisible knights who worked for him, and him only. Whoever didn't agree to work for him was killed, whoever got their identity revealed got thrown into the void. Parrot however, didn't agree with this high-stakes game and decided that he wanted to put an end to all of it. Ashswagg was also the person who had dragged many of Parrotx2's friends away from him, causing the death of Deanthebean9, one of Parrotx2's close friends. The Invisible Mafia, led by Ashswagg on Unstable SMP were eventually defeated when a resistance alliance destroyed their ender pearls, with many members disbanded or killed following the destruction of their leader’s power base.

 Leow0ok 
Parrot and Leow0ok have a primarily antagonistic, high-stakes relationship, frequently interacting as enemies or rivals. Leow0ok tried to kill Parrot while they were part of different, often conflicting groups. But during the The Director Arc, they worked together in Bounty Assassin Team or BAT (formerly) to find the true identity of The Director aka Wifies.  Leow0ok sometimes did not like Parrot because of how he did not accept his teammates or his mistakes. During The LAW arc, Parrot did not care about Leow0ok at all and fought him as an enemy to the end. It seems like he either does not know of his death or simply does not care for his former friend.

 PrinceZam 
Parrot's first encounter with PrinceZam was during the scavenger hunt Spoke had sent him out to finish with Wifies. 

They then worked together to chunkban Spoke, but Wifies was also trapped. Parrot tried convincing him to disable the chunk ban for 60 seconds, but he failed, causing him to break open every chunkban.

On the Unstable SMP, PrinceZam and Parrot generally hold a contentious, adversarial relationship characterized by power struggles, prison breaks, and mutual sabotage. Their conflict often involves Parrot breaking into PrinceZam’s secure prisons and sabotaging his projects (like stealing from his "Kings/Election Arc" initiatives), while Zam hires others to eliminate Parrot. 

 LettuceK 
Parrot and LettuceK were rivals during The Kings Arc. While LettuceK (an antagonist) favors strict, organized control, Parrot represents a "Big Good" figure focused on empowering others, creating tension between their methods. During The Kings Arc, Parrot was forced to go to prison by LettuceK because so Lettuce can be king of the Unstable SMP. However, he refound a rebellion called District 13, ultimately managing to beat Lettuce in the final showdown. His realisation at the vault of The Mafia was one of the things that led him to believe that no player is inherently evil. For this reason he spares Lettuce but still hates him.

=== Wifies ===
[[Wifies]] was formerly Parrot's best friend. After helping him with a plethora of tasks, such as breaking people out of prison, creating the [[The End Civilization|End Civilization]] together, and more. This changed after Wifies faked his death, as he would go on to become the [[The Director|Director]]. Wifies did a lot of immoral things as the Director, causing Parrot to highly dislike Wifies after learning about his new identity. Wifies trapped Parrot in a miniature world where they could build, and have fun together, called [[Paragon]].

Parrot still showed that he likely at least cared a little for Wifies still, even when Wifies died. When Wifies died, Parrot sighed. He also went back to get the spyglass that they were known for having, after he dropped it off of a building. Parrot still tried to kill Wifies multiple times unsuccessfully while he was in Paragon, however, after being led to a white room with quartz pillars and two pressure plates in the middle of a circle, Parrot was forced onto the pressure plates and Wifies said that stepping off would kill both of them by blowing up. Unfortunately for Wifies, Parrot had the spyglass. Using the spyglass, Parrot was able to step off and leave the chamber, where he would die to TNT.

DeanTheBean was one of Parrot's best friends. They got to know each other during [[I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization]] when Wifies and Parrot uncovered his identity by removing his invisibility with a trap. After some talking Parrot decided to allow Dean to join the civilization. After finding out about Dean's condition where if his invisibility ran out, he would get sent into the void, Parrot saves his life by telling him to set another stasis and the moment his stasis gets pulled they pull his second stasis. An example of this is when he tried to kill Ashswagg even though if he did every single player in the Mafia would die. Their relationship doesn't get any better due to Wemmbu killing his pet Happy Ghast Sky, after exposing Wemmbu's identity, they split ways on bad terms. During the Kings/Election Arc (Kings for Wemmbu, Election for Parrot, check the arcs naming) Parrot was looking for Wemmbu and requested him to go back to spawn to expose LettuceK for his lies.

On the way back Wemmbu threatened to kill Parrot after boxing him up to which Eggchan stops him and they go back to spawn. They expose Lettuce they split ways again. They meet up again with Flame and Spoke and they defeat the Law, after that Wemmbu and Eggchan leave.

title: Pirate City
content:
Pirate City, formerly known as Ranger Point is a massive marine-style complex located in the center of the Great Sea. It is where Jaden develops his Pirate Civilization.

 History 
Wemmbu, disguised as Invisible Knight, and Jaden attempted to take over the base. However, they were both outnumbered and out-geared, forcing them to flee using a riptide trident. 

Parrot and Theo also broke in, and were captured and placed in the "Lobster Cage", before escaping.

Wemmbu killed TheLobsterMan in a 1v1, leaking his name to Jaden. He allowed Jaden to rebuild his Pirate Civilization. Jaden took over the base and transform it into a pirate outpost.

Jaden turned the outpost into a civilization of pirates, i.e. Pirate City. He rescued Wemmbu and leads him there.

LettuceK threatened to blow up the island with an Orbital Strike Cannon. Wemmbu was able to destroy the orbital, but Pirate Civilization were abandoned, due to a large amount of attacks by LettuceK.

A large army led by Jaden was captured by the Law. Due to high casualties the Law abandons its campaign to take over the Great Sea.

Jaden was freed and The Law was destroyed. Jaden probably returned to his position of power in the Great Sea.

title: Pirates
content:
The Pirates is a faction of bandits that formerly robbed civilizations and players. The team was led by Jaden_MAN. After Wemmbu and Jaden took over Ranger Point, Jaden developed Pirates into his Pirate Civilization.

 History 
TheobaldTheBird is seen with a pirates shield. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan tried to make a civilization. They got invaded by The Pirates. Wemmbu kills the majority of its members. Wemmbu follows Spongs and after he returns to his civilization, it was blown up and Eggchan is held hostage. Wemmbu cleared his inventory (and Echest) as ordered by Jaden but he kept one of his maces in his Echest. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan were taken to the Pirate Islands. They were chased by members of the Pirates. Theo secretly helped Wemmbu with invisibility potions, and a trident. Jaden fled into a hole which leads to an abandoned civilization. 

Jaden was imprisoned by Wemmbu in an abandoned civilization and forced to return Wemmbu's other mace.

Jaden used his Pirates to fight Flame.

Jaden created a large castle. The castle was destroyed by Wemmbu. 

Wemmbu, as Invisible Knight, helped Jaden conquer Ranger Point which led to the rebirth of the Pirates as an important faction, Pirate Civilization.

However, during Wemmbu's video, Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea, the Pirates were completely wiped out in a battle with the Law with almost all members killed. The rest of the population of The Great Sea like DaFraDoDaFraDo is a player who tried to rob Wemmbu during the events of I explored the Minecraft Great Sea. He was seen as a Pirate in a different faction (not Jaden's Pirate Civilization) were probably flagged as Pirates by the Law and are ruthlessly killed. LettuceK showed this when he killed innocent players at Frog Island. Other outposts occupied by Jaden's Pirates or other pirate factions were likely to have the same fate. However, even though all the Pirates were dead and Jaden was captured, Wemmbu finished the mission to destroy the Orbital Strike Cannon that LettuceK and the Law had built. The Pirates were then Inactive without any members surviving from the Battle and Jaden being captured.

After Jaden was released and the Law defeated, he probably went back to Pirate City and rebuilt his civilization. But this is speculation. Also this is supported by the fact that Wemmbu called the king of the pirates in the 4v4 fight.

title: PlanetLord
content:
PlanetLord, or simply Planet, is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. He is a teammate of SpokeIsHere and Mapicc.

 History 

 Season 1 
PlanetLord is guarding a skybase. Spoke comes to the skybase and destroys the duped items using an orbital cannon, despite PlanetLord trying to stop him.

PlanetLord is seen at an end base.

Spoke and Mapicc find a stash of what he thinks are duped items. He finds the chests are empty. A player named PlanetLord comes in and they try to kill him as he places shulker boxes which appear to be duped because they have identical items in all of them. PlanetLord is able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc see Roshambogames and PlanetLord at a flower farm. The Mafia destroys the entire farm with TNT. 

Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord. The Mafia comes over and tries to kill them. They trap the Mafia players using a sand trap, though none of them die. They are able to escape.

Mapicc is captured by the Mafia. PlanetLord introduces Baconnwaffles0 and TheRealSquiddo to MinuteTech, a friend of Spoke. A Mafia member named BobDaGreenFrog tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills the Mafia member. The Mafia starts trying to kill them again. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, to which MinuteTech replies "no". The Mafia continues attacking them. Spoke is able to escape, though he almost dies.

TheRealSquiddo shows the team some coordinates that she was given that could be the coordinates to a Mafia outpost. She also states that everybody in the master builders group has disappeared. She says she was commissioned to do a build by an anonymous player.

The team goes over to an outpost and find a large amount of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after being handed a book.

PlanetLord and Spoke discover that JamatoP’s base is destroyed. Spoke and PlanetLord try to dupe items in the base, but realize that it doesn’t work anymore. Ashswagg, the leader of the Mafia, comes in and reveals that all the glitches and exploits were patched, and that Jamato told him so. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech was working for him, and orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. Spoke and PlanetLord escape.

Spoke and PlanetLord go under one of the wonders where they put weaponless mobs. They find that the mobs are named coordinates. They find a replica of Jamato’s base made out of wood, and all of the glitched features have been removed. He finds a book stating that if he is reading the book, he is captured or dead. It states he has exiled himself, that he has been hunted by the Mafia, that he was captured in an outpost, and that there is an item that can fix everything. They find a compass that is named “The Mafia”.

Following the compass, they find a Mafia outpost. They see Mafia members in a room. They go above the players and drop dripstone on them, killing one of the players and using the totem of undying of another player named Leow0ok. Leow0ok agrees to team with them, and reveals he is only in the Mafia hire teammates to help him kill ClownPierce. The outpost starts exploding. They follow a member of the Mafia to Mafia City, where there are different tiers of Mafia members. They find Mapicc in a prison and break him out.

Spoke and the team are tasked to kill ParrotX2 but fails. Ashswagg kills one of the members who was helping them. They run away. They are then tasked with guarding a vault. ManePear and Wemmbu start trying to break into the vault.

The team is now tasked to get diamonds. Ashswagg promotes them to gold tier.

The team is tasked with killing PlanetLord, but they do not kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the Mafia members until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. He starts fighting a diamond player to become diamond. Spoke’s totem of undying is used during the fight, revealing to ashswagg that he is Spoke. They try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he’s MinuteTech.

 Season 2 
Spoke borrows a snowy fox from PlanetLord.

PlanetLord helps Spoke raid a secret base owned by Yeah_Jaron and Reddoons.

PlanetLord is seen competing in the trial to become a member of BAT.

 Season 3 
PlanetLord is seen in the Far Lands leading a group of chainmail players. He helped Spoke and Jumper but was later captured by Null Hunters and presumably killed or sent through nether portal

title: PrinceTetra
content:
PrinceTetra is the current leader of the Merchant City Vanguard, and possibly of the whole of Merchant City after DanchoGold was overthrown.

 History 
PrinceTetra is seen protecting the gates of his home. He lets ParrotX2 enter Merchant City with his bodyguards TheobaldTheBird and ReinaDrop.

PrinceTetra joins Parrot's army to stop Cindercrest.
