content:
About 
PrinceZam, also known simply as Zam, is a supporting character in Unstable Universe. She was one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside FlameFrags) in Season 1. He serves as the tritagonist of Spoke's BAT Arc.   

He was the former ruler of the Zam Empire, a faction that once thrived on influence and control. Early in the server, Prince Zam and Wemmbu had a very strong alliance, however Zam's paranoia and need for control ultimately led to her betraying Wemmbu. The Wemmbu Arc spanned several episodes, with Zam constantly obsessing over chasing Wemmbu down, then letting him escape and forcing Wemmbu to live in fear. This conflict comes to a head after Wemmbu detonates an Orbital Strike Cannon against Zam, when ClownPierce imprisons them together for entertainment. Zam and Wemmbu are forced to work together, and they become close again, although they are never truly allies again.  

Despite its earlier prominence, the Zam Empire ultimately fell, leading to its dissolution following internal and external conflicts, including opposition from notable figures like Wemmbu, ClownPierce and Reddoons. This collapse marked a significant turning point in Zam's arc within the server's story.

Personality
PrinceZam is known for her ambitious and tenacious nature, aiming to consolidate power and secure dominance through strategic planning and fortifications, such as the infamous wall that led to discord among other factions and various prisons where he chunkbanned many of his enemies. Zam's leadership showcased both determination and an ability to command respect, even amidst controversy. Zam is also characterized by an intense need for control of both her citizens and the full server, as well as extreme paranoia and concern over people who potentially pose a threat to the Empire. 

History
SpokeIsHere helps Mapicc steal from Zam Empire. PrinceZam now wants to ban Spoke.

Wemmbu agrees to team with PrinceZam to kill Spoke. A war between people against and with PrinceZam starts as they are talking.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu interrogate TheRealSquiddo and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn’t give information on Spoke. They check her barrels and find out that she has glitched items. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates. PrinceZam chunk bans TheRealSquiddo.

Parrot and Wifies go to PrinceZam’s base as a clue in a scavenger hunt set up by Spoke. Parrot and Wifies see Wemmbu, who questions them about a "disc" that they were talking about. Parrot says that Spoke left something at his base and that Spoke claims there’s a server secret, and they’re trying to find the next clue. PrinceZam comes over to them. PrinceZam says that they should give them all the information they found, however they don’t oblige. Parrot and Wifies fly away over to the castle and start exploring it while Wemmbu tries to kill them. Eventually they escape by flying out, and Wemmbu loses them.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam decide to go to the stronghold to get to the end base that TheRealSquiddo was talking about. Once they were there, they see there are three Spoke guards at the stronghold, RealReeon, Sharkilz_,  and Mapicc. They dig down to the stronghold, and make their way to the portal room. They find the guards and start fighting them. They flee to the end, except for RealReeon. They chunk ban RealReeon. They go into the end and start flying to the coordinates that the end base is at. They break into the base and start killing Spoke and his guards. Spoke is able to escape before being chunk banned.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam leave to the overworld to get some materials. This includes getting a mace. After going to the trial chambers and getting a heavy core, other people go into the trial chamber and see it’s already looted. Wemmbu and PrinceZam hide. The people who break into the trail chamber are Mapicc, Fantst, Arcn, Only_A_Squid, and Sharooh, all enemies of the Zam empire. Mapicc finds them and they start fighting.

Wemmbu escapes the fight and crafts a mace. PrinceZam escapes to the surface, and Wemmbu uses the mace to try and kill some of the players. All of the people flee the fight by running or using stasis chambers. Arcn is chunk banned by PrinceZam. They use the arrows that they left on the ground and a strategy with TNT to try and find the location of Spoke. They find a base that Only_A_Squid is at. They chunk ban Only_A_Squid.

They use the second arrow to find Fantst and Sharooh. Fantst runs away and they chunk ban Sharooh. They find an obsidian box, and inside is the player Mapicc. Spoke and his teammates come in and start to fight Wemmbu and PrinceZam. PrinceZam’s armor all breaks, and he almost dies. Spoke and his team run away because PrinceZam holds a chunk ban.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam use an arrow to find an obsidian maze. They find two chests with peoples stuff inside of them. They hear Parrot in the maze. This is because Parrot and Wifies followed a clue left by Spoke which lead them to the maze. A guard who was there signaled for them to put all of their items in chests for no advantages in the maze. He eventually finds Parrot and Wifies who have no items. They agree to lead Wemmbu to the clue, however, because Wemmbu and PrinceZam don’t have the texture pack that goes along with the hunt, they would not be able to get any use out of it. Wemmbu gets a turtle egg and music disc from the chest. Wifies and Parrot get their stuff and leave the maze. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam realize that they need a texture pack and begin chasing Wifies and Parrot, however they’ve already escaped. Wemmbu and PrinceZam store the disc and turtle egg in a vault.

They follow an arrow to an underwater base. They find Sharkilz_ and chunk ban him. The base explodes which gets rid of the chunk ban, meaning that Sharkilz_ is unbanned because the chunk ban is exploded. Fantst now comes to help Sharkilz_ kill Wemmbu and PrinceZam. They chunk ban Fantst and Sharkilz_.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam are teleported to the vault, where Parrot and Wifies are stealing the music disc and turtle egg. Wemmbu starts killing them, and they manage to fly away and escape. Parrot and Wifies dig down and go into the nether, however Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them in the nether, since they unluckily spawned in a nether cave. Parrot gives Wemmbu and PrinceZam the disc. Parrot says that to find Spoke they need a turtle egg, as baby turtles always go back to their home beach. They agree to team up, however after Wemmbu and PrinceZam go into the overworld to team up, Parrot and Wifies mine away and escape.

The Zam Empire finds and tries to kill Spoke. Parrot is also trying to kill Spoke with them, as Spoke had just chunk banned Wifies. Spoke goes into the puzzle area that Parrot and Wifies were in, and start chasing him. Before they can kill Spoke, he chunk bans himself, with Wifies also stuck in the chunk ban.

Parrot and Rekrap try to convince PrinceZam to disable the chunk ban for one minute so that they can let Wifies out. PrinceZam says no. Parrot breaks into all of his prisons.

PrinceZam hires ClownPierce to kill Parrot as he broke all of his prisons.

PrinceZam gives Wemmbu the task making a civilization to guard a vault. It turns out this is just a plan by PrinceZam to get rid of Wemmbu. The vault contains nothing.

Wemmbu goes to his Orbital Strike Cannon to try and destroy PrinceZam’s empire, but sees the orbital cannon has been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and eggchan discover that PrinceZam has started taking over the spawn. Once Wemmbu and eggchan are far enough from the Zam empire, ManePear tells them that he’s not a big fan of being a guard of PrinceZam, and that if they need help, he can help him.

Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and his civilization try to use an orbital strike cannon to destroy the Zam Empire, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam. Wemmbu is able to escape.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray the Zam Empire.

ManePear distracts yungwillx by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, Merffinn, and Peentar on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, so Wemmbu and ManePear take him hostage. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage. 

While they are taking Sorhin hostage, the Zam Empire breaks out yungwillx and Peentar. The entire Zam Empire destroys Wemmbu's civilization. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and they watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, but then realize that the Zam Empire took eggchan.

PrinceZam takes down the obsidian sheet protecting the Zam Empire. Wemmbu goes over to PrinceZam, with no armor, and they imprison Wemmbu. Wemmbu picks up 36 cakes, which normally shows he has no items in his inventory, but uses the crafting menu to store extra items to smuggle in four items. He uses the orbital cannon which lags the server, giving him enough time to give eggchan full netherite armor from his ender chest to escape. They break out of the prison. Wemmbu destroys the Zam Empire. ClownPierce comes and takes PrinceZam and Wemmbu to a prison.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu are trapped in a miniature version of the normal world with only three totems. PrinceZam tries to kill Wemmbu, but he’s able to escape, though PrinceZam uses three of Wemmbu’s totems.

Wemmbu and eggchan find PrinceZam to ask him if he found any lava, but PrinceZam starts attacking them. They run away.

PrinceZam and Pangi find Wemmbu and eggchan. They start fighting, but because they have better armor, Wemmbu and eggchan run away. They escape by digging underground. They find a slime chunk under PrinceZam’s base. They’re able to get enchantments by fishing.

ClownPierce sends his guard into the prison to try and kill them, and says that if you pop the guards totem, they’re teleported out. The guard teleported in is FerreMC. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to co-exist to kill Ferre. Wemmbu and eggchan sees that they somehow got obsidian. Pangi goes to the nether, but gets chunk banned.

Wemmbu and eggchan build a creeper farm, but it doesn’t work. They go over to PrinceZam to ask why the creeper farm isn’t working, and see he has villagers. They ask how PrinceZam got obsidian, and he says that completing a raid can give obsidian. PrinceZam helps them diagnose the problem with their creeper farm. ClownPierce uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy PrinceZam’s base because of Pangi going to the nether to escape. PrinceZam thinks this is Wemmbu’s fault, so he tries to kill him. PrinceZam stops trying to kill him realizing that Wemmbu is better at PvP than him. He convinces PrinceZam to give Wemmbu his looting sword. Wemmbu and eggchan leave. Wemmbu comes back to his base and sees it is destroyed by the orbital cannon.

PrinceZam goes over to Wemmbu’s base and tries to kill him. PrinceZam now has maxed enchanted diamond armor. Wemmbu shows PrinceZam that if he gets close to killing him, ClownPierce will interrupt it. He proves this by taking off all his armor, and ClownPierce plays a sound saying that the next round of juggernaut is going to happen. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to team again to escape the prison. They use a TNT minecart to activate Ferre’s totem of undying, so he gets teleported out. ClownPierce says that he now knows about a potential escape plan.

A bunch of new members are put into the prison and PrinceZam tries to recruit them. These players include _Kenadian_, SykerMC, loppezz, LuckyMixx, Dol9hin, and Spepticle.

PrinceZam and his teammates comes over to Wemmbu and try to kill them. Eventually they leave. Wemmbu and his team set up a stasis chamber using honey. Wemmbu puts his pearl in the stasis chamber. ClownPierce starts activating people’s stasis chambers to trap them in the prison. Wemmbu is the only one who is able to escape using an ender pearl cannon.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam are trapped by ClownPierce in an escape room made by Wato1876. They are eventually able to escape.

He is imprisoned by The Law ran by LettuceK but is broken out by SpokeIsHere.

He joins Spoke out of debt and helps him attempt to get revenge on Leowo0k. This fails and he leaves with Wemmbu.

He helps Spoke find Mapicc and then helps him get revenge on Leo again.

They construct an army, District 13 (v2), with the help of JumperWho and her spies to defeat LAW and the remainder of BAT.

 Boundaries 

 Shipping is okay (as long as it follows cc boundaries, no self-shipping/shipping with oc)
 No NSFW

 Trivia 

 PrinceZam is the actor for one of the members of Quackenstein's village, TrucksAndTrains. She showed this on a tweet.
 Zam revealed in “I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP…” that she ran off to the Farlands during/post-Mafia arc.
 Zam mentioned in a stream called Lifesteal SMP My Full Power** that she left Unstable for an undisclosed reason.

title: Proton
content:
Proton was a prison built in Unstable Universe designed to hold many players at once. This prison was made for ClownPierce’s entertainment, as he wanted to see what players would do when faced with it.

 History

 Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison 
Kenadian designs the prison. The prison is built and Eggchan, ParrotX2, Kenadian, Wifies, JumperWho, Derapchu, and Rekrap2 are trapped in it.

They managed to escape the prison with help from Leow0ok and Wemmbu. 

Kenadian is still trapped in the prison but they teleport him out using an ender pearl stasis chamber hidden in Kenadian’s base. 

 Design 
The prison is made of three main rings. Each ring is circle shaped and large, about the size of a biome. The cell is basically normal Minecraft terrain, except there was no sand or lava. On the borders of each cell are chunk-banned walls. There were only a few spots that sometimes had an inactive chunk ban, and they are hallways connecting the three cells. In the middle of the three rings is the control tower, and outside of all of it, are chunk-banned crying obsidian walls so thick that it goes outside render distance.

The hallways connecting the three cells are usually chunk-banned at the entrance, and the chunk bans are only temporary turned off when the prisoners are getting moved. There middle of these hallways are not chunk banned because there are solitary confinement cells located in between.

Around every hour, the players are moved to another cell through the hallways connecting the three cells by invisible armed guards. The guards are armed with things like splash potions of poison to control misbehaving prisoners. Each cell is usually designed to hold two prisoners. Each prisoner would usually see the same person every six hours.

When prisoners misbehave, the guards take the prisoner into a small solitary confinement cell for hours and even days depending on what the prisoner did. The cell is located underneath each hallway connecting the three cells. There are two per hallway. The cell has a calibrated skulk sensor connected to an inactive chunk ban. If the player were to place or break any blocks, it would activate the chunk ban.

title: Purpled
content:
Purpled is a minor antagonist featured in Unstable Universe. He was the leader of the Far Lands Warrior Council before Parrot's election.

 Personality 
Purpled is known to be a powerful, paranoid, and tyrannical player. Not only does he heavily dislike the Farmers and goes out of his way to tell the other Warriors about how pathetic the Farmers district is, he prioritizes hierarchy and power over peace and progress. 

 History 
Purpled is seen as the leader of the Warriors District in Far Lands.

He made the choice to leave the Farmers alone in their time of need, yet he continues to be upset at the Farmers for not doing their jobs of providing for the Warriors, highlighting his hypocrisy. He is paranoid about Parrot, and betrays him and the Warrior Council by pretending to be Mafia members to attempt to maintain his position of power, but Parrot escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members.

In I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge, Purpled is one of the remaining candidates in the “dining hall”. Everything was going well until LettuceK announces the second round, whilst a group of assassins try and kill the candidates. Purpled tries to fight, but he is outnumbered. Purpled escapes but at the cost of Naparizel’s life.

Lettuce calls the emergency meaning and tells the Unstable Members that Napa died, and he gives each candidate 120 votes to be split among the remaining candidates. After the votes are split, Lettuce announces the purge. All the candidates either run or fight and Purpled wants to fight. Purpled demands that Parrot give him his book and has 2 unknown affiliated players. Until Theo arrives at the Northern Council and decides to fight Purpled. Parrot then escapes and the fight between Theo and Purpled begins. Theo, using his TNT minecart combat style is able to wear down Purpled’s armor and in the end Purpled runs away and Theo calls it quits there to find Parrot. 

After the event of Parrot, Horace, and Fymada escaping a trap, the three are now on their way back to the Northern Council until Horace falls into a sand trap made by Purpled, he demands someone to give him the votes, in which Parrot says that Boosfer stole them. Purpled is angered by this response and gives Parrot and Fymada four hours to get the votes back. Parrot then sneaks into the Viking village Purpled owns and successfully helps Horace escape a trap that if he was to die, he would fall in lava. Purpled then goes after Parrot. Parrot manages to lose Purpled by hiding behind a tree.  

Purpled is one of the 4 remaining candidates in the election alongside Boosfer, ParrotX2, and LettuceK.

He later renounced from the election and supported LettuceK. He then joined the Law at the Battle of The Northern Council.

 Trivia

When Parrot asked him to stop bidding, and that his kingship was at a risk if he didn't get the chicken, he proceeded to bid 1000, 100 over the amount Parrot and [[TheobaldTheBird]] had. Theo, in a panic, accidentally bid 100,000 diamonds instead of 1,100. REALRoyalty stated that he needed the chicken, and was dissapointed by the loss.

title: Rasplin
content:
Rasplin was a minor character in Unstable Universe, briefly serving as a minor antagonist. He was recently seen in ParrotX2's video, Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia, where he served as a gambler in a floating house far out in the End. 

 History 
Rasplin was seen as a member in Roshambogames Civilization which was attacked by the PrinceZam Empire.

He challenged Parrot to a game of eight-fold, and if Parrot won he would give him the key he needed to open the door to the Tomb of the Mafia. He places increasingly large bets and wins every game, taking a shulker box full of diamonds and Parrot's armor. 

Shortly after their last game, he was killed by Marlowww in an attempt to retrieve the key.

 Trivia 

 Rasplin likely rigged the game of eight-fold, evidenced by the fact he won every game he played with Parrot. Assuming this is true, he used the rather ingenious strategy of getting his dealer HerobaneNair to give Parrot a high-value card, making him bet confidently, then following the strong card with a weak one.
 He makes brainrot reaction content on his channel.
 He owns a Roblox rant channel with over 800k subscribers.

title: Reddoons
content:
Reddoons is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. He acted as the former mayor of Capital City 2.0 and was an ally of The Invisible Mafia. 

History

 Season 1 
ParrotX2, Wifies, and deanthebean9 try to steal from Capital City. They are caught by Reddoons and five of his guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks to be able to leave Capital City. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

Parrot steals from Capital City vaults and gives people diamond blocks for them to be able to leave.

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota.

Reddoons catches Parrot and Wifies after they have left a vault. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke, the guard, says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. 

Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

Reddoons forces people to play a game of roulette which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and the Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they say no. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber and they escape.

 Season 2 
Reddoons is seen at a secret base with Yeah_Jaron. Spoke secretly spies on him for 100 days in the base. Spoke eventually raids the entire base and destroys it. He tries to steal the dragon egg from Reddoons but fails.

Spoke spies on Yeah_Jaron and sees him enter a new secret base with Reddoons. He eventually again raids the entire base.

Reddoons becomes the mayor of Capital City 2.0. He is seen as a tyrant, as he forces people to operate shops where they must pay him 90% of their earnings in taxes. However, they cannot escape because they are scared of the world outside of the city. He makes a deal with Parrot and TheobaldtheBird to forgive everyone's debt in exchange for them safely transporting Reddoons's friend (Hexatope) from spawn to the city.

Reddoons was out of town when Wemmbu came and demanded information about FlameFrags's location. To punish the city for not cooperating, Wemmbu uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy a portion of the city. Security is increased as a result.

In the same video, it is also mentioned that Reddoons had made a sacred pact with Boosfer to not harm the bandits outside of the city walls in exchange for the bandits not raiding the city, but it is unclear when the pact was made.

title: Redstone Town
content:
Redstone Town is a major location in Unstable Universe. Unlike the chaotic outer world of the server, Redstone Town stands as the main trading outpost for redstone. It's a safe place where redstone experts and even people who need/have redstone can buy and sell powerful components used for some of the most complex machinery on the server, including key devices like Orbital Strike Cannons or arrow cannons.

In the town, there are some key landmarks as well, the main ones (that have been shown) being the "Basic Redstone Shop", run by 4CVIT and the "TNT Shop".  With workshops, vaults, and powerful items behind its walls, it’s more than just a place to buy gear—it’s a critical supply line for survival and power. For the BAT team, their stop at Redstone Town isn’t just business—it’s the key to fighting back. 

Next was in Season 2 when Wemmbu was looking for a way to the far lands when looking for 4CVIT so he could save Egg. It was covered with Law guards at that time. He sneaked in going through the walls and trees, going through a mob farm and slime farm until he went into a bamboo farm right under 4CVIT base and talked to him. 4CVIT said he destroyed the pearl cannon into the far lands because too many people were threatening him. When Wemmbu threatened him to rebuild it 4CVIT called the Law guards and they chased Wemmbu out.

In Season 3 Parrot came here and asked 4CVIT to help him to build a cooked chicken farm. 4CVIT refused at first, but later felt bad and built a large enough farm for Parrot (except for most importantly, the chicken, which Parrot wins at an auction).

title: ReinaDrop
content:
ReinaDrop, or Reina for short, was a member of ParrotX2's failed Skymore Civilization. 

 Personality 
Reina is very smart, as evidenced by her winning a 1v1 with Ralamus by dropping a piece of dripstone on him, and also shown by the clues left by Zoe, which used complex ciphers Zoe knew she was smart enough to understand. 

She is calm and collected, and thinks through things quietly, using few words to express herself.

Reina is also somewhat vengeful, with her saying she's going to kill every last member of Cindercrest. 

 History  
Reina was one of the 10 survivors of the 1000 player civilization that was massacred by Cindercrest. She and Zoe444 were two of the survivors, taken instead to grow crops for Cindercrest. They eventually escaped but were split up. Reina was found in Skymore by ParrotX2 and TheoBaldTheBird, who gave her the news that Zoe had died. She then decided to join Parrot and Theo's quest to battle Cindercrest.

Reina won over the strongest bandit by using trident given by parrot to pierce dripstone and skewer opponent. She helped threatening the leader of Merchant City, DanchoGold. She and Theo went to spy on Cindercrest. She acted determined, confident and cautious, just like a clone of Parrot.

 Trivia 

 She is the last surviving member of Skymore.
 She is played by hpneybee, who is friends with the protagonists. She was in Levels SMP Season 1 and was one of the thousand hunters in Karl's 3v1000 with FlameFrags.

'''Rejoicin''', also known as, '''Rejoice''', was a player who guarded a spire in [[The Abandoned Civilization]] from the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]]. He was also a guard for [[Proton]].

== Personality ==
Rejoicin was a kind and pacifistic player who also had a clueless streak. He craved friendship after his long period of isolation, and didn't want to see anyone die, friend or enemy.

==History==
{{Section Improvement}}
=== Season 1 ===
Rejoicin is seen as a guard at [[Proton]].

=== Season 2 ===
[[Wemmbu]] and [[eggchan]] find a player named Rejoicin at the top of a spire. Rejoicin explains that he was a guard for the spire to protect it against the Mafia. He tells Wemmbu and Eggchan that [[Jaden_MAN|Jaden]] is in the armory.

Rejoicin stops Wemmbu and Jaden from fighting. Jaden starts attacking Rejoicin. They try to kill Jaden, but he escapes.

Wemmbu and Rejoice return to Eggchan and Loppezz Wemmbu argues about them becoming a team. Eventually Wemmbu gives in a they become a team to celebrate they make trimmed armour that matches.

Rejoicin, Wemmbu, Eggchan, and [[loppezz]] try to kill Jaden. Rejoicin is killed by wardens.

title: Rekrap2
content:
Rekrap2, Also known as Rek or Parker, is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. He was temporarily a member of District 13.

History
ParrotX2 and Rekrap2 attempt to break into the prison which holds Wifies and SpokeIsHere to get Wifies out. They get caught and have to eat chorus fruit to escape.

Parrot and Rekrap plan to free one of Spoke’s henchmen, so they go over to an end dimension chunk ban to try and free them. Parrot builds a TNT cannon to try and explode the chunk ban, but the TNT cannon explodes itself and the guards notice. The guards almost kill Parrot, but he is able to fly away and hide. Parrot comes back to try and make a new TNT cannon, but the guards come back. Luckily, Parrot is invisible. Parrot quickly builds another TNT cannon, but again this one fails to break the chunk ban. Parrot builds another TNT cannon, but this time he’s caught. He flies away and escapes.

Parrot tries to convince PrinceZam to temporarily disable the chunk ban in Spoke's prison to let Wifies out, but he says no. Parrot and Rekrap start breaking into an underwater prison. They are successful in breaking out Derapchu.

Parrot and Rekrap and Derapchu go over to the next prison, which is built in a jungle. They start breaking into the prison. They manage to explode the chunk ban using their TNT cannon.

While travelling to PrinceZam’s empire, the server crashes. When they join, they are sent back to a previous save. It turns out that PrinceZam had added a new defense which makes it so that the server crashes when getting too close to certain locations. This is called a memory ban.

The team go to a nether prison, and try to break in. They discover that there are three chunk bans in this prison. They manage to destroy one of the chunk bans.

They move onto an ice themed prison. Using flying machines, they are able to free Fantst. Fantst agrees to join their team to break people out of prisons.

They go to a sky prison. They are able to destroy the chunk ban.

Fantst chunk bans himself as he thinks that the prisons will just get harder and harder.

They go to a new end prison and use TNT minecarts to destroy the chunk ban. The player has no interest of teaming with them. The team goes over to the first end prison they went to, and easily destroy the chunk ban using TNT minecarts. The player freed is JumperWho, who agrees to help them.

The team uses the nether to avoid the memory bans that crash the server. They find the prison that holds Spoke and Wifies and try to break in. They retreat back to their cave area to plan an escape. They figure out how they can chunk ban the guards. They set up an underground chunk ban setup, and have JumperWho lead the guards to the chunk ban. They manage to chunk ban all of the guards. Parrot is able to get _Kenadian_ to help them break out Spoke and Wifies using a wither bore. They kill the baby piglins which are holding chunk bans using flying machines and TNT minecarts. 

The team is successful in breaking out Wifies. They also accidentally free Spoke.

Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ burn the tree in Rekrap2's base.

Wemmbu is paid by Boosfer to destroy "the valley", which is revealed to be Rekrap2's base. Parrot and Wifies convince him not to destroy certain parts of the base.

Rekrap2 is trapped in Proton. The prisoners are eventually able to escape with the help of Wemmbu.

Rekrap2 is temporarily a member of District 13. He later leaves due to minimal progress.

 He prefers to be drawn as a human

 No sexualization
 No shipping

Trivia 

Rek is the first member to show behind the scenes footage of a video. He shows the behind the scenes of ParrotX2's "I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison" in a video on his second channel labeled Addressing the GYATT allegations.

 History 
Roshambogames is hired to be a guard of one of The Wonders.

Wemmbu and eggchan set up a job where people can hire them to blow up things. Roshambo hires Wemmbu and eggchan to blow up Spoke’s end base. They are successful in doing so.

Wemmbu sees that FlameFrags and Merffinn are trying to invade Roshambogames Civilization (unnamed in video). FlameFrags almost kills Roshambo, but Wemmbu stops him. title: SOLO Player VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction
content:
SOLO Player VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction is the 75th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
The episode starts with FlameFrags giving a summary about ClownPierce and his achievements, and he enters what seems to be a guard supply room for the ClownPierce's Nether Faction’s guards. Flame meets two guards and he kills them effortlessly. Flame keeps roaming around the Nether and he eventually meets ParrotX2. Parrot, wearing a shield that matches the Clown's guard force. Flame thinks that means Parrot joined Clown's Guards and chases him. Parrot pulls a trap that makes Flame pummel down a chute but Flame block-clutches and saves himself. Flame enderpearls out to catch Parrot running away to a tunnel. Parrot digs the roof dropping lava on Flame but Flame pearls past. Parrot jumps down a hole and breaks a block to make Flame drop down another hole but Flame block-clutches to  prevent himself from dying. Flame then chases Parrot as Parrot runs to Theo. Theo splashes invisibilty on both of them but Flame manages to catch Parrot and pop his  totem. Parrot then bluffs saying he has a TNT minecart trap that would kill all three of them. Parrot says Flame to go back to his job of working for clown but Flame says he isn't working for clown but instead trying to kill him. Flame and Parrot decide to make an alliance as both of them had  the same objective.  

Together, all three of them make  their way to the Nether Civilization to assassinate Clown or FerreMC. Flame goes to the nether festival and Theo pressures him to fight a player named "GeneralChungus". Flame kills GeneralChungus. Flame and Theo make their way to the central building where they jump Ferre. Although Clown and his guards eventually make their way up to save Theo, they were unsuccessful and Ferre is taken hostage. Parrot denies Flame his fight against Clown purposefully by taking Ferre to a remote bunker. Parrot drops Ferre some maps and other junk making it seemlike the maps were useless. Parrot then lets Ferre free. Flame, furious starts attacking Parrot for letting Ferre out. Parrot tracks the general direction of Ferre and decides to hold a stakeout to see any guards of Clown passing by.  

Flame pretends to go AFK and Parrot says he is just using Flame to get to Clown's nether vault. Flame hears them and runs away to Clown's castle with the goal to betray Parrot. Flame recruits Clown and gives him Parrot's location in exchange for information about Wemmbu. Together the group, makes their way to Parrot and jumps Parrot and Theo. Parrot is able to run away but Theo is captured. Parrot jumps down attempting to make negotiations so Theo is spared but instead, Parrot is captured too. Clown says he knows nothing about Wemmbu. Before Parrot is executed, he apologizes to Flame for using him and Flame accepts it and tells Clown that they'd have to get through him first, betraying Clown. This gives Parrot and Theo time to find the vault. Clown runs away to catch Parrot so his vault isn't ransacked leaving his army behind. Clown's army is eventually defeated and Flame comes out on top. Afterwards, Flame decides to go to Capital City to offer Parrot a deal to find Wemmbu. Flame offers Parrot the tomb of The Invisible Mafia. Parrot accepts his deal. 

 Trivia 

 The video was originally titled "Minecraft Combat Master VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction"

'''SOLO Player VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction''' is the 75th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Plot ==
The episode starts with FlameFrags giving a summary about [[ClownPierce]] and his achievements, and he enters what seems to be a guard supply room for the [[ClownPierce|ClownPierce's]] Nether Faction’s guards. Flame meets two guards and he kills them effortlessly. Flame keeps roaming around the Nether and he eventually meets [[ParrotX2]]. Parrot, wearing a shield that matches the Clown's guard force. Flame thinks that means Parrot joined Clown's Guards and chases him. Parrot pulls a trap that makes Flame pummel down a chute but Flame block-clutches and saves himself. Flame enderpearls out to catch Parrot running away to a tunnel. Parrot digs the roof dropping lava on Flame but Flame pearls past. Parrot jumps down a hole and breaks a block to make Flame drop down another hole but Flame block-clutches to  prevent himself from dying. Flame then chases Parrot as Parrot runs to [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]]. Theo splashes invisibilty on both of them but Flame manages to catch Parrot and pop his  totem. Parrot then bluffs saying he has a TNT minecart trap that would kill all three of them. Parrot says Flame to go back to his job of working for clown but Flame says he isn't working for clown but instead trying to kill him. Flame and Parrot decide to make an alliance as both of them had  the same objective.  

Together, all three of them make  their way to the [[Nether Civilization]] to assassinate Clown or [[FerreMC]]. Flame goes to the nether festival and Theo pressures him to fight a player named "GeneralChungus". Flame kills GeneralChungus. Flame and Theo make their way to the central building where they jump Ferre. Although Clown and his guards eventually make their way up to save Theo, they were unsuccessful and Ferre is taken hostage. Parrot denies Flame his fight against Clown purposefully by taking Ferre to a remote bunker. Parrot drops Ferre some maps and other junk making it seemlike the maps were useless. Parrot then lets Ferre free. Flame, furious starts attacking Parrot for letting Ferre out. Parrot tracks the general direction of Ferre and decides to hold a stakeout to see any guards of Clown passing by.  

Flame pretends to go AFK and Parrot says he is just using Flame to get to Clown's nether vault. Flame hears them and runs away to Clown's castle with the goal to betray Parrot. Flame recruits Clown and gives him Parrot's location in exchange for information about [[Wemmbu]]. Together the group, makes their way to Parrot and jumps Parrot and Theo. Parrot is able to run away but Theo is captured. Parrot jumps down attempting to make negotiations so Theo is spared but instead, Parrot is captured too. Clown says he knows nothing about [[Wemmbu]]. Before Parrot is executed, he apologizes to Flame for using him and Flame accepts it and tells Clown that they'd have to get through him first, betraying Clown. This gives Parrot and Theo time to find the vault. Clown runs away to catch Parrot so his vault isn't ransacked leaving his army behind. Clown's army is eventually defeated and Flame comes out on top. Afterwards, Flame decides to go to [[Capital City 2.0|Capital City]] to offer Parrot a deal to find [[Wemmbu]]. Flame offers Parrot the tomb of [[The Invisible Mafia]]. Parrot accepts his deal. 

== Trivia ==

* The video was originally titled "Minecraft Combat Master VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction"

title: SOLO Player VS Minecraft Bounty Hunters
content:
SOLO Player VS Minecraft Bounty Hunters is the 52nd episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Flame's best friend, Jaden_MAN, has mysteriously disappeared off the server, and he goes around asking players if they know where Jaden went. One player in specific, LettuceK, tells Flame that Jaden is not someone he should be looking for, which makes Flame suspicious, so he follows Lettuce with invisibility. Flame makes it to the base of Lettuce's team of bounty hunters, he questions what it meant by Jaden is captured, and Lettuce says he worked to get things done and have Jaden captured, and so Flame attacks them. Flame quickly pops some of their totems, but is then shot with weakness arrows and is drained of resources. Lettuce proposes that Flame not look for Jaden and that they stop fighting, and Flame agrees just to get them to stop. Flame goes and spies on The Law's meeting invisible to get any intel on where Jaden could be. The first meeting had nothing important, but a few hours later they held another and Flame overhears them talking about Leow0ok taking on a 1v5 and ended up beating The Law, they also mentioned holding an auction a few days from then, so Flame plans on attending it to get a lead on Jaden's location. 

Flame goes to the destroyed B.A.T. Headquarters to look for Leo. Leo thinks he's there to kill him, but Flame says he's there to learn Leo's PvP techniques, which costed Flame an IOU to learn Leo's strategies. Leo shows Flame to use a crossbow and flint and steel to explode the TNT minecarts instantly, and they begin practicing together. With crossbow carting understood, Flame heads to the auction and uses his newfound knowledge and wipes out a good amount of players. Lettuce wants to talk it out and knows Flame won't get the information out of killing him, and he says the reason why he can't tell Flame where Jaden was is because he couldn't let others go through what he had to, so Flame lets him go.

Flame has an idea goes back to the B.A.T. Headquarters and asks Leo for a favor, Leo doesn't want to work with Flame, but Flame gives him an offer of a stack of experience bottles and Leo accepts. He tells Leo to turn himself in to see where The Law takes him and hope that they take the bait. They make it to The Law's base and Leo turns himself in, they take him outside of the base and head towards an ender pearl cannon, where Leo stops pretending and starts to fight The Law. Leo breaks the scaffolding leading up to the cannon, Lettuce and his lawmen begin to stack up. Leo says he's done his job, so Flame gives him the other half of the stack of experience and tries to stop The Law from escaping, but was too late. Flame uses the cannon and is teleported to the Pirate Islands. Flame chases them from island to island, until they reach the last island, which had to have Jaden. Flame carts the lawmen and they're forced to run into the castle. They all jump down the hole that leads to the Abandoned Civilization, Flame asks again where Jaden is, but Lettuce says he needs to stay locked up for the good of everyone. After killing one more lawmen, Lettuce and the remaining lawmen flee and says Flame wins this time. Flame looks around the civilization and finds Jaden inside of a house and gives Jaden food before he starved to death. Flame said he dealt with The Law for Jaden, but Jaden doesn't know who Flame is talking about. Flame asks who put Jaden down there then, and Jaden replies, "It was Wemmbu."

title: SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Civilization
content:
SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Civilization is the 48th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
FlameFrags is surrounded by a group of toxic players that demand him to drop all his items, instead of doing so, he wipes them all out. Flame goes to find a base and finds Lomedy's base to reside in for the time being. The toxic clan finds Flame before he could even devise a plan on how to find the leader of the clan, they're all wiped out once again. One of the bodies dropped a lodestone compass, which gave him a clue to find the leader. After regearing, Flame travels towards the location, which is a castle on an island in the middle of the ocean. The toxic clan sees him and try to intimidate him to leave when he says he's looking for their leader. The leader, VEN0M, appears out of nowhere with a mace and revealed that he was a diamond trim Mafia member like Flame was. Flame however doesn't think VEN0M is intimidating despite having a mace and being as skilled as he is, so he takes on the fight against all of them at once. The army dies and it's only Flame and VEN0M left, Flame switches to a different sword and begins to beat VEN0M, causing him to run and call it a stalemate. Flame knew going into the toxic civilization base would take more resources, so he mends his armor and heads back to Lomedy's base where Lomedy was being pressed by more toxic players, and Flame takes of all of them and spares one when they give him a map. Flame trains Lomedy in PvP so he doesn't make Flame look bad later on, he teaches Lomedy how to use cobwebs to slow players down and heads off to the location on the map afterwards.

The map shows a location of one of the toxic clan's vault, Flame forces Lomedy to come with him to the vault. The location is inside of one of the clan's bases and Flame jumps all the guards outside, once inside the clan's territory kills the guards there, and goes into the vaults and kills the guards there too. Flame and Lomedy loot the vault and get a lot of good gear, more guards come in and Flame uses the TNT minecarts and flame bow he just looted to get rid of them. Flame goes out of the vault and kills the rest of the toxic clan that resided inside of that base and escapes, going back to Lomedy's base to meet back up with him. Flame and Lomedy talk and Lomedy reveals that his old teammate was a Mafia member with a mace. Flame tells Lomedy to go a thousand blocks out and set up TNT dupers, while Flame was waiting for Lomedy to return, VEN0M and a group of the toxic players confront Flame about the missing loot in his vault. VEN0M makes fun of Flame about how he thinks he's the immortal demon and Flame tells him to show him that he's not, and they begin fighting. Flame uses slow falling arrows to prevent VEN0M from using his mace, Lomedy returns to his base and gives his former teammate's mace to Flame to help. Flame easily kills off the toxic clan, leaving VEN0M alone again, who runs away again. Flame asks Lomedy why he gave him the mace, and Lomedy says that he's been alone ever since his teammate died and it was nice to hang around with someone again and wants to follow Flame along in his journey, but Flame says he works better alone. 

Flame heads to the TNT dupers Lomedy built and activates it, and it slowly moves towards the clan's base. Flame pearls into the base and jumps the guards, the TNT dupers come in and blow up the base at the same time, which helps kill some of them off. All of the guards die, and it's only Flame and VEN0M for the third time, Flame is confident he can kill VEN0M that he takes off all his armor except his chestplate, and inevitably maces VEN0M to death still. Flame goes back to Lomedy and returns his maces and get Ashen back before heading off.

title: SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Clan
content:
SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Clan is the 46th episode featured in Unstable Universe 

 Plot 
The episode begins in FlameFrags reuturning to his camp only to see people griefing it. The toxic players also kidnap Ashen.  

FlameFrags follows the toxic players and attacks the first few people he sees in the base.  The players are using strength to increase their attack damage but this doesn't work on Flame as he kills the players in the first base.After killing the first wave of toxic players, FlameFrags blows up their base and follows the path into the next base.  

The players begin using poison arrows but that doesn't work on Flame as he kills them all. He then destroys their base and follows the path into another base.  

This time they use harming arrows. Flame barely manages to kill all of them and the last player dies from fire damage. Flame destroys the base and continues blowing up their base. 

Flame finds an enchanting table and he upgrades his armour before tracking down another base and destroying it until he finds Ashen. 

This time, the players have soul sand placed around their base and are wearing soul speed boots with the speed and weaving effects which makes them go faster on soul sand and prevents them from getting stuck in cobwebs as well as using slowness potions on Flame. Flame uses the harming arrows he got from the previous base to kill the players. He then loots the base, blows it up and leaves.

He then finds a base underwater. The players there are using water breathing, turtle shells and tridents. Flame doesn't have a hard time killing all of them. After killing all the players he places obsidian in all of their houses and griefs it.

At the next base, he goes down a ladder into complete darkness. He is ambushed by players shifting behind the doors and this time Flame barely kills all of them. After killing all of them he blows the base up.

Then he meets T0X1N and his 6 other commanders representing the leaders for every base up to now. Flame tries to free Ashen but they fight and the winner gets to keep Ashen. Flame kills some of them before his helmet and chestplate almost break so he picks up the dead players loot and he takes their armour to wear it. After some time he kills all of TOX1N's commanders.

TOX1N threatens to kill Ashen if Flame doesn't drop all his gear. Flame drops his potions and a water bucket but TOX1N allows him to keep his armour and weapons. TOX1N then forces Flame to send him a screenshot of his inventory. TOX1N then forces Flame to jump on a ladder on top of a pit of chickens. He then splashes a potion of wind charging and a potion of harming that sends Flame up into the sky. TOX1N's attempt at executing Flame has failed because Flame has wind charge clutched to negate his fall damage. He had pulled out a wind charge from his bundle hiding it from TOX1N.

Flame then kills TOX1N and frees his wolf Ashen.

 Trivia 

 In a tweet, Lettuce said this is his favorite recording he has done on Unstable.

title: SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Team
content:
SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Team is the 41st episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
FlameFrags was exploring the server until his wolf teleports to him and began growling, which only happens when a wolf gets attacked. FlameFrags decides to check on his base and he finds out his base was griefed by a toxic team. The team of toxic players had blown his entire base up and killed all his wolves and the wolf that teleported to him was the only survivor. 

FlameFrags heads out to set a temporary camp until he gets attacked by a band of players from the toxic team. They use pots to steal FlameFrags's weapon but FlameFrags proves that he can win a fight against these players with his fists. The toxic players loot FlameFrags's camp and destroy it and he has an argument with the remaining players. They reveal that their leader is Razor2gud. FlameFrags's wolf kills one of the remaining players and one of them drops a lodestone compass. 

FlameFrags goes to where the lodestone compass leads to and finds Razor2gud. FlameFrags tries to confront Razor2gud but he taunts him and runs away. FlameFrags tries to have a fight with Razor2gud but he says that if he wants to fight him, he has to downgrade his gear. After switching to iron armour and weapons, Razor2gudbrings his army to try to kill FlameFrags. The fight goes well, they start using strength potions but FlameFrags is still able to kill all of them. FlameFrags finds a map in one of the houses and realizes that the base he raided wasn't the only base the players own. If he wanted to find all of their bases and destroy them as well as getting revenge on Razor, he had to find the bases. 

FlameFrags sets up another temporary camp inside a cave where he gives his dog new armour and a name, Ashen. FlameFrags uses his map to find a bunker since he knew that they could have TNT after what happened to his base. On his way to the bunker, FlameFrags finds another group of members from the same team. He goes into the bunker and is met with more people trying to defend it. FlameFrags defeats a wave of players there. He begins looting the base until another wave of players jump him.  He uses the fireworks and the crossboy he looted to kill them all. FlameFrags then blows up the entire bunker.

FlameFrags heads to another town and he kills the players living there in case one of them drops a lodestone compass. While he was looting a potion stash, he finds a bunch of strength potions and protects his dog until he gets confronted by Razor2gud and his team. FlameFrags crafts a bunch of TNT minecarts and he also enchants his iron leggings with blast protection to take less damage as well as gathering a few turtle master potions in case he's about to die. title: SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server
content:
SOLO Player VS Unstable SMP is the 64th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
FlameFrags is running out of resources, and if he wants to stay alive on Unstable, he's going to have to get rich fast. Flame gets a chance of doing so when he comes across a mysterious invisible player offers Flame riches if he completes their quests. The player instructs Flame to take bring back stolen potions from a dangerous player named MisterLegend101, and so Flame heads to Capital City in search for him. When he gets to Capital City, nobody is around and it appeared to have been destroyed. He spots a random person and asks where everyone is and they explain that Wemmbu came by earlier and was looking for Flame, but Flame doesn't care about that as of now and continues looking for MisterLegend101. He finds MisterLegend101 right after and presses him for the potions, but MisterLegend101 says he doesn't have any and will give it back in two weeks, Flame pops his totems until he gives them up. He heads back to the invisible player and hands over the shulker full of potions. His reward is an enchanted golden apple, the invisible player tells him he can receive more if Flame gets a Happy Ghast. However, the Nether is a dangerous dimension as it's guarded by ClownPierce and his army, so he has to go deep into the Nether. He stumbles across Nether scavengers that offer to help him traverse the Nether if he protects them. While exploring, the scavengers explain how they supply groups such as B.A.T. and The Law. They get to a part of the Nether that has been unlooted and finds a dried Ghast.

Headed back to spawn, Flame meets back with the invisible player, the player says they appreciate Flame's work and gives Flame a beacon, Flame doesn't think the beacon isn't a powerful item and demands for better items. The invisible player asks if Flame wants to know who they are, and they reveal themselves to be Spoke, a person who's manipulated many people in the past, and Flame knows to not trust him because of that. Flame attacks Spoke because he knows that Spoke was scamming him, Spoke drops a book and goes into an escape tunnel. Flame reads the book that tasks him to kill a group of bandits called the Skullhounds and that this could be his final moments on the server. Unsure of how to find them, Flame visits The Law's base to get any intel on them. The Law's base has also seem to be blown up, Flame asks LettuceK if he knows anything about the Skullhounds, Lettuce says that they're located about 15,000 blocks out from spawn. Flame thinks that Lettuce could be lying, but Lettuce says he has no reason to as of now, seeing the current state that he's in and that he's been trying to kill them himself, but if Flame wants to do it himself, The Law wouldn't interfere. Lettuce also tells Flame to talk to Wemmbu to stop blowing stuff up, but Flame doesn't care about that right now.

Flame is out in the wild and finds a random player and asks if they know the leader of the Skullhounds, they point Flame towards a direction, he finds griefed villages and lava casts, as well as player's loot that has yet to despawn, meaning that they were nearby. He finds the Skullhounds and confronts them, they tell him not to care about what they're doing if he's not apart of Law or B.A.T., two of the bandits stall them while the other builds a small railgun behind him, however Flame notices due to not being able to hear his game, so he quickly places blocks and covers himself to prevent himself from being shot to death. The bandits jump him and puts up a tough fight, almost breaking Flame's armor and resorting to diamond armor, but Flame manages to kill them all off in the end. He picks up their shields and the main bandit's chestplate with trims as proof that he completed the mission. Back at spawn, Spoke is seen high up in the air, trying to avoid being attacked again. He drops down and Flame gives him the shield and armor and asks for his rewards, Spoke says he deserves to be rewarded and that he's trying to build any type of alliance because of his mistakes in the past and is trying to make up for it. Spoke gives Flame a book that leads to a Mafia stash that would lead him to a lifetime full of stashes. Spoke explains how there's so much loot that nobody knows about and that Flame would be rich forever and that the only reason why he hasn't gone there himself is because he's afraid of the people near there, how he doesn't need the loot and Flame needs it more than him. He mentions how he had Flame go through trials to prove that he's ready for this final mission and says they should work closely more in the future.

Flame makes it to the Mafia stash built inside of the mountains of a Bandlands biome that appears to be blown up and looted, each area he goes to has rooms full of chests that are all empty. Flame finds some diamond armor and experience bottles, allowing him to mend his Netherite, he walks out of a dining area and outside onto the bridges that link to other parts of the stash, he's then greeted with Wemmbu standing right above where he just came out of. Wemmbu asks for a rematch, Flame thinks it's pointless since he's beaten Wemmbu every other time, but Wemmbu says he thinks he's the strongest now, Flame laughs at him and Wemmbu sends down a stab shot right at Flame. Flame is shocked and confused at the powers Wemmbu has, he manages to get a few hits in, but is unable to for the most part due to Wemmbu flying in and out. Wemmbu uses an orbital strike cannon as well, making Flame even more confused than before, Flame still has confidence that he can beat Wemmbu even with his TNT powers. The stab shots blow through the entire mountain and reveals an ancient city underneath, Flame grabs a hoe and breaks the sculk for experience in order to mend his armor. Wemmbu stab shots out and Flame chases him, and Wemmbu spams orbitals to try and kill Flame. An invisible person drops Flame more potions to help him out. Now out of totems, Flame starts to use turtle master potions to stay alive, the invisible player drops a couple more totems for Flame. Wemmbu drops another stab shot on Flame, popping a totem, but more importantly breaking Flame's chestplate, his most prized possession. Flame tries to regear with his shulkers, but Wemmbu blows them up before he has the chance to. Without any more totems this time, Flame drops all the way down to bedrock and digs a tunnel to hide. Wemmbu talks knowing Flame probably hears him, he says he doesn't want to kill Flame and wants him to know he'll never be the strongest ever again and flies off.

Flame goes back to spawn where Spoke said he would be, instead of finding Spoke, a sign is placed saying, "Thank you my friend" with a wither rose right in front of it. Flame is upset that he lost to Wemmbu and destroys everything inside of his ender chest and inventory. He says to himself that it's over for Wemmbu, implying he's going to get stronger and get revenge on Wemmbu.

 Trivia 

 The title of the video was briefly changed to "Minecraft SOLO Player VS Hardcore SMP" before it was changed back to it's original title. 
 It has since then been changed to SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server.

title: SargeLAW
content:
thumb|1x1px
SargeLAW or Sergeant is a character in Unstable Universe. He was an officer of The Law, indicated by his full netherite armor.

 History 
 Season 2 
 The Kings Arc 
 Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea 
SargeLAW appears near the orbital strike cannon in The Law's battle against the pirates. He does not appear after that though.

SargeLaw is one of the officers in The Law with similar power to Deputy_Ace, G0dOfWar and The Oroboros. He commands elite Law units and players with full netherite armour. He is shown to be a good commander.

 I Got Trained By A Minecraft Spear Master 
In order to attract The Law, FlameFrags and ManePear blow up a village and kill its inhabitants, while instructing the survivors to ask The Law for help.

SargeLAW shows up. He mentions that his brother was SargeRaxby, but he was maced and killed by Wemmbu in Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP.

While he is willing to fight solo, Flame and Mane ask him to call for reinforcements. Sarge's reinforcements are in full netherite armor (one of them has an elytra and a spear), and they are able to force ManePear to run and capture FlameFrags.

SargeLAW comes back after learning FlameFrags has escaped, alongside an army of players. He loses the fight and has to run away. 

 2 Minecraft Pros vs 1000 Hunters 
SargeLAW shows up at Smuggler's Pass with some Law soldiers, as well as eggchan. He waits for Parrot and Wemmbu invisibly but they find him. 

He decides to duel Wemmbu instead of attacking with all the soldiers as his revenge would be more satisfying that way. After losing the duel, he gets the soldiers to attack Parrot and Wemmbu. 

After Parrot and Wemmbu splash invisibility, SargeLAW starts carting random soldiers in hopes of exposing Parrot and Wemmbu. 

SargeLAW and TheG0DOfWar ambush TheobaldTheBird after he kills The_Oroboros. 

 I Became King of the Unstable SMP (4 Protagonists) 
SargeLAW sends troops at Law HQ to fight district 13. The troops are defeated and LettuceK orders SargeLAW to retreat from battle.

After Deputy Ace helps Parrot and TheobaldTheBird escape, SargeLAW ends up killing him.

SargeLAW fights at the Battle of The Northern Council alongside The Law.

During the battle he defects from the Law with a handful of soldiers and escapes the battle.

'''SargeLAW''' or '''Sergeant''' is a character in [[Unstable Universe]]. He was an officer of The Law, indicated by his full netherite armor.

== History ==
=== [[Season 2]] ===
==== [[The Kings Arc]] ====
==== Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea ====
SargeLAW appears near the orbital strike cannon in The Law's battle against the pirates. He does not appear after that though.

SargeLaw is one of the officers in The Law with similar power to [[Deputy_Ace]], [[G0dOfWar]] and [[The Oroboros]]. He commands elite Law units and players with full netherite armour. He is shown to be a good commander.

==== I Got Trained By A Minecraft Spear Master ====
In order to attract The Law, FlameFrags and ManePear blow up a village and kill its inhabitants, while instructing the survivors to ask The Law for help.

SargeLAW shows up. He mentions that his brother was [[SargeRaxby]], but he was maced and killed by Wemmbu in [[Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP]].

While he is willing to fight solo, Flame and Mane ask him to call for reinforcements. Sarge's reinforcements are in full netherite armor (one of them has an elytra and a spear), and they are able to force ManePear to run and capture FlameFrags.

SargeLAW comes back after learning FlameFrags has escaped, alongside an army of players. He loses the fight and has to run away. 

==== 2 Minecraft Pros vs 1000 Hunters ====
SargeLAW shows up at Smuggler's Pass with some Law soldiers, as well as eggchan. He waits for Parrot and Wemmbu invisibly but they find him. 

He decides to duel Wemmbu instead of attacking with all the soldiers as his revenge would be more satisfying that way. After losing the duel, he gets the soldiers to attack Parrot and Wemmbu. 

After Parrot and Wemmbu splash invisibility, SargeLAW starts carting random soldiers in hopes of exposing Parrot and Wemmbu. 

SargeLAW and TheG0DOfWar ambush TheobaldTheBird after he kills The_Oroboros. 

==== I Became King of the Unstable SMP (4 Protagonists) ====
SargeLAW sends troops at Law HQ to fight district 13. The troops are defeated and LettuceK orders SargeLAW to retreat from battle.

After Deputy Ace helps Parrot and TheobaldTheBird escape, SargeLAW ends up killing him.

SargeLAW fights at the Battle of The Northern Council alongside The Law.

During the battle he defects from the Law with a handful of soldiers and escapes the battle. 

He later shows up, attempting to sabotage Parrot's attempt to bring a boatload (or rather minecart-load) of cooked chicken to spawn, only to be tricked by Parrot with fake chest minecarts. 

It (was) speculated that Sargelaw is leading some king of rebellion against Parrots kingdom.

SargeLAW is revealed to have taken over The LAW with a change of leadership. Parrot demands he joins The Royal Army but SargeLAW refuses. SargeLAW reveals that he plans on joining Cindercrest. Parrot then activates a TNT trap which kills the remaining 1000 LAW men and destroys LAW city. SargeLAW is presumably imprisoned.

title: SargeRaxby
content:
SargeRaxby is a character in Unstable Universe.

 History 
SargeRaxby is seen as the prison warden and PvP trainer. Wemmbu notes that he doesn't item check, unlike Loppezz.

He believes the prisoners will eventually reform work for The Law, and as such trains them in PvP. 

As Wemmbu, PrinceZam, Fantst, and Baablu are escaping, SargeRaxby pleads to them and laments that he thought they were better, before being slammed and killed by Wemmbu.

PrinceZam would take and use SargeRaxby's Black Law Shield as it was the only shield he had, which was later noticed by LettuceK and Wemmbu, the latter of which laughingly remarking that Zam was evil for it.

Following his death, his brother SargeLAW suceeded him as Law Commander and swore to avenge his death, relentlessly hunting Wemmbu down and serving the law up till LettuceK's defeat.

title: Sculk Kingdom
content:
The Sculk Kingdom is a faction in the Unstable Universe that inhabits a sculk-themed castle base. They were allied with Arachn1d and his kingdom before their destruction following their leader's death by the hands of Wemmbu.

 History  
This faction consisted of an army of players who lived underground in a deep dark biome. After allying with Arachn1d, they take Eggchan hostage, possibly on Arachn1d's orders. They are in the midst of interrogating him, including stealing his notes, when Wemmbu attempts to release him. In the massive battle that follows, Yungyx leads around a thousand Skulk Kingdom players to their doom against Wemmbu.  After Wemmbu departs, the players who were grilling Eggchan to get Information about The Abandoned Civilization are killed by the invisible player and Eggchan's notes stolen by the player.

title: Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
content:
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing is the 126th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Spoke recaps what he's gone through for the past month; looking for a thousand players, trying to find his best friend, finding clues that players left behind, all to find out there are anonymous players take players to places that nobody else has seen before on the server.

The episode starts right where it left off previously, Mapicc unveils his identity and tells Spoke and Jumper that he doesn't have a lot of time and to pack everything they have and to meet him at a set of coordinates in a signed book by a player named Revenant44. This leaves the both of them speechless, but they had no other choice other than to listen to his instructions. 

They reach the coordinates and spot a tree getting broken and replaced, hinting that's where the hidden bunker is and so they go down the ladder. As they do, one of the Null Hunters watch them from a distance. At the bottom of the bunker, there are four eerie identical tunnels lit with redstone torches, Mapicc tells them to follow him down one. Spoke asks Mapicc what's happened to him and asks for an explanation about everything. Mapicc explains that he was captured by NULL , but was able to escape and has a chance to save the rest of the players. He then goes on to say that they're heading towards a pearl cannon that leads to a camp and they'll be able to gear up and meet up with Revenant, the same player who wrote the book, saved Mapicc. Just as they think they're safe, the Null Hunters hide in the walls of the tunnel and dig out and start chasing. Mapicc insists going to the pearl cannon is the only way out of this, so they keep running to the cannon. Spoke and Jumper hold them off easily and they make it to the cannon and pearl into it. 

As the three all teleport, Mapicc says the cannon had failed to teleport them to the right location and the hunters may have tampered with it. Spoke opens up his F3 menu and sees that they're 12 million blocks out and thinks it's going to take forever to go back to spawn, but Mapicc says being out that much is a good thing and begins walking towards the Far Lands. Mapicc says to be careful of Null Hunters that could potentially be out in the Farlands since the camp is deep inside. The three of them go inside of the Farlands rather than the top to not show themselves, Mapicc says they'll keep going until they reach a biome he recognizes. When they reach the end of the tunnel, it's a biome that's all flowers, which isn't the one Mapicc recognizes. Mapicc then spots a Null Hunter so they sneak and watch him. They overhear their squad leader telling the rest of the hunters instructing them on what to do before they used their traveling methods to leave. They come out of hiding and start walking forward again, Mapicc tells Spoke and Jumper that there are other people that have escaped NULL and that NULL isn't the only things they should be worried about in the Farlands. Mapicc makes a point that with NULL capturing bad players, they're bound to do bad things even in the Farlands, so he suggests for Spoke and Jumper to blend in with them and not use their netherite armor. Spoke then suggests that they use the shortcuts that the hunters since there's a good chance they'd get lost in the Farlands, and so they do. As they run back the opposite direction, they spot a cave entrance and go inside. They splash invis for safety measures and spot Null Hunters running right past them. After all of them have passed, they come out of hiding and turn left and reach the red plains biome of the Farlands, which is the biome the camp is located at. Spoke asks why they don't go through the Nether, Mapicc tells him that nether portals are a bad omen and whoever has gone through the Nether that isn't NULL have never returned. He theorizes that the hunters may have taken these players into the Nether. 

Eventually, they find the campsite, but with no signs of Revenant anywhere. Spoke spots a hole caused by an explosion with cobwebs, signaling that the hunters had found the camp and took all of the gear. With no other leads, they have no other ideas and need to come up with something new. Mapicc has the idea of killing the other missing players, Spoke doesn't think that seems ideal. Just as they say that, a group of the missing players run their direction and they start running the opposite direction and towering up to the mineshaft up in the air with the players towering up as well. Spoke and Jumper put on their netherite armor and start attacking them, but they hear one of them say that they were the players that raided the camp. Spoke is confused and asks them to repeat themselves, they think that Spoke is a part of NULL because of his shield pattern and demands to know why he attacked the camp. Spoke explains to them that him and Jumper are the only players who know about NULL and what they've been doing, and that convinces them to team up. The Null Hunters start towering up, the missing players tell them to take their horses at the bottom and to head north while they fight off the hunters. Mapicc couldn't believe that they convinced the missing players to work with them, Spoke says although they are all bad people, they'd have to work with each other. It cuts back to the missing players being confronted by the Null Hunters, they make all the missing players take off all their armor and go through a nether portal. Spoke finally uses the time to ask Mapicc why he gave him the NULL shield. Mapicc goes to say when him and MinuteTech went to the end right before the final fight against the Law, they split off and Mapicc encountered the Null Hunters for the first time. He says that they helped him by giving the shield and invited him to join NULL. Since he was about to fight a war, he couldn't join quite yet, but in the middle of the fight, they pulled his stasis due to him being way too trusting.

The three of them make it near the end of the biome, where chunks of the biome start appearing on top. Jumper spots Null Hunters coming from the distance, but Spoke says they can outrun them with their horses. Shortly after, they make it out of the red plains biome and enter the Farlands Rings biome. They go upwards and see names, and so they go to investigate. They find a house and a group of players surrounding a campfire playing a game. Spoke holds up the NULL shield and asks if they know anything about the group, the player speaking tells him that he should talk to their leader and brings them over to their leader, who is PlanetLord. He invites them into a house with an enchantment table and allows them to gear up. After they get all new gear, Spoke asks Planet what he's been up to, Planet says he's been in the Farlands for a while and he used to explore a lot of the biomes before NULL started patrolling it and that him and the village believes the biomes weren't created naturally, but rather that whoever discovered the Farlands first on Unstable made them. The three go to the farm and collect wheat and carrots and begin fishing, when all of a sudden the same player that they talked to earlier gets killed by a Null Hunter. They go back invis and spy on the leader talking to Planet asking where Spoke had went, but Planet says he doesn't know in order to protect them, and so the hunters force Planet to go through a nether portal. Spoke sees the house they were just in and realizes he left all of his shulkers in the house, so he goes down to the house to collect them. The Null Hunters see that Jumper and Mapicc are above and start attacking them, causing them to run. 

They make it to the end of the Farlands Rings and enter a big plains biome with no trees or water. They run through that whole biome and enter a biome that's entirely dark and filled with black. They realize that the armor's enchantment glints is the only way to see in this darkness, so they take off their armor and place a torch to see each other. They come up with a plan to use this to their advantage, as the hunters don't know how to track them through this biome. They sneak up on a few of the hunters and kill them off one by one. One of the hunters drops chainmail armor, which meant Planet could have possibly died. The leader comes up to them and asks what they did to his team, and they start jumping the leader. Before they kill him off, he asks what they want. Spoke says he knows it's not easy to become a leader and wants him to answer a few questions. Firstly, he asks why they take players from spawn to the Farlands, but the leader says he's just the middleman and knows nothing and was sent by someone. The next question Spoke asks is who sent these hunters, but he isn't able to share that information, however, he can show the place where they come from. Spoke forces the leader to drop his netherite armor for precautionary reasons and make him take him to the place. When they reach the place where the Null Hunters travel through, he's too scared to go down the trapdoor and says he can't be seen with Spoke. The leader tries to run away, and Jumper kills him. They then drop down the trapdoor, which seems to be an infinite stone brick staircase that keeps going down and down. They finally reach the end, which has fibers that may lead to the different biomes like the leader said. Spoke says they should go to the bottom and starts lighting the place up with redstone torches to be able to see. They see a light in the distance and walks towards it to discover a village looking area. Jumper sees someone coming from the darkness, Spoke is taken aback and shocked when he sees JamatoP come into view. The episode ends as Jamato tells them that he's there to help.

 Trivia 

 Unlike Wemmbu, Spoke's ender chest did not get cleared when he entered in the Farlands.
 Null Hunters can light nether portal in the Farlands.
 The red plain biome, the fabric biome, and Mapicc saying "soul corrupted to darkness" are reference to Wifies' world that doesn't exist ARG series.
 The endless downward ladder, and Mapicc saying "soul corrupted to darkness" may be a reference to the Underworld.
 The word "Revenant" means "a person who returns after a long absence or, in folklore, a visible ghost or animated corpse that returns from the dead to haunt the living" which suggests that Revenant might return.
