Firstly, he asks why they take players from spawn to the Farlands, but the leader says he's just the middleman and knows nothing and was sent by someone. The next question Spoke asks is who sent these hunters, but he isn't able to share that information, however, he can show the place where they come from. Spoke forces the leader to drop his netherite armor for precautionary reasons and make him take him to the place. When they reach the place where the Null Hunters travel through, he's too scared to go down the trapdoor and says he can't be seen with Spoke. The leader tries to run away, and Jumper kills him. They then drop down the trapdoor, which seems to be an infinite stone brick staircase that keeps going down and down. They finally reach the end, which has fibers that may lead to the different biomes like the leader said. Spoke says they should go to the bottom and starts lighting the place up with redstone torches to be able to see. They see a light in the distance and walks towards it to discover a village looking area. Jumper sees someone coming from the darkness, Spoke is taken aback and shocked when he sees [[JamatoP]] come into view. The episode ends as Jamato tells them that he's there to help.

== Trivia ==

* Unlike [[Wemmbu]], Spoke's ender chest did not get cleared when he entered in the Farlands.
* [[Null Hunters]] can light nether portal in the Farlands.
* The red plain biome, the fabric biome, and Mapicc saying "soul corrupted to darkness" are reference to Wifies' world that doesn't exist ARG series.
* The endless downward ladder, and Mapicc saying "soul corrupted to darkness" may be a reference to [[the Underworld]].
* The word "Revenant" means "a person who returns after a long absence or, in folklore, a visible ghost or animated corpse that returns from the dead to haunt the living" which suggests that Revenant might return.

title: Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
content:
Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing is the 131st episode featured in Unstable Universe

 Plot 
Wemmbu begins the episode by telling the viewers that he doesn't have a lot of friends, except his friend Eggchan. Wemmbu then recaps his previous video, that a mysterious player wanted Egg dead, however during an encounter he and Egg split off and he hasn't found Egg every since. However, while he was split off from Egg he managed to kill the mysterious player who was revealed to be a player named Cytharam. He believed that he managed to kill the mysterious player until he saw the mysterious player next to him. The player told him to meet him at his base and stasises away. Wemmbu asks the mysterious player where Egg is. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu that he doesn't know where Egg is. The player tells Wemmbu that Egg is valuable and that he needs to kill Egg or he will get captured and it will end badly for everyone .  Wemmbu eventually agrees to work with this player to find Egg. The mysterious player asks Wemmbu if he has any idea where Egg could be. Wemmbu tells the player that he has an idea. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu that he needs to restock his orbitals as he anticipates they will get into a lot of fights. Both of them head to a town to get information about Egg, they begin to look for a player who is selling armor. A player named Wheatgust rings a bell bringing them to his shop. Wemmbu then asks wheatgust if he has any armor that he doesn't need. Wheatgust shakes his head yes and gives armor to Wemmbu and the mysterious player. The mysterious player gives Wheatgust diamond blocks and Wemmbu and him began walking all over town. Then, Yungyx and 3 guards appear in the town and start interrogating people about the whereabouts of Egg. Yungyx tells the players that Arachn1d really wants Egg, Wemmbu asks the mysterious player why he wants Egg and the mysterious player tells Wemmbu again that Egg is too valuable. Wemmbu heads to the pond where Yungyx and begins fishing, secretly listening to Yungyx's conversation with the other players.

After a few seconds of listening to Yungy's conversation, Wemmbu maces Yungy catching him by surprise. Wemmbu begins fighting Yungy and his guards when the town guards starting fighting Wemmbu. Wemmbu manages to kill Yungy's guards and makes Yungy'x flee. The town guards continue to fight Wemmbu while Yungy continues to flee. Wemmbu jumps off a bridge with his elyta and flies to Yungy, however the town guards continue to fight Wemmbu. Eventually ,Yungy flees leaving Wemmbu and the town guards alone. The town guards continue to fight Wemmbu, they eventually stop and Wemmbu leaves the town guards. Wemmbu comes back to the mysterious player who tells Wemmbu that he should have kept a low profile as everyone from the town left leaving them with no information. Wemmbu and the mysterious player head to Egg's fishing spot to find any clues about where Egg could be. They don't find anything and Wemmbu asks the player why Egg is so valuable in the first place. The mysterious player ignores Wemmbu and Wemmbu begins to leave when the player tells Wemmbu fine. The player tells Wemmbu that Arachn1d isn't the only one hunting Egg down and that the only reason why Arachn1d is hunting Egg is to control him. Wemmbu then asks the player why he knows that information about Arachn1d's plans. The player tells Wemmbu that Arachn1d payed him to capture Wemmbu alive and that many of his enemies will pay big to keep him alive. Wemmbu believes that the planted wheat seed is a clue and the mysterious player says "The Wheat Village". The player then tells Wemmbu that they is where Egg is, they head to the Wheat Kingdom in hope of finding Egg. They discover that the Wheat Kingdom has been destroyed and find a group of players in the destruction. 

A player writes on a sign saying "This invis guy kidnapped Egg", Wemmbu then tells the invisible player that he has Egg all this time. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu why would he be working with Wemmbu if he had already gotten Egg. Wemmbu then believes that the mace that he has is the one that he gave to FieldsOfElysium. Wemmbu then tells the player that the deal is off and attacks the player with a stab shot, killing a player from the group in the process. Wemmbu then unleases an orbital strike on the wheat farms blowing up a big chunk of it. Wemmbu continues to fight the player for a long time, using another orbital strike on him. The mysterious player stasises away and Wemmbu meets up to the group of players. The group of players reveal that someone was with the invisble player, that someone was FlameFrags. Wemmbu comes to FlameFrag's base to find two players guarding the entrance. Wemmbu orbitals them instantly killing them and heads into Flame's base. He finds Flame, Lomedy, and the invisible player and knows that they have Egg. Flame tells Wemmbu that he is forced as he is in Cindercrest. Wemmbu asks Flame why he is working with the invisble player. Flame tells Wemmbu that if he cooperates Egg won't die. Wemmbu then unleashes an orbital strike on Flame's base and starts fighting Flame. Wemmbu and Flame continue to fight, with Wemmbu continuing to stab shot Flame. Flame tells Lomedy to kill Egg and Wemmbu rushes after Lomedy trying to stop him. Wemmbu discovers an obsidian box and realizes that the invisible player took Egg. Flame tells Wemmbu that it is Wemmbu's fault, Wemmbu asks Flame why was he working with the invisible guy. Flame tells Wemmbu that he was working with him because he is in Cindercrest. Flame tells Wemmbu that he was asking Egg questions and when he refused to answer any questions, he put him in an obsidian box.

Wemmbu and Flame begin sailing to Linnwyrm's base, and find that Linnwyrm is afk because he is getting doordash. Lynnworm returns and is greeted by Wemmbu and Flame, Wemmbu asks Linnworm if he has see Egg. Linnworm tells Wemmbu that he hasn't see Egg, Wemmbu asks Linn how did he know that he needed the armor that he is wearing. Linn tells Wemmbu that ever since the Law had came out of power that there have been many players stirring in the world. He wanted Wemmbu to be at full strength if anything came up. Wemmbu asks Linnwyrm if he knew about the mysterious trimmed player,Linn tells Wemmbu that he knows the mysterious player. Wemmbu and Flame gives the recap of his story with the mysterious player. Lynn reveals that he knows where the mysterious player's base is and tells Wemmbu that it's time to get looking. Jaden_MAN then appears to help and Linn tells Wemmbu and Flame that they need all the help they can get. Flame and Jaden start arguing with each other, they eventually agree to work with each other. Wemmbu, Flame, and Jaden begin looting up to prepare for the journey to the mysterious player's base. Wemmbu begins disenchanting a bunch of fishing rods and bows to get xp for his armor. Wemmbu asks Flame for totems, hesistant Flame eventually places a shulker box full of totems which Wemmbu quickly snatches. Wemmbu, Jaden, and Flame begin to head out of Linn's base just before Linn gives them a warning about how dangerous the player. They begin to head off when they realize they've never asked the coords to the base. Once they have the coords. they sail to find an enormous island which they presume is the player's base. They approach the island and find Yungyx and Arachn1d with three guards who tell them that they want Egg. They all head up the mysterious player's to see Egg, they find Egg and the mysterious player. 

Egg greets Wemmbu and Wemmbu aks Egg how he got in this situation. The mysterious player tells everyone that he has a proposition, he tells them that who ever pays him the most will be given Egg. Wemmbu asks the player what happened to him, killing Egg of the server. The mysterious player then puts Egg in a remote stasis chamber for his safety. Everyone starts arguing about their riches until Flame tells everyone he is on the behalf of Cindercrest. Wemmbu being surprised asks Flame why. Flame tells everyone that Cindercrest needs Egg's knowledge. Getting impatient, Wemmbu tells everyone that he will kill everyone there, he then unleashes an orbital strike bringing in a huge fight. Everyone starts fighting each other, Jaden and Wemmbu manage to kill two of Arachn1d's guards before unleashing another orbital strike. The huge fight continues wth Wemmbu only focusing Flame. Flame then brings a bunch of armored wolf's to the fight, Wemmbu then starts fighting Yungy. Wemmbu eventually goes back into the fight with everyone. Wemmbu and Yungy fly into a cave and start dueling when the invisible player and and Flame enter as well. Wemmbu and Flame continue to fight for a long time, Wemmbu then goes after Yungy, he then notices an intresting building in the cave. Wemmbu then goes invis to hide from everyone. He goes into the mysterious cave building and finds a maze, Wemmbu begins to go through it until he digs down. He finds nothing and continues to got though the maze almost going into a trap. He finds a dripstone trap and realizes he could use the dripstone. 

He manages to pop the invisible player's totem with the dripstone revealing his name which is Flbthp. He chases after Flbthp and finds Arachn1d, Jaden, and an invis guy (possibly still Flbthp) in a big room. The invis guy tells them to wait for the representative for Cindercrest, Flame and Yungy both arrive and the mysterious player tells everyone he is willing to negotiate. Arachn1d tells the mysterious player that he will give him, the entire treasure of the caverns. The mysterious player accepts his offer and expects the offer to be true. Wemmbu asks Yungy and Arachn1d, why they want Egg so badly, Yungy tells Wemmbu that with Egg, they have him and with him they have a bunch of power which will allow for Arachn1d to be the rightful king. Yungy then tells Wemmbu that with him on their side they will win a lot of battles in the future.  The episode ends off with Yungy giving Wemmbu an ultimatum, join him in the caves or they will kill Egg.

 Trivia 
 There was a moment in this video where Wemmbu was in creative mode.

title: Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing
content:
Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing is the 123rd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
On the Unstable SMP, thousands of players are online concurrently, but a small percent of these players have disappeared within the past month. Most players don't seem to notice the disappearances, as death bans are super common, but Spoke thinks it may be something much more sinister going on. A case of this happening was his best friend Mapicc, who went missing a month ago after spending years on Unstable. Spoke went on a search for him, which turned into a mission that unraveled one of the biggest mysteries on the server. Spoke goes on to recap what happened in the previous episode and the episode begins where it left off.

Spoke picks up the mission: null book and goes through the pages, which have usernames and coordinates linked to that player. He gives it to JumperWho, neither of them know what it means. Jumper goes through the hundred pages to see if she recognizes a name, Spoke sees the bounty hunters coming from a distance and tells Jumper to invis up and run into the house. Both of them hide on top of lanterns just as the hunters barge inside the house and begin destroying it. A nether portal spawns nearby, another leader of the bounty hunters named _x_6_00 comes through and gives the hunters extra resources. The leader builds a grave and goes back through the portal, the hunters then spread out and walk away. Once the coast is clear, Spoke and Jumper jump down from their hiding spot and go over to the grave and break the block underneath the wither rose. A chest appears under and there's a book signed by the leader, Spoke takes the book and reads it. It reads as following:

"I know you stole it.

It doesn't belong to you.

Surrender and return what is ours.

Now, rebuild the portal."

Spoke gets scared at the fact that the leader knew he was going to break the portal, so they run towards a direction he knew the hunters didn't go. He mentions that some of the coordinates were close by and suggests that they should investigate in case this could have any leads on Mapicc's whereabouts. The first set of coordinates leads them to a house built out of cherry blossom wood, Jumper finds a dog left abandoned inside of the house, which confirms their theory that these players have gone missing. They begin heading over to another set of coordinates, they spot a nether portals in their path, signifying that the hunters are traveling through the nether to watch them. Spoke makes an escape tunnel in the nearby area because of this. Once Spoke builds the hole, they walk to the next set of coordinates and spots a player named Cornflakecapt4in living there. Spoke asks Cornflake if they've seen someone named Calvin6 and they say that Calvin was their teammate that went missing after he went out to get an enchantment table. Jumper goes through the book again and sees that Cornflake's name is also in the book at the exact same coordinates of Calvin, Spoke suggests that Cornflake should escape quickly. Cornflakes immediately starts digging into the ground. They see a nether portal spawn on a mountain close by, the hunters start attacking Spoke and Jumper, who barely have any resources to survive. Spoke has no more food or blocks, Jumper tells him that they need to run right then and now to one of their escape tunnels. Spoke doesn't have enough resources to get there, so he gets up on a mountain and gets invisibility from his ender chest. He goes back over to the base and rescues Jumper. 

A chase breaks out, Spoke spots another base in the distance and hides full invis in it. He hides on the outsides of the base and sees a boat placed on the ice. He doesn't know where Jumper is, so he has no way of contacting her and telling her to meet him over at the boat, but Jumper is already in the boat and spins around in it, showing Spoke that she was there first. The leader chases them, who drifts into a tree, giving them a bigger lead. When they get in water, the hunters are already all on boats and continue to chase. The hunters attempt to sink Spoke and Jumper's boat, Spoke tries to shoot and break their boats, but fails to. With no other option, they head back on land and continue heading towards the direction of Spoke's escape tunnel. Spoke towers upwards, but gets knocked off. He sees Jumper as soon as he falls and they start running again, the escape tunnel is right in front of them, Spoke breaks a melon and exposes the hole. He looks down and sees that there's not water down to bedrock and realizes the hunters broke the bedrock and turned it into a void trap. Spoke uses his Elytra and flies down slowly, he asks Jumper to drop rockets for him. The hunters have blocked off the entrance, Jumper makes up a plan real quick, she realizes the people are in the book for a reason and they're all trappers, so the coordinates in the book could have a void trap as well. The first set of coordinates have nothing, so they quickly go over to the next. As they continue to fly, Spoke's Elyta's durability wears down and is close to breaking until they spot something in the void. It's a happy ghast floating in the void with five players stuck on it. Jumper flies up and breaks the obsidian, she places water, but it doesn't flow down as blocks don't go beneath bedrock. Spoke steps up and pearls up, going through the obsidian entirely and breaks it. After Spoke gets up, he gets Jumper to get a saddle so they can all ride the happy ghast upwards, but because there's more than four of them, he asks if any of them were willing to jump and one of them jumps into the void. Spoke gives one of the players a pearl and they pearl up, Jumper then puts the saddle on the happy ghast and flies it upwards so the rest of them can swim up. As soon as they all make it up safely, Jumper gives them signs and asks what happened. One of them writes that they were trapped by someone named MisterMinion, who was the name in the book and were stuck down there for over three months. Spoke and Jumper leave them to be and lets them keep the base and leaves.

Jumper says she was right about NULL targeting bad players. Spoke says what they know about NULL is that they're ruthless and that they kill people, random people, friends, griefers, and it's more about their actions that affects players all around the server. Spoke says they need more help finding out what's going on. Spoke thinks that there's one player that could help them rally up players together, Jumper asks who he has in mind and Spoke says they need to go to spawn to visit the king. They head to the front of the Northern Council, Spoke nicely asks the guards to let them see the king, but they nod their heads no. One of them blows a horn, Spoke thinks they should start going full invis and sneaking in, just as he says that, Jumper sees TheobaldTheBird walking out of the Northern Council to see what they want. Spoke says they need to see the king, Theo doesn't allow to let them through without any reason, Spoke places down his ender chest and says he has goodies, which piques Theo's interest. Theo makes them pay two totems as down payment to walk foot inside the Northern Council and two pieces of netherite when they're at the front of the castle. Spoke says he does have netherite to give Theo and gives him directions to where it is, Theo writes it down in a book and quill, Spoke and Jumper run past him while he's distracted. Theo catches up to them and asks for his tip, Spoke gives him a stack of TNT. The three of them walk up to where Parrot is, Theo tells Parrot that Spoke and Jumper were there to visit and forces them to bow. Parrot stops Theo since they're his friends and asks how they've been. Spoke cuts to the chase, he asks Parrot if he knows anything about NULL. He explains Parrot what NULL has been doing and that players have gone missing inside of the book they got their hands on. Parrot says he has gotten zero reports about any player disappearances and that most of the coordinates inside of the book were inside of his kingdom. Parrot goes on to say this is the first time he's heard of this and he would've known if players were actually going missing. Jumper begins to explain how everybody in the book is theorized to be players who are trappers, griefers, scammers, bad people overall. Parrot says all of the people that have disappeared are bad and NULL is doing more good for his kingdom than bad. He doesn't believe NULL is a real thing, but rather that they're using him to find Mapicc and is willing to give them resources to find him and that NULL isn't a top priority for him. Spoke crashes out and says he's the king and that he should be worried about a mysterious group of players terrorizing his kingdom. In the end, Parrot tells them he doesn't have a lot of resources and gives them as much as he can. 

Spoke, Jumper, and five guards walk down the obsidian highway. Spoke asks Jumper if she has anybody they can ask for help, as Jumper answers, Spoke sees a nether portal on top of a lava cast and senses that something is wrong. The bounty hunters break out of the walls and instantly kill Parrot's guards. Another chase breaks out, Spoke and Jumper desperately try to boat away, but the bounty hunters are constantly on their tail. Spoke tries the tree strat again by hiding in a tree, but the hunters spot him. Spoke then wind charges up a lava cast and towers up, Jumper follows shortly after. Jumper accidentally misclicks and that causes them both to get knocked down. They make it back on ice, Spoke boats away, but gets stuck in a pothole. The hunters catch up, Spoke swims down into the water and digs into a cave and wind charges out, successfully juking out most of the hunters. He reaches the top of the tower again, he pearls away and pretends to get knocked off to distract the hunters. He spots Jumper in the distance and goes full invis in a boat to go save her. Spoke fails to boat away and sees another cave in the distance. He gets Jumper to follow him into the cave, the hunters come following and Spoke hides right below a waterfall and jukes the hunters again. He then uses this opportunity to make an escape tunnel. He climbs out of the tunnel and signals Jumper to pearl to him, they both jump down the tunnel, Spoke drains the water and places a dripstone where the water was, popping four of the hunter's totems and making them teleport. They go into crawl mode and begin to dig away, the hunters catch up, but end up losing their trail.

He mentions how there's so much going on in the server for players to care and that just the two of them aren't enough to stop it all. Spoke says they only have one more option, and that's to use Jumper's spies. Jumper dislikes the idea of using her spies and reminds him of the spies' actual purpose and that if they do go through with this plan, they would essentially be declaring war on NULL. They then decide to go to the last remaining set of coordinates to find any clues on Mapicc. The last house appears to be another regular house, Spoke looks around on the outside and sees there's a part of the house hidden somewhere and stumbles across a hidden passageway inside of the chimney hiding behind a painting. Inside of the secret room is random loot and a book hidden in an item frame named "road to null" signed by anticsparty06, a different player who isn't shown in the mission: null book. Spoke begins reading the book, it reveals that Antics hasn't left their base in weeks because they would find him and this time he doesn't think he would escape. Antics joined Unstable with the intent of building farm with friends and creating a factory to give new players gear in order to survive and wanted to be remembered as a good player. Antics starts to talk about NULL, they came rummaging the base and forced him to march for tens of thousands of blocks to a mountain, where a pearl cannon was built and was said to teleport them to the Road of Null. Antics never got to see where it lead, he attempted to offset the cannon and send his pearl elsewhere. Right before he was killed, his pearl landed in the middle of the Far Lands. He was able to reach the border to find food and resources to build a pearl cannon of his own. He says NULL has been relentlessly hunting and watching him and asks for whoever found the book to come save them and gives them a set of coordinates; 50,000 in each direction. Spoke thinks this may lead to the coordinates of the pearl cannon and this is their only chance of saving the missing players as well as Mapicc. Spoke says they have to go into this world and makes a plan to gather up the spies while NULL is distracted. Spoke goes in one direction and Jumper goes towards another, before they set off, Jumper tells Spoke to give them a choice to come join them.

They get ahold of fourteen more spies and they all fly towards the pearl cannon using happy ghasts. Just as they reach the pearl cannon, another set of happy ghasts come flying from the other side of the mountain. NULL had gotten there at the same time and begin shooting arrows at the spies. Spoke comes up with a plan, goes full invis and jumps down. He walks to the pearl cannon and throws a pearl into it. The leader sees it being activated and blows the cannon up, and the hunters kill off Jumper's spies, causing Spoke and Jumper to retreat. Jumper sounds defeated at the fact that she brought her spies into war when she promised to keep them safe from any kind of conflict. They had lost the last players that could help them and with no pearl cannon to get to where they need to go. They head back to Spoke's hidden base from the previous episode, a lamp goes off signaling that someone is at the entrance and Jumper goes to see who it is. She comes back and tells Spoke someone is at the door and doesn't know who it is. Spoke comes up to the entrance and sees an invisible player with a copper helmet, diamond chestplate, copper leggings, and iron boots. The invisible player drinks milk and it is revealed to be Mapicc.

title: Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist
content:
Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist is the 125th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
As the king of Unstable, Parrot sent a group of players over a hundred thousand blocks out on an expedition. He made it their mission to build a civilization in this unexplored territory and determine if it was safe for the players inside of his kingdom to stay in. He gives them a week's time and promises to return by then to deliver more supplies. When the time comes, he makes the journey back to the civilization, which was given the name Skymore, to see that all thousand players had vanished. Parrot, Theo, and a few guards look around for any signs of life and are skeptical of what happened. Parrot holds an emergency meeting with his guards and instructs them to search around the area, and so they all split off. Parrot and Theo stay together and investigate the civilization itself, as even Parrot has never seen anything like this before, Theo notices that the houses were unfinished and says he doesn't have a good feeling about this. Everything was still intact, it wasn't looted or griefed, it all happened all at once. After thirty minutes of searching, Parrot finds a sign inside of a house that tells a player named Reina that they had to run and to follow the farmland. They go down to the farmland, and Parrot notices that there's a pattern in the farmland and builds up, revealing a message written in morse code using dirt. Parrot deciphers it and it reads out, "I RAN EAST, -ZOE". This gives them a clue of where to go next and figure out what actually happened. As Parrot was about to blow his horn to signal all his guards to return, Cachetale goes up to him and says he heard the horn, but Parrot says he hadn't. Parrot blows the actual horn this time and runs around the civilization, but only five out of the twenty guards returned. Parrot and his squad gets on their horses and heads east to see where the rest of the squad went, they overhear the same horn being blown and decide to keep going near it. Parrot discovers a secret stairway beneath a layer of dirt and wants to go deeper in, but the rest of his squad is too afraid to follow along. Parrot takes Theo along and tells whoever was down there to come out, but once they reached the bottom, all they found were  chests full of his squad's loot, implying that they died. Once they came back up, they see that even the ones who stayed above went missing as well.

Theo gets frustrated that Parrot keeps blowing the horn and revealing their locations, but Parrot says they have a clue to keep going and needs to figure out if these people are even alive still. They keep heading eastwards, but the more they headed east, the lesser the territory has been explored and won't know what to expect heading forward. They spot a town up ahead and go talk to the players inside of it, but none of them talk to them or really acknowledge them. Parrot goes around the town and finds a wall full of usernames, he spots the name zoe444 on the wall and thinks it could be the same person they're looking for. A person named capybaradunk comes from behind and asks if they know someone named Zoe and Parrot explains that they've been looking for someone named Zoe, capybara brings them into a house to talk. Theo asks what the signs are about, capybara goes on to explain how the town was created by new players who just logged on and and twenty people went out to go get food, but never returned. Parrot says the same thing happened to his civilization and that Zoe may have showed up at this town, capybara says Zoe was here and asked weird questions and acted strange before heading off. Parrot keeps asking if she left any clues behind, capybara says she did leave a message specifically for Reina only, Parrot kept asking for the message, so capybara gives it to him. Parrot reads the book and it ends up being another cipher. Parrot says they'll begin heading off, capybara is afraid they'd go missing too and begs for them to stay. Parrot and Theo still decide to go to figure out what's going on. Parrot knows that this part of the world was strange and that somebody or a group of players were up to this and were smarter and stronger than the average player and even Zoe knew that, hence why she left clues rather than being blunt. 

Parrot tells Theo that he tried to decipher it with no clues, however, this was a lie to mislead anybody that may be listening onto them and reveals that the actual clue wasn't the jumbled letters at the bottom of the book, but rather the first letters of each word which spelt out "Find the white flowers". Parrot and Theo ride their horses more east and follows the white flowers as said. After another 2,500 blocks they stumble across a camp of some sort. As they get closer, it seems to be deserted. On the tents they see a banner pattern that they've never seen before, one that resembles some kind of flame. Parrot overhears somebody digging dirt beneath them, Theo thinks Parrot is joking, but Parrot insists he heard it and decides to go back to their horses. Unfortunately for them, when they returned to where they parked their horses, they were stolen or vanished. Parrot finds it odd that if these players wanted to kill them, why go for their horses? Parrot writes inside of a book for Theo, he tells Theo that whoever these players are wants to think they ran out of resources and asks Theo to pretend to be out of food. Parrot believes that this would be enough to reveal whoever's been following them. In the desert, they find a ruin out in the middle of nowhere. It left no clues, so they move along. As they keep walking, they spot a random bed with a chest and a furnace, inside of the chest lies a book and quill. Parrot opens it and finds that it's another message written by Zoe, this time being a caesar cipher that tells Reina to head south from here. This message felt off to Parrot since this message was more simpler than before and that Zoe would've put a white flower inside of the chest to show that it was actually her that wrote it. Parrot decides to set up a farm and leave some items in the chest as bait for whoever's been following them. He pretends to explore around the desert to give the players enough time to hijack their items. As they come back, they see that their crops have been taken and most items in the chest. However, the book that Zoe had supposedly written was still there and they would've had every reason to take it, this reveals that this book was in fact fake. 

Parrot and Theo keep pushing east, following the white flowers that were placed every now and then. Parrot and Theo walk further into the forest, which brought them closer to where Zoe is. Eventually, they actually do run low on food and resort to towering up using the spruce saplings. Shortly after, they hear the horn being blown again. Parrot's plan was to wait for them to attack and fight back in order to detain and question the players. Worst case scenario, they would run away knowing who was after them. The people keep blowing the horn instead of attacking until it stops. A chest opens beneath them, Parrot breaks blocks and opens up the chest, which has two maps inside of it. Both of them take one each and see two icons forward and behind them, Parrot goes to chase the one upwards while Theo goes to the one behind. Before Parrot could continue chasing, he realizes something and goes back to Theo and tells him to stop. He explains to Theo that everything they've gone through, the players following them stopped whenever they heard Theo. They took everything from them, their teammates, their food, their horses, but never laid their fingers on Parrot or Theo. The map was their way of trying to separate the two and was afraid of Theo. Parrot has a plan and writes it in a book and gives it to Theo. Theo says this plan is stupid and doesn't want to follow Parrot around anymore and he decides to head back. 

Parrot follows the flowers and sees that it starts to become more common to see them as the horns follow him around. Eventually, he sees a house that's surrounded by white flowers for hundreds of blocks all around it and goes to investigate. He finds a book written by Zoe, it explains that something existed out there and anyone who left the civilization would never return, the survivors decided to call this entity "the monster". After two days, they were attacked by this so-called monster, which turned out to be a kingdom of players far stronger than they were. The survivors ended up relocating to this other kingdom named Cindercrest, which was a kingdom full of old players. Few of the survivors died from starvation, natural causes, or in attempts of escaping, which left only Zoe and her friend Reina. One day, Reina asked Zoe a question about the world being infinite and that made Zoe realize there was something wrong about the world, but didn't know what exactly. Zoe and Reina eavesdrop on two of the players conversation about taking back spawn. One of the players, saparata, hears Zoe talking and that leads to Zoe running away before they executed them. Zoe ran back to Skymore since that was the only place she knew on the server and started to leave clues for Reina to find her. At the end of the book, Zoe says if Reina is the one that is reading it, she had mostly unfortunately starved to death and to answer the question she was asking herself.

As soon as Parrot finishes reading the book, the horn is blown and ShoeBilly stands at the front of the house. Parrot says that ShoeBilly has been the one terrorizing all these players and is going to declare war on his kingdom, Billy says to not blame him and he's only working for the highest bidder. Parrot gets angry that Billy took the lives of a thousand player, robbing them of a chance of playing on the server again. He asks Billy if he felt any remorse for killing any of them, Billy says not at all and that the only the strong are meant to survive and the only way to survive is to be a little bit selfish. Billy gets ready to kill Parrot and asks for his last words, Parrot yells for Theo to strike and he sets off a bunch of TNT minecarts that kill off the members of Cindercrest standing behind. A flashback plays to when Parrot wrote the plan in the book, he had Theo fake a reaction of an outrageous plan and to tail behind using the map. Theo holds Billy back as Parrot runs back to Skymore. Parrot stands up top on a castle at Skymore, Theo arrives looking roughed up and in full diamond armor rather than his usual netherite. Right before they head back, they see somebody running into the civilization. They go up to the player and see that it's Reina, she asks Parrot if he knows where Zoe is and Parrot gives her the book Zoe wrote. Parrot apologizes and says how he wanted to build this civilization to protect everyone. He looks at Theo and says they need to put an end to Cindercrest before they try to take back spawn. Theo says it's not possible and that he's even afraid of Billy, Parrot says he trusts Theo's judgement for saving his life countless amounts of times and decides not to jump right into a war. Parrot says they need to warn the rest of the server about Cindercrest a war actually breaks out. Reina steps up and says if Cindercrest never existed, she wouldn't have died and wants to help them fight. Parrot allows her to join them and the three of them head back to spawn.

 Trivia 

 This episode referenced Wifies' popular "Searching for a World that doesn't exist" ARG video multiple times with the title, the thumbnail, and Parrot claiming himself The King in Yellow in the video as well. The mysterious civilization that follows them behave like The King.

'''Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist''' is the 125th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Plot ==
As the king of Unstable, [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] sent a group of players over a hundred thousand blocks out on an expedition. He made it their mission to build a civilization in this unexplored territory and determine if it was safe for the players inside of his kingdom to stay in. He gives them a week's time and promises to return by then to deliver more supplies. When the time comes, he makes the journey back to the civilization, which was given the name Skymore, to see that all thousand players had vanished. Parrot, [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]], and a few guards look around for any signs of life and are skeptical of what happened. Parrot holds an emergency meeting with his guards and instructs them to search around the area, and so they all split off. Parrot and Theo stay together and investigate the civilization itself, as even Parrot has never seen anything like this before, Theo notices that the houses were unfinished and says he doesn't have a good feeling about this. Everything was still intact, it wasn't looted or griefed, it all happened all at once. After thirty minutes of searching, Parrot finds a sign inside of a house that tells a player named [[ReinaDrop|Reina]] that they had to run and to follow the farmland. They go down to the farmland, and Parrot notices that there's a pattern in the farmland and builds up, revealing a message written in morse code using dirt. Parrot deciphers it and it reads out, "''I RAN EAST, -[[Zoe444|ZOE]]''". This gives them a clue of where to go next and figure out what actually happened. As Parrot was about to blow his horn to signal all his guards to return, [[Cachetale]] goes up to him and says he heard the horn, but Parrot says he hadn't. Parrot blows the actual horn this time and runs around the civilization, but only five out of the twenty guards returned. Parrot and his squad gets on their horses and heads east to see where the rest of the squad went, they overhear the same horn being blown and decide to keep going near it. Parrot discovers a secret stairway beneath a layer of dirt and wants to go deeper in, but the rest of his squad is too afraid to follow along. Parrot takes Theo along and tells whoever was down there to come out, but once they reached the bottom, all they found were  chests full of his squad's loot, implying that they died. Once they came back up, they see that even the ones who stayed above went missing as well.

Theo gets frustrated that Parrot keeps blowing the horn and revealing their locations, but Parrot says they have a clue to keep going and needs to figure out if these people are even alive still. They keep heading eastwards, but the more they headed east, the lesser the territory has been explored and won't know what to expect heading forward. They spot a town up ahead and go talk to the players inside of it, but none of them talk to them or really acknowledge them. Parrot goes around the town and finds a wall full of usernames, he spots the name zoe444 on the wall and thinks it could be the same person they're looking for. A person named capybaradunk comes from behind and asks if they know someone named Zoe and Parrot explains that they've been looking for someone named Zoe, capybara brings them into a house to talk. Theo asks what the signs are about, capybara goes on to explain how the town was created by new players who just logged on and and twenty people went out to go get food, but never returned. Parrot says the same thing happened to his civilization and that Zoe may have showed up at this town, capybara says Zoe was here and asked weird questions and acted strange before heading off. Parrot keeps asking if she left any clues behind, capybara says she did leave a message specifically for Reina only, Parrot kept asking for the message, so capybara gives it to him. Parrot reads the book and it ends up being another cipher. Parrot says they'll begin heading off, [[Capybaradunk|capybara]] is afraid they'd go missing too and begs for them to stay. Parrot and Theo still decide to go to figure out what's going on. Parrot knows that this part of the world was strange and that somebody or a group of players were up to this and were smarter and stronger than the average player and even Zoe knew that, hence why she left clues rather than being blunt. 

Parrot tells Theo that he tried to decipher it with no clues, however, this was a lie to mislead anybody that may be listening onto them and reveals that the actual clue wasn't the jumbled letters at the bottom of the book, but rather the first letters of each word which spelt out "''Find the white flowers''". Parrot and Theo ride their horses more east and follows the white flowers as said. After another 2,500 blocks they stumble across a camp of some sort. As they get closer, it seems to be deserted. On the tents they see a banner pattern that they've never seen before, one that resembles some kind of flame. Parrot overhears somebody digging dirt beneath them, Theo thinks Parrot is joking, but Parrot insists he heard it and decides to go back to their horses. Unfortunately for them, when they returned to where they parked their horses, they were stolen or vanished. Parrot finds it odd that if these players wanted to kill them, why go for their horses? Parrot writes inside of a book for Theo, he tells Theo that whoever these players are wants to think they ran out of resources and asks Theo to pretend to be out of food. Parrot believes that this would be enough to reveal whoever's been following them. In the desert, they find a ruin out in the middle of nowhere. It left no clues, so they move along. As they keep walking, they spot a random bed with a chest and a furnace, inside of the chest lies a book and quill. Parrot opens it and finds that it's another message written by Zoe, this time being a caesar cipher that tells Reina to head south from here. This message felt off to Parrot since this message was more simpler than before and that Zoe would've put a white flower inside of the chest to show that it was actually her that wrote it. Parrot decides to set up a farm and leave some items in the chest as bait for whoever's been following them. He pretends to explore around the desert to give the players enough time to hijack their items. As they come back, they see that their crops have been taken and most items in the chest. However, the book that Zoe had supposedly written was still there and they would've had every reason to take it, this reveals that this book was in fact fake. 

Parrot and Theo keep pushing east, following the white flowers that were placed every now and then. Parrot and Theo walk further into the forest, which brought them closer to where Zoe is. Eventually, they actually do run low on food and resort to towering up using the spruce saplings. Shortly after, they hear the horn being blown again. Parrot's plan was to wait for them to attack and fight back in order to detain and question the players. Worst case scenario, they would run away knowing who was after them. The people keep blowing the horn instead of attacking until it stops. A chest opens beneath them, Parrot breaks blocks and opens up the chest, which has two maps inside of it. Both of them take one each and see two icons forward and behind them, Parrot goes to chase the one upwards while Theo goes to the one behind. Before Parrot could continue chasing, he realizes something and goes back to Theo and tells him to stop. He explains to Theo that everything they've gone through, the players following them stopped whenever they heard Theo. They took everything from them, their teammates, their food, their horses, but never laid their fingers on Parrot or Theo. The map was their way of trying to separate the two and was afraid of Theo. Parrot has a plan and writes it in a book and gives it to Theo. Theo says this plan is stupid and doesn't want to follow Parrot around anymore and he decides to head back. 

Parrot follows the flowers and sees that it starts to become more common to see them as the horns follow him around. Eventually, he sees a house that's surrounded by white flowers for hundreds of blocks all around it and goes to investigate. He finds a book written by Zoe, it explains that something existed out there and anyone who left the civilization would never return, the survivors decided to call this entity "the monster". After two days, they were attacked by this so-called monster, which turned out to be a kingdom of players far stronger than they were. The survivors ended up relocating to this other kingdom named Cindercrest, which was a kingdom full of old players. Few of the survivors died from starvation, natural causes, or in attempts of escaping, which left only Zoe and her friend Reina. One day, Reina asked Zoe a question about the world being infinite and that made Zoe realize there was something wrong about the world, but didn't know what exactly. Zoe and Reina eavesdrop on two of the players conversation about taking back spawn. One of the players, [[saparata]], hears Zoe talking and that leads to Zoe running away before they executed them. Zoe ran back to Skymore since that was the only place she knew on the server and started to leave clues for Reina to find her. At the end of the book, Zoe says if Reina is the one that is reading it, she had mostly unfortunately starved to death and to answer the question she was asking herself.

As soon as Parrot finishes reading the book, the horn is blown and [[ShoeBilly]] stands at the front of the house. Parrot says that ShoeBilly has been the one terrorizing all these players and is going to declare war on his kingdom, Billy says to not blame him and he's only working for the highest bidder. Parrot gets angry that Billy took the lives of a thousand player, robbing them of a chance of playing on the server again. He asks Billy if he felt any remorse for killing any of them, Billy says not at all and that the only the strong are meant to survive and the only way to survive is to be a little bit selfish. Billy gets ready to kill Parrot and asks for his last words, Parrot yells for Theo to strike and he sets off a bunch of TNT minecarts that kill off the members of Cindercrest standing behind. A flashback plays to when Parrot wrote the plan in the book, he had Theo fake a reaction of an outrageous plan and to tail behind using the map. Theo holds Billy back as Parrot runs back to Skymore. Parrot stands up top on a castle at Skymore, Theo arrives looking roughed up and in full diamond armor rather than his usual netherite. Right before they head back, they see somebody running into the civilization. They go up to the player and see that it's Reina, she asks Parrot if he knows where Zoe is and Parrot gives her the book Zoe wrote. Parrot apologizes and says how he wanted to build this civilization to protect everyone. He looks at Theo and says they need to put an end to Cindercrest before they try to take back spawn. Theo says it's not possible and that he's even afraid of Billy, Parrot says he trusts Theo's judgement for saving his life countless amounts of times and decides not to jump right into a war. Parrot says they need to warn the rest of the server about Cindercrest a war actually breaks out. Reina steps up and says if Cindercrest never existed, she wouldn't have died and wants to help them fight. Parrot allows her to join them and the three of them head back to spawn.

'''Season 2''' of ''[[Unstable Universe]]'' started on 2 February 2025 with [[I Created Minecraft's Most Secure Base]] and ended 16 February 2026 with [[2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master]].  A new protagonist, [[FlameFrags]], was introduced in this season. 

'''NOTE''': Seasons have been abolished, meaning that episodes no longer operate into seasons past [[Season 1]]. More information can be found [https://unstable-universe-mc.fandom.com/f/p/4400000000000137302 here]. That being said, the downfall of [[the LAW]] was widely deemed as the finale of [[Season 2]] by viewers. To see later episodes, refer to [[Season 3]] or [[Unstable Universe|all episodes]].

title: Serpentbound333
content:
Serpentbound333 is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe, and is one of the First Generation Players introduced in Season 2. He is the current leader of a golden kingdom thus known as Serpentbound's Kingdom.

 Personality 

He is a player shown to have immense authority, even amongst the other First Generation Players. Unlike Nitenly who's first decision is always to fight, he usually comes up with a plan before attacking. Serpentbound333 is also shown to be a player who doesn't fight much, usually boring the person away, or making a plan to trap said person.

He seems to be leading the First Generation Players, which his leadership was probably gained when Lakerek left. He is close with the First Generation Players, especially with Nitenly as shown in I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void, even treating him as some sort of right hand man.

 History 
In one of the Echoes in the Far Lands, specifically the Ocean Monument one, Serpentbound is seen to be swimming around with Lakerek, Nitenly, Firestar2008, and GeeGeeGamer.

While Wemmbu was fighting Nitenly in his kingdom, Serpentbound, as well as the other First Generation Players shows up, as he calms Nitenly down, breaking up the fight. After that, he offers to show Wemmbu and Eggchan around his kingdom.

Wemmbu asks him what and where is The Forge, in which he replied he didn't know, and Wemmbu threatened to kill him and the others.

He lied to Wemmbu and Eggchan about what The Forge is and that he'll take them to it while Wemmbu was getting Orbital Strike Cannon shots, he distracted them, before GeeGeeGamer shot an arrow supposed to hit Wemmbu, but Eggchan blocked it, resulting to Eggchan getting stuck in The End instead of Wemmbu.

Serpentbound and the other First Generation Players were then forced to fight Wemmbu, in which they lost, resulting to Firestar2008 and Nitenly falling into the void and stasised away, and GeeGeeGamer died. He eventually convinced Wemmbu to not kill him, helping him have access to the orbitals in exchange for leaving them alone, before bringing him back to the kingdom and hitting him into the end portal to go back to Spawn.

 Quotes 

 Trivia 

 In I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void, he confirms to know where and what The Forge is and that The Forge is not the large amounts of orbitals in the Far Lands, yet refuses to tell Wemmbu where it is or what it even is.
 He is implied to have history or interactions with JamatoP, even being in good terms.
 He wears diamond armor with netherite trims despite having a lot of netherite armor in stock.

title: ShoeBilly
content:
ShoeBilly_ is an major antagonist in Unstable Universe Season 3. He is a bounty hunter in I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization. Billy is hired to kill TheobaldTheBird and ParrotX2, but fails to do so. Billy is formally Theo's master/teacher, but even after training with Theo for months, Shoe is many times more advanced, especially at elytra-macing. 

 Personality 
ShoeBilly_ has been shown to be sadistic and spiteful to the server's new players, placing him firmly on the side of the old ones. Billy craves power and has no qualms about killing people to increase his own personal strength and influence. The danger Billy poses is further tempered by his confidence and PVP ability.

 History 
Shoebilly joins Capital City police and attacks Parrot and TheoBaldTheBird. After a confrontation with Theo he retreats but also tells him that Parrot is using him and tries to convince him that the server is falling apart because of the new players. He later destroys a building with hundreds of new players inside. He plans a massacre in Captial City but the plot is foiled and he retreats to CinderCrest

CinderCrest hires him to destroy King Parrot's experimental civilization of Skymore. The civilization is easily overrun and without any mercy Shoebilly enacts yet another massacre this time killing almost 1000 players (The massacre is of the same level as the one Wemmbu and Flamefrags did in the 2v1000 but since the servers population has increased so much it does not affect the server in the same way) He then hunts down Parrot and attempts to separate him from Theo. (He probably does not want to fight Theo because of their past affiliation and how strong Theo is at PVP) Parrot finally confronts him after reading Zoe's story and asks him if he feels any remorse. [[ShoeBilly_]] is an major antagonist in ''[[Unstable Universe]]'' [[Season 3]]. He is a bounty hunter in [[I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization]]. Billy is hired to kill [[TheobaldTheBird]] and [[ParrotX2]], but fails to do so. Billy is formally Theo's master/teacher, but even after training with Theo for months, Shoe is many times more advanced, especially at elytra-[[Maces|macing]]. 

== Personality ==
ShoeBilly_ has been shown to be sadistic and spiteful to the server's new players, placing him firmly on the side of the old ones. Billy craves power and has no qualms about killing people to increase his own personal strength and influence. The danger Billy poses is further tempered by his confidence and PVP ability.

== History ==
Shoebilly joins [[Capital City Police Force|Capital City police]] and attacks [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and [[TheobaldTheBird|TheoBaldTheBird]]. After a confrontation with Theo he retreats but also tells him that Parrot is using him and tries to convince him that the server is falling apart because of the new players. He later destroys a building with hundreds of new players inside. He plans a massacre in Captial City but the plot is foiled and he retreats to [[Cindercrest|CinderCrest]]

[[Cindercrest|CinderCrest]] hires him to destroy King Parrot's experimental civilization of [[Skymore Civilization|Skymore.]] The civilization is easily overrun and without any mercy Shoebilly enacts yet another massacre this time killing almost 1000 players (The massacre is of the same level as the one Wemmbu and Flamefrags did in the [[2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players|2v1000]] but since the servers population has increased so much it does not affect the server in the same way) He then hunts down Parrot and attempts to separate him from Theo. (He probably does not want to fight Theo because of their past affiliation and how strong Theo is at PVP) Parrot finally confronts him after reading Zoe's story and asks him if he feels any remorse. Shoebilly says he feels none at all and tells Parrot that only the strong are meant to survive which reminds Parrot of old memories with [[Ashswagg]] but is forced into a confrontation with Theo. After a very hard fought battle Shoebilly is forced to retreat but he appears to have broken all of [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo's]] netherite armour.

title: Skill vs Power Arc
content:
*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes* FlameFrags gets recruited by his friend Lomedy to help deal with Spongs and Willsion, who've been harassing him and destroying his farm, but without any violence. After Spongs and Willie show up, Flame builds traps that nearly kill them. Flame sneaks onto their farm and steals their prized sniffer egg, so in retaliation they blow up most of Lomedy's farm. Flame helps Lomedy rebuild, and then they go and blow up the entirety of Spongs' and Willie's. Flame lets them live, though.

Flame gets tasked by an invis player to perform a number of tasks. He receives small rewards from each one, with the last task being to kill a group of bandits that actually put up a fight. The invis player is revealed as SpokeIsHere, and he gives Flame a book with coords to an old Mafia stash. Flame goes there and finds a few shulkers of items before being attacked by Wemmbu. Wemmbu calls down orbital cannon strikes on Flame, popping over a dozen of his totems, destroying his restock shulkers, and breaking his eye trim chestplate. In the end, Flame is forced to flee, having lost his title as the strongest player.

Flame returns to his old base, but finds it occupied by bandits. He kills some people for gear, then gets Lomedy to build him a new base, and then visits the Nether, which is ruled by ClownPierce. Some of his minions attack, but Flame escapes them. Finally ready for a rematch, he heads to Capital City 2.0 to get info on Wemmbu, only to be told Wemmbu is dead.

When pressed, that person tells Flame he got the info from Luke4472. Flame finds Luke's base destroyed by the same bandits he fought for Spoke, and goes to their base, but finds no one. He finds some explorers and forces them to tell him where the other bandit bases are, and successfully finds and frees Luke. Luke tells him he heard it from MinuteTech, so they go to the End. Flame fights Minute for the information, and Minute finally surrenders, only to once again tell Flame that Wemmbu is dead. Flame returns to his base, out of leads, only for Boosfer to show up with information on Wemmbu.

Boosfer makes Flame go get ender pearls from Capital City, and then protect him from an attack led by an invis player. Boosfer sends Flame to steal ParrotX2's helmet, since his broke, but Boosfer calls it invalid due to the bad enchantments. Flame finally decides to kill him if he doesn't give up the info, but then the invis player shows up again wit about twenty people. Flame kills most of them despite struggling, but the invis player convinces him that Boosfer doesn't actually have the information, and they should just kill him. Boosfer escapes, but not before telling Flame that ClownPierce is the one who killed Wemmbu.

Flame enters the Nether and finds Parrot and TheobaldTheBird, who convince him they should team up, since both need access to Clown's castle. Flame and Theo sneak inside and fight FerreMC, Clown's second-in-command, and kidnap him. Parrot, however, lets him go as part of his plan to find Clown's secret vault, which Flame doesn't care about. He overhears Parrot and Theo planning to betray him and goes to Clown, offering to bring him to Parrot if he talks about Wemmbu. Clown agrees, but fails to hold up his end of the bargain, so Flame kills every single one of his guards, then leaves. With all of his leads at an end, he visits Parrot in Capital City and hires him to find Wemmbu.

LettuceK shows up to Flame's base and invites him to Law City, offering him the chance to either surrender or be captured in three days. Flame recruits Lomedy to help him prepare, and they sneak into Law City, learning that a shipment of gear is arriving soon. Flame kills the people bringing it, angering Lomedy, who is only partially satisfied by Flame's explanations. Flame decides to attack Law City early, but Lettuce brings about fifty people to fight him. After a very long battle, Flame kills almost all the people and leaves.

Parrot orchestrates a trap for Wemmbu, which works perfectly, revealing his identity. He and Flame start to fight, but The Law show up, necessitating an escape. Flame and Wemmbu alternate between fighting each other and the Law before finally running far away, all the way to Flame's base to regear, planning to kill the Law and then each other. The Law shows up and Flame and Wemmbu kill all fifty or so people there, forcing Lettuce to flee. They follow him back to his city, but he reveals that even if they kill him, the Law won't stop. Wemmbu offers a fight between the two of them and every single Law member, to which Lettuce agrees.

Lettuce brings a thousand people, and Flame and Wemmbu fight them all. Constantly struggling, Flame is convinced by Wemmbu to pick up a mace someone dropped, which he does, increasing his effectiveness. They eventually manage to kill every single player. Flame burns the mace and attacks Wemmbu, and they fight for a while before Wemmbu gives up the title of the strongest player, no longer caring. They depart on relatively good terms.

title: Sky
content:
Sky was a ghast owned by ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird.  

 History 
Sky was rehydrated by Parrot to rescue JumperWho and Derapchu from a trap set up by the Director. After they saved the players, BAT took him into a "safe space" (unknown location) and was not seen for a while. He was returned in The Unstable SMP Experience, when Leow0ok, the leader of BAT, decided that Parrot should keep the ghast, as it was his in the first place. After a fight with Boosfer, Parrot and his friend TheobaldTheBird escaped by using the ghast.

Parrot used the ghast to store valuable treasure form different vaults on his missions to get resources for new players on the SMP. Primarily using chest minecarts.

But tragically, Sky was maced by Wemmbu in I Got Impersonated on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP to prevent Parrot and TheobaldTheBird from escaping while they were impersonating him.

title: Skyblock Civilization
content:
Skyblock Civilization was a civilization created by Yeah_Jaron, before being conquered by The Invisible Mafia. 

 History 
Wemmbu sees a couple of players flying up. He decides to follow them and find the Skyblock Civilization. He finds a player named Pangi who brings him to Yeah_Jaron, their leader. He says that he has to be a citizen or die. Wemmbu tries to escape, but is caught by Straight. Wemmbu is forced to do tasks.

Wemmbu and Straight fight in a sumo duel which decides if Wemmbu is let free or not. Wemmbu loses the sumo fight. Wemmbu does more tasks for the civilization. Wemmbu spies on the members talking about himself in the castle. 

When asked how Wemmbu found the civilization, he says that he just saw people flying up. They go down to see what Wemmbu was talking about. Once down, the Mafia finds and begins attacking them. They are able to kill two of the members, but the third member escapes. They go back to skyblock civilization, and Wemmbu smuggles in an ender chest.

While helping Pangi with building a drowned farm, Wemmbu messages loppezz to come over and distract him. While distracted, Wemmbu and Wato1876 go to the storage and see they have materials not normally possible to obtain in normal Minecraft skyblock. Wemmbu convinces some of the members to distract Pangi and says it’s his birthday. Straight finds Wemmbu at the back of Yeah_Jaron's castle. Wemmbu says he was building an extra part to the castle. He goes into the castle. He spies on Yeah_Jaron and Straight having a conversation.

Wemmbu talks to Straight about how there are tons of items not normally obtainable in skyblock that they have.

The civilization uses an ender pearl to go down to the normal world. They go over to The End Civilization which has been raided by the Mafia. Wemmbu and the members of the Skyblock Civilization pretend to be one of the Mafia members. Their invisibility runs out and they start getting killed. The Mafia members escape.

They go over to Capital City and find more Mafia members, and another fight breaks out. They are able to escape from them.

Yeah_Jaron tells Wemmbu that there is a traitor. Jaron gives him a mace. Wemmbu exposes Yeah_Jaron for having items you are not normally able to get in skyblock, and says he is just trying to control the players. Wemmbu leaves the meeting. He sees that Straight has been with the Mafia the entire time. The Mafia takes over the civilization.

 Trivia 

 According to Yeah_Jaron, the Skyblock Civilization was one year old.

*[[DumbIsDumb]]}}'''Skyblock Civilization''' was a civilization created by [[Yeah_Jaron]], before being conquered by [[The Invisible Mafia]]. 

== History ==
[[Wemmbu]] sees a couple of players flying up. He decides to follow them and find the Skyblock Civilization. He finds a player named [[Pangi]] who brings him to Yeah_Jaron, their leader. He says that he has to be a citizen or die. Wemmbu tries to escape, but is caught by [[Straight]]. Wemmbu is forced to do tasks.

Wemmbu and Straight fight in a sumo duel which decides if Wemmbu is let free or not. Wemmbu loses the sumo fight. Wemmbu does more tasks for the civilization. Wemmbu spies on the members talking about himself in the castle. 

When asked how Wemmbu found the civilization, he says that he just saw people flying up. They go down to see what Wemmbu was talking about. Once down, the Mafia finds and begins attacking them. They are able to kill two of the members, but the third member escapes. They go back to skyblock civilization, and Wemmbu smuggles in an ender chest.

While helping Pangi with building a drowned farm, Wemmbu messages [[loppezz]] to come over and distract him. While distracted, Wemmbu and [[Wato1876]] go to the storage and see they have materials not normally possible to obtain in normal Minecraft skyblock. Wemmbu convinces some of the members to distract Pangi and says it’s his birthday. Straight finds Wemmbu at the back of Yeah_Jaron's castle. Wemmbu says he was building an extra part to the castle. He goes into the castle. He spies on Yeah_Jaron and Straight having a conversation.

Wemmbu talks to Straight about how there are tons of items not normally obtainable in skyblock that they have.

The civilization uses an ender pearl to go down to the normal world. They go over to [[The End Civilization]] which has been raided by the Mafia. Wemmbu and the members of the Skyblock Civilization pretend to be one of the Mafia members. Their invisibility runs out and they start getting killed. The Mafia members escape.

They go over to [[Capital City]] and find more Mafia members, and another fight breaks out. They are able to escape from them.

Yeah_Jaron tells Wemmbu that there is a traitor. Jaron gives him a mace. Wemmbu exposes Yeah_Jaron for having items you are not normally able to get in skyblock, and says he is just trying to control the players. Wemmbu leaves the meeting. He sees that Straight has been with the Mafia the entire time. The Mafia takes over the civilization.

== Trivia ==

* According to Yeah_Jaron, the Skyblock Civilization was one year old.

title: Skymore Civilization
content:
The Skymore Civilization was a failed civilization created somewhat far out from spawn by Parrot, the king of the Unstable SMP. It was probably meant to solve the overpopulation crisis at Spawn, the Northern Council, and Capital City. 

 History 
The civilization was meant as a safe haven for the new players who have been getting attacked by older ones. ParrotX2 brings 1000 players there, promising to return in a week with supplies while they set up the civilization. However, when he returns, the civilization is abandoned. there is no clear cause as to why it is abandoned, but there is a sign from a player named Zoe to her friend, Reina. Later, we find out that this is a player named zoe444 who escaped from the Cindercrest nation, leaving clues for her friend ReinaDrop to find. 999 of the original players have been killed by ShoeBilly and Cindercrest including Zoe, with the sole survivor being ReinaDrop. When the Cindercrest nation attacked Skymore, 990 players were killed with 10 being taken hostage. Soon, 8 more died, leaving only Zoe, who escaped after being scared by Saparata but died of starvation, and Reina, who is now traveling with ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird to defeat the Cindercrest nation.

Later we find that ShoeBilly, a renowned assassin, slowly killed all 1000 players when they went on expeditions for food. The only survivors of Skymore were Zoe and Reina who were forced to grow wheat for Cindercrest.

 History

title: Spawn
content:
Spawn is the server spawn of Unstable SMP. It is a key central hub where players begin their journeys and interact with the server's evolving dynamics. Known for its semi-neutral status, Spawn has become a focal point of activity and strategy. Spawn's history is divided into 5 moments currently, each being more or less deadly than the other.
+Spawn History TableTime/ArcDanger levelAboutSeason 1Moderate.The OG spawn of the sever, it was mostly clean, with very little griefing or danger. The server had a small population back then.The Invisible Mafia ArcSafe The Mafia made an obsidian cage camping spawn to force new players into joining their evil empire. Refusing equaled death so no one dared refuse. People who joined the server were given jobs by The Mafia. Some never even got to see the surface of the server. Because of The Mafia's control there was no griefing.Season 2DeadlyWithers everywhere, extreme terrain. All of the obsidian used by The Mafia was turned into roads for players.The Election ArcDeadlyEven more withers present, slightly better terrain. Law men were ordered to kill new players at spawn. The Kingdoms ArcSafeAs Parrot finishes up the newest spawn at the time, for his first king action, all dangers gone, a new castle city covers the spawn area. Food and instructions on how to survive well is given as well. During this time, the amount of people joining accelerated by multiple times. 

 History 
SpokeIsHere and ParrotX2 both build houses in spawn.

The Zam Empire starts taking over the spawn area by building a small village and building a giant statue of PrinceZam. Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the statue of PrinceZam.

Spawn is torn down by The Invisible Mafia to create a giant prison to force new players to join the Mafia. The prison is designed by _Kenadian_. Parrot, Wemmbu, eggchan, Mapicc, and Spoke break into the prison to find where pearls are transported to destroy the Mafia.

Spawn is griefed by the players, leaving behind massive lavacasts, exploded terrain, and withers. There are obsidian highways leading players out of spawn, one leading to Capital City.

The withers in spawn were killed by ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird. Soon later rebuilt by Horace_Altman and his team to help make spawn a safer place for new players by making a main castle where they would spawn in, including a village in the surrounding area. With a path leading to Capital City. As well as a player who would handout 16 pieces of cooked chicken to new players whenever they would go downstairs from the initial spawn room.

title: Spears
content:
thumb|Netherite Spear
The spear is a weapon that deals more damage the faster you move relative to your enemies. When they were first introduced to the Unstable Universe, they were extremely over-powered due to the fact that players were using modified spears that would deal significantly higher damage than the normal version. However, after the events of I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master, modified spears ceased to exist.

They are frequently used by players to travel and paired alongside the mace for spear-mace combat, a form of combat that utilizes the spear's Lunge enchantment to move across short distances in a sort of "dash."

However, after the events of [[I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master]], modified spears ceased to exist.

They are frequently used by players to travel and paired alongside the [[Maces|mace]] for spear-mace combat, a form of combat that utilizes the spear's ''Lunge'' enchantment to move across short distances in a sort of "dash."
