title: SpokeIsHere
content:
SpokeIsHere, or simply Spoke, is one of the four main protagonists of Unstable Universe alongside ParrotX2, Wemmbu, and FlameFrags. 

 Personality 
Spoke has a very chaotic and manipulative personality. He is shown to ignore the needs or feeling of other in exchange for what he wants, deeming that everything he does is justified and must be accomplished. His egotistical nature is best reflected when he chooses to make an excuse of, underplay or deny his wrongdoings instead of admitting them, often lying even to his best friend about his actions. An example of this is when he killed all the witnesses, made an enormous lie and went all out to hunt down Leow0ok just to cover his accidental burning down of a single village. 

He is a good speaker and leader, being the only leader of an empire that did not promise anything to its member, as well as the one who gathered and lead the protagonists to defeat the LAW. Despite this, he is continuously avoided by other players due to his reputation as an untrustworthy and dangerous individual as well as his enigma-like nature. 

Spoke, when idle, is mischievous and like to prank others, including tricking Parrot & Wifies to find secret and stealing items from Reddoons. He is frivolous even when people surrounding him are deadly serious. An example of this is when he claimed to be the Director, playfully said "boom boom boom", and pulled off TNT cart trap whilst being hunted by B. A. T. in their void base. He enjoys laughing over silly things like the moonwalking spy. He genuinely cares about his friends, in particular Mapicc and doesn't often hold grudges for very long.  

Spoke is reckless and self-endangering, like when he often builds a Nether portal for escaping despite knowing that the dimension was completely under the control of ClownPierce. Despite this, he is quite intelligent and is shown have an extensive mental library of traps and escape methods. He has slowly started descending to madness like Ashswagg predicted. 

He lost his chestplate Alt, Mapicc, JumperWho, all of his items, and his name as the player impossible to catch due to his obsessiveness with killing Jamato and revealing his identity. It is unclear whether he will redeem himself or go down a dark path. 

 Relationships 

 Mapicc 
Spoke and Mapicc has been best friends since How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items. Mapicc is as mischievous as Spoke but he is against Spoke's chaotic, manipulative and egocentric behavior. Despite their differences, they are extremely close. Mapicc is immensely loyal to Spoke, assisting Spoke in his plans even if he doesn't approve. Mapicc also acts as Spoke's emotional anchor, with Spoke panicking every time Mapicc is in danger. Even going as far as to almost blow-up Capital City when he thought Mapicc died. 

Mapicc went missing again in 4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players, and Spoke dedicated his time to finding Mapicc. Mapicc reappeared in Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing, and in the next video explains that he was captured by NULL.  

At the end of Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players Mapicc cut all ties with Spoke after learning of everything his friend lied about. He broke Alt but spared Spoke which caused both to be taken to the nether by Null Hunters and JamatoP.

 JumperWho 
In season 1, Jumper worked for Spoke in It's Impossible to Catch This Player supposably for duped items. She later is temporarily chunk banned.

In season 2, Jumper worked with Leo to hunt down Spoke and expose his crimes. Jumper betrayed Leo when he began abusing her spies and instead proposed a team up with Spoke. Spoke initially refuses to do this, but later teams with her and they take down B.A.T. and LAW. She believes that Spoke did not commit his former crimes and works in coordination with him to kill Leo. 

In season 3, Jumper protects Spoke from the bounty hunters that are pursuing him and works on helping Spoke figure out what happened to Mapicc. She is hired by Spoke and becomes a close ally as she saves Spoke multiple times and helps him overcome the bounty hunters. She is eventually captured by the hunters and it's currently unknown if she knows what Spoke has done or is simply imprisoned.   

 Wemmbu 
Spoke and Wemmbu are enemies throughout the beginning of season 1 where they continuously attempt to kill each other until Spoke is temporarily chunk banned.

Spoke repairs relations with Wemmbu in The Invisible Mafia Arc and later works with him to destroy the Mafia.

Spoke lures Wemmbu and FlameFrags into a Mafia stash and since they're enemies they start fighting. Spoke orchastrated this and takes some items from Flame as proof of his demise.

Spoke broke Wemmbu out of prison and in return Wemmbu owed him a favor. Spoke cashed in the favor to assassinate Leo but they fail. Spoke demands another favor.

Spoke later gathers an army which includes Wemmbu to take down the Law. This succeeds.

 FlameFrags 
Spoke and Flame were enemies since The PrinceZam Empire Arc as he attempts to destroy the empire Flame was a part of. Flame then joins the Mafia which Spoke successfully destroys.

Spoke later leads an army to try and kill Flame which fails.

Spoke disguises himself as an invisible player and gives Flame quests in return for goods to trick Flame into doing his bidding. Spoke eventually lures Wemmbu and Flame into a Mafia stash to start a battle between the two enemies. Spoke fakes the death of Flame when neither die and steals some of his stuff to convince Leo of this.

Spoke later gathers an army that includes Flame to take down the Law. This succeeds.

 ParrotX2 
They had a bad relationship in the Princezam Empire Arc, after Spoke made a very long scavenger hunt for some "secret". Which ended up with Wifies getting chunk-banned just for Parrot to know the "secret". Spoke reveals that there was no secret, just revenge, and says he's an idoit. 

Later on, they work together to take down Mafia which mends their relationship. 

Soon, Spoke tricks Parrot and the rest of BAT that the Director was hiding in their base, and once his identity was revealed, Spoke and Parrots relationship became bad. Not until Spoke was confronted at the top of Capital City threatening to blow it up after thinking that he has lost Mapicc does him and Parrot get back on good terms, later on working together to defeat The LAW and now consider each other friends.

 LettuceK 
Spoke barely knew LettuceK existed before The LAW take over however when LettuceK surrenders he views him with contempt and is more than ready to kill him with FlameFrags. This shows that Spoke would not be the one to give mercy to his opponents even though he did not fight LettuceK directly like the others and instead fought Leow0ok.

 Ashswagg 
Early in the series, Ashswagg manipulated Spoke into destroying several farms and resources. This act was designed to turn the server against Spoke and distance him from his ally, Mapicc. Ash also attempted to pressure Spoke into revealing server exploits. During Season 1, Spoke infiltrated into Ashswagg's Invisible Mafia. His code name was Fish Bucket. Ashswagg said that Spoke (Fish Bucket) is like him which is something Spoke had trouble disagreeing with.

Spoke later spares Ash's life after destroying The Mafia and cornering him. Ashswagg says that Spoke will turn out to be just like him and make a Mafia of his own. Spoke ignores this. 

In season 2, Spoke raids Ashswagg and TheRealSquiddo's base, Point Nemo.

 Leow0ok 
During Season 1, Leo and Spoke were allies especially when Spoke infiltrated the Invisible Mafia. Spoke saw Leow0ok as an ally but sometimes there was tension between the two of them.

In Season 2, Spoke originally viewed Leow0ok as a normal player and an ally of sorts, but when word came out about Spoke's crimes he instantly turned against Leow0ok and hated him more than any other player on the entire server. To the extent of not being content with simply just killing him, he also wanted to humiliate Leo for attempting to kill him for his crimes. 

Spoke got ahold Leow0ok's ender pearl and could have used it to kill him at any time but chose to make it so the last person Leo every would see would be him by making a stasis to trigger both of them at the same time. His last act of revenge against Leow0ok was to look at him one more time as Leow0ok fell into the void.

 PrinceZam 
During Season 1, Zam's main goal was to capture Spoke. They held a grudge against each other until Spoke freed Zam from the Law prison in Season 2.

Spoke used Zam and held him close for his future plans and they both held neutral relationship, bounded by obligation.

 PlanetLord 
He raided Planet's dupe stash, but they became good friends. Spoke hunted PlanetLord when he infiltrated the Mafia but let him go. PlanetLord vanished after the invis mafia. They reunited in the Far Lands. PlanetLord was then captured by Null Hunters.

 JamatoP 
JamatoP was Spoke's first friend on the sever but left when he believed Spoke was going too far with the exploits and was trying to "play god". During the time he was gone, he was keeping an eye on Spoke and watching his every move. Eventually, he created NULL in an attempt to neutralize Spoke who he deemed as the biggest threat to the server's stability and peace. 

 Boundaries 

 No shipping
 No heavy gore
 No NSFW

 Quotes 

 Trivia 

 Spoke's real-life family has been featured on Unstable Universe in many instances.
 In I Got Hunted by the Minecraft Mafia, his younger brother BobDaGreenFrog was briefly featured.
 In I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia, iMajesticRose and BeckyTronVIII, his sister and younger brother respectively were featured.
 In The End of the Minecraft Mafia, his father Quackenstein123 was featured.
 In Trapping Secret Bases on a Hardcore SMP... and I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Stalkers..., BeckyTronVIII, and Quackenstein123, are featured again.
 Spoke is one of the only holders of orbital strike cannons, the others being Wemmbu and people in the Farlands.
 Wemmbu still owes Spoke a favor.
 Spoke’s first ever face reveal was a joke on a Mapicc livestream.
 All poppies in Spoke's pov are replaced with rose (texture pack) except in replay mod view. This might be a reference to IMajesticRose. Roses, or poppies, are therefore associated with death on Unstable SMP.
 Spoke has the least amount of videos posted on Unstable Universe with only 25 videos.
 Spoke's Unstable SMP Playlist is missing the finale of The BAT Arc/The Kings Arc video which is 4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players.

In Season 2, Spoke originally viewed Leow0ok as a normal player and an ally of sorts, but when word came out about Spoke's crimes he instantly turned against Leow0ok and hated him more than any other player on the entire server. To the extent of not being content with simply just killing him, he also wanted to humiliate Leo for attempting to kill him for his crimes. 

Spoke got ahold Leow0ok's ender pearl and could have used it to kill him at any time but chose to make it so the last person Leo every would see would be him by making a stasis to trigger both of them at the same time. His last act of revenge against Leow0ok was to look at him one more time as Leow0ok fell into the void.

=== PrinceZam ===
During Season 1, Zam's main goal was to capture Spoke. They held a grudge against each other until Spoke freed Zam from the Law prison in Season 2.

Spoke used Zam and held him close for his future plans and they both held neutral relationship, bounded by obligation.

=== PlanetLord ===
He raided Planet's dupe stash, but they became good friends. Spoke hunted PlanetLord when he infiltrated the Mafia but let him go. PlanetLord vanished after the invis mafia. They reunited in the [[Far Lands]]. PlanetLord was then captured by [[Null Hunters]].

=== JamatoP ===
JamatoP was Spoke's first friend on the sever but left when he believed Spoke was going too far with the exploits and was trying to "play god". During the time he was gone, he was keeping an eye on Spoke and watching his every move. Eventually, he created [[Null Hunters|NULL]] in an attempt to neutralize Spoke who he deemed as the biggest threat to the server's stability and peace.

* No heavy gore

If you wish to save your home, I have only one demand; prove to me that my best friend, Mapicc, isn't dead. Show me that's he's been at least captured or if he was somewhat alive. Because otherwise, I'll leave this server into RUINS.|[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]|to the residents of [[Capital City]] in [[My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP]]}}{{Quote|“If you have an Elytra in you hotbar right now why didn’t you follow him!”|[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]|to [[JumperWho]] in [[Minecraft Trapper VS 1000 Players]]}}{{Quote|Of course [[Null Hunters|Null]] wasn't the one going to kill me. Of course [[JamatoP|Jamato]] wasn't the one going to kill me. He wanted you to do it. You're going to be the one—you're the one who's going to ban me.|[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]|to [[Mapicc]] in [[Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players]]}}

== Trivia ==

* Spoke's real-life family has been featured on [[Unstable Universe]] in many instances.
** In [[I Got Hunted by the Minecraft Mafia]], his younger brother [[BobDaGreenFrog]] was briefly featured.
** In [[I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia]], [[iMajesticRose]] and [[BeckyTronVIII]], his sister and younger brother respectively were featured.

** In [[Trapping Secret Bases on a Hardcore SMP...]] and [[I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Stalkers...]], [[BeckyTronVIII]], and [[Quackenstein123]], are featured again.
* Spoke is one of the only holders of [[Orbital Strike Cannon|orbital strike cannons]], the others being [[Wemmbu]] and people in the Farlands.
* [[Wemmbu]] still owes Spoke a favor.
* Spoke’s first ever face reveal was a joke on a Mapicc livestream.
* All poppies in Spoke's pov are replaced with rose (texture pack) except in replay mod view. This might be a reference to [[IMajesticRose]]. Roses, or poppies, are therefore associated with death on Unstable SMP.
* Spoke has the least amount of videos posted on [[Unstable Universe]] with only 25 videos.
* Spoke's Unstable SMP Playlist is missing the finale of [[The BAT Arc]]/[[The Kings Arc]] video which is [[4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players]].

title: SpokeIsHere/History
content:
History 
 Season 1 
 The Exploit Arc 
Spoke shows JamatoP that he got a full set of diamond armor with every protection enchantment, which is not normally possible except for in older versions of Minecraft. Jamato shows him his base, where he has also obtained glitched features. Jamato lets him take a full set of netherite armor with every protection enchantment. Wemmbu spies on Spoke and sees him take the netherite armor. Spoke goes to the end dimension and sees Wemmbu who asks him about the armor that Spoke has. Spoke lies and says that he got it himself.

Spoke and Jamato duplicate items using a glitch with shulker boxes and anvils. Using these items, they pay TheRealSquiddo to have her create The Wonders. Spoke secretly uses these to store glitched items. He hires some people to guard the wonders, including JumperWho, Roshambogames, Fantst, Derapchu, and Wemmbu.

Spoke goes to the end dimension to try and duplicate mobs using a glitch. Wemmbu sees him there, and Spoke is confused about why he is not guarding his wonder. They start fighting and Spoke escapes by flying to the outer end islands. Spoke decides he should destroy the end portals. Jamato says that Spoke just wants to play god, and that he doesn't want to be part of this anymore. Spoke tries to convince Jamato to change his mind by trying to give him a command block, bedrock, etc.

Wemmbu discovers what were inside the wonders. He tries to kill Spoke but he escapes. Spoke uses an orbital cannon to destroy the wonders. Wemmbu finds what appears to be a vault where Spoke's orbital cannon was at. Once Wemmbu is inside, Spoke traps him in a room full of chest mine carts and a warden. Wemmbu escapes and tries to kill Spoke, but he escapes using a fishing rod stasis chamber.

Spoke finds a stash of duped items, and tries to break in to find the duped items. He destroys all the duped items, however he ends up getting trapped in an obsidian box underneath the stash with Roshambogames, surrounded by end crystals and TNT minecarts. Spoke explodes them, uses his totem of undying, and escapes.

Spoke helps Mapicc steal from the Zam Empire. They go to TheRealSquiddo's base to destroy duped items that she has, and accidentally burn down her castle in the process. Spoke then find a bunch of duped emeralds in Jepexx's trading hall and hide the villager trading hall.

Spoke sets an orbital cannon to destroy another dupe stash, but once there discover it's Jepexx's base. They accidentally destroy his base. They leave.

Spoke goes to the "final vault". Once there, he realizes there is no vault. Roshambo traps him in the end. Spoke escapes to the outer islands. He comes back to the main island with invisibility potions, and follows them to their end base. Once there, he realizes that the end base has no duped items in it. Spoke and Mapicc go back to the first dupe stash they found, and discover duped items behind the obsidian walls.

Spoke had his supporters attack the Zam Empire. Only TeamKalal died as they all used stasis chambers to escape.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu interrogate TheRealSquiddo and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn't give information on Spoke. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates.

Spoke sets up a scavenger hunt for a "secret" for ParrotX2 and Wifies. It later turns out that this is just a plan to get revenge on Parrot by chunk banning his friend. Wemmbu and PrinceZam find Spoke and try to kill him, but Spoke chunk bans himself before they do, in the same chunk ban that Wifies is in.

Parrot assembles a team which breaks out all of Spoke's henchmen. They eventually break Wifies and Spoke out by chunk banning the guards at the prison.

 The Mafia Arc 
Spoke and Mapicc find a stash of what they think are duped items. They find the chests are empty. A player named PlanetLord comes in and they try to kill him as he places shulker boxes which appear to be duped because they have identical items in all of them. PlanetLord is able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc go to a raid farm and see three invisible players. Ashswagg comes over and tells the invisible player to leave, and they oblige. Ashswagg says he doesn't know the players. Spoke and Mapicc go to TheRealSquiddo's house to see if there are any duped items there. Under the floor, they find a bunch of books with coordinates to farms. Ashswagg finds Spoke and Mapicc and says that he wants to team with them.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the farms and rig them to not produce items. While Jepexx is showing Spoke and Mapicc his panda farm, a group of invisible players come and start attacking them. Spoke and Mapicc yell for ashswagg to stop, and all the invisible players run away. Ashswagg says that he was just trying to help them.

Spoke and Mapicc see that ashswagg completely destroyed the coordinates of farms that they gave to him. Later, they see ManePear in a piglin farm, who appears to be AFK. He comes back and starts killing Spoke and Mapicc. They escape by breaking the bedrock on the nether roof and flying away.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the next farm and find two invisible players destroying it with TNT. He pops one of their totems and it reveals they are USmellLikeUpdog. Ash teleports USmellLikeUpdog into the void, banning him because he stated ashswagg was the leader. Mapicc leaves because he doesn’t trust ashswagg. He meets ashswagg at the next farm.

Spoke gives ashswagg the rest of the coordinates to the farms. Ashswagg completely destroys all of the farms. Spoke and Mapicc go to their end base and see that Wemmbu and eggchan are destroying it. This is because they were paid by Roshambo to destroy the end base.

They go over to the last farm, which is an EOL farm. Ashswagg says that he framed them into looking like they destroyed all of the farms. The invisible players are part of a group called The Invisible Mafia. The mafia members try to kill Spoke and Mapicc, but they escape using the nether. A player named Minutetech spots them in the nether and helps them. MinuteTech reveals he was once part of the mafia.

Spoke and Mapicc follow him back to his base. They show MinuteTech their base at spawn. They get attacked underground by the mafia. MinuteTech kills one of the mafia members using a mace. They manage to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord at Jepexx’s old villager trading hall. Then, the mafia members attempt to kill them. They trap the mafia players using a sand trap, though none of them die, and they are able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc try to prove to ManePear that there are invisible players attacking them, but ManePear decides to try and kill Spoke and Mapicc. They are able to escape, then the mafia starts attacking them. They run away shortly after. 

The mafia attacks Spoke and Mapicc. Spoke is able to escape, but Mapicc did not.

PlanetLord introduces Baconnwaffles0 and TheRealSquiddo to MinuteTech. A mafia member named BobDaGreenFrog tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills Bob, and the mafia starts trying to kill them. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, and MinuteTech replies "no". The mafia continues attacking them. Spoke is able to escape, though he almost dies.

TheRealSquiddo shows the team some coordinates that she was given that could be the coordinates to a mafia outpost. She also states that everybody in the master builders group has disappeared.

The team goes over to the outpost and find a lot of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after he was given a book.

PlanetLord and Spoke discover that Jamato’s base is destroyed. Spoke and PlanetLord try to dupe in the base, but realize that it doesn’t work anymore. Ashswagg comes in and reveals that all the glitches and exploits were patched, and that Jamato told him so. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech was working for him, and then orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. They are able to escape again.

Spoke and PlanetLord go under one of the wonders where they put weaponless mobs. They find that the mobs are named coordinates. They find a replica of Jamato’s base made out of wood, and all of the glitched features have been removed. They find a book stating that if they are reading the book, Jamato is either captured or dead. It states he has exiled himself, that he has been hunted by the mafia, that he was captured in an outpost, and that an item can fix everything. They find a compass that is named “The Mafia”.

Following the compass, they find a mafia outpost. They find some mafia members in a room. They go above the players and drop dripstone on them, killing one of the players and using the totem of undying of another player named Leow0ok. The outpost starts exploding. Spoke teams up with Leo, and they follow a member of the mafia to the mafia city, where there are different tiers of mafia members. They find Mapicc in a prison and break him out.

Spoke is tasked to kill Parrot but doesn’t want to, so he deliberately fails. Ashswagg kills one of the members who was helping them. They run away. They are then tasked with guarding a vault. ManePear and Wemmbu start trying to break into the vault and succeed.

The team is now tasked to get diamonds. Ashswagg promotes them to copper tier. They are tasked with killing Baconnwaffles for a mission. Baconnwaffles says they are betraying the mafia, so they destroy his base. They go over to Reddoons at Capital City and trade.

The team is given the task of getting an elytra. Spoke asks Wemmbu if he can give him any elytra. They are able to find nine elytra in the Zam empire. Wemmbu finds a mafia member and starts killing them, but realizes it's eggchan.

They are promoted to iron after giving ashswagg the elytra. They are then tasked with building redstone machines. They sabotage the other opponents and win.

They are tasked with killing PlanetLord, but don't kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the members until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Spoke is tasked with killing iMajesticRose. He obliges and kills her with dripstone. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. He fights a diamond player to become diamond. (The diamond player reveals that he is minutetech after spokes totem pop) Spoke’s totem pops, revealing his identity. Spoke and minute try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. 

Spoke goes over to the square civilization to warn Cash that the mafia is going to break into their civilization and destroy it. Cash doesn’t listen and everyone in the civilization dies. Spoke warns the sleepy nation that the mafia is going to try to kill them. The sleepy nation takes back their items that were stolen by the mafia. The leaders of sleepy nation join the mafia and try to kill Spoke and his teammates.

Spoke and Mapicc go over to TheRealSquiddo to try and find the coordinates of "The Withered". The mafia destroys her castle. Spoke and Mapicc go to spawn where they see Parrot and Wifies. They agree to team to try and end the mafia. They show Parrot and Wifies the area where Spoke killed iMajesticRose. They find a diamond tier mafia player and follow him. They find a village where there is a player in iron armor named Quackenstein123 who claims to be the father of iMajesticRose.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the end to get obsidian. They see the mafia who tries to kill them. They are able to escape.

They go back to Quackenstein's base and find a secret staircase under it. They find a stash of loot including diamond trimmed armor and a mace, proving that Quackenstein is the diamond tier player. Quackenstein gives them a book leading to the coordinates of where the stasis chambers are stored.

Spoke and Mapicc show Parrot the book. Parrot invites them to District 13, the last resistance against the mafia.

Spoke and Mapicc check the coordinates and find a chest containing a book called "THE GATEWAY", which appears to contain directions to something. They show the members of District 13 the book. The members are disappointed so Spoke and Mapicc leave.

Spoke, Parrot, and Mapicc break into a spawn prison. This is where the mafia gets new members. Their plan is to follow wherever pearls are thrown all the way to the main stasis chamber area. They find an area where guards transport the pearls. They find a pearl cannon and use it to get teleported millions of blocks out, where they find a man-made mountain. Inside of the mountain is where every stasis chamber is stored.

Spoke tells Parrot about the stasis chambers. Spoke and Mapicc go to the void and start destroying every stasis chamber. The diamond tier players try to kill Spoke in the void, but using chorus fruit, Spoke is able to escape. The mafia ends.

Spoke finds ashswagg’s stasis chamber and activates it. He spares ashswagg.

 Season 2 
Spoke sees Ashswagg enter a secret base. Spoke decides to spy on him inside of the base. Inside of the secret base, he finds a second secret tunnel. Following the tunnel, he finds a new room. He sees TheRealSquiddo smelt something and a tunnel opens up. Spoke makes a secret base inside of the base.

Spoke hears ashswagg talking about having a dragon egg. Spoke accidentally sets an alarm, but TheRealSquiddo says it was probably just a fish. Spoke eventually finds a stash of items. Spoke finds a new room with a villager, which is very rare on the server. Spoke accidentally kills the villager. Reddoons pays ashswagg hundreds of mending books for the villager, only to discover that the villager is gone. Spoke raids the entire base.

Spoke finds the void room, containing a large amount of unrenewable items. Ashswagg catches him. Ashswagg tells Spoke that he traded the dragon egg to Reddoons.

Spoke sees Reddoons enter a secret base and follows him. Spoke sees Yeah_Jaron in the base. Spoke finds a vault of mobs, and accidentally kills a snowy fox, but replaces the fox with a new one from PlanetLord. Spoke sees Mapicc and PlanetLord in the base as they followed Spoke. They discover a villager in the base. Spoke and the team destroy the entire base and steal all the items. Spoke tries to steal the dragon egg from Reddoons but fails.

Spoke spies on Yeah_Jaron and sees him enter a secret base. Inside of the base, he sees another player, Reddoons.

Spoke rigs multiple farms to secretly only give items to Spoke. Spoke sees buzzman02 and flintandsteell attacking Yeah_Jaron. He protects Yeah_Jaron from them as he doesn’t want him dying for now. Spoke hires them to intercept a trade that Yeah_Jaron has. Spoke rigs their stasis chambers to trap them, and tries to force them to give items. They say no so Spoke kills them.

Spoke intercepts a trade between Yeah_Jaron and FartSteve08 while invisible. Spoke sets up fake coordinates for Reddoons to trade at to scam him, and hires Jepexx to do the fake trade. Reddoons leaves as Jepexx is AFK.

Spoke sees a raid get activated in the base, which is not normally possible due to almost all villagers being dead.

While Spoke is trying to steal a villager, Spoke sees the base getting raided. He kills the bandits using a TNT minecart trap and destroys the entire base.

Spoke and a team of players try multiple times to kill FlameFrags but fail.

Spoke sees members from Bounty Assassin Team enter a secret void base. Spoke secretly enters and spies on them. The team eventually sees Spoke holding a carrot and running around the base, and try to kill him. The base is put on lockdown, stopping him from escaping. They are eventually able to trap him in an interrogation room. Spoke pretends to be The Director. They try to kill Spoke but he's able to escape.

Spoke creates an empire with 1000 players and forms the Spoke Galactic Empire. Spoke attacks Baconnwaffles, Hannahxxrose and unintentionally, MinuteTech. 

The Spoke Galactic Empire betray Spoke, and try to kill him. Spoke and Mapicc escape. A player, named The Executive, talks to Spoke. The players reach Spoke and Mapicc's platform and they escape using a nether portal. They meet The Executive again who attempts to give Spoke a book but it burns in lava.

Spoke and Mapicc make a fortress in the nether. The players find them and to enter the fortress. Spoke and Mapicc eventually escape on a happy ghast. 

Spoke and Mapicc find a base in a jungle biome. They steal from the base and get caught by Leowook. Spoke discusses with Leowook about helping them fight against the players. The Executive appears once again trying to convince Leo not to team with them. The Executive leaves and a bunch of players attack them and rob Leowook's base. Leowook invites Spoke and Mapicc to his team. 

Spoke, while invisible and using signs, tells FlameFrags to complete tasks for him. Spoke says he will give him items in return. After giving items which Flame believed to not be very good, Flame gets frustrated at Spoke. Spoke reveals himself to FlameFrags. Flame tries to kill Spoke but he escapes. Spoke eventually tells Flame to go to an old Mafia stash, where Wemmbu is. Spoke secretly spectates the fight between Wemmbu and FlameFrags, while also helping Flame. 

Spoke and Mapicc discover an exploit/glitch that allows them to go fully invisible, even when wearing their armor, as long as they don't take damage. They use this exploit to prank many players and civilizations. 

Spoke joins Bounty Assassin Team, and goes on a mission to discover a player stealing poison potions. The player doesn't listen to Spoke's threats, and Spoke burns down his whole village. Scared that Leow0ok would be mad at him for burning down a village, Spoke becomes determined to eliminate all the witnesses of the fire. Spoke hunts down all the witnesses, heading to small civilizations in the Amplified Region and killing their players with traps to avoid showing his name in the death message. 

Leow0ok confronts Spoke many times about the crimes committed in the Amplified, but Spoke claims that he's innocent. 

Spoke is being watched by invisible spies, causing Spoke to kill them. Leow0ok confronts Spoke about this. It is revealed that Spoke's been giving the items and armor from the players he has killed to Quackenstein123 and his family. 

Spoke is stalked by JumperWho's spies, and he leads them into a base with traps. One of the spies drops a BAT archives book with Spoke's name in the title. JumperWho finds Spoke in his base with more spies, and realizes Spoke has the book and demands that he give it back. Spoke is able to escape, after killing multiple spies.

While Spoke is building a tower with Quackenstein and his family, Leow0ok is watching. Leow0ok threatens to kill the family, causing Spoke to evacuate the family to their old base, giving them all the armor of the dead spies. Spoke lets himself be caught by BAT, and gives all of his items away.

Leow0ok takes Spoke to see Lettuce's speech. Spoke is able to escape during the speech. Spoke begins stalking Leow0ok, planning on how to kill him. Spoke helps Wemmbu, Fantst, PrinceZam, and Baablu escape. Wemmbu helps Spoke with trying to kill Leow0ok. They are unable to kill Leow0ok, and Leow0ok discovers that Spoke tried to kill Leow0ok.

Mapicc sets up a stasis chamber, so he can be saved if he is in danger. Spoke sends Mapicc to get items from an old mafia base. After an hour, Spoke pulls the stasis. Mapicc is quickly teleported away afterwards, due to throwing an ender pearl right before the stasis was pearled. Spoke goes to the location that Mapicc was. He finds items on the ground and cobwebs on the ground, indicating that a fight had taken place recently. Spoke goes to PrinceZam's base, looking for Mapicc. He is ambushed by BAT spies. Spoke is able to kill almost all of the spies, and escapes.

PrinceZam tells Spoke that he doesn't know where Mapicc is. Spoke heads back to his secret base, where he sees an invisible player, who he assumes is Mapicc because they have Mapicc's shield. The invisible player then drinks milk, revealing that they are actually Leow0ok. Leow0ok tells Spoke that he killed Mapicc. Spoke is able to escape from Leow0ok. 

Spoke threatens to blow up Capital City, unless proof of Mapicc being alive is given. Parrot is able to convince Spoke not to blow up Capital City. Spoke and PrinceZam are able to find an ender pearl cannon, which ends them millions of blocks out to a lighthouse. They eventually find a house next to the farlands, with two players, who turn out to be Mapicc and JamatoP. Spoke attempts to secretly kill Jamato but he is able to escape. Spoke tells Mapicc and Zam that Leow0ok killed him. 

Despite previous encounters, JumperWho gains Spoke's trust by saving him and his allies from the Law attacks multiple times, and they unite for the goal of killing Leow0ok. Spoke, Mapicc and PrinceZam head to the law prison in the mountains in order to free her spies. After Spoke is overpowered by the Law forces, Jumper and MinuteTech save them. Spoke apologizes to Minute for raiding the end dimension. 

Mapicc and MinuteTech head to the end dimension in order to recover some items from stashes. Spoke, Jumper and PrinceZam head to the main Law prison, intending to find Parrot. After long search, they don't find any of his traces, but they notice the highly guarded area. They believe, Parrot is imprisoned there. After destroying multiple layers of obsidian, they find, that the imprisoned one was Jaden_Man. 

During that operation, they notice Wemmbu and FlameFrags, who have also been raiding this area. After escaping the prison area they head to the Amplified. One of the Jumper's spies get the info about the huge army of the Law soldiers, who are heading to some unknown location. Spoke reaches there first using the ender pearl cannon he made. 

Spoke notices Parrot and Theo, who are trying to defend themselves on the happy ghast high above. He sets up some traps and kills multiple Law members. Soon, other protagonists arrive. Together, they loot the base and get all the resources needed to equip Parrot's army. After thay, they arrive to the renovated District 13 and prepare for the final fight. 

During the fight, Spoke mostly kills players with TNT, and at some point Mapicc goes missing. At the end of the fight, Spoke hoped that LettuceK would be executed, but the vote decides otherwise. Jumper tells Spoke, that their spies have found Leow0ok, who is weakened and had some armour broken. They quickly arrive to that location start fighting. After Leo is trapped in webs, he uses the stasis chamber, not knowing that it was previously discovered and rigged by Spoke using exploit. Leo dies after being dropped into the void. Spoke looks down and disappears through a Nether portal.

 Season 3 
 The NULL Arc 
After the battle with the Law. Spoke returns to his base, alone. He doesn't do anything untill he's jumped by a group of hunters, hunters with skins that look like void and unintelligible names. With traps set up early, he pulls one of them just for none of the hunters to fall in which surprises him. While trying to escape the players, he's able to pull another trap which all the hunters fall into. JumperWho arrives with the two investigating the pitfall trap only to not find any remains, no items or signs of escape. They talk for a moment, Spoke explaining the idea behind the trap untill they tower out.  They are out of the trap and with JumperWho saying that she has seen them before, except that she has no information about the hunters. Not knowing their reasoning, ideas and whereabouts. She hands Spoke a piece of paper with some cords, explaining that nobody else is allowed to have it continueing with saying that there will be a safe house of some sort but Spoke hands it back. 

When dropping the paper back, he says that he doesn't want to go to any safe house aslong as Jumper and her Spies don't get any work done. JumperWho questions what Spoke is talking about to which he replies with saying that Jumper has something else to worry about, a mission of some sorts. Spoke continues, saying that assignment is the whole reason they're still working together, he asks about updates which Jumper seeminly doesn't have.  Spoke starts to get a little upset, saying that it has been 4 weeks since they saw him. JumperWho sputters that her and her team is obviously trying with Spoke dismissing her, he says that he wants to actually have information about him the next time they meet. 

Spoke leaves the base. Walking through the wild to find bases with only the items in his inventory to aid. He does emphasize that he regrets being so mean to Jumper. He starts to explain, saying that it had been 4 weeks since they saw his best friend; Mapicc. After the battle with Law, nobody had seen Mapicc. Nobody saw where he went, nobody knows where he is. After days of searching, Spoke hired JumperWho to help find Mapicc. But Spoke says something, he says that the hunters carried a specific shield. The exact same design as the shield Mapicc gave Spoke before the battle, he wonders what that could mean. What if Mapicc was leading the group, what if he was responsible for the attack. 

With bases not having any good loot and Spoke still on edge, he finds a base hidden inside a wall. He goes inside to find chest full of dirt and cobblestone. After concluding that the base is useless the supposed owner of the base appears. Without a mic, the players is unable to stop Spoke and is swiftly killed which causes a death message. Spoke realizes that the death message could reveal his location to the hunters. He quickly starts to set up a TNT cart trap, hoping its enough to kill them.  

The hunters arrive with Spoke setting off the trap. But the trap didn't do anything, the players are unharmed, only having a few totems popped. Spoke runs down the mineshaft, exclaiming that the players literally just vanished. Using a water cave to escape, he's able to reach land but still has the hunters after him. With a iron helmet and not even full netherite, he has no chance to win a 1 against 10. With the netherite chestplate he got from Jamato, he's unable to use windcharges due to the chestplate having blast protection so he resorts to switching it to a diamond.  

Being able to shake off some hunters at platform, he continues to run. Realizing that the hunters have speed potions, he starts to use terrain to outrun them. He runs into the water and is attacked by fireworks from the hunters, he returns to land only to go back to the water and start to dig a 1x1 tunnel. The hunters follow him in and he returns to the surface. He continues to run, starting to get distressed saying that he needs to have speed to win but he's able to calm himself down. He returns to the water and jukes them again. Then Spoke decides to use an enderpearl, it'll give him a good lead on them and he sees a house in the distance. Contemplating his choices, he decides to go to the safe house. He goes into the house in the distance and gears up, splashing invisibility and picking up some fire resistance. The hunters arrive and kill the player who lived in the house. Spoke runs down the stairwell into a room and blocks it up, hoping that the hunters won't suspect it. He's successfully able to do so but is quickly caught by the hunters again.  

He runs out of the house and uses blue ice to run faster. He decides to go to the safe house but is still being followed by the hunters. He unequips all his armor and hides using invisiblity. He stays hidden with the hunters killing another player. He aims to go to the safe house. He climbs up the mountain only for his invisibility to run out, he quickly wears his armor and continues to scale the mountain, terrified that the hunters may have seen him. He starts to use leaves to pillar up but notices a hunter, he's able to escape using his elytra.   

Spoke steps away to go to the bathroom and the hunters pass him, he returns and notices the players. They run past him and leave him. Spoke finds the supposed safe house, only to be spotted by the hunters once again. When entering the safe house, a group of invisible spies come out of the flooring and attack the hunters. JumperWho arrives and orders Spoke to follow him, Spoke complies and they head towards THE safe house. A leader of the hunters follow them with Spoke and JumperWho deciding to run away.    

After a while, Spoke jumps down a 1x1 made by JumperWho and they are able to leave the hunter stranded. When going through the tunnels, Spoke expresses regret for immediately going to the bunker and apologizes to JumperWho, who happily takes the apology.    

Entering THE safe house, Spoke starts to get upset saying that he doesn't want to stay inside a safe house. JumperWho retaliates with that it's for Spoke safety, Spoke doesn't listen. He knows that Jumper doesn't know how to defeat the hunters and he explains that the hunters disappear every time their totem is popped. Spoke and Jumper continue to argue until Jumper agrees to let Spoke out. Being victorious, Spoke orders for the elevator to come down and JumperWho says that it isn't possible, a safe house is supposed to be safe.      

After a painfully long time exiting the safe house, Spoke begins to explain to Jumper that the hunters are vulnerable for a split second after popping their totem. Jumper is confused and says to Spoke about killing them in half a second. He shows JumperWho a arrow rail cannon which had the possibility of killing a hunter. Jumper says that Spoke has a valid plan and asks how Spoke knows about it. Spoke replies by saying he saw it on youtube. Jumper then questions Spoke about what killing a hunter would do to which Spoke replies that he does not know either. Spoke says that he thinks it could lead to a lead on Mapicc and the player who is orchestrating this chaos. He also tells Jumperwho about the connection between Mapicc and the shield patterns the hunters use.  Jumper then says that she saw them before.      

Arriving at a  base, Jumper explains to Spoke that she has seen the hunters before and followed them. She explains that a trader connected with her and her spies disappeared one day and so she went to their base and saw the hunters.  Jumper tells that the hunters were doing some weird things and tells Spoke that she saw a armourless player. She explains that that player had a bounty on and it was claimed in 3 hours.. Jumper explains that perhaps the person who was in charge of the bounties were helping them. Spoke says that he suspects that the hunters are making it look like these players die when they really dont. She also says that she was about to investigate further when Spoke pulled her emergency statis chamber. This emergency statis shows the amount of trust Jumper and Spoke has with each other as both know that a enderpearl could also be used to kill a player. She gives Spoke some gear before explaining something else      

Jumper tells Spoke that every player that went missing had an bounty on their head. She says that minutes before Spoke was jumped a bounty was also placed on his head for a huge amount. Jumper tells Spoke that she went to merchant city where the bounties are being placed and arrested the person who did it. Spoke is replied but Jumper leads them into another base. Jumper says that the person only wanted to talk to Spoke for some reason.      

The player in charge of the bounties is revealed to be SirPig, former mayor of capital city. Spoke asks SirPig why he called him to which SirPig replies that he agrees that they have things to go over but asks for some privacy and asks Jumper to go away, to which Jumper reluctantly obliges. Spoke then begins his conversation with SirPig. SirPig says he slightly changed professions and Spoke says that he can keep SirPig in the cell for as long as he needs to until he knows who the hunters are. He tells to SirPig that a bounty was placed on him and minutes later he was attacked by the mysterious players. SirPig says that he does not know about the hunters but Spoke does not believe him. SirPig continues saying he is not sure why he was here in the first place which irritates Spoke. SirPig says that Spoke should start worrying about himself. He continues saying that his business as the head bounties allowed him to meet many people. SirPig says that the person who came to him was someone he never saw before, adding on that he does not deal with strangers. SirPig says that they came from a land that they never heard before, but aside from all of that he said that the amount they were willing to pay was something they never saw before in a very long time. SirPig places a shulker box. Spoke opens it and finds stacks and stacks of diamond blocks, and stacks of normal diamonds too which really shocks Spoke. SirPig grabs the shulker box and Spoke asks him to give him just one name, one reason or just a lead. SirPig said that he never cared about where they came from but he said that the token they asked to prove that Spoke was dead was his special chestplate (Which references the glitched enchantments on the chestplate to which only JamatoP knows) that was given to him as a gift. (JamatoP was the one who gave it to Spoke)  Spoke now threatens SirPig with his life but SirPig is unfazed. SirPig then teleports away using a statis chamber momentarily leaving Spoke alone.       

Spoke is then attacked by the Hunters (Please add on from here Im too tired) - RealBrox
