== History ==
=== [[Season 1]] ===
==== [[The Exploit Arc]] ====
Spoke shows [[JamatoP]] that he got a full set of diamond armor with every protection enchantment, which is not normally possible except for in older versions of Minecraft. Jamato shows him his base, where he has also obtained glitched features. Jamato lets him take a full set of netherite armor with every protection enchantment. Wemmbu spies on Spoke and sees him take the netherite armor. Spoke goes to the end dimension and sees Wemmbu who asks him about the armor that Spoke has. Spoke lies and says that he got it himself.

Spoke and Jamato duplicate items using a glitch with shulker boxes and anvils. Using these items, they pay [[TheRealSquiddo]] to have her create [[The Wonders]]. Spoke secretly uses these to store glitched items. He hires some people to guard the wonders, including [[JumperWho]], [[Roshambogames]], [[Fantst]], [[Derapchu]], and Wemmbu.

Spoke goes to the end dimension to try and duplicate mobs using a glitch. Wemmbu sees him there, and Spoke is confused about why he is not guarding his wonder. They start fighting and Spoke escapes by flying to the outer end islands. Spoke decides he should destroy the end portals. Jamato says that Spoke just wants to play god, and that he doesn't want to be part of this anymore. Spoke tries to convince Jamato to change his mind by trying to give him a command block, bedrock, etc.

Wemmbu discovers what were inside the wonders. He tries to kill Spoke but he escapes. Spoke uses an orbital cannon to destroy the wonders. Wemmbu finds what appears to be a vault where Spoke's orbital cannon was at. Once Wemmbu is inside, Spoke traps him in a room full of chest mine carts and a warden. Wemmbu escapes and tries to kill Spoke, but he escapes using a fishing rod stasis chamber.

Spoke finds a stash of duped items, and tries to break in to find the duped items. He destroys all the duped items, however he ends up getting trapped in an obsidian box underneath the stash with Roshambogames, surrounded by end crystals and TNT minecarts. Spoke explodes them, uses his totem of undying, and escapes.

Spoke helps [[Mapicc]] steal from the [[Zam Empire]]. They go to TheRealSquiddo's base to destroy duped items that she has, and accidentally burn down her castle in the process. Spoke then find a bunch of duped emeralds in [[Jepexx]]'s trading hall and hide the villager trading hall.

Spoke sets an orbital cannon to destroy another dupe stash, but once there discover it's Jepexx's base. They accidentally destroy his base. They leave.

Spoke goes to the "final vault". Once there, he realizes there is no vault. Roshambo traps him in the end. Spoke escapes to the outer islands. He comes back to the main island with invisibility potions, and follows them to their end base. Once there, he realizes that the end base has no duped items in it. Spoke and Mapicc go back to the first dupe stash they found, and discover duped items behind the obsidian walls.

Spoke had his supporters attack the Zam Empire. Only TeamKalal died as they all used stasis chambers to escape.

[[PrinceZam]] and Wemmbu interrogate TheRealSquiddo and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn't give information on Spoke. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates.

Spoke sets up a scavenger hunt for a "secret" for ParrotX2 and [[Wifies]]. It later turns out that this is just a plan to get revenge on Parrot by chunk banning his friend. Wemmbu and PrinceZam find Spoke and try to kill him, but Spoke chunk bans himself before they do, in the same chunk ban that Wifies is in.

Parrot assembles a team which breaks out all of Spoke's henchmen. They eventually break [[Wifies]] and Spoke out by chunk banning the guards at the prison.

==== [[The Mafia Arc]] ====
Spoke and Mapicc find a stash of what they think are duped items. They find the chests are empty. A player named PlanetLord comes in and they try to kill him as he places shulker boxes which appear to be duped because they have identical items in all of them. PlanetLord is able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc go to a raid farm and see three invisible players. [[Ashswagg]] comes over and tells the invisible player to leave, and they oblige. Ashswagg says he doesn't know the players. Spoke and Mapicc go to TheRealSquiddo's house to see if there are any duped items there. Under the floor, they find a bunch of books with coordinates to farms. Ashswagg finds Spoke and Mapicc and says that he wants to team with them.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the farms and rig them to not produce items. While Jepexx is showing Spoke and Mapicc his panda farm, a group of invisible players come and start attacking them. Spoke and Mapicc yell for ashswagg to stop, and all the invisible players run away. Ashswagg says that he was just trying to help them.

Spoke and Mapicc see that ashswagg completely destroyed the coordinates of farms that they gave to him. Later, they see [[ManePear]] in a piglin farm, who appears to be AFK. He comes back and starts killing Spoke and Mapicc. They escape by breaking the bedrock on the nether roof and flying away.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the next farm and find two invisible players destroying it with TNT. He pops one of their totems and it reveals they are USmellLikeUpdog. Ash teleports USmellLikeUpdog into the void, banning him because he stated ashswagg was the leader. Mapicc leaves because he doesn’t trust ashswagg. He meets ashswagg at the next farm.

Spoke gives ashswagg the rest of the coordinates to the farms. Ashswagg completely destroys all of the farms. Spoke and Mapicc go to their end base and see that Wemmbu and eggchan are destroying it. This is because they were paid by Roshambo to destroy the end base.

They go over to the last farm, which is an EOL farm. Ashswagg says that he framed them into looking like they destroyed all of the farms. The invisible players are part of a group called [[The Invisible Mafia]]. The mafia members try to kill Spoke and Mapicc, but they escape using the nether. A player named Minutetech spots them in the nether and helps them. MinuteTech reveals he was once part of the mafia.

Spoke and Mapicc follow him back to his base. They show MinuteTech their base at spawn. They get attacked underground by the mafia. MinuteTech kills one of the mafia members using a mace. They manage to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord at Jepexx’s old villager trading hall. Then, the mafia members attempt to kill them. They trap the mafia players using a sand trap, though none of them die, and they are able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc try to prove to ManePear that there are invisible players attacking them, but ManePear decides to try and kill Spoke and Mapicc. They are able to escape, then the mafia starts attacking them. They run away shortly after. 

The mafia attacks Spoke and Mapicc. Spoke is able to escape, but Mapicc did not.

[[PlanetLord]] introduces [[Baconnwaffles0]] and TheRealSquiddo to MinuteTech. A mafia member named BobDaGreenFrog tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills Bob, and the mafia starts trying to kill them. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, and MinuteTech replies "no". The mafia continues attacking them. Spoke is able to escape, though he almost dies.

TheRealSquiddo shows the team some coordinates that she was given that could be the coordinates to a mafia outpost. She also states that everybody in the master builders group has disappeared.

The team goes over to the outpost and find a lot of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after he was given a book.

PlanetLord and Spoke discover that Jamato’s base is destroyed. Spoke and PlanetLord try to dupe in the base, but realize that it doesn’t work anymore. Ashswagg comes in and reveals that all the glitches and exploits were patched, and that Jamato told him so. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech was working for him, and then orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. They are able to escape again.

Spoke and PlanetLord go under one of the wonders where they put weaponless mobs. They find that the mobs are named coordinates. They find a replica of Jamato’s base made out of wood, and all of the glitched features have been removed. They find a book stating that if they are reading the book, Jamato is either captured or dead. It states he has exiled himself, that he has been hunted by the mafia, that he was captured in an outpost, and that an item can fix everything. They find a compass that is named “The Mafia”.

Following the compass, they find a mafia outpost. They find some mafia members in a room. They go above the players and drop dripstone on them, killing one of the players and using the totem of undying of another player named [[Leow0ok]]. The outpost starts exploding. Spoke teams up with Leo, and they follow a member of the mafia to the mafia city, where there are different tiers of mafia members. They find Mapicc in a prison and break him out.

Spoke is tasked to kill Parrot but doesn’t want to, so he deliberately fails. Ashswagg kills one of the members who was helping them. They run away. They are then tasked with guarding a vault. ManePear and Wemmbu start trying to break into the vault and succeed.

The team is now tasked to get diamonds. Ashswagg promotes them to copper tier. They are tasked with killing Baconnwaffles for a mission. Baconnwaffles says they are betraying the mafia, so they destroy his base. They go over to Reddoons at Capital City and trade.

The team is given the task of getting an elytra. Spoke asks Wemmbu if he can give him any elytra. They are able to find nine elytra in the Zam empire. Wemmbu finds a mafia member and starts killing them, but realizes it's eggchan.

They are promoted to iron after giving ashswagg the elytra. They are then tasked with building redstone machines. They sabotage the other opponents and win.

They are tasked with killing PlanetLord, but don't kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the members until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Spoke is tasked with killing [[iMajesticRose]]. He obliges and kills her with dripstone. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. He fights a diamond player to become diamond. (The diamond player reveals that he is minutetech after spokes totem pop) Spoke’s totem pops, revealing his identity. Spoke and minute try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. 

Spoke goes over to the square civilization to warn Cash that the mafia is going to break into their civilization and destroy it. Cash doesn’t listen and everyone in the civilization dies. Spoke warns the sleepy nation that the mafia is going to try to kill them. The sleepy nation takes back their items that were stolen by the mafia. The leaders of sleepy nation join the mafia and try to kill Spoke and his teammates.

Spoke and Mapicc go over to TheRealSquiddo to try and find the coordinates of "The Withered". The mafia destroys her castle. Spoke and Mapicc go to spawn where they see Parrot and Wifies. They agree to team to try and end the mafia. They show Parrot and Wifies the area where Spoke killed iMajesticRose. They find a diamond tier mafia player and follow him. They find a village where there is a player in iron armor named [[Quackenstein123]] who claims to be the father of iMajesticRose.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the end to get obsidian. They see the mafia who tries to kill them. They are able to escape.

They go back to Quackenstein's base and find a secret staircase under it. They find a stash of loot including diamond trimmed armor and a mace, proving that Quackenstein is the diamond tier player. Quackenstein gives them a book leading to the coordinates of where the stasis chambers are stored.

Spoke and Mapicc show Parrot the book. Parrot invites them to [[District 13]], the last resistance against the mafia.

Spoke and Mapicc check the coordinates and find a chest containing a book called "THE GATEWAY", which appears to contain directions to something. They show the members of District 13 the book. The members are disappointed so Spoke and Mapicc leave.

Spoke, Parrot, and Mapicc break into a spawn prison. This is where the mafia gets new members. Their plan is to follow wherever pearls are thrown all the way to the main stasis chamber area. They find an area where guards transport the pearls. They find a pearl cannon and use it to get teleported millions of blocks out, where they find a man-made mountain. Inside of the mountain is where every stasis chamber is stored.

Spoke tells Parrot about the stasis chambers. Spoke and Mapicc go to the void and start destroying every stasis chamber. The diamond tier players try to kill Spoke in the void, but using chorus fruit, Spoke is able to escape. The mafia ends.

Spoke finds ashswagg’s stasis chamber and activates it. He spares ashswagg.

=== [[Season 2]] ===
Spoke sees Ashswagg enter a secret base. Spoke decides to spy on him inside of the base. Inside of the secret base, he finds a second secret tunnel. Following the tunnel, he finds a new room. He sees TheRealSquiddo smelt something and a tunnel opens up. Spoke makes a secret base inside of the base.

Spoke hears ashswagg talking about having a dragon egg. Spoke accidentally sets an alarm, but TheRealSquiddo says it was probably just a fish. Spoke eventually finds a stash of items. Spoke finds a new room with a villager, which is very rare on the server. Spoke accidentally kills the villager. [[Reddoons]] pays ashswagg hundreds of mending books for the villager, only to discover that the villager is gone. Spoke raids the entire base.

Spoke finds the void room, containing a large amount of unrenewable items. Ashswagg catches him. Ashswagg tells Spoke that he traded the dragon egg to Reddoons.

Spoke sees Reddoons enter a secret base and follows him. Spoke sees [[Yeah_Jaron]] in the base. Spoke finds a vault of mobs, and accidentally kills a snowy fox, but replaces the fox with a new one from [[PlanetLord]]. Spoke sees Mapicc and PlanetLord in the base as they followed Spoke. They discover a villager in the base. Spoke and the team destroy the entire base and steal all the items. Spoke tries to steal the dragon egg from Reddoons but fails.

Spoke spies on Yeah_Jaron and sees him enter a secret base. Inside of the base, he sees another player, Reddoons.

Spoke rigs multiple farms to secretly only give items to Spoke. Spoke sees buzzman02 and flintandsteell attacking Yeah_Jaron. He protects Yeah_Jaron from them as he doesn’t want him dying for now. Spoke hires them to intercept a trade that Yeah_Jaron has. Spoke rigs their stasis chambers to trap them, and tries to force them to give items. They say no so Spoke kills them.

Spoke intercepts a trade between Yeah_Jaron and FartSteve08 while invisible. Spoke sets up fake coordinates for Reddoons to trade at to scam him, and hires Jepexx to do the fake trade. Reddoons leaves as Jepexx is AFK.

Spoke sees a raid get activated in the base, which is not normally possible due to almost all villagers being dead.

While Spoke is trying to steal a villager, Spoke sees the base getting raided. He kills the bandits using a TNT minecart trap and destroys the entire base.

Spoke and a team of players try multiple times to kill FlameFrags but fail.

Spoke sees members from [[Bounty Assassin Team]] enter a secret void base. Spoke secretly enters and spies on them. The team eventually sees Spoke holding a carrot and running around the base, and try to kill him. The base is put on lockdown, stopping him from escaping. They are eventually able to trap him in an interrogation room. Spoke pretends to be [[The Director]]. They try to kill Spoke but he's able to escape.

Spoke creates an empire with 1000 players and forms the [[Spoke Galactic Empire]]. Spoke attacks Baconnwaffles, Hannahxxrose and unintentionally, MinuteTech. 

The Spoke Galactic Empire betray Spoke, and try to kill him. Spoke and Mapicc escape. A player, named [[Baconnwaffles0|The Executive]], talks to Spoke. The players reach Spoke and Mapicc's platform and they escape using a nether portal. They meet The Executive again who attempts to give Spoke a book but it burns in lava.

Spoke and Mapicc make a fortress in the nether. The players find them and to enter the fortress. Spoke and Mapicc eventually escape on a happy ghast. 

Spoke and Mapicc find a base in a jungle biome. They steal from the base and get caught by Leowook. Spoke discusses with Leowook about helping them fight against the players. [[Baconnwaffles0|The Executive]] appears once again trying to convince Leo not to team with them. The Executive leaves and a bunch of players attack them and rob Leowook's base. Leowook invites Spoke and Mapicc to his team. 

Spoke, while invisible and using signs, tells FlameFrags to complete tasks for him. Spoke says he will give him items in return. After giving items which Flame believed to not be very good, Flame gets frustrated at Spoke. Spoke reveals himself to FlameFrags. Flame tries to kill Spoke but he escapes. Spoke eventually tells Flame to go to an old Mafia stash, where Wemmbu is. Spoke secretly spectates the fight between Wemmbu and FlameFrags, while also helping Flame. 

Spoke and Mapicc discover an exploit/glitch that allows them to go fully invisible, even when wearing their armor, as long as they don't take damage. They use this exploit to prank many players and civilizations. 

Spoke joins Bounty Assassin Team, and goes on a mission to discover a player stealing poison potions. The player doesn't listen to Spoke's threats, and Spoke burns down his whole village. Scared that Leow0ok would be mad at him for burning down a village, Spoke becomes determined to eliminate all the witnesses of the fire. Spoke hunts down all the witnesses, heading to small civilizations in the Amplified Region and killing their players with traps to avoid showing his name in the death message. 

Leow0ok confronts Spoke many times about the crimes committed in the Amplified, but Spoke claims that he's innocent. 

Spoke is being watched by invisible spies, causing Spoke to kill them. Leow0ok confronts Spoke about this. It is revealed that Spoke's been giving the items and armor from the players he has killed to [[Quackenstein123]] and his family. 

Spoke is stalked by JumperWho's spies, and he leads them into a base with traps. One of the spies drops a BAT archives book with Spoke's name in the title. JumperWho finds Spoke in his base with more spies, and realizes Spoke has the book and demands that he give it back. Spoke is able to escape, after killing multiple spies.

While Spoke is building a tower with Quackenstein and his family, Leow0ok is watching. Leow0ok threatens to kill the family, causing Spoke to evacuate the family to their old base, giving them all the armor of the dead spies. Spoke lets himself be caught by BAT, and gives all of his items away.

Leow0ok takes Spoke to see Lettuce's speech. Spoke is able to escape during the speech. Spoke begins stalking Leow0ok, planning on how to kill him. Spoke helps Wemmbu, [[Fantst]], PrinceZam, and [[Baablu]] escape. Wemmbu helps Spoke with trying to kill Leow0ok. They are unable to kill Leow0ok, and Leow0ok discovers that Spoke tried to kill Leow0ok.

Mapicc sets up a stasis chamber, so he can be saved if he is in danger. Spoke sends Mapicc to get items from an old mafia base. After an hour, Spoke pulls the stasis. Mapicc is quickly teleported away afterwards, due to throwing an ender pearl right before the stasis was pearled. Spoke goes to the location that Mapicc was. He finds items on the ground and cobwebs on the ground, indicating that a fight had taken place recently. Spoke goes to PrinceZam's base, looking for Mapicc. He is ambushed by BAT spies. Spoke is able to kill almost all of the spies, and escapes.

PrinceZam tells Spoke that he doesn't know where Mapicc is. Spoke heads back to his secret base, where he sees an invisible player, who he assumes is Mapicc because they have Mapicc's shield. The invisible player then drinks milk, revealing that they are actually Leow0ok. Leow0ok tells Spoke that he killed Mapicc. Spoke is able to escape from Leow0ok. 

Spoke threatens to blow up Capital City, unless proof of Mapicc being alive is given. Parrot is able to convince Spoke not to blow up Capital City. Spoke and PrinceZam are able to find an ender pearl cannon, which ends them millions of blocks out to a lighthouse. They eventually find a house next to the farlands, with two players, who turn out to be Mapicc and JamatoP. Spoke attempts to secretly kill Jamato but he is able to escape. Spoke tells Mapicc and Zam that Leow0ok killed him. 

Despite previous encounters, JumperWho gains Spoke's trust by saving him and his allies from the Law attacks multiple times, and they unite for the goal of killing Leow0ok. Spoke, Mapicc and PrinceZam head to the law prison in the mountains in order to free her spies. After Spoke is overpowered by the Law forces, Jumper and MinuteTech save them. Spoke apologizes to Minute for raiding the end dimension. 

Mapicc and MinuteTech head to the end dimension in order to recover some items from stashes. Spoke, Jumper and PrinceZam head to the main Law prison, intending to find Parrot. After long search, they don't find any of his traces, but they notice the highly guarded area. They believe, Parrot is imprisoned there. After destroying multiple layers of obsidian, they find, that the imprisoned one was Jaden_Man. 

During that operation, they notice Wemmbu and FlameFrags, who have also been raiding this area. After escaping the prison area they head to the Amplified. One of the Jumper's spies get the info about the huge army of the Law soldiers, who are heading to some unknown location. Spoke reaches there first using the ender pearl cannon he made. 

Spoke notices Parrot and Theo, who are trying to defend themselves on the happy ghast high above. He sets up some traps and kills multiple Law members. Soon, other protagonists arrive. Together, they loot the base and get all the resources needed to equip Parrot's army. After thay, they arrive to the renovated District 13 and prepare for the final fight. 

During the fight, Spoke mostly kills players with TNT, and at some point [[Mapicc]] goes missing. At the end of the fight, Spoke hoped that [[LettuceK]] would be executed, but the vote decides otherwise. Jumper tells Spoke, that their spies have found Leow0ok, who is weakened and had some armour broken. They quickly arrive to that location start fighting. After Leo is trapped in webs, he uses the stasis chamber, not knowing that it was previously discovered and rigged by Spoke using exploit. Leo dies after being dropped into the void. Spoke looks down and disappears through a Nether portal.

=== [[Season 3]] ===
==== [[The NULL Arc]] ====
After the battle with the Law. Spoke returns to his base, alone. He doesn't do anything untill he's jumped by a group of hunters, hunters with skins that look like void and unintelligible names. With traps set up early, he pulls one of them just for none of the hunters to fall in which surprises him. While trying to escape the players, he's able to pull another trap which all the hunters fall into. [[JumperWho]] arrives with the two investigating the pitfall trap only to not find any remains, no items or signs of escape. They talk for a moment, Spoke explaining the idea behind the trap untill they tower out.  They are out of the trap and with JumperWho saying that she has seen them before, except that she has no information about the hunters. Not knowing their reasoning, ideas and whereabouts. She hands Spoke a piece of paper with some cords, explaining that nobody else is allowed to have it continueing with saying that there will be a safe house of some sort but Spoke hands it back. 

When dropping the paper back, he says that he doesn't want to go to any safe house aslong as Jumper and her Spies don't get any work done. JumperWho questions what Spoke is talking about to which he replies with saying that Jumper has something else to worry about, a mission of some sorts. Spoke continues, saying that assignment is the whole reason they're still working together, he asks about updates which Jumper seeminly doesn't have.  Spoke starts to get a little upset, saying that it has been 4 weeks since they saw him. JumperWho sputters that her and her team is obviously trying with Spoke dismissing her, he says that he wants to actually have information about [[Mapicc|him]] the next time they meet. 

Spoke leaves the base. Walking through the wild to find bases with only the items in his inventory to aid. He does emphasize that he regrets being so mean to Jumper. He starts to explain, saying that it had been 4 weeks since they saw his best friend; [[Mapicc]]. After the battle with Law, nobody had seen Mapicc. Nobody saw where he went, nobody knows where he is. After days of searching, Spoke hired JumperWho to help find Mapicc. But Spoke says something, he says that the hunters carried a specific shield. The exact same design as the shield Mapicc gave Spoke before the battle, he wonders what that could mean. What if Mapicc was leading the group, what if he was responsible for the attack. 

With bases not having any good loot and Spoke still on edge, he finds a base hidden inside a wall. He goes inside to find chest full of dirt and cobblestone. After concluding that the base is useless the supposed owner of the base appears. Without a mic, the players is unable to stop Spoke and is swiftly killed which causes a death message. Spoke realizes that the death message could reveal his location to the hunters. He quickly starts to set up a TNT cart trap, hoping its enough to kill them.  

The hunters arrive with Spoke setting off the trap. But the trap didn't do anything, the players are unharmed, only having a few totems popped. Spoke runs down the mineshaft, exclaiming that the players literally just vanished. Using a water cave to escape, he's able to reach land but still has the hunters after him. With a iron helmet and not even full netherite, he has no chance to win a 1 against 10. With the netherite chestplate he got from Jamato, he's unable to use windcharges due to the chestplate having blast protection so he resorts to switching it to a diamond.  

Being able to shake off some hunters at platform, he continues to run. Realizing that the hunters have speed potions, he starts to use terrain to outrun them. He runs into the water and is attacked by fireworks from the hunters, he returns to land only to go back to the water and start to dig a 1x1 tunnel. The hunters follow him in and he returns to the surface. He continues to run, starting to get distressed saying that he needs to have speed to win but he's able to calm himself down. He returns to the water and jukes them again. Then Spoke decides to use an enderpearl, it'll give him a good lead on them and he sees a house in the distance. Contemplating his choices, he decides to go to the safe house. He goes into the house in the distance and gears up, splashing invisibility and picking up some fire resistance. The hunters arrive and kill the player who lived in the house. Spoke runs down the stairwell into a room and blocks it up, hoping that the hunters won't suspect it. He's successfully able to do so but is quickly caught by the hunters again.  

He runs out of the house and uses blue ice to run faster. He decides to go to the safe house but is still being followed by the hunters. He unequips all his armor and hides using invisiblity. He stays hidden with the hunters killing another player. He aims to go to the safe house. He climbs up the mountain only for his invisibility to run out, he quickly wears his armor and continues to scale the mountain, terrified that the hunters may have seen him. He starts to use leaves to pillar up but notices a hunter, he's able to escape using his elytra.   

Spoke steps away to go to the bathroom and the hunters pass him, he returns and notices the players. They run past him and leave him. Spoke finds the supposed safe house, only to be spotted by the hunters once again. When entering the safe house, a group of invisible spies come out of the flooring and attack the hunters. JumperWho arrives and orders Spoke to follow him, Spoke complies and they head towards THE safe house. A leader of the hunters follow them with Spoke and JumperWho deciding to run away.    

After a while, Spoke jumps down a 1x1 made by JumperWho and they are able to leave the hunter stranded. When going through the tunnels, Spoke expresses regret for immediately going to the bunker and apologizes to JumperWho, who happily takes the apology.    

Entering THE safe house, Spoke starts to get upset saying that he doesn't want to stay inside a safe house. JumperWho retaliates with that it's for Spoke safety, Spoke doesn't listen. He knows that Jumper doesn't know how to defeat the hunters and he explains that the hunters disappear every time their totem is popped. Spoke and Jumper continue to argue until Jumper agrees to let Spoke out. Being victorious, Spoke orders for the elevator to come down and JumperWho says that it isn't possible, a safe house is supposed to be safe.      

After a painfully long time exiting the safe house, Spoke begins to explain to Jumper that the hunters are vulnerable for a split second after popping their totem. Jumper is confused and says to Spoke about killing them in half a second. He shows JumperWho a arrow rail cannon which had the possibility of killing a hunter. Jumper says that Spoke has a valid plan and asks how Spoke knows about it. Spoke replies by saying he saw it on youtube. Jumper then questions Spoke about what killing a hunter would do to which Spoke replies that he does not know either. Spoke says that he thinks it could lead to a lead on Mapicc and the player who is orchestrating this chaos. He also tells Jumperwho about the connection between Mapicc and the shield patterns the hunters use.  Jumper then says that she saw them before.      

Arriving at a  base, Jumper explains to Spoke that she has seen the hunters before and followed them. She explains that a trader connected with her and her spies disappeared one day and so she went to their base and saw the hunters.  Jumper tells that the hunters were doing some weird things and tells Spoke that she saw a armourless player. She explains that that player had a bounty on and it was claimed in 3 hours.. Jumper explains that perhaps the person who was in charge of the bounties were helping them. Spoke says that he suspects that the hunters are making it look like these players die when they really dont. She also says that she was about to investigate further when Spoke pulled her emergency statis chamber. This emergency statis shows the amount of trust Jumper and Spoke has with each other as both know that a enderpearl could also be used to kill a player. She gives Spoke some gear before explaining something else      

Jumper tells Spoke that every player that went missing had an bounty on their head. She says that minutes before Spoke was jumped a bounty was also placed on his head for a huge amount. Jumper tells Spoke that she went to merchant city where the bounties are being placed and arrested the person who did it. Spoke is replied but Jumper leads them into another base. Jumper says that the person only wanted to talk to Spoke for some reason.      

The player in charge of the bounties is revealed to be [[SirPig]], former mayor of capital city. Spoke asks SirPig why he called him to which SirPig replies that he agrees that they have things to go over but asks for some privacy and asks Jumper to go away, to which Jumper reluctantly obliges. Spoke then begins his conversation with SirPig. SirPig says he slightly changed professions and Spoke says that he can keep SirPig in the cell for as long as he needs to until he knows who the hunters are. He tells to SirPig that a bounty was placed on him and minutes later he was attacked by the mysterious players. SirPig says that he does not know about the hunters but Spoke does not believe him. SirPig continues saying he is not sure why he was here in the first place which irritates Spoke. SirPig says that Spoke should start worrying about himself. He continues saying that his business as the head bounties allowed him to meet many people. SirPig says that the person who came to him was someone he never saw before, adding on that he does not deal with strangers. SirPig says that they came from a land that they never heard before, but aside from all of that he said that the amount they were willing to pay was something they never saw before in a very long time. SirPig places a shulker box. Spoke opens it and finds stacks and stacks of diamond blocks, and stacks of normal diamonds too which really shocks Spoke. SirPig grabs the shulker box and Spoke asks him to give him just one name, one reason or just a lead. SirPig said that he never cared about where they came from but he said that the token they asked to prove that Spoke was dead was his special chestplate (Which references the glitched enchantments on the chestplate to which only JamatoP knows) that was given to him as a gift. (JamatoP was the one who gave it to Spoke)  Spoke now threatens SirPig with his life but SirPig is unfazed. SirPig then teleports away using a statis chamber momentarily leaving Spoke alone.       

Spoke is then attacked by the Hunters (Please add on from here Im too tired) - RealBrox

title: Spongs
content:
Spongs is a supporting character in Unstable Universe. He was the antagonist of The Great Farm War alongside Willsion. 

 Personality 
Spongs is described as chaotic, unserious, and often creates questionable plans. During on a mission with FlameFrags, he doesn't take things seriously, causing a lot of problems happening. Besides this, Spongs is not careful about his items, especially throwing important items away or even trading his armor.

 History 
Spongs is a supporting character and recurring antagonist. He is known for shifting allegiances, as Spongs has served as a mercenary, a prison guard, and a core antagonist in regional conflicts like The Great Farm War.

 Season 1 
Spongs is seen as a teammate of Jaden_MAN when he invades Wemmbu's Civilization.

Spongs and Jaden_MAN are hired to be game masters, by ClownPierce. 

Spongs is seen as a guard at Proton.

 Season 2 
During Season 2, Wemmbu saves Spongs while he is being raided by Jaden_MAN and his team.

Eggchan invites Spongs to the civilization. Wemmbu follows Spongs and sees that he goes over to a pirate themed base. Wemmbu comes back to the civilization. Jaden_MAN  and his team including Spongs threaten to kill eggchan if Wemmbu does not drop all of his stuff and all of his stuff in his ender chest, so Wemmbu obliges.

Spongs is seen as a part of the Avengers.

Spongs is seen as a farmer, who griefs Lomedy's farm. Spongs served as a primary antagonist alongside Willsion. They griefed Lomedy's Farm, leading to a retaliation by FlameFrags. Flame eventually destroyed their farm using TNT dupers, though he chose to spare Spongs' life, leaving him to live with the knowledge he would never be the server's greatest farmer.

Spongs and Willsion teams up temporally with FlameFrags and Lomedy to defend the base against Arachn1d kingdom

Spongs joins FlameFrags Law team with Lomedy, JakeVC42_ and Gunter______ for 100 days

title: Stasis Chamber
content:
Stasis Chamber, or simply stasis, is an ender pearl that stays and oscillates at a safe place and can be triggered (pulled) by a variety of mechanisms, manually or remotely. It is widely used on the Unstable SMP.

 Mechanism 
The ender pearl is thrown into an upward bubble column created by soul sand and water, or thrown at a strict angle towards some honey blocks on an oscillating piston. The former one can be turned into a trap by adding wind charged chicken launcher above the pearl and piston to remove soul sand under the pearl, with bedrock below the soul sand removed by glitch. The pearl will load the chunk so it is always triggerable. Fishing rod is connected to wirelessly pulling stasis by the same glitch used in setting fishing rod trigger for Orbital Strike Cannon and Orbital Dog Cannon.

 History 

Wemmbu visited Proton prisoners and set stasis inside it to break everyone out.

The Invisible Mafia forced players to throw ender pearl and transport all portals to Mafia Stasis Chambers far away from Spawn and also the tomb of the Mafia far in the first void of the end ring. These stasis chambers, when triggered, send players into the void immediately and kill them. Ashswagg had the fishing rods to trigger the stases in Mafia Stasis Chambers to control the Mafia. Mafia Stasis Chambers was destroyed by Spoke.

Wemmbu used stasis chamber to get in and out his most secure base.

MrCube6 stasised away from BAT prison after leaving BAT a dandelion.

The PvP tournament where Wemmbu and FlameFrags participated had totem-triggered stasis chambers. This mechanism is likely related to Shadow Item glitch and is also used by Wifies, JamatoP, and Null Hunters.

Parrot built a mirror-receiver-triggered stasis chamber. After revealing Invisible Knight is Wemmbu, he got knocked into the void by an angry Wemmbu, and clutched by looking at the direction for mirror receiver.

Spoke used stasis chamber in the air activated by wind charge to infiltrate Leow0ok's spies into the BAT secret vault.

Wemmbu set a stasis chamber at Far Lands Orbital Strike Cannon array to refill them whenever needed.

Spoke found Leow0ok's stasis chamber and set trap to kill him alongside Wemmbu but failed due to Leo possibly already knowing this and having a backup stasis.

Spoke pulled off Mapicc's stasis chamber which led him to discover JamatoP, his archenemy. He used a stasis chamber to pretend he was Leo and manipulate Mapicc. His stasis chamber was pulled by JumperWho who asked for alliance against Leo.

Spoke later found Leow0ok's stasis chamber again using arrow TNT triangulation and transported the pearl to a void trap, which killed Leo when he was cornered and tried to teleport.

Spoke pulled Jumper and her spies' stasis to call for their help against Null Hunters. SirPig_ teleported away with fishing rod during Spoke's interrogation, leaving Spoke and Jumper in a passive and vulnerable position for Null Hunters to attack.

title: Swight
content:
Swight is a supporting character featured in Unstable Universe. He is extremely skilled in PvP and formerly a hired assassin for the Law. He trained Flame in PvP.

 Personality 
Swight is characterized as a cold and calculating mercenary. Unlike other figures in the Unstable Universe who are driven by power or faction loyalty, Swight is motivated almost entirely by professionalism and profit. He views the world through the lens of contracts and compensation, famously showing no interest in the identity or "justice" of his targets—only in whether the requester can pay his fee. His loyalty is flexible. While he is reliable once a contract is signed, he is willing to negotiate with his own targets if they offer a better "deal" than his original employer, demonstrating that he values survival and gear over a reputation for honesty. In other words, he is like Wild Card in server's politics. You can trust him to follow the best deal, but you can never trust him to be a permanent ally. Swight hates people who kill for stupid purposes like vengeance, titles and etc.

 History 
Swight was originally contracted by the Law with a clear mission: to track down and eliminate FlameFrags. To find a student worthy of his time, Swight hosted a tournament to see who was the "best player" for him to teach, eventually selecting a mysterious "invisible player."

Throughout their sessions, Swight put the player through rigorous combat trials, unaware that his student was actually his target, FlameFrags, using a secret identity. Swight’s training focused on elite PvP mechanics, reflecting his real-world status as a Tier 1 player in multiple disciplines.

The tension peaked when the invisible player was revealed to be FlameFrags. Instead of completing the assassination for the Law, Swight showed his true mercenary nature. He agreed to spare Flame and "betray" the original contract in exchange for high-tier gear vault. This solidified Swight as a character who values personal gain and skill over professional loyalty to any "Law."

 Quotes 

 Trivia 
 His skin is based off Young Gojo from Jujutsu Kaisen Universe
 As mentioned by Flame, He is commonly known as one of the best players in all the Minecraft, being third on the MCTiers Rankings and having Tier 1 in UHC and Axe.
 He has retired from Axe and UHC following the DangerMario scandal.

title: Th3Blurpinstein
content:
Th3Blurpinstein is a minor comic relief character in Unstable Universe.  He was prisoned by the Law along with alongside Fantst, PrinceZam, Baablu, and others for mass murder and other criminal acts to the server, which are not explicitly stated but hinted by LettuceK to be worse than anyone else's in the Law's prison.  He uses a low quality voice changer and has a permanent Curse of Binding pumpkin on his head.

 Personality 
Th3Blurpinstein usually acts as annoying, childish, and bratty. He is known for a recurring gag of being more dangerous as he seems, being put in solitary for long periods of time and given higher punishment than the rest of the prisoners, as well as him not telling what crimes he committed. He is usually the center of many jokes in the plot, as a comic relief character. 

 History 

Th3Blurpinstein is seen as a prisoner in the Law's prison with the rest of the prisoners, and attempts to make friends with Wemmbu, who brushes him off. 

When Wemmbu, PrinceZam, and Baablu plot to escape in the cafeteria, Th3Blurpinstein tries to snitch on them. PrinceZam starts an argument with Th3Blurpinstein and creates a distraction, allowing for them to escape. 

After Wemmbu's escape attempt, LettuceK implements a policy that every prisoners must wear Curse of Binding armor. Th3Blurpinstein steps on the pressure plate, and a curse of binding pumpkin is placed on his head.

LettuceK refuses to divulge Th3Blurpinstein's crimes, however, Th3Blurpinstein states that he has killed a large amount of people and that his lore is "really violent".

Th3Blurpinstein is then put into solitary confinement.

Later, when he's released, Th3Blurpinstein asks for help escaping the prison when Wemmbu and others are escaping. A Law guard frees him. He asks Lomedy to join them in the escape, but he refuses. PrinceZam (whom Blurpenstein had previously threatened and argued with) is seen later seen chasing him down, attempting to kill him. 

Th3Blurpinstein is seen again in the prison, recaptured. He is in solitary confinement talking to Parrot, and distracts the guard when Parrot attempts to escape. This time he is seen, he acts more mature and says that he is now regretful of his crimes. 

Later, when Spoke breaks into the prison with the goal to find Parrot, Th3Blurpinstein is seen talking to them, and PrinceZam is now seen being friendly to him. He eventually escapes the prison during their fight. 

 Trivia 

 Blurpinstein is theorized to be a secret former netherite Mafia player and is acting dumb on purpose. This makes sense considering the existence of Quackenstein123 who has a similar name and was a diamond Mafia player.
 Blurpinstein swore his allegiance to Spoke, but it is unclear if this was serious or not.
 Blurpinstein made friends with Lomedy inside the Law's prison.

title: TheGOdOfWar
content:
TheGOdOfWar is a supporting character in Unstable Universe.

He serves as a major antagonist in The Kings Arc.

TheG0dofWar is a very skilled player in The Law with almost the same skill in sword as FlameFrags. He is a reflection of Pre-Law FlameFrags in a lot of ways. TheG0dofWar has a huge ego like how FlameFrags has one and he says he only has his name as a fierce PVPer just like how FlameFrags said the same. He as equal skill in sword and refuses to run from battle.

 History 
TheG0dofWar is one of the four commanders of The Law, led by LettuceK. He is seen when fighting against Jaden's Pirates and Wemmbu. He also fights FlameFrags twice and beats him the first time.

In Flame's video, I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master, in which he serves as the main antagonist. We hear about TheG0dofWar by many players which say that he really is The God of War. Flame refuses to believe him but then he runs into him in the black market. TheG0dofWar pardons all criminals which lead them into telling him about Flame. Flame who is not very prepared for battle is forced to fight TheG0dOfWar but is decisively beaten by him in a stunning duel which puts Flame into shock. TheG0dofWar humiliates Flame in every single way forcing him to run from a fight which he would have never done before. After Flame trains with Theo, He vows to reclaim his title from TheG0dOfWar and goes into the desert to fight him.

The two met and started a duel. Flame's carts slowly begin to overpower TheG0dOfWar but he refuses to give up and continues to battle Flame. Flame continues to fight him and Law soldiers watch in awe as the battle continues. Eventually TheG0dofWar attempts to end the battle by running but Flame calls after him saying that he is not done yet. TheG0dofWar refuses to run from the battle and continues fighting Flame. In the end he runs out of resources. TheG0dofWar says that his title is the only thing he has but Flame continues to fight him. With half of his armor broken, TheG0dofWar finally surrenders. Flame spares him because it seems like he sees himself in him like how Flame was before The Law humbled him. Flame tells TheG0dofWar to never fight him again unless he is certain of being better then him.

It is possible that before the duel against Flame, TheG0dofWar and SargeLaw captured TheobaldTheBird.

In Wemmbu's video, "Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Players," TheG0dOfWar is seen in the end after Wemmbu and eggchan returns with MinuteTech. He battles them alongside Lawmen.

After escaping to the Overworld, MinuteTech and Wemmbu battles TheG0dOfWar. He survives Wemmbu's orbital strikes without popping a totem, before Wemmbu leaves them in order to confront LettuceK and his lawmen, and MinuteTech is left to battle TheG0dOfWar by himself.
 Thumbnails 

 Triva 

 His sword Chaos, his name, and his skin are all references to Kratos from the God of War series of video games.

title: TheRealSquiddo
content:
TheRealSquiddo, more commonly known as Squiddo, is a character in Unstable Universe.

 Personality 
Squiddo is an unserious, generous, and funny character. She is unwilling to kill players, as shown when she remained a copper trim in the mafia despite being one of the people closest to Ash. She is incredibly loyal to certain people and states that she misses Spoke, Mapicc, and the rest of her friends even long after she left to join Ash. She is sentimental, keeping a version of the "Garlic Hamster" pet at every single one of her bases. She also is shown to be very silly, as shown with her antics at Point Nemo. She brings out a less serious side of Ash, despite his stoic front. She is one of the only people in the series that he opens up to and trusts.

 History 

 Season 1 
Squiddo leads the master builders group. SpokeIsHere pays her to have the master builders group help Spoke build The Wonders. 

Squiddo builds a portal and breaks an obsidian at the same moment that a chunk suppressor was accidentally activated by Spoke. Spoke sees this and tells her that it is a normal thing which happens when the server lags. Spoke then destroys the glitched portal and advises that she doesn’t share it and that nobody would believe her.

Squiddo's house is accidentally burned down by Spoke when he is trying to get rid of her duped netherite blocks.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam interrogate Squiddo and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn’t give information on Spoke. They check her barrels and find out that she has glitched items. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension for Spoke, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates. Zam chunk bans Squiddo.

Parrot breaks Squiddo out of prison.

Squiddo joins Wemmbu's Civilization.

 Season 2 
Squiddo is seen in a secret base with ashswagg called Point Nemo. Spoke later completely destroys the entire base and raids all of it.

Spoke, invisible, destroys Squiddo's base in the Amplified with fire and lava.

 Boundaries 

 Shipping is okay
 No NSFW

 Trivia 

 Squiddo was the copper trim player that was with Ashswagg in the Far Lands after the Mafia had fallen.
 She and Ashswagg are dating in real life, as they revealed in YouTube video and series of tweets on February 14th, and have joked about being married in Unstable Universe.
Squiddo has changed her skin several times between and during episodes, making her, Ashswagg, Parrot,  Wemmbu, and Mapicc the only characters to do so in all of Unstable.
Squiddo was offered the opportunity to be the fourth protagonist of Unstable. However, she declined as she wanted to focus on Lifesteal content and agreed to be a background character instead.https://youtube.com/shorts/Yj4c0rU4S4c

title: The Avengers
content:
The Avengers was a group of players consisting of Wemmbu's old enemies, who attempted to kill Wemmbu.

 History 
Not to be confused with District 13.  

During a battle in the Spikelands within the Farther Lands, saw The Avengers fought against both Wemmbu and Eggchan. The battle almost ended with a victory for the Avengers but it took an unprecedented turn, as FlameFrags decided to betray The Avengers and fight alongside Wemmbu and Eggchan. The battle ended in a defeat for The Avengers, and Wemmbu's mace was subsequently returned to him.

The Avengers was a ragtag group of players assembled  by Jaden_Man. Frequent member conflict led to its complete collapse. In the final battle FlameFrags betrayed the alliance and fought the Avengers.  This led to the betrayal arc in which Jaden and FlameFrags fought.

The effects of the battle can still be seen especially from Jaden & Flame's rivalry which started in this battle. The rivalry still continues even though neither one of them regards Wemmbu as an enemy and Jaden being one of Wemmbu's closest allies.

The battle ended in a defeat for The Avengers, and Wemmbu's mace was subsequently returned to him.

The Avengers was a ragtag group of players assembled  by Jaden_Man. Frequent member conflict led to its complete collapse. In the final battle FlameFrags betrayed the alliance and fought the Avengers.  This led to the betrayal arc in which Jaden and FlameFrags fought.

The effects of the battle can still be seen especially from Jaden & Flame's rivalry which started in this battle. The rivalry still continues even though neither one of them regards Wemmbu as an enemy and Jaden being one of Wemmbu's closest allies.

title: The BAT Arc
content:
*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes* SpokeIsHere gathers an army of 1,000 players and creates the Spoke Galactic Empire. He forcibly recruits builder Horace Altman to improve the empire, as well as deals with assassination attempts. His friend Mapicc joins him, and together they attack Sleepy Nation, which betrayed them a while ago. After that they go to terrorize the End, only to find it's the home of their old friend MinuteTech. After that awkward situation, Spoke deals with more assassination attempts, and finally his army starts to turn against him, forcing him to run away.

*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes* Spoke and Mapicc are attacked at their base by the army, but manage to escape through the Nether. There, they meet The Executive, the new leader of the army. They try to fight the army, but eventually are forced to flee. They find a portal going to Leow0ok's base, another old friend of theirs. The three of them fight off the army together, killing them all, and Leo offers to let the two join BAT, his team.

Spoke has to race a couple of other people in completing tasks to become a member of BAT. After failing a few and coming into conflict with ApexPoint multiple times, he learns that BAT hates FlameFrags and decides to use that. He pays Flame using stolen items to complete multiple different tasks, and sends a random player to go find Wemmbu, another of BAT's enemies, to lure both to the same location. He secretly watches the battle, which Wemmbu wins, and then reports back to Leo saying he killed them. Leo's skeptical, but since he's heard reports of Wemmbu's death, he believes it and welcomes Spoke to the team.

*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes* Mapicc discovers an invisibility exploit, which he and Spoke utilize to troll a new player. ApexPoint returns, however, recruiting the new player. Spoke and Mapicc find TheRealSquiddo's base, and troll her, then eventually burn it down. Apex's team finds Jepexx's base and attacks, but Spoke is able to save both Jepexx and his horse. He and Mapicc sneak into Apex's base, but get spotted and run. They are followed back to their base, and Apex's team discovers the exploit. They use it against Spoke, who blows up their base and kills them to protect the exploit from getting out.

Spoke accidentally burns down a base while on a mission from Leo. To cover it up, he sets up traps at the witnesses' base, killing all of them, but Leo's spies arrive and start investigating. Leo himself questions Spoke, but Spoke deflects. He goes to his base with Mapicc and is watched by two spies, but escapes. He finds the other secret base of the remaining witnesses, successfully trapping it and killing everyone. However, two spies show up and attack him. He manages to kill both of them and returns to his base, finding Leo there. It's revealed that the spies Leo didn't actually send the spies, and he theorizes that JumperWho sent them instead. Spoke sneaks off to another base, where Quackenstein123 lives, and gives all the items he's gotten to him, revealing his ultimate mission has been to atone for IMajesticRose's death.

More spies follow Spoke, but he kills them, obtaining a book that reveals BAT is investigating him. Jumper shows up, but he manages to outplay her and escape. Leo and Jumper are waiting for him at his base, revealing they're working together again, They let Spoke go due to a lack of evidence of his wrongdoings, but leave spies to watch. Spoke and Mapicc flee their base and kill one of their pursuers, obtaining coords to BAT's secret vault. Spoke sets up a plan and they kill another spy, whom Spoke impersonates to get inside, learning that Leo wants to kill him while Jumper wants to wait for evidence. Spoke flees the base and a player he recruited pretends to be him, resulting in his death. Spoke plans to use that player to prove his innocence, and visits Quackenstein again. Leo shows up as well, though, and threatens Quackenstein if Spoke doesn't give up, before flying away.

*All following videos are part of The Kings Arc, but due to Spoke including them in his BAT arc playlist, they are also included here*

Spoke watches as Leow0ok and his spies destroy Quackenstein’s family base, searching for the armor pieces, prompting them to escape through a tunnel with Quackenstein and his family, sending them to safety via a Nether portal, where the family heads to their old snow base before breaking it. Leo and his spies catch up, forcing Spoke to reveal his inventory, but Jumper defends him due to a lack of evidence. Following a speech by LettuceK, leader of The LAW, Spoke plans to have Wemmbu kill Leo and later eavesdrops on Leo’s conversation to track him. After infiltrating The Law's base, Spoke offers to help Wemmbu escape in exchange for a favor, but Wemmbu refuses. Eventually, Spoke breaks the prisoners out, but when they confront Leo, it becomes clear that Leo's true motive was to catch Spoke in a mistake, proving his guilt as they prepare for an inevitable clash.

Mapicc goes on a mission to a BAT gear stash, but when he doesn't come back, Spoke follows the tracks and finds the place where he supposedly died. He refuses to believe it at first, until Leo shows up at his base holding Mapicc's shield. Spoke rigs Capital City to blow up unless he gets proof of Mapicc's life, but no one comes except for Parrot, and he wasn't even sent by the Law. However, he does convince Spoke to stand down. After some time, Spoke brings Zam to the BAT gear stash, where he found signs from spies that didn't join the fight, indicating another player was there and saved Mapicc. They follow the tracks, which eventually take them to the Far Lands, where Mapicc is with JamatoP, Spoke's oldest friend. Mapicc wants to live peacefully. Spoke and Jamato speak privately, both condemning each other for supposed villainy, and Jamato stasises away. Spoke disguises himself as Leo and attacks Mapicc and Zam, pretending to get scared off, then comes back as himself, revealing Jamato 'died'. The three of them resolve to kill Leo.

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam find a village, which Spoke blows up using an exploit to get items from reluctant townsfolk. They visit BAT's secret library, where they find wreckage from a battle and realize someone is following them. They set up secret stasises and build a sky base, when beacons light up suddenly. Spoke follows them and finds Leo and a bunch of Lawmen. He warns the others, and they prepare to fight them off before escaping when the base is overwhelmed. They attack Leo and make him stasis away, then use an arrow trick to find his current location. On the way there, Spoke's stasis gets pulled.

It's revealed that JumperWho teleported Spoke and betrayed BAT, because Leo kept using her spies as soldiers. Spoke refuses her offer of teaming up, and instead sends a message to the Law, giving them his coordinates. He sets up traps with help from Mapicc and Zam, and then Jumper makes her offer again. He refuses it, and the three head to where Leo has set up camp. They kill his soldiers, but Leo takes Zam hostage. Jumper saves him, and Spoke has another argument with her. She shows him Leo's secret base, where he's been building TNT cannons. They successfully escape and take down more Lawmen, and Spoke finally agrees to team with Jumper.

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam sneak into a Law prison and free the BAT spies imprisoned there, but are attacked by Lawmen. MinuteTech saves them, brought by Jumper, and Jumper sends her spies off. They report that ParrotX2 is in the Law prison, and so the three sneak in (Mapicc and Minute are off getting Minute's other gear stashes). Wemmbu and FlameFrags break into the prison at the same time, and Spoke aids Flame in fighting. The three find someone surrounded by obsidian and guards, but it turns out to be Jaden MAN rather than Parrot. Spoke brings everyone, Flame and Wemmbu included, to his castle, where Mapicc and Minute meet them. They learn via spies that hundreds of Lawman are converging on a Law stash, and head there. Spoke sets up landmines and realizes Parrot and TheobaldTheBird are there. It turns into a massive battle, after which Parrot brings them all to District 13. They go to the Northern Council and destroy Lettuce's army. Mapicc vanishes. After Lettuce surrenders, Jumper's spies report Leo's location, so the two go there. They trap him, but he activates his stasis. Spoke, however, found Leo's stasis chamber earlier and set it up over the void. Leo dies.

title: The Betrayal Arc
content:
*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes* FlameFrags joins a PVP tournament out of boredom, defeating Willsion easily. He learns his enemy Wemmbu is also there, then fights FerreMC, and though it's closer, he still wins. Next is TheobaldTheBird, who fights with TNT minecarts, so Flame enchants his leggings with blast protection. It's still a tough fight, but he wins, and his final match is against Wemmbu. They both pop two totems, but Flame wins.

Flame's friend Jaden MAN is missing, so Flame goes around interrogating people. LettuceK acts suspicious, and after spying on his team, The Law, Flame learns they imprisoned Jaden. He loses a fight to try and make them tell him, but learns that Leow0ok managed to beat them. Leo teaches Flame TNT minecart PVP, which Flame uses to defeat the Law, but Lettuce would rather die than give up the info. Leo stages his capture so Flame can find their prison, and he does so successfully, forcing the Law to run to avoid dying, since Jaden has already been found by Flame.

Jaden gathers a team, The Avengers, to kill Wemmbu, who imprisoned him. They find Wemmbu in the Far Lands, but fail to kill him. Jaden and Flame split off from the others and find Conexion, who joins their team and gives (with some trickery involved) Flame his mace, which once belonged to Jaden. The other half of the Avengers fail to kill Wemmbu, but they have a meeting point for a final battle. Flame comes up with a plan, but his team refuses to follow it, so he betrays them, fighting alongside Wemmbu. The Avengers are scared off, and Flame returns the mace to Wemmbu, its original owner. Suddenly, the stasis Flame set to get out of the Farlands is pulled.

It turns out to be the Law, but Flame escapes and meets up with Jaden. They are attacked again by the Law, then go to a nearby town whose inhabitants they rob, and then are attacked again. This time they chase the Law when they retreat, killing a couple, then continue on to their base. Flame gets trapped in an obsidian box, but survives multiple traps. The Law comes down to kill him, revealing Jaden betrayed him, but he escapes.

Flame meets up with his friend Lomedy, but Lomedy gets attacked by Jaden and has his mace stolen. Jaden uses a Riptide trident to mace Flame, who eventually seeks shelter. Jaden gives him a compass leading to his new pirate base and leaves. Flame gears back up and goes off to fight him, but after a long battle, Jaden concedes that Flame has won and then flies off with his trident.

title: The Director Arc
content:
Story 
ItzRealMe attacks ParrotX2, but the Bounty Assassin Team saves him. They plan to trap and kill him, but Itz reveals he has a mace and uses it to kill half the attacking players. Parrot and Leow0ok, head of BAT, go to spy on Itz, but get caught and nearly killed. Itz lures the rest of BAT away from their HQ and nearly kills Parrot, but Leo saves him. Itz visits Parrot and reveals the Director sent him, but that he’s done now.

MrCube6 attempts to kill Parrot, presumably by the Director's orders. They play mind games, each trying to outsmart the other. Derapchu continually causes problems, culminating in all of BAT's wealth being stolen. Parrot and Derapchu go out to recover it, and do so successfully, fighting off bandits along the way. Cube and Parrot meet for one final contest, and after Parrot outsmarts Cube, Derapchu arrives and takes him into custody. He gives Parrot a message from the Director, greeting Parrot.

BAT attempts to kill Parrot, but Jumper helps him escape, and later explains that BAT thinks he’s the Director. She sneaks him into BAT, but he gets caught and barely escapes. Later, she betrays him to BAT, but items she gave him helps him escape, and she later explains she had to regain BAT’s trust. One of her spies overhears them, forcing her to kill him. The Director arranges for a meeting with Parrot, which Jumper secretly brings BAT too. After the Director leaves, BAT finds the spy’s grave, and Jumper is kicked off the team.

BAT get attacked by TruOriginal, a hacker. They escape, but he destroys BAT HQ. They flee and set up an underground base, then get materials to build a mirror receiver, planning to link it to their orbital strike cannon to kill Tru. That fails, however, and Parrot is nearly killed, but Nufuli helps him escape. Leo and Derapchu are captured, and Tru tells them to come to BAT HQ. They do so, and this time manage to successfully kill Tru with the cannon, and save Leo and Derapchu. Nufuli decides to leave the team, but gets killed by the Director.

BAT follow the Director and get trapped with netherite zombies, but kill them and claim the netherite. They bribe a shop owner for info, then follow who they believe to be the Director, but it's actually MrCube. The Director gives Parrot two weeks to find his identity, then tries to kill him, but he is saved by Jumper. Jumper brings them to her base, where they stay for a while, and after Parrot believes one of BAT betrayed, Leo tries to kill him, blaming him for all the bad things that have happened. title: The End Civilization
content:
The End Civilization was a civilization created by ParrotX2, Wifies and deanthebean9, before subsequently being conquered by The Invisible Mafia.

History
Parrot and Wifies try to create a civilization in the end. They see that a player has been following them. They pop the totem of the person underground and find that it’s deanthebean9. He says he’s a part of the Mafia. They recruit him as a member in their civilization. They move villagers into their civilization. Players from the Mafia find them and start trying to kill them. They are able to escape.

Parrot hires Horace_Altman to build the civilization. They finish bringing the villagers and see Horace made a giant island. Parrot goes into the Mafia’s base to get deanthebean9 out of his stasis chamber. They are successful in getting him out.

Parrot breaks his bed in the overworld and goes back into the end. For some reason he now cannot leave the end. Parrot logs on the next day and sees Horace moved the entire island 100 blocks down. A couple of members join the civilization. Horace builds a giant castle at the civilization. He also builds outposts near spawn. Boosfer comes over and tries to take over the civilization. Horace sets up chunk bans around the civilization.

What_Max goes to an outpost to join the civilization, but finds that the Mafia is there. The civilization helps him escape, but Parrot almost dies.

Horace greatly expands the empire. Wifies shows Parrot that he found a giant crater near their base. Boosfer talks more about how he’ll run against Parrot. Fantst and LettuceK tell Parrot that there are invisible players circling around the chunk bans. The Mafia send multiple bomber planes, but the civilization is able to stop them. Parrot tells them in the meeting room that they are unable to leave the end if they don’t have a bed in the overworld.

Horace builds a giant dome around the civilization. Boosfer, Kier, and Dev come over for the election. Boosfer is unsuccessful in winning the election. He tries to leave but gets chunk banned.

Deanthebean9 tells Parrot that yesterday an invisible player got into the civilization. A new bomber plane is sent to destroy the civilization. The mole from the Mafia is able to turn off the chunk bans. After the Mafia invades, all of the members of the civilization run away.

Parrot and his friends try to explode the civilization.

The Mafia reskins the civilization to be mafia themed. They use the civilization to imprison the members of the Warriors District.

title: The End of the Minecraft Mafia
content:
The End of the Minecraft Mafia is the 27th episode featured in Unstable Universe. This marks the finale of Season 1, as well as the end of Spoke's perspective on Season 1.  

Plot
The video begins with Spoke and Mapicc at Square City, warning Cash about the Mafia attacking them. Cash ridicules them and tells them that the last thing his citizens would worry about is The Mafia running around and dismisses Spoke and Mapicc. Nico tells Cash that they are under attack and gets killed by an iron trimmed player. The iron trimmed player tries to kill Cash but gets his statis pulled. Cash thinks he defeated The Mafia but Ash walks into Cash's house and tells him that "everyone will be Mafia soon" and orders the gold trimmed player to kill Cash. The gold trimmed player tells Ash that Spoke and Mapicc are hiding on the roof and Spoke and Mapicc flee from Square city. Mapicc suggests that they use MinuteTech's trap but Spoke tells Mapicc that he's going to use his own instead. Mapicc asks Spoke if its the oak tree with flowers all around it and Spoke tells Mapicc that it used to be under a dark oak tree but he messed it up. Spoke and Mapicc get attacked by 2 diamond players who find and trigger his trap because of how obvious it is. They find MinuteTech's escape route which is a void trap. Mapicc tells Spoke the coordinates of the way out of the void trap and end up in a cave. 

Spoke tells Mapicc that they need to find coordinates to the other civilizations so they visit Squiddo to ask her for the coordinates of the other civilizations in Ash's desire board. Spoke also explains how the Mafia works to Squiddo and she gives them the coordinates to Sleepy Nation. While they fly there MinuteTech follows them. While exploring Sleepy Nation they get jumped by invisible players, however it turns out that the invisible players were Hannah and im_a_squid_kid. Spoke and Mapicc meet up with Wallibear. Wallibear tells them that their stashes were overrun by The Mafia and that half of their soldiers are dead. Spoke tells Hannah and Squid about the news and they all steal the items in the stash back from The Mafia. While they were on their way to return to Wallibear they find out that the place was all blown up and they see Ash and a diamond player. They make fun of Spoke, Mapicc and Minute and they also tell him that Wallibear is in the Mafia now. They go back to Sleepy Nation to warn Hannah and Squid that the Mafia is coming and they show them an alternate exit, however Hannah and Squid wear gold trimmed chestplates, pot up and jump them. Spoke tries to kill them but Minute tells them that they were forced into the Mafia and tell them not to kill them. They escape Sleepy Nation and Spoke has an argument with Minute. Minute leaves and Mapicc gets upset at Spoke for sending him off. They visit Squiddo again but they get jumped by the same two diamond players and an iron player. Baconnwaffles blows up Squiddo's castle and they escape using Squiddo's void escape route.

Spoke and Mapicc check up on spawn only to find Mafia players destroying it. They fly away and spot Parrot and Wifies, they discuss about the desire board and Spoke assumes that the same place where he killed iMajesticRose was The Withered. Parrot, Wifies Spoke and Mapicc go to that location and find a diamond player destroying the house. They follow the diamond player and find a guy named Quackenstein. They intimidate Quackenstein but then later stop because they feel bad for him. Quackenstein tours them around the house and he also shows them a memorial for Rose. Spoke regrets killing rose. Parrot and WIfies leave the house. Spoke spends some time with Becky going fishing when Quackenstein meets them and Spoke promises to protect them. Quackenstein tells them to build a mountain over his town.

Spoke and Mapicc head to the end to get obsidian from the pillars until they spot Ash. They try to escape the end until Ash notices that there are people breaking blocks under him. He realizes that the people breaking blocks are Spoke and Mapicc and he calls them out to scare them. He also says that everything Spoke loves is now destroyed by the Mafia. A diamond trimmed player finds Spoke and Mapicc's hole and they attempt to kill them until Spoke and Mapicc escape. Spoke and Mapicc notice that Becky and Quackenstein are missing so they search for them until they find a staircase in Quackenstein's house that leads to a diamond player set along with a mace. They notice Quackenstein entering the room and they confront him. Spoke threatens to kill Quackenstein and he says that he actually met Rose and Becky before and that he feels better for killing Rose and Mapicc tells Spoke to stop and compares him to Ash. Quackenstein and Mapicc tell Spoke to put his mace down and Quackenstein tells him his backstory after Spoke puts his mace down.

At first it was just him and Rose. They travelled hundreds of thousands of blocks away from the server's initial problems (presumably Zam Empire or ClownPierce). Him and Rose were building houses and castles until one day a player named Ashswagg invited them join his team. He promised that if they built castles for him and joined the Invisible Mafia they would protect them and give them infinite resources. Quackenstein was suspicious initially but Rose saw this as a great opportunity to build so they agreed. After they finished building this castle it was being used as a statis chamber to torment the members. Ash told them not to write down the coordinates of the statis chamber however Quackenstein did write down the coordinates of the monument. After Quackenstein found out what the statis chamber was really about he assembled a team to try to take it down however, it was already destroyed. After Ash found out what happened, that's when Rose died. Spoke realizes that he has been hiding and that's why he has no invis and in iron armour. Quackenstein gives Spoke a book called "Mafia Eyes" that is signed by Ashswagg. Spoke then apologizes to Quackenstein for killing Rose. He explains that while he was infiltrating the Mafia he was put on a mission to kill Rose and that was why he killed her. Spoke and Mapicc say goodbye to Becky before leaving and they tell Parrot and Wifies that they found a potential lead to the statis chamber.

Parrot invites them to District 13 where Spoke shows everyone the book. Parrot sends Spoke out to destroy the stasis chamber. Spoke and Mapicc notice a giant crater. They try to find something until Mapicc finds a chest. The chest contains a book called "The Gateway" which is also signed by Ash and the contents of the book are "<" and ">" signs. They don't know what it means so they go back to District 13 to tell them about it. They also don't understand what the book means and they get upset at Spoke. After an argument Spoke gets kicked out of District 13 and he almost gives up until he finds a massive obsidian box that's way bigger than the one they were building when they met Parrot. They then return to District 13 to tell Parrot about the spawn prison and they head to spawn to plan how they are going to break in. Wemmbu and Eggchan distract the guards while Parrot, Spoke and Mapicc break in by setting their spawn, going to the end and going into the portal and into the prison. They find a room with an iron door where they throw a pearl but they don't realize it's purpose yet. They also find Wato as one of the guards. Parrot, Wato, Spoke and Mapicc go back to the room where pearls are being thrown and they follow it and find sandstone halls. They get spotted by a diamond player and they get chased by them. While hiding from the diamond player, Mapicc realizes that the book with "<" and ">" signs.

Spoke and Mapicc begin going through the directions of the book while being chased by Mafia players until they find what appears to be a dead end until they mine through the walls and find a tunnel. The tunnel leads to a pearl cannon where they throw the pearls and it sends them to where it would lead to. The pearl cannon teleports them to what looks like the middle of nowhere until they see a huge man made mountain. They think back to what Quackenstein said about building a mountain over his town and realize that the statis chamber may be inside the mountain. They find a castle with all the Mafia statis chamber pearls. They find one with Mapicc's name in it (with no pearl), one with Squiddo's name and one with Wifies' name. They accidentally pull one of their statises and it turns out that they are a no trimmed Mafia player. The no trimmed guy wanders around while Spoke and Mapicc follows him. A diamond player spots him and maces him. They find the exit and tell Parrot and Wemmbu about the statis chamber. Parrot suggests that Spoke mines the soul sand in the void so that the pearls fall in the void however they get jumped by multiple Mafia members. After the fight, Parrot tells Spoke to destroy the stasis chamber while Wemmbu, Eggchan and Wato distract ClownPierce. After arriving there they notice that the diamond players are suspicious. Spoke falls into the void and realizes he forgot a shovel. Spoke crafts an iron shovel and realize that it's not that good. Spoke eventually runs out of fireworks and Mapicc pulls his statis to save him.

Mapicc gives Spoke a shovel good enough to destroy the stasis chamber along with a ton of fireworks and Spoke makes it back into the void to destroy more statis pearls. Spoke mines out an entire section of pearls. The video begins with [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and [[Mapicc]] at Square City, warning Cash about the Mafia attacking them. Cash ridicules them and tells them that the last thing his citizens would worry about is The Mafia running around and dismisses Spoke and Mapicc. Nico tells Cash that they are under attack and gets killed by an iron trimmed player. The iron trimmed player tries to kill Cash but gets his statis pulled. Cash thinks he defeated The Mafia but Ash walks into Cash's house and tells him that "everyone will be Mafia soon" and orders the gold trimmed player to kill Cash. The gold trimmed player tells Ash that Spoke and Mapicc are hiding on the roof and Spoke and Mapicc flee from Square city. Mapicc suggests that they use MinuteTech's trap but Spoke tells Mapicc that he's going to use his own instead. Mapicc asks Spoke if its the oak tree with flowers all around it and Spoke tells Mapicc that it used to be under a dark oak tree but he messed it up. Spoke and Mapicc get attacked by 2 diamond players who find and trigger his trap because of how obvious it is. They find MinuteTech's escape route which is a void trap. Mapicc tells Spoke the coordinates of the way out of the void trap and end up in a cave. 

Spoke tells Mapicc that they need to find coordinates to the other civilizations so they visit Squiddo to ask her for the coordinates of the other civilizations in Ash's desire board. Quackenstein and Mapicc tell Spoke to put his mace down and Quackenstein tells him his backstory after Spoke puts his mace down.
