title: The Fake Identity Arc
content:
The Fake Identity Arc is the third Wemmbu arc in Unstable Universe Season 2.

 Story 
Bored with the server, Wemmbu decides to fake his death and take on a new identity. He heads to Capital City 2.0, the biggest current civilization, and joins the guard force there. While on guard, Boosfer kills a random player, so Wemmbu fights him, accidentally breaking a treaty between Boosfer's group of bandits and Capital City. The guard force fights the bandits, and Wemmbu is forced to use his mace against Boosfer, scaring off the bandits. He pursues them to their base and reveals his identity, killing everyone but Boosfer and Boomie, whom he reoslves to hunt down.

Wemmbu joins up with Jaden MAN, who's going on an expedition to the Great Sea, which Boosfer mentioned. They fight the Ocean Rangers, then head off to an island, then fight them again and get captured. Wemmbu manages to get them both out, though, and they manage to find Boomie. However, ParrotX2 saves Boomie, forcing Wemmbu to follow them across the ocean until they finally stop. He kills Boomie and leaves, returning to Jaden. They go to the Ocean Rangers' base, where Wemmbu duels LobsterMan, their leader, and kills him, revealing his name. He makes Jaden promise not to tell anyone, then flies of to hunt Boosfer.

Wemmbu visits the End, and Egg tells him Boosfer's teamed with Flame now. Wemmbu also meets Salvationism again, the guard captain from Capital City. They put together a group to try and kill Boosfer, but fail. Salvationism decides to build a massive void trap, which fails to kill Boosfer or Flame. He and the entire guard force die in the resulting battle, but Wemmbu convinces Flame to help him kill Boosfer. Boosfer escapes through a Nether portal, and Wemmbu follows him.

On the other side is a void trap, and they both fall through. Instead of dying, though, they land in a mysterious world and are separated. Wemmbu finds a tower and brews potions, then gets attacked by some of the world's inhabitants. He and Boosfer are both imprisoned, but Wemmbu convinces Boosfer to give him his mace and a couple ender pearls, which he uses to kill the guard and escape. They head for the void hole, but the other players are already there guarding it. Boosfer gets through and is able to gear up Wemmbu, who kills three more people before they escape. He returns Boosfer's mace and promises to spare him if Boosfer never reveals his identity.

Wemmbu is accused of crimes he didn’t commit, and learns someone is impersonating him. He visits Egg and warns him, then visits Boosfer and finds the impostor already there. They fight but escape. Wemmbu learns a trial is being held in Capital City, and attends. He gets trapped with mining fatigue and fights two impostors, popping their totems to reveal Parrot and TheobaldTheBird. Despite their best efforts, though, Wemmbu escapes.

Parrot and Theo show up, and Wemmbu chases them down a tunnel before being trapped in BAT Headquarters. He fights Theo while trying to escape, and forces Parrot to use his escape method before escaping himself. Theo follows him, and they fight around the destroyed base before Wemmbu finally runs out of equipment and uses BAT's pearl cannon. However, Parrot planned for that, and now Wemmbu is trapped again. Parrot explains that he was hired by Flame to do this, and Flame shows up. While trying to escape, Wemmbu reveals his identity. He knocks Parrot into the void and attacks Flame.

Wemmbu and Flame fight until The Law show up. They escape and alternate between fighting each other and the Law, which keeps following them, before finally escaping and gearing up at Flame’s base. They attack LettuceK in Law City, and Wemmbu proposes a fight between them and every single Law member, to which Lettuce agrees. Flame and Wemmbu get actually geared up, with EXP and potions, then head off to fight Lettuce’s army. Lettuce brings a thousand players, and Flame and Wemmbu fight and kill every single one of them, including one skilled mace wielder. They have one final battle, and Wemmbu gives up his title as the strongest player to Flame, then throws away the extra mace he got. Lettuce picks it up and threatens Wemmbu, who's almost out of gear. This leads directly into The Kings Arc.

title: The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadliest Vault
content:
The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadlist Vault is the 78th episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Parrot's goal for this episode is to get to a secret, mysterious vault within the Nether, which is currently monopolized and controlled by the "King of the Nether" — ClownPierce, who kills unauthorized players on sight if they are seen in the Nether. However, every few months, Clown hosts a festival in the Nether that everyone is allowed to attend, and Parrot uses this as an opportunity to find this hidden vault.

Parrot and Theo enter the Nether and, by sheer coincidence, run into Clown and FerreMC — his right-hand man— who immediately gives chase. Clown warns Ferre that the newcomers aren't there for the festival, but for the treasure inside his vault. The duo manages to escape without a particularly difficult fight and then proceeds to set up several traps and a small shelter. They craft shields with ClownPierce's banner pattern on them to blend in with his guards to not get caught.

However, Parrot encounters FlameFrags who demands to know why he is carrying Clown's shield. Parrot doesn't answer, and is pursued. The traps only manage to slow down Flame before eventually reaching the base, where Parrot bluffs that the entire place is rigged to blow at the break of a single block. It's revealed that Flame is in the Nether with the goal of killing Clown, and the three form a flimsy alliance. Heading to the festival, Flame burns an innocent shop owner's enchanted golden apple (his favorite item) and then refuses to recover it. While he and Theo go to investigate the festival, Parrot takes it upon himself to recover the enchanted golden apple. He wins one from another player by perfectly completing a 10-question quiz on Minecraft mechanics.

Parrot devises a plan: they will kidnap Ferre from Clown's fortress and interrogate him to find the coordinates of the vault. Infiltrating the fortress with invisibility potions, Theo and Flame try to break Ferre's armor to force him to come with them, but he activates an alarm, alerting the fortress of intruders. Parrot slips past the guards and Clown, who are searching the massive fortress, and finds the panel used to enter the deactivation PIN. Parrot breaks the mechanism, but Clown realizes that an outsider has disabled the alarm. They decide to check the top floors, where the fight with Ferre is taking place. To buy them time, Parrot pulls a lever that activates the Mining Fatigue effect throughout the lower levels. From the outside, Parrot makes his way to the roof. The building is so enormous that it takes him a full minute to arrive, but once he does, he blows a hole in the wall with TNT which Ferre is extracted and taken to the trio's temporary base.

They question him, but he refuses to give up the vault's coordinates. However, Parrot has a secret plan; he secretly places some random items and maps into Ferre's inventory, then giving him an elytra in exchange for revealing the coordinates of the vault. Instead, Ferre simply flees, and the team blames Parrot for being "stupid", even attempting to kill him. Parrot reveals his true plan to Theo and Flame, among the items he gave Ferre, Parrot had slipped in a locator map. Now, the original map that Parrot holds will show the location of Ferre, who is holding the copy, as long as he is within the map's range. The three track him to an open plain, hoping that someone else will follow Ferre to the vault, assuming Ferre is going there to get new items.

While they take shifts watching for passersby, Theo pulls Parrot aside and asks if there is any situation in which someone could outsmart him. Parrot replies that it's possible and once again lists the types of people on the server. "There are those who want to have fun, those who want to build, those who want to farm, those who want to explore, those who want to rule over others, but also those who want everything for themselves. And if there's such a person, who has nothing to lose and somehow decides they want the entire server, they will take it, and there will be nothing to stop them!"

"Don't treat him like a god," Theo scolds. But Parrot speaks the truth: "FlameFrags is such a person. He has done so many evil things, but in my opinion, he doesn't have the capacity to become the absolute ruler of the server. But if he decided to, no one could successfully stand in his way."

The two then move away so FlameFrags (who is AFK) won't overhear them. After their dialogue, they return, only to be surprised that he is gone.

This leads to a dramatic monologue from Parrot: "I always want to make the server a better place, but I think I'm always the one messing things up. There is no way FlameFrags can be a good person after all he has done, but is it right for me to use him for my own goals? What I did was definitively not a good thing, despite the fact that it was for the good of the server."

Shortly after, ClownPierce, along with FlameFrags who has revealed their location, attacks Parrot and Theo. They surrender after less than a minute of fighting. Flame tells Parrot that he heard everything and could no longer be on a team with him. "Why did you team up with Clown?!" Parrot asks in disbelief. "Because in exchange, he said he would tell me what happened to Wemmbu!" Flame replies. "And how could you trust Clown?" Parrot continues to question him. ClownPierce intervenes: "How do you think I know what happened to Wemmbu? I've been in the Nether this entire time!" Clown gives Parrot a chance to say his last words. Parrot apologizes to Flame and awaits his death. "You two are coming with us," ClownPierce decides, planning to abduct them.

But then, FlameFrags stands his ground: "If you want to take them, you'll have to go through me first!" This is considered by many to be one of the most heroic moments on the server.

FlameFrags and Theo hold off ClownPierce's army while Parrot heads for the treasure. After some time, the villain appears, tampers with a redstone mechanism, and then leaves. Parrot presses a button, and a tunnel opens, leading straight into the massive vault. It is built as a pool of lava containing many bastions, with walls made of obsidian. The shape of the vault is a massive cuboid.

Parrot begins to look through the chests, but ClownPierce's voice speaks from behind him: "How dare you enter my vault? There is no escape now!"

Parrot is pursued and flees using the elytra Theo gave him earlier. A chase begins in the gigantic, but relatively low-ceilinged, space. As he flies from bastion to bastion, our hero loots as many chests as he can. In one of them are stacks of chorus fruit, which Parrot grabs and uses. By some chance, he teleports into an obsidian box housing the elder guardians—the mobs that inflict the Mining Fatigue effect. Parrot gets out, throws some items from his inventory, but as he drops his flint and steel into the lava, he realizes he could have used it to light a Nether portal to escape safely to the Overworld. However, in another chest, there is another flint and steel, which Parrot takes and later uses to exit the vault via the Overworld.

When he returns to Capitol City, Theo is surprised to see him still alive. FlameFrags enters the potion shop. This time, he doesn't want to steal or buy anything. Instead, he gives Parrot a task that he claims "only he can accomplish." Parrot says he will do it out of the goodness of his heart, not because he wants something in return.

"You must find the Mafia's tomb. There's a truly massive treasure there!" - Flame insists.

Parrot recalls all the dramatic moments from the Great War. Without much hesitation, he agrees. But FlameFrags adds a condition: in exchange, Parrot must find out what happened to Wemmbu.

'''The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadlist Vault''' is the 78th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Plot ==
[[ParrotX2|Parrot's]] goal for this episode is to get to a secret, mysterious vault within the Nether, which is currently monopolized and controlled by the "King of the Nether" — [[ClownPierce]], who kills unauthorized players on sight if they are seen in the Nether. However, every few months, Clown hosts a festival in the Nether that everyone is allowed to attend, and Parrot uses this as an opportunity to find this hidden vault.

Parrot and [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]] enter the Nether and, by sheer coincidence, run into Clown and [[FerreMC]] — his right-hand man— who immediately gives chase. Clown warns Ferre that the newcomers aren't there for the festival, but for the treasure inside his vault. The duo manages to escape without a particularly difficult fight and then proceeds to set up several traps and a small shelter. They craft shields with ClownPierce's banner pattern on them to blend in with his guards to not get caught.

However, Parrot encounters [[FlameFrags]] who demands to know why he is carrying Clown's shield. Parrot doesn't answer, and is pursued. The traps only manage to slow down Flame before eventually reaching the base, where Parrot bluffs that the entire place is rigged to blow at the break of a single block. It's revealed that Flame is in the Nether with the goal of killing Clown, and the three form a flimsy alliance. Heading to the festival, Flame burns an innocent shop owner's enchanted golden apple (his favorite item) and then refuses to recover it. While he and Theo go to investigate the festival, Parrot takes it upon himself to recover the enchanted golden apple. He wins one from another player by perfectly completing a 10-question quiz on Minecraft mechanics.

Infiltrating the fortress with invisibility potions, Theo and Flame try to break Ferre's armor to force him to come with them, but he activates an alarm, alerting the fortress of intruders. Parrot slips past the guards and Clown, who are searching the massive fortress, and finds the panel used to enter the deactivation PIN. Parrot breaks the mechanism, but Clown realizes that an outsider has disabled the alarm. They decide to check the top floors, where the fight with Ferre is taking place. To buy them time, Parrot pulls a lever that activates the Mining Fatigue effect throughout the lower levels. From the outside, Parrot makes his way to the roof. The building is so enormous that it takes him a full minute to arrive, but once he does, he blows a hole in the wall with TNT which Ferre is extracted and taken to the trio's temporary base.

title: The Invisible Mafia
content:
The Invisible Mafia was one of the main antagonistic factions in Unstable Universe. It was a large and powerful authoritarian group led and owned by Ashswagg. 

 Structure 

Leadership
The Mafia Leader, Ashswagg, commanded all the players in the faction. He initiated hits and where members would go. He was not invisible, talks, and didn't wear armor. It was said that if he did die, the stasis chamber of everyone in the mafia would activate, killing them in the void. According to MinuteTech, the Mafia used to have a different leader who was less cruel. 
Hierarchy
The Mafia’s hierarchy was based around the color of your armor trims. The highest ranking members had diamond trims, and were tasked with the most important jobs. The better the material that the trim is made of, the higher ranking the member was, with no trim being the lowest tier. 

The majority of the Mafia were new players who don’t know much about the server. It was later revealed that after killing a player, unranked players were given the choice to either "leave" the Mafia or to rank up to Copper. If a player chose to leave, their stasis would be pulled and they would be killed in the void. 

When a player killed another player, their name appeared in the chat, revealing their identity. It was one of the only times when their identity was allowed to be shared. When a mafia member killed another player, they could rank up, and become anonymous again, unless they were a diamond trim mafia player.

Rankings and Armor Trims
Full Article: The Invisible Mafia Members

Each member of the mafia wore a netherite chestplate. Depending on the rank of the soldier, the chestplate was trimmed with the eye-armor trim, where the material of the trim decides the rank of the player.

For an Iron player, a Copper player or an untrimmed player to rank up, they needed to successfully complete 3 tasks/missions which were given by Gold trimmed mafia members.

For a Gold trim to rank up to a Diamond trim and get the mace, they needed to schedule a duel and beat a Diamond trim in a 1v1 to the death, overseen by Ashswag. If the gold trim succeeded in killing the diamond, both their usernames would show in chat, and the gold player’s ender pearl in the stasis would be moved into the separate and unique stasis chamber away from the other players, replacing the dead former diamond trim. This means that the amount of diamond trims would never increase, and that the gold trim needed to actually be a part of the mafia. 

All diamond trimmed mafia members had a mace, except for FlameFrags, who disliked maces.

Diamond trim players were usually the players who lead attacks to destroy civilizations on the server, and were often accompanied by gold trim players.

Special trims like netherite or redstone trims were picked out by Ash, as the only netherite trim we've seen has been ClownPierce, and the only Redstone trim has been FerreMC. 

The copper player are the second lowest ranking members in the mafia (the others being trimless, Iron, Gold and Diamond) they don't have a lot of resources to help them in battle. They each have full netherite gear with a copper eye trim on their chestplates though. The players R4trick and Finiahn left District 13 to go into the Mafia as copper players. To become a copper player, you have to kill a player who is not in the Mafia. The Mafia was created by Ashwagg and if a player doesn't do what Ashwagg tells them to do, they get killed. 

The Iron Mafia Players are the third lowest tier of The Mafia besides Copper and trimless(The two above being Gold and Diamond). To become a Iron Mafia Player, you must complete missions that you got from the "Higher Ups". Each Iron Mafia Player had full netherite armor with a Iron eye trim on their chestplates. Each member of The Iron Players got some windcharges and colored firework rockets so people can tell their part of the Mafia. 

On the Unstable SMP, Diamond Ranked Mafia Members are the highest rank in the Invisible Mafia, all of them, excluding FlameFrags, had a Mace. To become a Diamond Ranked Mafia Members, you have to kill another Diamond Rank, this was implemented so Ashswagg wouldn’t have to try and get new Maces. 
RankingThe Mafia LeaderRedstoneNetheriteDiamond Gold Iron Copper Untrimmed
Practices 

Each active member was made to throw a ender pearl into a tunnel of bubble columns leading to a heavily guarded large stasis chamber by trusted diamond players only. Their stasis was set in a stasis chamber, and if the stasis chamber was mined under so that once the stasis was pulled (activated), the player fell into the void, died, and got banned off of the server. This meant that if a mafia member was seen visible by other mafia members or by allies of the mafia and reported, they would teleport into the void and be killed. For this reason, mafia members did not carry any totems of undying, because if it popped, their invisibility would be removed and they would get killed anyways. This method of control was how the Mafia took over the server. It was later revealed that Ashswagg still had the enderpearl's of all former members in The Mafia Tomb. If any resources were taken from The Tomb, all former members of The Invisible Mafia would be killed meaning that The Mafia still technically exists.
Fireworks were used to signal the Mafia to or from an area/player. White fireworks called the Mafia away, black fireworks signaled the Mafia to an area to kill a player, and red fireworks signaled the start of a mission.
If Ashswagg died all members of the Invisible Mafia would be teleported to their statis chambers and would be killed in the void with him. This prevented any attempts to end the mafia by killing Ashswagg. 

 History 

 Season 1 
Spoke and Mapicc go to a raid farm as they plan to stop all farms from working to get rid of lag, and see three invisible players. They almost die to the invisible players, but ashswagg comes and tells the invisible players to leave, and they oblige. Ashswagg says he doesn’t know the players.

Spoke and Mapicc go to TheRealSquiddo’s house. Under the floor, they find a bunch of books with coordinates. Ashswagg finds Spoke and Mapicc and says that he wants to team with them.

Jepexx is seen at his villager trading hall. Spoke and Mapicc splash the villagers invisible and pretend they are dead. Jepexx also shows them their panda farm, but then a group of invisible players come and try to kill Jepexx. They yell out for ashswagg to stop, and all the invisible players run away. Ashswagg says that he was just trying to help them.

Spoke and Mapicc break a couple more farms. They find that Ashswagg completely obliterated the coordinates to farms that they gave to him.

They go to the next farm and find two invisible players destroying it with TNT. He pops one of their totems and it reveals they are USmellLikeUpdog. Ash teleports USmellLikeUpdog into the void, banning him because he stated ashswagg was the leader. Mapicc leaves because he doesn’t trust ashswagg. Spoke meets ashswagg at the next farm.

He gives ashswagg the rest of the coordinates to the farms. Ashswagg uses a fishing rod to teleport away.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the next farm, which is a flower farm. They see Roshambogames and PlanetLord there. Ashswagg destroys the entire farm with TNT. Mapicc says he saw invisible people leaving, implying this was ashswagg. They go to the other farms and see ashswagg destroyed all of them. They go to the last farm, which is an EOL farm. They make it there before ashswagg destroyed it. Mapicc leaves so Spoke can talk to ashswagg. 

Ashswagg tells him that, since Spoke was the one at every farm, everyone will think he destroyed them. Ashswagg tries to convince him to give him exploits he knows about, but Spoke says no. They find a lot of invisible players who try to kill them. Spoke and Mapicc are able to escape. A player finds them in the nether named MinuteTech. MinuteTech saves them and reveals he was once part of the Mafia.

Spoke and Mapicc follow him back to his base. They show MinuteTech their base at spawn. They get attacked underground by the Mafia. MinuteTech kills one of the Mafia members using a mace. They manage to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord at Jepexx’s old villager trading hall. The Mafia comes over and tries to kill them. They trap the Mafia players using a sand trap, though none of them die. They are able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc try to prove to ManePear that there are invisible players attacking them, but ManePear decides to try and kill Spoke and Mapicc. They are able to escape. The Mafia starts attacking them. They are able to escape again.

The Mafia tries to kill Spoke and Mapicc. Spoke is able to escape, but Mapicc is captured. PlanetLord introduces Baconnwaffles0 and TheRealSquiddo to MinuteTech. A Mafia member named BobDaGreenFrog tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills them. The Mafia starts trying to kill them. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, to which MinuteTech replies "no". The Mafia continues attacking them. Spoke is able to escape, though he almost dies.

TheRealSquiddo shows the team some coordinates that she was given that could be the coordinates to a Mafia outpost. She also states that everybody in the master builders group has disappeared. She also states she was commissioned to do a build by an anonymous player.

The team goes over to the outpost and find a lot of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after being handed a book.

Spoke and PlanetLord try to dupe, but realize that it doesn’t work anymore. Ashswagg comes in and reveals that all the glitches and exploits were patched, and that Jamato told him so. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech was working for him, and orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. Spoke and PlanetLord escape.

Spoke and PlanetLord go under one of the Wonders where they put weaponless mobs. They find that the mobs are named coordinates. They find a replica of Jamato’s base made out of wood at the coordinates, and all of the glitched features have been removed. He finds a book stating that if anyone is reading it, he is captured or dead. It states he exiled himself, that he has been hunted by the Mafia, that he was captured in an outpost, and that an item can fix everything. They find a compass that is named "The Mafia".

Following the compass, they find a Mafia outpost. They find Mafia members in a room. They go above the players and drop dripstone on them, killing one of the players and using the totem of undying of another player named Leow0ok. The outpost starts exploding to TNT. Leow0ok agrees to team with them. They follow a member of the Mafia to Mafia City, where there are different tiers of Mafia members. They find Mapicc in a prison and break him out.

The End Civilization is taken over by the Mafia.

Ashswagg tries to force Parrot to join the Mafia in Capital City, but Parrot escapes using a stasis chamber. The Mafia starts trying to kill them.

Spoke and his team is now tasked with getting diamonds. Ashswagg promotes them to gold tier. They go over to Baconnwaffles for a mission. Baconnwaffles says they are betraying the Mafia, so they destroy his base. They go over to Reddoons at capital city and trade.

Spoke and his team is given the task of getting an elytra. They are able to find nine elytra in the Zam empire. Wemmbu finds a Mafia member and starts killing them, but realizes it is eggchan. They are promoted to iron after giving ashswagg the elytra. They are then tasked with building redstone machines. They sabotage the other opponents and win.

Spoke and his team are tasked with killing Parrot but fail.

They are tasked with killing PlanetLord, but they do not kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the members until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Spoke is personally tasked by Ash with killing IMajesticRose to show that he is not a coward. He obliges and kills her with dripstone. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. He fights a diamond player to become diamond. Spoke’s totem of undying is used, revealing to ashswagg that he is Spoke. They try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he is MinuteTech.

Parrot goes on a mission with the warriors to kill a diamond tier player in Mafia city. They retreat from the fight.

The Far Lands discovers that there are Mafia players near the farlands. They find a gold tier player in the nether who is able to escape. They intercept the gold tier player when he is giving his message to ashswagg. They pretend to be diamond tier players, and then kill him with a fall trap.

Parrot sees the mafia sending a bunch of TNT bomber planes heading towards spawn. He uses the totem of undying of one of the Mafia members, revealing it is deanthebean9. Deanthebean9 is teleported into the void and dies.

The Mafia destroys the Far Lands. Horace Altman and the five other players who are still alive create a new civilization against the Mafia named District 13

The Mafia destroys Skyblock Civilization.

Spoke goes over to the Square Civilization to warn Cash that the Mafia is going to break into their civilization and destroy it. Cash doesn’t listen and everyone in the civilization dies. Spoke warns the Sleepy Nation that the Mafia is going to try to kill them. They take back their items that were stolen from the Mafia. The leaders of sleepy nation reveal that they are part of the Mafia.

Spoke and Mapicc go over to TheRealSquiddo to try and find the coordinates of "The Withered". The Mafia destroys her castle. 

The Mafia begins tearing down spawn to construct a prison to force people to join the Mafia. Spoke and Mapicc go to spawn where they see Parrot and Wifies. They agree to team up to try and end the Mafia. They show Parrot and Wifies the area where they killed iMajesticRose. They find a diamond tier Mafia player and follow them. They find a village where there is a player in iron armor named Quackenstein123 who claims to be the father of iMajesticRose.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the end to get obsidian. They are able to escape the Mafia who are trying to kill them in the end. They go back to Quackenstein123's base and find a secret staircase underneath it. They find a stash of loot, including the diamond tier player's armor, and a mace, proving that they are the diamond tier player. The player comes into the vault. Quackenstein123 gives them a book which are coordinates to where all the stasis chambers are stored. He shows Parrot this book, and Parrot invites him to District 13.

Spoke and Mapicc check the coordinates and find a chest containing a book called "THE GATEWAY" which appears to contain directions to something. They show the members of District 13 the book. The members are disappointed so Spoke and Mapicc leave.

Parrot and Wifies build a house in a snowy biome. Ashswagg finds them and tries to force them to join the mafia. He gives them 10 minutes to decide. Wifies joins the mafia for Parrot.

Spoke, Parrot, and Mapicc break into a spawn prison. This is where they get new members. Their plan is to follow wherever pearls are thrown all the way to the main stasis chamber area. They find an area where guards transport the pearls. They find a pearl cannon and use it to get teleported millions of blocks out, where they find a man-made mountain. Inside of the mountain is where every stasis chamber is stored. The place is heavily guarded by diamond players.

Spoke tells Parrot about how he found all of the Mafia’s stasis chambers.

Ashswagg "kills" Wifies in front of Parrot by dropping him into the void, but it is later revealed that Wifies faked his death.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the void and start destroying every stasis chamber while Wemmbu and his team distracts ClownPierce and Ferre by fighting him. The diamond tier players try to kill Spoke in the void, but using chorus fruit, Spoke is able to escape and traps the two diamond players in the void. Both of them die when they run out of fireworks. The Mafia's statis chambers are destroyed. Parrot sends one last beacon signal to the resistance cells and all Mafia members begin drinking milk, ending the mafia.

 Season 2 
Rejoicin says that he was a guard protecting a spire from the Mafia.

VEN0M was a former diamond trim, who was eventually killed by Flame.

Although The Mafia has since been defeated, the Tomb of the Mafia still exists, containing all resources from the server along with stasis chambers for every former Mafia member, which kill all Mafia members if anything is taken. This means that the Mafia still technically exists despite its official dissolution. It is guarded by Marlowww, who was ranked number one in the world on mctiers. Her main goal is to guard the tomb with lethal force.

[[The Invisible Mafia]] was one of the main antagonistic factions in ''[[Unstable Universe]]''. It was a large and powerful authoritarian group led and owned by [[Ashswagg]]. 

== Structure ==

===Leadership===
The Mafia Leader, Ashswagg, commanded all the players in the faction. He initiated hits and where members would go. He was not invisible, talks, and didn't wear armor. It was said that if he did die, the stasis chamber of everyone in the mafia would activate, killing them in the void. According to [[MinuteTech]], the Mafia used to have a different leader who was less cruel. 
===Hierarchy===
The Mafia’s hierarchy was based around the color of your armor trims. The highest ranking members had diamond trims, and were tasked with the most important jobs. The better the material that the trim is made of, the higher ranking the member was, with no trim being the lowest tier. 

The majority of the Mafia were new players who don’t know much about the server. It was later revealed that after killing a player, unranked players were given the choice to either "leave" the Mafia or to rank up to Copper. If a player chose to leave, their stasis would be pulled and they would be killed in the void. 

When a player killed another player, their name appeared in the chat, revealing their identity. It was one of the only times when their identity was allowed to be shared. When a mafia member killed another player, they could rank up, and become anonymous again, unless they were a diamond trim mafia player.

===Rankings and Armor Trims===
''Full Article: [[The Invisible Mafia Members]]''

Each member of the mafia wore a netherite chestplate. Depending on the rank of the soldier, the chestplate was trimmed with the eye-armor trim, where the material of the trim decides the rank of the player.

For an Iron player, a Copper player or an untrimmed player to rank up, they needed to successfully complete 3 tasks/missions which were given by Gold trimmed mafia members.

For a Gold trim to rank up to a Diamond trim and get the mace, they needed to schedule a duel and beat a Diamond trim in a 1v1 to the death, overseen by Ashswag. If the gold trim succeeded in killing the diamond, both their usernames would show in chat, and the gold player’s ender pearl in the stasis would be moved into the separate and unique stasis chamber away from the other players, replacing the dead former diamond trim. This means that the amount of diamond trims would never increase, and that the gold trim needed to actually be a part of the mafia. 

All diamond trimmed mafia members had a mace, except for [[FlameFrags]], who disliked maces.

Diamond trim players were usually the players who lead attacks to destroy civilizations on the server, and were often accompanied by gold trim players.

Special trims like netherite or redstone trims were picked out by Ash, as the only netherite trim we've seen has been ClownPierce, and the only Redstone trim has been FerreMC. 

The copper player are the second lowest ranking members in the [[The Invisible Mafia|mafia]] (the others being trimless, [[Mafia Iron Players|Iron]], [[Mafia Gold Players|Gold]] and [[Mafia Diamond Players|Diamond]]) they don't have a lot of resources to help them in battle. They each have full netherite gear with a copper eye trim on their chestplates though. The players [[R4trick]] and [[Finiahn]] left [[District 13]] to go into the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] as copper players. To become a copper player, you have to kill a player who is not in the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]]. The [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] was created by [[Ashswagg|Ashwagg]] and if a player doesn't do what [[Ashswagg|Ashwagg]] tells them to do, they get killed. 

The Iron Mafia Players are the third lowest tier of [[The Invisible Mafia|The Mafia]] besides [[Mafia Copper Players|Copper]] and trimless(The two above being [[Mafia Gold Players|Gold]] and [[Mafia Diamond Players|Diamond]]). To become a Iron Mafia Player, you must complete missions that you got from the [[Ashswagg|"Higher Ups"]]. Each Iron Mafia Player had full netherite armor with a Iron eye trim on their chestplates. Each member of The Iron Players got some windcharges and colored firework rockets so people can tell their part of the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]]. 

On the Unstable SMP, Diamond Ranked [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]] Members are the highest rank in the Invisible Mafia, all of them, excluding [[FlameFrags]], had a [[Maces|Mace]]. To become a Diamond Ranked Mafia Members, you have to kill another Diamond Rank, this was implemented so [[Ashswagg]] wouldn’t have to try and get new Maces.

===Practices=== 

*Each active member was made to throw a ender pearl into a tunnel of bubble columns leading to a heavily guarded large stasis chamber by trusted diamond players only. Their stasis was set in a stasis chamber, and if the stasis chamber was mined under so that once the stasis was pulled (activated), the player fell into the void, died, and got banned off of the server. This meant that if a mafia member was seen visible by other mafia members or by allies of the mafia and reported, they would teleport into the void and be killed. For this reason, mafia members did not carry any totems of undying, because if it popped, their invisibility would be removed and they would get killed anyways. This method of control was how the Mafia took over the server. It was later revealed that Ashswagg still had the enderpearl's of all former members in The Mafia Tomb. If any resources were taken from The Tomb, all former members of The Invisible Mafia would be killed meaning that The Mafia still technically exists.
*Fireworks were used to signal the Mafia to or from an area/player. White fireworks called the Mafia away, black fireworks signaled the Mafia to an area to kill a player, and red fireworks signaled the start of a mission.
*If Ashswagg died all members of the Invisible Mafia would be teleported to their statis chambers and would be killed in the void with him. This prevented any attempts to end the mafia by killing Ashswagg. 

== History ==

=== Season 1 ===
[[Spoke]] and [[Mapicc]] go to a raid farm as they plan to stop all farms from working to get rid of lag, and see three invisible players. They almost die to the invisible players, but [[Ashswagg|ashswagg]] comes and tells the invisible players to leave, and they oblige. Ashswagg says he doesn’t know the players.

Spoke and Mapicc go to [[TheRealSquiddo]]’s house. Under the floor, they find a bunch of books with coordinates. Ashswagg finds Spoke and Mapicc and says that he wants to team with them.

[[Jepexx]] is seen at his villager trading hall. Spoke and Mapicc splash the villagers invisible and pretend they are dead. Jepexx also shows them their panda farm, but then a group of invisible players come and try to kill Jepexx. They yell out for ashswagg to stop, and all the invisible players run away. Ashswagg says that he was just trying to help them.

Spoke and Mapicc break a couple more farms. They find that Ashswagg completely obliterated the coordinates to farms that they gave to him.

They go to the next farm and find two invisible players destroying it with TNT. He pops one of their totems and it reveals they are USmellLikeUpdog. Ash teleports USmellLikeUpdog into the void, banning him because he stated ashswagg was the leader. Mapicc leaves because he doesn’t trust ashswagg. Spoke meets ashswagg at the next farm.

He gives ashswagg the rest of the coordinates to the farms. Ashswagg uses a fishing rod to teleport away.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the next farm, which is a flower farm. They see [[Roshambogames]] and [[PlanetLord]] there. Ashswagg destroys the entire farm with TNT. Mapicc says he saw invisible people leaving, implying this was ashswagg. They go to the other farms and see ashswagg destroyed all of them. They go to the last farm, which is an EOL farm. They make it there before ashswagg destroyed it. Mapicc leaves so Spoke can talk to ashswagg. 

Ashswagg tells him that, since Spoke was the one at every farm, everyone will think he destroyed them. Ashswagg tries to convince him to give him exploits he knows about, but Spoke says no. They find a lot of invisible players who try to kill them. Spoke and Mapicc are able to escape. A player finds them in the nether named [[MinuteTech]]. MinuteTech saves them and reveals he was once part of the Mafia.

Spoke and Mapicc follow him back to his base. They show MinuteTech their base at spawn. They get attacked underground by the Mafia. MinuteTech kills one of the Mafia members using a mace. They manage to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord at Jepexx’s old villager trading hall. The Mafia comes over and tries to kill them. They trap the Mafia players using a sand trap, though none of them die. They are able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc try to prove to ManePear that there are invisible players attacking them, but ManePear decides to try and kill Spoke and Mapicc. They are able to escape. The Mafia starts attacking them. They are able to escape again.

The Mafia tries to kill Spoke and Mapicc. Spoke is able to escape, but Mapicc is captured. PlanetLord introduces [[Baconnwaffles0]] and [[TheRealSquiddo]] to MinuteTech. A Mafia member named [[BobDaGreenFrog]] tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills them. The Mafia starts trying to kill them. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, to which MinuteTech replies "no". The Mafia continues attacking them. Spoke is able to escape, though he almost dies.

TheRealSquiddo shows the team some coordinates that she was given that could be the coordinates to a Mafia outpost. She also states that everybody in the master builders group has disappeared. She also states she was commissioned to do a build by an anonymous player.

The team goes over to the outpost and find a lot of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after being handed a book.

Spoke and PlanetLord try to dupe, but realize that it doesn’t work anymore. Ashswagg comes in and reveals that all the glitches and exploits were patched, and that Jamato told him so. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech was working for him, and orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. Spoke and PlanetLord escape.

Spoke and PlanetLord go under one of [[the Wonders]] where they put weaponless mobs. They find that the mobs are named coordinates. They find a replica of Jamato’s base made out of wood at the coordinates, and all of the glitched features have been removed. He finds a book stating that if anyone is reading it, he is captured or dead. It states he exiled himself, that he has been hunted by the Mafia, that he was captured in an outpost, and that an item can fix everything. They find a compass that is named "The Mafia".

Following the compass, they find a Mafia outpost. They find Mafia members in a room. They go above the players and drop dripstone on them, killing one of the players and using the totem of undying of another player named [[Leow0ok]]. The outpost starts exploding to TNT. Leow0ok agrees to team with them. They follow a member of the Mafia to Mafia City, where there are different tiers of Mafia members. They find Mapicc in a prison and break him out.

[[The End Civilization]] is taken over by the Mafia.

Ashswagg tries to force Parrot to join the Mafia in [[Capital City]], but Parrot escapes using a stasis chamber. The Mafia starts trying to kill them.

Spoke and his team is now tasked with getting diamonds. Ashswagg promotes them to gold tier. They go over to Baconnwaffles for a mission. Baconnwaffles says they are betraying the Mafia, so they destroy his base. They go over to Reddoons at capital city and trade.

Spoke and his team is given the task of getting an elytra. They are able to find nine elytra in the Zam empire. Wemmbu finds a Mafia member and starts killing them, but realizes it is eggchan. They are promoted to iron after giving ashswagg the elytra. They are then tasked with building redstone machines. They sabotage the other opponents and win.

Spoke and his team are tasked with killing Parrot but fail.

They are tasked with killing PlanetLord, but they do not kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the members until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Spoke is personally tasked by Ash with killing [[IMajesticRose]] to show that he is not a coward. He obliges and kills her with dripstone. Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. He fights a diamond player to become diamond. Spoke’s totem of undying is used, revealing to ashswagg that he is Spoke. They try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he is MinuteTech.

Parrot goes on a mission with the warriors to kill a diamond tier player in Mafia city. They retreat from the fight.

The [[Far Lands]] discovers that there are Mafia players near the farlands. They find a gold tier player in the nether who is able to escape. They intercept the gold tier player when he is giving his message to ashswagg. They pretend to be diamond tier players, and then kill him with a fall trap.

Parrot sees the mafia sending a bunch of TNT bomber planes heading towards spawn. He uses the totem of undying of one of the Mafia members, revealing it is deanthebean9. Deanthebean9 is teleported into the void and dies.

The Mafia destroys the [[Far Lands]]. [[Horace Altman]] and the five other players who are still alive create a new civilization against the Mafia named [[District 13]]

The Mafia destroys [[Skyblock Civilization]].

Spoke goes over to the Square Civilization to warn [[Cash]] that the Mafia is going to break into their civilization and destroy it. Cash doesn’t listen and everyone in the civilization dies. Spoke warns the [[Sleepy Nation]] that the Mafia is going to try to kill them. They take back their items that were stolen from the Mafia. The leaders of sleepy nation reveal that they are part of the Mafia.

Spoke and Mapicc go over to TheRealSquiddo to try and find the coordinates of "The Withered". The Mafia destroys her castle. 

The Mafia begins tearing down spawn to construct a prison to force people to join the Mafia. Spoke and Mapicc go to spawn where they see Parrot and Wifies. They agree to team up to try and end the Mafia. They show Parrot and Wifies the area where they killed iMajesticRose. They find a diamond tier Mafia player and follow them. They find a village where there is a player in iron armor named [[Quackenstein123]] who claims to be the father of iMajesticRose.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the end to get obsidian. They are able to escape the Mafia who are trying to kill them in the end. They go back to [[Quackenstein123]]'s base and find a secret staircase underneath it. They find a stash of loot, including the diamond tier player's armor, and a mace, proving that they are the diamond tier player. The player comes into the vault. [[Quackenstein123]] gives them a book which are coordinates to where all the stasis chambers are stored. He shows Parrot this book, and Parrot invites him to District 13.

Spoke and Mapicc check the coordinates and find a chest containing a book called "THE GATEWAY" which appears to contain directions to something. They show the members of District 13 the book. The members are disappointed so Spoke and Mapicc leave.

Parrot and [[Wifies]] build a house in a snowy biome. Ashswagg finds them and tries to force them to join the mafia. He gives them 10 minutes to decide. Wifies joins the mafia for Parrot.

Spoke, Parrot, and Mapicc break into a spawn prison. This is where they get new members. Their plan is to follow wherever pearls are thrown all the way to the main stasis chamber area. They find an area where guards transport the pearls. They find a pearl cannon and use it to get teleported millions of blocks out, where they find a man-made mountain. Inside of the mountain is where every stasis chamber is stored. The place is heavily guarded by diamond players.

Spoke tells Parrot about how he found all of the Mafia’s stasis chambers.

Ashswagg "kills" Wifies in front of Parrot by dropping him into the void, but it is later revealed that Wifies faked his death.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the void and start destroying every stasis chamber while [[Wemmbu]] and his team distracts [[ClownPierce]] and Ferre by fighting him. The diamond tier players try to kill Spoke in the void, but using chorus fruit, Spoke is able to escape and traps the two diamond players in the void. Both of them die when they run out of fireworks. The Mafia's statis chambers are destroyed. Parrot sends one last beacon signal to the resistance cells and all Mafia members begin drinking milk, ending the mafia.

=== Season 2 ===
Rejoicin says that he was a guard protecting a spire from the Mafia.

VEN0M was a former diamond trim, who was eventually killed by Flame.

Although The Mafia has since been defeated, the Tomb of the Mafia still exists, containing all resources from the server along with stasis chambers for every former Mafia member, which kill all Mafia members if anything is taken. This means that the Mafia still technically exists despite its official dissolution. It is guarded by [[Marlowww]], who was ranked number one in the world on mctiers. Her main goal is to guard the tomb with lethal force.

content:
The Invisible Mafia Arc, is the second major arc in Unstable Universe.

 Story 
SpokeIsHere and Mapicc suspect that Roshambogames has been duping more items. They obtain a list of coords to various farms from TheRealSquiddo's base, and Ashswagg saves them from invisible attackers, but it's later revealed he sent the players, causing tension between Mapicc, who doesn't trust him, and Spoke, who does. Mapicc temporarily leaves the team, but Spoke convinces him to rejoin. Their End base gets destroyed by Wemmbu and Eggchan, hired by Roshambo. They find Roshambo at a flower farm and realize he's never had any malicious plans, and then it gets blown up by invisible players, leading Spoke to finally realize Ash has betrayed them. They head around to previous farms and find them all blown up, so go to the last one. Ash is there, and he reveals he wants Spoke's exploits, then sends in invisible players. Spoke and Mapicc both barely manage to escape.

ParrotX2 and Wifies decide to start an End civilization that no one can find. Deanthebean9 promptly finds it, explaining he's part of The Invisible Mafia and was sent to kill them. They gather villagers for their civilization with help from Kenadian, while Horace Altman builds the civilization. Parrot and Dean head to the Invisible Mafia HQ, where he pops Dean's totem. Dean gets teleported into the void, but Kenadian saves him using a stasis, freeing him. Boosfer shows up to claim the civilization, and Parrot agrees to hold an election with him. Horace builds chunkbans, and Parrot nearly dies to the Mafia while saving a new member. Their civilization grows, and Boosfer ends up losing the election. The Mafia gets into the civilization, forcing everyone to flee, but Parrot, Wifies, and Dean later return and blow it up.

Parrot, Wifies, and Dean try to break into Capital City, but get caught by Reddoons and sentenced to the mines. They meet LuigiToan, a miner, and CoinMonke, the warden. They manage to sneak into Capital City and steal diamond blocks, paying off the debts of four miners before Red gets suspicious. Parrot attempts to blackmail him with the stolen diamonds, so Red builds a roulette wheel, forcing whoever mines the fewest diamonds to play. It ends up being Parrot, but Coin doesn't kill him, and Parrot uses that to blackmail him into helping break into another vault. They fail to steal anything, and play roulette again. Red kills Luigi, inspiring the miners to revolt. Parrot organizes a plan and they get into the primary vault, but Red's waiting for them, and he reveals everyone has been captured. Parrot convinces him to play roulette to decide the winner, and Red wins, but lets everyone go except for Parrot, Dean, and Wifies. He takes them to meet Ash, who wants them to join the Mafia, but they decline and escape.

Spoke and Mapicc get attacked by the Mafia, but saved by MinuteTech, who initially refuses to work with them, but after they prove their worth in a second attack, he agrees. They split up to recruit people, and Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord, but get attacked by more Mafia players and barely escape. They attempt to recruit Squiddo, but are chased by the Mafia. Spoke escapes and meets with Minute, but Mapicc gets captured. Planet arrives with Squiddo, and they head to her castle, where Ash supposedly left coordinates of some kind. They get waylaid by the Mafia along the way, but manage to shake them. Squiddo has to leave, but the other three follow the coords to a Mafia trap, where Spoke and Planet are forced to leave Minute behind. They decide to finally use exploits, heading to JamatoP's old base. However, the exploits fail to work, and Ash shows up with Minute, who has betrayed. Spoke and Planet escape and Spoke almost gives up, but Planet convinces him to try and find Jamato. They successfully find coords hidden under a Wonder, and follow them to a base with a compass that leads to the Mafia HQ.

Wemmbu discovers Skyblock Civilization, led by Yeah Jaron and guarded by Straight, where he is forced to stay. There he finds Pangi and Wato1876, and plots to escape with Wato. He, Jaron, and Straight head down to spawn, and are attacked by Invisible Mafia members, but Straight kills them. Back up top, Wemmbu and Wato realize Jaron has items unobtainable through skyblock, and plan to expose him. Wemmbu spies on Straight and Jaron, and afterwards Straight tells him he wants to help with the exposing plan. By talking to various citizens, they learn about Parrot's End civilization and Capital City both, visit both, and get attacked at both, but eventually manage to escape. Jaron secretly gives Wemmbu a mace, and implies Straight is a traitor; Straight later confirms this and gives Wemmbu the chance to leave, which he takes.

Parrot, Dean, and Wifies are pursued by the Mafia as they travel to Luigi's house. Inside, they find his diary and a compass to the Farlands, which they set out towards. They gear up during their travels, surviving multiple Mafia attacks and reading through Luigi's diary. Eventually, they find an obsidian wall and R4trick, who offers to be a tour guide through the Mafia-controlled areas beyond, but he flees when the Mafia attacks them. They continue on, Wifies pushing to leave Dean behind, and finally it's revealed that Dean is the reason the Mafia keeps finding them. Dean sneaks away, forcing Wifies and Parrot to continue on alone. However, when Wifies burns the compass and tries to convince Parrot to run away with him, Parrot refuses and leaves him, continuing on his own. He eventually reaches the Farlands, and finds Far Lands Civilisation, led by Horace, whom he convinces to help fight the Mafia.

Spoke and Planet find a Mafia outpost and break Leow0ok's totem, but he reveals he's infiltrating the Mafia to kill ClownPierce. The three head to Mafia City, where Planet leaves and they free Mapicc. The three are sent on various missions, encountering both Parrot and Wemmbu, and eventually rank up to copper tier, then iron. They are sent to hunt Planet, but fail to kill him, which their chaperone witnesses, leading to multiple players getting killed by Ash as he tries to figure out who did it. Leo and Mapicc both rank up to gold, but Spoke is left behind, as Ash knows it was him. He is sent to kill IMajesticRose, an innocent player, which he does. Ash congratulates him, and informs him that to become a diamond player, he has to defeat one in a fight, which Spoke agrees to do. He secretly cheats at the fight, but his totem still pops, revealing himself as Spoke. Ash tries to get the diamond to kill him, but the diamond betrays instead, revealing himself as Minute, and letting them escape.

Wemmbu trades his mace to ManePear in exchange for training. They visit multiple Mafia outposts, killing many players and obtaining a lot of gear, which Mane uses to teach Wemmbu about proper kits. He sends him off to kill gold players, and Wemmbu successfully kills three. Mane sends him after a diamond next, and Wemmbu meets Spoke while searching. They get attacked by an invis player, and Wemmbu nearly kills him before realizing it's Eggchan, whom he brings back to Mane's treehouse. They visit Ice Mountain Civilization with the intention of killing a diamond player, and Wemmbu gets to test out the mace against invading Mafia members, but they fail to kill the diamond. Back home, Mane teaches Wemmbu how to use the mace. Later, Egg's Mafia stasis gets pulled, and Wemmbu goes to save him, fighting diamond FlameFrags for a long time before finally being forced to give up his mace. Wemmbu and Egg return home, but find Mane has left them, permanently.

Parrot joins the Warriors District of the Farlands. After his squad's leader dies, TheobaldTheBird becomes the new leader, as well as a member of the Warriors Council. Wifies arrives at the Farlands and joins the Farmers District, who have a long-standing feud with the Warriors due to the latter thinking the former is useless. Parrot hopes to prove them wrong by using strategy to win a game of capture the flag. The squad gets sent to kill a diamond player but are forced to retreat. Parrot challenges DumbIsDumb for his seat in the Council, and wins using more strategy. Additionally, he visits Dean, living on his own in the jungle. Council leader Purpled reveals that the Warriors don't have enough members to meaningfully challenge the Mafia, and Parrot suggests merging the three districts. Purpled tries to have him assassinated, and Parrot uses that to seize control of the Warriors. He and the Farmers go to stop bomber planes from the Mafia, and in the process it's revealed that Dean was forced to rejoin, and his stasis gets pulled, killing him. The rest of the Warriors get captured, but Parrot and the Farmers successfully break them out of the End civilization. Parrot demands to be taken to Ash, who reveals that he knows where the Farlands are. Parrot stasises out.

Clown and Ferre burn down Mane’s treehouse. Parrot shows up and takes Wemmbu and Egg to District 13, where they plot to kill a diamond player. After a long battle, they succeed, giving Wemmbu a mace. He goes to Clown’s castle for revenge, but is forced to flee. Ferre takes Egg captive, but Wemmbu and Egg defeat him and force him to give up his mace in exchange for his life. They reuinite with Parrot and Spoke, then all head to a prison at spawn, where Wemmbu distracts the Mafia so the others can break in and hopefully find the Mafia's stasises. They succeed, but the Mafia attacks District 13. Wemmbu kills most of them, and while Spoke goes to destroy the stasises, he flies out with Egg to distract Clown and Ferre. After enough time has passed, they leave the fight and, with the Mafia successfully destroyed, decide to go make another civilization.

Farland City is destroyed. Horace builds District 13 for those who remain, then joins the Mafia. Parrot, Wifies, and Theo go to assassinate Ash, but Clown stops them. Parrot kills Yusai, a new recruit to District 13, out of suspicion that he's a Mafia spy. While surveying spawn, Parrot and Wifies meet Spoke and Mapicc, and they head to IMajesticRose's house to try and find clues. There they find Quackenstein123, who supposedly has coords to the Mafia's stasises, but it turns out to be fake. Ash and Wifies confront Parrot, and he pulls Wifies' stasis, killing him. Parrot returns to District 13, which gets attacked. He leaves the battle and goes back to Farland City, lighting beacons around the server to serve as a distraction for Spoke, who successfully destroys the Mafia. Parrot later visits Ash, living in exile in the Farlands, who tells him the Director was the one who killed Wifies, not him.

Square City is destroyed by the Mafia, despite Spoke's and Mapicc's attempts to stop them. They regroup with MinuteTech, then head to Sleepy Nation, where they manage to reclaim a stash of gear from the Mafia, but are betrayed by its inhabitants. Spoke kicks Minute out due to frustration. With the Mafia gone, Spoke and Mapicc go to the Farlands and pull Ash's stasis, but Spoke decides not to kill him to avoid becoming like him. Ash promises that one day he'll have a mafia of his own, then flies off.

'''The Invisible Mafia Arc''', is the second '''major''' arc in [[Unstable Universe]].

== Story ==
[[SpokeIsHere]] and [[Mapicc]] suspect that [[Roshambogames]] has been duping more items. They obtain a list of coords to various farms from [[TheRealSquiddo]]'s base, and [[Ashswagg]] saves them from invisible attackers, but it's later revealed he sent the players, causing tension between Mapicc, who doesn't trust him, and Spoke, who does. Mapicc temporarily leaves the team, but Spoke convinces him to rejoin. Their End base gets destroyed by [[Wemmbu]] and [[Eggchan]], hired by Roshambo. They find Roshambo at a flower farm and realize he's never had any malicious plans, and then it gets blown up by invisible players, leading Spoke to finally realize Ash has betrayed them. They head around to previous farms and find them all blown up, so go to the last one. Ash is there, and he reveals he wants Spoke's exploits, then sends in invisible players. Spoke and Mapicc both barely manage to escape.

[[ParrotX2]] and [[Wifies]] decide to start an End civilization that no one can find. [[Deanthebean9]] promptly finds it, explaining he's part of [[The Invisible Mafia]] and was sent to kill them. They gather villagers for their civilization with help from [[Kenadian]], while [[Horace Altman]] builds the civilization. Parrot and Dean head to the Invisible Mafia HQ, where he pops Dean's totem. Dean gets teleported into the void, but Kenadian saves him using a stasis, freeing him. [[Boosfer]] shows up to claim the civilization, and Parrot agrees to hold an election with him. Horace builds chunkbans, and Parrot nearly dies to the Mafia while saving a new member. Their civilization grows, and Boosfer ends up losing the election. The Mafia gets into the civilization, forcing everyone to flee, but Parrot, Wifies, and Dean later return and blow it up.

Parrot, Wifies, and Dean try to break into [[Capital City]], but get caught by [[Reddoons]] and sentenced to the mines. They meet [[LuigiToan]], a miner, and [[CoinMonke]], the warden. They manage to sneak into Capital City and steal diamond blocks, paying off the debts of four miners before Red gets suspicious. Parrot attempts to blackmail him with the stolen diamonds, so Red builds a roulette wheel, forcing whoever mines the fewest diamonds to play. It ends up being Parrot, but Coin doesn't kill him, and Parrot uses that to blackmail him into helping break into another vault. They fail to steal anything, and play roulette again. Red kills Luigi, inspiring the miners to revolt. Parrot organizes a plan and they get into the primary vault, but Red's waiting for them, and he reveals everyone has been captured. Parrot convinces him to play roulette to decide the winner, and Red wins, but lets everyone go except for Parrot, Dean, and Wifies. He takes them to meet Ash, who wants them to join the Mafia, but they decline and escape.

Spoke and Mapicc get attacked by the Mafia, but saved by [[MinuteTech]], who initially refuses to work with them, but after they prove their worth in a second attack, he agrees. They split up to recruit people, and Spoke and Mapicc find [[PlanetLord]], but get attacked by more Mafia players and barely escape. They attempt to recruit Squiddo, but are chased by the Mafia. Spoke escapes and meets with Minute, but Mapicc gets captured. Planet arrives with Squiddo, and they head to her castle, where Ash supposedly left coordinates of some kind. They get waylaid by the Mafia along the way, but manage to shake them. Squiddo has to leave, but the other three follow the coords to a Mafia trap, where Spoke and Planet are forced to leave Minute behind. They decide to finally use exploits, heading to [[JamatoP|JamatoP's]] old base. However, the exploits fail to work, and Ash shows up with Minute, who has betrayed. Spoke and Planet escape and Spoke almost gives up, but Planet convinces him to try and find Jamato. They successfully find coords hidden under a [[The Wonders|Wonder]], and follow them to a base with a compass that leads to the Mafia HQ.

Wemmbu discovers [[Skyblock Civilization]], led by [[Yeah Jaron]] and guarded by [[Straight]], where he is forced to stay. There he finds [[Pangi]] and [[Wato1876]], and plots to escape with Wato. He, Jaron, and Straight head down to spawn, and are attacked by Invisible Mafia members, but Straight kills them. Back up top, Wemmbu and Wato realize Jaron has items unobtainable through skyblock, and plan to expose him. Wemmbu spies on Straight and Jaron, and afterwards Straight tells him he wants to help with the exposing plan. By talking to various citizens, they learn about Parrot's End civilization and Capital City both, visit both, and get attacked at both, but eventually manage to escape. Jaron secretly gives Wemmbu a mace, and implies Straight is a traitor; Straight later confirms this and gives Wemmbu the chance to leave, which he takes.

Parrot, Dean, and Wifies are pursued by the Mafia as they travel to Luigi's house. Inside, they find his diary and a compass to the Farlands, which they set out towards. They gear up during their travels, surviving multiple Mafia attacks and reading through Luigi's diary. Eventually, they find an obsidian wall and [[R4trick]], who offers to be a tour guide through the Mafia-controlled areas beyond, but he flees when the Mafia attacks them. They continue on, Wifies pushing to leave Dean behind, and finally it's revealed that Dean is the reason the Mafia keeps finding them. Dean sneaks away, forcing Wifies and Parrot to continue on alone. However, when Wifies burns the compass and tries to convince Parrot to run away with him, Parrot refuses and leaves him, continuing on his own. He eventually reaches the Farlands, and finds [[Far Lands Civilisation]], led by Horace, whom he convinces to help fight the Mafia.

Spoke and Planet find a Mafia outpost and break [[Leow0ok|Leow0ok's]] totem, but he reveals he's infiltrating the Mafia to kill [[ClownPierce]]. The three head to [[Mafia City]], where Planet leaves and they free Mapicc. The three are sent on various missions, encountering both Parrot and Wemmbu, and eventually rank up to copper tier, then iron. They are sent to hunt Planet, but fail to kill him, which their chaperone witnesses, leading to multiple players getting killed by Ash as he tries to figure out who did it. Leo and Mapicc both rank up to gold, but Spoke is left behind, as Ash knows it was him. He is sent to kill [[IMajesticRose]], an innocent player, which he does. Ash congratulates him, and informs him that to become a diamond player, he has to defeat one in a fight, which Spoke agrees to do. He secretly cheats at the fight, but his totem still pops, revealing himself as Spoke. Ash tries to get the diamond to kill him, but the diamond betrays instead, revealing himself as Minute, and letting them escape.

Wemmbu trades his mace to [[ManePear]] in exchange for training. They visit multiple Mafia outposts, killing many players and obtaining a lot of gear, which Mane uses to teach Wemmbu about proper kits. He sends him off to kill gold players, and Wemmbu successfully kills three. Mane sends him after a diamond next, and Wemmbu meets Spoke while searching. They get attacked by an invis player, and Wemmbu nearly kills him before realizing it's Eggchan, whom he brings back to Mane's treehouse. They visit [[Ice Mountain Civilization]] with the intention of killing a diamond player, and Wemmbu gets to test out the mace against invading Mafia members, but they fail to kill the diamond. Back home, Mane teaches Wemmbu how to use the mace. Later, Egg's Mafia stasis gets pulled, and Wemmbu goes to save him, fighting diamond [[FlameFrags]] for a long time before finally being forced to give up his mace. Wemmbu and Egg return home, but find Mane has left them, permanently.

Parrot joins the [[Warriors District]] of the Farlands. After his squad's leader dies, [[TheobaldTheBird]] becomes the new leader, as well as a member of the [[Warriors Council]]. Wifies arrives at the Farlands and joins the Farmers District, who have a long-standing feud with the Warriors due to the latter thinking the former is useless. Parrot hopes to prove them wrong by using strategy to win a game of capture the flag. The squad gets sent to kill a diamond player but are forced to retreat. Parrot challenges [[DumbIsDumb]] for his seat in the Council, and wins using more strategy. Additionally, he visits Dean, living on his own in the jungle. Council leader [[Purpled]] reveals that the Warriors don't have enough members to meaningfully challenge the Mafia, and Parrot suggests merging the three districts. Purpled tries to have him assassinated, and Parrot uses that to seize control of the Warriors. He and the Farmers go to stop bomber planes from the Mafia, and in the process it's revealed that Dean was forced to rejoin, and his stasis gets pulled, killing him. The rest of the Warriors get captured, but Parrot and the Farmers successfully break them out of the End civilization. Parrot demands to be taken to Ash, who reveals that he knows where the Farlands are. Parrot stasises out.

Clown and Ferre burn down Mane’s treehouse. Parrot shows up and takes Wemmbu and Egg to District 13, where they plot to kill a diamond player. After a long battle, they succeed, giving Wemmbu a mace. He goes to Clown’s castle for revenge, but is forced to flee. Ferre takes Egg captive, but Wemmbu and Egg defeat him and force him to give up his mace in exchange for his life. They reuinite with Parrot and Spoke, then all head to a prison at spawn, where Wemmbu distracts the Mafia so the others can break in and hopefully find the Mafia's stasises. They succeed, but the Mafia attacks District 13. Wemmbu kills most of them, and while Spoke goes to destroy the stasises, he flies out with Egg to distract Clown and Ferre. After enough time has passed, they leave the fight and, with the Mafia successfully destroyed, decide to go make another civilization.

Farland City is destroyed. Horace builds [[District 13]] for those who remain, then joins the Mafia. Parrot, Wifies, and Theo go to assassinate Ash, but Clown stops them. Parrot kills [[Yusai]], a new recruit to District 13, out of suspicion that he's a Mafia spy. While surveying spawn, Parrot and Wifies meet Spoke and Mapicc, and they head to IMajesticRose's house to try and find clues. There they find [[Quackenstein123]], who supposedly has coords to the Mafia's stasises, but it turns out to be fake. title: The Invisible Mafia Members
content:
The Invisible Mafia used different eye armor trims to represent the ranking of each member. Players start of without a trim. Usually, the lower ranking players know almost nothing about the higher ranking players and are usually unwelcome in another higher ranking tier in Mafia City. By completing missions, they can gain the copper, iron and gold eye armor trims. The diamond eye armor trim however, cannot be gained through completing missions.
 Ranks of the Mafia 
Untrimmed → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Netherite → Redstone → Mafia leader

 Untrimmed 
The Untrimmed Mafia members are the lowest ranking players in The Invisible Mafia. They are usually the soldiers, guards or messengers of the Mafia. A lot of them are players who don’t know much, and were indoctrinated in via spawn prison at spawn or the Mafia finding random players around the world.

 Copper 
The Copper Trimmed Mafia player is the second lowest ranked in The Invisible Mafia. They are higher ranking than the Untrimmed members, therefore they can command them in battles or in Mafia City.

 Iron 
The Iron Trimmed Mafia members are sixth highest of ranks in The Invisible Mafia trimmed players. They outrank both Copper Trims and untrimmed, they are usually equiped with wind charges, and can use different colored fireworks to communicate with each other.

 Gold 
The Gold Trimmed Mafia members are the fifth highest trimmed players in The Invisible Mafia. They outrank the Iron Trimmed members, and are responsible for handing out missions for the lower ranking players via book and quill, and usually leading them.

 Diamond 
The Diamond Trimmed Mafia members are the fourth highest ranking trimmed player in The Invisible Mafia, and the most skilled. To achieve this rank, the Gold Trimmed players must kill a Diamond Trimmed player to gain their chestplate, meaning that the total number of diamond players would never increase. The Diamond Trimmed members all wield a mace, (Except FlameFrags, who dislikes maces) They lead armies and groups to destroy civilizations and to kill off any enemies of the Mafia. Notable players were as follows:
FlameFrags
mp6
MinuteTech
Quackeinstein123
VEN0M ✝
Iqcniq ✝
Crystzx
cocomelon2 ✝ 

 Netherite 
While only one person holds this rank that person being ClownPierce often called the deadliest minecraft player ClownPierce was given access to two maces. Meaning clown is one of the five people that have or have ever had two maces. Addtionally this rank serves as the third highest rank in the Invisible mafia as well as the exicutioner of the Invisible mafia.
ClownPierce

 Redstone 
While only one person holds this rank is FerreMC. This serves as the 2nd highest rank in all of the Invisible Mafia as well as the second in command of the Mafia. Ferre also at one point had two maces.  One became Wemmbu’s gambit and another was Ferres own mace. As well as the Redstone trims command the Diamond players.
FerreMC

 Mafia Leader 
This is the highest rank in all of the Mafia whoever is in this role has absolute authority over anything going on in the Mafia, the statis chambers, who gets promoted, who dies, and especially who lives, this role has only ever been filled by two players the players being an unnamed leader who preceded Ashswagg who is the only other person to have this role.
