title: The Kingdoms Arc
content:
The Kingdoms Arc, or Kingdoms, formerly known as The Kingdoms Saga, is the 16th Arc of Unstable Universe. *Spoke's The NULL Arc takes place at the same time, and video summaries will be included on this page as well*.

 Story 
Wemmbu kills some of Arachn1d's soldiers who accost him while he's building, then runs out of materials and heads to nearby Elysium for more. There, he scares off Yungyx, and the leader mentions they used to have a diamond player protecting them, but he left the server and hid his mace somewhere. Wemmbu gets Eggchan, then goes to meet with a player who might know where the mace is. LordSirWessley challenges them to a fight for the info, and Wemmbu recruits Jaden MAN and an unknown invis player to his side, while Wessley has TheGOdOfWar and Yungyx. Wemmbu's side wins the fight, and they follow Wessley's instructions to a giant cavern, killing some players that try and attack them. There, the invis player from before takes the mace, but Wemmbu forces him to give it back after a fight, and they return to Elysium and give up the mace.

Flame video

ParrotX2 gets booed during his coronation, so he promises to fix the server. He starts off by killing all the withers at spawn with TheobaldTheBird, then making Fymada the mayor of Capitol City. He travels to Merchant City and competes in an auction for a chicken, during which Theo bets 100,000 diamonds. He attempts to get Redstone Town to help him build chicken farms, but only 4CVIT helps. Parrot brings the food back to spawn, but SargeLAW attacks. However, Parrot manages to get away. Horace Altman has built a kingdom around spawn to protect new players, but many old players dislike Parrot for it. He goes to talk to LettuceK, who tells him he's made a mistake.

SpokeIsHere is attacked by mysterious players in his base, but they stasis away before they can die. JumperWho arrives, and gives Spoke coords to a safehouse for if he gets attacked again. Spoke leaves and finds a random player's base, setting up a trap, but again the mysterious players stasis away when they should have died. Spoke flees to the safehouse, meeting up with Jumper. BAT spies hold off the hunters while Spoke and Jumper flee, but the red-trimmed leader nearly kills them. They escape and head to a base where SirPig is being held; he may have ties to the mysterious players. However, SirPig stasises away and the players attack. Spoke and Jumper run to an arrow cannon Spoke set up earlier, which they are able to use to kill the red-trimmed player, who drops a book titled 'null'.

Flame video

Eggchan gets kidnapped by an army of players. Wemmbu follows them and overhears a conversation between their leader and Arachn1d. Once Arachn1d leaves, he attempts to enter the army's base, but they have wardens as guards. He eventually manages to sneak inside and finds Eggchan. He is able to save him, and then kills the entire army. After he leaves, the invis player from before finds Eggchan's book of coordinates.

Parrot and Theo are attacked and imprisoned by Capital City's guard for supposedly killing 43 players. The Merchant City Vanguard breaks them out, because Theo still owes 100k diamonds. They sneak back into Capital City, with Parrot going to talk to Fymada, who is now nothing but a puppet. Meanwhile, Theo is attacked by his old trainer, ShoeBilly. Parrot flees from guards and Theo is nearly killed by ShoeBilly. Parrot discovers a massive building where all of the new players are imprisoned, to be executed soon. Theo meets up with Parrot, but ShoeBilly finds them again and they're separated. Theo refuses to betray Parrot, so ShoeBilly leaves, saying he'll come back when Theo's ready. Parrot is cornered by guards, but convinces them to confirm they framed him. He reveals that he got Fymada to gather a bunch of citizens to witness the confession, proving his innocence. Later, Parrot and Theo discuss how it feels like there's someone out to get the new players.

The null book lists 100 players and coordinates. Spoke and Jumper find a base at the nearest set of coords, before being jumped by the mysterious players. They run to an escape tunnel they'd set up previously, but the players turned it into a void hole. However, they are able to escape through another void hole at the base of another player in the book, a notorious trapper. They visit Parrot for help, but he turns them down, since he's too busy with his kingdom. While leaving they are attacked again, and barely get away. They continue to visit the coords in the book, before finally finding a book at one location, explaining that the players are called Null, and that they have a pearl cannon called the Road of Null. Jumper gathers her spies and they head to the place, but Null is waiting. The cannon is destroyed and most of the spies die. Defeated, they return to Spoke's base, only for Mapicc to suddenly show up.

Flame joins The Mist to try and assassinate their leader, Mistrul. He is forced to team with FluffalsSupreme, but they continually get into conflict. Eventually, they settle it in a duel, where Fluffals dies. Flame brings Lomedy to the Mist, and they sneak out of the civilization to go looking for Mistrul. Members of Archan1d's army attack them there, and they take refuge in a cave. That cave turns out to be Mistrul's base. Flame fights him, but retreats when he attacks Lomedy. The two escape, but as they're leaving on a happy ghast, Lomedy is knocked off.

Parrot video

Mapicc gives Spoke coords, then stasises away. Spoke and Jumper find Mapicc with a pearl cannon at the coords, but Null attacks. They take the cannon to the Far Lands and hide from Null. They attempt to meet up with the player who helped Mapicc escape Null, but encounter other escapees instead, and then Null. They escape and find PlanetLord leading a small group of players, who give them a bit of gear. Null attacks and again they run, towards an unnaturally dark forest. There, though, they are able to ambush and kill several Null members, and force the last to take them to Null's leader. The member brings them to a trapdoor, which they go down, eventually finding a massive underground area. JamatoP shows up.

While searching for Lomedy, Flame gets attacked by Mistrul. NotSkrilley splashes him with invis and takes him to a small village of players who escaped Mistrul. Flame agrees to help them escape the greater Mist if they find Lomedy. Flame, Skrilley, and Flowtives go to a cavern, but Mistrul attacks them there and they barely escape. They are followed back to the village, which is destroyed, its citizens killed. Skrilley leads Flame to one more place Lomedy might be, but they find Flowtives and Mistrul there instead, with a grave for Lomedy. Flame fights them both, but is forced to run. With Lomedy dead, he enters the Zone and invades the Mist civilization, killing Mistrul in a 1v1 and wiping out a majority of the players there. He duels Flowtives, but chooses to leave him alive so he can live with his destroyed civilization. Flame returns to his base only to find Lomedy alive with Skrilley, having been hiding the whole time.

Wemmbu video

While coming back to spawn, Parrot, Theo, and Reina are attacked by bandits. However, Parrot recruits them as well as the larger group they're a part of to his army, which he plans to use to fight Cindercrest. They head to Merchant City for resources, but the leader DanchoGold tries to imprison them for Theo's debt. They take Dancho hostage instead, and use him to gain the allegiance of the Merchant City guard force. Parrot steals diamonds from him, then goes to the Nether to visit ClownPierce, from whom he buys 40k TNT. He sends Theo and Reina on a scouting mission, during which they see Flame and ShoeBilly leading hundreds of Cindercrest forces. Parrot tries to recruit the Law, and those who don't join him, he kills with TNT and his growing army. He spends a lot of time recruiting other players, and when Theo and Reina return, he shows them his full army, around 15,000 players.

Jamato blackmails Spoke to stay silent, and brings them up to the surface. Spoke convinces them to go the opposite direction. Null continually attacks them along the way, but eventually they make it to a rainbow forest. They find a player there, who leads them into a trap. However, they convince the leader to give them a compass leading to a secret gear stash. They head there, losing resources to mobs, only for Null to steal the gear out from under them. Running low on food, they enter a nearby forest and find another settlement led by CookieBunsquat, one of Jumper's own spies. While Jamato is re-gearing, Spoke disguises himself as a Null member and attempts to kill him, but Mapicc catches him. The two fight, eventually ending up deep underground, where Spoke's totem pops, clearing his invis. Mapicc leaves. Spoke eventually finds an exit into a maze, where he's met with Jamato, who confirms he is Null's leader and that Null exists to get rid of all the bad players in the world, most notably Spoke. Jamato leaves, and Spoke finds the exit. However, Mapicc shows up, revealing Jamato told him everything, and he breaks Spoke's prized chestplate. Null attacks, and Mapicc blames Spoke before being captured. Jamato returns and forces Spoke to burn all his items, including what's in his ender chest, before capturing him as well.

title: The Kings Arc
content:
The Kings Arc, also known as The Election Arc, is the third major arc in Unstable Universe.

 Story 
Note: Spoke's episodes will be included both here and at the BAT Arc page. 

FlameFrags gets attacked by members of The Law, because their leader LettuceK has exiled him from a 50k radius around spawn. He attends an announcement Lettuce makes to the entire server, where Lettuce reveals his plans to hold an election for a king, as well as the fact that he has captured Wemmbu. Flame returns to his base but gets attacked again. Realizing he needs trap supplies, he recruits a reluctant Lomedy, and comes into conflict with the Law again. He ends up losing the fight and is forced to run away, swearing to not return until he's mastered PVP. 

Wemmbu gets imprisoned by Lettuce, weakened by his last fight with Flame. They run through the prison routine, where Wemmbu meets inmates Fantst, Baablu, and PrinceZam, and guard Loppezz. Lettuce takes him for the announcement, and on the way back someone splashes them with an invisible potion. Wemmbu tries to escape but gets recaptured, so Lettuce puts curse of binding armor on all the inmates before tossing Wemmbu solitary confinement. SpokeIsHere breaks in to offer Wemmbu his freedom in exchange for assistance, but Wemmbu refuses. 

Flame gets attacked by Deputy Ace, Lettuce's second in command. He escapes the battle and goes to Lomedy's farm, convincing a very reluctant Lomedy to let him stay just to regear. While getting wind charges, the Law shows up, but Flame escapes them. Ace comes back with a dozen people and start blowing up Lomedy's farm. Lomedy gives Flame his mace, but Flame is unable to kill them all, and so runs. 

Wemmbu gets out of solitary and begins plotting his escape. He manages to obtain some signs, and uses them to talk to the other prisoners. They start trying to break each other's armor. Baablu has invis in his ender chest, so Wemmbu comes up with a plan to get them into the prison storeroom. It works, but Loppezz catches them. Baablu manages to keep one invis poition, though. While out mining, the prisoners attempt to use it to escape, but get recaptured. All of them are put into solitary, and Spoke returns. Wemmbu finally agrees to Spoke's plan, so Spoke kills the guards and frees the prisoners, allowing them to gear up. They fight their way out of the prison, killing two dozen Law members before being forced to run away.      

Wemmbu flees from the Law as they pursue him. He decides to return to the Far Lands, to acquire more power, but when he attempts to take the ender pearl cannon he used previously, he finds it destroyed. The Law attacks, but he manages to get away and visits the End, to see if Eggchan knows how to build a pearl cannon. Instead, he ends up deciding to free Egg, but to do so he needs help from Spoke. Spoke offers him assistance if Wemmbu helps him kill Leow0ok. Wemmbu tries but fails, and Sloke gives him the info on the condition that Wemmbu owes him another favor. Wemmbu frees Egg and they sneak into Capital City 2.0, intending to run to the Great Sea. The Law attacks them, and after a long fight Wemmbu is forced to surrender. However, Jaden MAN saves him, forcing the Law to flee, and he brings Wemmbu and Egg to Ranger Point.      

ParrotX2 gets a note from 'The Owl' telling them to attend a meeting, which is Lettuce's announcement. His friend TheobaldTheBird convinces him to run for king, and they find another note from the Owl with a compass. It takes them to a giant treehouse, under attack from a group of bandits, who have kidnapped someone. Parrot decides to save them even if it means losing the election, and follows them to their base. He and Theo manage to free the player, and the treehouse's citizens all vote for him as thanks. The bandits attack, but thanks to Parrot's planning they are beaten, with only the leader escaping. Parrot submits his name for the election, currently in sixteenth place.      

Spoke watches as Leow0ok and his spies destroy Quackenstein’s family base, searching for the armor pieces, prompting them to escape through a tunnel with Quackenstein and his family, sending them to safety via a Nether portal, where the family heads to their old snow base before breaking it. Leo and his spies catch up, forcing Spoke to reveal his inventory, but Jumper defends him due to a lack of evidence. Following a speech by LettuceK, Spoke plans to have Wemmbu kill Leo and later eavesdrops on Leo’s conversation to track him. After infiltrating The Law's base, Spoke offers to help Wemmbu escape in exchange for a favor, but Wemmbu refuses. Eventually, Spoke breaks the prisoners out, but when they confront Leo, it becomes clear that Leo's true motive was to catch Spoke in a mistake, proving his guilt as they prepare for an inevitable clash.      

Flame finds Swight, one of the best PVPers, with a Law shield, so he goes invisible and requests training. There are five other competitors, and they are split into groups to fight bandits. Flame's group loses a memmber, while Yungy's doesn't. During a test fight, Flame's invis runs out, forcing him to hide. He gets a do-over on the fight and wins easily, leaving only him and Yungyx left. Swight sends them to face two elite bandits. Yungy runs away from the fight, but Flame manages to kill them both, and so Swight declares him the winner.      

Jaden tells Wemmbu the Law is building an orbital strike cannon and need a full set of music discs, which is rumored to be owned by an item collector. Wemmbu and Egg set out to find the collector, but instead find an island of frog worshippers. The Law find them, but they escape, ending up in a trading port. They find a vendor with slime balls, which are very rare, and Egg persuades him to reveal his buyer. They successfully locate the collector, and Wemmbu duels him, but eventually they make peace. However, Lettuce secretly followed them, and now he steals the music discs and kills the collector. Wemmbu and Egg escape.      

Mapicc goes on a mission to a BAT gear stash, but when he doesn't come back, Spoke follows the tracks and finds the place where he supposedly died. He refuses to believe it at first, until Leo shows up at his base holding Mapicc's shield. Spoke rigs Capital City to blow up unless he gets proof of Mapicc's life, but no one comes except for Parrot, and he wasn't even sent by the Law. However, he does convince Spoke to stand down. After some time, Spoke brings Zam to the BAT gear stash, where he found signs from spies that didn't join the fight, indicating another player was there and saved Mapicc. They follow the tracks, which eventually take them to the Far Lands, where Mapicc is with JamatoP, Spoke's oldest friend. Mapicc wants to live peacefully. Spoke and Jamato speak privately, both condemning each other for supposed villainy, and Jamato stasises away. Spoke disguises himself as Leo and attacks Mapicc and Zam, pretending to get scared off, then comes back as himself, revealing Jamato 'died'. The three of them resolve to kill Leo.      

Lettuce tell that the candidates will live in the Northern Council for their protection. Parrot receives another message from the Owl in his new home. However, while he's away a guard steals the book, forcing Parrot to kill him to get it back. Lettuce announces debates between the candidates, and he will be matched with Parrot. Parrot finally meets the Owl, revealed to be Spepticle. During the debate, Lettuce accuses Parrot of killing the guard, but Spepticle intervenes and takes the fall, getting executed for it. Afterwards, Parrot hears of Capital City being under attack, and stops Spoke from blowing it up, which causes enough people to vote for him that he passes into the next round.      

Flame and Swight come across a base, where a group of players hire them to kill some bandits, who have lots of loot. They agree, and Swight trains Flame in bow boosting while they wait. When the bandits arrive, they fight them off, Flame using traps since killing would reveal his identity. The bandits retreat and they follow them to their base. Flame uses TNT minecarts, but after the bandits are killed, a Lawman shows up, and accuses Flame of being Flame. Flame reveals his identity, causing Swight to attack him, but after a long battle, Swight agrees to let him go.      

All the pirates attack the Law's orbital strike cannon, but Wemmbu steps into a trap that blasts him a hundred thousand blocks away. He visits the location of the Great Sea Treasure, and obtains a Riptide trident as well as directions to another player. That player outfits him with proper gear, and he returns to battle. He attempts to break into the dome surrounding the orbital cannon, but fails due to ender guardians and retreats. At Ranger Point, he reunites with Egg and the remaining pirates (Jaden was captured), and they decide to make one last effort. After a long and hard battle, Wemmbu breaks inside and destroys the cannon.      

Flame finds ManePear's base, and although Mane initially doesn't want to train him, he later agrees, teaching him the basics. They attack a base full of elite bandits, and Mane tries to renege on the deal, but relents when Flame followed him. He teaches Flame how to use the spear, and then Flame convinces him to help find the Law's base. They debate Flame's mindset and ego on the way there. At a small village, they kill everyone while trying to get information, and SargeLaw shows up with Lawmen, managing to take Flame captive. However, Mane breaks him out, and they go on a rampage before parting ways.      

Bandits attack the Northern Council and kill Naparizel. Lettuce reveals that Napa supposedly wrote a book requesting a 24-hour time where the candidates can kill each other to obtain books that contain Napa's votes. Parrot gives his up to save Horace Altman from Boosfer, but Boosfer and Fymada both loses theirs to Arachn1d. They follow Arachnid, but he sets up a trap for them, and Parrot and Horace are caught. Parrot signals Fymada to get help, and they are able to escape, forcing Arachnid to drop all the books so he doesn't die. On the way back, they are ambushed by Purpled, who captures Horace. Parrot and Fymada break him out and return home, where Horace and Fymada let Parrot keep their vote books so he can pass on to the next round.      

Flame finds ItzRealMe at the old BAT Headquarters, and requests training. Itz tests him in all four game modes: sword, spear, mace, and carts, then teaches him mace techniques, as well as 'the zone', where you must free yourself of distractions. Some random players show up and try to attack Flame, so he kills them. Itz brings him to a giant floating island and requests his mace, which Flame reluctantly gives. Itz attacks him, and Flame runs and hides before realizing Itz is trying to make him use the zone. He comes back out and successfully defeats Itz, earning his mace back.      

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam find a village, which Spoke blows up using an exploit to get items from reluctant townsfolk. They visit BAT's secret library, where they find wreckage from a battle and realize someone is following them. They set up secret stasises and build a sky base, when beacons light up suddenly. Spoke follows them and finds Leo and a bunch of Lawmen. He warns the others, and they prepare to fight them off before escaping when the base is overwhelmed. They attack Leo and make him stasis away, then use an arrow trick to find his current location. On the way there, Spoke's stasis gets pulled.      

Lettuce announces another debate, and Parrot decides to go try and find Wemmbu, to prove Lettuce's incompetence. He finds him at the Great Sea and convinces him to team up. Parrot visits CoinMonke, a smuggler, and he gives them a route back to spawn. They are continually attacked by Lawmen as they try to make their way back to spawn, since they have both been declared criminals. Wemmbu finally captures Parrot, planning to kill him for unveiling his identity, but Parrot convinces him they need each other to stop the Law. They reach the contact Coin gave them, but he turns out to be a Lawman and blows up TNT. Theo shows up there and fights The Oroboros, one of the Law's commanders, killing him but being apprehended by SargeLaw. Parrot brings Wemmbu to the debate, and accuses Lettuce of failing, but Lettuce cancels the election under the pretense of continued danger, and privately threatens Parrot to back down or else Theo will die.      

When Parrot visits Wemmbu, Wemmbu plans to kill him, and directs Egg to secretly follow them to attack at the right time. They are attacked by Lawmen multiple times, and Wemmbu also talks briefly with Egg, learning that he's trying to infiltrate the Law. They are caught by SargeLaw in a mountain, but Parrot, Egg, and Wemmbu are able to escape together, and Wemmbu kills the few Lawmen that follow them. He plans to kill Parrot, but Parrot convinces him that they need each other to defeat the Law. Wemmbu lets him live and attends the debate, then stasises away when Lettuce attacks him. He teleported to the same pearl cannon Spoke used where 4CVIT and Egg are waiting for him.      

Wemmbu and Egg return to the Farlands. They are met by Jamato, and Wemmbu convinces him they are friends with Serpentbound333, the leader of the Farlands civilization. Jamato brings them to a jungle with murals of places, one of which Wemmbu recognizes as The Underworld. They enter the Underworld through a portal, then enter another portal that brings them to the correct side of the Farlands. Wemmbu attacks Jamato, since he doesn't need him anymore, but Jamato stasies away. Wemmbu and Egg are attacked by Nitenly and Firestar2008, members of the Farlands civilization, on the way to the orbital cannons, but both are defeated. Wemmbu reloads the cannons and sets up a stasis for future use. They then find a stronghold and enter the End.      

Flame finds Theo, a master of TNT minecarts, and requests to train with him. He's reluctant to let Parrot go to the Great Sea alone, but eventually agrees. He teaches Flame some TNT minecart tricks, and then they go to the Black Market outside Capital City to get more minecarts. Flame also obtains several stacks of EXP. G0dOfWar, one of the Law commanders, shows up, and Flame fights him but is forced to flee due to lack of gear. Theo trains him more, then sends him off to fight GodOfWar again. Flame meditates to enter the zone, then goes to GodOfWar's base. The two fight for a long time before Flame eventually forces GodOfWar to surrender, telling him to come back when he's stronger before leaving. All that's left now is to take out the Law.      

It's revealed that JumperWho teleported Spoke and betrayed BAT, because Leo kept using her spies as soldiers. Spoke refuses her offer of teaming up, and instead sends a message to the Law, giving them his coordinates. He sets up traps with help from Mapicc and Zam, and then Jumper makes her offer again. He refuses it, and the three head to where Leo has set up camp. They kill his soldiers, but Leo takes Zam hostage. Jumper saves him, and Spoke has another argument with her. She shows him Leo's secret base, where he's been building TNT cannons. They successfully escape and take down more Lawmen, and Spoke finally agrees to team with Jumper.      

Wemmbu and Egg find the End full of Lawmen, and Wemmbu realizes his orbitals don't work there. They escape to the outer islands, and Egg leads them to a stash of gear MinuteTech told him about. They find Minute himself, gear up, and then go back. After a massive battle, they escape through the End portal back into the Overworld. Minute and Wemmbu fight GodOfWar, and then Wemmbu flies to the Northern Council to confront Lettuce. Lettuce, however, threatens to kill Jaden if Wemmbu doesn't surrender.      

Parrot is taken prisoner by Lettuce, but an unknown person breaks him out. He attacks a random Lawman and learns where Theo is being held. He goes and successfully breaks Theo out, but Lettuce pulls a stasis he forced Theo to set. He then brings Parrot back to the Northern Council to force him to endorse him, but Parrot refuses. Lettuce brings Parrot and Theo both to Capital City to be executed, but Deputy_Ace saves them, and is killed by Lettuce for his betrayal. Parrot and Theo head to District 13 and find it full of people, whom Parrot convinces to help fight the Law. They sneak into a Law outpost, but are forced to retreat. While plotting a way to break in, Spoke, Wemmbu, and Flame all show up and attack the base. They get the gear and all head to the Northern Council. After a massive battle, Lettuce surrenders. It's put to a vote whether he lives or dies, but Wemmbu chooses to let him live. Parrot restarts the election and wins, becoming the first king of the Unstable SMP.      

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam sneak into a Law prison and free the BAT spies imprisoned there, but are attacked by Lawmen. Minute saves them, brought by Jumper, and Jumper sends her spies off. They report that Parrot is in the Law prison, and so the three sneak in (Mapicc and Minute are off getting Minute's other gear stashes). Wemmbu and Flame break into the prison at the same time, and Spoke aids Flame in fighting. The three find someone surrounded by obsidian and guards, but it turns out to be Jaden_MAN rather than Parrot. Spoke brings everyone, Flame and Wemmbu included, to his castle, where Mapicc and Minute meet them. They learn via spies that hundreds of Lawman are converging on a Law stash, and head there. Spoke sets up landmines and realizes Parrot and Theo are there. It turns into a massive battle, after which Parrot brings them all to District 13. They go to the Northern Council and destroy Lettuce's army. Mapicc vanishes. After Lettuce surrenders, Jumper's spies report Leo's location, so the two go there. They trap him, but he activates his stasis. Spoke, however, found Leo's stasis chamber earlier and set it up over the void. Leo dies.      

Lettuce threatens to kill Jaden if Wemmbu ever fights him again. Wemmbu leaves and meets up with Egg again, and then Jumper finds them and tells them Jaden is being held at the same prison Wemmbu escaped from. Wemmbu heads there and finds Flame at his base, gearing up, so they attack the prison together. While Flame goes in, Wemmbu stays on the surface to fight. Eventually, Jaden is released and he, Flame, Spoke, Zam, and Jumper come up. They all head to Spoke's castle together, meeting up with Mapicc, Minute, and Egg. They head to the Law outpost and pick up Parrot, who brings them to District 13 to make a speech. They march on the Northern Council and kill both of Lettuce's armies. Wemmbu and Minute chase Lettuce but fail to catch up, and they talk about killing Lettuce on the way back, influencing Wemmbu's decision to spare Lettuce after he surrenders. Wemmbu and Egg leave to start a new adventure.      

Flame is gearing up to free Lomedy from prison when Lettuce visits him and makes one last plea for him to stop. Flame refuses, so Lettuce leaves, and then Wemmbu shows up. They team up and break into the prison, Flame entering and killing guards with help from Spoke, Zam, and Jumper. Lomedy, however, refuses to go with him. Flame accompanies the others to Spoke's castle and then to the Law stash, though he doesn't see why they need Parrot. They destroy the Law's army at the Northern Council, and after Lettuce flees, Flame attacks Jaden, intending to get back the mace for Lomedy. Wemmbu intervenes, but their fight is ended when Lettuce returns. Flame doesn't understand why everyone wants to spare him, but makes a promise to Lettuce to try and do better, then goes back to the prison for Lomedy. He returns his mace, and Lomedy decides to go with him.

[[The Kings Arc]], also known as [[The Election Arc]], is the third '''major''' arc in ''[[Unstable Universe]]''.

== Story ==
'''Note:''' Spoke's episodes will be included both here and at the [[BAT Arc]] page. 

[[FlameFrags]] gets attacked by members of [[The Law]], because their leader [[LettuceK]] has exiled him from a 50k radius around spawn. He attends an announcement Lettuce makes to the entire server, where Lettuce reveals his plans to hold an election for a king, as well as the fact that he has captured [[Wemmbu]]. Flame returns to his base but gets attacked again. Realizing he needs trap supplies, he recruits a reluctant [[Lomedy]], and comes into conflict with the Law again. He ends up losing the fight and is forced to run away, swearing to not return until he's mastered PVP. 

Wemmbu gets imprisoned by Lettuce, weakened by his last fight with Flame. They run through the prison routine, where Wemmbu meets inmates [[Fantst]], [[Baablu]], and [[PrinceZam]], and guard [[Loppezz]]. Lettuce takes him for the announcement, and on the way back someone splashes them with an invisible potion. Wemmbu tries to escape but gets recaptured, so Lettuce puts curse of binding armor on all the inmates before tossing Wemmbu solitary confinement. [[SpokeIsHere]] breaks in to offer Wemmbu his freedom in exchange for assistance, but Wemmbu refuses. 

Flame gets attacked by [[Deputy Ace]], Lettuce's second in command. He escapes the battle and goes to Lomedy's farm, convincing a very reluctant Lomedy to let him stay just to regear. While getting wind charges, the Law shows up, but Flame escapes them. Ace comes back with a dozen people and start blowing up Lomedy's farm. Lomedy gives Flame his mace, but Flame is unable to kill them all, and so runs. 

Wemmbu gets out of solitary and begins plotting his escape. He manages to obtain some signs, and uses them to talk to the other prisoners. They start trying to break each other's armor. Baablu has invis in his ender chest, so Wemmbu comes up with a plan to get them into the prison storeroom. It works, but Loppezz catches them. Baablu manages to keep one invis poition, though. While out mining, the prisoners attempt to use it to escape, but get recaptured. All of them are put into solitary, and Spoke returns. Wemmbu finally agrees to Spoke's plan, so Spoke kills the guards and frees the prisoners, allowing them to gear up. They fight their way out of the prison, killing two dozen Law members before being forced to run away.      

Wemmbu flees from the Law as they pursue him. He decides to return to the [[Far Lands]], to acquire more power, but when he attempts to take the ender pearl cannon he used previously, he finds it destroyed. The Law attacks, but he manages to get away and visits the End, to see if [[Eggchan]] knows how to build a pearl cannon. Instead, he ends up deciding to free Egg, but to do so he needs help from Spoke. Spoke offers him assistance if Wemmbu helps him kill [[Leow0ok]]. Wemmbu tries but fails, and Sloke gives him the info on the condition that Wemmbu owes him another favor. Wemmbu frees Egg and they sneak into [[Capital City 2.0]], intending to run to the [[Great Sea]]. The Law attacks them, and after a long fight Wemmbu is forced to surrender. However, [[Jaden MAN]] saves him, forcing the Law to flee, and he brings Wemmbu and Egg to [[Ranger Point]].      

[[ParrotX2]] gets a note from 'The Owl' telling them to attend a meeting, which is Lettuce's announcement. His friend [[TheobaldTheBird]] convinces him to run for king, and they find another note from the Owl with a compass. It takes them to a giant treehouse, under attack from a group of bandits, who have kidnapped someone. Parrot decides to save them even if it means losing the election, and follows them to their base. He and Theo manage to free the player, and the treehouse's citizens all vote for him as thanks. The bandits attack, but thanks to Parrot's planning they are beaten, with only the leader escaping. Parrot submits his name for the election, currently in sixteenth place.      

Spoke watches as Leow0ok and his spies destroy Quackenstein’s family base, searching for the armor pieces, prompting them to escape through a tunnel with Quackenstein and his family, sending them to safety via a Nether portal, where the family heads to their old snow base before breaking it. Leo and his spies catch up, forcing Spoke to reveal his inventory, but Jumper defends him due to a lack of evidence. Following a speech by LettuceK, Spoke plans to have Wemmbu kill Leo and later eavesdrops on Leo’s conversation to track him. After infiltrating The Law's base, Spoke offers to help Wemmbu escape in exchange for a favor, but Wemmbu refuses. Eventually, Spoke breaks the prisoners out, but when they confront Leo, it becomes clear that Leo's true motive was to catch Spoke in a mistake, proving his guilt as they prepare for an inevitable clash.      

Flame finds [[Swight]], one of the best PVPers, with a Law shield, so he goes invisible and requests training. There are five other competitors, and they are split into groups to fight bandits. Flame's group loses a memmber, while Yungy's doesn't. During a test fight, Flame's invis runs out, forcing him to hide. He gets a do-over on the fight and wins easily, leaving only him and [[Yungyx]] left. Swight sends them to face two elite bandits. Yungy runs away from the fight, but Flame manages to kill them both, and so Swight declares him the winner.      

Jaden tells Wemmbu the Law is building an orbital strike cannon and need a full set of music discs, which is rumored to be owned by an item collector. Wemmbu and Egg set out to find the collector, but instead find an island of frog worshippers. The Law find them, but they escape, ending up in a trading port. They find a vendor with slime balls, which are very rare, and Egg persuades him to reveal his buyer. They successfully locate the collector, and Wemmbu duels him, but eventually they make peace. However, Lettuce secretly followed them, and now he steals the music discs and kills the collector. Wemmbu and Egg escape.      

Mapicc goes on a mission to a BAT gear stash, but when he doesn't come back, Spoke follows the tracks and finds the place where he supposedly died. He refuses to believe it at first, until Leo shows up at his base holding Mapicc's shield. Spoke rigs Capital City to blow up unless he gets proof of Mapicc's life, but no one comes except for Parrot, and he wasn't even sent by the Law. However, he does convince Spoke to stand down. After some time, Spoke brings Zam to the BAT gear stash, where he found signs from spies that didn't join the fight, indicating another player was there and saved Mapicc. They follow the tracks, which eventually take them to the [[Far Lands]], where Mapicc is with [[JamatoP]], Spoke's oldest friend. Mapicc wants to live peacefully. Spoke and Jamato speak privately, both condemning each other for supposed villainy, and Jamato stasises away. Spoke disguises himself as Leo and attacks Mapicc and Zam, pretending to get scared off, then comes back as himself, revealing Jamato 'died'. The three of them resolve to kill Leo.      

Lettuce tell that the candidates will live in the Northern Council for their protection. Parrot receives another message from the Owl in his new home. However, while he's away a guard steals the book, forcing Parrot to kill him to get it back. Lettuce announces debates between the candidates, and he will be matched with Parrot. Parrot finally meets the Owl, revealed to be [[Spepticle]]. During the debate, Lettuce accuses Parrot of killing the guard, but Spepticle intervenes and takes the fall, getting executed for it. Afterwards, Parrot hears of Capital City being under attack, and stops Spoke from blowing it up, which causes enough people to vote for him that he passes into the next round.

When the bandits arrive, they fight them off, Flame using traps since killing would reveal his identity. The bandits retreat and they follow them to their base. Flame uses TNT minecarts, but after the bandits are killed, a Lawman shows up, and accuses Flame of being Flame. Flame reveals his identity, causing Swight to attack him, but after a long battle, Swight agrees to let him go.

He attempts to break into the dome surrounding the orbital cannon, but fails due to ender guardians and retreats. At Ranger Point, he reunites with Egg and the remaining pirates (Jaden was captured), and they decide to make one last effort. It's revealed that [[JumperWho]] teleported Spoke and betrayed BAT, because Leo kept using her spies as soldiers. Spoke refuses her offer of teaming up, and instead sends a message to the Law, giving them his coordinates. He sets up traps with help from Mapicc and Zam, and then Jumper makes her offer again. He refuses it, and the three head to where Leo has set up camp. They kill his soldiers, but Leo takes Zam hostage. Jumper saves him, and Spoke has another argument with her. She shows him Leo's secret base, where he's been building TNT cannons. They successfully escape and take down more Lawmen, and Spoke finally agrees to team with Jumper.      

Wemmbu and Egg find the End full of Lawmen, and Wemmbu realizes his orbitals don't work there. They escape to the outer islands, and Egg leads them to a stash of gear [[MinuteTech]] told him about. They find Minute himself, gear up, and then go back. After a massive battle, they escape through the End portal back into the Overworld. Minute and Wemmbu fight GodOfWar, and then Wemmbu flies to the [[Northern Council]] to confront Lettuce. Lettuce, however, threatens to kill Jaden if Wemmbu doesn't surrender.      

Parrot is taken prisoner by Lettuce, but an unknown person breaks him out. He attacks a random Lawman and learns where Theo is being held. He goes and successfully breaks Theo out, but Lettuce pulls a stasis he forced Theo to set. He then brings Parrot back to the Northern Council to force him to endorse him, but Parrot refuses. Lettuce brings Parrot and Theo both to [[Capital City]] to be executed, but Deputy_Ace saves them, and is killed by Lettuce for his betrayal. Parrot and Theo head to [[District 13]] and find it full of people, whom Parrot convinces to help fight the Law. They sneak into a Law outpost, but are forced to retreat. While plotting a way to break in, Spoke, Wemmbu, and Flame all show up and attack the base. They get the gear and all head to the Northern Council. After a massive battle, Lettuce surrenders. It's put to a vote whether he lives or dies, but Wemmbu chooses to let him live. Parrot restarts the election and wins, becoming the first king of the Unstable SMP.      

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam sneak into a Law prison and free the BAT spies imprisoned there, but are attacked by Lawmen. Minute saves them, brought by Jumper, and Jumper sends her spies off. They report that Parrot is in the Law prison, and so the three sneak in (Mapicc and Minute are off getting Minute's other gear stashes). Wemmbu and Flame break into the prison at the same time, and Spoke aids Flame in fighting. The three find someone surrounded by obsidian and guards, but it turns out to be Jaden_MAN rather than Parrot. Spoke brings everyone, Flame and Wemmbu included, to his castle, where Mapicc and Minute meet them. They learn via spies that hundreds of Lawman are converging on a Law stash, and head there. Spoke sets up landmines and realizes Parrot and Theo are there. It turns into a massive battle, after which Parrot brings them all to District 13. They go to the Northern Council and destroy Lettuce's army. Mapicc vanishes. After Lettuce surrenders, Jumper's spies report Leo's location, so the two go there. They trap him, but he activates his stasis. Spoke, however, found Leo's stasis chamber earlier and set it up over the void. Leo dies.      

Lettuce threatens to kill Jaden if Wemmbu ever fights him again. Wemmbu leaves and meets up with Egg again, and then Jumper finds them and tells them Jaden is being held at the same prison Wemmbu escaped from. Wemmbu heads there and finds Flame at his base, gearing up, so they attack the prison together. While Flame goes in, Wemmbu stays on the surface to fight. Eventually, Jaden is released and he, Flame, Spoke, Zam, and Jumper come up. They all head to Spoke's castle together, meeting up with Mapicc, Minute, and Egg. They head to the Law outpost and pick up Parrot, who brings them to District 13 to make a speech. They march on the Northern Council and kill both of Lettuce's armies. Wemmbu and Minute chase Lettuce but fail to catch up, and they talk about killing Lettuce on the way back, influencing Wemmbu's decision to spare Lettuce after he surrenders. Wemmbu and Egg leave to start a new adventure.      

Flame is gearing up to free Lomedy from prison when Lettuce visits him and makes one last plea for him to stop. Flame refuses, so Lettuce leaves, and then Wemmbu shows up. They team up and break into the prison, Flame entering and killing guards with help from Spoke, Zam, and Jumper. Lomedy, however, refuses to go with him. Flame accompanies the others to Spoke's castle and then to the Law stash, though he doesn't see why they need Parrot. They destroy the Law's army at the Northern Council, and after Lettuce flees, Flame attacks Jaden, intending to get back the mace for Lomedy. Wemmbu intervenes, but their fight is ended when Lettuce returns. Flame doesn't understand why everyone wants to spare him, but makes a promise to Lettuce to try and do better, then goes back to the prison for Lomedy. He returns his mace, and Lomedy decides to go with him.

title: The Law
content:
The Law, also spelled as the LAW, was one of the largest teams on the Unstable SMP. It was founded by LettuceK in early Season 2 (right before The Director's death) and serves as the main antagonists of The Kings Arc. Their main goal was to "serve justice to evil and protect all players on the Unstable SMP". 

After a battle against FlameFrags and Wemmbu, losing 1000 of it's soldiers, The Law's goals changed. It's leader, LettuceK, is willing to do anything to achieve his goals, and uses The Law's influence to take over the server. Almost all members of The Law followed LettuceK's orders blindly and did not know the truth. These players truly believe that they are doing it for the good of the server.  

After the imprisonment of LettuceK, The Law started spreading newspapers to inform people about what was going on in the server. It was revealed that The Law's new leader is CircusMaximus_ in the Kingdoms Arc, and that they had a major change of leadership making them now a good organization again.

Despite the change of leadership, SargeLAW and his rouge band of former Law members managed to take over Law and expanded its membership yet again and also planned to join Cindercrest. Law was destroyed by Parrot and his Royal Army before they could join Cindercrest.

 History 
The Law prevented FlameFrags from trying to find Jaden_MAN. Flame temporarily got rid of them and saves Jaden_MAN. Jaden later betrayed FlameFrags for The Law.

Wemmbu demanded that they tell him where FlameFrags is but they don't cooperate. The Law’s weak army attacked Wemmbu, trying to kill him, which lead to Wemmbu blowing them up as well as destroying The Law’s base with orbital strike cannons.

While Flame and Wemmbu's rivalry was ongoing, The Law got stronger and bigger in numbers.

The Law tried to imprison and kill Flame and Wemmbu and multiple times due to the crimes they've committed in the past. Flame and Wemmbu sneak into The Law's Headquarters and challenged Lettuce to a fight between them against every member of The Law, to which Lettuce agreed. They both killed all 1000 players Lettuce sent after them, leaving no one alive but himself. Flame turned on Wemmbu at the end of fight, wanting to continue their duel, which lead to Wemmbu giving up on the title of "The Strongest" and admitting Flame had won. Lettuce was then able to imprison Wemmbu who ran out all resources in the fight.

Wemmbu was taken to The Law Prison which also had PrinceZam, Baablu, Fantst and other criminals. Lettuce gave a speech in front of the whole server, where he announced that the server needs a ruler and announced the election. Wanting to become king, Lettuce brought Wemmbu in front of everyone and states that he would swiftly execute him if he was elected.

Spoke secretly offered his help to Wemmbu by helping him escape on three different occasions in exchange for his loyalty. Wemmbu refused the first two chances but later, having no choice, accepted Spoke's help on the third occasion.

The Law killed a large amount of pirates in the Great Sea, as well as innocent players who didn't comply, and captured Jaden_MAN. Lettuce was able to obtain enough music discs required to finish the Orbital Strike Cannon, however, the machine was blown up by Wemmbu and eggchan eventually.

FlameFrags was imprisoned by The Law, but ManePear was able to help him escape, causing him to now be an enemy of The Law due to working with a criminal and helping him escape prison. They killed a huge number of Law elites.

Following the qualification of Parrot into the quarter-finals of the election, Lettuce commenced a purge. He hired assassins to kill Naparizel mentioned that Napa left a will that 1/7th of his votes (120 votes) should be equally distributed to all the candidates through books signed by him, and announced that all crime would be allowed between candidates in order for them to receive each other's votes in the next 24 hours. The 4 winners ended up being Lettuce, Purpled, Parrot and Boosfer.

The Law hunted down Parrot and Wemmbu but were unable to kill them. Law commander The_Oroboros was killed in combat by TheobaldTheBird.

Leow0ok dragged The Law into his war against Spoke and Jumper. Spoke successfully killed hundreds of Law-men in battle. Following internal conflict in the Bounty Assassin Team, Leow0ok joined The Law and became a High Ranking Commander. 

LettuceK uses The Law's manpower to send huge armies against Wemmbu and MinuteTech in the end dimension. They both killed hundreds of Law-men in the battles. After Wemmbu defeated Law-men he confronted Lettuce, who threatened to kill Jaden_MAN. 

Law commander Deputy_Ace betrayed Law to help Parrot escape instead of killing him and SargeLAW killed him. 

Purpled joieds The Law as an Elite and was present during the final battle. 

The Law fought its final battle and were finally defeated by District 13. SargeLAW deserted Lettuce in battle. The Law used its largest army of elites which were fully stacked with netherite armors but the army was still destroyed. The Law's reputation was destroyed because they lost thousands of players in the battle and Lettuce was captured.  TheGOdOfWar left Law presumably to do PvP training. Not long after High Ranking Commander of Law, Leow0ok was killed by Spoke. Parrot becomes the king of the server, Wemmbu can finally roam free again and FlameFrags begins his journey of becoming a combat grandmaster.

 After LettuceK 
After the 6 day war, a lot of members of Law decided to leave and do their own thing and The Law's numbers have been declining since. The Law's old leadership was almost completely finished and a few remaining members of The Law's elite force have taken charge since.

After Law got defeated, a player by the name OrionCat was sent to deliver newspapers and they spotted FlameFrags and Lomedy, handed them newspaper and told them that they aren't in bad terms with The Law anymore. The remaining Law-men even helped rebuild FlameFrags' base which was destroyed by a player wanting to challenge him. The Law now would truly help players following the change of leadership, under CircusMaximus_, the new Law commander. He wanted nothing to do with old Law (under LettuceK).

Law built a huge base for FlameFrags but used a lot of resources which they no longer have a lot of, so they came to repossess the base they built for FlameFrags. FlameFrags wished to keep the base and asked if there was another way he could help. OrionCat introduced him to The Law's new commander who made FlameFrags join The Law for 100 days in exchange for having the base. FlameFrags helped The Law in multiple tasks but also loses two Law-men which made the commander upset. It seemed that The Law is also fighting Arachn1d, with some of their outposts being captured and some members of Law are being taken hostage as well. FlameFrags' last task was to see if Lettuce was still alive and he was sent by the commander who feared that other Law-men will free Lettuce. This showed that The LAW's new leadership now no longer likes Lettuce.  

After FlameFrags left Law he was hired by them again to infiltrate The Mist and kill Mistrul. FlameFrags infiltrated The Mist but fails to kill Mistrul. FlameFrags asks The Law to send him Lomedy which they did by force. LAW revealed that Mistrul had been killing many Law-men.  

During this time SargeLAW and his rouge band of LAW soldiers successfully took over The Law and replaced CircusMaximus_ and new Law with his own dictatorship. He had a plan to join Cindercrest. During this period Law's membership swelled again to 1000 Law-men under SargeLAW. He recruited new players who have joined the server because of Parrot clearing Spawn and making it safe. Despite this Law lost focus of its ideals yet again. New Law's leadership were probably forced to join this or exiled.  

FlameFrags and Lomedy left Law and join Cindercrest. SargeLAW took over leadership. King Parrot made a fateful decision. He forcefully asked SargeLAW to join his Royal Army. Some new players of The Law decided to cross the bridge from Law City and join Parrot. Then SargeLAW revealed that he planned on joining Cindercrest. Without mercy, Parrot activated a giant TNT trap that killed hundreds of Law-men who refused to join and also destroyed most of the Law city. SargeLAW was presumably imprisoned or killed by King Parrot's army along with the rest of his troops. With this, the remaining 1000 players of The Law were all killed, except for the few who joined the Royal Army. This likely finished off The Law for good. It is unlikely that New Law had retaken control as they probably had joined the Royal Army. 

The members of LAW that defected to the royal army make their own LAW under Parrot but it is significantly weakened and is under the Royal Army. Members of The LAW legion were probably destroyed by Cindercrest in order to advance to Highwater City. 

 Hierarchy 
Most members of The Law were given protection 2 diamond armor, 5 golden apples, 16 bread and white banner shields containing The Law's insignia. They had very weak equipment but they had such large numbers that were unseen before in the server. These ordinary members of The Law were numbered in the thousands. Following the 6 day war there were still a lot members of The Law.

High ranking members of The Law which were part of The Law's Elite Force were given protection 4 netherite armor, and their shields have a black banner with The Law's insignia instead of a white one. They were very stacked but were almost completely wiped out in the numerous battles they fought in as The Law did not have the resources to recruit more. 

The Law also had high ranking officers such as Deputy Ace, SargeLAW, TheGOdOfWar, The_Oroboros, and Leow0ok. These officers gave orders to Law forces around the server and were the main commanders of The Law.

We are a group on the server that serves justice to evil and protects all of you every single day.|[[LettuceK]] to the Unstable SMP|[[I Got Exiled from the Unstable SMP]], [[I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP]]}}

[[The Law]], also spelled as [[The Law|the LAW]], was one of the largest teams on the Unstable SMP. It was founded by [[LettuceK]] in early [[Season 2]] (right before [[The Director]]'s death) and serves as the main antagonists of [[The Kings Arc]]. Their main goal was to "serve justice to evil and protect all players on the [[Unstable SMP]]". 

After a battle against [[FlameFrags]] and [[Wemmbu]], losing 1000 of it's soldiers, The Law's goals changed. It's leader, LettuceK, is willing to do anything to achieve his goals, and uses The Law's influence to take over the server. Almost all [[The Law's Elite Force|members]] of The Law followed LettuceK's orders blindly and did not know the truth. These players truly believe that they are doing it for the good of the server.  

After the imprisonment of [[LettuceK]], The Law started spreading newspapers to inform people about what was going on in the server. It was revealed that The Law's new leader is [[CircusMaximus_]] in [[the Kingdoms Arc]], and that they had a major change of leadership making them now a good organization again.

Despite the change of leadership, [[SargeLAW]] and his rouge band of former Law members managed to take over Law and expanded its membership yet again and also planned to join [[Cindercrest]]. Law was destroyed by [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and his [[Royal Army]] before they could join Cindercrest.

== History ==
The Law prevented [[FlameFrags]] from trying to find [[Jaden_MAN]]. Flame temporarily got rid of them and saves Jaden_MAN. Jaden later betrayed FlameFrags for The Law.

[[Wemmbu]] demanded that they tell him where FlameFrags is but they don't cooperate. The Law’s weak army attacked [[Wemmbu]], trying to kill him, which lead to Wemmbu blowing them up as well as destroying The Law’s base with [[Orbital Strike Cannon|orbital strike cannons]].

While Flame and Wemmbu's rivalry was ongoing, The Law got stronger and bigger in numbers.

The Law tried to imprison and kill Flame and Wemmbu and multiple times due to the crimes they've committed in the past. Flame and Wemmbu sneak into The Law's Headquarters and challenged Lettuce to a fight between them against every member of The Law, to which Lettuce agreed. They both killed all 1000 players Lettuce sent after them, leaving no one alive but himself. Flame turned on Wemmbu at the end of fight, wanting to continue their duel, which lead to Wemmbu giving up on the title of "The Strongest" and admitting Flame had won. Lettuce was then able to imprison Wemmbu who ran out all resources in the fight.

Wemmbu was taken to The Law Prison which also had [[PrinceZam]], [[Baablu]], [[Fantst]] and other criminals. Lettuce gave a speech in front of the whole server, where he announced that the server needs a ruler and announced the election. Wanting to become king, Lettuce brought Wemmbu in front of everyone and states that he would swiftly execute him if he was elected.

[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] secretly offered his help to Wemmbu by helping him escape on three different occasions in exchange for his loyalty. Wemmbu refused the first two chances but later, having no choice, accepted Spoke's help on the third occasion.

The Law killed a large amount of pirates in the [[Great Sea]], as well as innocent players who didn't comply, and captured [[Jaden_MAN]]. Lettuce was able to obtain enough music discs required to finish the [[Orbital Strike Cannon]], however, the machine was blown up by [[Wemmbu]] and [[eggchan]] eventually.

FlameFrags was imprisoned by The Law, but [[ManePear]] was able to help him escape, causing him to now be an enemy of The Law due to working with a criminal and helping him escape prison. They killed a huge number of Law elites.

Following the qualification of [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] into the quarter-finals of the election, Lettuce commenced a purge. He hired assassins to kill [[Naparizel]] mentioned that Napa left a will that 1/7th of his votes (120 votes) should be equally distributed to all the candidates through books signed by him, and announced that all crime would be allowed between candidates in order for them to receive each other's votes in the next 24 hours. The 4 winners ended up being Lettuce, [[Purpled]], Parrot and [[Boosfer]].

The Law hunted down Parrot and Wemmbu but were unable to kill them. [[The Law's Elite Force|Law commander]] [[The_Oroboros]] was killed in combat by [[TheobaldTheBird]].

[[Leow0ok]] dragged The Law into his war against Spoke and [[JumperWho|Jumper]]. Spoke successfully killed hundreds of Law-men in battle. Following internal conflict in the [[Bounty Assassin Team]], Leow0ok joined The Law and became a [[The Law's Elite Force|High Ranking Commander]]. 

LettuceK uses The Law's manpower to send huge armies against Wemmbu and MinuteTech in the end dimension. They both killed hundreds of Law-men in the battles. After Wemmbu defeated Law-men he confronted Lettuce, who threatened to kill Jaden_MAN. 

Law commander [[Deputy_Ace]] betrayed Law to help Parrot escape instead of killing him and SargeLAW killed him. 

[[Purpled]] joieds The Law as an [[The Law's Elite Force|Elite]] and was present during the final battle. 

The Law fought its final battle and were finally defeated by [[District 13]]. [[SargeLAW]] deserted Lettuce in battle. The Law used its largest army of elites which were fully stacked with netherite armors but the army was still destroyed. The Law's reputation was destroyed because they lost thousands of players in the battle and Lettuce was captured.  [[TheGOdOfWar]] left Law presumably to do PvP training. Not long after [[The Law's Elite Force|High Ranking Commander]] of Law, [[Leow0ok]] was killed by Spoke. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] becomes the king of the server, [[Wemmbu]] can finally roam free again and [[FlameFrags]] begins his journey of becoming a combat grandmaster.

=== After LettuceK ===
After the 6 day war, a lot of members of Law decided to leave and do their own thing and The Law's numbers have been declining since. The Law's old leadership was almost completely finished and a few remaining members of The Law's elite force have taken charge since.

After Law got defeated, a player by the name [[OrionCat]] was sent to deliver newspapers and they spotted [[FlameFrags]] and [[Lomedy]], handed them newspaper and told them that they aren't in bad terms with The Law anymore. The remaining Law-men even helped rebuild FlameFrags' base which was destroyed by a player wanting to challenge him. The Law now would truly help players following the change of leadership, under [[CircusMaximus_]], the new Law commander. He wanted nothing to do with old Law (under LettuceK).

Law built a huge base for FlameFrags but used a lot of resources which they no longer have a lot of, so they came to repossess the base they built for FlameFrags. FlameFrags wished to keep the base and asked if there was another way he could help. [[OrionCat]] introduced him to The Law's new commander who made FlameFrags join The Law for 100 days in exchange for having the base. FlameFrags helped The Law in multiple tasks but also loses two Law-men which made the commander upset. It seemed that The Law is also fighting [[Arachn1d]], with some of their outposts being captured and some members of Law are being taken hostage as well. FlameFrags' last task was to see if Lettuce was still alive and he was sent by the commander who feared that other Law-men will free Lettuce. This showed that The LAW's new leadership now no longer likes Lettuce.  

After FlameFrags left Law he was hired by them again to infiltrate [[The Mist]] and kill [[Mistrul]]. FlameFrags infiltrated The Mist but fails to kill Mistrul. FlameFrags asks The Law to send him [[Lomedy]] which they did by force. LAW revealed that Mistrul had been killing many Law-men.  

During this time [[SargeLAW]] and his rouge band of LAW soldiers successfully took over The Law and replaced [[CircusMaximus_]] and new Law with his own dictatorship. He had a plan to join [[Cindercrest]]. During this period Law's membership swelled again to 1000 Law-men under [[SargeLAW]]. He recruited new players who have joined the server because of Parrot clearing Spawn and making it safe. Despite this Law lost focus of its ideals yet again. New Law's leadership were probably forced to join this or exiled.  

FlameFrags and Lomedy left Law and join [[Cindercrest]]. [[SargeLAW]] took over leadership. King [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] made a fateful decision. He forcefully asked SargeLAW to join his [[Royal Army]]. Some new players of The Law decided to cross the bridge from [[Law City]] and join Parrot. Then SargeLAW revealed that he planned on joining [[Cindercrest]]. Without mercy, Parrot activated a giant TNT trap that killed hundreds of Law-men who refused to join and also destroyed most of the [[Law city]]. SargeLAW was presumably imprisoned or killed by King Parrot's army along with the rest of his troops. With this, the remaining 1000 players of The Law were all killed, except for the few who joined the Royal Army. This likely finished off The Law for good. It is unlikely that New Law had retaken control as they probably had joined the Royal Army. 

The members of LAW that defected to the royal army make their own LAW under Parrot but it is significantly weakened and is under the [[Royal Army]]. Members of The LAW legion were probably destroyed by [[Cindercrest]] in order to advance to [[Highwater City]]. 

== Hierarchy ==
Most members of The Law were given protection 2 diamond armor, 5 golden apples, 16 bread and white banner shields containing The Law's insignia. They had very weak equipment but they had such large numbers that were unseen before in the server. These ordinary members of The Law were numbered in the thousands. Following the 6 day war there were still a lot members of The Law.

High ranking members of The Law which were part of [[The Law's Elite Force]] were given protection 4 netherite armor, and their shields have a black banner with The Law's insignia instead of a white one. They were very stacked but were almost completely wiped out in the numerous battles they fought in as The Law did not have the resources to recruit more. 

The Law also had high ranking officers such as [[Deputy Ace]], [[SargeLAW]], [[TheGOdOfWar]], [[The_Oroboros]], and [[Leow0ok]]. These officers gave orders to Law forces around the server and were the main commanders of The Law.

=== Info ===
The Law's Elite Force is a group of Experienced PVPers who has good rank and Full Netherite Armor on the Unstable SMP.

The Law's Elite Force was created by LettuceK, and 4 commanders which is: Deputy_Ace, SargeLaw, The_Oroboros and G0dOfWar. The Law's Elite Force was meant to react to any attacks , whenever a Law member was killed, The Law's Elite Force will be there.

The Law's Elite Force was in the 2v1000 battle against FlameFrags and Wemmbu, none of them survived, then they appeared again when fighting Jaden's Pirates and Wemmbu, the latest appearance of them was in the episode: I Got Trained by A Minecraft Spear Master, they were meant to kill ManePear and FlameFrags, with no doubt, they lost and no one survived except SargeLaw. As Netherite is rare on the Unstable SMP, the only person we know for sure in The Law's Elite Guard are probably the commanders themselves.

In the 1v1000 it is shown that many of The Law's Elite Force had maces which points to the possibility of them being former Mafia players. These players also probably believe in The Law and are unaware of LettuceK's manipulation that allowed him to get total control. Members like SargeLaw think that they are hunting down a evil person and in FlameFrags's latest video he does not kill FlameFrags despite him attempting escape multiple times. This shows that at least most members actually believing in The Law's Ideals. The Mist is a foggy low-visibility frozen region. In the Mist there is Mist Civilization. Members of the civilization prevent anyone from leaving the Mist. title: The NULL Arc
content:
The NULL Arc, or NULL, is an individual arc of SpokeIsHere in Unstable Universe.

 Story 

It begins with Spoke inside of his base enchanting, when all of a sudden his alarm alerted him of players were nearby. Spoke assumes it was bandits and would have to go through his traps first, but it turned out to be more dangerous than he thought. Skinless players with jumbled names came barging in and dodges the first trap, runs into the base and attacks Spoke. This isn't a fight Spoke can take on, so he kites all of the hunters into the middle of the base and sets off a piston trap and drops all of them down on dripstone. Spoke wind charges a lever which activates a stasis, pulling JumperWho and her spies to investigate, as there were no death messages. Spoke believes that someone had hired these hunters to go after him, but doesn't know how to fight them if they don't fear death. Jumper says she's seen them, but doesn't know anything about the hunters, even with her spies, there had no leads to figuring out who they are. Spoke packs up his base and Jumper gives him a paper with coordinates to a safehouse, but he doesn't take it if Jumper isn't going to work on the mission on finding Mapicc.

Spoke goes invisible and wanders off into the wilderness of the Unstable SMP. He talks to the viewers and explains that he hasn't seen Mapicc in over four weeks and after searching around for a few days, he hired Jumper and her spies to help. He says what was strange about the hunters was that they carried a shield with the same pattern as the one Mapicc gave before the big battle against The Law. He goes closer to spawn to find more bases to camp in temporarily, he finds a secret one in a mountain and kills the person living there before him for being a hazard. He quickly realizes that was a bad idea since it would be shown to anyone nearby, and so he sets up a TNT minecart trap right above the entrance. He waits and sees the hunters coming closer, when they enter the tunnel leading into the base, Spoke activates the trap, several hunters get their totems popped and they vanish instantly. Spoke escapes from the base with the remaining hunters chasing after him. The hunters have speed, which covers more horizontal ground and Spoke uses this to his advantage and uses pearls and his trident to get a lead from them. Spoke breaks into somebody's house and restocks, the hunters come shortly after and kill off the residents living there. He tries to leave the base fully invis, but the hunters see him and foils his plan. Spoke still manages to make it out and uses uses blue ice to gain speed to outrun them, and with no other choice, he decides to go to the coordinates to the safehouse. Spoke then decides to tower up and Elytra the rest of the way there, although he dislikes using the Elytra, he thought it was necessary since it was an emergency. Only 200 blocks away, Spoke hides in a mountain quickly to use the bathroom and enables sneak toggle and lets the hunters run by. He inches closer and closer to the safehouse, but the hunters are tailing right behind him. Spoke enters the house, which seemed abandoned, but spies come up from the ground and starts fighting the hunters, giving Spoke time to escape. Jumper was also at the house and the two leave together as the hunters are distracted. Spoke asks if this was the safehouse, but Jumper said it wasn't and that it was just a house. As they run, the leader of the group, _1_88_____x chases after them, but they lose them after getting to the escape tunnel. 

At the end of the escape tunnel is the real safehouse, Jumper instructs Spoke to stay inside of it until she and her spies handle it. Spoke says they don't know how the hunters work and he's seen it work in the past and says they're unkillable. However, Spoke knows a trap that can kill someone even with a totem and says that it's already built and will show Jumper it if he wasn't held hostage inside of the base they were standing inside of. They arrive at the trap, which turns out to be the same arrow rail cannon they built inside in a previous episode. Spoke explains that you can trick the game into shooting it milliseconds after the first shot, and that it looks like there's three shots all in one. Jumper asks Spoke how he knows if killing them would stop this, but Spoke says it may not, but it would get a closer lead on figuring out where Mapicc is. Spoke brings up how Jumper had seen them before and asks what she saw, Jumper tells Spoke that she followed them along with her spies followed one of the hunters and based on what they found, they have a reason to believe Mapicc is still alive. She goes on and says how one of her traders went missing, so she went to the trader's base and saw the exact same hunters, so she followed the hunters for thousands of blocks, when all of a sudden, they'd stop moving and look into the distance. She got closer to get a better view of what happened and saw an armorless player and they all started walking in a straight line. It was revealed that there was a bounty on that armorless player's head and an hour later it was claimed and that they were dead, three hours before she saw that player marching. Spoke now understands that they're trying to break all of his armor to do the same thing to him. Spoke thinks this is a bigger threat than trying to find Mapicc and wants to put an end to this and wants to help out. vc bonbon 

As they walk to their destination, Jumper explains their targets have all had bounties on their heads, Spoke included, and Jumper went to Merchant City and kidnapped the person responsible for this. She says the person doesn't want to talk to Jumper or her spies, but was willing to talk to Spoke. They make it to the location and Jumper breaks a block, revealing a ladder going underground into an obsidian tunnel. Multiple spies guard the entire thing, and once they reach the obsidian box that holds the person, a guard breaks the obsidian, allowing Spoke and Jumper inside. The person that's responsible for this is SirPig_, former mayor of Capital City. He tells Jumper to leave and that everything is between him and Spoke. Spoke confronts SirPig and asks what he knows about the hunters, but SirPig says he has no idea. Spoke tries to bribe him to tell him information, but SirPig tells Spoke to stop worrying about him and start worrying about himself. Spoke says he's trying to work with him, asks for any clues, but all SirPig says all they asked for was a token to prove Spoke was dead was his chestplate gifted to him. Spoke asks for a name one last time or else SirPig dies, SirPig then pulls a fishing rod and stasises out. Spoke hears dozens of people right outside the box and tons of hunters come in and starts attacking him. Jumper comes to help him get out, they get onto the surface, but the hunters make it up before them. Spoke tries to wind charge and pearl to get the hunters off their tail, but the hunters, specifically their leader catch up quickly. The firework rockets shred through their armor and their resources slowly drain. Spoke tells Jumper he has a way to escape, but she won't be able to catch up and tells her to escape on her own for now. Spoke goes on top of a hill full invis and spots Jumper coming up, he quickly asks for an ender chest and grabs an invis potion from a shulker box. He splashes the both of them with invis and they go full invis and hide in a tree, losing track of the hunters. Jumper says her spies are in formation and they need to go activate the trap. The hunters stand looking at Spoke and Jumper, and as they get closer, Jumper commands her spies to come out. The spies serve as a distraction for the hunters. Spoke's armor starts to break, only having his chestplate and a turtle helmet left. Spoke and Jumper run from the fight with the leader, the only one chasing after them. As they near the trap, Spoke tells Jumper to get there first and he'll be there after. Spoke makes it to the house and kites the hunter around as Jumper prepares the trap. Once the trap is set up, Spoke runs towards it and wind charges above, Jumper sets off the trap and kills them in an instant. Their inventory is scattered all over the floor and Spoke picks up a book named "mission: null".

Spoke and Jumper are then forced to run and hide by the appearance of more hunters. They build a grave for their fallen leader and leave a book in a chest before leaving.

Spoke breaks into somebody's house and restocks, the hunters come shortly after and kill off the residents living there. He tries to leave the base fully invis, but the hunters see him and foils his plan. Spoke still manages to make it out and uses uses blue ice to gain speed to outrun them, and with no other choice, he decides to go to the coordinates to the safehouse. Spoke then decides to tower up and Elytra the rest of the way there, although he dislikes using the Elytra, he thought it was necessary since it was an emergency. Only 200 blocks away, Spoke hides in a mountain quickly to use the bathroom and enables sneak toggle and lets the hunters run by. He inches closer and closer to the safehouse, but the hunters are tailing right behind him. Spoke enters the house, which seemed abandoned, but spies come up from the ground and starts fighting the hunters, giving Spoke time to escape. Jumper was also at the house and the two leave together as the hunters are distracted. Spoke asks if this was the safehouse, but Jumper said it wasn't and that it was just a house. As they run, the leader of the group, [[_1_88_____x]] chases after them, but they lose them after getting to the escape tunnel. 

At the end of the escape tunnel is the real safehouse, Jumper instructs Spoke to stay inside of it until she and her spies handle it. Spoke says they don't know how the hunters work and he's seen it work in the past and says they're unkillable. However, Spoke knows a trap that can kill someone even with a totem and says that it's already built and will show Jumper it if he wasn't held hostage inside of the base they were standing inside of. They arrive at the trap, which turns out to be the same arrow rail cannon they built inside in a previous episode. Spoke explains that you can trick the game into shooting it milliseconds after the first shot, and that it looks like there's three shots all in one. Jumper asks Spoke how he knows if killing them would stop this, but Spoke says it may not, but it would get a closer lead on figuring out where Mapicc is. Spoke brings up how Jumper had seen them before and asks what she saw, Jumper tells Spoke that she followed them along with her spies followed one of the hunters and based on what they found, they have a reason to believe Mapicc is still alive. She goes on and says how one of her traders went missing, so she went to the trader's base and saw the exact same hunters, so she followed the hunters for thousands of blocks, when all of a sudden, they'd stop moving and look into the distance. She got closer to get a better view of what happened and saw an armorless player and they all started walking in a straight line. It was revealed that there was a bounty on that armorless player's head and an hour later it was claimed and that they were dead, three hours before she saw that player marching. Spoke now understands that they're trying to break all of his armor to do the same thing to him. Spoke thinks this is a bigger threat than trying to find Mapicc and wants to put an end to this and wants to help out. vc bonbon 

As they walk to their destination, Jumper explains their targets have all had bounties on their heads, Spoke included, and Jumper went to [[Merchant City]] and kidnapped the person responsible for this. She says the person doesn't want to talk to Jumper or her spies, but was willing to talk to Spoke. They make it to the location and Jumper breaks a block, revealing a ladder going underground into an obsidian tunnel. Multiple spies guard the entire thing, and once they reach the obsidian box that holds the person, a guard breaks the obsidian, allowing Spoke and Jumper inside. The person that's responsible for this is [[SirPig_]], former mayor of Capital City. He tells Jumper to leave and that everything is between him and Spoke. Spoke confronts SirPig and asks what he knows about the hunters, but SirPig says he has no idea. Spoke tries to bribe him to tell him information, but SirPig tells Spoke to stop worrying about him and start worrying about himself. Spoke says he's trying to work with him, asks for any clues, but all SirPig says all they asked for was a token to prove Spoke was dead was his chestplate gifted to him. Spoke asks for a name one last time or else SirPig dies, SirPig then pulls a fishing rod and stasises out. Spoke hears dozens of people right outside the box and tons of hunters come in and starts attacking him. Jumper comes to help him get out, they get onto the surface, but the hunters make it up before them. Spoke tries to wind charge and pearl to get the hunters off their tail, but the hunters, specifically their leader catch up quickly. The firework rockets shred through their armor and their resources slowly drain. Spoke tells Jumper he has a way to escape, but she won't be able to catch up and tells her to escape on her own for now. Spoke goes on top of a hill full invis and spots Jumper coming up, he quickly asks for an ender chest and grabs an invis potion from a shulker box. He splashes the both of them with invis and they go full invis and hide in a tree, losing track of the hunters. Jumper says her spies are in formation and they need to go activate the trap. The hunters stand looking at Spoke and Jumper, and as they get closer, Jumper commands her spies to come out. The spies serve as a distraction for the hunters. Spoke's armor starts to break, only having his chestplate and a turtle helmet left. Spoke and Jumper run from the fight with the leader, the only one chasing after them. As they near the trap, Spoke tells Jumper to get there first and he'll be there after. Spoke makes it to the house and kites the hunter around as Jumper prepares the trap. Once the trap is set up, Spoke runs towards it and wind charges above, Jumper sets off the trap and kills them in an instant. Their inventory is scattered all over the floor and Spoke picks up a book named "''mission: null''".

Spoke and Jumper are then forced to run and hide by the appearance of more hunters. They build a grave for their fallen leader and leave a book in a chest before leaving.
