title: The Oroboros
content:
The_Oroboros was a high ranking member of the Law, being one of its commanders. 

 History 
He was LettuceK’s third or fourth in command in The Law and a fearsome crossbowman, often using tipped arrows to fight players, much to the chagrin of Wemmbu, whose Achilles heel in combat is arrow effects, particularly slow falling. He has also used weakness arrows as well, particularly to counter Flamefrags.

He was first seen fighting Wemmbu and The Pirates in I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea.

He was seen guarding the orbital strike cannon in Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea. He briefly fought Wemmbu, and fled from combat using an elytra.

He was killed by  TheobaldTheBird In 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters after a lengthy, destructive TNT minecart battle.

 Trivia 

 Despite people suspecting he was related to Ouroboroid due to having a similar name as well as emerald armor trims, this was likely just a coincidence. But there is an ambiguity that creates doubt when Lettucek says to Ouroboide, ‘You know, Ouroboide, I really took the best from both of you,’ possibly referring to The_Ouroboros, since their first appearance is in the same video.

 He has a bow named "Eternity"

title: The Pirate Arc
content:
The Pirate Arc is the third arc in Unstable Universe.

 Story 
Wemmbu and Eggchan build a house, but are attacked by TheobaldTheBird, who wants to fight them. They attempt to trap him using creakings, but when that fails, Wemmbu recruits Kenadian to help him build a base Theo can't break into, and while they complete the base, Theo still gets inside. He holds Kenadian hostage, prompting Wemmbu to finally fight him. Theo loses, but is able to escape due to Wemmbu running out of rockets.

Wemmbu and Egg gather EXP bottles and start their own empire, recruiting many people, including Wato1876. After Wato and a player named Spongs are both mugged by players with pirate shields, Wemmbu locates their base and kills almost everyone there. During his absence, Egg has taken over the empire and expanded it, recruiting Spongs and Arcn. Wemmbu follows Spongs to the pirate HQ, but finds the place empty. He returns to the empire, where Jaden MAN, the leader of the pirates, holds Egg hostage and forces him to give up all his gear, though he manages to keep his mace.

Wemmbu and Egg are exiled to a set of islands. They kill some people for gear before coming into conflict with some of the pirates, which they barely escape. Wemmbu retrieves his mace and they go to Jaden's castle. Wemmbu nearly dies before the castle somehow blows up, allowing him and Egg to escape. They are met by Theo, who reveals he's been secretly helping them all along, and they go to fight Jaden together, forcing him to escape down a mysterious tunnel. Wemmbu and Egg follow him.

Wemmbu and Egg find themselves in an abandoned civilization, trapped with Jaden due to mining fatigue. They manage to get some gear, also meeting Rejoicin and Loppezz, the latter of which is a former pirate that they team up with. Wemmbu ends up on his own and fights Jaden with Rejoicin, but Jaden eventually escapes. Rejoicin gears them all up, and then they head to fight Jaden again. Rejoicin dies to wardens, and Jaden gets away, but Wemmbu finds a secret room with an elytra. He uses it to finally defeat Jaden, forcing him to drop all of his items, but letting him live since he can't escape. The three leave.

 Major Characters 

 Wemmbu (protagonist)
 Eggchan
 Jaden_MAN (main antagonist)
 TheobaldTheBird
 Loppezz
 Rejoicin
 LettuceK
 Arcn

title: The Power Arc
content:
The Power Arc is an arc in Unstable Universe. It is concurrent with the Betrayal Arc (second half of this arc) as well as the Director Arc

 Story 
Wemmbu and Eggchan get some gear by killing people, then plan to steal cows from another group to make an enchanting table. It all goes wrong, and Wemmbu is forced to kill them all. Now with proper gear, he heads to FlameFrags' house for a rematch, and they fight to a standstill. Flame shows Wemmbu around and then he leaves.

Wemmbu is raiding BAT Headquarters when he gets jumped by a couple players and their invisible assassin. He escapes and follows one player back to their base, and though the player doesn't know the assassin's identity, he gives the coords to his friends' bases. He gets ambushed at one such base, but kills his attackers, one of whom drops a compass that leads to Mafia City, where WyLL is revealed as the invis hunter. Wyll says if Wemmbu kills the last person he’ll stop attacking him, so Wemmbu does so, but Wyll betrays him and traps him into the void. Wemmbu flies to a void hole at BAT HQ and escapes. He returns to the castle, where he kills most of Wyll’s team and nearly kills Wyll himself before he stasises out.

Wemmbu is recruited by Loppezz to kill Fantst, who took over Ice Mountain Civilization. Wemmbu goes in and kills some people, but Loppezz makes him stop when Fantst reveals the mountain is rigged to blow. They stealth around a bit before being caught and kicked out again. Wemmbu goes in and kills everyone except for Fantst, but the mountain gets entirely blown up. Somewhat guilty, he gives Loppezz some of his netherite before leaving.

Wemmbu meets Baablu, who tells him about an End guardian stopping him from respawning the Ender dragon for lingering potions. Wemmbu agrees to help him, and fights the guardian, MinuteTech, allowing the dragon to be spawned. Baablu’s team arrives, including Fantst, and start trying to kill Wemmbu, prompting him to flee with Minute. Minute reveals to Wemmbu that Baablu's team wanted to respawn the dragon to dupe it and cause chaos. Wemmbu comes over to Minute's side. They manage to find an End city despite being chased, and gear back up with an ender chest. They return to the main island and kill some people, forcing the rest to flee. Minute and Wemmbu part ways.

Wemmbu enters a PVP tournament hosted by AJTHEBOLD, hoping for a rematch with Flame. He easily beats his first opponent, but next up is WyLL, who has slow fall arrows and restocks. Wemmbu still wins, though. After the match, Wyll gives him advice to beat Conexion, whom he hates even more than Wemmbu himself. Wemmbu utilizes the advice to win the battle, and the final match is against him and Flame. Despite a long, close fight, Flame ultimately wins.

Sharpness (Conexion) steals Wemmbu’s mace by placing pots on the ground. Wemmbu accidentally places his mace in a pot, allowing Sharpness to steal it. Wemmbu and Egg head to the Far Lands to catch him, and find him at the old Far Lands Civilisation. The battle turns into a siege, but Sharpness eventually escapes. Wemmbu and Egg deal with strange glitches before finding a copy of the Zam Empire, complete with echoes of its members. Sharpness attacks, and after a long fight Wemmbu puts his mace in his ender chest. Sharpness gives him thirty minutes to gear up for a final duel, which Wemmbu puts to good use. During the battle, Wemmbu is severely outgeared, but finally manages to knock Sharpness into the void. He’s forced to save him to avoid his mace getting destroyed, though, and Sharpness stashes it in his ender chest before leaving.

Wemmbu gets attacked by The Avengers, comprised of his old enemies. He manages to escape, and he and Egg find a strange build. Inside they meet Lakerek, who fights Wemmbu using strange items from 'The Forge', and upon being defeated allows Wemmbu to kill him and acquire large amounts of gear, Some of the Avengers jump them, but Wemmbu forces all but one to flee, and he arranges a fight at a spikes biome in the Farlands. The Avengers show up there, but during the fight FlameFrags betrays. The two eventually scare off the Avengers, and Flame returns Wemmbu’s mace, which he got from Sharpness.

Wemmbu and Egg continue on, since Wemmbu wants to find the Forge. They find a trial chamber and fight Firestar2008, but he stasis-es away. Wemmbu destroys all the ominous vaults, and then they continue on. They find repeating dungeons containing god apples, obtaining close to a stack total, then continue on, dealing with bizarre world generation. Eventually they find another echo of Lakarek alongside others in an ocean monument, as well as five stasis chambers. Going further on, they are attacked by Nitenly, who was also in the echo. Wemmbu defeats him, and they bridge out over the void before finally locating a city in the Far Lands, which they believe to be The Forge.

At the city, they meet a number of Lakarek’s friends, who tell them this is not the Forge, but let them wander freely anyway. Nitenly is still openly antagonistic, though. Wemmbu and Egg gather gear and destroy a stash of maces. Egg finds a compass that leads back out to the Farlands, where they find an array of orbital strike cannons, used by Lakarek. Lakarek’s friends show up there, and reveal this isn’t the Forge, which is actually back at base. At base, Wemmbu and Egg are presented with an End portal, and Egg jumps in front of Wemmbu to be knocked in by an arrow. Wemmbu 4v1s everyone, killing one and forcing two others to retreat. The last he forces to help him load every single orbital cannon there.

Wemmbu visits Capital City 2.0 to try and find Flame, using his cannons as leverage, and SirPig tells him The Law has been hunting Flame. Wemmbu goes and fights the Law, learns Flame is after Jaden MAN, then blows up their base. Jaden fights him using a mace, but Wemmbu scares him off and then blows up his entire castle. With no leads, he visits Flame's base and gets attacked by a random player, who drops a compass supposedly leading to Flame. Flame shows up, and they fight, Wemmbu struggling despite using his cannons and mace both. Eventually, however, he makes Flame run, and declares himself the strongest player of Unstable.

 Trivia 

 This is the longest arc that only represents a single POV.
 People often refer to the second part of the arc as the far lands arc.

title: The PrinceZam Empire Arc
content:
The PrinceZam Empire Arc, or The Zam Empire Arc is the first arc in Unstable Universe.

 Story 

 The Exploits 
SpokeIsHere discovered a number of different exploits, and paid TheRealSquiddo using exploited items to create The Wonders as a cover for his work. Wemmbu began to suspect he was up to something, culminating in a battle beneath one of the Wonders that led to Spoke deciding to destroy the Wonders.

ParrotX2 and Roshambogames tried to protect the Wonders as Spoke destroyed them one by one. Ro was revealed to be working with Wemmbu against Parrot, and the final Wonder was destroyed.

Spoke teamed up with Mapicc to continue his quest to destroy exploited items, contained in a number of vaults made by Roshambo. They successfully destroyed several vaults of exploited items, destroying the houses of Squiddo and Jepexx in the process, before Ro trapped himself and Spoke in the End. Spoke followed him to his End base, where he revealed that there were no more exploited items. Spoke escaped and realized that the final vault was the first one he'd visited and found nothing at. He and Mapicc return and destroy the items there.

Spoke sent Parrot on a quest for the server's 'greatest secret', and Parrot recruited his friend Wifies to help. They made it through many trials, including an explosive cave, being trapped in the void, a giant ice parkour challenge, a maze of obsidian, an underwater scavenger hunt, and a giant escape room. During this time, they came into conflict with Wemmbu and PrinceZam, who also wanted to find Spoke to kill him. Finally, they met Spoke in-person and completed the final trial, where Spoke revealed that one of them would have to chunkban themselves for the other to learn the secret. Wifies chunkbanned himself, and Spoke revealed the secret was fake all along, and he only wanted revenge against Parrot for an unknown thing. Wemmbu and Zam then arrived, and after a long chase Spoke chunkbanned himself to avoid being killed.

During the scavenger hunt, Spoke's henchmen blew up part of the Zam Empire, so Wemmbu teamed up with Zam to ban Spoke. Using arrows left behind from the battle, they went around the server chunkbanning Spoke's henchmen one by one (including Squiddo, JumperWho, Derapchu, and Fantst), although Spoke was nearly able to kill Zam through an ambush. Spoke invisibly forced Wemmbu and Zam to complete some of the same trials as Parrot and Wifies had been through. Eventually, Wemmbu fought Spoke at Squiddo's old base, but Spoke escaped via stasis. They were able to use arrows he fired to track him down, though, leading to his chunkban.

 Zam Empire Conflict 
After Wifies got chunkbanned, Parrot decided to break him out from the prison constructed by Zam, with help from Rekrap2. After some initial difficulties, they were able to free Derapchu from another one of the chunkbans, and later on Fantst as well, though Fantst later chunkbanned himself because he was afraid of dying. As the prisons fell, the guards were moved to the prison containing both Wifies and Spoke, making freeing Jumper very easy. They were able to chunkban all six guards at the final prison, and Parrot recruited Kenadian to help him break in. After much difficulty, they successfully freed Wifies, however Spoke escaped as well. For that, Zam hired ClownPierce to kill him.

As a favor for helping to ban Spoke, Zam requested Wemmbu build a colony of the Zam Empire to protect a secret vault. Wemmbu recruited his friend Eggchan to help, but they were attacked by FlameFrags, who'd betrayed the Empire. They got Horace Altman to build up their colony, and also briefly met Parrot, learning that Clown was hunting him. Zam left ManePear and Merffinn to guard the colony, but Wemmbu learned that they were sabotaging the colony's defenses. Wemmbu and Eggchan freed Fantst from his chunkban, also acquiring a large amount of resources from Parrot's prison team. Parrot later returned to the colony, and it was revealed that Zam had hired Clown and likely betrayed Wemmbu. Flame and several others (including an invisible Clown) showed up to fight, and Flame nearly killed Wemmbu in the end, but stopped when Zam arrived. Zam and his guards then blew up the colony.

Meanwhile, Parrot and Wifies were being hunted by Clown, though neither knew why. During one fight, they were saved by Leow0ok, Jumper, Derapchu, and Woogiex, who then set up a vault with the intent of luring Clown in. Clown showed up with Mugm and FerreMC, and the trap failed, though Parrot and Wifies escaped. They set up a chunkban at Clown's base, but that failed, and in retaliation Clown blew up Leo's base. Parrot left the Clown hunters and joined up with Wemmbu, helping to repel the attack, but left and returned to the Clown hunters after. They decided to kidnap BranzyCraft, a friend of Clown's, but Ferre kidnapped Wifies, forcing Parrot to free Branzy. Disheartened, he ran away, but Clown forced Wifies to reveal Parrot's coords. Parrot and Wifies went to Wemmbu's Civilization, but found it destroyed. Angered, Parrot returned to the Clown hunters, and they blew up Clown's castle. Parrot decided to 1v1 Clown the following day, and planned to set up a trap as well as kill Branzy. However, Wifies was able to talk him down from killing Branzy, and Parrot instead just visited to talk to him about Clown. The day of the 1v1, Parrot activated the trap and Clown vanished. He and Wifies went to tell the Clown hunters, but found them gone with a sign left from Clown. Confused, they returned to spawn, and Parrot found a book waiting in his old base.

Since they had no resources, Wemmbu and Egg decided to become base-destroyers for hire. Roshambo was their first customer, paying them to destroy Spoke's End base, which they successfully completed. Woogie was the second, hiring them to destroy Ferre's. They had much more difficulty there, but were able to succeed, acquiring a lot of resources between stealing and Woogie's payment. ManePear, a sympathetic Zam guard, secretly gave them coords to a team called the Treasure Hunters. Boosfer, a Treasure Hunter, hired them to destroy an entire biome. Egg had IRL stuff, but Wemmbu’a destruction was interrupted by Parrot and Wifies, who explained that the Treasure Hunters were actually the villains. Wemmbu received his payment, then they built an orbital strike cannon and destroyed the Treasure Hunters’ base, raising their vault. Wemmbu returned to Egg, and together they blew up the statue of Zam at spawn, officially initiating war.

In order to find Clown, Parrot and Wifies were forced to complete a number of challenges, each one tied to a prized possession of the missing players. They came into conflict with Kierrrr and Its Dev (minions of Boosfer) multiple times, culminating in them threatening to blow up Rekrap's base. Parrot and Wifies were able to stop Wemmbu from destroying the base, then resumed their quest. Kier and Dev stole all of the items they'd gathered so far, and so the two plus Wemmbu destroyed their base in revenge. The two then obtained the last items before being met with Clown himself, who revealed the seventh and final item was Parrot's prized spyglass. Parrot gave it up, and Clown forced them to remove their armor before taking them to his inescapable prison, Proton.

Wemmbu and some hired minions attack the Zam Empire, and Wemmbu nearly kills Zam, but is forced to flee due to his guards. He later returns and helps ManePear, who wanted to betray, get away, where Mane reveals that Zam is planning to attack Roshambo's civilization. Wemmbu heads there and manages to stall long enough for Ro's people to escape, then escapes himself. They decide to go after the top people of the Zam Empire, and successfully manage to capture Yungwillx, Peentar, and Sorhin through traps and blackmail. However, Zam and his guards arrived, freed them, and after a long fight successfully forced Wemmbu and Mane to surrender while capturing Egg. Wemmbu and Mane escaped, and Wemmbu considered giving up, but managed to create and enact a plan to save Egg and unleash his orbital strike cannon. The Zam Empire gets blown up and Zam and Wemmbu duel, ending with Zam finally apologizing for his actions. ClownPierce suddenly shows up and kidnaps them both.

 The Experiment 
Wemmbu, Zam, Egg, and Pangi all get dropped into Proton by Clown. They split into two groups, gathering gear and occasionally fighting. Clown sends in Ferre, forcing them to work together to survive. Pangi attempts to enter the Nether and gets chunkbanned, forcing Zam to agree to work with Wemmbu and Egg. They gather gunpowder for an ender pearl cannon, but Clown uses an orbital strike cannon on Zam’s base, which he blames and nearly kills Wemmbu for. Clown sends in Ferre again, forcing the three back together to fight him using TNT minecarts, which Ferre realizes is a weakness of the prison. They beat Ferre, and then Clown sends in a bunch of people, most of whom Zam recruits. Wemmbu gets Kenadian’s help to design a pearl cannon, and they fight Zam’s people, but Wemmbu reminds Zam that Clown won’t let either of them die, and he leaves them alone. Clown teleports all the newcomers out, and Wemmbu finishes the cannon as guards come in. Egg stays behind due to having no pearl, while Wemmbu successfully escapes.

Parrot and Wifies get switched between cells in the redesigned Proton, each meeting all five of the captured players. Parrot devises a method to communicate between cells (maps), and gets visited by Leo, who requests they build a stasis chamber for Wemmbu to sneak in contraband items. Parrot and the other inmates gather materials (using wandering traders to get saplings to get beehives for honey) while trying to hide from the guards, who are starting to catch on. Kenadian wants to stay, however. Jumper gets put in solitary confinement. They construct a stasis for Wemmbu, which Kenadian nearly sabotages, but Parrot convinces him not to. Wemmbu gets in and gears them up, then goes to find Eggchan, who's still trapped somewhere. The others head to the guard HQ and let Jumper out, then start destroying chunkbans to escape. The last one is unbreakable, forcing them to elytra-pearl past it, but they have one elytra too few, so Kenadian gives his up to Parrot, letting him escape. Once they're out, he sends them a message through the maps, and they go to his base and pull his secret stasis, freeing him too.

Zam and Wemmbu are trapped in an escape room together. After making it through some stages, Zam leaves Wemmbu behind, forcing Wato1876, the designer, to save him. Wemmbu proceeds through the escape room with Wato's guidance, and eventually reunites with Zam after Wato leaves. Wemmbu obtains a mace, which they use to solve several more challenges, getting armor and gear along the way. Eventually, they escape into the End dimension, where Clown is waiting. He demands the mace. Zam escapes, but Clown respawns the dragon and starts fighting Wemmbu. Eventually, Wemmbu is forced to drop the mace. Clown leaves and Wemmbu escapes.

title: The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands
content:
The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands is the 21st episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The video begins with ParrotX2, Wifies and deanthebean9 hiding from The Invisible Mafia in a remote forest after escaping Capital City. The Mafia stops hunting them eventually. They planned on finding the far lands to recruit more people to fight The Mafia. While Parrot, Wifies and Dean explore a lush cave, Wifies gives Dean a goat horn and Parrot tells Dean that if they get jumped or if they are in any sort of danger, Dean has to blow the goat horn. They split off after that to get resources, however The Mafia found them. Dean blows his goat horn and they also hear explosions. They find Dean and they leave the cave.

They make a trip to Luigi's house. Parrot finds a book which happens to be Luigi's diary. They check the storage section of Luigi's house and find a lodestone compass which leads to the Far Lands City. They head to the nether after finding a ruined portal to get brewing materials since they found a fortress immediately after lighting the portal. The Mafia finds them and starts blowing up the fortress. They go to the overworld to escape them.

Parrot and Wifies loot up a jungle temple to get arrows and other loot from the jungle temple. They also loot up a desert temple and get a bunch of TNT. After a while they get attacked by singular Mafia member. Parrot uses the TNT he got from the desert to make a minecart trap. They pop the totem of the invisible player and they get stasised into the void. They realize this is exactly what almost happened to Dean. Parrot, Wifies and Dean go to a jungle and Parrot asks them if he can trust them. They both say yes. 

They find a woodland mansion so they loot the woodland mansion to get totems. After each getting at least 1 totem, they leave the woodland mansion and enter an ancient city however, The Mafia found them again. Dean blows his goat horn and they start blowing up the ancient city, spawning a warden in the process. They managed to rescue Dean. They head to a village to trade with villagers for better gear then they leave the village. After a while they spot a massive obsidian border. They find a house next to the border and it turns out the house belongs to R4trick and Finiahn. They explain that the wall was made by The Mafia. Parrot tells them he's thinking of going across the border. They ride camels across the border and they notice strange things such as craters,  trees without leaves, strange terrain, drained lakes, and more. Ratrick asks them why they want to go through Mafia territory and Parrot explains that it's to get to the Far Lands to avenge LuigiToan. They all continue exploring, telling jokes and telling stories. They also blow up an iron farm built by The Mafia however, The Mafia spots them and tries to kill them. Wifies gives Parrot his chestplate since they broke his chestplate and Parrot tries to hide from them in a jungle. 

Parrot goes invisible and he chooses not to take his armour off because he thinks he has arrows all over him, however all of his armour pieces break. Wifies tells Parrot to take off his chestplate since there are no arrows on him and Parrot throws his chestplate away. Parrot tries to run away from The Mafia while being invisible. Parrot manages to lose them and Wifies finds him. Dean tells Parrot and Wifies that they stopped chasing him at one point. 

They head out of Mafia territory and go to the nether to loot up a bastion. 

After leaving the nether they find a trial chamber. They loot the trial chamber in peace until they get jumped by the Mafia in the trial chamber. They leave the trial chamber and start running from the invisible players. They escape in the nether because Wifies baits them by making another portal. Parrot has an argument with Wifies over Dean and Wifies tells Parrot that Dean is not going to die. They go back to the overworld to tame horses so that they can go to the nether roof and use the horses to go faster. They get jumped by The Mafia yet again in the nether roof. They head back to the overworld and find a remote jungle. Parrot goes on a mining trip to get materials until he overhears Wifies and Dean arguing. After eavesdropping, Parrot acts like he didn't hear anything. Wifies asks if they are going to keep going but Parrot tells them that they will if they tell him what's going on. Wifies and Parrot argue over Dean again until Dean tells them the truth.    

Dean admits to Parrot that he's the reason why The Mafia found them all the time and that they have been taking advantage of him not being skilled and apologizes for it. Parrot gets upset at Dean and he walks away. Wifies follows Parrot and they discuss about how Dean had even leaked their location. Wifies implies that maybe they got Dean to shoot arrows when they weren't with them. Parrot considers asking Dean about the arrows but while he talks about doing so with Wifies, Dean puts the lodestone compass he had in a chest, blows the goat horn and runs away. Parrot and Wifies thinks he's in danger after he blows the goat horn and they look for Dean until they see the compass. Parrot feels bad and tries searching for Dean but Wifies tells Parrot not to because he's been long gone already.      

Parrot and Wifies continue travelling without Dean, but things change as soon as they reach a village. Wifies tells Parrot to give him the compass so Parrot proceeds in doing so but in return, Wifies burns the compass. Parrot thinks it was a fake compass but Wifies tells him that it was the real one. Wifies tells Parrot he doesn't want to go to the Far Lands because he thinks Parrot will die. They have an argument about going to the Far Lands until Parrot walks away and throws his spyglass. Wifies apologizes to him in private messages but Parrot ignores him.            

Parrot spends the rest of his journey on his own. He finds the farlands but not the Far Lands City. Parrot finishes reading Luigi's journal and tries to throws the emerald away but his allay keeps giving it back to him. He finds a player named Qu1nten. Parrot assumes Quinten is a part of the Far Lands because there would be no other reason why he would be out here. Parrot tells Quinten to lead him to the Far Lands city. Parrot tells him he needs to talk to Horace so Quinten leads him to Horace. Parrot warns Horace that The Mafia will find the Far Lands city and he talks about what The Mafia did to all of his friends starting with Luigi. He tells Horace that The Mafia killed LuigiToan, weaponized Dean's friendship thus making him run away and made Wifies burn the compass leading to the city because Wifies wanted survival over everything and finally tells him that The Mafia will find the place so they have to fight back and Horace is convinced.            

 Trivia 

 In Spoke's I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia episode it is revealed that the Mafia members that were chasing them in the trial chamber were Spoke, Mapicc and a random gold trimmed player

title: The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom
content:
The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom is the 67th episode featured in Unstable Universe,

 Plot 
In the early days of the Unstable SMP, three people named Myra, Luma, and Verda built a city called Verdaria as a safehaven for them and their treasures. Word was spread quickly about the existence of Verdaria, allowing players to find it. Scared that their treasures would fall into the wrong hands, the three created a scavenger hunt that led to Verdaria's location before they all disappeared. Throughout the years, players have tried to look for this place, but none have succeeded. Parrot thinks that this place is made up, until DragonMC gave him a book that had coords in them and was signed by Verda herself. Dragon says he tried to look for the next clue himself, but to no avail, believing that Parrot would be able to find the location himself. Theo, still skeptical, decides to join Parrot in his adventure. Parrot and Theo start to gather resources for their journey, leaving off with Sky, their happy Ghast. 

As they approached the coordinates, they find a crater, presumably made by the hundreds of players looking for the next clue. They look inside of the hole to find nothing, even as far as going beneath the bedrock into the void looking for the next clue. Parrot tells Theo the clue hasn't been found because nobody has looked in the right places. They start to fly up thousands of blocks in the air, hoping the next clue would be there. To Parrot's surprise, there is a shulker box floating up in the air. Theo flies to the shulker box, revealing that it was nametagged with another set of coords. The two set sail again to the next set of coords, until suddenly they were ambushed by Boosfer and his goons. Boosfer confronts Parrot, and Parrot pretends to just be exploring. Boosfer reveals that he knows about Verdaria too and wants to know where the next location is. Boosfer starts to get aggressive, threatening Parrot to tell him where he's going next. Parrot runs, until he's at a cliff, Boosfer and his goons catch up to him, Parrot, with no other choice, stalls out Boosfer by telling him where he's headed. Theo flies by with a pig with a saddle attached and Parrot gets on the pig, allowing them to escape.

Now that Boosfer and his group of bandits aren't on their tail, Parrot and Theo decide to continue their journey up on the Nether roof. Once they reached the next set of coordinates, they stumble across a waterfall up on a mountain. It reveals to be a lush cave, which doesn't naturally spawn in Plains. This proved that it was manmade, and so they explore around a bit. Theo accidentally sets off a trap, but neither of them got hurt. They then find a mural of Verdaria, as well as a fox trapped inside of a cage with the next clue in its mouth. Parrot assumes that the cage is trapped with TNT, so breaking the cage isn't an option. He covers up the floor with wool to prevent the sculk sensors from activating beneath them, he then places a dispenser facing the fox and places a steak in it and activates it, since food overrides any item that the fox holds in its mouth. Reading into the next hint, the next coordinates were  written using the pigpen cypher. It was also revealed that ClownPierce was the one of the players that tried to look for this location. As soon as Parrot and Theo leave the cave, Boosfer and his gang appears again, demanding the second book. Boosfer says the only way he would be able to get the book was to kill Parrot, and so a fight breaks out. Parrot quickly crafts a crossbow and rockets, allowing him to do massive amounts of damage to the bandits. Parrot and Theo run from Boosfer, going back through the Nether portal, Parrot's plan was to go through as Boosfer went through the portal.

The two successfully escaped once again, letting their journey continue on. After an hour, they made it to their next stop, which was a ravine that used to be a mining town that has since been abandoned. The two start looking for clues, but to no avail. With no other leads, they start exploring the ravine, stumbling upon a player named jagle. Parrot gives the book to jagle, and jagle says he has no idea of what Verdaria may be. Parrot and Theo decide to stay in the ravine, hoping to find clues inside of the ravine. They build a temporary base, over the course of the next week they scour the ravine for anything. Parrot finally asks jagle what happened to this place, and so jagle explains that five years ago the ravine used to be a mining town, until one day, the three people who built Verdaria showed up asking him to hide something for them. Soon, ClownPierce came searching for answers, and jagle hid it from him. This caused Clown to kill everyone, leaving jagle, which caused him to hide the next clue from anybody else. Even jagle has never been to Verdaria, but he's heard what it holds, and that gives Parrot and Theo newfound hope to keep going. Hearing that Parrot wants to help out the server, jagle gives the next clue to Parrot. As soon as they were about to head off, Boosfer and his gang ambushes Parrot and Theo once again. Running low on resources, the two surrender and promise to give Boosfer the clue. Boosfer holds Parrot hostage, making him and Theo come with him to solve it.

The next set of coordinates lead to a jungle, they walk down a path, at the end of the path there's a book that has the last task inside of it. Boosfer reads it first, but he isn't smart enough to decipher it, so he lets Parrot read it. The last sentence of the book says, "I'm sorry. The final clue dies with me." Parrot quickly realizes this could be a trap, even mentioning the fact that the book was placed on top of a build of ClownPierce's head. The final clue didn't exist, which meant the search was all for nothing. They explore the jungle a little more before stumbling across a crater. The crater is filled with craters, but just barely out of sight is a staircase hidden inside. Going down reveals to be a huge obsidian box with pillars and an execution chamber inside of it. Boosfer and his bandits leave because there was no trace. Theo tells Parrot that this was a big waste of time too, but Parrot digs around, saying that the secret died with Verda. Parrot picks up the lava from the execution chamber, revealing a compass that lead to the location of Verdaria. This meant that ClownPierce tried to get the location through brute force, after it failed, he resorted to threatening Verda to telling him where it was. Verda didn't budge, causing her to sacrifice herself to protect the location, and to plant the compass.

Once obtaining the compass, they head to the city that was once rumored to be lost. After multiple Minecraft days pass, the compass finally turned. They start to head down, and it is revealed to actually be Verdaria, which has been untouched for years. They start to look through chests, only to have junk inside of them. They find a hidden path with more chests, with them being empty as well. Inside of the small room was a small sculpture, which happened to be in the small lush cave they saw earlier. Parrot breaks the painting that was on the sculpture, revealing a lever hidden inside of it. Once flipped, a secret entrance was opened, leading to another dropdown. Parrot and Theo gets filled with excitement as they see the treasure. There are hundreds of blocks of ore, dozens of diamond and netherite armor sets, and every enchantment book possible. The two fill up boat chests with the loot, tying them to Sky, and starts to fly back home. Theo asks Parrot, "You think the founders would be happy with us finding it?" Parrot replies, "I hope so."

 Trivia 
 The locations of Myra and Luma are unknown so there is a chance they haven't died yet
 Wifies has confirmed himself that he plays one of Boosfer's bandits in this video.

Hearing that Parrot wants to help out the server, jagle gives the next clue to Parrot. As soon as they were about to head off, Boosfer and his gang ambushes Parrot and Theo once again. Running low on resources, the two surrender and promise to give Boosfer the clue. Boosfer holds Parrot hostage, making him and Theo come with him to solve it.

The next set of coordinates lead to a jungle, they walk down a path, at the end of the path there's a book that has the last task inside of it. Boosfer reads it first, but he isn't smart enough to decipher it, so he lets Parrot read it. The last sentence of the book says, "I'm sorry. The final clue dies with me." Parrot quickly realizes this could be a trap, even mentioning the fact that the book was placed on top of a build of ClownPierce's head. The final clue didn't exist, which meant the search was all for nothing. They explore the jungle a little more before stumbling across a crater. The crater is filled with craters, but just barely out of sight is a staircase hidden inside. Going down reveals to be a huge obsidian box with pillars and an execution chamber inside of it. Boosfer and his bandits leave because there was no trace. Theo tells Parrot that this was a big waste of time too, but Parrot digs around, saying that the secret died with Verda. Parrot picks up the lava from the execution chamber, revealing a compass that lead to the location of Verdaria. This meant that ClownPierce tried to get the location through brute force, after it failed, he resorted to threatening Verda to telling him where it was. Verda didn't budge, causing her to sacrifice herself to protect the location, and to plant the compass.

Once obtaining the compass, they head to the city that was once rumored to be lost. After multiple Minecraft days pass, the compass finally turned. They start to head down, and it is revealed to actually be Verdaria, which has been untouched for years. They start to look through chests, only to have junk inside of them. They find a hidden path with more chests, with them being empty as well. Inside of the small room was a small sculpture, which happened to be in the small lush cave they saw earlier. Parrot breaks the painting that was on the sculpture, revealing a lever hidden inside of it. Once flipped, a secret entrance was opened, leading to another dropdown. Parrot and Theo gets filled with excitement as they see the treasure. There are hundreds of blocks of ore, dozens of diamond and netherite armor sets, and every enchantment book possible. The two fill up boat chests with the loot, tying them to Sky, and starts to fly back home. Theo asks Parrot, "You think the founders would be happy with us finding it?" Parrot replies, "I hope so."

== Trivia ==
* The locations of Myra and Luma are unknown so there is a chance they haven't died yet
* Wifies has confirmed himself that he plays one of Boosfer's bandits in this video.

title: The Search for Minecraft's Sunken Empire
content:
The Search for Minecraft's Sunken Empire is the 73rd episode featured in Unstable Universe.

 Plot 

DragonMC gives Parrot and Theo a new book containing a clue to a lost underwater city. This time, the two don't hesitate to set off.

The journey takes them to the Great Sea, a vast ocean expanse where the terrain and islands are unlike those in the vanilla game. At the first location, they find nothing and realize the chest with the next clue has already been looted. However, they spot a nearby island occupied by other players. This is a group called the "Ocean Rangers". They summon the travelers for questioning after claiming to have never heard of the lost city. Parrot and Theo agree, hoping the Rangers might provide more information.

However, they are forced to empty their inventories. Parrot manages to smuggle a bucket of fish and a bucket of axolotl into their cell, where they find another player named Boomie. The players are underwater and afflicted with the Mining Fatigue effect. Theo complains about how Parrot always shares their hard-earned treasures with new players on the server. When their guard is called to a meeting, Parrot uses a little-known mechanic to remove the Mining Fatigue: by helping an axolotl kill a fish, any negative effects are cleared. They secretly retrieve their items, but the Rangers spot them. Boomie has nothing on him and makes a run for it. Just then, another squad arrives, led by an invisible player with a voice changer and Jaden_MAN. They are clearly at war with the Rangers. The cell guard chases Parrot, but he manages to kill him using the fall damage caused by the ice from his Frost Walker boots.

The next clue leads to an archipelago of sunken ships. Both the Rangers' and the invisible player's groups are already there. Parrot lures the latter group by throwing Wind Charges to draw them towards the former. He and Theo use the ensuing chaos to reach the next clue: a piston, which in pirate speak (a reference to the in-game language option) is called a "raised deck," the phrase mentioned in the clue book. With their food running low, they decide to go fishing.

"What are you gonna do with that fish you're catching? Give it to some new player at spawn?" Theo asks sarcastically.

Silence.

"You need this stuff. What, are you going to give away your armor? Your fishing rod? You need all of this to live! If you give away everything you have, you'll be left with nothing!"

Parrot answers with wisdom:

"There are two groups of players on the server. The first has everything, and the second is left with nothing. But there's a third group—those who could have everything, but choose to share, giving to those in need. Because that is the right thing to do. Treasure, items, power—those are temporary things. If you take them, you'll end up alone."

Theo claps mockingly. "Bravo, for being so morally perfect!"

"This server needs help, and I am going to save it!" Parrot declares firmly.

"Since when are you like this?" Theo asks.

"For a while now. That's a story for another time."

"A story? A story about how you ended up at spawn with three carrots? Haha."

They soon reach a new island. They feed a dolphin to lead them to the nearest naturally-generated underwater treasure. This, in turn, leads them to another island, where they breed turtles, knowing the mother will return to her home beach to lay its eggs. But just then, the Rangers, led by TheLobsterMan, catch up to them. Boomie is their hostage. "Either he dies, or you give us the clue!" TheLobsterMan commands. In either scenario, Parrot stands to lose something. Theo begs him to sacrifice the player, calling him useless. Instead, Parrot throws an invisibility potion at Boomie and pulls him with a fishing rod, giving the defenseless player a chance to escape. Parrot and Theo get away as well, but Theo has had enough of Parrot's heroic deeds, which risk everything to save every single soul. He abandons the mission.

Parrot, in a boat with Boomie, reaches the underwater city. On a small island next to it, Boomie states that maybe the best solution would have been to leave him to his fate, as he was truly a useless player. Parrot disagrees and promises to do everything he can for him.

Then, the surprise comes, a stab shot gets sent down, the invisible player had killed Boomie, under the pretext that he was a "threat to his identity." When Parrot says he has no idea who is standing before him, the invisible player replies that, in that case, there is no reason to kill him. He also refuses to take the treasure, claiming he doesn't need it.

Parrot takes the resources from the underwater city and returns to the first archipelago. Theo is waiting for him there, with their Happy Ghast, Sky, tied up. He apologizes, and Parrot forgives him. Now, Parrot has a clear idea of who this invisible player really is and shares that he will do everything in his power to foil his plan.

title: The Search for Wemmbu
content:
The Search for Wemmbu is the 84th episode featured in Unstable Universe.
 Plot 
The episode starts off with FlameFrags visiting Parrot in his potion shop at Capital City and asks to figure out what happened to Wemmbu in return for a set of coordinates of a Mafia stash in the End. Flame goes on about how Wemmbu beat him in a fight, and after that he was nowhere to be found. Both Parrot and Flame find that suspicious, and so Parrot goes to visit people all around Capital City, asking each person who they heard the rumors from. The last person he asks says eggchan, Wemmbu's best friend, said Flame killed Wemmbu. Parrot heads to the End dimension, he searches everywhere for eggchan, but wasn't able to find him. He then threatens to blow up the End if nobody lived there, eggchan then reveals himself. Parrot asks eggchan what happened to Wemmbu, and he says that Wemmbu was maced to death, which didn't match up to the story to what he told others.

Parrot devises a plan and gets the same armor and trims as Wemmbu. Since Parrot doesn't know where Wemmbu is, he impersonates Wemmbu and robs a store in Capital City, framing Wemmbu as a thief to catch his attention. Parrot then goes around the server searching for Wemmbu, but finds nothing. He returns to Capital City and is stopped by guards for stealing. Wemmbu then appears in front of them, confronting Parrot for impersonating him. Wemmbu then tries to pop Parrot's totem, which would get rid of all potion effects he has on. Parrot quickly takes off his totem, so if Wemmbu kills him, his name would appear in chat. Parrot then tries to walk away since his invisibility was running out, but Wemmbu follows him. Parrot then goes to a silverfish farm, uses a potion of wind charging and potion of harming to launch himself thousands of blocks up in the air, leading to his escape.

Parrot's next idea is to go back to the End dimension and try to trick eggchan into thinking he was Wemmbu. When he gets there, eggchan pretended like Parrot didn't exist. This didn't help Parrot's case, and before heading back to the Overworld, Parrot mentions a courthouse meeting to eggchan. Parrot and Theo then travels to Boosfer's base for clues, since Wemmbu and Boosfer had an altercation before. When Parrot arrives at Boosfer's base, Boosfer asks, "Why are you wearing your invisibility again?" Parrot tries to use this time to get Boosfer to admit that the invisible player was Wemmbu, but Wemmbu appears shortly after. Boosfer can't tell the two apart, and makes them do trials to figure out who's the real Wemmbu. This doesn't solve anything, and so Wemmbu begins to attack Parrot, trying to pop his totem. Parrot runs out of the factory and swaps out with Theo, who's also pretending to be the invisible player. Parrot and Theo start to attack Wemmbu, and Wemmbu begins to mace them. This causes them to flee, they try to fly away using their Happy Ghast, but Wemmbu kills it. With no other choice, they travel through the Nether to escape back to Capital City.

The next day, Parrot tells Flame that the invisible player has an Elytra and mace, but it wasn't enough evidence to prove that it was Wemmbu. His next plan was to trap the courthouse room, hopefully revealing Wemmbu's identity. He trades sets of Netherite armor in return for replicas of Wemmbu's exact armor and trims and hires people in Capital City to pretend to be the invisible player as well. Once the time comes, the courtroom meeting starts, and all of the players in Capital City are stasised out, which only left Wemmbu in the room. Wemmbu and Theo start fighting, and Parrot waits for Flame to show up, in which Flame ended up not doing. Parrot and Theo uses chorus fruit to get out, and Wemmbu escapes himself. Parrot wasn't going to give up easily, and begins to chase Wemmbu. They end up on a mountain, and Wemmbu asks Parrot and Theo why they care about him. One of Parrot's reasonings is because Wemmbu killed Boomie, believing that Boomie was an innocent player, but Wemmbu tells him that Boomie was a bandit who killed random players. Wemmbu asks if they're going to stop hunting him now, but Parrot says that they're not going to stop until they revealed his identity. Wemmbu then heads towards them, ready to attack. Parrot and Theo build a roof above their head, and Wemmbu uses a stab shot to blow it up and popping both their totems. This causes the both of them to fly away.

Parrot flies to Flame's base asking where he was, and Flame says he was dealing with The Law. He says that he was trying to prepare for the situation until The Law showed up to his base. Parrot has one last plan, he uses the exact same strategies the Director used against him to uncover Wemmbu's identity. He also sets up traps for Wemmbu. Parrot hides out in the stronghold and meets Wemmbu again face to face. He gives Wemmbu an ultimatum to reveal his own identity. Wemmbu, obviously not wanting to, starts to attack Parrot. Parrot flies through a massive tunnel, and at the end of the tunnel was the same meeting room used to trap MrCube6 in. The plan was to have Theo and Wemmbu fight to drain his resources, and Parrot flees. 

He heads to the same ender pearl cannon that the Director built and throws a pearl into it. Parrot teleports millions of blocks out, where he meets back up with Flame, and the final trap is set. A flashback shows Parrot telling Flame to use the cannon and build a dome covered with obsidian and the insides with powdered snow, lava, and TNT. Parrot waits on the center platform for Wemmbu to show up. As predicted, Wemmbu ends up right across from Parrot. He then tells Wemmbu that this is the end of Wemmbu's fake identity. Parrot then explains how he figured out that The Invisible Knight was Wemmbu. He asks Wemmbu why he faked his own death, and Wemmbu tells him that he wants to enjoy the server like a normal player. Parrot said he knew the Invisible Knight was Wemmbui all along, but pretended not to know in order to save his own life. Wemmbu says that he could kill Parrot right now, but then Parrot reveals that Flame is there with them. Wemmbu then tries to escape, but whilist pearl catching, his wind charge went through the powdered snow and lava, causing the TNT surrounding the dome to explode. This caused the dogs both Parrot and Flame tamed to die in the explosion, showing their death in chat, as well exposing Wemmbu's name in the death message. 

Now that the job was done, Parrot has second thoughts about if revealing Wemmbu's identity was the right thing to do. Because there's no escape, Wemmbu and Flame end back up on the platform with Parrot, and Parrot tells Wemmbu to take off his invisibility. Parrot asks Flame for his end of the deal, and Flame gives the book with the coordinates to the Mafia tomb. Wemmbu asks why this happened, and Parrot says that he had to "tie up some loose ends", and tries to frame Wemmbu as a bad person for killing Boomie, Sky, and a bunch of innocent civilians in Capital City. Parrot tries to say more, but Wemmbu wind charges him off the platform. As Parrot's falling into the void, he looks in a specific direction, which activates a mirror receiver to set off a stasis, saving his life.

 Trivia 

 The video's original title was “Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Shouldn't Exist”.

title: The Toxic War Arc
content:
Story 
*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes* FlameFrags is attacked by a group of players led by SpokeIsHere. He loses his netherite armor in the fight, but gets ambushed by another group and kills them all. He heads to Merchant City and trades the gear for a netherite helmet, but gets attacked by the Bounty Assassin Team. He gets netherite boots from the fight and escapes. Wemmbu attacks him at his house, but since neither can kill the other they stop and talk. Wemmbu gives him coords to Spoke's base, and he goes there, surviving multiple traps before Spoke flees. On the way out he's attacked again, and obtains netherite leggings, completing his set.

title: The Treasure Arc
content:
The Treasure Arc is an arc in  Unstable Universe Chronologically, it follows up on The Director Arc, happens concurrently with The Fake Identity Arc, Skill vs Power Arc, and is followed up by The Kings Arc.

 Story 
ParrotX2 takes an End portal to spawn after escaping Paragon. Withers are everywhere, but his old friend TheobaldTheBird saves him and takes him to Capital City 2.0, led by Reddoons. Parrot runs a shop there, but it soon becomes a smuggling business, as citizens pay the duo to get their friends from spawn to Capital City. They continually come into conflict with Boosfer. Eventually, Reddoons finds out about this, and asks Parrot to save his friend Hexatope. Parrot agrees, on the condition that Reddoons forgive the debt of everyone in the city, to which he agrees. They successfully save Hexatope, and everyone celebrates.

Parrot and Theo hear about the lost city of Verdaria, rumored to be home to amazing treasures. They successfully solve the first few clues, but Boosfer is after the treasure too. He finally corners them and forces them to help him, but they hit a dead end, since the final clue was apparently destroyed to stop ClownPierce from getting it. Boosfer leaves, but Parrot figures out the real final clue, and they find Verdaria, loading up their happy ghast Sky to carry all the treasure away, with the intention of distributing it to the players.

Parrot and Theo hear about a treasure in the Great Sea. They head there and meet TheLobsterMan, who takes them prisoner along with Boomie. They escape, inadvertently helped by an invisible player. They follow a couple more clues before Lobster's group catches up again, trying to use Boomie as leverage to get a clue from Parrot. Parrot manages to get them both out, but splits off from Theo after an argument over their plans for the treasure. The invisible player kills Boomie, and Parrot finds the treasure, making up with Theo and heading off, but secretly planning revenge on the invisible player.

Parrot plans to steal from ClownPierce's vault next. While in the Nether, he meets FlameFrags, who's also looking for Clown, and they team up. Flame and Theo successfully kidnap FerreMC, Clown's right-hand man, but Parrot lets him escape as part of a plan to track him. He and Theo talk, and he reveals he's planning to betray Flame, but Flame overhears this and brings Clown to the location. Clown lets him say his last words, and Parrot apologizes to Flame, causing Flame to switch sides. Parrot escapes and finds the vault by following Clown, but Clown catches him. He escapes with barely any gear and returns to Capital City with Theo. Flame shows up in his shop and hires him to find Wemmbu.

Parrot decides to impersonate Wemmbu, thinking he’s the invis player from before. He successfully gets the real invis player to show up, fighting him multiple times before he kills Sky with a mace, confirming his identity. Parrot sets up a trap in Capital City, which works, but Flame doesn’t show up, allowing Wemmbu to escape. Parrot decides to channel the Director, and sets up one final trap, which works flawlessly, getting Wemmbu into an inescapable cell along with Flame. His work done, Parrot gets coords to the loot stash Flame promised him, then leaves.

Parrot and Theo head out to the loot stash, left over by The Invisible Mafia. Once there, they witness Marlowww, the guard, kill a group of bandits, and help one escape. He brings them to an End base, where Parrot gambles against Rasplin for the key to access the treasure. Marlow shows up and kills Rasplin, and Parrot and Theo flee back to her island. They manage to steal the key from Marlow and sneak inside, where Theo supposedly sacrifices himself to Marlow so Parrot can escape. Parrot finds Marlow's room, and learns that she's guarding the stash to protect people, since if a single item is taken stasis chambers will activate and kill hundreds of people. Parrot leaves without taking anything, and swear off treasure hunting as he and Theo return home.

title: The Underworld
content:
The Underworld is a world underneath the bedrock of the nether, where the void should be. Only a select few players are able to place blocks in the underworld, them living in The Underworld and are called "Soul Keepers". Mapicc referred to a place called the "Underworld" but it is technically not proven that that is the same dimension being referred to, though it is very likely.  

__TOC__

 Structure 

 Description 
This place is primarily dark and gray. Although the Underworld is almost completely devoid of any color, you can still see some vibrance, especially of green, placed on the buildings and landmarks. Withers can be found throughout as well, and structures like a castle and a graveyard can also be noted. You can also find deep chasms here. 

In an unknown location in the Underworld there is a portal hub that can teleports to presumably multiple points of interest in the server. Although as of now we've only seen 2 of 20~ portals being the one to Serpentbound's kingdom, and the one to the unknown flow forest 
 Glitches 

 Placing and Breaking: 
thumb|428x428px|Picture of the Gold Block, teased at the end of the world's debut video
In this dimension, only the citizens (Players with green armor trims) have the ability to break and place blocks. The reason for this is unknown.

 The Gold Block 
The Gold block is located in (about) the middle of the castle, and standing on it or near it makes your game extremely laggy.

 Nether Portal Lobby 
The Underworld has connection to Far Lands in every direction through a lobby of nether portals guarded by Soul Keepers.

 History 
Wemmbu and Boosfer were fighting. They both dropped into the Nether's void. They thought they were going to die, as there was no escape. Instead of taking damage, they landed on a blocked surface, something they did not expect. The residence hated their pressence and proseded to try and kill them. Thanks to PVP and a bit of luck, they survived this and escaped.  

Near the end of My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP, Mapicc mentions that JamatoP has been to the underworld which basically comfirms the theory that The Underworld is home to glitches, giving Jamato more power than before. 

Wemmbu travels to the opposite end of the Far Lands in negative X direction where Jamato's flower base is compared to that in positive Z direction where he got his orbital strike cannons. Jamato finds Wemmbu and eggchan rummaging through his house and takes them to go to Serpentbound when Wemmbu says he knows the Far Lands people. As they walk through the Far Lands forest, Wemmbu and egg find small monuments in the floor and Wemmbu mentions that one of them looks like the Underworld. Jamato tells him he's not supposed to know about that place and to not go there. Afterwards, they go through the forest's nether portal, which sends them into the Underworld where the soul keepers have portals linked to important places of the Far Lands. 

 Theories 

They are rumored to connect to the Null Hunters because of their skins, names, and totem effects.

 Navigation

title: The Underworld Theories
content:
This page is for theories for the Underworld.

 Theories 
left|thumb|400x400px|Wifies in his own Discord, replying to a comment

 Wifies posted "did you see the end of Wemmbu's newest video?" after I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension, teasing the idea that he might revive soon because of something at the end of the video, likely from the gold block in the Underworld.

 JamatoP is the sixth keeper, because he knows about a lot of glitches and exploits. He has been traveling a lot since he disappeared, and his armor trims are green.
 Null Hunters may originate from the Underworld, since they use nether portals to travel extremely fast, and travels faster than normal player on flat surface, which is prominent feature of the Underworld. They may also have a connection with JamatoP, because they share the same type (different color) of trim as Jamato, and use the totem teleport mechanism which was also used by Jamato.

title: The Wonders
content:
The Wonders were five builds used to store glitched items and features. The builds were originally created by the Master Builders, and used by SpokeIsHere and JamatoP to store glitched features. Each wonder has a guard, who is not allowed to check inside of any wonders. 

 List of The Wonders 

 The Gardens of Babylon: 
This massive temple is most likely based off of the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, an ancient structure destroyed by earthquake. This Wonder, placed in a savanna biome, with its gardens full of lush acacia trees and yellow flowers, was the first to be blown up by an orbital cannon. 

 The Frosted Palace: 
The Frosted Palace is a huge ice castle built on a snowy hill surrounded by ice. This gargantuan build is filled with extraordinary details, scattered with large stone rocks, giant trees, and ice spikes. This wonder was the last to be destroyed, attempted to be saved by ParrotX2, but was blown up nonetheless.

 The Crone: 
The Crone is a massive stone statue standing on a plain completely surrounded by river. The cloaked woman holds a staff in her right hand and an unknown object in her left. This Wonder was the second to be blown up.

 The Marshland Mansion: 
The Mansion is located in a swamp biome. This large overgrown manor, filled with trees, uses froglights to light up its mud and copper walls. The Marshland Mansion was the fourth Wonder to be destroyed.

 The Pyramid of Anubis: 
The Pyramid of Anubis is an ancient Egyptian-styled pyramid dotted with hieroglyphics and contains a gold cap. Each side of the pyramid holds two large  statues of Anubis, the Egyptian god of funerary and care of the dead. This Wonder was the third one to be destroyed.

 History 
Spoke pays Squiddo to have the Master Builders build them. His plan is to make them so beautiful that no one wants to destroy or mine into it. Spoke and Jamato create the first glitched features in the wonders. The builders do not know that Spoke and Jamato are creating these in the wonders.

Spoke hires Jumper, Roshambogames, Fantst, Derapchu, and Wemmbu to guard the wonders.

Wemmbu discovers what is inside The Wonders and started to attack Spoke.

Spoke destroys all of the wonders, despite Parrot trying to stop them from being destroyed.

title: TheobaldTheBird
content:
TheobaldTheBird, also known as Theobald or most commonly Theo, is a supporting character and the deuteragonist of Parrot's Season 2 videos featured in the Unstable Universe. He has been Parrot's best friend and teammate since Wifies' death.

 Personality 
Theo is a highly skilled and charismatic player, being a PVP minecart focused fighter. He is Parrot’s best friend and loyal bodyguard, with Theo being highly protective of the other and often putting his friend before himself, even in life-or-death scenarios. Theo is often the victim of friendly robbery and teases from allies which he always indignant of. He is shown to be highly airheaded outside of battles, with him having issues with writing, reading and numbers. This bird-brained personally leads act as a comic relief and he tends to lean into this trait of his to lighten dark situations. However, he is prone to aggressive outbursts and has an incredibly short temper. Additionally, he regularly uses intimidation and violence against others to get what he wants.

Theo shares Parrot's vision of wanting the sever to be a safe environment for newcomers of the server without the threats of being banned or facing corruption. Theo has his ideals about helping the server, he is also sensible and focuses on saving the live of the many rather than the lives of the few. He is an adamant individual, sticking to his guns despite external influences and people of his past, such as ShoeBilly_. Rather than dwelling on his past, he focuses entirely on the future of the Unstable server.

 History 
 Season 1 
TheobaldTheBird is first introduced in the Unstable SMP: The First War as a member of the Far Lands Warrior faction, initially seeming cold stoic to Parrot. During a competition with ParrotX2, he pops the totem of undying of Purpled using TNT mine carts, meaning he becomes a mission leader. He helps Parrot become the leader of the Warrior faction after the other 3 members of the council try to kill the both of them.

After the Far Lands Civilization is taken over by The Invisible Mafia, TheobaldTheBird joins District 13. He later leaves District 13 due to minimal progress.

 Season 2 
Wemmbu and Eggchan travel millions of blocks out to make a base alone. TheobaldTheBird secretly follows them, as he wants to PvP someone. TheobaldTheBird leaves. Wemmbu and Eggchan set up a trap with the creaking. TheobaldTheBird destroys their base again and their trap fails. Kenadian helps Wemmbu and Eggchan make their base more secure. TheobaldTheBird breaks into the base and tries to kill Wemmbu. TheobaldTheBird threatens to kill Kenadian if Wemmbu doesn’t have a fair fight with him. TheobaldTheBird eventually runs from the fight.

TheobaldTheBird secretly helps Wemmbu survive in the Pirate Islands. He helps Wemmbu try to kill Jaden_MAN.

TheobaldTheBird enters a PvP tournament, but loses to FlameFrags.

TheobaldTheBird meets ParrotX2 at spawn and saves him from a wither. He then leads parrot to Capital City, and reintroduces him to Reddoons. When Reddoons goes afk, Theo gets ParrotX2 to come with him to the black market, where they meet Puqi_, and are paid 64 diamonds to bring Puqi_'s friend DragonMC, from spawn to capital city. Reddoons eventually catches them helping people escape spawn, and have them help his friend Hexatope escape into capital city, and promises to remove all debt from the citizens if they do so. The citizens give ParrotX2 and Theo an elytra.

 The Lost City 
Parrot and Theo attempt to find Verdaria.

After escaping the wither, a new wither begins attacking him. TheobaldTheBird saves Parrot from the wither.

Parrot fears that Theo will kill him. However, Theo says that he won't. They both venture to Capital City, which has now been completely remade, at spawn. After arriving, Theo uses the nether star from the dead wither to pay off his debt and Parrot opens a potion shop.

Running the shop did not go according to plan however, and only one sale was made. Theo and Parrot go to spawn to help players escape spawn for payment.

Parrot and Theo enter a betting game led by Boosfer, which turns out to be a scam. Figuring this out, Parrot is able to steal their entire stash of three enchanted apples, three totems and three netherite ingots.

Parrot gets a letter and a lodestone compass, from Leow0ok, explaining how Bounty Assassin Team is being remade. In the book, he instructs Parrot on how he could get a happy ghast. They are however, attacked by Boosfer and his guards, while going to the location. They are able to escape with the happy ghast.

Once back in Capital City, Parrot places the Happy Ghast in Reddoons' Animal Care Department. Reddoons asks Parrot to help Hexatope escape from spawn. In return, Parrot asks for the clearing of debt of all citizens of the city. Reddoons agrees.

Hexatope is able to escape spawn. Before they can enter Capital City, Boosfer and his guards confront them. Parrot and Theo are able to kill them, and Boosfer has to run away.

Reddoons absolves everybody of their debt in Capital City.

Parrot and Theo are told about Verdaria, a civilization with a large amount of resources. They go to a specific set of coordinates, which supposedly contains the first clue for where Verdaria is. Parrot and Theo find a crater at the coordinates, from players looking for the next clue. They do not find anything in the hole. They discover, very high up, a shulker, name tagged a specific set of coordinates. Boosfer tries to threaten Parrot into telling him where he is going. Parrot is able to escape with the help of Theo.

Parrot and Theo eventually reach the next set of coordinates. Theo and Parrot accidentally set off a trap in a mountain. After exploring inside the mountain, they eventually find a fox trapped inside of a cage with the next clue in its mouth. Parrot assumes that the cage is trapped with TNT, meaning that they couldn't break any blocks. Using wool, he is able to get the item out of the fox's mouth. The item contains the next set of coordinates.

Boosfer and his guards attempt to kill Parrot and Theo, but fail.

After an hour, they make it to the next set of coordinates, which is a ravine that used to be a mining town that has since been abandoned. The two start looking for clues, but do not find anything. They find a player named Jagle. Parrot gives the book to Jagle, and Jagle says he has no idea of what Verdaria may be. Parrot and Theo decide to stay in the ravine, hoping to find clues inside of the ravine. 

They build a temporary base, and over the course of the next week they scour the ravine for anything. Parrot asks Jagle what happened to the ravine, so Jagle explains that five years ago the ravine used to be a mining town, until one day, the three people who built Verdaria showed up asking him to hide something for them. Soon, ClownPierce came searching for answers, and Jagle hid it from him. This caused Clown to kill everyone, leaving Jagle, which caused him to hide the next clue from anybody else. Hearing that Parrot wants to help out the server, Jagle gives the next clue to Parrot. As soon as they are about to leave, Boosfer and his gang ambushes Parrot and Theo once again. Running low on resources, the two surrender and promise to give Boosfer the clue. Boosfer holds Parrot hostage, making him and Theo come with him to solve it.

The next set of coordinates lead to a jungle. They walk down a path, at the end of the path there's a book that has the last task inside of it. Boosfer reads it first, but he isn't able to decipher it, so he lets Parrot read it. The last sentence of the book says, "I'm sorry. The final clue dies with me." Parrot quickly realizes this could be a trap, even mentioning the fact that the book was placed on top of a build of ClownPierce's head. They eventually find a crater. They find a staircase, and going down, they find a huge obsidian box with pillars and an execution chamber inside of it. Boosfer and his bandits leave. Parrot picks up the lava from the execution chamber, revealing a compass that leads to the location of Verdaria.

Afterwards, they go to the coordinates of Verdaria. They eventually find Verdaria. Parrot and Theo find a room filled with treasure. They give a large amount of treasure to other players.

DragonMC__ comes to Parrot and Theo's potion shop, saying that he had bought the clue but couldn't solve it. Parrot and Theo then follow the clue to the Great Sea. They find the first chest but realize that it has already been looted.

Parrot and Theo go to a different island where they find a team called the ocean rangers. The team forces them to empty their inventory. Parrot manages to smuggle in a bucket of fish and a bucket of axolotl.  

The ocean rangers take Parrot and Theo back to there base where they are locked in an underwater cell with a conduit for water breathing. Inside they met a player named Boomie. Parrot, Theo, and Boomie escape.

Parrot and Theo find an island, with a dolphin. Once they feed the dolphin it leads them to the nearest naturally generating buried treasure, leading to an island with turtles. Parrot and Theo save Boomie from the ocean rangers, who were trying to use Boomie as a hostage. Theo leaves, and stops trying to find the lost treasure. Wemmbu, invisible, kills Boomie with an orbital strike cannon. Parrot collects the treasure.

Parrot and Theo go into the nether dimension, owned by ClownPierce. Their goal is to steal from ClownPierce's vault to give to other players. Clown and Ferre try to kill Parrot and Theo, but they escape. Parrot and Theo find FlameFrags. Flame tries to kill them due to Parrot and Theo wearing shields designed for people who work for ClownPierce. Parrot says that he has a trap, which would blow Flame up, causing him to stop attacking. Flame, Parrot, and Theo form an alliance as Flame is trying to kill ClownPierce.

Flame and Theo try to kidnap Ferre to use as leverage. Parrot gives Ferre a map, and lets him free, assuming that they can use the map to find the location of the vault. Parrot shares with Theo that he dislikes FlameFrags, and Flame is secretly able to hear them. Flame leaves, and Parrot discovers Flame was able to hear them. Flame betrays Parrot, and tells ClownPierce the location of parrot. Clown attempts to kill Parrot. Parrot apologizes to Flame, causing Flame to save Parrot and Theo.

Parrot finds the location of the vault. He attempts to steal items from the vault, but ClownPierce finds him, and attempts to kill him. Parrot is able to escape using chorus fruit. He goes back to steal more items, then he escapes again.

Flame asks Parrot to help him find out where Wemmbu is, and in return says he will give Parrot the location of the Tomb of the Mafia. Parrot goes to the location of Eggchan, Wemmbu's friend, and asks where Wemmbu is. Eggchan's story is not consistent with what he had said before, causing Parrot to be suspicious. Parrot, assuming Wemmbu is the Invisible Knight, comes back, invisible. Eggchan is able to deduce that the invisible player is not Wemmbu. Parrot impersonates the Invisible Knight, and does bad things as him, causing the Invisible Knight to be no longer allowed to come to Capital City.

 The Election Arc 
In the video I Survived The Unstable SMP Purge, Parrot attends a meeting held by Lettuce, and gets jumped by assassins. Naparizel dies and Lettuce then announces The Purge, where candidates can kill each other for books. Purpled attacks Parrot for his books, knowing that Parrot is weaker than others in pvp. Theo comes and helps parrot, popping Purpled’s totems multiple times while Parrot escapes. 

Theo later meets another player named PearitX2, and goes with Pearit to restock and get more votes. Pearit used a voicechanger, so Theo didn’t know it was an imposter. 

After Parrot recieves Horace Altman and Fymada’s votes, he returns to his tower in the Northern Council. Then, he finds Theo with Pearit and gets really confused. Pearit runs away and is never seen again. 

After Theo and Parrot reunite at the Northern Council, the two express doubt about Parrot’s chances in the election regardless of his endorsements from Horace and Fymada, as he was still around six thousand votes off of Lettuce. Parrot then considers one last possibility to swing the election in his favor, someone they needed to find.

Theo then appears again at the climax of 2 Minecraft Pros vs. 1000 Hunters, appearing in earnest to 1v1 The_Oroboros in cart combat, furious at the Law for nearly blowing up Parrot after successfully luring him and Wemmbu into a trap. He manages to finally slay The Oroboros, but is subsequently taken captive by SargeLaw and TheG0dofWar, as proclaimed by Lettuce at the Second Debate. Parrot, in a dark rage and remembering all the good times with Theo and how much he truly depended on his friendship over the past months, tells Lettuce that he should’ve kept their strife between the two of them.

Before his defeat of The_Oroboros and capture, Parrot and Theo are encountered by FlameFrags, who requests Theo to train him in TNT minecart combat, since he is the master of it. Initially, Theo and Parrot are hesitant, but Parrot eventually persuades him to train Flame after Flame vows he will use all of his new combat skills to battle the Law. Theo admits later he thought would be a waste of his time. However, he is surprised when Flame exhibits above-average skill in cart combat, and agrees to train him further. Theo then admits he has not brought enough carts to continue, so they go to the Black Market under Capital City to purchase more.

However, as Flame acquires more carts, one of the commanders of Lettuce, G0dOfWar, arrives, having been alerted by a Law officer guarding the entrance to the market. Theo attempts to diffuse the situation after Flame is found but is unsuccessful, and G0dOfWar swiftly defeats Flame in battle as the two retreat from the market.

Theo acknowledges the defeat but encourages Flame in spite of it, showing him the terrain-based mechanics of TNT minecart combat and the importance of timing and feet placement. Flame picks up the style quickly, impressing Theo. He also shows off the alternative yet more destructive method of crossbow cart combat.

After they finish basic training, Theo urges Flame to put his new skills to the test in combat and avenge his defeat to G0dOfWar. Flame and Theo part ways soon after.

Possibly after or even before FlameFrags had his duel with TheG0dofWar, Theo fought The_Oroboros in a very heated duel. Theo used his TNT Minecarts to their fullest potential and it let him kill a dangerous commander of The Law.  Following this, G0d0fWar and SargeLaw turned up and detained Theo under LettuceK's orders. Theo is now being used as a hostage, possibly in the same prison as Jaden MAN, another prisoner captured by the law. 

 Quotes 

 Trivia 
 Theo played a minor background invis player several times, he was the first player Wemmbu ever killed for ManePear during his training arc, as shown in a BTS Youtube short posted by Theo.
 He often claims to be the best at PvP. His PvP skill is comparable to that of Flowtives, Sharpness or FlameFrags in real life but on Unstable SMP he was greatly nerfed.
 He is teamed with ParrotX2 because he is the brawn and Parrot is the brain.
 Theo is bi in real life, as confirmed in his 50k subscribers video
 Theo claims to be the biggest bird, and argues with Parrot about who the title should go to.
