-->{{Quote|Yo, good luck, man. I'm proud of you. But—don't let this get to your head, buddy. You're still not the biggest bird.|[[TheobaldTheBird]] to [[ParrotX2]]|in [[I Became King of the Unstable SMP]]}}

[[TheobaldTheBird]], also known as [[TheobaldTheBird|Theobald]] or most commonly [[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]], is a supporting character and the deuteragonist of [[ParrotX2|Parrot]]'s [[Season 2]] videos featured in the [[Unstable Universe]]. He has been Parrot's best friend and teammate since [[Wifies]]' death.

== Personality ==
Theo is a highly skilled and charismatic player, being a PVP minecart focused fighter. He is Parrot’s best friend and loyal bodyguard, with Theo being highly protective of the other and often putting his friend before himself, even in life-or-death scenarios. Theo is often the victim of friendly robbery and teases from allies which he always indignant of. He is shown to be highly airheaded outside of battles, with him having issues with writing, reading and numbers. This bird-brained personally leads act as a comic relief and he tends to lean into this trait of his to lighten dark situations. However, he is prone to aggressive outbursts and has an incredibly short temper. Additionally, he regularly uses intimidation and violence against others to get what he wants.

Theo shares Parrot's vision of wanting the sever to be a safe environment for newcomers of the server without the threats of being banned or facing corruption. Theo has his ideals about helping the server, he is also sensible and focuses on saving the live of the many rather than the lives of the few. He is an adamant individual, sticking to his guns despite external influences and people of his past, such as [[ShoeBilly_]]. Rather than dwelling on his past, he focuses entirely on the future of the Unstable server.

== History ==
=== Season 1 ===
TheobaldTheBird is first introduced in the [[Unstable SMP: The First War]] as a member of the [[Far Lands]] Warrior faction, initially seeming cold stoic to Parrot. During a competition with [[ParrotX2]], he pops the totem of undying of [[Purpled]] using TNT mine carts, meaning he becomes a mission leader. He helps Parrot become the leader of the Warrior faction after the other 3 members of the council try to kill the both of them.

After the Far Lands Civilization is taken over by [[The Invisible Mafia]], TheobaldTheBird joins [[District 13]]. He later leaves District 13 due to minimal progress.

=== Season 2 ===
[[Wemmbu]] and [[Eggchan]] travel millions of blocks out to make a base alone. TheobaldTheBird secretly follows them, as he wants to PvP someone. TheobaldTheBird leaves. Wemmbu and Eggchan set up a trap with the creaking. TheobaldTheBird destroys their base again and their trap fails. [[Kenadian]] helps Wemmbu and Eggchan make their base more secure. TheobaldTheBird breaks into the base and tries to kill Wemmbu. TheobaldTheBird threatens to kill Kenadian if Wemmbu doesn’t have a fair fight with him. TheobaldTheBird eventually runs from the fight.

TheobaldTheBird secretly helps Wemmbu survive in the [[Pirate Islands]]. He helps Wemmbu try to kill [[Jaden_MAN]].

TheobaldTheBird enters a PvP tournament, but loses to [[FlameFrags]].

TheobaldTheBird meets ParrotX2 at spawn and saves him from a wither. He then leads parrot to [[Capital City 2.0|Capital City]], and reintroduces him to [[Reddoons]]. When Reddoons goes afk, Theo gets ParrotX2 to come with him to the black market, where they meet Puqi_, and are paid 64 diamonds to bring Puqi_'s friend [[DragonMC]], from spawn to capital city. Reddoons eventually catches them helping people escape spawn, and have them help his friend Hexatope escape into capital city, and promises to remove all debt from the citizens if they do so. The citizens give ParrotX2 and Theo an elytra.

==== The Lost City ====
Parrot and Theo attempt to find [[Verdaria]].

After escaping the wither, a new wither begins attacking him. TheobaldTheBird saves Parrot from the wither.

Parrot fears that Theo will kill him. However, Theo says that he won't. They both venture to Capital City, which has now been completely remade, at spawn. After arriving, Theo uses the nether star from the dead wither to pay off his debt and Parrot opens a potion shop.

Running the shop did not go according to plan however, and only one sale was made. Theo and Parrot go to spawn to help players escape spawn for payment.

Parrot and Theo enter a betting game led by Boosfer, which turns out to be a scam. Figuring this out, Parrot is able to steal their entire stash of three enchanted apples, three totems and three netherite ingots.

Parrot gets a letter and a lodestone compass, from Leow0ok, explaining how Bounty Assassin Team is being remade. In the book, he instructs Parrot on how he could get a happy ghast. They are however, attacked by Boosfer and his guards, while going to the location. They are able to escape with the happy ghast.

Once back in Capital City, Parrot places the Happy Ghast in Reddoons' Animal Care Department. Reddoons asks Parrot to help [[Hexatope]] escape from spawn. In return, Parrot asks for the clearing of debt of all citizens of the city. Reddoons agrees.

Hexatope is able to escape spawn. Before they can enter Capital City, Boosfer and his guards confront them. Parrot and Theo are able to kill them, and Boosfer has to run away.

Reddoons absolves everybody of their debt in Capital City.

Parrot and Theo are told about [[Verdaria]], a civilization with a large amount of resources. They go to a specific set of coordinates, which supposedly contains the first clue for where Verdaria is. Parrot and Theo find a crater at the coordinates, from players looking for the next clue. They do not find anything in the hole. They discover, very high up, a shulker, name tagged a specific set of coordinates. Boosfer tries to threaten Parrot into telling him where he is going. Parrot is able to escape with the help of Theo.

Parrot and Theo eventually reach the next set of coordinates. Theo and Parrot accidentally set off a trap in a mountain. After exploring inside the mountain, they eventually find a fox trapped inside of a cage with the next clue in its mouth. Parrot assumes that the cage is trapped with TNT, meaning that they couldn't break any blocks. Using wool, he is able to get the item out of the fox's mouth. The item contains the next set of coordinates.

Boosfer and his guards attempt to kill Parrot and Theo, but fail.

After an hour, they make it to the next set of coordinates, which is a ravine that used to be a mining town that has since been abandoned. The two start looking for clues, but do not find anything. They find a player named Jagle. Parrot gives the book to Jagle, and Jagle says he has no idea of what Verdaria may be. Parrot and Theo decide to stay in the ravine, hoping to find clues inside of the ravine. 

They build a temporary base, and over the course of the next week they scour the ravine for anything. Parrot asks Jagle what happened to the ravine, so Jagle explains that five years ago the ravine used to be a mining town, until one day, the three people who built Verdaria showed up asking him to hide something for them. Soon, ClownPierce came searching for answers, and Jagle hid it from him. This caused Clown to kill everyone, leaving Jagle, which caused him to hide the next clue from anybody else. Hearing that Parrot wants to help out the server, Jagle gives the next clue to Parrot. As soon as they are about to leave, Boosfer and his gang ambushes Parrot and Theo once again. Running low on resources, the two surrender and promise to give Boosfer the clue. Boosfer holds Parrot hostage, making him and Theo come with him to solve it.

The next set of coordinates lead to a jungle. They walk down a path, at the end of the path there's a book that has the last task inside of it. Boosfer reads it first, but he isn't able to decipher it, so he lets Parrot read it. The last sentence of the book says, "I'm sorry. The final clue dies with me." Parrot quickly realizes this could be a trap, even mentioning the fact that the book was placed on top of a build of ClownPierce's head. They eventually find a crater. They find a staircase, and going down, they find a huge obsidian box with pillars and an execution chamber inside of it. Boosfer and his bandits leave. Parrot picks up the lava from the execution chamber, revealing a compass that leads to the location of Verdaria.

Afterwards, they go to the coordinates of Verdaria. They eventually find Verdaria. Parrot and Theo find a room filled with treasure. They give a large amount of treasure to other players.

DragonMC__ comes to Parrot and Theo's potion shop, saying that he had bought the clue but couldn't solve it. Parrot and Theo then follow the clue to the [[Great Sea]]. They find the first chest but realize that it has already been looted.

Parrot and Theo go to a different island where they find a team called the ocean rangers. The team forces them to empty their inventory. Parrot manages to smuggle in a bucket of fish and a bucket of axolotl.  

The ocean rangers take Parrot and Theo back to there base where they are locked in an underwater cell with a conduit for water breathing. Inside they met a player named [[Boomie]]. Parrot, Theo, and Boomie escape.

Parrot and Theo find an island, with a dolphin. Once they feed the dolphin it leads them to the nearest naturally generating buried treasure, leading to an island with turtles. Parrot and Theo save Boomie from the ocean rangers, who were trying to use Boomie as a hostage. Theo leaves, and stops trying to find the lost treasure. Wemmbu, invisible, kills Boomie with an orbital strike cannon. Parrot collects the treasure.

Parrot and Theo go into the nether dimension, owned by [[ClownPierce]]. Their goal is to steal from ClownPierce's vault to give to other players. Clown and Ferre try to kill Parrot and Theo, but they escape. Parrot and Theo find FlameFrags. Flame tries to kill them due to Parrot and Theo wearing shields designed for people who work for ClownPierce. Parrot says that he has a trap, which would blow Flame up, causing him to stop attacking. Flame, Parrot, and Theo form an alliance as Flame is trying to kill ClownPierce.

Flame and Theo try to kidnap Ferre to use as leverage. Parrot gives Ferre a map, and lets him free, assuming that they can use the map to find the location of the vault. Parrot shares with Theo that he dislikes FlameFrags, and Flame is secretly able to hear them. Flame leaves, and Parrot discovers Flame was able to hear them. Flame betrays Parrot, and tells ClownPierce the location of parrot. Clown attempts to kill Parrot. Parrot apologizes to Flame, causing Flame to save Parrot and Theo.

Parrot finds the location of the vault. He attempts to steal items from the vault, but ClownPierce finds him, and attempts to kill him. Parrot is able to escape using chorus fruit. He goes back to steal more items, then he escapes again.

Flame asks Parrot to help him find out where Wemmbu is, and in return says he will give Parrot the location of the Tomb of the Mafia. Parrot goes to the location of Eggchan, Wemmbu's friend, and asks where Wemmbu is. Eggchan's story is not consistent with what he had said before, causing Parrot to be suspicious. Parrot, assuming Wemmbu is the Invisible Knight, comes back, invisible. Eggchan is able to deduce that the invisible player is not Wemmbu. Parrot impersonates the Invisible Knight, and does bad things as him, causing the Invisible Knight to be no longer allowed to come to Capital City.

=== The Election Arc ===
In the video I Survived The Unstable SMP Purge, Parrot attends a meeting held by Lettuce, and gets jumped by assassins. [[Naparizel]] dies and Lettuce then announces The Purge, where candidates can kill each other for books. Purpled attacks Parrot for his books, knowing that Parrot is weaker than others in pvp. Theo comes and helps parrot, popping Purpled’s totems multiple times while Parrot escapes. 

Theo later meets another player named [[PearitX2]], and goes with Pearit to restock and get more votes. Pearit used a voicechanger, so Theo didn’t know it was an imposter. 

After Parrot recieves [[Horace Altman]] and [[Fymada]]’s votes, he returns to his tower in the [[Northern Council]]. Then, he finds Theo with Pearit and gets really confused. Pearit runs away and is never seen again. 

After Theo and Parrot reunite at the Northern Council, the two express doubt about Parrot’s chances in the election regardless of his endorsements from Horace and Fymada, as he was still around six thousand votes off of Lettuce. Parrot then considers one last possibility to swing the election in his favor, [[Wemmbu|someone]] they needed to find.

Theo then appears again at the climax of [[2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters|2 Minecraft Pros vs. 1000 Hunters]], appearing in earnest to 1v1 [[The_Oroboros]] in cart combat, furious at the Law for nearly blowing up Parrot after successfully luring him and [[Wemmbu]] into a trap. He manages to finally slay The Oroboros, but is subsequently taken captive by [[SargeLaw]] and TheG0dofWar, as proclaimed by [[LettuceK|Lettuce]] at the Second Debate. Parrot, in a dark rage and remembering all the good times with Theo and how much he truly depended on his friendship over the past months, tells Lettuce that he should’ve kept their strife between the two of them.

Before his defeat of The_Oroboros and capture, Parrot and Theo are encountered by [[FlameFrags]], who requests Theo to train him in TNT minecart combat, since he is the master of it. Initially, Theo and Parrot are hesitant, but Parrot eventually persuades him to train Flame after Flame vows he will use all of his new combat skills to battle the Law. Theo admits later he thought would be a waste of his time. However, he is surprised when Flame exhibits above-average skill in cart combat, and agrees to train him further. Theo then admits he has not brought enough carts to continue, so they go to the [[Black Market]] under [[Capital City (season 2)|Capital City]] to purchase more.

However, as Flame acquires more carts, one of the commanders of [[LettuceK|Lettuce]], [[G0dOfWar]], arrives, having been alerted by a Law officer guarding the entrance to the market. Theo attempts to diffuse the situation after Flame is found but is unsuccessful, and G0dOfWar swiftly defeats Flame in battle as the two retreat from the market.

Theo acknowledges the defeat but encourages Flame in spite of it, showing him the terrain-based mechanics of TNT minecart combat and the importance of timing and feet placement. Flame picks up the style quickly, impressing Theo. He also shows off the alternative yet more destructive method of crossbow cart combat.

After they finish basic training, Theo urges Flame to put his new skills to the test in combat and avenge his defeat to G0dOfWar. Flame and Theo part ways soon after.

Possibly after or even before FlameFrags had his duel with TheG0dofWar, Theo fought [[The_Oroboros]] in a very heated duel. Theo used his TNT Minecarts to their fullest potential and it let him kill a dangerous commander of The Law.  Following this, G0d0fWar and SargeLaw turned up and detained Theo under LettuceK's orders. Theo is now being used as a hostage, possibly in the same prison as [[Jaden MAN]], another prisoner captured by the law. 

== Quotes ==

{{Quote|NO YOU’RE NOT!|[[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]]|in response to [[Wemmbu]]'s ragebait in [[Unstable SMP: After The Mafia]]}}
{{Quote|We're in it to win it bro!|[[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]]|to [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] in [[Unstable SMP: The First King]]}}
{{Quote|Forty-three play- bro. This guy couldn't kill forty-three players even if he WANTED to! Like, what is this, bro?!|[[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]]|in response to the [[Capitol City Police Force]]'s allegations against [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] in [[I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization]]}}
{{Quote|IT'S RAINING LOOT, HALLELUJAH! |[[TheobaldTheBird|Theo]]|collecting the loot dropped by [[Cindercrest]]'s soldiers as [[Parrot]] uses his [[Arrow Cannon]]}}
== Trivia ==
* Theo played a minor background invis player several times, he was the first player Wemmbu ever killed for ManePear during his training arc, as shown in a BTS Youtube short posted by Theo.
* He often claims to be the best at PvP. His PvP skill is comparable to that of Flowtives, Sharpness or FlameFrags in real life but on Unstable SMP he was greatly nerfed.
* He is teamed with ParrotX2 because he is the brawn and Parrot is the brain.
* Theo is bi in real life, as confirmed in his 50k subscribers video
* Theo claims to be the biggest bird, and argues with Parrot about who the title should go to.

title: This Button Destroys the World
content:
This Button Destroys the World is the second episode featured in Unstable Universe and the first episode released by Parrot. 

Plot
The episode starts with ParrotX2 entering his own base to encounter Wemmbu, who claims to have something greatly interesting. Seeing Parrot's confusion, Wemmbu prompts him to follow.

Parrot flies behind Wemmbu until they reach a large crater in the ground. Wemmbu claims that he wasn't responsible for the destruction, and that it was a test site for an orbital cannon—a weapon that can destroy any location at a whim. Together, Parrot and Wemmbu deduce that the cannon must belong to SpokeIsHere, as he'd seen Wemmbu build one before, but they don't understand why Spoke did it. 

They decide to check The Wonders. Although Parrot doesn't know who built The Wonders and why, he assumes that they would be the only builds worthy of being targeted by Spoke. 

Along with Wemmbu, Parrot returns to his base to brainstorm a plan to stop Spoke. However, they get interrupted by Roshambogames who informs them that the server is lagging and that the Wonder he'd been guarding had been nuked by a giant mass of TNT. Roshambo leads them to the Wonder and shows them the destruction. Wemmbu confirms that it's the work of an orbital cannon, and proceeds to explain to Roshambo what that is. Parrot discovers a netherrack room beneath the destroyed monument. He asks Wemmbu what his thoughts are about it, but Wemmbu dismisses it and says it's probably useless.

Parrot  realizes that if nobody will try to stop The Wonders from getting destroyed, he'll have no choice but to protect them himself. To do that, though, he needs to build an orbital cannon of his own, but he has no idea how. He decides to start practicing with small machines until he can understand how to build an orbital cannon. While flying over a Wonder, he spots Roshambo. Parrot  asks Roshambo about the netherrack box beneath his Wonder, but Roshambo says he's never seen one. Confused, Parrot returns to his attempt at a TNT machine, only to discover that it had been griefed with obsidian.

Later, Parrot calls Wemmbu to show him his machine and ask for help. Wemmbu sees the machine and claims that it won't do any damage at all, but when Parrot activates it, it launches both of them into the air. After the initial explosion, the machine continues to detonate multiple rounds of TNT until Parrot manually breaks it. He  complains to Wemmbu that he'd previously created a cannon that got destroyed, but Wemmbu laughs and suggests that Parrot had probably done it by himself on accident. 

Wemmbu  leaves, but Parrot is certain that his redstone had been ruined by another player. He wonders why Wemmbu tried to cover that up, and why, despite knowing how to, he wasn't assisting Parrot in building the orbital cannon.

Parrot spots Wemmbu talking to Roshambo at the Marshland Mansion and decides to listen in on their conversation. They seem to be talking about illegal items, and about offering them to other players. Roshambo talks about how he needs the items because he has nothing left, and that the others probably don't, but Wemmbu reassures that it'll become the same for them. Wemmbu  expresses his concerns about Parrot catching on to their plans. He advises Roshambo to stop destroying Parrot's builds and tells him to be more subtle about the distractions. Finally, Roshambo says something about trying to get the others on their side. Wemmbu leaves, and Parrot follows him.

Wemmbu flies toward his base at spawn, and due to being distracted by a skeleton, Parrot loses him. He enters the base and calls out to Wemmbu, but is met with no reply, so he leaves.

Parrot continues his attempts at building cannons, and a while later, Wemmbu comes back to check on him. Parrot explains that he thinks building an orbital cannon requires power and precision, but Wemmbu says that he doesn't get what Parrot means. Parrot demonstrates his latest machine on an iron golem, and it ends up successfully killing it, but the server experiences a lag spike. The two players fly back to spawn and Parrot tries to celebrate his achievement, only for Wemmbu to criticize how it lagged the server. Parrot is confused and he claims that he's tested the machine multiple times without it lagging. Wemmbu realizes that Parrot's machine isn't supposed to lag and flies off.

Wemmbu leads Parrot to a Wonder, The Crone, and discovers that it's been blown up. The guard, Fantst, explains that a ball of TNT appeared and destroyed it. While Fantst complains about his loss, Parrot observes various redstone components within the debris and asks him about them. Fantst says he doesn't know anything, and Wemmbu suggests that it might be the remnants of a cobblestone duper. Parrot argues that cobble dupers don't appear like that. He asks about what their plan is now, but Wemmbu leaves. After confirming that Fantst truly has no clue about the redstone, Parrot attempts to follow Wemmbu. He spots Wemmbu entering his base at spawn, but when Parrot goes in to look for him, he isn't there.

A while later, Parrot calls Wemmbu to show him another cannon. It's able to fire TNT at specific locations according to which button is pressed on the machine. Wemmbu messes around with it before agreeing that it's cool. He asks Parrot why he's testing the machine on the ocean instead of on land, to which Parrot responds that he's not interested in destroying things. Parrot asks who built The Wonders and accuses Wemmbu of lying when he says he doesn't know. Wemmbu and Parrot have an argument about it. When Parrot states that Wemmbu can build an orbital cannon but refuses to help, Wemmbu reveals that he's only interested in knowing where Spoke's cannon is, but refuses to tell Parrot why. Wemmbu asks Parrot where Spoke is, but Parrot doesn't know. He claims that he does, however, have notes on how to find Spoke's orbital cannon and says that he's kept the notes in the Frosted Palace. Wemmbu leaves in pursuit of the book containing the notes.

With him busy, Parrot decides to check Wemmbu's base once more. He reaches it, and after some searching, finds a hidden lever that opens a secret passageway. Parrot drops down and follows a very long tunnel to a 3 x 3 iron door with a button next to it. Parrot contemplates pressing the button, but decides against it as he thinks Wemmbu will catch him. He flies out of Wemmbu's house.

Parrot returns to the last cannon that he'd made, and finds Wemmbu using it. When Wemmbu sees him, he asks Parrot where he's been and why the notes weren't in the monument. Parrot apologizes and says they were in his base and he went to grab them. Wemmbu asks Parrot for them, and Parrot replies by asking why Wemmbu wants them anyway. Wemmbu says that he just wants to destroy Spoke's cannon, and he and Parrot bicker for some time. Finally, Wemmbu asks him how to find Spoke's cannon, with or without notes, and Parrot claims that they have to use the lag. Seeing Wemmbu's confusion, Parrot explains that they can use the velocity of the TNT and the time to calculate the distance from Spoke's cannon. Wemmbu agrees with the idea. Parrot realizes that even if they destroy Spoke's orbital cannon, only two of The Wonders will remain standing at best. He tells Wemmbu that he is ready to build the orbital cannon and asks him for help. Wemmbu questions why Parrot even wants to build one, and Parrot says that he wants to blow up Spoke's, but Wemmbu says it's a bad idea to blow up that location. Parrot leaves.

He still doesn't know why Spoke is destroying The Wonders, and he doesn't know what Wemmbu is hiding in his base. There's something about the server that he just doesn't understand, but there's only one thing he knows he can do. Parrot builds an orbital cannon.

Once Parrot has built the cannon, Wemmbu shows up and accuses Parrot of not knowing what he's doing. Parrot says that he does and when Wemmbu asks if Parrot even found Spoke's location, Parrot says that that's what he's waiting on. Wemmbu starts criticizing parts of Parrot's redstone, and Parrot asks why Wemmbu doesn't just build the cannon himself. Wemmbu says he doesn't understand why Parrot is so insistent on using an orbital cannon and says he's wasting time, but Parrot says that he's not wasting time if the machine works. Wemmbu claims that the cannon will blow itself up when activated, then proceeds to mess with it so that it does, and says that Parrot doesn't understand anything that's going on. Parrot states that Wemmbu used to guard a Wonder, to which Wemmbu says that he did until said Wonder got destroyed, so Parrot asks why Wemmbu doesn't care. Wemmbu explains that just because he guarded it doesn't mean he cares. Parrot says that blowing up Spoke's cannon is the only way to prevent him from destroying the other Wonders, and that he doesn't get why Wemmbu doesn't want that. In return, Wemmbu says he doesn't get why Parrot cares so much, but Parrot says that it's because nobody else is doing anything about it—not even Wemmbu, who used to be a guardian. Wemmbu says that he used to care until everything important in his monument got nuked, so Parrot reminds Wemmbu that he said at the beginning that The Wonders were pointless. Wemmbu says that they are, and Parrot leaves.

Wemmbu follows Parrot to another Wonder. Parrot gives Wemmbu one last chance to explain, but Wemmbu says he doesn't know what Parrot is talking about. Parrot states that there's something beneath every Monument and says he'll dig straight into the one they're standing on. However, before he can start digging, a mass of TNT appears and destroys it. Parrot and Wemmbu watch as the Wonder is blown up, and Wemmbu reminds Parrot that they can now pinpoint Spoke's location. They discover the coordinates and Wemmbu leaves. Parrot notices that there are redstone machines beneath the debris of the monument.

He realizes that the only way to find out what Wemmbu is hiding is to enter the secret room in his base. Parrot goes there and presses the button. He goes inside to discover one of the machines he'd once seen in the remains of a Wonder, along with that seem to be duped fireworks. While he's investigating, however, he hears Wemmbu and Roshambo coming into the room. Parrot hides in the weeping vines on the ceiling, eavesdropping on their conversation. Wemmbu says that Parrot is getting too close to properly finishing the orbital cannon, and that he needs Roshambo to take care of him—that Parrot's cannon mustn't be fired under any circumstances—and says he'll give Roshambo what he wants. Once Roshambo leaves, Parrot drops down, hits Wemmbu, and threatens to kill him. Upon realized that Wemmbu is more skilled than him, Parrot proceeds to interrogate him instead, but Wemmbu runs away.

Parrot flies after him and threatens to just keep chasing him, but Wemmbu claims that Parrot doesn't have enough rockets to get to where Wemmbu's headed. Parrot stops following Wemmbu, returns to his orbital cannon, and starts fixing it.

While he's working on the cannon, he gets interrupted by Roshambo who tells him to stop. Roshambo is followed by JumperWho, Derapchu, and Fantst. He says there's no reason to set the cannon off, but Parrot argues that he wants to save The Wonders. Roshambo explains that most of them at this point are gone, and firing the cannon will only perpetuate a cycle of destruction until everything else is gone, too. Parrot tells him that the cannon is set to fire in ten minutes, and Roshambo says either Parrot should prevent that or he'll prevent it himself. Parrot questions the other three guardians if they're on Roshambo's side, and they say that they are. When Parrot asks what he told them, Roshambo says that it doesn't matter. Parrot claims that Roshambo is being manipulated by Wemmbu, and Roshambo points out that Parrot is being manipulated by Spoke. Parrot disagrees and tells the other three about how he discovered a vault in Wemmbu's base with duped items. He prompts them to follow him to the base to prove that Roshambo and Wemmbu have been planning something. 

After accusing Parrot of trying to distract them, the group eventually follows him to Wemmbu's base. However, when he leads them into the base, he discovers that the door to the secret room is gone. Roshambo's group talk about how they now only have five minutes left to stop the cannon and start chasing Parrot as he tries to run away.

When Parrot stops, they start fighting him. He says that he doesn't understand what they're trying to accomplish before flying off once more. '''This Button Destroys the World''' is the second episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]] and the first episode released by [[ParrotX2|Parrot]]. 

==Plot==
The episode starts with [[ParrotX2]] entering his own base to encounter [[Wemmbu]], who claims to have something greatly interesting. Seeing Parrot's confusion, Wemmbu prompts him to follow.

Parrot flies behind Wemmbu until they reach a large crater in the ground. Wemmbu claims that he wasn't responsible for the destruction, and that it was a test site for an [[Orbital Strike Cannon|orbital cannon]]—a weapon that can destroy any location at a whim. Together, Parrot and Wemmbu deduce that the cannon must belong to [[SpokeIsHere]], as he'd seen Wemmbu build one before, but they don't understand why Spoke did it. 

They decide to check [[The Wonders]]. Although Parrot doesn't know who built The Wonders and why, he assumes that they would be the only builds worthy of being targeted by Spoke. 

Along with Wemmbu, Parrot returns to his base to brainstorm a plan to stop Spoke. However, they get interrupted by [[Roshambogames]] who informs them that the server is lagging and that the Wonder he'd been guarding had been nuked by a giant mass of TNT. Roshambo leads them to the Wonder and shows them the destruction. Wemmbu confirms that it's the work of an orbital cannon, and proceeds to explain to Roshambo what that is. Parrot discovers a netherrack room beneath the destroyed monument. He asks Wemmbu what his thoughts are about it, but Wemmbu dismisses it and says it's probably useless.

Parrot  realizes that if nobody will try to stop [[The Wonders]] from getting destroyed, he'll have no choice but to protect them himself. To do that, though, he needs to build an orbital cannon of his own, but he has no idea how. He decides to start practicing with small machines until he can understand how to build an orbital cannon. While flying over a Wonder, he spots Roshambo. Parrot  asks Roshambo about the netherrack box beneath his Wonder, but Roshambo says he's never seen one. Confused, Parrot returns to his attempt at a TNT machine, only to discover that it had been griefed with obsidian.

Later, Parrot calls Wemmbu to show him his machine and ask for help. Wemmbu sees the machine and claims that it won't do any damage at all, but when Parrot activates it, it launches both of them into the air. After the initial explosion, the machine continues to detonate multiple rounds of TNT until Parrot manually breaks it. He  complains to Wemmbu that he'd previously created a cannon that got destroyed, but Wemmbu laughs and suggests that Parrot had probably done it by himself on accident. 

Wemmbu  leaves, but Parrot is certain that his redstone had been ruined by another player. He wonders why Wemmbu tried to cover that up, and why, despite knowing how to, he wasn't assisting Parrot in building the orbital cannon.

Parrot spots Wemmbu talking to Roshambo at the [[The Wonders#The Marshland Mansion:|Marshland Mansion]] and decides to listen in on their conversation. They seem to be talking about illegal items, and about offering them to other players. Roshambo talks about how he needs the items because he has nothing left, and that the others probably don't, but Wemmbu reassures that it'll become the same for them. Wemmbu  expresses his concerns about Parrot catching on to their plans. He advises Roshambo to stop destroying Parrot's builds and tells him to be more subtle about the distractions. Finally, Roshambo says something about trying to get the others on their side. Wemmbu leaves, and Parrot follows him.

Wemmbu flies toward his base at spawn, and due to being distracted by a skeleton, Parrot loses him. He enters the base and calls out to Wemmbu, but is met with no reply, so he leaves.

Parrot continues his attempts at building cannons, and a while later, Wemmbu comes back to check on him. Parrot explains that he thinks building an orbital cannon requires power and precision, but Wemmbu says that he doesn't get what Parrot means. Parrot demonstrates his latest machine on an iron golem, and it ends up successfully killing it, but the server experiences a lag spike. The two players fly back to spawn and Parrot tries to celebrate his achievement, only for Wemmbu to criticize how it lagged the server. Parrot is confused and he claims that he's tested the machine multiple times without it lagging. Wemmbu realizes that Parrot's machine isn't supposed to lag and flies off.

Wemmbu leads Parrot to a Wonder, [[The Wonders#The Crone:|The Crone]], and discovers that it's been blown up. The guard, [[Fantst]], explains that a ball of TNT appeared and destroyed it. While Fantst complains about his loss, Parrot observes various redstone components within the debris and asks him about them. Fantst says he doesn't know anything, and Wemmbu suggests that it might be the remnants of a cobblestone duper. Parrot argues that cobble dupers don't appear like that. He asks about what their plan is now, but Wemmbu leaves. After confirming that Fantst truly has no clue about the redstone, Parrot attempts to follow Wemmbu. He spots Wemmbu entering his base at spawn, but when Parrot goes in to look for him, he isn't there.

A while later, Parrot calls Wemmbu to show him another cannon. It's able to fire TNT at specific locations according to which button is pressed on the machine. Wemmbu messes around with it before agreeing that it's cool. He asks Parrot why he's testing the machine on the ocean instead of on land, to which Parrot responds that he's not interested in destroying things. Parrot asks who built The Wonders and accuses Wemmbu of lying when he says he doesn't know. Wemmbu and Parrot have an argument about it. When Parrot states that Wemmbu can build an orbital cannon but refuses to help, Wemmbu reveals that he's only interested in knowing where Spoke's cannon is, but refuses to tell Parrot why. Wemmbu asks Parrot where Spoke is, but Parrot doesn't know. He claims that he does, however, have notes on how to find Spoke's orbital cannon and says that he's kept the notes in the [[The Wonders#The Frosted Palace:|Frosted Palace]]. Wemmbu leaves in pursuit of the book containing the notes.

With him busy, Parrot decides to check Wemmbu's base once more. He reaches it, and after some searching, finds a hidden lever that opens a secret passageway. Parrot drops down and follows a very long tunnel to a 3 x 3 iron door with a button next to it. Parrot contemplates pressing the button, but decides against it as he thinks Wemmbu will catch him. He flies out of Wemmbu's house.

Parrot returns to the last cannon that he'd made, and finds Wemmbu using it. When Wemmbu sees him, he asks Parrot where he's been and why the notes weren't in the monument. Parrot apologizes and says they were in his base and he went to grab them. Wemmbu asks Parrot for them, and Parrot replies by asking why Wemmbu wants them anyway. Wemmbu says that he just wants to destroy Spoke's cannon, and he and Parrot bicker for some time. Finally, Wemmbu asks him how to find Spoke's cannon, with or without notes, and Parrot claims that they have to use the lag. Seeing Wemmbu's confusion, Parrot explains that they can use the velocity of the TNT and the time to calculate the distance from Spoke's cannon. Wemmbu agrees with the idea. Parrot realizes that even if they destroy Spoke's orbital cannon, only two of The Wonders will remain standing at best. He tells Wemmbu that he is ready to build the orbital cannon and asks him for help. Wemmbu questions why Parrot even wants to build one, and Parrot says that he wants to blow up Spoke's, but Wemmbu says it's a bad idea to blow up that location. Parrot leaves.

He still doesn't know why Spoke is destroying The Wonders, and he doesn't know what Wemmbu is hiding in his base. There's something about the server that he just doesn't understand, but there's only one thing he knows he can do. Parrot builds an orbital cannon.

Once Parrot has built the cannon, Wemmbu shows up and accuses Parrot of not knowing what he's doing. Parrot says that he does and when Wemmbu asks if Parrot even found Spoke's location, Parrot says that that's what he's waiting on. Wemmbu starts criticizing parts of Parrot's redstone, and Parrot asks why Wemmbu doesn't just build the cannon himself. Wemmbu says he doesn't understand why Parrot is so insistent on using an orbital cannon and says he's wasting time, but Parrot says that he's not wasting time if the machine works. Wemmbu claims that the cannon will blow itself up when activated, then proceeds to mess with it so that it does, and says that Parrot doesn't understand anything that's going on. Parrot states that Wemmbu used to guard a Wonder, to which Wemmbu says that he did until said Wonder got destroyed, so Parrot asks why Wemmbu doesn't care. Wemmbu explains that just because he guarded it doesn't mean he cares. Parrot says that blowing up Spoke's cannon is the only way to prevent him from destroying the other Wonders, and that he doesn't get why Wemmbu doesn't want that. In return, Wemmbu says he doesn't get why Parrot cares so much, but Parrot says that it's because nobody else is doing anything about it—not even Wemmbu, who used to be a guardian. Wemmbu says that he used to care until everything important in his monument got nuked, so Parrot reminds Wemmbu that he said at the beginning that The Wonders were pointless. Wemmbu says that they are, and Parrot leaves.

Wemmbu follows Parrot to another Wonder. Parrot gives Wemmbu one last chance to explain, but Wemmbu says he doesn't know what Parrot is talking about. Parrot states that there's something beneath every Monument and says he'll dig straight into the one they're standing on. However, before he can start digging, a mass of TNT appears and destroys it. Parrot and Wemmbu watch as the Wonder is blown up, and Wemmbu reminds Parrot that they can now pinpoint Spoke's location. They discover the coordinates and Wemmbu leaves. Parrot notices that there are redstone machines beneath the debris of the monument.

He realizes that the only way to find out what Wemmbu is hiding is to enter the secret room in his base. Parrot goes there and presses the button. He goes inside to discover one of the machines he'd once seen in the remains of a Wonder, along with that seem to be duped fireworks. While he's investigating, however, he hears Wemmbu and Roshambo coming into the room. Parrot hides in the weeping vines on the ceiling, eavesdropping on their conversation. Wemmbu says that Parrot is getting too close to properly finishing the orbital cannon, and that he needs Roshambo to take care of him—that Parrot's cannon mustn't be fired under any circumstances—and says he'll give Roshambo what he wants. Once Roshambo leaves, Parrot drops down, hits Wemmbu, and threatens to kill him. Upon realized that Wemmbu is more skilled than him, Parrot proceeds to interrogate him instead, but Wemmbu runs away.

Parrot flies after him and threatens to just keep chasing him, but Wemmbu claims that Parrot doesn't have enough rockets to get to where Wemmbu's headed. Parrot stops following Wemmbu, returns to his orbital cannon, and starts fixing it.

While he's working on the cannon, he gets interrupted by Roshambo who tells him to stop. Roshambo is followed by [[JumperWho]], [[Derapchu]], and Fantst. He says there's no reason to set the cannon off, but Parrot argues that he wants to save The Wonders. Roshambo explains that most of them at this point are gone, and firing the cannon will only perpetuate a cycle of destruction until everything else is gone, too. Parrot tells him that the cannon is set to fire in ten minutes, and Roshambo says either Parrot should prevent that or he'll prevent it himself. Parrot questions the other three guardians if they're on Roshambo's side, and they say that they are. When Parrot asks what he told them, Roshambo says that it doesn't matter. Parrot claims that Roshambo is being manipulated by Wemmbu, and Roshambo points out that Parrot is being manipulated by Spoke. Parrot disagrees and tells the other three about how he discovered a vault in Wemmbu's base with duped items. He prompts them to follow him to the base to prove that Roshambo and Wemmbu have been planning something.

title: This Player Stole My Identity
content:
This Player Stole My Identity is the 79th episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
The episode begins with Wemmbu and Fantst inside of a restaurant, having a casual conversation. LettuceK, the leader of a team called The Law and a few of his members, arrive and accuse Wemmbu (as the invisible player) of stealing from Capital City. Wemmbu attempts to defend himself to Lettuce by saying he doesn't need to steal, but Lettuce begins to pot up. Wemmbu escapes from the restaurant and loses the trail of his pursuers, successfully leaving Merchant City.

Wemmbu returns to Capital City to figure out who's been impersonating him, traversing sneakily to avoid getting caught and makes a secret base near the front gate to observe players going in and out of the city to catch his impersonator. Soon, he spots an invisible player wearing his exact same armor and trims, prompting a confrontation. However, the impersonator insists that Wemmbu is impersonating them, not the other way around. The other invisible player has a totem in their offhand, and so Wemmbu uses that as his time to attack them to pop their totem to reveal their identity, not to kill them. The player takes the totem off so Wemmbu can't reveal their identity without revealing his own. The invisible player tells Wemmbu to "count his days" before trying to leave, but Wemmbu follows suit. The impersonator actives a hidden contraption that launches players up thousands of blocks in the air, and Wemmbu loses them in the sky.

Since there's only three players who know Wemmbu's true identity (his friend eggchan, Boosfer, and Jaden_MAN), he goes to Egg in the End Dimension to get Boosfer's location to get leads on his impersonator. Egg tells Wemmbu that Boosfer is back at the mushroom island. When he gets there, he sees the impersonator had beaten him to Boosfer, and since Boosfer couldn't tell the two apart, he suggested them to undergo a set of trials to prove which invisible player is the real Wemmbu. The first trial is to make a one block neo, but both of them fails. When that doesn't work out, Boosfer assigns them to get them a coal block, Wemmbu refuses and the impersonator goes. This doesn't prove anyone's identity, and the impersonator tries to manipulate Boosfer to say something only the real Wemmbu would know. Fed up of the back-and-forth strut, Wemmbu tells Boosfer to stay quiet and attempts to pop the impersonator's totem. The impersonator runs out of the factory to "swap out", revealing a second impersonator named "Agent 22". The two team up on Wemmbu, and with no other choice, Wemmbu brings out his mace. The impersonators try to escape using a Happy Ghast, but Wemmbu flies up high to detect being seen, due to his cape and Elytra being purple. He drops down and kills the Happy Ghast, prompting one of the two impersonators to yell "SKY!" (indirectly revealing their identities). However, the two impersonators still manage to escape from Wemmbu.

Wemmbu goes back to the End DImension again to meet back up with Egg, this time to ask if there's an easier way to get to the Great Sea without having to wait for rain to travel with his Riptide Trident or go through the Nether. Egg tells Wemmbu that Jaden has teamed up with Capital City to make a dolphin highway to his Pirate Civilization, but before Wemmbu goes through the portal to return to the Overworld, Egg stops Wemmbu and tells him how one of the impersonators came through the End as well and mentioned a courtroom trial, which opens an opportunity for Wemmbu to pop their totem and reveal the impersonator's identity(s).

When Wemmbu arrives back in Capital City, he sees other invisible people with his same armor trims going to the courtroom, likely the trial Egg was talking about. When he walks in, there are dozens of invisible players with his same armor. The main impersonator speaks up, saying that they gathered all of the people here to uncover the identity of "The Invisible Knight." It was then revealed that this courtroom was a trap, as all of the invisible players get stasised out besides the main impersonator standing on the stage and Agent 22. The courtroom is boxed in a layer of obsidian and Elder Guardians are beneath, trapping the three inside and causing mining fatigue so Wemmbu can't mine out. The main impersonator boxes themselves in with glass while Agent 22 tries to kill Wemmbu. 

Wemmbu pops Agent 22's totem, revealing it to be TheobaldTheBird. Wemmbu and Theo fight each other, but Theo accidentally carts and blows up the glass blocks encasing the other impersonator. Wemmbu immediately pops their totem, revealing the main impersonator to be ParrotX2. Parrot and Theo try to devise a backup plan since FlameFrags failed to show up, and then chorus fruit out of the courtroom, leaving Wemmbu inside. Quickly hatching a plan, he retrieves Ender Pearls from his ender chest without them looking. Wemmbu tries to pearl glitch out of the obsidian, but to no avail. Parrot, catching onto Wemmbu's trick, traps Wemmbu in glass while he's in crawl mode. Because the courtroom is made out of wood, Wemmbu crafts a crafting table makes ladders, escaping successfully by pearl glitching out with the ladder.

The episode ends with Wemmbu and his dialogue:

"The impersonator was named Parrot, one of the smartest players on the Unstable SMP. But I had no clue why he even cared about what I was doing, or what he meant by not having a choice to hunt me down. The only thing I know for certain was that this was not going to be the last time that I was going to be seeing Parrot."

 Trivia 

 This video went through three title changes. Originally, it was called “I Got Impersonated on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP”, then it was changed to “I Got Impersonated on a Minecraft SMP”, then to “This Player Pretended To Be Me” before it was named “This Player Stole My Identity”.

title: TomLWSM
content:
TomLWSM is a character in Unstable Universe Season 2. 

TomLWSM was seen as a candidate for king of Unstable Universe. In the debate, he said he planned to give everyone free baguettes (since baguettes are unfortunately not in Minecraft, he had to use bread to represent them).  They were eliminated in the first round.

title: TruOriginal
content:
TruOriginal was a minor antagonist featured in Unstable Universe during the Director Arc.

History
TruOriginal first appeared as a mysterious "hacker" hired by The Director to eliminate Parrot and the Bounty Assassin Team (BAT). He was first encountered in a completely destroyed town, which he claimed to have leveled simply out of boredom. From the start, he demonstrated abilities far beyond a normal player, including teleportation, walking on water, and the ability to morph into other players to deceive his targets.

Throughout his hunt, he proved to be a nearly unstoppable force. During a confrontation in a flower field (owned by R4trick and F1nlo), the team discovered his only notable weakness: Cobwebs, which managed to slow him down despite his hacks. However, TruOriginal's ego grew rapidly; he eventually proclaimed himself "way above The Director," abandoning his original orders to keep Parrot alive and instead attempting to kill the entire team for his own amusement.

In a desperate final stand at BAT Headquarters, the team lured him into a false sense of security. While TruOriginal believed he had trapped them, Nufuli used a Mirror Receiver to trigger a maximum-power blast from the Orbital Strike Cannon. TruOriginal was caught in the center of the explosion, which destroyed the base and presumably killed him. He was seen wielding a mace, which was destroyed along with him in the blast.

 Trivia 
 He was one of the few mace wielders.
 TruOriginal's full list of powers was immense. Not only could he alter his speed to ludicrous values and fly, but he could take on the appearance of other players and create false duplicates of himself. He could also mine multiple blocks at a time and walk on water, and he was even able to slow down time and swap his location with that of another player. He was possessed of a "kill aura" and could instantly remove all of the items in a player's inventory when they hit him. Some of his dialogue hinted that he had a full list of hacks that he could modify at will.

title: Unstable Events
content:
Unstable Events is the official Discord & Minecraft server for Unstable members to host events created in June 2025. The first event was hosted by SpokeIsHere for his Spoke Galactic Empire video. 

 Info 
The link to the Unstable Events Discord server is https://discord.gg/unstableevents, and the server IP is UnstableEvents.net

There are a variety types of events in the Unstable Events such as: 

 Mocap Events
 Recording Events
 Beta Testing
 Plot Build Events
 Thumbnail Events

 Mocap Events 
Mocap Events are events where players wander around a specific location in the server while getting recorded. They are often used for scenes used in the intros of a video. 

 Recording Events 
Recording Events are events hosted to get players into the actual videos and are actually canon to the Unstable SMP Lore. The first recording event was by SpokeIsHere for his Spoke Galactic Empire video.

 Beta Testing 
Beta Testing events are usually called by the admins (Horace, and Lukas) for a few players to test and debug the server. 

 Plot Build Events 
The Plot Build Events are in a seperate SMP (in the Unstable Events server) where players can build and their builds have a chance of actually getting in an Unstable video.

 Thumbnail Events 
Thumbnail Events are usually hosted to assist in making a thumbnail for an Unstable SMP video.   

 Compatibility 
In order to play on the Unstable Events server you must have:

 Minecraft Java Edition (not a cracked version) 1.21.6-1.21.11+ 
 Some events (usually beta testing events) support Java Edition 1.21.9 only.
 Minecraft Bedrock Edition (the latest version supported by Geyser)

 History 
The Discord server was created in June 11, 2025. The server was made public in June 25, 2025 after they had finished the server.

title: Unstable SMP
content:
Unstable SMP is the server where Unstable Universe takes place.

 Background and Characteristics 
 Unstable SMP is an explicitly scripted, anarchy, hardcore server.
 The protagonists' personality are based on their Lifesteal S4–S5 counterpart, so you can view it as a Lifesteal spinoff.
 Death message only show locally except for Mafia member teleportation to void death. Starting from Season 2, death is accompanied by a sound effect.
 Resources are severely limited, as mobs rarely spawn, villagers and ominous vaults have been destroyed since The Invisible Mafia, and netherite and potions was monopolized by Nether Civilization lead by ClownPierce.

 Brief History 
The three protagonist set their bases at spawn, fought over exploit items and The Wonders builds. PrinceZam created an empire but later betrayed Wemmbu, leading to the empire's downfall. The Invisible Mafia took over the server including spawn, and hunted players to every corner of the world, so the three protagonist form ally to destroy it.

Parrot was hunted by an invisible player called the Director, which turned out to be someone he was more than familiar with. Wemmbu and Flame fought each other multiple times. Wemmbu went to Far Lands, came back with Orbital Strike Cannons to sweep across the server. Spoke ran into issue with Bounty Assassin Team despite the latter saved him from a disastrous civilization creation attempt. The Law led by LettuceK tried to take over the server. Protagonists were forced to unite and fight it again. Parrot vied for the king of the server and tried hard to assume the responsibility. Flame became a combat master.

Spoke and Mapicc were hunted and captured by a group called Null Hunters. Wemmbu and Eggchan were hunted by an Invisible Guy. Parrot's Kingdom was under threat by old players.

 Overall Map

Unknown but important: The Forge

 Lore 
 The server starts years earlier than the 1st episode, so there is First Generation Players that might have created the terrain in the Far Lands.
 The server might have reference to 2b2t, the largest anarchy server. The lava cast filled, chaotic spawn in Season 2, the great sea, the glitches and the admin behind the server all have similar appearance on 2b2t. 2b2t started from early Minecraft versions (which give rise to the great sea on it) and later upgrade to modern versions, so the same may hold for Unstable SMP, hence the existence of so many weird terrain, Far Lands, and a lot of glitches that can be exploited.
 The server contains exploit that are unique to it.
 The server contains terrains that are not found on other servers: Great Sea, The Amplified, The Mist, Far Lands, The Underworld, Skyblock Civilization, ... They are generally built by Horace_Altman builder team behind the scenes.
 The server may have admins unknown to us.

 Unspoken Rules 
 No /msg, discord, or group voice chat allowed since Season 2. Only way to communicate is proximity chat.
 No logging off allowed (immersed storyline)
 No chunkban allowed since Season 2.
 No hacking allowed except for TruOriginal.
 Beds, respawn anchors and end crystals exist (in limited amount, as all require mob resources to be renewable) but cannot be used as explosives or in PvP.

 Unstable SMP is actually filmed on multiple servers instead of one server.
 The hardcore hearts seen in the videos are texture pack. Deathban functions as hardcore.

title: Unstable SMP: After The Mafia
content:
Unstable SMP: After The Mafia is the 28th episode featured Unstable Universe.

 Plot 
Wemmbu and Eggchan try to begin a new life, away from fighting. After defeating the Mafia, they run millions of blocks away to a Pale Garden biome and begin to make a house, the first real base that they've had since Mane's tree. While designing their new home, they get interrupted by TheobaldTheBird. He has followed them and is looking for a fight. Theo says that he knows Wemmbu is a good enough player to give him an entertaining fight, but Wemmbu is too stubborn to give him what he wants. 

Theo begins destroying their base and says he'll give Wemmbu some time to prepare for when he returns. Wemmbu and Eggchan prepare for this by making a creaking trap that they intend to drop Theo into. However, their trap doesn't work, and when Theo returns, he griefs their base again. Tired of this and not wanting to give into Theo's wishes, Wemmbu sets out to find Kenadian to commission him to make their base secure. At first, Kenadian was scared but eventually he does end up helping Wemmbu. He explains what Wemmbu and Eggchan need to do to secure their base. Theo interrupts them again. Wemmbu tells Theo that if he wants to fight him, he has to let them build the defenses and Theo has to break into the base. Theo tells Wemmbu that he will come back in a week.

Wemmbu and Eggchan begin making their defenses. They finish making the defenses and they're confident that Theo won't break in. Theo returns and begins trying to break in. Wemmbu watches Theo while being invisible. Wemmbu realizes that his break in attempt might end up successful, so he sabotages him by griefing the tunnel. Wemmbu steals some of his shulkers and taunts Theo. He successfully breaks into the base and activates both Wemmbu and Egg's stasises. Wemmbu is still too stubborn to fight so Theo takes Kenadian hostage and threatens to kill him unless they fight. Wemmbu takes the 1v1. Theo gets annoyed by the creakings and he leaves the base with Kenadian. Theo tells Wemmbu that if he doesn't fight him outside the base he will kill Kenadian. Wemmbu leaves the base and asks Theo about Kenadian. Theo tells Wemmbu that he killed him and later tells him that he let him go. Wemmbu takes the fight and ends up winning the fight against Theo. Theo leaves, telling Wemmbu that it was worth it.

 Trivia 

 This video's original title was "I Created Minecraft's Most Secure Base" however, Wemmbu changed the title.
 Before seasons were abolished, this was the first episode of Season 2.
 The video's thumnail was updated sometime in April 2026, this is the fourth thumbnail where Wemmbu's cape can be shown.
 The new thumbnail further proves that Wemmbu was willing to settle down and give up PvPing if it weren't for Theo.

title: Unstable SMP: Civil War
content:
Unstable SMP: Civil War is the 133rd episode featured in Unstable Universe.                                                
 Plot 
Parrot starts the episode by telling the viewers that after he became King, the world split into two different sides. There are the new players who poured into the server and the old players who have been on the Unstable SMP for months or even years. Parrot believes that the old players are very mad that he and the new players are destroying what they created. So, they split off from his Kingdom and formed Cindercrest, who had the main goal of wiping Parrot and the new players from the server. Because of that, Parrot formed a massive army of his own to fight off Cindercrest. He stations his army in different major cities, and he believed that Cindercrest would attack Fort Feather first where his eastern gateway is. Parrot and his two friends TheobaldTheBird and ReinaDrop, along with their army stand ontop of the wall of Fort Feather to scout for Cindercrest. Parrot uses his spyglass and sees a bunch of Cindercrest's players on boats heading towards them. 

They see Saparata, the leader of Cindercrest who uses one of his player's as bait to set up the hidden mines in Fort Feather. Parrot tells his army to launch the TNT cannons, unfortunately for him one of the TNT cannons actually blows up members of his army. They continue to fight until they see a redstone blimp in the sky, Parrot knows that the blimp has Cindercrest players and tells his army to build up in the sky. Parrot and his army build up and see ShoeBilly in the sky who starts killing the players in the sky with a mace. The blimp continues to head closer to Fort Feather and Parrot realizes that the fight is already over. Parrot tells his army to get on horses and escape through a tunnel in a storage room. Parrot uses a TNT trap in the storage room and manages to kill a huge chunk of Cindercrest's players. He and his army use the tunnel and go to Merchant City. In the moment, Parrot realizes what he's actually going through, he saw that Cindercrest was far stronger and smarter than he thought. Since his army was made up of mostly new players, winning this civil war was way harder than he thought. Luckily, Fort Feather is only one of the cities inside of the kingdom, and if Cindercrest wanted to win the war, they'd have to keep moving deeper. Now that they had taken over Fort Feather, they gained access direct path to Merchant City, where the Merchant City Vanguard are already waiting. 

Parrot reaches the end of the tunnel and walks to the surface to regroup with whoever made it alive, as he tries to tell everyone the bad news, PrinceTetra stops him in his tracks and says they already heard the news of what happened at Fort Feather and threatens to blow up the entire place if Parrot tries anything. Parrot is confused and says they're apart of his army too, PrinceTetra asks Parrot to give them a reason to fight Cindercrest, otherwise they have no choice to kill him or turn him in. Parrot tells them if they don't fight Cindercrest, they're going to lose the war, but PrinceTetra puts him in a dilemma, he asks what makes him believe that they won't end up like the rest of his army that just died. Parrot goes quiet, Theo tries to convince Parrot to say anything, but nothing comes out of his mouth. PrinceTetra counts down from ten, Parrot speaks up after five seconds, he asks when it's ever going to end and that he doesn't expect everyone to survive the war, so he gives them all the chance to leave the war. He says if they don't beat Cindercrest, it won't ever end, and if Cindercrest wins, tens of thousands of new players are going to die, whoever else is left will live in a world where food is scarce, where people will die for no reason, which was how the server was like before Parrot, and he makes it clear that he became king to change that. Parrot says when he became king, he promised to protect everyone on the server, and so he asks the guards if they want to kill him, then to do it right then and there and that Cindercrest is already coming. The guards stand down and PrinceTetra asks what his plan is to defeat Cindercrest.

White flags are built across the top of the castle. Parrot, Theo, Reina, and a few guards stand on top and wait for Cindercrest to arrive. Theo notices that his donkey Dingus and Parrot's horse are being ridden, which excites him that they're going to get their horses back, but Reina says to calm down otherwise the whole plan fails. When Saps comes into distance, Parrot tells him that they surrender, Saps doesn't believe it whatsoever. FlameFrags believes otherwise and wants to barge right in, Saps says they will come in, but via their blimp. Although they probably thought Saps outsmarted them, they played right into Parrot's hands. If it looked like there was a trap under the gate, there wasn't, and them using the blimp was all apart of his plan. Parrot watches the blimp come closer and tells the vanguard to prepare for battle. He goes up to Theo and Reina and ask if the machine was ready, Theo says it is. Parrot then goes to explain that Cindercrest used their blimp to take over the fort while avoiding all their ground defenses, but in the time that they marched from Fort Feather to Merchant City, he ordered a new machine, which uses complicated redstone to counter the blimp strategy. Parrot keeps a watch on the blimp, he then shoots an arrow in the middle of the trapdoors of the machine and informs Reina of when to activate. He keeps watching the blimp until it's directly in the middle of the city, he tells Reina to get ready. Once the trapdoors open, he tells Reina to start it, sounds of TNT exploding starts to play, and the Cindercrest army that are falling down from the blimp start to die off. He then tasks Reina to let the vanguard into the inner area of Merchant City, Parrot tells them to target anyone in netherite. They push forward and attack when Cindercrest is weak, afterwards, Parrot looks at Saps from the top of the castle and watches as he and the rest of Cindercrest march away from the city. 

With the victory given to Parrot, he heads back to his castle with the vanguard. However, he knew it wouldn't be long until Cindercrest would attack again, or where they would go next or what strategies they would use. By the time they made it back, word had spread around the server, as Parrot and his army walk down the obsidian highway, players stand on the side of it and cheer for them. Just as they're about to walk into the Northern Council, Parrot hears TNT being set off and tells the vanguard to back off. Dozens of players get blown up, Parrot and Theo notices somebody trying to escape the scene, Reina mines to them and tells Theo not to kill them since they could interrogate the player. They take this player, soldier73, down to the prison. Parrot asks them where Cindercrest is headed next, but she doesnn't tell Parrot that. Parrot asks questions about any other leads, but she doesn't budge at all. Parrot then apologizes for what she's about to go through and tells Reina she can do whatever she wants to her. Reina starts to drown soldier73 down to half a heart, where she then says she'll talk. Reina asks where Cindercrest is headed towards, in which soldier73 says High Water City and that she was sent to kill Parrot. Reina walks out the cell and tells Parrot they should head out, as the entire council is waiting for him.

Parrot begins the meeting with all of the leaders of the cities inside of his kingdom, he has all of them introduce themselves and their positions of whatever city they lead. Right after, Parrot tells them Cindercrest has declared war on his kingdom and although they were beaten at Merchant City, he knows they're coming back, which is the reason why he brought them all there. Horace asks if Parrot knows where they're headed next, and Parrot says Highwater City, which makes sense since that city is responsible for 80% of the food source coming into the kingdom. If Cindercrest were to seize the entirety of the city and prevent all the food from coming, they would win this war. Parrot then tells 4CVIT to build a cannon in Highwater City, but 4C says he doesn't have time or resources to. He asks Fymada to tear down the railraods and automatic farms in Capitol City to build these machines, Fymada seems unsure about it since that was used to evacuate the towns, but Parrot says if they don't have another weapon to defeat them, there would be no place for anybody to evacuate to. 4C then asks theoretically if he were to get these materials, how quickly does Parrot expect him to build it, Parrot asks the question back, how quickly does he think he can build it? 4C says about eight hours, Parrot tells him to make it six and that he'll go fend off Cindercrest, he asks for CorporalPaul, the leader of The LAW for his help. 

Parrot explains if Cindercrest was really going for HIghwater City next, they'd be in huge trouble. After the events of Merchant City, Parrot knows they won't use the blimp again. If they wanted to defeat Cindercrest at Highwater, 4C would have to build the machine in time. Since then Parrot knew they were heading to Highwater City, he deduces the path that they would probably be taking to go to it in order to delay them.

Parrot sees the massive army headed towards his direction, he tells his team their plan is to delay them and to not take any fights they don't have to take. Parrot walks in the middle with Flame, Parrot says he's glad they're finally having this conversation between just the two of them. Parrot wanted to talk to him specifically, not because he's the strongest player in Cindercrest, but because they used to be friends who fought in wars together. Parrot doesn't understand why Flame joined and he asks him why he joined and if he even knows who they are. Flame says he does and knows there's a whole story behind it. Parrot goes on to say those same players were the same people who destroyed an entire civilization that he made, and if they beat him in the war, they're going to take over his kingdom and kill tens of thousands of new players who don't deserve to die. He tells Flame he doesn't understand why he'd join them and asks if it was a mixup, Flame says it's a long story and that Lomedy has his beliefs, Flame goes to bring Lomedy up to explain it himself. Parrot asks if Lomedy was the reason Flame joined Cindercrest, Lomedy says he is and that he's like everybody else in Cindercrest. Lomedy asks if Parrot even knows why he joined Cindercrest, he goes on to say Parrot becoming king is horrible, he lets people die from starvation and his kingdom is unsafe to the point where bandits killing people. He says it's hard to see as a farmer, Parrot tries to say he's been trying, but Flame interrupts and asks if it really is true that this is happening. Parrot says he's been trying his best, Lomedy says it's not enough and asks if he really cares about the server. Parrot asks would he be standing there if he didn't. Lomedy sees that he doesn't seem convinced, Flame says Parrot has a point and that he's been attacked by bandits within the kingdom too. Lomedy says he doesn't like to see people die, but he has no choice and that stopping Parrot is their best option. Parrot tells the two that he has a legion of hundreds of players, and that if they try to push forwards on the bridge instead of wrapping around the mountain, they won't hesitate to kill and to tell Saps that. 

Parrot goes back to his army, he doesn't see the the army of lawmen anywhere, which makes the total amount of their army lower than expected. Parrot reminds them the point of the battle is to not let them cross the bridge until the machine is fully built. The front group uses their bows as a wall of cobwebs is built. Theo hits Billy with slow falling and Parrot asks him to deal with Billy. A bunch of them get hunched up together and Theo manages to get tons of kills with his TNT minecarts. This causes Cindercrest to slow down, but with how little players Parrot has in his army, they were still losing ground. Theo gets tons more kills, but Parrot's army keeps falling and are forced to fall back. Cindercrest reaches the end of the bridge, but are still pushed back from Theo, just as they're about to make it through, LAW arrives with their army and serves as a distraction as Parrot and his friends head into the town. 

As they get closer to the city, they see one of the two machines almost fully built. By this point, all of Highwater City had been evacuated and Parrot stationed one of his legions there and with more reinforcements coming. It was clear the battle for Highwater City would be the most important one during this entire war. They climb the scaffolding up to the machine, Parrot asks how the progress is going and 4C says it'll be done in about thirty minutes. Parrot asks if it could speed up, but 4C says it's not possible with just the three people that are already working on it. Parrot asks if he, Theo, or Reina could help, but 4C says no and that the mayor of Highwater City wasn't there, Parrot says they'll keep holding back Cindercrest for the time being. The three of them stand in front of the river, Parrot gives them the rundown of his plan and believes Cindercrest would come from the direction that they came from and hopes 4C finishes the machine in time. Theo gets bored waiting and wanders off, more time passes and Reina asks Parrot if it's true what Lomedy said and asks isn't the server meant to be infinite? Parrot says it technically is, and Reina asks why people are starving in an infinite world, in which Parrot doesn't know. Reina says he tried making food farms, Parrot says the city they're about to defend should be able to supply most of his kingdom with food, but for some reason, there's never enough to go around and he can't figure out the reason. Reina asks about the bandits, Parrot says he tried his best, but they come back stronger each time. Parrot asks Reina what she's going to do after defeating Cindercrest, and Reina says she's going to quit the server. Parrot is surprised that she's going to leave the server after working so hard to defeating Cindercrest, she asks what there is to do on the server and Parrot says there's so many places to go, builds to see, people to meet, and asks if she's interested in doing any of those things, and Reina seems unsure about it. A flashback plays with Reina and Zoe where Zoe gives Reina a white flower and a promise that they'll both survive. Parrot tells her to think about it and that him and Theo have been on the server for so long, he asks Theo to back him up, but Theo's too distracted doing a triple neo jump and forgets the question.

Parrot hears the horn being blown, which indicates that Cindercrest is here. Parrot has a small pep talk, he says this is going to be the most decisive battle of the entire war, Cindercrest is going to do everything they can to take over the city, which might mean they're going to take over the entire kingdom. Parrot tells Theo to resume his position on top of the artillery cannon, he then tells Reina he's going to delay as much as possible and when he tolds both of his totems out, that's her signal to fire. He wishes them luck, Reina looks back and sees a white flower on the ground, the same one Zoe gave her and picks it up. 

Cindercrest comes closer to him, Parrot tells Saps before he invades the city, he wants to have a conversation with him. Parrot has them in the perfect position and needs to wait it out until nighttime for 4C to finish the machine. Parrot says he knows what he's trying to do, he thinks Saps is trying to invade the city and cut off the food supply that he can starve his entire kingdom and win the war. He asks Saps if it was really necessary, Saps asks him for a good reason not to, Parrot asks if he knows how many people are going to starve to death and how many innocent players are going to die and he doesn't care if he's an old player, that doesn't give him a right to kill new players. Saps asks if he knows how many people have already suffered and this is one step of making sure this won't happen again. Parrot tells Flame he doesn't have to do this, but Flame says over time, his opinion of Parrot changed. Saps gives him the chance to surrender and give up king to make things right, Parrot says they were so close to making sure there were no more bandits or anybody starving before Cindercrest invaded. Parrot says they can turn back now, Saps said it's all his fault, after he opened up spawn, there hadn't been enough food to go around for all the players. Saps says he was apart of Capitol City with his friends, but after Parrot opened it up, there wasn't enough food to go around and forced to leave Capitol City to build their own food farm. Although they settled down with their own food farms, but Saps and his friends didn't have the protection of Capitol City, which caused bandits to attack them and have all of Saps' friends die. He says Parrot ruined the server with the decision of letting players in and that's why he's going to take it back and reminds Parrot that he vowed to protect all of them. Parrot says he's not the first person to say that to him and apologizes, he gives them one last chance to turn back. Saps asks Parrot one question, who is he going to save; the new players or the old ones. Parrot says one day, the players in his kingdom won't have to fight to survive, one day, his kingdom will be big enough for anyone to live in. Parrot says he needed enough time to stop all of these problems, but Saps says it's already too late, he says what makes him weak is that people are starving and dying to bandits and only wants Parrot to close off spawn. He then tells Parrot that he can't bring himself to watch his people die and that he can't even bring himself to kill Saps himself. Just as he says that, Parrot pulls out his other totem, arrows instantly shoot his direction and kill off 70% of the Cindercrest army, Saps is forced to retreat back down to water. 

With the arrow cannon, Cindercrest couldn't get close to the city. While they waited around thinking of what to do, the reinforcements Parrot called for went to their location to wipe them out. He knew that Saps was going to tell Billy to destroy the cannon, which happened just as expected. Parrot tells Theo to fire the cannon, he watches arrows follow Billy from behind, which causes Billy to retreat. With the two arrow cannons, Cindercrest couldn't fight on air or land, and with no time left, it wouldn't be long before Parrot's reinforcements got to them. With Cindercrest being down to their last sixty players, this was going to be the end of the war. Parrot sees they're going for a fullscale invasion and tells Reina to start shooting. Parrot watches from a top of a building and wonders what their plan is as he watches Cindercrest dies. In the distance, Flame went invis and snuck down to the artillery cannon to blow it up, Billy was also to fly up to the arrow cannon and destroyed that as well. Parrot says they killed off most of Cindercrest and were probably able to fight the rest off. He towers up on a booth and sees Saps blowing the horn, Saps looks back, but says nothing to him. Parrot runs around the city aimlessly, he spots two people flying into the vicinity, he uses his spyglass and is in disbelief when he sees Wemmbu flying towards the city. He warns everyone there that an orbital strike cannon is about the hit and to get down. Parrot has his army retreat, he gets Reina, and tries to get Theo, but Theo believes the fight is still winnable. Parrot tells him they lost Highwater City due to Wemmbu being there, Theo mentions that arachn1d_ is there too, which rubs salt in the wound for Parrot. As Parrot is trying to escape, Yungyx tasks Wemmbu to kill Parrot. Parrot runs out of the city with Reina and Theo following him, Parrot says they have to go, but Theo thinks they could still try, Parrot reminds him that they have three Elytra-macers on their team and Flame, there was no way for them to win this battle. As they sail away, Parrot realizes that Saps sacrificed the rest of his army to serve as a distraction for Flame. Theo asks what they do now, but Parrot has no idea anymore.

In the final scene, Saps stands above everyone remaining over at Highwater City, he tells them if anyone joined the server before Parrot and put that crown on his head, that Saps is not their enemy, but rather Parrot. He asks them if they remember what the server used to be, when Capitol City had enough food, when farms fed the farmers, when every house, every road meant something because they made it. He says Parrot opened spawn and called it mercy, called it saving people, Saps says it actually invited thousands of starving players into a kingdom that could barely feed its own people. When there was nothing left for the old players, he told them to be patient. Now that they had control over Highwater City, they cut off all the food supply coming into Parrot's kingdom, which would force the players inside to either starve or surrender. Before they march into the kingdom, Saps has an announcement to all the players of the server, if they joined the server before Parrot became king, they may join Cindercrest. When Cindercrest takes over the server, those who join them will be spared, and anyone else will be killed. He says this battle marks the beginning of the end of Parrot's reign, where he wanted a world big enough for everyone, but Saps is building one big enough for the people who deserve it.
