'''Unstable SMP: The First War''' is the 24th episode featured in [[Unstable Universe]]. 

== Plot ==
The video begins in [[The Invisible Mafia|The Mafia]] invading most of the [[Farmers District]] and killing most of it's members.

Horace splits the civilization into 3 factions. The [[Farmers District]], the [[Warriors District]] and the [[Builders District]]. The Farmers supplies everyone with resources, the Warriors are the fighters and the Builders are the humble ones. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] wants to become a warrior because he wants to avenge [[LuigiToan]]. To determine Parrot's faction he has to go through a test. How the test works is that you have to use ~5 items to kill a wither. Parrot uses chickens, an instant damage potion, a wind charging potion and a mace. After completing the test, [[Horace Altman|Horace]] tells Parrot that a warrior would usually kill the wither normally, a builder would wait until it's gone and a farmer would trap it or use some strategy but Parrot didn't do any of that which shocked him. Horace and [[CoinMonke]] tell Parrot that he is both but he also tells him that there's a conflict between the Warriors and Farmers, therefore he won't make a fourth faction for Parrot because the Warriors and Farmers wouldn't like that. Parrot chooses to join the Warriors.

Parrot talks to two of the council members, [[Lamibee]] and [[Dimofyy]] about The Mafia but they tell him that he has to go on his first mission in half an hour. Parrot flies next to the statue which is where he meets [[TheobaldTheBird]]. Theo tells Parrot that he regrets joining the Warriors because he was on a mission where he had to collect resources even though that's the Farmers' job. Parrot asks Theo if he joined the Warriors to fight The Mafia but to his surprise, Theo doesn't know what the Mafia is. Parrot asks Theo why he even joined in the first place if he isn't fighting The Mafia. Theo tells him it's to prove that he's the best. 

Dimofyy announces to his squad that they are going to destroy one of The Mafia's outposts and loot anything valuable. As they enter the outpost they spot 2 invisible players. They jump the invisible players but they flee. Dimofyy gets disappointed at them and tells them that they have to train more. Parrot asks if he has TNT and Dimofyy pulls out a shulker full of TNT. They blow up the outpost and Parrot notices an obsidian tunnel. As they walk through the tunnel, the lights inside turn off and they get mining fatigue. They see a [[FlameFrags|diamond player]] who jumps them and the diamond player who is revealed to be [[FlameFrags|Flamefrags]] (death message), kills Dimofyy. Parrot lights a portal and they escape through the nether. [[Lezy]] finds Parrot and tells him that everyone wanted Dimofyy to die because he was annoying and thought so highly of himself.

Parrot and the rest of the squad head back to the Far Lands city to talk to the [[Warriors Council]] about Dimofyy's death and how they managed to escape. The leader [[Purpled]] starts calling Parrot a farmer for escaping the way a farmer would. Purpled makes an announcement that Dimofyy is dead so he will be opening a new spot in the council. He tells everyone that if they want to become a council, they have to pop his totem in a 1v1 and he will duel them in 30 minutes. Parrot is the only person who arrives within 30 minutes so Purpled gives him the shield until Theo enters. Parrot removes his shield as he now has to duel Purpled to get it. Before Parrot duels Purpled, [[Naparizel]] explains the rules to him. Parrot loses the duel and Theo steps in and wins the duel using TNT minecarts therefore earning a spot in the Warriors Council. 

Parrot starts checking the city out until [[Wifies]] appears out of nowhere. Parrot walks away but Wifies follows him because he wants to apologize to Parrot. Parrot tells Wifies that he doesn't want to talk to him and he flies away to go for another mission. Theo and his squad fly to [[Zam Empire]] to set up mines to disrupt whatever they are planning. They head to a different location since there's no activity where they were currently at until they get jumped by a few Mafia members. Theo kills all of the Mafia members that were jumping them and they continue building mines. Purpled gets impressed by Theo killing 11 Mafia members. Theo tells Purpled that there's no point in sending them on random missions because they could end The Mafia if they actually tried to kill them instead of putting members on pointless missions. Parrot agrees with Theo and Purpled decides to put them on a harder mission and he also warns them that the last time people were put on this mission all 4 members died. 

Parrot decides to check out the Farming District and sees a familiar face. [[Kenadian]]. Kenadian tells him that he's the leader of the Farming District and also assumes that Parrot wants to join the Farmers because of Wifies also being part of the Farming District. Parrot tells Kenadian that he's in the warriors already and asks why the place looks abandoned. Kenadian doesn't want to tell Parrot why because he's a Warrior. Parrot tells Kenadian that he's both a Warrior and a Farmer and Kenadian sends him to the Farmer's council room. Kenadian, [[Wato1876|Wato]] and Wifies discuss about Parrot being both a Warrior and a Farmer. Kenadian tells Parrot that after he left Parrot's [[The End Civilization|End Civilization]], he joined Horace's Far Lands civilization and became the first farmer. He explains that the Warriors were supposed to protect the Farmers and the Farmers are supposed to provide them resources to protect them and he built the Farming District several million blocks away from the farlands and he thought the Warriors would help protect them, however Kenadian had 3 days notice that The Mafia is about to attack them. He tried to contact the Warriors but none of them responded and The Mafia destroyed the Farming District and killed about 70-80% of the Farming District. After this, they stopped giving them resources.

Parrot tells them that they have to put it aside and that he will try to fix everything. All 3 of the Farmers don't believe Parrot and he gets pissed when Wifies starts talking and he claims that Wifies is only in the Far Lands to sabotage Parrot. Wifies denies that statement and tells him that if he was trying to sabotage him he would be doing that. Parrot states that the war is unwinnable if they don't put their differences aside.

The Warriors play a game of capture the flag to train. Parrot doesn't have a team so he teams up with all the farmers including Wifies. Since the teams were outnumbered [[meta64]] joins Parrot's team. They place their banner/flag behind a tree and put bone meal on grass so it's not that easy to find. They then light a portal to the nether and splash each other with invisibility. After returning to the overworld they burn the forest to distract the Warriors while Parrot uses a chicken blaster made by Wifies. He splashes himself with invisibility and slow falling and launches himself using the chicken blasters and he steals the Warriors' flag and places it next to their flag and wins. The Warriors get embarrassed by how they lost.

Wifies apologizes to Parrot again and tells Parrot that he wants to help him. Parrot tells Wifies that he wants to be a part of the Warriors council but in order to do that he has to beat one of the members in a 1v1 but since he believes there are no strategies he doesn't know how he could win and also tells him that he's going on a mission and the last time a squad went on this mission, they didn't make it out alive. Wifies tries to provide Parrot with help but Parrot denies it and walks away. After a few days of practicing archery to use debuff arrows against The Mafia, he asks Wifies for help for using static targets. Wifies suggests doing a mini bow duel with the debuffs. Parrot loses at first but after a few rounds he finally wins a round against Wifies. He starts consistently winning every bow duel against Wifies. After this, Parrot practices switching arrows and targets with Wifies. The final phase of practicing is another duel where Wifies uses melee to attack Parrot while Parrot uses only a bow and the arrows. Parrot wins the duel. 

Parrot and Wifies have a conversation about fighting in the war. Wifies tells Parrot that if he's going to fight in the war, he will too. Wifies also gives Parrot back his spyglass that he dropped in their argument during their journey to the Far Lands as a promise that Parrot won't die. Parrot wonders what [[Deanthebean9|Dean]] is into and he considers checking up on him to say goodbye. Parrot goes back to the jungle where he last saw Dean. He notices a trail of netherrack and he follows the trail which leads to a dark oak forest with a shack. Parrot calls out Dean and he responds. He finds Dean fishing. Dean tells Parrot that he made the trail so that someone could find him. Parrot tells Dean about the mission he's about to go to and says goodbye to him just in case he doesn't make it out alive. Dean gives Parrot a tour of his house and also blows the goat horn again because he doesn't care about The Mafia finding him. Dean asks Parrot if he can come with him but Parrot tells Dean that he wont because he doesn't trust him. Dean apologizes and tells Parrot he will do anything to get him to trust him again. Parrot tells Dean to stay until he wins the war. Dean asks Parrot if he could tell him when he finally trusts him again. Parrot tells Dean he will and returns to the Far Lands.

Theo leads all of them to [[Mafia City]]. His plan was to take out a diamond player after going up through all their stages. They search all the diamond players' castles but they don't see anyone. They continue exploring until Parrot notices a diamond player. The diamond player tries to kill the entire squad. Theo tells all of them to leave him with the diamond player however, a gold player and another diamond player tries to kill them. Parrot uses the debuff arrows against the diamond player that he practiced with Wifies. The diamond player pops Parrot's totem multiple times. Theo and the squad retreat. As they leave Mafia City the diamond players follow them. Parrot tells them to go back to Mafia City while being invisible to disguise as a no-trimmed member and the diamond players will lose them. They all proceed in doing so and they lose the diamond player. After reuniting with Theo, they return to the Far Lands. Purpled gets disappointed when he finds out they didn't kill the diamond player but he gives them all diamond silence trimmed boots. Theo explains that if it weren't for Parrot they would've all died. Parrot tells Purpled that they have to fight against The Mafia strategically if they want to win. Purpled tells Parrot that he makes the decisions along with the rest of the council. Parrot says he wants to join the council. Purpled tells him that he has to 1v1 a council member. Parrot chooses [[DumbIsDumb]]. Purpled tells him that Dumb is one of if not the most skilled fighter in the Warriors Council. Parrot changes his mind but it's already too late.

Parrot returns to the Farming District to ask Wifies for help again. Parrot explains to Wifies what happened and why he needs Wifies' help. Parrot suggest they make something above them since they normally wouldn't look above them. They head above the colosseum where they build an ice platform. They finish building the ice platform and Wifies tells Parrot he will break the ice from above while he's fighting Dumb. The fight begins and Parrot tells Wifies to break the ice now that they're fighting. As the water starts flooding the arena, Parrot uses it to his advantage, he uses his tridents to hit Dumb while he's completely unprepared. Parrot breaks Dumb's helmet and later breaks his boots. Parrot pops Dumb's totem and Dumb gives his shield. Parrot shows the council shield to Wifies.

Parrot's first council meeting begins. Parrot begins talking about how the missions are pointless and they have to actually do something impactful against The Mafia. Purpled tells Parrot that he doesn't think they can defeat The Mafia due to the fact that The Mafia outnumbers them, so he's putting members of the Warriors on little missions to give them false hope. Theo agrees with Parrot saying that they need to do something that will actually impact The Mafia. Parrot suggests that they unite all the factions. Purpled disagrees because he doesn't want anything to do with the farmers. The argument continues until Purpled walks away. Upon returning, Purpled tells them that a builder was spotted by a Mafia member and they have to deal with the Mafia member. Purpled tells Parrot to get people since he doesn't have a squad so Parrot makes a squad with the Farmers. They head to the nether roof and split up to find the Mafia member.

They eventually find the Mafia member and it appears to be a [[Z4YA|gold trimmed player]]. They jump the gold trimmed player but the gold trimmed player escapes using chorus fruit. Kenadian provides them with chorus fruit and they eat it to leave the nether roof, however by that point the gold player has been long gone. Parrot suggests they go to Mafia City because that's where the gold player could be heading, disguise as diamond players and try to catch him. Upon arriving close to Mafia City, Parrot mines a lot of trees to make signa because Mafia members communicate using signs. Kenadian pulls up spare eye trim smithing templates he possibly obtained before The Mafia began taking over the server. Parrot poses as a diamond player and looks for the gold player. 

Parrot finds the gold player and tries to convince him that he can give [[Ashswagg|Ash]] the message. Since the gold player doesn't trust him enough he ignores Parrot and walks away. Parrot chases him and tells him to unmute himself. The gold player gets suspicious because the voice sounds familiar but Parrot convinces him otherwise. He convinces him that it's not worth giving Ash the coordinates and he's not going to rank up. Parrot tells him that he's a bit jealous about him finding the Far Lands civilization. Parrot tells him that he will join the squadron of diamond players. The gold player is convinced and Parrot tells the squadron to make a trap. Upon arrival, the gold player is suspicious again. The squadron of farmers start praising him and act impressed. The gold player asks him why he hasn't seen their faces but he has heard their voices. Parrot reveals himself and Kenadian activates the trap, killing him in the process.

Purpled gives Parrot silence trimmed leggings for killing the gold player. Parrot tells Purpled that the farmers were the reason why he was able to kill the gold player. Purpled thought he was going to get a squadron of warriors. Purpled explains that it's the warriors job to protect the civilization which in response, Parrot brings up the Warriors abandoning the farmers while they were being attacked. Purpled says it isn't his problem. Theo suggests that they unite the Farmers and the Warriors again. Parrot tells Purpled that they should apologize to the Farmers. Purpled and [[Naparizel]] tell Parrot that he has to become a leader if he wants to make decisions. Parrot and Theo continue arguing with Purpled until the meeting is dismissed.

Theo talks to Parrot about the meeting and tells him Purpled sees him as a threat. Theo then tells Parrot that he's exactly what the Warriors need leadership-wise. Parrot tells Theo how much he cares about winning the war against The Mafia. Theo wonders how the Farmers are so drawn to Parrot but hate the rest of the Warriors. Parrot tells Theo that when his test results came, Horace said he was both a Warrior and a Farmer. They continue to discuss about the beef with the warriors and the farmers. Theo tells Parrot that maybe the reason why the council hates Parrot is because he has something that they don't and since Parrot arrived things have changed. Theo leaves after the conversation. 

Parrot visits Dean again. Dean notices Parrot's armour trims. Parrot tells him that it's from the Far Lands and Dean gets a bit jealous about it. Dean tells Parrot about what he's been up to the whole time. Parrot asks if everything has been good and Dean says that everything has been good so Parrot decides to leave but Dean asks if he could go with Parrot again. Parrot asks him what he would be able to do if he did go with him. Dean wants Parrot to trust him. Parrot tells Dean he will trust him after the war. Dean responds saying "What if you don't? What if you just die and I'm stuck here and nobody "will ever trust me again?". He also states that Wifies might die too.  He tells Parrot that Ash was the person who took him when he had nothing and he thought he could have friends. Parrot responds by saying that The Mafia isn't a sense of community. Dean didn't know that at the time. They just told him that he would have all the freedom he could've ever wanted if he joined. He then states that the war is not winnable. He's seen it all while Parrot has just seen a fraction of it and Parrot is going to die in the war and he will be alone. Parrot asks Dean why did he betray him if he cared so much about the war and tells him that everything will be fixed after the war before leaving. 

Purpled starts another council meeting. Parrot asks if Purpled could come up with a war strategy since it's been just mission after mission. Parrot asks what the point of the Warriors faction existing if they aren't coming up with strategies to beat The Mafia. They begin arguing again but Purpled admits that the missions they have been doing was just to give everyone false hope. Purpled dismisses everyone except for Parrot and he tells Parrot to deliver a bunch of things to a set of coordinates. He gets Parrot to clear his inventory and fill it up with shulkers. Parrot enters an obsidian hole which leads to a tunnel and as he places all the shulkers he gets jumped by all the council members. Theo arrives trying and helps Parrot. Parrot barely manages to escape. 

After Parrot and Theo return to the Far Lands they confront Purpled and Theo tries to kill him Purpled continues talking as if nothing happened. Parrot asks Purpled why he tried to kill him and Purpled says that it's because Parrot is trying to drag the into war. Purpled tells Parrot that he's the one tearing them apart. Naparizel and [[Lamibee]] agree with Parrot this time Parrot decides to do a poll on who should become leader of the Warriors faction. Everyone votes for Parrot and Purpled gives him the armour. Parrot is now the leader of the Warriors. Parrot does a speech. During the speech he destroys all the silence trimmed armour and tells everyone to replace any silence armour trim with their normal armour because he believes that the way Purpled used to run the Warriors faction was corrupt and they gave everyone false hope and he tells everyone that unity is stronger than hope. The warriors including Parrot apologize to the Farmers for abandoning them. The Farmers accept their apology. Parrot states that the true enemy is Ash and The Mafia and tells the Warriors to destroy anything important to The Mafia and what keeps them invisible and he would join the Farmers for their mission. Parrot concludes the speech by stating that a new era is born. An era of trust, unity, hope and forgiveness. Parrot keeps the word forgiveness in his mind as he is about to visit Dean again. 

Parrot goes for another visit with Dean but he notices that Dean is missing. He doesn't see any traces of him anywhere. Parrot tells Wifies that Dean wasn't present. Parrot and Wifies talk to the rest of the Farmers to go to the mission that Parrot mentioned in the speech to destroy all the Mafia A1C bombers. They head near [[Spawn]] and find a lot of A1C bombers. They begin destroying the A1C bombers but however while doing so they see them starting. They try to disable them but they get jumped by Mafia members. Parrot follows a Mafia member but they just fly away. Parrot and Wifies continue fighting the invisible players while Kenadian and [[Wato1876|Wato]] destroy the A1C bombers. Parrot tells them that he will drop an invisible player. The invisible player is shooting it's own teammates and Parrot decides to drop him. The invisible player's totem pops and it's revealed to be Dean. Dean blows his goat horn one last time before getting killed in the void. Parrot gets furious and tries to kill one of the Mafia members until the diamond player shows up and starts macing him. After flying away to an island they talk about what happened however Parrot isn't in the mood after witnessing his friend die. Parrot realizes that he was shooting the other Mafia members because that was his way of trying to earn their trust back.

Parrot goes back to Dean's shack to bury Dean. After writing the sign in the gravestone he says "I trust you". Ash interrupts the funeral and starts mocking Dean, comparing his life to a cockroach saying that he was pointless. Ash states that he knew Dean was going to betray him when he rejoined The Mafia and he also put Dean on that mission intentionally so that Parrot could kill him. Parrot gets furious and threatens to kill Ash. Ash tells him that he kidnapped the entire Warriors faction and will execute them. Parrot tries to kill Ash but he teleports away using a stasis chamber. 

Upon returning to the Far Lands civilization, Parrot tells the Farmers about the Warriors getting kidnapped. They come up with a plan to break in to one of Ash's prisons. It turns out that it's located in The End Civilization before going to the end, they all set stasis chambers. As they arrive to The End Civilization, Parrot notices the city was retextured into a Mafia theme (possibly the reason why they didn't blow it up). As they sneak through the entire city, they break into the cell where the Warriors are held hostage. The Farmers place an ender chest to provide the Warriors with gear. As they break out of the cell, they notice the chunk bans being reactivated. Parrot tells [[Cristalit]] to try to fly out of the civilization to test if the chunk bans are active and he gets chunk banned. They get caught by diamond players. Parrot tells the Warriors to distract the diamond players while the Farmers, including Parrot build a chicken blaster pearl cannon. After finishing building the chicken blaster pearl cannon, Parrot tells the Warriors to throw a pearl while the Farmers distract the diamond players. A diamond player catches them so Parrot activates the cannon, teleporting all of them away from the city. Parrot tells the rest of the farmers to activate their stasises and tells Wifies not to pull his because he has to talk to Ash. 

Parrot tells the diamond players to take him to Ash. He even clears his entire inventory. As they take him to Ash's castle Parrot tells Ash that he's lucky he didn't bring a sword. Ash tells Parrot that if he dies, the entire Mafia goes down with him. Parrot tells Ash that he wonders how he can get people to listen to him. Ash shows him around the castle but gets interrupted by Parrot reminding him about [[I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City|when he said that fear is control]] to tell him that the opposite of fear is unity. He tells Ash that he wants to duel him but Ash clowns on him and continues showing him around the castle. Parrot notices the dragon egg and a desire board. He notices the farming district isn't red on the desire board. Ash asks Parrot if he has ever stopped to ask himself why The Mafia always wears invisibility and tells him that it's a symbol and it's part of something bigger and compares that to how the farming district is part of the Far Lands. Ash tells Parrot that he knows where the Far Lands civilization is and he is sending battalions of 2 diamond players each and he tells Parrot the exact coordinates of the Far Lands. Parrot pulls his stasis and looks over the Far Lands civilization.

title: Unstable SMP: The Great Farm War
content:
Unstable SMP: The Farm War is the 61st episode featured in Unstable Universe. 

 Plot 
Lomedy asks Flame for help fighting a war, but it turns out to be all over crops. Flame thinks it's nonsense, but Lomedy shows a horse with maxed out attributes as a reward, so Flame agrees to help outfarm Spongs and Willsion, Lomedy's rivals. Lomedy explains the rules of being a farmer to Flame, which is to wear leather armor and not to use weapons, so Flame sets traps all across Lomedy's farm to kill them. When nighttime comes, Spongs and his group of farmers come and rob the farm. Two robbers die to traps, Spongs and Willsion chase Flame around the farm to try and kill him seeing that he's in full leather. Spongs and Willsion leave after destroying the farm enough, Flame and Lomedy clean up the farm and head to a farmer's trading town after. They get to the trading town and Flame asks to trade with one of the players, but they're afraid of Flame because of his reputation. Lomedy takes over and gives the player crops, the player looks at Flame afraid and Flame raises his voice at them and drops all the enchanted books.

When they get back to the farm, they see Spongs trashing it. Flame confronts Spongs, but Spongs laughs at him for following the farmer's rules of no weapons and that he can't do anything, and Flame proves them wrong by killing Spongs' team of farmers with just strength and a hoe. Flame beats Spongs and Willsion nearly to death and they flee. Flame wants payback on Spongs and Willsion for destroying their farm for the third time, so they head over to their farm and robs them of their crops. They spot Lomedy and Flame, and they hide inside one of the buildings, Flame and Lomedy then plan to steal their camel and sniffer egg, Flame gets the sniffer egg and Lomedy is already on the Happy Ghast with the camel attached ready to go. Spongs and Willsion are on the ground and will keep chasing them, so Flame goes down to distract while Lomedy finds a safe place to hide the animals. Flame finds Lomedy on top of a mountain and they continously knock Spongs and his team off, Flame leaves once he sees Lomedy has left as well. They meet back up in jungle and stumble across an abandoned jungle village, they loot the village for anything valuable for Lomedy's farm. Lomedy finds a small hole underneath one of the houses, and they go down, which turns out to be a huge maze with ravagers inside. They get to the end of the maze and find a Netherite hoe, with the hoe, a camel, and sniffer egg, they've became richer than the usual farmer. Flame and Lomedy go back to their farm and dance to Lava Chicken and clean their farm up, Flame goes in their house and falls into a fall trap and manages to pearl clutch and glitch into a block, saving his life. Spongs and Willsion blow the farm up again and Flame doesn't know what to do other than killing them to, they taunt and laugh at Lomedy for not being able to protect his own farm, leaving him with no more crops or animals, they leave. 

Lomedy is upset that Flame dragged him into this by using violence and that everything could've been prevented if they gave Spongs and Willsion what they wanted. Lomedy is about to give up farming entirely and give all his stuff up, but Flame tells him to stay and farm with him one last time, and they repair the farm and make it look better than it was originally. After helping Lomedy, Flame is about to head off and deal with Spongs and Willsion himself to get his pets back, but Lomedy decides to help him out and sets up TNT dupers that faced Spongs and Willsion's farm. Flame finds his dog and the horse in the farm and places them somewhere safe and blows the horn, signaling to Lomedy to activate the TNT dupers. Flame reveals himself and walks around not doing anything. He tells them that he will never be farmer, but he's better at taking things one step further than them and tells them to look around. The TNT dupers are in range and start destroying every single bit of their farm, Flame doesn't kill Spongs or Willsion, and would rather keep them alive and have them live with their destroyed farms knowing they won't ever be the greatest farmers of Unstable. Willsion gives up all his items after losing everything and Spongs gives up being a farmer and head off in different directions. Without Spongs and Willsion in Lomedy's way, he can become the best farmer, and as promised, he gives Flame the horse as a thank you for helping him.

Spongs and Willsion blow the farm up again and Flame doesn't know what to do other than killing them to, they taunt and laugh at Lomedy for not being able to protect his own farm, leaving him with no more crops or animals, they leave. 

Lomedy is upset that Flame dragged him into this by using violence and that everything could've been prevented if they gave Spongs and Willsion what they wanted. Lomedy is about to give up farming entirely and give all his stuff up, but Flame tells him to stay and farm with him one last time, and they repair the farm and make it look better than it was originally. After helping Lomedy, Flame is about to head off and deal with Spongs and Willsion himself to get his pets back, but Lomedy decides to help him out and sets up TNT dupers that faced Spongs and Willsion's farm. Flame finds his dog and the horse in the farm and places them somewhere safe and blows the horn, signaling to Lomedy to activate the TNT dupers. Flame reveals himself and walks around not doing anything. He tells them that he will never be farmer, but he's better at taking things one step further than them and tells them to look around. The TNT dupers are in range and start destroying every single bit of their farm, Flame doesn't kill Spongs or Willsion, and would rather keep them alive and have them live with their destroyed farms knowing they won't ever be the greatest farmers of Unstable. Willsion gives up all his items after losing everything and Spongs gives up being a farmer and head off in different directions. Without Spongs and Willsion in Lomedy's way, he can become the best farmer, and as promised, he gives Flame the horse as a thank you for helping him.

title: Unstable SMP: The LAW
content:
Unstable SMP: The LAW is the 114th episode featured in Unstable Universe. This marks the end of Wemmbu's perspective of The Kings Arc.

 Plot 
The episode starts off with the events of the previous episode, LettuceK threatens Wemmbu that if he ever crosses him or The Law again, he would ban Jaden off of the server. Wemmbu thinks about shooting a stab shot directly at Lettuce, instead he flies away. He meets up back with eggchan at an old base they built underground and he catches egg up with whats been happening. Wemmbu spots invis particles in their enchantment table and blocks it off and threatens to blow them up unless they reveal their identity. Egg says they've been chill and the person drinks milk, revealing to be JumperWho. She explains that she's friends with Jaden and that Lettuce is going to execute him no matter what. She tasks Wemmbu to free him from the prison before Lettuce does so. Wemmbu agrees to do so and tells egg to meet him at FlameFrags' base while he nukes the prison. Wemmbu flies over to Flame's base and sees Flame readying up for something, the both of them have the same goal in common, which is to break a friend out of prison, and so they team up to kill all the lawmen over at Law HQ.

They head over to the Law HQ and a fight breaks out, SargeLAW commands the guards and team kills most of the lawmen with his minecarts rather than doing damage to either Flame or Wemmbu. The two kill off every guard except SargeLAW. Wemmbu picks up a dead lawman's netherite armor and caused mass destruction on the entire place. Wemmbu tells Flame where Lomedy is located while he sits up top and keeps an eye out for more guards. He goes up a floor of the building he's in to Lettuce's office and takes a peek at a book sitting on the lectern, it's Lettuce's old book where he talks about being a side character in an unstable universe and wishes to have control of his own life, having been written all the way back in the Sky Civilization days. He takes the book and hears a lawman spying on him underneath and kills them, he sits on top of a roof until he hears the Law's horn, more lawmen barge into the HQ as well as Lettuce. Wemmbu immediately starts stab shotting the lawmen and Lettuce asks what Wemmbu is doing, Wemmbu says he's a bystander and that he's only fighting back because it's self defense. He then shifts his focus on killing lawmen, but once his totem pops, he quickly flies out of the base and Lettuce chases him. Wemmbu says he had no choice in coming over because Lettuce was going to kill Jaden no matter what and asks what he's ever done to Lettuce to deserve everything. Lettuce says Wemmbu has killed his friends and destroyed every civilization that he joined and Wemmbu joined after. Lettuce says he's not a hero, but he needs to do what needs to be done. Wemmbu says he's trying to bring order to a server where it doesn't belong, Lettuce says he's going to prove everyone wrong and pulls the fishing rod, but a death message with Jaden's name doesn't show up. Seconds later, Jaden, Spoke, Jumper, and PrinceZam come to them and attempts to kill Lettuce. Another wave of guards come to assist Lettuce, but it's not enough. Lettuce flies away from the fight, Wemmbu tries to follow, but runs out of rockets and tries to do the infinite fly method, but it's too slow to continue the chase. He goes back to the group and Spoke explains the plan on finding Parrot and he brings them all to his Amplified castle.

They get to the castle where Mapicc and MinuteTech are already there, Spoke gathers them all up and tells them the overall plan, one of Jumper's invisible spies comes and gives her a book, which tells them all information saying that The Law has lawmen coming to a remote location the opposite direction of where spawn is located and it may be where Parrot is. Wemmbu agrees to help Parrot, as soon as Jumper gives the coordinates out, Wemmbu immediately flies over to the island. By the time he lands, Spoke is already there before him. The group of lawmen that Jumper's spy was talking about starts to arrive, Wemmbu sets off an orbital and Spoke tells Wemmbu to start fighting, but Wemmbu gets stubborn and decides not to help fight. It's only until Flame pulls up when Wemmbu starts to help fight. During the aftermath, Parrot and Theo continue looting the island and get it all attached to a happy ghast. Wemmbu flies back to the castle with his Elytra while the others are still on their way back. Once everyone else is back, Parrot says that he revamped his old District 13 base to hold his army and they should converge into one. Flame pulls Wemmbu aside and says egg may have gone to Flame's old base over at spawn. Wemmbu goes to the old base and finds egg in front of the base, egg says he's ready to fight, but Wemmbu says he already broke Jaden out of jail and everything, they then head off to the District 13 base. 

Wemmbu breaks the redstone door attempting to enter District 13, Parrot starts his speech when Wemmbu gets there, mentioning how The Law has affected all of them in a way and that today is the day they destroy The Law. All of them march into Northern Council, frames begin dropping the closer they get to the middle. When they arrive, Wemmbu holds back the group and gives Parrot time to talk to Lettuce first. He then flies up to get a better view, and once Parrot is done with his talk, Wemmbu sets off three orbitals and kills hundreds of lawmen in seconds. The first battle starts, but also ends relatively quickly, and so they go up to where the palace is and sees Lettuce and his commanders. They all confront Lettuce and calls him a coward, but Lettuce tells them to look behind and all his netherite guards come out from behind the watchpoint towers, commencing the second battle. Throughout this battle, Wemmbu blows up a majority of the Northern Council and kills some lawmen along the way. With Lettuce being the only one left, everyone focuses on him and breaks all of his armor, Lettuce flies away once more and Wemmbu pursues him, but runs out of rockets mid-chase. He gets wind charges from his ender chest and tries to continue chasing, Minute tries to continue chasing after him, but comes back to Wemmbu and says Lettuce had an escape route ready. On their way back, Minute says it's not bad that Lettuce was able to get away and that the server sees him for who he actually is and that he has to live knowing the mistakes that he's made. 

The two make it back to the Northern Council and give the news of Lettuce escaping, all of them sound exhausted after fighting for hours on end. Flame starts to kill Jaden to get Lomedy's mace back, Wemmbu jumps in to defend Jaden. In the middle of the fight, Lettuce comes back empty handed and surrenders. Parrot decides to spare Lettuce and brings him into the castle, Flame suggests a vote to see who wants him dead and who wants him alive, Wemmbu is the last vote and Minute stares at him, reminding him of their talk. Wemmbu goes over to Parrot's side, ending the vote in a tie, so they encase Lettuce in an obsidian cage. Wemmbu hands Lettuce his old sky civilization book as a reminder and Lettuce calls him cruel. Wemmbu grabs egg and they head out of the castle, Parrot asks where they're headed next, egg says the library, but Wemmbu says otherwise and heads off.  They run on the highway and see Flame in the distance, Wemmbu asks what his problem is with Jaden and Flame explains that Jaden's mace belongs to another friend. Flame asks where they're headed, Wemmbu says he has an idea and turns right from the highway.

 Trivia 
 This is the longest post-mafia arc episode, beating 4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players by about 2 minutes.
 In the outro, Wemmbu mentions that this was a long video, which tells the viewers that videos over two hours will not be the norm.

title: Unstable SMP: The Mafia
content:
Unstable SMP: The Mafia is the 26th episode featured in Unstable Universe. This marks the end of Wemmbu's perspective in Season 1.

Plot
The video starts off with Wemmbu and eggchan hanging out in ManePear's treehouse. ClownPierece and Ferre unexpectedly comes and burns the whole tree down. They start attacking Wemmbu and egg, causing their resources to dwindle. Egg manages to escape first, letting him able to create an escape tunnel for Wemmbu. The two manages to escape through the Nether and hide out for 24 hours until the coast is clear. They go back to the treehouse, staring at the remains of it. Wemmbu vows to kill Clown because of what he has done.

Parrot appears behind the two, asking them to join his team again. A flashback appears of Parrot asking them to join prior to the attack, and Wemmbu rejecting Parrot every time. Parrot tells Wemmbu that their interests are aligned by the fact that Wemmbu wants to kill Clown and that Parrot wants to destroy the Mafia.

Parrot leads Wemmbu and Egg to District 13 and devises a plan to take down Ashswagg. However, Wemmbu doesn't care. Parrot then tells Wemmbu he should be the one to distract Clown, or at least give them enough time to go through with their plan. Wemmbu requests to get him to fight a diamond trim Mafia player with a Mace he'll go along with their plan.

Wemmbu, Egg, Parrot, and Wifies go to a beach near spawn to set up a fall trap. Wifies sets up a beacon that alerts nearby Mafia members to their location. Eventually, a Mafia player shows up, but it was a non-trim. The second wave arrives, only an iron trim and a few non-trim show up. They kill the Mafia members with ease. After a while longer, a diamond trim finally shows up with other trimmed players as well. The fight lasts a while, once the diamond trim is alone they set the trap off. They all manage to corner the diamond trim, and as the diamond trim tries to escape, Parrot get the kill.

They all go back to the District 13 base, Parrot and Wemmbu start arguing, both of them trying taking credit for obtaining a mace. Wemmbu says after getting the mace, he has no point in helping Parrot anymore. Before heading off, Parrot tells Wemmbu where Clown could be located. Wemmbu flies to Clown's castle and pots up for a fight. He sneaks into the castle, but almost blows his cover by breaking a sand block, causing the others to fall. He then jumps Clown and Ferre. After all his armor and restocks break, he decides to flee from battle. Clown and Ferre chase, but not for long.

Wemmbu decides to go back to District 13, only to find nobody is there. He then revisits Mane's treehouse again, meeting back up with Egg. Egg tells Wemmbu he has a plan, and the two go fishing. Eggchan suddenly teleports away, and Ferre whispers to Wemmbu that he has Egg held hostage in the jungle temple near the treehouse and to return back. Ferre tells Wemmbu that he was assigned to kill him. If Wemmbu dies, Ferre would let Egg free. Egg tells Wemmbu to "execute order 36", which is their secret code to set off a trap. Dozens of TNT minecarts go off, killing the two gold trim players that were with Ferre immediately, however, Ferre survives. Wemmbu and Egg fight off Ferre, eventually breaking all his armor. Wemmbu tries to get the mace off of Ferre, but Ferre stashes it in his ender chest and tries to fly away before Wemmbu could kill him. Caught one last time, Ferre hands over the mace for Wemmbu to spare his life.

Egg says his actual plan was to stasis back and put a beacon where their treehouse was and pretend to be a Mafia member. Egg then advises Wemmbu to rejoin Parrot, since working with other players makes him stronger. The two head back to District 13, but was met with Spoke and Mapicc instead. As they asked each other why they were looking for Parrot, Parrot appears. Parrot tells Spoke the reason why the resistance left was because of Spoke. Wemmbu and Egg build a house inside the base while they argue. Meanwhile, Spoke devises a plan to destroy the Mafia without having to kill Ash.

All of them head to spawn, Wemmbu's objective is to distract all the Mafia so the others can break in. Wemmbu says they need a team name and Spoke suggests "Team Unstable". Wemmbu tries to break into the prison, but remembers that they're supposed to be distractions. They head up to the top of the prison, and trimmed players spot them and begin to attack. Wemmbu easily kills all of them with his mace. While contemplating dropping down into the prison and freeing any new players, more guards come and jump them. Wemmbu kills all but one iron trim, telling him to call for backup.

A third wave of Mafia members show up, and realizing they can't win the fight, they fly away. Wemmbu escapes for a second, only to be found again. He has no other choice but to jump into the hole. He meets up with Wato, who isn't an actual Mafia member, and they make up for Wemmbu ditching Wato in Sky Civilization. Wato shows Wemmbu around the prison, and eventually meets up with Kenadian. They find where the pearls are being moved around, Wemmbu throws a pearl in and jumps in to get it. Parrot and Wemmbu meet back up, and they get out of the prison. Parrot instructs Wemmbu and Wato to head back to District 13 while he does something else. Spoke, Mapicc, and Egg are already there waiting for them.

Parrot comes back, saddened, saying that Wifies had died. Spoke explains how he found where the ender pearls are located and how he plans on taking it down. Wemmbu builds another house while this goes down. Spoke then instructs Wemmbu to kill Clown, or at least distract him while their plan is in action. Mafia members come and raid their base, griefing it and attacking them. Egg manages to kill a diamond player. After the fight, Wemmbu realizes fighting Clown would be pointless since they're at the same position as they were when he fought the first place. Egg says to ask Clown for a fair one on one fight, and Wemmbu goes to do so.

Wemmbu goes back to Clown's castle and proposes an actual duel, since all the previous times it hasn't been a fair fight. Clown and Ferre start to argue with each other as Wemmbu and his friends stare. Ferre flies off, and the fight begins. In the end, Ferre comes back and they all stasis out. They wait at the District 13 base to see if Spoke and Mapicc come back, but get impatient. Wemmbu and Egg head off back to their treehouse.

The video ends with Wemmbu and Egg heading off to build their own base.

 Trivia 

 This episode's title was originally "How I Survived the Minecraft Mafia" and was later changed to "Unstable SMP: The Minecraft Mafia" before getting shortened to "Unstable SMP: The Mafia".
 The title was also briefly changed to "Unstable SMP: The Invisible Mafia" before getting changed back to "Unstable SMP: The Mafia."

Egg then advises Wemmbu to rejoin Parrot, since working with other players makes him stronger. The two head back to District 13, but was met with [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] and [[Mapicc]] instead. As they asked each other why they were looking for Parrot, Parrot appears. Parrot tells Spoke the reason why the resistance left was because of Spoke. Wemmbu and Egg build a house inside the base while they argue. Meanwhile, Spoke devises a plan to destroy the Mafia without having to kill Ash.

All of them head to spawn, Wemmbu's objective is to distract all the Mafia so the others can break in. Wemmbu says they need a team name and Spoke suggests "Team Unstable". Wemmbu tries to break into the prison, but remembers that they're supposed to be distractions. They head up to the top of the prison, and trimmed players spot them and begin to attack. Wemmbu easily kills all of them with his mace. While contemplating dropping down into the prison and freeing any new players, more guards come and jump them. Wemmbu kills all but one iron trim, telling him to call for backup.

A third wave of Mafia members show up, and realizing they can't win the fight, they fly away. Wemmbu escapes for a second, only to be found again. He has no other choice but to jump into the hole. He meets up with [[Wato1876|Wato]], who isn't an actual Mafia member, and they make up for Wemmbu ditching Wato in Sky Civilization. Wato shows Wemmbu around the prison, and eventually meets up with [[Kenadian]]. They find where the pearls are being moved around, Wemmbu throws a pearl in and jumps in to get it. Parrot and Wemmbu meet back up, and they get out of the prison. Parrot instructs Wemmbu and Wato to head back to District 13 while he does something else. Spoke, Mapicc, and Egg are already there waiting for them.

Parrot comes back, saddened, saying that Wifies had died. Spoke explains how he found where the ender pearls are located and how he plans on taking it down. Wemmbu builds another house while this goes down. Spoke then instructs Wemmbu to kill Clown, or at least distract him while their plan is in action. Mafia members come and raid their base, griefing it and attacking them. Egg manages to kill a diamond player. After the fight, Wemmbu realizes fighting Clown would be pointless since they're at the same position as they were when he fought the first place. Egg says to ask Clown for a fair one on one fight, and Wemmbu goes to do so.

Wemmbu goes back to Clown's castle and proposes an actual duel, since all the previous times it hasn't been a fair fight. Clown and Ferre start to argue with each other as Wemmbu and his friends stare. Ferre flies off, and the fight begins. In the end, Ferre comes back and they all stasis out. They wait at the District 13 base to see if Spoke and Mapicc come back, but get impatient. Wemmbu and Egg head off back to their treehouse.

The video ends with Wemmbu and Egg heading off to build their own base.

== Trivia ==

* This episode's title was originally "How I Survived the Minecraft Mafia" and was later changed to "Unstable SMP: The Minecraft Mafia" before getting shortened to "Unstable SMP: The Mafia".
** The title was also briefly changed to "Unstable SMP: The Invisible Mafia" before getting changed back to "Unstable SMP: The Mafia."

title: Unstable SMP: The PrinceZam Empire War
content:
Unstable SMP: The PrinceZam Empire War is the 13th episode featured in Unstable Universe.  

Plot
The episode starts off with Wemmbu and Eggchan assembling a team of players, ItsLilKae, LuckyMixx, and Block_Facts, to wage war on the Zam Empire. He plans to use the orbital cannon that ParrotX2 and Wifies helped him build to strike the empire first before attacking. He leads the team to the empire, but discovers that it has a giant obsidian roof covering the entire empire. Wemmbu ditches the orbital cannon part of the plan and his team engages into combat with the guards, Pangi, Dol9hin, loppezz, LuigiToan, WyLL_, and What_Max. He himself sneaks off to PrinceZam's castle to murder him. 

A fight ensues between Wemmbu and PrinceZam and his minions. He eventually manages to get himself and Zam alone in a cave. He is on the verge of killing Zam when his guards arrive. Wemmbu is trapped and PrinceZam starts taunting him on how weak he is. Wemmbu retorts that Zam can never take a fair 1 v 1; he calls his guards to do all of his dirty work. He pulls off an escape and reconvenes with Eggchan at the Wemmbu Civilization. 

Horace_Altman, a builder they hired, has renovated their empire, repairing it from the TNT and making a bigger obsidian wall around the expanding empire. Wemmbu pays him with netherite ingots he and Egg stole from the Treasure Hunters' vault. 

Wemmbu realises how outnumbered they really are and he and Eggchan form a plan to sneak into the Zam Empire again to fetch ManePear, a Zam guard who betrayed, conveniently AFK during their previous fight. He theorises that with Mane’s PVP skills and knowledge of the empire, they could potentially defeat Zam. He pots invis and sneaks into the Zam Empire, distracting the guards with firework traps they set up around the empire. He frees Mane from the obsidian box he trapped him in while AFK and they escape back to the Wemmbu Civilization. 

Mane tells Wemmbu that PrinceZam will launch an attack to conquer the Roshambogames Civilization. Still unsure of ManePear’s ulterior motives, he traps Mane in another obsidian box since he doesn’t have a pickaxe and decides to go check it out. If the Zam Empire is really taking over Ro's civilization, then he’ll know that Mane is telling the truth. 

Wemmbu sets an ender pearl stasis, pots invis, and heads to the Ro Civilization. He sees FlameFrags and Merffinn at the entrance, interrogating Ro. They make a deal that Flame will duel Ro. If Ro wins, his empire will be left alone. If Flame wins, then he will have to surrender everything. They head to an arena in the empire and the fight begins. Flame pulls out a wooden sword to fight Ro with, and easily gains the upper hand. All of Ro’s armour pieces except for his chestplate pop, and Wemmbu shows himself in defence of Ro. 

Wemmbu tells Flame that he’ll duel Flame instead, and heads elsewhere with Ro to prepare. He tells Ro to pack everything of value up and take the citizens somewhere safe while he distracts Flame. He returns to the arena and the duel starts. Ro finally confirms that everyone is out after a few minutes and Wemmbu stasises away. 

He meets back up with Egg and they free Mane from the obsidian box. They go to the renovated town hall and discuss their plans moving forward. Since they don’t have the manpower to take all of Zam’s guards at once, they decide to take down all of the high-ranking officers before going for Zam himself. Regarding the failed attack they launched on the Zam Empire, Zam probably wouldn’t be online without Flame anymore. They go with yungwillx first, because he is the easiest to kill and is prone to traps. He owns a castle and heads there when he isn’t working for Zam, so they decide to set a TNT minecart trap there. 

Since the Zam Empire doesn’t know that Mane betrayed yet, he will distract yungwillx while Wemmbu sets up the trap. Wemmbu fumbles with the trap, and yungwillx is confused as to why Mane is visiting him, but they manage to make it work. They escape before their cover can be blown, but they still need to activate the trap. They disguise Wemmbu as Mane and pot invis while Mane goes without armor to activate the trap. Wemmbu arrives back at yungwillx’s property and Mane types in the chat that his mom is in the room, so he is muted. He also accidentally potted invis instead of speed. However, when Mane activates the trap, it fails to kill yungwillx, and they are discovered. They engage in combat, but Zam and his guards arrive. They pop yungwillx’s armour and tell the Zam Empire forces that if they don’t leave, then they will kill yungwillx. After some debate, Zam and his guards fly off. They take yungwillx hostage and imprison him in the Wemmbu Civilization’s colony. 

Wemmbu, Mane, and Egg meet again in the town hall. Wemmbu wants to kidnap Peentar, yungwillx’s closest friend on this server, next. Since Zam is probably already planning to retrieve yungwillx, they’ll leave a note for Peentar in his house telling him that if he doesn’t come alone to the Wemmbu Civilization, they’ll kill yungwillx. Egg tells Wemmbu that he shouldn’t do this, and that he’s just following in Zam’s footsteps at this point, but he doesn’t care. 

Wemmbu writes the book, telling Peentar to make a secret underground tunnel system to the Zam Empire and Zam’s castle and set a trap beneath Zam’s throne before coming to the Wemmbu Civilization. They sneak into the Zam empire and successfully finish the job, setting fire to his house in the process. 

Peentar eventually arrives and Wemmbu and Mane let him see yungwillx on the condition that he drops all of his items. However, it is a trap and they successfully imprison Peentar as well. Mane wants to just kill them both, and Wemmbu starts siding with him, but Egg protests, saying that they can still use the prisoners for leverage, and that it is morally wrong. Wemmbu finally relents, but Egg says that he still doesn’t want any part in this bloodshed. 

Wemmbu and Mane go to the Zam Empire to see if Peentar had built the tunnels and the trap. He did, in fact, build them, so they go to the trap and activate it, thinking that Zam is on the throne. Instead, the trap fails and all they accomplish is trapping Sorhin, another one of Zam's guards. With a failed trap, they just decide to cover their tracks and take Sorhin prisoner. 

Once Wemmbu and Mane arrive at the Wemmbu Civilization, things take a turn for the worse. They hear lots of withers spawning, and discover that Zam has freed yungwillx and Peentar and is launching an attack on the empire. They try to fend off the Zam Empire, but their civilization is bombed all the same, like last time. They trap Wemmbu and pop everything except his chestplate, but in the end, Wemmbu surrenders and says that he’ll leave the Zam Empire alone and just mind his own business. PrinceZam spares him and gives him a second chance.

Mane, however, decides that it is a good idea to challenge FlameFrags, the Immortal Demon, to a duel to the death to see who is the stronger player once and for all. Wemmbu gears him up and they start fighting while the rest of the players spectate from the side. Before either side could win, though, Mane pauses and takes off all of his armour, seeing that he was starting to lose. Zam says that they won’t bother the Wemmbu Civilization anymore if he doesn’t bother them. 

Wemmbu pots invis, tired of Zam’s yapping, and runs away. He and Mane both escape, but before he is able to make it out, he sees Egg being held captive by Zam and his guards. Zam tells Egg that he’ll let Wemmbu go, but he’ll keep him indefinitely. Wemmbu realises that Egg is already long gone and just leaves. 

Wemmbu, Mane, and Lucky regroup on an island near the Zam Empire, which has their obsidian roof taken down, and regear themselves. They discuss their plans moving forward. Mane still wants to fight, but Wemmbu opposes him. However, there is still one way to get revenge on the Zam Empire. 

He heads into the Zam Empire and sets off a TNT bomb to catch the guards’ attention. They eventually see him and he asks to be taken to Zam. The guards lead him to the castle, and he sees Zam sitting on his throne. Zam, confused, asks why he’s here. Wemmbu replies that since his civilization is no more, and all that he can do is just play alone on this server, he might as well just create a new singleplayer survival world. In short, he wants to turn himself in. Zam sees nothing that he could do to oppose him anymore, so he takes Wemmbu down to Egg and tells him that he’ll take the liberty to imprison him with Egg as a final wish. 

Before entering the prison, Zam tells Wemmbu to clear his inventory and gives him thirty-seven cakes, thirty-six for his inventory and one for his offhand, to check that he really has a clear inventory. Wemmbu, however, outsmarts him by picking up all of the cakes and putting his ender chests, elytra, and a stack of notches in his four crafting slots. He pulls the act off, gears himself from his ender chest, frees Egg, escapes, and activates the orbital strike cannon.

Zam and his guards are shocked, and start chasing him down as TNT rains from the sky in multiple strikes, lagging the server. Egg manages to escape, and Wemmbu eventually loses Zam’s minions, leaving only him and Zam. They start fighting, and Zam berates Wemmbu for destroying everything that he worked for from the start of this server. Wemmbu taunts him about how it feels to have all of his work destroyed in a matter of minutes, and that this was entirely his fault. 

They drain each other of their resources and, in the end, land on the roof of a house overlooking the harbor. Wemmbu asks Zam why he betrayed him, but Zam tells him that he has no business knowing that. Wemmbu pushes more, and Zam finally relents, apologizing to him and saying that they both have made lots of mistakes. Wemmbu admits that they’re essentially even now.

They are interrupted by ClownPierce, who lands and starts threatening to ban Wemmbu off of the server. He tells them both that they’re coming with him.

 Trivia 

 This video's title used to be "I Fought Minecraft's Greatest War". It was then changed to "Unstable SMP: The Empire War" and was finally changed to "Unstable SMP: The PrinceZam Empire War".

title: Warriors Council
content:
The Warriors Council is a group of players in charge of leading the Warriors District in the Far Lands. It is made of 5 elite warriors, and in order to become a council member, a player must defeat an existing council member or pop the totem of the Leader. Players on the council are distinguished by their shields, which are white with a black skull on it, and by their silence armor trims.

 History 
One of the mission leaders die to a diamond tier Mafia player.

Parrot and TheobaldTheBird have a competition for who becomes the next mission leader. TheobaldTheBird wins using TNT minecarts.

Parrot agrees to fight DumbIsDumb to become a council member. By flooding the arena with water and using tridents, Parrot is able to win.

Purpled tries to have the council members kill Parrot, but he escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members. Parrot unites the warriors and the farmers, and tells everybody to throw their diamond trimmed armor into a cactus and replace it with normal netherite armor.

Ashswagg takes the warriors hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. The Mafia destroys the Far Lands Civilization and the Warriors Council ends.

title: Wato1876
content:
Wato1876, also known as Wato, is a supporting character in Unstable Universe. He is known for building escape rooms, taking commissions from other players.

Personality
Wato is shown to be mostly reserved, choosing to stay hidden rather than actively take part in conflict. He also generally dislikes social interaction with other people, being highly inscrutable to both Wemmbu and PrinceZam.  

Despite his deadpan personality, he does seem to somewhat develop a unique friendship with Wemmbu; later on during the latter's escape, he expresses genuine concern for his safety, going as far as defying ClownPierce's orders to secure their safety. He values loyalty, although he recognizes that sometimes people do what is necessary for survival. he is stubborn and holds his morals near to his heart, although he is willing to let them go if he is in danger.   

His closest ally seems to be Kenadian, and he often follows his lead, like when he joined the mafia with him. They also were the leaders of the Farmers Faction together, alongside Wifies.    

 History 
Wemmbu and PrinceZam are trapped by ClownPierce in an escape room made by Wato1876.

Wato1876 is seen as a member of Skyblock Civilization.

Wato1876 is seen as a member of the Farming District in Far Lands.

Wato1876 joins District 13. he later leaves and joins The Invisible Mafia.

Wato1876 helps during the break in of the spawn prison made by the Mafia.

title: Wemmbu
content:
Wemmbu is one of the four main protagonists of Unstable Universe, alongside ParrotX2, SpokeIsHere, and FlameFrags. Wemmbu was the founder of Wemmbu's Civilization, was a member of the Zam Empire, a member of the Skyblock Civilization, and a member of the Ice Mountain Civilization. He currently holds two of the few maces left on the server, and a large supply of orbital strike cannons.

 Personality 
Wemmbu is loud, sarcastic, competitive, and emotionally explosive. His behavior frequently oscillates between friendly banter and destructive hostility, depending on how threatened he may feel in the moment. He has a tendency to act within his own self interest, sometimes refusing to help others unless there is something for him to gain. 

He is quick to resorting to violence and has a desperate need to be "the strongest." He believes in doing whatever it takes to achieve victory and that fighting with honor is an unnecessary limitation (a belief he learned from ManePear). Although he can be cunning, his impulsivity often leads to a lack of strategic thought behind most of his decisions. He is an extremely skilled and capable fighter who holds great respect for his weapons, particularly his signature maces, Gambit and Crucible. Wemmbu is also known for his use of Orbital Strike Cannons that he uses whenever he feels outnumbered or outskilled (for example, when Wemmbu fought FlameFrags and opted to blow him up with his Orbital Strike Cannons rather than fight fairly). 

Wemmbu is also heavily protective of his best friend Eggchan, despite the latter's weakness and inexperience with the game. He has also grown to learn to forgive his enemies rather than kill them (PrinceZam, Jaden_Man, and LettuceK) and that violence isn't the answer to every problem he faces, such as when he had a chance to kill two players to steal their Riptide tridents and instead chose to help them in exchange for a trident.

 Gear 
Item NameItem Type Enchantment(s)GambitMaceDensity 5, Wind Burst 1, Fire Aspect 2, Mending, Unbreaking 3.Nuke ShotFishing RodTriggers Orbital Strike Cannon and instantly breaks when used.Stab ShotFishing RodTriggers Orbital Strike Cannon and instantly breaks when used.Netherite SwordSwordSharpness 5, Fire Aspect 2, Unbreaking 3, Mending, Looting 3, Sweeping Edge 3Netherite SwordSwordSharpness 5, Fire Aspect 2, Unbreaking 3, Knockback 1, Looting 3, Sweeping Edge 3

 Relationships 

 Eggchan 
Wemmbu and Eggchan are best friends, getting along despite Wemmbu frequently teasing and bullying Egg. They met when Wemmbu invited Eggchan to his empire in I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization, and have a very close bond, shown by how Egg is constantly being kidnapped by people who want something from Wemmbu. 

Egg is usually Wemmbu's moral anchor (except for the incident of hanging a player over boiling lava to get them to talk), often holding him back from violence. When he's not there, such as when Egg was stuck in the end, Wemmbu often shows little moral restrain and tends to go on a villain arc. 

Wemmbu often has to rescue Egg from dangerous situations, due to Egg's lack of PVP skill. However, Wemmbu doesn't understand a lot of the things Egg talks about and often makes fun of him for using big or scientific words.

They were together until Egg sacrificed his own freedom to allow Wemmbu to escape prison, and met again in I Mastered Minecraft Combat, when Wemmbu popped the totem of an invis mafia player who ended up being Eggchan.  

After the Mafia ended Egg and Wemmbu stuck together and were able to move past their disagreements in Unstable SMP: The Eggchan Empire, showing the resilience of their friendship. In the farlands, Egg sacrificed himself for Wemmbu, getting shot into the end so Wemmbu didn't have to.

Egg was later freed, and they've been adventuring together ever since.

 SpokeIsHere 
Spoke and Wemmbu were enemies back in PrinceZam Empire Arc, with Wemmbu working with PrinceZam, ParrotX2, and Wifies to defeat the exploiter. 

Later on, they fixed their relationship and worked together to destroy The Mafia.

Spoke was the one who led Wemmbu to the mafia outpost where he fought FlameFrags. He helped Flame survive the fight against Wemmbu by giving him totems.

Spoke broke Wemmbu out of prison and in return Wemmbu owed him a favor. Spoke used the favor to assassinate Leo but failed. In exchange for his help, he told Wemmbu how to get Eggchan out of the end.

Later in the "Kings Arc,” Spoke helped Wemmbu as one of the 4 protagonists in the final Law Battle.  

 ParrotX2 
Wemmbu and Parrot worked together in the PrinceZam Empire Arc to defeat Spoke, an exploiter. They teamed up when they realized Spoke was making them do the same puzzles.

Wemmbu helped Parrot hide from ClownPierce, who was hunting him. He lied to ClownPierce and gave Parrot a place to hide in his empire.

ClownPierce created a prison, Proton, in which he imprisoned various members of Unstable for his entertainment. Wemmbu escaped this prison and later returned to help Parrot and his friends.

Parrot and Wemmbu teamed up during the reign of the Invisible Mafia. Parrot helped Wemmbu come up with a plan to kill a diamond player and get a mace. Wemmbu distracted ClownPierce and FerreMC while Spoke destroys the stasis chambers and Parrot kills Ashswagg. While Parrot did not kill Ashswagg, they did successfully defeat the Mafia.

Parrot was hired by FlameFrags to find Wemmbu, who had faked his death. Parrot pretended to be Wemmbu’s alternate identity, The Invisible Knight, and managed to reveal him using wolves.

Parrot asked for Wemmbu’s help in the election. Parrot helped Wemmbu sneak back to spawn to reveal that he had escaped LettuceK’s prison. They successfully returned to the Northern Council and revealed Lettuce’s incompetence.

Wemmbu and Parrot worked together, along with Flame, Spoke, and various other players, to defeat The Law.

 FlameFrags 
FlameFrags worked under PrinceZam. At Zam’s request, he pretended to betray the empire and attacked Wemmbu’s empire, destroying it numerous times.

FlameFrags joined the Mafia, where he kidnapped Eggchan and made Wemmbu give him his mace in exchange for Egg’s life.

Wemmbu attacked Flame’s base, but the fight ended in a stalemate as Flame showed Wemmbu around his house.

Wemmbu imprisoned Flame’s ally, JadenMAN, in an underground civilization. Flame agreed to help Jaden get revenge, forming the Avengers and hunting down Wemmbu in the Far Lands. However, Flame ended up betraying the team and gave Wemmbu back his mace which had been stolen from him by Sharpness.

Flame and Wemmbu fought in a PVP tournament, where they constantly taunted each other throughout the rounds. Flame beat Wemmbu in the finals.

Wemmbu and Flame fought at an abandoned mafia outpost. Wemmbu used orbital strike canons and nearly killed Flame. Flame thought the fight was unfair and demanded a rematch.

When Wemmbu faked his death, Flame hunted him down, not believing the lie. He worked with Parrot to reveal Wemmbu’s identity. Before they could fight, however, The Law came.

The two put their fight on hold to kill The Law, fighting 1000 players. They grew closer in the experience, becoming friends after Wemmbu gave Flame the title of Strongest Player. They fought together once again to defeat the Law for good, their dynamic changing from hostile rivals to friendly competitors.

 ManePear 
ManePear helped Wemmbu destroy the Zam Empire after ManePear revealed he was unsatisfied by the working conditions.

Wemmbu later sought out ManePear as a mentor, so he could become a better fighter. ManePear agreed to be his mentor after Wemmbu revealed he had a mace. However, Wemmbu was constantly disobeying ManePear and going against him, so ManePear left a sign that read “Lost Cause.” He hasn’t been seen by Wemmbu since, but Wemmbu still uses the techniques ManePear taught him in his fights.

 PrinceZam 
PrinceZam and Wemmbu became allies in It's Impossible to Catch this Player, united by their common goal of finding Spoke. They got along well until Zam asked if Wemmbu would betray him, and Wemmbu said he would if it was convenient. Wemmbu then left Zam in a 4v1, planting further distrust, but made up for it by elytra-macing their enemies. Despite his previous statement, Wemmbu seemed to be loyal to Zam, going as far as giving up his mace to save Zam's life.

PrinceZam tasked Wemmbu to expand his Civilization, claiming it had a vault of valuables under it but telling Wemmbu not to check the vault. Wemmbu obeyed. However, as assassins were sent after Wemmbu, Zam became a prime suspect and when Wemmbu checked the vault, there was nothing there. Zam blew up Wemmbu's empire and called him weak, saying he was too pathetic to kill. 

Zam gave Wemmbu an out, saying if Wemmbu left Zam alone Zam would do the same for him. However, Wemmbu wanted revenge and waged war on the Zam Empire, blowing it up with an orbital strike cannon. Throughout the war, Zam refused to kill Wemmbu, even when it made no sense and angered his guards.

During their final fight, Zam realized his mistake, but it was too late and both Zam and Wemmbu were put in a large prison by ClownPierce. Zam was first paranoid and tried to kill Wemmbu, with Wemmbu avoiding Zam at all costs, but eventually they were able to begrudgingly get along and work together. This was ruined when Clown destroyed Zam's second empire as punishment for them working together, and Zam continued plotting to kill Wemmbu. Despite this, Wemmbu no longer held a grudge against Zam, since they were "even", and just wanted Zam to stop trying to kill him.

They were then put in an escape room, also by Clown, and this time they were willing to get along to escape. At first they were annoyed at having to work together, but soon they grew to actually like each other again. Wemmbu even fought ClownPierce so Zam could have a chance to escape.

Later Wemmbu was put in prison by the Law, and reunited with Zam, who was also in prison. They got along and worked together to escape, with their relationship being fully repaired. They also fought in the Law war together.

 ClownPierce 
ClownPierce and Wemmbu are enemies on the Unstable SMP.

Wemmbu helped ParrotX2 hide from Clown, who was hunting him.

Clown captured Wemmbu and PrinceZam after the PrinceZam Empire War. He put them in a prison, Proton, for his own entertainment. When Wemmbu escaped, he captured him again and put him in an escape room with Zam. Wemmbu ended up fighting Clown at the end of the escape room to let Zam escape, although he lost the fight.

Wemmbu fought ClownPierce and FerreMC, who were both apart of the Mafia. He failed his first fight against them, being forced to run, but he came back and managed to hold his ground against Clown while  Eggchan and Wato1876 distracted Ferre. Wemmbu left when he determined he had bought Parrot and Spoke enough time to defeat the Mafia.

ClownPierce was falsely accused of killing Wemmbu by Boosfer, who lied and told FlameFrags he had done it. Flame eventually found out about Boosfer’s lie. 

 LettuceK 
Lettuce was a part of the Skyblock Civilization, the civilization Wemmbu found in the sky that he had a part in destroying. Lettuce was also part of the Ice Mountain Civilization, which Wemmbu coincidentally also destroyed.

Wemmbu blew up The Law’s base while trying to find FlameFrags.

Later, during the Fake Identity Arc, Lettuce interrupted Wemmbu’s fight with Flame, sending in Lawmen to kill Flame. They also hunted down Wemmbu after finding out he was alive. Flame and Wemmbu told Lettuce to send his entire army after them. He sent 1000 players, which the duo killed.

Lettuce captured Wemmbu after he fought Flame. He took a mace Wemmbu had dropped and imprisoned him. He brought him to the Northern Council, where he announced to the server that Wemmbu was alive, imprisoned, and set to be executed for his crimes if Lettuce were to become King of Unstable.

Wemmbu escaped the Law prison with the help of Spoke, but Lettuce kept it a secret in fear of losing support.

Wemmbu fled to the Great Sea, seeking the help of his friend, JadenMAN. Lettuce was attacking the Great Sea and was actively building an orbital strike canon to destroy Jaden’s Pirate Empire. Wemmbu tried to stop him, but failed. Lettuce captured Jaden and the empire was abandoned.

Parrot brought Wemmbu to spawn to expose Lettuce.

Wemmbu broke into the Law prison to free Jaden. He had already been rescued by Spoke, but he ended up teaming up with him and Flame (later also Parrot) to defeat Lettuce. They beat the army, but then had to decide what to do with Lettuce. Despite Wemmbu’s former urge to kill Lettuce, he voted to let him live after having a conversation with MinuteTech.

When Lettuce was put in a cage, temporarily until he would be transferred to a formal prison, Wemmbu gave Lettuce a book he had written in the SkyBlock Civilization.

 Trivia 
He is surprisingly good at 1.8 PvP, his first channel being assorted Bedwars clips.
He often overestimates his 1.9 skill level, as when he tried to claim to ManePear on two separate occasions that he was high tier and the same level as Mane, only to be badly beaten by Mane.
After being told to "lock in" by ManePear, Wemmbu actually did. Not only killing three gold tier players and bringing back their chestplates to Mane, but even holding his own against FlameFrags on the occasion when Flame was attacking Snow Civilization.
He found a sign at the end of his training arc left by ManePear who went missing, which read "lost cause". It is not totally clear what Mane meant by this, but Wemmbu afterwards told Eggchan that ManePear was not coming back.
In Spoke's video I Survived as a Hardcore Assassin, it's shown that Spoke was behind the fourth Wemmbu vs Flame rematch and he pretended to kill Wemmbu and lied about his death.
He killed Sky the Happy Ghast, making him an enemy to Parrot and TheobaldTheBird. See all happy ghasts here: Museum Of Happy Ghasts
When he went invisible after faking his death, he chose netherite as his trim material because of MinuteTech's own trims. He decided not to wear netherite armor to not bring attention to himself but having netherite trims made the effort useless, as it stood out.
He hates when other people have maces and will try to kill them.
He is told by MinuteTech that his rivalry with FlameFrags is going to kill them both one day.
His Density-enchanted mace is named Gambit, while his Breach-enchanted mace is named Crucible. Only Gambit has the Wind Burst enchantment on it.
He had a netherite sword named Nightrider.
He holds the record for the longest video in the series, being "I Mastered Minecraft Combat" which is 3:59:59 long.
Ironically, he also holds the record for the shortest video in the series, being "How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP" which is 24:21 long.
In April 2026 he is the 5th most subbed member after Cash, AJTHEBOLD, NotNico, and Wifies. He has the most subs for a protagonist followed by Parrot.
Before starting Unstable, Wemmbu was known for using hacks and exploits, similar to Spoke. However, unlike Spoke, we don't seem him using hacks or exploits in Unstable.
He still owes Spoke a favor.
The crown on his head is actually not a crown but it is a tiara as in one of his old videos he says that he thinks crowns are overused.

[[Wemmbu]] is one of the four main protagonists of ''[[Unstable Universe]]'', alongside [[ParrotX2]], [[SpokeIsHere]], and [[FlameFrags]]. Wemmbu was the founder of [[Wemmbu's Civilization]], was a member of the [[Zam Empire]], a member of the [[Skyblock Civilization]], and a member of the [[Ice Mountain Civilization]]. He currently holds two of the few [[maces]] left on the server, and a large supply of [[Orbital Strike Cannon|orbital strike cannons.]]

== Personality ==
Wemmbu is loud, sarcastic, competitive, and emotionally explosive. His behavior frequently oscillates between friendly banter and destructive hostility, depending on how threatened he may feel in the moment. He has a tendency to act within his own self interest, sometimes refusing to help others unless there is something for him to gain. 

He is quick to resorting to violence and has a desperate need to be "the strongest." He believes in doing whatever it takes to achieve victory and that fighting with honor is an unnecessary limitation (a belief he learned from [[ManePear]]). Although he can be cunning, his impulsivity often leads to a lack of strategic thought behind most of his decisions. He is an extremely skilled and capable fighter who holds great respect for his weapons, particularly his signature maces, [[Maces#Gambit|Gambit]] and [[Maces#Crucible|Crucible]]. Wemmbu is also known for his use of [[Orbital Strike Cannon|Orbital Strike Cannons]] that he uses whenever he feels outnumbered or outskilled (for example, when Wemmbu fought [[FlameFrags]] and opted to blow him up with his Orbital Strike Cannons rather than fight fairly). 

Wemmbu is also heavily protective of his best friend [[Eggchan]], despite the latter's weakness and inexperience with the game. He has also grown to learn to forgive his enemies rather than kill them ([[PrinceZam]], [[Jaden MAN|Jaden_Man]], and [[LettuceK]]) and that violence isn't the answer to every problem he faces, such as when he had a chance to kill two players to steal their Riptide tridents and instead chose to help them in exchange for a trident.

== Relationships ==
