Wemmbu and Eggchan are best friends, getting along despite Wemmbu frequently teasing and bullying Egg. They met when Wemmbu invited Eggchan to his empire in [[I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization]], and have a very close bond, shown by how Egg is constantly being kidnapped by people who want something from Wemmbu. 

Egg is usually Wemmbu's moral anchor (except for the incident of hanging a player over boiling lava to get them to talk), often holding him back from violence. When he's not there, such as when Egg was stuck in the end, Wemmbu often shows little moral restrain and tends to go on a villain arc. 

Wemmbu often has to rescue Egg from dangerous situations, due to Egg's lack of PVP skill. However, Wemmbu doesn't understand a lot of the things Egg talks about and often makes fun of him for using big or scientific words.

They were together until Egg sacrificed his own freedom to allow Wemmbu to escape prison, and met again in [[I Mastered Minecraft Combat]], when Wemmbu popped the totem of an invis mafia player who ended up being Eggchan.  

After the Mafia ended Egg and Wemmbu stuck together and were able to move past their disagreements in [[Unstable SMP: The Eggchan Empire]], showing the resilience of their friendship. In the farlands, Egg sacrificed himself for Wemmbu, getting shot into the end so Wemmbu didn't have to.

Egg was later freed, and they've been adventuring together ever since.

Wemmbu helped [[ParrotX2]] hide from Clown, who was hunting him.

Clown captured Wemmbu and [[PrinceZam]] after the PrinceZam Empire War. He put them in a prison, [[Proton]], for his own entertainment. When Wemmbu escaped, he captured him again and put him in an escape room with Zam. Wemmbu ended up fighting Clown at the end of the escape room to let Zam escape, although he lost the fight.

Wemmbu fought ClownPierce and [[FerreMC]], who were both apart of the [[The Invisible Mafia|Mafia]]. He failed his first fight against them, being forced to run, but he came back and managed to hold his ground against Clown while  [[Eggchan]] and [[Wato1876]] distracted Ferre. Wemmbu left when he determined he had bought Parrot and [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] enough time to defeat the Mafia.

ClownPierce was falsely accused of killing Wemmbu by [[Boosfer]], who lied and told [[FlameFrags]] he had done it. Flame eventually found out about Boosfer’s lie. 

=== LettuceK ===
Lettuce was a part of the [[Skyblock Civilization]], the civilization Wemmbu found in the sky that he had a part in destroying. Lettuce was also part of the [[Ice Mountain Civilization]], which Wemmbu coincidentally also destroyed.

Wemmbu blew up [[The LAW|The Law]]’s base while trying to find [[FlameFrags]].

Later, during the [[The Fake Identity Arc|Fake Identity Arc]], Lettuce interrupted Wemmbu’s fight with Flame, sending in Lawmen to kill Flame. They also hunted down Wemmbu after finding out he was alive. Flame and Wemmbu told Lettuce to send his entire army after them. He sent 1000 players, which the duo killed.

Lettuce captured Wemmbu after he fought Flame. He took a mace Wemmbu had dropped and imprisoned him. He brought him to the [[Northern Council]], where he announced to the server that Wemmbu was alive, imprisoned, and set to be executed for his crimes if Lettuce were to become King of Unstable.

Wemmbu escaped the Law prison with the help of [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]], but Lettuce kept it a secret in fear of losing support.

Wemmbu fled to the [[Great Sea]], seeking the help of his friend, [[Jaden MAN|JadenMAN]]. Lettuce was attacking the Great Sea and was actively building an orbital strike canon to destroy Jaden’s Pirate Empire. Wemmbu tried to stop him, but failed. Lettuce captured Jaden and the empire was abandoned.

Parrot brought Wemmbu to spawn to expose Lettuce.

Wemmbu broke into the Law prison to free Jaden. He had already been rescued by Spoke, but he ended up teaming up with him and Flame (later also Parrot) to defeat Lettuce. They beat the army, but then had to decide what to do with Lettuce. Despite Wemmbu’s former urge to kill Lettuce, he voted to let him live after having a conversation with [[MinuteTech]].

When Lettuce was put in a cage, temporarily until he would be transferred to a formal prison, Wemmbu gave Lettuce a book he had written in the SkyBlock Civilization.

== Trivia ==
*He is surprisingly good at 1.8 PvP, his first channel being assorted Bedwars clips.
*He often overestimates his 1.9 skill level, as when he tried to claim to [[ManePear]] on two separate occasions that he was high tier and the same level as [[ManePear|Mane]], only to be badly beaten by [[ManePear|Mane]].
*After being told to "lock in" by [[ManePear]], Wemmbu actually did. Not only killing three gold tier players and bringing back their chestplates to [[ManePear|Mane]], but even holding his own against [[FlameFrags]] on the occasion when [[FlameFrags|Flame]] was attacking Snow Civilization.
*He found a sign at the end of his training arc left by [[ManePear]] who went missing, which read "lost cause". It is not totally clear what Mane meant by this, but Wemmbu afterwards told Eggchan that ManePear was not coming back.
*In [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke's]] video [[I Survived as a Hardcore Assassin]], it's shown that [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] was behind the fourth Wemmbu vs Flame rematch and he pretended to kill Wemmbu and lied about his death.
*He killed [[Sky]] the Happy Ghast, making him an enemy to [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and [[TheobaldTheBird]]. ''See all happy ghasts here: [[Museum Of Happy Ghasts]]''
*When he went invisible after faking his death, he chose netherite as his trim material because of [[MinuteTech|MinuteTech's]] own trims. He decided not to wear netherite armor to not bring attention to himself but having netherite trims made the effort useless, as it stood out.
*He hates when other people have maces and will try to kill them.
*He is told by [[MinuteTech]] that his rivalry with [[FlameFrags]] is going to kill them both one day.
*His Density-enchanted mace is named Gambit, while his Breach-enchanted mace is named Crucible. Only Gambit has the Wind Burst enchantment on it.
*He had a netherite sword named Nightrider.
*He holds the record for the longest video in the series, being "[[I Mastered Minecraft Combat]]" which is 3:59:59 long.
*Ironically, he also holds the record for the shortest video in the series, being "[[How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft SMP|How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP]]" which is 24:21 long.
*In April 2026 he is the 5th most subbed member after [[Cash|Cash,]] [[AJTHEBOLD]], [[NotNico]], and [[Wifies]]. He has the most subs for a protagonist followed by [[ParrotX2|Parrot]].
*Before starting Unstable, Wemmbu was known for using hacks and exploits, similar to Spoke. However, unlike Spoke, we don't seem him using hacks or exploits in Unstable.
*He still owes Spoke a favor.
*The crown on his head is actually not a crown but it is a tiara as in one of his old videos he says that he thinks crowns are overused.

Wemmbu’s Civilization, or The Grand Empire, was a Minecraft civilization established by Wemmbu within Unstable Universe. The civilization was marked by large-scale constructions, a well-structured society, and strategic planning, though it did not dominate the server. It focused more on creative experimentation with empire-building, establishing territories and resource management. Despite its efforts, the empire never gained widespread control over the server but was still a notable feature due to its ambitious designs and infrastructure.

 History 
PrinceZam tells Wemmbu to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make a civilization to guard a vault. PrinceZam tells him not to go inside. Wemmbu gets his friend Eggchan to help him build his empire. FlameFrags comes over to Wemmbu. FlameFrags acts like he is not a guard of PrinceZam, and he’s not wearing his PrinceZam gear. FlameFrags starts attacking Wemmbu. Eggchan pulls Wemmbu’s stasis chamber, which means that Wemmbu escapes. Wemmbu gives eggchan all of his armor.

Wemmbu sends Eggchan to distract FlameFrags. Wemmbu uses TNT minecarts to try to kill FlameFrags. It pops his totem and they mine down to try and escape. Eggchan accidentally breaks all of Wemmbu’s armor.

The civilization recruits a new player, C4CorvetteOwner. A team of people including Jaden_MAN come over and try to kill the Wemmbu empire. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps.

Wemmbu has a professional builder, Horace_Altman help him build the empire. After a day has passed, they come back to the base and see Horace has built a village. They invite a couple of new residents. ClownPierce is seen chasing an invisible player in the civilization. ClownPierce eventually leaves. ClownPierce comes back and hears Wemmbu talking with Parrot. He starts killing villagers to try and get information, but Wemmbu tells him he has no information. Parrot leaves.

ManePear, Merffinn, and PrinceZam come over. PrinceZam comes over to check up on the colony. He says that FlameFrags betrayed him. Wemmbu asks if he put a bounty on Parrot and hired ClownPierce to kill him, but PrinceZam says that he is not affiliated with ClownPierce. PrinceZam leaves his two guards at the vault to help the citizens not die.

Wemmbu and eggchan go over to Parrot’s testing base where they experimented on how to break into prisons. He takes a bunch of useful items there, including full netherite armor, golden apples, etc. They destroy the chunk ban that Fantst is in, and ask him if he wants to join their civilization. He agrees to join it. Horace adds giant obsidian walls around the empire.

Wemmbu hears Merffinn and ManePear messing with their rail gun. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that they broke their railgun. They decide to see what the vault is. They dig down and discover it is an obsidian box with nothing in it.

Parrot comes back to the empire and asks if they can protect him from ClownPierce. Wemmbu agrees to help him. Parrot has the idea to put chunk bans around the empire to protect it from invaders.

A team of people including FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN invade. The civilization manages to get them to run away, but the entrance part of their colony is destroyed. Parrot parts ways with the empire. Wemmbu and eggchan try to figure out how they could kill FlameFrags. While planning, FlameFrags comes over and tries to kill them. Wemmbu almost dies, but PrinceZam logs on and FlameFrags says "I guess you have to live now." PrinceZam comes over to the civilization to check on Wemmbu. Wemmbu tells him that he found out that there was nothing in the obsidian vault they had been guarding.

PrinceZam destroys all of his civilization and tells him to pretend like none of this ever happened. He says that his original plan was to chunk ban Wemmbu, but he changes his mind and says that Wemmbu is too weak to even be a threat anymore.

Wemmbu goes to his orbital cannon to try and destroy the Zam Empire, but sees the orbital cannon has been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam Empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn. They blow it up.

Wemmbu and some of the members of his civilization try to use a new orbital cannon to destroy the base, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray Zam Empire.

Wemmbu sees that FlameFrags and Merffinn are trying to invade the Roshambogames Civilization. FlameFrags almost kills Roshambogames with a wooden sword, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges FlameFrags to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in the Roshambo empire to evacuate, and he escapes using a stasis chamber.

Horace_Altman expands Wemmbu's new civilization greatly, and makes it fire-proof.

ManePear distracts yungwillx by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, Merffinn, and Peentar on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, and they take him hostage, forcing Zam and his guards to leave. Wemmbu and ManePear take yungwillx to the dungeon. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage and put him in the dungeon. ManePear and Wemmbu think about killing the hostages, but are dissuaded by eggchan. While they are taking Sorhin hostage, players from Zam Empire break out yungwillx and Peentar before regearing them with Zam Empire ear. 

The Zam Empire destroys Wemmbu’s civilization. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, and Zam imprison eggchan.

title: Wemmbu/History
content:
History 
 Season 1 
Wemmbu secretly spies on SpokeIsHere having a conversation with JamatoP, and hears them talking about an exploit. Jamato gives Spoke an armor set, to which Spoke reacts to the armor set surprised. Wemmbu leaves into a nearby cave. In the end dimension, Wemmbu asks Spoke what his armor is. Spoke lies to him and says that he grinded for the armor himself. Wemmbu is interviewed to guard one of The Wonders. He shows that using a fishing rod he can activate an orbital strike cannon. This gets him the job to guard one of The Wonders. Wemmbu gets more suspicious of Spoke when he meets him in the end, where Wemmbu is not guarding The Wonders. Wemmbu respawns the dragon, suffocating Spoke in obsidian in an end pillar he hollowed out. Spoke is able to get out, and Wemmbu questions Spoke. Spoke starts trying to kill him, but Wemmbu is stronger than him. Wemmbu is unable to kill Spoke as he escapes using the outer end islands. Spoke checks one of The Wonders and exclaims that "it" is still here, referring to the glitched items that he stores in the wonders. Wemmbu hears this and says "what’s still here, Spoke?". He attacks Spoke, almost killing him. Spoke escapes by mining out of the wonder. Wemmbu and ParrotX2 discover that The Wonders were being destroyed. Wemmbu uses Parrot to give him the coordinates of Spoke. At those coordinates, he finds a massive vault of duped items, and attempts to break in. Tyrad finds him, a guard of the vault. Tyrad fails in to stop him from breaking in. He also spots 2 other guards, Sharkilz and RealReeon. He kills Tyrad, and escapes from them. He finds the guards again, but this time Only_A_Squid is also there. Wemmbu escapes again. Wemmbu breaks into the main area, where he’s trapped in an area full of chest minecarts with a warden.  

Spoke says that Wemmbu’s stuck in his prison. Wemmbu manages to escape by going to a corner, destroying a couple of chest minecarts, and mining out. He tries to kill Spoke, but Spoke escapes. He finally escapes the vault by mining out. He finds Spoke and attempts to kill him, but he escapes again using a stasis chamber. Wemmbu asks Parrot if he knows where Spoke is, to which he says no. He then finds JamatoP in his base after he’s vanished. Jamato says that he doesn’t know where Spoke is because he parted ways with him and hasn’t seen him since. Other players come into the base, ManePear and FlameFrags, and start attacking Wemmbu and Jamato and asking if they know anything about Spoke. Wemmbu explains that he’s also trying to find Spoke. They explain that they’re part of the Zam empire. They go over to the Zam Empire, where PrinceZam is with his two guards Peentarand yungwillx. He agrees to team with PrinceZam to kill Spoke. Wemmbu helps loppezz kill people who are taking over Ice Mountain Civilization. He almost kills them, but loppezz advises for Wemmbu to stop after they threaten to blow up the entire mountain. Wemmbu and loppezz come back in and are trapped by one of the raiders. After escaping, they discover that there actually is a large amount of TNT in the base.

Wemmbu and loppezz try to break into the base to defuse the explosives using water, but are spotted by another player. They are able to escape. Wemmbu goes alone into the mountain to assassinate Fantst. Fantst explodes the entire base. Wemmbu tries to kill Fantst but he is able to escape. 

Wemmbu travels to a stronghold to go to the end to get elytras and sell them to get rich. Upon entering a stronghold, he finds out there are people living in there. He meets Baablu in the stronghold. Baablu tells him not to enter the portal because someone is keeping it for themselves. Baablu wants Wemmbu to respawn the ender dragon but he needs end crystals. Wemmbu and Baablu set their stasis' and head to a vault. They find the end crystals in the vault and leave the vault using the stasis chamber. 

Wemmbu goes in the end and meets MinuteTech. Minute asks why Wemmbu is in the end. Wemmbu tells Minute he has to respawn the ender dragon. Wemmbu attempts to respawn the ender dragon but Minute wont let him so he tries to kill Minute. During the fight, Wemmbu spawns withers to distract Minute. Baablu enters the end to fight Minute. Minute warns Wemmbu about what he's about to do but Wemmbu respawns the dragon anyways. Wemmbu helps Baablu to try to kill Minute now that he successfully respawned the dragon until Fantst appears and begins attacking Wemmbu. Baablu reveals that he was just using Wemmbu to respawn the dragon.

Wemmbu and Minute team up and head to the outer end islands. Minute explains that Baablu wanted to respawn the ender dragon so that they can duplicate them and destroy spawn completely. Wemmbu and Minute realize they could've won the fight if they didn't waste their resources fighting each other. They then get jumped by members of Fantst's team and they try to escape the fight due to minimal resources, but they are followed. Wemmbu and Minute manage to kill all of them except for one. 

Wemmbu and Minute search for an un-looted end city and after traveling 100k blocks away from the main end island, they find two un-looted end cities, one of them with a ship. They take the items from the end city, but they were followed. They are then jumped by Fantst, Baablu, and the rest of the team. Wemmbu and Minute are able to escape.

Wemmbu and Minute notice there are now 3 ender dragons. Wemmbu maces one of them and almost kills it. Fantst and Baablu escape.

Wemmbu participates in a PVP tournament hosted by AJTHEBOLD. The point of the tournament is to determine who is the strongest player in PvP. Each player has 3 totems. If all of them are used, their stasis is pulled and they are disqualified. Elytra's are not allowed in the fight.

The first fight is Wemmbu vs Epaxial. Wemmbu is able to win the fight.

Horace begins cleaning up the arena, and Wemmbu gives him his pickaxe to help. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he will be fighting him the next round, which is proven to be correct. Wyll has access to stacks of god apples and slow falling arrows, making the fight very difficult for Wemmbu. Wemmbu is able to beat Wyll.

Wemmbu watches the other matches and everyone is dismissed into the festival. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he's going to fight Conexion next and gives him advice on how he can win against Sharpness.

Wemmbu fights Sharpness in an ice arena. Wemmbu is able to defeat Conexion.

Wemmbu fights Flame, but is unable to defeat him.

Wemmbu goes to the location of eggchan, where he last logged off. Conexion tells Wemmbu to fight him and he proceeds in doing so. Conexion places a pot and steals one of Wemmbu's maces and runs away. Wemmbu tries chasing him but Conexion teleports away using an ender pearl stasis chamber. Wemmbu asks 4CVIT if he knows the location of Conexion. 4CVIT shows him an ender pearl cannon that he was commissioned to build, leading to the beginning of the farlands.

Wemmbu and Eggchan begin exploring the farlands until they spot Sharpness next to the Far Lands City. Conexion almost kills Wemmbu while they are in a confined space, but Wemmbu is able to escape. 

Wemmbu and eggchan notice that not only do firework rockets don't no longer work once you are a certain distance in the farlands, but they cannot access anything in their Ender Chests. They notice a house and some glitched chests, however, the chests don't have anything valuable, so they continue exploring. As they continue exploring, they notice more glitched terrain as well as glitched versions of old structures. They notice another house this time with someone living in it. They ask the person if they knew where Conexion was. They tell them the direction that Conexion went. 

As soon as they arrive they see a completely intact version of Zam Empire, before it was blown up by Wemmbu. They begin exploring the empire until they find echoes of past players, specifically of Pangi, ManePear, FlameFrags, Sorhin and PrinceZam. 

Wemmbu and Conexion have a fight. Right before Wemmbu dies, he puts his mace in his ender chest. Conexion breaks the ender chest and tells Wemmbu to meet back up in 30 minutes to resume the fight, then leaves. Wemmbu is able to craft a new ender chest, meaning he is able to use his mace again, and Conexion and Wemmbu fight again. Conexion puts his mace in his ender chest right before dying, causing Wemmbu to stop fighting him. 

Wemmbu explores deeper within the Farlands. A team lead by FlameFrags, called The Avengers, consisting of enemies of Wemmbu, try to kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu is able to escape. 

Wemmbu and eggchan find a temple with two players, one of them being named Lakerek. Wemmbu decides to fight Lakerek. Lakerek uses orbital strike cannons throughout the fight. Lakerek eventually takes off his armor, and Wemmbu kills him. Wemmbu is told of a place called the Forge. The Avengers, now without FlameFrags, try to kill Wemmbu. The Avengers eventually runs away. Later, the Avengers once again tries to kill Wemmbu, but fails, as FlameFrags betrays them, using Conexion's mace to kill them. Flame then gives the mace back to Wemmbu.

Wemmbu and eggchan find a naturally generating trial chamber with ominous vaults still inside. Wemmbu and eggchan destroy the ominous vaults. A player named Nitenly tries to kill them multiple times, but fails. Wemmbu and Eggchan keep traveling and bridging across void until they reach a palace. The players there claim to not know about the Forge. Wemmbu and eggchan find a large amount of orbital strike cannons, which is seemingly the Forge, though Serpentbound333 claims it is not the Forge. The players attempt to send Wemmbu into the end dimension by hitting him through the portal, but accidentally hit eggchan into the portal instead, effectively trapping eggchan in the end due to his spawn being set in the farlands. Wemmbu is able to kill some of the players, with the others running away. Wemmbu takes a large amount of orbital strike cannon fishing rods, and leaves.

The Law attempts to capture Wemmbu due to him allegedly stealing items from members of Capital City. Wemmbu assumes that someone is impersonating him. He creates a secret base to spy on players. He is eventually able to find a player with the same trims as him. Wemmbu asks them about why they are impersonating them, and they do not answer. The invisible player is able to escape.

Wemmbu finds eggchan and tells him not to say what his identity is if someone claims to be him.

Wemmbu goes to Boosfer to tell him not to reveal his identity to the other player. Wemmbu attempts to kill the invisible player, and a second invisible player is seen, referred to as "agent 22". They attempt to escape using a happy ghast, which Wemmbu kills.

Eggchan tells Wemmbu about something that’ll happen in the Capital City courtroom. Wemmbu travels to the courtroom. The invisible players, revealed to be ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird, fight Wemmbu. Parrot reveals that he is trying to reveal his identity. While Wemmbu tries to escape, Theo continues to persuade Wemmby to tell his identity. Promising that he wouldn't tell a soul. Wemmbu doesn't listen and continues trying to escape. Parrot teleports back in and traps Wemmbu in a box, the plan being to wait for his invis to run out. Wemmbu is eventually able to escape using an enderpearl glitch and runs away.

Wemmbu is still running from Parrot. Wemmbu resorted to use his elytra, accepting the risks of being recognized due to the bright purple colored elytra. He lands on top of a peak and waits for Parrot and Theo to arrive, hoping to kill them. Wemmbu questions why Parrot is fighting him, Parrot stating that it was all for Boomie to which Wemmbu snaps at him saying that he wasn't innocent. That he attacked Capital City with Boosfer. Wemmbu continues talking, he knows that Parrot is smart and would almost certainly unmask him one day but Parrot jumps back on the subject of Boomie to which Wemmbu ignores. 

Wemmbu gives them an ultimatum, leave him alone and he'd let them live or continue hunting him and they would die. Theo laughs and Parrot decides to continue hunting him. Then Wemmbu flies down to continue attacking them. After using his orbital strikes Parrot and Theo try to run, Wemmbu gives them one last chance and Theo uses a stasis and teleports away.

Wemmbu decides to return to the stronghold planning to go to the End to meet up with Eggchan. He finds some enderchests in the stronghold and takes them due to Parrot and Theo stealing his last enderchest. He still decided to enter the End and finds Parrot before going to the portal. Wemmbu instantly attacks Parrot but Parrot stops him, telling Wemmbu that he would never stop hunting him. Parrot hands Wemmbu a milk bucket, giving him a choice to reveal his identity now or face death in the near future but Wemmbu refuses, going to attack Parrot once again.

Wemmbu follows Parrot through a tunnel until they reach an obsidian box with with pressure plates and no way out. Wemmbu decides that this was the perfect location to kill them off. Wemmbu fight Theo and Parrot with Theo trying to use slow falling to try to stop Wemmbu from using the mace, to which he was unsuccessful. Wemmbu decided it was better to now escape. Theo continues to convince Wemmbu to reveal his identity, trying to calm the situation using words.

Wemmbu is successfully able to escape using enderpearls once again. He discovers that he's by the BAT base, a base he had visited before and it had potions. Wemmbu is able to use find invis pots and continues to hide his identity. Theo and Wemmbu fight for a while until Wemmbu spots an enderpearl cannon, which could be his ticket out of the ongoing fight.

He rushes towards the cannon and uses it, only to be teleport to a dome where he's standing on a platform, opposite of him is Parrot. Parrot explains what happened, also revealing that Parrot had discovered his identity. He continues, telling Wemmbu what happened. While Parrot talks, Wemmbu tries to find an escape. Thats when Wemmbu found out that Parrot had been hired by Flamefrags, Wemmbu's rival. Parrot questions why Wemmbu did this, why he faked his death and why he went undercover. Wemmbu doesn't listen and asks Parrot why he was so confident that Wemmbu wouldn't just kill Parrot now. To which Parrot reveals that he brought a little friend. 

Behind Wemmbu, Flamefrags appears. He teleports to the other platform, joining Parrot by his side. Wemmbu still tries to deny the proof, lying through his teeth, saying that he isn't Wemmbu. Wemmbu throws a windcharge and it flies through the powdered snow, going perfectly to Parrot's plan, the windcharge traverses the lava and hits the TNT and ignite it. The explosion kills the hidden dogs revealing Wemmbu's identity. (This plan coming from Wifies, who used the same trick of dogs to make Parrot believe that he was dead)

Wemmbu lands on the platform with Parrot, questioning the avian on why he did this. Parrot doesn't listen and requests Flamefrags to uphold his part of the deal to which Flamefrags complies and hands him a book, then Parrot tells Wemmbu to take off his invis. Wemmbu drinks the milk in his inventory, revealing his identity to the two. Wemmbu questions Parrot's choice again after Parrot and Flamefrags celebrate, Parrot replies with that he had to tie up lose ends, that they clearly didn't like each other to which Wemmbu shoots back, asking when has he not liked Parrot. 

Parrot continues and Wemmbu uses a windcharge to blow him off, he turns to Flamefrags asking him why. Flamefrags responds stating that Wemmbu was spreading that he was the strongest, Wemmbu protests saying it was Eggchan. The argument results into Flamefrags challenging Wemmbu to a fight.

They begin fighting. Wemmbu flies up and sees hundreds of lawmen approaching. Wemmbu and FlameFrags agree to fight the law together before fighting each other again. They defeat the lawmen on hand and go back to fighting each other. After several fights being interrupted by LettuceK's lawmen, the two agree to work together to deal with the lawmen before they continue their fight. Wemmbu and Flame go to the Law base and command Lettuce to send every single lawman he has at them all at once, as the small squads clearly do nothing but fail. The two then chose a location for the battle, waiting for Lettuce to show up with his army.  

After a while, the Law horn blows as Letty and his army of one thousand players pull up, wemmbu orbital strikes them several times, killing a decent amount of them, and he and Flame get into it, slowly making their way through the thousand players. They even encounter players with elytras and maces, which is surprisong and causes some small difficulties. Finally, the entire army has been dispatched. Flame throws away the elytra and mace ge got from wemmbu, who had killed one of the elytra-macers to get them, and proceeds to launch an attack on wemmbu.

He and wemmbu duel, Flame using his dogs until he realises Wemmbu is spending more time getting rid of them than fighting Flame and then killing off the dogs so Wemmbu will focus on him. Wemmbu uses a stab shot and misses. After some time, Wemmbu falls into the hole from the stab shot and Wemmbu decides that flame can be the best after thinking about their rivalry for a while. Flame leaves rather akwardly.

Wemmbu throws away a random third mace he's aquired during the fight, but LettuceK swoops in and grabs it (the mace is then named Executioner, see Maces page for more info), and arrests Wemmbu on the spot.

Wemmbu stashes some of his gear in his e-chest and follows Lettuce to the prison, where he finds out that a "certain fallen emperor" known as PrinceZam, along with Baablu and Fanst, all of which are old enemies of his, are also stuck in the prison. He is told to put on a prison jumpsuit layer on his skin (see the "imprisoned" skin in the main Wemmbu tab) and is kept locked in a cell when he's not doing various menial tasks in the prison. He is brought to the Northern Council at one point to be shown off to the server population. Wemmbu is then used as LettuceK's bargaining chip to become King of the server. After Lettuce finishes his speech, they return to the prison, where an invisible player splashes Wemmbu with invisibility, allowing him to escape. He seeks refuge in a random chungy's house before being caught and brought back and promptly inventory checked. Because of his escape, Lettuce then enacts a new protocol with curse of binding copper armor to be put on all prisoners. Wemmbu is sent into solitary confinement where SpokeIsHere appears before Wemmbu, revealing he was the invisible player from earlier. He makes an offer to Wemmbu where he frees big W in exchange for a favor from him. Wemmbu declines, however Spoke tells Wemmbu that the offer is still on if he decides to change his mind, curious of how he will escape. A week later, Wemmbu is let out of solitary. He plots an escape. The prisoners begin a day of tree chopping. Later, the other prisoners ragebait lopezzz so hard Wemmbu gets the chance to smuggle a few items past the inventory check. The next day, lopezzz brings the Law's very own Friedrich von Steuben, SargeRaxby. Wemmbu begins talking and planning with Zam using signs while Fantst and Baablu begin their grueling training.
