== History ==
=== [[Season 1]] ===
Wemmbu secretly spies on [[SpokeIsHere]] having a conversation with [[JamatoP]], and hears them talking about an exploit. Jamato gives Spoke an armor set, to which [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] reacts to the armor set surprised. Wemmbu leaves into a nearby cave. In the end dimension, Wemmbu asks Spoke what his armor is. Spoke lies to him and says that he grinded for the armor himself. Wemmbu is interviewed to guard one of The Wonders. He shows that using a fishing rod he can activate an [[Orbital Strike Cannon|orbital strike cannon]]. This gets him the job to guard one of [[The Wonders]]. Wemmbu gets more suspicious of Spoke when he meets him in the end, where Wemmbu is not guarding The Wonders. Wemmbu respawns the dragon, suffocating Spoke in obsidian in an end pillar he hollowed out. Spoke is able to get out, and Wemmbu questions Spoke. Spoke starts trying to kill him, but Wemmbu is stronger than him. Wemmbu is unable to kill Spoke as he escapes using the outer end islands. Spoke checks one of The Wonders and exclaims that "it" is still here, referring to the glitched items that he stores in the wonders. Wemmbu hears this and says "what’s still here, Spoke?". He attacks Spoke, almost killing him. Spoke escapes by mining out of the wonder. Wemmbu and ParrotX2 discover that The Wonders were being destroyed. Wemmbu uses Parrot to give him the coordinates of Spoke. At those coordinates, he finds a massive vault of duped items, and attempts to break in. [[Tyrad]] finds him, a guard of the vault. Tyrad fails in to stop him from breaking in. He also spots 2 other guards, [[Sharkilz]] and [[RealReeon]]. He kills Tyrad, and escapes from them. He finds the guards again, but this time [[Only_A_Squid]] is also there. Wemmbu escapes again. Wemmbu breaks into the main area, where he’s trapped in an area full of chest minecarts with a warden.  

Spoke says that Wemmbu’s stuck in his prison. Wemmbu manages to escape by going to a corner, destroying a couple of chest minecarts, and mining out. He tries to kill Spoke, but Spoke escapes. He finally escapes the vault by mining out. He finds Spoke and attempts to kill him, but he escapes again using a stasis chamber. Wemmbu asks Parrot if he knows where Spoke is, to which he says no. He then finds JamatoP in his base after he’s vanished. Jamato says that he doesn’t know where Spoke is because he parted ways with him and hasn’t seen him since. Other players come into the base, [[ManePear]] and FlameFrags, and start attacking Wemmbu and Jamato and asking if they know anything about Spoke. Wemmbu explains that he’s also trying to find Spoke. They explain that they’re part of the Zam empire. They go over to the Zam Empire, where PrinceZam is with his two guards [[Peentar]]<nowiki/>and [[yungwillx]]. He agrees to team with PrinceZam to kill Spoke. [[Mapicc]] comes into the room and starts attacking PrinceZam. Part of the room they are in explodes. They chase after Mapicc to try and kill him. A war breaks out between people against PrinceZam, and the Zam empire. The only person who died was [[TeamKalal]], since everybody against PrinceZam got away using stasis chambers. PrinceZam and Wemmbu interrogate [[TheRealSquiddo]] and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn’t give information on Spoke. They check her barrels and find out that she has glitched items. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates. PrinceZam chunk bans TheRealSquiddo.

Parrot and [[Wifies]] go to the Zam Empire as a clue in a scavenger hunt set up by Spoke. Parrot and Wifies see Wemmbu, who questions them about a "disc" that they were talking about. Parrot says that Spoke left something at his base and that Spoke claims there’s a server secret, and they’re trying to find the next clue. PrinceZam comes over to them. He says that they should give them all the information they found, however they don’t oblige. Parrot and Wifies fly away over to the castle and start exploring it while Wemmbu tries to kill them. Eventually they escape by flying out, and Wemmbu loses them. Wemmbu and PrinceZam decide to go to the stronghold to get to the end base that TheRealSquiddo was talking about. Once they were there, they see there are three Spoke guards at the stronghold, RealReeon, Sharkilz_,  and Mapicc. They dig down to the stronghold, and make their way to the portal room. They find the guards and start fighting them. The guards flee to the end, except for RealReeon. They chunk ban RealReeon. They go into the end and start flying to the coordinates that the end base is at.

They break into the base and start killing Spoke and his guards. Spoke is able to escape before being chunk banned. They leave to the overworld to get some materials. This includes getting a [[Maces|mace]]. After going to the trial chambers and getting a mace, people go into the trial chamber and see it’s already looted. Wemmbu and PrinceZam hide. The people who break into the trail chamber are Mapicc, [[Fantst]], [[Arcn]], Only_A_Squid, and [[Sharooh]], all enemies of the Zam empire. Mapicc finds them and they start fighting. Wemmbu escapes the fight and crafts a mace. PrinceZam escapes to the surface, and Wemmbu uses the mace to try and kill some of the players. All of the people flee the fight by running or using stasis chambers. Arcn is chunk banned by PrinceZam. They use an exploit that has to do with arrows and TNT to try and find Spoke. They find Only_A_Squid at a base and chunk ban him.

They use the second arrow to find Fantst and Sharooh. Fantst runs away and they chunk ban Sharooh. Wemmbu and PrinceZam find an obsidian box, and inside is Mapicc. Spoke and his teammates come in and start to fight Wemmbu and PrinceZam. PrinceZam’s armor all breaks, and he almost dies. PrinceZam holds a chunk ban which scares them away. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam use the arrow to find an obsidian maze. They find two chests with peoples stuff inside of them. They hear Parrot in the maze. This is because Parrot and Wifies followed a clue left by Spoke which lead them to the maze. A guard who was there signaled for them to put all of their items in chests for no advantages in the maze. He eventually finds Parrot and Wifies who have no items. They agree to lead Wemmbu to the clue, however, because they don’t have the texture pack that goes along with the hunt, they would not be able to get any use out of it. Wemmbu gets a turtle egg and music disc from the chest. Wifies and Parrot get their stuff and leave the maze. Wemmbu and PrinceZam realize that they need a texture pack and begin chasing Wifies and Parrot, however they’ve already escaped. Wemmbu and PrinceZam store the disc and turtle egg in the vault.

They follow the arrow to an underwater base. They find Sharkilz_ and chunk ban him. The base explodes which gets rid of the chunk ban, meaning that Sharkilz_ is unbanned because the chunk ban is exploded. Fantst now comes to help Sharkilz_ kill Wemmbu and PrinceZam. They chunk ban Fantst and Sharkilz_. Wemmbu finds a destroyed castle from the first clue that Parrot and Wifies found. He finds an invisible player, who is later revealed to be Spoke. The invisible player says he will take Wemmbu to Spoke. He brings him to an ice parkour mountain, which is the second clue that Parrot and Wifies found. He tells him to do the parkour, however Wemmbu cheats his way through it. The invisible player leads him to the maze he was in earlier. He puts all his items in the chest, except for some enchanted golden apples, two pearls, and a totem of undying.

He completes the maze. The guard tries to trap him using obsidian, but Wemmbu uses his ender pearl to escape. The invisible player leads him to a shipwreck, also a puzzle that Parrot and Wifies had to solve. The player writes on a sign that Squiddo’s castle is the location of Spoke, to which Wemmbu reacts by trying to kill him. The player escapes by using a stasis chamber. Wemmbu finds Spoke at Squiddo’s castle, which is being burned. He starts killing Spoke. Spoke escapes by using a stasis chamber. 

Wemmbu is teleported to the vault, where Parrot and Wifies are stealing the disc and turtle egg. Wemmbu starts killing them, and they manage to fly away. Parrot and Wifies dig down and go into the nether, however Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them in the nether, since they unluckily spawned in a nether cave. Parrot gives Wemmbu and PrinceZam the disc. Parrot says that to find Spoke they need a turtle egg, as baby turtles always go back to their home beach. They agree to team up, however after Wemmbu and PrinceZam go into the overworld to team up, Parrot and Wifies mine away and escape. The Zam Empire finds Spoke and try to kill him. Parrot is also trying to kill Spoke with them, as Spoke had just chunk banned Wifies. Spoke goes into the puzzle area that Parrot and Wifies were in, and start chasing him. Before they can kill Spoke, he chunk bans himself, with Wifies also stuck in the chunk ban.

PrinceZam tells Wemmbu to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make a colony to guard a vault he has. PrinceZam tells him not to go inside the vault. Wemmbu gets his friend [[eggchan]] to help him build his empire. FlameFrags comes over to Wemmbu. FlameFrags acts like he is not a guard of PrinceZam, and he’s not wearing his PrinceZam gear. FlameFrags starts attacking Wemmbu. eggchan pulls Wemmbu’s stasis chamber, meaning that he escapes. He gives eggchan all his netherite armor. He sends eggchan to distract FlameFrags. Wemmbu uses TNT minecarts to try to kill Flame. One of thmempops his totem and they mine down to try and escape. eggchan accidentally breaks all of Wemmbu’s armor.

They build a villager breeder to automatically produce villagers. They make a pumpkin farm and build an obsidian wall around the base. They start a raid to get totems of undying. They recruit a new player, C4CorvetteOwner. A team of people including Jaden_MAN come over and try to kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps. Wemmbu has a professional builder, [[Horace_Altman]], help him build the empire. After a day has passed, they come back to the base and see Horace has built a village. They invite a couple of residents, including TheRealSquiddo, Dione4k, and Block_Facts. [[ClownPierce]] is seen chasing an invisible player. He eventually leaves. ClownPierce comes back and hears Wemmbu talking with Parrot, who was the invisible player. ClownPierce starts killing villagers to try and get information, but Wemmbu tells him he has no information. Parrot leaves.

ManePear, [[Merffinn]], and PrinceZam come over. PrinceZam comes over to check up on the colony. He says that FlameFrags betrayed him. Wemmbu asks if he put a bounty on Parrot and hired ClownPierce to kill him, but PrinceZam says that he is not affiliated with ClownPierce. PrinceZam leaves two guards at the vault to help the citizens not die. Wemmbu and eggchan go over to Parrot’s testing base where they experimented on how to break into prisons. He takes a bunch of useful items there, including full netherite armor, golden apples, etc. They destroy the chunk ban that Fantst is in, and ask him if he wants to join their civilization. He agrees to join it. Horace adds giant obsidian walls around the empire.

Wemmbu hears Merffinn and ManePear messing with their rail gun. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that they broke their railgun. They decide to check inside of the vault. They dig down and discover it is an obsidian box with nothing in it. Parrot comes back to the empire and asks if they can protect him from ClownPierce. Wemmbu agrees to help him. Parrot has the idea to put chunk bans around the empire to protect it from invaders.

A team of people including FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN invade the colony. The empire manages to get them to run away, but the entrance part of their colony is destroyed. Parrot parts ways with the empire. Wemmbu and eggchan try to figure out how they could kill FlameFrags. While planning, FlameFrags comes over and tries to kill them. Wemmbu almost dies, but PrinceZam logs on and FlameFrags says "I guess you have to live now." PrinceZam comes over to the empire to check on Wemmbu. Wemmbu tells him that there is nothing in the vault. PrinceZam destroys all of his empire and tells him to pretend like none of this ever happened. He says that his plan was to chunk ban Wemmbu, but he is too weak to even be a threat to the Zam empire. 

Wemmbu goes to his orbital cannon to try and destroy PrinceZam’s empire, but sees the orbital cannon been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn. Wemmbu and eggchan set up a job where people can hire them to blow up things. [[Roshambogames]] hires Wemmbu and eggchan to blow up Spoke’s end base. They are successful in doing so. [[Woogiex]] hires them to blow up [[FerreMC]]’s base. They find that Ferre has a secret tunnel system in his tower, so they go to investigate. Ferre catches him and Wemmbu tries to escape. He goes underground, and eventually Ferre leaves. Wemmbu and Eggchan come back to destroy the base.

They send three TNT missiles to destroy the base. They are able to destroy the base using TNT, and are able to escape by going underground. Woogiex gives Wemmbu and eggchan their payment of a shulker box of netherite ingots. Woogiex says that all of the members of the team against ClownPierce have disappeared. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that PrinceZam has started taking over spawn. Once far enough from the Zam empire, ManePear says that he’s not a big fan of being a guard of PrinceZam, and that if they need help, he can help him. ManePear tells Wemmbu and eggchan to go over to the treasure hunters base and give them coordinates to go to. Once there, they see [[Kierrrr]] and [[Its_Dev_]]. It turns out that Kier and Dev are working for [[Boosfer]]. They say they’re not the treasure hunters, but this is a lie. Boosfer pays Wemmbu and eggchan to destroy "the valley". Wemmbu creates TNT bomber planes to destroy the valley. He also discovers there is a giant tree in the valley. While destroying the valley, he finds Parrot and Wifies.

Parrot and Wifies explain that this is [[Rekrap2]]’s base which they are trying to protect from Its_Dev_, Kierrrr, and Boosfer. Wemmbu ignores this and continues blowing up the base. Parrot also says that a bunch of players on the server somehow just disappeared. Wemmbu agrees to team with Parrot and Wifies to steal from Boosfer and his team, and go on his quest. Parrot and Wifies say that Wemmbu is allowed to blow up specific parts of the build.

Parrot and Wifies help Wemmbu build an orbital cannon to destroy Boosfer's base. Wemmbu agrees to only use one shot on Boosfer and one shot on PrinceZam. They use the orbital cannon, withers, and TNT to destroy their headquarters. Wemmbu finds their vault of items. Wemmbu steals thousands of netherite blocks and thousands of diamond blocks.

Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and his civilization try to use the orbital cannon to try and destroy the Zam Empire, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam. Wemmbu is able to escape.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray the Zam empire.

Wemmbu sees that FlameFrags and Merffinn are trying to invade Roshambo’s empire. FlameFrags almost kills Roshambo, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges FlameFrags to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in the Roshambo empire to evacuate, and he escapes using a stasis chamber.

Wemmbu decides to rebuild his empire. Horace_Altman expands Wemmbu's empire greatly.

Wemmbu plans to take a member of the Zam Empire hostage. ManePear distracts yungwillx by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, Merffinn, and Peentar on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, and they take him hostage. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage. 

While they are taking Sorhin hostage, the Zam empire breaks out [[yungwillx]] and Peentar. The entire Zam empire destroys Wemmbu’s colony. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and they watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, but then realize that they took eggchan hostage.

PrinceZam takes down the obsidian sheet protecting the Zam empire from an orbital strike cannon. Wemmbu goes over to PrinceZam, with no armor, and they imprison Wemmbu. He fills his inventory with cakes to prove he has not smuggled in any items, but uses the crafting menu to store the extra items to smuggle in four items. He uses the orbital cannon which lags the server, giving him enough time to give eggchan full netherite armor from his ender chest to escape. They break out of the prison. Wemmbu destroys the Zam empire, and ClownPierce comes and takes PrinceZam and Wemmbu to a prison.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu are trapped in a miniature version of the normal world with only three totems. PrinceZam tries to kill Wemmbu, but he’s able to escape, though PrinceZam uses three of Wemmbu's totems. eggchan is also put into the prison. eggchan and Wemmbu wait for [[Pangi]] to be put into the prison to steal his totem. They get the totem and leave. They gear up underground and get full iron armor. They build a skybase in the corner of the map.

Wemmbu and eggchan find PrinceZam to ask him if he found any lava, but PrinceZam starts attacking them. They run away.

PrinceZam and Pangi find Wemmbu and eggchan. They start fighting, but because they have better armor, Wemmbu and eggchan run away. They escape by digging underground. They find a slime chunk under PrinceZam’s base. They’re able to get enchantments by fishing.

ClownPierce sends his guard into the prison to try and kill them, and says that if they pop the guards totem, the guard is teleported out. The guard teleported in is FerreMC. They are able to pop his totem. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to co-exist. They see that PrinceZam somehow got obsidian. Pangi goes to the nether, but gets chunk banned.

Wemmbu and Eggchan build a creeper farm, but it doesn’t work. They go over to PrinceZam to ask why the creeper farm isn’t working, and see he has villagers. PrinceZam says that completing a raid can give obsidian. PrinceZam helps them diagnose the problem with their creeper farm. ClownPierce uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy PrinceZam’s base because of Pangi going to the nether to escape. PrinceZam thinks this is Wemmbu’s fault, so he tries to kill him. PrinceZam stops trying to kill him realizing that Wemmbu is better at PvP than him. 

He convinces PrinceZam to give Wemmbu his looting sword. Wemmbu and eggchan leave. Wemmbu comes back to his base and sees it is destroyed by the orbital cannon.

PrinceZam goes over to Wemmbu’s base and tries to kill him. PrinceZam now has maxed enchanted diamond armor. He shows PrinceZam that if he gets close to killing him, ClownPierce will interrupt it. He proves this by taking off all his armor, and ClownPierce plays a sound saying that the next round of juggernaut is going to happen. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to team again to escape the prison. They use a TNT minecart to pop Ferre's totem of undying, and he is teleported out. ClownPierce says that he now knows about a potential escape plan.

A bunch of new members are put into the prison and PrinceZam tries to recruit them. These players include [[_Kenadian_]], [[SykerMC]], [[Loppezz]], [[LuckyMixx]], [[Dol9hin]], and [[Spepticle]]. They both leave.

PrinceZam and his teammates comes over to Wemmbu and try to kill them. Eventually they leave. Wemmbu and his team set up a stasis chamber using honey. Wemmbu puts his pearl in the stasis chamber. ClownPierce starts activating people’s stasis chambers to trap them in the prison. Wemmbu is the only one who is able to escape using an ender pearl cannon.

Wemmbu breaks out the people in the Proton prison by giving them contraband items.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam are trapped by ClownPierce in an escape room made by [[Wato1876]]. While solving the escape room, they obtain the servers last mace. After escaping, they make it to the end where ClownPierce is there to get their mace. Wemmbu gives ClownPierce the last mace.

Wemmbu sees a couple of players flying up. He decides to follow them and finds the [[Skyblock Civilization]]. He finds a player named Pangi who brings him to [[Yeah_Jaron]], their leader. He says that he has to be a citizen or die. Wemmbu tries to escape, but is caught by [[Straight]]. Wemmbu is forced to do tasks.

Wemmbu and Straight fight in a sumo duel which decides if Wemmbu is let free or not. Wemmbu loses the sumo fight. Wemmbu does more tasks for the civilization. Wemmbu spies on the members talking about himself in the castle. Wemmbu says that he just saw people flying up. They go down to see what Wemmbu was talking about. Once down, [[The Invisible Mafia]] finds and begins attacking them. 

They are able to kill two of the members, but the third member escapes. They go back to skyblock civilization, and Wemmbu smuggles in an ender chest. While helping Pangi with building a drowned farm, Wemmbu messages Loppezz to come over and distract him. While distracted, Wemmbu and Wato1876 go to the storage and see they have materials not normally possible to obtain in normal Minecraft Skyblock. Wemmbu convinces some of the members to distract Pangi and says it’s his birthday. Straight finds Wemmbu at the back of the castle. Wemmbu says he was building an extra part to the castle. He goes into the inside part of the castle. 

He spies on Yeah_Jaron and Straight having a conversation. Wemmbu talks to Straight about how there are tons of items not normally obtainable in skyblock that they have. The civilization uses an ender pearl to go down to the normal world. They go over to [[The End Civilization]] which has been raided by the mafia. Wemmbu and the team pretend to be one of the mafia members. Their invisibility runs out and they start getting killed. The mafia members escape.

They go over to Capital City and find more Invis Mafia members, and another fight breaks out. They are able to escape from them.

Yeah_Jaron tells Wemmbu that there is a traitor. Jaron gives him a mace. Wemmbu exposes Yeah_Jaron for having items you are not normally able to get in skyblock, and says he is just trying to control the players. Wemmbu leaves the meeting. He sees that Straight has been with the Mafia the entire time. Wemmbu leaves and the Mafia destroys the civilization.

Wemmbu pays ManePear a mace to teach him how to fight. They raid a Mafia base that contains a large amount of items. They then raid another one.

ManePear fights Wemmbu to train him. Wemmbu fights a gold tier mafia member as practice. Wemmbu meets up with Spoke for a deal. Wemmbu helps Spoke get an elytra, and Spoke helps Wemmbu find Mafia members. In the Zam empire, Wemmbu spots an invisible player. He uses their totem of undying, revealing it is eggchan.

Wemmbu and eggchan go over to an ice mountain, and find some players from the sky civilization. The Mafia begins attacking them. One of the diamond tier players and Wemmbu agree to have a 1v1. The other Mafia members join into the fight because Wemmbu uses a restock shulker box, and he eventually retreats.

ManePear gives Wemmbu back his mace. ManePear has them kill the mafia members in the mountain. They are able to kill the gold tier players. They see ManePear fighting a diamond tier player. The mafia member escapes. ManePear helps him learn how to use the mace.

Spoke gives ManePear a wind charge enchantment book. ManePear tries to convince Wemmbu to give him the mace. ManePear tells the mafia about eggchan breaking the rules of the mafia, so his stasis chamber is activated. Wemmbu tries to break eggchan out of prison, and uses the totem of undying of one of the Mafia members, revealing that they are FlameFrags. After an instense 1V1, Wemmbu gives Flame the mace so that he doesn’t kill eggchan. FlameFrags gives the mace to ClownPierce.

ClownPierce and FerreMC destroy ManePear’s tree. Wemmbu and eggchan escape by going into the Nether. They agree to team with Parrot to kill ClownPierce and together, they kill a diamond player by trapping them in an obsidian box, granting Wemmbu a mace. Wemmbu says that he was the one who killed the diamond tier player, and that Parrot and Wifies didn’t help. Wemmbu leaves.

Wemmbu tries to kill ClownPierce and FerreMC but fails. Ferre threatens to kill eggchan if Wemmbu doesn’t let ClownPierce kill him. Ferre fails to kill eggchan and he escapes. They almost kill Ferre by breaking all of his armor. Ferre gives them their mace to not die.

Wemmbu distracts the mafia while Parrot, Spoke, and Mapicc break into the spawn prison. They eventually go inside of the prison and find Parrot. Everyone goes back to the base. Parrot tells them that Wifies died. The mafia starts killing them.

Wemmbu, Wato1876, and Eggchan distract ClownPierce by trying to kill him while Spoke and Mapicc destory the Mafia's stasis chambers. They eventually leave by using a fishing rod stasis. Spoke and Mapicc successfully end the Mafia.

=== [[Season 2]] ===
Wemmbu and eggchan travel millions of blocks out to make a base. TheobaldTheBird secretly follows them as he wants to PvP someone. TheobaldTheBird leaves after destroying their base. Wemmbu and eggchan set up a trap with the creaking. TheobaldTheBird destroys their base again. _Kenadian_ helps Wemmbu and eggchan make their base more secure. 

TheobaldTheBird breaks into the base and tries to kill Wemmbu. TheobaldTheBird threatens to kill _Kenadian_ if Wemmbu doesn’t have a fair fight with him. TheobaldTheBird eventually runs from the fight. Wemmbu leaves the base.

Wemmbu goes over to some people and steals their bottles of enchanting. Later, while Wemmbu and eggchan are building a creeper farm, a group of players come over and try to kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu kills almost the entire team. Wemmbu invites Wato1876 to his small empire that Wemmbu and Eggchan are building at ManePear’s tree.

Wemmbu and eggchan go to Pangi’s base. Pangi gives them free bottles of enchanting. Wemmbu see's Spongs being robbed by Jaden_MAN and his team. Wemmbu saves Spongs.

Wemmbu goes back to the base and sees that Horace_Altman greatly improved the empire. Wemmbu steals two shulker boxes of bottles of enchanting from a group of players. Wemmbu sees that eggchan invited Spongs to the civilization. Wemmbu follows Spongs and sees that he goes over to a pirate themed base. Wemmbu comes back to the civilization. Jaden_MAN and his team threaten to kill eggchan if Wemmbu does not drop all of his stuff and leaves all of it in his ender chest.

Jaden_MAN exiles Wemmbu to his Pirate Civilization. Two pirates try to kill Wemmbu but fail. Wemmbu finds eggchan who was captured by three pirates. Wemmbu kills the pirates and frees eggchan.

Wemmbu and eggchan find two players in diamond armor. They try to loot the items in their house, but the two players, loppezz and [[LettuceK]] find them. Wemmbu and eggchan threaten to blow up their entire house if they don’t give them their gear.

A team of pirates try to kill Wemmbu and eggchan. Wemmbu and eggchan are captured. Wemmbu finds an ender chest and uses his mace in it to kill the pirates.

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN and tries to kill him. While fighting him, someone bombs Jaden’s castle. TheobaldTheBird tells Wemmbu and eggchan that he was secretly helping him. Wemmbu and TheobaldTheBird try to kill Jaden_MAN.

Wemmbu and eggchan follow Jaden_MAN down a hole into an abandoned underground civilization. Wemmbu is given mining fatigue. They try to kill Jaden_MAN, but he leads them into a hoard of wardens and escapes. Wemmbu and eggchan are able to escape the wardens.

Wemmbu and eggchan see Jaden_MAN trying to escape but manage to stop him from escaping. Jaden manages to get away. Wemmbu and eggchan go up a spire to try and find Jaden_MAN. eggchan finds a book that says that the civilization held a vote to seal themselves off from the outside world.

eggchan accidentally activates a trap, causing a large number of wardens to drop down and start attacking them. Wemmbu escapes the warden and at the top of the spire they find a player named [[Rejoicin]]. Rejoicin explains that he was a guard for the spire to protect it against the Mafia.

Wemmbu and eggchan find Jaden in an armory. Because Jaden is more geared, they run away. They manage to trap Jaden between two iron doors. Wemmbu and eggchan find a villager trading hall and enchant their gear.

Wemmbu and eggchan lead wardens over to Jaden to try and kill him, but see he escaped from his trap. Wemmbu and eggchan find loppezz in the civilization and invite them into their team.

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN killing elder guardians and tries to kill him. Jaden almost kills Wemmbu, but Rejoicin stops the fight and tries to convince them to be friends. Jaden starts attacking Rejoicin. They try to kill Jaden but he escapes.

Wemmbu and eggchan learn that the civilization was going to have a vote to decide if they were going to go to the surface in a book, but the next page after that is blank. The team finds Jaden_MAN at a trap near a warden factory. Rejoicin is killed by a warden.

The team finds an elytra. Using the elytra and a mace, Wemmbu uses all of Jaden’s totems. Wemmbu takes all of his items, removes all of the chorus fruit in the civilization, and traps him underground. Wemmbu and the team leaves.

Wemmbu stops wearing his armor due to it having trims which is rare on the server, and he wants to avoid being robbed. Wemmbu and Eggchan see who tries to rob him, but Wemmbu kills him. Wemmbu and eggchan get gear. Wemmbu and eggchan find a group of players who try to kill them. They are able to kill them using a mace. They find a new group of players and steal two of their cows for leather. They find Wemmbu and try to kill him, but he eventually manages to escape. Wemmbu comes back and kills the players using his mace and an elytra.

Wemmbu later gears up to try to kill FlameFrags but he fails.

Wemmbu finds the abandoned [[BAT Headquarters]]. A team of players are hired to kill Wemmbu, including an invisible player in full netherite armor. The players try to kill him using an arrow cannon but fail. Wemmbu follows one of the players back to their base and threatens to kill their pets unless they give information on the invisible player who tried to kill Wemmbu. The invisible player tries to kill Wemmbu but fails.

Wemmbu goes over to a base and finds invisible players in netherite armor. Two invisible players try to kill Wemmbu but fail. Wemmbu kills both of the players and obtains a lodestone compass from one of them. Wemmbu follows the compass to the abandoned [[Mafia City]]. Wemmbu finds the invisible player who tried to kill him and the player reveals himself to be [[Wyll|WyLL_]]. Wyll tells Wemmbu that if he kills the last remaining person who paid him to hunt Wemmbu, he'll stop hunting him down. However, after Wemmbu kills the player, Wyll decides to trap him to try and kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu flies over to a void trap that was made at the BAT Headquarters for Parrot and uses it to escape from the void and survive.

Wemmbu sneaks back into Mafia City and pretends to be one of Wyll's invisible henchmen, and takes a large amount of items. After Wyll finds out which one is Wemmbu, they attempt to kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu is able to kill his guards, and Wyll is forced to escape using a fishing rod stasis chamber.

Wemmbu helps loppezz kill people who are taking over [[Ice Mountain Civilization]]. He almost kills them, but loppezz advises for Wemmbu to stop after they threaten to blow up the entire mountain. Wemmbu and loppezz come back in and are trapped by one of the raiders. After escaping, they discover that there actually is a large amount of TNT in the base.

Wemmbu and loppezz try to break into the base to defuse the explosives using water, but are spotted by another player. They are able to escape. Wemmbu goes alone into the mountain to assassinate Fantst. Fantst explodes the entire base. Wemmbu tries to kill Fantst but he is able to escape. 

Wemmbu travels to a stronghold to go to the end to get elytras and sell them to get rich. Upon entering a stronghold, he finds out there are people living in there. He meets Baablu in the stronghold. Baablu tells him not to enter the portal because someone is keeping it for themselves. Baablu wants Wemmbu to respawn the ender dragon but he needs end crystals. Wemmbu and Baablu set their stasis' and head to a vault. They find the end crystals in the vault and leave the vault using the stasis chamber. 

Wemmbu goes in the end and meets [[MinuteTech]]. Minute asks why Wemmbu is in the end. Wemmbu tells Minute he has to respawn the ender dragon. Wemmbu attempts to respawn the ender dragon but Minute wont let him so he tries to kill Minute. During the fight, Wemmbu spawns withers to distract Minute. Baablu enters the end to fight Minute. Minute warns Wemmbu about what he's about to do but Wemmbu respawns the dragon anyways. Wemmbu helps Baablu to try to kill Minute now that he successfully respawned the dragon until Fantst appears and begins attacking Wemmbu. Baablu reveals that he was just using Wemmbu to respawn the dragon.

Wemmbu and Minute team up and head to the outer end islands. Minute explains that Baablu wanted to respawn the ender dragon so that they can duplicate them and destroy spawn completely. Wemmbu and Minute realize they could've won the fight if they didn't waste their resources fighting each other. They then get jumped by members of Fantst's team and they try to escape the fight due to minimal resources, but they are followed. Wemmbu and Minute manage to kill all of them except for one. 

Wemmbu and Minute search for an un-looted end city and after traveling 100k blocks away from the main end island, they find two un-looted end cities, one of them with a ship. They take the items from the end city, but they were followed. They are then jumped by Fantst, Baablu, and the rest of the team. Wemmbu and Minute are able to escape.

Wemmbu and Minute notice there are now 3 ender dragons. Wemmbu maces one of them and almost kills it. Fantst and Baablu escape.

Wemmbu participates in a PVP tournament hosted by [[AJTHEBOLD]]. The point of the tournament is to determine who is the strongest player in PvP. Each player has 3 totems. If all of them are used, their stasis is pulled and they are disqualified. Elytra's are not allowed in the fight.

The first fight is Wemmbu vs [[Epaxial]]. Wemmbu is able to win the fight.

Horace begins cleaning up the arena, and Wemmbu gives him his pickaxe to help. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he will be fighting him the next round, which is proven to be correct. Wyll has access to stacks of god apples and slow falling arrows, making the fight very difficult for Wemmbu. Wemmbu is able to beat Wyll.

Wemmbu watches the other matches and everyone is dismissed into the festival. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he's going to fight [[Conexion]] next and gives him advice on how he can win against Sharpness.

Wemmbu fights Sharpness in an ice arena. Wemmbu is able to defeat Conexion.

Wemmbu fights Flame, but is unable to defeat him.

Wemmbu goes to the location of eggchan, where he last logged off. Conexion tells Wemmbu to fight him and he proceeds in doing so. Conexion places a pot and steals one of Wemmbu's maces and runs away. Wemmbu tries chasing him but Conexion teleports away using an ender pearl stasis chamber. Wemmbu asks 4CVIT if he knows the location of Conexion. 4CVIT shows him an ender pearl cannon that he was commissioned to build, leading to the beginning of the farlands.

Wemmbu and Eggchan begin exploring the farlands until they spot Sharpness next to the [[Far Lands|Far Lands City]]. Conexion almost kills Wemmbu while they are in a confined space, but Wemmbu is able to escape. 

Wemmbu and eggchan notice that not only do firework rockets don't no longer work once you are a certain distance in the farlands, but they cannot access anything in their Ender Chests. They notice a house and some glitched chests, however, the chests don't have anything valuable, so they continue exploring. As they continue exploring, they notice more glitched terrain as well as glitched versions of old structures. They notice another house this time with someone living in it. They ask the person if they knew where Conexion was. They tell them the direction that Conexion went. 

As soon as they arrive they see a completely intact version of Zam Empire, before it was blown up by Wemmbu. They begin exploring the empire until they find echoes of past players, specifically of Pangi, ManePear, FlameFrags, Sorhin and PrinceZam. 

Wemmbu and Conexion have a fight. Right before Wemmbu dies, he puts his mace in his ender chest. Conexion breaks the ender chest and tells Wemmbu to meet back up in 30 minutes to resume the fight, then leaves. Wemmbu is able to craft a new ender chest, meaning he is able to use his mace again, and Conexion and Wemmbu fight again. Conexion puts his mace in his ender chest right before dying, causing Wemmbu to stop fighting him. 

Wemmbu explores deeper within the Farlands. A team lead by FlameFrags, called [[The Avengers]], consisting of enemies of Wemmbu, try to kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu is able to escape. 

Wemmbu and eggchan find a temple with two players, one of them being named Lakerek. Wemmbu decides to fight Lakerek. Lakerek uses orbital strike cannons throughout the fight. Lakerek eventually takes off his armor, and Wemmbu kills him. Wemmbu is told of a place called the [[The Forge|Forge]]. The Avengers, now without FlameFrags, try to kill Wemmbu. The Avengers eventually runs away. Later, the Avengers once again tries to kill Wemmbu, but fails, as FlameFrags betrays them, using Conexion's mace to kill them. Flame then gives the mace back to Wemmbu.

Wemmbu and eggchan find a naturally generating trial chamber with ominous vaults still inside. Wemmbu and eggchan destroy the ominous vaults. A player named [[Nitenly]] tries to kill them multiple times, but fails. Wemmbu and Eggchan keep traveling and bridging across void until they reach a palace. The players there claim to not know about the Forge. Wemmbu and eggchan find a large amount of orbital strike cannons, which is seemingly the Forge, though Serpentbound333 claims it is not the Forge. The players attempt to send Wemmbu into the end dimension by hitting him through the portal, but accidentally hit eggchan into the portal instead, effectively trapping eggchan in the end due to his spawn being set in the farlands. Wemmbu is able to kill some of the players, with the others running away. Wemmbu takes a large amount of orbital strike cannon fishing rods, and leaves.

The Law attempts to capture Wemmbu due to him allegedly stealing items from members of Capital City. Wemmbu assumes that someone is impersonating him. He creates a secret base to spy on players. He is eventually able to find a player with the same trims as him. Wemmbu asks them about why they are impersonating them, and they do not answer. The invisible player is able to escape.

Wemmbu finds eggchan and tells him not to say what his identity is if someone claims to be him.

Wemmbu goes to Boosfer to tell him not to reveal his identity to the other player. Wemmbu attempts to kill the invisible player, and a second invisible player is seen, referred to as "agent 22". They attempt to escape using a happy ghast, which Wemmbu kills.

Eggchan tells Wemmbu about something that’ll happen in the Capital City courtroom. Wemmbu travels to the courtroom. The invisible players, revealed to be ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird, fight Wemmbu. Parrot reveals that he is trying to reveal his identity. While Wemmbu tries to escape, Theo continues to persuade Wemmby to tell his identity. Promising that he wouldn't tell a soul. Wemmbu doesn't listen and continues trying to escape. Parrot teleports back in and traps Wemmbu in a box, the plan being to wait for his invis to run out. Wemmbu is eventually able to escape using an enderpearl glitch and runs away.

Wemmbu is still running from Parrot. Wemmbu resorted to use his elytra, accepting the risks of being recognized due to the bright purple colored elytra. He lands on top of a peak and waits for Parrot and Theo to arrive, hoping to kill them. Wemmbu questions why Parrot is fighting him, Parrot stating that it was all for Boomie to which Wemmbu snaps at him saying that he wasn't innocent. That he attacked [[Capital City (season 2)|Capital City]] with Boosfer. Wemmbu continues talking, he knows that Parrot is smart and would almost certainly unmask him one day but Parrot jumps back on the subject of Boomie to which Wemmbu ignores. 

Wemmbu gives them an ultimatum, leave him alone and he'd let them live or continue hunting him and they would die. Theo laughs and Parrot decides to continue hunting him. Then Wemmbu flies down to continue attacking them. After using his orbital strikes Parrot and Theo try to run, Wemmbu gives them one last chance and Theo uses a stasis and teleports away.

Wemmbu decides to return to the stronghold planning to go to the End to meet up with Eggchan. He finds some enderchests in the stronghold and takes them due to Parrot and Theo stealing his last enderchest. He still decided to enter the End and finds Parrot before going to the portal. Wemmbu instantly attacks Parrot but Parrot stops him, telling Wemmbu that he would never stop hunting him. Parrot hands Wemmbu a milk bucket, giving him a choice to reveal his identity now or face death in the near future but Wemmbu refuses, going to attack Parrot once again.

Wemmbu follows Parrot through a tunnel until they reach an obsidian box with with pressure plates and no way out. Wemmbu decides that this was the perfect location to kill them off. Wemmbu fight Theo and Parrot with Theo trying to use slow falling to try to stop Wemmbu from using the mace, to which he was unsuccessful. Wemmbu decided it was better to now escape. Theo continues to convince Wemmbu to reveal his identity, trying to calm the situation using words.

Wemmbu is successfully able to escape using enderpearls once again. He discovers that he's by the [[BAT Headquarters|BAT base]], a base he had visited before and it had potions. Wemmbu is able to use find invis pots and continues to hide his identity. Theo and Wemmbu fight for a while until Wemmbu spots an enderpearl cannon, which could be his ticket out of the ongoing fight.

He rushes towards the cannon and uses it, only to be teleport to a dome where he's standing on a platform, opposite of him is Parrot. Parrot explains what happened, also revealing that Parrot had discovered his identity. He continues, telling Wemmbu what happened. While Parrot talks, Wemmbu tries to find an escape. Thats when Wemmbu found out that Parrot had been hired by [[FlameFrags|Flamefrags]], Wemmbu's rival. Parrot questions why Wemmbu did this, why he faked his death and why he went undercover. Wemmbu doesn't listen and asks Parrot why he was so confident that Wemmbu wouldn't just kill Parrot now. To which Parrot reveals that he brought a little friend. 

Behind Wemmbu, Flamefrags appears. He teleports to the other platform, joining Parrot by his side. Wemmbu still tries to deny the proof, lying through his teeth, saying that he isn't Wemmbu. Wemmbu throws a windcharge and it flies through the powdered snow, going perfectly to Parrot's plan, the windcharge traverses the lava and hits the TNT and ignite it. The explosion kills the hidden dogs revealing Wemmbu's identity. (This plan coming from Wifies, who used the same trick of dogs to make Parrot believe that he was dead)

Wemmbu lands on the platform with Parrot, questioning the avian on why he did this. Parrot doesn't listen and requests Flamefrags to uphold his part of the deal to which Flamefrags complies and hands him a book, then Parrot tells Wemmbu to take off his invis. Wemmbu drinks the milk in his inventory, revealing his identity to the two. Wemmbu questions Parrot's choice again after Parrot and Flamefrags celebrate, Parrot replies with that he had to tie up lose ends, that they clearly didn't like each other to which Wemmbu shoots back, asking when has he not liked Parrot. 

Parrot continues and Wemmbu uses a windcharge to blow him off, he turns to Flamefrags asking him why. Flamefrags responds stating that Wemmbu was spreading that he was the strongest, Wemmbu protests saying it was Eggchan. The argument results into Flamefrags challenging Wemmbu to a fight.

They begin fighting. Wemmbu flies up and sees hundreds of lawmen approaching. Wemmbu and FlameFrags agree to fight the law together before fighting each other again. They defeat the lawmen on hand and go back to fighting each other. After several fights being interrupted by LettuceK's lawmen, the two agree to work together to deal with the lawmen before they continue their fight. Wemmbu and Flame go to the Law base and command Lettuce to send every single lawman he has at them all at once, as the small squads clearly do nothing but fail. The two then chose a location for the battle, waiting for Lettuce to show up with his army.  

After a while, the Law horn blows as Letty and his army of one thousand players pull up, wemmbu orbital strikes them several times, killing a decent amount of them, and he and Flame get into it, slowly making their way through the thousand players. They even encounter players with elytras and maces, which is surprisong and causes some small difficulties. Finally, the entire army has been dispatched. Flame throws away the elytra and mace ge got from wemmbu, who had killed one of the elytra-macers to get them, and proceeds to launch an attack on wemmbu.

He and wemmbu duel, Flame using his dogs until he realises Wemmbu is spending more time getting rid of them than fighting Flame and then killing off the dogs so Wemmbu will focus on him. Wemmbu uses a stab shot and misses. After some time, Wemmbu falls into the hole from the stab shot and Wemmbu decides that flame can be the best after thinking about their rivalry for a while. Flame leaves rather akwardly.

Wemmbu throws away a random third mace he's aquired during the fight, but LettuceK swoops in and grabs it (the mace is then named Executioner, see [[Maces]] page for more info), and arrests Wemmbu on the spot.

Wemmbu stashes some of his gear in his e-chest and follows Lettuce to the prison, where he finds out that a "certain fallen emperor" known as PrinceZam, along with Baablu and Fanst, all of which are old enemies of his, are also stuck in the prison. He is told to put on a prison jumpsuit layer on his skin (see the "imprisoned" skin in the main Wemmbu tab) and is kept locked in a cell when he's not doing various menial tasks in the prison. He is brought to the Northern Council at one point to be shown off to the server population. Wemmbu is then used as LettuceK's bargaining chip to become King of the server. After Lettuce finishes his speech, they return to the prison, where an invisible player splashes Wemmbu with invisibility, allowing him to escape. He seeks refuge in a random chungy's house before being caught and brought back and promptly inventory checked. Because of his escape, Lettuce then enacts a new protocol with curse of binding copper armor to be put on all prisoners. Wemmbu is sent into solitary confinement where [[SpokeIsHere]] appears before Wemmbu, revealing he was the invisible player from earlier. He makes an offer to Wemmbu where he frees big W in exchange for a favor from him. Wemmbu declines, however Spoke tells Wemmbu that the offer is still on if he decides to change his mind, curious of how he will escape. A week later, Wemmbu is let out of solitary. He plots an escape. The prisoners begin a day of tree chopping. Later, the other prisoners ragebait lopezzz so hard Wemmbu gets the chance to smuggle a few items past the inventory check. The next day, lopezzz brings the Law's very own Friedrich von Steuben, [[SargeRaxby]]. Wemmbu begins talking and planning with Zam using signs while [[Fantst]] and [[Baablu]] begin their grueling training. [editors pick it up from here my arms hurt]
