title: Wifies/History
content:
History 
 Season 1 
Parrot invites Wifies to help him find a secret. Parrot finds a music disc with a texture pack that was put there by Spoke. He listens to the disc, which gives him a set of coordinates to go to. Parrot finds a medieval castle and opens the door by having him and Wifies step on two pressure plates. They obtain a disc and fly out as the castle is exploding to TNT.

Spoke sends Parrot another texture pack, so Parrot plays the disc and it says that he has to "follow the light". Parrot assumes this means to go to the Zam Empire. He sees Wemmbu, and after a bit of chatting with Wemmbu, PrinceZam comes over. Wemmbu and PrinceZam are eager to get information about what is happening, as it has to do with Spoke. Wifies and Parrot fly over to the castle. Parrot almost dies multiple times as Wemmbu and PrinceZam attacks them, but eventually they’re able to escape. He waits for them to leave, and then sees that the lighthouse’s redstone lamp is blinking in morse code. The morse code comes out as -64.

They find a stairway in the lighthouse to the coordinates -64, and open a chest which contains a music disc. The disc tells them to bring flight duration three rockets, and not flight duration one. They have to travel 2000 blocks north. They decide not to bring flight duration three rockets, as they realize that one flight duration one rocket can travel super far. They get to the coordinates and find a void base made out of chest minecarts and shulker mobs, however they realize that the opening is sealed with obsidian. They go back to the old opening, but realize that it has now been sealed with cobblestone and obsidian. They go back to the void base to try and figure out what to do. Parrot realizes that using a fishing rod, he can probably help Wifies to travel more distance with his limited firework rockets.

They go back to the old opening, and place a crafting table on the block where they broke a cobblestone. Parrot crafts a fishing rod, and uses that to fishing rod Wifies all the way to a separate base 5000 blocks out. They make it out of the void through a different void hole someone else made.

They use the disc which gives a code. Parrot figures out that this is the code to PrinceZam's vault. They break into PrinceZam’s castle and take the lodestone compass and disc.

They play the disc, and it says that it’s "pretty straight forward" and that this riddle gets "pretty straight to the point", with the riddle itself being "lodestone". They follow the compass to a lodestone in an ice spikes biome. They eventually find a chest that contains another lodestone compass. They follow the compass to a parkour ice mountain. There’s a person in full netherite armor with the chestplate and leggings being trimmed with redstone. This person is SpokeIsHere, but Parrot and Wifies don’t know that. He signals for them to put their items in two chests. They oblige and do the parkour.

After finishing the parkour, the guard gives them a music disc and lodestone compass along with their stuff. They play the disc and begin the next challenge. They follow the compass to a massive obsidian structure. The guard places the two chests so Wifies and Parrot put their items in there again. They go into the obsidian maze, and discover that there are people in it. These people are Wemmbu and PrinceZam. Wemmbu finds them in the maze while they have nothing. They agree to lead Wemmbu to the next clue.

Since Wemmbu did not have the texture pack, it would be useless to him. After PrinceZam and Wemmbu get the jukebox and disc, Wifies and Parrot leave, successfully scamming them. They go to PrinceZam’s empire to see if they hid the disc, so they break into the vault and get the disc and a turtle egg, although getting close to death. They escape into the nether, but Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them. They convince PrinceZam and Wemmbu to go into the overworld so they can team up, but after Wemmbu and PrinceZam go into the overworld, they mine out of the nether cave and escape.

They use the turtle egg to get to a shipwreck, where the guard signals them to put away their stuff. They’re given five water breathing potions, and a turtle shell. They go into the giant ship and use the clues they are given to discover an underground area covered with sculk, sculk sensors, and sculk shriekers. Luckily, wardens don’t spawn with man-made sculk shriekers, which allows them to obtain the next disc and a lodestone compass.

They travel to the coordinates the lodestone compass is pointing to, a jungle temple. They take the music disc and leave. The disc says to go to the coordinates 5000 5000 in the nether. The guard tells them to put away their items. They go through a nether portal which leads to an escape room with multiple wardens. They eventually manage to escape.

They find themselves in a badlands biome, however it’s actually enclosed in an obsidian box, and no mobs spawn. They explore the area and find a couple of useful items. They also find a cave spider spawner. Using slime block launchers and blocks they obtained from underneath sugarcane, they’re able to get into a new room. They go back into the badlands biome as they’re probably missing something. They come back with more wool blocks, and finally escape with their items.

Parrot and Wifies go back to Parrot’s house, where they find the guard, who reveals that they’re Spoke. Spoke says that only one person can uncover the secret, and that the other person will be banned off the server. He has them put all of their gear into the chests. They go down two different staircases. They go head to head in six challenges. After these challenges are completed, they’re tied 3 - 3. The final game they play is chess. Spoke shows a red line, which is a chunk ban for whoever loses.

Parrot talks to Wifies and plans to end the game as a stalemate. They go through with the plan, playing out the chess game and ending it with a stalemate. Spoke says that somebody has to be banned. Wifies steps on the red line, banning himself.

Parrot and Rekrap2 attempt to break Wifies out of the chunk ban.

Parrot and a team of people including _Kenadian_ are able to break Wifies out of prison. Spoke is also broken out of the prison.

Parrot and Wifies find ClownPierce who has been sent to assassinate Parrot, in a carnival. This is where he plans to have a fair 1v1 with Parrot. Parrot and Wifies 2v1 ClownPierce. They get mining fatigue meaning that they can't break out and have to fight ClownPierce. Leow0ok, Willsion, and Woogiex, enemies of ClownPierce break Parrot and Wifies out before they die. JumperWho and Derapchu are also teamed with them and are enemies of ClownPierce. They bring Parrot and Wifies to their base. Parrot and Wifies are sent to ClownPierce’s castle to blow it up. Parrot and Wifies manage to escape.

Leow0ok agrees with Parrot and Wifies to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, FerreMC, and Mugm_ come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues.

Parrot and Wifies try to find the escape. They figure out how to make it through the first two layers of the escape room. ClownPierce and his team break in. They hide in the second layer of the prison area. ClownPierce and his team find the second layer. Parrot and Wifies find the exit labeled B5.

Parrot and Wifies go to Leow0ok and his team to argue about how they were abandoned in the vault. Wifies comes to his base and sees that ClownPierce blew up the terrain around it. Parrot flies away to Wemmbu’s colony. ClownPierce eventually leaves after being unable to find Parrot.

Parrot and Wifies train for fighting ClownPierce. Parrot, Wifies, and the players against ClownPierce set up chunk bans at his castle. The team ambushes ClownPierce and his team. Unable to kill anybody, they leave and go back to the base. They see that the base has been completely destroyed.

They go over to BranzyCraft’s base to try and negotiate with him to tell ClownPierce to stop trying to kill Parrot. Parrot leaves to find a better team.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok’s team to help him kidnap Branzy, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Parrot leaves to a jungle and starts building a base there. Wifies is able to find Parrot. He tries to convince him to come back and defeat ClownPierce. ClownPierce and FerreMC find his jungle base and destroy it. Parrot runs away.

Parrot comes back to Wemmbu’s empire and sees it is destroyed. He goes over to ClownPierce’s castle with the team, and starts destroying his castle. He tells ClownPierce he wants to 1v1 him. Parrot goes over to Branzy’s base to kill him, but changes his mind after talking with Branzy and Wifies about it.

Parrot fights ClownPierce in a 1v1. He has secretly made a trap with 30,000 TNT. Parrot is unable to kill ClownPierce with his trap. Parrot discovers ClownPierce blew up Leow0ok’s teams headquarters secret meeting room.

Parrot discovers a book in his house. The book says to meet him at specific coordinates, and it has been written by ClownPierce. He thinks this book might have the answers to why certain players have disappeared from the server. Parrot and Wifies go to these coordinates and find two players, Jaden_MAN and Spongs, who call themselves the game masters. They state that for the quest, they can only use items that they give them, and they can not cheat. They tell them to get a heart of the sea and bring it back to them. They can only use iron gear for this. They go into an underwater trial and are able to get a lodestone compass.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find Parrot and Wifies while they follow the lodestone compass. They try to intercept the hunt, but Parrot and Wifies escape using invisibility. They find two ships, which appear to be ClownPierce themed. They use the clue they find at the ships which say to go to where the winds meet. They find an escape room and quickly solve it and obtain the heart of the sea. They realize that Derapchu’s most prized possession is a heart of the sea, meaning that each item will probably correlate to one of the missing players.

The next quest is to get a pair of netherite boots, which would make sense because netherite boots are one of JumperWho’s most prized possessions. They find a giant mountain which leads into the clouds, and go inside. They are given five tasks to help the town in the sky, which are found in a book. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find them again. He edits the book to get rid of some clues, and then gives the book to them. After they do all the tasks, they tell Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ that the hot air balloons are in an arrow, and that they have to follow the arrow. This is a lie. After they leave, they figure out that by flicking a certain lever, it activates a bunch of flying machines which look like flying lanterns. They find the netherite boots in a chest, and they leave.

They go to Boosfers base, who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince him not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

The next quest is to get a poppy. They find a giant field of flowers, and they have to find which one is the poppy. They eventually find the poppy. They accidentally dig under the poppy and find a giant underground forest. They find a very long cave and follow it. It’s made out of only stone.

Eventually they find a valley. Following the valley, they find a giant tree. Inside of the tree, they find an escape room. After solving the escape room, they get a riddle. As they read that, Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ come over to the tree and start griefing it. They burn the tree. They see Parrot in leather armor, and Parrot runs away and hides. They are able to find Parrot and Wifies.

Parrot gives them a fake riddle. They figure out that it’s a fake riddle, but Wifies has already secured the item in his ender chest. Parrot and Wifies realize this is Rekrap2’s base. Boosfer and his team leave. They figure out this is a save haven for the passive animals, so they start to move all the animals out. While moving the animals, they see multiple massive TNT bomber planes coming. This is because Boosfer paid Wemmbu to destroy the valley. After moving the animals inside of mountains so they don’t get blown up, they build up using melons. Wemmbu spawns withers. Using the melons, they try to stop the planes. Wemmbu finds them and after a bit, they agree to team to steal Boosfer and his team’s items.

Parrot and Wifies go to the next quest, and they find a sculk themed escape room. They make it through the escape room and find a cave. After following the cave, they find an ancient city. The clue says that the key to the vault is the heart of a warden. This implies they have to kill a warden. They plan to use dripstone to kill the warden. After killing it, they make it through the vault and get a diamond. They put the diamond in the item frame at the base, however Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find the diamond and steal it. They steal all of the items Parrot and Wifies obtained.

Wemmbu, Parrot, and Wifies go to the headquarters to blow it up. They build an orbital cannon to destroy the base. After flying to the base, they activate the orbital cannon, completely destroying the top layer of the base. They use TNT and spawn withers to destroy the base. Wemmbu finds a stash of netherite blocks and diamond blocks and they steal all the items.

In the nether, Parrot and Wifies find a bunch of nether quartz which appears to be morse code. It says 090.256 rurple. They go to the next coordinates and find a sign that says 840.32 cyan. They next find a chest which has items in it. They find that the items in the chest probably mean 670.5 brown. They find a sign under lava that says 960.18 pink. On the nether roof they find a sign saying 390.43 blue. They find a giant castle and go inside using striders.

Parrot and Wifies use the numbers they found to find books. After finding all the books, they bring it to the vault and input the books. In the vault they find the item, a wither rose.

Parrot and Wifies move onto the next quest, which is to go to the end. They go to the end with almost no items. In the end, they find an escape room-like obstacle course. After finishing the course, the book they find says "+ +". They end up finding an end city, and inside is Wifies's prized dragon head. Right before going through the end portal to escape, they find Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to kill Parrot and Wifies, but they escape to the outer islands.

Parrot and Wifies find an ender chest and get the gear from their ender chest. They go back to the main island, and try to kill them. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ run away, so Parrot and Wifies leave.

Parrot and Wifies go back to the base, and find ClownPierce. They ask ClownPierce why people have been missing, but he says he doesn’t know. Parrot puts his last item, the spyglass, in the item frame.

Parrot and Wifies are trapped by ClownPierce in a prison called Proton. Inside of the prison, they are given a small world with resources in it, although they have no items. They purposefully went into the prison to try and break some of their friends out. They realize no mobs are spawning in the prison. Wifies tries to go to a green section of the prison, but when he walks into the area, he gets chunk banned.

Wifies comes over to Parrot after being un-chunk banned by a guard. They see in a map that someone wrote S.O.S. in morse code. They communicate using morse code in maps. A guard comes in and moves Parrot to a new cell.

Wifies finds Parrot. They find a wandering trader who sells sand. Parrot is moved into the next cell. Parrot plans to make a stasis chamber to escape.

Parrot sees Wifies and tells him about his plan to escape.

Parrot gives everybody in the cell, including Wifies, contraband items. Parrot ender pearls to every cell and gives everyone ender chests.

The prisoners go into the control room invisible, and pretend to be guards. JumperWho escapes from solitary confinement. Kenadian builds three wither bores and a missile to destroy the chunk ban. Using a couple more TNT flying machines, they are able to destroy all of the chunk bans, until they find a slime block machine which stops them from going further. Using pearls, they are able to pearl over the rest of the chunk bans. Parrot uses the elytra to escape, leaving Kenadian in the prison. Kenadian writes in morse code on the map that he has an ender pearl stasis chamber at his base. They find his base in a lava pool and activate his stasis chamber.

Parrot and Wifies try to create a civilization in the end. They see that a player has been following them. They pop the totem of the person underground and find that it’s a player named deanthebean9. He says he’s a part of the Mafia. They recruit him as a member in their civilization. Parrot tries to recruit people from the Zam empire, but sees it is completely destroyed. They move villagers into their end civilization.

Players from the Mafia find them and start trying to kill them while they are moving villagers. They are able to escape. Parrot hires Horace_Altman to build the civilization. They finish bringing the villagers and see Horace made a giant island. Parrot goes into the Mafia’s base to get deanthebean9 out of his stasis chamber. They are successful in getting him out.

Parrot breaks his bed in the overworld and goes back into the end. For some reason he now cannot leave the end. Parrot logs on the next day and sees Horace moved the entire island 100 blocks down. A couple of members join the civilization. Parrot learns that Wifies is able to go to the overworld. Horace builds a giant castle at the civilization. He also builds outposts near spawn. Boosfer comes over and tries to take over the civilization. Horace sets up chunk bans around the civilization.

What_Max goes to an outpost to join Parrot’s civilization, but finds that the Mafia is there. The civilization helps him escape.

Horace greatly expands the empire. Wifies shows Parrot that he found a giant crater near their base. While going to the main island, Boosfer talks about how he’ll run against Parrot. Fantst and LettuceK tell Parrot that there are invisible players circling around the chunk bans. The Mafia send multiple bomber planes, but the civilization is able to stop them. Parrot tells them in the meeting room that they are unable to leave the end if they do not have a bed respawn set in the overworld.

Horace builds a giant dome around the civilization. Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ come over for the election. Boosfer is unsuccessful in winning the election. He tries to leave but gets chunk banned.

Deanthebean9 tells Parrot that yesterday an invisible player got into the civilization. A new bomber plane is sent to destroy the civilization. The mole from the Mafia is able to turn off the chunk bans. After the Mafia invades, all of the members of the civilization run away.

Parrot and his friends try to explode the civilization.

Parrot, Wifies, and deanthebean9 try to steal from Capital City, owned by Reddoons. They are caught by Reddoons and five of his guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

They find a group of miners, with CoinMonke as the warden. Parrot spends his time mining. Parrot and his friends steal from capital city vaults. Parrot gives PikaTM more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from capital city for them to be set free.

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. CoinMonke is fired. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in the vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

LuigiToan mentions a Far Lands Civilization to Parrot. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and the Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they disagree. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber.

Parrot and his team run away. The Mafia for some reason stops chasing them. The Mafia finds them underground and begins blowing up the area. They are able to escape. The team goes into the nether, and again, the Mafia finds them there and begins exploding the area. Using suspicious stew giving fire resistance, they go under lava and escape to the overworld.

While boating, a Mafia member finds them. They manage to use the Mafia member’s totem of undying by exploding them with a TNT minecart. He is teleported to the void for not being invisible. While inside of an ancient city, Mafia members come in and begin exploding the ancient city. A warden spawns. They escape to the nether. After travelling a million blocks out, they find two players, R4trick and Finiahn, who agree to help them cross an obsidian wall that is owned by the Mafia. R4trick says there are thousands of Mafia members.

Parrot starts destroying an iron farm, but Mafia members find them destroying it, and R4trick runs away. They escape using invisibility. They loot a trial chamber, but find that all of the ominous vaults were removed. They hear people who are revealed in a later episode to be Spoke and his friends, and start mining out. They go to the nether to escape.

They go onto the nether roof with horses and begin making it to the farlands. The Mafia finds them and begins killing them. They escape to the overworld.

Right before getting to the farlands, deanthebean9 tells Parrot that he’s been the reason the Mafia found them every time. Deanthebean9 leaves. Wifies burns the compass they were using to find the farlands civilization. Parrot leaves without Wifies.

Parrot sees Wifies in the farlands civilization. Parrot goes over to the farming faction, which Wifies is at, and _Kenadian_ explains that the reason why they dislike the warriors is because the warriors never protected them when they needed protection, so they stopped giving them resources.

The warriors and the farmers play Capture the Flag. The farmers win the game with Parrot’s help.

Parrot fights DumbIsDumb to become a warriors council member. By flooding the arena with water with the help of Wifies, Parrot is able to win.

The civilization discovers that there is a Mafia member near the farlands civilization. They find a gold tier player in the nether who is able to escape. The warriors faction are able to kill the player.

Parrot becomes the new leader of the warriors council because Purpled is outvoted by the council members. Parrot unites the warriors and the farmers.

Ashswagg takes the warrior members hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. After evacuating all of the members, Parrot goes over to ashswagg’s castle to talk to him. Parrot leaves using his fishing rod stasis chamber.

The Mafia destroys the farlands civilization. Horace and the five other players who are still alive create a new civilization named District 13. Parrot invites R4trick and Finiahn. Horace joins the Mafia and leaves. They try to kill ashswagg, but he escapes. ClownPierce tries to kill them, but they are able to escape.

A new player named Yusai_ is added to the civilization. Parrot kills him as he could be a part of the Mafia. Parrot and Wifies go to spawn and see that the Mafia is tearing down spawn.

Spoke and Mapicc see Parrot and Wifies and they talk about the Mafia. They go over to the base of iMajesticRose, where Spoke was sent to assassinate her when he was infiltrating the Mafia. They see a diamond tier player at the base. They follow the diamond tier player to a base where a full iron armor player named Quackenstein123 is at. The player asks if they know anything about who killed iMajesticRose, who was his daughter. Spoke is able to find a book allegedly containing the coordinates of the stasis chambers of Mafia members.

Parrot invites Spoke and Mapicc to District 13. Spoke tells them that at the coordinates he went to where the stasis chamber would allegedly be, there was instead a book that looked like it was directions to something else. Spoke and Mapicc leave. R4trick, Finiahn, _Kenadian_, and JumperWho join the Mafia. Rekrap2, Wato1876, and TheobaldTheBird leave. It’s now just Parrot and Wifies.

Wemmbu and eggchan agree to team with Parrot and Wifies to kill ClownPierce. Together, they are able to kill a diamond tier player. Parrot and Wifies try to kill ashswagg, but because him dying automatically kills everyone in the Mafia, including their friends, they don’t kill ashswagg.

Parrot and Wifies build a house in a snowy biome. They see a sign that says "I found you." Ashswagg tells them to join the Mafia. Wifies joins the Mafia for Parrot.

Ashswagg meets Parrot at Parrot and Wifies house. Wifies had convinced Ashswagg beforehand to help him fake his death, causing Parrot and everyone else to think he's dead. He did this through getting Parrot to tame a dog. He named the dog Wifies, and replaced the dog in the house with a dog he tamed himself. When Ashswagg presumably teleported Wifies into the void, the dog was the one which actually died. This gave Parrot the message that 'Wifies fell out of the world', leading him to believe Wifies died. From then on, Wifies became the Director, only showing himself as an invisible player with a voice changer, while wearing Netherite armor with quartz Flow armor trims.

 Season 2 
Wifies then secretly hires ItzRealMe to trap Parrot. He fails, and lets Parrot know he was sent by the Director.

Wifies hires MrCube6 to trap Parrot. Through a book he had Cube give to Parrot, he taunts him and The Bounty Assassin Team (BAT), referring to himself as the player who killed Wifies. He uses a stasis pearl to teleport Cube out of his cell, on the next page of the book he states "Don't worry about Cube, his job is done, not because you beat him, but because I said so. I don't think he's a big fan of dandelions anyways..", much to the surprise of BAT as the Director shouldn't know that Cube had been given a dandelion.

After Parrot was falsely accused of being The Director by BAT, Wifies left him a book in an abandoned warehouse stating that it was time for he and Parrot to meet face-to-face. During their meeting, Wifies (fully invis and wearing quartz flow trim netherite), explained that this chapter of the story was coming to a close, and that he didn't want BAT to continue believing that Parrot was behind it all. When Parrot asked why he killed Wifies, The Director responded by saying he killed him because he had to, specifically because of his closeness to Parrot. After Parrot repeatedly demanded that The Director remove his voice changer, Wifies told him that the voice changer wasn't to protect himself, but to protect Parrot, saying that if Parrot knew who The Director really was, he wouldn't be angry, he would be terrified. The Director then leaves using a stasis chamber.

Wifies hires TruOriginal, a hacker, to trap Parrot. After TruOriginal dies, Wifies finds BAT and kills Nufuli using an arrow cannon. BAT starts trying to kill him. He taunts Parrot, remarking that Parrot can't beat him in a story he wrote. Wifies is able to escape using an ender pearl cannon. BAT uses the ender pearl cannon to try and chase after Wifies, but are trapped in an obsidian box, filled with a large amount of zombies in full netherite armor.

MrCube6 pretends to be the Director and is caught by BAT. Wifies rescues MrCube6.

Wifies sends Parrot a message using a book and tells Parrot that he wants to meet up with him in one week. After Wifies and Parrot meet up and talk, Wifies leaves with a stasis chamber. Wifies holds a chest plate which appears to be Spoke's red trimmed chest plate to throw them off when they are trying to figure out who the Director is.

Wifies traps JumperWho and Derapchu, two members of BAT, in an obsidian room underground. He tells Parrot that he has to guess who he is in order for his friends to be set free. Leow0ok saves Jumper and Derapchu while Parrot distracts Wifies. He reveals to Parrot that he is Wifies and tells him how he faked his death. He explains that Parrot was never in any real danger. He asks Parrot to follow him. Parrot refuses, saying that Wifies obviously isn't gonna kill him if he doesn't. Wifies says that while that's true, he will not hesitate to kill Parrots friends. Parrot follows him.

Wifies traps Parrot in Paragon. Wifies gives Parrot some food and then leaves. Parrot attempts to escape the prison, only to discover that outside of his cell was a much bigger prison, enclosing the terrain of the map. Wifies tells Parrot to drop all of his items, and he obliges, including discarding his spyglass. After Wifies left, Parrot went back for his spyglass and picked it back up.

Parrot tries to kill Wifies, but Wifies manages to escape as after his totem of undying was used, a stasis chamber teleported him away. Parrot tries to escape the prison, but as he is building out of the prison, two invisible players splash him with slow falling and hit him off. Parrot tries to escape again using a stasis chamber, but fails.

Parrot tries to kill Wifies while he's AFK with dripstone, but fails. Wifies shows Parrot a door to the outside world, where Wifies says that the way he knew things that he shouldn't have known, was by using JumperWho.

Parrot traps one of the guards to try and steal their gear and escape. The guard who is trapped is revealed to be JumperWho. She explains that the other guards are Derapchu and Leow0ok. Wifies catches Parrot and tells JumperWho to leave.

Wifies shows that he knows the exact items in his hotbar, and how many hunger bars he has left. Wifies brings Parrot to a room where there are two pressure plates. After they step on them, Wifies tells Parrot that if either of them step off or break any blocks, the entire place explodes. Parrot manages to smuggle in a spyglass. Parrot drops the spyglass on the pressure plate and escapes. Wifies steps off the pressure plate to pick up the spyglass, and the entire base explodes, killing Wifies.

Spideyarmy also says hi to Wifies <3 🔪

== History ==
=== Season 1 ===
Parrot invites Wifies to help him find a secret. Parrot finds a music disc with a texture pack that was put there by [[Spoke]]. He listens to the disc, which gives him a set of coordinates to go to. Parrot finds a medieval castle and opens the door by having him and Wifies step on two pressure plates. They obtain a disc and fly out as the castle is exploding to TNT.

[[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] sends [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] another texture pack, so [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] plays the disc and it says that he has to "follow the light". Parrot assumes this means to go to the [[Zam Empire]]. He sees [[Wemmbu]], and after a bit of chatting with [[Wemmbu]], [[PrinceZam]] comes over. [[Wemmbu]] and [[PrinceZam]] are eager to get information about what is happening, as it has to do with Spoke. Wifies and [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] fly over to the castle. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] almost dies multiple times as [[Wemmbu]] and [[PrinceZam]] attacks them, but eventually they’re able to escape. He waits for them to leave, and then sees that the lighthouse’s redstone lamp is blinking in morse code. The morse code comes out as -64.

They find a stairway in the lighthouse to the coordinates -64, and open a chest which contains a music disc. The disc tells them to bring flight duration three rockets, and not flight duration one. They have to travel 2000 blocks north. They decide not to bring flight duration three rockets, as they realize that one flight duration one rocket can travel super far. They get to the coordinates and find a void base made out of chest minecarts and shulker mobs, however they realize that the opening is sealed with obsidian. They go back to the old opening, but realize that it has now been sealed with cobblestone and obsidian. They go back to the void base to try and figure out what to do. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] realizes that using a fishing rod, he can probably help Wifies to travel more distance with his limited firework rockets.

They go back to the old opening, and place a crafting table on the block where they broke a cobblestone. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] crafts a fishing rod, and uses that to fishing rod Wifies all the way to a separate base 5000 blocks out. They make it out of the void through a different void hole someone else made.

They use the disc which gives a code. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] figures out that this is the code to [[PrinceZam|PrinceZam's]] vault. They break into [[PrinceZam|PrinceZam’s]] castle and take the lodestone compass and disc.

They play the disc, and it says that it’s "pretty straight forward" and that this riddle gets "pretty straight to the point", with the riddle itself being "lodestone". They follow the compass to a lodestone in an ice spikes biome. They eventually find a chest that contains another lodestone compass. They follow the compass to a parkour ice mountain. There’s a person in full netherite armor with the chestplate and leggings being trimmed with redstone. This person is [[The Wonders|SpokeIsHere]], but [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and Wifies don’t know that. He signals for them to put their items in two chests. They oblige and do the parkour.

After finishing the parkour, the guard gives them a music disc and lodestone compass along with their stuff. They play the disc and begin the next challenge. They follow the compass to a massive obsidian structure. The guard places the two chests so Wifies and [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] put their items in there again. They go into the obsidian maze, and discover that there are people in it. These people are [[Wemmbu]] and [[PrinceZam]]. [[Wemmbu]] finds them in the maze while they have nothing. They agree to lead [[Wemmbu]] to the next clue.

Since [[Wemmbu]] did not have the texture pack, it would be useless to him. After [[PrinceZam]] and [[Wemmbu]] get the jukebox and disc, Wifies and [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] leave, successfully scamming them. They go to [[Zam Empire|PrinceZam’s empire]] to see if they hid the disc, so they break into the vault and get the disc and a turtle egg, although getting close to death. They escape into the nether, but [[Wemmbu]] and [[PrinceZam]] find them. They convince [[PrinceZam]] and Wemmbu to go into the overworld so they can team up, but after [[Wemmbu]] and [[PrinceZam]] go into the overworld, they mine out of the nether cave and escape.

They use the turtle egg to get to a shipwreck, where the guard signals them to put away their stuff. They’re given five water breathing potions, and a turtle shell. They go into the giant ship and use the clues they are given to discover an underground area covered with sculk, sculk sensors, and sculk shriekers. Luckily, wardens don’t spawn with man-made sculk shriekers, which allows them to obtain the next disc and a lodestone compass.

They travel to the coordinates the lodestone compass is pointing to, a jungle temple. They take the music disc and leave. The disc says to go to the coordinates 5000 5000 in the nether. The guard tells them to put away their items. They go through a nether portal which leads to an escape room with multiple wardens. They eventually manage to escape.

They find themselves in a badlands biome, however it’s actually enclosed in an obsidian box, and no mobs spawn. They explore the area and find a couple of useful items. They also find a cave spider spawner. Using slime block launchers and blocks they obtained from underneath sugarcane, they’re able to get into a new room. They go back into the badlands biome as they’re probably missing something. They come back with more wool blocks, and finally escape with their items.

[[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and Wifies go back to [[ParrotX2|Parrot’s]] house, where they find the guard, who reveals that they’re [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]]. [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] says that only one person can uncover the secret, and that the other person will be banned off the server. He has them put all of their gear into the chests. They go down two different staircases. They go head to head in six challenges. After these challenges are completed, they’re tied 3 - 3. The final game they play is chess. [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] shows a red line, which is a chunk ban for whoever loses.

[[ParrotX2|Parrot]] talks to Wifies and plans to end the game as a stalemate. They go through with the plan, playing out the chess game and ending it with a stalemate. Spoke says that somebody has to be banned. Wifies steps on the red line, banning himself.

[[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and [[Rekrap2]] attempt to break Wifies out of the chunk ban.

[[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and a team of people including [[_Kenadian_]] are able to break Wifies out of prison. [[SpokeIsHere|Spoke]] is also broken out of the prison.

Parrot and Wifies find [[ClownPierce]] who has been sent to assassinate Parrot, in a carnival. This is where he plans to have a fair 1v1 with Parrot. Parrot and Wifies 2v1 ClownPierce. They get mining fatigue meaning that they can't break out and have to fight ClownPierce. [[Leow0ok]], [[Willsion]], and [[Woogiex]], enemies of ClownPierce break Parrot and Wifies out before they die. [[JumperWho]] and [[Derapchu]] are also teamed with them and are enemies of ClownPierce. They bring Parrot and Wifies to their base. Parrot and Wifies are sent to [[ClownPierce|ClownPierce’s]] castle to blow it up. [[ParrotX2|Parrot]] and Wifies manage to escape.

Leow0ok agrees with Parrot and Wifies to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, [[FerreMC]], and [[Mugm_]] come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues.

Parrot and Wifies try to find the escape. They figure out how to make it through the first two layers of the escape room. ClownPierce and his team break in. They hide in the second layer of the prison area. ClownPierce and his team find the second layer. Parrot and Wifies find the exit labeled B5.

Parrot and Wifies go to Leow0ok and his team to argue about how they were abandoned in the vault. Wifies comes to his base and sees that ClownPierce blew up the terrain around it. Parrot flies away to Wemmbu’s colony. ClownPierce eventually leaves after being unable to find Parrot.

Parrot and Wifies train for fighting ClownPierce. Parrot, Wifies, and the players against ClownPierce set up chunk bans at his castle. The team ambushes ClownPierce and his team. Unable to kill anybody, they leave and go back to the base. They see that the base has been completely destroyed.

They go over to [[BranzyCraft]]’s base to try and negotiate with him to tell ClownPierce to stop trying to kill Parrot. Parrot leaves to find a better team.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok’s team to help him kidnap Branzy, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Parrot leaves to a jungle and starts building a base there. Wifies is able to find Parrot. He tries to convince him to come back and defeat ClownPierce. ClownPierce and FerreMC find his jungle base and destroy it. Parrot runs away.

Parrot comes back to Wemmbu’s empire and sees it is destroyed. He goes over to ClownPierce’s castle with the team, and starts destroying his castle. He tells ClownPierce he wants to 1v1 him. Parrot goes over to Branzy’s base to kill him, but changes his mind after talking with Branzy and Wifies about it.

Parrot fights ClownPierce in a 1v1. He has secretly made a trap with 30,000 TNT. Parrot is unable to kill ClownPierce with his trap. Parrot discovers ClownPierce blew up Leow0ok’s teams headquarters secret meeting room.

Parrot discovers a book in his house. The book says to meet him at specific coordinates, and it has been written by ClownPierce. He thinks this book might have the answers to why certain players have disappeared from the server. Parrot and Wifies go to these coordinates and find two players, [[Jaden_MAN]] and [[Spongs]], who call themselves the game masters. They state that for the quest, they can only use items that they give them, and they can not cheat. They tell them to get a heart of the sea and bring it back to them. They can only use iron gear for this. They go into an underwater trial and are able to get a lodestone compass.

[[Kierrrr]] and [[Its_Dev_]] find Parrot and Wifies while they follow the lodestone compass. They try to intercept the hunt, but Parrot and Wifies escape using invisibility. They find two ships, which appear to be ClownPierce themed. They use the clue they find at the ships which say to go to where the winds meet. They find an escape room and quickly solve it and obtain the heart of the sea. They realize that Derapchu’s most prized possession is a heart of the sea, meaning that each item will probably correlate to one of the missing players.

The next quest is to get a pair of netherite boots, which would make sense because netherite boots are one of JumperWho’s most prized possessions. They find a giant mountain which leads into the clouds, and go inside. They are given five tasks to help the town in the sky, which are found in a book. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find them again. He edits the book to get rid of some clues, and then gives the book to them. After they do all the tasks, they tell Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ that the hot air balloons are in an arrow, and that they have to follow the arrow. This is a lie. After they leave, they figure out that by flicking a certain lever, it activates a bunch of flying machines which look like flying lanterns. They find the netherite boots in a chest, and they leave.

They go to [[Boosfer|Boosfers]] base, who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince him not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

The next quest is to get a poppy. They find a giant field of flowers, and they have to find which one is the poppy. They eventually find the poppy. They accidentally dig under the poppy and find a giant underground forest. They find a very long cave and follow it. It’s made out of only stone.

Eventually they find a valley. Following the valley, they find a giant tree. Inside of the tree, they find an escape room. After solving the escape room, they get a riddle. As they read that, Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ come over to the tree and start griefing it. They burn the tree. They see Parrot in leather armor, and Parrot runs away and hides. They are able to find Parrot and Wifies.

Parrot gives them a fake riddle. They figure out that it’s a fake riddle, but Wifies has already secured the item in his ender chest. Parrot and Wifies realize this is Rekrap2’s base. Boosfer and his team leave. They figure out this is a save haven for the passive animals, so they start to move all the animals out. While moving the animals, they see multiple massive TNT bomber planes coming. This is because Boosfer paid Wemmbu to destroy the valley. After moving the animals inside of mountains so they don’t get blown up, they build up using melons. Wemmbu spawns withers. Using the melons, they try to stop the planes. Wemmbu finds them and after a bit, they agree to team to steal Boosfer and his team’s items.

Parrot and Wifies go to the next quest, and they find a sculk themed escape room. They make it through the escape room and find a cave. After following the cave, they find an ancient city. The clue says that the key to the vault is the heart of a warden. This implies they have to kill a warden. They plan to use dripstone to kill the warden. After killing it, they make it through the vault and get a diamond. They put the diamond in the item frame at the base, however Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find the diamond and steal it. They steal all of the items Parrot and Wifies obtained.

Wemmbu, Parrot, and Wifies go to the headquarters to blow it up. They build an orbital cannon to destroy the base. After flying to the base, they activate the orbital cannon, completely destroying the top layer of the base. They use TNT and spawn withers to destroy the base. Wemmbu finds a stash of netherite blocks and diamond blocks and they steal all the items.

In the nether, Parrot and Wifies find a bunch of nether quartz which appears to be morse code. It says 090.256 rurple. They go to the next coordinates and find a sign that says 840.32 cyan. They next find a chest which has items in it. They find that the items in the chest probably mean 670.5 brown. They find a sign under lava that says 960.18 pink. On the nether roof they find a sign saying 390.43 blue. They find a giant castle and go inside using striders.

Parrot and Wifies use the numbers they found to find books. After finding all the books, they bring it to the vault and input the books. In the vault they find the item, a wither rose.

Parrot and Wifies move onto the next quest, which is to go to the end. They go to the end with almost no items. In the end, they find an escape room-like obstacle course. After finishing the course, the book they find says "+ +". They end up finding an end city, and inside is Wifies's prized dragon head. Right before going through the end portal to escape, they find Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to kill Parrot and Wifies, but they escape to the outer islands.

Parrot and Wifies find an ender chest and get the gear from their ender chest. They go back to the main island, and try to kill them. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ run away, so Parrot and Wifies leave.

Parrot and Wifies go back to the base, and find ClownPierce. They ask ClownPierce why people have been missing, but he says he doesn’t know. Parrot puts his last item, the spyglass, in the item frame.

Parrot and Wifies are trapped by ClownPierce in a prison called [[Proton]]. Inside of the prison, they are given a small world with resources in it, although they have no items. They purposefully went into the prison to try and break some of their friends out. They realize no mobs are spawning in the prison. Wifies tries to go to a green section of the prison, but when he walks into the area, he gets chunk banned.

Wifies comes over to Parrot after being un-chunk banned by a guard. They see in a map that someone wrote S.O.S. in morse code. They communicate using morse code in maps. A guard comes in and moves Parrot to a new cell.

Wifies finds Parrot. They find a wandering trader who sells sand. Parrot is moved into the next cell. Parrot plans to make a stasis chamber to escape.

Parrot sees Wifies and tells him about his plan to escape.

Parrot gives everybody in the cell, including Wifies, contraband items. Parrot ender pearls to every cell and gives everyone ender chests.

The prisoners go into the control room invisible, and pretend to be guards. JumperWho escapes from solitary confinement. Kenadian builds three wither bores and a missile to destroy the chunk ban. Using a couple more TNT flying machines, they are able to destroy all of the chunk bans, until they find a slime block machine which stops them from going further. Using pearls, they are able to pearl over the rest of the chunk bans. Parrot uses the elytra to escape, leaving Kenadian in the prison. Kenadian writes in morse code on the map that he has an ender pearl stasis chamber at his base. They find his base in a lava pool and activate his stasis chamber.

Parrot and Wifies try to create a [[The End Civilization|civilization in the end]]. They see that a player has been following them. They pop the totem of the person underground and find that it’s a player named [[deanthebean9]]. He says he’s a part of the Mafia. They recruit him as a member in their civilization. Parrot tries to recruit people from the Zam empire, but sees it is completely destroyed. They move villagers into their end civilization.

Players from the Mafia find them and start trying to kill them while they are moving villagers. They are able to escape. Parrot hires [[Horace_Altman]] to build the civilization. They finish bringing the villagers and see Horace made a giant island. Parrot goes into the Mafia’s base to get deanthebean9 out of his stasis chamber. They are successful in getting him out.

Parrot breaks his bed in the overworld and goes back into the end. For some reason he now cannot leave the end. Parrot logs on the next day and sees Horace moved the entire island 100 blocks down. A couple of members join the civilization. Parrot learns that Wifies is able to go to the overworld. Horace builds a giant castle at the civilization. He also builds outposts near spawn. Boosfer comes over and tries to take over the civilization. Horace sets up chunk bans around the civilization.

What_Max goes to an outpost to join Parrot’s civilization, but finds that the Mafia is there. The civilization helps him escape.

Horace greatly expands the empire. Wifies shows Parrot that he found a giant crater near their base. While going to the main island, Boosfer talks about how he’ll run against Parrot. [[Fantst]] and [[LettuceK]] tell Parrot that there are invisible players circling around the chunk bans. The Mafia send multiple bomber planes, but the civilization is able to stop them. Parrot tells them in the meeting room that they are unable to leave the end if they do not have a bed respawn set in the overworld.

Horace builds a giant dome around the civilization. Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ come over for the election. Boosfer is unsuccessful in winning the election. He tries to leave but gets chunk banned.

Deanthebean9 tells Parrot that yesterday an invisible player got into the civilization. A new bomber plane is sent to destroy the civilization. The mole from the Mafia is able to turn off the chunk bans. After the Mafia invades, all of the members of the civilization run away.

Parrot and his friends try to explode the civilization.

Parrot, Wifies, and deanthebean9 try to steal from [[Capital City]], owned by [[Reddoons]]. They are caught by Reddoons and five of his guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

They find a group of miners, with [[CoinMonke]] as the warden. Parrot spends his time mining. Parrot and his friends steal from capital city vaults. Parrot gives [[PikaTM]] more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from capital city for them to be set free.

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. CoinMonke is fired. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in the vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

[[LuigiToan]] mentions a [[Far Lands|Far Lands Civilization]] to Parrot. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to [[ashswagg]] and the Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they disagree. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber.

Parrot and his team run away. The Mafia for some reason stops chasing them. The Mafia finds them underground and begins blowing up the area. They are able to escape. The team goes into the nether, and again, the Mafia finds them there and begins exploding the area. Using suspicious stew giving fire resistance, they go under lava and escape to the overworld.

While boating, a Mafia member finds them. They manage to use the Mafia member’s totem of undying by exploding them with a TNT minecart. He is teleported to the void for not being invisible. While inside of an ancient city, Mafia members come in and begin exploding the ancient city. A warden spawns. They escape to the nether. After travelling a million blocks out, they find two players, [[R4trick]] and [[Finiahn]], who agree to help them cross an obsidian wall that is owned by the Mafia. R4trick says there are thousands of Mafia members.

Parrot starts destroying an iron farm, but Mafia members find them destroying it, and R4trick runs away. They escape using invisibility. They loot a trial chamber, but find that all of the ominous vaults were removed. They hear people who are revealed in a later episode to be Spoke and his friends, and start mining out. They go to the nether to escape.

They go onto the nether roof with horses and begin making it to the farlands. The Mafia finds them and begins killing them. They escape to the overworld.

Right before getting to the farlands, deanthebean9 tells Parrot that he’s been the reason the Mafia found them every time. Deanthebean9 leaves. Wifies burns the compass they were using to find the farlands civilization. Parrot leaves without Wifies.

Parrot sees Wifies in the farlands civilization. Parrot goes over to the farming faction, which Wifies is at, and _Kenadian_ explains that the reason why they dislike the warriors is because the warriors never protected them when they needed protection, so they stopped giving them resources.

The warriors and the farmers play Capture the Flag. The farmers win the game with Parrot’s help.

Parrot fights DumbIsDumb to become a warriors council member. By flooding the arena with water with the help of Wifies, Parrot is able to win.

The civilization discovers that there is a Mafia member near the farlands civilization. They find a gold tier player in the nether who is able to escape. The warriors faction are able to kill the player.

Parrot becomes the new leader of the warriors council because Purpled is outvoted by the council members. Parrot unites the warriors and the farmers.

Ashswagg takes the warrior members hostage. The farmers find the prison and break everyone out. After evacuating all of the members, Parrot goes over to ashswagg’s castle to talk to him. Parrot leaves using his fishing rod stasis chamber.

The Mafia destroys the farlands civilization. Horace and the five other players who are still alive create a new civilization named [[District 13]]. Parrot invites R4trick and Finiahn. Horace joins the Mafia and leaves. They try to kill ashswagg, but he escapes. ClownPierce tries to kill them, but they are able to escape.

A new player named [[Yusai_]] is added to the civilization. Parrot kills him as he could be a part of the Mafia. Parrot and Wifies go to spawn and see that the Mafia is tearing down spawn.

Spoke and Mapicc see Parrot and Wifies and they talk about the Mafia. They go over to the base of [[iMajesticRose]], where Spoke was sent to assassinate her when he was infiltrating the Mafia. They see a diamond tier player at the base. They follow the diamond tier player to a base where a full iron armor player named [[Quackenstein123]] is at. The player asks if they know anything about who killed iMajesticRose, who was his daughter. Spoke is able to find a book allegedly containing the coordinates of the stasis chambers of Mafia members.

Parrot invites Spoke and Mapicc to District 13. Spoke tells them that at the coordinates he went to where the stasis chamber would allegedly be, there was instead a book that looked like it was directions to something else. Spoke and Mapicc leave. R4trick, Finiahn, _Kenadian_, and JumperWho join the Mafia. Rekrap2, [[Wato1876]], and [[TheobaldTheBird]] leave. It’s now just Parrot and Wifies.

Wemmbu and [[eggchan]] agree to team with Parrot and Wifies to kill ClownPierce. Together, they are able to kill a diamond tier player. Parrot and Wifies try to kill ashswagg, but because him dying automatically kills everyone in the Mafia, including their friends, they don’t kill ashswagg.

Parrot and Wifies build a house in a snowy biome. They see a sign that says "I found you." Ashswagg tells them to join the Mafia. Wifies joins the Mafia for Parrot.

Ashswagg meets Parrot at Parrot and Wifies house. Wifies had convinced Ashswagg beforehand to help him fake his death, causing Parrot and everyone else to think he's dead. He did this through getting Parrot to tame a dog. He named the dog Wifies, and replaced the dog in the house with a dog he tamed himself. When Ashswagg presumably teleported Wifies into the void, the dog was the one which actually died. This gave Parrot the message that 'Wifies fell out of the world', leading him to believe Wifies died. From then on, Wifies became the Director, only showing himself as an invisible player with a voice changer, while wearing Netherite armor with quartz Flow armor trims.

=== Season 2 ===
Wifies then secretly hires [[ItzRealMe]] to trap Parrot. He fails, and lets Parrot know he was sent by the Director.

Wifies hires [[MrCube6]] to trap Parrot. Through a book he had Cube give to Parrot, he taunts him and The Bounty Assassin Team (BAT), referring to himself as the player who killed Wifies. He uses a stasis pearl to teleport Cube out of his cell, on the next page of the book he states "Don't worry about Cube, his job is done, not because you beat him, but because I said so. I don't think he's a big fan of dandelions anyways..", much to the surprise of BAT as the Director shouldn't know that Cube had been given a dandelion.

After Parrot was falsely accused of being The Director by BAT, Wifies left him a book in an abandoned warehouse stating that it was time for he and Parrot to meet face-to-face. During their meeting, Wifies (fully invis and wearing quartz flow trim netherite), explained that this chapter of the story was coming to a close, and that he didn't want BAT to continue believing that Parrot was behind it all. When Parrot asked why he killed Wifies, The Director responded by saying he killed him because he had to, specifically because of his closeness to Parrot. After Parrot repeatedly demanded that The Director remove his voice changer, Wifies told him that the voice changer wasn't to protect himself, but to protect Parrot, saying that if Parrot knew who The Director really was, he wouldn't be angry, he would be terrified. The Director then leaves using a stasis chamber.

Wifies hires [[TruOriginal]], a hacker, to trap Parrot. After TruOriginal dies, Wifies finds BAT and kills [[Nufuli]] using an arrow cannon. BAT starts trying to kill him. He taunts Parrot, remarking that Parrot can't beat him in a story he wrote. Wifies is able to escape using an ender pearl cannon. BAT uses the ender pearl cannon to try and chase after Wifies, but are trapped in an obsidian box, filled with a large amount of zombies in full netherite armor.

MrCube6 pretends to be the Director and is caught by BAT. Wifies rescues MrCube6.

Wifies sends Parrot a message using a book and tells Parrot that he wants to meet up with him in one week. After Wifies and Parrot meet up and talk, Wifies leaves with a stasis chamber. Wifies holds a chest plate which appears to be Spoke's red trimmed chest plate to throw them off when they are trying to figure out who the Director is.

Wifies traps JumperWho and Derapchu, two members of BAT, in an obsidian room underground. He tells Parrot that he has to guess who he is in order for his friends to be set free. Leow0ok saves Jumper and Derapchu while Parrot distracts Wifies. He reveals to Parrot that he is Wifies and tells him how he faked his death. He explains that Parrot was never in any real danger. He asks Parrot to follow him. Parrot refuses, saying that Wifies obviously isn't gonna kill him if he doesn't. Wifies says that while that's true, he will not hesitate to kill Parrots friends. Parrot follows him.

Wifies traps Parrot in [[Paragon]]. Wifies gives Parrot some food and then leaves. Parrot attempts to escape the prison, only to discover that outside of his cell was a much bigger prison, enclosing the terrain of the map. Wifies tells Parrot to drop all of his items, and he obliges, including discarding his spyglass. After Wifies left, Parrot went back for his spyglass and picked it back up.

Parrot tries to kill Wifies, but Wifies manages to escape as after his totem of undying was used, a stasis chamber teleported him away. Parrot tries to escape the prison, but as he is building out of the prison, two invisible players splash him with slow falling and hit him off. Parrot tries to escape again using a stasis chamber, but fails.

Parrot tries to kill Wifies while he's AFK with dripstone, but fails. Wifies shows Parrot a door to the outside world, where Wifies says that the way he knew things that he shouldn't have known, was by using JumperWho.

Parrot traps one of the guards to try and steal their gear and escape. The guard who is trapped is revealed to be JumperWho. She explains that the other guards are Derapchu and Leow0ok. Wifies catches Parrot and tells [[JumperWho]] to leave.

Wifies shows that he knows the exact items in his hotbar, and how many hunger bars he has left. Wifies brings Parrot to a room where there are two pressure plates. After they step on them, Wifies tells Parrot that if either of them step off or break any blocks, the entire place explodes. Parrot manages to smuggle in a spyglass. Parrot drops the spyglass on the pressure plate and escapes. Wifies steps off the pressure plate to pick up the spyglass, and the entire base explodes, killing Wifies.

<small>Spideyarmy also says hi to Wifies <3 🔪</small>

title: Wiki Guidelines
content:
General Guidelines

Abide by FANDOM's Terms of Use.
Strictly do not post any leaks related to Unstable Universe (or for any media for that matter), whether that'd be map downloads, content from Unstable Events, images or spoilers that were not posted by a UU member, etc– Please respect their privacy and hard work.
Any instance of this will result in a warning on the first offense and a 1 week block on the 2nd.
To prevent argument, please refrain from discussing controversies about any of the content creators beyond light topics. The wiki will only focus on their in-character counterparts. 
Do not make personal attacks on other people. If you need to criticize another user’s argument, do so without attacking them as a person. Do not use bigoted language, including slurs which degrade another person or group of people based on gender, race, sexual orientation, nationality, religion, etc.
Contribute to the wiki in line with the established processes and conventions. Need help? Ask an administrator or fellow community member!
Disrupting the wiki with “edit warring” over differing opinions of a topic with another user or group of users is not productive.
Do not harass other users. If somebody asks you to stop posting certain content on their wall or user talk page, respect their wishes. It is their space.
Do not hound, bait, or troll: Friendly debate and conversation can be useful tools in creating a resourceful wiki, but deliberately pushing others to the point of breaching civility is not allowed.
Do not threaten harm or spam/vandalism to other users and wikis. If you see anyone threatening another person or wiki, report to the administrator.
Do not doxx or reveal any personal information about others, regardless of circumstance.

 Editing Guidelines 

 Please do not make long, winding articles; always quality over quantity.
 Please proofread edits before making them.
 Please do not make articles on extremely niche/off topic information, or else they may be removed by a staff member.
 Add articles into relevant categories.

 History

title: WyLL
content:
WyLL_, or WyLL, is a supporting character in Unstable Universe.

 History 
WyLL is seen as a soldier at the PrinceZam Empire, fighting Wemmbu to protect Zam.

When the Mafia collapses, WyLL takes over Mafia City and takes the remaining resources.

A team of players is hired to kill Wemmbu, including an invisible player in full netherite armor, later revealed to be WyLL. The players try to kill him using an arrow cannon but fail. Wemmbu then starts hunting all the people who hired WyLL and ultimately kills them. WyLL tries to kill Wemmbu again, saying that if he killed him, people would consider him a good player, but he fails.

WyLL traps Wemmbu under the void to try and kill him, but Wemmbu manages to escape using the old void trap opening in the BAT Headquarters.

Wemmbu sneaks into Mafia City and pretends to be one of WyLL's invisible henchmen. Wyll realizes that he is the player with a purple smile shield and pots strength and tries to kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu tries to kill WyLL. He is able to kill WyLL's guards, and WyLL is forced to escape using a fishing-rod stasis chamber.

WyLL participates in a PvP tournament. He loses against Wemmbu.

WyLL fights alongside FlameFrags in the Far Lands to kill Wemmbu, but he fails again. He had also aided the team with resources to help win against Wemmbu. He fights Conexion during the final fight in the mountain spikes biome.

_x_6_00 is the leader of another squad of Null Hunters in Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing after the former squad's leader, _1_88_____x, died to Spoke's arrow cannon. Just like their predecessor, they wore a redstone flow-trimmed netherite chestplate unlike normal squad members who wore netherite flow-trimmed netherite chestplates. They also used black multishot firework crossbow.

 History 
They appears in a nether portal where his predecessor was killed by SpokeIsHere and JumperWho. They placed a book in the grave expecting them to read it and return the mission: null book. They continued to hunt them down throughout the rest of that episode.

They appeared watching over Spoke as he entered Mapicc's pearl cannon, implying that they tampered with it. It's unclear why they didn't completely destroy the cannon.

title: Zam Empire
content:
The PrinceZam Empire, often referred to as the Zam Empire, was a powerful faction led by PrinceZam in Unstable Universe. It gained notoriety for its strategic ambition and expansive control, notably marked by the construction of a massive wall around the server's spawn area. This wall symbolized the empire's dominance but also sparked significant opposition from other players and factions, such as Wemmbu.

History
Wemmbu agrees to help the Zam Empire kill SpokeIsHere. Spoke has his supporters attack the Zam empire. Nobody dies in Spoke’s team except for TeamKalal as they all used stasis chambers to escape.

Parrot and Wifies go to the Zam Empire multiple times as part of a scavenger hunt set up by Spoke.

The Zam Empire finds Spoke and tries to kill him, but he chunk bans himself before being killed in the same chunk ban that Wifies is in.

Parrot breaks out everybody who PrinceZam had imprisoned, including Wifies and Spoke. PrinceZam hires ClownPierce to assassinate Parrot but he fails.

PrinceZam asks Wemmbu to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make a colony to guard a vault he has, and tells him to never go inside. This turns out to just be a plan to kill Wemmbu. He sends his guard FlameFrags to kill Wemmbu and pretends that FlameFrags betrayed him. Wemmbu checks inside the vault and finds nothing. PrinceZam tells Wemmbu that he is too weak to be a threat to the empire anymore.

Wemmbu goes to his Orbital Strike Cannon to try and destroy PrinceZam’s empire, but sees the orbital cannon has been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam Empire built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and eggchan discover that PrinceZam has started taking over the spawn. Once they are far enough from the Zam Empire, ManePear says that he’s not a big fan of being a guard of PrinceZam, and that if they need help, they can help him.

Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and his civilization try to use an orbital cannon to destroy the Zam Empire, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill them. they are able to escape.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray the Zam Empire.

ManePear distracts yungwillx, a guard of the Zam Empire, by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, Merffinn, and Peentar on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, and they take him hostage. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage. While they are taking Sorhin hostage, the Zam empire breaks out yungwillx and Peentar. 

The entire Zam empire destroys Wemmbu's Civilization. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and they watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, but then realize that they took eggchan, Wemmbu's friend.

PrinceZam takes down the obsidian sheet protecting the Zam Empire. Wemmbu goes over to PrinceZam, with no armor, and they imprison Wemmbu. 

Wemmbu enters the Zam Empire on the pretense of reuniting with eggchan. The guards take him to Zam, and they take him to eggchan's cell. Zam forces Wemmbu to go through an inventory check before entering eggchan's cell. Wemmbu drops all of his items, but saves his ender chests, fishing rod, elytra, and . Wemmbu triggers the orbital cannon, causing a lag spike long enough to allow Wemmbu to place down an ender chest and regearshimself and eggchan. Wemmbu flies away with eggchan, pursued by Zam and his guards. Eggchan escapes, while Zam and his guards chase Wemmbu around the Zam Empire, attempting to kill him mid-flight.

The orbital strike begins coming in, gradually destroying the Zam Empire. Zam's guards abandon him, leaving Zam to fight Wemmbu alone. After the fight, ClownPierce takes Zam, Wemmbu, eggchan, and Pangi to a prison and the empire ends.

[[zoe444]], or [[Zoe444|Zoe]] was a member of Parrot's failed [[Skymore Civilization]].

== History == 
She was one of the 10 survivors of that massacred 1000 player civilization. Zoe was forced to grow wheat and food for her captors in [[Cindercrest]], the perpetrators of the killings. Zoe escaped Cindercrest but has likely died due to starvation, which [[ReinaDrop|Reina]] claims was the fault of [[ShoeBilly]]. Before she went missing, she managed to leave a series of clues intended to help Reina find her location.
